```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'
require 'securerandom'

class SEPAGeneratorNokogiri
  def initialize(creditor_details, payments)
    @creditor = creditor_details
    @payments = payments
    @message_id = "MSG-#{DateTime.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
  end

  def generate_pain_001
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.Document('xmlns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001.03',
                   'xmlns:xsi' => 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance') do
        build_pain_001_content(xml)
      end
    end
    builder.to_xml
  end

  private

  def build_pain_001_content(xml)
    xml.CstmrCdtTrfInitn do
      build_group_header(xml)
      build_payment_informations(xml)
    end
  end

  def build_group_header(xml)
    xml.GrpHdr do
      xml.MsgId(@message_id)
      xml.CreDtTm(DateTime.now.iso8601)
      xml.NbOfTxs(@payments.size)
      xml.CtrlSum(control_sum)
      xml.InitgPty do
        xml.Nm(@creditor[:name])
      end
    end
  end

  def build_payment_informations(xml)
    xml.PmtInf do
      xml.PmtInfId("PMTINF-#{@message_id}")
      xml.PmtMtd('TRF')
      xml.BtchBookg(true)
      xml.NbOfTxs(@payments.size)
      xml.CtrlSum(control_sum)
      xml.PmtTpInf do
        xml.SvcLvl do
          xml.Cd('SEPA')
        end
      end
      xml.ReqdExctnDt((Date.today + 1).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
      
      build_debtor(xml)
      build_debtor_account(xml)
      build_charges(xml)
      build_credit_transfers(xml)
    end
  end

  def build_debtor(xml)
    xml.Dbtr do
      xml.Nm(@creditor[:name])
    end
  end

  def build_debtor_account(xml)
    xml.DbtrAcct do
      xml.Id do
        xml.IBAN(@creditor[:iban])
      end
    end
  end

  def build_charges(xml)
    xml.ChrgBr('SLEV')
  end

  def build_credit_transfers(xml)
    @payments.each_with_index do |payment, index|
      xml.CdtTrfTxInf do
        xml.PmtId do
          xml.EndToEndId(payment[:reference] || "REF-#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}")
        end
        xml.Amt do
          xml.InstdAmt('%.2f' % payment[:amount], Ccy: 'EUR')
        end
        xml.CdtrAgt do
          xml.FinInstnId do
            xml.BIC(payment[:vendor_bic])
          end
        end
        xml.Cdtr do
          xml.Nm(payment[:vendor_name])
        end
        xml.CdtrAcct do
          xml.Id do
            xml.IBAN(payment[:vendor_iban])
          end
        end
        xml.RmtInf do
          xml.Ustrd(payment[:description])
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def control_sum
    '%.2f' % @payments.sum { |p| p[:amount] }
  end

  def save_to_file(filename)
    xml_content = generate_pain_001
    File.write(filename, xml_content)
    puts "SEPA файл успішно збережено як #{filename}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative '../lib/plaid_client'
require_relative '../models/account'
require_relative '../models/balance'
require_relative '../models/transaction'

class BankingDataService
  def initialize(access_token)
    @access_token = access_token
    @plaid_client = PlaidClient.new
  end

  def sync_data(start_date, end_date)
    sync_balances
    sync_transactions(start_date, end_date)
  end

  def sync_balances
    balance_response = @plaid_client.get_balance(@access_token)
    return unless balance_response
    
    balance_response.accounts.each do |plaid_account|
      account = find_or_create_account(plaid_account)
      
      Balance.create!(
        account_id: account.id,
        available: plaid_account.balances.available,
        current: plaid_account.balances.current,
        limit: plaid_account.balances.limit,
        iso_currency_code: plaid_account.balances.iso_currency_code,
        unofficial_currency_code: plaid_account.balances.unofficial_currency_code,
        recorded_at: Time.current
      )
    end
  end

  def sync_transactions(start_date, end_date)
    transactions_response = @plaid_client.get_transactions(@access_token, start_date, end_date)
    return unless transactions_response
    
    transactions_response.transactions.each do |plaid_transaction|
      account = Account.find_by(plaid_account_id: plaid_transaction.account_id)
      next unless account
      
      Transaction.find_or_create_by(plaid_transaction_id: plaid_transaction.transaction_id) do |transaction|
        transaction.account_id = account.id
        transaction.amount = plaid_transaction.amount
        transaction.date = plaid_transaction.date
        transaction.name = plaid_transaction.name
        transaction.merchant_name = plaid_transaction.merchant_name
        transaction.payment_channel = plaid_transaction.payment_channel
        transaction.transaction_type = plaid_transaction.transaction_type
        transaction.pending = plaid_transaction.pending
        transaction.category = plaid_transaction.category&.join(', ')
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def find_or_create_account(plaid_account)
    Account.find_or_create_by(plaid_account_id: plaid_account.account_id) do |account|
      account.name = plaid_account.name
      account.official_name = plaid_account.official_name
      account.type = plaid_account.type
      account.subtype = plaid_account.subtype
      account.iso_currency_code = plaid_account.balances.iso_currency_code
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# tax_calculator.rb
require 'taxjar'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class TaxCalculator
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['TAXJAR_API_KEY']
    validate_api_key!
    @client = Taxjar::Client.new(api_key: @api_key)
  end

  def calculate_sales_tax(order_data)
    validate_order_data!(order_data)
    
    begin
      response = @client.tax_for_order(order_data)
      format_tax_response(response)
    rescue Taxjar::Error::NotFound => e
      raise "Адресу не знайдено: #{e.message}"
    rescue Taxjar::Error::Unauthorized => e
      raise "Неавторизований доступ. Перевірте API ключ: #{e.message}"
    rescue Taxjar::Error => e
      raise "Помилка API TaxJar: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def validate_address(address_data)
    begin
      response = @client.validate_address(address_data)
      {
        valid: response.valid?,
        address: response.valid? ? format_address_response(response) : nil,
        message: response.valid? ? 'Адресу підтверджено' : 'Адресу недійсна'
      }
    rescue Taxjar::Error => e
      { valid: false, message: "Помилка перевірки адреси: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_api_key!
    raise "API ключ TaxJar не вказано. Додайте TAXJAR_API_KEY до .env файлу" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end

  def validate_order_data!(order_data)
    required_fields = [:to_country, :to_zip, :to_state, :shipping, :amount]
    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |field| order_data.key?(field) }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise "Відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def format_tax_response(response)
    {
      order_total_amount: response.amount_to_collect,
      shipping: response.shipping,
      taxable_amount: response.taxable_amount,
      amount_to_collect: response.amount_to_collect,
      rate: response.rate,
      freight_taxable: response.freight_taxable,
      tax_source: response.tax_source,
      jurisdiction: {
        country: response.jurisdictions.country,
        state: response.jurisdictions.state,
        county: response.jurisdictions.county,
        city: response.jurisdictions.city
      },
      breakdown: response.breakdown ? format_breakdown(response.breakdown) : nil
    }
  end

  def format_breakdown(breakdown)
    {
      taxable_amount: breakdown.taxable_amount,
      tax_collectable: breakdown.tax_collectable,
      combined_tax_rate: breakdown.combined_tax_rate,
      state_taxable_amount: breakdown.state_taxable_amount,
      state_tax_rate: breakdown.state_tax_rate,
      state_tax_collectable: breakdown.state_tax_collectable,
      county_taxable_amount: breakdown.county_taxable_amount,
      county_tax_rate: breakdown.county_tax_rate,
      county_tax_collectable: breakdown.county_tax_collectable,
      city_taxable_amount: breakdown.city_taxable_amount,
      city_tax_rate: breakdown.city_tax_rate,
      city_tax_collectable: breakdown.city_tax_collectable
    }
  end

  def format_address_response(response)
    {
      country: response.country,
      state: response.state,
      zip: response.zip,
      city: response.city,
      street: response.street
    }
  end
end
```

**Код реалізації:**

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dry-validation'

# Модель для банківської транзакції
class BankTransaction
  attr_accessor :entry_id, :amount, :currency, :value_date, :remittance_info, :debtor_name, :debtor_account
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    @entry_id = attributes[:entry_id]
    @amount = attributes[:amount]
    @currency = attributes[:currency]
    @value_date = attributes[:value_date]
    @remittance_info = attributes[:remittance_info]
    @debtor_name = attributes[:debtor_name]
    @debtor_account = attributes[:debtor_account]
  end
end

# Модель для рахунку
class Invoice
  attr_accessor :id, :number, :amount, :currency, :due_date, :reference, :paid
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    @id = attributes[:id]
    @number = attributes[:number]
    @amount = attributes[:amount]
    @currency = attributes[:currency]
    @due_date = attributes[:due_date]
    @reference = attributes[:reference]
    @paid = attributes[:paid] || false
  end
end

# Схема валідації для транзакції
class TransactionSchema < Dry::Validation::Contract
  params do
    required(:entry_id).filled(:string)
    required(:amount).filled(:decimal, gt?: 0)
    required(:currency).filled(:string)
    required(:value_date).filled(:date)
    optional(:remittance_info).maybe(:string)
    optional(:debtor_name).maybe(:string)
    optional(:debtor_account).maybe(:string)
  end
end

# Парсер CAMT.053
class Camt053Parser
  NAMESPACES = {
    'xmlns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02'
  }.freeze

  def parse(xml_content)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    transactions = []

    doc.xpath('//xmlns:Ntry', NAMESPACES).each do |entry|
      transaction = parse_entry(entry)
      transactions << transaction if transaction_valid?(transaction)
    end

    transactions
  end

  private

  def parse_entry(entry)
    entry_id = entry.xpath('xmlns:NtryRef', NAMESPACES).text
    amount = entry.xpath('xmlns:Amt', NAMESPACES).text.to_f
    currency = entry.xpath('xmlns:Amt/@Ccy', NAMESPACES).text
    value_date = Date.parse(entry.xpath('xmlns:ValDt/xmlns:Dt', NAMESPACES).text)
    
    remittance_info = entry.xpath('xmlns:AddtlNtryInf', NAMESPACES).text
    
    debtor_info = entry.xpath('xmlns:NtryDtls/xmlns:TxDtls/xmlns:RltdPties', NAMESPACES)
    debtor_name = debtor_info.xpath('xmlns:Dbtr/xmlns:Nm', NAMESPACES).text
    debtor_account = debtor_info.xpath('xmlns:DbtrAcct/xmlns:Id/xmlns:IBAN', NAMESPACES).text

    BankTransaction.new(
      entry_id: entry_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      value_date: value_date,
      remittance_info: remittance_info,
      debtor_name: debtor_name,
      debtor_account: debtor_account
    )
  end

  def transaction_valid?(transaction)
    schema = TransactionSchema.new
    result = schema.call(
      entry_id: transaction.entry_id,
      amount: transaction.amount,
      currency: transaction.currency,
      value_date: transaction.value_date,
      remittance_info: transaction.remittance_info,
      debtor_name: transaction.debtor_name,
      debtor_account: transaction.debtor_account
    )
    
    result.success?
  end
end

# Сервіс для зіставлення транзакцій з рахунками
class TransactionMatcher
  def initialize(invoices_repository)
    @invoices_repository = invoices_repository
  end

  def match_transactions(transactions)
    results = []

    transactions.each do |transaction|
      unpaid_invoices = @invoices_repository.find_unpaid_by_amount_and_reference(
        transaction.amount,
        transaction.currency,
        transaction.remittance_info
      )

      if unpaid_invoices.any?
        # Знаходимо найбільш підходящий рахунок
        best_match = find_best_match(transaction, unpaid_invoices)
        results << MatchResult.new(transaction, best_match, :matched) if best_match
      else
        results << MatchResult.new(transaction, nil, :unmatched)
      end
    end

    results
  end

  private

  def find_best_match(transaction, invoices)
    # Спершу шукаємо за точним збігом номера рахунку в призначенні платежу
    exact_matches = invoices.select do |invoice|
      transaction.remittance_info&.include?(invoice.reference) ||
      transaction.remittance_info&.include?(invoice.number)
    end

    return exact_matches.first if exact_matches.any?

    # Якщо точного збігу немає, повертаємо перший рахунок з відповідною сумою
    invoices.first
  end
end

# Результат зіставлення
class MatchResult
  attr_reader :transaction, :invoice, :status

  def initialize(transaction, invoice, status)
    @transaction = transaction
    @invoice = invoice
    @status = status
  end

  def matched?
```

```ruby
require 'active_record'

  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'invoices.db'

rescue ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid

# Models
class Invoice < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_one :bank_transaction
  scope :unpaid, -> { where(paid: false) }
  
  validates :invoice_number, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
end

class BankTransaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :invoice, optional: true
  
  validates :transaction_id, uniqueness: true, allow_nil: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
end

class CAMT053Parser
  NAMESPACES = {
    'xmlns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(xml_content)
    @doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
  end

  def parse_transactions
    transactions = []
    
    @doc.xpath('//xmlns:Ntry', NAMESPACES).each do |entry|
      # Extract basic transaction information
      amount_element = entry.xpath('./xmlns:Amt', NAMESPACES).first
      amount = BigDecimal(amount_element.text) if amount_element
      currency = amount_element['Ccy'] if amount_element
      
      value_date_element = entry.xpath('./xmlns:ValDt/xmlns:Dt', NAMESPACES).first
      value_date = Date.parse(value_date_element.text) if value_date_element
      
      # Extract transaction ID
      entry_ref = entry.xpath('./xmlns:NtryRef', NAMESPACES).first&.text
      
      # Extract remittance information (where invoice references are typically stored)
      remittance_info = extract_remittance_info(entry)
      
      # Extract debtor information
      debtor_info = extract_debtor_info(entry)
      
      transactions << {
        transaction_id: entry_ref,
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        value_date: value_date,
        remittance_info: remittance_info,
        debtor_name: debtor_info[:name],
        debtor_account: debtor_info[:account]
      }
    end
    
    transactions
  end

  private

  def extract_remittance_info(entry)
    # Look for remittance information in various possible locations
    remittance_elements = entry.xpath('.//xmlns:RmtInf/xmlns:Ustrd', NAMESPACES)
    return remittance_elements.map(&:text).join(' ') if remittance_elements.any?
    
    # Alternative location for remittance info
    unstructured_info = entry.xpath('.//xmlns:Ustrd', NAMESPACES).first
    unstructured_info.text if unstructured_info
  end

  def extract_debtor_info(entry)
    debtor = entry.xpath('.//xmlns:Dbtr', NAMESPACES).first
    debtor_name = debtor.xpath('./xmlns:Nm', NAMESPACES).first&.text if debtor
    
    debtor_account = entry.xpath('.//xmlns:DbtrAcct/xmlns:Id/xmlns:IBAN', NAMESPACES).first&.text
    
    {
      name: debtor_name,
      account: debtor_account
    }
  end
end

class TransactionMatcher
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end

  def import_and_match(camt_xml_content)
    parser = CAMT053Parser.new(camt_xml_content)
    transactions = parser.parse_transactions
    
    matched_count = 0
    unmatched_transactions = []
    
    transactions.each do |tx_data|
      begin
        # Create or find bank transaction
        bank_tx = BankTransaction.find_or_initialize_by(transaction_id: tx_data[:transaction_id])
        bank_tx.assign_attributes(tx_data.except(:transaction_id))
        
        # Try to match with unpaid invoices
        matched_invoice = find_matching_invoice(tx_data)
        
        if matched_invoice
          bank_tx.invoice = matched_invoice
          matched_invoice.update!(paid: true)
          @logger.info "Matched transaction #{tx_data[:transaction_id]} with invoice #{matched_invoice.invoice_number}"
          matched_count += 1
        else
          unmatched_transactions << tx_data[:transaction_id]
          @logger.warn "No match found for transaction #{tx_data[:transaction_id]}"
        end
        
        bank_tx.save!
      rescue => e
        @logger.error "Error processing transaction #{tx_data[:transaction_id]}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    {
      total_transactions: transactions.size,
      matched_count: matched_count,
      unmatched_count: unmatched_transactions.size,
      unmatched_transactions: unmatched_transactions
    }
  end

  private

  def find_matching_invoice(transaction_data)
    # First, try to match by reference number in remittance info
    if transaction_data[:remittance_info]
      # Extract potential invoice numbers from remittance info
      invoice_numbers = extract_invoice_numbers(transaction_data[:remittance_info])
      
      invoice_numbers.each do |invoice_number|
        invoice = Invoice.unpaid.find_by(invoice_number: invoice_number)
        return invoice if invoice && amount_matches?(invoice, transaction_data[:amount], transaction_data[:currency])
      end
      
      # Try matching by reference number field
      invoice = Invoice.unpaid.find_by(reference_number: transaction_data[:remittance_info])
      return invoice if invoice && amount_matches?(invoice, transaction_data[:amount], transaction_data[:currency])
    end
    
    # Fallback: match by amount (less reliable)
    if transaction_data[:amount]
      Invoice.unpaid.where(amount: transaction_data[:amount], currency: transaction_data[:currency]).first
    end
  end

  def extract_invoice_numbers(remittance_info)
    # Simple regex to find potential invoice numbers
    # Adjust this pattern based on your invoice numbering scheme
    patterns = [
      /INV[-\s]?(\d+)/i,      # INV-12345, INV 12345
      /Invoice[-\s]?(\d+)/i,   # Invoice-12345
      /(\d{4,})/               # Any sequence of 4+ digits
    ]
    
    invoice_numbers = []
    patterns.each do |pattern|
      remittance_info.scan(pattern) do |match|
        invoice_numbers << match[0] if match[0]
      end
    end
    
    invoice_numbers.uniq
  end

  def amount_matches?(invoice, transaction_amount, transaction_currency)
    # Allow small tolerance for floating point arithmetic
    invoice.amount == transaction_amount && invoice.currency == transaction_currency
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'active_model'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string/strip'

class CreditCardValidator
  include ActiveModel::Model
  include ActiveModel::Validations

  attr_accessor :card_number
  attr_reader :brand

  # Card brand patterns (simplified examples)
  BRAND_PATTERNS = {
    visa: /^4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3})?$/,
    mastercard: /^5[1-5][0-9]{14}$/,
    amex: /^3[47][0-9]{13}$/,
    discover: /^6(?:011|5[0-9]{2})[0-9]{12}$/,
    diners_club: /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68][0-9])[0-9]{11}$/,
    jcb: /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}$/
  }.freeze

  validates :card_number, presence: true
  validate :valid_card_number_format
  validate :valid_luhn_checksum

  def initialize(attributes = {})
    super
    detect_brand
  end

  def card_number=(value)
    @card_number = value.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Remove spaces
    detect_brand
  end

  def valid?
    super
    errors.empty?
  end

  private

  def detect_brand
    @brand = if card_number.nil? || card_number.empty?
               :unknown
             else
               BRAND_PATTERNS.find { |_, pattern| card_number =~ pattern }&.first || :unknown
             end
  end

  def valid_card_number_format
    return if card_number.blank?

    # Basic format validation: only digits, length between 13-19
    unless card_number =~ /^\d{13,19}$/
      errors.add(:card_number, 'must contain only digits and be between 13-19 characters')
    end
  end

  def valid_luhn_checksum
    return if card_number.blank? || errors[:card_number].any?

    unless luhn_valid?
      errors.add(:card_number, 'is not a valid credit card number')
    end
  end

  def luhn_valid?
    digits = card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0

    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.even?
        sum += digit
      else
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      end
    end

    sum % 10 == 0
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/braintree_subscription_service.rb
require 'braintree'
require 'dotenv/load'

class BraintreeSubscriptionService
  def initialize
    configure_braintree
  end

  def configure_braintree
    Braintree::Configuration.environment = ENV['BRAINTREE_ENVIRONMENT']&.to_sym || :sandbox
    Braintree::Configuration.merchant_id = ENV['BRAINTREE_MERCHANT_ID']
    Braintree::Configuration.public_key = ENV['BRAINTREE_PUBLIC_KEY']
    Braintree::Configuration.private_key = ENV['BRAINTREE_PRIVATE_KEY']
  end

  # Create a customer in Braintree
  def create_customer(user_params)
    result = Braintree::Customer.create(
      first_name: user_params[:first_name],
      last_name: user_params[:last_name],
      email: user_params[:email],
      phone: user_params[:phone]
    )

    if result.success?
      result.customer.id
    else
      raise "Customer creation failed: #{result.errors.map(&:message).join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  # Create payment method for customer
  def create_payment_method(customer_id, payment_method_nonce)
    result = Braintree::PaymentMethod.create(
      customer_id: customer_id,
      payment_method_nonce: payment_method_nonce,
      options: {
        verify_card: true
      }
    )

    if result.success?
      result.payment_method.token
    else
      raise "Payment method creation failed: #{result.errors.map(&:message).join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  # Create monthly subscription with free trial
  def create_monthly_subscription_with_trial(customer_id, payment_method_token, plan_id, trial_days = 14)
    result = Braintree::Subscription.create(
      payment_method_token: payment_method_token,
      plan_id: plan_id,
      options: {
        start_immediately: true
      },
      first_billing_date: (Date.today + trial_days.days).to_date
    )

    if result.success?
      {
        subscription_id: result.subscription.id,
        status: result.subscription.status,
        next_billing_date: result.subscription.next_billing_date,
        trial_period: trial_days
      }
    else
      raise "Subscription creation failed: #{result.errors.map(&:message).join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  # Cancel subscription when user deletes account
  def cancel_subscription(subscription_id)
    result = Braintree::Subscription.cancel(subscription_id)

    if result.success?
      {
        success: true,
        subscription_id: result.subscription.id,
        status: result.subscription.status
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: result.errors.map(&:message)
      }
    end
  end

  # Get subscription details
  def get_subscription(subscription_id)
    Braintree::Subscription.find(subscription_id)
  rescue Braintree::NotFoundError
    nil
  end

  # Get customer's subscriptions
  def get_customer_subscriptions(customer_id)
    customer = Braintree::Customer.find(customer_id)
    customer.payment_methods.flat_map do |payment_method|
      payment_method.subscriptions
    end
  end

  # Check if subscription is active
  def subscription_active?(subscription_id)
    subscription = get_subscription(subscription_id)
    subscription && %w[Active Pending].include?(subscription.status)
  end
end
```

```ruby
    # Create customer in Braintree if not exists
    unless braintree_customer_id
      @braintree_customer_id = subscription_service.create_customer(
        first_name: first_name,
        last_name: last_name,
        email: email,
        phone: phone
      )
    end

    # Create payment method
    payment_method_token = subscription_service.create_payment_method(
      braintree_customer_id, 
      payment_method_nonce
    )

    # Create subscription with free trial
    subscription_data = subscription_service.create_monthly_subscription_with_trial(
      braintree_customer_id,
      payment_method_token,
      plan_id,
      trial_days
    )

    @subscription_id = subscription_data[:subscription_id]
    save

    subscription_data
  end

  def active_subscription?
    return false unless subscription_id
    subscription_service = BraintreeSubscriptionService.new
    subscription_service.subscription_active?(subscription_id)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class VIESChecker
  # Сервіс VIES WSDL endpoint
  VIES_WSDL_URL = 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl'
  
  # Країни ЄС та їх коди
  EU_COUNTRIES = {
    'AT' => 'Австрія',
    'BE' => 'Бельгія',
    'BG' => 'Болгарія',
    'CY' => 'Кіпр',
    'CZ' => 'Чехія',

    'FR' => 'Франція',
    'GB' => 'Великобританія', # Примітка: вийшла з ЄС, але може бути актуальною для історичних даних
    'HR' => 'Хорватія',
    'HU' => 'Угорщина',
    'IE' => 'Ірландія',
    'IT' => 'Італія',
    'LT' => 'Литва',
    'LU' => 'Люксембург',
    'LV' => 'Латвія',
    'MT' => 'Мальта',
    'NL' => 'Нідерланди',
    'PL' => 'Польща',
    'PT' => 'Португалія',
    'RO' => 'Румунія',
    'SE' => 'Швеція',
    'SI' => 'Словенія',
    'SK' => 'Словаччина'
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    @client = Savon.client(wsdl: VIES_WSDL_URL, log: false, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 10)
  end

  # Основний метод перевірки VAT номера
  def check_vat(vat_number)
    # Очищаємо та форматуємо номер
    vat_number = vat_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Витягуємо код країни (перші 2 символи)
    country_code = vat_number[0..1]
    number = vat_number[2..-1]
    
    # Перевіряємо чи країна підтримується
    unless EU_COUNTRIES.key?(country_code)
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: "Країна #{country_code} не підтримується або не є членом ЄС"
      }
    end

    begin
      # Виклик SOAP сервісу VIES
      response = @client.call(:check_vat, message: {
        country_code: country_code,
        vat_number: number
      })

      parse_response(response.body)
      
    rescue Savon::Error => e
      { valid: false, error: "Помилка зв'язку з VIES: #{e.message}" }
    rescue Timeout::Error
      { valid: false, error: 'Таймаут під час звернення до VIES' }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { valid: false, error: "Неочікувана помилка: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка VAT номера з детальною інформацією про компанію
  def check_vat_detail(vat_number)
    result = check_vat(vat_number)
    
    return result unless result[:valid]
    
    # Додаткові дані можна отримати з інших джерел або API
    result.merge(get_company_info(result[:country_code], result[:vat_number]))
  end

  # Масовa перевірка кількох номерів
  def batch_check(vat_numbers)
    results = {}
    
    vat_numbers.each do |vat_number|
      results[vat_number] = check_vat(vat_number)
      
      # Затримка для уникання перевантаження сервісу
      sleep(0.5)
    end
    
    results
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response_body)
    result = response_body[:check_vat_response][:check_vat_result]
    
    {
      valid: result[:valid] == 'true',
      vat_number: "#{result[:country_code]}#{result[:vat_number]}",
      country_code: result[:country_code],
      country_name: EU_COUNTRIES[result[:country_code]],
      request_date: result[:request_date],
      name: result[:name],
      address: result[:address],
      raw_response: result
    }
  end

  def get_company_info(country_code, vat_number)
    # Тут можна додати інтеграцію з іншими сервісами для отримання додаткової інформації
    {
      additional_info: 'Додаткова інформація може бути отримана через інші API'
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class PaymentProcessor
  def initialize
    @client = Coinbase::Commerce::Client.new
    @orders = {} # In production, use a proper database
  end

  # Create a new charge for an order
  def create_charge(order_id, amount, currency = 'BTC', description = 'Order payment')
    charge_data = {
      name: "Order ##{order_id}",
      description: description,
      pricing_type: 'fixed_price',
      local_price: {
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency
      },
      metadata: {
        order_id: order_id
      }
    }

    begin
      charge = @client.charge.create(charge_data)
      @orders[order_id] = {
        charge_id: charge.id,
        status: 'pending',
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency
      }
      charge
    rescue Coinbase::Commerce::Errors::BaseError => e
      puts "Error creating charge: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Verify webhook signature (important for security)
  def valid_webhook_signature?(payload, signature, secret)
    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(
      OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha256'),
      secret,
      payload
    )
    Rack::Utils.secure_compare(expected_signature, signature)
  end

  # Process webhook events
  def process_webhook_event(event)
    case event.type
    when 'charge:confirmed'
      handle_charge_confirmed(event)
    when 'charge:failed'
      handle_charge_failed(event)
    when 'charge:pending'
      handle_charge_pending(event)
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_charge_confirmed(event)
    charge = event.data
    order_id = charge.metadata['order_id']
    
    if order_id && @orders[order_id]
      @orders[order_id][:status] = 'paid'
      @orders[order_id][:confirmed_at] = Time.now
      
      # Here you would typically update your database
      mark_order_as_paid(order_id)
      
      puts "Order #{order_id} marked as paid"
    end
  end

  def handle_charge_failed(event)
    charge = event.data
    order_id = charge.metadata['order_id']
    
    if order_id && @orders[order_id]
      @orders[order_id][:status] = 'failed'
      puts "Payment failed for order #{order_id}"
    end
  end

  def handle_charge_pending(event)
    charge = event.data
    order_id = charge.metadata['order_id']
    
    if order_id && @orders[order_id]
      @orders[order_id][:status] = 'pending'
      puts "Payment pending for order #{order_id}"
    end
  end

  def mark_order_as_paid(order_id)
    # Implement your business logic here
    # This could update a database, send confirmation emails, etc.
    puts "Implement order fulfillment for order #{order_id}"
    
    # Example:
    # Order.find(order_id).update(status: 'paid', paid_at: Time.now)
    # send_confirmation_email(order_id)
  end
end

# Sinatra web application
class CoinbaseCommerceApp < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :payment_processor, PaymentProcessor.new
    set :webhook_secret, ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET']
  end

  # Create a new payment charge
  post '/create-charge' do
    content_type :json
    
    order_id = params[:order_id]
    amount = params[:amount]
    currency = params[:currency] || 'BTC'
    
    unless order_id && amount
      status 400
      return { error: 'Missing order_id or amount' }.to_json
    end

    charge = settings.payment_processor.create_charge(order_id, amount, currency)
    
    if charge
      { 
        charge_id: charge.id,
        hosted_url: charge.hosted_url,
        expires_at: charge.expires_at,
        pricing: charge.pricing
      }.to_json
    else
      status 500
      { error: 'Failed to create charge' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Webhook endpoint for payment notifications
  post '/webhook' do
    payload = request.body.read
    signature = request.env['HTTP_X_CC_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE']
    
    # Verify webhook signature
    unless settings.payment_processor.valid_webhook_signature?(
      payload, signature, settings.webhook_secret
    )
      status 401
      return { error: 'Invalid signature' }.to_json
    end

    begin
      event_data = JSON.parse(payload)
      event = Coinbase::Commerce::Event.new(event_data)
      
      settings.payment_processor.process_webhook_event(event)
      
      status 200
      { status: 'success' }.to_json
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      status 400
      { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 500
      { error: 'Internal server error' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Get order status
  get '/order/:order_id/status' do
    content_type :json
    
    order_id = params[:order_id]
    processor = settings.payment_processor
    
    if processor.instance_variable_get(:@orders)[order_id]
      processor.instance_variable_get(:@orders)[order_id].to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class StockAnalyzer
  ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'.freeze
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    raise "API key not found. Please set ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY in .env file" unless @api_key
  end
  
  def fetch_historical_prices(ticker, output_size: 'compact')
    params = {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: ticker,
      outputsize: output_size,
      apikey: @api_key
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.get(ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL, query: params)
    
    if response.success?
      data = response.parsed_response
      
      if data['Error Message']
        raise "API Error: #{data['Error Message']}"
      elsif data['Note']
        raise "API Limit: #{data['Note']}"
      elsif data['Time Series (Daily)']
        return parse_historical_data(data['Time Series (Daily)'])
      else
        raise "Unexpected response format"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def calculate_moving_average(prices, period = 20)
    return [] if prices.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    prices.each_cons(period) do |window|
      average = window.sum { |price| price[:close].to_f } / period
      moving_averages << {
        date: window.last[:date],
        moving_average: average.round(4),
        close_price: window.last[:close].to_f
      }
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end
  
  def analyze_stock(ticker, period = 20)
    puts "Fetching historical prices for #{ticker}..."
    prices = fetch_historical_prices(ticker)
    
    puts "Calculating #{period}-day moving average..."
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, period)
    
    display_results(ticker, moving_averages)
    
    { prices: prices, moving_averages: moving_averages }
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_historical_data(time_series_data)
    prices = []
    
    time_series_data.each do |date_str, daily_data|
      prices << {
        date: Date.parse(date_str),
        open: daily_data['1. open'],
        high: daily_data['2. high'],
        low: daily_data['3. low'],
        close: daily_data['4. close'],
        volume: daily_data['5. volume']
      }
    end
    
    # Sort by date ascending
    prices.sort_by! { |price| price[:date] }
  end
  
  def display_results(ticker, moving_averages)
    puts "\n#{ticker} - 20-Day Moving Average Analysis"
    puts "=" * 50
    
    if moving_averages.empty?
      puts "Not enough data to calculate moving average"
      return
    end
    
    # Show latest 10 moving average values
    moving_averages.last(10).reverse.each do |data|
      date = data[:date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
      ma = data[:moving_average]
      close = data[:close_price]
      trend = close > ma ? "ABOVE" : "BELOW"
      
      puts "#{date}: MA20 = $#{ma}, Close = $#{close.round(2)} (#{trend})"
    end
    
    latest = moving_averages.last
    puts "\nLatest: MA20 = $#{latest[:moving_average]}, Close = $#{latest[:close_price].round(2)}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# vies_vat_validator.rb
require 'savon'
require 'date'

class VIESVATValidator
  # VIES service WSDL endpoint
  VIES_WSDL_URL = 'https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl'
  
  # EU country codes for validation
  EU_COUNTRY_CODES = %w[
    AT BE BG CY CZ DE DK EE EL ES FI FR GB GR HR HU IE IT LT LU LV MT NL PL PT RO SE SI SK
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @client = Savon.client(wsdl: VIES_WSDL_URL, log: false, pretty_print_xml: true)
  end

  # Validates a VAT number using VIES service
  # @param country_code [String] 2-letter country code (e.g., 'DE', 'FR')
  # @param vat_number [String] VAT number without country code
  # @return [Hash] Validation result with keys: valid, name, address, request_date, vies_response
  def validate_vat(country_code, vat_number)
    # Basic validation
    return invalid_result("Invalid country code") unless valid_country_code?(country_code)
    return invalid_result("VAT number cannot be empty") if vat_number.to_s.strip.empty?

    # Clean VAT number
    cleaned_vat = vat_number.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/, '').upcase

    begin
      response = @client.call(:check_vat, message: {
        country_code: country_code.upcase,
        vat_number: cleaned_vat
      })

      process_vies_response(response)
    rescue Savon::Error => e
      { valid: false, error: "VIES service error: #{e.message}", vies_response: nil }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { valid: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}", vies_response: nil }
    end
  end

  # Creates a reverse-charge invoice with VAT validation
  # @param invoice_data [Hash] Invoice data including vat_country_code and vat_number
  # @return [Hash] Invoice result with validation status
  def create_reverse_charge_invoice(invoice_data)
    vat_country = invoice_data[:vat_country_code] || invoice_data[:country_code]
    vat_number = invoice_data[:vat_number]

    # Validate VAT number
    validation_result = validate_vat(vat_country, vat_number)

    if validation_result[:valid]
      invoice = build_reverse_charge_invoice(invoice_data, validation_result)
      {
        success: true,
        invoice: invoice,
        validation: validation_result,
        message: "Reverse-charge invoice created successfully"
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        invoice: nil,
        validation: validation_result,
        message: "Cannot create invoice: VAT validation failed"
      }
    end
  end

  # Batch validate multiple VAT numbers
  # @param vat_numbers [Array<Hash>] Array of hashes with country_code and vat_number keys
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Array of validation results
  def batch_validate(vat_numbers)
    vat_numbers.map do |vat_data|
      validate_vat(vat_data[:country_code], vat_data[:vat_number])
    end
  end

  private

  def valid_country_code?(country_code)
    EU_COUNTRY_CODES.include?(country_code.to_s.upcase)
  end

  def invalid_result(error_message)
    { valid: false, error: error_message, vies_response: nil }
  end

  def process_vies_response(response)
    body = response.body[:check_vat_response]
    
    {
      valid: body[:valid],
      vat_number: "#{body[:country_code]}#{body[:vat_number]}",
      name: body[:name],
      address: body[:address],
      request_date: parse_vies_date(body[:request_date]),
      vies_response: body,
      error: nil
    }
  end

  def parse_vies_date(date_string)
    # VIES returns date in format: "2023-12-25+01:00"
    return nil unless date_string
    
    # Handle various date formats returned by VIES
    if date_string.is_a?(Date) || date_string.is_a?(Time)
      date_string
    else
      begin
        DateTime.parse(date_string.to_s)
      rescue ArgumentError
        nil
      end
    end
  end

  def build_reverse_charge_invoice(invoice_data, validation_result)
    {
      invoice_number: generate_invoice_number,
      issue_date: Date.today,
      supplier: invoice_data[:supplier_info] || {},
      customer: {
        name: validation_result[:name],
        address: validation_result[:address],
        vat_number: validation_result[:vat_number],
        country_code: invoice_data[:vat_country_code]
      },
      items: invoice_data[:items] || [],
      total_amount: invoice_data[:total_amount],
      vat_amount: 0, # Reverse charge means VAT is 0
      reverse_charge: true,
      vat_validation: {
        valid: true,
        validated_at: Time.now,
        vies_reference: validation_result[:request_date]
      },
      notes: "Reverse charge applied according to EU VAT Directive Article 194"
    }
  end

  def generate_invoice_number
    "INV-#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d')}-#{SecureRandom.hex(4).upcase}"
  end
end
```

## Additional Utility Class for Caching and Rate Limiting

```ruby
# vies_cache_manager.rb
require 'json'
require 'fileutils'

class VIESCacheManager
  def initialize(cache_dir: '/tmp/vies_cache', ttl: 86400) # 24 hours TTL
    @cache_dir = cache_dir
    @ttl = ttl
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(@cache_dir)
  end

  def cached_validation(country_code, vat_number)
    cache_key = "#{country_code}_#{vat_number}".gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/, '_')
    cache_file = File.join(@cache_dir, "#{cache_key}.json")
    
    return nil unless File.exist?(cache_file)
    
    cache_data = JSON.parse(File.read(cache_file), symbolize_names: true)
    
    # Check if cache is still valid
    if Time.now - File.mtime(cache_file) < @ttl
      cache_data
    else
      File.delete(cache_file)
      nil
    end
  rescue => e
    # If cache is corrupt, delete it and return nil
    File.delete(cache_file) if File.exist?(cache_file)
    nil
  end

  def cache_validation(country_code, vat_number, validation_result)
    cache_key = "#{country_code}_#{vat_number}".gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/, '_')
    cache_file = File.join(@cache_dir, "#{cache_key}.json")
    
    cache_data = {
      country_code: country_code,
      vat_number: vat_number,
      validation_result: validation_result,
      cached_at: Time.now.iso8601
    }
    
    File.write(cache_file, JSON.pretty_generate(cache_data))
  end
end

# Enhanced validator with caching
class CachedVIESVATValidator < VIESVATValidator
  def initialize(cache_dir: '/tmp/vies_cache', ttl: 86400)
    super()
    @cache_manager = VIESCacheManager.new(cache_dir: cache_dir, ttl: ttl)
  end

  def validate_vat(country_code, vat_number)
    # Try cache first
    cached = @cache_manager.cached_validation(country_code, vat_number)
    return cached[:validation_result] if cached

    # If not in cache, call VIES service
    result = super(country_code, vat_number)
    
    # Cache successful validations
    @cache_manager.cache_validation(country_code, vat_number, result) if result[:valid]
    
    result
  end
end
```

```ruby
class CreditCardValidator
  # Визначення платіжних систем за префіксами та довжинами номерів
  PAYMENT_SYSTEMS = {
    visa: {
      prefixes: ['4'],
      lengths: [13, 16, 19]
    },
    mastercard: {
      prefixes: ['51', '52', '53', '54', '55', '2221', '2222', '2223', '2224', '2225', '2226', '2227', '2228', '2229', '223', '224', '225', '226', '227', '228', '229', '23', '24', '25', '26', '270', '271', '2720'],
      lengths: [16]
    },
    american_express: {
      prefixes: ['34', '37'],
      lengths: [15]
    },
    discover: {
      prefixes: ['6011', '622126', '622127', '622128', '622129', '62213', '62214', '62215', '62216', '62217', '62218', '62219', '6222', '6223', '6224', '6225', '6226', '6227', '6228', '62290', '62291', '622920', '622921', '622922', '622923', '622924', '622925', '644', '645', '646', '647', '648', '649', '65'],
      lengths: [16, 19]
    },
    jcb: {
      prefixes: ['3528', '3529', '353', '354', '355', '356', '357', '358'],
      lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19]
    },
    diners_club: {
      prefixes: ['300', '301', '302', '303', '304', '305', '36', '38', '39'],
      lengths: [14, 16, 19]
    },
    unionpay: {
      prefixes: ['62'],
      lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19]
    },
    mir: {
      prefixes: ['2200', '2201', '2202', '2203', '2204'],
      lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19]
    }
  }.freeze

  attr_reader :card_number, :validation_result

  def initialize(card_number)
    @card_number = card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Видаляємо пробіли
    @validation_result = {}
  end

  def validate
    validate_luhn
    identify_payment_system
    @validation_result
  end

  def valid?
    validate if @validation_result.empty?
    @validation_result[:luhn_valid]
  end

  def payment_system
    validate if @validation_result.empty?
    @validation_result[:payment_system]
  end

  private

  # Алгоритм Луна
  def validate_luhn
    digits = @card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    
    # Перевірка, що номер містить тільки цифри
    if @card_number !~ /^\d+$/
      @validation_result[:luhn_valid] = false
      @validation_result[:luhn_error] = 'Номер картки повинен містити тільки цифри'
      return
    end

    # Перевертаємо цифри та подвоюємо кожну другу
    sum = digits.reverse.each_with_index.sum do |digit, index|
      if index.even?
        digit
      else
        doubled = digit * 2
        doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      end
    end

    @validation_result[:luhn_valid] = (sum % 10 == 0)
    @validation_result[:luhn_sum] = sum
  end

  # Визначення платіжної системи
  def identify_payment_system
    return unless @validation_result[:luhn_valid]

    PAYMENT_SYSTEMS.each do |system, rules|
      prefix_match = rules[:prefixes].any? { |prefix| @card_number.start_with?(prefix) }
      length_match = rules[:lengths].include?(@card_number.length)
      
      if prefix_match && length_match
        @validation_result[:payment_system] = system.to_s
        @validation_result[:payment_system_name] = system_name(system)
        return
      end
    end

    @validation_result[:payment_system] = 'unknown'
    @validation_result[:payment_system_name] = 'Невідома платіжна система'
  end

  def system_name(system)
    {
      visa: 'Visa',
      mastercard: 'MasterCard',
      american_express: 'American Express',
      discover: 'Discover',
      jcb: 'JCB',
      diners_club: 'Diners Club',
      unionpay: 'UnionPay',
      mir: 'МИР'
    }[system]
  end
end
```

```ruby
      # Перевірка підпису вебхука
      unless Coinbase::Commerce::Webhook.verify(payload, signature, webhook_secret)
        return { error: 'Невалідний підпис вебхука' }
      end

      event = JSON.parse(payload)
      
      case event['type']
      when 'charge:confirmed'
        handle_confirmed_payment(event)
      when 'charge:failed'
        handle_failed_payment(event)
      when 'charge:pending'
        handle_pending_payment(event)
      else
        { handled: false, message: 'Тип події не обробляється' }
      end
    rescue => e
      { error: "Помилка обробки вебхука: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_confirmed_payment(event)
    charge_data = event['data']
    order_id = charge_data['metadata']['order_id']
    charge_id = charge_data['id']
    
    # Позначаємо замовлення як оплачене
    mark_order_as_paid(order_id, charge_id)
    
    {
      handled: true,
      action: 'order_marked_paid',
      order_id: order_id,
      charge_id: charge_id,
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
    }
  end

  def handle_failed_payment(event)
    charge_data = event['data']
    order_id = charge_data['metadata']['order_id']
    
    # Позначаємо замовлення як невдале
    mark_order_as_failed(order_id)
    
    {
      handled: true,
      action: 'order_marked_failed',
      order_id: order_id,
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
    }
  end

  def handle_pending_payment(event)
    charge_data = event['data']
    order_id = charge_data['metadata']['order_id']
    
    # Оновлюємо статус замовлення на "очікує оплати"
    update_order_status(order_id, 'pending')
    
    {
      handled: true,
      action: 'order_pending_payment',
      order_id: order_id,
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
    }
  end

  # Методи для роботи з замовленнями (потрібно адаптувати під вашу систему)
  def mark_order_as_paid(order_id, charge_id)
    # Знаходимо замовлення за order_id
    order = find_order(order_id)
    
    if order
      order.update(
        payment_status: 'paid',
        paid_at: Time.now,
        transaction_id: charge_id
      )
      puts "Замовлення ##{order_id} позначено як оплачене"
    else
      puts "Замовлення ##{order_id} не знайдено"
    end
  end

  def mark_order_as_failed(order_id)
    order = find_order(order_id)
    
    if order
      order.update(payment_status: 'failed')
      puts "Замовлення ##{order_id} позначено як невдале"
    else
      puts "Замовлення ##{order_id} не знайдено"
    end
  end

  def update_order_status(order_id, status)
    order = find_order(order_id)
    
    if order
      order.update(payment_status: status)
      puts "Статус замовлення ##{order_id} оновлено на: #{status}"
    else
      puts "Замовлення ##{order_id} не знайдено"
    end
  end

  def find_order(order_id)
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'

class NBUExchangeRates
  BASE_URL = 'https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange'
  
  def initialize(date = Date.today)
    @date = date.is_a?(String) ? Date.parse(date) : date
    @rates = {}
  end
  
  # Отримати курс валюти за кодом
  def get_rate(currency_code)
    fetch_rates if @rates.empty?
    rate_info = @rates[currency_code.upcase]
    rate_info ? rate_info[:rate] : nil
  end
  
  # Отримати всю інформацію про валюту
  def get_currency_info(currency_code)
    fetch_rates if @rates.empty?
    @rates[currency_code.upcase]
  end
  
  # Отримати всі курси на задану дату
  def get_all_rates
    fetch_rates if @rates.empty?
    @rates
  end
  
  # Отримати курси популярних валют
  def get_popular_currencies
    fetch_rates if @rates.empty?
    popular_codes = ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'PLN', 'CHF', 'JPY', 'CAD']
    @rates.select { |code, _| popular_codes.include?(code) }
  end
  
  # Перевірити, чи є дані за вказану дату
  def data_available?
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}?date=#{format_date}&json")
    response.code == 200 && !response.body.empty?
  end
  
  private
  
  def fetch_rates
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}?date=#{format_date}&json")
    
    if response.code == 200 && !response.body.empty?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      data.each do |currency|
        code = currency['cc']
        @rates[code] = {
          rate: currency['rate'].to_f,
          name: currency['txt'],
          amount: currency['rate'].to_f / currency['rate'].to_f, # Для валют, які торгуються не за 1 одиницю
          date: Date.parse(currency['exchangedate'])
        }
      end
    else
      raise "Не вдалося отримати дані за дату #{@date}. Можливо, банк не публікував курси у вихідний день."
    end
  end
  
  def format_date
    @date.strftime('%Y%m%d')
  end
end
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# loan_amortization.rb
require 'axlsx'

class LoanAmortizationCalculator
  attr_reader :principal, :annual_rate, :term_years, :monthly_payment, :schedule

  def initialize(principal, annual_rate, term_years)
    @principal = principal.to_f
    @annual_rate = annual_rate.to_f
    @term_years = term_years.to_i
    @schedule = []
    calculate_amortization_schedule
  end

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    monthly_rate = @annual_rate / 12.0 / 100.0
    n = @term_years * 12
    @monthly_payment = @principal * (monthly_rate * (1 + monthly_rate)**n) / ((1 + monthly_rate)**n - 1)
  end

  def calculate_amortization_schedule
    calculate_monthly_payment
    balance = @principal
    monthly_rate = @annual_rate / 12.0 / 100.0

    (1..(@term_years * 12)).each do |month|
      interest_payment = balance * monthly_rate
      principal_payment = @monthly_payment - interest_payment
      balance -= principal_payment

      # Handle final payment adjustment
      if balance < 0
        principal_payment += balance
        @monthly_payment += balance
        balance = 0
      end

      @schedule << {
        month: month,
        payment: @monthly_payment.round(2),
        principal: principal_payment.round(2),
        interest: interest_payment.round(2),
        balance: balance.round(2)
      }

      break if balance <= 0
    end
  end

  def export_to_excel(filename = "loan_amortization_schedule.xlsx")
    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Amortization Schedule") do |sheet|
        # Add header row
        sheet.add_row(["Loan Amortization Schedule"])
        sheet.add_row(["Principal: $#{@principal}", "Annual Rate: #{@annual_rate}%", "Term: #{@term_years} years"])
        sheet.add_row(["Monthly Payment: $#{@monthly_payment.round(2)}"])
        sheet.add_row([]) # Empty row for spacing

        # Add table headers
        sheet.add_row(["Month", "Payment", "Principal", "Interest", "Remaining Balance"])

        # Add schedule data
        @schedule.each do |payment|
          sheet.add_row([
            payment[:month],
            "$#{payment[:payment]}",
            "$#{payment[:principal]}",
            "$#{payment[:interest]}",
            "$#{payment[:balance]}"
          ])
        end

        # Add summary
        sheet.add_row([])
        total_payments = @schedule.sum { |p| p[:payment] }
        total_interest = @schedule.sum { |p| p[:interest] }
        sheet.add_row(["Total Payments: $#{total_payments.round(2)}"])
        sheet.add_row(["Total Interest: $#{total_interest.round(2)}"])

        # Style the sheet
        sheet.rows[0].cells[0].style = sheet.styles.add_style(b: true, sz: 16)
        sheet.rows[4].cells.each { |cell| cell.style = sheet.styles.add_style(b: true, bg_color: "DDDDDD") }
        
        # Auto-adjust column widths
        sheet.column_widths 10, 15, 15, 15, 20
      end

      p.serialize(filename)
    end
    puts "Amortization schedule exported to #{filename}"
  end

  def display_schedule(limit = 12)
    puts "\nLoan Amortization Schedule (First #{limit} months)"
    puts "Principal: $#{@principal}, Annual Rate: #{@annual_rate}%, Term: #{@term_years} years"
    puts "Monthly Payment: $#{@monthly_payment.round(2)}"
    puts "\nMonth\tPayment\t\tPrincipal\tInterest\tBalance"
    puts "-" * 70

    @schedule.first(limit).each do |payment|
      puts "#{payment[:month]}\t$#{payment[:payment]}\t\t$#{payment[:principal]}\t\t$#{payment[:interest]}\t\t$#{payment[:balance]}"
    end

    total_payments = @schedule.sum { |p| p[:payment] }
    total_interest = @schedule.sum { |p| p[:interest] }
    puts "\nSummary:"
    puts "Total Payments: $#{total_payments.round(2)}"
    puts "Total Interest: $#{total_interest.round(2)}"
  end
end

# Example usage and main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Example loan: $200,000 at 4.5% for 30 years
  puts "Loan Amortization Calculator"
  puts "=" * 40

  # Get user input or use default values
  print "Enter principal amount (default: 200000): "
  principal = gets.chomp
  principal = principal.empty? ? 200000 : principal.to_f

  print "Enter annual interest rate % (default: 4.5): "
  annual_rate = gets.chomp
  annual_rate = annual_rate.empty? ? 4.5 : annual_rate.to_f

  print "Enter loan term in years (default: 30): "
  term_years = gets.chomp
  term_years = term_years.empty? ? 30 : term_years.to_i

  # Create calculator and generate schedule
  calculator = LoanAmortizationCalculator.new(principal, annual_rate, term_years)
  
  # Display first 12 months in console
  calculator.display_schedule(12)
  
  # Export to Excel
  print "\nEnter Excel filename (default: loan_amortization_schedule.xlsx): "
  filename = gets.chomp
  filename = "loan_amortization_schedule.xlsx" if filename.empty?
  
  calculator.export_to_excel(filename)
end
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv/load'

# Database configuration
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'db/monobank_transactions.db'

# models/transaction.rb
class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :transaction_id, uniqueness: true
  
  def self.latest_timestamp
    maximum(:time) || 0
  end
end

# services/monobank_client.rb
class MonobankClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  
  def initialize(api_token)
    @api_token = api_token
    @headers = {
      'X-Token' => @api_token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def get_client_info
    self.class.get('/personal/client-info', headers: @headers)
  end
  
  def get_statement(account_id, from = nil, to = nil)
    endpoint = "/personal/statement/#{account_id}"
    endpoint += "/#{from}" if from
    endpoint += "/#{to}" if to && from
    
    self.class.get(endpoint, headers: @headers)
  end
end

# services/transaction_processor.rb
class TransactionProcessor
  def initialize(monobank_client, account_id)
    @client = monobank_client
    @account_id = account_id
  end
  
  def fetch_and_save_new_transactions
    latest_timestamp = Transaction.latest_timestamp
    from_time = latest_timestamp > 0 ? latest_timestamp + 1 : nil
    
    response = @client.get_statement(@account_id, from_time)
    
    if response.success?
      transactions = JSON.parse(response.body)
      save_transactions(transactions)
      puts "Saved #{transactions.count} new transactions"
      transactions
    else
      puts "Error fetching transactions: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      []
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def save_transactions(transactions_data)
    transactions_data.each do |tx_data|
      Transaction.create!(
        transaction_id: tx_data['id'],
        time: tx_data['time'],
        description: tx_data['description'],
        amount: tx_data['amount'],
        operation_amount: tx_data['operationAmount'],
        currency_code: tx_data['currencyCode'],
        commission_rate: tx_data['commissionRate'],
        cashback_amount: tx_data['cashbackAmount'],
        balance: tx_data['balance'],
        hold: tx_data['hold'],
        mcc: tx_data['mcc']
      )
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      puts "Transaction #{tx_data['id']} already exists"
    end
  end
end

    unless @api_token && @account_id
      puts "Please set MONOBANK_API_TOKEN and MONOBANK_ACCOUNT_ID environment variables"
      exit 1
    end
    
    @client = MonobankClient.new(@api_token)
    @processor = TransactionProcessor.new(@client, @account_id)
```

```ruby
# exchange_rate_fetcher.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class NBUExchangeRateFetcher
  BASE_URL = 'https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange'

  def initialize
    @client = HTTParty
  end

  # Fetch exchange rates for a specific date
  # @param date [Date, String] The date to fetch rates for (YYYY-MM-DD format or Date object)
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Array of exchange rate hashes
  def fetch_rates(date)
    date = parse_date(date)
    url = build_url(date)
    
    response = @client.get(url)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Fetch exchange rate for a specific currency on a given date
  # @param currency_code [String] ISO 4217 currency code (USD, EUR, etc.)
  # @param date [Date, String] The date to fetch rate for
  # @return [Hash, nil] Exchange rate data or nil if not found
  def fetch_rate(currency_code, date)
    rates = fetch_rates(date)
    rates.find { |rate| rate[:cc] == currency_code.upcase }
  end

  private

  def parse_date(date)
    case date
    when Date
      date
    when String
      Date.parse(date)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Date must be a Date object or string in YYYY-MM-DD format"
    end
  rescue ArgumentError
    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid date format. Use YYYY-MM-DD"
  end

  def build_url(date)
    "#{BASE_URL}?date=#{date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}&json"
  end

  def parse_response(xml_response)
    # The API returns JSON despite the 'json' parameter
    json_data = JSON.parse(xml_response)
    
    json_data.map do |rate|
      {
        r030: rate['r030'],           # Digital code
        txt: rate['txt'],             # Currency name
        rate: rate['rate'].to_f,      # Exchange rate
        cc: rate['cc'],               # Currency code (USD, EUR, etc.)
        exchangedate: rate['exchangedate'] # Date of exchange
      }
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    case response.code
    when 404
      raise "Exchange rates not found for the specified date"
    when 400
      raise "Invalid request parameters"
    when 500
      raise "National Bank of Ukraine API server error"
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates: HTTP #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# credit_calculator.rb
require 'axlsx'

class CreditCalculator
  def initialize(loan_amount, annual_rate, term_months, start_date = Date.today)
    @loan_amount = loan_amount.to_f
    @annual_rate = annual_rate.to_f
    @term_months = term_months.to_i
    @start_date = start_date
    @monthly_rate = @annual_rate / 12 / 100
  end

  # Розрахунок щомісячного платежу за формулою ануїтету
  def monthly_payment
    return @loan_amount / @term_months if @monthly_rate == 0
    
    @loan_amount * (@monthly_rate * (1 + @monthly_rate)**@term_months) / 
    ((1 + @monthly_rate)**@term_months - 1)
  end

  # Генерація графіка погашення
  def generate_schedule
    schedule = []
    remaining_balance = @loan_amount
    monthly_pmt = monthly_payment
    
    @term_months.times do |month|
      interest_payment = remaining_balance * @monthly_rate
      principal_payment = monthly_pmt - interest_payment
      
      # Корекція останнього платежу
      if month == @term_months - 1
        principal_payment = remaining_balance
        monthly_pmt = principal_payment + interest_payment
      end
      
      remaining_balance -= principal_payment
      remaining_balance = remaining_balance.round(2)
      
      payment_date = @start_date.next_month(month)
      
      schedule << {
        month: month + 1,
        date: payment_date,
        payment: monthly_pmt.round(2),
        principal: principal_payment.round(2),
        interest: interest_payment.round(2),
        remaining_balance: remaining_balance.round(2)
      }
    end
    
    schedule
  end

  # Експорт у Excel
  def export_to_excel(filename = "credit_schedule.xlsx")
    schedule = generate_schedule
    
    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Графік погашення") do |sheet|
        # Додавання заголовків
        sheet.add_row([
          "Місяць", 
          "Дата платежу", 
          "Щомісячний платіж", 
          "Погашення основного боргу", 
          "Відсотки", 
          "Залишок боргу"
        ])
        
        # Додавання даних
        schedule.each do |payment|
          sheet.add_row([
            payment[:month],
            payment[:date].strftime("%d.%m.%Y"),
            payment[:payment],
            payment[:principal],
            payment[:interest],
            payment[:remaining_balance]
          ])
        end
        
        # Форматування стовпців
        sheet.column_widths 10, 15, 18, 25, 15, 18
      end
      
      p.serialize(filename)
    end
    
    puts "Графік погашення збережено у файлі: #{filename}"
    filename
  end

  # Вивід статистики кредиту
  def print_summary
    schedule = generate_schedule
    total_payment = schedule.sum { |p| p[:payment] }
    total_interest = schedule.sum { |p| p[:interest] }
    
    puts "=== СТАТИСТИКА КРЕДИТУ ==="
    puts "Сума кредиту: #{@loan_amount} грн"
    puts "Річна процентна ставка: #{@annual_rate}%"
    puts "Термін кредиту: #{@term_months} місяців"
    puts "Щомісячний платіж: #{monthly_payment.round(2)} грн"
    puts "Загальна сума виплат: #{total_payment.round(2)} грн"
    puts "Загальні відсотки: #{total_interest.round(2)} грн"
    puts "Переплата: #{(total_interest / @loan_amount * 100).round(2)}%"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# privat_business_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'openssl'
require 'time'

class PrivatBusinessClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://acp.privatbank.ua/api'

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password, card_number = nil)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
    @card_number = card_number
  end

  # Get account balance
  def balance
    make_request('balance', { cardnum: @card_number })
  end

  # Get account statement for a date range
  def statement(start_date, end_date)
    make_request('rest', {
      oper: 'cmt',
      wait: '0',  # 0 - don't wait, 1 - wait for response
      test: '0',  # 0 - production, 1 - test mode
      payment: {
        prop: {
          sd: start_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
          ed: end_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
          card: @card_number
        }
      }
    })
  end

  private

  def make_request(operation, data)
    # Generate signature
    data_string = data.to_json
    signature = generate_signature(data_string)

    # Prepare request headers
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json; charset=UTF-8',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Signature' => signature
    }

    # Prepare request body
    request_body = {
      id: @merchant_id,
      data: Base64.strict_encode64(data_string)
    }.to_json

    # Make API call
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/#{operation}",
      headers: headers,
      body: request_body,
      verify: true  # SSL verification
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  def generate_signature(data_string)
    # Encode data to base64
    data_base64 = Base64.strict_encode64(data_string)
    
    # Create signature string: data + password
    signature_string = data_base64 + @merchant_password
    
    # Generate SHA1 hash and encode to base64
    signature_sha1 = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA1.digest(signature_string)
    Base64.strict_encode64(signature_sha1)
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      begin
        response_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
        
        if response_data['result'] == 'error'
          raise "API Error: #{response_data['error']['message']}"
        end
        
        # Decode the data if it's base64 encoded
        if response_data['data']
          decoded_data = Base64.decode64(response_data['data'])
          JSON.parse(decoded_data)
        else
          response_data
        end
      rescue JSON::ParserError => e
        raise "Failed to parse response: #{e.message}"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# mono_transactions.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'active_support/core_ext/numeric/time'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class MonoBankAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  
  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
  end
  
  def get_client_info
    make_request('/personal/client-info')
  end
  
  def get_statement(account_id, from = nil, to = nil)
    endpoint = "/personal/statement/#{account_id}"
    endpoint += "/#{from}" if from
    endpoint += "/#{to}" if to && from
    
    make_request(endpoint)
  end
  
  private
  
  def make_request(endpoint)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      headers: {
        'X-Token' => @token,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

class TransactionStorage
  def initialize(db_path = 'mono_transactions.db')
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new(db_path)
    create_table_if_not_exists
  end
  
  def save_transactions(transactions, account_id)
    transactions.each do |transaction|
      # Перевіряємо, чи транзакція вже існує
      existing = @db.get_first_value(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE id = ?", 
        transaction['id']
      )
      
      next if existing > 0 # Пропускаємо якщо транзакція вже є в базі
      
      @db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO transactions (id, account_id, time, description, amount, balance, currency_code, cashback_amount) 
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        [
          transaction['id'],
          account_id,
          Time.at(transaction['time']).to_s,
          transaction['description'],
          transaction['amount'],
          transaction['balance'],
          transaction['currencyCode'],
          transaction['cashbackAmount'] || 0
        ]
      )
    end
  end
  
  def get_latest_transaction_time(account_id)
    result = @db.get_first_value(
      "SELECT MAX(time) FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ?", 
      account_id
    )
    
    result ? Time.parse(result).to_i : nil
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_table_if_not_exists
    @db.execute <<-SQL
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        time DATETIME NOT NULL,
        description TEXT,
        amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
        balance INTEGER NOT NULL,
        currency_code INTEGER NOT NULL,
        cashback_amount INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
    SQL
  end
end

class MonoBankSync
  def initialize(api_token)
    @api = MonoBankAPI.new(api_token)
    @storage = TransactionStorage.new
  end
  
  def sync_transactions(account_id = nil)
    # Якщо account_id не вказано, отримуємо перший рахунок
    account_id ||= get_first_account_id
    
    # Отримуємо час останньої синхронізації
    from_time = @storage.get_latest_transaction_time(account_id)
    
    # Якщо це перша синхронізація, беремо транзакції за останній місяць
    from_time ||= (Time.now - 1.month).to_i
    
    # Отримуємо виписку
    statement = @api.get_statement(account_id, from_time)
    
    # Зберігаємо нові транзакції
    @storage.save_transactions(statement, account_id)
    
    puts "Синхронізація завершена. Додано #{statement.size} транзакцій."
    statement
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка синхронізації: #{e.message}"
    []
  end
  
  private
  
  def get_first_account_id
    client_info = @api.get_client_info
    account = client_info['accounts'].first
    account ? account['id'] : raise("Не вдалося знайти рахунок")
  end
end
```

```ruby
# main.rb
require 'alphavantage'
require 'dotenv'
require 'date'

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    
    unless @api_key
      raise "API ключ не знайдено. Будь ласка, вкажіть його в змінній середовища ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY або передайте як аргумент"
    end
    
    @client = Alphavantage::Client.new(key: @api_key)
  end

  def get_stock_data(ticker, days: 100)
    begin
      stock = @client.stock(symbol: ticker)
      timeseries = stock.timeseries(type: "daily", outputsize: "full")
      
      # Отримуємо дані за останні `days + 20` днів (потрібно для розрахунку 20-денного ковзного середнього)
      data = timeseries.data.first(days + 20)
      
      if data.empty?
        puts "Не вдалося отримати дані для тикеру #{ticker}"
        return nil
      end
      
      puts "Отримано #{data.size} днів даних для #{ticker}"
      data
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні даних: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(data, window_size: 20)
    return [] if data.nil? || data.size < window_size
    
    # Сортуємо дані за датою (від найстаріших до найновіших)
    sorted_data = data.sort_by { |entry| Date.parse(entry["date"]) }
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    (window_size - 1...sorted_data.size).each do |i|
      window = sorted_data[(i - window_size + 1)..i]
      average_price = window.sum { |day| day["close"].to_f } / window_size
      
      moving_averages << {
        date: sorted_data[i]["date"],
        close_price: sorted_data[i]["close"].to_f,
        moving_average: average_price.round(4),
        window_size: window_size
      }
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

  def analyze_stock(ticker, days: 100, window_size: 20)
    puts "Аналіз акції #{ticker}..."
    
    stock_data = get_stock_data(ticker, days: days)
    return unless stock_data
    
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(stock_data, window_size: window_size)
    
    if moving_averages.any?
      puts "\nРезультати аналізу для #{ticker}:"
      puts "=" * 60
      puts "Дата\t\tЦіна закриття\t20-денне ковзне середнє"
      puts "-" * 60
      
      # Показуємо останні 10 значень
      moving_averages.last(10).each do |result|
        puts "#{result[:date]}\t#{result[:close_price]}\t\t#{result[:moving_average]}"
      end
      
      # Статистика
      latest = moving_averages.last
      puts "\nОстанні дані:"
      puts "Дата: #{latest[:date]}"
      puts "Ціна закриття: #{latest[:close_price]}"
      puts "20-денне ковзне середнє: #{latest[:moving_average]}"
      puts "Різниця: #{(latest[:close_price] - latest[:moving_average]).round(4)}"
      
      return moving_averages
    else
      puts "Недостатньо даних для розрахунку ковзного середнього"
      return nil
    end
  end
end

    puts "Будь ласка, встановіть змінну середовища ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY"
    puts "Або створіть файл .env з вмістом: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY=ваш_ключ"
    exit 1
  end
  
  analyzer = StockAnalyzer.new(api_key: api_key)
```

## Main Application Code

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'mollie'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Configure Mollie client
Mollie::Client.configure do |config|
  config.api_key = ENV['MOLLIE_API_KEY']
end

# Simple in-memory order store (replace with your database in production)
class OrderStore
  @orders = {}
  @mutex = Mutex.new

  class << self
    def create_order(order_data)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        id = SecureRandom.uuid
        order_data.merge!(
          id: id,
          status: 'created',
          created_at: Time.now,
          updated_at: Time.now
        )
        @orders[id] = order_data
        order_data
      end
    end

    def find_order(id)
      @mutex.synchronize { @orders[id] }
    end

    def update_order(id, updates)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return nil unless @orders[id]
        
        @orders[id].merge!(updates)
        @orders[id][:updated_at] = Time.now
        @orders[id]
      end
    end
  end
end

# Payment service
class PaymentService
  def self.create_payment(order)
    begin
      # Create payment at Mollie
      payment = Mollie::Payment.create(
        amount: {
          value: order[:amount].to_s,
          currency: order[:currency] || 'EUR'
        },
        description: order[:description] || "Order #{order[:id]}",
        redirectUrl: order[:redirect_url],
        webhookUrl: "#{ENV['BASE_URL']}/webhook",
        metadata: {
          order_id: order[:id]
        }
      )

      # Update order with payment details
      OrderStore.update_order(order[:id], {
        payment_id: payment.id,
        payment_status: payment.status,
        checkout_url: payment.checkout_url
      })

      {
        success: true,
        payment_id: payment.id,
        checkout_url: payment.checkout_url,
        status: payment.status
      }
    rescue Mollie::Exception => e
      logger.error("Mollie API error: #{e.message}")
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  def self.handle_webhook(payment_id)
    begin
      # Retrieve payment from Mollie to verify status
      payment = Mollie::Payment.get(payment_id)
      order_id = payment.metadata['order_id']

      if order_id && (order = OrderStore.find_order(order_id))
        # Update order status based on payment status
        updates = { payment_status: payment.status }
        
        case payment.status
        when 'paid'
          updates[:status] = 'paid'
          updates[:paid_at] = Time.now
        when 'failed', 'expired', 'canceled'
          updates[:status] = 'failed'
        when 'pending'
          updates[:status] = 'pending'
        end

        OrderStore.update_order(order_id, updates)
        
        logger.info("Order #{order_id} updated to status: #{payment.status}")
        { success: true, order_id: order_id, status: payment.status }
      else
        logger.error("Order not found for payment #{payment_id}")
        { success: false, error: 'Order not found' }
      end
    rescue Mollie::Exception => e
      logger.error("Mollie API error in webhook: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def self.logger
    @logger ||= Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end
end

# Sinatra application
class MolliePaymentApp < Sinatra::Base
  set :port, 4567
  set :logger, PaymentService.logger

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  # Create a new order and payment
  post '/orders' do
    request_body = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    
    # Validate required fields
    unless request_body[:amount] && request_body[:redirect_url]
      status 400
      return { error: 'Amount and redirect_url are required' }.to_json
    end

    # Create order
    order = OrderStore.create_order(request_body)
    
    # Create Mollie payment
    result = PaymentService.create_payment(order)
    
    if result[:success]
      status 201
      {
        order_id: order[:id],
        payment_id: result[:payment_id],
        checkout_url: result[:checkout_url],
        status: result[:status]
      }.to_json
    else
      status 422
      { error: result[:error] }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Get order status
  get '/orders/:id' do
    order = OrderStore.find_order(params[:id])
    
    if order
      order.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Mollie webhook endpoint
  post '/webhook' do
    # Mollie sends the payment ID in the request body
    payment_id = params[:id]
    
    unless payment_id
      status 400
      return { error: 'Payment ID required' }.to_json
    end

    # Process the webhook
    result = PaymentService.handle_webhook(payment_id)
    
    if result[:success]
      status 200
      { processed: true, order_id: result[:order_id], status: result[:status] }.to_json
    else
      status 422
      { error: result[:error] }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Health check
  get '/' do
    { status: 'OK', service: 'Mollie Payment API' }.to_json
  end
end

# Run the application
if __FILE__ == $0
  MolliePaymentApp.run!
end
```
