```ruby
# invoice_exporter.rb
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'oauth2'
require 'dotenv'
require 'active_record'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

# Database setup (assuming you have an invoices table)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'invoices.db'
)

# Invoice model (simplified)
class Invoice < ActiveRecord::Base
  scope :paid, -> { where(status: 'paid') }
  scope :not_exported, -> { where(quickbooks_exported: false) }
end

class QuickBooksExporter
  def initialize
    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID'],
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      site: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com',
      authorize_url: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2',
      token_url: 'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer'
    )
    
    @access_token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      @client, 
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      refresh_token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    )
    
    @quickbooks_service = Quickbooks::Service::Invoice.new
    @quickbooks_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_COMPANY_ID']
    @quickbooks_service.access_token = @quickbooks_service_access_token
  end

  def quickbooks_service_access_token
    Quickbooks::AccessToken.new(
      token: @access_token.token,
      refresh_token: @access_token.refresh_token,
      expires_at: @access_token.expires_at,
      consumer_key: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID'],
      consumer_secret: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET']
    )
  end

  def refresh_token_if_needed
    if @access_token.expired?
      @access_token = @access_token.refresh!
      # You might want to save the new tokens to your environment/database
      puts "Token refreshed successfully"
    end
  end

  def find_or_create_customer(customer_name, email: nil)
    customer_service = Quickbooks::Service::Customer.new
    customer_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_COMPANY_ID']
    customer_service.access_token = quickbooks_service_access_token

    # Search for existing customer
    query = customer_service.query("SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE DisplayName = '#{customer_name}'")
    return query.entries.first if query.entries.any?

    # Create new customer if not found
    customer = Quickbooks::Model::Customer.new
    customer.display_name = customer_name
    customer.email_address = email if email
    customer_service.create(customer)
  end

  def find_or_create_item(item_name, price: 0.0)
    item_service = Quickbooks::Service::Item.new
    item_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_COMPANY_ID']
    item_service.access_token = quickbooks_service_access_token

    # Search for existing item
    query = item_service.query("SELECT * FROM Item WHERE Name = '#{item_name}'")
    return query.entries.first if query.entries.any?

    # Create new item if not found
    item = Quickbooks::Model::Item.new
    item.name = item_name
    item.type = 'Service' # or 'Inventory', 'NonInventory'
    item.unit_price = price
    
    # Set income account
    income_account = Quickbooks::Model::Account.new
    income_account.id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_INCOME_ACCOUNT_ID'] # You need to set this
    item.income_account_ref = Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new(income_account.id)
    
    item_service.create(item)
  end

  def create_quickbooks_invoice(local_invoice)
    refresh_token_if_needed

    # Find or create customer
    customer = find_or_create_customer(
      local_invoice.customer_name, 
      email: local_invoice.customer_email
    )

    # Create QuickBooks invoice
    invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    invoice.customer_id = customer.id
    invoice.txn_date = local_invoice.paid_at || Date.today
    invoice.due_date = (local_invoice.paid_at || Date.today) + 30.days

    # Add line items
    line_item = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
    line_item.amount = local_invoice.total_amount
    line_item.description = local_invoice.description || "Invoice ##{local_invoice.id}"
    
    # Set sales item detail
    sales_item_line_detail = Quickbooks::Model::SalesItemLineDetail.new
    sales_item_line_detail.item_id = find_or_create_item(
      local_invoice.item_name || "Service", 
      price: local_invoice.total_amount
    ).id
    sales_item_line_detail.quantity = 1
    sales_item_line_detail.unit_price = local_invoice.total_amount
    
    line_item.sales_item_line_detail = sales_item_line_detail
    invoice.line_items << line_item

    # Create the invoice in QuickBooks
    begin
      result = @quickbooks_service.create(invoice)
      puts "Successfully exported invoice #{local_invoice.id} to QuickBooks as invoice #{result.id}"
      return result
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error exporting invoice #{local_invoice.id}: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def export_paid_invoices
    paid_invoices = Invoice.paid.not_exported
    
    if paid_invoices.empty?
      puts "No paid invoices to export"
      return
    end

    puts "Exporting #{paid_invoices.count} paid invoices to QuickBooks..."

    paid_invoices.each do |invoice|
      quickbooks_invoice = create_quickbooks_invoice(invoice)
      
      if quickbooks_invoice
        # Mark as exported in your database
        invoice.update(
          quickbooks_exported: true,
          quickbooks_invoice_id: quickbooks_invoice.id,
          exported_at: Time.current
        )
        puts "✓ Invoice #{invoice.id} exported successfully"
      else
        puts "✗ Failed to export invoice #{invoice.id}"
      end
    end

    puts "Export process completed"
  end

  # Method to run as a scheduled job
  def self.run
    exporter = new
    exporter.export_paid_invoices
  end
end

end
```

```ruby
class MonobankClient
  BASE_URL = ENV['MONOBANK_API_URL'] || 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  
  def initialize(api_token)
    @api_token = api_token
    @headers = {
      'X-Token' => @api_token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Створення рахунку
  def create_invoice(invoice_data)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/api/merchant/invoice/create"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: invoice_data.to_json
    })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка при створенні рахунку: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу рахунку
  def check_invoice_status(invoice_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/api/merchant/invoice/status?invoiceId=#{invoice_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка при перевірці статусу: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

  end

      unless valid_signature?(signature, webhook_data)
        status 401
        return { error: 'Invalid signature' }.to_json
      end
      
      # Обробка вебхука
      process_webhook(webhook_data)
      
      status 200
      { status: 'success' }.to_json
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      status 400
      { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 500
      { error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  private

    true # Заглушка для прикладу
  end

  end
  
  def handle_expired_invoice(invoice_id)

  end
```

```ruby
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  enum status: {
    pending: 'pending',
    processing: 'processing',
    paid: 'paid',
    failed: 'failed',
    canceled: 'canceled'
  }

  validates :amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :currency, presence: true
  validates :description, presence: true
  
  before_create :generate_order_number
  
  def generate_order_number
    self.order_number ||= "ORD-#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d')}-#{SecureRandom.hex(4).upcase}"
  end
  
  def create_mollie_payment(redirect_url, webhook_url)
    mollie_client = Mollie::Client.new
    
    payment_params = {
      amount: {
        value: "%.2f" % amount,
        currency: currency
      },
      description: description,
      redirectUrl: redirect_url,
      webhookUrl: webhook_url,
      metadata: {
        order_id: id,
        order_number: order_number
      }
    }
    
    response = mollie_client.payments.create(payment_params)
    
    if response.success?
      update(mollie_payment_id: response.id, mollie_payment_status: response.status)
      response
    else
      false
    end
  end
  
  def update_from_mollie
    return unless mollie_payment_id
    
    mollie_client = Mollie::Client.new
    payment = mollie_client.payments.get(mollie_payment_id)
    
    if payment
      update(
        mollie_payment_status: payment.status,
        status: map_payment_status(payment.status)
      )
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def map_payment_status(mollie_status)
    case mollie_status
    when 'paid'
```

### 5. Фонова задача для оновлення статусу (app/jobs/order_status_update_job.rb)

```ruby
class OrderStatusUpdateJob
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  
  def perform(order_id)
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    return unless order
    
    mollie_client = Mollie::Client.new
    
    begin
      payment = mollie_client.payments.get(order.mollie_payment_id)
      
      if payment
        order.update(
          mollie_payment_status: payment.status,
          status: order.send(:map_payment_status, payment.status)
        )
        
        # Додаткові дії після успішної оплати
        if payment.status == 'paid'
          send_confirmation_email(order)
          update_inventory(order)
        end
      end
    rescue Mollie::Exception => e
      Rails.logger.error "Mollie API error: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def send_confirmation_email(order)
    # Логіка відправки email підтвердження
    OrderMailer.payment_confirmation(order).deliver_later
  end
  
  def update_inventory(order)
    # Логіка оновлення інвентаря
    order.order_items.each do |item|
      item.product.decrement!(:quantity, item.quantity)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'faraday'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

class WayForPay
  attr_reader :merchant_account, :merchant_secret_key, :api_url
  
  def initialize
    @merchant_account = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT']
    @merchant_secret_key = ENV['WAYFORPAY_SECRET_KEY']
    @api_url = ENV['WAYFORPAY_API_URL'] || 'https://api.wayforpay.com/api'
    
    validate_configuration!
  end
  
  def create_invoice(order_params)
    params = {
      transactionType: 'CREATE_INVOICE',
      merchantAccount: @merchant_account,
      merchantDomainName: order_params[:merchant_domain_name],
      orderReference: order_params[:order_reference],
      orderDate: order_params[:order_date] || Time.now.to_i,
      amount: order_params[:amount],
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      productName: order_params[:product_name],
      productCount: order_params[:product_count] || 1,
      productPrice: order_params[:product_price],
      serviceUrl: order_params[:service_url] # URL для callback-ів
    }
    
    params[:merchantSignature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    response = Faraday.post("#{@api_url}/invoice", params.to_json, {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    })
    
    JSON.parse(response.body) if response.success?
  end
  
  def verify_callback_signature(params)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    received_signature = params['merchantSignature']
    
    expected_signature == received_signature
  end
  
  def generate_signature(params)
    signature_string = [
      params[:merchantAccount],
      params[:merchantDomainName],
      params[:orderReference],
      params[:orderDate],
      params[:amount],
      params[:currency],
      params[:productName],
      params[:productCount],
      params[:productPrice]
    ].compact.join(';')
    
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('md5', @merchant_secret_key, signature_string)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_configuration!
    raise "WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT is not set" unless @merchant_account
    raise "WAYFORPAY_SECRET_KEY is not set" unless @merchant_secret_key
  end
end
```

### app/controllers/payments_controller.rb

```ruby
require_relative '../models/order'
require_relative '../config/initializers/wayforpay'

class PaymentsController
  def initialize
    @wayforpay = WayForPay.new
  end
  
  def create_payment(order_id)
    order = Order.find(order_id)
    
    invoice_params = {
      merchant_domain_name: ENV['MERCHANT_DOMAIN'] || 'yourdomain.com',
      order_reference: order.reference_number,
      amount: order.total_amount,
      currency: order.currency,
      product_name: order.product_name,
      product_count: order.quantity,
      product_price: order.unit_price,
      service_url: "#{ENV['BASE_URL']}/wayforpay/callback"
    }
    
    @wayforpay.create_invoice(invoice_params)
  end
  
  def handle_callback(callback_params)
    # Перевіряємо підпис
    unless @wayforpay.verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
      return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid signature' }
    end
    
    order_reference = callback_params['orderReference']
    status = callback_params['transactionStatus']
    
    order = Order.find_by_reference(order_reference)
    
    unless order
      return { status: 'error', message: 'Order not found' }
    end
    
    case status
    when 'Approved'
      approve_order(order, callback_params)
    when 'Refunded', 'Declined', 'Expired'
      decline_order(order, callback_params)
    else
      # Інші статуси можна обробити за потребою
      { status: 'info', message: "Received status: #{status}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def approve_order(order, callback_params)
    if order.update(
      status: 'approved',
      payment_status: 'completed',
      payment_reference: callback_params['reference'],
      approved_at: Time.now
    )
      # Тут можна додати додаткову логіку:
      # - Надіслати email підтвердження
      # - Оновити інвентар
      # - Створити завдання для доставки тощо
      
      { status: 'success', message: 'Order approved successfully' }
    else
      { status: 'error', message: 'Failed to update order' }
    end
  end
  
  def decline_order(order, callback_params)
    order.update(
      status: 'declined',
      payment_status: 'failed',
      decline_reason: callback_params['reason'],
      declined_at: Time.now
    )
    
    { status: 'success', message: 'Order declined' }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'securerandom'

class Order
  attr_accessor :id, :reference_number, :total_amount, :currency, :product_name,
                :quantity, :unit_price, :status, :payment_status, :payment_reference,
                :approved_at, :declined_at, :decline_reason
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    @id = attributes[:id] || SecureRandom.uuid
    @reference_number = attributes[:reference_number] || generate_reference
    @total_amount = attributes[:total_amount]
    @currency = attributes[:currency] || 'UAH'
    @product_name = attributes[:product_name]
    @quantity = attributes[:quantity] || 1
    @unit_price = attributes[:unit_price]
    @status = attributes[:status] || 'pending'
    @payment_status = attributes[:payment_status] || 'pending'
  end
  
  def self.find(order_id)
    # Тут має бути логіка пошуку замовлення в базі даних
    # Для прикладу повертаємо заглушку
    Order.new(id: order_id)
  end
  
  def self.find_by_reference(reference)
    # Пошук замовлення за reference number
    Order.new(reference_number: reference)
  end
  
  def update(attributes)
    attributes.each do |key, value|
      send("#{key}=", value) if respond_to?("#{key}=")
    end
    true # Заглушка - завжди повертаємо успіх
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_reference
    "ORD_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}".upcase
  end
end
```

```ruby
# privat_business_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class PrivatBusinessAPI
  # Базові URL API ПриватБанку для бізнес-клієнтів
  BASE_URL = 'https://acp.privatbank.ua/api'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, password, card_number = nil)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @password = password
    @card_number = card_number
  end
  
  # Генерація підпису запиту
  def generate_signature(data)
    signature_string = data.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    signature_string += @password
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end
  
  # Отримання залишку по рахунку
  def get_balance
    data = {
      'oper' => 'cmt',
      'wait' => '0',
      'test' => '0',
      'payment_id' => Time.now.to_i.to_s
    }
    
    # Додаємо дані картки, якщо вказано
    data['cardnum'] = @card_number if @card_number
    
    signature = generate_signature(data)
    
    request_data = data.merge({
      'merchant' => @merchant_id,
      'signature' => signature
    })
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/balance",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Отримання виписки по рахунку
  def get_statement(start_date, end_date)
    data = {
      'oper' => 'cmt',
      'wait' => '0',
      'test' => '0',
      'payment_id' => Time.now.to_i.to_s,
      'sd' => start_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
      'ed' => end_date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')
    }
    
    # Додаємо дані картки, якщо вказано
    data['cardnum'] = @card_number if @card_number
    
    signature = generate_signature(data)
    
    request_data = data.merge({
      'merchant' => @merchant_id,
      'signature' => signature
    })
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/restatement",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка запиту: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Допоміжний клас для роботи з випискою
class StatementProcessor
  def initialize(api_client)
    @api = api_client
  end
  
  # Отримання залишку з форматуванням
  def formatted_balance
    balance_data = @api.get_balance
    format_balance_response(balance_data)
  end
  
  # Отримання виписки з форматуванням
  def formatted_statement(start_date, end_date)
    statement_data = @api.get_statement(start_date, end_date)
    format_statement_response(statement_data)
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_balance_response(data)
    if data['error'] && data['error'].to_i > 0
      return { error: data['error_message'] || 'Невідома помилка' }
    end
    
    balances = []
    
    if data['data'] && data['data'].is_a?(Array)
      data['data'].each do |account|
        balances << {
          card_number: account['card_number'],
          currency: account['currency'],
          balance: account['balance'].to_f,
          available_balance: account['balance'].to_f, # Уточніть поле для доступного залишку
          card_name: account['card_name'] || 'Назва не вказана'
        }
      end
    end
    
    { success: true, balances: balances }
  end
  
  def format_statement_response(data)
    if data['error'] && data['error'].to_i > 0
      return { error: data['error_message'] || 'Невідома помилка' }
    end
    
    transactions = []
    
    if data['data'] && data['data'].is_a?(Array)
      data['data'].each do |transaction|
        transactions << {
          date: transaction['trandate'],
          amount: transaction['amount'].to_f,
          currency: transaction['currency'],
          description: transaction['description'],
          transaction_type: transaction['trantype'],
          terminal: transaction['terminal'],
          card_amount: transaction['cardamount'].to_f
        }
      end
    end
    
    { success: true, transactions: transactions, count: transactions.size }
  end
end
```

**Ruby Implementation**
```ruby
require 'iban-tools'

def validate_and_extract_mfo(iban_number)
  # Remove any spaces and convert to uppercase
  iban = iban_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
  
  # Validate the IBAN format and country
  unless IBANTools::IBAN.valid?(iban)
    return { valid: false, error: "Invalid IBAN format" }
  end
  
  iban_obj = IBANTools::IBAN.new(iban)
  
  # Check if it's a Ukrainian IBAN
  unless iban_obj.country_code == 'UA'
    return { valid: false, error: "Not a Ukrainian IBAN" }
  end
  
  # Check length (Ukrainian IBAN should be 29 characters)
  unless iban.length == 29
    return { valid: false, error: "Ukrainian IBAN must be 29 characters long" }
  end
  
  # Extract MFO code (positions 9-14 in the BBAN part)
  # UA21 399622 0000026007233566001
  # Structure: UAkk bbbbbb cccccccccccccccc
  # Where bbbbbb = MFO code (6 digits)
  bban = iban_obj.bban
  mfo_code = bban[0..5]  # First 6 digits of BBAN
  
  # Validate MFO code format (should be 6 digits)
  unless mfo_code.match?(/^\d{6}$/)
    return { valid: false, error: "Invalid MFO code format" }
  end
  
  {
    valid: true,
    iban: iban,
    country: 'UA',
    mfo_code: mfo_code,
    bank_code: mfo_code  # Alias for MFO code
  }
end

# Example usage and test cases
if __FILE__ == $0
  test_ibans = [
    'UA21 399622 0000026007233566001',  # Valid Ukrainian IBAN
    'UA213996220000026007233566001',    # Valid without spaces
    'GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32',      # Valid but not Ukrainian
    'UA21399622000002600723356600',     # Invalid length
    'UA21 39962X 0000026007233566001'   # Invalid characters
  ]
  
  test_ibans.each do |iban|
    puts "Testing: #{iban}"
    result = validate_and_extract_mfo(iban)
    
    if result[:valid]
      puts "✓ Valid Ukrainian IBAN"
      puts "  MFO Code: #{result[:mfo_code]}"
    else
      puts "✗ Invalid: #{result[:error]}"
    end
    puts "-" * 50
  end
end
```

This implementation:

1. **Validates the IBAN** using the `iban-tools` gem for general IBAN validation
2. **Checks specific Ukrainian requirements**:
   - Country code must be 'UA'
   - Length must be 29 characters
3. **Extracts the MFO code** from positions 9-14 of the IBAN (which correspond to the first 6 digits of the BBAN)
4. **Returns a structured result** with validation status and extracted data

The MFO code (МФО in Ukrainian) is the 6-digit bank identifier that uniquely identifies Ukrainian banks in the banking system. In a Ukrainian IBAN, it appears as characters 9-14 (after the country code and check digits).

Example breakdown of `UA21 399622 0000026007233566001`:
- `UA` = Country code
- `21` = Check digits  
- `399622` = MFO code (bank identifier)
- `0000026007233566001` = Account number

```ruby
  client_id: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
  client_secret: ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
  redirect_uri: ENV['XERO_REDIRECT_URI'],
```

## Модель для зберігання токенів (app/models/xero_token.rb)

```ruby
class XeroToken < ApplicationRecord
  validates :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_at, presence: true
  
  def expired?
    expires_at <= Time.current
  end
  
  def about_to_expire?
    expires_at <= 15.minutes.from_now
  end
  
  def refresh_if_needed
    refresh! if about_to_expire? || expired?
  end
  
  def refresh!
    token_set = xero_client.refresh_token_set({
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
      refresh_token: refresh_token
    })
    
    update!(
      access_token: token_set[:access_token],
      refresh_token: token_set[:refresh_token],
      expires_at: Time.current + token_set[:expires_in].to_i.seconds
    )
  end
end
```

## Модель рахунку (app/models/invoice.rb)

```ruby
class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  enum status: {
    draft: 0,
    sent: 1,
    paid: 2,
    overdue: 3
  }
  
  validates :amount, :due_date, presence: true
  validates :xero_invoice_id, uniqueness: true, allow_nil: true
  
  # Конвертація в формат Xero
  def to_xero_invoice
    {
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        name: customer_name,
        email_address: customer_email
      },
      date: created_at.to_date,
      due_date: due_date,
      line_items: [
        {
          description: description || 'Service',
          quantity: 1,
          unit_amount: amount,
          account_code: ENV['XERO_SALES_ACCOUNT_CODE'] || '200'
        }
      ],
      reference: reference_number,
      status: xero_status
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def xero_status
    case status.to_sym
    when :draft then 'DRAFT'
    when :sent then 'AUTHORISED'
    when :paid then 'PAID'
    else 'AUTHORISED'
    end
  end
end
```

## Сервіс для роботи з Xero API (app/services/xero_invoice_service.rb)

```ruby
class XeroInvoiceService
  class XeroError < StandardError; end
  
  def initialize
    @token = XeroToken.last
    raise XeroError, 'Xero token not found' unless @token
    @token.refresh_if_needed
  end
  
  # Надсилання рахунку до Xero
  def create_invoice(invoice)
    xero_invoice = invoice.to_xero_invoice
    accounting_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(xero_client)
    
    response = accounting_api.create_invoices(
      xero_tenant_id, 
      { invoices: [xero_invoice] }
    )
    
    xero_invoice = response.invoices.first
    invoice.update!(
      xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
      xero_invoice_number: xero_invoice.invoice_number,
      status: map_xero_status(xero_invoice.status)
    )
    
    invoice
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Xero API Error: #{e.message}"
    raise XeroError, "Failed to create invoice in Xero: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  # Синхронізація статусу оплати
  def sync_invoice_status(invoice)
    return unless invoice.xero_invoice_id
    
    accounting_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(xero_client)
    response = accounting_api.get_invoice(
      xero_tenant_id, 
      invoice.xero_invoice_id
    )
    
    xero_invoice = response.invoices.first
    new_status = map_xero_status(xero_invoice.status)
    amount_paid = xero_invoice.amount_paid.to_f
    
    invoice.update!(
      status: new_status,
      amount_paid: amount_paid,
      paid_at: amount_paid > 0 ? Time.current : nil
    )
    
    invoice
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Xero API Error: #{e.message}"
    raise XeroError, "Failed to sync invoice status: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  # Масове оновлення статусів
  def sync_all_invoices
    Invoice.where.not(xero_invoice_id: nil).find_each do |invoice|
      sync_invoice_status(invoice)
    rescue XeroError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync invoice #{invoice.id}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def xero_client
    @xero_client ||= begin
      client = ::xero_client
      client.set_token_set(
        access_token: @token.access_token,
        refresh_token: @token.refresh_token,
        expires_at: @token.expires_at.to_i
      )
      client
    end
  end
  
  def xero_tenant_id
    @xero_tenant_id ||= ENV['XERO_TENANT_ID'] || get_tenant_id
  end
  
  def get_tenant_id
    identity_api = XeroRuby::IdentityApi.new(xero_client)
    connections = identity_api.get_connections
    connections.first.tenant_id
  end
  
  def map_xero_status(xero_status)
    case xero_status
    when 'DRAFT' then :draft
    when 'AUTHORISED', 'SUBMITTED' then :sent
    when 'PAID' then :paid
    when 'VOIDED' then :draft
    else :sent
    end
  end
end
```

## Контролер для авторизації Xero (app/controllers/xero_auth_controller.rb)

```ruby
class XeroAuthController < ApplicationController
  def connect
    auth_url = xero_client.authorization_url
    redirect_to auth_url, allow_other_host: true
  end
  
  def callback
    if params[:code]
      token_set = xero_client.get_token_set_from_callback(params)
      
      XeroToken.create!(
        access_token: token_set[:access_token],
        refresh_token: token_set[:refresh_token],
        expires_at: Time.current + token_set[:expires_in].to_i.seconds
      )
      
      redirect_to root_path, notice: 'Successfully connected to Xero'
    else
      redirect_to root_path, alert: 'Xero connection failed'
    end
  end
end
```

## Фонова задача для синхронізації (app/jobs/sync_xero_invoices_job.rb)

```ruby
class SyncXeroInvoicesJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(invoice_id = nil)
    service = XeroInvoiceService.new
    
    if invoice_id
      invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
      service.sync_invoice_status(invoice)
    else
      service.sync_all_invoices
    end
  rescue XeroInvoiceService::XeroError => e
    Rails.logger.error "SyncXeroInvoicesJob failed: #{e.message}"
    raise e if invoice_id # Перевидати помилку для окремого рахунку
  end
end
```

## Контролер для рахунків (app/controllers/invoices_controller.rb)

```ruby
class InvoicesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_invoice, only: [:show, :send_to_xero, :sync_status]
  
  def create
    @invoice = Invoice.new(invoice_params)
    
    if @invoice.save
      redirect_to @invoice, notice: 'Invoice created successfully'
    else
      render :new
    end
  end
  
  def send_to_xero
    service = XeroInvoiceService.new
    service.create_invoice(@invoice)
    
    redirect_to @invoice, notice: 'Invoice sent to Xero successfully'
  rescue XeroInvoiceService::XeroError => e
    redirect_to @invoice, alert: "Failed to send to Xero: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  def sync_status
    SyncXeroInvoicesJob.perform_later(@invoice.id)
    
    redirect_to @invoice, notice: 'Sync started'
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_invoice
    @invoice = Invoice.find(params[:id])
  end
  
  def invoice_params
    params.require(:invoice).permit(:customer_name, :customer_email, :amount, :due_date, :description)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'oauth2'

class QuickBooksClient
  attr_reader :access_token, :client
  
  def initialize
    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID'],
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      site: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT'] == 'production' ? 
            'https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com' : 
            'https://sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com',
      token_url: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT'] == 'production' ?
                'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer' :
                'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer'
    )
    
    @access_token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      @client, 
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      refresh_token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    )
  end
  
  def service
    Quickbooks::Service::AccessToken.new
  end
  
  def refresh_token_if_needed
    if access_token.expired?
      new_token = access_token.refresh!
      # Тут потрібно оновити токени в базі даних або змінних середовища
      update_tokens(new_token)
    end
    access_token
```

```ruby
require_relative '../config/quickbooks_client'

class QuickBooksInvoiceExporter
  def initialize
    @client = QuickBooksClient.new
    @service = Quickbooks::Service::Invoice.new
    @service.access_token = @client.access_token
    @service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
  end
  
  def export_paid_invoice(invoice)
    return unless invoice.paid?
    
    begin
      # Оновлення токена, якщо потрібно
      @client.refresh_token_if_needed
      
      # Створення рахунку-фактури в QuickBooks
      qb_invoice = build_quickbooks_invoice(invoice)
      created_invoice = @service.create(qb_invoice)
      
      # Оновлення статусу оплати
      mark_invoice_as_paid_in_quickbooks(created_invoice, invoice.paid_date)
      
      puts "Рахунок #{invoice.invoice_number} успішно експортовано до QuickBooks"
      return created_invoice
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Помилка при експорті рахунку #{invoice.invoice_number}: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  def export_multiple_paid_invoices(invoices)
    exported_invoices = []
    
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      if invoice.paid?
        begin
          exported_invoice = export_paid_invoice(invoice)
          exported_invoices << exported_invoice if exported_invoice
        rescue StandardError => e
          puts "Помилка при експорті рахунку #{invoice.invoice_number}: #{e.message}"
          # Продовжуємо з наступними рахунками
        end
      end
    end
    
    exported_invoices
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_quickbooks_invoice(invoice)
    qb_invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    qb_invoice.doc_number = invoice.invoice_number
    qb_invoice.txn_date = invoice.paid_date || Date.today
    qb_invoice.due_date = invoice.due_date
    
    # Додавання клієнта
    customer = find_or_create_customer(invoice.customer_name, invoice.customer_email)
    qb_invoice.customer_id = customer.id
    
    # Додавання лінійних елементів
    invoice.line_items.each do |line_item|
      qb_line_item = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
      qb_line_item.amount = line_item[:amount]
      qb_line_item.description = line_item[:description]
      qb_line_item.sales_item! do |detail|
        detail.item_id = line_item[:item_id] || find_or_create_item(line_item[:description]).id
        detail.quantity = line_item[:quantity] || 1
        detail.unit_price = line_item[:unit_price] || line_item[:amount]
      end
      qb_invoice.line_items << qb_line_item
    end
    
    qb_invoice
  end
  
  def mark_invoice_as_paid_in_quickbooks(qb_invoice, paid_date)
    payment_service = Quickbooks::Service::Payment.new
    payment_service.access_token = @client.access_token
    payment_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    
    payment = Quickbooks::Model::Payment.new
    payment.customer_id = qb_invoice.customer_id
    payment.total = qb_invoice.total
    payment.txn_date = paid_date
    
    # Зв'язок платежу з рахунком
    payment_line = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
    payment_line.amount = qb_invoice.total
    payment_linked_txn = Quickbooks::Model::LinkedTransaction.new
    payment_linked_txn.txn_id = qb_invoice.id
    payment_linked_txn.txn_type = 'Invoice'
    payment_line.linked_transactions = [payment_linked_txn]
    
    payment.line_items = [payment_line]
    
    payment_service.create(payment)
  end
  
  def find_or_create_customer(customer_name, email)
    customer_service = Quickbooks::Service::Customer.new
    customer_service.access_token = @client.access_token
    customer_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    
    # Пошук існуючого клієнта
    query = "SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE DisplayName = '#{customer_name}'"
    existing_customers = customer_service.query(query)
    
    if existing_customers.any?
      return existing_customers.first
    else
      # Створення нового клієнта
      customer = Quickbooks::Model::Customer.new
      customer.display_name = customer_name
      customer.primary_email_address = email if email
      customer_service.create(customer)
    end
  end
  
  def find_or_create_item(description)
    item_service = Quickbooks::Service::Item.new
    item_service.access_token = @client.access_token
    item_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    
    # Пошук існуючого товару/послуги
    query = "SELECT * FROM Item WHERE Name = '#{description}'"
    existing_items = item_service.query(query)
    
    if existing_items.any?
      return existing_items.first
    else
      # Створення нового товару/послуги
      item = Quickbooks::Model::Item.new
      item.name = description
      item.type = 'Service' # або 'Inventory', 'NonInventory'
      item.income_account_ref = find_default_income_account
      item_service.create(item)
    end
  end
  
  def find_default_income_account
    # Пошук рахунку доходів за замовчуванням
    account_service = Quickbooks::Service::Account.new
    account_service.access_token = @client.access_token
    account_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    
    query = "SELECT * FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Income'"
    income_accounts = account_service.query(query)
    income_accounts.first || raise("Не знайдено рахунок доходів")
  end
end
```

```ruby
class MonoInvoice
  BASE_URL = ENV['MONOBANK_API_URL'] || 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  
  def initialize(api_token)
    @api_token = api_token
    @client = Faraday.new(
      url: BASE_URL,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'X-Token' => @api_token
      }
    ) do |f|
      f.request :json
      f.response :json
      f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
  end

  # Create a new invoice
  def create_invoice(amount, currency: 980, redirect_url: nil, webhook_url: nil, validity: 3600, payment_type: 'debit')
    # Amount should be in cents/kopiykas
    # Currency: 980 = UAH, 840 = USD, 978 = EUR
    
    invoice_data = {
      amount: amount,
      ccy: currency,
      redirectUrl: redirect_url,
      webHookUrl: webhook_url,
      validity: validity, # in seconds
      paymentType: payment_type # 'debit' or 'hold'
    }

    response = @client.post('/api/merchant/invoice/create') do |req|
      req.body = invoice_data.to_json
    end

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get invoice status
  def get_invoice_status(invoice_id)
    response = @client.get("/api/merchant/invoice/status?invoiceId=#{invoice_id}")
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Cancel invoice (if it's a hold type)
  def cancel_invoice(invoice_id)
    response = @client.post('/api/merchant/invoice/cancel') do |req|
      req.body = { invoiceId: invoice_id }.to_json
    end
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get merchant details
  def merchant_details
    response = @client.get('/api/merchant/details')
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      { error: "API Error: #{response.status}", body: response.body }
    end
  rescue Faraday::Error => e
    { error: "Connection error: #{e.message}" }
  end
end
```

## Plaid Service

```ruby
# services/plaid_service.rb
class PlaidService
  def initialize(access_token)
    @access_token = access_token
  end
  
  def fetch_accounts
    response = PLAID_CLIENT.accounts.get(@access_token)
    response.accounts
  rescue Plaid::ApiError => e
    puts "Error fetching accounts: #{e.response_body}"
    []
  end
  
  def fetch_transactions(start_date:, end_date:)
    # Fetch transactions for the last 30 days by default
    start_date ||= 30.days.ago.to_date
    end_date ||= Date.today
    
    response = PLAID_CLIENT.transactions.get(
      @access_token,
      start_date.iso8601,
      end_date.iso8601
    )
    response.transactions
  rescue Plaid::ApiError => e
    puts "Error fetching transactions: #{e.response_body}"
    []
  end
  
  def sync_accounts_and_transactions
    accounts = fetch_accounts
    transactions = fetch_transactions(start_date: 30.days.ago.to_date, end_date: Date.today)
    
    sync_accounts(accounts)
    sync_transactions(transactions)
  end
  
  private
  
  def sync_accounts(plaid_accounts)
    plaid_accounts.each do |plaid_account|
      existing_account = BankAccount.find_by(account_id: plaid_account.account_id)
      
      if existing_account
        existing_account.update_from_plaid(plaid_account)
      else
        BankAccount.create_from_plaid(plaid_account)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def sync_transactions(plaid_transactions)
    plaid_transactions.each do |plaid_transaction|
      account = BankAccount.find_by(account_id: plaid_transaction.account_id)
      next unless account
      
      existing_transaction = BankTransaction.find_by(transaction_id: plaid_transaction.transaction_id)
      
      unless existing_transaction
        BankTransaction.create_from_plaid(plaid_transaction, account)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Rakefile for Database Tasks

```ruby
# Rakefile
require_relative 'config/environment'
require 'rake'

namespace :db do
  desc "Create the database"
  task :create do
    config = YAML.load_file('config/database.yml')[ENV['RACK_ENV'] || 'development']
    database = config['database']
    
    # Connect to postgres database to create our app database
    system("createdb", "-h", config['host'] || 'localhost', "-U", config['username'] || `whoami`.chomp, database)
    puts "Database #{database} created."
  rescue => e
    puts "Error creating database: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  desc "Run migrations"
  task :migrate do
    migration_files = Dir['db/migrate/*.rb'].sort
    migration_files.each do |file|
      require file
      migration_name = File.basename(file, '.rb').split('_').drop(1).join('_').camelize
      migration_class = Object.const_get(migration_name)
      migration_class.new.migrate(:up)
      puts "Migrated: #{migration_name}"
    end
  end
  
  desc "Drop the database"
  task :drop do
    config = YAML.load_file('config/database.yml')[ENV['RACK_ENV'] || 'development']
    database = config['database']
    
    system("dropdb", "-h", config['host'] || 'localhost', "-U", config['username'] || `whoami`.chomp, database)
    puts "Database #{database} dropped."
  rescue => e
    puts "Error dropping database: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  desc "Reset database (drop, create, migrate)"
  task reset: [:drop, :create, :migrate]
end
```

```ruby
# iban_validator.rb
require 'iban-tools'
require 'active_model'

class UkrainianIBANValidator
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  
  UA_IBAN_LENGTH = 29
  MFO_LENGTH = 6
  
  attr_accessor :iban, :mfo
  
  validates :iban, presence: true
  validate :valid_ukrainian_iban_format
  validate :valid_iban_checksum
  
  def initialize(iban)
    @iban = iban.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
  end
  
  def valid?
    errors.clear
    validate
    errors.empty?
  end
  
  def extract_mfo
    return nil unless valid?
    
    # Український IBAN має формат: UAkk BBBB BBCC CCCC CCCC CCCC CCCC CCCC
    # де BBBBBB - код МФО банку (позиції 9-14)
    @mfo = @iban[8, MFO_LENGTH]
  end
  
  private
  
  def valid_ukrainian_iban_format
    return if iban.blank?
    
    if iban.length != UA_IBAN_LENGTH
      errors.add(:iban, "має бути довжиною #{UA_IBAN_LENGTH} символів")
      return
    end
    
    unless iban.start_with?('UA')
      errors.add(:iban, 'має починатися з UA')
    end
    
    unless iban.match?(/\AUA\d{27}\z/)
      errors.add(:iban, 'має містити тільки цифри після UA')
    end
  end
  
  def valid_iban_checksum
    return if iban.blank? || errors[:iban].any?
    
    unless IBANTools::IBAN.valid?(iban)
      errors.add(:iban, 'має невірну контрольну суму')
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
def validate_ukrainian_iban_and_extract_mfo(iban_number)
  validator = UkrainianIBANValidator.new(iban_number)
  
  if validator.valid?
    mfo = validator.extract_mfo
    puts "IBAN #{iban_number} є валідним"
    puts "Код МФО банку: #{mfo}"
    mfo
  else
    puts "IBAN #{iban_number} невірний:"
    validator.errors.full_messages.each { |msg| puts "- #{msg}" }
    nil
  end
end
```

**Додатково: спрощена версія без використання гемів**
```ruby
# simple_iban_validator.rb
class SimpleUkrainianIBANValidator
  UA_IBAN_LENGTH = 29
  MFO_LENGTH = 6
  
  def self.validate_and_extract_mfo(iban)
    iban = iban.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Перевірка формату
    return {valid: false, error: "IBAN має бути довжиною #{UA_IBAN_LENGTH} символів"} if iban.length != UA_IBAN_LENGTH
    return {valid: false, error: "IBAN має починатися з UA"} unless iban.start_with?('UA')
    return {valid: false, error: "IBAN має містити тільки цифри після UA"} unless iban.match?(/\AUA\d{27}\z/)
    
    # Перевірка контрольної суми (спрощена)
    return {valid: false, error: "IBAN має невірну контрольну суму"} unless valid_checksum?(iban)
    
    # Витягнення МФО
    mfo = iban[8, MFO_LENGTH]
    
    {valid: true, mfo: mfo}
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.valid_checksum?(iban)
    # Перетворення IBAN для перевірки контрольної суми
    rearranged = iban[4..-1] + iban[0..3]
    converted = rearranged.chars.map do |char|
      char.match?(/\d/) ? char : (char.ord - 55).to_s
    end.join
    
    # Обчислення залишку від ділення на 97
    remainder = 0
    converted.each_char do |char|
      remainder = (remainder * 10 + char.to_i) % 97
    end
    
    remainder == 1
  end
end

# Приклад використання спрощеної версії
if __FILE__ == $0
  iban = "UA213223130000026007233566001"
  result = SimpleUkrainianIBANValidator.validate_and_extract_mfo(iban)
  
  if result[:valid]
    puts "IBAN #{iban} є валідним"
    puts "Код МФО банку: #{result[:mfo]}"
  else
    puts "Помилка: #{result[:error]}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  enum status: { draft: 0, sent: 1, paid: 2, overdue: 3 }
  enum sync_status: { pending: 0, synced: 1, failed: 2 }

  belongs_to :customer
  has_many :line_items, dependent: :destroy
  
  validates :invoice_number, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :due_date, presence: true
  validates :xero_invoice_id, uniqueness: true, allow_nil: true

  before_create :generate_invoice_number, unless: :invoice_number?
  after_commit :sync_to_xero, on: :create, if: :should_sync?

  def sync_to_xero
    XeroSyncJob.perform_later(id)
  end

  def update_from_xero(xero_invoice_data)
    update!(
      xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice_data.invoice_id,
      status: map_xero_status(xero_invoice_data.status),
      amount_paid: xero_invoice_data.amount_paid.to_f,
      updated_at: Time.current
    )
  end

  def should_sync?
    sent? && xero_invoice_id.blank?
  end

  private

  def generate_invoice_number
    self.invoice_number = "INV-#{Time.current.strftime('%Y%m%d')}-#{SecureRandom.hex(4).upcase}"
  end

  def map_xero_status(xero_status)
    case xero_status.downcase
    when 'draft' then :draft
    when 'submitted', 'authorised' then :sent
    when 'paid' then :paid
    when 'voided' then :draft
    else :sent
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/xero_sync_job.rb
class XeroSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  retry_on XeroRuby::ApiError, wait: :exponentially_longer, attempts: 3

  def perform(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
    connection = XeroConnection.active.first

    unless connection
      raise "No active Xero connection found"
    end

    connection.refresh! if connection.expired?

    xero_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(Rails.configuration.xero_client)

    # Create invoice in Xero
    contact = find_or_create_contact(xero_api, connection.tenant_id, invoice.customer)
    xero_invoice = create_xero_invoice(xero_api, connection.tenant_id, invoice, contact)

    # Update local invoice with Xero ID
    invoice.update!(
      xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
      sync_status: :synced
    )

    logger.info "Successfully synced invoice #{invoice.id} to Xero"
  rescue => e
    invoice.update(sync_status: :failed) if invoice
    logger.error "Failed to sync invoice #{invoice_id}: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end

  private

  def find_or_create_contact(xero_api, tenant_id, customer)
    # Try to find existing contact
    contacts = xero_api.get_contacts(tenant_id, where: "Name==\"#{customer.name}\"")
    return contacts.contacts.first if contacts.contacts.any?

    # Create new contact
    contact = XeroRuby::Accounting::Contact.new(
      name: customer.name,
      email_address: customer.email,
      addresses: [
        XeroRuby::Accounting::Address.new(
          address_type: 'POBOX',
          address_line1: customer.address
        )
      ]
    )

    created_contact = xero_api.create_contacts(tenant_id, [contact])
    created_contact.contacts.first
  end

  def create_xero_invoice(xero_api, tenant_id, invoice, contact)
    line_items = invoice.line_items.map do |item|
      XeroRuby::Accounting::LineItem.new(
        description: item.description,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit_amount: item.unit_price,
        account_code: item.account_code || '200' # Sales account code
      )
    end

    xero_invoice = XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice.new(
      type: 'ACCREC', # Accounts Receivable
      contact: XeroRuby::Accounting::Contact.new(contact_id: contact.contact_id),
      date: invoice.created_at.to_date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      invoice_number: invoice.invoice_number,
      line_items: line_items,
      status: 'AUTHORISED' # Send invoice immediately
    )

    created_invoice = xero_api.create_invoices(tenant_id, [xero_invoice])
    created_invoice.invoices.first
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/xero_payment_sync_job.rb
class XeroPaymentSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  sidekiq_options retry: 3

  def perform
    connection = XeroConnection.active.first
    return unless connection

    connection.refresh! if connection.expired?

    xero_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(Rails.configuration.xero_client)
    
    # Get invoices updated in the last hour
    since_time = 1.hour.ago.iso8601
    invoices_response = xero_api.get_invoices(
      connection.tenant_id,
      if_modified_since: since_time,
      where: 'Status=="AUTHORISED" OR Status=="PAID"'
    )

    invoices_response.invoices.each do |xero_invoice|
      sync_invoice_payment(xero_invoice, connection.tenant_id)
    end
  rescue => e
    logger.error "Failed to sync payments from Xero: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end

  private

  def sync_invoice_payment(xero_invoice, tenant_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find_by(xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id)
    return unless invoice

    # Update invoice status and amount paid
    invoice.update_from_xero(xero_invoice)

    # If invoice is paid in Xero but not in our system, sync payments
    if xero_invoice.status == 'PAID' && invoice.status != 'paid'
      sync_payment_details(invoice, xero_invoice, tenant_id)
    end
  end

  def sync_payment_details(invoice, xero_invoice, tenant_id)
    xero_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(Rails.configuration.xero_client)
    
    # Get payments for this invoice
    payments_response = xero_api.get_payments(
      tenant_id,
      invoice_id: invoice.xero_invoice_id
    )

    payments_response.payments.each do |payment|
      # Create or update payment record in your system
      Payment.find_or_create_by(
        invoice: invoice,
        xero_payment_id: payment.payment_id
      ) do |p|
        p.amount = payment.amount.to_f
        p.payment_date = payment.date
        p.payment_method = payment.payment_type
        p.reference = payment.reference
      end
    end

    invoice.update!(status: :paid)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# checkbox_receipt_issuer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class CheckboxReceiptIssuer
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.checkbox.in.ua/api/v1'

  def initialize
    @license_key = ENV['CHECKBOX_LICENSE_KEY']
    @access_token = ENV['CHECKBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @cashier_id = ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ID']
  end

  def authenticate_cashier
    # Authenticate cashier and get access token
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/cashier/signin",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'X-LICENSE-KEY' => @license_key
      },
      body: {
        login: ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_LOGIN'],
        password: ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_PASSWORD']
      }.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      @cashier_id = response.parsed_response['cashier']['id']
      puts "Cashier authenticated successfully"
      return true
    else
      puts "Authentication failed: #{response.parsed_response}"
      return false
    end
  end

  def create_shift
    # Start a new shift for the cashier
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shifts",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Shift started successfully"
      return response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "Failed to start shift: #{response.parsed_response}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def issue_receipt(order_data)
    # Issue a fiscal receipt for an online payment
    receipt_data = {
      goods: order_data[:items].map do |item|
        {
          good: {
            code: item[:code],
            name: item[:name],
            price: item[:price],
            tax: item[:tax_code] || [2] # Default VAT 20%
          },
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          is_return: false
        }
      end,
      payments: [
        {
          type: 'CARD', # Online payment is considered card payment
          value: order_data[:total_amount],
          label: 'Картка'
        }
      ],
      delivery: order_data[:delivery] || {},
      header: order_data[:header] || 'Онлайн замовлення',
      footer: order_data[:footer] || 'Дякуємо за покупку!',
      barcode: order_data[:order_id],
      id: order_data[:order_id]
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/sell",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      },
      body: receipt_data.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      receipt = response.parsed_response
      puts "Receipt issued successfully: #{receipt['id']}"
      puts "Fiscal receipt number: #{receipt['fiscal_code']}"
      return receipt
    else
      puts "Failed to issue receipt: #{response.parsed_response}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
    # Check receipt status
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      return response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "Failed to get receipt status: #{response.parsed_response}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def close_shift
    # Close the current shift
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shifts/close",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Shift closed successfully"
      return response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "Failed to close shift: #{response.parsed_response}"
      return nil
    end
  end
end

# Usage example

  Dotenv.load

  # Create receipt issuer instance
  issuer = CheckboxReceiptIssuer.new

    # Start shift
    shift = issuer.create_shift
    if shift
      # Example order data for online payment
      order_data = {

          {

        header: "Інтернет-магазин TechStore",
```

```ruby
    13 => 'тринадцять', 14 => 'чотирнадцять', 15 => 'п\'ятнадцять',
    16 => 'шістнадцять', 17 => 'сімнадцять', 18 => 'вісімнадцять',
    19 => 'дев\'ятнадцять'
  }

  TENS = {
    2 => 'двадцять', 3 => 'тридцять', 4 => 'сорок', 5 => 'п\'ятдесят',
    6 => 'шістдесят', 7 => 'сімдесят', 8 => 'вісімдесят', 9 => 'дев\'яносто'
  }

  HUNDREDS = {
    1 => 'сто', 2 => 'двісті', 3 => 'триста', 4 => 'чотириста',
    5 => 'п\'ятсот', 6 => 'шістсот', 7 => 'сімсот', 8 => 'вісімсот',
    9 => 'дев\'ятсот'
  }

  # Currency forms
  HRYVNIA_FORMS = %w[гривня гривні гривень]
  KOPIYKA_FORMS = %w[копійка копійки копійок]

  def self.convert(amount)
    new.convert(amount)
  end

  def convert(amount)
    # Handle numeric input
    amount = amount.to_f if amount.is_a?(String)
    
    # Split into hryvnias and kopecks
    hryvnias = amount.to_i
    kopecks = ((amount - hryvnias) * 100).round
    
    # Handle case when kopecks round up to 100
    if kopecks == 100
      hryvnias += 1
      kopecks = 0
    end

    hryvnia_words = number_to_words(hryvnias, HRYVNIA_FORMS)
    kopiyka_words = number_to_words(kopecks, KOPIYKA_FORMS)

    "#{hryvnia_words} #{kopiyka_words}".strip.capitalize
  end

  private

  def number_to_words(number, forms)
    return "#{forms[2]}" if number.zero?

    words = []
    
    # Billions
    if number >= 1_000_000_000
      billions = number / 1_000_000_000
      words << convert_triplet(billions, %w[мільярд мільярди мільярдів])
      number %= 1_000_000_000
    end

    # Millions
    if number >= 1_000_000
      millions = number / 1_000_000
      words << convert_triplet(millions, %w[мільйон мільйони мільйонів])
      number %= 1_000_000
    end

    # Thousands
    if number >= 1000
      thousands = number / 1000
      words << convert_triplet(thousands, %w[тисяча тисячі тисяч], true)
      number %= 1000
    end

    # Hundreds, tens, ones
    if number > 0 || words.empty?
      words << convert_triplet(number, forms)
    end

    words.join(' ')
  end

  def convert_triplet(number, forms, is_thousands = false)
    return '' if number.zero?

    words = []
    
    # Hundreds
    hundreds = number / 100
    if hundreds > 0
      words << HUNDREDS[hundreds]
    end

    # Tens and ones
    remainder = number % 100
    if remainder.between?(10, 19)
      words << TEENS[remainder]
    else
      tens = remainder / 10
      ones = remainder % 10
      
      words << TENS[tens] if tens > 0
      
      if ones > 0
        # Use feminine forms for thousands
        if is_thousands
          feminine_ones = {
            1 => 'одна', 2 => 'дві', 3 => 'три', 4 => 'чотири',
            5 => 'п\'ять', 6 => 'шість', 7 => 'сім', 8 => 'вісім', 9 => 'дев\'ять'
          }
          words << feminine_ones[ones]
        else
          words << ONES[ones]
        end
      end
    end

    # Add the appropriate form
    word_form = get_form(number, forms)
    words << word_form if word_form

    words.join(' ')
  end

  def get_form(number, forms)
    return nil if forms.nil? || forms.empty?

    last_two = number % 100
    last_one = number % 10

    if last_two.between?(11, 19)
      forms[2] # genitive plural
    else
      case last_one
      when 1 then forms[0] # nominative singular
      when 2..4 then forms[1] # genitive singular
      else forms[2] # genitive plural
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# tax_calculator.rb
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'active_model'

class SoleProprietorTaxCalculator
  include ActiveModel::Model
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  
  # Tax rates for 3rd group (as of current Ukrainian legislation)
  SINGLE_TAX_RATE = BigDecimal('0.05')  # 5%
  MINIMUM_SALARY = BigDecimal('8000')   # Minimum monthly salary in UAH
  SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION_RATE = BigDecimal('0.22')  # 22% of minimum salary
  
  attr_accessor :quarterly_income, :monthly_contributions, :quarter
  
  validates :quarterly_income, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :quarter, presence: true, inclusion: { in: [1, 2, 3, 4] }
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    super
    @monthly_contributions ||= true  # Default to paying monthly
  end
  
  def calculate
    return { error: errors.full_messages } unless valid?
    
    single_tax = calculate_single_tax
    social_contribution = calculate_social_contribution
    
    {
      quarterly_income: quarterly_income.to_f,
      single_tax: single_tax.to_f,
      social_contribution: social_contribution.to_f,
      total_tax_burden: (single_tax + social_contribution).to_f,
      net_income: (BigDecimal(quarterly_income.to_s) - single_tax - social_contribution).to_f
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def calculate_single_tax
    BigDecimal(quarterly_income.to_s) * SINGLE_TAX_RATE
  end
  
  def calculate_social_contribution
    monthly_contribution = MINIMUM_SALARY * SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION_RATE
    
    if monthly_contributions
      # If paying monthly: 3 months of contributions for the quarter
      monthly_contribution * 3
    else
      # If paying quarterly: check if income exceeds threshold
      # For 3rd group, social contribution is mandatory regardless of income
      monthly_contribution * 3
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class QuarterlyTaxReport

    results = {}

      )

    puts "Annual Tax Summary for Sole Proprietor (3rd Group)"

    total_income = 0
    total_tax = 0
    total_social = 0
    
    report.each do |quarter, result|
      next if result[:error]
      
      total_income += result[:quarterly_income]
      total_tax += result[:single_tax]
      total_social += result[:social_contribution]

         "Tax: #{total_tax.round(2)} UAH, " +
```

```ruby
I18n.load_path += Dir[File.expand_path('locales/*.yml', __dir__)]
I18n.default_locale = :uk

class MoneyToWordsUA
  # Основні одиниці
  UNITS = {
    0 => '', 1 => 'одна', 2 => 'дві', 3 => 'три', 4 => 'чотири',
    5 => 'п\'ять', 6 => 'шість', 7 => 'сім', 8 => 'вісім', 9 => 'дев\'ять'
  }.freeze

  # Числа від 10 до 19
  TEENS = {
    10 => 'десять', 11 => 'одинадцять', 12 => 'дванадцять', 13 => 'тринадцять',
    14 => 'чотирнадцять', 15 => 'п\'ятнадцять', 16 => 'шістнадцять',
    17 => 'сімнадцять', 18 => 'вісімнадцять', 19 => 'дев\'ятнадцять'
  }.freeze

  # Десятки
  TENS = {
    2 => 'двадцять', 3 => 'тридцять', 4 => 'сорок', 5 => 'п\'ятдесят',
    6 => 'шістдесят', 7 => 'сімдесят', 8 => 'вісімдесят', 9 => 'дев\'яносто'
  }.freeze

  # Сотні
  HUNDREDS = {
    1 => 'сто', 2 => 'двісті', 3 => 'триста', 4 => 'чотириста',
    5 => 'п\'ятсот', 6 => 'шістсот', 7 => 'сімсот', 8 => 'вісімсот', 9 => 'дев\'ятсот'
  }.freeze

  # Назви розрядів (гривня)
  CURRENCY_NAMES = {
    :grn => {
      1 => 'гривня',
      2 => 'гривні', 
      3 => 'гривні',
      4 => 'гривні',
      5 => 'гривень',
      6 => 'гривень',
      7 => 'гривень',
      8 => 'гривень',
      9 => 'гривень',
      0 => 'гривень'
    },
    :kop => {
      1 => 'копійка',
      2 => 'копійки',
      3 => 'копійки',
      4 => 'копійки',
      5 => 'копійок',
      6 => 'копійок', 
      7 => 'копійок',
      8 => 'копійок',
      9 => 'копійок',
      0 => 'копійок'
    }
  }.freeze

  def initialize(amount)
    @amount = amount.to_f.round(2)
  end

  def to_words
    # Розділяємо на гривні та копійки
    hryvnias, kopiykas = split_amount
    
    hryvnia_words = number_to_words(hryvnias, :grn)
    kopiyka_words = number_to_words(kopiykas, :kop)
    
    # Об'єднуємо результати
    result = [hryvnia_words, kopiyka_words].reject(&:empty?).join(' ')
    result.capitalize
  end

  private

  def split_amount
    whole_part = @amount.to_i
    fractional_part = ((@amount - whole_part) * 100).round
    
    # Виправлення для випадків, коли fractional_part стає 100
    if fractional_part >= 100
      whole_part += 1
      fractional_part = 0
    end
    
    [whole_part, fractional_part]
  end

  def number_to_words(number, currency_type)
    return '' if number.zero? && currency_type == :kop
    
    if number.zero?
      return "нуль #{CURRENCY_NAMES[currency_type][0]}"
    end

    words = []
    
    # Обробка мільйонів
    millions = number / 1_000_000
    if millions > 0
      words << convert_three_digits(millions, :million)
      number %= 1_000_000
    end

    # Обробка тисяч
    thousands = number / 1_000
    if thousands > 0
      words << convert_three_digits(thousands, :thousand)
      number %= 1_000
    end

    # Обробка одиниць
    if number > 0 || words.empty?
      words << convert_three_digits(number, :unit)
    end

    # Додаємо назву валюти з правильним відмінком
    last_digit = number % 10
    currency_word = CURRENCY_NAMES[currency_type][last_digit]
    words << currency_word if currency_type == :grn || currency_type == :kop

    words.reject(&:empty?).join(' ')
  end

  def convert_three_digits(number, scale)
    return '' if number.zero?

    hundreds = number / 100
    tens_and_units = number % 100
    
    words = []
    
    # Сотні
    words << HUNDREDS[hundreds] if hundreds > 0

    # Десятки та одиниці
    if tens_and_units > 0
      if tens_and_units < 10
        word = scale == :thousand ? feminine_form(UNITS[tens_and_units]) : UNITS[tens_and_units]
        words << word
      elsif tens_and_units < 20
        words << TEENS[tens_and_units]
      else
        tens = tens_and_units / 10
        units = tens_and_units % 10
        words << TENS[tens]
        if units > 0
          word = scale == :thousand ? feminine_form(UNITS[units]) : UNITS[units]
          words << word
        end
      end
    end

    # Додаємо назву розряду
    words << scale_name(number, scale)

    words.reject(&:empty?).join(' ')
  end

  def feminine_form(word)
    # Перетворення в жіночий рід для тисяч
    {
      'один' => 'одна',
      'два' => 'дві'
    }[word] || word
  end

  def scale_name(number, scale)
    return '' if scale == :unit

    last_digit = number % 10
    last_two_digits = number % 100

    case scale
    when :thousand
      if last_two_digits.between?(11, 19)
        'тисяч'
      else
        case last_digit
        when 1 then 'тисяча'
        when 2, 3, 4 then 'тисячі'
        else 'тисяч'
        end
      end
    when :million
      if last_two_digits.between?(11, 19)
        'мільйонів'
      else
        case last_digit
        when 1 then 'мільйон'
        when 2, 3, 4 then 'мільйони'
        else 'мільйонів'
        end
      end
    else
      ''
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# fop_tax_calculator.rb
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'i18n'

class FopTaxCalculator
  # Ставки податку та ЄСВ станом на 2024 рік
  SINGLE_TAX_RATE = BigDecimal('0.05')  # 5% єдиний податок
  MIN_SALARY = BigDecimal('8000')       # Мінімальна зарплата
  ESV_RATE = BigDecimal('0.22')         # 22% ЄСВ
  
  # Ліміти доходу для 3-ї групи
  QUARTERLY_INCOME_LIMIT = BigDecimal('7839000')  # ~7.839 млн грн за квартал
  MONTHLY_INCOME_LIMIT = QUARTERLY_INCOME_LIMIT / 3

  def initialize(quarterly_income, is_pensioner: false, has_disability: false)
    @quarterly_income = BigDecimal(quarterly_income.to_s)
    @is_pensioner = is_pensioner
    @has_disability = has_disability
    validate_income
  end

  def calculate
    {
      quarterly_income: format_amount(@quarterly_income),
      single_tax: calculate_single_tax,
      esv: calculate_esv,
      total_tax_burden: calculate_total_tax_burden,
      net_income: calculate_net_income
    }
  end

  private

  def validate_income
    if @quarterly_income > QUARTERLY_INCOME_LIMIT
      raise ArgumentError, "Дохід перевищує ліміт для 3-ї групи ФОП (#{format_amount(QUARTERLY_INCOME_LIMIT)} за квартал)"
    end
  end

  def calculate_single_tax
    tax = @quarterly_income * SINGLE_TAX_RATE
    format_amount(tax)
  end

  def calculate_esv
    # ЄСВ сплачується щомісячно, розраховуємо за квартал
    monthly_esv = calculate_monthly_esv
    quarterly_esv = monthly_esv * 3
    format_amount(quarterly_esv)
  end

  def calculate_monthly_esv
    # Мінімальний ЄСВ розраховується від мінімальної зарплати
    base_esv = MIN_SALARY * ESV_RATE
    
    # Пільги для пенсіонерів та осіб з інвалідністю
    if @is_pensioner || @has_disability
      BigDecimal('0')  # Звільнені від сплати ЄСВ
    else
      base_esv
    end
  end

  def calculate_total_tax_burden
    single_tax = @quarterly_income * SINGLE_TAX_RATE
    esv = calculate_monthly_esv * 3
    total = single_tax + esv
    format_amount(total)
  end

  def calculate_net_income
    total_tax = @quarterly_income * SINGLE_TAX_RATE + calculate_monthly_esv * 3
    net_income = @quarterly_income - total_tax
    format_amount(net_income)
  end

  def format_amount(amount)
    # Форматуємо до двох знаків після коми
    amount.round(2)
  end
end
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# liqpay_payout.rb
require 'liqpay'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class LiqPayPayout
  def initialize(public_key: nil, private_key: nil)
    @public_key = public_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']
    @private_key = private_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    
    validate_credentials!
    
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: @public_key,
      private_key: @private_key
    )
  end

  def payout_to_card(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name, options = {})
    # Validate required parameters
    validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    
    # Prepare the request parameters
    params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      amount: amount.to_f,
      currency: currency.upcase,
      description: options[:description] || 'Payout to Ukrainian card',
      order_id: options[:order_id] || generate_order_id,
      receiver_card: format_card_number(card_number),
      receiver_last_name: recipient_name.split(' ').last,
      receiver_first_name: recipient_name.split(' ').first
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters
    params[:ip] = options[:ip] if options[:ip]
    params[:phone] = options[:phone] if options[:phone]
    params[:email] = options[:email] if options[:email]
    
    begin
      # Make the API call
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      
      # Parse and return the response
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: "API call failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  def check_payout_status(order_id)
    params = {
      action: 'status',
      version: '3',
      order_id: order_id
    }
    
    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: "Status check failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    if @public_key.nil? || @public_key.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, 'LiqPay public key is required'
    end
    
    if @private_key.nil? || @private_key.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, 'LiqPay private key is required'
    end
  end

  def validate_payout_params(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    raise ArgumentError, 'Amount must be positive' unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise ArgumentError, 'Currency is required' if currency.nil? || currency.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, 'Card number is required' if card_number.nil? || card_number.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, 'Recipient name is required' if recipient_name.nil? || recipient_name.empty?
    
    # Validate Ukrainian card format (16 digits, typically starts with 4, 5, or 6)
    unless card_number.gsub(/\s+/, '') =~ /^[4-6]\d{15}$/
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid card number format'
    end
  end

  def format_card_number(card_number)
    # Remove any spaces and ensure it's a string of digits
    card_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
  end

  def generate_order_id
    "payout_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    # LiqPay returns a JSON string, so parse it
    result = response.is_a?(String) ? JSON.parse(response) : response
    
    {
      success: result['status'] == 'success',
      status: result['status'],
      order_id: result['order_id'],
      transaction_id: result['transaction_id'],
      amount: result['amount'],
      currency: result['currency'],
      receiver_card: result['receiver_card'],
      error_code: result['err_code'],
      error_description: result['err_description'],
      raw_response: result
    }
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables from .env file
  Dotenv.load
  
  # Initialize the payout service
  payout_service = LiqPayPayout.new
  
  # Example payout parameters
  payout_params = {
    amount: 100.0,                    # Amount in the specified currency
    currency: 'UAH',                  # Currency (UAH for Ukrainian hryvnia)
    card_number: '5375414101234567',  # Ukrainian card number (example)
    recipient_name: 'Ivan Petrenko',  # Recipient's full name
    description: 'Salary payment',    # Optional: Payment description
    order_id: 'salary_jan_2024',      # Optional: Your internal order ID
    email: 'ivan@example.com',        # Optional: Recipient email
    phone: '+380501234567'            # Optional: Recipient phone
  }
  
  # Make the payout
  result = payout_service.payout_to_card(
    payout_params[:amount],
    payout_params[:currency],
    payout_params[:card_number],
    payout_params[:recipient_name],
    payout_params
  )
  
  puts "Payout Result:"
  puts JSON.pretty_generate(result)
  
  # Check status if payout was initiated
  if result[:success] && result[:order_id]
    sleep(2) # Wait a moment before checking status
    status_result = payout_service.check_payout_status(result[:order_id])
    puts "\nStatus Check Result:"
    puts JSON.pretty_generate(status_result)
  end
end
```

```env
LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY=your_public_key_here
LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key_here
```

## Usage Instructions

1. **Install dependencies:**
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. **Set up LiqPay account:**
   - Register at [LiqPay](https://www.liqpay.ua/)
   - Get your public and private keys from the merchant dashboard
   - Ensure P2P payments are enabled for your account

3. **Configure environment variables** in your `.env` file

4. **Run the script:**
   ```bash
   ruby liqpay_payout.rb
   ```

## Important Notes

- **Card Number Format**: Ukrainian cards are typically 16 digits and start with 4 (Visa), 5 (MasterCard), or 6 (Maestro)
- **Currency**: Use 'UAH' for Ukrainian hryvnia
- **Amount**: Minimum amount and fees depend on LiqPay's current policies
- **Security**: Never commit your `.env` file to version control
- **Testing**: Use LiqPay's sandbox environment for testing before going live

## Response Handling

The implementation handles various response statuses:
- `success` - Payment was successful
- `error` - Payment failed with error details
- `wait_accept` - Waiting for recipient to accept
- `processing` - Payment is being processed

This code provides a robust foundation for LiqPay P2P payouts to Ukrainian cards with proper error handling and status tracking.

### app/services/fondy_service.rb

```ruby
require 'json'
require 'httparty'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class FondyService
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end
  
  # Створення платежу
  def create_payment(order_params)
    params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_desc: order_params[:description],
      amount: order_params[:amount], # в копійках
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      response_url: order_params[:response_url],
      server_callback_url: order_params[:callback_url]
    }.merge(order_params[:additional_params] || {})
    
    # Додаємо підпис
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/checkout/url",
      body: JSON.generate(request: params),
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if json_response['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          checkout_url: json_response['response']['checkout_url'],
          payment_id: json_response['response']['payment_id']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: json_response['response']['error_message']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  def check_payment_status(order_id)
    params = {
      order_id: order_id,
      merchant_id: @merchant_id
    }
    
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/status/order_id",
      body: JSON.generate(request: params),
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if json_response['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          status: json_response['response']['order_status'],
          response: json_response['response']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: json_response['response']['error_message']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка підпису відповіді від Fondy
  def verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
    # Копіюємо параметри та видаляємо підпис для перевірки
    params_to_verify = callback_params.dup
    signature = params_to_verify.delete('signature')
    
    # Генеруємо підпис з отриманих параметрів
    calculated_signature = generate_signature(params_to_verify)
    
    # Порівнюємо підписи
    secure_compare(calculated_signature, signature)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Генерація підпису
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Сортуємо параметри за ключами у алфавітному порядку
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    
    # Формуємо рядок для підпису
    string_to_sign = @secret_key + '|' + 
                    sorted_params.map { |k, v| "#{v}" }.join('|')
    
    # Обчислюємо SHA-1 хеш
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, @secret_key, string_to_sign)
    
    signature
  end
  
  # Безпечне порівняння рядків (захист від timing attacks)
  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.blank? || b.blank? || a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    
    l = a.unpack "C#{a.bytesize}"
    
    res = 0
    b.each_byte { |byte| res |= byte ^ l.shift }
    res == 0
  end
end
```

```ruby
      # Зберігаємо інформацію про платіж у базі даних
      payment = Payment.create(
        order_id: order_params[:order_id],
        amount: params[:amount],
        status: 'pending',
        checkout_url: result[:checkout_url]
      )
      
      redirect_to result[:checkout_url]
    else
      flash[:error] = "Помилка створення платежу: #{result[:error]}"
      redirect_back fallback_location: root_path
    end
  end
  
  # Сторінка успішного платежу (redirect від Fondy)
  def success
    @payment = Payment.find_by(order_id: params[:order_id])
    
    if @payment
      # Перевіряємо статус платежу
      status_result = @fondy_service.check_payment_status(params[:order_id])
      
      if status_result[:success]
        @payment.update(status: status_result[:status])
        @status = status_result[:status]
      else
        flash[:error] = "Помилка перевірки статусу платежу"
      end
    else
      flash[:error] = "Платіж не знайдений"
      redirect_to root_path
    end
  end
  
  # Callback від Fondy (server-to-server)
  def callback
    # Перевіряємо підпис
    if @fondy_service.verify_callback_signature(params.permit!.to_h)
      order_id = params[:order_id]
      status = params[:order_status]
      
      # Оновлюємо статус платежу в базі даних
      payment = Payment.find_by(order_id: order_id)
      if payment
        payment.update(
          status: status,
          fondy_payment_id: params[:payment_id],
          updated_at: Time.current
        )
        
        # Обробка різних статусів платежу
        handle_payment_status(payment, status)
        
        render json: { status: 'ok' }, status: 200
      else
        render json: { error: 'Payment not found' }, status: 404
      end
    else
      render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: 400
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  def check_status
    @payment = Payment.find(params[:id])
    
    result = @fondy_service.check_payment_status(@payment.order_id)
    
    if result[:success]
      @payment.update(status: result[:status])
      @status = result[:status]
    else
      flash[:error] = "Помилка перевірки статусу: #{result[:error]}"
    end
    
    render :status
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_order_id
    "#{Time.now.to_i}#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
  
  def handle_payment_status(payment, status)
    case status
    when 'approved'
      # Платіж успішний

      # Активуємо послуги тощо
```
