```ruby
# app/services/fondy_payment_service.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class FondyPaymentService
  include HTTParty

  # Fondy API endpoints
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api'
  CHECKOUT_URL = "#{API_BASE_URL}/checkout/url"
  VERIFY_SIGNATURE_URL = "#{API_BASE_URL}/checkout/verify_signature"

  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key, options = {})
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @options = {
      currency: 'USD',
      lang: 'en'
    }.merge(options)
  end

  # Create a payment and get redirect URL
  def create_payment(order_params)
    required_params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
      amount: order_params[:amount],
      currency: @options[:currency]
    }

    # Validate required parameters
    missing_params = required_params.select { |k, v| v.nil? || v.to_s.empty? }
    if missing_params.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing_params.keys.join(', ')}"
    end

    # Prepare request data
    request_data = {
      request: {
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        order_id: order_params[:order_id],
        order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
        amount: (order_params[:amount].to_f * 100).to_i, # Convert to cents
        currency: @options[:currency],
        response_url: order_params[:response_url] || @options[:response_url],
        server_callback_url: order_params[:server_callback_url] || @options[:server_callback_url],
        lang: @options[:lang],
        signature: nil # Will be calculated
      }.compact
    }

    # Generate signature
    request_data[:request][:signature] = generate_signature(request_data[:request])

    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post(
      CHECKOUT_URL,
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Verify callback signature from Fondy
  def verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
    # Extract signature from callback
    received_signature = callback_params.delete('signature')
    
    unless received_signature
      raise ArgumentError, 'No signature provided in callback'
    end

    # Generate our own signature from the received parameters
    generated_signature = generate_signature(callback_params)

    # Compare signatures
    if generated_signature == received_signature
      {
        valid: true,
        message: 'Signature is valid'
      }
    else
      {
        valid: false,
        message: 'Signature verification failed',
        received_signature: received_signature,
        generated_signature: generated_signature
      }
    end
  end

  # Generate signature for request or verification
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Sort parameters alphabetically and create signature string
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    
    # Remove signature parameter if present
    sorted_params.delete('signature')
    sorted_params.delete(:signature)
    
    # Create signature string: secret_key + | + param1|value1|param2|value2...
    signature_string = @secret_key + '|'
    signature_string += sorted_params.map { |k, v| "#{k}|#{v}" }.join('|')
    
    # Generate SHA-1 hash
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, @secret_key, signature_string)
    
    signature
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if json_response['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          checkout_url: json_response['response']['checkout_url'],
          payment_id: json_response['response']['payment_id'],
          response: json_response['response']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error_code: json_response['response']['error_code'],
          error_message: json_response['response']['error_message'],
          response: json_response['response']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error_message: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}",
        response: response.body
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error_message: "Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}",
      response: response.body
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# easy_pay_bill_payer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'sequel'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

Dotenv.load

class EasyPayBillPayer
  # EasyPay API configuration
  EASYPAY_BASE_URL = ENV['EASYPAY_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.easypay.example.com'
  EASYPAY_API_KEY = ENV['EASYPAY_API_KEY']
  EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY = ENV['EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY']
  
  def initialize
    setup_logger
    setup_database
    validate_config
  end
  
  private
  
  def setup_logger
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  def setup_database
    # Create SQLite database for storing payment receipts
    @db = Sequel.sqlite('easypay_receipts.db')
    
    # Create receipts table if it doesn't exist
    unless @db.table_exists?(:payment_receipts)
      @db.create_table :payment_receipts do
        primary_key :id
        String :user_id, null: false
        String :bill_id, null: false
        String :utility_type, null: false
        Float :amount, null: false
        String :currency, default: 'USD'
        String :payment_reference, null: false, unique: true
        String :status, null: false
        String :easypay_transaction_id
        Text :response_data
        DateTime :paid_at
        DateTime :created_at
      end
    end
    
    @receipts = @db[:payment_receipts]
    @logger.info("Database setup completed")
  end
  
  def validate_config
    unless EASYPAY_API_KEY && EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY
      raise "Missing EasyPay API credentials. Please set EASYPAY_API_KEY and EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY environment variables."
    end
  end
  
  def api_headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{EASYPAY_API_KEY}",
      'X-API-Secret' => EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY
    }
  end
  
  public
  
  # Pay a utility bill
  def pay_bill(user_id, bill_details)
    begin
      @logger.info("Processing bill payment for user #{user_id}")
      
      # Validate bill details
      validate_bill_details(bill_details)
      
      # Prepare payment payload
      payment_payload = {
        user_id: user_id,
        bill_id: bill_details[:bill_id],
        utility_type: bill_details[:utility_type],
        amount: bill_details[:amount],
        currency: bill_details[:currency] || 'USD',
        account_number: bill_details[:account_number],
        payment_method: bill_details[:payment_method] || 'bank_transfer'
      }
      
      # Make API call to EasyPay
      response = HTTParty.post(
        "#{EASYPAY_BASE_URL}/api/v1/payments",
        headers: api_headers,
        body: payment_payload.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      # Process response
      if response.success?
        process_successful_payment(response, user_id, bill_details)
      else
        process_failed_payment(response, user_id, bill_details)
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error processing payment: #{e.message}")
      store_receipt(
        user_id: user_id,
        bill_id: bill_details[:bill_id],
        utility_type: bill_details[:utility_type],
        amount: bill_details[:amount],
        currency: bill_details[:currency] || 'USD',
        payment_reference: generate_reference,
        status: 'failed',
        response_data: { error: e.message }
      )
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  # Get payment receipt by reference
  def get_receipt(payment_reference)
    @receipts.where(payment_reference: payment_reference).first
  end
  
  # Get all receipts for a user
  def get_user_receipts(user_id)
    @receipts.where(user_id: user_id).order(Sequel.desc(:created_at)).all
  end
  
  # Check payment status
  def check_payment_status(payment_reference)
    receipt = get_receipt(payment_reference)
    return nil unless receipt
    
    if receipt[:easypay_transaction_id]
      response = HTTParty.get(
        "#{EASYPAY_BASE_URL}/api/v1/payments/#{receipt[:easypay_transaction_id]}",
        headers: api_headers
      )
      
      if response.success?
        update_receipt_status(payment_reference, response.parsed_response['status'])
        return response.parsed_response['status']
      end
    end
    
    receipt[:status]
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_bill_details(bill_details)
    required_fields = [:bill_id, :utility_type, :amount, :account_number]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| bill_details[field].nil? || bill_details[field].to_s.empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    unless bill_details[:amount].to_f > 0
      raise "Amount must be greater than 0"
    end
  end
  
  def process_successful_payment(response, user_id, bill_details)
    response_data = response.parsed_response
    transaction_id = response_data['transaction_id']
    status = response_data['status'] || 'completed'
    
    receipt = store_receipt(
      user_id: user_id,
      bill_id: bill_details[:bill_id],
      utility_type: bill_details[:utility_type],
      amount: bill_details[:amount],
      currency: bill_details[:currency] || 'USD',
      payment_reference: response_data['payment_reference'] || generate_reference,
      status: status,
      easypay_transaction_id: transaction_id,
      response_data: response_data,
      paid_at: Time.now
    )
    
    @logger.info("Payment successful. Receipt ID: #{receipt[:id]}, Transaction ID: #{transaction_id}")
    receipt
  end
  
  def process_failed_payment(response, user_id, bill_details)
    error_message = response.parsed_response['error'] || 'Payment failed'
    
    receipt = store_receipt(
      user_id: user_id,
      bill_id: bill_details[:bill_id],
      utility_type: bill_details[:utility_type],
      amount: bill_details[:amount],
      currency: bill_details[:currency] || 'USD',
      payment_reference: generate_reference,
      status: 'failed',
      response_data: response.parsed_response
    )
    
    @logger.error("Payment failed: #{error_message}")
    raise "Payment failed: #{error_message}"
  end
  
  def store_receipt(receipt_data)
    receipt_data[:created_at] = Time.now
    receipt_id = @receipts.insert(receipt_data)
    @receipts.where(id: receipt_id).first
  end
  
  def update_receipt_status(payment_reference, status)
    @receipts.where(payment_reference: payment_reference).update(
      status: status,
      paid_at: (status == 'completed' ? Time.now : nil)
    )
  end
  
  def generate_reference
    "EP#{Time.now.to_i}#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
end
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# ukrainian_payment_qr.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'base64'

class UkrainianPaymentQR
  # Field identifiers according to NBU standard
  FIELD_IDS = {
    version: '001',
    encoding: '1',
    bank_account: 'UA',
    recipient_name: '2',
    recipient_account: '3',
    recipient_bank_code: '4',
    payment_purpose: '5',
    amount: '6',
    currency: '7',
    payment_details: '8',
    payment_id: '9'
  }

  CURRENCY_CODES = {
    'UAH' => '980',
    'EUR' => '978',
    'USD' => '840'
  }

  def initialize(options = {})
    @options = {
      version: '1',
      encoding: 'UTF-8',
      currency: 'UAH'
    }.merge(options)
  end

  def generate(recipient_data)
    validate_required_fields(recipient_data)
    
    qr_data = build_qr_string(recipient_data)
    generate_qr_code(qr_data)
  end

  private

  def validate_required_fields(data)
    required_fields = [:recipient_name, :recipient_account, :recipient_bank_code]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| data[field].nil? || data[field].empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end

    # Validate bank account format (IBAN)
    unless valid_iban?(data[:recipient_account])
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid IBAN format for recipient account"
    end

    # Validate bank code (MFO)
    unless valid_bank_code?(data[:recipient_bank_code])
      raise ArgumentError, "Bank code must be 6 digits"
    end
  end

  def valid_iban?(iban)
    # Basic IBAN validation for Ukraine (UA + 27 digits)
    iban = iban.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    iban.match?(/^UA\d{27}$/)
  end

  def valid_bank_code?(code)
    code.to_s.match?(/^\d{6}$/)
  end

  def build_qr_string(data)
    fields = []

    # Version (fixed)
    fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:version]}#{@options[:version]}"

    # Encoding
    encoding_char = @options[:encoding].upcase == 'UTF-8' ? '1' : '2'
    fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:encoding]}#{encoding_char}"

    # Bank account (IBAN)
    fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:bank_account]}#{data[:recipient_account].gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase}"

    # Recipient name
    fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:recipient_name]}#{sanitize_text(data[:recipient_name])}"

    # Recipient bank code (MFO)
    fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:recipient_bank_code]}#{data[:recipient_bank_code]}"

    # Payment purpose
    if data[:payment_purpose]
      fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:payment_purpose]}#{sanitize_text(data[:payment_purpose])}"
    end

    # Amount (optional)
    if data[:amount]
      amount = format('%.2f', data[:amount].to_f)
      fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:amount]}#{amount}"
    end

    # Currency (defaults to UAH)
    currency_code = CURRENCY_CODES[data[:currency] || @options[:currency]]
    fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:currency]}#{currency_code}"

    # Payment details (optional)
    if data[:payment_details]
      fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:payment_details]}#{sanitize_text(data[:payment_details])}"
    end

    # Payment ID (optional - for invoice number, etc.)
    if data[:payment_id]
      fields << "#{FIELD_IDS[:payment_id]}#{sanitize_text(data[:payment_id])}"
    end

    fields.join
  end

  def sanitize_text(text)
    # Remove or replace characters that might break QR code format
    text.to_s.gsub(/[^\w\sа-яА-ЯіІїЇєЄґҐ\-\.\,\:\;\?\!\(\)\@\#\$\%\&\*\+\=\[\]\{\}\\\/\|\<\>]/, '')
         .gsub(/\n/, ' ')
         .strip
  end

  def generate_qr_code(data)
    # Generate QR code with optimal settings for payment systems
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(
      data,
      level: :m,  # Medium error correction
      mode: :byte_8bit,
      size: 8
    )

    qrcode
  end
end

# Helper method to save QR code as PNG
def save_qr_as_png(qr_code, filename, size: 300)
  png = qr_code.as_png(
    bit_depth: 1,
    border_modules: 4,
    color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
    color: 'black',
    file: nil,
    fill: 'white',
    module_px_size: 6,
    resize_exactly_to: false,
    resize_gte_to: false,
    size: size
  )
  
  File.open(filename, 'wb') { |f| f.write(png.to_s) }
  puts "QR code saved as #{filename}"
end

# Helper method to display QR code in terminal (for quick testing)
def display_qr_in_terminal(qr_code)
  puts qr_code.as_ansi(
    light: "\033[47m", 
    dark: "\033[40m",
    fill_character: "  ",
    quiet_zone_size: 1
  )
end

    recipient_name: "ТОВ 'ПРИКЛАДНА КОМПАНІЯ'",
    recipient_account: "UA123456789012345678901234567",
    recipient_bank_code: "123456",
    payment_purpose: "Оплата за послуги за лютий 2024",
    amount: "1500.50",
    currency: "UAH",
    payment_details: "Договір №123 від 15.01.2024",

    # Display the raw QR data for verification

  rescue ArgumentError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Features

1. **NBU Standard Compliance**: Follows the Ukrainian National Bank QR payment standard
2. **Field Validation**: Validates required fields and formats (IBAN, MFO code)
3. **Multiple Currencies**: Supports UAH, EUR, and USD
4. **Error Handling**: Comprehensive validation and error messages
5. **Flexible Output**: Can generate PNG files or display in terminal
6. **Text Sanitization**: Properly handles Ukrainian characters and special symbols

## Required Fields

- `recipient_name`: Name of the recipient
- `recipient_account`: IBAN account number (UA + 27 digits)
- `recipient_bank_code`: Bank MFO code (6 digits)

## Optional Fields

- `payment_purpose`: Purpose of payment
- `amount`: Payment amount
- `currency`: Currency code (default: UAH)
- `payment_details`: Additional payment details
- `payment_id`: Invoice or payment identifier

The code generates QR codes that are compatible with Ukrainian banking apps and payment systems that support the NBU standard.

### 3. Клієнт EasyPay API

```ruby
# services/easypay_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class EasyPayClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['EASYPAY_BASE_URL']
  
  def initialize(api_key, secret_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}",
      'X-Secret-Key' => secret_key
    }
  end
  
  def make_payment(amount, utility_type, user_info)
    body = {
      amount: amount,
      currency: 'UAH',
      utility_type: utility_type,
      user_id: user_info[:user_id],
      description: "Оплата #{utility_type} для #{user_info[:name]}",
      metadata: {
        account_number: user_info[:account_number],
        period: user_info[:period] # місяць/рік оплати
      }
    }.to_json
    
    response = self.class.post('/api/v1/payments', 
                              headers: @headers, 
                              body: body)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "EasyPay API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_receipt(transaction_id)
    response = self.class.get("/api/v1/receipts/#{transaction_id}", 
                             headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "EasyPay API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def check_payment_status(transaction_id)
    response = self.class.get("/api/v1/payments/#{transaction_id}/status", 
                             headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "EasyPay API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Сервіс оплати комунальних послуг

```ruby
# services/utility_payment_service.rb
require 'dotenv'
Dotenv.load

class UtilityPaymentService
  def initialize
    setup_database
    @easypay_client = EasyPayClient.new(
      ENV['EASYPAY_API_KEY'],
      ENV['EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY']
    )
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end
  
  def pay_utility(utility_type, amount, user_info)
    @logger.info("Початок оплати #{utility_type} на суму #{amount} для користувача #{user_info[:user_id]}")
    
    # Створюємо запис про оплату
    invoice = Invoice.create!(
      utility_type: utility_type,
      amount: amount,
      user_id: user_info[:user_id],
      status: 'pending'
    )
    
    begin
      # Виконуємо оплату через EasyPay
      payment_response = @easypay_client.make_payment(amount, utility_type, user_info)
      
      # Оновлюємо інвойс з ID транзакції
      invoice.update!(
        easypay_transaction_id: payment_response['transaction_id'],
        status: payment_response['status']
      )
      
      # Якщо оплата успішна, отримуємо квитанцію
      if payment_response['status'] == 'success'
        receipt = @easypay_client.get_receipt(payment_response['transaction_id'])
        invoice.update!(
          status: 'paid',
          receipt_data: receipt.to_json,
          paid_at: Time.current
        )
        
        @logger.info("Оплата успішна. Транзакція: #{payment_response['transaction_id']}")
        return { success: true, invoice: invoice, receipt: receipt }
      else
        invoice.update!(status: 'failed')
        @logger.error("Помилка оплати: #{payment_response['error_message']}")
        return { success: false, error: payment_response['error_message'] }
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      invoice.update!(status: 'failed')
      @logger.error("Помилка при оплаті: #{e.message}")
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  def get_user_invoices(user_id)
    Invoice.where(user_id: user_id).order(created_at: :desc)
  end
  
  def get_invoice_receipt(transaction_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find_by(easypay_transaction_id: transaction_id)
    return nil unless invoice && invoice.receipt_data
    
    JSON.parse(invoice.receipt_data)
  end
  
  def retry_failed_payment(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
    return { success: false, error: 'Інвойс не знайдено' } unless invoice
    return { success: false, error: 'Інвойс вже оплачено' } if invoice.paid?
    
    user_info = {
      user_id: invoice.user_id,
      name: 'Користувач', # Можна отримати з User model
      account_number: '123456' # Можна отримати з User model
    }
    
    pay_utility(invoice.utility_type, invoice.amount, user_info)
  end
  
  private
  
  def setup_database
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: ENV['DATABASE_URL'].split(':').last
    )
    
    # Створюємо таблиці, якщо їх немає
    unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?('invoices')
      CreateInvoices.new.change
    end
  end
end
```

### 5. Контролер для веб-інтерфейсу або API

```ruby
# controllers/utility_payments_controller.rb
class UtilityPaymentsController
  def initialize
    @payment_service = UtilityPaymentService.new
  end
  
  def create_payment(params)
    required_params = [:utility_type, :amount, :user_id, :account_number, :period]
    
    unless required_params.all? { |param| params[param] }
      return { error: "Відсутні обов'язкові параметри", status: 400 }
    end
    
    user_info = {
      user_id: params[:user_id],
      name: params[:name] || 'Користувач',
      account_number: params[:account_number],
      period: params[:period]
    }
    
    result = @payment_service.pay_utility(
      params[:utility_type],
      params[:amount].to_f,
      user_info
    )
    
    if result[:success]
      { 
        success: true, 
        transaction_id: result[:invoice].easypay_transaction_id,
        receipt: result[:receipt],
        status: 200 
      }
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: result[:error],
        status: 422 
      }
    end
  end
  
  def get_payment_history(user_id)
    invoices = @payment_service.get_user_invoices(user_id)
    
    {
      success: true,
      invoices: invoices.map do |invoice|
        {
          id: invoice.id,
          utility_type: invoice.utility_type,
          amount: invoice.amount,
          status: invoice.status,
          created_at: invoice.created_at,
          paid_at: invoice.paid_at
        }
      end
    }
  end
  
  def get_receipt(transaction_id)
    receipt = @payment_service.get_invoice_receipt(transaction_id)
    
    if receipt
      { success: true, receipt: receipt }
    else
      { success: false, error: 'Квитанцію не знайдено', status: 404 }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv'
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

module Portmone
  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :payee_id, :login, :password, :test_mode, :return_url, :callback_url
    
    def initialize
      @payee_id = ENV['PORTMONE_PAYEE_ID']
      @login = ENV['PORTMONE_LOGIN']
      @password = ENV['PORTMONE_PASSWORD']
      @test_mode = ENV['PORTMONE_TEST_MODE'] == 'true'
      @return_url = ENV['PORTMONE_RETURN_URL']
      @callback_url = ENV['PORTMONE_CALLBACK_URL']
    end
  end

  class << self
    attr_accessor :configuration
  end

  def self.configure
    self.configuration ||= Configuration.new
    yield(configuration) if block_given?
  end

  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    BASE_URLS = {
      production: 'https://www.portmone.com.ua/gateway/',
      test: 'https://test.portmone.com.ua/gateway/'
    }
    
    def initialize
      @config = Portmone.configuration
      base_url = @config.test_mode ? BASE_URLS[:test] : BASE_URLS[:production]
      self.class.base_uri(base_url)
      self.class.headers('Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    end
    
    def create_payment_link(amount, order_number, description = '', email = '')
      params = {
        payeeId: @config.payee_id,
        shopOrderNumber: order_number,
        billAmount: amount,
        description: description,
        successUrl: @config.return_url,
        failureUrl: @config.return_url,
        preauthFlag: 'N',
        lang: 'uk',
        encoding: 'UTF-8',
        email: email
      }
      
      response = self.class.post('/', body: params)
      
      if response.success?
        # У відповіді має бути URL для перенаправлення
        extract_payment_url(response.body)
      else
        raise "Помилка створення платіжного посилання: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    end
    
    def get_payment_status(order_number)
      params = {
        method: 'result',
        payeeId: @config.payee_id,
        login: @config.login,
        password: @config.password,
        shopOrderNumber: order_number
      }
      
      response = self.class.post('/', body: params)
      
      if response.success?
        parse_status_response(response.body)
      else
        raise "Помилка отримання статусу платежу: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def extract_payment_url(response_body)
      # Парсимо HTML відповіді для отримання URL форми
      doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response_body)
      form = doc.at_css('form')
      form ? form['action'] : nil
    rescue
      nil
    end
    
    def parse_status_response(response_body)
      # Парсимо XML відповідь
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)
      
      {
        order_id: doc.at_css('order_id')&.text,
        status: doc.at_css('status')&.text,
        amount: doc.at_css('bill_amount')&.text,
        auth_code: doc.at_css('auth_code')&.text,
        error_message: doc.at_css('error_message')&.text
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
      return { success: false, error: 'Недостатньо даних' }
    end
    
    # Оновлення статусу платежу в базі даних
    update_payment_status(shop_order_number, status, auth_code, bill_amount)
    
    # Відповідь для Portmone
    { success: true, status: 'OK' }
  end
  
  def check_payment_status(order_number)
    begin
      status = @portmone_client.get_payment_status(order_number)
      { success: true, status: status }
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_order_number
    "ORD#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
  
  def update_payment_status(order_number, status, auth_code, amount)
    # Тут має бути логіка оновлення статусу в вашій базі даних
    puts "Оновлення статусу платежу #{order_number}: #{status}, код авторизації: #{auth_code}, сума: #{amount}"
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require_relative './controllers/payments_controller'

class PaymentApp < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :portmone_client, PaymentsController.new
  end
  
  before do
    content_type 'application/json'
  end
  
  # Створення платіжного посилання
  post '/api/payments/create' do
    request_body = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    
    result = settings.portmone_client.create_payment(request_body)
    
    result.to_json
  end
  
  # Зворотний виклик від Portmone (POST)
  post '/api/payments/callback' do
    result = settings.portmone_client.handle_callback(params)
    
    # Portmone очікує XML відповідь
    content_type 'text/xml'
    
    if result[:success]
      <<~XML
        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <response>
          <status>OK</status>
        </response>
      XML
    else
      <<~XML
        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <response>
          <status>ERROR</status>
          <error_message>#{result[:error]}</error_message>
        </response>
      XML
    end
  end
  
  # Сторінка повернення після оплати (GET)
  get '/payment/result' do
    result = settings.portmone_client.handle_callback(params)
    
    if result[:success]
      # Перенаправлення на сторінку успіху
      redirect to('/payment/success')
    else
      # Перенаправлення на сторінку помилки
      redirect to('/payment/error')
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  get '/api/payments/:order_number/status' do
    order_number = params[:order_number]
    
    result = settings.portmone_client.check_payment_status(order_number)
    
    result.to_json
  end
  
  # Сторінка успішного платежу
  get '/payment/success' do
    "Платіж успішно виконано!"
  end
  
  # Сторінка помилки платежу
  get '/payment/error' do
    "Сталася помилка під час оплати. Спробуйте ще раз."
  end
end

PaymentApp.run! if __FILE__ == $0
```

```ruby
# qr_payment_generator.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'base64'

class NBUQRPaymentGenerator
  # Стандартні коди валют за ISO 4217
  CURRENCY_CODES = {
    uah: '980',  # Українська гривня
    usd: '840',  # Долар США
    eur: '978'   # Євро
  }.freeze

  def initialize(recipient_data = {})
    @recipient_data = {
      name: '',           # Найменування отримувача
      account: '',        # Рахунок отримувача
      bank_code: '',      # Код банку отримувача (МФО)
      amount: 0.0,        # Сума платежу
      currency: :uah,     # Валюта
      purpose: '',        # Призначення платежу
      edrpou: '',         # ЄДРПОУ отримувача (якщо є)
      payment_id: ''      # Унікальний ідентифікатор платежу
    }.merge(recipient_data)
  end

  # Генерація QR-коду у вигляді рядка для відображення в консолі
  def generate_ascii_qr
    qr_string = generate_qr_string
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string)
    qrcode.as_ansi
  end

  # Генерація QR-коду у вигляді PNG зображення
  def generate_png_qr(filename = 'payment_qr.png')
    qr_string = generate_qr_string
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string)
    
    png = qrcode.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      file: nil,
      fill: 'white',
      module_px_size: 6,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      resize_gte_to: false,
      size: 240
    )
    
    File.write(filename, png.to_s)
    filename
  end

  # Генерація QR-коду у вигляді base64 рядка (для веб-застосунків)
  def generate_base64_qr
    qr_string = generate_qr_string
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string)
    
    png = qrcode.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      file: nil,
      fill: 'white',
      module_px_size: 6,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      resize_gte_to: false,
      size: 240
    )
    
    "data:image/png;base64,#{Base64.strict_encode64(png.to_s)}"
  end

  private

  # Генерація рядка для QR-коду за стандартом НБУ
  def generate_qr_string
    data = [
      "BCD",                      # Версія специфікації
      "001",                      # Кодування (1 - UTF-8)
      "1",                        # Ідентифікатор функції (1 - B2B)
      generate_recipient_string,  # Дані отримувача
      generate_amount_string,     # Сума та валюта
      generate_purpose_string,    # Призначення платежу
      generate_additional_data    # Додаткові дані
    ].compact.join("\n")

    data
  end

  def generate_recipient_string
    recipient_info = [
      "S",                        # Тип ідентифікатора (S - IBAN)
      @recipient_data[:account],  # IBAN рахунку
      @recipient_data[:bank_code] # Код банку (МФО)
    ].join("\n")

    # Додаємо інформацію про отримувача
    recipient_info += "\n#{@recipient_data[:name]}" if @recipient_data[:name].present?
    recipient_info += "\n#{@recipient_data[:edrpou]}" if @recipient_data[:edrpou].present?
    
    recipient_info
  end

  def generate_amount_string
    amount = sprintf('%.2f', @recipient_data[:amount].to_f)
    currency_code = CURRENCY_CODES[@recipient_data[:currency]] || CURRENCY_CODES[:uah]
    
    "#{amount}\n#{currency_code}"
  end

  def generate_purpose_string
    @recipient_data[:purpose].to_s.gsub("\n", " ").strip
  end

  def generate_additional_data
    additional = []
    additional << "ALT+#{@recipient_data[:payment_id]}" if @recipient_data[:payment_id].present?
    additional.join("\n") if additional.any?
  end
end

# Допоміжний модуль для перевірки наявності даних
class Object
  def present?
    !nil? && !to_s.empty?
  end
end
```

## Додатковий клас для валідації даних

```ruby
# qr_payment_validator.rb
class NBUQRPaymentValidator
  def self.validate_payment_data(data)
    errors = []

    # Перевірка обов'язкових полів
    errors << "Назва отримувача обов'язкова" if data[:name].to_s.empty?
    errors << "Номер рахунку обов'язковий" if data[:account].to_s.empty?
    errors << "Код банку (МФО) обов'язковий" if data[:bank_code].to_s.empty?
    
    # Перевірка формату рахунку (спрощена перевірка IBAN)
    unless data[:account].to_s.match(/^UA\d{27}$/)
      errors << "Невірний формат рахунку. Має бути у форматі IBAN: UAXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
    end

    # Перевірка коду банку
    unless data[:bank_code].to_s.match(/^\d{6}$/)
      errors << "Код банку має містити 6 цифр"
    end

    # Перевірка суми
    if data[:amount].to_f <= 0
      errors << "Сума платежу має бути більше 0"
    end

    errors
  end
end
```

```ruby
# liqpay_payout.rb
require 'liqpay'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class LiqPayPayout
  def initialize
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      private_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    )
  end

  # Основна функція для виплати
  def make_payout(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name, description = "P2P кредит")
    begin
      # Підготовка параметрів
      params = {
        action: 'p2pcredit',
        version: '3',
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        description: description,
        order_id: generate_order_id,
        receiver_card: card_number,
        receiver_last_name: recipient_name.split(' ').last,
        receiver_first_name: recipient_name.split(' ').first,
        sandbox: ENV['LIQPAY_SANDBOX'] == 'true' ? 1 : 0
      }

      # Виконання запиту
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      
      # Обробка відповіді
      if response['result'] == 'ok'
        {
          success: true,
          payment_id: response['payment_id'],
          order_id: response['order_id'],
          amount: amount,
          currency: currency,
          message: 'Виплата успішно здійснена'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error_code: response['err_code'],
          error_description: response['err_description'],
          message: 'Помилка при виконанні виплати'
        }
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message,
        message: 'Виникла помилка при обробці запиту'
      }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  def check_payment_status(order_id)
    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', {
        action: 'status',
        version: '3',
        order_id: order_id
      })
      
      {
        status: response['status'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        sender_card: response['sender_card'],
        receiver_card: response['receiver_card']
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  # Генерація унікального ID замовлення
  def generate_order_id
    "payout_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/card_validator.rb
class CardValidator
  # Валідація номера картки за алгоритмом Луна
  def self.valid_card_number?(card_number)
    return false unless card_number =~ /^\d{13,19}$/
    
    digits = card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    check = digits.pop
    
    sum = digits.reverse.each_slice(2).flat_map do |x, y|
      [x * 2, y || 0]
    end.map { |x| x > 9 ? x - 9 : x }.sum
    
    (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10 == check
  end

  # Валідація суми
  def self.valid_amount?(amount)
    amount.is_a?(Numeric) && amount > 0 && amount <= 15000  # Максимальна сума P2P
  end

  # Валідація імені
  def self.valid_recipient_name?(name)
    name.is_a?(String) && name.split.length >= 2 && name.length <= 100
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# privatbank_importer.rb
require 'csv'
require 'money'
require 'terminal-table'
require 'colorize'

class PrivatBankImporter
  # Define transaction categories with keywords
  CATEGORIES = {
    food: {
      keywords: ['супермаркет', 'магазин', 'продукти', 'євроопт', 'атб', 'сильпо', 'фуршет', 'метро'],
      color: :green
    },
    utilities: {
      keywords: ['комунальні', 'оплата послуг', 'енерго', 'газ', 'вода', 'тепло', 'електри'],
      color: :blue
    },
    transport: {
      keywords: ['заправка', 'азс', 'окко', 'wog', 'авто', 'транспорт', 'такси', 'uber'],
      color: :yellow
    },
    entertainment: {
      keywords: ['кіно', 'ресторан', 'кафе', 'бар', 'розваги', 'клуб', 'концерт'],
      color: :magenta
    },
    shopping: {
      keywords: ['торгівельний', 'торговий центр', 'одяг', 'взуття', 'техніка', 'інтернет магазин'],
      color: :cyan
    },
    healthcare: {
      keywords: ['аптека', 'ліки', 'лікар', 'медичний', 'стоматолог', 'поліклініка'],
      color: :red
    },
    salary: {
      keywords: ['зарплата', 'заробітна плата'],
      color: :green
    },
    transfer: {
      keywords: ['переказ', 'переказ коштів'],
      color: :white
    },
    other: {
      keywords: [],
      color: :light_black
    }
  }.freeze

  def initialize(csv_file_path)
    @csv_file_path = csv_file_path
    @transactions = []
  end

  def import
    puts "Importing transactions from #{@csv_file_path}...".yellow
    
    CSV.foreach(@csv_file_path, headers: true, encoding: 'UTF-8') do |row|
      transaction = parse_transaction(row)
      @transactions << transaction if transaction
    end
    
    puts "Successfully imported #{@transactions.size} transactions".green
    @transactions
  end

  def categorize_transactions
    @transactions.each do |transaction|
      transaction[:category] = detect_category(transaction[:description])
    end
  end

  def print_summary
    categorize_transactions
    
    # Group by category and calculate totals
    category_totals = Hash.new(0)
    @transactions.each do |t|
      category_totals[t[:category]] += t[:amount]
    end

    # Create summary table
    summary_table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
      t.title = "Transaction Summary".green
      t.headings = ['Category', 'Count', 'Total Amount', 'Percentage']
      t.style = { all_separators: true }
      
      total_amount = @transactions.sum { |t| t[:amount] }.abs
      
      category_totals.sort_by { |_, amount| amount.abs }.reverse.each do |category, amount|
        count = @transactions.count { |t| t[:category] == category }
        percentage = total_amount > 0 ? (amount.abs / total_amount * 100).round(2) : 0
        
        color = CATEGORIES[category][:color]
        t.add_row [
          category.to_s.send(color),
          count,
          format_amount(amount),
          "#{percentage}%"
        ]
      end
    end
    
    puts summary_table
  end

  def print_transactions(filter_category: nil)
    filtered_transactions = if filter_category
      @transactions.select { |t| t[:category] == filter_category }
    else
      @transactions
    end

    transactions_table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
      t.title = filter_category ? "Transactions - #{filter_category}".green : "All Transactions".green
      t.headings = ['Date', 'Description', 'Amount', 'Category']
      t.style = { all_separators: true }
      
      filtered_transactions.sort_by { |tr| tr[:date] }.reverse.each do |transaction|
        category_color = CATEGORIES[transaction[:category]][:color]
        amount_color = transaction[:amount] >= 0 ? :green : :red
        
        t.add_row [
          transaction[:date].strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
          truncate_description(transaction[:description]),
          format_amount(transaction[:amount]).send(amount_color),
          transaction[:category].to_s.send(category_color)
        ]
      end
    end
    
    puts transactions_table
  end

  private

  def parse_transaction(row)
    # PrivatBank CSV format typically has these columns:
    # Дата, Час, Назва операції, Картка, Код авторизації, Сума, Валюта, Категорія, МСС, Країна, Місто
    return nil if row.empty? || row[0].nil?
    
    begin
      {
        date: Date.parse(row[0]),
        description: row[2] || '',
        amount: parse_amount(row[5] || '0'),
        currency: row[6] || 'UAH'
      }
    rescue Date::Error => e
      puts "Warning: Could not parse date '#{row[0]}' - #{e.message}".red
      nil
    end
  end

  def parse_amount(amount_str)
    # Remove spaces and convert to float
    amount_str.gsub(/\s+/, '').gsub(',', '.').to_f
  end

  def detect_category(description)
    description_down = description.downcase
    
    CATEGORIES.each do |category, data|
      data[:keywords].each do |keyword|
        return category if description_down.include?(keyword.downcase)
      end
    end
    
    :other
  end

  def format_amount(amount)
    if amount >= 0
      "+#{amount.round(2)} UAH"
    else
      "#{amount.round(2)} UAH"
    end
  end

  def truncate_description(description, max_length = 40)
    if description.length > max_length
      description[0...max_length] + '...'
    else
      description
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.empty?
    puts "Usage: ruby privatbank_importer.rb <csv_file_path>".yellow
    puts "Example: ruby privatbank_importer.rb statement.csv".yellow
    exit
  end

  csv_file = ARGV[0]
  
  unless File.exist?(csv_file)
    puts "Error: File #{csv_file} not found".red
    exit 1
  end

  importer = PrivatBankImporter.new(csv_file)
  transactions = importer.import
  
  if transactions.any?
    importer.print_summary
    puts "\n" + "="*80 + "\n"
    
    # Ask user if they want to see transactions for a specific category
    puts "Enter a category to view transactions (or press Enter for all transactions):"
    puts "Available categories: #{PrivatBankImporter::CATEGORIES.keys.join(', ')}"
    print "Category: "
    category_input = gets.chomp.downcase
    
    filter_category = if category_input.empty?
      nil
    else
      category_input.to_sym
    end
    
    importer.print_transactions(filter_category: filter_category)
  else
    puts "No transactions found in the file.".red
  end
end
```

```ruby
class PartialPaymentService
  def initialize(order_id, customer_info)
    @order_id = order_id
    @customer_info = customer_info
  end
  
  def create_partial_payment(total_amount, description)
    payment = Payment.create(
      order_id: @order_id,
      total_amount: total_amount,
      paid_amount: 0.0,
      description: description,
      customer_email: @customer_info[:email],
      customer_phone: @customer_info[:phone]
    )
    
    {
      payment_id: payment.payment_id,
      total_amount: total_amount,
      status: payment.status
    }
  end
  
  def process_partial_payment(payment_id, amount)
    payment = Payment[payment_id: payment_id]
    return { error: 'Payment not found' } unless payment
    return { error: 'Payment cannot accept partial payments' } unless payment.can_process_partial_payment?
    
    # Генеруємо запит на оплату через ПриватБанк
    payment_data = {
      order_id: payment.payment_id,
      amount: amount,
      details: "Partial payment for order #{payment.order_id}",
      ext_details: "Remaining: #{payment.remaining_amount - amount} UAH"
    }
    
    response = PRIVATBANK_CLIENT.payment(payment_data)
    
    if response['state'] == 'success'
      new_paid_amount = payment.paid_amount.to_f + amount
      payment.update(paid_amount: new_paid_amount)
      
      # Якщо оплачено повністю
      if new_paid_amount >= payment.total_amount
        payment.update(status: 'completed')
      end
      
      {
        success: true,
        payment_url: response['payment_url'],
        paid_amount: new_paid_amount,
        remaining_amount: payment.remaining_amount,
        status: payment.status
      }
    else
      {
        error: 'Payment processing failed',
        bank_response: response
      }
    end
  end
  
  def get_payment_status(payment_id)
    payment = Payment[payment_id: payment_id]
    return { error: 'Payment not found' } unless payment
    
    payment.update_status_from_bank
    
    {
      payment_id: payment.payment_id,
      order_id: payment.order_id,
      total_amount: payment.total_amount,
      paid_amount: payment.paid_amount,
      remaining_amount: payment.remaining_amount,
      status: payment.status,
      created_at: payment.created_at
    }
  end
  
  def get_available_partial_options(total_amount)
    # Варіанти часткової оплати: 25%, 50%, 75%, повна сума
    [
      { percentage: 25, amount: (total_amount * 0.25).round(2) },
      { percentage: 50, amount: (total_amount * 0.5).round(2) },
      { percentage: 75, amount: (total_amount * 0.75).round(2) },
      { percentage: 100, amount: total_amount }
    ]
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class PaymentsController < Sinatra::Base
  set :show_exceptions, false
  
  before do
    content_type :json
  end
  
  post '/api/payments' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    service = PartialPaymentService.new(data['order_id'], data['customer_info'])
    result = service.create_partial_payment(data['amount'], data['description'])
    
    status 201
    result.to_json
  end
  
  post '/api/payments/:payment_id/partial' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    service = PartialPaymentService.new(nil, {})
    result = service.process_partial_payment(params['payment_id'], data['amount'])
    
    if result[:error]
      status 400
    else
      status 200
    end
    
    result.to_json
  end
  
  get '/api/payments/:payment_id' do
    service = PartialPaymentService.new(nil, {})
    result = service.get_payment_status(params['payment_id'])
    
    if result[:error]
      status 404
    else
      status 200
    end
    
    result.to_json
  end
  
  get '/api/payments/options/:total_amount' do
    service = PartialPaymentService.new(nil, {})
    options = service.get_available_partial_options(params['total_amount'].to_f)
    
    { options: options }.to_json
  end
  
  post '/api/payments/:payment_id/callback' do
    # Callback від ПриватБанку для оновлення статусу оплати
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    payment = Payment[payment_id: params['payment_id']]
    if payment
      payment.update_status_from_bank
      status 200
      { success: true }.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Payment not found' }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  error do
    status 500
    { error: env['sinatra.error'].message }.to_json
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Transaction
  attr_accessor :date, :amount, :currency, :description, :category, :card_number
  
  def initialize(date, amount, currency, description, card_number = nil)

    @amount = amount.to_f
    @currency = currency
    @description = description
    @card_number = card_number

  end
  
  def to_s

  end
  
  def income?
    amount > 0
  end
  
  def expense?
    amount < 0
  end
```

```ruby
require 'csv'
require 'date'

class PrivatbankImporter
  def initialize(file_path)
    @file_path = file_path
    @transactions = []
  end
  
  def import
    CSV.foreach(@file_path, headers: true, encoding: 'UTF-8') do |row|
      # ПриватБанк використовує різні формати CSV, тому перевіряємо структуру
      transaction = parse_row(row)
      @transactions << transaction if transaction
    end
    
    categorize_transactions
    @transactions
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Помилка імпорту: #{e.message}"
    []
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_row(row)
    # Спроба визначити формат на основі доступних стовпців
    if row['Дата операции']
      # Новий формат ПриватБанку
      date = row['Дата операции']
      amount = row['Сумма операции']
      currency = row['Валюта операции']
      description = row['Детали операции'] || row['Описание операции']
      card_number = row['Номер карты']
    elsif row['Дата']
      # Старий формат
      date = row['Дата']
      amount = row['Сумма']
      currency = row['Валюта']
      description = row['Описание'] || row['Детали']
      card_number = row['Карта']
    else
      puts "Невідомий формат CSV. Доступні заголовки: #{row.headers}"
      return nil
    end
    
    Transaction.new(date, amount, currency, description, card_number)
  end
  
  def categorize_transactions
    @transactions.each do |transaction|
      CategoryManager.categorize(transaction)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class ReportGenerator
  def initialize(transactions)
    @transactions = transactions
  end
  
  def generate_summary
    expenses = @transactions.select(&:expense?)
    incomes = @transactions.select(&:income?)
    
    puts "=== ЗВІТ ПРО ТРАНЗАКЦІЇ ==="
    puts "Загальна кількість транзакцій: #{@transactions.count}"
    puts "Витрати: #{expenses.count} на суму #{expenses.sum(&:amount).abs}"
    puts "Доходи: #{incomes.count} на суму #{incomes.sum(&:amount)}"
    puts ""
    
    generate_category_report(expenses, 'ВИТРАТИ')
    generate_category_report(incomes, 'ДОХОДИ')
  end
  
  def generate_category_report(transactions, type)
    puts "=== #{type} ПО КАТЕГОРІЯМ ==="
    
    by_category = transactions.group_by(&:category)
    
    by_category.each do |category, trans|
      total = trans.sum(&:amount).abs
      percentage = (total / transactions.sum(&:amount).abs * 100).round(2)
      
      puts "#{category}: #{total} (#{percentage}%)"
    end
    
    puts ""
  end
  
  def generate_detailed_report
    puts "=== ДЕТАЛЬНИЙ ЗВІТ ==="
    @transactions.sort_by(&:date).each do |transaction|
      puts transaction.to_s
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# medoc_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'

# Auto-load classes
loader = Zeitwerk::Loader.new
loader.push_dir(File.dirname(__FILE__))
loader.setup

class MEDocClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # M.E.Doc API endpoints (these are examples - use actual endpoints from documentation)
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.medoc.gov.ua'
  
  # API paths
  LOGIN_PATH = '/api/v1/auth/login'
  INVOICE_PATH = '/api/v1/invoices'
  STATUS_PATH = '/api/v1/invoices/status'
  
  def initialize(api_key:, certificate_path:, certificate_password:, base_url: BASE_URL)
    @api_key = api_key
    @certificate_path = certificate_path
    @certificate_password = certificate_password
    @base_url = base_url
    @token = nil
    
    # Configure HTTParty with certificate
    self.class.base_uri(base_url)
    self.class.ssl_client_cert(OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(certificate_path)))
    self.class.ssl_client_key(OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(certificate_path), certificate_password))
  end
  
  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post(
      LOGIN_PATH,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: { timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601 }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @token = response.parsed_response['token']
      true
    else
      raise AuthenticationError, "Failed to authenticate: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def send_invoice(invoice_data)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    # Convert invoice data to M.E.Doc XML format
    xml_data = InvoiceBuilder.build(invoice_data)
    
    response = self.class.post(
      INVOICE_PATH,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'X-API-Key' => @api_key
      },
      body: xml_data
    )
    
    if response.success?
      parse_invoice_response(response.body)
    else
      raise InvoiceSubmissionError, "Failed to submit invoice: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def check_invoice_status(invoice_id)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{STATUS_PATH}/#{invoice_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'X-API-Key' => @api_key
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      parse_status_response(response.body)
    else
      raise StatusCheckError, "Failed to check status: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_invoice_response(response_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)
    {
      invoice_id: doc.at_xpath('//InvoiceID')&.text,
      status: doc.at_xpath('//Status')&.text,
      message: doc.at_xpath('//Message')&.text,
      timestamp: doc.at_xpath('//Timestamp')&.text
    }
  end
  
  def parse_status_response(response_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)
    {
      invoice_id: doc.at_xpath('//InvoiceID')&.text,
      status: doc.at_xpath('//Status')&.text,
      error_message: doc.at_xpath('//ErrorMessage')&.text,
      last_updated: doc.at_xpath('//LastUpdated')&.text
    }
  end
end

# Invoice Builder for M.E.Doc XML format
class InvoiceBuilder
  def self.build(invoice_data)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.ROOT do
      xml.Document do
        # Header section
        xml.Head do
          xml.Version '1.0'
          xml.DocType 'J12'
          xml.DocDate invoice_data[:document_date]
          xml.DocNumber invoice_data[:document_number]
        end
        
        # Seller information
        xml.Seller do
          xml.INN invoice_data[:seller][:inn]
          xml.Name invoice_data[:seller][:name]
          xml.Address invoice_data[:seller][:address]
        end

            xml.InvoiceItem do

              xml.ProductName item[:name]
              xml.Unit item[:unit]
              xml.Quantity item[:quantity]
              xml.Price item[:price]
              xml.Sum item[:sum]
              xml.TaxRate item[:tax_rate]
              xml.TaxSum item[:tax_sum]
            end

        end
        
        # Totals
        xml.Totals do
          xml.TotalSum invoice_data[:total_sum]
          xml.TotalTaxSum invoice_data[:total_tax_sum]
          xml.TotalWithTax invoice_data[:total_with_tax]
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
end
```

```ruby
# dhl_tracker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class DHLTracker
  BASE_URL = 'https://api-eu.dhl.com/track/shipments'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'DHL-API-Key' => @api_key
    }
  end

  def track(tracking_number)
    validate_tracking_number(tracking_number)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}?trackingNumber=#{tracking_number}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def display_events(shipment_data)
    if shipment_data['shipments'] && shipment_data['shipments'].any?
      shipment = shipment_data['shipments'].first
      
      puts "\n📦 DHL Parcel Tracking Results"
      puts "=" * 50
      puts "Tracking Number: #{shipment['id']}"
      puts "Service: #{shipment['service']}"
      puts "Status: #{shipment['status']['status']}"
      puts "Destination: #{shipment['destination']['address']['addressLocality']}"
      puts "=" * 50
      
      if shipment['events'] && shipment['events'].any?
        puts "\n📋 Delivery Events (Most Recent First):"
        puts "-" * 50
        
        shipment['events'].reverse.each_with_index do |event, index|
          puts "#{index + 1}. #{format_event(event)}"
          puts "   Location: #{event['location']['address']['addressLocality']}" if event['location']
          puts "   #{event['description']}" if event['description']
          puts
        end
      else
        puts "No tracking events available."
      end
    else
      puts "No shipment data found for this tracking number."
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_tracking_number(tracking_number)
    unless tracking_number.match?(/^\d{10,35}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid tracking number format"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 404
      raise "Tracking number not found"
    when 401
      raise "Invalid API key"
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."
    when 500..599
      raise "DHL API server error"
    else
      raise "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def format_event(event)
    timestamp = Time.parse(event['timestamp']).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    status = event['statusCode'] ? "(#{event['statusCode']})" : ""
    "#{timestamp} #{status} - #{event['status']}"
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Get API key from environment variable or prompt user
  api_key = ENV['DHL_API_KEY'] || begin
    print "Enter your DHL API key: "
    gets.chomp
  end

  tracker = DHLTracker.new(api_key)

  print "Enter DHL tracking number: "
  tracking_number = gets.chomp

  begin
    shipment_data = tracker.track(tracking_number)
    tracker.display_events(shipment_data)
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "❌ Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# ups_shipping_rates.rb
require 'ups'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class UPSShippingCalculator
  def initialize
    setup_ups_client
  end

  def get_rates(parcel_params, from_address, to_address)
    begin
      shipment = build_shipment(parcel_params, from_address, to_address)
      response = @ups.shipments.rates(shipment)
      
      format_rates_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: "Failed to get UPS rates: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def setup_ups_client
    @ups = UPS.new(
      license_number: ENV['UPS_LICENSE_NUMBER'],
      user_id: ENV['UPS_USER_ID'],
      password: ENV['UPS_PASSWORD'],
      test_mode: ENV['UPS_TEST_MODE'] == 'true'
    )
  end

  def build_shipment(parcel_params, from_address, to_address)
    {
      # Package details
      package_weight: parcel_params[:weight],
      package_unit: parcel_params[:unit] || 'LBS', # LBS or KGS
      package_length: parcel_params[:length],
      package_width: parcel_params[:width],
      package_height: parcel_params[:height],
      package_dimension_unit: parcel_params[:dimension_unit] || 'IN', # IN or CM
      
      # Shipping addresses
      shipper: format_address(from_address),
      ship_to: format_address(to_address),
      
      # Service options (optional)
      service_code: parcel_params[:service_code], # Optional: specify service type
      pickup_type: parcel_params[:pickup_type] || '01', # 01=Daily Pickup
      customer_classification: parcel_params[:customer_classification] || '01' # 01=Wholesale
    }
  end

  def format_address(address)
    {
      company_name: address[:company],
      attention_name: address[:name],
      phone_number: address[:phone],
      address_line_1: address[:street1],
      address_line_2: address[:street2],
      city: address[:city],
      state_code: address[:state],
      postal_code: address[:zip],
      country_code: address[:country] || 'US'
    }
  end

  def format_rates_response(response)
    rates = []
    
    if response && response.rated_shipments
      response.rated_shipments.each do |shipment|
        rates << {
          service: shipment.service.name,
          service_code: shipment.service.code,
          total_charges: shipment.total_charges.monetary_value,
          currency: shipment.total_charges.currency_code,
          delivery_date: shipment.guaranteed_delivery&.date,
          delivery_time: shipment.guaranteed_delivery&.time,
          billing_weight: shipment.billing_weight.weight,
          billing_weight_unit: shipment.billing_weight.unit
        }
      end
    end
    
    {
      success: rates.any?,
      rates: rates,
      raw_response: response.to_h
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'fedex'

require 'fileutils'
require 'json'

class FedExShipment
  def initialize(credentials)
    @fedex = Fedex::Shipment.new(credentials)
  end

  def create_shipment(shipment_details)
    begin
      # Створення відправлення
      shipment = @fedex.ship(
        shipper: shipper_info(shipment_details[:shipper]),
        recipient: recipient_info(shipment_details[:recipient]),
        packages: package_info(shipment_details[:packages]),
        service_type: shipment_details[:service_type] || 'FEDEX_GROUND',
        packaging_type: shipment_details[:packaging_type] || 'YOUR_PACKAGING',
        label_specification: {
          image_type: 'PDF',
          label_stock_type: 'PAPER_4X6'
        }
      )

      # Збереження PDF-етикетки
      save_label(shipment[:labels], shipment_details[:label_filename])

      # Повернення номера відстеження
      {
        success: true,
        tracking_number: shipment[:tracking_number],
        label_path: File.expand_path(shipment_details[:label_filename])
      }

    rescue Fedex::RateError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "FedEx Error: #{e.message}"
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "General Error: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def shipper_info(shipper_details)
    {
      name: shipper_details[:name],
      company: shipper_details[:company],
      phone_number: shipper_details[:phone],
      address: shipper_details[:address],
      city: shipper_details[:city],
      state: shipper_details[:state],
      postal_code: shipper_details[:zip],
      country_code: shipper_details[:country] || 'US'
    }
  end

  def recipient_info(recipient_details)
    {
      name: recipient_details[:name],
      company: recipient_details[:company],
      phone_number: recipient_details[:phone],
      address: recipient_details[:address],
      city: recipient_details[:city],
      state: recipient_details[:state],
      postal_code: recipient_details[:zip],
      country_code: recipient_details[:country] || 'US'
    }
  end

  def package_info(packages)
    packages.map do |pkg|
      {
        weight: { units: 'LB', value: pkg[:weight] },
        dimensions: {
          length: pkg[:length],
          width: pkg[:width],
          height: pkg[:height],
          units: 'IN'
        }
      }
    end
  end

  def save_label(labels, filename)
    # Створення директорії якщо не існує
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(filename))
    
    # Збереження PDF-файлу
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(labels.first[:image])
    end
  end
end
```

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# medoc_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'json'

class MEDocClient
  # Константи для тестового та продуктивного середовища
  TEST_ENDPOINT = 'https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua/medoc/api'
  PRODUCTION_ENDPOINT = 'https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua/medoc/api'
  
  def initialize(api_key, secret_key, environment = :test)
    @api_key = api_key
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @base_url = environment == :production ? PRODUCTION_ENDPOINT : TEST_ENDPOINT
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Надсилання податкової накладної
  def send_invoice(invoice_data)
    # Підготовка XML згідно з вимогами M.E.Doc
    xml_data = build_invoice_xml(invoice_data)
    
    # Підпис XML (якщо потрібно)
    signed_xml = sign_xml(xml_data) if requires_signature?
    
    # Формування запиту
    request_body = build_request_body(signed_xml || xml_data, invoice_data)
    
    # Надсилання запиту
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/invoices",
      headers: @headers.merge(auth_headers),
      body: request_body.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу накладної
  def get_invoice_status(invoice_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/invoices/#{invoice_id}",
      headers: @headers.merge(auth_headers),
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Побудова XML накладної
  def build_invoice_xml(invoice_data)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    # Базова структура згідно з вимогами ДПС
    xml.DECLAR xmlns: 'http://tax.gov.ua/medoc' do
      xml.DECLARHEAD do
        xml.TIN invoice_data[:seller_tin] # ІПН продавця
        xml.C_DOC invoice_data[:document_type] || 'J12' # Тип документа
        xml.C_DOC_SUB invoice_data[:document_subtype] || '020'
        xml.C_DOC_VER invoice_data[:document_version] || '10'
        xml.C_DOC_CNT invoice_data[:document_number] # Номер документа
        xml.C_REG invoice_data[:region_code] || '1'
        xml.C_RAJ invoice_data[:district_code] || '1'
        xml.PERIOD_MONTH invoice_data[:period_month]
        xml.PERIOD_TYPE invoice_data[:period_type] || '1'
        xml.PERIOD_YEAR invoice_data[:period_year]
        xml.C_STI_ORIG invoice_data[:tax_office_code] # Код податкової
        xml.D_FILL invoice_data[:filling_date] || Date.today.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')
        xml.SOFTWARE invoice_data[:software] || 'Custom Ruby App'
      end
      
      xml.DECLARBODY do
        # Деталі накладної
        build_invoice_body(xml, invoice_data)
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
  
  # Побудова тіла накладної
  def build_invoice_body(xml, invoice_data)
    # Тут має бути детальна реалізація згідно з вимогами ДПС
    # Це спрощений приклад
    
    xml.R01G1 invoice_data[:invoice_number]
    xml.R01G2 invoice_data[:invoice_date].strftime('%d.%m.%Y')
    xml.R01G3 invoice_data[:invoice_type] || '1'
    
    # Дані продавця
    xml.R02G1 invoice_data[:seller_name]
    xml.R02G2 invoice_data[:seller_tin]
    
    # Дані покупця
    xml.R03G1 invoice_data[:buyer_name]
    xml.R03G2 invoice_data[:buyer_tin]
    
    # Товари/послуги
    invoice_data[:items].each_with_index do |item, index|
      xml.R04G1S do
        xml.R04G1 index + 1
        xml.R04G2 item[:name]
        xml.R04G3 item[:code] || ''
        xml.R04G4 item[:unit] || 'шт.'
        xml.R04G5 format('%.2f', item[:quantity])
        xml.R04G6 format('%.2f', item[:price])
        xml.R04G7 format('%.2f', item[:amount])
        xml.R04G8 item[:vat_rate] || '20.00'
        xml.R04G9 format('%.2f', item[:vat_amount])
        xml.R04G10 format('%.2f', item[:total_amount])
      end
    end
    
    # Підсумки
    xml.R05G1 format('%.2f', invoice_data[:total_amount])
    xml.R05G2 format('%.2f', invoice_data[:vat_amount])
    xml.R05G3 format('%.2f', invoice_data[:total_with_vat])
  end
  
  # Підпис XML (спрощена версія)
  def sign_xml(xml_data)
    # Реалізація підпису з використанням КЕП
    # Це спрощений приклад - реальна реалізація потребує КЕП та відповідних бібліотек
    
    # Для тестування повертаємо оригінальний XML
    xml_data
  end
  
  # Перевірка чи потрібен підпис
  def requires_signature?
    true # За замовчуванням вимагає підпис
  end
  
  # Формування тіла запиту
  def build_request_body(xml_data, invoice_data)
    {
      invoice: {
        xml_data: Base64.strict_encode64(xml_data),
        document_number: invoice_data[:document_number],
        invoice_date: invoice_data[:invoice_date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        total_amount: invoice_data[:total_amount],
        vat_amount: invoice_data[:vat_amount]
      }
    }
  end
  
  # Заголовки автентифікації
  def auth_headers
    timestamp = Time.now.utc.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
    signature = generate_signature(timestamp)
    
    {
      'X-API-Key' => @api_key,
      'X-Timestamp' => timestamp,
      'X-Signature' => signature
    }
  end
  
  # Генерація підпису
  def generate_signature(timestamp)
    data_to_sign = "#{@api_key}#{timestamp}"
    
    # Спрощена реалізація - у реальному проекті використовуйте HMAC або інший механізм
    # вказаний в документації API M.E.Doc
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', @secret_key, data_to_sign)
  end
  
  # Обробка відповіді
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise "Помилка запиту: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise "Помилка автентифікації"
    when 403
      raise "Доступ заборонено"
    when 500
      raise "Внутрішня помилка сервера"
    else
      raise "Невідома помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

**lib/ipay/client.rb** (основний клієнт)
```ruby
require 'faraday'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

class Ipay::Client
  def initialize
    @config = Ipay.config
    @connection = Faraday.new(url: @config.base_url) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      faraday.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    end
  end
  
  # Створення платежу
  def create_payment(params)
    payload = build_payment_payload(params)
    signature = generate_signature(payload)
    
    payload[:signature] = signature
    
    response = @connection.post('/payment') do |req|
      req.body = payload.to_json
    end
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу транзакції
  def check_transaction_status(transaction_id)
    payload = {
      merchant_id: @config.merchant_id,
      transaction_id: transaction_id,
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(payload)
    payload[:signature] = signature
    
    response = @connection.get("/transaction/#{transaction_id}") do |req|
      req.params = payload
    end
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Валідація callback від iPay
  def valid_callback?(params)
    received_signature = params.delete('signature')
    calculated_signature = generate_signature(params)
    
    received_signature == calculated_signature
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_payment_payload(params)
    {
      merchant_id: @config.merchant_id,
      amount: params[:amount],
      currency: params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      description: params[:description],
      order_id: params[:order_id],
      customer_email: params[:customer_email],
      customer_phone: params[:customer_phone],
      callback_url: params[:callback_url],
      success_url: params[:success_url],
      fail_url: params[:fail_url],
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }.compact
  end
  
  def generate_signature(data)
    string_to_sign = data.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join(';')
    string_to_sign += @config.secret_key
    
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest(string_to_sign)
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise Ipay::Error, "HTTP #{response.status}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

class Ipay::Error < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
# shipment_creator.rb
require 'fedex'
require 'prawn'
require 'dotenv'
require 'fileutils'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class FedExShipmentCreator
  attr_reader :tracking_number, :label_pdf_path

  def initialize
    @client = Fedex::Shipment.new(
      key: ENV['FEDEX_KEY'],
      password: ENV['FEDEX_PASSWORD'],
      account_number: ENV['FEDEX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER'],
      meter: ENV['FEDEX_METER_NUMBER'],
      mode: ENV['FEDEX_MODE'] || 'production'
    )
    @tracking_number = nil
    @label_pdf_path = nil
  end

  def create_shipment(shipment_details)
    begin
      # Create shipment request
      shipment = @client.ship(
        shipper: shipper_info(shipment_details[:shipper]),
        recipient: recipient_info(shipment_details[:recipient]),
        packages: package_info(shipment_details[:packages]),
        service_type: shipment_details[:service_type] || 'FEDEX_GROUND',
        payment_type: shipment_details[:payment_type] || 'SENDER',
        label_specification: {
          label_format_type: 'COMMON2D',
          image_type: 'PDF',
          label_stock_type: 'PAPER_85X11_TOP_HALF_LABEL'
        }
      )

      # Extract tracking number
      @tracking_number = shipment.tracking_number
      
      # Download and save label
      @label_pdf_path = save_label(shipment, shipment_details[:label_filename])
      
      # Store shipment information
      store_shipment_info(shipment_details)
      
      return true
      
    rescue Fedex::RateError => e
      puts "FedEx Error: #{e.message}"
      return false
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error creating shipment: #{e.message}"
      return false
    end
  end

  private

  def shipper_info(shipper_details)
    {
      name: shipper_details[:name],
      company: shipper_details[:company],
      phone_number: shipper_details[:phone],
      address: shipper_details[:address],
      city: shipper_details[:city],
      state: shipper_details[:state],
      postal_code: shipper_details[:zip],
      country_code: shipper_details[:country] || 'US'
    }
  end

  def recipient_info(recipient_details)
    {
      name: recipient_details[:name],
      company: recipient_details[:company],
      phone_number: recipient_details[:phone],
      address: recipient_details[:address],
      city: recipient_details[:city],
      state: recipient_details[:state],
      postal_code: recipient_details[:zip],
      country_code: recipient_details[:country] || 'US',
      residential: recipient_details[:residential] || false
    }
  end

  def package_info(packages)
    packages.map do |pkg|
      {
        weight: { units: pkg[:weight_unit] || 'LB', value: pkg[:weight] },
        dimensions: {
          length: pkg[:length],
          width: pkg[:width],
          height: pkg[:height],
          units: pkg[:dimension_unit] || 'IN'
        },
        item_description: pkg[:description] || 'General Merchandise'
      }
    end
  end

  def save_label(shipment, filename = nil)
    # Create labels directory if it doesn't exist
    FileUtils.mkdir_p('labels')
    
    # Generate filename if not provided
    filename ||= "fedex_label_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.pdf"
    filepath = File.join('labels', filename)
    
    # Save the label PDF
    File.open(filepath, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(shipment.label.file)
    end
    
    puts "Label saved to: #{filepath}"
    filepath
  end

  def store_shipment_info(shipment_details)
    # Create shipments directory if it doesn't exist
    FileUtils.mkdir_p('shipments')
    
    shipment_record = {
      tracking_number: @tracking_number,
      label_path: @label_pdf_path,
      created_at: Time.now.iso8601,
      shipper: shipment_details[:shipper],
      recipient: shipment_details[:recipient],
      packages: shipment_details[:packages],
      service_type: shipment_details[:service_type],
      payment_type: shipment_details[:payment_type]
    }
    
    filename = "shipment_#{@tracking_number}.json"
    filepath = File.join('shipments', filename)
    
    File.open(filepath, 'w') do |file|
      file.write(JSON.pretty_generate(shipment_record))
    end
    
    puts "Shipment information stored: #{filepath}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
      puts "-" * 40
      
      if shipment[:events] && shipment[:events].any?

          puts "#{index + 1}. #{event[:timestamp]} - #{event[:location]}"
          puts "   #{event[:description]}"
          puts "   Статус: #{event[:status_code]}"
          puts
        end
      else
        puts "Події відсутні"
      end
      
      # Інформація про одержувача
      if shipment[:receiver]
        puts "\nІнформація про одержувача:"

      end
      
    else

  end
```

```ruby
require 'active_record'

class AmazonOrder < ActiveRecord::Base

# lib/sp_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'oauth2'
require 'jwt'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class SpApiClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com' # Change region as needed
  
  def initialize
    @client_id = ENV['SP_API_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['SP_API_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @refresh_token = ENV['SP_API_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    @access_key_id = ENV['SP_API_ACCESS_KEY_ID']
    @secret_access_key = ENV['SP_API_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
    @role_arn = ENV['SP_API_ROLE_ARN']
  end

  def get_orders(created_after: nil, created_before: nil, max_results: 100)
    # Use last 24 hours if no specific time provided
    created_after ||= (Time.now - 86400).iso8601
    created_before ||= Time.now.iso8601

    endpoint = "/orders/v0/orders"
    params = {
      CreatedAfter: created_after,
      CreatedBefore: created_before,
      MarketplaceIds: ENV['MARKETPLACE_IDS'].split(','),
      MaxResultsPerPage: max_results
    }

    response = make_request(:get, endpoint, params)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error fetching orders: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def get_order_details(amazon_order_id)
    endpoint = "/orders/v0/orders/#{amazon_order_id}"
    
    response = make_request(:get, endpoint)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error fetching order details: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def make_request(method, endpoint, params = {})
    access_token = get_access_token
    url = "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-amz-access-token' => access_token
    }

    case method
    when :get
      HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers, query: params)
    when :post
      HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: params.to_json)
    else
      raise "Unsupported HTTP method: #{method}"
    end
  end

  def get_access_token
    # First, get an LWA access token using refresh token
    oauth_client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      @client_id,
      @client_secret,
      site: 'https://api.amazon.com',
      token_url: '/auth/o2/token'
    )

    begin
      token = oauth_client.get_token(
        grant_type: 'refresh_token',
        refresh_token: @refresh_token
      )
      token.token
    rescue OAuth2::Error => e
      puts "Error getting access token: #{e.response.body}"
      raise
    end
  end
end
```
