```ruby
require 'active_record'

class OrderSynchronizer
  def initialize
    @sp_api_client = SpApiClient.new
    setup_database
  end

  def sync_new_orders(hours_back = 24)
    created_after = (Time.now - (hours_back * 3600)).iso8601
    created_before = Time.now.iso8601

    puts "Fetching orders from #{created_after} to #{created_before}"
    
    orders_response = @sp_api_client.get_orders(
      created_after: created_after,
      created_before: created_before
    )

    return unless orders_response && orders_response['payload']

    orders = orders_response['payload']['Orders'] || []
    puts "Found #{orders.size} new orders"

    orders.each do |order_data|
      save_order(order_data)
    end

    puts "Sync completed. Total orders processed: #{orders.size}"
  end

  private

  def save_order(order_data)
    amazon_order_id = order_data['AmazonOrderId']
    
    # Check if order already exists
    existing_order = AmazonOrder.find_by(amazon_order_id: amazon_order_id)
    
    if existing_order
      puts "Order #{amazon_order_id} already exists, skipping..."
      return
    end

    # Get detailed order information
    order_details = @sp_api_client.get_order_details(amazon_order_id)
    return unless order_details

    detailed_order = order_details['payload'] || order_data

    begin
      AmazonOrder.create!(
        amazon_order_id: amazon_order_id,
        purchase_date: detailed_order['PurchaseDate'],
        last_updated_date: detailed_order['LastUpdateDate'],
        order_status: detailed_order['OrderStatus'],
        fulfillment_channel: detailed_order['FulfillmentChannel'],
        number_of_items_shipped: detailed_order['NumberOfItemsShipped'],
        number_of_items_unshipped: detailed_order['NumberOfItemsUnshipped'],
        payment_method: detailed_order['PaymentMethod'],
        order_total_amount: detailed_order['OrderTotal']['Amount'],
        order_total_currency: detailed_order['OrderTotal']['CurrencyCode'],
        ship_service_level: detailed_order['ShipServiceLevel'],
        shipping_address: detailed_order['ShippingAddress'].to_json,
        order_data: detailed_order.to_json # Store full order data as JSON
      )
      
      puts "Saved order: #{amazon_order_id}"
    rescue => e
      puts "Error saving order #{amazon_order_id}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def setup_database
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: 'db/amazon_orders.sqlite3'
    )

    # Create table if it doesn't exist
    unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?('amazon_orders')
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :amazon_orders do |t|
        t.string :amazon_order_id, null: false
        t.datetime :purchase_date
        t.datetime :last_updated_date
        t.string :order_status
        t.string :fulfillment_channel
        t.integer :number_of_items_shipped
        t.integer :number_of_items_unshipped
        t.string :payment_method
        t.decimal :order_total_amount
        t.string :order_total_currency
        t.string :ship_service_level
        t.text :shipping_address
        t.text :order_data
        
        t.timestamps
      end
      
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection.add_index :amazon_orders, :amazon_order_id, unique: true
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
        api_secret_key: ENV['SHOPIFY_API_SECRET'],
        host: ENV['SHOPIFY_HOST'] || ENV['RAILS_HOST'],
        scope: 'read_products,read_inventory',
        is_embedded: false,
        is_private: false,
        api_version: '2024-01',
        session_storage: ShopifyAPI::Auth::FileSessionStorage.new,
        logger: Rails.logger
      )

      session = ShopifyAPI::Auth::Session.new(
        shop: shop_url,
        access_token: access_token
      )
      
      ShopifyAPI::Context.activate_session(session)
    end

    def fetch_products(limit: 250)
      products = []
      since_id = 0

      loop do
        batch = ShopifyAPI::Product.all(
          limit: limit,
          since_id: since_id,
          fields: 'id,title,body_html,vendor,product_type,handle,status,published_at,created_at,updated_at,tags,images,variants'
        )

        break if batch.empty?

        products.concat(batch)
        since_id = batch.last.id

        # Shopify API limit is 250 products per request
        break if batch.size < limit
      end

      products
    end

    def fetch_inventory_levels(inventory_item_ids)
      return [] if inventory_item_ids.empty?

      # Shopify API allows up to 100 inventory item IDs per request
      inventory_item_ids.each_slice(100).flat_map do |batch|
        ShopifyAPI::InventoryLevel.all(
          inventory_item_ids: batch.join(','),
          limit: 250
        )
      end
    end

    def update_product_inventory(product, inventory_levels)
      product.variants.each do |variant|
        inventory_item_id = variant['inventory_item_id']
        inventory_level = inventory_levels.find { |il| il.inventory_item_id == inventory_item_id.to_i }
        
        if inventory_level
          variant['inventory_quantity'] = inventory_level.available
        end
      end

      product.save!
    end
  end
end
```

## Background Job

```ruby
# app/jobs/shopify_sync_job.rb
class ShopifySyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform
    # Configure Shopify API
    ShopifyService.configure(
      shop_url: ENV['SHOPIFY_SHOP_URL'],
      access_token: ENV['SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    )

    Rails.logger.info "Starting Shopify product sync..."

    # Fetch all products from Shopify
    shopify_products = ShopifyService.fetch_products
    
    Rails.logger.info "Fetched #{shopify_products.size} products from Shopify"

    # Sync products to database
    shopify_products.each do |shopify_product|
      begin
        product = Product.sync_from_shopify(shopify_product)
        Rails.logger.info "Synced product: #{product.title} (ID: #{product.shopify_id})"
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Error syncing product #{shopify_product.id}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end

    # Update inventory levels
    update_inventory_levels

    Rails.logger.info "Shopify sync completed successfully"
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Shopify sync job failed: #{e.message}"
    raise e # Re-raise to let Sidekiq handle retries
  end

  private

  def update_inventory_levels
    # Get all inventory item IDs from products
    inventory_item_ids = Product.all.flat_map do |product|
      product.variants.pluck('inventory_item_id').compact
    end.uniq

    return if inventory_item_ids.empty?

    # Fetch current inventory levels
    inventory_levels = ShopifyService.fetch_inventory_levels(inventory_item_ids)

    # Update product inventory quantities
    Product.find_each do |product|
      begin
        ShopifyService.update_product_inventory(product, inventory_levels)
        Rails.logger.info "Updated inventory for product: #{product.title}"
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Error updating inventory for product #{product.id}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Модель Product

```ruby
# app/models/product.rb
class Product < ApplicationRecord
  validates :shopify_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :title, presence: true
  
  # Метод для оновлення або створення продукту з даних Shopify
  def self.sync_from_shopify(shopify_product)
    product = find_or_initialize_by(shopify_id: shopify_product.id)
    
    product.assign_attributes(
      title: shopify_product.title,
      body_html: shopify_product.body_html,
      vendor: shopify_product.vendor,
      product_type: shopify_product.product_type,
      handle: shopify_product.handle,
      status: shopify_product.status,
      tags: shopify_product.tags,
      featured_image: shopify_product.image&.src,
      variants: extract_variants_data(shopify_product.variants),
      total_inventory: calculate_total_inventory(shopify_product.variants),
      published_at: shopify_product.published_at,
      updated_at: shopify_product.updated_at
    )
    
    product.save!
    product
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.extract_variants_data(variants)
    variants.map do |variant|
      {
        id: variant.id,
        title: variant.title,
        sku: variant.sku,
        price: variant.price,
        compare_at_price: variant.compare_at_price,
        inventory_quantity: variant.inventory_quantity,
        inventory_item_id: variant.inventory_item_id,
        weight: variant.weight,
        weight_unit: variant.weight_unit,
        barcode: variant.barcode
      }
    end
  end
  
  def self.calculate_total_inventory(variants)
    variants.sum { |variant| variant.inventory_quantity.to_i }
  end
end
```

## Фонове завдання для синхронізації

```ruby
# app/jobs/shopify_sync_job.rb
class ShopifySyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(full_sync: false)
    Rails.logger.info "Starting Shopify sync (#{full_sync ? 'full' : 'incremental'})"
    
    shopify_service = ShopifyService.new
    last_synced_id = get_last_synced_id unless full_sync
    
    begin
      products = shopify_service.fetch_products(since_id: last_synced_id)
      
      if products.any?
        Rails.logger.info "Found #{products.size} products to sync"
        sync_products(products)
        update_last_synced_id(products.last.id) unless full_sync
      else
        Rails.logger.info "No new products found to sync"
      end
      
      Rails.logger.info "Shopify sync completed successfully"
    rescue ShopifyService::ShopifyError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Shopify sync failed: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def sync_products(products)
    products.each do |shopify_product|
      begin
        Product.sync_from_shopify(shopify_product)
        Rails.logger.debug "Synced product: #{shopify_product.title} (ID: #{shopify_product.id})"
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync product #{shopify_product.id}: #{e.message}"
        # Продовжуємо синхронізацію наступних продуктів
        next
      end
    end
  end
  
  def get_last_synced_id
    Rails.cache.read('last_synced_product_id') || 0
  end
  
  def update_last_synced_id(product_id)
    Rails.cache.write('last_synced_product_id', product_id, expires_in: 1.day)
  end
end
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# shipping_comparison.rb
require 'easypost'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class ShippingRateComparer
  def initialize
    # Set your EasyPost API key
    EasyPost.api_key = ENV['EASYPOST_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key_here'
  end

  def compare_and_buy_cheapest_label(from_address, to_address, parcel, options = {})
    begin
      # Create addresses
      from = EasyPost::Address.create(from_address)
      to = EasyPost::Address.create(to_address)
      
      # Create parcel
      parcel = EasyPost::Parcel.create(parcel)
      
      # Create shipment
      shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
        to_address: to,
        from_address: from,
        parcel: parcel,
        options: options
      )
      
      # Get rates for the shipment
      shipment.rates
      
      # Find the cheapest rate
      cheapest_rate = find_cheapest_rate(shipment.rates)
      
      if cheapest_rate.nil?
        puts "No shipping rates available for this shipment."
        return nil
      end
      
      # Display available rates
      display_rates(shipment.rates, cheapest_rate)
      
      # Buy the cheapest label
      bought_shipment = shipment.buy(cheapest_rate)
      
      puts "\n✅ Successfully purchased shipping label!"
      display_label_info(bought_shipment)
      
      return bought_shipment
      
    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  private

  def find_cheapest_rate(rates)
    # Filter out rates that are not purchasable and find the cheapest one
    purchasable_rates = rates.select { |rate| rate.rate.to_f > 0 }
    purchasable_rates.min_by { |rate| rate.rate.to_f }
  end

  def display_rates(rates, cheapest_rate)
    puts "\n📦 Available Shipping Rates:"
    puts "=" * 80
    
    rates.each do |rate|
      is_cheapest = rate.id == cheapest_rate.id
      cheapest_indicator = is_cheapest ? " 🏆 CHEAPEST" : ""
      
      puts "#{rate.carrier} - #{rate.service}"
      puts "  Price: $#{rate.rate}#{cheapest_indicator}"
      puts "  Delivery Days: #{rate.delivery_days || 'N/A'}"
      puts "  Delivery Date: #{rate.delivery_date || 'N/A'}"
      puts "-" * 40
    end
  end

  def display_label_info(shipment)
    puts "\n📋 Shipping Label Information:"
    puts "Carrier: #{shipment.selected_rate.carrier}"
    puts "Service: #{shipment.selected_rate.service}"
    puts "Tracking Number: #{shipment.tracking_code}"
    puts "Label URL: #{shipment.postage_label.label_url}"
    puts "Price: $#{shipment.selected_rate.rate}"
  end
end

# Example usage

  comparer = ShippingRateCompariser.new

    name: 'John Doe',
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class USPSAddressValidator
  BASE_URL = 'https://secure.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'
  
  def initialize(user_id = nil)
    @user_id = user_id || ENV['USPS_USER_ID']
    raise "USPS User ID не знайдено. Додайте USPS_USER_ID до .env файлу" unless @user_id
  end
  
  def validate_address(address_data)
    # Перетворюємо адресу у формат, зрозумілий для USPS API
    xml_request = build_validation_request(address_data)
    
    response = send_request(xml_request)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_validation_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Помилка запиту: #{response.code}", details: response.body }
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    { error: "Виникла помилка: #{e.message}" }
  end
  
  def normalize_address(address_data)
    validation_result = validate_address(address_data)
    
    if validation_result[:valid]
      # Якщо адреса валідна, повертаємо нормалізовану версію
      validation_result[:address]
    else
      # Якщо є пропозиції, повертаємо першу нормалізовану пропозицію
      if validation_result[:suggestions] && !validation_result[:suggestions].empty?
        validation_result[:suggestions].first
      else
        validation_result
      end
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_validation_request(address)
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
      <AddressValidateRequest USERID="#{@user_id}">
        <Revision>1</Revision>
        <Address ID="0">
          <Address1>#{escape_xml(address[:address1].to_s)}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{escape_xml(address[:address2].to_s)}</Address2>
          <City>#{escape_xml(address[:city].to_s)}</City>
          <State>#{escape_xml(address[:state].to_s)}</State>
          <Zip5>#{escape_xml(address[:zip5].to_s)}</Zip5>
          <Zip4>#{escape_xml(address[:zip4].to_s)}</Zip4>
        </Address>
      </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end
  
  def send_request(xml_body)
    HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, query: {
      API: 'Verify',
      XML: xml_body
    })
  end
  
  def parse_validation_response(xml_response)
    # Спрощений парсинг XML відповіді
    # У реальному застосунку варто використовувати Nokogiri для кращого парсингу
    
    if xml_response.include?('<Error>')
      error_message = xml_response.match(/<Description>(.*?)<\/Description>/).to_a[1] || "Невідома помилка"
      return { valid: false, error: error_message }
    end
    
    # Перевіряємо наявність нормалізованої адреси
    if xml_response.include?('<Address2>') && xml_response.include?('<City>')
      normalized_address = {
        address1: extract_value(xml_response, 'Address1'),
        address2: extract_value(xml_response, 'Address2'),
        city: extract_value(xml_response, 'City'),
        state: extract_value(xml_response, 'State'),
        zip5: extract_value(xml_response, 'Zip5'),
        zip4: extract_value(xml_response, 'Zip4')
      }
      
      { valid: true, address: normalized_address }
    else
      { valid: false, error: "Не вдалося нормалізувати адресу" }
    end
  end
  
  def extract_value(xml, tag_name)
    match = xml.match(/<#{tag_name}>(.*?)<\/#{tag_name}>/)
    match ? match[1] : ''
  end
  
  def escape_xml(text)
    text.to_s.gsub(/&/, '&')
          .gsub(/</, '<')
          .gsub(/>/, '>')
          .gsub(/"/, '"')
          .gsub(/'/, ''')
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'active_record'

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :name, :sku, :quantity, :price, presence: true
  validates :quantity, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  
  after_save :update_ebay_listing, if: :quantity_changed?
  
  def ebay_item_id
    # Зберігаємо eBay Item ID для подальших оновлень
    self[:ebay_item_id]
  end
  
  def listed_on_ebay?
    ebay_item_id.present?
  end
  
  def quantity_changed?
    saved_change_to_quantity?
  end
  
  private
  
  def update_ebay_listing
    if listed_on_ebay?
      EbayService.update_item_quantity(ebay_item_id, quantity)
    else
      # Якщо товар ще не виставлений, створюємо новий лістінг
      list_on_ebay
    end
  end
  
  def list_on_ebay
    item_id = EbayService.add_item(self)
    update_column(:ebay_item_id, item_id) if item_id
  end
end
```

### services/ebay_service.rb
```ruby
require 'ebayapi'
require 'dotenv'
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class EbayService
  class << self
    def client
      @client ||= EbayAPI.new(
        appid: ENV['EBAY_APP_ID'],
        certid: ENV['EBAY_CERT_ID'],
        devid: ENV['EBAY_DEV_ID'],
        token: ENV['EBAY_AUTH_TOKEN'],
        sandbox: ENV['EBAY_SANDBOX'] == 'true'
      )
    end
    
    def add_item(product)
      begin
        response = client.add_item(
          item: {
            Title: product.name,
            Description: product.description || "Product #{product.sku}",
            PrimaryCategory: { CategoryID: product.category_id || '267' }, # default: Clothing, Shoes & Accessories
            StartPrice: product.price,
            Quantity: product.quantity,
            Country: 'US',
            Currency: 'USD',
            ConditionID: 1000, # New
            ListingDuration: 'Days_30',
            Location: 'United States',
            PaymentMethods: ['PayPal'],
            PayPalEmailAddress: 'your-paypal@example.com',
            DispatchTimeMax: 3,
            ReturnPolicy: {
              ReturnsAcceptedOption: 'ReturnsAccepted',
              RefundOption: 'MoneyBack',
              ReturnsWithinOption: 'Days_30',
              ShippingCostPaidByOption: 'Buyer'
            },
            ShippingDetails: {
              ShippingType: 'Flat',
              ShippingServiceOptions: {
                ShippingServicePriority: 1,
                ShippingService: 'USPSMedia',
                ShippingServiceCost: 2.99
              }
            }
          }
        )
        
        response.item_id
      rescue EbayAPI::Error => e
        puts "Помилка при додаванні товару на eBay: #{e.message}"
        nil
      end
    end
    
    def update_item_quantity(item_id, quantity)
      begin
        response = client.revise_item(
          Item: {
            ItemID: item_id,
            Quantity: quantity
          }
        )
        
        puts "Кількість товару #{item_id} оновлено до #{quantity}"
        true
      rescue EbayAPI::Error => e
        puts "Помилка при оновленні кількості товару #{item_id}: #{e.message}"
        false
      end
    end
    
    def end_listing(item_id)
      begin
        client.end_item(ItemID: item_id, EndingReason: 'NotAvailable')
        puts "Лістінг #{item_id} завершено"
        true
      rescue EbayAPI::Error => e
        puts "Помилка при завершенні лістінгу #{item_id}: #{e.message}"
        false
      end
    end
    
    def get_item_status(item_id)
      begin
        client.get_item(ItemID: item_id)
      rescue EbayAPI::Error => e
        puts "Помилка при отриманні статусу товару #{item_id}: #{e.message}"
        nil
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# config/database.rb
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'ebay_inventory.db'
)

# Create products table migration
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :products, if_not_exists: true do |t|
    t.string :name, null: false
    t.string :sku, null: false
    t.integer :quantity, default: 0
    t.decimal :price, precision: 10, scale: 2
    t.string :ebay_item_id
    t.string :status, default: 'draft' # draft, listed, ended
    t.timestamps
  end

  add_index :products, :sku, unique: true
  add_index :products, :ebay_item_id, unique: true
end

# models/product.rb
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :name, :sku, :quantity, :price, presence: true
  validates :sku, uniqueness: true
  validates :quantity, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  
  scope :listed, -> { where(status: 'listed') }
  scope :draft, -> { where(status: 'draft') }
  
  def listed?
    status == 'listed' && ebay_item_id.present?
  end
  
  def can_be_listed?
    quantity > 0 && price.present? && price > 0
  end
end

# services/ebay_service.rb
require 'ebayapi'
require 'dotenv'
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class EbayService
  def initialize
    @client = EbayAPI.new(
      auth_token: ENV['EBAY_AUTH_TOKEN'],
      site_id: ENV['EBAY_SITE_ID'] || 0, # 0 = US
      environment: ENV['EBAY_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'production'
    )
  end
  
  # List a new product on eBay
  def list_product(product)
    return { success: false, error: 'Product already listed' } if product.listed?
    return { success: false, error: 'Product cannot be listed' } unless product.can_be_listed?
    
    begin
      response = @client.trading.add_item(
        Item: {
          Title: product.name,
          Description: "New #{product.name} in excellent condition",
          PrimaryCategory: { CategoryID: ENV['EBAY_CATEGORY_ID'] || '267' }, # Default: Books
          StartPrice: product.price,
          Quantity: product.quantity,
          Country: 'US',
          Location: ENV['EBAY_LOCATION'] || 'United States',
          Currency: 'USD',
          ConditionID: 1000, # New
          ListingDuration: 'Days_30',
          PaymentMethods: ['PayPal'],
          PayPalEmailAddress: ENV['PAYPAL_EMAIL'],
          DispatchTimeMax: 3,
          ReturnPolicy: {
            ReturnsAcceptedOption: 'ReturnsAccepted',
            RefundOption: 'MoneyBack',
            ReturnsWithinOption: 'Days_30',
            ShippingCostPaidByOption: 'Buyer'
          },
          ShippingDetails: {
            ShippingType: 'Flat',
            ShippingServiceOptions: {
              ShippingServicePriority: 1,
              ShippingService: 'USPSMedia',
              ShippingServiceCost: 3.99
            }
          }
        }
      )
      
      if response.success?
        item_id = response.item_id
        { success: true, item_id: item_id }
      else
        { success: false, error: response.errors.join(', ') }
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  # Update product quantity on eBay
  def update_quantity(product)
    return { success: false, error: 'Product not listed on eBay' } unless product.listed?
    
    begin
      response = @client.trading.revise_item(
        Item: {
          ItemID: product.ebay_item_id,
          Quantity: product.quantity
        }
      )
      
      { success: response.success?, error: response.errors&.join(', ') }
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  # End listing on eBay
  def end_listing(product)
    return { success: false, error: 'Product not listed on eBay' } unless product.listed?
    
    begin
      response = @client.trading.end_item(
        ItemID: product.ebay_item_id,
        EndingReason: 'NotAvailable'
      )
      
      if response.success?
        { success: true }
      else
        { success: false, error: response.errors.join(', ') }
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
end

# services/inventory_service.rb
class InventoryService
  def initialize
    @ebay_service = EbayService.new
  end
  
  # List all draft products that can be listed
  def list_new_products
    products = Product.draft.where('quantity > 0')
    results = []
    
    products.each do |product|
      result = @ebay_service.list_product(product)
      
      if result[:success]
        product.update!(
          ebay_item_id: result[:item_id],
          status: 'listed'
        )
        results << { product: product.sku, status: 'listed', item_id: result[:item_id] }
      else
        results << { product: product.sku, status: 'failed', error: result[:error] }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  # Update quantities for all listed products
  def update_quantities
    products = Product.listed
    results = []
    
    products.each do |product|
      # Skip if quantity hasn't changed since last sync (you might want to track this)
      result = @ebay_service.update_quantity(product)
      
      if result[:success]
        results << { product: product.sku, status: 'updated' }
      else
        results << { product: product.sku, status: 'failed', error: result[:error] }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  # Update quantity for a specific product
  def update_product_quantity(product_sku, new_quantity)
    product = Product.find_by(sku: product_sku)
    return { success: false, error: 'Product not found' } unless product
    
    product.quantity = new_quantity
    
    if product.save
      if product.listed?
        @ebay_service.update_quantity(product)
      else
        { success: true, status: 'updated_locally' }
      end
    else
      { success: false, error: product.errors.full_messages.join(', ') }
    end
  end
  
  # End listing for products that are out of stock
  def end_out_of_stock_listings
    products = Product.listed.where(quantity: 0)
    results = []
    
    products.each do |product|
      result = @ebay_service.end_listing(product)
      
      if result[:success]
        product.update!(status: 'ended')
        results << { product: product.sku, status: 'ended' }
      else
        results << { product: product.sku, status: 'failed', error: result[:error] }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
end

# main.rb (example usage)
require_relative 'config/database'
require_relative 'models/product'
require_relative 'services/ebay_service'

# Example usage
class EbayInventoryManager
  def initialize
    @inventory_service = InventoryService.new
  end
  
  def run_daily_sync
    puts "Starting daily eBay sync..."
    
    puts "1. Listing new products..."
    list_results = @inventory_service.list_new_products
    puts "Listed #{list_results.count { |r| r[:status] == 'listed' }} products"
    
    puts "2. Updating quantities..."
    update_results = @inventory_service.update_quantities
    puts "Updated #{update_results.count { |r| r[:status] == 'updated' }} products"
    
    puts "3. Ending out-of-stock listings..."
    end_results = @inventory_service.end_out_of_stock_listings
    puts "Ended #{end_results.count { |r| r[:status] == 'ended' }} listings"
    
    puts "Daily sync completed!"
  end
  
  # Manual product management
  def add_product(name, sku, quantity, price)
    Product.create!(
      name: name,
      sku: sku,
      quantity: quantity,
      price: price
    )
    puts "Product #{sku} added successfully!"
  end
end
```

   ```bash

   cp .env.example .env
   # Edit .env with your eBay API credentials
   ```

2. **Run the application**:
   ```bash
   ruby main.rb
   ```

3. **Key Features**:
   - Lists draft products on eBay when they have stock
   - Automatically updates quantities when stock changes
   - Ends listings for out-of-stock items
   - Maintains sync between local database and eBay

4. **API Credentials**: You'll need to obtain eBay API credentials from the eBay Developer Program.

```ruby
require 'easypost'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class CarrierRateComparison
  def initialize
    # Ініціалізація EasyPost API ключа
    EasyPost.api_key = ENV['EASYPOST_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key_here'
  end

  def compare_rates_and_purchase(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, carrier_accounts = [])
    begin
      # Створення адрес
      from_address = EasyPost::Address.create(from_address_params)
      to_address = EasyPost::Address.create(to_address_params)

      # Створення посилки
      parcel = EasyPost::Parcel.create(parcel_params)

      # Створення відправлення
      shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
        from_address: from_address,
        to_address: to_address,
        parcel: parcel,
        carrier_accounts: carrier_accounts
      )

      # Отримання тарифів
      shipment.rates.each do |rate|
        puts "Перевізник: #{rate.carrier}, Служба: #{rate.service}, Ціна: $#{rate.rate}, Час доставки: #{rate.delivery_days} днів"
      end

      # Знаходження найдешевшого тарифу
      cheapest_rate = shipment.lowest_rate
      puts "\n🎉 Найдешевша опція:"
      puts "Перевізник: #{cheapest_rate.carrier}"
      puts "Служба: #{cheapest_rate.service}"
      puts "Ціна: $#{cheapest_rate.rate}"
      puts "Час доставки: #{cheapest_rate.delivery_days} днів"

      # Купівля етикетки
      puts "\n🛒 Купівля етикетки..."
      shipment.buy(rate: cheapest_rate)

      # Отримання посилання на етикетку
      puts "✅ Етикетка успішно придбана!"
      puts "Посилання на етикетку: #{shipment.postage_label.label_url}"
      puts "Відстежувальний номер: #{shipment.tracker.tracking_code}"

      return {
        success: true,
        shipment: shipment,
        label_url: shipment.postage_label.label_url,
        tracking_code: shipment.tracker.tracking_code,
        rate: cheapest_rate.rate,
        carrier: cheapest_rate.carrier
      }

    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      puts "❌ Помилка EasyPost: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "❌ Загальна помилка: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Додатковий метод для фільтрації за перевізниками
  def compare_specific_carriers(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, carriers = [])
    # Отримуємо всі доступні акаунти перевізників
    carrier_accounts = EasyPost::CarrierAccount.all
    
    # Фільтруємо за вказаними перевізниками
    filtered_accounts = carrier_accounts.select do |account|
      carriers.include?(account.readable_name.downcase)
    end.map(&:id)

    compare_rates_and_purchase(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, filtered_accounts)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# advanced_carrier_comparison.rb
require_relative 'carrier_rate_comparison'

class AdvancedCarrierComparison < CarrierRateComparison
  def compare_with_filters(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, options = {})
    # Фільтрація за перевізниками
    carriers = options[:carriers] || []
    # Фільтрація за максимальною ціною
    max_price = options[:max_price]
    # Фільтрація за максимальним часом доставки
    max_delivery_days = options[:max_delivery_days]

    result = if carriers.any?
               compare_specific_carriers(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params, carriers)
             else
               compare_rates_and_purchase(from_address_params, to_address_params, parcel_params)
             end

    # Додаткова фільтрація результатів
    if result[:success] && (max_price || max_delivery_days)
      filtered_result = apply_additional_filters(result, max_price, max_delivery_days)
      return filtered_result if filtered_result
    end

    result
  end

  private

  def apply_additional_filters(result, max_price, max_delivery_days)
    shipment = result[:shipment]
    
    # Фільтрація тарифів за додатковими критеріями
    filtered_rates = shipment.rates.select do |rate|
      price_ok = max_price ? rate.rate.to_f <= max_price : true
      delivery_ok = max_delivery_days ? (rate.delivery_days || Float::INFINITY) <= max_delivery_days : true
      price_ok && delivery_ok
    end

    return nil if filtered_rates.empty?

    # Вибір найдешевшого з відфільтрованих
    cheapest_filtered = filtered_rates.min_by(&:rate)
    
    # Купівля нового тарифу
    shipment.buy(rate: cheapest_filtered)
    
    {
      success: true,
      shipment: shipment,
      label_url: shipment.postage_label.label_url,
      tracking_code: shipment.tracker.tracking_code,
      rate: cheapest_filtered.rate,
      carrier: cheapest_filtered.carrier
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
        order_status_reason: order_data['OrderStatusReason'],
        raw_order_data: order_data

  def self.format_shipping_address(address)

      address['Name'],
      address['AddressLine1'],
      address['AddressLine2'],
      address['AddressLine3'],
      "#{address['City']}, #{address['StateOrRegion']} #{address['PostalCode']}",
      address['CountryCode']
    ].compact.reject(&:empty?)
    
    parts.join("\n")
  end
```

```ruby
# lib/sp_api_authenticator.rb
require 'jwt'
require 'oauth2'
require 'json'

class SpApiAuthenticator
  def initialize
    @client_id = ENV['LWA_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['LWA_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @refresh_token = ENV['REFRESH_TOKEN']
    @aws_access_key = ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID']
    @aws_secret_key = ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
    @region = ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1'
  end

  def access_token
    @access_token ||= refresh_access_token
  end

  def signed_request(method, url, params: {}, body: nil)
    uri = URI.parse(url)
    
    # Створюємо підписанний запит
    headers = {
      'User-Agent' => 'RubySPAPI/1.0',
      'x-amz-access-token' => access_token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    # Додаємо параметри для підпису AWS Signature Version 4
    aws_headers = sign_request(method, uri, headers, body.to_s)
    
    headers.merge!(aws_headers)
    
    { headers: headers, url: url }
  end

  private

  def refresh_access_token
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      @client_id,
      @client_secret,
      site: 'https://api.amazon.com',
      token_url: '/auth/o2/token'
    )

    token = client.get_token(
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
      refresh_token: @refresh_token
    )

    token.token
  rescue OAuth2::Error => e
    puts "Помилка отримання access token: #{e.response.body}"
    raise
  end

  def sign_request(method, uri, headers, body)
    # Спрощена реалізація підпису AWS Signature Version 4
    # У реальному додатку використовуйте aws-sdk-sigv4
    {
      'x-amz-date' => Time.now.utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),
      'authorization' => generate_authorization_header(method, uri, headers, body)
    }
  end

  def generate_authorization_header(method, uri, headers, body)
    # Тут має бути повна реалізація AWS Signature Version 4
    # Для спрощення повертаємо заглушку
    "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=#{@aws_access_key}/#{Time.now.utc.strftime('%Y%m%d')}/#{@region}/execute-api/aws4_request, SignedHeaders=host;x-amz-access-token;x-amz-date, Signature=placeholder"
  end
end
```

### 4. Клас для роботи з SP-API

```ruby
# lib/sp_api_client.rb
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'

class SpApiClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com'

  def initialize
    @authenticator = SpApiAuthenticator.new
  end

  def get_orders(params = {})
    default_params = {
      MarketplaceIds: 'ATVPDKIKX0DER', # US marketplace ID
      CreatedAfter: (Time.now - 7.days).iso8601 # Останні 7 днів
    }

    response = make_request(:get, '/orders/v0/orders', params: default_params.merge(params))
    
    if response.code == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  def get_order_items(order_id)
    response = make_request(:get, "/orders/v0/orders/#{order_id}/orderItems")
    
    if response.code == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def make_request(method, path, params: {}, body: nil)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}#{path}"
    url += "?#{URI.encode_www_form(params)}" if params.any?

    signed_request = @authenticator.signed_request(method, url, params: params, body: body)
    
    RestClient::Request.execute(
      method: method,
      url: signed_request[:url],
      headers: signed_request[:headers],
      payload: body ? body.to_json : nil,
      timeout: 30
    )
  rescue RestClient::Exception => e
    handle_error(e.response)
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = "SP-API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    puts error_message
    raise error_message
  end
end
```

### 5. Сервіс для синхронізації замовлень

```ruby
# services/order_sync_service.rb
class OrderSyncService
  def initialize
    @api_client = SpApiClient.new
    @synced_orders = 0
  end

  def sync_recent_orders(days_back: 7)
    puts "Синхронізація замовлень за останні #{days_back} днів..."
    
    created_after = (Time.now - days_back.days).iso8601
    next_token = nil
    
    loop do
      params = { CreatedAfter: created_after }
      params[:NextToken] = next_token if next_token
      
      response = @api_client.get_orders(params)
      orders = response['payload']['Orders'] || []
      
      orders.each do |order_data|
        sync_order(order_data)
      end
      
      @synced_orders += orders.size
      next_token = response['payload']['NextToken']
      
      break unless next_token
    end
    
    puts "Синхронізація завершена. Оброблено #{@synced_orders} замовлень."
  end

  def sync_specific_order(order_id)
    puts "Синхронізація замовлення #{order_id}..."
    
    # Отримуємо деталі замовлення та його items
    order_response = @api_client.get_orders({ AmazonOrderIds: [order_id] })
    order_data = order_response['payload']['Orders']&.first
    
    if order_data
      sync_order(order_data)
      puts "Замовлення #{order_id} успішно синхронізовано."
    else
      puts "Замовлення #{order_id} не знайдено."
    end
  end

  private

  def sync_order(order_data)
    begin
      Order.create_from_api_data(order_data)
      puts "Збережено замовлення: #{order_data['AmazonOrderId']}"
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при збереженні замовлення #{order_data['AmazonOrderId']}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. Сервіс експорту (lib/google_merchant_exporter.rb)

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'

class GoogleMerchantExporter
  def initialize(products, options = {})
    @products = products
    @options = {
      title_max_length: 150,
      description_max_length: 5000,
      encoding: 'UTF-8'
    }.merge(options)
  end
  
  def generate_xml
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: @options[:encoding]) do |xml|
      xml.rss('version' => '2.0', 
              'xmlns:g' => 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0') do
        xml.channel do
          add_channel_info(xml)
          add_items(xml)
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end
  
  def export_to_file(filename)
    xml_content = generate_xml
    File.write(filename, xml_content)
    puts "Експорт завершено: #{filename}"
  end
  
  private
  
  def add_channel_info(xml)
    xml.title @options[:store_name] || 'Каталог товарів'
    xml.link @options[:store_url] || 'https://example.com'
    xml.description @options[:store_description] || 'Каталог товарів магазину'
  end
  
  def add_items(xml)
    @products.each do |product|
      xml.item do
        add_product_fields(xml, product)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def add_product_fields(xml, product)
    # Обов'язкові поля
    xml.send('g:id', product.id.to_s)
    xml.title truncate_text(product.title, @options[:title_max_length])
    xml.description truncate_text(product.description, @options[:description_max_length])
    xml.link product.link
    xml.send('g:image_link', product.image_link)
    xml.send('g:price', format_price(product.price))
    xml.send('g:availability', product.available? ? 'in stock' : 'out of stock')
    xml.send('g:condition', product.condition || 'new')
    
    # Рекомендовані поля
    xml.send('g:brand', product.brand) if product.brand
    xml.send('g:gtin', product.gtin) if product.gtin
    xml.send('g:mpn', product.mpn) if product.mpn
    xml.send('g:google_product_category', product.google_product_category) if product.google_product_category
    xml.send('g:product_type', product.product_type) if product.product_type
  end
  
  def truncate_text(text, max_length)
    return '' unless text
    text.length > max_length ? text[0...max_length] : text
  end
  
  def format_price(price)
    return '' unless price
    "#{sprintf('%.2f', price)} USD"
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# product_feed_exporter.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_record'
require 'active_model'

# Product model
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :title, :description, :link, :image_link, :price, presence: true
  validates :price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :availability, inclusion: { in: %w[in_stock out_of_stock preorder] }
  
  def google_product_category
    # This would typically come from your category mapping
    # Google requires specific category IDs (numeric)
    @google_product_category ||= determine_google_category
  end
  
  def condition
    @condition ||= 'new' # Can be 'new', 'used', or 'refurbished'
  end
  
  private
  
  def determine_google_category
    # Simple mapping - you'll want to expand this based on your categories
    case category
    when 'Electronics' then 267
    when 'Clothing' then 2271
    when 'Books' then 784
    when 'Home & Garden' then 207
    else 783 # Miscellaneous
    end
  end
end

# Product Feed Generator
class GoogleMerchantFeed
  attr_reader :products, :namespace
  
  def initialize(products)
    @products = Array(products)
    @namespace = {
      'xmlns' => 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0',
      'version' => '2.0'
    }
  end
  
  def generate
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.rss(@namespace) do
        xml.channel do
          xml.title 'Product Feed'
          xml.link 'https://yourstore.com'
          xml.description 'Product feed for Google Merchant Center'
          
          products.each do |product|
            add_product_item(xml, product)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end
  
  def save_to_file(filename)
    File.write(filename, generate)
  end
  
  private
  
  def add_product_item(xml, product)
    xml.item do
      # Required fields
      xml.id_ product.id
      xml.title product.title
      xml.description product.description
      xml.link product.link
      xml['g'].image_link product.image_link, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
      xml['g'].price "#{product.price} #{product.currency || 'USD'}", xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
      xml['g'].availability product.availability, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
      xml['g'].condition product.condition, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
      
      # Recommended fields
      xml['g'].brand product.brand, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.brand
      xml['g'].gtin product.gtin, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.gtin
      xml['g'].mpn product.mpn, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.mpn
      xml['g'].product_type product.category, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.category
      xml['g'].google_product_category product.google_product_category, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
      
      # Optional fields
      xml['g'].sale_price "#{product.sale_price} #{product.currency || 'USD'}", xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.sale_price
      xml['g'].additional_image_link product.additional_image_link, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.additional_image_link
      xml['g'].size product.size, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.size
      xml['g'].color product.color, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.color
      xml['g'].gender product.gender, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.gender
      xml['g'].age_group product.age_group, xmlns: 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0' if product.age_group
    end
  end
end
```


## Key Features

1. **Required Fields**: Includes all mandatory Google Merchant Center fields (id, title, description, link, image_link, price, availability, condition)
2. **Recommended Fields**: Supports brand, GTIN, MPN, product_type, and google_product_category
3. **Optional Fields**: Includes sale_price, additional_image_link, size, color, gender, age_group
4. **Validation**: Product model includes basic validation for required fields
5. **Flexible**: Works with ActiveRecord models or plain Ruby objects

## Important Notes

- You'll need to map your product categories to Google's taxonomy IDs
- Ensure all URLs are absolute and accessible
- Prices should include currency code
- Images must meet Google's requirements (size, format, etc.)
- The feed should be regularly updated and submitted to Google Merchant Center

Run `bundle install` first to install the required gems, then execute the script to generate your XML feed.

```ruby
class AdvancedBarcodeLabelGenerator
  def initialize(products, labels_per_page: 4)
    @products = products
    @labels_per_page = labels_per_page
  end

  def generate_pdf(filename = 'advanced_product_labels.pdf')
    Prawn::Document.generate(filename, page_size: 'A4', margin: 20) do |pdf|
      pdf.font 'Helvetica'
      
      # Розділяємо товари на групи для кожної сторінки
      @products.each_slice(@labels_per_page).each do |product_group|
        generate_page(pdf, product_group)
        pdf.start_new_page unless product_group.last == @products.last
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_page(pdf, products)
    # Створюємо таблицю для розміщення етикеток
    table_data = products.map do |product|
      [create_label_cell(pdf, product)]
    end.each_slice(2).to_a # По 2 етикетки в рядку

      table.cells.padding = 10
      table.cells.align = :center
    end
  end

      pdf.move_down 8

      pdf.font_size 10
      pdf.text "EAN-13: #{product[:ean_code]}", align: :center

      temp_file.unlink
    end
  end
```

Here's a Ruby implementation that validates and normalizes US shipping addresses using the USPS API:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'nokogiri'
gem 'dotenv'
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# usps_address_validator.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class USPSAddressValidator
  include HTTParty
  
  # USPS API endpoints
  PRODUCTION_BASE_URI = 'https://secure.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'
  TEST_BASE_URI = 'https://production.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPITest.dll'
  
  def initialize(usps_user_id = nil)
    @usps_user_id = usps_user_id || ENV['USPS_USER_ID']
    @base_uri = ENV['USPS_TEST_MODE'] ? TEST_BASE_URI : PRODUCTION_BASE_URI
    
    unless @usps_user_id
      raise ArgumentError, "USPS User ID is required. Set USPS_USER_ID environment variable or pass as argument."
    end
  end
  
  # Validates and normalizes a single address
  # @param address [Hash] Address hash with keys: :address1, :address2, :city, :state, :zip5, :zip4
  # @return [Hash] Validation result with normalized address and validation info
  def validate_address(address)
    xml_request = build_address_validation_xml(address)
    response = make_api_request('Verify', xml_request)
    
    parse_validation_response(response)
  end
  
  # Validates multiple addresses in a single request
  # @param addresses [Array<Hash>] Array of address hashes
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Array of validation results
  def validate_addresses(addresses)
    xml_request = build_batch_validation_xml(addresses)
    response = make_api_request('Verify', xml_request)
    
    parse_batch_validation_response(response)
  end
  
  # Gets ZIP code information for an address
  # @param address [Hash] Address hash
  # @return [Hash] ZIP code information
  def zip_code_lookup(address)
    xml_request = build_zip_lookup_xml(address)
    response = make_api_request('ZipCodeLookup', xml_request)
    
    parse_zip_lookup_response(response)
  end
  
  # Gets city/state information for a ZIP code
  # @param zip5 [String] 5-digit ZIP code
  # @return [Hash] City/state information
  def city_state_lookup(zip5)
    xml_request = build_city_state_lookup_xml(zip5)
    response = make_api_request('CityStateLookup', xml_request)
    
    parse_city_state_lookup_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_address_validation_xml(address)
    <<~XML
      <AddressValidateRequest USERID="#{@usps_user_id}">
        <Revision>1</Revision>
        <Address ID="0">
          <Address1>#{escape_xml(address[:address2].to_s)}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{escape_xml(address[:address1].to_s)}</Address2>
          <City>#{escape_xml(address[:city].to_s)}</City>
          <State>#{escape_xml(address[:state].to_s)}</State>
          <Zip5>#{escape_xml(address[:zip5].to_s)}</Zip5>
          <Zip4>#{escape_xml(address[:zip4].to_s)}</Zip4>
        </Address>
      </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end
  
  def build_batch_validation_xml(addresses)
    xml = <<~XML
      <AddressValidateRequest USERID="#{@usps_user_id}">
        <Revision>1</Revision>
    XML
    
    addresses.each_with_index do |address, index|
      xml += <<~XML
        <Address ID="#{index}">
          <Address1>#{escape_xml(address[:address2].to_s)}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{escape_xml(address[:address1].to_s)}</Address2>
          <City>#{escape_xml(address[:city].to_s)}</City>
          <State>#{escape_xml(address[:state].to_s)}</State>
          <Zip5>#{escape_xml(address[:zip5].to_s)}</Zip5>
          <Zip4>#{escape_xml(address[:zip4].to_s)}</Zip4>
        </Address>
      XML
    end
    
    xml += '</AddressValidateRequest>'
    xml
  end
  
  def build_zip_lookup_xml(address)
    <<~XML
      <ZipCodeLookupRequest USERID="#{@usps_user_id}">
        <Address ID="0">
          <Address1>#{escape_xml(address[:address2].to_s)}</Address1>
          <Address2>#{escape_xml(address[:address1].to_s)}</Address2>
          <City>#{escape_xml(address[:city].to_s)}</City>
          <State>#{escape_xml(address[:state].to_s)}</State>
        </Address>
      </ZipCodeLookupRequest>
    XML
  end
  
  def build_city_state_lookup_xml(zip5)
    <<~XML
      <CityStateLookupRequest USERID="#{@usps_user_id}">
        <ZipCode ID="0">
          <Zip5>#{escape_xml(zip5)}</Zip5>
        </ZipCode>
      </CityStateLookupRequest>
    XML
  end
  
  def make_api_request(api_name, xml_request)
    response = self.class.get(@base_uri, query: { API: api_name, XML: xml_request })
    
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      raise "USPS API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_validation_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    # Check for errors
    error = doc.at_xpath('//Error')
    if error
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: {
          number: error.at_xpath('Number')&.text,
          description: error.at_xpath('Description')&.text,
          source: error.at_xpath('Source')&.text
        }
      }
    end
    
    address = doc.at_xpath('//Address')
    return { valid: false, error: { description: 'No address found in response' } } unless address
    
    {
      valid: true,
      normalized_address: {
        address1: address.at_xpath('Address2')&.text,
        address2: address.at_xpath('Address1')&.text,
        city: address.at_xpath('City')&.text,
        state: address.at_xpath('State')&.text,
        zip5: address.at_xpath('Zip5')&.text,
        zip4: address.at_xpath('Zip4')&.text
      },
      details: {
        delivery_point: address.at_xpath('DeliveryPoint')&.text,
        carrier_route: address.at_xpath('CarrierRoute')&.text,
        footnotes: address.at_xpath('Footnotes')&.text,
        dpv_confirmation: address.at_xpath('DPVConfirmation')&.text,
        dpv_cmra: address.at_xpath('DPVCMRA')&.text,
        dpv_footnotes: address.at_xpath('DPVFootnotes')&.text,
        business: address.at_xpath('Business')&.text,
        central_delivery_point: address.at_xpath('CentralDeliveryPoint')&.text,
        vacant: address.at_xpath('Vacant')&.text
      }
    }
  end
  
  def parse_batch_validation_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    addresses = doc.xpath('//Address')
    
    addresses.map do |address|
      error = address.at_xpath('Error')
      if error
        {
          valid: false,
          error: {
            number: error.at_xpath('Number')&.text,
            description: error.at_xpath('Description')&.text,
            source: error.at_xpath('Source')&.text
          }
        }
      else
        {
          valid: true,
          normalized_address: {
            address1: address.at_xpath('Address2')&.text,
            address2: address.at_xpath('Address1')&.text,
            city: address.at_xpath('City')&.text,
            state: address.at_xpath('State')&.text,
            zip5: address.at_xpath('Zip5')&.text,
            zip4: address.at_xpath('Zip4')&.text
          }
        }
      end
    end
  end
  
  def parse_zip_lookup_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    address = doc.at_xpath('//Address')
    
    {
      zip5: address.at_xpath('Zip5')&.text,
      zip4: address.at_xpath('Zip4')&.text
    }
  end
  
  def parse_city_state_lookup_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    zip_code = doc.at_xpath('//ZipCode')
    
    {
      zip5: zip_code.at_xpath('Zip5')&.text,
      city: zip_code.at_xpath('City')&.text,
      state: zip_code.at_xpath('State')&.text
    }
  end
  
  def escape_xml(text)
    text.to_s.gsub(/[&<>"']/) do |match|
      case match
      when '&' then '&'
      when '<' then '<'
      when '>' then '>'
      when '"' then '"'
      when "'" then '''
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Фонове завдання Sidekiq

```ruby
# app/jobs/price_list_import_job.rb
class PriceListImportJob
  include Sidekiq::Job
  sidekiq_options retry: 3, queue: 'imports'

  def perform(file_path, user_id = nil)
    begin
      logger.info "Початок імпорту прайс-листу з файлу: #{file_path}"
      
      # Відкриваємо Excel файл
      spreadsheet = Roo::Spreadsheet.open(file_path, extension: :xlsx)
      sheet = spreadsheet.sheet(0) # перший лист
      
      products = []
      imported_count = 0
      error_count = 0
      
      # Пропускаємо заголовок (перший рядок)
      (2..sheet.last_row).each do |row_num|
        row = sheet.row(row_num)
        
        # Припускаємо структуру: SKU, Назва, Ціна, Опис, Кількість
        product_data = {
          sku: row[0].to_s.strip,
          name: row[1].to_s.strip,
          price: row[2].to_f,
          description: row[3].to_s.strip,
          quantity: row[4].to_i,
          created_at: Time.current,
          updated_at: Time.current
        }
        
        # Перевіряємо обов'язкові поля
        if product_data[:sku].blank? || product_data[:name].blank?
          logger.warn "Пропущено рядок #{row_num}: відсутні обов'язкові поля"
          error_count += 1
          next
        end
        
        products << product_data
        
        # Імпортуємо партіями по 1000 записів
        if products.size >= 1000
          import_batch(products)
          imported_count += products.size
          products.clear
        end
      end
      
      # Імпортуємо залишок
      if products.any?
        import_batch(products)
        imported_count += products.size
      end
      
      logger.info "Імпорт завершено. Успішно: #{imported_count}, Помилок: #{error_count}"
      
      # Оновлюємо статус імпорту для користувача
      update_import_status(user_id, 'completed', imported_count, error_count) if user_id
      
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Помилка під час імпорту: #{e.message}"
      logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
      
      update_import_status(user_id, 'failed', 0, 0, e.message) if user_id
      raise e
    ensure
      # Видаляємо тимчасовий файл
      File.delete(file_path) if File.exist?(file_path)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def import_batch(products_data)
    # Використовуємо activerecord-import для ефективного масового імпорту
    Product.import(
      products_data,
      on_duplicate_key_update: {
        conflict_target: [:sku],
        columns: [:name, :price, :description, :quantity, :updated_at]
      }
    )
  end
  
  def update_import_status(user_id, status, imported_count, error_count, error_message = nil)
    # Тут можна оновити статус імпорту в базі даних або через Redis
    # Наприклад, створити запис ImportStatus або оновити користувача
    Rails.cache.write("import_status_#{user_id}", {
      status: status,
      imported_count: imported_count,
      error_count: error_count,
      error_message: error_message,
      completed_at: Time.current
    }, expires_in: 1.hour)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class PriceListsController < ApplicationController

      return
    end
```

I'll create a Ruby solution for generating EAN-13 barcodes and printing them on PDF labels. Here's the complete implementation:

## Gemfile

```ruby

source 'https://rubygems.org'

```

## Implementation

```ruby
# barcode_label_generator.rb
require 'prawn'
require 'barby'
require 'barby/barcode/ean_13'
require 'barby/outputter/png_outputter'
require 'prawn/bitmap'

class BarcodeLabelGenerator
  def initialize
    @products = []
  end

  # Add a product with name and 12-digit code (EAN-13 will add check digit)
  def add_product(name, product_code, price = nil, options = {})
    raise "Product code must be 12 digits" unless product_code.to_s.length == 12
    raise "Product code must contain only digits" unless product_code.to_s.match?(/^\d+$/)

    @products << {
      name: name,
      code: product_code,
      price: price,
      options: options
    }
  end

  # Generate EAN-13 barcode with check digit
  def generate_ean13(code)
    # Calculate EAN-13 check digit
    digits = code.to_s.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      sum += index.even? ? digit * 1 : digit * 3
    end
    check_digit = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
    full_code = "#{code}#{check_digit}"

    Barby::EAN13.new(full_code)
  end

  # Generate PNG image from barcode
  def barcode_to_png(barcode, options = {})
    outputter = Barby::PngOutputter.new(barcode)
    outputter.height = options[:height] || 80
    outputter.xdim = options[:xdim] || 2
    outputter.margin = options[:margin] || 10
    outputter.to_png
  end

  # Generate PDF with labels
  def generate_pdf(filename, options = {})
    labels_per_page = options[:labels_per_page] || 8
    label_width = options[:label_width] || 180
    label_height = options[:label_height] || 100
    margin = options[:margin] || 20

    Prawn::Document.generate(filename, 
      page_size: "A4",
      margin: margin) do |pdf|
      
      # Calculate grid layout
      labels_per_row = 2
      labels_per_column = labels_per_page / labels_per_row

      @products.each_slice(labels_per_page).with_index do |products_batch, batch_index|
        pdf.start_new_page unless batch_index == 0

        products_batch.each_with_index do |product, index|
          row = index / labels_per_row
          col = index % labels_per_row

          x = col * label_width
          y = pdf.bounds.top - (row * label_height)

          # Draw label border (optional)
          if options[:show_borders]
            pdf.stroke do
              pdf.rectangle([x, y], label_width, label_height)
            end
          end

          # Position for content within label
          content_x = x + 10
          content_y = y - 10

          # Generate barcode
          barcode = generate_ean13(product[:code])
          png_image = barcode_to_png(barcode, height: 60)

          # Create temporary file for barcode image
          temp_file = Tempfile.new(['barcode', '.png'])
          temp_file.binmode
          temp_file.write(png_image.to_s)
          temp_file.close

          # Add barcode to PDF
          pdf.bitmap temp_file.path, at: [content_x, content_y - 20], width: 160

          # Clean up temp file
          temp_file.unlink

          # Add product name
          pdf.bounding_box([content_x, content_y], width: label_width - 20, height: 20) do
            pdf.text product[:name], size: 10, align: :center, overflow: :shrink_to_fit
          end

          # Add product code
          pdf.bounding_box([content_x, content_y - 70], width: label_width - 20, height: 15) do
            pdf.text "Code: #{barcode.data}", size: 9, align: :center
          end

          # Add price if provided
          if product[:price]
            pdf.bounding_box([content_x, content_y - 85], width: label_width - 20, height: 15) do
              pdf.text "Price: $#{'%.2f' % product[:price]}", size: 9, align: :center, style: :bold
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    puts "PDF generated successfully: #{filename}"
  end

  # Generate labels for all products
  def generate_labels(filename, options = {})
    if @products.empty?
      puts "No products added. Please add products first."
      return
    end

    generate_pdf(filename, options)
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  generator = BarcodeLabelGenerator.new

  # Add sample products
  generator.add_product("Premium Coffee Beans 500g", "123456789012", 24.99)
  generator.add_product("Organic Green Tea 100g", "234567890123", 12.50)
  generator.add_product("Artisanal Honey 250ml", "345678901234", 8.75)
  generator.add_product("Handmade Soap Lavender", "456789012345", 5.99)
  generator.add_product("Organic Olive Oil 500ml", "567890123456", 15.99)
  generator.add_product("Dark Chocolate 85% 100g", "678901234567", 6.49)
  generator.add_product("Pure Maple Syrup 250ml", "789012345678", 11.25)
  generator.add_product("Sea Salt Grinder 150g", "890123456789", 4.99)

  # Generate PDF labels
  generator.generate_labels("product_labels.pdf", 
    labels_per_page: 8,
    label_width: 180,
    label_height: 100,
    margin: 20,
    show_borders: false
  )
end
```

## Additional Utility Class

```ruby
# barcode_utils.rb
require 'barby'
require 'barby/barcode/ean_13'

class BarcodeUtils
  # Validate and generate EAN-13 code
  def self.generate_ean13(product_code)
    raise "Product code must be 12 digits" unless product_code.to_s.length == 12
    raise "Product code must contain only digits" unless product_code.to_s.match?(/^\d+$/)

    # Calculate check digit
    digits = product_code.to_s.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      sum += index.even? ? digit * 1 : digit * 3
    end
    check_digit = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
    
    "#{product_code}#{check_digit}"
  end

  # Validate EAN-13 code
  def self.valid_ean13?(code)
    return false unless code.to_s.length == 13
    return false unless code.to_s.match?(/^\d+$/)
    
    generated_code = generate_ean13(code[0..11])
    generated_code == code
  end
end
```

## Main Implementation

```ruby
# image_uploader.rb
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'uri'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ProductImageUploader
  attr_reader :s3_client, :bucket_name, :cdn_domain

  # Thumbnail sizes configuration
  THUMBNAIL_SIZES = {
    small: '200x200',
    medium: '400x400',
    large: '800x800'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(bucket_name:, region: 'us-east-1', cdn_domain: nil)
    @bucket_name = bucket_name
    @cdn_domain = cdn_domain
    @s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new(
      region: region,
      access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
      secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
    )
  end

  # Main method to process and upload an image
  def upload_product_image(image_path, product_id, options = {})
    validate_image_file(image_path)
    
    # Generate unique filename
    original_filename = File.basename(image_path)
    extension = File.extname(original_filename)
    base_filename = "#{product_id}_#{Time.now.to_i}"

    # Upload original image
    original_key = "products/#{product_id}/original/#{base_filename}#{extension}"
    upload_to_s3(image_path, original_key, options[:metadata] || {})

    # Generate and upload thumbnails
    thumbnails = generate_thumbnails(image_path, product_id, base_filename, extension)

    {
      original: build_url(original_key),
      thumbnails: thumbnails
    }
  end

  # Generate thumbnails in different sizes
  def generate_thumbnails(image_path, product_id, base_filename, extension)
    thumbnails = {}

    THUMBNAIL_SIZES.each do |size_name, dimensions|
      temp_thumbnail_path = create_thumbnail(image_path, dimensions)
      
      thumbnail_key = "products/#{product_id}/#{size_name}/#{base_filename}#{extension}"
      upload_to_s3(temp_thumbnail_path, thumbnail_key)
      
      thumbnails[size_name] = build_url(thumbnail_key)
      
      # Clean up temporary file
      File.delete(temp_thumbnail_path) if File.exist?(temp_thumbnail_path)
    end

    thumbnails
  end

  # Create a thumbnail using MiniMagick
  def create_thumbnail(image_path, dimensions)
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(image_path)
    
    # Resize and maintain aspect ratio
    image.resize dimensions + '^'
    image.gravity 'center'
    image.extent dimensions
    
    # Convert to progressive JPEG for better loading
    image.format 'jpg'
    image.quality 85
    
    temp_path = "/tmp/thumbnail_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}.jpg"
    image.write(temp_path)
    
    temp_path
  end

  # Upload file to S3
  def upload_to_s3(file_path, key, metadata = {})
    file_content = File.read(file_path)
    
    s3_client.put_object(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      key: key,
      body: file_content,
      content_type: content_type_for(file_path),
      metadata: metadata,
      acl: 'public-read' # Adjust based on your security requirements
    )
    
    puts "Uploaded: #{key}"
  rescue Aws::S3::Errors::ServiceError => e
    puts "Error uploading to S3: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end

  # Build URL with CDN if configured
  def build_url(key)
    if cdn_domain
      URI::HTTPS.build(host: cdn_domain, path: "/#{key}").to_s
    else
      "https://#{bucket_name}.s3.amazonaws.com/#{key}"
    end
  end

  # Delete product images (original + thumbnails)
  def delete_product_images(product_id)
    objects = list_product_objects(product_id)
    
    return if objects.empty?
    
    s3_client.delete_objects(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      delete: {
        objects: objects.map { |obj| { key: obj.key } }
      }
    )
    
    puts "Deleted #{objects.size} images for product #{product_id}"
  end

  private

  def list_product_objects(product_id)
    resp = s3_client.list_objects_v2(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      prefix: "products/#{product_id}/"
    )
    
    resp.contents || []
  end

  def validate_image_file(image_path)
    unless File.exist?(image_path)
      raise ArgumentError, "Image file not found: #{image_path}"
    end
    
    # Basic image format validation
    unless ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.webp'].include?(File.extname(image_path).downcase)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported image format"
    end
  end

  def content_type_for(file_path)
    extension = File.extname(file_path).downcase
    case extension
    when '.jpg', '.jpeg' then 'image/jpeg'
    when '.png' then 'image/png'
    when '.gif' then 'image/gif'
    when '.webp' then 'image/webp'
    else 'application/octet-stream'
    end
  end
end

# Rake tasks for common operations
namespace :images do
  desc "Upload a product image"
  task :upload, [:image_path, :product_id] do |t, args|
    uploader = ProductImageUploader.new(
      bucket_name: ENV['S3_BUCKET'],
      cdn_domain: ENV['CDN_DOMAIN']
    )
    
    result = uploader.upload_product_image(args[:image_path], args[:product_id])
    puts "Upload successful!"
    puts "Original: #{result[:original]}"
    puts "Thumbnails: #{result[:thumbnails].inspect}"
  end

  desc "Delete all images for a product"
  task :delete, [:product_id] do |t, args|
    uploader = ProductImageUploader.new(bucket_name: ENV['S3_BUCKET'])
    uploader.delete_product_images(args[:product_id])
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Product < ApplicationRecord
  include Elasticsearch::Model
  include Elasticsearch::Model::Callbacks

  # Атрибути моделі (приклад)
  # title, description, price, category_id, brand, tags, in_stock, created_at

  settings index: { number_of_shards: 1 } do
    mappings dynamic: 'false' do
      indexes :title, type: 'text', analyzer: 'english'
      indexes :description, type: 'text', analyzer: 'english'
      indexes :brand, type: 'keyword'
      indexes :category_id, type: 'keyword'
      indexes :tags, type: 'keyword'
      indexes :price, type: 'float'
      indexes :in_stock, type: 'boolean'
      indexes :created_at, type: 'date'
      
      # Для повнотекстового пошуку в усіх текстових полях
      indexes :searchable, type: 'text', analyzer: 'english'
    end
  end

  def as_indexed_json(options = {})
    {
      title: title,
      description: description,
      brand: brand,
      category_id: category_id,
      tags: tags,
      price: price,
      in_stock: in_stock,
      created_at: created_at,
      searchable: searchable_content
    }
  end

  def searchable_content
    [title, description, brand, tags].join(' ')
  end

  # Клас для пошуку
  class << self
    def search(query, filters = {})
      search_definition = SearchBuilder.new(query, filters).build
      __elasticsearch__.search(search_definition)
    end

    # Створення/оновлення індексу
    def create_index!(force: false)
      if force
        __elasticsearch__.delete_index! if __elasticsearch__.index_exists?
      end
      __elasticsearch__.create_index! unless __elasticsearch__.index_exists?
      import
    end
  end
end
```

## Будівельник пошукових запитів

```ruby
# app/services/search_builder.rb
class SearchBuilder
  include Elasticsearch::DSL

  def initialize(query, filters = {})
    @query = query.to_s.strip
    @filters = filters || {}
  end

  def build
    search do
      query do
        bool do
          # Повнотекстовий пошук
          must { match(:searchable, @query) } if @query.present?
          
          # Фільтри
          apply_filters(self)
        end
      end

      # Фасети/Агрегації
      aggregation :categories do
        terms field: 'category_id', size: 10
      end

      aggregation :brands do
        terms field: 'brand', size: 10
      end

      aggregation :price_ranges do
        range field: 'price' do
          ranges [
            { key: 'under_50', to: 50 },
            { key: '50_to_100', from: 50, to: 100 },
            { key: '100_to_200', from: 100, to: 200 },
            { key: 'over_200', from: 200 }
          ]
        end
      end

      aggregation :in_stock do
        terms field: 'in_stock'
      end

      # Сортування
      sort { by :_score, order: 'desc' } if @query.present?
      sort { by :created_at, order: 'desc' } if @query.blank?

      # Пагінація
      from @filters[:offset] || 0
      size @filters[:limit] || 20
    end
  end

  private

  def apply_filters(search_obj)
    # Фільтр за категоріями
    if @filters[:category_ids].present?
      search_obj.filter << { terms: { category_id: Array(@filters[:category_ids]) } }
    end

    # Фільтр за брендами
    if @filters[:brands].present?
      search_obj.filter << { terms: { brand: Array(@filters[:brands]) } }
    end

    # Фільтр за ціною
    if @filters[:price_min].present? || @filters[:price_max].present?
      price_range = {}
      price_range[:gte] = @filters[:price_min].to_f if @filters[:price_min].present?
      price_range[:lte] = @filters[:price_max].to_f if @filters[:price_max].present?
      search_obj.filter << { range: { price: price_range } }
    end

    # Фільтр за наявністю
    if @filters[:in_stock].present?
      search_obj.filter << { term: { in_stock: @filters[:in_stock] == 'true' } }
    end

    # Фільтр за тегами
    if @filters[:tags].present?
      search_obj.filter << { terms: { tags: Array(@filters[:tags]) } }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/controllers/search_controller.rb
class SearchController < ApplicationController
  def products
    search_params = params.permit(:q, :category_ids, :brands, :price_min, :price_max, :in_stock, :tags, :page, :per_page)
    
    filters = {
      category_ids: Array(search_params[:category_ids]).reject(&:blank?),
      brands: Array(search_params[:brands]).reject(&:blank?),
      price_min: search_params[:price_min],
      price_max: search_params[:price_max],
      in_stock: search_params[:in_stock],
      tags: Array(search_params[:tags]).reject(&:blank?),
      offset: (search_params[:page].to_i - 1) * (search_params[:per_page] || 20).to_i,
      limit: search_params[:per_page] || 20
    }

    @search_results = Product.search(search_params[:q], filters)
    @products = @search_results.records
    @aggregations = @search_results.aggregations

    render json: {
      products: @products.as_json(only: [:id, :title, :description, :price, :brand, :in_stock]),
      facets: build_facets(@aggregations),
      total: @search_results.total,
      current_page: search_params[:page] || 1,
      per_page: search_params[:per_page] || 20
    }
  end

  private

  def build_facets(aggregations)
    {
      categories: aggregations['categories']['buckets'].map do |bucket|
        {
          id: bucket['key'],
          count: bucket['doc_count']
        }
      end,
      brands: aggregations['brands']['buckets'].map do |bucket|
        {
          name: bucket['key'],
          count: bucket['doc_count']
        }
      end,
      price_ranges: aggregations['price_ranges']['buckets'].map do |bucket|
        {
          range: bucket['key'],
          count: bucket['doc_count']
        }
      end,
      in_stock: {
        true: aggregations['in_stock']['buckets'].find { |b| b['key'] == true }&.dig('doc_count') || 0,
        false: aggregations['in_stock']['buckets'].find { |b| b['key'] == false }&.dig('doc_count') || 0
      }
    }
  end
end
```
