Here's a Ruby implementation for importing a large product price list from an Excel file in a background job: ## Gemfile ```ruby # Gemfile source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'rails', '~> 7.0' gem 'sidekiq', '~> 7.0' gem 'redis', '~> 4.0' gem 'roo', '~> 2.10' gem 'axlsx_rails', '~> 0.6' gem 'rubyzip', '>= 1.3.0' ``` ## Implementation ### 1. Product Model ```ruby # app/models/product.rb class Product < ApplicationRecord validates :sku, presence: true, uniqueness: true validates :name, presence: true validates :price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 } end ``` ### 2. Price Import Model (to track import operations) ```ruby # app/models/price_import.rb class PriceImport < ApplicationRecord has_many :import_errors enum status: { pending: 0, processing: 1, completed: 2, failed: 3 } validates :filename, presence: true def total_records successful_imports + failed_imports end end # app/models/import_error.rb class ImportError < ApplicationRecord belongs_to :price_import validates :row_number, presence: true validates :error_message, presence: true end ``` ### 3. Excel Parser Service ```ruby # app/services/excel_price_parser.rb class ExcelPriceParser require 'roo' def initialize(file_path) @file_path = file_path @spreadsheet = Roo::Spreadsheet.open(file_path) @worksheet = @spreadsheet.sheet(0) end def parse_rows rows = [] # Skip header row (assuming first row is headers) (2..@worksheet.last_row).each do |row_num| row_data = { row_number: row_num, sku: @worksheet.cell(row_num, 1)&.to_s&.strip, name: @worksheet.cell(row_num, 2)&.to_s&.strip, price: parse_price(@worksheet.cell(row_num, 3)), description: @worksheet.cell(row_num, 4)&.to_s&.strip, category: @worksheet.cell(row_num, 5)&.to_s&.strip } rows << row_data if valid_row?(row_data) end rows rescue StandardError => e raise "Error parsing Excel file: #{e.message}" end def headers @worksheet.row(1) end def total_rows @worksheet.last_row - 1 # Exclude header end private def parse_price(value) return nil if value.nil? # Handle different price formats: "100.00", "$100.00", "100,00" price_str = value.to_s.gsub(/[^\d.,]/, '').gsub(',', '.') BigDecimal(price_str) rescue nil end def valid_row?(row_data) row_data[:sku].present? && row_data[:name].present? && row_data[:price].present? end end ``` ### 4. Background Job ```ruby # app/jobs/price_import_job.rb class PriceImportJob < ApplicationJob queue_as :default def perform(price_import_id, file_path) price_import = PriceImport.find(price_import_id) price_import.update!(status: :processing, started_at: Time.current) parser = ExcelPriceParser.new(file_path) total_rows = parser.total_rows price_import.update!(total_rows: total_rows) successful_imports = 0 failed_imports = 0 # Process in batches to avoid memory issues batch_size = 1000 current_batch = [] parser.parse_rows.each do |row_data| current_batch << row_data if current_batch.size >= batch_size processed = process_batch(current_batch, price_import) successful_imports += processed[:successful] failed_imports += processed[:failed] current_batch = [] end end # Process remaining records unless current_batch.empty? processed = process_batch(current_batch, price_import) successful_imports += processed[:successful] failed_imports += processed[:failed] end price_import.update!( status: :completed, completed_at: Time.current, successful_imports: successful_imports, failed_imports: failed_imports ) # Clean up the uploaded file File.delete(file_path) if File.exist?(file_path) rescue StandardError => e price_import.update!( status: :failed, completed_at: Time.current, error_message: e.message ) raise e # Re-raise for Sidekiq retry mechanism end private def process_batch(batch, price_import) successful = 0 failed = 0 batch.each do |row_data| result = import_product(row_data) if result[:success] successful += 1 else failed += 1 create_import_error(price_import, row_data[:row_number], result[:error]) end end { successful: successful, failed: failed } end def import_product(row_data) product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(sku: row_data[:sku]) product.assign_attributes( name: row_data[:name], price: row_data[:price], description: row_data[:description], category: row_data[:category] ) if product.save { success: true } else { success: false, error: product.errors.full_messages.join(', ') } end end def create_import_error(price_import, row_number, error_message) ImportError.create!( price_import: price_import, row_number: row_number, error_message: error_message, raw_data: error_message ) end end ``` ### 5. Controller for Uploading Files ```ruby # app/controllers/price_imports_controller.rb class PriceImportsController < ApplicationController def new @price_import = PriceImport.new end def create uploaded_file = params[:price_import][:file] if uploaded_file.nil? redirect_to new_price_import_path, alert: 'Please select a file' return end # Validate file type unless valid_file_type?(uploaded_file.original_filename) redirect_to new_price_import_path, alert: 'Please upload a valid Excel file (.xlsx, .xls)' return end # Save file temporarily file_path = Rails.root.join('tmp', "price_import_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{uploaded_file.original_filename}") File.open(file_path, 'wb') do |file| file.write(uploaded_file.read) end # Create import record price_import = PriceImport.create!( filename: uploaded_file.original_filename, status: :pending, uploaded_by: current_user&.id ) # Start background job PriceImportJob.perform_later(price_import.id, file_path.to_s) redirect_to price_import_path(price_import), notice: 'Price import started successfully' rescue StandardError => e redirect_to new_price_import_path, alert: "Error starting import: #{e.message}" end def show @price_import = PriceImport.includes(:import_errors).find(params[:id]) end private def valid_file_type?(filename) ['.xlsx', '.xls'].include?(File.extname(filename).downcase) end end ``` ### 6. Sidekiq Configuration ```ruby # config/initializers/sidekiq.rb Sidekiq.configure_server do |config| config.redis = { url: 'redis://localhost:6379/0' } end Sidekiq.configure_client do |config| config.redis = { url: 'redis://localhost:6379/0' } end ``` ### 7. Database Migrations ```ruby # db/migrate/20240101000000_create_products.rb class CreateProducts < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0] def change create_table :products do |t| t.string :sku, null: false, index: { unique: true } t.string :name, null: false t.decimal :price, precision: 10, scale: 2, null: false t.text :description t.string :category t.timestamps end end end # db/migrate/20240101000001_create_price_imports.rb class CreatePriceImports < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0] def change create_table :price_imports do |t| t.string :filename, null: false t.integer :status, default: 0 t.integer :total_rows t.integer :successful_imports, default: 0 t.integer :failed_imports, default: 0 t.text :error_message t.datetime :started_at t.datetime :completed_at t.integer :uploaded_by t.timestamps end end end # db/migrate/20240101000002_create_import_errors.rb class CreateImportErrors < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0] def change create_table :import_errors do |t| t.references :price_import, null: false, foreign_key: true t.integer :row_number, null: false t.text :error_message, null: false t.text :raw_data t.timestamps end end end ``` ### 8. View Template ```erb

Import Product Prices

<%= form_with model: @price_import, url: price_imports_path, multipart: true do |form| %>
<%= form.label :file, "Excel File" %> <%= form.file_field :file, accept: '.xlsx,.xls', required: true %> Supported formats: .xlsx, .xls
<%= form.submit "Start Import" %>
<% end %>

Expected Excel format:
- First row: Headers (SKU, Name, Price, Description, Category)
- Subsequent rows: Product data

``` ### 9. Routes ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do resources :price_imports, only: [:new, :create, :show] # ... other routes end ``` ## Usage 1. Start Redis server: `redis-server` 2. Start Sidekiq: `bundle exec sidekiq` 3. Upload an Excel file through the web interface 4. Monitor the import progress through the show page This implementation handles large files efficiently by processing in batches, provides error tracking, and gives feedback on the import progress.

I'll create a complete Ruby on Rails application with Elasticsearch integration for product search. Here's the implementation: ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' # Core Rails gems gem 'rails', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'sqlite3' gem 'puma', '~> 5.0' gem 'sass-rails' gem 'webpacker' # Elasticsearch integration gem 'elasticsearch-model' gem 'elasticsearch-rails' gem 'searchkick' # Additional utilities gem 'kaminari' # For pagination gem 'jbuilder' # For JSON API responses group :development do gem 'spring' gem 'spring-watcher-listen' end ``` ## Product Model (app/models/product.rb) ```ruby class Product < ApplicationRecord include Elasticsearch::Model include Elasticsearch::Model::Callbacks searchkick word_start: [:name, :description], suggest: [:name], filterable: [:category, :brand, :price_range, :in_stock] # Define attributes validates :name, :price, :category, presence: true validates :price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 } # Define price ranges for faceting def search_data { name: name, description: description, category: category, brand: brand, price: price, in_stock: in_stock, price_range: price_range, created_at: created_at } end private def price_range case price when 0..50 then "0-50" when 51..100 then "51-100" when 101..200 then "101-200" when 201..500 then "201-500" else "500+" end end end ``` ## Search Service (app/services/product_search_service.rb) ```ruby class ProductSearchService def initialize(params = {}) @query = params[:q] || '*' @category = params[:category] @brand = params[:brand] @price_range = params[:price_range] @in_stock = params[:in_stock] @min_price = params[:min_price] @max_price = params[:max_price] @page = params[:page] || 1 @per_page = params[:per_page] || 20 @sort_by = params[:sort_by] || 'relevance' end def search search_options = { page: @page, per_page: @per_page, where: where_conditions, aggs: aggregations, order: sort_order, match: :word_start } Product.search(@query, search_options) end private def where_conditions conditions = {} conditions[:category] = @category if @category.present? conditions[:brand] = @brand if @brand.present? conditions[:price_range] = @price_range if @price_range.present? conditions[:in_stock] = @in_stock == 'true' if @in_stock.present? # Price range filter price_condition = {} price_condition[:gte] = @min_price.to_f if @min_price.present? price_condition[:lte] = @max_price.to_f if @max_price.present? conditions[:price] = price_condition if price_condition.present? conditions end def aggregations { category: {}, brand: {}, price_range: {}, in_stock: {} } end def sort_order case @sort_by when 'price_asc' { price: :asc } when 'price_desc' { price: :desc } when 'name' { name: :asc } when 'newest' { created_at: :desc } else { _score: :desc } # relevance end end end ``` ## Products Controller (app/controllers/products_controller.rb) ```ruby class ProductsController < ApplicationController def index search_service = ProductSearchService.new(search_params) @search_result = search_service.search @products = @search_result.results @aggregations = @search_result.aggs respond_to do |format| format.html format.json { render json: search_response } end end def suggest suggestions = Product.search( params[:q], fields: [:name], match: :word_start, limit: 10, load: false, misspellings: { below: 5 } ).suggestions render json: { suggestions: suggestions } end private def search_params params.permit(:q, :category, :brand, :price_range, :in_stock, :min_price, :max_price, :page, :per_page, :sort_by) end def search_response { products: @products, total_count: @search_result.total_count, current_page: params[:page] || 1, total_pages: (@search_result.total_count / (params[:per_page] || 20).to_f).ceil, aggregations: @aggregations } end end ``` ## Routes (config/routes.rb) ```ruby Rails.application.routes.draw do resources :products, only: [:index] do collection do get :suggest end end root 'products#index' end ``` ## Search Form Partial (app/views/products/_search_form.html.erb) ```erb <%= form_with url: products_path, method: :get, local: true, class: "search-form" do |form| %>
<%= form.text_field :q, value: params[:q], placeholder: "Search products...", class: "search-input", data: { autocomplete_url: suggest_products_path } %> <%= form.submit "Search", class: "search-button" %>
<%= form.select :category, options_for_select([['All', '']] + category_options, params[:category]), {}, class: "filter-select" %>
<%= form.select :brand, options_for_select([['All', '']] + brand_options, params[:brand]), {}, class: "filter-select" %>
<%= form.select :price_range, options_for_select([['All', '']] + price_range_options, params[:price_range]), {}, class: "filter-select" %>
<%= form.select :sort_by, options_for_select(sort_options, params[:sort_by]), {}, class: "filter-select" %>
<% end %> ``` ## Products Index View (app/views/products/index.html.erb) ```erb

<% end %> <% if @aggregations['brand'] && @aggregations['brand']['buckets'] %>

Brands

<% @aggregations['brand']['buckets'].each do |bucket| %> <%= link_to products_path(search_params.merge(brand: bucket['key'])), class: "facet-item" do %> <%= bucket['key'] %> (<%= bucket['doc_count'] %>) <% end %> <% end %>
<% end %> <% if @aggregations['price_range'] && @aggregations['price_range']['buckets'] %>

Price Range

<% @aggregations['price_range']['buckets'].each do |bucket| %> <%= link_to products_path(search_params.merge(price_range: bucket['key'])), class: "facet-item" do %> $<%= bucket['key'] %> (<%= bucket['doc_count'] %>) <% end %> <% end %>
<% end %> <% end %>

Product.reindex puts "Reindexing complete!" end end ``` ## Usage Instructions 1. **Install Elasticsearch**: Make sure Elasticsearch is running on your system 2. **Bundle install**: Run `bundle install` 3. **Create and migrate database**: `rails db:create db:migrate` 4. **Create Elasticsearch indices**: `rails elasticsearch:create_indices` 5. **Seed data**: Add some products to test the search functionality 6. **Start the server**: `rails server` ## Features Included - **Full-text search** with word start matching - **Filters** by category, brand, price range, and stock status - **Facets/aggregations** for navigation - **Sorting** by relevance, price, name, and date - **Pagination** for large result sets - **Auto-suggest** functionality - **JSON API** for frontend applications This implementation provides a robust product search system that can be easily extended with additional features like search analytics, synonyms, or advanced filtering options.

## Основна реалізація

### 1. Конфігурація (config/initializers/klaviyo.rb)

```ruby
require 'klaviyo'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

Klaviyo.configure do |config|
  config.public_api_key = ENV['KLAVIYO_PUBLIC_KEY']
```

### 2. Модель покинутого кошика (app/models/abandoned_cart.rb)

```ruby
class AbandonedCart
  attr_accessor :user_email, :items, :total_amount, :abandoned_at, :cart_token

  def initialize(user_email:, items: [], total_amount: 0, cart_token: nil)
    @user_email = user_email
    @items = items
    @total_amount = total_amount
    @abandoned_at = Time.now
    @cart_token = cart_token || SecureRandom.hex(16)
  end

  def to_klaviyo_profile
    {
      email: user_email,
      properties: {
        abandoned_cart_token: cart_token,
        abandoned_cart_total: total_amount,
        abandoned_cart_items: items.map { |item| item[:name] }.join(', '),
        abandoned_cart_items_count: items.count,
        abandoned_at: abandoned_at.iso8601
      }
    }
  end
end
```

### 3. Сервіс для роботи з Klaviyo (app/services/klaviyo_service.rb)

```ruby
class KlaviyoService
  def self.track_abandoned_cart(abandoned_cart)
    begin
      # Створюємо або оновлюємо профіль користувача
      Klaviyo::Profiles.add_profile(abandoned_cart.to_klaviyo_profile)

      # Відправляємо подію покинутого кошика
      Klaviyo::Events.track(
        event: 'Abandoned Cart',
        email: abandoned_cart.user_email,
        properties: {
          value: abandoned_cart.total_amount,
          items: abandoned_cart.items,
          cart_token: abandoned_cart.cart_token,
          abandoned_at: abandoned_cart.abandoned_at
        }
      )

      # Додаємо користувача до списку покинутих кошиків
      list_id = ENV['KLAVIYO_ABANDONED_CART_LIST_ID']
      if list_id
        Klaviyo::Lists.add_members_to_list(list_id, [{
          email: abandoned_cart.user_email
        }])
      end

      true
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error "Klaviyo error: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end

  def self.send_abandoned_cart_reminder(email, cart_token, template_id)
    begin
      # Запускаємо кампанію нагадування
      Klaviyo::Campaigns.trigger_campaign(
        campaign_id: template_id,
        recipients: [{
          email: email,
          properties: {
            cart_token: cart_token
          }
        }]
      )
      true
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error "Klaviyo campaign error: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Воркер для обробки покинутих кошиків (app/workers/abandoned_cart_worker.rb)

```ruby
class AbandonedCartWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(user_email, cart_data, delay_hours = 1)
    # Затримка перед відправкою нагадування
    sleep(delay_hours * 3600) if delay_hours > 0

    abandoned_cart = AbandonedCart.new(
      user_email: user_email,
      items: cart_data[:items],
      total_amount: cart_data[:total_amount],
      cart_token: cart_data[:cart_token]
    )

    # Відправляємо перше нагадування
    KlaviyoService.track_abandoned_cart(abandoned_cart)
    
    # Запускаємо кампанію нагадування
    template_id = ENV['KLAVIYO_ABANDONED_CART_TEMPLATE_ID']
    KlaviyoService.send_abandoned_cart_reminder(
      user_email, 
      abandoned_cart.cart_token, 
      template_id
    )
  end
end
```

### 5. Сервіс для відстеження кошиків (app/services/cart_tracker_service.rb)

```ruby
class CartTrackerService
  def initialize(redis_client = Redis.new)
    @redis = redis_client
  end

  def track_cart_activity(user_email, cart_data)
    cart_key = "cart:#{user_email}"
    
    # Зберігаємо дані кошика в Redis на 7 днів
    @redis.setex(cart_key, 7.days, cart_data.to_json)
    
    # Відзначаємо активність
    activity_key = "cart_activity:#{user_email}"
    @redis.setex(activity_key, 30.minutes, Time.now.to_i)
  end

  def check_abandoned_carts
    abandoned_carts = []
    
    # Шукаємо користувачів без активності за останні 30 хвилин
    active_keys = @redis.keys("cart_activity:*")
    
    active_keys.each do |activity_key|
      user_email = activity_key.split(':').last
      cart_key = "cart:#{user_email}"
      
      cart_data = @redis.get(cart_key)
      if cart_data
        cart = JSON.parse(cart_data, symbolize_names: true)
        abandoned_carts << {
          email: user_email,
          cart_data: cart
        }
      end
    end
    
    abandoned_carts
  end

  def mark_cart_recovered(user_email)
    # Видаляємо дані про кошик при відновленні
    @redis.del("cart:#{user_email}")
    @redis.del("cart_activity:#{user_email}")
  end
end
```

### 6. Контролер для обробки подій кошика (app/controllers/carts_controller.rb)

```ruby
class CartsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :initialize_cart_tracker

  def update
    # Оновлення кошика
    cart_data = {
      items: params[:items],
      total_amount: params[:total_amount],
      cart_token: params[:cart_token] || SecureRandom.hex(16)
    }

    # Відстежуємо активність
    @cart_tracker.track_cart_activity(current_user.email, cart_data)
    
    # Скасовуємо заплановані нагадування
    cancel_scheduled_reminders(current_user.email)
    
    render json: { success: true }
  end

  def abandoned
    # Ендпоінт для перевірки покинутих кошиків (для cron job)
    abandoned_carts = @cart_tracker.check_abandoned_carts
    
    abandoned_carts.each do |abandoned_cart|
      # Заплановати нагадування через 1 годину
      AbandonedCartWorker.perform_in(
        1.hour,
        abandoned_cart[:email],
        abandoned_cart[:cart_data]
      )
    end
    
    render json: { processed: abandoned_carts.count }
  end

  def recovered
    # Користувач повернувся до кошика
    @cart_tracker.mark_cart_recovered(current_user.email)
    render json: { success: true }
  end

  private

  def initialize_cart_tracker
    @cart_tracker = CartTrackerService.new
  end

  def cancel_scheduled_reminders(user_email)
    # Логіка для скасування запланованих нагадувань
    # (залежить від вашої реалізації Sidekiq)
  end
end
```

**Реалізація коду:**

```ruby
# etsy_api_client.rb
require 'oauth2'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class EtsyApiClient
  # Базовий URL API Etsy v3
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'
  
  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, access_token = nil)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = access_token
    
    # Створюємо OAuth2 клієнт
    @oauth_client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      client_id,
      client_secret,
      site: API_BASE_URL,
      token_url: '/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )
  end
  
  # Отримання URL для авторизації (перший крок OAuth)
  def authorization_url(redirect_uri, scopes = %w[listings_r orders_r])
    @oauth_client.auth_code.authorize_url(
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      scope: scopes.join(' '),
      response_type: 'code'
    )
  end
  
  # Обмін коду авторизації на access token
  def get_access_token(authorization_code, redirect_uri)
    token = @oauth_client.auth_code.get_token(
      authorization_code,
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )
    @access_token = token.token
    token
  end
  
  # Виконання авторизованих запитів до API
  def make_authenticated_request(endpoint, method = :get, params = {})
    raise 'Access token is required' unless @access_token
    
    url = "#{API_BASE_URL}#{endpoint}"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => @client_id
    }
    
    case method
    when :get
      response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers, query: params)
    when :post
      response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: params.to_json)
    when :put
      response = HTTParty.put(url, headers: headers, body: params.to_json)
    when :delete
      response = HTTParty.delete(url, headers: headers)
    else
      raise "Unsupported HTTP method: #{method}"
    end
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Обробка відповіді API
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body) if response.body && !response.body.empty?
    else
      error_message = "HTTP #{response.code}: #{response.message}"
      if response.body
        error_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
        error_message += " - #{error_data['error']}" if error_data['error']
      end
      raise error_message
    end
  end
  
  # Отримання оголошень магазину
  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, params = {})
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings"
    make_authenticated_request(endpoint, :get, params)
  end
  
  # Отримання замовлень магазину
  def get_shop_orders(shop_id, params = {})
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/orders"
    make_authenticated_request(endpoint, :get, params)
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про магазин
  def get_shop(shop_id)
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}"
    make_authenticated_request(endpoint, :get)
  end
  
  # Отримання деталей конкретного замовлення
  def get_order(order_id)
    endpoint = "/application/orders/#{order_id}"
    make_authenticated_request(endpoint, :get)
  end
end
```

## Основний клас для роботи з S3 та мініатюрами

```ruby
# lib/image_processor.rb
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'uri'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class ImageProcessor
  attr_reader :s3_client, :bucket_name, :cdn_base_url

  def initialize
    @bucket_name = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME']
    @cdn_base_url = ENV['CDN_BASE_URL']
    
    @s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new(
      access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
      secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'],
      region: ENV['AWS_REGION']
    )
  end

  # Завантаження оригінального зображення до S3
  def upload_image(file_path, product_id, filename)
    file_extension = File.extname(filename)
    s3_key = "products/#{product_id}/original#{file_extension}"
    
    File.open(file_path, 'rb') do |file|
      s3_client.put_object(
        bucket: bucket_name,
        key: s3_key,
        body: file,
        acl: 'public-read',
        content_type: "image/#{file_extension.gsub('.', '')}"
      )
    end
    
    "#{cdn_base_url}/#{s3_key}"
  end

  # Генерація мініатюр різних розмірів
  def generate_thumbnails(original_image_url, product_id)
    # Завантажуємо оригінальне зображення з S3
    original_key = extract_s3_key(original_image_url)
    temp_file = download_from_s3_to_temp(original_key)
    
    thumbnails = {}
    
    # Розміри мініатюр
    thumbnail_sizes = {
      small: { width: 100, height: 100 },
      medium: { width: 300, height: 300 },
      large: { width: 600, height: 600 }
    }
    
    thumbnail_sizes.each do |size, dimensions|
      thumbnail_url = create_thumbnail(temp_file.path, product_id, size, dimensions)
      thumbnails[size] = thumbnail_url
    end
    
    # Очищаємо тимчасовий файл
    File.delete(temp_file.path) if File.exist?(temp_file.path)
    
    thumbnails
  end

  private

  # Створення мініатюри
  def create_thumbnail(temp_file_path, product_id, size, dimensions)
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(temp_file_path)
    
    # Змінюємо розмір зі збереженням пропорцій
    image.resize "#{dimensions[:width]}x#{dimensions[:height]}"
    
    # Зберігаємо в тимчасовий файл
    extension = File.extname(temp_file_path)
    temp_thumbnail = Tempfile.new(["thumbnail_#{size}", extension])
    image.write(temp_thumbnail.path)
    
    # Завантажуємо мініатюру до S3
    s3_key = "products/#{product_id}/#{size}#{extension}"
    
    File.open(temp_thumbnail.path, 'rb') do |file|
      s3_client.put_object(
        bucket: bucket_name,
        key: s3_key,
        body: file,
        acl: 'public-read',
        content_type: "image/#{extension.gsub('.', '')}"
      )
    end
    
    temp_thumbnail.close
    temp_thumbnail.unlink
    
    "#{cdn_base_url}/#{s3_key}"
  end

  # Завантаження файлу з S3 до тимчасового файлу
  def download_from_s3_to_temp(s3_key)
    temp_file = Tempfile.new('original_image')
    
    response = s3_client.get_object(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      key: s3_key,
      response_target: temp_file.path
    )
    
    temp_file
  end

  # Витягуємо ключ S3 з URL
  def extract_s3_key(url)
    uri = URI.parse(url)
    uri.path[1..-1] # Видаляємо перший слеш
  end
end
```

## Сервіс для управління зображеннями товарів

```ruby
# lib/product_image_service.rb
require_relative 'image_processor'

class ProductImageService
  def initialize
    @image_processor = ImageProcessor.new
  end

  # Основний метод для обробки зображення товару
  def process_product_image(file_path, product_id, filename)
    # Завантажуємо оригінальне зображення
    original_url = @image_processor.upload_image(file_path, product_id, filename)
    
    # Генеруємо мініатюри
    thumbnails = @image_processor.generate_thumbnails(original_url, product_id)
    
    {
      original: original_url,
      thumbnails: thumbnails,
      product_id: product_id,
      processed_at: Time.now
    }
  end

  # Видалення всіх зображень товару
  def delete_product_images(product_id)
    s3_client = @image_processor.s3_client
    bucket_name = @image_processor.bucket_name
    
    # Отримуємо всі об'єкти для даного product_id
    objects = s3_client.list_objects_v2(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      prefix: "products/#{product_id}/"
    )
    
    # Видаляємо всі знайдені об'єкти
    if objects.contents.any?
      objects_to_delete = objects.contents.map { |obj| { key: obj.key } }
      
      s3_client.delete_objects(
        bucket: bucket_name,
        delete: {
          objects: objects_to_delete
        }
      )
    end
    
    true
  end

  # Отримання URL-адрес всіх зображень товару
  def get_product_images(product_id)
    s3_client = @image_processor.s3_client
    bucket_name = @image_processor.bucket_name
    cdn_base_url = @image_processor.cdn_base_url
    
    objects = s3_client.list_objects_v2(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      prefix: "products/#{product_id}/"
    )
    
    images = {}
    
    objects.contents.each do |obj|
      size = File.basename(obj.key, File.extname(obj.key))
      images[size.to_sym] = "#{cdn_base_url}/#{obj.key}"
    end
    
    images
  end
end
```

### 3. Abandoned Cart Tracker

```ruby
# app/services/abandoned_cart_tracker.rb
require 'redis'
require 'json'

class AbandonedCartTracker
  def initialize
    @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'])
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
  end

  # Track when a cart is created or updated
  def track_cart_activity(cart)
    key = "cart:activity:#{cart.user_id}"
    cart_data = {
      'cart_id' => cart.id,
      'user_id' => cart.user_id,
      'user_email' => cart.user_email,
      'items' => cart.items,
      'total_value' => cart.total_value,
      'last_activity_at' => Time.now.to_i
    }
    
    @redis.setex(key, 3600, cart_data.to_json) # Expire after 1 hour
    @logger.info("Cart activity tracked for user #{cart.user_id}")
  end

  # Check for abandoned carts (carts with no activity for 30 minutes)
  def find_abandoned_carts
    abandoned_carts = []
    cursor = 0
    
    loop do
      cursor, keys = @redis.scan(cursor, match: 'cart:activity:*', count: 100)
      
      keys.each do |key|
        cart_data = JSON.parse(@redis.get(key))
        last_activity = Time.at(cart_data['last_activity_at'])
        
        if Time.now - last_activity > 1800 # 30 minutes
          cart = Cart.new(
            id: cart_data['cart_id'],
            user_id: cart_data['user_id'],
            user_email: cart_data['user_email'],
            items: cart_data['items'],
            total_value: cart_data['total_value'],
            abandoned_at: last_activity
          )
          
          abandoned_carts << cart
          @redis.del(key) # Remove from active tracking
        end
      end
      
      break if cursor == '0'
    end
    
    abandoned_carts
  end

  # Mark cart as recovered (when user completes purchase)
  def mark_cart_recovered(user_id)
    key = "cart:activity:#{user_id}"
    @redis.del(key)
    @logger.info("Cart recovered for user #{user_id}")
  end
end
```

### 4. Klaviyo Service

```ruby
# app/services/klaviyo_service.rb
require 'klaviyo'

class KlaviyoService
  def initialize
    @client = Klaviyo::Client.new(ENV['KLAVIYO_API_KEY'])
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
  end

  # Create or update profile in Klaviyo
  def sync_profile(cart)
    begin
      profile_data = cart.to_klaviyo_profile
      @client.Profiles.identify(profile_data)
      @logger.info("Profile synced for #{cart.user_email}")
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to sync profile: #{e.message}")
    end
  end

  # Track abandoned cart event
  def track_abandoned_cart(cart)
    begin
      event_data = cart.to_klaviyo_event
      @client.Public.track(event_data)
      @logger.info("Abandoned cart event tracked for #{cart.user_email}")
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to track abandoned cart: #{e.message}")
    end
  end

  # Send abandoned cart email through Klaviyo flow
  def trigger_abandoned_cart_flow(cart, flow_id)
    begin
      # First ensure profile exists
      sync_profile(cart)
      
      # Trigger the flow
      @client.Flows.trigger_flow(
        flow_id: flow_id,
        email: cart.user_email,
        properties: {
          'cart_items' => cart.items,
          'cart_value' => cart.total_value,
          'abandoned_cart_url' => "https://yourapp.com/cart/#{cart.id}"
        }
      )
      
      @logger.info("Abandoned cart flow triggered for #{cart.user_email}")
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to trigger flow: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
```

### 5. Background Worker

```ruby
# app/workers/abandoned_cart_worker.rb
require 'sidekiq'

class AbandonedCartWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform
    @tracker = AbandonedCartTracker.new
    @klaviyo_service = KlaviyoService.new
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)

    @logger.info("Starting abandoned cart check...")
    
    abandoned_carts = @tracker.find_abandoned_carts
    
    abandoned_carts.each do |cart|
      # Track the event in Klaviyo
      @klaviyo_service.track_abandoned_cart(cart)
      
      # Trigger email flow (replace with your actual flow ID)
      @klaviyo_service.trigger_abandoned_cart_flow(cart, 'YOUR_FLOW_ID_HERE')
      
      @logger.info("Processed abandoned cart for #{cart.user_email}")
    end
    
    @logger.info("Abandoned cart check completed. Found #{abandoned_carts.size} carts.")
  end
end
```

```ruby
    { status: 'success', message: 'Cart marked as recovered' }.to_json
  end

  # Manual trigger for testing

    content_type :json

    { status: 'success', message: 'Abandoned cart check initiated' }.to_json
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :cart_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :products, through: :cart_items
  
  # For guest carts, we'll store them in session
  before_create :generate_token
  
  def add_product(product, quantity = 1)
    current_item = cart_items.find_by(product_id: product.id)
    
    if current_item
      current_item.quantity += quantity
      current_item.save
    else
      current_item = cart_items.build(product: product, quantity: quantity)
    end
    
    current_item
  end
  
  def total_price
    cart_items.sum(&:total_price)
  end
  
  def apply_coupon(coupon_code)
    coupon = Coupon.find_by(code: coupon_code, active: true)
    return false unless coupon && coupon.valid_for_cart?(self)
    
    update(coupon: coupon)
    true
  end
  
  def remove_coupon
    update(coupon: nil)
  end
  
  def discounted_total
    return total_price unless coupon
    
    coupon.apply_discount(total_price)
  end
  
  def discount_amount
    return 0 unless coupon
    
    total_price - discounted_total
  end
  
  def clear
    cart_items.destroy_all
    remove_coupon
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_token
    self.token = SecureRandom.hex(10) unless token.present?
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Coupon < ApplicationRecord
  DISCOUNT_TYPES = %w[percentage fixed_amount].freeze
  
  validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :discount_type, inclusion: { in: DISCOUNT_TYPES }
  validates :discount_value, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :minimum_purchase, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validate :expiration_date_cannot_be_in_past
  
  has_many :carts
  
  scope :active, -> { where(active: true).where('expiration_date > ? OR expiration_date IS NULL', Time.current) }
  
  def apply_discount(total_amount)
    case discount_type
    when 'percentage'
      total_amount * (1 - discount_value / 100.0)
    when 'fixed_amount'
      [total_amount - discount_value, 0].max
    else
      total_amount
    end
  end
  
  def valid_for_cart?(cart)
    return false unless active?
    return false if expiration_date && expiration_date < Time.current
    return false if cart.total_price < minimum_purchase
    
    true
  end
  
  private
  
  def expiration_date_cannot_be_in_past
    if expiration_date.present? && expiration_date < Date.current
      errors.add(:expiration_date, "can't be in the past")
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class CartsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_cart
  
  def show
    render json: {
      cart: cart_data,
      items: @cart.cart_items.map { |item| cart_item_data(item) },
      summary: cart_summary
    }
  end
  
  def add_item
    product = Product.find(params[:product_id])
    quantity = params[:quantity].to_i || 1
    
    if product.in_stock? && quantity <= product.available_quantity
      @cart.add_product(product, quantity)
      
      if @cart.save
        render json: { 
          success: true, 
          message: 'Product added to cart',
          cart: cart_summary
        }
      else
        render json: { success: false, errors: @cart.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    else
      render json: { success: false, message: 'Product not available in requested quantity' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def update_item
    cart_item = @cart.cart_items.find_by(id: params[:item_id])
    
    if cart_item
      quantity = params[:quantity].to_i
      
      if quantity > 0
        cart_item.update(quantity: quantity)
        render json: { success: true, cart: cart_summary }
      else
        cart_item.destroy
        render json: { success: true, message: 'Item removed from cart', cart: cart_summary }
      end
    else
      render json: { success: false, message: 'Item not found in cart' }, status: :not_found
    end
  end
  
  def remove_item
    cart_item = @cart.cart_items.find_by(id: params[:item_id])
    
    if cart_item&.destroy
      render json: { success: true, message: 'Item removed from cart', cart: cart_summary }
    else
      render json: { success: false, message: 'Item not found in cart' }, status: :not_found
    end
  end
  
  def apply_coupon
    if @cart.apply_coupon(params[:coupon_code])
      render json: { 
        success: true, 
        message: 'Coupon applied successfully',
        cart: cart_summary
      }
    else
      render json: { success: false, message: 'Invalid or expired coupon' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def remove_coupon
    @cart.remove_coupon
    render json: { 
      success: true, 
      message: 'Coupon removed',
      cart: cart_summary
    }
  end
  
  def clear
    @cart.clear
    render json: { success: true, message: 'Cart cleared', cart: cart_summary }
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_cart
    @cart = if current_user
              current_user.cart || current_user.create_cart
            else
              # For guest users, use session cart
              Cart.find_by(token: session[:cart_token]) || create_guest_cart
            end
  end
  
  def create_guest_cart

    session[:cart_token] = cart.token

      id: @cart.id,
      items_count: @cart.cart_items.sum(:quantity),
      created_at: @cart.created_at

    {
      id: item.id,
      product_id: item.product_id,
      product_name: item.product.name,
      quantity: item.quantity,
      unit_price: item.product.price,
      total_price: item.total_price

      total: @cart.discounted_total,
      coupon: @cart.coupon&.code,
      items_count: @cart.cart_items.sum(:quantity)
    }
  end
```

```ruby
    @client_secret = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @access_token = get_access_token

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    body = build_delivery_payload(order_details)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(BASE_URL, 
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_delivery_status(delivery_id)
    headers = {

    }
    
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}/#{delivery_id}", headers: headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

    handle_response(response)
  end

        client_secret: @client_secret,
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        scope: 'eats.deliveries'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?

    else
      raise "Помилка автентифікації: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def build_delivery_payload(order_details)
    {
      pickup_address: order_details[:pickup_address],

      pickup_phone_number: order_details[:pickup_phone],

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)

      error_message = "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      raise error_message
    end
  end
```

## Main Implementation

```ruby
# etsy_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'oauth2'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyAPIClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, access_token = nil)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = access_token
    
    # Configure HTTParty defaults
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'User-Agent' => 'Etsy API Client/1.0'
    }
    
    @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}" if @access_token
  end

  # Generate OAuth authorization URL
  def authorization_url(redirect_uri, scopes = %w[listings_r orders_r])
    scopes_string = scopes.join('%20')
    "https://www.etsy.com/oauth/connect?response_type=code&client_id=#{@client_id}&redirect_uri=#{redirect_uri}&scope=#{scopes_string}&state=#{SecureRandom.hex(10)}"
  end

  # Exchange authorization code for access token
  def get_access_token(code, redirect_uri)
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      @client_id,
      @client_secret,
      site: 'https://api.etsy.com',
      token_url: '/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )

    token = client.auth_code.get_token(
      code,
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )
    
    @access_token = token.token
    @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    
    token
  end

  # Get shop ID by shop name
  def get_shop_id(shop_name)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops",
      headers: @headers,
      query: { shop_name: shop_name }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    
    if response['results']&.any?
      response['results'].first['shop_id']
    else
      raise "Shop '#{shop_name}' not found"
    end
  end

  # Get all listings for a shop
  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, params = {})
    default_params = {
      limit: 100,
      offset: 0,
      sort_on: 'created',
      sort_order: 'desc'
    }
    
    final_params = default_params.merge(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings",
      headers: @headers,
      query: final_params
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response
  end

  # Get active listings for a shop
  def get_active_listings(shop_id, params = {})
    params = params.merge(state: 'active')
    get_shop_listings(shop_id, params)
  end

  # Get a specific listing by ID
  def get_listing(listing_id, params = {})
    default_params = {
      includes: %w[Images Shop Shipping].join(',')
    }
    
    final_params = default_params.merge(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/listings/#{listing_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      query: final_params
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response
  end

  # Get all receipts/orders for a shop
  def get_shop_receipts(shop_id, params = {})
    default_params = {
      limit: 100,
      offset: 0,
      sort_on: 'created',
      sort_order: 'desc'
    }
    
    final_params = default_params.merge(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts",
      headers: @headers,
      query: final_params
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response
  end

  # Get a specific receipt by ID
  def get_receipt(receipt_id, params = {})
    default_params = {
      includes: %w[Buyer Listings Transactions].join(',')
    }
    
    final_params = default_params.merge(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      query: final_params
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response
  end

  # Get transactions for a receipt
  def get_receipt_transactions(receipt_id, params = {})
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/receipts/#{receipt_id}/transactions",
      headers: @headers,
      query: params
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response
  end

  # Paginate through all results
  def paginate_all(endpoint_method, initial_params = {}, &block)
    offset = 0
    limit = initial_params[:limit] || 100
    all_results = []
    
    loop do
      params = initial_params.merge(offset: offset, limit: limit)
      response = send(endpoint_method, params)
      
      results = response['results'] || []
      break if results.empty?
      
      if block_given?
        results.each { |result| yield(result) }
      else
        all_results.concat(results)
      end
      
      offset += limit
      
      # Etsy API has rate limits, be respectful
      sleep(0.1)
    end
    
    block_given? ? nil : all_results
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      # Success
      return true
    when 400
      raise "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise "Unauthorized: Invalid or expired token"
    when 403
      raise "Forbidden: Insufficient permissions"
    when 404
      raise "Not Found: Resource not found"
    when 429
      raise "Rate Limit Exceeded: Too many requests"
    when 500..599
      raise "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage class
class EtsyExample
```

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# recommendation_engine.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'active_record'
require 'standalone_migrations'

# Моделі бази даних
class User < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
  has_many :order_items, through: :orders
  has_many :products, through: :order_items
end

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :order_items
  has_many :orders, through: :order_items
  has_many :users, through: :orders
end

class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
  has_many :order_items
  has_many :products, through: :order_items
end

class OrderItem < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :order
  belongs_to :product
end

# Основний клас рекомендаційної системи
class RecommendationEngine
  def initialize
    setup_database
  end
  
  # Головний метод для отримання рекомендацій
  def recommend_products(user_id, limit: 10)
    user = User.find_by(id: user_id)
    return [] unless user
    
    # Отримуємо матрицю користувач-товар
    user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix
    
    # Обчислюємо схожість між користувачами
    similarities = calculate_user_similarities(user_id, user_product_matrix)
    
    # Генеруємо рекомендації
    generate_recommendations(user_id, similarities, user_product_matrix, limit)
  end
  
  private
  
  def setup_database
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: 'recommendations.db'
    )
  end
  
  def build_user_product_matrix
    users = User.all
    products = Product.all
    
    # Створюємо матрицю розміром users × products
    matrix = {}
    
    users.each do |user|
      matrix[user.id] = {}
      products.each do |product|
        # Кількість разів, коли користувач купував цей товар
        purchase_count = OrderItem.joins(:order)
                                 .where(orders: { user_id: user.id }, product_id: product.id)
                                 .sum(:quantity)
        
        matrix[user.id][product.id] = purchase_count.to_f
      end
    end
    
    matrix
  end
  
  def calculate_user_similarities(target_user_id, user_product_matrix)
    similarities = {}
    target_vector = user_product_matrix[target_user_id]
    
    user_product_matrix.each do |user_id, user_vector|
      next if user_id == target_user_id
      
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, user_vector)
      similarities[user_id] = similarity if similarity > 0
    end
    
    similarities.sort_by { |_, similarity| -similarity }.to_h
  end
  
  def cosine_similarity(vector1, vector2)
    dot_product = 0.0
    magnitude1 = 0.0
    magnitude2 = 0.0
    
    vector1.each do |product_id, value1|
      value2 = vector2[product_id] || 0
      dot_product += value1 * value2
      magnitude1 += value1 * value1
      magnitude2 += value2 * value2
    end
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1.zero? || magnitude2.zero?
    
    dot_product / (Math.sqrt(magnitude1) * Math.sqrt(magnitude2))
  end
  
  def generate_recommendations(target_user_id, similarities, user_product_matrix, limit)
    target_user_products = user_product_matrix[target_user_id]
    
    # Зважена сума оцінок схожих користувачів
    weighted_scores = {}
    similarity_sum = {}
    
    similarities.each do |similar_user_id, similarity|
      user_product_matrix[similar_user_id].each do |product_id, rating|
        # Пропускаємо товари, які вже купив цільовий користувач
        next if target_user_products[product_id] && target_user_products[product_id] > 0
        
        weighted_scores[product_id] ||= 0.0
        similarity_sum[product_id] ||= 0.0
        
        weighted_scores[product_id] += rating * similarity
        similarity_sum[product_id] += similarity.abs
      end
    end
    
    # Обчислюємо середній зважений бал
    recommendations = {}
    weighted_scores.each do |product_id, score|
      recommendations[product_id] = score / similarity_sum[product_id] if similarity_sum[product_id] > 0
    end
    
    # Сортуємо за рейтингом і обмежуємо кількість
    recommendations.sort_by { |_, score| -score }
                  .first(limit)
                  .map { |product_id, score| { product_id: product_id, score: score.round(4) } }
  end
end
```

### 2. Uber Direct API Client

```ruby
# lib/uber_direct_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class UberDirectClient
  attr_reader :access_token, :base_url

  def initialize
    @base_url = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_API_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.uber.com'
    @sandbox_mode = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_SANDBOX']&.downcase == 'true'
    authenticate
  end

  def authenticate
    client_id = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_CLIENT_ID']
    client_secret = ENV['UBER_DIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET']

    raise "Missing Uber Direct credentials" unless client_id && client_secret

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/oauth/token",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      },
      body: {
        client_id: client_id,
        client_secret: client_secret,
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        scope: 'eats.deliveries'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def create_delivery(pickup_address, dropoff_address, order_details)
    delivery_data = {
      pickup_address: pickup_address,
      dropoff_address: dropoff_address,
      order_details: order_details,
      sandbox: @sandbox_mode
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/deliveries",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: delivery_data.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_delivery_status(delivery_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/deliveries/#{delivery_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def cancel_delivery(delivery_id)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/deliveries/#{delivery_id}/cancel",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      error_message = "API Error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
      raise error_message
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Delivery Service

```ruby
# lib/delivery_service.rb
require_relative 'uber_direct_client'
require_relative 'order'

class DeliveryService
  def initialize
    @uber_client = UberDirectClient.new
  end

  def book_delivery(order, pickup_location, delivery_location)
    # Prepare delivery data for Uber Direct API
    delivery_data = build_delivery_data(order, pickup_location, delivery_location)

    begin
      response = @uber_client.create_delivery(
        delivery_data[:pickup_address],
        delivery_data[:dropoff_address],
        delivery_data[:order_details]
      )

      # Update order with delivery information
      order.delivery_id = response['delivery_id']
      
      {
        success: true,
        delivery_id: response['delivery_id'],
        status: response['status'],
        estimated_pickup_time: response['estimated_pickup_time'],
        estimated_dropoff_time: response['estimated_dropoff_time'],
        fee: response['fee']
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  def check_delivery_status(delivery_id)
    begin
      response = @uber_client.get_delivery_status(delivery_id)
      {
        success: true,
        status: response['status'],
        tracking_url: response['tracking_url'],
        courier_info: response['courier']
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  def cancel_delivery(delivery_id)
    begin
      response = @uber_client.cancel_delivery(delivery_id)
      {
        success: true,
        cancellation_fee: response['cancellation_fee']
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_delivery_data(order, pickup_location, delivery_location)
    {
      pickup_address: {
        street_address: pickup_location[:address],
        city: pickup_location[:city],
        state: pickup_location[:state],
        zip_code: pickup_location[:zip_code],
        country: pickup_location[:country] || 'US'
      },
      dropoff_address: {
        street_address: delivery_location[:address],
        city: delivery_location[:city],
        state: delivery_location[:state],
        zip_code: delivery_location[:zip_code],
        country: delivery_location[:country] || 'US',
        contact: {
          first_name: order.customer_name.split(' ').first,
          last_name: order.customer_name.split(' ').last,
          phone: delivery_location[:phone],
          email: delivery_location[:email]
        }
      },
      order_details: {
        order_number: order.id,
        items: order.items.map do |item|
          {
            name: item[:name],
            quantity: item[:quantity],
            price: item[:price]
          }
        end,
        ready_time: order.ready_at.iso8601
      }
    }
  end
end
```

### 5. Main Application

```ruby
# app.rb
require_relative 'lib/delivery_service'
require_relative 'lib/order'

class DeliveryApp
  def initialize
    @delivery_service = DeliveryService.new
  end

  def process_order_ready(order_data, pickup_location, delivery_location)
    order = Order.new(order_data)
    
    puts "Booking delivery for order ##{order.id}..."
    
    result = @delivery_service.book_delivery(order, pickup_location, delivery_location)
    
    if result[:success]
      puts "✅ Delivery booked successfully!"
      puts "Delivery ID: #{result[:delivery_id]}"
      puts "Status: #{result[:status]}"
      puts "Estimated pickup: #{result[:estimated_pickup_time]}"
      puts "Estimated dropoff: #{result[:estimated_dropoff_time]}"
      puts "Fee: $#{result[:fee]}"
      
      # Return the updated order with delivery info
      order.delivery_id = result[:delivery_id]
      order
    else
      puts "❌ Failed to book delivery: #{result[:error]}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def check_delivery(delivery_id)
    puts "Checking status for delivery ##{delivery_id}..."
    
    result = @delivery_service.check_delivery_status(delivery_id)
    
    if result[:success]
      puts "Delivery Status: #{result[:status]}"
      puts "Tracking URL: #{result[:tracking_url]}"
      if result[:courier_info]
        puts "Courier: #{result[:courier_info]['name']}" if result[:courier_info]['name']
      end
    else
      puts "❌ Failed to check delivery status: #{result[:error]}"
    end
    
    result
  end
end
```

```ruby
      missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| data[field].blank? }

        raise ArgumentError, "Відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"

      data
```

```ruby
class ProductsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_product, only: [:show, :edit, :update, :destroy, :sync]
  
  def create
    @product = Product.new(product_params)
    
    if @product.save
      # Синхронізація з BigCommerce
      bigcommerce_product = @product.sync_to_bigcommerce
      
      if bigcommerce_product
        redirect_to @product, notice: 'Товар успішно створено та синхронізовано з BigCommerce'
      else
        redirect_to @product, alert: 'Товар створено локально, але сталася помилка синхронізації з BigCommerce'
      end
    else
      render :new
    end
  end
  
  def update
    if @product.update(product_params)
      # Оновлення в BigCommerce
      @product.update_in_bigcommerce
      
      redirect_to @product, notice: 'Товар успішно оновлено'
    else
      render :edit
    end
  end
  
  def sync
    if @product.sync_to_bigcommerce
      redirect_to @product, notice: 'Товар успішно синхронізовано з BigCommerce'
    else
      redirect_to @product, alert: 'Помилка синхронізації з BigCommerce'
    end
```

```ruby
# nova_poshta_tracker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class NovaPoshtaTracker
  API_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
  end
  
  def track_package(tracking_number)
    response = make_api_request(tracking_number)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_tracking_response(response)
    else
      { error: "Failed to fetch tracking information", status_code: response.code }
    end
  end
  
  def display_status(tracking_number)
    result = track_package(tracking_number)
    
    if result[:error]
      puts "❌ Error: #{result[:error]}"
      return
    end
    
    puts "📦 Nova Poshta Tracking Information"
    puts "=================================="
    puts "Tracking Number: #{result[:tracking_number]}"
    puts "Status: #{result[:status]}"
    puts "Delivery Date: #{result[:scheduled_delivery_date] || 'Not scheduled yet'}"
    puts "Recipient: #{result[:recipient]}"
    puts "Phone: #{result[:recipient_phone]}"
    
    if result[:warehouse_recipient]
      puts "Warehouse: #{result[:warehouse_recipient]}"
      puts "Address: #{result[:warehouse_recipient_address]}"
    end
    
    if result[:events] && !result[:events].empty?
      puts "\n📋 Tracking History:"
      puts "-------------------"
      result[:events].each do |event|
        puts "#{event[:date]} - #{event[:status]}"
        puts "  #{event[:location]}" if event[:location]
        puts ""
      end
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def make_api_request(tracking_number)
    HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'TrackingDocument',
        calledMethod: 'getStatusDocuments',
        methodProperties: {
          Documents: [
            {
              DocumentNumber: tracking_number,
              Phone: '' # Optional: recipient's phone for additional verification
            }
          ]
        }
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
  end
  
  def parse_tracking_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['success']
      document_data = data['data'].first
      
      {
        tracking_number: document_data['Number'],
        status: translate_status(document_data['Status']),
        scheduled_delivery_date: document_data['ScheduledDeliveryDate'],
        recipient: document_data['RecipientFullName'],
        recipient_phone: document_data['PhoneRecipient'],
        warehouse_recipient: document_data['WarehouseRecipient'],
        warehouse_recipient_address: document_data['WarehouseRecipientAddress'],
        events: parse_events(document_data)
      }
    else
      { error: data['errors'].join(', ') }
    end
  end
  
  def parse_events(document_data)
    return [] unless document_data['TrackingUpdateDate']
    
    # Create events array from the tracking data
    events = []
    
    # Add creation event
    if document_data['DateCreated']
      events << {
        date: format_date(document_data['DateCreated']),
        status: 'Shipment created',
        location: document_data['CitySender']
      }
    end
    
    # Add current status event
    events << {
      date: format_date(document_data['TrackingUpdateDate']),
      status: translate_status(document_data['Status']),
      location: document_data['CityRecipient']
    }
    
    events.sort_by { |e| e[:date] }.reverse
  end
  
  def translate_status(status_code)
    status_mapping = {
      '1' => 'Order processing in the branch',
      '2' => 'Sent to the recipient city',
      '3' => 'In the recipient city',
      '4' => 'In the warehouse',
      '5' => 'On the way to the recipient',
      '6' => 'Awaiting return to warehouse',
      '7' => 'Received',
      '8' => 'Received (paid)',
      '9' => 'Cancelled',
      '10' => 'Problematic shipment',
      '11' => 'Lost shipment',
      '12' => 'Returned to sender',
      '102' => 'Not found',
      '103' => 'International shipment',
      '104' => 'Information received',
      '105' => 'In transit',
      '106' => 'Arrived at destination country',
      '108' => 'Transferred to customs',
      '111' => 'Awaiting payment'
    }
    
    status_mapping[status_code] || "Unknown status (#{status_code})"
  end
  
  def format_date(date_string)
    return 'N/A' unless date_string
    
    # Convert from API format to more readable format
    if date_string.match?(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)
      Time.parse(date_string).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    else
      date_string
    end
  end
end

# Command line interface
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.empty?
    puts "Usage: ruby nova_poshta_tracker.rb <tracking_number>"
    puts "Example: ruby nova_poshta_tracker.rb 59000000000000"
    exit
  end
  
  tracking_number = ARGV[0]
  
  # Initialize tracker (API key from environment variable)
  tracker = NovaPoshtaTracker.new
  
  puts "🔄 Tracking package #{tracking_number}..."
  puts ""
  
  tracker.display_status(tracking_number)
end
```

```ruby
# product_recommender.rb
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'matrix'
require 'ruby-progressbar'

class ProductRecommender
  # Configure database connection
  def initialize(database_path = ':memory:')
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: database_path
    )
    
    setup_database unless database_path != ':memory:'
  end

  # Database schema setup
  def setup_database
    ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
      create_table :customers, force: true do |t|
        t.string :name
        t.timestamps
      end

      create_table :products, force: true do |t|
        t.string :name
        t.timestamps
      end

      create_table :orders, force: true do |t|
        t.references :customer
        t.references :product
        t.integer :quantity, default: 1
        t.decimal :rating, precision: 3, scale: 2
        t.timestamps
      end

      add_index :orders, [:customer_id, :product_id], unique: true
    end
  end

  # Models
  class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
    has_many :orders
    has_many :products, through: :orders
  end

  class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
    has_many :orders
    has_many :customers, through: :orders
  end

  class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
    belongs_to :customer
    belongs_to :product
    
    validates :customer_id, uniqueness: { scope: :product_id }
  end

  # Add sample data for demonstration
  def seed_sample_data
    # Create customers
    customers = 5.times.map { |i| Customer.create(name: "Customer #{i + 1}") }
    
    # Create products
    products = 10.times.map { |i| Product.create(name: "Product #{i + 1}") }
    
    # Create orders with ratings
    ratings = [
      [5, 3, 0, 1, 4, 0, 0, 2, 0, 1], # Customer 1
      [4, 0, 3, 2, 0, 5, 1, 0, 0, 2], # Customer 2
      [0, 5, 4, 0, 3, 2, 0, 1, 5, 0], # Customer 3
      [2, 0, 0, 4, 5, 0, 3, 0, 2, 4], # Customer 4
      [0, 4, 2, 3, 0, 0, 5, 4, 1, 0]  # Customer 5
    ]
    
    customers.each_with_index do |customer, cust_index|
      products.each_with_index do |product, prod_index|
        rating = ratings[cust_index][prod_index]
        if rating > 0
          Order.create(
            customer: customer,
            product: product,
            rating: rating,
            quantity: rand(1..3)
          )
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # Collaborative filtering using cosine similarity
  def recommend_products(customer_id, limit: 5)
    customer = Customer.find(customer_id)
    
    # Build user-product matrix
    user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix
    
    # Calculate similarities
    similarities = calculate_similarities(user_product_matrix, customer_id)
    
    # Generate recommendations
    recommendations = generate_recommendations(customer_id, user_product_matrix, similarities)
    
    # Return top recommendations
    recommendations.first(limit).map do |product_id, score|
      product = Product.find(product_id)
      { product: product.name, score: score.round(4) }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_user_product_matrix
    customers = Customer.all
    products = Product.all
    
    # Initialize matrix with zeros
    matrix = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = {} }
    
    # Fill matrix with ratings
    Order.includes(:customer, :product).each do |order|
      matrix[order.customer_id][order.product_id] = order.rating || 1
    end
    
    # Fill missing values with 0
    customers.each do |customer|
      products.each do |product|
        matrix[customer.id][product.id] ||= 0
      end
    end
    
    matrix
  end

  def calculate_similarities(matrix, target_customer_id)
    similarities = {}
    target_vector = matrix[target_customer_id].values
    
    matrix.each do |customer_id, product_ratings|
      next if customer_id == target_customer_id
      
      other_vector = product_ratings.values
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, other_vector)
      similarities[customer_id] = similarity
    end
    
    similarities
  end

  def cosine_similarity(vector_a, vector_b)
    dot_product = vector_a.zip(vector_b).map { |a, b| a * b }.sum
    magnitude_a = Math.sqrt(vector_a.map { |x| x ** 2 }.sum)
    magnitude_b = Math.sqrt(vector_b.map { |x| x ** 2 }.sum)
    
    return 0 if magnitude_a.zero? || magnitude_b.zero?
    
    dot_product / (magnitude_a * magnitude_b)
  end

  def generate_recommendations(target_customer_id, matrix, similarities)
    target_products = matrix[target_customer_id]
    recommendations = {}
    
    # Find products the target customer hasn't purchased
    unrated_products = target_products.select { |_, rating| rating == 0 }.keys
    
    unrated_products.each do |product_id|
      weighted_sum = 0
      similarity_sum = 0
      
      similarities.each do |similar_customer_id, similarity|
        rating = matrix[similar_customer_id][product_id]
        if rating > 0 && similarity > 0
          weighted_sum += similarity * rating
          similarity_sum += similarity
        end
      end
      
      if similarity_sum > 0
        predicted_rating = weighted_sum / similarity_sum
        recommendations[product_id] = predicted_rating
      end
    end
    
    # Sort by predicted rating (descending)
    recommendations.sort_by { |_, score| -score }
  end

  # Alternative method using item-based collaborative filtering
  def recommend_similar_products(product_id, limit: 5)
    product = Product.find(product_id)
    
    # Build product-user matrix (transposed)
    product_user_matrix = build_product_user_matrix
    
    # Calculate product similarities
    product_similarities = calculate_product_similarities(product_user_matrix, product_id)
    
    # Return most similar products
    product_similarities.first(limit).map do |similar_product_id, similarity|
      similar_product = Product.find(similar_product_id)
      { product: similar_product.name, similarity: similarity.round(4) }
    end
  end

  def build_product_user_matrix
    customers = Customer.all
    products = Product.all
    
    matrix = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = {} }
    
    Order.includes(:customer, :product).each do |order|
      matrix[order.product_id][order.customer_id] = order.rating || 1
    end
    
    products.each do |product|
      customers.each do |customer|
        matrix[product.id][customer.id] ||= 0
      end
    end
    
    matrix
  end

  def calculate_product_similarities(matrix, target_product_id)
    similarities = {}
    target_vector = matrix[target_product_id].values
    
    matrix.each do |product_id, customer_ratings|
      next if product_id == target_product_id
      
      other_vector = customer_ratings.values
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, other_vector)
      similarities[product_id] = similarity
    end
    
    similarities.sort_by { |_, similarity| -similarity }
  end
end
```

## Key Features

1. **User-Based Collaborative Filtering**: Recommends products based on similar customers' preferences
2. **Item-Based Collaborative Filtering**: Recommends similar products based on item similarities
3. **Cosine Similarity**: Measures similarity between users/items
4. **Rating Prediction**: Predicts ratings for unrated products
5. **Database Integration**: Uses ActiveRecord for data persistence

## How it Works

1. **Build User-Product Matrix**: Creates a matrix of customer ratings for products
2. **Calculate Similarities**: Uses cosine similarity to find similar customers
3. **Generate Predictions**: Weighted average of similar customers' ratings
4. **Rank Recommendations**: Sorts by predicted rating for final recommendations

This implementation provides a solid foundation for collaborative filtering that you can extend with more advanced features like matrix factorization or neural networks.

```ruby
        RecipientAddress: order_data[:recipient_address_ref],
        ContactRecipient: order_data[:recipient_contact_ref],
        RecipientsPhone: order_data[:recipient_phone]
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_cities(city_name)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "Address",
      calledMethod: "getCities",
      methodProperties: {
        FindByString: city_name
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_warehouses(city_ref)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "Address",
      calledMethod: "getWarehouses",
      methodProperties: {
        CityRef: city_ref
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def create_counterparty(counterparty_data)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "Counterparty",
      calledMethod: "save",
      methodProperties: {
        FirstName: counterparty_data[:first_name],
        MiddleName: counterparty_data[:middle_name],
        LastName: counterparty_data[:last_name],
        Phone: counterparty_data[:phone],
        Email: counterparty_data[:email],
        CounterpartyType: counterparty_data[:counterparty_type] || "PrivatePerson",
        CounterpartyProperty: counterparty_data[:counterparty_property] || "Recipient"
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_counterparty_contact_person(counterparty_ref)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "Counterparty",
      calledMethod: "getCounterpartyContactPersons",
      methodProperties: {
        Ref: counterparty_ref
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if json_response["success"]
        {
          success: true,
          data: json_response["data"],
          errors: json_response["errors"],
          warnings: json_response["warnings"]
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          errors: json_response["errors"],
          warnings: json_response["warnings"]
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: ["HTTP Error: #{response.code}"]
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# meest_express_delivery_cost.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class MeestExpressDeliveryCalculator
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.meest.com/api/v1'  # Replace with actual Meest Express API URL
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MEEST_EXPRESS_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end

  # Calculate delivery cost for a parcel
  def calculate_cost(params)
    # Validate required parameters
    validate_params(params)
    
    # Prepare request payload
    payload = build_payload(params)
    
    # Make API request
    response = make_api_request(payload)
    
    # Parse and return the result
    parse_response(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    { error: "Failed to calculate delivery cost: #{e.message}" }
  end

  private

  def validate_params(params)
    required_params = [:from_country, :from_city, :to_country, :to_city, :weight, :length, :width, :height]
    missing_params = required_params.select { |param| params[param].nil? || params[param].to_s.empty? }
    
    unless missing_params.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing_params.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Validate numeric parameters
    numeric_params = [:weight, :length, :width, :height]
    numeric_params.each do |param|
      value = params[param]
      if value.to_f <= 0
        raise ArgumentError, "#{param} must be a positive number"
      end
    end
  end

  def build_payload(params)
    {
      from: {
        country: params[:from_country],
        city: params[:from_city],
        postal_code: params[:from_postal_code]
      },
      to: {
        country: params[:to_country],
        city: params[:to_city],
        postal_code: params[:to_postal_code]
      },
      parcel: {
        weight: params[:weight].to_f,  # in kg
        length: params[:length].to_f,  # in cm
        width: params[:width].to_f,    # in cm
        height: params[:height].to_f,  # in cm
        declared_value: params[:declared_value] || 0,  # optional
        parcel_type: params[:parcel_type] || 'package' # optional
      },
      service_type: params[:service_type] || 'standard' # standard, express, etc.
    }.compact
  end

  def make_api_request(payload)
    HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/delivery/calculate",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      {
        success: true,
        cost: data['cost'],
        currency: data['currency'] || 'EUR',
        delivery_days: data['delivery_days'],
        service_type: data['service_type'],
        estimated_delivery_date: data['estimated_delivery_date']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Invalid response format from API"
    }
  end
end
```
