```ruby
# rozetka_order_manager.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class RozetkaOrderManager
  # API endpoints (these are typical endpoints, adjust based on actual Rozetka API documentation)
  ORDERS_ENDPOINT = 'https://api-seller.rozetka.com.ua/orders'
  ORDER_STATUS_ENDPOINT = 'https://api-seller.rozetka.com.ua/orders/%s/status'

  def initialize(api_key, seller_id, logger_level: Logger::INFO)
    @api_key = api_key
    @seller_id = seller_id
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = logger_level
    
    # Configure HTTParty with default headers
    @http_options = {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      },
      timeout: 30
    }
  end

  # Fetch new orders from Rozetka API
  def fetch_new_orders(status: 'new', from_date: nil, to_date: nil, limit: 100)
    @logger.info("Fetching #{status} orders from Rozetka API")
    
    params = {
      seller_id: @seller_id,
      status: status,
      limit: limit
    }
    
    # Add date filters if provided
    params[:from_date] = from_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if from_date
    params[:to_date] = to_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if to_date
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      ORDERS_ENDPOINT,
      @http_options.merge(query: params)
    )
    
    if response.success?
      orders = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @logger.info("Successfully fetched #{orders.size} orders")
      orders
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch orders: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      []
    end
  rescue HTTParty::Error => e
    @logger.error("HTTP error while fetching orders: #{e.message}")
    []
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error("Unexpected error while fetching orders: #{e.message}")
    []
  end

  # Update order status
  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status, reason: nil)
    @logger.info("Updating order #{order_id} to status: #{new_status}")
    
    payload = {
      status: new_status,
      seller_id: @seller_id
    }
    payload[:reason] = reason if reason
    
    response = HTTParty.put(
      ORDER_STATUS_ENDPOINT % order_id,
      @http_options.merge(body: payload.to_json)
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Successfully updated order #{order_id} to #{new_status}")
      true
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to update order #{order_id}: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      false
    end
  rescue HTTParty::Error => e
    @logger.error("HTTP error while updating order #{order_id}: #{e.message}")
    false
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error("Unexpected error while updating order #{order_id}: #{e.message}")
    false
  end

  # Process new orders with custom logic
  def process_new_orders(status_mapping = {})
    new_orders = fetch_new_orders(status: 'new')
    
    processed_count = 0
    failed_count = 0
    
    new_orders.each do |order|
      order_id = order['id']
      
      # Determine new status based on your business logic
      # This is where you'd implement your specific status mapping logic
      new_status = determine_new_status(order, status_mapping)
      
      if new_status && update_order_status(order_id, new_status)
        processed_count += 1
      else
        failed_count += 1
      end
    end
    
    @logger.info("Processing complete: #{processed_count} successful, #{failed_count} failed")
    { processed: processed_count, failed: failed_count }
  end

  private

  # Customize this method based on your specific business logic
  def determine_new_status(order, status_mapping)
    # Example logic - customize based on your needs:
    
    # Check if there's a specific mapping for this order type
    if status_mapping[order['type']]
      return status_mapping[order['type']]
    end
    
    # Default logic based on order properties
    case order['payment_method']
    when 'prepaid'
      'confirmed'  # Ready for processing if already paid
    when 'cash_on_delivery'
      'pending_payment'  # Wait for payment
    else
      'processing'  # Default status
    end
  end
end

# Example usage and main execution script

  Dotenv.load
  
  api_key = ENV['ROZETKA_API_KEY']

  unless api_key && seller_id
    puts "Error: Please set ROZETKA_API_KEY and ROZETKA_SELLER_ID environment variables"
    exit(1)
  end
  
  # Create order manager instance
  order_manager = RozetkaOrderManager.new(api_key, seller_id)
```

```ruby
        ContactRecipient: invoice_data[:recipient_contact_ref],
        RecipientsPhone: invoice_data[:recipient_phone]
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }

    handle_response(response)

          }
        ]
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(

      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

  end

      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'Address',

      methodProperties: {
        CityName: city_name,
        Limit: 5
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Пошук відділень

    request_data = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'Address',
      calledMethod: 'getWarehouses',

        CityRef: city_ref,

      }

      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else

    end
```

```ruby
        MiddleName: counterparty_data[:middle_name],
        LastName: counterparty_data[:last_name],
        Phone: counterparty_data[:phone],
        Email: counterparty_data[:email],
        CounterpartyType: counterparty_data[:counterparty_type] || 'PrivatePerson',
        CounterpartyProperty: counterparty_data[:counterparty_property] || 'Recipient'
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання списку контрагентів
  def get_counterparties(counterparty_property = 'Recipient')
    request_data = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'Counterparty',
      calledMethod: 'getCounterparties',
      methodProperties: {
        CounterpartyProperty: counterparty_property,
        Page: '1'
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end
```

```ruby
class ProductSyncService
  def self.sync_to_bigcommerce(local_product)
    product_data = build_product_data(local_product)
    
    if local_product.bigcommerce_id.present?
      # Update existing product
      BigcommerceProduct.update(local_product.bigcommerce_id, product_data)
    else
      # Create new product
      response = BigcommerceProduct.create(product_data)
      local_product.update(bigcommerce_id: response['data']['id'])
    end
  end
  
  def self.sync_from_bigcommerce(bigcommerce_product_id)
    product_data = BigcommerceProduct.find(bigcommerce_product_id)
    
    local_product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(bigcommerce_id: bigcommerce_product_id)
    local_product.assign_attributes(
      name: product_data['data']['name'],
      description: product_data['data']['description'],
      price: product_data['data']['price'],
      sku: product_data['data']['sku'],
      inventory: product_data['data']['inventory_level']
    )
    
    local_product.save!
    local_product
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.build_product_data(product)
    {
      name: product.name,
      type: 'physical',
      sku: product.sku,
      description: product.description,
      price: product.price.to_f,
      categories: product.category_ids,
      weight: product.weight.to_f,
      width: product.width.to_f,
      height: product.height.to_f,
      depth: product.depth.to_f,
      inventory_level: product.inventory.to_i,
      is_visible: product.active?
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class OrderSyncService
  def self.create_in_bigcommerce(local_order)
    order_data = build_order_data(local_order)
    
    response = BigcommerceOrder.create(order_data)
    local_order.update(bigcommerce_id: response['id'])
    
    # Add products to the order
    local_order.order_items.each do |item|
      product_data = {
        product_id: item.product.bigcommerce_id,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        price_inc_tax: item.unit_price.to_f
      }
      BigcommerceOrder.add_product(response['id'], product_data)
    end
    
    response
  end
  
  def self.sync_status_from_bigcommerce(local_order)
    return unless local_order.bigcommerce_id.present?
    
    order_data = BigcommerceOrder.find(local_order.bigcommerce_id)
    local_order.update(status: map_status(order_data['status_id']))
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.build_order_data(order)
    {
      customer_id: order.customer.bigcommerce_id,
      date_created: order.created_at.iso8601,
      billing_address: build_address_data(order.billing_address),
      shipping_addresses: [build_address_data(order.shipping_address)],
      status_id: map_status_to_bigcommerce(order.status),
      currency_code: 'USD',
      currency_exchange_rate: 1.0
    }
  end
  
  def self.build_address_data(address)
    {
      first_name: address.first_name,
      last_name: address.last_name,
      street_1: address.street1,
      street_2: address.street2,
      city: address.city,
      state: address.state,
      zip: address.zip_code,
      country: address.country,
      phone: address.phone
    }
  end
  
  def self.map_status_to_bigcommerce(status)
    status_mapping = {
      'pending' => 0,
      'awaiting_payment' => 1,
      'awaiting_fulfillment' => 2,
      'shipped' => 3,
      'completed' => 10,
      'cancelled' => 5
    }
    status_mapping[status] || 0
  end
  
  def self.map_status(status_id)
    status_mapping = {
      0 => 'pending',
      1 => 'awaiting_payment', 
      2 => 'awaiting_fulfillment',
      3 => 'shipped',
      10 => 'completed',
      5 => 'cancelled'
    }
    status_mapping[status_id] || 'pending'
  end
end
```

```ruby
# ukrposhta_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaClient
  def initialize(api_token = nil, base_url = nil)
    @api_token = api_token || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_TOKEN']
    @base_url = base_url || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_BASE_URL'] || 'https://ukrposhta.ua/api'
    
    raise "API token is required" unless @api_token
    
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}"
    }
  end

  # Create a new shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/shipments"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers,
      body: shipment_data.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get shipment label
  def get_shipment_label(shipment_id, format = 'pdf')
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers.merge('Accept' => "application/#{format}"),
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      handle_response(response)
    end
  end

  # Save label to file
  def save_label_to_file(shipment_id, filename = nil, format = 'pdf')
    label_data = get_shipment_label(shipment_id, format)
    
    filename ||= "ukrposhta_label_#{shipment_id}.#{format}"
    
    File.binwrite(filename, label_data)
    puts "Label saved to: #{filename}"
    filename
  end

  # Get shipment status
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_id)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/shipments/#{shipment_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "API Error #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
      puts error_message
      raise error_message
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise "Failed to parse JSON response: #{e.message}"
  end
end

      phone: phone,

    }

  end

  def to_individual(first_name, last_name, phone, address)

      last_name: last_name,
      phone: phone,
```

```ruby
# hotline_price_list_generator.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'date'

class HotlinePriceListGenerator
  def initialize(company_name, company_id, products = [])
    @company_name = company_name
    @company_id = company_id
    @products = products
  end

  def generate_xml
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.price do
      xml.date Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
      xml.firm do
        xml.id @company_id
        xml.name @company_name
      end
      xml.categories do
        # Generate categories from products or use default categories
        generate_categories(xml)
      end
      xml.items do
        @products.each do |product|
          generate_product_item(xml, product)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def generate_categories(xml)
    # Extract unique categories from products or use defaults
    categories = @products.map { |p| p[:category_id] }.uniq
    
    if categories.empty?
      # Default categories if no products provided
      default_categories.each do |cat_id, cat_name|
        xml.category(cat_id, name: cat_name)
      end
    else
      categories.each do |cat_id|
        xml.category(cat_id, name: "Category #{cat_id}")
      end
    end
  end

  def generate_product_item(xml, product)
    xml.item do
      xml.id product[:id]
      xml.categoryId product[:category_id]
      xml.code product[:code] if product[:code]
      xml.vendor product[:vendor]
      xml.name product[:name]
      xml.description product[:description] if product[:description]
      
      # Price information
      xml.price do
        xml.retail product[:price].to_f
        xml.unit 'шт' # piece - default unit
      end
      
      # Additional product information
      xml.param(product[:param_value], name: product[:param_name]) if product[:param_name]
      
      # Stock information
      xml.stock product[:stock] || 'есть в наличии' # in stock by default
      
      # Guarantee/warranty
      xml.guarantee product[:guarantee] if product[:guarantee]
      
      # Delivery information
      if product[:delivery_time]
        xml.delivery do
          xml.id 1 # Default delivery method ID
          xml.time product[:delivery_time]
          xml.cost product[:delivery_cost] || 0
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def save_to_file(filename)
    xml_content = generate_xml
    File.open(filename, 'w') do |file|
      file.write(xml_content)
    end
    puts "Hotline.ua price list saved to #{filename}"
  end

  private

  def default_categories
    {
      1 => 'Computers & Laptops',
      2 => 'Smartphones & Tablets',
      3 => 'Home Appliances',
      4 => 'Electronics'
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# meest_express_delivery.rb
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class MeestExpressDeliveryCalculator
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.meest.com/api/v1'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MEEST_EXPRESS_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end

  # Розрахунок вартості доставки
  def calculate_cost(params)
    validate_params(params)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/delivery/calculate",
      headers: @headers,
      body: params.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання списку відділень
  def get_branches(country_code = 'UA')
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/branches",
      headers: @headers,
      query: { country: country_code }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Розрахунок вартості між двома адресами
  def calculate_point_to_point(delivery_params)
    required_params = [:from_city, :from_country, :to_city, :to_country, :weight, :volume]
    
    missing_params = required_params - delivery_params.keys
    unless missing_params.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing_params.join(', ')}"
    end

    calculate_cost(delivery_params)
  end

  # Розрахунок вартості до відділення
  def calculate_to_branch(params)
    default_params = {
      service_type: 'branch',
      delivery_type: 'standard'
    }

    calculate_cost(default_params.merge(params))
  end

  # Розрахунок вартості адресної доставки
  def calculate_door_to_door(params)
    default_params = {
      service_type: 'door',
      delivery_type: 'standard'
    }

    calculate_cost(default_params.merge(params))
  end

  private

  def validate_params(params)
    required = [:from_country, :to_country, :weight, :volume]
    missing = required - params.keys
    
    unless missing.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing.join(', ')}"
    end

    if params[:weight] <= 0 || params[:volume] <= 0
      raise ArgumentError, "Weight and volume must be positive values"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = case response.code
                   when 400
                     "Bad request: Invalid parameters"
                   when 401
                     "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
                   when 404
                     "Endpoint not found"
                   when 500
                     "Server error"
                   else
                     "HTTP Error #{response.code}"
                   end

    raise StandardError, "#{error_message}: #{response.body}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'

class HotlinePriceGenerator
  def initialize(products)
    @products = products
    @doc = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.price do
        xml.date(Time.now.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M'))
        xml.firm('Назва вашої компанії') # Замініть на назву вашої компанії
        xml.currency('UAH')
      end
    end
  end

  def generate
    items = @doc.doc.at('price')
    
    @products.each do |product|
      items.add_child(build_item(product))
    end

    @doc.to_xml
  end

  def save_to_file(filename)
    File.write(filename, generate)
  end

  private

  def build_item(product)
    Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.item do
        xml.id(product[:id])
        xml.name(product[:name])
        xml.categoryId(product[:category_id]) if product[:category_id]
        xml.vendor(product[:vendor]) if product[:vendor]
        xml.description(product[:description]) if product[:description]
        
        # Основна ціна
        xml.price(product[:price])
        
        # Стара ціна (якщо є акція)
        xml.oldprice(product[:old_price]) if product[:old_price]
        
        # Наявність
        xml.stock(product[:stock] || 'в наличии')
        
        # URL товару на вашому сайті
        xml.url(product[:url]) if product[:url]
        
        # URL картинки
        xml.image(product[:image]) if product[:image]
        
        # Гарантія
        xml.guarantee(product[:guarantee]) if product[:guarantee]
        
        # Параметри товару
        if product[:params] && product[:params].any?
          product[:params].each do |param|
            xml.param(param[:value], name: param[:name])
          end
        end
      end
    end.doc.root
  end
end
```

```ruby
# db_product_loader.rb
require 'sqlite3'

class DBProductLoader
  def initialize(db_path)
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new(db_path)
  end

  def load_products
    products = []
    
    @db.execute("SELECT id, name, category_id, vendor, description, price, old_price, stock_status, url, image_url, guarantee FROM products") do |row|
      product = {
        id: row[0],
        name: row[1],
        category_id: row[2],
        vendor: row[3],
        description: row[4],
        price: row[5],
        old_price: row[6],
        stock: map_stock_status(row[7]),
        url: row[8],
        image: row[9],
        guarantee: row[10]
      }
      
      # Завантажуємо параметри товару
      product[:params] = load_product_params(row[0])
      
      products << product
    end
    
    products
  end

  private

  def load_product_params(product_id)
    params = []
    @db.execute("SELECT param_name, param_value FROM product_params WHERE product_id = ?", product_id) do |row|
      params << { name: row[0], value: row[1] }
    end
    params
  end

  def map_stock_status(status)
    case status
    when 'in_stock' then 'в наличии'
    when 'out_of_stock' then 'нет в наличии'
    when 'preorder' then 'под заказ'
    else status
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
        Documents: [
          {
            DocumentNumber: tracking_number,
            Phone: ''
          }
        ]
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, 
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response, tracking_number)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response, tracking_number)
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if data['success']
        display_tracking_info(data['data'][0], tracking_number)
      else
        puts "❌ Помилка: #{data['errors'].join(', ')}".red
      end
    else
      puts "❌ Помилка мережі: #{response.code} - #{response.message}".red
    end
  end

  def display_tracking_info(tracking_data, tracking_number)
    return puts "❌ Посилку з номером #{tracking_number} не знайдено".red unless tracking_data

    status_number = tracking_data['StatusCode'].to_i
    status_text = get_status_description(status_number)

    table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
      t.title = "📦 Інформація про посилку Nova Poshta".green
      t.headings = ['Параметр', 'Значення']
      t.add_row ['Номер накладної', tracking_number.blue]
      t.add_row ['Статус', format_status(status_text, status_number)]
      t.add_row ['Дата оновлення', format_date(tracking_data['DateCreated'])]
      t.add_row ['Отримувач', tracking_data['RecipientFullName'] || 'Не вказано']
      t.add_row ['Відправник', tracking_data['SendersPhone'] || 'Не вказано']
      
      if tracking_data['ScheduledDeliveryDate']
        t.add_row ['Очікувана дата доставки', format_date(tracking_data['ScheduledDeliveryDate'])]
      end
      
      if tracking_data['WarehouseRecipient']
        t.add_row ['Відділення отримання', tracking_data['WarehouseRecipient']]
      end
    end

    puts table
    display_additional_info(tracking_data)
  end

  def format_status(status_text, status_number)
    case status_number
    when 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11
      status_text.green
    when 2, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108
      status_text.yellow
    when 101
      status_text.blue
    else
      status_text
    end
  end

  def format_date(date_string)
    return 'Не вказано' unless date_string
    
    # Конвертуємо з формату "2024-01-15 14:30:00"
    DateTime.parse(date_string).strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")
  rescue
    date_string
  end

  def get_status_description(status_code)
    status_descriptions = {
      1 => "Створено електронну накладну",
      2 => "Є зворотний зв'язок з клієнтом",
      3 => "Помилка у даних",
      4 => "Відмова від відправлення",
      5 => "Змінено адресу",
      6 => "Прибув у відділення",
      7 => "Прибув у місто",
      8 => "Отримано",
      9 => "Відмова отримувача",
      10 => "Відмова з боку відправника",
      11 => "Призупинено зберігання",
      101 => "В дорозі",
      102 => "У місті отримувача",
      103 => "Відправлення у відділенні",
      104 => "Очікує на вантаж",
      105 => "Видано",
      106 => "Відправлення отримано",
      107 => "Відправлення отримано (грошовий переказ)",
      108 => "Відправлення отримано (післяплата)"
    }

    status_descriptions[status_code] || "Невідомий статус (#{status_code})"
  end

  def display_additional_info(tracking_data)
    if tracking_data['Address'] || tracking_data['CityRecipient']
      puts "\n📍 Додаткова інформація:".blue
      puts "Місто отримувача: #{tracking_data['CityRecipient']}" if tracking_data['CityRecipient']
      puts "Адреса: #{tracking_data['Address']}" if tracking_data['Address']
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class UkrposhtaClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri UkrposhtaAPI::API_BASE_URL

  def initialize
    @api_token = ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_TOKEN']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}"
    }
  end

  # Створення відправлення
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    endpoint = 'shipments'
    
    response = self.class.post(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers,
      body: shipment_data.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання етикетки у форматі PDF
  def get_label(shipment_id, format = 'pdf')
    endpoint = "shipments/#{shipment_id}/label"
    
    response = self.class.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers,
      query: { format: format }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Друк етикетки (збереження у файл)
  def print_label(shipment_id, filename = nil)
    label_data = get_label(shipment_id)
    
    filename ||= "label_#{shipment_id}_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}.pdf"
    
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(label_data)
    end
    
    puts "Етикетку збережено у файл: #{filename}"
    filename
  end

  # Перевірка статусу відправлення
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_id)
    endpoint = "shipments/#{shipment_id}/status"
    
    response = self.class.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      response.body
    when 401
      raise 'Помилка авторизації. Перевірте API токен.'
    when 404
      raise 'Ресурс не знайдено.'
    when 422
      raise "Помилка валідації: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Shipment
  attr_accessor :sender, :recipient, :parcel, :service_type, :payment_method

  def initialize(attributes = {})
    @sender = attributes[:sender] || {}
    @recipient = attributes[:recipient] || {}
    @parcel = attributes[:parcel] || {}
    @service_type = attributes[:service_type] || 'standard'
    @payment_method = attributes[:payment_method] || 'cash'
  end

  def to_api_format
    {
      sender: format_address(sender),
      recipient: format_address(recipient),
      parcel: {
        weight: parcel[:weight], # у грамах
        length: parcel[:length], # у см
        width: parcel[:width],   # у см
        height: parcel[:height], # у см
        declared_value: parcel[:declared_value] || 0 # у гривнях
      },
      service_type: service_type,
      payment_method: payment_method,
      description: parcel[:description] || 'Відправлення'
    }
  end

  private

  def format_address(address)
    {
      first_name: address[:first_name],
      last_name: address[:last_name],
      phone: address[:phone],
      city: address[:city],
      region: address[:region],
      street: address[:street],
      building: address[:building],
      apartment: address[:apartment],
      post_code: address[:post_code]
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class NovaPoshtaService
  API_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'.freeze
  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
  
  def initialize
    @api_key = API_KEY
  end
  
  def get_cities
    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'Address',
      calledMethod: 'getCities',
      methodProperties: {}
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, body: payload.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_departments
    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'AddressGeneral',
      calledMethod: 'getWarehouses',
      methodProperties: {}
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, body: payload.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if json_response['success']
        json_response['data']
      else
        raise "API Error: #{json_response['errors']}"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class DataUpdaterService
  def initialize
    @nova_poshta_service = NovaPoshtaService.new
  end
  
  def update_all_data
    Rails.logger.info "Starting data update at #{Time.current}"
    
    update_cities
    update_departments
    
    Rails.logger.info "Data update completed at #{Time.current}"
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Data update failed: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end
  
  def update_cities
    cities_data = @nova_poshta_service.get_cities
    
    City.transaction do
      # Оновлюємо існуючі та додаємо нові міста
      cities_data.each do |city_data|
        city = City.find_or_initialize_by(ref: city_data['Ref'])
        city.assign_attributes(
          name: city_data['Description'],
          name_ua: city_data['Description'],
          name_en: city_data['DescriptionRu'],
          region: city_data['RegionsDescription'],
          area: city_data['AreaDescription'],
          delivery_1: city_data['Delivery1'] == '1',
          delivery_2: city_data['Delivery2'] == '1',
          delivery_3: city_data['Delivery3'] == '1',
          delivery_4: city_data['Delivery4'] == '1',
          delivery_5: city_data['Delivery5'] == '1',
          delivery_6: city_data['Delivery6'] == '1',
          delivery_7: city_data['Delivery7'] == '1'
        )
        city.save!
      end
      
      # Помічаємо міста як неактивні, якщо вони більше не існують в API
      existing_refs = cities_data.map { |c| c['Ref'] }
      City.where.not(ref: existing_refs).update_all(is_active: false)
    end
    
    Rails.logger.info "Updated #{cities_data.size} cities"
  end
  
  def update_departments
    departments_data = @nova_poshta_service.get_departments
    
    Department.transaction do
      # Оновлюємо існуючі та додаємо нові відділення
      departments_data.each do |dept_data|
        department = Department.find_or_initialize_by(ref: dept_data['Ref'])
        department.assign_attributes(
          number: dept_data['Number'],
          city_ref: dept_data['CityRef'],
          city: City.find_by(ref: dept_data['CityRef']),
          name: dept_data['Description'],
          name_ua: dept_data['Description'],
          name_en: dept_data['DescriptionRu'],
          short_address: dept_data['ShortAddress'],
          short_address_ua: dept_data['ShortAddress'],
          short_address_en: dept_data['ShortAddressRu'],
          phone: dept_data['Phone'],
          schedule: dept_data['Schedule'],
          latitude: dept_data['Latitude'],
          longitude: dept_data['Longitude'],
          type: dept_data['TypeOfWarehouse'],
          is_active: true
        )
        department.save!
      end
      
      # Помічаємо відділення як неактивні, якщо вони більше не існують в API
      existing_refs = departments_data.map { |d| d['Ref'] }
      Department.where.not(ref: existing_refs).update_all(is_active: false)
    end
    
    Rails.logger.info "Updated #{departments_data.size} departments"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class RozetkaApiClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['ROZETKA_API_BASE_URL']
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def get_orders(status: nil, limit: 100, offset: 0)
    params = { limit: limit, offset: offset }
    params[:status] = status if status
    
    response = self.class.get('/orders', {
      headers: @headers,
      query: params
    })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_status(order_id, status, reason: nil)
    body = { status: status }
    body[:reason] = reason if reason
    
    response = self.class.put("/orders/#{order_id}", {
      headers: @headers,
      body: body.to_json
    })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_new_orders
    # Статуси нових замовлень (може відрізнятись залежно від API)
    get_orders(status: 'new')
  end
end
```

**app/services/order_sync_service.rb:**
```ruby
require_relative '../models/order'

class OrderSyncService
  def initialize(api_client)
    @api_client = api_client
    @processed_orders = {}
  end
  
  def sync_new_orders
    begin
      response = @api_client.get_new_orders
      orders_data = response['orders'] || response['data'] || []
      
      orders = orders_data.map { |data| Order.from_api_data(data) }
      
      orders.each do |order|
        process_order(order)
      end
      
      { success: true, processed: orders.count }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_statuses
    # Отримуємо замовлення, які потребують оновлення статусу
    pending_orders = get_pending_orders
    
    pending_orders.each do |order|
      update_single_order_status(order)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_order(order)
    # Логіка обробки нового замовлення
    puts "Processing order ##{order.number} with status: #{order.status}"
    
    # Зберігаємо інформацію про замовлення
    save_order(order)
    
    # Оновлюємо статус (приклад)
    if should_update_status?(order)
      new_status = determine_new_status(order)
      update_order_status(order.id, new_status)
    end
  end
  
  def save_order(order)
    # Тут може бути логіка збереження в базу даних
    @processed_orders[order.id] = order
    puts "Order ##{order.number} saved locally"
  end
  
  def get_pending_orders
    # Тут може бути логіка отримання замовлень з локальної бази
    @processed_orders.values.select { |order| order.status == 'pending' }
  end
  
  def should_update_status?(order)
    # Логіка визначення чи потрібно оновлювати статус
    ['new', 'pending'].include?(order.status)
  end
  
  def determine_new_status(order)
    # Логіка визначення нового статусу
    case order.status
    when 'new' then 'processing'
    when 'processing' then 'shipped'
    else order.status
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status)
    begin
      response = @api_client.update_order_status(order_id, new_status)
      puts "Order #{order_id} status updated to: #{new_status}"
      true
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Failed to update order #{order_id}: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
  
  def update_single_order_status(order)
    new_status = determine_new_status(order)
    
    if order.status_changed?(new_status)
      update_order_status(order.id, new_status)
      order.status = new_status
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class RozetkaOrderSyncWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

    api_key = ENV['ROZETKA_API_KEY']
    
    unless api_key
      logger.error "ROZETKA_API_KEY not set"
      return
    end
    
    client = RozetkaApiClient.new(api_key)

    else
      logger.error "Sync failed: #{result[:error]}"
    end
    
    # Оновлення статусів існуючих замовлень
    sync_service.update_order_statuses
  end
end
```

Код готовий до використання та може бути розширений додатковою функціональністю.

Here's a Ruby implementation for exporting products to Prom.ua YML format and importing orders through their API:

## Gemfile

## Implementation

```ruby
# promua_api.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'builder'
require 'dry/configurable'

class PromuaAPI
  extend Dry::Configurable

  setting :api_key, default: ENV['PROMUA_API_KEY']
  setting :base_url, default: 'https://my.prom.ua/api/v1'
  setting :company_id, default: ENV['PROMUA_COMPANY_ID']

  # Initialize with optional override settings
  def initialize(api_key: nil, company_id: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || self.class.config.api_key
    @company_id = company_id || self.class.config.company_id
    @base_url = self.class.config.base_url
  end

  # Export products to YML format
  def export_products_to_yml(products, output_file_path = 'prom_ua_export.yml')
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml = builder.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')) do |yml|
      yml.shop do |shop|
        shop.name 'Your Store Name'
        shop.company 'Your Company Name'
        shop.url 'https://yourstore.com'
        
        shop.currencies do |currencies|
          currencies.currency(id: 'UAH', rate: 1)
        end
        
        shop.categories do |categories|
          # Extract unique categories from products
          product_categories(products).each do |category|
            categories.category(category[:name], id: category[:id], parentId: category[:parent_id])
          end
        end
        
        shop.offers do |offers|
          products.each do |product|
            offers.offer(id: product[:id], available: product[:available] ? 'true' : 'false') do |offer|
              offer.url product[:url] if product[:url]
              offer.price product[:price]
              offer.currencyId 'UAH'
              offer.categoryId product[:category_id]
              offer.name product[:name]
              offer.description product[:description] if product[:description]
              offer.vendor product[:vendor] if product[:vendor]
              
              # Add images
              Array(product[:images]).each do |image|
                offer.picture image
              end
              
              # Add parameters
              if product[:params]
                product[:params].each do |param|
                  offer.param(param[:value], name: param[:name], unit: param[:unit])
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    File.write(output_file_path, xml)
    puts "Products exported to #{output_file_path}"
    
    xml
  end

  # Import orders from Prom.ua
  def import_orders(status: nil, date_from: nil, date_to: nil)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/orders/list"
    
    params = {
      company_id: @company_id
    }
    params[:status] = status if status
    params[:date_from] = date_from if date_from
    params[:date_to] = date_to if date_to
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: headers,
      query: params
    )
    
    if response.success?
      parse_orders_response(response.parsed_response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Get order details by ID
  def get_order(order_id)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/orders/#{order_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: headers,
      query: { company_id: @company_id }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      parse_order_response(response.parsed_response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Update order status
  def update_order_status(order_id, status, reason: nil)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/orders/#{order_id}/status"
    
    body = {
      company_id: @company_id,
      status: status
    }
    body[:reason] = reason if reason
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      endpoint,
      headers: headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json'),
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      { success: true, message: "Order #{order_id} status updated to #{status}" }
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def product_categories(products)
    categories = []
    products.each do |product|
      categories << {
        id: product[:category_id],
        name: product[:category_name],
        parent_id: product[:category_parent_id]
      }
    end
    categories.uniq { |c| c[:id] }
  end

  def parse_orders_response(response_data)
    return [] unless response_data.is_a?(Hash) && response_data['orders']
    
    response_data['orders'].map do |order_data|
      {
        id: order_data['id'],
        status: order_data['status'],
        created_at: order_data['created_at'],
        total_price: order_data['total_price'],
        client_first_name: order_data['client_first_name'],
        client_last_name: order_data['client_last_name'],
        client_phone: order_data['client_phone'],
        delivery_info: order_data['delivery_info'],
        items: parse_order_items(order_data['items'])
      }
    end
  end

  def parse_order_response(order_data)
    return nil unless order_data.is_a?(Hash)
    
    {
      id: order_data['id'],
      status: order_data['status'],
      created_at: order_data['created_at'],
      total_price: order_data['total_price'],
      client_first_name: order_data['client_first_name'],
      client_last_name: order_data['client_last_name'],
      client_phone: order_data['client_phone'],
      client_email: order_data['client_email'],
      delivery_info: order_data['delivery_info'],
      payment_method: order_data['payment_method'],
      comment: order_data['comment'],
      items: parse_order_items(order_data['items'])
    }
  end

  def parse_order_items(items_data)
    return [] unless items_data.is_a?(Array)
    
    items_data.map do |item|
      {
        product_id: item['product_id'],
        sku: item['sku'],
        name: item['name'],
        price: item['price'],
        quantity: item['quantity'],
        total_price: item['total_price']
      }
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = if response.parsed_response.is_a?(Hash)
      response.parsed_response['error'] || response.parsed_response['message']
    else
      response.body
    end
    
    {
      success: false,
      error: "API Error (#{response.code}): #{error_message}"
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class NewPostDeliveryCalculator

  def calculate_cost(sender_city, recipient_city, weight, declared_value, service_type = 'WarehouseWarehouse')
    request_data = {

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if data['success']
        cost_info = data['data'].first
        {
          success: true,
          cost: cost_info['Cost'],
          estimated_delivery_date: cost_info['EstimatedDeliveryDate'],
          cost_details: {
            delivery_cost: cost_info['Cost'],
            redelivery_cost: cost_info['CostRedelivery'],
            insurance_cost: cost_info['CostPack'],
            total_cost: cost_info['Cost']
          }
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          errors: data['errors'] || data['warnings'] || ['Невідома помилка']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: ["Помилка мережі: #{response.code}"]
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    {
      success: false,
      errors: ["Помилка парсингу відповіді: #{e.message}"]
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# olx_partner_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

Dotenv.load

class OLXPartnerAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://olx.ua/partner/api'

  def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:)
    @client_id = client_id || ENV['OLX_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = client_secret || ENV['OLX_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @access_token = nil
    authenticate
  end

  # Authenticate and get access token
  def authenticate
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/token",
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        scope: 'v2 write read'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      puts "Authentication successful!"
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end

  # Get categories for Ukraine
  def get_categories
    make_request('/categories', :get)
  end

  # Get attributes for a specific category
  def get_category_attributes(category_id)
    make_request("/categories/#{category_id}/attributes", :get)
  end

  # Get locations (regions and cities)
  def get_locations
    make_request('/locations', :get)
  end

  # Create a new advert
  def create_advert(advert_data)
    make_request('/partner/adverts', :post, advert_data)
  end

  # Get all adverts
  def get_adverts(status: nil, page: 1, limit: 50)
    params = { page: page, limit: limit }
    params[:status] = status if status
    make_request('/partner/adverts', :get, nil, params)
  end

  # Get specific advert by ID
  def get_advert(advert_id)
    make_request("/partner/adverts/#{advert_id}", :get)
  end

  # Update an existing advert
  def update_advert(advert_id, advert_data)
    make_request("/partner/adverts/#{advert_id}", :patch, advert_data)
  end

  # Delete an advert
  def delete_advert(advert_id)
    make_request("/partner/adverts/#{advert_id}", :delete)
  end

  # Activate/Deactivate advert
  def change_advert_status(advert_id, active: true)
    action = active ? 'activate' : 'deactivate'
    make_request("/partner/adverts/#{advert_id}/#{action}", :post)
  end

  # Upload image and get image ID
  def upload_image(image_path)
    image_data = File.read(image_path)
    base64_image = Base64.strict_encode64(image_data)
    
    response = make_request('/partner/images', :post, {
      image: base64_image
    })
    
    response['id'] if response
  end

  private

  def make_request(endpoint, method, body = nil, params = {})
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    options = {
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    }

    options[:body] = body.to_json if body
    options[:query] = params if params.any?

    url = BASE_URL + endpoint

    begin
      response = case method
                 when :get
                   HTTParty.get(url, options)
                 when :post
                   HTTParty.post(url, options)
                 when :patch
                   HTTParty.patch(url, options)
                 when :delete
                   HTTParty.delete(url, options)
                 end

      if response.success?
        response.parsed_response
      else
        puts "API Error (#{response.code}): #{response.parsed_response}"
        nil
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Request failed: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
end

# Helper class for building advert data
class OLXAdvertBuilder
  attr_accessor :title, :description, :category_id, :price, :currency, :location,
                :contact, :images, :attributes, :external_id

  def initialize
    @attributes = {}
    @images = []
  end

  def set_basic_info(title, description, category_id, price, currency = 'UAH')
    @title = title
    @description = description
    @category_id = category_id
    @price = price
    @currency = currency
    self
  end

  def set_location(city_id, region_id = nil)
    @location = { city_id: city_id }
    @location[:region_id] = region_id if region_id
    self
  end

  def set_contact(phone, name, email = nil)
    @contact = {
      phone: phone,
      name: name
    }
    @contact[:email] = email if email
    self
  end

  def add_image(image_id)
    @images << { id: image_id }
    self
  end

  def add_attribute(attribute_id, value)
    @attributes[attribute_id] = value
    self
  end

  def set_external_id(id)
    @external_id = id
    self
  end

  def build
    advert = {
      title: @title,
      description: @description,
      category_id: @category_id.to_i,
      price: {
        value: @price.to_f,
        currency: @currency
      },
      location: @location,
      contact: @contact,
      external_id: @external_id
    }

    advert[:images] = @images if @images.any?
    advert[:attributes] = @attributes if @attributes.any?

    advert.deep_stringify_keys
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/services/nova_poshta_service.rb
class NovaPoshtaService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  def fetch_cities(page = 1, limit = 100)
    make_request('Address', 'getCities', {
      Page: page,
      Limit: limit
    })
  end

  def fetch_warehouses(page = 1, limit = 100)
    make_request('AddressGeneral', 'getWarehouses', {
      Page: page,
      Limit: limit
    })
  end

  private

  def make_request(model_name, called_method, method_properties = {})
    body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: model_name,
      calledMethod: called_method,
      methodProperties: method_properties
    }

    response = self.class.post('', body: body.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Nova Poshta API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/workers/nova_poshta_import_worker.rb
class NovaPoshtaImportWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options retry: 3

  def perform
    api_key = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    
    unless api_key
      Rails.logger.error "Nova Poshta API key not configured"
      return
    end

    service = NovaPoshtaService.new(api_key)
    
    import_cities(service)
    import_warehouses(service)
    
    Rails.logger.info "Nova Poshta data import completed successfully"
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Nova Poshta import failed: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end

  private

  def import_cities(service, page = 1, limit = 500)
    loop do
      response = service.fetch_cities(page, limit)
      break unless response && response['success']

      cities_data = response['data']
      break if cities_data.empty?

      Rails.logger.info "Importing cities page #{page}, #{cities_data.size} records"

      cities_data.each do |city_data|
        import_city(city_data)
      end

      break if cities_data.size < limit
      page += 1
    end
  end

  def import_warehouses(service, page = 1, limit = 500)
    loop do
      response = service.fetch_warehouses(page, limit)
      break unless response && response['success']

      warehouses_data = response['data']
      break if warehouses_data.empty?

      Rails.logger.info "Importing warehouses page #{page}, #{warehouses_data.size} records"

      warehouses_data.each do |warehouse_data|
        import_warehouse(warehouse_data)
      end

      break if warehouses_data.size < limit
      page += 1
    end
  end

  def import_city(city_data)
    city = NovaPoshtaCity.find_or_initialize_by(ref: city_data['Ref'])
    
    city.assign_attributes(
      name_ua: city_data['Description'],
      name_ru: city_data['DescriptionRu'],
      name_en: city_data['DescriptionEn'],
      area_ref: city_data['Area'],
      area_name_ua: city_data['AreaDescription'],
      area_name_ru: city_data['AreaDescriptionRu'],
      area_name_en: city_data['AreaDescriptionEn'],
      region_ref: city_data['Regions'],
      region_name_ua: city_data['RegionDescription'],
      region_name_ru: city_data['RegionDescriptionRu'],
      region_name_en: city_data['RegionDescriptionEn'],
      delivery_1: city_data['Delivery1'] == '1',
      delivery_2: city_data['Delivery2'] == '1',
      delivery_3: city_data['Delivery3'] == '1',
      delivery_4: city_data['Delivery4'] == '1',
      delivery_5: city_data['Delivery5'] == '1',
      delivery_6: city_data['Delivery6'] == '1',
      delivery_7: city_data['Delivery7'] == '1',
      post_code: city_data['PostCode'],
      city_id: city_data['CityID'],
      latitude: city_data['Latitude'].to_f if city_data['Latitude'].present?,
      longitude: city_data['Longitude'].to_f if city_data['Longitude'].present?
    )

    city.save!
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to import city #{city_data['Ref']}: #{e.message}"
  end

  def import_warehouse(warehouse_data)
    branch = NovaPoshtaBranch.find_or_initialize_by(ref: warehouse_data['Ref'])
    
    branch.assign_attributes(
      site_key: warehouse_data['SiteKey'],
      description_ua: warehouse_data['Description'],
      description_ru: warehouse_data['DescriptionRu'],
      description_en: warehouse_data['DescriptionEn'],
      short_address_ua: warehouse_data['ShortAddress'],
      short_address_ru: warehouse_data['ShortAddressRu'],
      short_address_en: warehouse_data['ShortAddressEn'],
      phone: warehouse_data['Phone'],
      city_ref: warehouse_data['CityRef'],
      city_name_ua: warehouse_data['CityDescription'],
      city_name_ru: warehouse_data['CityDescriptionRu'],
      city_name_en: warehouse_data['CityDescriptionEn'],
      settlement_ref: warehouse_data['SettlementRef'],
      settlement_description_ua: warehouse_data['SettlementDescription'],
      settlement_description_ru: warehouse_data['SettlementDescriptionRu'],
      settlement_description_en: warehouse_data['SettlementDescriptionEn'],
      number: warehouse_data['Number'],
      type: warehouse_data['Type'],
      latitude: warehouse_data['Latitude'].to_f if warehouse_data['Latitude'].present?,
      longitude: warehouse_data['Longitude'].to_f if warehouse_data['Longitude'].present?,
      is_warehouse: warehouse_data['Warehouse'] == '1',
      is_working: warehouse_data['IsWorking'] == '1',
      schedule: parse_schedule(warehouse_data['Schedule']),
      receiving_limits: parse_limits(warehouse_data['ReceivingLimitsOnDimensions']),
      delivery_limits: parse_limits(warehouse_data['DeliveryLimitsOnDimensions'])
    )

    branch.save!
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to import warehouse #{warehouse_data['Ref']}: #{e.message}"
  end

  def parse_schedule(schedule_string)
    return {} unless schedule_string.present?
    
    # Parse schedule string like "Пн-Пт: 09:00-18:00, Сб: 10:00-16:00"
    { raw: schedule_string }
  end

  def parse_limits(limits_string)
    return {} unless limits_string.present?
    
    # Parse limits string like "Від 0.5 кг до 30 кг"
    { raw: limits_string }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# nova_poshta_delivery_calculator.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class NovaPoshtaDeliveryCalculator
  API_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'.freeze
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    raise "Nova Poshta API key is required" unless @api_key
  end

  # Main method to calculate delivery cost
  def calculate_delivery_cost(city_name, weight_kg, declared_value_uah = 0, service_type = "WarehouseWarehouse")
    # Step 1: Find city reference by name
    city_ref = find_city_reference(city_name)
    return { error: "City '#{city_name}' not found" } unless city_ref

    # Step 2: Get warehouses in the city
    warehouses = get_city_warehouses(city_ref)
    return { error: "No warehouses found in '#{city_name}'" } if warehouses.empty?

    # Step 3: Calculate delivery cost
    calculate_cost(city_ref, warehouses.first['Ref'], weight_kg, declared_value_uah, service_type)
  end

  private

  def find_city_reference(city_name)
    response = make_api_request('Address', 'searchSettlements', {
      CityName: city_name,
      Limit: 1
    })
    
    if response['success'] && response['data'].any?
      settlements = response['data'].first['Addresses']
      return settlements.first['Ref'] if settlements.any?
    end
    
    nil
  end

  def get_city_warehouses(city_ref)
    response = make_api_request('AddressGeneral', 'getWarehouses', {
      CityRef: city_ref
    })
    
    response['success'] ? response['data'] : []
  end

  def calculate_cost(city_ref, warehouse_ref, weight_kg, declared_value_uah, service_type)
    response = make_api_request('InternetDocument', 'getDocumentPrice', {
      CitySender: '8d5a980d-391c-11dd-90d9-001a92567626', # Kyiv sender reference
      CityRecipient: city_ref,
      Weight: weight_kg,
      ServiceType: service_type,
      Cost: declared_value_uah,
      CargoType: 'Parcel',
      SeatsAmount: 1
    })
    
    if response['success'] && response['data'].any?
      cost_data = response['data'].first
      {
        cost: cost_data['Cost'].to_f,
        assessed_cost: cost_data['AssessedCost'].to_f,
        insurance_cost: cost_data['InsuranceCost'].to_f,
        total_cost: (cost_data['Cost'].to_f + cost_data['InsuranceCost'].to_f).round(2),
        weight: weight_kg,
        declared_value: declared_value_uah,
        currency: 'UAH'
      }
    else
      { error: "Failed to calculate cost: #{response['errors']&.join(', ')}" }
    end
  end

  def make_api_request(model_name, method_name, params = {})
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: model_name,
      calledMethod: method_name,
      methodProperties: params
    }.to_json

    response = HTTParty.post(
      API_URL,
      body: request_body,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    { 'success' => false, 'errors' => ["JSON parsing error: #{e.message}"] }
  rescue StandardError => e
    { 'success' => false, 'errors' => ["Request error: #{e.message}"] }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# olx_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class OLXClient
  def initialize
    @base_url = ENV['OLX_BASE_URL']
    @access_token = ENV['OLX_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Version' => '2.0'
    }
  end

  # Отримання токена доступу (якщо потрібно)
  def get_access_token
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/oauth/token",
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: ENV['OLX_CLIENT_ID'],
        client_secret: ENV['OLX_CLIENT_SECRET']
      }.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання токена: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Отримання категорій
  def get_categories
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/categories",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання атрибутів категорії
  def get_category_attributes(category_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/categories/#{category_id}/attributes",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Публікація нового оголошення
  def create_advertisement(ad_data)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/partner/advertisements",
      body: ad_data.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Оновлення існуючого оголошення
  def update_advertisement(ad_id, ad_data)
    response = HTTParty.patch(
      "#{@base_url}/partner/advertisements/#{ad_id}",
      body: ad_data.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання інформації про оголошення
  def get_advertisement(ad_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/partner/advertisements/#{ad_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Видалення оголошення
  def delete_advertisement(ad_id)
    response = HTTParty.delete(
      "#{@base_url}/partner/advertisements/#{ad_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання списку оголошень
  def get_advertisements(status = 'active', limit = 50, offset = 0)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/partner/advertisements",
      headers: @headers,
      query: {
        status: status,
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'builder'
require 'time'

class PromYmlExporter
  def initialize(shop_name, shop_company, shop_url)
    @shop_name = shop_name
    @shop_company = shop_company
    @shop_url = shop_url
  end

  def generate_yml(products)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')) do
      xml.shop do
        xml.name @shop_name
        xml.company @shop_company
        xml.url @shop_url
        
        xml.currencies do
          xml.currency(id: 'UAH', rate: 1)
        end
        
        xml.categories do
          categories = products.map { |p| p[:category] }.uniq
          categories.each_with_index do |category, index|
            xml.category(category, id: index + 1)
          end
        end
        
        xml.offers do
          products.each do |product|
            xml.offer(id: product[:id], available: product[:available]) do
              xml.url product[:url] if product[:url]
              xml.price product[:price]
              xml.currencyId 'UAH'
              xml.categoryId categories.index(product[:category]) + 1
              xml.picture product[:image_url] if product[:image_url]
              
              xml.name product[:name]
              xml.description product[:description] if product[:description]
              xml.vendor product[:vendor] if product[:vendor]
              xml.vendorCode product[:vendor_code] if product[:vendor_code]
              
              if product[:params]
                product[:params].each do |key, value|
                  xml.param(value, name: key)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end

  def export_to_file(products, filename)
    yml_content = generate_yml(products)
    File.open(filename, 'w') { |file| file.write(yml_content) }
    puts "YML файл успішно експортовано: #{filename}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
    response = self.class.get("/orders/#{order_id}")
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['order']
    else
      handle_error(response)
      nil
    end
  end

  def update_order_status(order_id, status, comment: nil)
    data = { status: status }
    data[:seller_comment] = comment if comment
    
    response = self.class.post("/orders/#{order_id}/edit", body: data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Статус замовлення #{order_id} успішно оновлено до '#{status}'"
      true
    else
      handle_error(response)
      false
    end
  end

  def import_recent_orders(hours: 24)
    # Отримуємо замовлення за останні N годин
    since_time = (Time.now - hours * 3600).iso8601
    params = { 
      limit: 500,
      created_at_from: since_time
    }
    
    response = self.class.get('/orders/list', query: params)
    
    if response.success?
      orders = JSON.parse(response.body)['orders'] || []
      process_imported_orders(orders)
      orders
    else
      handle_error(response)
      []
    end
  end

  private

  def process_imported_orders(orders)
    orders.each do |order|
      puts "Імпорт замовлення ##{order['id']}:"
      puts "  Клієнт: #{order['client_first_name']} #{order['client_last_name']}"
      puts "  Телефон: #{order['client_phone']}"
      puts "  Статус: #{order['status_name']}"
      puts "  Сума: #{order['price']} #{order['currency']}"
      puts "  Товари:"
      
      order['products'].each do |product|
        puts "    - #{product['name']}: #{product['quantity']} x #{product['price']}"
      end
      puts "-" * 50
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = if response.body && !response.body.empty?
                      JSON.parse(response.body)['error'] rescue response.body
                    else
                      "HTTP #{response.code}"
                    end
    
    puts "Помилка API: #{error_message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# nova_poshta_return_shipment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class NovaPoshtaReturnShipment
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Main method to create a return shipment
  def create_return_shipment(original_order_data, return_data)
    # First, get information about the original order
    original_order = get_order_info(original_order_data[:ttn])
    
    unless original_order
      puts "Error: Could not find original order with TTN #{original_order_data[:ttn]}"
      return nil
    end

    # Prepare return shipment data
    return_shipment_data = prepare_return_data(original_order, return_data)
    
    # Create the return shipment
    response = send_request('InternetDocument', 'save', return_shipment_data)
    
    if response['success']
      puts "Return shipment created successfully!"
      puts "Return TTN: #{response['data'][0]['IntDocNumber']}"
      return response['data'][0]
    else
      puts "Error creating return shipment:"
      puts response['errors'].join(', ')
      return nil
    end
  end

  private

  def get_order_info(ttn)
    data = {
      DocumentNumber: ttn,
      Phone: '' # Optional: sender's phone for verification
    }
    
    response = send_request('TrackingDocument', 'getStatusDocuments', data)
    
    if response['success'] && response['data'].any?
      response['data'][0]
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  def prepare_return_data(original_order, return_data)
    {
      SenderWarehouseIndex: original_order['WarehouseRecipient'], # Return from recipient's warehouse
      RecipientWarehouseIndex: original_order['WarehouseSender'], # Return to sender's warehouse
      PayerType: return_data[:payer_type] || 'Recipient', # Who pays for return
      PaymentMethod: return_data[:payment_method] || 'Cash',
      DateTime: return_data[:date] || Date.today.strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
      CargoType: return_data[:cargo_type] || 'Parcel',
      VolumeGeneral: return_data[:volume] || '0.1',
      Weight: return_data[:weight] || '1',
      ServiceType: return_data[:service_type] || 'WarehouseWarehouse',
      SeatsAmount: return_data[:seats] || '1',
      Description: return_data[:description] || 'Return shipment',
      Cost: return_data[:cost] || '0',
      CitySender: original_order['CityRecipient'],
      Sender: original_order['Recipient'],
      SenderAddress: original_order['WarehouseRecipient'],
      ContactSender: return_data[:sender_contact_ref] || original_order['RecipientContact'],
      SendersPhone: return_data[:sender_phone] || original_order['RecipientPhone'],
      CityRecipient: original_order['CitySender'],
      Recipient: original_order['Sender'],
      RecipientAddress: original_order['WarehouseSender'],
      ContactRecipient: original_order['SenderContact'],
      RecipientsPhone: original_order['SenderPhone'],
      BackwardDeliveryData: [
        {
          PayerType: 'Recipient',
          CargoType: 'Money',
          RedeliveryString: return_data[:refund_amount].to_s
        }
      ] if return_data[:refund_amount]
    }.compact
  end

  def send_request(model_name, method_name, data)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: model_name,
      calledMethod: method_name,
      methodProperties: data
    }.to_json

    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: request_body,
      headers: @headers
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end

# Usage example:
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Replace with your actual API key from Nova Poshta
  API_KEY = 'your_nova_poshta_api_key_here'

  # Initialize the client
  np_client = NovaPoshtaReturnShipment.new(API_KEY)

  # Original order data
  original_order_data = {
    ttn: '59000000000000' # Replace with actual TTN
  }

  # Return shipment details
  return_data = {
    payer_type: 'Recipient', # Who pays for return shipping
    payment_method: 'Cash',
    cargo_type: 'Parcel',
    weight: '2.5', # kg
    volume: '0.02', # m³
    seats: '1',
    description: 'Return of defective product',
    cost: '500', # UAH
    refund_amount: '1000', # Amount to refund to customer
    sender_phone: '+380501234567' # Customer's phone number
  }

  # Create the return shipment
  result = np_client.create_return_shipment(original_order_data, return_data)
  
  if result
    puts "Success! Return shipment details:"
    puts JSON.pretty_generate(result)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
Dotenv.load

class NovaPoshtaReturn
  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
  BASE_URL = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_BASE_URL']

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || API_KEY
    raise "API ключ не знайдено" unless @api_key
  end

  # Основний метод для створення повернення
  def create_return(order_data)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "AdditionalService",
      calledMethod: "save",
      methodProperties: {
        OrderRef: order_data[:order_ref],
        IntDocNumber: order_data[:int_doc_number],
        PaymentMethod: "Cash",
        Reason: order_data[:reason] || "Повернення товару",
        SubtypeReason: "NotLiked", # або інший підтип
        Note: order_data[:note] || "",
        OrderType: "orderReturn"
      }
    }

    response = send_api_request(request_body)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання інформації про існуючі повернення
  def get_returns(filters = {})
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "AdditionalService",
      calledMethod: "getReturnOrdersList",
      methodProperties: filters
    }

    response = send_api_request(request_body)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання деталей конкретного повернення
  def get_return_details(return_ref)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "AdditionalService",
      calledMethod: "getReturnOrderDocuments",
      methodProperties: {
        Ref: return_ref
      }
    }

    response = send_api_request(request_body)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def send_api_request(request_body)
    HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result["success"]
        {
          success: true,
          data: result["data"],
          errors: result["errors"],
          warnings: result["warnings"]
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          errors: result["errors"],
          warnings: result["warnings"]
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: ["HTTP помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"]
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class EpicentrSync
  include HTTParty
  
  # Base configuration
  base_uri 'https://api.epicentr.ua'  # Replace with actual Epicentr API URL
  
  # Default headers
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  headers 'Accept' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, seller_id: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['EPICENTR_API_KEY']
    @seller_id = seller_id || ENV['EPICENTR_SELLER_ID']
    
    raise "Missing API credentials" unless @api_key && @seller_id
    
    self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    self.class.headers 'X-Seller-ID' => @seller_id
  end
  
  # Sync a single product
  def sync_product(product_data)
    endpoint = '/api/v1/products'  # Replace with actual endpoint
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: product_data.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response, "Product sync")
  end
  
  # Sync multiple products in batch
  def sync_products_batch(products_array)
    endpoint = '/api/v1/products/batch'  # Replace with actual batch endpoint
    
    response = self.class.post(endpoint, body: { products: products_array }.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response, "Batch products sync")
  end
  
  # Update stock quantity for a product
  def update_stock(sku, quantity)
    endpoint = "/api/v1/products/#{sku}/stock"  # Replace with actual stock endpoint
    
    stock_data = {
      sku: sku,
      quantity: quantity,
      updated_at: Time.now.iso8601
    }
    
    response = self.class.put(endpoint, body: stock_data.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response, "Stock update for SKU: #{sku}")
  end
  
  # Update stock for multiple products in batch
  def update_stock_batch(stock_updates)
    endpoint = '/api/v1/products/stock/batch'  # Replace with actual batch stock endpoint
    
    response = self.class.put(endpoint, body: { updates: stock_updates }.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response, "Batch stock update")
  end
  
  # Get product information
  def get_product(sku)
    endpoint = "/api/v1/products/#{sku}"
    
    response = self.class.get(endpoint)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response, "Fetch product #{sku}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Get current stock levels
  def get_stock(sku = nil)
    endpoint = sku ? "/api/v1/products/#{sku}/stock" : '/api/v1/products/stock'
    
    response = self.class.get(endpoint)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response, "Fetch stock#{sku ? " for #{sku}" : ""}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Delete a product
  def delete_product(sku)
    endpoint = "/api/v1/products/#{sku}"
    
    response = self.class.delete(endpoint)
    
    handle_response(response, "Delete product #{sku}")
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response, action)
    if response.success?
      puts "#{action} successful"
      JSON.parse(response.body) if response.body && !response.body.empty?
    else
      handle_error(response, action)
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def handle_error(response, action)
    error_message = "#{action} failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    
    if response.body && !response.body.empty?
      begin
        error_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
        error_message += " - #{error_data['error'] || error_data['message']}"
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        error_message += " - #{response.body}"
      end
    end
    
    puts error_message
    # You might want to raise an exception or log to a proper logging system
    # raise EpicentrAPIError, error_message
  end
end
```

```ruby
class DeliveryAutoClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.delivery-auto.com/api/v4'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key = nil, login = nil, password = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_API_KEY']
    @login = login || ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_PASSWORD']
    @token = nil
  end

  # Authenticate and get access token
  def authenticate
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/Account/Login",
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        login: @login,
        password: @password
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @token = response.parsed_response['token']
      puts "Authentication successful. Token received."
      true
    else
      puts "Authentication failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  end

  # Get shipment status by tracking number
  def get_shipment_status(tracking_number)
    unless @token
      puts "Please authenticate first"
      return nil
    end

    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/Public/PostGetStatus",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        number: tracking_number
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get multiple shipment statuses
  def get_multiple_shipment_statuses(tracking_numbers)
    unless @token
      puts "Please authenticate first"
      return nil
    end

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/Public/PostGetStatusList",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        orders: tracking_numbers.map { |num| { number: num } }
      }.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get shipment details with full information
  def get_shipment_details(tracking_number)
    unless @token
      puts "Please authenticate first"
      return nil
    end

    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/Public/PostGetDetails",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        number: tracking_number
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class GlovoOrder
  include HTTParty
  
  # Glovo API endpoints (these might need to be updated based on current API)
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.glovoapp.com'
  
  # API endpoints
  ENDPOINTS = {
    auth: '/oauth/token',
    estimate: '/b2b/orders/estimate',
    create: '/b2b/orders',
    track: '/b2b/orders/:id/tracking'
  }
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, api_secret: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['GLOVO_API_SECRET']
    @access_token = nil
    
    raise "Missing API credentials" unless @api_key && @api_secret
    
    authenticate!
  end
  
  # Authenticate with Glovo API
  def authenticate!
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{ENDPOINTS[:auth]}",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @api_key,
        client_secret: @api_secret
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      puts "✅ Authenticated successfully"
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Get delivery estimate
  def get_estimate(delivery_params)
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{ENDPOINTS[:estimate]}",
      headers: authenticated_headers,
      body: delivery_params.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Get estimate")
  end
  
  # Create a new order
  def create_order(order_params)
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{ENDPOINTS[:create]}",
      headers: authenticated_headers,
      body: order_params.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Create order")
  end
  
  # Track an existing order
  def track_order(order_id)
    endpoint = ENDPOINTS[:track].gsub(':id', order_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      headers: authenticated_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Track order")
  end
```
