```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class DeliveryStatusService
  include HTTParty
  
  # Базові налаштування API
  base_uri ENV['DELIVERY_API_BASE_URL']
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['DELIVERY_API_KEY']}"
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['DELIVERY_API_KEY']
    self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
  end
  
  # Отримати статус конкретного відправлення
  def get_shipment_status(tracking_number)
    begin
      response = self.class.get("/shipments/#{tracking_number}/status")
      
      case response.code
      when 200
        parse_status_response(response.body)
      when 404
        { error: "Відправлення з номером #{tracking_number} не знайдено" }
      when 401
        { error: "Неавторизований доступ. Перевірте API ключ" }
      when 500
        { error: "Внутрішня помилка сервера служби доставки" }
      else
        { error: "Невідома помилка: #{response.code}" }
      end
      
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { error: "Помилка мережі: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: "Неочікувана помилка: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Отримати статуси для декількох відправлень
  def get_multiple_shipments_status(tracking_numbers)
    return { error: "Необхідно вказати масив номерів відстеження" } unless tracking_numbers.is_a?(Array)
    
    results = {}
    tracking_numbers.each do |tracking_number|
      results[tracking_number] = get_shipment_status(tracking_number)
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_status_response(response_body)
    data = JSON.parse(response_body)
    
    {
      tracking_number: data['tracking_number'],
      status: data['status'],
      description: status_description(data['status']),
      last_update: data['last_updated'],
      estimated_delivery: data['estimated_delivery'],
      current_location: data['current_location'],
      events: data['events'] || []
    }
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { error: "Помилка парсингу відповіді API" }
  end
  
  def status_description(status_code)
    status_descriptions = {
      'created' => 'Відправлення створено',
      'picked_up' => 'Відправлення забрано кур\'єром',
      'in_transit' => 'Відправлення в дорозі',
      'at_warehouse' => 'Відправлення на складі',
      'out_for_delivery' => 'Відправлення виїхало до отримувача',
      'delivered' => 'Відправлення доставлено',
      'exception' => 'Виникла проблема з доставкою',
      'returned' => 'Відправлення повернуто'
    }
    
    status_descriptions[status_code] || 'Невідомий статус'
  end
end

# Приклад використання

      end
    end
  end
  
  # Отримати статуси для декількох відправлень
```

```ruby
# lib/epicentr_api/client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class EpicentrApi::Client
  include HTTParty
  base_uri ENV['EPICENTR_API_BASE_URL']
  
  def initialize(api_key, seller_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @seller_id = seller_id
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Seller-ID' => seller_id
    }
  end
  
  def get_products(page: 1, per_page: 100)
    response = self.class.get(
      '/api/v1/seller/products',
      headers: @headers,
      query: { page: page, per_page: per_page }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def update_stock(sku, quantity)
    response = self.class.put(
      "/api/v1/seller/products/#{sku}/stock",
      headers: @headers,
      body: { quantity: quantity }.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def update_product_price(sku, price)
    response = self.class.put(
      "/api/v1/seller/products/#{sku}/price",
      headers: @headers,
      body: { price: price }.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def create_product(product_data)
    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/seller/products',
      headers: @headers,
      body: product_data.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise AuthenticationError, 'Invalid API key or seller ID'
    when 403
      raise AuthorizationError, 'Insufficient permissions'
    when 404
      raise NotFoundError, 'Resource not found'
    when 429
      raise RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded'
    else
      raise ApiError, "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Помилки API
class AuthenticationError < StandardError; end
class AuthorizationError < StandardError; end
class NotFoundError < StandardError; end
class RateLimitError < StandardError; end
class ApiError < StandardError; end
```

### 4. Сервіс синхронізації

```ruby
# services/product_sync_service.rb
require 'logger'

class ProductSyncService
  def initialize
    @api_client = EpicentrApi::Client.new(
      ENV['EPICENTR_API_KEY'],
      ENV['EPICENTR_SELLER_ID']
    )
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end
  
  def sync_all_products
    @logger.info('Starting full product sync from Epicentr')
    
    page = 1
    total_products = 0
    
    loop do
      begin
        response = @api_client.get_products(page: page)
        products_data = response['products'] || []
        
        break if products_data.empty?
        
        products_data.each do |product_data|
          sync_single_product(product_data)
          total_products += 1
        end
        
        @logger.info("Synced page #{page} - #{products_data.size} products")
        
        # Перевіряємо чи є наступна сторінка
        break unless response['has_next_page']
        page += 1
        
        # Запобігаємо rate limiting
        sleep(0.5)
        
      rescue => e
        @logger.error("Error syncing page #{page}: #{e.message}")
        break
      end
    end
    
    @logger.info("Product sync completed. Total products: #{total_products}")
    total_products
  end
  
  def sync_single_product(product_data)
    Product.sync_from_epicentr(product_data)
    @logger.info("Synced product: #{product_data['sku']}")
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error syncing product #{product_data['sku']}: #{e.message}")
  end
  
  def update_stock_for_product(sku, quantity)
    @api_client.update_stock(sku, quantity)
    product = Product.find_by(sku: sku)
    product.update!(stock_quantity: quantity, last_synced_at: Time.current)
    @logger.info("Updated stock for #{sku}: #{quantity}")
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error updating stock for #{sku}: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def update_price_for_product(sku, price)
    @api_client.update_product_price(sku, price)
    product = Product.find_by(sku: sku)
    product.update!(price: price, last_synced_at: Time.current)
    @logger.info("Updated price for #{sku}: #{price}")
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error updating price for #{sku}: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def push_local_products_to_epicentr
    local_products = Product.where(external_id: nil)
    
    local_products.each do |product|
      product_data = {
        sku: product.sku,
        name: product.name,
        description: product.description,
        price: product.price,
        stock_quantity: product.stock_quantity
      }
      
      response = @api_client.create_product(product_data)
      product.update!(external_id: response['id'], last_synced_at: Time.current)
      @logger.info("Pushed product to Epicentr: #{product.sku}")
      
      sleep(0.2) # Запобігаємо rate limiting
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# workers/product_sync_worker.rb
require 'sidekiq'

class ProductSyncWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options retry: 3, queue: 'epicentr_sync'
  
  def perform(sync_type, *args)
    service = ProductSyncService.new
    
    case sync_type.to_sym
    when :full_sync
      service.sync_all_products
    when :update_stock
      service.update_stock_for_product(args[0], args[1])
    when :update_price
      service.update_price_for_product(args[0], args[1])
    when :push_local
      service.push_local_products_to_epicentr
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown sync type: #{sync_type}"
    end
  end
```

### bas_exporter.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class BASExporter
  BAS_API_ENDPOINTS = {
    test: 'https://api-test.bas.e-conomic.com/api/v1',
    production: 'https://api.bas.e-conomic.com/api/v1'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(api_key:, environment: :test, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
    @api_key = api_key
    @environment = environment
    @logger = logger
    @base_url = BAS_API_ENDPOINTS[environment]
  end

  # Експорт одного замовлення
  def export_order(order_data)
    validate_order_data(order_data)
    
    begin
      # Створення XML для BAS
      xml_data = build_bas_xml(order_data)
      
      # Відправка даних до BAS API
      response = send_to_bas(xml_data)
      
      # Обробка відповіді
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error "Помилка при експорті замовлення #{order_data[:order_number]}: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end

  # Масовий експорт замовлень
  def export_orders(orders_data)
    results = []
    
    orders_data.each do |order_data|
      begin
        result = export_order(order_data)
        results << { success: true, order_number: order_data[:order_number], data: result }
      rescue StandardError => e
        results << { success: false, order_number: order_data[:order_number], error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end

  # Перевірка підключення до BAS
  def test_connection
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/ping",
      headers: default_headers
    )
    
    response.success?
  end

  private

  def validate_order_data(order_data)
    required_fields = [:order_number, :customer_code, :order_date, :items]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| order_data[field].nil? || order_data[field].to_s.empty? }
    
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    if order_data[:items].empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Замовлення має містити хоча б один товар"
    end
  end

  def build_bas_xml(order_data)
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    builder.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    builder.order do |xml|
      xml.orderNumber order_data[:order_number]
      xml.orderDate format_date(order_data[:order_date])
      xml.customerCode order_data[:customer_code]
      xml.customerName order_data[:customer_name] if order_data[:customer_name]
      xml.deliveryAddress build_address_xml(order_data[:delivery_address]) if order_data[:delivery_address]
      xml.currency order_data[:currency] || 'UAH'
      xml.totalAmount format_amount(order_data[:total_amount]) if order_data[:total_amount]
      xml.vatAmount format_amount(order_data[:vat_amount]) if order_data[:vat_amount]
      
      xml.items do
        order_data[:items].each do |item|
          xml.item do
            xml.productCode item[:product_code]
            xml.productName item[:product_name]
            xml.quantity item[:quantity]
            xml.unitPrice format_amount(item[:unit_price])
            xml.vatRate format_amount(item[:vat_rate] || 20.0) # Стандартне ПДВ 20%
            xml.totalAmount format_amount(item[:total_amount]) if item[:total_amount]
          end
        end
      end
      
      xml.notes order_data[:notes] if order_data[:notes]
    end
    
    builder.target!
  end

  def build_address_xml(address)
    return '' unless address.is_a?(Hash)
    
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new
    builder.address do |xml|
      xml.street address[:street] if address[:street]
      xml.city address[:city] if address[:city]
      xml.region address[:region] if address[:region]
      xml.postalCode address[:postal_code] if address[:postal_code]
      xml.country address[:country] || 'Україна'
    end
    
    builder.target!
  end

  def send_to_bas(xml_data)
    HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/orders",
      body: xml_data,
      headers: default_headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/xml')
    )
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      parse_success_response(response.body)
    when 400
      raise "BAS: Невірний запит - #{parse_error_response(response.body)}"
    when 401
      raise "BAS: Неавторизований доступ - перевірте API ключ"
    when 500
      raise "BAS: Внутрішня помилка сервера"
    else
      raise "BAS: Невідома помилка (код: #{response.code})"
    end
  end

  def parse_success_response(body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(body)
    {
      bas_order_id: doc.at('orderId')&.text,
      status: doc.at('status')&.text,
      message: doc.at('message')&.text,
      timestamp: doc.at('timestamp')&.text
    }
  end

  def parse_error_response(body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(body)
    doc.at('error')&.text || 'Невідома помилка'
  end

  def default_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'User-Agent' => 'BAS-Exporter/1.0'
    }
  end

  def format_date(date)
    case date
    when Date, Time, DateTime
      date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    when String
      Date.parse(date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    else
      Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    end
  rescue
    Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
  end

  def format_amount(amount)
    sprintf('%.2f', amount.to_f)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class OrderDataBuilder
  def self.build_from_hash(data)
    {
      order_number: data[:order_number] || data['order_number'],
      order_date: data[:order_date] || data['order_date'] || Date.today,
      customer_code: data[:customer_code] || data['customer_code'],
      customer_name: data[:customer_name] || data['customer_name'],

      notes: data[:notes] || data['notes'],
      delivery_address: build_address(data[:delivery_address] || data['delivery_address']),
      items: build_items(data[:items] || data['items'] || [])
    }
  end

  def self.build_address(address_data)
    return nil unless address_data
    
    {
      street: address_data[:street] || address_data['street'],
      city: address_data[:city] || address_data['city'],
      region: address_data[:region] || address_data['region'],

      country: address_data[:country] || address_data['country'] || 'Україна'
```

**Ruby implementation:**
```ruby
# companies_house_lookup.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class CompaniesHouseLookup
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.company-information.service.gov.uk'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY']
    raise "API key not found. Set COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY environment variable." unless @api_key
  end

  def lookup_company(company_number)
    # Remove any spaces or special characters from company number
    company_number = company_number.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase

    url = "#{BASE_URL}/company/#{company_number}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, {
      basic_auth: {
        username: @api_key,
        password: '' # Companies House API uses empty password
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 404
      { error: 'Company not found' }
    when 401
      { error: 'Unauthorized - check your API key' }
    when 429
      { error: 'Rate limit exceeded' }
    else
      { error: "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}" }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0

  lookup = CompaniesHouseLookup.new

  # Example company numbers (you can replace these)
  company_numbers = [
    '00000006',  # A known test company
    '09387422',  # Example real company
    'INVALID123' # Test invalid number
  ]

  company_numbers.each do |company_number|
    puts "Looking up company number: #{company_number}"
    result = lookup.lookup_company(company_number)
    
    if result['error']
      puts "Error: #{result['error']}"
    else
      puts "Company Name: #{result['company_name']}"
      puts "Company Status: #{result['company_status']}"
      puts "Company Type: #{result['type']}"
      puts "Registered Office Address:"
      if result['registered_office_address']
        result['registered_office_address'].each do |key, value|
          puts "  #{key}: #{value}"
        end
      end
      puts "Incorporation Date: #{result['date_of_creation']}"
      puts "-" * 50
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# rozetka_feed_generator.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'builder'
require 'date'

class RozetkaFeedGenerator
  def initialize
    @categories = []
    @products = []
  end

  # Add category to the feed
  def add_category(id, name, parent_id = nil)
    @categories << {
      id: id,
      name: name,
      parent_id: parent_id
    }
  end

  # Add product to the feed
  def add_product(product_data)
    required_fields = [:id, :name, :price, :category_id, :vendor, :description]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields - product_data.keys
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end

    @products << product_data.merge(
      added_at: product_data[:added_at] || Time.now.iso8601,
      params: product_data[:params] || {}
    )
  end

  # Generate the XML feed
  def generate_feed
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')) do
      # Shop section
      xml.shop do
        # Categories
        xml.categories do
          @categories.each do |category|
            xml.category(category[:name], id: category[:id], parentId: category[:parent_id])
          end
        end

        # Products
        @products.each do |product|
          xml.offer(id: product[:id], available: product[:available] || true) do
            xml.url product[:url] if product[:url]
            xml.price product[:price]
            xml.oldprice product[:old_price] if product[:old_price]
            xml.currencyId product[:currency] || 'UAH'
            xml.categoryId product[:category_id]
            xml.picture product[:image_url] if product[:image_url]
            
            # Multiple images
            if product[:additional_images]
              product[:additional_images].each do |image_url|
                xml.picture image_url
              end
            end
            
            xml.vendor product[:vendor]
            xml.stock_quantity product[:stock_quantity] || 10
            xml.name { xml.cdata!(product[:name]) }
            xml.description { xml.cdata!(product[:description]) }
            
            # Product parameters
            if product[:params].any?
              product[:params].each do |param_name, param_value|
                xml.param(param_value, name: param_name)
              end
            end
            
            # Additional fields
            xml.vendorCode product[:vendor_code] if product[:vendor_code]
            xml.barcode product[:barcode] if product[:barcode]
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end

  # Save feed to file
  def save_to_file(filename = "rozetka_feed_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')}.xml")
    File.write(filename, generate_feed)
    puts "Feed saved to #{filename}"
    filename
  end
end
```

## Key Features

1. **Complete Rozetka XML Structure**: Follows Rozetka's required XML format
2. **Categories Management**: Supports hierarchical categories with parent-child relationships
3. **Product Parameters**: Flexible parameter system for product specifications
4. **Multiple Images**: Support for main image and additional product images
5. **Validation**: Basic validation for required fields
6. **CDATA Support**: Proper handling of HTML content in descriptions
7. **Flexible Output**: Can return XML string or save directly to file

## Required Fields for Products

- `id` - Unique product identifier
- `name` - Product name
- `price` - Current price
- `category_id` - ID of the category
- `vendor` - Manufacturer/brand
- `description` - Product description

## Optional Fields

- `old_price` - Original price for discounts
- `url` - Product page URL
- `image_url` - Main product image
- `additional_images` - Array of additional images
- `vendor_code` - Vendor's product code
- `stock_quantity` - Available quantity
- `params` - Hash of product parameters/specifications

The generated XML will be compatible with Rozetka's marketplace import requirements.

```ruby
class CommerceMlController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_1c
  
  def exchange
    case params[:mode]
    when 'checkauth'
      handle_checkauth
    when 'init'
      handle_init
    when 'file'
      handle_file
    when 'import'
      handle_import
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown mode"
    end
  end
  
  def orders
    case params[:mode]
    when 'checkauth'
      handle_checkauth
    when 'init'
      handle_orders_init
    when 'query'
      handle_orders_query
    when 'success'
      handle_orders_success
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown mode"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def authenticate_1c
    authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic do |username, password|
      username == ENV['1C_USERNAME'] && password == ENV['1C_PASSWORD']
    end
  end
  
  def handle_checkauth
    render plain: "success\nsession\n#{SecureRandom.hex(16)}"
  end
  
  def handle_init
    render plain: "zip=yes\nfile_limit=100000000"
  end
  
  def handle_file
    file_data = request.body.read
    filename = params[:filename]
    
    if filename.present? && file_data.present?
      CommerceMlImportJob.perform_later(filename, file_data)
      render plain: "success"
    else
      render plain: "failure\nInvalid file data"
    end
  end
  
  def handle_import
    render plain: "success"
  end
  
  def handle_orders_init
    render plain: "zip=no"
  end
  
  def handle_orders_query
    orders = Order.where(status: ['new', 'processing']).order(created_at: :asc)
    
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.CommercialInformation do
        xml.Classifier do
          # Можна додати класифікатор, якщо потрібно
        end
        xml.Document do
          orders.each do |order|
            build_order_xml(xml, order)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    send_data builder.to_xml, filename: 'orders.xml', type: 'application/xml'
  end
  
  def handle_orders_success
    order_ids = params[:order_ids].to_s.split(',')
    Order.where(external_id: order_ids).update_all(status: 'shipped')
    render plain: "success"
  end
  
  def build_order_xml(xml, order)
    xml.Document_(
      id: order.external_id,
      number: order.number,
      date: order.created_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
      operation: 'Заказ товара'
    ) do
      xml.Contragents do
        xml.Contragent do
          xml.Id order.customer_external_id
          xml.Name order.customer_name
        end
      end
      xml.Products do
        order.order_items.each do |item|
          xml.Product do
            xml.Id item.product.external_id
            xml.Name item.product.name
            xml.Quantity item.quantity
            xml.Price item.price
            xml.Sum item.total_price
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Джоби для обробки даних

### app/jobs/commerce_ml_import_job.rb
```ruby
class CommerceMlImportJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(filename, file_data)
    temp_file = save_temp_file(filename, file_data)
    
    if filename.end_with?('.zip')
      process_zip_file(temp_file)
    else
      process_xml_file(temp_file, filename)
    end
    
    File.delete(temp_file) if File.exist?(temp_file)
  end
  
  private
  
  def save_temp_file(filename, data)
    temp_path = Rails.root.join('tmp', filename)
    File.binwrite(temp_path, data)
    temp_path.to_s
  end
  
  def process_zip_file(zip_path)
    Zip::File.open(zip_path) do |zip_file|
      zip_file.each do |entry|
        next unless entry.name.end_with?('.xml')
        
        temp_xml_path = Rails.root.join('tmp', entry.name)
        entry.extract(temp_xml_path)
        process_xml_file(temp_xml_path, entry.name)
        File.delete(temp_xml_path)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def process_xml_file(file_path, filename)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(file_path))
    
    if filename.include?('import')
      process_import_xml(doc)
    elsif filename.include?('offers')
      process_offers_xml(doc)
    end
  end
  
  def process_import_xml(doc)
    products = doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/Каталог/Товары/Товар')
    
    products.each do |product_node|
      external_id = product_node.xpath('Ид').text
      product = Product.find_or_initialize_by_external_id(external_id)
      
      product.assign_attributes(
        name: product_node.xpath('Наименование').text,
        description: product_node.xpath('Описание').text,
        article: product_node.xpath('Артикул').text,
        active: true
      )
      
      if product.save
        process_product_properties(product, product_node)
        process_product_images(product, product_node)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def process_offers_xml(doc)
    offers = doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/ПакетПредложений/Предложения/Предложение')
    
    offers.each do |offer_node|
      product_external_id = offer_node.xpath('Ид').text.split('#').first
      product = Product.find_by(external_id: product_external_id)
      
      next unless product
      
      price_node = offer_node.xpath('Цены/Цена')
      price_value = price_node.xpath('ЦенаЗаЕдиницу').text.to_f
      currency = price_node.xpath('Валюта').text
      
      Price.create!(
        product: product,
        value: price_value,
        currency: currency,
        valid_from: Time.current
      )
    end
  end
  
  def process_product_properties(product, product_node)
    properties = product_node.xpath('ЗначенияСвойств/ЗначенияСвойства')
    
    properties.each do |prop_node|
      property_name = prop_node.xpath('Наименование').text
      property_value = prop_node.xpath('Значение').text
      
      # Збереження властивостей продукту (можна розширити)
      product.product_properties ||= {}
      product.product_properties[property_name] = property_value
    end
    
    product.save
  end
  
  def process_product_images(product, product_node)
    images = product_node.xpath('Картинка')
    
    images.each do |image_node|
      image_url = image_node.text
      ProductImage.create!(
        product: product,
        image_url: image_url,
        filename: File.basename(image_url)
      )
    end
  end
end
```

**Код реалізації (docusign_signer.rb):**
```ruby
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'rest-client'

class DocuSignSigner
  def initialize
    # Завантаження конфігурації з .env файлу
    @integrator_key = ENV['DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATOR_KEY']
    @user_id = ENV['DOCUSIGN_USER_ID']
    @account_id = ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID']
    @base_path = ENV['DOCUSIGN_BASE_PATH'] || 'https://demo.docusign.net/restapi'
    @private_key = ENV['DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY']&.gsub('\\n', "\n")
    @client = nil
  end

  def authenticate
    # Конфігурація клієнта DocuSign
    configuration = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @base_path

    @client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    
    # JWT аутентифікація
    jwt_scope = 'signature'
    token_response = @client.request_jwt_user_token(
      @integrator_key,
      @user_id,
      @private_key,
      jwt_scope,
      3600 # Токен на 1 годину
    )

    @client.access_token = token_response.access_token
    puts "Аутентифікація успішна"
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Помилка аутентифікації: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end

  def create_envelope(pdf_path, signer_email, signer_name, document_name = "Договір")
    authenticate unless @client

    # Завантаження PDF файлу
    pdf_content = File.binread(pdf_path)
    base64_file_content = Base64.encode64(pdf_content)

    # Створення документа для конверта
    document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new({
      documentBase64: base64_file_content,
      name: document_name,
      fileExtension: 'pdf',
      documentId: '1'
    })

    # Створення підписанта
    signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new({
      email: signer_email,
      name: signer_name,
      recipientId: '1',
      routingOrder: '1'
    })

    # Позиція підпису (таб)
    sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new({
      documentId: '1',
      pageNumber: '1',
      recipientId: '1',
      tabLabel: 'SignHereTab',
      xPosition: '200',
      yPosition: '200'
    })

    # Додавання табу до підписанта
    signer.tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new({
      signHereTabs: [sign_here]
    })

    # Створення конверта
    envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new({
      emailSubject: "Будь ласка, підпишіть цей документ",
      documents: [document],
      recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new({
        signers: [signer]
      }),
      status: 'sent' # Відправлення негайно
    })

    # API виклик для створення конверта
    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@client)
    result = envelopes_api.create_envelope(@account_id, envelope_definition)
    
    puts "Конверт створено: #{result.envelope_id}"
    result.envelope_id
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Помилка створення конверта: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end

  def download_completed_document(envelope_id, output_path)
    authenticate unless @client

    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@client)
    
    # Перевірка статусу конверта
    envelope = envelopes_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
    
    if envelope.status == 'completed'
      # Завантаження документів
      temp_file = envelopes_api.get_document(@account_id, 'combined', envelope_id)
      File.binwrite(output_path, temp_file)
      puts "Документ завантажено до: #{output_path}"
      return true
    else
      puts "Конверт ще не підписано. Поточний статус: #{envelope.status}"
      return false
    end
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Помилка завантаження документа: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end

  def check_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    authenticate unless @client

    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@client)
    envelope = envelopes_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
    
    {
      status: envelope.status,
      created_date: envelope.created_date_time,
      sent_date: envelope.sent_date_time,
      completed_date: envelope.completed_date_time
    }
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Створення .env файлу з вашими даними:
  # DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATOR_KEY=your_integrator_key
  # DOCUSIGN_USER_ID=your_user_id
  # DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID=your_account_id
  # DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key

  signer = DocuSignSigner.new
  
  # Створення конверта для підписання
  envelope_id = signer.create_envelope(
    'contract.pdf',           # Шлях до PDF файлу
    'signer@example.com',     # Email підписанта
    'John Doe',               # Ім'я підписанта
    'Важливий договір'        # Назва документа
  )

  puts "Очікування підписання... Конверт ID: #{envelope_id}"
  
  # Перевірка статусу кожні 30 секунд
  loop do
    status = signer.check_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    puts "Статус: #{status[:status]}"
    
    if status[:status] == 'completed'
      # Завантаження підписаного документа
      signer.download_completed_document(envelope_id, 'signed_contract.pdf')
      break
    elsif status[:status] == 'declined'
      puts "Документ відхилено"
      break
    end
    
    sleep(30) # Чекаємо 30 секунд перед наступною перевіркою
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'

class BASExporter
  # BAS API endpoints and configuration

      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
      'Accept' => 'application/xml'
    }
  end

  # Main export method
  def export_orders(orders)
    validate_orders(orders)
    
    orders.map do |order|
      begin
        xml_data = build_bas_xml(order)
        response = send_to_bas(xml_data)
        
        {
          order_id: order[:id],
          success: response.success?,
          bas_reference: extract_bas_reference(response),
          timestamp: Time.now.iso8601,
          errors: response.success? ? [] : [response.body]
        }
      rescue StandardError => e
        {
          order_id: order[:id],
          success: false,
          bas_reference: nil,
          timestamp: Time.now.iso8601,
          errors: [e.message]
        }
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_orders(orders)
    raise ArgumentError, "Orders array cannot be empty" if orders.empty?
    
    orders.each do |order|
      validate_order_structure(order)
      validate_ukrainian_requirements(order)
    end
  end

  def validate_order_structure(order)
    required_fields = [:id, :date, :customer, :items, :total_amount]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| order[field].nil? }
    
    raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" unless missing_fields.empty?
    
    # Validate items structure
    order[:items].each do |item|
      item_required_fields = [:name, :quantity, :price, :vat_rate]
      missing_item_fields = item_required_fields.select { |field| item[field].nil? }
      
      unless missing_item_fields.empty?
        raise ArgumentError, "Item missing required fields: #{missing_item_fields.join(', ')}"
      end
    end
  end

  def validate_ukrainian_requirements(order)
    # Validate Ukrainian VAT rates
    order[:items].each do |item|
      unless VAT_RATES.values.include?(item[:vat_rate])
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid VAT rate: #{item[:vat_rate]}. Must be one of: #{VAT_RATES.values.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    # Validate currency (should be UAH for Ukrainian businesses)
    if order[:currency] && order[:currency] != 'UAH'
      puts "Warning: Order currency is #{order[:currency]}, expected UAH for Ukrainian BAS system"
    end

    # Validate customer has required Ukrainian business details
    if order[:customer][:edrpou].nil? && order[:customer][:inn].nil?
      raise ArgumentError, "Customer must have either EDRPOU or INN for Ukrainian business"
    end
  end

  def build_bas_xml(order)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.Document('xmlns' => 'http://bas.gov.ua/schemas/export/v1') do
        xml.Header do
          xml.CompanyCode(@company_info[:code])
          xml.ApiKey(@api_key)
          xml.Timestamp(Time.now.iso8601)
        end
        
        xml.Order do
          build_order_header(xml, order)
          build_customer_info(xml, order[:customer])
          build_order_items(xml, order[:items])
          build_totals(xml, order)
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end

  def build_order_header(xml, order)
    xml.OrderHeader do
      xml.OrderNumber(order[:id])
      xml.OrderDate(order[:date].iso8601)
      xml.Currency(order[:currency] || 'UAH')
      xml.PaymentType(order[:payment_type] || 'cash') # cash, card, bank_transfer
      xml.Notes(order[:notes]) if order[:notes]
    end
  end

  def build_customer_info(xml, customer)
    xml.Customer do
      xml.Name(customer[:name])
      xml.EDRPOU(customer[:edrpou]) if customer[:edrpou]
      xml.INN(customer[:inn]) if customer[:inn]
      xml.Address do
        xml.Street(customer[:address][:street]) if customer[:address]
        xml.City(customer[:address][:city]) if customer[:address]
        xml.PostalCode(customer[:address][:postal_code]) if customer[:address]
      end if customer[:address]
    end
  end

  def build_order_items(xml, items)
    xml.OrderItems do
      items.each_with_index do |item, index|
        xml.Item do
          xml.LineNumber(index + 1)
          xml.Name(item[:name])
          xml.Quantity(item[:quantity])
          xml.UnitPrice(item[:price])
          xml.VATRate(item[:vat_rate])
          xml.TotalAmount(item[:quantity] * item[:price])
          xml.Unit(item[:unit] || 'шт.') # pieces by default
          xml.ProductCode(item[:product_code]) if item[:product_code]
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def build_totals(xml, order)
    xml.Totals do
      total_amount = order[:items].sum { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:price] }
      
      xml.TotalAmount(total_amount)
      xml.TotalVAT(calculate_total_vat(order[:items]))
      xml.TotalWithVAT(total_amount + calculate_total_vat(order[:items]))
      
      # Ukrainian specific fields
      xml.FiscalCode(generate_fiscal_code(order))
      xml.QRCodeData(generate_qr_code_data(order, total_amount))
    end
  end

  def calculate_total_vat(items)
    items.sum do |item|
      item_amount = item[:quantity] * item[:price]
      item_amount * (item[:vat_rate] / 100.0)
    end
  end

  def generate_fiscal_code(order)
    # Generate a fiscal code according to Ukrainian requirements
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i.to_s
    order_id = order[:id].to_s
    "#{timestamp}-#{order_id}-#{Digest::MD5.hexdigest([timestamp, order_id].join)}"[0..15]
  end

  def generate_qr_code_data(order, total_amount)
    # Generate QR code data for Ukrainian fiscal receipts
    data = {
      t: Time.now.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M'),
      s: sprintf('%.2f', total_amount),
      fn: @company_info[:fiscal_number],
      i: generate_fiscal_code(order),
      fp: Digest::MD5.hexdigest([@company_info[:fiscal_number], generate_fiscal_code(order)].join)[0..9]
    }
    
    data.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
  end

  def send_to_bas(xml_data)
    HTTParty.post(
      "#{BAS_API_BASE_URL}/api/orders/export",
      body: xml_data,
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
  end

  def extract_bas_reference(response)
    return nil unless response.success?
    
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    doc.at_xpath('//ReferenceNumber')&.text || doc.at_xpath('//FiscalNumber')&.text
  end
end
```

## Additional utility class for batch processing

```ruby
# bas_batch_exporter.rb
require 'csv'

class BASBatchExporter
  def initialize(bas_exporter, batch_size: 50, delay_between_batches: 5)
    @bas_exporter = bas_exporter
    @batch_size = batch_size
    @delay_between_batches = delay_between_batches
  end

  def export_from_csv(csv_file_path)
    orders = read_orders_from_csv(csv_file_path)
    export_in_batches(orders)
  end

  private

  def read_orders_from_csv(file_path)
    CSV.read(file_path, headers: true, header_converters: :symbol).map do |row|
      {
        id: row[:order_id],
        date: Time.parse(row[:order_date]),
        currency: row[:currency] || 'UAH',
        customer: {
          name: row[:customer_name],
          edrpou: row[:edrpou],
          inn: row[:inn]
        },
        items: parse_items(row[:items]),
        total_amount: row[:total_amount].to_f
      }
    end
  end

  def parse_items(items_json)
    return [] unless items_json
    
    JSON.parse(items_json).map do |item|
      {
        name: item['name'],
        quantity: item['quantity'].to_f,
        price: item['price'].to_f,
        vat_rate: item['vat_rate'].to_f,
        unit: item['unit'] || 'шт.'
      }
    end
  end

  def export_in_batches(orders)
    results = []
    
    orders.each_slice(@batch_size).with_index do |batch, index|
      puts "Processing batch #{index + 1} of #{((orders.size - 1) / @batch_size) + 1}"
      
      batch_results = @bas_exporter.export_orders(batch)
      results.concat(batch_results)
      
      # Log progress
      successful = batch_results.count { |r| r[:success] }
      puts "Batch #{index + 1}: #{successful}/#{batch.size} successful"
      
      sleep(@delay_between_batches) if index < (orders.size / @batch_size)
    end
    
    generate_export_report(results)
  end

  def generate_export_report(results)
    report = {
      total_orders: results.size,
      successful: results.count { |r| r[:success] },
      failed: results.count { |r| !r[:success] },
      details: results
    }
    
    # Save report to file
    File.write('bas_export_report.json', JSON.pretty_generate(report))
    report
  end
end
```

This implementation provides:

1. **BAS XML Format**: Creates properly structured XML according to Ukrainian BAS requirements
2. **Validation**: Validates orders for Ukrainian business requirements (EDRPOU/INN, VAT rates, etc.)
3. **Fiscal Codes**: Generates Ukrainian fiscal codes and QR code data
4. **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error handling and reporting
5. **Batch Processing**: Support for processing orders in batches
6. **Ukrainian Specifics**: Handles Ukrainian VAT rates, currency (UAH), and business identifiers

The code is modular and can be easily extended for specific BAS API requirements or additional Ukrainian fiscal regulations.

## Implementation

```ruby
# docusign_pdf_signer.rb
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class DocuSignPDFSigner
  def initialize
    @access_token = nil
    @account_id = nil
    @base_path = nil
  end

  # Step 1: Authenticate with DocuSign using JWT Grant
  def authenticate
    integration_key = ENV['DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATION_KEY']
    user_id = ENV['DOCUSIGN_USER_ID']
    private_key_file = ENV['DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE']
    auth_server = ENV['DOCUSIGN_AUTH_SERVER'] || 'account-d.docusign.com'

    # Read private key
    private_key = File.read(private_key_file)

    # Create JWT token
    token = JWT.encode(
      {
        iss: integration_key,
        sub: user_id,
        iat: Time.now.to_i,
        exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600,
        aud: auth_server,
        scope: 'signature'
      },
      OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(private_key),
      'RS256'
    )

    # Get access token
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "https://#{auth_server}/oauth/token",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      },
      body: {
        grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
        assertion: token
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      get_account_info
      true
    else
      puts "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  end

  # Step 2: Get account information
  def get_account_info
    auth_server = ENV['DOCUSIGN_AUTH_SERVER'] || 'account-d.docusign.com'
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "https://#{auth_server}/oauth/userinfo",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      user_info = response.parsed_response
      @account_id = user_info['accounts'].first['account_id']
      @base_path = user_info['accounts'].first['base_uri'] + '/restapi'
      puts "Authenticated successfully. Account ID: #{@account_id}"
    else
      puts "Failed to get account info: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Step 3: Create and send envelope with PDF
  def send_contract_for_signature(pdf_file_path, recipient_email, recipient_name)
    return unless authenticated?

    # Read the PDF file
    pdf_content = File.binread(pdf_file_path)
    pdf_base64 = Base64.encode64(pdf_content)

    # Create envelope definition
    envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new
    envelope_definition.email_subject = 'Please sign this document'
    envelope_definition.email_blurb = 'Please review and sign the attached document.'
    envelope_definition.status = 'sent'

    # Add document
    document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new
    document.document_base64 = pdf_base64
    document.name = File.basename(pdf_file_path)
    document.file_extension = 'pdf'
    document.document_id = '1'

    envelope_definition.documents = [document]

    # Add recipient
    signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new
    signer.email = recipient_email
    signer.name = recipient_name
    signer.recipient_id = '1'
    signer.routing_order = '1'

    # Create sign here tab
    sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new
    sign_here.anchor_string = '/signature/'
    sign_here.anchor_units = 'pixels'
    sign_here.anchor_x_offset = '20'
    sign_here.anchor_y_offset = '10'

    tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new
    tabs.sign_here_tabs = [sign_here]
    signer.tabs = tabs

    recipients = DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new
    recipients.signers = [signer]
    envelope_definition.recipients = recipients

    # Send envelope
    envelopes_api = create_envelopes_api
    result = envelopes_api.create_envelope(@account_id, envelope_definition)

    puts "Envelope sent successfully! Envelope ID: #{result.envelope_id}"
    result.envelope_id
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Error sending envelope: #{e.response_body}"
    nil
  end

  # Step 4: Check envelope status and download when completed
  def download_signed_pdf(envelope_id, output_file_path)
    return unless authenticated?

    envelopes_api = create_envelopes_api

    # Wait for envelope to be completed (polling)
    puts "Waiting for signature completion..."
    loop do
      envelope = envelopes_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
      
      case envelope.status.downcase
      when 'completed'
        puts "Envelope completed! Downloading signed document..."
        break
      when 'declined', 'voided'
        puts "Envelope was #{envelope.status}. Cannot download."
        return false
      else
        puts "Current status: #{envelope.status}. Checking again in 30 seconds..."
        sleep(30)
      end
    end

    # Download the signed document
    documents_api = create_documents_api
    document_list = documents_api.list_documents(@account_id, envelope_id)
    
    # Find the completed document
    signed_document = document_list.envelope_documents.find { |doc| doc.document_id == '1' }
    
    if signed_document
      document_content = documents_api.get_document(
        @account_id, 
        envelope_id, 
        signed_document.document_id
      )
      
      File.binwrite(output_file_path, document_content)
      puts "Signed PDF downloaded to: #{output_file_path}"
      true
    else
      puts "Signed document not found"
      false
    end
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Error downloading document: #{e.response_body}"
    false
  end

  private

  def authenticated?
    !@access_token.nil? && !@account_id.nil?
  end

  def create_envelopes_api
    configuration = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @base_path
    api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(api_client)
  end

  def create_documents_api
    configuration = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @base_path
    api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    DocuSign_eSign::DocumentsApi.new(api_client)
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Create an environment file (.env) with these variables:
  # DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATION_KEY=your_integration_key
  # DOCUSIGN_USER_ID=your_user_id
  # DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE=path/to/private/key.pem
  # DOCUSIGN_AUTH_SERVER=account-d.docusign.com (or account.docusign.com for production)

  signer = DocuSignPDFSigner.new
  
  if signer.authenticate
    # Send contract for signature
    envelope_id = signer.send_contract_for_signature(
      'contract.pdf',           # Path to your PDF file
      'recipient@example.com',  # Recipient email
      'John Doe'                # Recipient name
    )
    
    if envelope_id
      # Download signed PDF when completed
      signer.download_signed_pdf(envelope_id, 'signed_contract.pdf')
    end
  else
    puts "Authentication failed. Please check your credentials."
  end
end
```

## Setup Instructions

1. **Install dependencies:**
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. **DocuSign Setup:**
   - Create a DocuSign Developer Account
   - Create an Integration Key (API Key) in the DocuSign Admin console
   - Generate an RSA key pair for JWT authentication
   - Add the RSA public key to your DocuSign integration

3. **Prepare your PDF:**
   - Ensure your PDF has an anchor string like `/signature/` where you want the signature field to appear

## Key Features

- **JWT Authentication**: Secure authentication without user interaction
- **PDF Upload**: Reads and encodes PDF files for DocuSign
- **Anchor Tagging**: Uses anchor strings to position signature fields
- **Status Polling**: Automatically checks envelope status until completed
- **Document Download**: Downloads the signed PDF when ready

## Usage Example

```ruby
signer.authenticate

# Send for signature

  'my_contract.pdf',
  'client@example.com', 
  'Jane Smith'
)

  signer.download_signed_pdf(envelope_id, 'signed_contract.pdf')
```

## Конфігурація KeyCRM клієнта

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/client.rb
module Keycrm
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    base_uri ENV['KEYCRM_API_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.keycrm.app/v1'

    def initialize
      @api_key = ENV['KEYCRM_API_KEY']
      @headers = {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    end

    # Отримання замовлення за ID
    def get_order(order_id)
      handle_response(self.class.get("/orders/#{order_id}", headers: @headers))
    end

    # Створення нового замовлення
    def create_order(order_data)
      handle_response(self.class.post('/orders', 
        headers: @headers, 
        body: order_data.to_json
      ))
    end

    # Оновлення замовлення
    def update_order(order_id, order_data)
      handle_response(self.class.put("/orders/#{order_id}", 
        headers: @headers, 
        body: order_data.to_json
      ))
    end

    # Отримання списку замовлень з фільтрами
    def get_orders(filters = {})
      handle_response(self.class.get('/orders', 
        headers: @headers, 
        query: filters
      ))
    end

    # Отримання клієнта за ID
    def get_customer(customer_id)
      handle_response(self.class.get("/customers/#{customer_id}", headers: @headers))
    end

    # Створення/оновлення клієнта
    def sync_customer(customer_data)
      # Перевіряємо, чи існує клієнт за email
      email = customer_data[:email]
      existing_customer = find_customer_by_email(email)
      
      if existing_customer
        update_customer(existing_customer['id'], customer_data)
      else
        create_customer(customer_data)
      end
    end

    private

    def find_customer_by_email(email)
      response = self.class.get('/customers', 
        headers: @headers, 
        query: { email: email }
      )
      response.success? ? response.parsed_response['data']&.first : nil
    end

    def create_customer(customer_data)
      handle_response(self.class.post('/customers', 
        headers: @headers, 
        body: customer_data.to_json
      ))
    end

    def update_customer(customer_id, customer_data)
      handle_response(self.class.put("/customers/#{customer_id}", 
        headers: @headers, 
        body: customer_data.to_json
      ))
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      if response.success?
        response.parsed_response
      else
        Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
        raise Keycrm::ApiError.new(response.code, response.body)
      end
    end
  end

  class ApiError < StandardError
    attr_reader :status_code, :response_body
    
    def initialize(status_code, response_body)
      @status_code = status_code
      @response_body = response_body
      super("KeyCRM API Error: #{status_code} - #{response_body}")
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/keycrm_sync_job.rb
class KeycrmSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(local_order_id)
    local_order = Order.find(local_order_id)
    client = Keycrm::Client.new
    
    order_data = build_order_data(local_order)
    
    if local_order.keycrm_id.present?
      # Оновлення існуючого замовлення
      client.update_order(local_order.keycrm_id, order_data)
    else
      # Створення нового замовлення
      response = client.create_order(order_data)
      local_order.update(keycrm_id: response['data']['id'])
    end
    
    Rails.logger.info "Order #{local_order.id} synced to KeyCRM"
  rescue Keycrm::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{local_order_id}: #{e.message}"
    # Можна додати сповіщення адміністратору
  end

  private

  def build_order_data(order)
    {
      number: order.number,
      status: map_status(order.status),
      customer: build_customer_data(order.customer),
      items: build_order_items(order.order_items),
      total_amount: order.total_amount.to_f,
      currency: order.currency,
      created_at: order.created_at.iso8601,
      updated_at: order.updated_at.iso8601
    }
  end

  def build_customer_data(customer)
    {
      email: customer.email,
      first_name: customer.first_name,
      last_name: customer.last_name,
      phone: customer.phone,
      address: customer.address
    }
  end

  def build_order_items(order_items)
    order_items.map do |item|
      {
        product_id: item.product.keycrm_id,
        name: item.product.name,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit_price: item.unit_price.to_f
      }
    end
  end

  def map_status(local_status)
    # Маппінг статусів між локальною системою та KeyCRM
    status_mapping = {
      'pending' => 'pending',
      'confirmed' => 'confirmed',
      'shipped' => 'shipped',
      'delivered' => 'delivered',
      'cancelled' => 'cancelled'
    }
    status_mapping[local_status] || 'pending'
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/keycrm_update_job.rb
class KeycrmUpdateJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(keycrm_order_id)
    client = Keycrm::Client.new
    keycrm_order = client.get_order(keycrm_order_id)
    
    local_order = Order.find_by(keycrm_id: keycrm_order_id)
    return unless local_order

    update_local_order(local_order, keycrm_order['data'])
  rescue Keycrm::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to update order #{keycrm_order_id}: #{e.message}"
  end

  private

  def update_local_order(local_order, keycrm_data)
    local_order.update(
      status: map_keycrm_status(keycrm_data['status']),
      updated_at: Time.zone.parse(keycrm_data['updated_at'])
    )
    
    # Оновлення інших полів за потребою
    Rails.logger.info "Order #{local_order.id} updated from KeyCRM"
  end

  def map_keycrm_status(keycrm_status)
    # Зворотній маппінг статусів
    status_mapping = {
      'pending' => 'pending',
      'confirmed' => 'confirmed',
      'shipped' => 'shipped',
      'delivered' => 'delivered',
      'cancelled' => 'cancelled'
    }
    status_mapping[keycrm_status] || 'pending'
  end
end
```

```ruby
    unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(signature, expected_signature)
      head :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def generate_signature(payload)
    secret = ENV['KEYCRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET']
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', secret, payload)
  end
```

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/client.rb
require 'httparty'

module KeyCRM
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    base_uri KeyCRM::CONFIG[:api_base_url]
    timeout KeyCRM::CONFIG[:timeout]
    
    def initialize
      raise ConfigurationError, "KEYCRM_API_KEY is required" unless KeyCRM::CONFIG[:api_key]
      
      @headers = {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{KeyCRM::CONFIG[:api_key]}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    end
    
    def create_order(order_data)
      with_retry do
        response = self.class.post(
          '/orders',
          headers: @headers,
          body: order_data.to_json
        )
        
        handle_response(response)
      end
    end
    
    def update_order(order_id, order_data)
      with_retry do
        response = self.class.put(
          "/orders/#{order_id}",
          headers: @headers,
          body: order_data.to_json
        )
        
        handle_response(response)
      end
    end
    
    def get_order(order_id)
      with_retry do
        response = self.class.get(
          "/orders/#{order_id}",
          headers: @headers
        )
        
        handle_response(response)
      end
    end
    
    def get_orders(params = {})
      with_retry do
        response = self.class.get(
          '/orders',
          headers: @headers,
          query: params
        )
        
        handle_response(response)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def with_retry
      retries = 0
      begin
        yield
      rescue HTTParty::Error, Timeout::Error => e
        retries += 1
        if retries <= KeyCRM::CONFIG[:max_retries]
          sleep(2 ** retries) # Exponential backoff
          retry
        else
          raise APIError, "KeyCRM API request failed after #{retries} attempts: #{e.message}"
        end
      end
    end
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200..299
        response.parsed_response
      when 401
        raise APIError, "KeyCRM API authentication failed"
      when 404
        raise APIError, "KeyCRM resource not found"
      when 422
        raise APIError, "KeyCRM validation failed: #{response.parsed_response}"
      when 429
        raise APIError, "KeyCRM API rate limit exceeded"
      when 500..599
        raise APIError, "KeyCRM server error: #{response.code}"
      else
        raise APIError, "KeyCRM API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
module KeyCRM
  class OrderMapper
    def self.to_keycrm_format(rails_order)
      {
        external_id: rails_order.id.to_s,
        customer: map_customer(rails_order.customer || rails_order.user),
        items: map_items(rails_order.line_items || rails_order.order_items),
        totals: map_totals(rails_order),
        shipping_address: map_address(rails_order.shipping_address),
        billing_address: map_address(rails_order.billing_address),
        payment_info: map_payment_info(rails_order),
        metadata: {
          source: 'rails_shop',
          created_at: rails_order.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: rails_order.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      }.compact
    end
    
    def self.from_keycrm_format(keycrm_order)
      {
        keycrm_id: keycrm_order['id'],
        keycrm_status: keycrm_order['status'],
        keycrm_data: keycrm_order
      }
    end
    
    private
    
    def self.map_customer(customer)
      return nil unless customer
      
      {
        external_id: customer.id.to_s,
        email: customer.email,
        first_name: customer.first_name,
        last_name: customer.last_name,
        phone: customer.phone
      }.compact
    end
    
    def self.map_items(line_items)
      Array(line_items).map do |item|
        {
          product_external_id: item.product_id.to_s,
          sku: item.sku || item.product&.sku,
          name: item.name || item.product&.name,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit_price: item.unit_price.to_f,
          total_price: item.total_price.to_f
        }.compact
      end
    end
    
    def self.map_totals(order)
      {
        subtotal: order.subtotal.to_f,
        tax: order.tax_amount.to_f,
        shipping: order.shipping_cost.to_f,
        discount: order.discount_amount.to_f,
        total: order.total_amount.to_f,
        currency: order.currency || 'USD'
      }.compact
    end
    
    def self.map_address(address)
      return nil unless address
      
      {
        first_name: address.first_name,
        last_name: address.last_name,
        company: address.company,
        address1: address.address_line1,
        address2: address.address_line2,
        city: address.city,
        state: address.state,
        zip: address.zip_code,
        country: address.country,
        phone: address.phone
      }.compact
    end
    
    def self.map_payment_info(order)
      return nil unless order.payment_method
      
      {
        method: order.payment_method,
        transaction_id: order.transaction_id,
        status: order.payment_status
      }.compact
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/order_service.rb
module KeyCRM
  class OrderService
    def initialize
      @client = Client.new
      @mapper = OrderMapper
    end
    
    def sync_order(rails_order)
      keycrm_data = @mapper.to_keycrm_format(rails_order)
      
      if rails_order.keycrm_id.present?
        # Update existing order in KeyCRM
        response = @client.update_order(rails_order.keycrm_id, keycrm_data)
      else
        # Create new order in KeyCRM
        response = @client.create_order(keycrm_data)
        rails_order.update(keycrm_id: response['id'])
      end
      
      response
    rescue APIError => e
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM sync failed for order #{rails_order.id}: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
    
    def get_order_status(keycrm_order_id)
      response = @client.get_order(keycrm_order_id)
      response['status']
    rescue APIError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to get order status from KeyCRM: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
    
    def find_orders(params = {})
      @client.get_orders(params)
    end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/keycrm_sync_job.rb
class KeyCRMSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  retry_on KeyCRM::APIError, wait: :exponentially_longer, attempts: 5
  
  def perform(order_id, action = :sync)
    order = Order.find(order_id)
    service = KeyCRM::OrderService.new
    
    case action
    when :sync
      service.sync_order(order)
    when :check_status
      status = service.get_order_status(order.keycrm_id)
      order.update(keycrm_status: status) if status
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
    Rails.logger.error "Order #{order_id} not found for KeyCRM sync"
  end
end
```

```ruby
      expiry_date_check_digit: line2[14],
      nationality: line2[15..17].strip,
      optional_data2: line2[18..28].strip,
      composite_check_digit: line2[29],
      surname: line3 ? extract_surname(line3[0..29]) : nil,
      given_names: line3 ? extract_given_names(line3[0..29]) : nil
    }
  end
  
  def self.extract_surname(name_field)
    names = name_field.split('<<')
    names[0].gsub('<', ' ').strip if names[0]
  end
  
  def self.extract_given_names(name_field)
    names = name_field.split('<<')
    names[1].gsub('<', ' ').strip if names[1]
  end
  
  def self.parse_date(date_str)
    return nil unless date_str && date_str.length == 6
    
    year = "20#{date_str[0..1]}"  # Assuming 21st century
    month = date_str[2..3]
    day = date_str[4..5]
    
    "#{year}-#{month}-#{day}"
  rescue
    date_str
  end
end
```

```ruby
class OCRMRZParser
  def self.extract_mrz_from_image(image_path)
    # Load image
    image = Magick::Image.read(image_path).first

    processed_image = preprocess_image(image)

    mrz_region = extract_mrz_region(processed_image)
    
    # Perform OCR
    engine = Tesseract::Engine.new do |e|
      e.language = :eng
      e.whitelist = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789<'
      e.psm = 6  # Uniform block of text
    end
    
    mrz_text = engine.text_for(mrz_region).strip
    mrz_text
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.preprocess_image(image)
    # Convert to grayscale
    image = image.quantize(256, Magick::GRAYColorspace)
    
    # Enhance contrast
    image = image.contrast(true)
    
    # Resize for better OCR accuracy
    image = image.resize_to_fit(2000, 2000)
    
    image
  end
  
  def self.extract_mrz_region(image)
    height = image.rows
    width = image.columns
    
    # MRZ is typically in the bottom 20% of the passport page
    mrz_height = (height * 0.2).to_i
    mrz_y = height - mrz_height
    
    image.crop(0, mrz_y, width, mrz_height)
  end
```

```ruby
# config/initializers/salesdrive.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'oj'

module SalesDrive
  class Client
    BASE_URL = ENV['SALESDRIVE_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.salesdrive.com/v1'
    
    def initialize(api_key = ENV['SALESDRIVE_API_KEY'])
      @api_key = api_key
      @connection = Faraday.new(
        url: BASE_URL,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
        }
      ) do |faraday|
        faraday.request :json
        faraday.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
        faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      end
    end
    
    def create_order(order_data)
      response = @connection.post('/orders') do |req|
        req.body = order_data.to_json
      end
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def get_order_status(order_id)
      response = @connection.get("/orders/#{order_id}")
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def update_order(order_id, update_data)
      response = @connection.patch("/orders/#{order_id}") do |req|
        req.body = update_data.to_json
      end
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    private
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200..299
        { success: true, data: response.body }
      else
        { success: false, error: response.body['error'] || 'Unknown error', status: response.status }
      end
    rescue Faraday::Error => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/sales_drive_order_sync_job.rb
class SalesDriveOrderSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(order_id)
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    return unless order
    
    client = SalesDrive::Client.new
    response = client.create_order(order.salesdrive_order_data)
    
    if response[:success]
      order.update(
        salesdrive_status: :synced,
        salesdrive_id: response[:data]['id'],
        last_sync_at: Time.current
      )
      
      Rails.logger.info "Order #{order.order_number} synced to SalesDrive with ID: #{response[:data]['id']}"
    else
      order.update(
        salesdrive_status: :sync_failed,
        sync_error: response[:error],
        last_sync_attempt_at: Time.current
      )
      
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order.order_number} to SalesDrive: #{response[:error]}"
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error in SalesDriveOrderSyncJob for order #{order_id}: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/sales_drive_status_sync_job.rb
class SalesDriveStatusSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform
    # Sync orders that are synced but might have status updates
    orders_to_sync = Order.synced.where('created_at > ?', 30.days.ago)
    
    client = SalesDrive::Client.new
    
    orders_to_sync.find_each do |order|
      sync_order_status(order, client)
      sleep(0.1) # Rate limiting
    end
  end
  
  def sync_single_order(order_id)
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    return unless order && order.salesdrive_id?
    
    client = SalesDrive::Client.new
    sync_order_status(order, client)
  end
  
  private
  
  def sync_order_status(order, client)
    response = client.get_order_status(order.salesdrive_id)
    
    if response[:success]
      order.update_from_salesdrive(response[:data])
      Rails.logger.info "Status updated for order #{order.order_number}"
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync status for order #{order.order_number}: #{response[:error]}"
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error syncing status for order #{order.id}: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# phone_number_formatter.rb
require 'phonelib'
require 'countries'

class PhoneNumberFormatter
  # Validate and format phone numbers
  def self.process(phone_number, country_code = nil)
    # Clean up the input
    cleaned_number = clean_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    # Parse the phone number
    phone = Phonelib.parse(cleaned_number, country_code)
    
    if phone.valid?
      {
        valid: true,
        original: phone_number,
        formatted: format_phone_number(phone),
        international: phone.international,
        national: phone.national,
        country: get_country_info(phone),
        type: phone.type,
        e164: phone.e164
      }
    else
      {
        valid: false,
        original: phone_number,
        error: "Invalid phone number",
        possible_countries: phone.valid_countries.map { |c| country_info(c) }
      }
    end
  end
  
  # Validate if a phone number is valid
  def self.valid?(phone_number, country_code = nil)
    cleaned_number = clean_phone_number(phone_number)
    Phonelib.valid?(cleaned_number, country_code)
  end
  
  # Get country information for a valid phone number
  def self.get_country_info(phone)
    return nil unless phone.valid?
    
    country_info(phone.country)
  end
  
  # Format phone number in a user-friendly way
  def self.format_phone_number(phone)
    return phone.international unless phone.valid?
    
    case phone.type
    when :mobile
      "📱 #{phone.international}"
    when :fixed_line
      "📞 #{phone.international}"
    when :toll_free
      "🆓 #{phone.international}"
    else
      phone.international
    end
  end
  
  # Clean phone number by removing non-digit characters except +
  def self.clean_phone_number(phone_number)
    phone_number.to_s.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
  end
  
  # Get country information
  def self.country_info(country_code)
    country = ISO3166::Country[country_code]
    return nil unless country
    
    {
      code: country_code,
      name: country.name,
      emoji: country.emoji_flag
    }
  end
  
  # Get all supported countries
  def self.supported_countries
    Phonelib.countries.map do |country_code|
      country_info(country_code)
    end.compact
  end
  
  # Find possible countries for a phone number
  def self.detect_country(phone_number)
    cleaned_number = clean_phone_number(phone_number)
    phone = Phonelib.parse(cleaned_number)
    
    phone.valid_countries.map { |c| country_info(c) }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# phone_number_batch_processor.rb
require 'csv'

class PhoneNumberBatchProcessor
  def self.process_csv(input_file, output_file, country_code = nil)
    results = []
    
    CSV.foreach(input_file, headers: true) do |row|
      phone_number = row['phone_number'] || row[0]
      next unless phone_number
      
      result = PhoneNumberFormatter.process(phone_number, country_code)
      results << result.merge(original_row: row.to_h)
    end
    
    # Write results to CSV
    CSV.open(output_file, 'w') do |csv|
      csv << ['Original Number', 'Valid', 'Formatted', 'E.164', 'Country', 'Type', 'Error']
      
      results.each do |result|
        csv << [
          result[:original],
          result[:valid],
          result[:formatted] || '',
          result[:e164] || '',
          result.dig(:country, :name) || '',
          result[:type] || '',
          result[:error] || ''
        ]
      end
    end
    
    valid_count = results.count { |r| r[:valid] }
    puts "Processed #{results.size} numbers. #{valid_count} valid, #{results.size - valid_count} invalid."
    
    results
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'onfido'

class OnfidoVerification
  def initialize
    @onfido = Onfido::API.new(
      api_key: ENV['ONFIDO_API_KEY'],
      region: ENV['ONFIDO_REGION'] || 'eu' # 'us' or 'eu'
    )

  # Step 1: Create an applicant
  def create_applicant(first_name:, last_name:, email:)
    applicant_data = {
      first_name: first_name,
      last_name: last_name,
      email: email
    }

    @onfido.applicant.create(applicant_data)
  rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
    puts "Error creating applicant: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  # Step 2: Upload a document for verification
  def upload_document(applicant_id:, file_path:, document_type: 'passport', side: 'front')
    file = File.open(file_path, 'rb')
    
    document_data = {
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      file: file,
      type: document_type,
      side: side
    }

    @onfido.document.create(document_data)
  rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
    puts "Error uploading document: #{e.message}"
    nil
  ensure
    file&.close
  end

    file = File.open(file_path, 'rb')
    
    live_photo_data = {
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      file: file,
      advanced_validation: true
    }

    @onfido.live_photo.create(live_photo_data)
  rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
    puts "Error uploading selfie: #{e.message}"
    nil
  ensure
    file&.close
  end

  # Step 4: Create a check to verify the documents
  def create_check(applicant_id:, report_names: ['document', 'facial_similarity'])
    check_data = {
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      report_names: report_names
    }

    @onfido.check.create(check_data)
  rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
    puts "Error creating check: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  # Step 5: Retrieve check results

    puts "Error retrieving check: #{e.message}"

  end

  # Complete verification flow
  def verify_identity(user_data, document_path, selfie_path)
    puts "Starting identity verification process..."
    
    # Create applicant
    applicant = create_applicant(user_data)
    return { error: 'Failed to create applicant' } unless applicant
    
    puts "Applicant created with ID: #{applicant['id']}"
    
    # Upload document
    document = upload_document(
      applicant_id: applicant['id'],
      file_path: document_path
    )
    return { error: 'Failed to upload document' } unless document
    
    puts "Document uploaded successfully"
    
    # Upload selfie
    selfie = upload_selfie(
      applicant_id: applicant['id'],
      file_path: selfie_path
    )
    return { error: 'Failed to upload selfie' } unless selfie
    
    puts "Selfie uploaded successfully"
    
    # Create verification check
    check = create_check(applicant_id: applicant['id'])
    return { error: 'Failed to create verification check' } unless check
    
    puts "Verification check created with ID: #{check['id']}"
    
    {
      applicant_id: applicant['id'],
      check_id: check['id'],
      status: check['status']
    }
  end

  # Poll for check completion (useful for async operations)
  def wait_for_check_completion(check_id, max_wait_time: 300, interval: 10)
    start_time = Time.now
    
    while Time.now - start_time < max_wait_time
      check = get_check_status(check_id)
      return check if check && ['complete', 'withdrawn', 'cancelled'].include?(check['status'])
      
      puts "Check status: #{check['status']}. Waiting #{interval} seconds..."
      sleep(interval)
    end
    
    { error: 'Check timeout', status: 'pending' }
  end

  # Check if verification passed
  def verification_passed?(check_result)
    return false unless check_result && check_result['reports']
    
    check_result['reports'].all? do |report|
      report['result'] == 'clear'
    end
  end

  # Get detailed verification results
  def get_verification_summary(check_result)
    return { error: 'Invalid check result' } unless check_result && check_result['reports']
    
    summary = {
      overall_status: check_result['status'],
      reports: {}
    }
    
    check_result['reports'].each do |report|
      summary[:reports][report['name']] = {
        result: report['result'],
        breakdown: report['breakdown'],
        properties: report['properties']
      }
    end
    
    summary
  end
end
```
