```ruby
require 'rmagick'
require 'rtesseract'
require 'date'

class PassportMRZParser
  # Типи MRZ (Machine Readable Zone)
  MRZ_TYPES = {
    'P<' => :passport,      # Паспорт
    'I<' => :id_card,       # ID картка
    'V<' => :visa           # Віза
  }

  def initialize(image_path)
    @image_path = image_path
  end

  def parse
    # Крок 1: Обробка зображення для покращення читабельності
    processed_image = preprocess_image
    
    # Крок 2: Розпізнавання тексту з MRZ
    mrz_text = extract_mrz_text(processed_image)
    
    # Крок 3: Парсинг MRZ тексту
    parse_mrz_text(mrz_text)
  rescue => e
    { error: "Помилка обробки: #{e.message}" }
  end

  private

  def preprocess_image
    # Завантаження зображення
    image = Magick::Image.read(@image_path).first
    
    # Конвертація в сірий
    image = image.quantize(256, Magick::GRAYColorspace)
    
    # Підвищення контрасту
    image = image.contrast(true)
    
    # Медіанний фільтр для зменшення шуму
    image = image.median_filter(0.5)
    
    # Бінаризація (поріг можна налаштувати)
    image = image.threshold(Magick::QuantumRange * 0.6)
    
    image
  end

  def extract_mrz_text(image)
    # Знаходимо MRZ зону (зазвичай внизу документа)
    mrz_region = find_mrz_region(image)
    
    # Виконуємо OCR на знайденій області
    tesseract = RTesseract.new(mrz_region.to_blob do |img|
      img.format = 'PNG'
    end)
    
    text = tesseract.to_s.strip
    puts "Розпізнаний текст: #{text}" # Для дебагінгу
    
    # Фільтруємо лише MRZ рядки (зазвичай 2-3 рядки по 44 символи)
    text.lines.select { |line| line.length >= 30 && line.match?(/^[A-Z0-9<]+$/) }
        .map { |line| line.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase }
        .join("\n")
  end

  def find_mrz_region(image)
    height = image.rows
    width = image.columns
    
    # MRZ зазвичай займає нижні 15-20% документа
    mrz_height = (height * 0.2).to_i
    mrz_top = height - mrz_height
    
    # Обрізаємо зображення до MRZ зони
    image.crop(0, mrz_top, width, mrz_height, true)
  end

  def parse_mrz_text(mrz_text)
    lines = mrz_text.split("\n").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
    
    return { error: "Не знайдено MRZ даних" } if lines.empty?
    
    # Визначаємо тип документа за першими символами
    document_type = detect_document_type(lines.first)
    
    case document_type
    when :passport
      parse_passport_mrz(lines)
    when :id_card
      parse_id_card_mrz(lines)
    when :visa
      parse_visa_mrz(lines)
    else
      { error: "Невідомий тип документа" }
    end
  end

  def detect_document_type(first_line)
    MRZ_TYPES.each do |prefix, type|
      return type if first_line.start_with?(prefix)
    end
    :unknown
  end

  def parse_passport_mrz(lines)
    return { error: "Недостатньо рядків для паспорту" } unless lines.size >= 2
    
    line1 = lines[0]
    line2 = lines[1]
    
    {
      document_type: 'P',
      issuing_country: line1[2..4],
      surname: extract_name(line1[5..43])[:surname],
      given_names: extract_name(line1[5..43])[:given_names],
      passport_number: line2[0..8].gsub('<', ''),
      nationality: line2[10..12],
      date_of_birth: parse_date(line2[13..18]),
      sex: parse_sex(line2[20]),
      expiration_date: parse_date(line2[21..26]),
      personal_number: line2[28..42].gsub('<', ''),
      check_digit: {
        passport_number: line2[9],
        birth_date: line2[19],
        expiration_date: line2[27]
      }
    }
  end

  def parse_id_card_mrz(lines)
    # Реалізація для ID карток (3 рядки)
    return { error: "Недостатньо рядків для ID картки" } unless lines.size >= 3
    
    line1 = lines[0]
    line2 = lines[1]
    line3 = lines[2]
    
    {
      document_type: 'ID',
      issuing_country: line1[2..4],
      document_number: line1[5..13].gsub('<', ''),
      birth_date: parse_date(line1[14..19]),
      sex: parse_sex(line1[20]),
      expiration_date: parse_date(line1[21..26]),
      nationality: line1[27..29],
      surname: extract_name(line2)[:surname],
      given_names: extract_name(line2)[:given_names]
    }
  end

  def parse_visa_mrz(lines)
    # Базова реалізація для віз
    { error: "Парсинг віз ще не реалізовано" }
  end

  def extract_name(name_field)
    names = name_field.split('<<').map { |n| n.gsub('<', ' ').strip }
    {
      surname: names[0],
      given_names: names[1] || ''
    }
  end

  def parse_date(date_string)
    return nil unless date_string.match?(/^\d{6}$/)
    
    year = "20#{date_string[0..1]}".to_i
    month = date_string[2..3].to_i
    day = date_string[4..5].to_i
    
    # Перевірка коректності дати
    if Date.valid_date?(year, month, day)
      Date.new(year, month, day)
    else
      nil
    end
  rescue
    nil
  end

  def parse_sex(sex_char)
    case sex_char
    when 'M' then 'Male'
    when 'F' then 'Female'
    when '<', 'X' then 'Unspecified'
    else 'Unknown'
    end
  end
end

  puts "Результат парсингу MRZ:"

## Додатковий модуль для перевірки контрольної суми

```ruby
module MRZChecksum
  # Ваги для обчислення контрольної суми
  WEIGHTS = [7, 3, 1]

  def calculate_checksum(data)
    sum = 0
    data.chars.each_with_index do |char, index|
      value = char_to_value(char)
      weight = WEIGHTS[index % WEIGHTS.size]
      sum += value * weight
    end
    sum % 10
  end

  def verify_checksum(data, expected_check_digit)
    calculated = calculate_checksum(data)
    calculated == expected_check_digit.to_i
  end

  private

  def char_to_value(char)
    case char
    when '0'..'9' then char.to_i
    when 'A'..'Z' then char.ord - 55
    when '<' then 0
    else 0
    end
  end
end

# Додаємо модуль до класу парсера
class PassportMRZParser
  include MRZChecksum
end

## Сервіс для роботи з SalesDrive API

### app/services/salesdrive/api_client.rb

```ruby
module SalesDrive
  class ApiClient
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri SalesDrive.configuration.base_url
    timeout SalesDrive.configuration.timeout
    
    def initialize
      @api_key = SalesDrive.configuration.api_key
      @headers = {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'User-Agent' => 'RailsStore/1.0'
      }
    end
    
    def create_order(order_data)
      response = self.class.post(
        '/api/v1/orders',
        headers: @headers,
        body: order_data.to_json
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def update_order_status(external_order_id, status_data)
      response = self.class.put(
        "/api/v1/orders/#{external_order_id}/status",
        headers: @headers,
        body: status_data.to_json
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def get_order_status(external_order_id)
      response = self.class.get(
        "/api/v1/orders/#{external_order_id}/status",
        headers: @headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def get_orders_updated_since(timestamp)
      response = self.class.get(
        '/api/v1/orders',
        headers: @headers,
        query: { updated_since: timestamp.iso8601 }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    private
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200..299
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      when 401
        raise AuthenticationError, 'Invalid API key'
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, 'Resource not found'
      when 429
        raise RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded'
      when 500..599
        raise ServerError, 'SalesDrive server error'
      else
        raise ApiError, "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raise ApiError, 'Invalid JSON response'
    rescue Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout
      raise TimeoutError, 'Request timeout'
    end
  end
  
  # Custom exceptions
  class ApiError < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < ApiError; end
  class NotFoundError < ApiError; end
  class RateLimitError < ApiError; end
  class ServerError < ApiError; end
  class TimeoutError < ApiError; end
end
```

module SalesDrive
  class StatusSynchronizer
    def self.sync_recent_orders(hours = 24)
      since_time = hours.hours.ago
      client = ApiClient.new
      
      response = client.get_orders_updated_since(since_time)
      
      response['orders'].each do |salesdrive_order|
        sync_order_status(salesdrive_order)
      end
    end
    
    def self.sync_order_status(salesdrive_order_data)
      external_id = salesdrive_order_data['external_id']
      salesdrive_status = salesdrive_order_data['status']
      
      order = Order.find_by(id: external_id)
      return unless order
      
      new_status = map_salesdrive_status_to_local(salesdrive_status)
      
      if order.status != new_status
        order.update!(status: new_status)
        Rails.logger.info "Synced status for order #{order.id}: #{new_status}"
      end
    end
    
    def self.map_salesdrive_status_to_local(salesdrive_status)
      case salesdrive_status.downcase
      when 'new' then :pending
      when 'in_progress' then :processing
      when 'shipped' then :shipped
      when 'completed' then :delivered
      when 'cancelled' then :cancelled
      else :pending
      end
    end
  end
end

  before_action :verify_webhook_signature
  
  def order_status_updated
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    SalesDrive::StatusSynchronizer.sync_order_status(payload['order'])
    
    head :ok
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    head :bad_request
  end
  
  private
  
  def verify_webhook_signature
    # Реалізуйте перевірку підпису вебхука для безпеки
    expected_signature = request.headers['X-SalesDrive-Signature']
    calculated_signature = calculate_signature(request.body.read)
    
    head :unauthorized unless ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(
      expected_signature, calculated_signature
    )
  end
  
  def calculate_signature(payload)
    secret = ENV['SALESDRIVE_WEBHOOK_SECRET']
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', secret, payload)
  end
end

# companies_house.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class CompaniesHouseClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.company-information.service.gov.uk'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY']
    raise "API key not found. Set COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY environment variable" unless @api_key
  end

  def find_company(company_number)
    endpoint = "/company/#{company_number}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      basic_auth: { username: @api_key, password: '' },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def search_companies(query, items_per_page: 20, start_index: 0)
    endpoint = "/search/companies"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      query: {
        q: query,
        items_per_page: items_per_page,
        start_index: start_index
      },
      basic_auth: { username: @api_key, password: '' },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 404
      { error: "Company not found", code: 404 }
    when 401
      { error: "Unauthorized - check your API key", code: 401 }
    when 429
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded", code: 429 }
    else
      { error: "API error: #{response.code}", code: response.code }
    end
  end
end

# companies_house_helper.rb
require_relative 'companies_house'

class CompaniesHouseHelper
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @client = CompaniesHouseClient.new(api_key)
  end

  def get_company_details(company_number)
    result = @client.find_company(company_number)
    
    if result[:error]
      { success: false, error: result[:error] }
    else
      {
        success: true,
        data: {
          name: result['company_name'],
          number: result['company_number'],
          status: result['company_status'],
          type: result['type'],
          incorporation_date: result['date_of_creation'],
          address: format_address(result['registered_office_address']),
          sic_codes: result['sic_codes'],
          accounts: result['accounts'],
          officers: result.dig('links', 'officers')
        }
      }
    end
  end

  def search_by_name(name, limit: 10)
    result = @client.search_companies(name, items_per_page: limit)
    
    if result[:error]
      { success: false, error: result[:error] }
    else
      {
        success: true,
        total_results: result['total_results'],
        companies: result['items'].map do |company|
          {
            name: company['title'],
            number: company['company_number'],
            status: company['company_status'],
            address: format_address(company['address']),
            date_of_creation: company['date_of_creation']
          }
        end
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def format_address(address_hash)
    return nil unless address_hash.is_a?(Hash)
    
    parts = [
      address_hash['premises'],
      address_hash['address_line_1'],
      address_hash['address_line_2'],
      address_hash['locality'],
      address_hash['region'],
      address_hash['postal_code'],
      address_hash['country']
    ].compact.reject(&:empty?)
    
    parts.join(', ')
  end
end

```ruby
class IdentityVerificationService
  def initialize(applicant_data)
    @applicant_data = applicant_data
    @onfido = Onfido::API.new
  end

  # Створення апліканта в Onfido
  def create_applicant
    begin
      applicant = @onfido.applicant.create(
        first_name: @applicant_data[:first_name],
        last_name: @applicant_data[:last_name],
        email: @applicant_data[:email],
        dob: @applicant_data[:date_of_birth], # формат "1990-01-01"
        address: {
          building_number: @applicant_data[:building_number],
          street: @applicant_data[:street],
          town: @applicant_data[:town],
          postcode: @applicant_data[:postcode],
          country: @applicant_data[:country]
        }
      )
      
      { success: true, applicant_id: applicant.id }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка створення апліканта: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Завантаження документа для перевірки
  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_data)
    begin
      document = @onfido.document.upload(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: document_data[:file],
        side: document_data[:side], # 'front' або 'back'
        type: document_data[:type] # 'passport', 'driving_licence', 'national_identity_card', etc.
      )
      
      { success: true, document_id: document.id }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка завантаження документа: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Завантаження селфі (фото обличчя)
  def upload_selfie(applicant_id, selfie_data)
    begin
      live_photo = @onfido.live_photo.upload(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: selfie_data[:file],
        advanced_validation: selfie_data[:advanced_validation] || true
      )
      
      { success: true, live_photo_id: live_photo.id }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка завантаження селфі: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Створення перевірки (check) з документами та селфі
  def create_check(applicant_id, document_ids, live_photo_id)
    begin
      check = @onfido.check.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        report_names: [
          'document',
          'facial_similarity_photo',
          'identity_enhanced'
        ],
        document_ids: document_ids,
        live_photo_ids: [live_photo_id]
      )
      
      { success: true, check_id: check.id, status: check.status }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка створення перевірки: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Отримання статусу перевірки
  def check_status(check_id)
    begin
      check = @onfido.check.find(check_id)
      
      {
        success: true,
        status: check.status,
        results: check.reports.map { |report| 
          {
            name: report.name,
            status: report.status,
            result: report.result,
            breakdown: report.breakdown,
            properties: report.properties
          }
        }
      }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка отримання статусу: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Повний процес перевірки
  def full_verification_process(document_file, selfie_file)
    # 1. Створення апліканта
    applicant_result = create_applicant
    return applicant_result unless applicant_result[:success]

    applicant_id = applicant_result[:applicant_id]

    # 2. Завантаження документа
    document_result = upload_document(applicant_id, 
      file: document_file,
      side: 'front',
      type: 'passport'
    )
    return document_result unless document_result[:success]

    # 3. Завантаження селфі
    selfie_result = upload_selfie(applicant_id,
      file: selfie_file,
      advanced_validation: true
    )
    return selfie_result unless selfie_result[:success]

    # 4. Створення перевірки
    create_check(applicant_id, [document_result[:document_id]], selfie_result[:live_photo_id])
  end
end
```

class VerificationController < ApplicationController
  def start_verification
    applicant_data = {
      first_name: params[:first_name],
      last_name: params[:last_name],
      email: params[:email],
      date_of_birth: params[:date_of_birth],
      building_number: params[:building_number],
      street: params[:street],
      town: params[:town],
      postcode: params[:postcode],
      country: params[:country]
    }

    service = IdentityVerificationService.new(applicant_data)
    
    # Отримання файлів з форми
    document_file = params[:document]&.tempfile
    selfie_file = params[:selfie]&.tempfile

    result = service.full_verification_process(document_file, selfie_file)

    if result[:success]
      # Збереження check_id для подальшого відстеження
      session[:check_id] = result[:check_id]
      redirect_to verification_status_path, notice: 'Перевірка розпочата успішно'
    else
      flash[:error] = result[:error]
      render :new
    end
  end

  def check_status
    service = IdentityVerificationService.new({})
    result = service.check_status(session[:check_id])

    if result[:success]
      @verification_status = result
      render :status
    else
      flash[:error] = result[:error]
      redirect_to root_path
    end
  end
end

**Реалізація (phone_formatter.rb):**
```ruby
require 'phonelib'
require 'countries'

class PhoneFormatter
  # Ініціалізація з необов'язковими параметрами
  def initialize(default_country: 'UA', strict: false)
    @default_country = default_country
    @strict = strict
  end

  # Основний метод для перевірки та форматування
  def format(phone_number, country_code: nil)
    return nil if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.strip.empty?

    country = country_code || @default_country
    phone = Phonelib.parse(phone_number, country)

    if phone.valid?
      format_valid_phone(phone)
    else
      handle_invalid_phone(phone_number, country)
    end
  end

  # Перевірка чи номер дійсний без форматування
  def valid?(phone_number, country_code: nil)
    country = country_code || @default_country
    Phonelib.valid?(phone_number, country)
  end

  # Отримання інформації про номер
  def info(phone_number, country_code: nil)
    country = country_code || @default_country
    phone = Phonelib.parse(phone_number, country)
    
    return nil unless phone.valid?

    {
      international: phone.international,
      national: phone.national,
      e164: phone.e164,
      country_code: phone.country_code,
      country: phone.country,
      valid: phone.valid?,
      type: phone.type,
      human_type: phone.human_type
    }
  end

  # Спроба виправлення номера
  def sanitize(phone_number, country_code: nil)
    country = country_code || @default_country
    
    # Видаляємо всі нецифрові символи крім '+'
    cleaned = phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
    
    # Якщо номер починається з 0, замінюємо на код країни
    if cleaned.start_with?('0') && country != 'US'
      country_data = ISO3166::Country[country]
      if country_data
        country_code = country_data.country_code
        cleaned = "+#{country_code}#{cleaned[1..-1]}"
      end
    end

    format(cleaned, country_code: country)
  end

  private

  def format_valid_phone(phone)
    {
      original: phone.original,
      formatted: phone.international,
      e164: phone.e164,
      national: phone.national,
      country: phone.country,
      valid: true
    }
  end

  def handle_invalid_phone(phone_number, country_code)
    if @strict
      { error: "Номер телефону недійсний", original: phone_number, valid: false }
    else
      # Спроба автоматичного виправлення
      sanitize(phone_number, country_code: country_code)
    end
  end
end

# Приклади використання

    '+38 (050) 123-45-67',

      puts "E164: #{result[:e164]}"
    else

    end
  end

  # Приклад з іншою країною
  puts "\n\nПеревірка американського номера:"
  us_phone = '+1-555-123-4567'
  result = formatter.format(us_phone, country_code: 'US')
  puts "Результат: #{result[:formatted]}"
end

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# rosetka_feed_generator.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'

class RozetkaFeedGenerator
  attr_reader :categories, :products
  
  def initialize
    @categories = []
    @products = []
  end
  
  def add_category(id, name, parent_id = nil)
    @categories << {
      id: id,
      name: name,
      parent_id: parent_id
    }
  end
  
  def add_product(product_params)
    @products << product_params
  end
  
  def generate_feed
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    builder.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    builder.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')) do |yml|
      # Секція з магазином
      yml.shop do |shop|
        generate_shop_info(shop)
        generate_categories(shop)
        generate_offers(shop)
      end
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_shop_info(shop)
    shop.name 'Ваш магазин'
    shop.company 'Назва вашої компанії'
    shop.url 'https://ваш-сайт.com'
    
    # Курси валют
    shop.currencies do |currencies|
      currencies.currency(id: 'UAH', rate: 1, plus: 0)
      currencies.currency(id: 'USD', rate: 'НБУ', plus: 0)
    end
  end
  
  def generate_categories(shop)
    shop.categories do |categories|
      @categories.each do |category|
        attrs = { id: category[:id] }
        attrs[:parentId] = category[:parent_id] if category[:parent_id]
        categories.category(attrs, category[:name])
      end
    end
  end
  
  def generate_offers(shop)
    shop.offers do |offers|
      @products.each do |product|
        offer_attrs = {
          id: product[:id],
          available: product[:available] ? 'true' : 'false',
          group_id: product[:group_id]
        }.compact
        
        offers.offer(offer_attrs) do |offer|
          generate_offer_content(offer, product)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  def generate_offer_content(offer, product)
    # Обов'язкові поля
    offer.url product[:url]
    offer.price product[:price]
    offer.currencyId 'UAH'
    offer.categoryId product[:category_id]
    
    # Зображення
    Array(product[:images]).each do |image|
      offer.picture image
    end
    
    # Назва та опис
    offer.name product[:name]
    offer.description product[:description] if product[:description]
    
    # Параметри товару
    if product[:params]
      product[:params].each do |param_name, param_value|
        offer.param(param_value, name: param_name)
      end
    end
    
    # Додаткові поля
    offer.vendor product[:vendor] if product[:vendor]
    offer.vendorCode product[:vendor_code] if product[:vendor_code]
    offer.stock_quantity product[:stock_quantity] if product[:stock_quantity]
  end
end
```

## Додатковий клас для валідації

```ruby
# rosetka_validator.rb
class RozetkaValidator
  REQUIRED_PRODUCT_FIELDS = [:id, :name, :price, :category_id, :url]
  
  def self.validate_product(product)
    errors = []
    
    REQUIRED_PRODUCT_FIELDS.each do |field|
      if product[field].nil? || product[field].to_s.empty?
        errors << "Відсутнє обов'язкове поле: #{field}"
      end
    end
    
    # Перевірка ціни
    if product[:price] && product[:price] <= 0
      errors << 'Ціна повинна бути більше 0'
    end
    
    # Перевірка категорії
    if product[:category_id] && product[:category_id] <= 0
      errors << 'ID категорії повинен бути більше 0'
    end
    
    errors
  end
  
  def self.validate_categories(categories)
    errors = []
    category_ids = categories.map { |c| c[:id] }
    
    categories.each do |category|
      if category[:parent_id] && !category_ids.include?(category[:parent_id])
        errors << "Категорія #{category[:id]} має неіснуючий батьківський ID: #{category[:parent_id]}"
      end
    end
    
    errors
  end
end

# rosetka_feed_generator_with_validation.rb

class RozetkaFeedGeneratorWithValidation < RozetkaFeedGenerator
  def add_product(product_params)
    errors = RozetkaValidator.validate_product(product_params)
    
    if errors.any?
      puts "Помилки в товарі #{product_params[:id]}:"
      errors.each { |error| puts "  - #{error}" }
      return
    end
    
    super(product_params)
  end
  
  def generate_feed
    category_errors = RozetkaValidator.validate_categories(@categories)
    
    if category_errors.any?
      puts "Помилки в категоріях:"
      category_errors.each { |error| puts "  - #{error}" }
      return nil
    end
    
    super
  end
end

Configure Devise for OmniAuth **config/initializers/devise.rb** ```ruby Devise.setup do |config| # ... existing configuration ... # Add OmniAuth configuration config.omniauth :google_oauth2, ENV['GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID'], ENV['GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET'], scope: 'email, profile' config.omniauth :apple, ENV['APPLE_CLIENT_ID'], ENV['APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET'], ENV['APPLE_KEY_ID'], ENV['APPLE_TEAM_ID'], scope: 'email name', key_id: ENV['APPLE_KEY_ID'], team_id: ENV['APPLE_TEAM_ID'], pem: ENV['APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY'], provider_ignores_state: true # ... rest of configuration ... end ``` ### 3. Update User model **app/models/user.rb** ```ruby class User < ApplicationRecord # Include default devise modules. Others available are: # :confirmable, :lockable, :timeoutable, :trackable and :omniauthable devise :database_authenticatable, :registerable, :recoverable, :rememberable, :validatable, :omniauthable, omniauth_providers: [:google_oauth2, :apple] def self.from_omniauth(auth) where(provider: auth.provider, uid: auth.uid).first_or_create do |user| user.email = auth.info.email user.password = Devise.friendly_token[0, 20] user.name = auth.info.name # For Apple, name might not be available after first sign in if auth.info.name.blank? user.name = auth.info.email.split('@').first end end end end ``` ### 4. ## Implementation Code

### 1. CommerceML Base Service

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/base_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class BaseService
    NAMESPACES = {
      'xmlns' => 'urn:1C:Enterprise:CommerceML_2',
      'xmlns:xs' => 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema',
      'xmlns:xsi' => 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'
    }.freeze

    def self.logger
      @logger ||= Rails.logger
    end

    protected

    def build_xml(&block)
      xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
      xml.instruct!(:xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8')
      xml.comment!('Generated by Rails Shop System')
      block.call(xml)
      xml.target!
    end

    def parse_xml(xml_content)
      Nokogiri::XML(xml_content).remove_namespaces!
    end

    def handle_error(error, context = {})
      logger.error "CommerceML Error in #{self.class.name}: #{error.message}"
      logger.error "Context: #{context.inspect}"
      logger.error error.backtrace.join("\n")
      
      # You might want to notify admins or log to external service
      ErrorNotifier.notify(error, context) if defined?(ErrorNotifier)
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. Export Service (Rails → 1C)

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/export_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class ExportService < BaseService
    def self.export_products(products, format: :xml)
      new.export_products(products, format: format)
    end

    def self.export_orders(orders, format: :xml)
      new.export_orders(orders, format: format)
    end

    def export_products(products, format: :xml)
      case format
      when :xml
        export_products_xml(products)
      when :json
        export_products_json(products)
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported format: #{format}"
      end
    end

    def export_orders(orders, format: :xml)
      case format
      when :xml
        export_orders_xml(orders)
      when :json
        export_orders_json(orders)
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported format: #{format}"
      end
    end

    private

    def export_products_xml(products)
      build_xml do |xml|
        xml.CommercialInformation(NAMESPACES) do
          xml.Classifier do
            xml.Id 'products_classifier'
            xml.Name 'Products Catalog'
            
            products.find_each do |product|
              xml.Groups do
                # Export product categories/groups if needed
                if product.category
                  xml.Group do
                    xml.Id product.category.id
                    xml.Name product.category.name
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end

          xml.Catalog do
            xml.Id 'products_catalog'
            xml.Name 'Products'
            xml.ClassifierId 'products_classifier'
            
            products.find_each do |product|
              xml.Product do
                xml.Id product.id
                xml.Name product.name
                xml.Description product.description
                xml.Article product.sku
                
                # Product properties
                product.properties.each do |prop|
                  xml.Property do
                    xml.Name prop.name
                    xml.Value prop.value
                  end
                end

                # Prices
                product.prices.each do |price|
                  xml.Price do
                    xml.PriceType price.price_type
                    xml.Price price.amount
                    xml.Currency price.currency
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      handle_error(e, products: products.pluck(:id))
      nil
    end

    def export_orders_xml(orders)
      build_xml do |xml|
        xml.CommercialInformation(NAMESPACES) do
          xml.Document do
            xml.Id 'orders_document'
            xml.Number 'ORDERS'
            xml.Date Time.now.iso8601
            
            orders.find_each do |order|
              xml.Order do
                xml.Id order.id
                xml.Number order.order_number
                xml.Date order.created_at.iso8601
                xml.Currency order.currency
                xml.Amount order.total_amount
                xml.Status order.status
                
                # Customer information
                if order.customer
                  xml.Counterparty do
                    xml.Id order.customer.id
                    xml.Name order.customer.name
                    xml.Email order.customer.email
                    xml.Phone order.customer.phone
                  end
                end

                # Order items
                order.order_items.each do |item|
                  xml.OrderItem do
                    xml.ProductId item.product_id
                    xml.Name item.product_name
                    xml.Quantity item.quantity
                    xml.Price item.unit_price
                    xml.Amount item.total_price
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      handle_error(e, orders: orders.pluck(:id))
      nil
    end

    def export_products_json(products)
      {
        commercial_information: {
          classifier: {
            id: 'products_classifier',
            name: 'Products Catalog',
            groups: products.map { |p| export_group_json(p.category) }.compact.uniq
          },
          catalog: {
            id: 'products_catalog',
            name: 'Products',
            classifier_id: 'products_classifier',
            products: products.map { |p| export_product_json(p) }
          }
        }
      }.to_json
    end

    def export_orders_json(orders)
      {
        commercial_information: {
          document: {
            id: 'orders_document',
            number: 'ORDERS',
            date: Time.now.iso8601,
            orders: orders.map { |o| export_order_json(o) }
          }
        }
      }.to_json
    end

    def export_product_json(product)
      {
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        description: product.description,
        article: product.sku,
        properties: product.properties.map { |p| { name: p.name, value: p.value } },
        prices: product.prices.map { |p| { price_type: p.price_type, price: p.amount, currency: p.currency } }
      }
    end

    def export_order_json(order)
      {
        id: order.id,
        number: order.order_number,
        date: order.created_at.iso8601,
        currency: order.currency,
        amount: order.total_amount,
        status: order.status,
        counterparty: order.customer ? {
          id: order.customer.id,
          name: order.customer.name,
          email: order.customer.email,
          phone: order.customer.phone
        } : nil,
        items: order.order_items.map { |i| {
          product_id: i.product_id,
          name: i.product_name,
          quantity: i.quantity,
          price: i.unit_price,
          amount: i.total_price
        } }
      }
    end

    def export_group_json(category)
      return nil unless category
      { id: category.id, name: category.name }
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Import Service (1C → Rails)

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/import_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class ImportService < BaseService
    def self.import_products(xml_content)
      new.import_products(xml_content)
    end

    def self.import_orders(xml_content)
      new.import_orders(xml_content)
    end

    def import_products(xml_content)
      doc = parse_xml(xml_content)
      
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        import_groups(doc)
        import_products_from_doc(doc)
      end
      
      { success: true, imported_count: @imported_count }
    rescue StandardError => e
      handle_error(e, xml_content: xml_content[0..500])
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end

    def import_orders(xml_content)
      doc = parse_xml(xml_content)
      
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        import_orders_from_doc(doc)
      end
      
      { success: true, imported_count: @imported_count }
    rescue StandardError => e
      handle_error(e, xml_content: xml_content[0..500])
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end

    private

    def import_groups(doc)
      groups = doc.xpath('//Classifier/Groups/Group')
      groups.each do |group_node|
        group_id = group_node.xpath('Id').text
        group_name = group_node.xpath('Name').text
        
        category = Category.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: group_id)
        category.update!(
          name: group_name,
          imported_at: Time.now
        )
      end
    end

    def import_products_from_doc(doc)
      @imported_count = 0
      products = doc.xpath('//Catalog/Product')
      
      products.each do |product_node|
        product_id = product_node.xpath('Id').text
        product_name = product_node.xpath('Name').text
        product_sku = product_node.xpath('Article').text
        
        product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: product_id)
        product.update!(
          name: product_name,
          sku: product_sku,
          description: product_node.xpath('Description').text,
          imported_at: Time.now
        )
        
        import_product_prices(product, product_node)
        import_product_properties(product, product_node)
        
        @imported_count += 1
      end
    end

    def import_product_prices(product, product_node)
      prices = product_node.xpath('Price')
      prices.each do |price_node|
        price_type = price_node.xpath('PriceType').text
        amount = price_node.xpath('Price').text.to_f
        currency = price_node.xpath('Currency').text
        
        price = product.prices.find_or_initialize_by(price_type: price_type)
        price.update!(
          amount: amount,
          currency: currency,
          updated_at: Time.now
        )
      end
    end

    def import_product_properties(product, product_node)
      properties = product_node.xpath('Property')
      properties.each do |prop_node|
        prop_name = prop_node.xpath('Name').text
        prop_value = prop_node.xpath('Value').text
        
        property = product.properties.find_or_initialize_by(name: prop_name)
        property.update!(value: prop_value)
      end
    end

    def import_orders_from_doc(doc)
      @imported_count = 0
      orders = doc.xpath('//Document/Order')
      
      orders.each do |order_node|
        order_id = order_node.xpath('Id').text
        order_number = order_node.xpath('Number').text
        
        order = Order.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: order_id)
        order.update!(
          order_number: order_number,
          status: order_node.xpath('Status').text,
          currency: order_node.xpath('Currency').text,
          total_amount: order_node.xpath('Amount').text.to_f,
          order_date: Time.parse(order_node.xpath('Date').text),
          imported_at: Time.now
        )
        
        import_order_customer(order, order_node)
        import_order_items(order, order_node)
        
        @imported_count += 1
      end
    end

    def import_order_customer(order, order_node)
      counterparty = order_node.xpath('Counterparty')
      return if counterparty.empty?
      
      customer_id = counterparty.xpath('Id').text
      customer_name = counterparty.xpath('Name').text
      
      customer = Customer.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: customer_id)
      customer.update!(
        name: customer_name,
        email: counterparty.xpath('Email').text,
        phone: counterparty.xpath('Phone').text
      )
      
      order.update!(customer: customer)
    end

    def import_order_items(order, order_node)
      items = order_node.xpath('OrderItem')
      
      items.each do |item_node|
        product_id = item_node.xpath('ProductId').text
        product_name = item_node.xpath('Name').text
        
        order_item = order.order_items.find_or_initialize_by(product_external_id: product_id)
        order_item.update!(
          product_name: product_name,
          quantity: item_node.xpath('Quantity').text.to_i,
          unit_price: item_node.xpath('Price').text.to_f,
          total_price: item_node.xpath('Amount').text.to_f
        )
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. API Controller

```ruby
# app/controllers/commerce_ml/api_controller.rb
class CommerceML::ApiController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_1c
  
  def catalog
    case request.method_symbol
    when :get
      export_catalog
    when :post
      import_catalog
    else
      render_method_not_allowed
    end
  end

  def orders
    case request.method_symbol
    when :get
      export_orders
    when :post
      import_orders
    else
      render_method_not_allowed
    end
  end

  private

  def authenticate_1c
    # Implement your authentication logic here
    # Typically 1C sends credentials in headers or parameters
    authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic do |username, password|
      username == ENV['1C_USERNAME'] && password == ENV['1C_PASSWORD']
    end
  end

  def export_catalog
    products = Product.updated_since(params[:since])
    xml_data = CommerceML::ExportService.export_products(products)
    
    if xml_data
      send_data xml_data, 
                type: 'application/xml', 
                disposition: 'inline',
                filename: "catalog_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')}.xml"
    else
      render xml: { error: 'Failed to generate catalog' }, status: :internal_server_error
    end
  end

  def import_catalog
    result = CommerceML::ImportService.import_products(request.body.read)
    
    if result[:success]
      render xml: { status: 'success', imported: result[:imported_count] }
    else
      render xml: { status: 'error', message: result[:error] }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def export_orders
    orders = Order.updated_since(params[:since]).where(status: %w[pending processing])
    xml_data = CommerceML::ExportService.export_orders(orders)
    
    if xml_data
      send_data xml_data, 
                type: 'application/xml', 
                disposition: 'inline',
                filename: "orders_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')}.xml"
    else
      render xml: { error: 'Failed to generate orders' }, status: :internal_server_error
    end
  end

  def import_orders
    result = CommerceML::ImportService.import_orders(request.body.read)
    
    if result[:success]
      render xml: { status: 'success', imported: result[:imported_count] }
    else
      render xml: { status: 'error', message: result[:error] }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def render_method_not_allowed
    render xml: { error: 'Method not allowed' }, status: :method_not_allowed
  end
end

Ось реалізація для заповнення PDF-форми даними з моделі та блокування полів:

**Gemfile:**
```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'pdf-forms'
gem 'activemodel' # або 'activerecord' якщо використовуєте ActiveRecord
```

**Реалізація (pdf_form_filler.rb):**
```ruby
require 'pdf/forms'
require 'tempfile'

class PdfFormFiller
  def initialize(model, template_path, output_path = nil)
    @model = model
    @template_path = template_path
    @output_path = output_path || generate_output_path
    @pdf_forms = PdfForms.new(ENV['PDF_FORMS_PATH'] || '/usr/bin/pdftk')
  end

  def fill_and_lock
    # Заповнюємо форму даними з моделі
    filled_pdf = fill_form
    
    # Робимо поля нередагованими
    lock_fields(filled_pdf)
    
    @output_path
  end

  private

  def fill_form
    temp_filled = Tempfile.new(['filled', '.pdf'])
    
    # Мапуємо атрибути моделі на поля PDF форми
    field_mapping = map_model_to_pdf_fields
    
    @pdf_forms.fill_form(@template_path, temp_filled.path, field_mapping, flatten: false)
    
    temp_filled
  end

  def lock_fields(filled_pdf)
    # Отримуємо список всіх полів форми
    fields = @pdf_forms.get_fields(filled_pdf.path)
    
    # Створюємо команду для блокування полів
    field_flags = fields.map { |field| "#{field.name} readonly" }.join(' ')
    
    # Виконуємо команду pdftk для блокування полів
    system("#{@pdf_forms.pdf_path} #{filled_pdf.path} output #{@output_path} drop_xfa flatten #{field_flags}")
    
    filled_pdf.close
    filled_pdf.unlink
  end

  def map_model_to_pdf_fields
    mapping = {}
    
    # Припускаємо, що модель має метод attributes, який повертає хеш атрибутів
    if @model.respond_to?(:attributes)
      @model.attributes.each do |attr_name, value|
        pdf_field_name = map_attribute_to_field(attr_name)
        mapping[pdf_field_name] = value.to_s if pdf_field_name
      end
    end
    
    # Додатково можна додати спеціальні мапінги
    custom_mappings.each do |model_attr, pdf_field|
      value = @model.send(model_attr) if @model.respond_to?(model_attr)
      mapping[pdf_field] = value.to_s if value
    end
    
    mapping
  end

  def map_attribute_to_field(attr_name)
    # Базова логіка мапінгу - можна перевизначити в підкласах
    {

require 'combine_pdf'

class PdfFormFillerCombinePdf
  def initialize(model, template_path, output_path = nil)
    @model = model
    @template_path = template_path
    @output_path = output_path || generate_output_path
  end

  def fill_and_lock
    # Завантажуємо PDF шаблон
    pdf = CombinePDF.load(@template_path)
    
    # Заповнюємо поля форми
    fill_form_fields(pdf)
    
    # Робимо поля нередагованими
    lock_form_fields(pdf)
    
    # Зберігаємо результат
    pdf.save(@output_path)
    
    @output_path
  end

  private

  def fill_form_fields(pdf)
    field_mapping = map_model_to_pdf_fields
    
    pdf.pages.each do |page|
      page[:Annots]&.each do |annotation|
        field_name = annotation[:T]&.to_s
        if field_mapping.key?(field_name)
          annotation[:V] = field_mapping[field_name]
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def lock_form_fields(pdf)
    pdf.pages.each do |page|
      page[:Annots]&.each do |annotation|
        # Встановлюємо флаг ReadOnly для поля
        annotation[:Ff] = (annotation[:Ff] || 0) | 1 # 1 = ReadOnly flag
      end
    end
  end

  def map_model_to_pdf_fields
    mapping = {}
    
    if @model.respond_to?(:attributes)
      @model.attributes.each do |attr_name, value|
        pdf_field_name = map_attribute_to_field(attr_name)
        mapping[pdf_field_name] = value.to_s if pdf_field_name
      end
    end
    
    mapping
  end

  def map_attribute_to_field(attr_name)
    {
      'first_name' => 'FirstName',
      'last_name' => 'LastName', 
      'email' => 'Email',
      'phone' => 'PhoneNumber'
    }[attr_name] || attr_name.camelize
  end

  def generate_output_path
    timestamp = Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    "filled_form_#{timestamp}.pdf"
  end
end

# pdf_form_filler.rb
require 'pdftk'
require 'tempfile'

# Sample model class representing the data to fill
class UserModel
  attr_accessor :first_name, :last_name, :email, :phone, :address, :city, :zip_code, :signature_date
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    attributes.each do |key, value|
      send("#{key}=", value) if respond_to?("#{key}=")
    end
  end
  
  # Method to convert model data to PDF form field mapping
  def to_pdf_fields
    {
      'first_name'    => first_name,
      'last_name'     => last_name,
      'email_address' => email,
      'phone_number'  => phone,
      'address_line1' => address,
      'city'          => city,
      'zip_code'      => zip_code,
      'signature_date' => signature_date || Date.today.to_s
    }
  end
end

class PdfFormFiller
  def initialize(template_path)
    @template_path = template_path
    @pdftk = PdfForms.new(ENV['PDFTK_PATH'] || '/usr/bin/pdftk')
  end
  
  # Fill the PDF form with model data and save to output path
  def fill_and_flatten(model, output_path, flatten: true)
    # Create a temporary file for the filled (non-flattened) PDF
    temp_filled = Tempfile.new(['filled', '.pdf'])
    
    begin
      # Fill the form with data
      @pdftk.fill_form(
        @template_path,
        temp_filled.path,
        model.to_pdf_fields,
        flatten: false  # Don't flatten yet
      )
      
      if flatten
        # Flatten the filled PDF to make fields non-editable
        @pdftk.flatten(temp_filled.path, output_path)
      else
        # Just copy the filled PDF to output path
        FileUtils.cp(temp_filled.path, output_path)
      end
      
      puts "PDF successfully created at: #{output_path}"
      
    ensure
      temp_filled.close
      temp_filled.unlink
    end
  end
  
  # Alternative method that returns the PDF as a string
  def fill_and_flatten_to_string(model)
    temp_output = Tempfile.new(['output', '.pdf'])
    
    begin
      fill_and_flatten(model, temp_output.path)
      File.read(temp_output.path)
    ensure
      temp_output.close
      temp_output.unlink
    end
  end
  
  # Get list of field names from the PDF template
  def field_names
    @pdftk.get_field_names(@template_path)
  end
end

## Advanced Version with Error Handling and Validation

```ruby
# advanced_pdf_form_filler.rb
require 'pdftk'
require 'tempfile'
require 'fileutils'

class AdvancedPdfFormFiller
  class PdfFormError < StandardError; end
  
  def initialize(template_path)
    raise PdfFormError, "Template file not found: #{template_path}" unless File.exist?(template_path)
    @template_path = template_path
    @pdftk = PdfForms.new(ENV['PDFTK_PATH'] || find_pdftk_path)
  end
  
  def fill_and_flatten(model, output_path, options = {})
    validate_output_path(output_path)
    
    temp_filled = Tempfile.new(['filled', '.pdf'])
    
    begin
      # Get field mapping from model
      field_data = model.respond_to?(:to_pdf_fields) ? model.to_pdf_fields : model
      
      # Fill the form
      fill_form_with_retry(temp_filled.path, field_data)
      
      # Flatten if requested
      if options[:flatten] != false
        flatten_pdf(temp_filled.path, output_path)
      else
        FileUtils.cp(temp_filled.path, output_path)
      end
      
      true
      
    rescue => e
      raise PdfFormError, "Failed to process PDF: #{e.message}"
    ensure
      temp_filled.close
      temp_filled.unlink
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def find_pdftk_path
    # Common pdftk paths on different systems
    possible_paths = ['/usr/bin/pdftk', '/usr/local/bin/pdftk', 'pdftk']
    
    possible_paths.find do |path|
      system("#{path} --version > /dev/null 2>&1")
    end || '/usr/bin/pdftk'
  end
  
  def fill_form_with_retry(output_path, field_data, retries = 3)
    attempts = 0
    begin
      @pdftk.fill_form(@template_path, output_path, field_data, flatten: false)
    rescue => e
      attempts += 1
      if attempts <= retries
        sleep(0.1 * attempts)
        retry
      else
        raise e
      end
    end
  end
  
  def flatten_pdf(input_path, output_path)
    @pdftk.flatten(input_path, output_path)
  end
  
  def validate_output_path(output_path)
    output_dir = File.dirname(output_path)
    unless File.directory?(output_dir)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(output_dir)
    end
  end
end

# ofac_checker.rb
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class OFACChecker
  # OFAC API endpoints (SDN List)
  OFAC_API_BASE = 'https://api.trade.gov/v1/sources/ofac/search'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['OFAC_API_KEY']
    raise "OFAC API key not provided" unless @api_key
  end

  def check_person(first_name:, last_name:, birth_date: nil, country: nil, city: nil)
    # Basic validation
    raise "First name and last name are required" if first_name.nil? || last_name.empty? || last_name.nil? || last_name.empty?

    # Build search parameters
    params = {
      name: "#{first_name} #{last_name}".strip,
      api_key: @api_key
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters if provided
    params[:countries] = country if country
    params[:cities] = city if city
    params[:birth_date] = birth_date if birth_date

    begin
      response = RestClient.get(OFAC_API_BASE, params: params)
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      {
        found: data['results'].any?,
        matches: data['results'],
        search_performed_at: Time.now.iso8601,
        search_criteria: {
          name: "#{first_name} #{last_name}",
          birth_date: birth_date,
          country: country,
          city: city
        }
      }
    rescue RestClient::ExceptionWithResponse => e
      handle_api_error(e)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}", found: false }
    end
  end

  def check_person_bulk(persons)
    # Check multiple people at once (for batch processing)
    results = persons.map do |person|
      {
        person: person,
        result: check_person(**person)
      }
    end
    
    {
      total_checked: persons.length,
      matches_found: results.count { |r| r[:result][:found] },
      results: results
    }
  end

  private

  def handle_api_error(error)
    case error.http_code
    when 401
      { error: "Invalid API key", found: false }
    when 429
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded", found: false }
    when 500
      { error: "OFAC API server error", found: false }
    else
      { error: "API error: #{error.message}", found: false }
    end
  end
end

# identity_document_ocr.rb
require 'rmagick'
require 'tesseract'

class IdentityDocumentOCR
  def initialize(image_path, language: 'eng')
    @image_path = image_path
    @language = language
    @engine = Tesseract::Engine.new do |e|
      e.language = language
      e.page_segmentation_mode = 6  # Uniform block of text
      e.whitelist = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789 -.,/'
    end
  end

  def extract_text
    # Load and preprocess the image
    image = Magick::Image.read(@image_path).first
    
    # Convert to grayscale for better OCR accuracy
    image = image.quantize(256, Magick::GRAYColorspace)
    
    # Enhance contrast
    image = image.contrast(true)
    
    # Apply slight sharpening
    image = image.sharpen(0.5)
    
    # Convert to blob for Tesseract
    image_blob = image.to_blob { |img| img.format = 'PNG' }
    
    # Perform OCR
    text = @engine.text_for(image_blob).strip
    
    # Post-process the text
    clean_text(text)
  end

  def extract_fields
    text = extract_text
    extract_identity_fields(text)
  end

  private

  def clean_text(text)
    # Remove excessive whitespace and clean up common OCR artifacts
    text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
        .gsub(/([0-9])O/, '\10')  # Replace O with 0 when next to numbers
        .gsub(/([A-Z])0/, '\1O')  # Replace 0 with O when next to letters
        .strip
  end

  def extract_identity_fields(text)
    fields = {}
    
    # Extract common identity document patterns
    # Name pattern (typically appears as "LASTNAME Firstname" or similar)
    if text =~ /([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]+[A-Z])\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)/
      fields[:last_name] = $1.strip
      fields[:first_name] = $2.strip
    end
    
    # Date of birth pattern (various formats)
    dob_patterns = [
      /\b(\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{4})\b/,  # MM/DD/YYYY
      /\b(\d{4}[\/\-\.]\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{1,2})\b/,  # YYYY/MM/DD
      /\b(\d{1,2}\s+(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\s+\d{4})\b/i  # DD Month YYYY
    ]
    
    dob_patterns.each do |pattern|
      if text =~ pattern
        fields[:date_of_birth] = $1.strip
        break
      end
    end
    
    # Document number pattern (typically alphanumeric, 6-12 characters)
    if text =~ /\b([A-Z0-9]{6,12})\b/
      fields[:document_number] = $1.strip
    end
    
    # Expiration date pattern (similar to DOB patterns)
    expiry_patterns = [
      /EXP[:\s]*(\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{4})/i,
      /EXPIRY[:\s]*(\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{4})/i,
      /VALID[:\s]*UNTIL[:\s]*(\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{1,2}[\/\-\.]\d{4})/i
    ]
    
    expiry_patterns.each do |pattern|
      if text =~ pattern
        fields[:expiration_date] = $1.strip
        break
      end
    end
    
    fields.merge(raw_text: text)
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.empty?
    puts "Usage: ruby identity_document_ocr.rb <image_path>"
    exit 1
  end

  image_path = ARGV[0]

  rescue => e

  APDU_SELECT_MASTER_FILE = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x00, 0x0C].pack('C*')
  APDU_SELECT_DF1 = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x01, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x50, 0x00].pack('C*')
  APDU_SELECT_DF2 = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x01, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x50, 0x01].pack('C*')
  
  # Файли з даними
  FILES = {
    personal_data: [0x50, 0x15], # Особисті дані
    document_data: [0x50, 0x16], # Дані документа
    address: [0x50, 0x17]        # Адреса
  }

  def initialize
    @context = nil
    @card = nil
  end

  # Підключення до зчитувача
  def connect
    begin
      @context = PCSC::Context.new
      readers = @context.list_readers
      
      if readers.empty?
        puts "Не знайдено жодного зчитувача смарт-карток"
        return false
      end

      puts "Доступні зчитувачі:"
      readers.each_with_index { |reader, i| puts "#{i + 1}. #{reader}" }
      
      # Використовуємо перший доступний зчитувач
      reader = readers.first
      puts "Використовуємо зчитувач: #{reader}"
      
      @card = @context.card(reader, :shared)
      @card.connect(:shared, :t1)
      
      puts "Підключено до картки"
      return true
      
    rescue PCSC::Error => e
      puts "Помилка підключення: #{e.message}"
      return false
    end
  end

  # Відправка APDU команди
  def send_apdu(apdu_command)
    return unless @card
    
    begin
      response = @card.transmit(apdu_command)
      status_word = response[-2..-1].unpack('n').first
      
      if status_word == 0x9000
        return response[0..-3] # Повертаємо дані без статусного слова
      else
        puts "Помилка APDU: #{status_word.to_s(16)}"
        return nil
      end
    rescue PCSC::Error => e
      puts "Помилка передачі APDU: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  # Вибір файлу
  def select_file(file_id)
    apdu = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x02, 0x0C, 0x02, file_id[0], file_id[1]].pack('C*')
    send_apdu(apdu)
  end

  # Читання файлу
  def read_file
    apdu = [0x00, 0xB0, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00].pack('C*')
    send_apdu(apdu)
  end

  # Парсинг особистих даних
  def parse_personal_data(data)
    return {} unless data
    
    # Простий парсинг TLV (Tag-Length-Value) структур
    # У реальному застосунку потрібно використовувати специфікацію ID-картки
    {
      surname: extract_field(data, 0x01),
      name: extract_field(data, 0x02),
      patronymic: extract_field(data, 0x03),
      birth_date: extract_field(data, 0x04)
    }
  end

  # Парсинг даних документа
  def parse_document_data(data)
    return {} unless data
    
    {
      document_type: extract_field(data, 0x0A),
      document_number: extract_field(data, 0x0B),
      issue_date: extract_field(data, 0x0C),
      expiry_date: extract_field(data, 0x0D),
      issuing_authority: extract_field(data, 0x0E)
    }
  end

  # Екстракція поля за тегом
  def extract_field(data, tag)
    index = data.index(tag.chr)
    return nil unless index
    
    length = data[index + 1].ord
    value = data[index + 2, length]
    value.force_encoding('UTF-8')
  rescue
    nil
  end

  # Отримання всіх даних з картки
  def read_all_data
    return unless connect
    
    puts "Зчитування даних з ID-картки..."
    
    begin
      # Вибір master file
      send_apdu(APDU_SELECT_MASTER_FILE)
      
      # Особисті дані
      select_file(FILES[:personal_data])
      personal_data = read_file
      
      # Дані документа
      select_file(FILES[:document_data])
      document_data = read_file
      
      # Адреса
      select_file(FILES[:address])
      address_data = read_file
      
      # Парсинг даних
      result = {
        personal: parse_personal_data(personal_data),
        document: parse_document_data(document_data),
        address: address_data ? address_data.force_encoding('UTF-8') : nil
      }
      
      result
      
    rescue PCSC::Error => e
      puts "Помилка читання даних: #{e.message}"
      nil
    ensure
      disconnect
    end
  end

  # Відключення
  def disconnect
    @card&.disconnect
    @context&.release
    puts "Відключено"
  end
end

# Використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  reader = EidReader.new
  data = reader.read_all_data
  
  if data
    puts "\n=== ОСОБИСТІ ДАНІ ==="
    data[:personal].each { |key, value| puts "#{key}: #{value}" if value }
    
    puts "\n=== ДАНІ ДОКУМЕНТУ ==="
    data[:document].each { |key, value| puts "#{key}: #{value}" if value }
    
    puts "\n=== АДРЕСА ==="
    puts data[:address] if data[:address]
  else
    puts "Не вдалося зчитати дані з картки"
  end
end

```ruby
# sam_gov_search.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class SAMGovSearch
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.sam.gov/prod/opportunities/v2/search'
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['SAM_GOV_API_KEY']
    raise "API key required. Set SAM_GOV_API_KEY environment variable or pass as argument." unless @api_key
  end
  
  def search_opportunities(params = {})
    default_params = {
      limit: 10,
      offset: 0,
      api_key: @api_key
    }
    
    query_params = default_params.merge(params)
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, query: query_params)
      
      if response.success?
        parse_response(response.body)
      else
        handle_error(response)
      end
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      puts "HTTP Error: #{e.message}"
      nil
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Search by keyword
  def search_by_keyword(keyword, options = {})
    params = { q: keyword }.merge(options)
    search_opportunities(params)
  end
  
  # Search by agency
  def search_by_agency(agency, options = {})
    params = { agency: agency }.merge(options)
    search_opportunities(params)
  end
  
  # Search by date range
  def search_by_date_range(start_date, end_date, options = {})
    params = { 
      postedFrom: format_date(start_date),
      postedTo: format_date(end_date)
    }.merge(options)
    search_opportunities(params)
  end
  
  # Search by opportunity type (e.g., 'p', 'r', 's', 'o')
  def search_by_type(type, options = {})
    params = { noticeType: type }.merge(options)
    search_opportunities(params)
  end
  
  # Get detailed opportunity by ID
  def get_opportunity_detail(notice_id)
    detail_url = "https://api.sam.gov/prod/opportunities/v2/opportunities/#{notice_id}"
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(detail_url, query: { api_key: @api_key })
      
      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        handle_error(response)
      end
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      puts "HTTP Error: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_response(response_body)
    data = JSON.parse(response_body)
    
    {
      total_records: data['totalRecords'],
      opportunities: data['opportunitiesData'] || [],
      metadata: {
        limit: data['limit'],
        offset: data['offset']
      }
    }
  end
  
  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    
    begin
      error_body = JSON.parse(response.body)
      error_message += " - #{error_body['error']['message']}" if error_body['error']
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      error_message += " - #{response.body}"
    end
    
    puts error_message
    { error: error_message }
  end
  
  def format_date(date)
    case date
    when Date, Time, DateTime
      date.strftime('%m/%d/%Y')
    when String
      date
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid date format"
    end
  end
end

# Usage examples
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Create .env file with your API key first
  # SAM_GOV_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

    results = sam.search_by_keyword('software development', limit: 5)
    puts JSON.pretty_generate(results) if results

# id_card_reader.rb
require 'pcsc'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class IDCardReader
  # APDU commands for reading data from ID cards
  # Note: These commands may vary by country and card type
  SELECT_MF = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x00, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x3F, 0x00].pack('C*')  # Select Master File
  SELECT_DF1 = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x01, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x11, 0x00].pack('C*') # Select DF (Data File)
  
  # Example file identifiers (adjust based on your country's eID specification)
  FILE_PERSONAL_DATA = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x02, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x11, 0x01].pack('C*')
  READ_BINARY = [0x00, 0xB0].pack('C*')  # Base for read binary command

  def initialize
    @context = nil
    @card = nil
  end

  def connect
    begin
      # Establish context
      @context = PCSC::Context.new
      puts "PC/SC Context established successfully"
      
      # List readers
      readers = @context.list_readers
      if readers.empty?
        puts "No smart card readers found"
        return false
      end
      
      puts "Available readers:"
      readers.each_with_index { |reader, i| puts "#{i + 1}. #{reader}" }
      
      # Use first reader (you might want to make this configurable)
      reader = readers.first
      puts "Using reader: #{reader}"
      
      # Connect to the card
      @card = @context.card(reader, PCSC::SHARE_EXCLUSIVE, PCSC::PROTOCOL_T0 | PCSC::PROTOCOL_T1)
      puts "Connected to card successfully"
      
      true
    rescue PCSC::Error => e
      puts "Error connecting to card reader: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end

  def disconnect
    begin
      @card&.disconnect
      @context&.release
      puts "Disconnected from card reader"
    rescue => e
      puts "Error disconnecting: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def send_apdu(apdu_command, expected_response = "9000")
    begin
      response = @card.transmit(apdu_command)
      status = response[-2..-1].unpack('H*').first.upcase
      
      if status == expected_response
        return response[0...-2]  # Return data without status word
      else
        puts "APDU error: Status word #{status} (expected #{expected_response})"
        return nil
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Error sending APDU command: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def select_file(file_apdu)
    send_apdu(file_apdu)
  end

  def read_binary(offset, length)
    # Construct READ BINARY APDU: CLA=00, INS=B0, P1=high byte of offset, P2=low byte of offset, Le=length
    p1 = (offset >> 8) & 0xFF
    p2 = offset & 0xFF
    apdu = [0x00, 0xB0, p1, p2, length].pack('C*')
    
    send_apdu(apdu)
  end

  def read_personal_data
    begin
      puts "Attempting to read personal data..."
      
      # Select master file
      unless select_file(SELECT_MF)
        puts "Failed to select master file"
        return nil
      end
      
      # Select data file (adjust based on your eID card structure)
      unless select_file(SELECT_DF1)
        puts "Failed to select data file"
        return nil
      end
      
      # Read data - these offsets and lengths depend on the specific eID card
      # You'll need to consult your country's eID documentation
      data = {}
      
      # Example: Read first 256 bytes (adjust as needed)
      raw_data = read_binary(0, 256)
      
      if raw_data
        puts "Raw data received (#{raw_data.bytesize} bytes)"
        data[:raw_hex] = raw_data.unpack('H*').first
        data[:raw_base64] = Base64.strict_encode64(raw_data)
        
        # Parse the data according to your country's eID specification
        parse_personal_data(raw_data, data)
      end
      
      data
    rescue => e
      puts "Error reading personal data: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def parse_personal_data(raw_data, data_hash)
    # This is a template - you need to implement the actual parsing
    # based on your country's eID card specification
    
    # Example for German eID card (adjust for your country):
    # data_hash[:last_name] = extract_field(raw_data, start_offset, length)
    # data_hash[:first_name] = extract_field(raw_data, start_offset, length)
    # etc.
    
    puts "Note: Implement parse_personal_data method for your specific eID card format"
    puts "Raw data (hex): #{data_hash[:raw_hex]}"
  end

  def get_card_info
    begin
      # Get ATR (Answer To Reset)
      atr = @card.atr
      puts "Card ATR: #{atr.unpack('H*').first}" if atr
      
      # Get card status
      status = @card.status
      puts "Card status: #{status.inspect}"
      
      { atr: atr, status: status }
    rescue => e
      puts "Error getting card info: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  reader = IDCardReader.new
  
  if reader.connect
    begin
      # Get basic card information
      card_info = reader.get_card_info
      
      # Attempt to read personal data
      personal_data = reader.read_personal_data
      
      if personal_data
        puts "\nPersonal Data:"
        personal_data.each do |key, value|
          puts "#{key}: #{value}" unless key == :raw_data
        end
      else
        puts "No personal data could be read"
      end
      
    ensure
      reader.disconnect
    end
  else
    puts "Failed to connect to card reader"
  end
end

class GermanEIDParser < IDCardReader
  # File identifiers for German eID card
  EF_COM = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x02, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x1F, 0x01].pack('C*')  # EF.COM
  EF_DG1 = [0x00, 0xA4, 0x02, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x01, 0x01].pack('C*')  # EF.DG1 (Document Data)

      # Select EF.COM

        return nil
      end
      
      # Read EF.COM data

      # Select EF.DG1 for document data
      unless select_file(EF_DG1)
        puts "Failed to select EF.DG1"
        return nil
      end
      
      # Read document data
      dg1_data = read_binary(0, 256)
      
      { com_data: com_data, dg1_data: dg1_data }
    rescue => e
      puts "Error reading German eID data: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

```ruby
# lib/ofac_checker.rb
require 'rest-client'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_model'
require 'redis'
require 'json'

class OFACChecker
  OFAC_API_URL = 'https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/'
  CACHE_EXPIRY = 24 * 60 * 60 # 24 години у секундах

  def initialize(use_cache: true)
    @redis = Redis.new if use_cache
    @use_cache = use_cache
  end

  # Перевіряє особу за повним іменем та датою народження
  def check_person(full_name, date_of_birth = nil, country = nil)
    cache_key = generate_cache_key(full_name, date_of_birth, country)
    
    # Перевірка кешу
    if @use_cache && cached_result = get_cached_result(cache_key)
      return cached_result
    end

    # Параметри запиту
    params = {
      'LastName' => extract_last_name(full_name),
      'FirstName' => extract_first_name(full_name)
    }
    params['DateOfBirth'] = date_of_birth.strftime('%m/%d/%Y') if date_of_birth
    params['Countries'] = country if country

    begin
      response = RestClient.post(OFAC_API_URL, params)
      result = parse_response(response.body)
      
      # Збереження в кеш
      cache_result(cache_key, result) if @use_cache
      
      result
    rescue RestClient::Exception => e
      { error: "Помилка запиту до OFAC: #{e.message}", sanctioned: false }
    end
  end

  private

  def extract_first_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').first
  end

  def extract_last_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').last
  end

  def generate_cache_key(full_name, date_of_birth, country)
    key_parts = [full_name.downcase.gsub(/\s+/, '_')]
    key_parts << date_of_birth.strftime('%Y%m%d') if date_of_birth
    key_parts << country.downcase if country
    "ofac_check:#{key_parts.join('_')}"
  end

  def get_cached_result(key)
    cached = @redis.get(key)
    JSON.parse(cached, symbolize_names: true) if cached
  end

  def cache_result(key, result)
    @redis.setex(key, CACHE_EXPIRY, result.to_json)
  end

  def parse_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    # Перевірка наявності санкціонованих осіб
    sanctioned_entries = doc.xpath('//sdnEntry')
    
    if sanctioned_entries.any?
      entries = sanctioned_entries.map do |entry|
        {
          name: entry.xpath('firstName').text + ' ' + entry.xpath('lastName').text,
          address: entry.xpath('addressList/address/address1').text,
          country: entry.xpath('addressList/address/country').text,
          program: entry.xpath('programList/program').text
        }
      end
      
      {
        sanctioned: true,
        match_count: sanctioned_entries.count,
        entries: entries
      }
    else
      { sanctioned: false, match_count: 0, entries: [] }
    end
  end
end

backup_codes = JSON.parse(otp_backup_codes) backup_codes.include?(code) end def consume_backup_code!(code) backup_codes = JSON.parse(otp_backup_codes) backup_codes.delete(code) self.otp_backup_codes = backup_codes.to_json save! end end ``` ## TwoFactorAuthentication Controller ```ruby # app/controllers/two_factor_authentication_controller.rb class TwoFactorAuthenticationController < ApplicationController before_action :authenticate_user! before_action :ensure_not_enabled, only: [:new, :create] before_action :ensure_enabled, only: [:destroy, :backup_codes] def new @qr_code = RQRCode::QRCode.new(current_user.provisioning_uri) end def create if current_user.validate_and_consume_otp!(params[:code]) current_user.update!(otp_required_for_login: true) redirect_to two_factor_authentication_backup_codes_path, notice: 'Two-factor authentication enabled successfully!' else flash[:alert] = 'Invalid code. Here's a Ruby implementation for validating German tax identification numbers and VAT numbers:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'sinatra', '~> 3.0'
gem 'sinatra-contrib', '~> 3.0'
gem 'haml', '~> 6.0'
gem 'i18n', '~> 1.12'

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'sinatra/reloader' if development?
require 'haml'
require 'i18n'

# Configure I18n
I18n.load_path = Dir[File.join(settings.root, 'locales', '*.yml')]
I18n.backend.load_translations

class GermanTaxValidator
  # Validates German Tax Identification Number (Steueridentifikationsnummer)
  def self.valid_tax_id?(tax_id)
    return false unless tax_id.is_a?(String)
    
    # Remove all non-digit characters
    clean_id = tax_id.gsub(/[^\d]/, '')
    
    # Must be exactly 11 digits
    return false unless clean_id.length == 11
    
    digits = clean_id.chars.map(&:to_i)
    
    # First digit cannot be 0
    return false if digits[0] == 0
    
    # Exactly one digit must appear exactly twice
    digit_counts = digits.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) { |d, h| h[d] += 1 }
    duplicate_digits = digit_counts.select { |_, count| count > 1 }
    
    return false unless duplicate_digits.size == 1
    return false unless duplicate_digits.values.first == 2
    
    # Checksum validation
    sum = 0
    product = 10
    
    digits[0..9].each do |digit|
      sum = (digit + product) % 10
      sum = 10 if sum == 0
      product = (sum * 2) % 11
    end
    
    checksum = 11 - product
    checksum = 0 if checksum == 10
    
    digits[10] == checksum
  end
  
  # Validates German VAT number (USt-IdNr)
  def self.valid_vat_number?(vat_number)
    return false unless vat_number.is_a?(String)
    
    # Remove spaces and convert to uppercase
    clean_vat = vat_number.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Must start with DE followed by 9 digits
    return false unless clean_vat.match?(/^DE\d{9}$/)
    
    digits = clean_vat[2..-1].chars.map(&:to_i)
    
    # Extended modulus 10 check
    weights = [2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2]
    sum = 0
    
    digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      product = digit * weights[index]
      # If product >= 10, add the digits of the product
      sum += product >= 10 ? product.to_s.chars.map(&:to_i).sum : product
    end
    
    # Sum must be divisible by 10
    (sum % 10) == 0
  end
end

# xml_signer.rb
require 'xmldsig'
require 'openssl'
require 'nokogiri'

class XMLSigner
  def initialize(private_key_path, certificate_path, password = nil)
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(private_key_path), password)
    @certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(certificate_path))
  end

  # Підпис XML-документа
  def sign_xml(xml_content, options = {})
    # Параметри за замовчуванням
    options = {
      id_attribute: 'ID',
      reference_uri: '',
      inclusive_namespaces: [],
      enveloped: true,
      digest_method: :sha256,
      signature_method: :rsa_sha256
    }.merge(options)

    # Створюємо документ з XML
    document = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    
    # Створюємо підпис
    signature = Xmldsig::SignedDocument.new(document)
    
    # Додаємо сертифікат до підпису
    signature.signatures.each do |sig|
      # Додаємо сертифікат до KeyInfo
      key_info = sig.at_xpath('ds:KeyInfo', ds: 'http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#')
      unless key_info
        key_info = Nokogiri::XML::Node.new('KeyInfo', document)
        key_info.namespace = Nokogiri::XML::Namespace.new(key_info, 'ds', 'http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#')
        sig.add_child(key_info)
      end
      
      x509_data = Nokogiri::XML::Node.new('X509Data', document)
      x509_cert = Nokogiri::XML::Node.new('X509Certificate', document)
      x509_cert.content = @certificate.to_pem.gsub(/-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----|-----END CERTIFICATE-----|\n/, '')
      x509_data.add_child(x509_cert)
      key_info.add_child(x509_data)
    end
    
    # Підписуємо документ
    signed_document = signature.sign(@private_key) do |signature, document, signature_info|
      # Налаштування Reference
      signature_info.reference_uri = options[:reference_uri]
      signature_info.digest_method = options[:digest_method]
      signature_info.inclusive_namespaces = options[:inclusive_namespaces]
      
      # Для enveloped підпису
      if options[:enveloped]
        signature_info.enveloped = true
      end
    end

    signed_document.to_xml
  end

  # Перевірка XML-підпису
  def verify_xml(xml_content, trusted_certificates = [])
    document = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    signature = Xmldsig::SignedDocument.new(document)
    
    # Додаємо довірені сертифікати
    if trusted_certificates.any?
      trusted_certificates.each do |cert_path|
        cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(cert_path))
        signature.trusted_certificates << cert
      end
    else
      # Використовуємо сертифікат з підпису, якщо не вказано довірені
      signature.trusted_certificates << @certificate
    end
    
    signature.verify
  end

  # Вилучення сертифіката з підписаного XML
  def extract_certificate_from_signed_xml(xml_content)
    document = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    x509_cert_node = document.at_xpath('//ds:X509Certificate', ds: 'http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#')
    
    return nil unless x509_cert_node
    
    cert_content = x509_cert_node.content
    cert_pem = "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n#{cert_content}\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"
    OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(cert_pem)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Приклад XML-документа для підпису
  xml_content = <<~XML
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    <Document ID="doc1">
      <Data>Важливі дані для підпису</Data>
      <Timestamp>#{Time.now.iso8601}</Timestamp>
    </Document>
  XML

  begin
    # Ініціалізація підписувача (шляхи до ключа та сертифіката)
    signer = XMLSigner.new(
      'private_key.pem',    # Шлях до приватного ключа
      'certificate.pem'     # Шлях до сертифіката
      # 'password'          # Пароль для ключа (якщо потрібно)
    )

    puts "Оригінальний XML:"
    puts xml_content
    puts "\n" + "="*50 + "\n"

    # Підпис XML
    signed_xml = signer.sign_xml(xml_content, {
      reference_uri: '#doc1',
      digest_method: :sha256,
      signature_method: :rsa_sha256
    })

    puts "Підписаний XML:"
    puts signed_xml
    puts "\n" + "="*50 + "\n"

    # Перевірка підпису
    is_valid = signer.verify_xml(signed_xml)
    puts "Перевірка підпису: #{is_valid ? 'УСПІШНО' : 'НЕВДАЛО'}"
    
    # Вилучення сертифіката з підписаного XML
    cert = signer.extract_certificate_from_signed_xml(signed_xml)
    puts "\nСертифікат з підпису:"
    puts cert.to_text if cert

  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    puts e.backtrace
  end
end
```
