## Implementation

```ruby
# ukraine_vat_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'

class UkraineVATChecker
  # Base URL for Ukrainian tax service SOAP API
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.reg.omsk.ua/soap'.freeze
  
  # SOAP action for checking VAT payer status
  SOAP_ACTION = 'urn:check_vat'.freeze
  
  # SOAP envelope template
  SOAP_TEMPLATE = <<~SOAP
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    <SOAP-ENV:Envelope 
        xmlns:SOAP-ENV="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" 
        xmlns:ns1="urn:check_vat">
        <SOAP-ENV:Body>
            <ns1:checkVat>
                <ns1:vatNumber>%{vat_number}</ns1:vatNumber>
            </ns1:checkVat>
        </SOAP-ENV:Body>
    </SOAP-ENV:Envelope>
  SOAP

  def initialize
    @client = HTTParty
  end

  # Check if a VAT payer is registered by their individual tax number (ІПН)
  # @param vat_number [String] - Individual tax number (ІПН)
  # @return [Hash] - Result containing status and details
  def check_vat_payer(vat_number)
    # Validate input
    return invalid_result('VAT number cannot be empty') if vat_number.nil? || vat_number.empty?
    
    # Clean and validate the format (ІПН should be 10 digits for individuals, 12 for companies)
    cleaned_vat = vat_number.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    unless valid_vat_format?(cleaned_vat)
      return invalid_result("Invalid VAT number format: #{vat_number}")
    end

    # Prepare SOAP request
    soap_body = SOAP_TEMPLATE % { vat_number: cleaned_vat }
    
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'text/xml; charset=utf-8',
      'SOAPAction' => SOAP_ACTION
    }

    begin
      # Make SOAP request
      response = @client.post(
        BASE_URL,
        body: soap_body,
        headers: headers,
        timeout: 30
      )

      # Parse SOAP response
      parse_soap_response(response, cleaned_vat)
      
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      error_result("HTTP error: #{e.message}")
    rescue StandardError => e
      error_result("Unexpected error: #{e.message}")
    end
  end

  private

  # Validate VAT number format (ІПН)
  def valid_vat_format?(vat_number)
    # Ukrainian ІПН: 10 digits for individuals, 12 digits for companies
    vat_number.match?(/^\d{10}$|^\d{12}$/)
  end

  # Parse SOAP response from tax service
  def parse_soap_response(response, vat_number)
    return error_result('Empty response from tax service') if response.body.nil? || response.body.empty?
    
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    
    # Remove namespaces for easier parsing
    doc.remove_namespaces!
    
    # Look for valid response elements
    valid_element = doc.at_xpath('//valid')
    name_element = doc.at_xpath('//name')
    address_element = doc.at_xpath('//address')
    request_date_element = doc.at_xpath('//requestDate')
    
    if valid_element
      is_valid = valid_element.text.downcase == 'true'
      
      {
        valid: is_valid,
        vat_number: vat_number,
        registered: is_valid,
        name: name_element&.text&.strip,
        address: address_element&.text&.strip,
        request_date: request_date_element&.text,
        error: nil
      }
    else
      # Try to find error information
      fault_string = doc.at_xpath('//faultstring')&.text
      error_message = fault_string || 'Invalid response format from tax service'
      
      {
        valid: false,
        vat_number: vat_number,
        registered: false,
        name: nil,
        address: nil,
        request_date: nil,
        error: error_message
      }
    end
  rescue Nokogiri::XML::XPath::SyntaxError => e
    error_result("Failed to parse response: #{e.message}")
  end

  def invalid_result(message)
    {
      valid: false,
      vat_number: nil,
      registered: false,
      name: nil,
      address: nil,
      request_date: nil,
      error: message
    }
  end

  def error_result(message)
    {
      valid: false,
      vat_number: nil,
      registered: false,
      name: nil,
      address: nil,
      request_date: nil,
      error: message
    }
  end
end

# Alternative implementation using public JSON API (if available)
class UkraineVATCheckerJSON
  # This uses a public API endpoint (example - actual endpoint may vary)
  API_URL = 'https://api.reg.omsk.ua/api/v1/vat'.freeze
  
  def check_vat_payer(vat_number)
    return invalid_result('VAT number cannot be empty') if vat_number.nil? || vat_number.empty?
    
    cleaned_vat = vat_number.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    unless valid_vat_format?(cleaned_vat)
      return invalid_result("Invalid VAT number format: #{vat_number}")
    end

    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(
        "#{API_URL}/#{cleaned_vat}",
        headers: { 'Accept' => 'application/json' },
        timeout: 30
      )

      parse_json_response(response, cleaned_vat)
      
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      error_result("HTTP error: #{e.message}")
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      error_result("Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}")
    rescue StandardError => e
      error_result("Unexpected error: #{e.message}")
    end
  end

  private

  def valid_vat_format?(vat_number)
    vat_number.match?(/^\d{10}$|^\d{12}$/)
  end

  def parse_json_response(response, vat_number)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    {
      valid: data['valid'] || false,
      vat_number: vat_number,
      registered: data['registered'] || false,
      name: data['name'],
      address: data['address'],
      request_date: data['request_date'],
      error: data['error']
    }
  rescue => e
    error_result("Failed to parse response: #{e.message}")
  end

  def invalid_result(message)
    { valid: false, vat_number: nil, registered: false, error: message }
  end

  def error_result(message)
    { valid: false, vat_number: nil, registered: false, error: message }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/ehealth_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'jwt'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'json'

class EHealthAPI
  # Базові URL API eHealth
  PRODUCTION_URL = "https://api.e-health.gov.ua"
  SANDBOX_URL = "https://sandbox-api.e-health.gov.ua"
  
  def initialize(client_id:, kid:, private_key:, base_url: SANDBOX_URL)
    @client_id = client_id
    @kid = kid
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(private_key)
    @base_url = base_url
    @token = nil
  end
  
  # Отримання access token
  def authenticate
    headers = {
      'kid' => @kid,
      'typ' => 'JWT',
      'alg' => 'RS256'
    }
    
    payload = {
      iss: @client_id,
      sub: @client_id,
      aud: "#{@base_url}/api/oauth/token",
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300, # 5 хвилин
      jti: SecureRandom.uuid
    }
    
    assertion = JWT.encode(payload, @private_key, 'RS256', headers)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/api/oauth/token",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      },
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_assertion_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer',
        client_assertion: assertion,
        scope: 'declaration'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      true
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Створення медичної декларації
  def create_medical_declaration(declaration_data)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/api/declarations",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: declaration_data.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про декларацію
  def get_declaration(declaration_id)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/api/declarations/#{declaration_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/medical_declaration_service.rb
class MedicalDeclarationService
  def initialize(api_client)
    @api = api_client
  end
  
  # Створення декларації з валідацією даних
  def create_declaration(patient_data, doctor_id, division_id)
    # Валідація обов'язкових полів
    validate_patient_data(patient_data)
    
    declaration_data = {
      person: format_patient_data(patient_data),
      doctor_id: doctor_id,
      division_id: division_id,
      declaration_type: 'REGULAR'
    }
    
    @api.create_medical_declaration(declaration_data)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу декларації
  def check_declaration_status(declaration_id)
    declaration = @api.get_declaration(declaration_id)
    {
      id: declaration['id'],
      status: declaration['status'],
      created_at: declaration['created_at'],
      updated_at: declaration['updated_at']
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_patient_data(data)
    required_fields = [:first_name, :last_name, :birth_date, :phone, :tax_id]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| data[field].nil? || data[field].empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise "Відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Перевірка формату дати
    begin
      Date.parse(data[:birth_date])
    rescue
      raise "Невірний формат дати народження"
    end
  end
  
  def format_patient_data(data)
    {
      first_name: data[:first_name],
      last_name: data[:last_name],
      second_name: data[:second_name],
      birth_date: data[:birth_date],
      sex: data[:sex] || 'UNKNOWN',
      phone: data[:phone],
      email: data[:email],
      addresses: data[:addresses] || [],
      identity_document: data[:identity_document],
      tax_id: data[:tax_id]
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# kupyna.rb
require 'matrix'

class Kupyna
  # Constants for Kupyna-256 (can be adjusted for Kupyna-384/512)
  ROWS = 8
  COLS_256 = 8
  BLOCK_SIZE_256 = 512 # bits
  ROUNDS = 10
  
  # Round constants for Kupyna-256
  ROUND_CONSTANTS = [
    0x6ea7a2d7c66bfae0, 0x5a8279994b1f7b2c,
    0x3b9aca00f1d25e5d, 0x2d9f1d3e6a9c2b4f,
    0x1f3b5e7a9c2d4f68, 0x0f1e2d3c4b5a6978,
    0x070f1e2d3c4b5a69, 0x03070f1e2d3c4b5a,
    0x0103070f1e2d3c4b, 0x000103070f1e2d3c
  ].freeze

  # S-box (similar to AES S-box)
  S_BOX = [
    0xa3, 0x1d, 0x69, 0xcd, 0x53, 0xf2, 0x9a, 0x4e,
    0x83, 0x3d, 0xce, 0x52, 0xf1, 0x9b, 0x4d, 0xa2,
    0x1c, 0x68, 0xcc, 0x53, 0xf2, 0x9a, 0x4e, 0x83,
    0x3d, 0xce, 0x52, 0xf1, 0x9b, 0x4d, 0xa2, 0x1c
  ].freeze

  def initialize(digest_size = 256)
    @digest_size = digest_size
    @cols = case digest_size
            when 256 then COLS_256
            when 384 then 12
            when 512 then 16
            else COLS_256
            end
    @block_size = digest_size
    @state = Matrix.zero(ROWS, @cols)
  end

  def hash(message)
    # Convert message to bytes
    message_bytes = message.bytes
    
    # Padding
    padded_message = pad_message(message_bytes)
    
    # Process blocks
    padded_message.each_slice(@block_size / 8).each do |block|
      process_block(block)
    end
    
    # Final transformation
    final_hash
  end

  private

  def pad_message(message_bytes)
    # Kupyna uses padding similar to SHA-3
    rate = @block_size / 8
    padded = message_bytes.dup
    padded << 0x06  # Kupyna padding byte
    while (padded.size + 1) % rate != 0
      padded << 0x00
    end
    padded << 0x80  # End padding
    padded
  end

  def process_block(block)
    # Convert block to state matrix
    block_matrix = bytes_to_matrix(block)
    
    # Add round constants and apply transformations
    ROUNDS.times do |round|
      # Add round constant
      add_round_constant(block_matrix, round)
      
      # SubBytes transformation
      sub_bytes(block_matrix)
      
      # ShiftRows transformation
      shift_rows(block_matrix)
      
      # MixColumns transformation  
      mix_columns(block_matrix)
    end
    
    # XOR with state
    @state = Matrix.build(ROWS, @cols) do |i, j|
      @state[i, j] ^ block_matrix[i, j]
    end
  end

  def bytes_to_matrix(bytes)
    matrix = Matrix.zero(ROWS, @cols)
    bytes.each_with_index do |byte, index|
      row = index % ROWS
      col = index / ROWS
      matrix[row, col] = byte if col < @cols
    end
    matrix
  end

  def add_round_constant(matrix, round)
    # Add round constant to each column
    @cols.times do |col|
      constant_byte = (ROUND_CONSTANTS[round] >> (8 * col)) & 0xFF
      matrix[col % ROWS, col] ^= constant_byte
    end
  end

  def sub_bytes(matrix)
    # Apply S-box to each byte
    matrix.map! { |byte| S_BOX[byte & 0x1F] || byte }
  end

  def shift_rows(matrix)
    # Rotate rows: row i is rotated left by i positions
    ROWS.times do |i|
      row = matrix.row(i).to_a
      rotated_row = row.rotate(-i)
      ROWS.times { |j| matrix[i, j] = rotated_row[j] }
    end
  end

  def mix_columns(matrix)
    # MixColumns using matrix multiplication (simplified)
    # Using a simple mixing pattern for demonstration
    @cols.times do |col|
      column = matrix.column(col).to_a
      mixed_column = Array.new(ROWS, 0)
      
      ROWS.times do |i|
        ROWS.times do |j|
          mixed_column[i] ^= gf_multiply(mixing_matrix[i][j], column[j])
        end
      end
      
      ROWS.times { |i| matrix[i, col] = mixed_column[i] }
    end
  end

  def mixing_matrix
    # Simple mixing matrix for demonstration
    # In actual Kupyna, this would be a carefully designed matrix
    @mixing_matrix ||= Matrix[
      [2, 3, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 1],
      [1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3],
      [3, 1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 2],
      [1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 2, 3],
      [1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 2, 3, 1],
      [2, 3, 1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1],
      [3, 1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 2],
      [1, 1, 2, 3, 1, 1, 2, 3]
    ]
  end

  def gf_multiply(a, b)
    # Simple Galois Field multiplication (modulo 2^8)
    result = 0
    8.times do
      result ^= a * (b & 1)
      b >>= 1
      carry = a & 0x80
      a = (a << 1) & 0xFF
      a ^= 0x1B if carry != 0
    end
    result & 0xFF
  end

  def final_hash
    # Apply final transformations and extract hash
    final_state = @state.dup
    
    ROUNDS.times do |round|
      add_round_constant(final_state, round)
      sub_bytes(final_state)
      shift_rows(final_state)
      mix_columns(final_state)
    end
    
    # Extract hash bytes
    hash_bytes = []
    @cols.times do |col|
      ROWS.times do |row|
        hash_bytes << final_state[row, col]
      end
    end
    
    # Return hash in hexadecimal format
    hash_bytes.map { |b| sprintf('%02x', b) }.join
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'twilio-ruby'
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Load environment variables from .env file
# You'll need to create a .env file with:
# TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=your_account_sid
# TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=your_auth_token
# TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER=your_twilio_phone_number

class SMSVerificationService
  def initialize
    @account_sid = ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID']
    @auth_token = ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
    @phone_number = ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER']
    
    # In-memory storage for verification codes (use a database in production)
    @verification_codes = {}
    
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(@account_sid, @auth_token)
  end

  # Generate a random 6-digit verification code
  def generate_verification_code
    rand(100000..999999).to_s
  end

  # Send verification code via SMS
  def send_verification_code(phone_number)
    code = generate_verification_code
    expiration_time = Time.now + 10 * 60  # 10 minutes from now
    
    @verification_codes[phone_number] = {
      code: code,
      expires_at: expiration_time,
      attempts: 0
    }
    
    message = @client.messages.create(
      body: "Your verification code is: #{code}. It will expire in 10 minutes.",
      from: @phone_number,
      to: phone_number
    )
    
    {
      success: true,
      message_sid: message.sid,
      phone_number: phone_number
    }
  rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: e.message
    }
  end

  # Verify the code entered by user
  def verify_code(phone_number, entered_code)
    stored_data = @verification_codes[phone_number]
    
    return { success: false, error: 'No verification code found for this phone number' } unless stored_data
    
    # Check if code has expired
    if Time.now > stored_data[:expires_at]
      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number)
      return { success: false, error: 'Verification code has expired' }
    end
    
    # Increment attempts
    stored_data[:attempts] += 1
    
    # Check if too many attempts
    if stored_data[:attempts] > 3
      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number)
      return { success: false, error: 'Too many failed attempts' }
    end
    
    # Verify code
    if stored_data[:code] == entered_code
      @verification_codes.delete(phone_number)  # Remove used code
      { success: true, message: 'Verification successful' }
    else
      { success: false, error: 'Invalid verification code' }
    end
  end

  # Clean up expired codes (call this periodically)
  def cleanup_expired_codes
    current_time = Time.now
    @verification_codes.delete_if { |phone, data| current_time > data[:expires_at] }
  end
end

# Web API using Sinatra
class VerificationAPI < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :sms_service, SMSVerificationService.new
    enable :logging
  end

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  # Endpoint to send verification code
  post '/send-code' do
    phone_number = params[:phone_number]
    
    if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.empty?
      status 400
      return { error: 'Phone number is required' }.to_json
    end
    
    result = settings.sms_service.send_verification_code(phone_number)
    
    if result[:success]
      status 200
      { message: 'Verification code sent successfully' }.to_json
    else
      status 400
      { error: result[:error] }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Endpoint to verify code
  post '/verify-code' do
    phone_number = params[:phone_number]
    code = params[:code]
    
    if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.empty? || code.nil? || code.empty?
      status 400
      return { error: 'Phone number and code are required' }.to_json
    end
    
    result = settings.sms_service.verify_code(phone_number, code)
    
    if result[:success]
      status 200
      { message: result[:message] }.to_json
    else
      status 400
      { error: result[:error] }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Health check endpoint
  get '/health' do
    { status: 'OK', timestamp: Time.now.iso8601 }.to_json
  end
end
```

```ruby
class SlackNotifier
  class << self
    def notify_new_order(order, channel: '#orders')
      return unless valid_slack_config?
      
      client = Slack::Web::Client.new
      
      message = build_order_message(order)
      
      begin
        client.chat_postMessage(
          channel: channel,
          text: message[:text],
          blocks: message[:blocks],
          attachments: message[:attachments]
        )
        Rails.logger.info "Slack notification sent for order #{order.id}"
      rescue Slack::Web::Api::Errors::SlackError => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to send Slack notification: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def build_order_message(order)
      {
        text: "🆕 Нове замовлення ##{order.id}",
        blocks: [
          {
            type: 'header',
            text: {
              type: 'plain_text',
              text: '🆕 Нове замовлення'
            }
          },
          {
            type: 'section',
            fields: [

              },
              {
                type: 'mrkdwn',
                text: "*Клієнт:*\n#{order.customer_name}"
              },
              {
                type: 'mrkdwn',

              },
              {
                type: 'mrkdwn',
                text: "*Статус:*\n#{order.status}"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            type: 'section',
            text: {
              type: 'mrkdwn',
              text: "*Товари:*\n#{format_order_items(order.items)}"

          },
          {
            type: 'actions',
            elements: [

                  text: 'Переглянути замовлення'
                },
                url: order_admin_url(order),
                style: 'primary'
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    end

      items.map do |item|

      end.join("\n")
    end
    
    def order_admin_url(order)
      # Замініть на ваш реальний URL

    def valid_slack_config?

    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class WhatsAppTemplateSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0'

  def initialize(phone_number_id, access_token)
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @access_token = access_token
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Send a template message
  def send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code = 'en', components = [])
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"
    
    payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: to_phone_number,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Add components if provided (for dynamic content in templates)
    payload[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Helper method to create header component
  def create_header_component(parameters)
    {
      type: 'header',
      parameters: parameters
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create body component
  def create_body_component(parameters)
    {
      type: 'body',
      parameters: parameters
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create parameter for text
  def create_text_parameter(text)
    {
      type: 'text',
      text: text
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create parameter for currency
  def create_currency_parameter(amount, currency_code = 'USD')
    {
      type: 'currency',
      currency: {
        fallback_value: amount.to_s,
        code: currency_code,
        amount_1000: (amount * 1000).to_i
      }
    }
  end

  # Helper method to create parameter for date/time
  def create_date_time_parameter(timestamp)
    {
      type: 'date_time',
      date_time: {
        fallback_value: timestamp.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        timestamp: timestamp.to_i
      }
    }
  end

  # Get template list (optional - to check available templates)
  def get_templates(business_account_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{business_account_id}/message_templates"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, {
      headers: @headers
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      puts "✅ Message sent successfully!"
      puts "Message ID: #{response.parsed_response['messages'].first['id']}" if response.parsed_response['messages']
      response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "❌ Error sending message:"
      puts "Status: #{response.code}"
      puts "Body: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

Для реалізації геш-функції Купина (ДСТУ 7564) на Ruby, спочатку створіть Gemfile з необхідними гемами:

**kupyna.rb:**
```ruby
require 'openssl'

class Kupyna
  # Константи згідно ДСТУ 7564
  BLOCK_SIZE = 512 # біт
  DIGEST_SIZES = {
    256 => 256,
    384 => 384,
    512 => 512
  }

  def initialize(digest_size = 256)
    raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported digest size" unless DIGEST_SIZES.key?(digest_size)
    @digest_size = digest_size
    @buffer = ""
  end

  def update(data)
    @buffer << data
    self
  end

  def digest
    # Доповнення повідомлення згідно стандарту
    padded_message = pad_message(@buffer)
    
    # Ініціалізація стану
    state = initialize_state
    
    # Обробка блоків
    padded_message.bytes.each_slice(BLOCK_SIZE / 8) do |block|
      state = process_block(block, state)
    end
    
    # Фіналізація
    finalize(state)
  end

  def hexdigest
    digest.unpack1('H*')
  end

  private

  def pad_message(message)
    # Доповнення повідомлення до кратності BLOCK_SIZE біт
    bit_length = message.bytesize * 8
    padding = 0x80.chr # біт "1" та нулі
    padding << "\x00" * ((-message.bytesize - 9) % (BLOCK_SIZE / 8))
    padding << [bit_length >> 8, bit_length & 0xFF].pack('n*')
    message + padding
  end

  def initialize_state
    # Ініціалізація стану згідно стандарту
    case @digest_size
    when 256
      # Для Kupyna-256: 8x8 матриця з 64-бітних слів
      Array.new(8) { Array.new(8, 0) }
    when 384, 512
      # Для Kupyna-384/512: 8x8 матриця з 64-бітних слів
      Array.new(8) { Array.new(8, 0) }
    end
  end

  def process_block(block, state)
    # Основна логіка обробки блоку
    # Це спрощена реалізація - повна реалізація вимагає специфікації ДСТУ 7564
    expanded_block = expand_block(block)
    
    # Раундові перетворення
    10.times do |round|
      state = add_round_key(state, expanded_block, round)
      state = sub_bytes(state)
      state = shift_rows(state)
      state = mix_columns(state)
    end
    
    state
  end

  def expand_block(block)
    # Розширення блоку для раундових ключів
    # Спрощена версія - реальна реалізація складніша
    block.each_slice(8).to_a
  end

  def add_round_key(state, round_keys, round)
    # Додавання раундового ключа
    state.map.with_index do |row, i|
      row.map.with_index do |val, j|
        val ^ round_keys[round % round_keys.size][j]
      end
    end
  end

  def sub_bytes(state)
    # Заміна байтів згідно S-блоку Купина
    state.map do |row|
      row.map { |byte| s_box(byte) }
    end
  end

  def s_box(byte)
    # Приклад S-блоку (справжній S-блок визначений в ДСТУ 7564)
    # Це заглушка - реальний S-блок містить 256 значень
    s_box_table = [
      0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07,
      # ... повна таблиця з 256 значень
    ]
    s_box_table[byte % 256]
  end

  def shift_rows(state)
    # Зсув рядків
    state.map.with_index do |row, i|
      row.rotate(i)
    end
  end

  def mix_columns(state)
    # Перемішування стовпців
    state.transpose.map do |col|
      # Матриця перемішування MDS
      mixed_col = Array.new(8, 0)
      8.times do |i|
        8.times do |j|
          mixed_col[i] ^= gf_mult(col[j], mds_matrix[i][j])
        end
      end
      mixed_col
    end.transpose
  end

  def gf_mult(a, b)
    # Множення в полі Галуа GF(2^8)
    result = 0
    8.times do
      result ^= a if b & 1 == 1
      hi_bit = a & 0x80
      a = (a << 1) & 0xFF
      a ^= 0x1D if hi_bit == 0x80
      b >>= 1
    end
    result
  end

  def mds_matrix
    # MDS матриця для перемішування стовпців
    # Приклад матриці (реальна матриця визначена в стандарті)
    [
      [0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x07, 0x04],
      [0x04, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x07],
      [0x07, 0x04, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06],
      [0x06, 0x07, 0x04, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x08],
      [0x08, 0x06, 0x07, 0x04, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01],
      [0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x07, 0x04, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05],
      [0x05, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x07, 0x04, 0x01, 0x01],
      [0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x07, 0x04, 0x01]
    ]
  end

  def finalize(state)
    # Фіналізація геш-значення
    case @digest_size
    when 256
      # Для Kupyna-256: беремо перші 256 біт
      state.flatten.pack('C*').unpack1('B*')[0...256].to_i(2).to_s(16).rjust(64, '0')
    when 384
      # Для Kupyna-384: беремо перші 384 біт
      state.flatten.pack('C*').unpack1('B*')[0...384].to_i(2).to_s(16).rjust(96, '0')
    when 512
      # Для Kupyna-512: беремо всі 512 біт
      state.flatten.pack('C*').unpack1('B*').to_i(2).to_s(16).rjust(128, '0')
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# vehicle_info.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class UkrainianVehicleInfo
  BASE_URL = 'https://index.minfin.com.ua/ua/transport/vehicle/'.freeze
  
  def initialize(license_plate)
    @license_plate = license_plate.to_s.upcase.gsub(/\s+/, '')
  end
  
  def get_info
    return { error: 'Некоректний номерний знак' } unless valid_plate?
    
    response = make_request
    return { error: 'Помилка при запиті до сервера' } unless response.success?
    
    parse_response(response.body)
  end
  
  private
  
  def valid_plate?
    # Паттерн для українських номерних знаків (стандарт 2004+)
    # Формат: AA 1234 BB або AA 123 BB (старий формат)
    plate_pattern = /\A[A-ZА-ЯІЇҐ]{2}\d{4}[A-ZА-ЯІЇҐ]{2}\z|\A[A-ZА-ЯІЇҐ]{2}\d{3}[A-ZА-ЯІЇҐ]{2}\z/
    @license_plate.match?(plate_pattern)
  end
  
  def make_request
    HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}#{@license_plate}", {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'
      },
      timeout: 30
    })
  end
  
  def parse_response(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    
    # Пошук таблиці з даними про транспортний засіб
    vehicle_table = doc.css('table.vehicle-info, table.auto, .vehicle-table, table')
    
    if vehicle_table.empty?
      return { error: 'Інформація не знайдена або номерний знак не існує' }
    end
    
    extract_vehicle_data(doc)
  end
  
  def extract_vehicle_data(doc)
    data = {}
    
    # Спроба знайти дані в різних форматах, що можуть бути на сайті
    doc.css('tr').each do |row|
      cells = row.css('td')
      next unless cells.size >= 2
      
      key = cells[0].text.strip.downcase
      value = cells[1].text.strip
      
      case key
      when /марка|brand|make/
        data[:brand] = value
      when /модель|model/
        data[:model] = value
      when /рік|year/
        data[:year] = value
      when /колір|color|colour/
        data[:color] = value
      when /тип|type/
        data[:type] = value
      when /об'єм|объем|engine/
        data[:engine_volume] = value
      when /пальне|fuel/
        data[:fuel_type] = value
      when /вага|weight/
        data[:weight] = value
      when /vin/
        data[:vin] = value
      when /власник|owner/
        data[:owner] = value
      when /реєстрація|registration/
        data[:registration_date] = value
      end
    end
    
    # Якщо не вдалося розпарсити таблицю, спробуємо знайти дані в іншому форматі
    if data.empty?
      data = extract_from_text(doc.text)
    end
    
    data.merge(license_plate: @license_plate)
  end
  
  def extract_from_text(text)
    data = {}
    
    # Пошук патернів у тексті
    if match = text.match(/Марка[:\s]+([^\n\r]+)/i)
      data[:brand] = match[1].strip
    end
    
    if match = text.match(/Модель[:\s]+([^\n\r]+)/i)
      data[:model] = match[1].strip
    end
    
    if match = text.match(/Рік[:\s]+(\d{4})/i)
      data[:year] = match[1].strip
    end
    
    if match = text.match(/Колір[:\s]+([^\n\r]+)/i)
      data[:color] = match[1].strip
    end
    
    data
  end
end

# Додатковий клас для роботи з API (якщо API стане доступним)
class VehicleAPI
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.mvs.gov.ua/api/vehicle'.freeze
  
  def self.get_info(license_plate, api_key = nil)
    # Це заготовка для майбутнього API
    # Наразі офіційне API може бути недоступним або вимагати авторизацію
    
    headers = {
      'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{api_key}" if api_key
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get("#{API_BASE_URL}/#{license_plate}", {
        headers: headers,
        timeout: 30
      })
      
      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        { error: "Помилка API: #{response.code}" }
      end
    rescue => e
      { error: "Помилка з'єднання: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'vehicle_info'

class AdvancedVehicleInfo < UkrainianVehicleInfo
  def get_detailed_info
    basic_info = get_info
    return basic_info if basic_info[:error]
    
    # Додаткові перевірки та інформація
    enhanced_info = basic_info.merge(
      checked_at: Time.now,
      plate_format: detect_plate_format,
      region: detect_region
    )
    
    enhanced_info
  end
  
  private
  
  def detect_plate_format
    case @license_plate
    when /\A[A-ZА-ЯІЇҐ]{2}\d{4}[A-ZА-ЯІЇҐ]{2}\z/

    region_codes = {
```

```ruby
# fcm_notification_sender.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'httparty'

class FCMNotificationSender
  def initialize(server_key)
    @fcm = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }
    
    response = @fcm.send([device_token], options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }
    
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send notification with custom options for different platforms
  def send_advanced_notification(device_tokens, options = {})
    default_options = {
      priority: 'high',
      content_available: true
    }
    
    final_options = default_options.merge(options)
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, final_options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # iOS specific notification with APNS payload
  def send_ios_notification(device_tokens, title, body, badge: nil, sound: 'default', data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: sound,
        badge: badge
      },
      data: data,
      apns: {
        headers: {
          'apns-priority' => '10'
        },
        payload: {
          aps: {
            alert: {
              title: title,
              body: body
            },
            sound: sound,
            badge: badge
          }
        }
      }
    }.compact # Remove nil values
    
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Android specific notification with custom options
  def send_android_notification(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default',
        android_channel_id: 'default_channel'
      },
      data: data,
      android: {
        priority: 'high',
        notification: {
          sound: 'default',
          tag: 'notification'
        }
      }
    }
    
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send data-only message (no notification display)
  def send_data_message(device_tokens, data)
    options = {
      data: data,
      content_available: true
    }
    
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = response[:body]
      puts "Notification sent successfully!"
      puts "Response: #{body}"
      
      # Parse and handle individual results
      if body && body['results']
        body['results'].each_with_index do |result, index|
          if result['error']
            puts "Message #{index + 1} failed: #{result['error']}"
          elsif result['message_id']
            puts "Message #{index + 1} sent successfully"
          end
        end
      end
      
      return { success: true, response: body }
    else
      puts "Failed to send notification. Status: #{response[:status_code]}"
      puts "Response: #{response[:body]}"
      return { success: false, error: "HTTP #{response[:status_code]}", response: response[:body] }
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error sending notification: #{e.message}"
    return { success: false, error: e.message }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# sendgrid_mailer.rb
require 'sendgrid-ruby'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'logger'

class SendGridMailer
  attr_reader :client, :logger

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    api_key ||= ENV['SENDGRID_API_KEY']
    raise "SendGrid API key is required" unless api_key

    @client = SendGrid::API.new(api_key: api_key).client
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end

  # Основний метод для відправки листа з динамічним шаблоном
  def send_dynamic_template(to_email, template_id, dynamic_data = {}, options = {})
    begin
      mail = build_mail(to_email, template_id, dynamic_data, options)
      response = @client.mail._('send').post(request_body: mail.to_json)
      
      if response.status_code.to_i >= 200 && response.status_code.to_i < 300
        logger.info "Email sent successfully to #{to_email}"
        { success: true, message_id: response.headers['x-message-id'] }
      else
        logger.error "Failed to send email: #{response.body}"
        { success: false, error: response.body }
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error "Error sending email: #{e.message}"
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Метод для відправки масових листів
  def send_batch(recipients, template_id, dynamic_data_array, options = {})
    results = []
    
    recipients.each_with_index do |recipient, index|
      data = dynamic_data_array[index] || {}
      result = send_dynamic_template(recipient, template_id, data, options)
      results << result.merge(email: recipient)
      
      # Невелика затримка для уникнення rate limiting
      sleep(0.1) if index % 10 == 0
    end
    
    results
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу шаблону
  def get_template(template_id)
    begin
      response = @client.templates._(template_id).get
      if response.status_code.to_i == 200
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        logger.error "Failed to get template: #{response.body}"
        nil
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error "Error getting template: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def build_mail(to_email, template_id, dynamic_data, options)
    from_email = options[:from] || ENV['DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL'] || 'noreply@example.com'
    from_name = options[:from_name] || ENV['DEFAULT_FROM_NAME']
    subject = options[:subject]
    reply_to = options[:reply_to]
    
    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.reply_to = SendGrid::Email.new(email: reply_to) if reply_to
    
    # Додаємо одержувача
    personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
    personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: to_email))
    
    # Додаємо динамічні дані для шаблону
    personalization.dynamic_template_data = dynamic_data if dynamic_data.any?
    
    mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    mail.template_id = template_id
    mail.subject = subject if subject
    
    mail
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# sendgrid_transactional_email.rb
require 'sendgrid-ruby'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class SendGridTransactionalEmail
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['SENDGRID_API_KEY']
    @client = SendGrid::API.new(api_key: @api_key).client
  end

  # Send email using a dynamic template
  # @param to_email [String] Recipient email address
  # @param template_id [String] SendGrid dynamic template ID
  # @param dynamic_template_data [Hash] Data to populate the template placeholders
  # @param from_email [String] Sender email address
  # @param from_name [String] Sender name (optional)
  # @param subject [String] Email subject (optional, can be set in template)
  # @param reply_to [String] Reply-to email address (optional)
  # @param attachments [Array<Hash>] Array of attachment hashes with :content and :filename keys
  # @return [Boolean] true if successful, false otherwise
  def send_email(
    to_email:, 
    template_id:, 
    dynamic_template_data: {},
    from_email: nil,
    from_name: nil,
    subject: nil,
    reply_to: nil,
    attachments: []
  )
    from_email ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL'] || 'noreply@example.com'
    from_name ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_NAME']

    mail = build_mail(
      to_email: to_email,
      template_id: template_id,
      dynamic_template_data: dynamic_template_data,
      from_email: from_email,
      from_name: from_name,
      subject: subject,
      reply_to: reply_to,
      attachments: attachments
    )

    send_mail(mail)
  end

  # Send email to multiple recipients with personalization
  # @param recipients [Array<Hash>] Array of recipient hashes with :email and :data keys
  # @param template_id [String] SendGrid dynamic template ID
  # @param from_email [String] Sender email address
  # @param from_name [String] Sender name (optional)
  # @param subject [String] Email subject (optional)
  # @return [Boolean] true if successful, false otherwise
  def send_bulk_email(
    recipients:,
    template_id:,
    from_email: nil,
    from_name: nil,
    subject: nil
  )
    from_email ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL'] || 'noreply@example.com'
    from_name ||= ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_NAME']

    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.template_id = template_id
    mail.subject = subject if subject

    # Add each recipient with their personalization data
    recipients.each do |recipient|
      personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
      personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: recipient[:email]))
      personalization.dynamic_template_data = recipient[:data] || {}
      mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    end

    send_mail(mail)
  end

  private

  def build_mail(to_email:, template_id:, dynamic_template_data:, from_email:, from_name:, subject:, reply_to:, attachments:)
    mail = SendGrid::Mail.new
    mail.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    mail.subject = subject if subject
    mail.reply_to = SendGrid::Email.new(email: reply_to) if reply_to
    
    personalization = SendGrid::Personalization.new
    personalization.add_to(SendGrid::Email.new(email: to_email))
    personalization.dynamic_template_data = dynamic_template_data
    mail.add_personalization(personalization)
    
    mail.template_id = template_id
    
    # Add attachments if any
    attachments.each do |attachment|
      mail.add_attachment(SendGrid::Attachment.new.tap do |a|
        a.content = Base64.strict_encode64(attachment[:content])
        a.filename = attachment[:filename]
        a.type = attachment[:type] || 'application/octet-stream'
      end)
    end

    mail
  end

  def send_mail(mail)
    begin
      response = @client.mail._('send').post(request_body: mail.to_json)
      
      if response.status_code.start_with?('2')
        puts "Email sent successfully! Status: #{response.status_code}"
        true
      else
        puts "Failed to send email. Status: #{response.status_code}"
        puts "Response body: #{response.body}"
        false
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error sending email: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# email_templates_helper.rb
require 'json'

class EmailTemplatesHelper
  # Predefined template data structures for common email types
  TEMPLATE_SCHEMAS = {
    welcome: {
      name: :string,
      verification_url: :string,
      support_email: :string
    },
    password_reset: {
      name: :string,
      reset_url: :string,
      expiry_hours: :number
    },
    order_confirmation: {
      name: :string,
      order_number: :string,
      order_date: :string,
      items: :array,
      subtotal: :string,
      shipping: :string,
      total: :string,
      shipping_address: :string
    },
    invoice: {
      name: :string,
      invoice_number: :string,
      due_date: :string,
      amount: :string,
      payment_url: :string
    }
  }

  # Validate template data against schema
  def self.validate_template_data(template_type, data)
    schema = TEMPLATE_SCHEMAS[template_type]
    return true unless schema # Skip validation if schema not defined
    
    schema.each do |key, expected_type|
      unless data.key?(key)
        raise ArgumentError, "Missing required field: #{key}"
      end
      
      case expected_type
      when :string
        unless data[key].is_a?(String)
          raise ArgumentError, "Field #{key} must be a string"
        end
      when :number
        unless data[key].is_a?(Numeric)
          raise ArgumentError, "Field #{key} must be a number"
        end
      when :array
        unless data[key].is_a?(Array)
          raise ArgumentError, "Field #{key} must be an array"
        end
      end
    end
    
    true
  end

  # Get template IDs from environment variables
  def self.template_id_for(type)
    ENV["SENDGRID_#{type.to_s.upcase}_TEMPLATE_ID"]
  end
end
```

```ruby
# firebase_notification_service.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'json'

class FirebaseNotificationService
  def initialize(server_key = nil)
    @server_key = server_key || ENV['FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY']
    @fcm = FCM.new(@server_key) if @server_key
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на один пристрій
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    return { success: false, error: 'FCM не ініціалізовано' } unless @fcm

    options = build_notification_options(title, body, data)
    
    begin
      response = @fcm.send(device_token, options)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на кілька пристроїв
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    return { success: false, error: 'FCM не ініціалізовано' } unless @fcm

    options = build_notification_options(title, body, data)
    
    begin
      response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення з кастомними параметрами
  def send_custom_notification(device_tokens, notification_payload)
    return { success: false, error: 'FCM не ініціалізовано' } unless @fcm

    begin
      response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, notification_payload)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_notification_options(title, body, data = {})
    {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default',
        badge: 1
      },
      data: data,
      android: {
        notification: {
          sound: 'default',
          priority: 'high'
        }
      },
      apns: {
        payload: {
          aps: {
            sound: 'default',
            badge: 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      if body['success'] == 1 || body['failure'] == 0
        { success: true, message_id: body['results'].first['message_id'] if body['results'] }
      else
        { 
          success: false, 
          error: "Помилка відправки: #{body}",
          details: body
        }
      end
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP помилка: #{response[:status_code]}",
        details: response[:body]
      }
    end
  end
end
```

## Service for Sending Notifications

```ruby
# app/services/webpush_service.rb
class WebpushService
  class WebpushError < StandardError; end
  
  def self.send_notification(subscription, message, options = {})
    begin
      # Default options
      default_options = {
        message: message.to_json,
        vapid: {
          subject: "mailto:admin@yourapp.com",
          public_key: ENV['VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY'],
          private_key: ENV['VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY']
        }
      }
      
      # Merge with provided options
      webpush_options = default_options.merge(options)
      
      # Send the notification
      response = Webpush.payload_send(
        **subscription.to_webpush_params.merge(webpush_options)
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue Webpush::InvalidSubscription => e
      # Subscription is invalid, delete it
      subscription.destroy
      raise WebpushError, "Invalid subscription: #{e.message}"
      
    rescue => e
      raise WebpushError, "Failed to send notification: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def self.send_to_user(user, message, options = {})
    successful_sends = 0
    failed_sends = 0
    
    user.subscriptions.each do |subscription|
      begin
        send_notification(subscription, message, options)
        successful_sends += 1
      rescue WebpushError
        failed_sends += 1
      end
    end
    
    { successful: successful_sends, failed: failed_sends }
  end
  
  def self.broadcast_to_all(message, options = {})
    successful_sends = 0
    failed_sends = 0
    
    Subscription.find_each do |subscription|
      begin
        send_notification(subscription, message, options)
        successful_sends += 1
      rescue WebpushError
        failed_sends += 1
      end
    end
    
    { successful: successful_sends, failed: failed_sends }
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.handle_response(response)
    case response
    when Net::HTTPSuccess
      Rails.logger.info "Web push notification sent successfully"
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Web push notification failed: #{response.body}"
      raise WebpushError, "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end
```

### lib/newsletter_subscriber.rb
```ruby
# lib/newsletter_subscriber.rb
require 'mailchimp_api'
require 'dotenv/load'

class NewsletterSubscriber
  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['MAILCHIMP_API_KEY']
    @server_prefix = ENV['MAILCHIMP_SERVER_PREFIX'] || 'us1'
    @audience_id = ENV['MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID']
    
    validate_configuration
    @client = Mailchimp::API.new(@api_key)
  end

  def add_subscriber(email:, first_name: nil, last_name: nil, status: 'subscribed')
    begin
      # Validate email format
      unless valid_email?(email)
        return { success: false, error: "Invalid email format" }
      end

      # Prepare merge fields
      merge_fields = {}
      merge_fields['FNAME'] = first_name if first_name
      merge_fields['LNAME'] = last_name if last_name

      # Add subscriber to Mailchimp
      response = @client.lists.add_list_member(
        @audience_id,
        {
          email_address: email,
          status: status,
          merge_fields: merge_fields
        }
      )

      { success: true, data: response }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListAlreadySubscribedError
      { success: false, error: "Email is already subscribed to the list" }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListDoesNotExistError
      { success: false, error: "Mailchimp audience/list does not exist" }
    rescue Mailchimp::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "Mailchimp API error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  def check_subscription_status(email)
    begin
      response = @client.lists.get_list_member(@audience_id, subscriber_hash(email))
      { subscribed: true, status: response['status'] }
    rescue Mailchimp::ListMemberDoesNotExistError
      { subscribed: false }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: "Error checking subscription: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_configuration
    missing_vars = []
    missing_vars << "MAILCHIMP_API_KEY" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
    missing_vars << "MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID" if @audience_id.nil? || @audience_id.empty?
    
    unless missing_vars.empty?
      raise "Missing required environment variables: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def valid_email?(email)
    email =~ /\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d\-]+(\.[a-z\d\-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i
  end

  def subscriber_hash(email)
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest(email.downcase)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# whatsapp_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class WhatsAppSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v17.0'

  def initialize(phone_number_id, access_token)
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @access_token = access_token
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Надсилання шаблонного повідомлення
  def send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code = 'en', components = [])
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"
    
    payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: to_phone_number,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Додаємо компоненти, якщо вони є
    payload[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надсилання шаблону з параметрами
  def send_template_with_parameters(to_phone_number, template_name, parameters, language_code = 'en')
    components = [
      {
        type: 'body',
        parameters: parameters.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
      }
    ]

    send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code, components)
  end

  # Надсилання шаблону з кнопками
  def send_template_with_buttons(to_phone_number, template_name, buttons, language_code = 'en')
    button_components = buttons.map do |button|
      {
        type: 'button',
        sub_type: 'quick_reply',
        index: button[:index],
        parameters: [
          {
            type: 'payload',
            payload: button[:payload]
          }
        ]
      }
    end

    components = [
      {
        type: 'body',
        parameters: [] # Можна додати параметри тіла, якщо потрібно
      },
      {
        type: 'button',
        buttons: button_components
      }
    ]

    send_template_message(to_phone_number, template_name, language_code, components)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{message_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка WhatsApp API: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

Додати підписника до аудиторії def subscribe_to_audience(audience_id, email, options = {}) begin # Перевірка наявності обов'язкових параметрів raise MailchimpError, "Audience ID is required" if audience_id.nil? || audience_id.empty? raise MailchimpError, "Email is required" if email.nil? || email.empty? # Параметри для підписки subscriber_data = { email_address: email, status: 'subscribed' } # Додаткові поля, якщо вони передані subscriber_data[:merge_fields] = options[:merge_fields] if options[:merge_fields] subscriber_data[:tags] = options[:tags] if options[:tags] subscriber_data[:language] = options[:language] if options[:language] response = @client.lists(audience_id).members.create( body: subscriber_data ) { success: true, data: response.body } rescue Gibbon::MailChimpError => e handle_mailchimp_error(e) rescue StandardError => e { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}" } end end # Оновити інформацію підписника def update_subscriber(audience_id, email, update_data) begin email_hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(email.downcase) response = @client.lists(audience_id).members(email_hash).update( body: update_data ) { success: true, data: response.body } rescue Gibbon::MailChimpError => e handle_mailchimp_error(e) end end private def handle_mailchimp_error(error) case error.status_code when 400 { success: false, error: "Bad request: #{error.detail}" } when 401 { success: false, error: "Unauthorized: Invalid API key" } when 404 { success: false, error: "Resource not found" } when 500..599 { success: false, error: "Mailchimp server error" } else { success: false, error: "Mailchimp error: #{error.detail}" } end end end ``` ### app/controllers/newsletter_controller.rb ```ruby class NewsletterController < ApplicationController before_action :set_mailchimp_service # Strong parameters (для Rails) def newsletter_params params.permit(:email, :first_name, :last_name) end end ``` ### config/routes.rb (додати маршрути) ```ruby Rails.application.routes.draw do post '/newsletter/subscribe', to: 'newsletter#subscribe' get '/newsletter/status', to: 'newsletter#subscription_status' end ``` ### .env.example (шаблон для змінних оточення) ```env MAILCHIMP_API_KEY=your_mailchimp_api_key_here MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID=your_audience_id_here ``` ## Приклад використання у формі ### app/views/newsletter/_form.html.erb ```erb <%= form_with url: newsletter_subscribe_path, local: true do |form| %>
<%= form.label :email, "Email адреса" %> <%= form.email_field :email, required: true %>
<%= form.label :first_name, "Ім'я" %> <%= form.text_field :first_name %>
<%= form.label :last_name, "Прізвище" %> <%= form.text_field :last_name %>
<%= form.submit "Підписатися на розсилку" %> <% end %> ``` ## Встановлення та налаштування 1. Додайте геми до вашого Gemfile та виконайте `bundle install` 2. Створіть обліковий запис Mailchimp та отримайте API ключ 3. Отримайте ID аудиторії (списку) в Mailchimp 4. Додайте змінні оточення до вашого `.env` файлу 5. ## Основна реалізація бота

```ruby
# bot.rb
require 'telegram/bot'
require 'json'

class OrderStatusBot
  def initialize
    @token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
    @orders_file = 'orders.json'
    load_orders
  end

  def run
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.listen do |message|
        handle_message(bot, message)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def load_orders
    @orders = if File.exist?(@orders_file)
                JSON.parse(File.read(@orders_file))
              else
                {}
              end
  end

  def save_orders
    File.write(@orders_file, JSON.pretty_generate(@orders))
  end

  def handle_message(bot, message)
    case message.text
    when '/start'
      send_welcome(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/help'
      send_help(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/my_orders'
      list_user_orders(bot, message.chat.id)
    when /^\/status\s+(\d+)$/
      order_id = $1.to_i
      show_order_status(bot, message.chat.id, order_id)
    when '/add_order'
      request_order_details(bot, message.chat.id)
    else
      handle_order_creation(bot, message)
    end
  end

  def send_welcome(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~TEXT
      👋 Вітаю! Я бот для перевірки статусу замовлень.
      
      Доступні команди:
      /start - Початок роботи
      /help - Допомога
      /my_orders - Мої замовлення
      /status <номер> - Статус конкретного замовлення
      /add_order - Додати нове замовлення

      Просто відправте номер замовлення для перевірки статусу!
    TEXT

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end

  def send_help(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~TEXT
      ℹ️ **Допомога**

      **Команди:**
      • `/my_orders` - переглянути всі ваші замовлення
      • `/status 123` - перевірити статус замовлення №123
      • `/add_order` - додати нове замовлення

      **Статуси замовлень:**
      • 🟢 Обробляється
      • 🟡 В дорозі
      • 🔵 Готово до відправки
      • ✅ Виконано
      • 🔴 Скасовано

      Щоб додати замовлення, використовуйте команду /add_order або просто надішліть опис замовлення.
    TEXT

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text, parse_mode: 'Markdown')
  end

  def list_user_orders(bot, chat_id)
    user_orders = @orders.select { |_, order| order['user_id'] == chat_id.to_s }
    
    if user_orders.empty?
      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "📭 У вас ще немає замовлень.")
      return
    end

    text = "📋 **Ваші замовлення:**\n\n"
    user_orders.each do |order_id, order|
      status_emoji = get_status_emoji(order['status'])
      text += "🆔 ##{order_id}: #{order['description']}\n"
      text += "📊 Статус: #{status_emoji} #{order['status']}\n"
      text += "📅 Дата: #{order['date']}\n\n"
    end

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text, parse_mode: 'Markdown')
  end

  def show_order_status(bot, chat_id, order_id)
    order = @orders[order_id.to_s]
    
    unless order
      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "❌ Замовлення ##{order_id} не знайдено.")
      return
    end

    if order['user_id'] != chat_id.to_s
      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: "❌ Це замовлення не належить вам.")
      return
    end

    status_emoji = get_status_emoji(order['status'])
    
    text = <<~TEXT
      📊 **Статус замовлення ##{order_id}**

      📝 Опис: #{order['description']}
      🏷️ Статус: #{status_emoji} #{order['status']}
      📅 Дата створення: #{order['date']}
      👤 Користувач: #{order['user_name'] || 'Невідомо'}
    TEXT

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text, parse_mode: 'Markdown')
  end

  def request_order_details(bot, chat_id)
    text = "📝 Будь ласка, введіть опис вашого замовлення:"
    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end

  def handle_order_creation(bot, message)
    # Перевіряємо, чи це не команда
    return if message.text.start_with?('/')

    # Створюємо нове замовлення
    create_new_order(bot, message.chat.id, message.text, message.from.first_name)
  end

  def create_new_order(bot, chat_id, description, user_name)
    order_id = Time.now.to_i
    statuses = ['Обробляється', 'В дорозі', 'Готово до відправки', 'Виконано', 'Скасовано']
    
    @orders[order_id.to_s] = {
      'user_id' => chat_id.to_s,
      'user_name' => user_name,
      'description' => description,
      'status' => statuses.sample, # Випадковий статус для прикладу
      'date' => Time.now.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")
    }

    save_orders

    status_emoji = get_status_emoji(@orders[order_id.to_s]['status'])
    
    text = <<~TEXT
      ✅ **Замовлення успішно створено!**

      🆔 Номер замовлення: ##{order_id}
      📝 Опис: #{description}
      📊 Статус: #{status_emoji} #{@orders[order_id.to_s]['status']}
      
      Ви можете перевіряти статус за допомогою команди /status #{order_id}
    TEXT

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text, parse_mode: 'Markdown')
  end

  def get_status_emoji(status)
    case status
    when 'Обробляється' then '🟢'
    when 'В дорозі' then '🟡'
    when 'Готово до відправки' then '🔵'
    when 'Виконано' then '✅'
    when 'Скасовано' then '🔴'
    else '⚪'
    end
  end
end
```

## Email Processor Service

```ruby
# app/services/email_processor.rb
class EmailProcessor
  attr_reader :email, :support_ticket

  def initialize(email_content)
    @email = Mail.new(email_content)
  end

  def process
    return false if spam_email?

    create_support_ticket
    process_attachments if @support_ticket.persisted?
    
    @support_ticket.persisted?
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error processing email: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  private

  def spam_email?
    # Basic spam filtering - extend as needed
    email.subject&.downcase&.include?('spam') || 
    email.from.blank? ||
    email.body.blank?
  end

  def create_support_ticket
    @support_ticket = SupportTicket.new(
      subject: extract_subject,
      body: extract_body,
      email_from: extract_sender
    )

    if @support_ticket.save
      Rails.logger.info "Support ticket created: #{@support_ticket.ticket_number}"
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to create support ticket: #{@support_ticket.errors.full_messages}"
    end
  end

  def extract_subject
    email.subject.presence || "No Subject - #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}"
  end

  def extract_body
    if email.text_part
      email.text_part.body.decoded
    elsif email.html_part
      # Strip HTML tags for plain text
      ActionController::Base.helpers.strip_tags(email.html_part.body.decoded)
    else
      email.body.decoded
    end
  end

  def extract_sender
    email.from&.first || 'unknown@example.com'
  end

  def process_attachments
    return unless email.attachments.any?

    attachments_metadata = []

    email.attachments.each do |attachment|
      next if attachment.inline? # Skip inline attachments

      begin
        # Generate a unique filename
        filename = sanitize_filename(attachment.filename)
        
        # Attach file to Active Storage
        @support_ticket.attachments.attach(
          io: StringIO.new(attachment.body.decoded),
          filename: filename,
          content_type: attachment.content_type
        )

        attachments_metadata << {
          filename: filename,
          content_type: attachment.content_type,
          size: attachment.body.decoded.bytesize
        }

        Rails.logger.info "Attached file: #{filename}"
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to process attachment #{attachment.filename}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end

    # Save attachments metadata
    @support_ticket.update(attachments_metadata: attachments_metadata)
  end

  def sanitize_filename(filename)
    # Remove any path components and sanitize the filename
    File.basename(filename).gsub(/[^0-9A-Za-z.\-]/, '_')
  end
end
```

## Email Receiver Controller

```ruby
# app/controllers/inbound_emails_controller.rb
class InboundEmailsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  def create
    # For services like SendGrid, Mailgun, etc.
    if params[:email].present? || params[:message].present?
      process_email_from_params
    elsif request.raw_post.present?
      process_raw_email
    else
      render json: { error: 'No email content received' }, status: :bad_request
      return
    end

    head :ok
  end

  private

  def process_email_from_params
    email_content = params[:email] || params[:message] || params[:raw_email]
    
    if email_content.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) || email_content.is_a?(Hash)
      email_content = reconstruct_email_from_params
    end

    EmailProcessingJob.perform_later(email_content.to_s)
  end

  def process_raw_email
    EmailProcessingJob.perform_later(request.raw_post)
  end

  def reconstruct_email_from_params
    # Reconstruct email from common webhook formats
    mail = Mail.new do |m|
      m.from params.dig(:from) || params.dig(:sender)
      m.to params.dig(:to)
      m.subject params.dig(:subject)
      m.body params.dig(:text) || params.dig(:body_plain) || params.dig(:stripped_text)
    end

    # Handle attachments from webhook
    if params[:attachments].present?
      params[:attachments].each do |attachment|
        mail.add_file(filename: attachment[:filename], content: attachment[:content])
      end
    end

    mail.to_s
  end
end
```

## Telegram Bot (bot.rb)

```ruby
# bot.rb
require 'telegram/bot'
require 'dotenv'
require_relative 'models/order'
require_relative 'models/user'

Dotenv.load

class OrderBot
  def initialize
    @token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
    raise "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN not found in environment variables" unless @token
  end

  def run
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.listen do |message|
        handle_message(bot, message)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(bot, message)
    case message
    when Telegram::Bot::Types::Message
      handle_text_message(bot, message)
    when Telegram::Bot::Types::CallbackQuery
      handle_callback_query(bot, message)
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error handling message: #{e.message}"
    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: message.chat.id, text: "Sorry, an error occurred. Please try again.")
  end

  def handle_text_message(bot, message)
    user = User.find_or_create(message.from)
    text = message.text.to_s.downcase

    case text
    when '/start'
      send_welcome_message(bot, message.chat.id, user)
    when '/help'
      send_help_message(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/myorders'
      send_user_orders(bot, message.chat.id, user)
    when '/status'
      ask_for_order_number(bot, message.chat.id)
    else
      if text.start_with?('/track ')
        order_number = text.gsub('/track ', '').strip
        send_order_status(bot, message.chat.id, order_number)
      else
        send_unknown_command(bot, message.chat.id)
      end
    end
  end

  def handle_callback_query(bot, callback)
    case callback.data
    when 'my_orders'
      user = User.find_by_telegram_id(callback.from.id)
      send_user_orders(bot, callback.message.chat.id, user)
    when 'check_status'
      ask_for_order_number(bot, callback.message.chat.id)
    end
  end

  def send_welcome_message(bot, chat_id, user)
    text = "👋 Welcome, #{user.first_name}!\n\n" \
           "I'm your Order Status Bot. Here's what I can do:\n\n" \
           "• Check order status\n" \
           "• View your orders\n" \
           "• Get order updates\n\n" \
           "Use the commands below or the buttons to get started!"

    keyboard = [
      [
        Telegram::Bot::Types::InlineKeyboardButton.new(text: '📦 My Orders', callback_data: 'my_orders'),
        Telegram::Bot::Types::InlineKeyboardButton.new(text: '🔍 Check Status', callback_data: 'check_status')
      ]
    ]

    markup = Telegram::Bot::Types::InlineKeyboardMarkup.new(inline_keyboard: keyboard)
    
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: text,
      reply_markup: markup
    )
  end

  def send_help_message(bot, chat_id)
    help_text = "🤖 *Order Bot Help*\n\n" \
                "*Commands:*\n" \
                "`/start` - Start the bot\n" \
                "`/help` - Show this help message\n" \
                "`/myorders` - Show your orders\n" \
                "`/status` - Check order status\n" \
                "`/track ORDER_NUMBER` - Track specific order\n\n" \
                "*Example:*\n" \
                "`/track ORD-12345`"

    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: help_text,
      parse_mode: 'Markdown'
    )
  end

  def send_user_orders(bot, chat_id, user)
    orders = Order.find_by_user(user.id)
    
    if orders.empty?
      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id,
        text: "You don't have any orders yet."
      )
    else
      orders.each do |order|
        bot.api.send_message(
          chat_id: chat_id,
          text: order.to_s
        )
      end
    end
  end

  def ask_for_order_number(bot, chat_id)
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: "Please enter your order number (e.g., ORD-12345):"
    )
  end

  def send_order_status(bot, chat_id, order_number)
    order = Order.find_by_order_number(order_number)
    
    if order
      status_emoji = case order.status
                     when 'pending' then '⏳'
                     when 'processing' then '🔧'
                     when 'shipped' then '🚚'
                     when 'delivered' then '✅'
                     when 'cancelled' then '❌'
                     else '📦'
                     end

      text = "#{status_emoji} *Order Status*\n\n" \
             "#{order.to_s}"

      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id,
        text: text,
        parse_mode: 'Markdown'
      )
    else
      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id,
        text: "Order #{order_number} not found. Please check the order number and try again."
      )
    end
  end

  def send_unknown_command(bot, chat_id)
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: "I don't understand that command. Use /help to see available commands."
    )
  end
end
```

```ruby
# admin.rb
require_relative 'models/order'

class OrderAdmin

    user = User.find_by_telegram_id(user_telegram_id)
    return "User not found" unless user

    existing_order = Order.find_by_order_number(order_number)
    return "Order number already exists" if existing_order

    order = Order.create(
      user_id: user.id,
      order_number: order_number,
      description: description,
      status: 'pending'
    )

    return "Order not found" unless order

    valid_statuses = ['pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled']
    return "Invalid status. Use: #{valid_statuses.join(', ')}" unless valid_statuses.include?(new_status)

    order.update_status(new_status)
    "Order #{order_number} status updated to #{new_status}"
  end

    orders = DB[:orders].all
    orders.map { |o| "##{o[:id]} - #{o[:order_number]} - #{o[:status]}" }.join("\n")
```

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'vonage'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class SMSSender
  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET'],
      signature_secret: ENV['VONAGE_SIGNATURE_SECRET'],
      signature_method: 'md5'
    )
  end

  def send_sms(to, text, from: nil, webhook_url: nil)
    from ||= ENV['VONAGE_PHONE_NUMBER']
    
    response = @client.sms.send(
      from: from,
      to: to,
      text: text,
      callback: webhook_url
    )

    if response.messages.first.status == '0'
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response.messages.first.message_id,
        status: 'sent',
        response: response.messages.first
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: response.messages.first.error_text,
        status: response.messages.first.status
      }
    end
  end

  def check_status(message_id)
    response = @client.sms.search(message_id)
    {
      message_id: response.message_id,
      status: response.status,
      price: response.price,
      network: response.network,
      error_text: response.error_text,
      date_received: response.date_received
    }
  rescue Vonage::Error => e
    { error: e.message }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'vonage'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'
require 'sinatra'
require 'puma'

class VonageSMSSender
  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET']
    )
  end

  def send_sms(to, message, webhook_url)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.send(
        from: ENV['VONAGE_BRAND_NAME'],
        to: to,
        text: message,
        callback: webhook_url
      )

      if response.messages.first.status == '0'
        {
          success: true,
          message_id: response.messages.first.message_id,
          status: 'sent',
          remaining_balance: response.messages.first.remaining_balance
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: response.messages.first.error_text,
          status: response.messages.first.status
        }
      end
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  # Method to check message status (if you have the message_id)
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    # Note: Vonage doesn't have a direct API to check status by message_id
    # Status updates come via webhooks. Store them in your database.
    puts "Use webhooks to track delivery status. Message ID: #{message_id}"
  end
end

# Webhook server to receive delivery receipts
class DeliveryReceiptServer < Sinatra::Base
  set :port, 4567

  # Endpoint to receive delivery receipts
  post '/webhooks/delivery-receipt' do
    content_type :json
    
    # Parse the delivery receipt
    receipt = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    # Log the receipt details
    log_delivery_receipt(receipt)
    
    # Update your database with the delivery status
    update_message_status(receipt)
    
    # Return 200 OK to Vonage
    status 200
    { status: 'ok' }.to_json
  end

  private

  def log_delivery_receipt(receipt)
    puts "=== Delivery Receipt Received ==="
    puts "Message ID: #{receipt['messageId']}"
    puts "To: #{receipt['to']}"
    puts "From: #{receipt['from']}"
    puts "Status: #{receipt['status']}"
    puts "Error Code: #{receipt['err-code']}" if receipt['err-code']
    puts "Error Text: #{receipt['error-text']}" if receipt['error-text']
    puts "Timestamp: #{receipt['message-timestamp']}"
    puts "================================="
  end

  def update_message_status(receipt)
    # Here you would update your database with the delivery status
    # For example:
    # Message.find_by(vonage_message_id: receipt['messageId'])
    #          .update(
    #            status: receipt['status'],
    #            delivered_at: receipt['message-timestamp'],
    #            error_code: receipt['err-code'],
    #            error_text: receipt['error-text']
    #          )
    
    puts "Updating message status in database for message ID: #{receipt['messageId']}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# teams_webhook_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class TeamsWebhookSender
  def initialize(webhook_url)
    @webhook_url = webhook_url
    validate_webhook_url
  end

  # Send a simple text message
  def send_message(title, message, theme_color = '0078D7')
    payload = {
      "@type" => "MessageCard",
      "@context" => "https://schema.org/extensions",
      "themeColor" => theme_color,
      "title" => title,
      "text" => message
    }

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  # Send a more detailed message with sections
  def send_detailed_message(title, message, sections = [], theme_color = '0078D7')
    payload = {
      "@type" => "MessageCard",
      "@context" => "https://schema.org/extensions",
      "themeColor" => theme_color,
      "title" => title,
      "text" => message,
      "sections" => sections
    }

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  # Send a message with potential actions (buttons)
  def send_message_with_actions(title, message, actions = [], theme_color = '0078D7')
    payload = {
      "@type" => "MessageCard",
      "@context" => "https://schema.org/extensions",
      "themeColor" => theme_color,
      "title" => title,
      "text" => message,
      "potentialAction" => actions
    }

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  # Send a custom payload (for advanced use cases)
  def send_custom_payload(payload)
    send_payload(payload)
  end

  private

  def validate_webhook_url
    raise ArgumentError, "Webhook URL cannot be nil or empty" if @webhook_url.nil? || @webhook_url.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Webhook URL must be a valid URL" unless @webhook_url.start_with?('http')
  end

  def send_payload(payload)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      @webhook_url,
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      { success: true, message: "Message sent successfully" }
    when 400
      { success: false, error: "Bad request - invalid payload" }
    when 404
      { success: false, error: "Webhook URL not found" }
    when 500..599
      { success: false, error: "Server error: #{response.code}" }
    else
      { success: false, error: "Unexpected response: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
end
```
