```ruby
# app/controllers/messenger_webhook_controller.rb
class MessengerWebhookController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :verify_webhook
  
  # GET /webhook
  # For Facebook webhook verification
  def verify
    if params['hub.verify_token'] == ENV['FACEBOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN']
      render plain: params['hub.challenge']
    else
      render plain: 'Error, wrong validation token', status: :forbidden
    end
  end

  # POST /webhook
  # Receive messages from Facebook Messenger
  def webhook
    entries = params['entry']
    
    entries.each do |entry|
      messaging_events = entry['messaging']
      
      messaging_events.each do |event|
        sender_id = event['sender']['id']
        
        if event['message']
          handle_message(sender_id, event['message'])
        elsif event['postback']
          handle_postback(sender_id, event['postback'])
        end
      end
    end
    
    render json: { status: 'success' }, status: :ok
  end

  private

  def verify_webhook
    return if request.get?
    
    # Verify the request came from Facebook (optional but recommended)
    # You can implement signature verification here
  end

  def handle_message(sender_id, message)
    if message['text']
      text = message['text'].downcase
      
      # Simple response logic - you can expand this
      case text
      when 'hello', 'hi', 'hey'
        send_text_message(sender_id, "Hello! How can I help you today?")
      when 'help'
        send_text_message(sender_id, "I'm a simple bot. Try saying 'hello' or ask me anything!")
      else
        send_text_message(sender_id, "You said: #{message['text']}")
      end
    elsif message['attachments']
      send_text_message(sender_id, "Thanks for sending me a file/image!")
    end
  end

  def handle_postback(sender_id, postback)
    payload = postback['payload']
    
    case payload
    when 'GET_STARTED'
      send_text_message(sender_id, "Welcome! Thanks for getting started.")
    else
      send_text_message(sender_id, "Postback received: #{payload}")
    end
  end

  def send_text_message(recipient_id, text)
    message_data = {
      recipient: { id: recipient_id },
      message: { text: text }
    }
    
    call_send_api(message_data)
  end

  def call_send_api(message_data)
    page_access_token = ENV['FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    url = "https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/me/messages?access_token=#{page_access_token}"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      url,
      body: message_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    if response.code != 200
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to send message: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

I'll create a Discord bot for deployment notifications with slash commands. Here's the complete implementation:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'discordrb'
gem 'dotenv'
gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
```

## Main Bot Implementation

```ruby
# deployment_bot.rb
require 'discordrb'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

class DeploymentBot
  def initialize
    @bot = Discordrb::Bot.new(
      token: ENV['DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN'],
      client_id: ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID']
    )
    @deployments = []
    setup_commands
  end

  def setup_commands
    # Slash command to deploy to an environment
    @bot.register_application_command(:deploy, 'Deploy to an environment') do |cmd|
      cmd.string('environment', 'Environment to deploy to', required: true, choices: {
        'production' => 'prod',
        'staging' => 'staging',
        'development' => 'dev'
      })
      cmd.string('version', 'Version to deploy (e.g., v1.2.3)', required: false)
      cmd.string('notes', 'Deployment notes', required: false)
    end

    # Slash command to check deployment status
    @bot.register_application_command(:status, 'Check deployment status') do |cmd|
      cmd.string('environment', 'Environment to check', required: false, choices: {
        'production' => 'prod',
        'staging' => 'staging',
        'development' => 'dev'
      })
    end

    # Slash command to rollback a deployment
    @bot.register_application_command(:rollback, 'Rollback deployment') do |cmd|
      cmd.string('environment', 'Environment to rollback', required: true, choices: {
        'production' => 'prod',
        'staging' => 'staging',
        'development' => 'dev'
      })
    end

    # Handle deploy command
    @bot.application_command(:deploy) do |event|
      handle_deploy_command(event)
    end

    # Handle status command
    @bot.application_command(:status) do |event|
      handle_status_command(event)
    end

    # Handle rollback command
    @bot.application_command(:rollback) do |event|
      handle_rollback_command(event)
    end
  end

  def handle_deploy_command(event)
    environment = event.options['environment']
    version = event.options['version'] || 'latest'
    notes = event.options['notes'] || 'No notes provided'

    # Simulate deployment process
    deployment_id = SecureRandom.uuid
    deployment = {
      id: deployment_id,
      environment: environment,
      version: version,
      notes: notes,
      status: 'in_progress',
      deployer: event.user.username,
      timestamp: Time.now
    }
    
    @deployments << deployment

    # Send initial deployment notification
    embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment, 'Deployment Started')
    event.respond(embeds: [embed])

    # Simulate deployment process with updates
    Thread.new do
      sleep(2)
      deployment[:status] = 'building'
      update_deployment_status(deployment, event.channel)

      sleep(3)
      deployment[:status] = 'testing'
      update_deployment_status(deployment, event.channel)

      sleep(2)
      deployment[:status] = 'completed'
      update_deployment_status(deployment, event.channel)
    end

    nil
  end

  def handle_status_command(event)
    environment = event.options['environment']

    if environment
      # Show status for specific environment
      env_deployments = @deployments.select { |d| d[:environment] == environment }
                                .sort_by { |d| d[:timestamp] }
                                .last(5) # Last 5 deployments

      if env_deployments.any?
        embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
          title: "Deployment Status - #{environment.capitalize}",
          color: 0x00ff00,
          timestamp: Time.now
        )

        env_deployments.each do |deploy|
          status_emoji = case deploy[:status]
                        when 'completed' then '✅'
                        when 'in_progress' then '🔄'
                        when 'failed' then '❌'
                        else '⚪'
                        end

          embed.add_field(
            name: "#{status_emoji} #{deploy[:version]}",
            value: "By: #{deploy[:deployer]}\n#{deploy[:timestamp].strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}",
            inline: true
          )
        end

        event.respond(embeds: [embed])
      else
        event.respond(content: "No deployments found for #{environment} environment.")
      end
    else
      # Show overall status
      embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
        title: "Overall Deployment Status",
        color: 0x0099ff,
        timestamp: Time.now
      )

      %w[prod staging dev].each do |env|
        last_deploy = @deployments.select { |d| d[:environment] == env }
                                 .max_by { |d| d[:timestamp] }
        
        status = last_deploy ? last_deploy[:status] : 'unknown'
        version = last_deploy ? last_deploy[:version] : 'N/A'
        
        embed.add_field(
          name: env.capitalize,
          value: "Status: #{status}\nVersion: #{version}",
          inline: true
        )
      end

      event.respond(embeds: [embed])
    end
  end

  def handle_rollback_command(event)
    environment = event.options['environment']
    
    # Find the previous deployment to rollback to
    env_deployments = @deployments.select { |d| d[:environment] == environment }
                               .sort_by { |d| d[:timestamp] }
    
    if env_deployments.size < 2
      event.respond(content: "Cannot rollback - not enough deployments in #{environment} environment.")
      return
    end

    current_deploy = env_deployments.last
    previous_deploy = env_deployments[-2]

    rollback = {
      id: SecureRandom.uuid,
      environment: environment,
      version: previous_deploy[:version],
      notes: "Rollback from #{current_deploy[:version]}",
      status: 'in_progress',
      deployer: event.user.username,
      timestamp: Time.now,
      is_rollback: true
    }

    @deployments << rollback

    embed = create_deployment_embed(rollback, 'Rollback Started')
    event.respond(embeds: [embed])

    # Simulate rollback process
    Thread.new do
      sleep(3)
      rollback[:status] = 'completed'
      update_deployment_status(rollback, event.channel)
    end

    nil
  end

  def create_deployment_embed(deployment, title)
    color = case deployment[:status]
           when 'completed' then 0x00ff00
           when 'in_progress' then 0xffa500
           when 'failed' then 0xff0000
           else 0x0099ff
           end

    Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: title,
      color: color,
      fields: [
        { name: 'Environment', value: deployment[:environment].capitalize, inline: true },
        { name: 'Version', value: deployment[:version], inline: true },
        { name: 'Deployed by', value: deployment[:deployer], inline: true },
        { name: 'Notes', value: deployment[:notes], inline: false }
      ],
      timestamp: deployment[:timestamp],
      footer: { text: "Deployment ID: #{deployment[:id][0..7]}" }
    )
  end

  def update_deployment_status(deployment, channel)
    action = deployment[:is_rollback] ? 'Rollback' : 'Deployment'
    title = "#{action} #{deployment[:status].capitalize.gsub('_', ' ')}"
    
    embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment, title)
    channel.send_message('', false, embed)
  end

  def post_deployment_notification(deployment, channel_id)
    channel = @bot.channel(channel_id)
    return unless channel

    embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment, 'Deployment Notification')
    channel.send_message('', false, embed)
  end

  # Method to manually trigger deployment notifications (for CI/CD integration)
  def notify_deployment(environment, version, notes, channel_id, deployer = 'CI/CD System')
    deployment = {
      id: SecureRandom.uuid,
      environment: environment,
      version: version,
      notes: notes,
      status: 'completed',
      deployer: deployer,
      timestamp: Time.now
    }

    @deployments << deployment
    post_deployment_notification(deployment, channel_id)
  end

  def run
    puts "Deployment bot is running! Invite URL: #{@bot.invite_url}"
    @bot.run
  end
end

# Environment configuration
if ENV['DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN'].nil? || ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID'].nil?
  puts "Please set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and DISCORD_CLIENT_ID environment variables"
  puts "Create a .env file with these values or export them in your shell"
  exit 1
end

# Start the bot
bot = DeploymentBot.new
bot.run
```

```ruby
class SupportTicket < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user, optional: true
  has_many :attachments, as: :attachable, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :replies, dependent: :destroy
  
  enum status: { open: 0, in_progress: 1, resolved: 2, closed: 3 }
  enum priority: { low: 0, medium: 1, high: 2, urgent: 3 }
  
  validates :subject, :description, presence: true
  validates :email, format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP }
  
  after_create :send_confirmation_email
  
  def self.create_from_email(email_data)
    ticket = new(
      email: email_data.from.first,
      subject: email_data.subject,
      description: extract_description(email_data),
      priority: detect_priority(email_data.subject, email_data.body)
    )
    
    if ticket.save
      process_attachments(ticket, email_data.attachments)
      ticket
    else
      nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.extract_description(email_data)
    # Extract plain text from email body
    if email_data.text_part
      email_data.text_part.body.decoded
    else
      email_data.body.decoded
    end
  end
  
  def self.detect_priority(subject, body)
    content = "#{subject} #{body}".downcase
    
    if content.include?('urgent') || content.include?('critical') || content.include?('emergency')
      :urgent
    elsif content.include?('high') || content.include?('important')
      :high
    elsif content.include?('low') || content.include?('minor')
      :low
    else
      :medium
    end
  end
  
  def self.process_attachments(ticket, email_attachments)
    email_attachments.each do |attachment|
      file_data = StringIO.new(attachment.body.decoded)
      file_data.class.class_eval { attr_accessor :original_filename, :content_type }
      file_data.original_filename = attachment.filename
      file_data.content_type = attachment.content_type
      
      ticket.attachments.create(file: file_data)
    end
  end
  
  def send_confirmation_email
    SupportTicketMailer.ticket_created(self).deliver_later
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Attachment < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :attachable, polymorphic: true
  
  has_one_attached :file
  
  validates :file, presence: true
  
  before_save :extract_text_content
  before_save :set_file_info
  
  def text_content
    super.presence || extract_text_from_file
  end
  
  private
  
  def extract_text_content
    self.text_content = extract_text_from_file if file.attached?
  end
  
  def extract_text_from_file
    return unless file.attached?
    
    case file.content_type
    when 'text/plain'
      file.download.force_encoding('UTF-8')
    when 'application/pdf'
      extract_text_from_pdf
    when 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
      extract_text_from_docx
    when 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'
      # Optional: OCR extraction
      # extract_text_from_image
      nil
    else
      nil
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error extracting text from attachment: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end
  
  def extract_text_from_pdf
    pdf = PDF::Reader.new(StringIO.new(file.download))
    pdf.pages.map(&:text).join("\n")
  end
  
  def extract_text_from_docx
    doc = Docx::Document.open(StringIO.new(file.download))
    doc.paragraphs.map(&:text).join("\n")
  end
  
  def set_file_info
    if file.attached?
      self.filename = file.filename.to_s
      self.file_size = file.byte_size
      self.content_type = file.content_type
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class EmailProcessor
  def self.process_unread_emails
    Mail.find(what: :first, count: 10, order: :asc, keys: 'UNSEEN') do |email|
      process_single_email(email)
    end
  end
  
  def self.process_single_email(email)
    # Mark as read
    email.mark_for_delete = false
    
    # Skip auto-replies and bulk emails
    return if auto_reply?(email)
    
    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      ticket = SupportTicket.create_from_email(email)
      
      if ticket.persisted?
        email.mark_for_delete = true if ENV['DELETE_PROCESSED_EMAILS'] == 'true'
        Rails.logger.info "Created support ticket ##{ticket.id} from email"
      else
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to create ticket from email: #{ticket.errors.full_messages}"
        handle_failed_email(email, ticket.errors)
      end
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error processing email: #{e.message}"
    handle_processing_error(email, e)
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.auto_reply?(email)
    email.header['Auto-Submitted']&.value != 'no' ||
    email.header['X-Auto-Response-Suppress'] ||
    email.subject =~ /^(auto:|automatic|out of office)/i
  end
  
  def self.handle_failed_email(email, errors)
    # Send error notification or move to failed folder
    SupportTicketMailer.processing_failed(email.from.first, errors).deliver_later
  end
  
  def self.handle_processing_error(email, error)
    Rails.logger.error "Email processing error: #{error.message}"
    # Implement retry logic or move to error folder
  end
end
```

Here's a complete Ruby solution for sending push notifications to iOS devices via APNs with token-based authentication:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'apnotic'
gem 'jwt'
gem 'net-http2'
```

## Implementation Code

```ruby
# apns_sender.rb
require 'apnotic'
require 'jwt'
require 'json'

class APNSSender
  attr_reader :team_id, :key_id, :private_key, :bundle_id, :environment

  def initialize(team_id:, key_id:, private_key_path:, bundle_id:, environment: :production)
    @team_id = team_id
    @key_id = key_id
    @private_key = File.read(private_key_path)
    @bundle_id = bundle_id
    @environment = environment
  end

  def send_notification(device_token, message, custom_payload = {})
    connection = create_connection
    notification = build_notification(device_token, message, custom_payload)

    response = connection.push(notification)
    connection.close

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def send_notification_async(device_token, message, custom_payload = {}, &callback)
    connection = create_connection
    notification = build_notification(device_token, message, custom_payload)

    push = connection.prepare_push(notification)
    push.on(:response) do |response|
      callback.call(handle_response(response)) if callback
      connection.close
    end

    connection.push_async(push)
  end

  def send_bulk_notifications(device_tokens, message, custom_payload = {})
    connection = create_connection
    responses = []

    device_tokens.each do |device_token|
      notification = build_notification(device_token, message, custom_payload)
      response = connection.push(notification)
      responses << { token: device_token, response: handle_response(response) }
    end

    connection.close
    responses
  end

  private

  def create_connection
    Apnotic::Connection.new(
      auth_method: :token,
      cert_path: nil,
      key_id: key_id,
      team_id: team_id,
      private_key: private_key,
      bundle_id: bundle_id,
      url: apns_url
    )
  end

  def build_notification(device_token, message, custom_payload = {})
    Apnotic::Notification.new(device_token).tap do |notification|
      notification.alert = {
        title: message[:title] || "Notification",
        body: message[:body] || ""
      }
      
      notification.badge = message[:badge] if message[:badge]
      notification.sound = message[:sound] || "default"
      notification.category = message[:category] if message[:category]
      notification.thread_id = message[:thread_id] if message[:thread_id]
      
      # Custom payload data
      notification.custom_payload = custom_payload
      
      # APNs specific headers
      notification.apns_id = message[:apns_id] if message[:apns_id]
      notification.expiration = message[:expiration] if message[:expiration]
      notification.priority = message[:priority] || 10
      notification.topic = message[:topic] || bundle_id
      notification.collapse_id = message[:collapse_id] if message[:collapse_id]
    end
  end

  def apns_url
    environment == :development ? 
      "https://api.development.push.apple.com:443" : 
      "https://api.push.apple.com:443"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.ok?
      { success: true, apns_id: response.headers["apns-id"] }
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        status: response.status,
        apns_id: response.headers["apns-id"],
        error: response.body ? JSON.parse(response.body) : "Unknown error"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Configuration - replace with your actual values
  TEAM_ID = "YOUR_TEAM_ID"  # From Apple Developer Account
  KEY_ID = "YOUR_KEY_ID"    # From APNs Auth Key
  PRIVATE_KEY_PATH = "path/to/AuthKey_#{KEY_ID}.p8"
  BUNDLE_ID = "com.yourcompany.yourapp"
  DEVICE_TOKEN = "YOUR_DEVICE_TOKEN"  # 64-character hex string

  # Initialize the sender
  apns_sender = APNSSender.new(
    team_id: TEAM_ID,
    key_id: KEY_ID,
    private_key_path: PRIVATE_KEY_PATH,
    bundle_id: BUNDLE_ID,
    environment: :development  # Use :production for production
  )

  # Example notification payload
  message = {
    title: "Hello from Ruby!",
    body: "This is a test push notification",
    badge: 1,
    sound: "default"
  }

  custom_payload = {
    custom_data: "Some custom data",
    action: "test_action"
  }

  # Send synchronous notification
  puts "Sending synchronous notification..."
  result = apns_sender.send_notification(DEVICE_TOKEN, message, custom_payload)
  puts "Result: #{result}"

  # Send asynchronous notification
  puts "Sending asynchronous notification..."
  apns_sender.send_notification_async(DEVICE_TOKEN, message, custom_payload) do |result|
    puts "Async result: #{result}"
  end

  # Wait a bit for async to complete
  sleep 2
end
```

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# apns_sender.rb
require 'apnotic'
require 'jwt'

class APNSSender
  def initialize(
    team_id: ENV['APNS_TEAM_ID'],
    key_id: ENV['APNS_KEY_ID'],
    key_file: ENV['APNS_KEY_FILE'],
    environment: ENV['APNS_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'production'
  )
    @team_id = team_id
    @key_id = key_id
    @key_file = key_file
    @environment = environment.to_sym
  end

  def send_notification(device_token, title, body, custom_data = {})
    # Підготовка сповіщення
    notification = build_notification(device_token, title, body, custom_data)
    
    # Відправка через APNs
    response = send_apns_request(notification)
    
    if response&.ok?
      puts "Сповіщення успішно відправлено!"
      true
    else
      handle_error(response)
      false
    end
  end

  private

  def build_notification(device_token, title, body, custom_data)
    Apnotic::Notification.new(device_token).tap do |notification|
      notification.alert = {
        title: title,
        body: body
      }
      
      notification.badge = custom_data[:badge] if custom_data[:badge]
      notification.sound = custom_data[:sound] || "default"
      notification.category = custom_data[:category] if custom_data[:category]
      notification.thread_id = custom_data[:thread_id] if custom_data[:thread_id]
      
      # Додаткові дані
      notification.custom_payload = custom_data[:custom_payload] || {}
      
      # Встановлення пріоритету
      notification.priority = custom_data[:priority] || 10
      
      # Термін дії сповіщення
      notification.expiration = custom_data[:expiration] if custom_data[:expiration]
      
      # Topic (Bundle ID)
      notification.topic = custom_data[:topic] if custom_data[:topic]
    end
  end

  def send_apns_request(notification)
    connection = nil
    
    begin
      # Створення підключення
      connection = Apnotic::Connection.new(
        auth_method: :token,
        cert_path: File.read(@key_file),
        key_id: @key_id,
        team_id: @team_id,
        url: apns_url
      )
      
      # Очікування підключення
      connection.on(:error) { |exception| puts "Помилка з'єднання: #{exception}" }
      
      # Відправка запиту
      push = connection.prepare_push(notification)
      push.on(:response) do |response|
        puts "Отримано відповідь від APNs"
      end
      
      connection.push_async(push)
      response = push.response
      
      response
    ensure
      connection&.close
    end
  end

  def apns_url
    case @environment
    when :development, :sandbox
      'https://api.sandbox.push.apple.com:443'
    else
      'https://api.push.apple.com:443'
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    if response.nil?
      puts "Помилка: Не вдалося отримати відповідь від APNs"
      return
    end

    case response.status
    when '200'
      puts "Сповіщення успішно доставлено"
    when '400'
      puts "Помилка запиту: #{response.body}"
    when '403'
      puts "Помилка автентифікації: перевірте токен та сертифікат"
    when '405'
      puts "Неправильний метод HTTP"
    when '410'
      puts "Device token більше не дійсний"
    when '413'
      puts "Завеликий payload"
    when '429'
      puts "Забагато запитів"
    when '500'
      puts "Внутрішня помилка сервера APNs"
    when '503'
      puts "Сервер APNs тимчасово недоступний"
    else
      puts "Невідома помилка: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# batch_apns_sender.rb
require_relative 'apns_sender'

class BatchAPNSSender < APNSSender
  def send_batch_notifications(notifications_data)
    connection = nil
    results = []
    
    begin
      connection = Apnotic::Connection.new(
        auth_method: :token,
        cert_path: File.read(@key_file),
        key_id: @key_id,
        team_id: @team_id,
        url: apns_url
      )
      
      notifications_data.each do |data|
        notification = build_notification(
          data[:device_token],
          data[:title],
          data[:body],
          data[:custom_data] || {}
        )
        
        push = connection.prepare_push(notification)
        push.on(:response) do |response|
          results << {
            device_token: data[:device_token],
            success: response&.ok?,
            status: response&.status,
            body: response&.body
          }
        end
        
        connection.push_async(push)
      end
      
      # Чекаємо завершення всіх запитів
      connection.join
      
    ensure
      connection&.close
    end
    
    results
  end
end
```

Here's a Ruby solution that checks an IMAP mailbox every 5 minutes and stores new messages:

## Gemfile

```ruby

source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'mail', '~> 2.8.0'

gem 'sqlite3', '~> 1.4'
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# message_reader.rb
require 'mail'
require 'net/imap'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'logger'

class MessageReader
  def initialize(config)
    @config = config
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new(@config[:database_path] || 'messages.db')
    
    # Create messages table if it doesn't exist
    @db.execute <<-SQL
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        message_id TEXT UNIQUE,
        subject TEXT,
        from_address TEXT,
        to_address TEXT,
        date TEXT,
        body TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
    SQL
  end

  def connect_imap
    @imap = Net::IMAP.new(@config[:server], port: @config[:port], ssl: @config[:ssl])
    @imap.login(@config[:username], @config[:password])
    @imap.select(@config[:mailbox] || 'INBOX')
    @logger.info("Connected to IMAP server")
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Failed to connect to IMAP: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  def disconnect_imap
    @imap.logout
    @imap.disconnect
    @logger.info("Disconnected from IMAP server")
  rescue => e
    @logger.warn("Error disconnecting from IMAP: #{e.message}")
  end

  def fetch_new_messages
    connect_imap
    
    # Search for unseen messages
    message_ids = @imap.search(['UNSEEN'])
    @logger.info("Found #{message_ids.size} new messages")
    
    messages = []
    message_ids.each do |msg_id|
      message_data = @imap.fetch(msg_id, ['RFC822', 'FLAGS']).first
      if message_data
        message = process_message(message_data.attr['RFC822'])
        messages << message if message
        mark_as_seen(msg_id)
      end
    end
    
    messages
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error fetching messages: #{e.message}")
    []
  ensure
    disconnect_imap
  end

  def process_message(raw_message)
    mail = Mail.new(raw_message)
    
    {
      message_id: mail.message_id,
      subject: mail.subject,
      from_address: mail.from.join(', '),
      to_address: mail.to.join(', '),
      date: mail.date.to_s,
      body: extract_body(mail)
    }
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error processing message: #{e.message}")
    nil
  end

  def extract_body(mail)
    if mail.multipart?
      # Try to get text/plain part first, fall back to text/html
      text_part = mail.text_part || mail.html_part || mail.parts.find { |p| p.content_type =~ /text\/plain/ }
      text_part ? text_part.body.decoded : mail.body.decoded
    else
      mail.body.decoded
    end
  rescue => e
    @logger.warn("Error extracting body: #{e.message}")
    mail.body.decoded rescue "Unable to extract body"
  end

  def mark_as_seen(message_id)
    @imap.store(message_id, '+FLAGS', [:Seen])
  rescue => e
    @logger.warn("Failed to mark message #{message_id} as seen: #{e.message}")
  end

  def store_messages(messages)
    messages.each do |message|
      begin
        @db.execute(
          "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO messages (message_id, subject, from_address, to_address, date, body) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
          [message[:message_id], message[:subject], message[:from_address], message[:to_address], message[:date], message[:body]]
        )
        @logger.info("Stored message: #{message[:subject]}")
      rescue => e
        @logger.error("Failed to store message #{message[:message_id]}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end
  end

  def run
    @logger.info("Starting message reader service")
    
    loop do
      begin
        messages = fetch_new_messages
        store_messages(messages) unless messages.empty?
      rescue => e
        @logger.error("Error in main loop: #{e.message}")
      end
      
      @logger.info("Waiting 5 minutes before next check...")
      sleep(300) # 5 minutes
    end
  end
end

# Configuration
config = {
  server: 'imap.gmail.com',     # Replace with your IMAP server
  port: 993,
  ssl: true,
  username: 'your-email@gmail.com',  # Replace with your email
  password: 'your-app-password',     # Replace with your password/app password
  mailbox: 'INBOX',
  database_path: 'messages.db'
}

# For Gmail, you'll need an App Password if using 2FA:
# Go to Google Account -> Security -> 2FA -> App Passwords

# Start the service
reader = MessageReader.new(config)
reader.run
```

```ruby
class MessageQuery

  end

    @db.execute(

       ORDER BY created_at DESC",
      ["%#{query}%", "%#{query}%", "%#{query}%"]
```

```ruby
class VoiceCallSender
  def initialize(account_sid, auth_token)
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
  end

  def send_voice_call(to_phone_number, from_phone_number, message, options = {})
    begin
      # Set default options
      options = {
        voice: 'alice',
        language: 'en-US',
        url: nil, # Custom TwiML URL (optional)
        method: 'GET'
      }.merge(options)

      call_params = {
        to: to_phone_number,
        from: from_phone_number
      }

      # If no custom URL is provided, use Twilio's built-in TTS
      if options[:url].nil?
        call_params[:twiml] = generate_twiml(message, options[:voice], options[:language])
      else
        call_params[:url] = options[:url]
        call_params[:method] = options[:method]
      end

      # Make the call
      call = @client.calls.create(call_params)

      puts "Voice call initiated successfully!"
      puts "Call SID: #{call.sid}"
      puts "Status: #{call.status}"
      puts "From: #{call.from}"
      puts "To: #{call.to}"
      
      return call
    rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
      puts "Twilio API Error: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_twiml(message, voice, language)
    <<~TWIML
      <Response>
        <Say voice="#{voice}" language="#{language}">
          #{message}
        </Say>
      </Response>
    TWIML
  end
end
```

## Gemfile

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# imap_reader.rb
require 'net/imap'
require 'mail'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ImapReader
  def initialize
    setup_logger
    load_config
    @processed_uids = load_processed_uids
  end

  def setup_logger
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
      "#{datetime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} #{severity}: #{msg}\n"
    end
  end

  def load_config
    @config = {
      host: ENV['IMAP_HOST'] || 'imap.gmail.com',
      port: ENV['IMAP_PORT'] || 993,
      ssl: ENV['IMAP_SSL'] != 'false',
      username: ENV['IMAP_USERNAME'],
      password: ENV['IMAP_PASSWORD'],
      mailbox: ENV['IMAP_MAILBOX'] || 'INBOX',
      storage_path: ENV['STORAGE_PATH'] || './emails'
    }

    validate_config
  end

  def validate_config
    unless @config[:username] && @config[:password]
      raise "IMAP_USERNAME and IMAP_PASSWORD environment variables are required"
    end
    
    Dir.mkdir(@config[:storage_path]) unless Dir.exist?(@config[:storage_path])
  end

  def load_processed_uids
    file_path = File.join(@config[:storage_path], 'processed_uids.txt')
    return Set.new unless File.exist?(file_path)
    
    Set.new(File.readlines(file_path).map(&:chomp).reject(&:empty?))
  end

  def save_processed_uids
    file_path = File.join(@config[:storage_path], 'processed_uids.txt')
    File.write(file_path, @processed_uids.to_a.join("\n"))
  end

  def connect
    @logger.info("Connecting to #{@config[:host]} as #{@config[:username]}")
    
    @imap = Net::IMAP.new(@config[:host], port: @config[:port], ssl: @config[:ssl])
    @imap.login(@config[:username], @config[:password])
    @imap.select(@config[:mailbox])
    
    @logger.info("Successfully connected to mailbox: #{@config[:mailbox]}")
  end

  def disconnect
    @imap&.logout
    @imap&.disconnect
    @logger.info("Disconnected from IMAP server")
  end

  def fetch_new_emails
    connect
    
    # Пошук нових листів (непрочитаних)
    uids = @imap.uid_search(['UNSEEN'])
    new_uids = uids.reject { |uid| @processed_uids.include?(uid.to_s) }
    
    if new_uids.empty?
      @logger.info("No new emails found")
      return
    end

    @logger.info("Found #{new_uids.size} new emails")
    
    new_uids.each do |uid|
      process_email(uid)
    end
    
    save_processed_uids
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error fetching emails: #{e.message}")
    @logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
  ensure
    disconnect
  end

  def process_email(uid)
    @logger.info("Processing email UID: #{uid}")
    
    # Отримуємо повний лист
    envelope = @imap.uid_fetch(uid, ['ENVELOPE']).first
    body_data = @imap.uid_fetch(uid, ['BODY.PEEK[]']).first
    
    return unless envelope && body_data
    
    # Створюємо об'єкт Mail для зручної обробки
    mail = Mail.new(body_data.attr['BODY[]'])
    
    # Зберігаємо лист у файл
    save_email_to_file(uid, mail)
    
    # Позначаємо як оброблений
    @processed_uids.add(uid.to_s)
    
    @logger.info("Email from #{mail.from&.first} saved successfully")
  end

  def save_email_to_file(uid, mail)
    timestamp = Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    filename = "email_#{timestamp}_#{uid}.eml"
    filepath = File.join(@config[:storage_path], filename)
    
    File.write(filepath, mail.to_s)
    
    # Додатково зберігаємо метадані у JSON
    metadata = {
      uid: uid,
      subject: mail.subject,
      from: mail.from,
      to: mail.to,
      date: mail.date.to_s,
      saved_at: Time.now.iso8601,
      filename: filename
    }
    
    metadata_path = File.join(@config[:storage_path], "metadata_#{timestamp}_#{uid}.json")
    File.write(metadata_path, JSON.pretty_generate(metadata))
  end

  def run
    @logger.info("Starting IMAP reader service")
    
    loop do
      begin
        fetch_new_emails
        @logger.info("Waiting 5 minutes until next check...")
        sleep(300) # 5 хвилин
      rescue Interrupt
        @logger.info("Shutting down...")
        save_processed_uids
        break
      rescue => e
        @logger.error("Unexpected error: #{e.message}")
        @logger.info("Waiting 1 minute before retry...")
        sleep(60)
      end
    end
  end
end

# Додатковий клас для запуску як демона
class ImapDaemon
  def self.start
    reader = ImapReader.new
    
    # Обробка сигналів для коректного завершення
    Signal.trap('INT') { raise Interrupt }
    Signal.trap('TERM') { raise Interrupt }
    
    reader.run
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  ImapDaemon.start
end
```

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for sending SMS messages through the TurboSMS API:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'dotenv'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# turbo_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class TurboSMS
  include HTTParty

  # TurboSMS API base URL
  base_uri 'https://api.turbosms.ua'

  # Default headers for API requests
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(login: nil, password: nil, sender: nil)
    @login = login || ENV['TURBOSMS_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['TURBOSMS_PASSWORD']
    @sender = sender || ENV['TURBOSMS_SENDER'] || 'TurboSMS'
    
    validate_credentials
    authenticate
  end

  # Send SMS to a single Ukrainian number
  # Phone number should be in format: +380XXXXXXXXX
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    validate_message(message)

    response = self.class.post('/message/send.json', {
      headers: auth_headers,
      body: {
        sender: options[:sender] || @sender,
        text: message,
        phones: [format_phone_number(phone_number)]
      }.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send SMS to multiple Ukrainian numbers
  def send_bulk_sms(phone_numbers, message, options = {})
    raise ArgumentError, "Phone numbers must be an array" unless phone_numbers.is_a?(Array)
    raise ArgumentError, "Maximum 400 numbers per request" if phone_numbers.size > 400

    validated_numbers = phone_numbers.map do |phone|
      validate_phone_number(phone)
      format_phone_number(phone)
    end

    response = self.class.post('/message/send.json', {
      headers: auth_headers,
      body: {
        sender: options[:sender] || @sender,
        text: message,
        phones: validated_numbers
      }.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check message status
  def message_status(message_id)
    response = self.class.post('/message/status.json', {
      headers: auth_headers,
      body: { message_id: message_id }.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get account balance
  def balance
    response = self.class.post('/user/balance.json', {
      headers: auth_headers
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    if @login.nil? || @password.nil?
      raise ArgumentError, "Login and password are required. Set TURBOSMS_LOGIN and TURBOSMS_PASSWORD environment variables or pass them as arguments."
    end
  end

  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post('/auth/login.json', {
      body: {
        login: @login,
        password: @password
      }.to_json
    })

    if response.success?
      token = response.parsed_response['response_result']['token']
      self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}"
    else
      raise AuthenticationError, "Failed to authenticate: #{response.parsed_response['response_status']}"
    end
  end

  def auth_headers
    { 'Authorization' => self.class.headers['Authorization'] }
  end

  def validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Ukrainian phone number validation: +380 followed by 9 digits
    unless phone_number.to_s.match?(/^\+380\d{9}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format. Expected: +380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end

  def validate_message(message)
    if message.nil? || message.strip.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Message cannot be empty"
    end

    if message.length > 160
      raise ArgumentError, "Message too long. Maximum 160 characters"
    end
  end

  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Ensure phone number starts with +
    phone_number.to_s.start_with?('+') ? phone_number : "+#{phone_number}"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise APIError, "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
end

# Custom exceptions
class AuthenticationError < StandardError; end
class APIError < StandardError; end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    # Initialize client (credentials can be passed directly or via environment variables)
    client = TurboSMS.new
    
    # Check balance
    balance_info = client.balance
    puts "Account balance: #{balance_info['response_result']['balance']}"
    
    # Send SMS
    result = client.send_sms('+380501234567', 'Hello from TurboSMS!')
    puts "Message sent! Message ID: #{result['response_result']['message_id']}"
    
    # Check message status
    # status = client.message_status(result['response_result']['message_id'])
    # puts "Message status: #{status}"
    
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Key Features

- **Authentication handling** - Automatically manages API tokens
- **Phone number validation** - Ensures Ukrainian number format (+380XXXXXXXXX)
- **Error handling** - Comprehensive error handling with custom exceptions
- **Batch sending** - Support for sending to multiple numbers (up to 400 per request)

I'll create a Ruby solution for sending SMS through the AlphaSMS API with an alphanumeric sender name. Here's the implementation:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'dotenv'
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# alpha_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class AlphaSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.sms.net.bd'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHASMS_API_KEY']
    raise "API key not provided. Set ALPHASMS_API_KEY environment variable or pass it to initialize." unless @api_key
  end

  def send_sms(to, message, sender_id = nil)
    # Validate parameters
    validate_parameters(to, message, sender_id)

    # Prepare the request
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/sendsms"
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    payload = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      msg: message,
      to: to
    }
    
    # Add sender ID if provided (for alphanumeric sender name)
    payload[:sender_id] = sender_id if sender_id

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        endpoint,
        headers: headers,
        body: payload.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )

      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      raise "HTTP Error: #{e.message}"
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise "Unexpected error: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def get_balance
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/user/balance"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{endpoint}?api_key=#{@api_key}",
      timeout: 30
    )

    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if data['error'] == '0'
        data['balance'].to_f
      else
        raise "API Error: #{data['msg']}"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_parameters(to, message, sender_id)
    raise "Phone number cannot be empty" if to.to_s.strip.empty?
    raise "Message cannot be empty" if message.to_s.strip.empty?
    
    # Validate sender ID format (if provided)
    if sender_id
      unless sender_id.match?(/^[a-zA-Z0-9]{3,11}$/)
        raise "Sender ID must be 3-11 alphanumeric characters"
      end
    end
    
    # Basic phone number validation
    unless to.match?(/^\d{10,15}$/)
      raise "Invalid phone number format. Expected 10-15 digits."
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if data['error'] == '0'
        {
          success: true,
          message_id: data['msg_id'],
          message: data['msg'],
          recipient: data['to'],
          credits_used: data['credit_used'].to_i
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error_code: data['error'],
          error_message: data['msg']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error_code: response.code,
        error_message: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage and demonstration
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    # Initialize the SMS client
    sms = AlphaSMS.new
    
    # Check balance first
    balance = sms.get_balance
    puts "Current balance: #{balance} credits"
    
    # Send SMS with alphanumeric sender name
    phone_number = "1234567890"  # Replace with actual phone number
    message = "Hello from AlphaSMS! This is a test message."
    sender_id = "MyCompany"      # Your alphanumeric sender name (3-11 chars)
    
    result = sms.send_sms(phone_number, message, sender_id)
    
    if result[:success]
      puts "SMS sent successfully!"
      puts "Message ID: #{result[:message_id]}"
      puts "Credits used: #{result[:credits_used]}"
    else
      puts "Failed to send SMS: #{result[:error_message]} (Error code: #{result[:error_code]})"
    end
    
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Services

```ruby
# app/services/notification_service.rb
class NotificationService
  def self.send_notification(user, title, message, type: 'info', metadata: {})
    # Create in-app notification
    notification = create_in_app_notification(user, title, message, type, metadata)
    
    # Send email notification if user prefers
    send_email_notification(user, notification) if user.notification_preference.should_send_email?
    
    notification
  end
  
  def self.create_in_app_notification(user, title, message, type, metadata)
    Notification.create!(
      user: user,
      title: title,
      message: message,
      notification_type: type,
      metadata: metadata,
      sent_at: Time.current
    )
  end
  
  def self.send_email_notification(user, notification)
    NotificationMailer.notification_email(user, notification).deliver_later
    notification.update(sent_via_email: true)
  end
  
  def self.send_digest(user, frequency)
    return unless user.notification_preference.email_notifications
    
    notifications = user.notifications
                       .for_digest(frequency)
                       .where('created_at >= ?', digest_timeframe(frequency))
                       .unread
    
    return if notifications.empty?
    
    NotificationMailer.digest_email(user, notifications, frequency).deliver_later
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.digest_timeframe(frequency)
    case frequency
    when 'daily' then 24.hours.ago
    when 'weekly' then 7.days.ago
    else 24.hours.ago
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'discordrb'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

class DeploymentBot
  def initialize
    @bot = Discordrb::Bot.new(
      token: ENV['DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN'],
      client_id: ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID']
    )
    
    setup_commands
    setup_events

  def run
    puts "Бот запускається..."
    @bot.run
  end

  private

  def setup_commands
    # Список усіх slash-команд
    @bot.register_application_command(:deploy, 'Керування розгортаннями') do |cmd|
      cmd.subcommand(:start, 'Запустити нове розгортання') do |sub|
        sub.string(:environment, 'Середовище (production/staging/development)', required: true)
        sub.string(:version, 'Версія для розгортання', required: true)
        sub.string(:description, 'Опис змін', required: false)
      end
      
      cmd.subcommand(:status, 'Перевірити статус розгортання') do |sub|
        sub.string(:deployment_id, 'ID розгортання', required: false)
      end
      
      cmd.subcommand(:list, 'Список останніх розгортань') do |sub|
        sub.integer(:limit, 'Кількість розгортань для показу', required: false, min_value: 1, max_value: 10)
      end
    end

    # Команда для отримання інформації про бота
    @bot.register_application_command(:info, 'Інформація про бота') do |cmd|
      # Без параметрів
    end

    # Команда для налаштувань сповіщень
    @bot.register_application_command(:notifications, 'Керування сповіщеннями') do |cmd|
      cmd.boolean(:enabled, 'Увімкнути/вимкнути сповіщення', required: true)
      cmd.channel(:channel, 'Канал для сповіщень', required: false)
    end
  end

  def setup_events
    setup_command_handlers
    setup_deployment_handlers
  end

  def setup_command_handlers
    # Обробник команди /deploy start
    @bot.application_command(:deploy).subcommand(:start) do |event|
      environment = event.options['environment']
      version = event.options['version']
      description = event.options['description'] || 'Без опису'
      
      deployment_data = create_deployment(environment, version, description, event.user)
      
      embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment_data, '🚀 Розгортання запущено')
      event.respond(embeds: [embed])
      
      # Надіслати сповіщення в загальний канал
      send_deployment_notification(deployment_data)
    end

    # Обробник команди /deploy status
    @bot.application_command(:deploy).subcommand(:status) do |event|
      deployment_id = event.options['deployment_id']
      
      if deployment_id
        status_data = get_deployment_status(deployment_id)
        if status_data
          embed = create_status_embed(status_data)
          event.respond(embeds: [embed])
        else
          event.respond(content: "❌ Розгортання з ID `#{deployment_id}` не знайдено")
        end
      else
        # Показати статус останнього розгортання
        last_deployment = get_last_deployment
        if last_deployment
          embed = create_status_embed(last_deployment)
          event.respond(embeds: [embed])
        else
          event.respond(content: "ℹ️ Розгортань ще не було")
        end
      end
    end

    # Обробник команди /deploy list
    @bot.application_command(:deploy).subcommand(:list) do |event|
      limit = event.options['limit'] || 5
      deployments = get_recent_deployments(limit)
      
      if deployments.any?
        embed = create_deployments_list_embed(deployments)
        event.respond(embeds: [embed])
      else
        event.respond(content: "ℹ️ Розгортань ще не було")
      end
    end

    # Обробник команди /info
    @bot.application_command(:info) do |event|
      embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
        title: "🤖 Deployment Bot",
        description: "Бот для керування розгортаннями та сповіщеннями",
        color: 0x00ff00,
        timestamp: Time.now
      )
      
      embed.add_field(
        name: "Версія",
        value: "1.0.0",
        inline: true
      )
      
      embed.add_field(
        name: "Автор",
        value: "Deployment Team",
        inline: true
      )
      
      embed.add_field(
        name: "Доступні команди",
        value: "`/deploy start`, `/deploy status`, `/deploy list`, `/notifications`",
        inline: false
      )
      
      event.respond(embeds: [embed])
    end

    # Обробник команди /notifications
    @bot.application_command(:notifications) do |event|
      enabled = event.options['enabled']
      channel = event.options['channel']
      
      if update_notification_settings(enabled, channel)
        status = enabled ? 'увімкнено' : 'вимкнено'
        channel_info = channel ? " в каналі <##{channel.id}>" : ""
        event.respond(content: "✅ Сповіщення #{status}#{channel_info}")
      else
        event.respond(content: "❌ Помилка при оновленні налаштувань")
      end
    end
  end

  def setup_deployment_handlers
    # Симуляція подій розгортання (в реальності це можуть бути webhook-и з CI/CD)
    Thread.new do
      loop do
        sleep(300) # Перевіряти кожні 5 хвилин
        
        # Симуляція завершення розгортання
        if rand(10) == 1 # 10% шанс кожні 5 хвилин
          complete_random_deployment
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # Методи для роботи з розгортаннями
  def create_deployment(environment, version, description, user)
    deployment_id = "DEP-#{Time.now.to_i}-#{rand(1000)}"
    
    deployment = {
      id: deployment_id,
      environment: environment,
      version: version,
      description: description,
      status: 'in_progress',
      started_at: Time.now,
      started_by: user.username,
      user_id: user.id
    }
    
    # Зберегти розгортання (в реальності - в базу даних)
    save_deployment(deployment)
    
    deployment
  end

  def get_deployment_status(deployment_id)
    # В реальності - отримати з бази даних або API
    load_deployments.find { |d| d[:id] == deployment_id }
  end

  def get_last_deployment
    deployments = load_deployments
    deployments.max_by { |d| d[:started_at] } if deployments.any?
  end

  def get_recent_deployments(limit = 5)
    deployments = load_deployments
    deployments.sort_by { |d| d[:started_at] }.reverse.first(limit)
  end

  def complete_random_deployment
    deployments = load_deployments.select { |d| d[:status] == 'in_progress' }
    return if deployments.empty?
    
    deployment = deployments.sample
    deployment[:status] = ['success', 'failed'].sample
    deployment[:completed_at] = Time.now
    deployment[:duration] = (Time.now - deployment[:started_at]).to_i
    
    save_deployment(deployment)
    
    # Надіслати сповіщення про завершення
    send_completion_notification(deployment)
  end

  # Методи для сповіщень
  def send_deployment_notification(deployment_data)
    notification_channel_id = ENV['NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID']
    return unless notification_channel_id
    
    channel = @bot.channel(notification_channel_id)
    return unless channel
    
    embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment_data, '🚀 Нове розгортання')
    channel.send_message(embeds: [embed])
  end

  def send_completion_notification(deployment_data)
    notification_channel_id = ENV['NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID']
    return unless notification_channel_id
    
    channel = @bot.channel(notification_channel_id)
    return unless channel
    
    status_emoji = deployment_data[:status] == 'success' ? '✅' : '❌'
    title = "#{status_emoji} Розгортання завершено"
    
    embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment_data, title)
    channel.send_message(embeds: [embed])
  end

  # Допоміжні методи для створення embed-повідомлень
  def create_deployment_embed(deployment_data, title)
    Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: title,
      color: deployment_data[:status] == 'success' ? 0x00ff00 : 
             deployment_data[:status] == 'failed' ? 0xff0000 : 0xffff00,
      timestamp: Time.now,
      fields: [
        { name: "ID", value: "`#{deployment_data[:id]}`", inline: true },
        { name: "Середовище", value: deployment_data[:environment], inline: true },
        { name: "Версія", value: deployment_data[:version], inline: true },
        { name: "Статус", value: format_status(deployment_data[:status]), inline: true },
        { name: "Запущено", value: deployment_data[:started_by], inline: true },
        { name: "Опис", value: deployment_data[:description], inline: false }
      ]
    )
  end

  def create_status_embed(status_data)
    Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "📊 Статус розгортання",
      color: status_data[:status] == 'success' ? 0x00ff00 : 
             status_data[:status] == 'failed' ? 0xff0000 : 0xffff00,
      timestamp: Time.now,
      fields: [
        { name: "ID", value: "`#{status_data[:id]}`", inline: true },
        { name: "Статус", value: format_status(status_data[:status]), inline: true },
        { name: "Тривалість", value: format_duration(status_data[:duration]), inline: true },
        { name: "Запущено", value: "<t:#{status_data[:started_at].to_i}:R>", inline: true },
        { name: "Завершено", value: status_data[:completed_at] ? "<t:#{status_data[:completed_at].to_i}:R>" : "В процесі", inline: true }
      ]
    )
  end

  def create_deployments_list_embed(deployments)
    embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "📋 Останні розгортання",
      color: 0x0099ff,
      timestamp: Time.now
    )
    
    deployments.each do |deployment|
      embed.add_field(
        name: "#{format_status(deployment[:status])} #{deployment[:environment]} - #{deployment[:version]}",
        value: "ID: `#{deployment[:id]}` | <t:#{deployment[:started_at].to_i}:R>",
        inline: false
      )
    end
    
    embed
  end

  def format_status(status)
    case status
    when 'in_progress' then '🟡 В процесі'
    when 'success' then '🟢 Успішно'
    when 'failed' then '🔴 Помилка'
    else status
    end
  end

  def format_duration(duration)
    return 'Невідомо' unless duration
    
    if duration < 60
      "#{duration} сек"
    else
      "#{duration / 60} хв #{duration % 60} сек"
    end
  end

  # Простий спосіб зберігання (в реальності використовуйте базу даних)
  def save_deployment(deployment)
    deployments = load_deployments
    deployments << deployment
    File.write('deployments.json', JSON.pretty_generate(deployments))
  end

  def load_deployments
    return [] unless File.exist?('deployments.json')
    
    JSON.parse(File.read('deployments.json'), symbolize_names: true)
  rescue
    []
  end

  def update_notification_settings(enabled, channel)
    # В реальності зберегти в базу даних
    ENV['NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED'] = enabled.to_s
    ENV['NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID'] = channel.id.to_s if channel
    true
  end
end
```

```ruby
    send_deployment_started(bot, payload)
  when 'deployment_completed'
    send_deployment_completed(bot, payload)
  when 'deployment_failed'
    send_deployment_failed(bot, payload)
  end
  
  status 200
  body 'Webhook received'
end

def send_deployment_started(bot, payload)
  channel_id = ENV['NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID']
  return unless channel_id
  
  embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
    title: "🚀 Розгортання розпочато",
    description: "Розгортання версії #{payload['version']} на #{payload['environment']}",
    color: 0xffff00,
    fields: [
      { name: "Проект", value: payload['project'], inline: true },
      { name: "Вітка", value: payload['branch'], inline: true },
      { name: "Коміт", value: payload['commit'][0..7], inline: true }
    ]
  )
  
  bot.send_message(channel_id, nil, false, embed)
end
```

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class TurboSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.turbosms.ua'.freeze
  
  def initialize(api_token = nil)
    @api_token = api_token || ENV['TURBOSMS_API_TOKEN']
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Перевірка балансу
  def balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/user/balance.json",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Відправка SMS
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    # Форматуємо номер телефону до українського формату
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    payload = {
      recipients: [formatted_phone],
      sms: {
        sender: options[:sender] || ENV['TURBOSMS_SENDER'] || 'TurboSMS',
        text: message
      }
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/message/send.json",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def message_status(message_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/message/status.json",
      query: { message_id: message_id },
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Приводимо номер до формату 380XXXXXXXXX
    phone = phone.to_s.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')
    
    case phone.length
    when 9  # Якщо номер без коду країни (XXX-XXX-XXX)
      "380#{phone}"
    when 10 # Якщо номер з 0 (0XX-XXX-XX-XX)
      "38#{phone}"
    when 12 # Якщо номер з +38 (+38-0XX-XXX-XX-XX)
      phone[1..-1]
    else
      phone
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}",
        body: response.body 
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { 
      success: false, 
      error: "Invalid JSON response",
      body: response.body 
    }
  end
end

# Приклад використання
```

```ruby
# advanced_sms_sender.rb
require_relative 'sms_sender'

class AdvancedSMSSender < TurboSMS
  # Масове відправлення SMS
  def send_bulk_sms(phone_numbers, message, options = {})
    formatted_numbers = phone_numbers.map { |phone| format_phone_number(phone) }
    
    payload = {
      recipients: formatted_numbers,
      sms: {
        sender: options[:sender] || ENV['TURBOSMS_SENDER'] || 'TurboSMS',
        text: message
      }
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/message/send.json",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Відправка SMS з валідацією номера
  def send_validated_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    # Перевірка формату українського номера
    unless valid_ukrainian_phone?(formatted_phone)
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format" 
      }
    end
    
    send_sms(phone_number, message, options)
  end
  
  private
  
  def valid_ukrainian_phone?(phone)
    phone.match?(/^380\d{9}$/)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# voice_call.rb
require 'twilio-ruby'
require 'dotenv/load'

class TwilioVoiceCall
  def initialize(account_sid, auth_token)
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
  end

  def make_call(from_phone, to_phone, message, options = {})
    # URL для TwiML, який буде виконуватися під час дзвінка
    twiml_url = options[:twiml_url] || generate_twiml_url(message, options)
    
    call_params = {
      to: to_phone,
      from: from_phone,
      url: twiml_url
    }

    # Додаткові параметри, якщо потрібно
    call_params[:method] = options[:method] if options[:method]
    call_params[:status_callback] = options[:status_callback] if options[:status_callback]
    call_params[:status_callback_method] = options[:status_callback_method] if options[:status_callback_method]

    begin
      call = @client.calls.create(call_params)
      puts "Дзвінок створено! SID: #{call.sid}"
      puts "Статус: #{call.status}"
      return call
    rescue Twilio::REST::RestError => e
      puts "Помилка при здійсненні дзвінка: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_twiml_url(message, options = {})
    # Створюємо базовий TwiML для синтезу мовлення
    voice = options[:voice] || 'alice'
    language = options[:language] || 'en-US'
    gender = options[:gender] || 'female'
    
    # Якщо ви хочете генерувати TwiML динамічно, ви можете використовувати сервер
    # Або використати статичний TwiML bin від Twilio
    # Тут ми використовуємо простий підхід з Say
    twiml = Twilio::TwiML::VoiceResponse.new do |response|
      response.say(message: message, voice: voice, language: language)
    end
    
    # Повертаємо XML як строку (у реальному застосунку це має бути URL)
    # Для спрощення використовуємо TwiML Bins або власний сервер
    puts "Згенерований TwiML:"
    puts twiml.to_s
    
    # У реальному застосунку, вам потрібно розмістити цей TwiML на публічно доступному URL
    # Натомість ви можете використати TwiML Bins: https://www.twilio.com/console/runtime/twiml-bins
    return options[:custom_twiml_url] if options[:custom_twiml_url]
    
    # Приклад статичного TwiML Bin URL (замініть на свій)
    "https://handler.twilio.com/twiml/YOUR_TWIML_BIN_SID"
  end
end

# Альтернативна реалізація з використанням готового TwiML Bin
class SimpleTwilioCall
  def initialize(account_sid, auth_token)
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
  end

  def make_simple_call(from_phone, to_phone, message)

    twiml_url = "https://handler.twilio.com/twiml/EHXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"

end

  message = "Привіт! Це тестовий дзвінок з синтезом мовлення. Дякую за увагу."
  
  # Створюємо екземпляр та робимо дзвінок
```

## Контролер для вебхука

### app/controllers/webhooks_controller.rb

```ruby
class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  
  def verify
    if params['hub.verify_token'] == ENV['FB_VERIFY_TOKEN']
      render plain: params['hub.challenge']
    else
      render plain: 'Error, wrong validation token', status: :forbidden
    end
  end
  
  def webhook
    body = request.body.read
    
    unless Facebook::Messenger::Bot.verify_signature(body, request.headers['HTTP_X_HUB_SIGNATURE'])
      render plain: 'Error, invalid signature', status: :forbidden
      return
    end
    
    payload = JSON.parse(body)
    
    if payload['object'] == 'page'
      process_page_payload(payload)
      render plain: 'EVENT_RECEIVED', status: :ok
    else
      render plain: 'Not a page event', status: :not_found
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_page_payload(payload)
    payload['entry'].each do |entry|
      entry['messaging'].each do |messaging|
        Facebook::Messenger::Bot.receive(messaging)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Бот для обробки повідомлень

### app/bots/messenger_bot.rb

```ruby
require 'facebook/messenger'

include Facebook::Messenger

Facebook::Messenger::Subscriptions.subscribe(
  access_token: ENV['FB_ACCESS_TOKEN']
)

# Обробка текстових повідомлень
Bot.on :message do |message|
  puts "Received message: #{message.inspect}"
  
  sender_id = message.sender['id']
  text = message.text
  
  # Зберігаємо повідомлення в базу даних
  user = User.find_or_create_by(facebook_id: sender_id)
  Message.create!(
    facebook_id: message.id,
    sender_id: sender_id,
    text: text,
    message_type: :text
  )
  
  # Відправляємо відповідь
  response = process_message(text)
  
  Bot.deliver(
    recipient: { id: sender_id },
    message: { text: response }
  )
end

# Обробка події "message delivered"
Bot.on :delivery do |delivery|
  puts "Message delivered: #{delivery.inspect}"
end

# Обробка події "message read"
Bot.on :read do |read|
  puts "Message read: #{read.inspect}"
end

# Обробка повідомлень з вкладеннями
Bot.on :attachment do |message|
  sender_id = message.sender['id']
  
  # Зберігаємо повідомлення з вкладенням
  user = User.find_or_create_by(facebook_id: sender_id)
  Message.create!(
    facebook_id: message.id,
    sender_id: sender_id,
    text: 'Attachment received',
    message_type: :attachment,
    attachment_url: message.attachments.first['payload']['url']
  )
  
  Bot.deliver(
    recipient: { id: sender_id },
    message: { text: 'Дякую за вкладення! Я поки що працюю тільки з текстом.' }
  )
end

# Обробка постбеків (кнопки, меню)
Bot.on :postback do |postback|
  sender_id = postback.sender['id']
  payload = postback.payload
  
  case payload
  when 'GET_STARTED'
    send_welcome_message(sender_id)
  when 'HELP'
    send_help_message(sender_id)
  else
    handle_custom_postback(sender_id, payload)
  end
end

private

def process_message(text)
  case text.downcase
  when /привіт|hello|hi/
    "Привіт! Я бот для Messenger. Чим можу допомогти?"
  when /допомога|help/
    "Доступні команди:\n- інформація\n- контакти\n- допомога"
  when /інформація|info/
    "Це демонстраційний бот для Facebook Messenger"
  when /контакти|contacts/
    "Наші контакти: example@email.com"
  else
    "Я не розумію запит '#{text}'. Напишіть 'допомога' для списку команд."
  end
end

def send_welcome_message(sender_id)
```

```ruby
class FacebookApiService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://graph.facebook.com/v15.0'
  
  def initialize(access_token = ENV['FB_ACCESS_TOKEN'])
    @access_token = access_token
  end
  
  def send_message(recipient_id, message_text)
    options = {
      body: {
        recipient: { id: recipient_id },
        message: { text: message_text },
        access_token: @access_token
      }.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    }
    
    self.class.post('/me/messages', options)
  end
  
  def get_user_profile(user_id)
    options = {
      query: {
        fields: 'first_name,last_name,profile_pic,locale,timezone,gender',
        access_token: @access_token
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.get("/#{user_id}", options)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
  
  def set_messenger_profile(profile_data)
    options = {
      body: profile_data.merge(access_token: @access_token).to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    }
    
    self.class.post('/me/messenger_profile', options)
  end
end
```

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# alpha_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class AlphaSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.smsfly.ua/'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key: nil, sender: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_SMS_API_KEY']
    @sender = sender || ENV['ALPHA_SMS_SENDER']
    
    validate_credentials
  end

  def send_sms(phone, message)
    validate_phone_number(phone)
    validate_message(message)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}api/",
      body: request_body(phone, message),
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}api/",
      body: balance_request_body,
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_balance_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    raise "API ключ не знайдено. Встановіть ALPHA_SMS_API_KEY в змінні оточення або передайте як аргумент" unless @api_key
    raise "Ім'я відправника не вказано. Встановіть ALPHA_SMS_SENDER в змінні оточення або передайте як аргумент" unless @sender
  end

  def validate_phone_number(phone)
    # Базова валідація номера телефону (український формат)
    unless phone.match?(/^(\+38|38)?(0\d{9})$/)
      raise "Невірний формат номеру телефону. Використовуйте український формат: +380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end

  def validate_message(message)
    raise "Повідомлення не може бути порожнім" if message.to_s.strip.empty?
    raise "Повідомлення занадто довге (макс. 1600 символів)" if message.length > 1600
  end

  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end

  def request_body(phone, message)
    {
      "api_key" => @api_key,
      "method" => "send",
      "data" => {
        "recipient" => format_phone_number(phone),
        "sender" => @sender,
        "message" => message,
        "channel" => "alpha"
      }
    }.to_json
  end

  def balance_request_body
    {
      "api_key" => @api_key,
      "method" => "balance"
    }.to_json
  end

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Приводимо номер до міжнародного формату
    phone.gsub(/^(\+38|38)?(0\d{9})$/, '380\2')
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          message_id: result['data']['message_id'],
          status: 'sent',
          balance: result['data']['balance']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: result['message'] || 'Невідома помилка'
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Помилка мережі: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Не вдалося розпізнати відповідь сервера"
    }
  end

  def handle_balance_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          balance: result['data']['balance'],
          currency: result['data']['currency'] || 'UAH'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: result['message'] || 'Невідома помилка'
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Помилка мережі: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Не вдалося розпізнати відповідь сервера"
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# bulk_sms.rb
require_relative 'alpha_sms'

class BulkSMS
  def initialize(api_key: nil, sender: nil)
    @sms_client = AlphaSMS.new(api_key: api_key, sender: sender)
    @results = []
  end

  def send_bulk(phones, message, delay: 1)
    phones.each_with_index do |phone, index|
      puts "Надсилання SMS на номер #{phone} (#{index + 1}/#{phones.length})"
      
      result = @sms_client.send_sms(phone, message)
      result[:phone] = phone
      @results << result
      
      # Затримка між відправками для уникнення обмежень API
      sleep(delay) if index < phones.length - 1
    end
    
    generate_report
  end

  private

  def generate_report
    successful = @results.count { |r| r[:success] }
    failed = @results.count { |r| !r[:success] }
    
    puts "\n=== ЗВІТ ПРО РОЗСИЛКУ ==="
    puts "Успішно надіслано: #{successful}"
    puts "Не вдалося надіслати: #{failed}"
    
    if failed > 0
      puts "\nПомилки:"
      @results.select { |r| !r[:success] }.each do |result|
        puts "#{result[:phone]}: #{result[:error]}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# kyivstar_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class KyivstarSMS
  # Kyivstar Business Messaging API endpoints
  PRODUCTION_URL = "https://api.kyivstar.ua/business/sms/v1"
  SANDBOX_URL = "https://api-test.kyivstar.ua/business/sms/v1"
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, use_sandbox: false)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['KYIVSTAR_API_KEY']
    @base_url = use_sandbox ? SANDBOX_URL : PRODUCTION_URL
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
    
    validate_credentials
  end
  
  # Send a single SMS
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    validate_message(message)
    
    payload = build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/messages",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Send multiple SMS messages in bulk
  def send_bulk_sms(messages)
    unless messages.is_a?(Array) && messages.all? { |msg| msg.is_a?(Hash) }
      raise ArgumentError, "Messages must be an array of hashes with :phone and :message keys"
    end
    
    messages.each do |msg|
      validate_phone_number(msg[:phone])
      validate_message(msg[:message])
    end
    
    payload = {
      messages: messages.map { |msg| build_message_object(msg[:phone], msg[:message], msg[:options] || {}) }
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}/messages/bulk",
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 60
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check SMS status by message ID
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/messages/#{message_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 15
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}/balance",
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 15
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    raise ArgumentError, "API key is required" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end
  
  def validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Basic Ukrainian phone number validation
    # Kyivstar numbers: +38067, +38068, +38096, +38097, +38098
    cleaned_phone = phone_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    unless cleaned_phone.match?(/^(\+380|380|0)?(67|68|96|97|98)\d{7}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message(message)
    raise ArgumentError, "Message cannot be empty" if message.nil? || message.strip.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Message too long (max 1600 characters)" if message.length > 1600
  end
  
  def build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    {
      phone: normalize_phone_number(phone_number),
      message: message,
      sender: options[:sender] || ENV['KYIVSTAR_SENDER_NAME'],
      callback_url: options[:callback_url],
      validity: options[:validity] || 1440, # 24 hours in minutes
      priority: options[:priority] || 'normal'
    }.compact
  end
  
  def build_message_object(phone_number, message, options)
    build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
  end
  
  def normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
    cleaned = phone_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    if cleaned.start_with?('0')
      "+38#{cleaned}"
    elsif cleaned.start_with?('380')
      "+#{cleaned}"
    else
      cleaned
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 403
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Forbidden: Insufficient permissions"
    when 404
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Not Found: Resource not found"
    when 429
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Rate Limit Exceeded"
    when 500..599
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise KyivstarAPIError, "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```
