# viber_sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ViberSMSSender
  # SMSClub API endpoints
  SMS_CLUB_BASE_URL = 'https://im.smsclub.mobi'
  VIBER_ENDPOINT = '/vibers/send'
  SMS_ENDPOINT = '/sms/send'

  def initialize(api_token, alpha_name = nil)
    @api_token = api_token
    @alpha_name = alpha_name
  end

  # Send message with Viber fallback to SMS
  def send_message(phone_number, message, viber_options = {})
    # First attempt to send via Viber
    viber_response = send_viber(phone_number, message, viber_options)
    
    if viber_successful?(viber_response)
      puts "Viber message sent successfully!"
      return {
        success: true,
        channel: :viber,
        response: viber_response
      }
    else
      puts "Viber failed, falling back to SMS..."
      # Fallback to SMS
      sms_response = send_sms(phone_number, message)
      
      if sms_successful?(sms_response)
        puts "SMS sent successfully!"
        return {
          success: true,
          channel: :sms,
          response: sms_response
        }
      else
        puts "Both Viber and SMS failed"
        return {
          success: false,
          channel: :none,
          viber_response: viber_response,
          sms_response: sms_response
        }
      end
    end
  end

  private

  # Send message via Viber
  def send_viber(phone_number, message, options = {})
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    payload = {
      phone: [phone_number],
      message: message,
      src_addr: @alpha_name
    }.merge(options)

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        "#{SMS_CLUB_BASE_URL}#{VIBER_ENDPOINT}",
        headers: headers,
        body: payload.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      JSON.parse(response.body) if response.body
    rescue => e
      { error: "Viber request failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Send message via SMS
  def send_sms(phone_number, message)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    payload = {
      phone: [phone_number],
      message: message,
      src_addr: @alpha_name
    }

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        "#{SMS_CLUB_BASE_URL}#{SMS_ENDPOINT}",
        headers: headers,
        body: payload.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      JSON.parse(response.body) if response.body
    rescue => e
      { error: "SMS request failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Check if Viber message was successful
  def viber_successful?(response)
    return false if response.nil? || response.is_a?(Hash) && response[:error]
    
    # SMSClub Viber API typically returns success in the response structure
    response.is_a?(Hash) && 
      (response['success'] == true || 
       response['id'].is_a?(Array) && !response['id'].empty?)
  end

  # Check if SMS message was successful
  def sms_successful?(response)
    return false if response.nil? || response.is_a?(Hash) && response[:error]
    
    # SMSClub SMS API success indicators
    response.is_a?(Hash) && 
      (response['success'] == true || 
       response['id'].is_a?(Array) && !response['id'].empty?)
  end
end

  def self.send_with_fallback(phone_number, message, viber_options = {})
    # Load credentials from environment variables
    api_token = ENV['SMSCLUB_API_TOKEN']
    alpha_name = ENV['SMSCLUB_ALPHA_NAME']
    
    unless api_token
      raise "Please set SMSCLUB_API_TOKEN environment variable"
    end
    
    sender = ViberSMSSender.new(api_token, alpha_name)
    sender.send_message(phone_number, message, viber_options)
  end
  
  # Send to multiple recipients
  def self.send_batch(recipients, message, viber_options = {})
    api_token = ENV['SMSCLUB_API_TOKEN']
    alpha_name = ENV['SMSCLUB_ALPHA_NAME']
    
    results = {}
    sender = ViberSMSSender.new(api_token, alpha_name)
    
    recipients.each do |phone_number|
      results[phone_number] = sender.send_message(phone_number, message, viber_options)
    end
    
    results
  end

  def initialize(api_key, base_url = 'https://api.infobip.com')
    configuration = InfobipApi::Configuration.new do |config|
      config.api_key_prefix['APIKeyHeader'] = 'App'
      config.api_key['APIKeyHeader'] = api_key
      config.host = base_url.gsub('https://', '')
      config.scheme = 'https'
    end
    
    @api_instance = InfobipApi::ViberApi.new(configuration)
  end

  def send_message(phone_number, message_text, from = nil)
    # Ukrainian phone number format: +380XXXXXXXXX
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    # Viber message content
    content = InfobipApi::ViberTextContent.new(
      text: message_text
    )
    
    # Create Viber message
    viber_message = InfobipApi::ViberMessage.new(
      from: from || 'ViberDemo', # Sender ID (must be approved by Infobip)
      to: formatted_phone,
      content: content
    )
    
    # Create send request
    request = InfobipApi::ViberBulkMessage.new(
      messages: [viber_message]
    )
    
    begin
      response = @api_instance.send_viber_message(request)
      puts "✅ Message sent successfully!"
      puts "Message ID: #{response.messages.first.message_id}"
      puts "Status: #{response.messages.first.status.name}"
      response
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      puts "❌ Error sending message: #{e.message}"
      puts "Response body: #{e.response_body}" if e.response_body

    end
  end

    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    # Create button

      text: button_text,
      url: button_url
    )
    
    # Create Viber text content with button
    content = InfobipApi::ViberTextContent.new(
      text: text,
      button: button
    )
    
    # Create Viber message
    viber_message = InfobipApi::ViberMessage.new(
      from: from || 'ViberDemo',
      to: formatted_phone,
      content: content
    )
    
    # Create send request
    request = InfobipApi::ViberBulkMessage.new(
      messages: [viber_message]
    )
    
    begin
      response = @api_instance.send_viber_message(request)
      puts "✅ Rich message sent successfully!"
      puts "Message ID: #{response.messages.first.message_id}"
      response
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      puts "❌ Error sending rich message: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Ensure Ukrainian phone number is in international format
    phone = phone_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      "+38#{phone}"
    elsif phone.start_with?('380')
      "+#{phone}"
    elsif phone.start_with?('+380')
      phone
    else
      # Assume it's already in correct format
      phone
    end
  end

require 'httparty'

class VodaUAMessaging
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.vodafone.ua'.freeze
  
  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, sender_name)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @sender_name = sender_name
    @access_token = nil
  end
  
  # Авторизація та отримання токена
  def authenticate
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/oauth2/token",
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      true
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
  
  # Відправка SMS

    authenticate unless @access_token
    
    payload = {
      msisdn: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      sender: @sender_name,
      text: message,
      messageType: 'SMS'
    }.merge(options)
    
    send_message(payload)
  end

    authenticate unless @access_token
    
    payload = {
      msisdn: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      sender: @sender_name,
      text: message,
      messageType: 'VIBER'
    }.merge(options)
    
    send_message(payload)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    authenticate unless @access_token
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/messaging/v1/messages/#{message_id}",
      headers: headers
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "Failed to get message status: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def send_message(payload)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/messaging/v1/messages",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "Failed to send message: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
  
  def headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

    # Форматування номера у відповідному форматі (380XXXXXXXXX)
    phone.gsub(/\D/, '').gsub(/^0/, '380').gsub(/^80/, '380')

# vodafone_ukraine_messaging.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class VodafoneUkraineMessaging
  BASE_URL = 'https://im.sky-future.com.ua/api/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}"
    }
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, sender_name = nil, options = {})
    payload = {
      phone: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      text: message,
      channel: 'sms'
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters
    payload[:sender] = sender_name if sender_name
    payload.merge!(options)
    
    make_request('/send', payload)
  end
  
  # Send Viber message
  def send_viber(phone_number, message, sender_name = nil, options = {})
    payload = {
      phone: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      text: message,
      channel: 'viber'
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters
    payload[:sender] = sender_name if sender_name
    payload.merge!(options)
    
    make_request('/send', payload)
  end
  
  # Send both SMS and Viber (fallback)
  def send_dual_channel(phone_number, message, sender_name = nil, options = {})
    payload = {
      phone: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      text: message,
      channel: 'viber,sms'  # Viber first, SMS as fallback
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters
    payload[:sender] = sender_name if sender_name
    payload.merge!(options)
    
    make_request('/send', payload)
  end
  
  # Check message status
  def message_status(message_id)
    make_request("/status/#{message_id}")
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def balance
    make_request('/balance')
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Ensure phone number is in international format (380XXXXXXXXX)
    phone.to_s.gsub(/\D/, '').sub(/^0/, '380').sub(/^80/, '380')
  end
  
  def make_request(endpoint, payload = nil)
    url = BASE_URL + endpoint
    
    begin
      if payload
        response = HTTParty.post(
          url,
          headers: @headers,
          body: payload.to_json,
          timeout: 30
        )
      else
        response = HTTParty.get(
          url,
          headers: @headers,
          timeout: 30
        )
      end
      
      parse_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}",
        status_code: response.code
      }
    end
  end
end

# otp_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'dotenv/load'

class LifecellOTPSender
  # Lifecell SMS API endpoints
  LIFECELL_API_URL = 'https://api.lifecell.com.ua/rest/sms/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key, sender_name = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @sender_name = sender_name || 'OTP'
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}"
    }
  end
  
  # Generate a random OTP code
  def generate_otp(length = 6)
    SecureRandom.random_number(10**length).to_s.rjust(length, '0')
  end
  
  # Send OTP via SMS
  def send_otp(phone_number, otp_code = nil, message_template = nil)
    otp_code ||= generate_otp
    message_template ||= "Your verification code is: #{otp_code}. Valid for 10 minutes."
    
    # Clean phone number (remove spaces, dashes, etc.)
    cleaned_phone = phone_number.gsub(/[\s\-\(\)]/, '')
    
    # Ensure phone number has country code
    unless cleaned_phone.start_with?('+')
      cleaned_phone = "+380#{cleaned_phone}" if cleaned_phone.start_with?('0')
      cleaned_phone = "+#{cleaned_phone}" unless cleaned_phone.start_with?('+')
    end
    
    payload = {
      phone: cleaned_phone,
      message: message_template,
      sender: @sender_name
    }
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        "#{LIFECELL_API_URL}/messages",
        headers: @headers,
        body: payload.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      handle_response(response, otp_code)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}", otp: otp_code }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}", otp: otp_code }
    end
  end
  
  # Check SMS delivery status
  def check_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(
        "#{LIFECELL_API_URL}/messages/#{message_id}",
        headers: @headers,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      if response.success?
        { success: true, status: response.parsed_response['status'] }
      else
        { success: false, error: "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}" }
      end
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response, otp_code)
    if response.success?
      response_data = response.parsed_response
      {
        success: true,
        otp: otp_code,
        message_id: response_data['id'],
        status: response_data['status'],
        recipient: response_data['phone']
      }
    else
      error_message = case response.code
                     when 401 then 'Invalid API key'
                     when 400 then 'Bad request - check phone number format'
                     when 403 then 'Insufficient credits or permissions'
                     when 429 then 'Rate limit exceeded'
                     else "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
                     end
      
      { success: false, error: error_message, otp: otp_code }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage and helper class
class OTPManager
  def initialize(api_key, sender_name = 'OTP')
    @sms_sender = LifecellOTPSender.new(api_key, sender_name)
    @otp_storage = {} # In production, use Redis or database
  end
  
  # Send OTP and store it for verification
  def send_otp(phone_number, expires_in = 600) # 10 minutes default
    otp = @sms_sender.generate_otp
    
    result = @sms_sender.send_otp(phone_number, otp)
    
    if result[:success]
      # Store OTP with expiration time
      @otp_storage[phone_number] = {
        code: otp,
        expires_at: Time.now + expires_in,
        sent_at: Time.now
      }
    end
    
    result
  end
  
  # Verify OTP code
  def verify_otp(phone_number, code)
    stored_data = @otp_storage[phone_number]
    
    return { success: false, error: 'OTP not found or expired' } unless stored_data
    
    if Time.now > stored_data[:expires_at]
      @otp_storage.delete(phone_number)
      return { success: false, error: 'OTP expired' }
    end
    
    if stored_data[:code] == code
      @otp_storage.delete(phone_number)
      { success: true, message: 'OTP verified successfully' }
    else
      { success: false, error: 'Invalid OTP code' }
    end
  end
  
  # Clean expired OTPs
  def cleanup_expired_otps
    current_time = Time.now
    @otp_storage.delete_if { |_, data| current_time > data[:expires_at] }
  end
end

require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class ViberSMSSender
  # Константи для URL API
  VIBER_API_URL = 'https://api.viber.com/send_message'
  SMSCLUB_API_URL = 'https://gate.smsclub.mobi/http/'

  def initialize
    @viber_api_key = ENV['VIBER_API_KEY']
    @smsclub_username = ENV['SMSCLUB_USERNAME']
    @smsclub_password = ENV['SMSCLUB_PASSWORD']
    @viber_sender_name = ENV['VIBER_SENDER_NAME']
  end

  # Основна функція для надсилання повідомлення
  def send_message(phone_number, message, viber_options = {})
    puts "Спроба надіслати Viber повідомлення на номер: #{phone_number}"
    
    # Спочатку намагаємося надіслати через Viber
    viber_success = send_viber_message(phone_number, message, viber_options)
    
    if viber_success
      puts "Viber повідомлення успішно надіслано"
      return true
    else
      puts "Viber доставка не вдалася, спроба надіслати SMS"
      # Якщо Viber не вдалося, надсилаємо SMS
      sms_success = send_sms_message(phone_number, message)
      
      if sms_success
        puts "SMS повідомлення успішно надіслано"
        return true
      else
        puts "І Viber, і SMS доставка не вдалися"
        return false
      end
    end
  end

  private

  # Надсилання повідомлення через Viber API
  def send_viber_message(phone_number, message, options = {})
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Viber-Auth-Token' => @viber_api_key
    }

    payload = {
      receiver: phone_number,
      type: 'text',
      text: message,
      sender: {
        name: options[:sender_name] || @viber_sender_name
      }
    }

    # Додаткові опції Viber
    payload[:min_api_version] = options[:min_api_version] if options[:min_api_version]
    payload[:tracking_data] = options[:tracking_data] if options[:tracking_data]

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        VIBER_API_URL,
        headers: headers,
        body: payload.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )

      if response.success?
        result = JSON.parse(response.body)
        result['status'] == 0 # статус 0 означає успіх у Viber API
      else
        false
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при надсиланні Viber повідомлення: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end

  # Надсилання повідомлення через SMSClub API
  def send_sms_message(phone_number, message)
    params = {
      username: @smsclub_username,
      password: @smsclub_password,
      from: 'Info', # Відправник SMS (можна змінити)
      to: phone_number,
      text: message
    }

    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(
        SMSCLUB_API_URL,
        query: params,
        timeout: 30
      )

      if response.success?
        # SMSClub API повертає ID повідомлення при успіху
        !response.body.include?('ERROR')
      else
        false
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при надсиланні SMS: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
end

```ruby
require 'infobip-api-ruby-client'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class ViberSender
  def initialize
    configuration = InfobipApi::Configuration.new do |config|
      config.api_key['APIKeyHeader'] = ENV['INFOBIP_API_KEY']
      config.host = ENV['INFOBIP_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.infobip.com'
    end

    @api_instance = InfobipApi::ViberApi.new(configuration)
  end

  def send_message(to_phone_number, message_text, from_name = 'MyApp')
    begin
      # Форматуємо номер телефону у міжнародному форматі для України
      formatted_phone = format_phone_number(to_phone_number)
      
      # Створюємо об'єкт повідомлення
      viber_message = InfobipApi::ViberTextMessage.new(
        from: from_name,
        to: formatted_phone,
        text: message_text
      )

      # Відправляємо повідомлення
      result = @api_instance.send_viber_message(viber_message)
      
      puts "Повідомлення успішно відправлено!"
      puts "Message ID: #{result.messages.first.message_id}"
      puts "Status: #{result.messages.first.status.name}"
      
      return result
      
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      puts "Помилка при відправці повідомлення: #{e.message}"
      puts "Деталі: #{e.response_body}" if e.response_body
      return nil
    end
  end

  def send_rich_message(to_phone_number, message_data, from_name = 'MyApp')
    begin
      formatted_phone = format_phone_number(to_phone_number)
      
      # Створюємо багате повідомлення з кнопками
      viber_message = InfobipApi::ViberMessage.new(
        from: from_name,
        to: formatted_phone,
        text: message_data[:text],
        button_text: message_data[:button_text] || 'Детальніше',
        button_url: message_data[:button_url]
      )

      result = @api_instance.send_viber_message(viber_message)
      
      puts "Багате повідомлення успішно відправлено!"
      puts "Message ID: #{result.messages.first.message_id}"
      
      return result
      
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      puts "Помилка при відправці багатого повідомлення: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def get_message_status(message_id)
    begin
      result = @api_instance.get_viber_message_delivery_reports(message_id: message_id)
      return result.results.first
    rescue InfobipApi::ApiError => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні статусу: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  private

  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Приводимо номер до міжнародного формату
    phone = phone_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    # Якщо номер починається з 0, замінюємо на +38
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      phone = '+38' + phone[1..-1]
    # Якщо номер починається з 380, додаємо +
    elsif phone.start_with?('380')
      phone = '+' + phone
    # Якщо номер починається з 80, замінюємо на +38
    elsif phone.start_with?('80')
      phone = '+3' + phone
    end
    
    phone
  end
end
```

### 2. Клас KyivstarSMS

```ruby
# kyivstar_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'base64'

Dotenv.load

class KyivstarSMS
  BASE_URL = ENV['KYIVSTAR_API_URL'] || 'https://api.it-solutions.kyivstar.ua:8443'
  
  def initialize
    @login = ENV['KYIVSTAR_LOGIN']
    @password = ENV['KYIVSTAR_PASSWORD']
    @sender_name = ENV['KYIVSTAR_SENDER_NAME']
    @auth_header = Base64.strict_encode64("#{@login}:#{@password}")
  end
  
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    validate_credentials
    
    # Форматування номера телефону
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    # Параметри запиту
    params = {
      destination: formatted_phone,
      message: message,
      sender: options[:sender] || @sender_name,
      validity: options[:validity] || 60, # хвилини
      priority: options[:priority] || 'NORMAL'
    }
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Basic #{@auth_header}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/messages/sms"
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        endpoint,
        headers: headers,
        body: params.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  def send_bulk_sms(phone_numbers, message, options = {})
    validate_credentials
    
    results = []
    phone_numbers.each do |phone|
      result = send_sms(phone, message, options)
      results << result.merge(phone: phone)
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  def get_balance
    validate_credentials
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Basic #{@auth_header}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/balance"
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(endpoint, headers: headers, timeout: 15)
      
      if response.success?
        { success: true, balance: response.parsed_response }
      else
        { success: false, error: "HTTP #{response.code}: #{response.body}" }
      end
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    unless @login && @password && @sender_name
      raise "Missing credentials. Please check your .env file"
    end
  end
  
  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Видаляємо всі нецифрові символи
    cleaned_phone = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Якщо номер починається з 0, замінюємо на +38
    if cleaned_phone.start_with?('0')
      "+38#{cleaned_phone}"
    # Якщо номер починається з 380, додаємо +
    elsif cleaned_phone.start_with?('380')
      "+#{cleaned_phone}"
    # Якщо номер починається з 80, замінюємо на +38
    elsif cleaned_phone.start_with?('80')
      "+3#{cleaned_phone}"
    else
      "+#{cleaned_phone}"
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response_data = response.parsed_response
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response_data['messageId'],
        status: response_data['status'],
        details: response_data
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP #{response.code}",
        details: response.body
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Додатковий утилітний клас для валідації

```ruby
# sms_validator.rb
class SMSValidator
  UKRAINIAN_OPERATORS_PREFIXES = ['39', '50', '63', '66', '67', '68', '73', '89', '91', '92', '93', '94', '95', '96', '97', '98', '99']
  
  def self.valid_ukrainian_phone?(phone)
    cleaned = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Перевірка формату українських номерів
    return false unless cleaned.length.between?(10, 12)
    
    if cleaned.length == 10
      # Формат: 0501234567
      prefix = cleaned[0..1]
      UKRAINIAN_OPERATORS_PREFIXES.include?(prefix)
    elsif cleaned.length == 11
      # Формат: 380501234567
      cleaned.start_with?('380') && UKRAINIAN_OPERATORS_PREFIXES.include?(cleaned[3..4])
    elsif cleaned.length == 12
      # Формат: 380501234567
      cleaned.start_with?('380') && UKRAINIAN_OPERATORS_PREFIXES.include?(cleaned[3..4])
    else
      false
    end
  end
  
  def self.validate_message_length(message)
    # SMS зазвичай обмежені 160 символами для латиниці або 70 для кирилиці
    if message.match?(/[а-яіїєґА-ЯІЇЄҐ]/)
      # Кирилиця
      max_length = 70
      encoding = 'Cyrillic'
    else
      # Латиниця
      max_length = 160
      encoding = 'Latin'
    end
    
    {
      length: message.length,
      max_length: max_length,
      encoding: encoding,
      valid: message.length <= max_length,
      parts: (message.length.to_f / max_length).ceil
    }
  end
end

    # Обробник події підписки
    @bot.on_subscribed do |event|

  end
  
  def send_welcome_message(user_id)
    welcome_text = "👋 Вітаємо в нашому боті замовлень!\n\n" \

    }

  def show_cart(user_id)
    @orders[user_id] ||= []

      @bot.send_message(user_id, "🛒 Ваш кошик порожній")
      show_menu(user_id)

    cart_text = "🛒 Ваш кошик:\n\n"

      @bot.send_message(user_id, "❌ Кошик порожній. Спочатку додайте товари.")
      show_menu(user_id)
      return
    end
    
    total = @orders[user_id].sum { |item| item[:price] }
    
    checkout_text = "✅ Замовлення прийнято!\n\n" \
                   "Деталі замовлення:\n"
    
    @orders[user_id].each_with_index do |item, index|
      checkout_text += "#{index + 1}. #{item[:name]} - #{item[:price]} грн\n"
    end
    
    checkout_text += "\n💰 Загальна сума: #{total} грn\n\n" \
                    "📞 Ми зв'яжемося з вами для підтвердження!"
    
    # Очищаємо кошик після оформлення
    @orders[user_id] = []
    
    keyboard = {
      Type: 'keyboard',
      DefaultHeight: true,
      Buttons: [
        { ActionType: 'reply', ActionBody: 'меню', Text: '📋 Нове замовлення', TextSize: 'medium' }

  def cancel_order(user_id)
    @orders[user_id] = []
    @bot.send_message(user_id, "❌ Замовлення скасовано. Кошик очищено.")
    send_welcome_message(user_id)
  end
  
  def handle_custom_message(user_id, text)
    @bot.send_message(user_id, "Не розумію ваш запит. Використовуйте кнопки меню.")
    send_welcome_message(user_id)
  end
  
  def webhook_endpoint
    @bot.raw_webhook do |request|
      content_type :json
      request.body.rewind
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      
      # Обробка подій Viber
      case data['event']
      when 'webhook'
        { status: 'ok' }.to_json
      when 'conversation_started'
        user_id = data['user']['id']
        send_welcome_message(user_id)
        { status: 'ok' }.to_json
      else
        @bot.handle_request(data)
        { status: 'ok' }.to_json
      end
    end
  end
end

@access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token'] puts "Authentication successful" else raise "Authentication failed: #{response.parsed_response}" end end # Get list of email campaigns def list_campaigns(limit = 10, offset = 0) make_authenticated_request(:get, "/campaigns?limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}") end # Get list of email addresses def list_address_books(limit = 10, offset = 0) make_authenticated_request(:get, "/addressbooks?limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}") end # Create a new email campaign def create_campaign(campaign_data) required_fields = [:sender_name, :sender_email, :subject, :body, :address_book_id] missing_fields = required_fields - campaign_data.keys unless missing_fields.empty? raise "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" end make_authenticated_request(:post, "/campaigns", campaign_data) end # Send a newsletter campaign def send_newsletter(options = {}) campaign_data = { sender_name: options[:sender_name], sender_email: options[:sender_email], subject: options[:subject], body: options[:body], address_book_id: options[:address_book_id], name: options[:name] || "Newsletter #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}", type: options[:type] || 'massmail' } # Add optional fields if provided campaign_data[:attachments] = options[:attachments] if options[:attachments] campaign_data[:send_date] = options[:send_date] if options[:send_date] response = create_campaign(campaign_data) if response && response['id'] puts "Newsletter campaign created successfully! Campaign ID: #{response['id']}" # Send the campaign immediately if no send_date was specified if !options[:send_date] && options[:send_now] != false send_campaign(response['id']) end end response end # Send an existing campaign def send_campaign(campaign_id) make_authenticated_request(:post, "/campaigns/#{campaign_id}/send") end # Get campaign statistics def campaign_statistics(campaign_id) make_authenticated_request(:get, "/campaigns/#{campaign_id}") end # Add email to address book def add_email_to_address_book(address_book_id, email, variables = {}) emails_data = [ { email: email, variables: variables } ] make_authenticated_request(:post, "/addressbooks/#{address_book_id}/emails", emails: emails_data) end private def make_authenticated_request(method, endpoint, body = nil) headers = { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}", 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } url = "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}" case method when :get response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers) when :post response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json) when :put response = HTTParty.put(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json) when :delete response = HTTParty.delete(url, headers: headers) else raise "Unsupported HTTP method: #{method}" end if response.success? response.parsed_response else puts "Request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}" nil end end end # Example usage if __FILE__ == $0 # Create .env file with your credentials first: # SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id # SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret begin newsletter = SendPulseNewsletter.new # Example 1: List available address books puts "Available address books:" address_books = newsletter.list_address_books puts JSON.pretty_generate(address_books) # Example 2: Send a newsletter newsletter_data = { sender_name: "Your Company", sender_email: "newsletter@yourcompany.com", subject: "Weekly Newsletter", body: "

Welcome to our newsletter!

", address_book_id: 12345, # Replace with your actual address book ID name: "Weekly Newsletter", send_now: true } # Uncomment to send a newsletter # result = newsletter.send_newsletter(newsletter_data) # puts "Newsletter sent: #{result}" # Example 3: Add email to address book # newsletter.add_email_to_address_book(12345, "user@example.com", {name: "John Doe"}) rescue => e puts "Error: #{e.message}" puts "Make sure you have set SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID and SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET in your .env file" end end ``` ## Environment Variables File Create a `.env` file in the same directory: ```bash # .env SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID=your_sendpulse_client_id_here SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_sendpulse_client_secret_here ``` ## Installation and Usage 1. **Install dependencies:** ```bash bundle install ``` 2. **Set up environment variables:** - Copy the `.env` example above - Replace with your actual SendPulse credentials from your SendPulse account 3. **Run the script:** ```bash ruby sendpulse_newsletter.rb ``` ## Key Features - **Authentication**: Automatically handles OAuth2 authentication with SendPulse API - **Newsletter Creation**: Create and send email campaigns - **Address Book Management**: List address books and add emails - **Campaign Management**: Send campaigns and check statistics - **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error handling and validation ## Methods Available - `list_campaigns()` - Get list of existing campaigns - `list_address_books()` - Get list of email address books - `send_newsletter()` - Create and send a newsletter - `send_campaign()` - Send an existing campaign - `campaign_statistics()` - Get campaign performance data - `add_email_to_address_book()` - Add subscribers to address books Make sure to replace the placeholder values with your actual SendPulse API credentials and address book IDs before running the code.

Дякуємо за реєстрацію на нашому сайті.

З повагою,
Команда компанії

HTML service.quick_send_campaign( 'Ласкаво просимо!', html_content, ['user1@example.com', 'user2@example.com'], 'welcome@yourcompany.com' ) ``` Цей код надає повний набір інструментів для роботи з eSputnik API, включаючи: 1. Додавання та оновлення контактів 2. Надсилання email-розсилок 3. Роботу з групами контактів 4. Моніторинг статусу розсилок 5. Спрощені сервісні методи для поширених операцій Не забудьте встановити залежності за допомогою `bundle install` та налаштувати свої облікові дані в файлі `.env`.

```ruby
# sms_fly_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class SMSFlyClient
  include HTTParty

  # SMS-fly API endpoints
  BASE_URL = 'https://sms-fly.ua/api/'
  
  # Default headers for API requests
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'text/xml'
  
  def initialize(login: nil, password: nil)
    @login = login || ENV['SMS_FLY_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['SMS_FLY_PASSWORD']
    
    raise ArgumentError, "Login and password are required" unless @login && @password
  end

  # Send SMS to single recipient
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    payload = build_sms_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, body: payload)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Send SMS to multiple recipients
  def send_bulk_sms(phone_numbers, message, options = {})
    payload = build_bulk_sms_payload(phone_numbers, message, options)
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, body: payload)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Check SMS status
  def check_status(message_id)
    payload = build_status_payload(message_id)
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, body: payload)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    payload = build_balance_payload
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, body: payload)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_sms_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    start_time = options[:start_time] || 'AUTO'
    end_time = options[:end_time] || 'AUTO'
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 1
    source = options[:source] || 'SMS Fly'
    description = options[:description] || 'Ruby API Send'

    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" end_time="#{end_time}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="#{description}" source="#{source}">
          <body>#{message}</body>
          <recipient>#{phone_number}</recipient>
        </message>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def build_bulk_sms_payload(phone_numbers, message, options)
    start_time = options[:start_time] || 'AUTO'
    end_time = options[:end_time] || 'AUTO'
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 1
    source = options[:source] || 'SMS Fly'
    description = options[:description] || 'Ruby API Send'

    recipients = Array(phone_numbers).map { |phone| "<recipient>#{phone}</recipient>" }.join

    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" end_time="#{end_time}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="#{description}" source="#{source}">
          <body>#{message}</body>
          #{recipients}
        </message>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def build_status_payload(message_id)
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>GETSTATUS</operation>
        <message id="#{message_id}"/>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def build_balance_payload
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>GETBALANCE</operation>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
      code = doc.xpath('//code').text
      description = doc.xpath('//description').text
      result = doc.xpath('//result').text
      
      {
        success: code == 'ACCEPT',
        code: code,
        description: description,
        result: result,
        raw_response: response.body
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}",
        raw_response: response.body
      }
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Parse error: #{e.message}",
      raw_response: response.body
    }
  end
end

# viber_bot.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class ViberBot < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :port, 3000
    set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
  end

  # Initialize Viber client
  def initialize
    super
    @viber = Viber::Client.new(
      auth_token: ENV['VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN'],
      name: 'OrderBot',
      avatar: 'https://example.com/bot_avatar.jpg'
    )
  end

  # Webhook endpoint for Viber
  post '/webhook' do
    content_type :json
    
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    case data['event']
    when 'webhook'
      handle_webhook_setup
    when 'conversation_started'
      handle_conversation_started(data)
    when 'message'
      handle_message(data)
    when 'subscribed'
      handle_subscribed(data)
    when 'unsubscribed'
      handle_unsubscribed(data)
    end

    { status: 'ok' }.to_json
  end

  # Set webhook URL (run once)
  get '/set_webhook' do
    webhook_url = "#{ENV['BASE_URL']}/webhook"
    result = @viber.set_webhook(webhook_url, ['delivered', 'seen', 'failed', 'subscribed', 'unsubscribed', 'conversation_started'])
    result.to_json
  end

  private

  def handle_webhook_setup
    puts "Webhook setup successfully"
  end

  def handle_conversation_started(data)
    user_id = data['user']['id']
    welcome_message = {
      receiver: user_id,
      min_api_version: 7,
      type: 'text',
      text: "Welcome to our Order Bot! 🛍️\n\nI can help you place orders for our products. What would you like to do?",
      keyboard: main_keyboard
    }
    
    @viber.send_message(welcome_message)
  end

  def handle_subscribed(data)
    user_id = data['user']['id']
    puts "User #{user_id} subscribed to the bot"
  end

  def handle_unsubscribed(data)
    user_id = data['user_id']
    puts "User #{user_id} unsubscribed from the bot"
  end

  def handle_message(data)
    user_id = data['sender']['id']
    message_text = data['message']['text']
    
    case message_text.downcase
    when 'place order', 'order'
      send_order_categories(user_id)
    when 'view menu', 'menu'
      send_menu(user_id)
    when 'track order', 'tracking'
      send_tracking_keyboard(user_id)
    when 'contact support', 'support'
      send_support_message(user_id)
    when 'back to main'
      send_main_keyboard(user_id)
    when /^category_/
      handle_category_selection(user_id, message_text)
    when /^product_/
      handle_product_selection(user_id, message_text)
    when 'confirm order'
      handle_order_confirmation(user_id)
    when 'cancel order'
      handle_order_cancellation(user_id)
    else
      send_unknown_command(user_id)
    end
  end

    message = {
      receiver: user_id,
      min_api_version: 7,
      type: 'text',

    }
    
    @viber.send_message(message)
  end

                "🍕 Pizza - $12.99\n" +
                "🍔 Burger - $8.99\n" +
                "🍝 Pasta - $10.99\n" +
                "🥗 Salad - $7.99\n" +
                "🍰 Cake - $5.99\n\n" +
                "Use 'Place Order' to start ordering!"
    
    message = {
      receiver: user_id,

      type: 'text',

      keyboard: main_keyboard

      text: "Please enter your order number to track its status:",

    }

      type: 'text',
      text: "📞 **Customer Support**\n\nPhone: +1-555-0123\nEmail: support@example.com\nHours: Mon-Fri 9AM-6PM",
      keyboard: main_keyboard
    }
    
    @viber.send_message(message)
  end

  def send_main_keyboard(user_id)
    message = {
      receiver: user_id,

      type: 'text',
      text: "What would you like to do?",
      keyboard: main_keyboard
    }
    
    @viber.send_message(message)
  end

    category_name = category.split('_').last.capitalize

  # Keyboard templates

# sms_fly_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'base64'
require 'dotenv/load'

class SmsFlyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # Базові URL API SMS-fly
  BASE_URL = 'https://sms-fly.ua/api/'
  
  def initialize(account, password)
    @account = account
    @password = password
    @auth_header = Base64.strict_encode64("#{@account}:#{@password}")
    
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.headers(
      'Authorization' => "Basic #{@auth_header}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml'
    )
  end
  
  # Перевірка балансу
  def get_balance
    xml_body = <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>BALANCE</operation>
      </request>
    XML
    
    response = self.class.post('api.php', body: xml_body)
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Відправка SMS
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    # Форматуємо номер телефону
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone)
    
    xml_body = build_sms_xml(formatted_phone, message, options)
    
    response = self.class.post('api.php', body: xml_body)
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Отримання статусу повідомлення
  def get_status(message_id)
    xml_body = <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>GETSTATUS</operation>
        <message message_id="#{message_id}" />
      </request>
    XML
    
    response = self.class.post('api.php', body: xml_body)
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Приводимо номер до формату 380XXXXXXXXX
    phone.gsub!(/\D/, '') # Видаляємо всі нецифрові символи
    
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      "38#{phone}"
    elsif phone.start_with?('380')
      phone
    else
      "380#{phone}"
    end
  end
  
  def build_sms_xml(phone, message, options)
    start_time = options[:start_time] || 'AUTO'
    end_time = options[:end_time] || 'AUTO'
    description = options[:description] || 'Ruby SMS'
    source = options[:source] || 'Info'
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 1
    
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" end_time="#{end_time}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="#{description}" source="#{source}">
          <body>#{message}</body>
          <recipient>#{phone}</recipient>
        </message>
      </request>
    XML
  end
  
  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
      
      # Перевіряємо наявність помилок
      error = doc.at_xpath('//error')
      if error
        {
          success: false,
          code: error['code'],
          description: error['description']
        }
      else
        {
          success: true,
          data: extract_response_data(doc)
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}",
        description: response.message
      }
    end
  end
  
  def extract_response_data(doc)
    data = {}
    
    # Обробляємо різні типи відповідей
    case doc.at_xpath('//operation')&.content
    when 'BALANCE'
      data[:balance] = doc.at_xpath('//balance')&.content
      data[:currency] = doc.at_xpath('//currency')&.content
    when 'SENDSMS'
      data[:message_id] = doc.at_xpath('//message')&.[]('id')
      data[:status] = doc.at_xpath('//state')&.content
    when 'GETSTATUS'
      data[:message_id] = doc.at_xpath('//message')&.[]('id')
      data[:status] = doc.at_xpath('//state')&.content
      data[:send_date] = doc.at_xpath('//send_date')&.content
    end
    
    data
  end
end

require_relative 'sms_fly_client'

class BatchSmsSender
  def initialize(account, password)
    @client = SmsFlyClient.new(account, password)
  end
  
  def send_batch(phone_messages, options = {})
    results = []
    
    phone_messages.each do |phone, message|
      puts "Відправка SMS на #{phone}..."
      
      result = @client.send_sms(phone, message, options)
      result[:phone] = phone
      results << result
      
      # Затримка між відправками (якщо потрібно)
      sleep(options[:delay] || 0.5) if options[:delay]
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  def generate_report(results)
    successful = results.count { |r| r[:success] }
    failed = results.count { |r| !r[:success] }
    
    puts "\n=== Звіт про відправку SMS ==="
    puts "Успішно відправлено: #{successful}"
    puts "Не вдалося відправити: #{failed}"
    
    if failed > 0
      puts "\nПомилки:"
      results.select { |r| !r[:success] }.each do |error|
        puts "#{error[:phone]}: #{error[:description]}"
      end
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# mobizon_sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class MobizonSMS
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.mobizon.com/service/'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  # Send SMS to a single recipient
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    endpoint = 'message/sendsmsmessage'
    
    params = {
      recipient: format_phone_number(phone),
      text: message,
      apiKey: @api_key
    }.merge(options)

    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Send SMS to multiple recipients
  def send_bulk_sms(phones, message, options = {})
    endpoint = 'message/sendsmsmessage'
    
    params = {
      recipient: phones.map { |phone| format_phone_number(phone) }.join(','),
      text: message,
      apiKey: @api_key
    }.merge(options)

    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Check SMS status by ID
  def get_sms_status(message_id)
    endpoint = 'message/getsmsstatus'
    
    params = {
      ids: Array(message_id).join(','),
      apiKey: @api_key
    }

    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    endpoint = 'user/getownbalance'
    
    params = {
      apiKey: @api_key
    }

    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  private

  def make_request(endpoint, params)
    url = "#{API_BASE_URL}#{endpoint}"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, body: params)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}",
        data: response.body
      }
    end
  rescue => e
    { 
      success: false, 
      error: "Request failed: #{e.message}"
    }
  end

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Remove any non-digit characters and ensure proper format
    cleaned_phone = phone.to_s.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Add Ukraine country code if missing
    if cleaned_phone.start_with?('380') && cleaned_phone.length == 12
      cleaned_phone
    elsif cleaned_phone.start_with?('0') && cleaned_phone.length == 10
      "38#{cleaned_phone}"
    elsif cleaned_phone.start_with?('80') && cleaned_phone.length == 11
      "3#{cleaned_phone}"
    else
      cleaned_phone # Return as-is if format is unclear
    end
  end
end

# lib/sms_otp_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

Dotenv.load

class SMSOTPSender
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    validate_configuration
  end
  
  # Генерація одноразового пароля
  def generate_otp(length = 6)
    charset = Array('0'..'9')
    Array.new(length) { charset.sample }.join
  end
  
  # Надсилання OTP через SMS
  def send_otp(phone_number, otp_code, message_template = nil)
    message = message_template || "Ваш код підтвердження: #{otp_code}. Не повідомляйте його нікому."
    
    payload = {
      api_key: ENV['LIFECELL_API_KEY'],
      sender: ENV['LIFECELL_SENDER_NAME'],
      phone: normalize_phone_number(phone_number),
      message: message
    }
    
    logger.info("Надсилання OTP на номер: #{phone_number}")
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        ENV['LIFECELL_API_URL'],
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        },
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      handle_response(response, phone_number, otp_code)
      
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      logger.error("Помилка HTTP: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: "Помилка мережі: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Неочікувана помилка: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: "Неочікувана помилка: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу SMS
  def check_sms_status(message_id)
    return { success: false, error: "ID повідомлення не вказано" } unless message_id
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(
        "#{ENV['LIFECELL_API_URL']}/status",
        query: {
          api_key: ENV['LIFECELL_API_KEY'],
          message_id: message_id
        },
        headers: {
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        },
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      if response.success?
        { success: true, status: response.parsed_response }
      else
        { success: false, error: "Помилка отримання статусу: #{response.code}" }
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Помилка перевірки статусу: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: "Помилка перевірки статусу: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def normalize_phone_number(phone)
    # Приведення номера до потрібного формату (380XXXXXXXXX)
    phone.gsub(/\D/, '').gsub(/^0/, '380').gsub(/^80/, '380')
  end
  
  def validate_configuration
    required_env_vars = ['LIFECELL_API_KEY', 'LIFECELL_SENDER_NAME', 'LIFECELL_API_URL']
    
    missing_vars = required_env_vars.select { |var| ENV[var].to_s.empty? }
    
    if missing_vars.any?
      raise "Відсутні обов'язкові змінні середовища: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response, phone_number, otp_code)
    if response.success?
      response_data = response.parsed_response
      
      if response_data['success']
        logger.info("OTP успішно відправлено на #{phone_number}. ID повідомлення: #{response_data['message_id']}")
        { 
          success: true, 
          message_id: response_data['message_id'],
          otp_code: otp_code,
          phone_number: phone_number
        }
      else
        error_msg = response_data['error'] || 'Невідома помилка API'
        logger.error("Помилка API lifecell: #{error_msg}")
        { success: false, error: error_msg }
      end
    else
      logger.error("HTTP помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      { success: false, error: "HTTP помилка: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
end

### lib/otp_manager.rb

```ruby
# lib/otp_manager.rb
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'

class OTPManager
  def initialize(storage_file = 'otp_storage.json')
    @storage_file = storage_file
    @otp_storage = load_storage
  end
  
  # Створення нового OTP для телефону
  def create_otp(phone_number, length = 6, expires_in = 300) # 5 хвилин за замовчуванням
    otp_code = generate_otp(length)
    expires_at = Time.now + expires_in
    
    otp_data = {
      code: otp_code,
      phone_number: phone_number,
      created_at: Time.now,
      expires_at: expires_at,
      used: false,
      attempts: 0
    }
    
    @otp_storage[phone_number] = otp_data
    save_storage
    
    { otp: otp_code, expires_at: expires_at }
  end
  
  # Перевірка OTP
  def verify_otp(phone_number, entered_otp, max_attempts = 3)
    otp_data = @otp_storage[phone_number]
    
    return { valid: false, error: "OTP не знайдено" } unless otp_data
    return { valid: false, error: "OTP вже використано" } if otp_data[:used]
    return { valid: false, error: "OTP прострочено" } if Time.now > otp_data[:expires_at]
    return { valid: false, error: "Перевищено ліміт спроб" } if otp_data[:attempts] >= max_attempts
    
    # Збільшуємо лічильник спроб
    otp_data[:attempts] += 1
    
    if otp_data[:code] == entered_otp
      otp_data[:used] = true
      otp_data[:verified_at] = Time.now
      save_storage
      { valid: true, message: "OTP підтверджено" }
    else
      save_storage
      { valid: false, error: "Невірний OTP", attempts_remaining: max_attempts - otp_data[:attempts] }
    end
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про OTP
  def get_otp_info(phone_number)
    @otp_storage[phone_number]
  end
  
  # Очищення прострочених OTP
  def cleanup_expired
    initial_count = @otp_storage.size
    @otp_storage.delete_if { |_, data| Time.now > data[:expires_at] }
    
    if @otp_storage.size < initial_count
      save_storage
      logger.info("Видалено #{initial_count - @otp_storage.size} прострочених OTP")
    end
    
    @otp_storage.size
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_otp(length)
    SecureRandom.random_number(10**length).to_s.rjust(length, '0')
  end
  
  def load_storage
    if File.exist?(@storage_file)
      JSON.parse(File.read(@storage_file), symbolize_names: true)
    else
      {}
    end
  end
  
  def save_storage
    File.write(@storage_file, JSON.pretty_generate(@otp_storage))
  end
end

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# bot.rb
require 'telegram/bot'
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'redis'
require 'json'

class UkraineAirRaidBot
  ALERT_MAP_URL = 'https://air-raid-alert-map.kyivindependent.com/'
  CACHE_DURATION = 300 # 5 minutes

  def initialize(token, redis_url = nil)
    @token = token
    @redis = Redis.new(url: redis_url) if redis_url
  end

  def run
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.listen do |message|
        handle_message(bot, message)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(bot, message)
    case message.text
    when '/start'
      send_welcome_message(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/map', '/alert', '/status'
      send_alert_map(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/help'
      send_help_message(bot, message.chat.id)
    else
      send_unknown_command(bot, message.chat.id)
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error handling message: #{e.message}"
    send_error_message(bot, message.chat.id)
  end

  def send_welcome_message(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~WELCOME
      🇺🇦 Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot 🇺🇦

      This bot provides real-time information about air-raid alerts across Ukraine.

      Commands:
      /start - Show this welcome message
      /map or /alert - Get current air-raid alert map
      /status - Get current alert status
      /help - Show help information

      Data source: Kyiv Independent Air Raid Alert Map
    WELCOME

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end

  def send_alert_map(bot, chat_id)
    map_data = fetch_alert_data
    
    if map_data[:image_url]
      caption = "🚨 Current Air-Raid Alert Status in Ukraine\n\n" \
                "🟥 Red - Active alerts\n" \
                "🟨 Yellow - Partial alerts\n" \
                "🟩 Green - No alerts\n\n" \
                "Last updated: #{map_data[:timestamp]}"
      
      bot.api.send_photo(
        chat_id: chat_id,
        photo: map_data[:image_url],
        caption: caption
      )
    else
      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id, 
        text: "⚠️ Unable to retrieve the air-raid alert map at the moment. Please try again later."
      )
    end
  end

  def send_help_message(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~HELP
      🤖 Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot Help

      This bot uses data from the Kyiv Independent to provide real-time air-raid alert information.

      Available commands:
      • /start - Welcome message
      • /map or /alert - Get current air-raid alert map
      • /status - Same as /map
      • /help - This help message

      The map shows:
      🟥 Red regions - Active air-raid alerts
      🟨 Yellow regions - Partial alerts
      🟩 Green regions - No current alerts

      Stay safe! 🇺🇦
    HELP

    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end

  def send_unknown_command(bot, chat_id)
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: "Unknown command. Use /help to see available commands."
    )
  end

  def send_error_message(bot, chat_id)
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: "❌ An error occurred. Please try again later."
    )
  end

  def fetch_alert_data
    # Check cache first
    cached_data = get_cached_data
    return cached_data if cached_data

    response = HTTParty.get(ALERT_MAP_URL)
    
    if response.success?
      doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
      
      # Look for the map image - this selector might need adjustment based on the actual site structure
      image_element = doc.css('img[src*="map"], img[alt*="alert"], img[alt*="air raid"]').first
      
      if image_element
        image_url = image_element['src']
        # Convert relative URL to absolute if needed
        image_url = URI.join(ALERT_MAP_URL, image_url).to_s unless image_url.start_with?('http')
        
        map_data = {
          image_url: image_url,
          timestamp: Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC"),
          regions: extract_alert_regions(doc)
        }
        
        cache_data(map_data)
        return map_data
      end
    end

    { image_url: nil, timestamp: Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC"), regions: [] }
  end

  def extract_alert_regions(doc)
    # This is a placeholder - you'd need to adapt based on the actual data structure
    # The Kyiv Independent map might have regional data in JSON format or specific HTML elements
    regions = []
    
    # Try to find alert information in script tags or data attributes
    doc.css('script').each do |script|
      if script.content.include?('regions') || script.content.include?('alerts')
        # Parse JSON data if available
        json_match = script.content.match(/var\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*({.*?});/m)
        if json_match
          begin
            data = JSON.parse(json_match[1])
            regions = data['regions'] if data.is_a?(Hash) && data['regions']
          rescue JSON::ParserError
            # Continue to next script tag if parsing fails
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    regions
  end

  def get_cached_data
    return nil unless @redis
    
    cached = @redis.get('air_raid_map_data')
    cached ? JSON.parse(cached, symbolize_names: true) : nil
  end

  def cache_data(data)
    return unless @redis
    
    @redis.setex('air_raid_map_data', CACHE_DURATION, data.to_json)
  end
end

# Configuration and startup
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Get bot token from environment variable for security
  token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
  
  unless token
    puts "Error: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable is required"
    exit 1
  end

  # Optional Redis URL for caching
  redis_url = ENV['REDIS_URL']
  
  puts "Starting Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot..."
  bot = UkraineAirRaidBot.new(token, redis_url)
  bot.run
end

```ruby
# mobizon_sms.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class MobizonSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.mobizon.com/service/'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MOBIZON_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
  end

  # Надсилання SMS
  def send_sms(phone, message, from = nil, options = {})
    endpoint = 'message/sendsmsmessage'
    
    params = {
      recipient: format_phone(phone),
      text: message,
      apiKey: @api_key
    }
    
    # Додаткові параметри
    params[:from] = from if from
    params.merge!(options)

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Перевірка балансу
  def balance
    endpoint = 'user/getownbalance'
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      query: { apiKey: @api_key }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання статусу повідомлення
  def message_status(message_id)
    endpoint = 'message/getsmsstatus'
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      query: {
        ids: message_id,
        apiKey: @api_key
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання списку повідомлень
  def message_list(filters = {})
    endpoint = 'message/list'
    
    params = { apiKey: @api_key }.merge(filters)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      query: params
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def format_phone(phone)
    # Приводимо номер до міжнародного формату
    phone.gsub!(/\s+/, '')
    
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      "+38#{phone}"
    elsif phone.start_with?('80')
      "+3#{phone}"
    elsif phone.start_with?('380')
      "+#{phone}"
    else
      phone
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['code'] == 0
        result['data']
      else
        raise "Mobizon API Error #{result['code']}: #{result['message']}"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

    Boolean :active, default: true

  end

  DB.create_table :notifications do
    primary_key :id
    foreign_key :user_id, :users
    foreign_key :outage_id, :outage_schedules

# Models
class OutageSchedule < Sequel::Model
  def before_save
    self.updated_at = Time.now
    super
  end
  
  def matches_address?(address)
    # Simple pattern matching - in real app, use more sophisticated geocoding
    address.downcase.include?(address_pattern.downcase)
  end
  
  def upcoming?
    start_date >= Date.today && active
  end
  
  def active_now?
    today = Date.today
    current_time = Time.now
    today.between?(start_date, end_date) && 
    current_time.between?(start_time, end_time) && active
  end
end

class User < Sequel::Model
  one_to_many :notifications
  
  def should_receive_sms?
    notification_preference == 'sms' || notification_preference == 'both'
  end
  
  def should_receive_email?
    notification_preference == 'email' || notification_preference == 'both'
  end
end

class Notification < Sequel::Model
  many_to_one :user
  many_to_one :outage_schedule
end

# Notification Workers
class SmsNotificationWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  
  def perform(user_id, outage_id, notification_type)
    user = User[user_id]
    outage = OutageSchedule[outage_id]
    
    return unless user && outage && user.should_receive_sms?
    
    # Configure Twilio (you'll need to set these in .env)
    account_sid = ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID']
    auth_token = ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
    from_phone = ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER']
    
    client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
    
    message = build_message(outage, notification_type)
    
    client.messages.create(
      from: from_phone,
      to: user.phone,
      body: message
    )
    
    # Record notification
    Notification.create(
      user_id: user_id,
      outage_id: outage_id,
      sent_at: Time.now,
      delivered: true,
      notification_type: notification_type
    )
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_message(outage, type)
    case type
    when 'reminder'
      "Нагадування: Відключення світла #{outage.start_date} з #{outage.start_time.strftime('%H:%M')} до #{outage.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}. #{outage.description}"
    when 'start'
      "УВАГА: Відключення світла розпочалося. Триватиме до #{outage.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}. #{outage.description}"
    when 'end'
      "Відключення світла завершено. Електропостачання відновлено."
    end
  end
end

class EmailNotificationWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  
  def perform(user_id, outage_id, notification_type)
    user = User[user_id]
    outage = OutageSchedule[outage_id]
    
    return unless user && outage && user.should_receive_email?
    
    subject, body = build_email_content(outage, notification_type)
    
    Pony.mail(
      to: user.email,
      subject: subject,
      body: body,
      via: :smtp,
      via_options: {
        address: ENV['SMTP_ADDRESS'],
        port: ENV['SMTP_PORT'],
        user_name: ENV['SMTP_USERNAME'],
        password: ENV['SMTP_PASSWORD'],
        authentication: :plain,
        enable_starttls_auto: true
      }
    )
    
    # Record notification
    Notification.create(
      user_id: user_id,
      outage_id: outage_id,
      sent_at: Time.now,
      delivered: true,
      notification_type: notification_type
    )
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_email_content(outage, type)
    case type
    when 'reminder'
      subject = "Нагадування про відключення світла"
      body = "Шановний користувач,\n\nНагадуємо, що за графіком '#{outage.group_name}' заплановано відключення світла:\n\n" +
             "Дата: #{outage.start_date}\n" +
             "Час: #{outage.start_time.strftime('%H:%M')} - #{outage.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}\n" +
             "Опис: #{outage.description}\n\n" +
             "Будь ласка, підготуйтеся заздалегідь."
    when 'start'
      subject = "Відключення світла розпочалося"
      body = "Шановний користувач,\n\nВідключення світла за графіком '#{outage.group_name}' розпочалося.\n\n" +
             "Триватиме до: #{outage.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}\n" +
             "Опис: #{outage.description}"
    when 'end'
      subject = "Електропостачання відновлено"
      body = "Шановний користувач,\n\nВідключення світла завершено. Електропостачання відновлено."
    end
    
    [subject, body]
  end
end

# Scheduler for sending notifications
class OutageNotifier
  def self.schedule_reminders
    # Find outages starting tomorrow
    tomorrow_outages = OutageSchedule.where(start_date: Date.today + 1)
    
    tomorrow_outages.each do |outage|
      affected_users = User.where(active: true).select do |user|
        outage.matches_address?(user.address)
      end
      
      affected_users.each do |user|
        # Schedule reminder for 24 hours before outage
        reminder_time = Time.new(outage.start_date.year, outage.start_date.month, outage.start_date.day, outage.start_time.hour, outage.start_time.min) - 24 * 60 * 60
        
        SmsNotificationWorker.perform_at(reminder_time, user.id, outage.id, 'reminder') if user.should_receive_sms?
        EmailNotificationWorker.perform_at(reminder_time, user.id, outage.id, 'reminder') if user.should_receive_email?
      end
    end
  end
  
  def self.monitor_active_outages
    # Check for outages starting now
    starting_outages = OutageSchedule.all.select(&:active_now?)
    
    starting_outages.each do |outage|
      affected_users = User.where(active: true).select do |user|
        outage.matches_address?(user.address)
      end
      
      affected_users.each do |user|
        SmsNotificationWorker.perform_async(user.id, outage.id, 'start') if user.should_receive_sms?
        EmailNotificationWorker.perform_async(user.id, outage.id, 'start') if user.should_receive_email?
      end
    end
  end
end

# diia_notification_service.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'jwt'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'base64'

class DiiaNotificationService
  # Diia API endpoints
  DIIA_BASE_URL = ENV['DIIA_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.diia.gov.ua'
  AUTH_ENDPOINT = '/api/v3/auth/acquirer'
  NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT = '/api/v3/notification'
  
  attr_reader :client_id, :private_key, :access_token

  def initialize(client_id: nil, private_key: nil, base_url: nil)
    @client_id = client_id || ENV['DIIA_CLIENT_ID']
    @private_key = private_key || load_private_key
    @base_url = base_url || DIIA_BASE_URL
    
    validate_credentials
  end

  # Send push notification to a user
  def send_notification(user_identifier, title, body, data = {})
    authenticate unless authenticated?
    
    payload = build_notification_payload(user_identifier, title, body, data)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: build_headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send multiple notifications in batch
  def send_batch_notifications(notifications)
    authenticate unless authenticated?
    
    batch_payload = notifications.map do |notification|
      build_notification_payload(
        notification[:user_identifier],
        notification[:title],
        notification[:body],
        notification[:data] || {}
      )
    end
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT}/batch",
      headers: build_headers,
      body: { notifications: batch_payload }.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check notification status
  def notification_status(notification_id)
    authenticate unless authenticated?
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{@base_url}#{NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT}/#{notification_id}",
      headers: build_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def authenticate
    jwt_token = generate_jwt_token
    auth_payload = { token: jwt_token }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{AUTH_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
      body: auth_payload.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['token']
      @token_expires_at = Time.now + response.parsed_response['expires_in'].to_i
    else
      raise AuthenticationError, "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def generate_jwt_token
    payload = {
      iss: @client_id,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300 # 5 minutes expiration
    }
    
    JWT.encode(payload, @private_key, 'RS256')
  end

  def build_notification_payload(user_identifier, title, body, data = {})
    {
      userIdentifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
    }
  end

  def build_headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      response.parsed_response
    when 401
      @access_token = nil # Clear expired token
      raise AuthenticationError, "Unauthorized: #{response.body}"
    when 400
      raise BadRequestError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
    when 500
      raise ServerError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise ApiError, "API error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def authenticated?
    @access_token && @token_expires_at && Time.now < @token_expires_at
  end

  def load_private_key
    private_key_content = ENV['DIIA_PRIVATE_KEY']
    if private_key_content
      OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(private_key_content)
    else
      raise ConfigurationError, "Private key not provided"
    end
  end

  def validate_credentials
    raise ConfigurationError, "Client ID is required" unless @client_id
    raise ConfigurationError, "Private key is required" unless @private_key
  end
end

class AuthenticationError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class ConfigurationError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class BadRequestError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class ServerError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class ApiError < DiiaNotificationError; end

# alert_notifier.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'redis'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class AlertNotifier
  ALERTS_API_BASE_URL = 'https://alerts.com.ua/api'
  
  def initialize
    @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')
  end
  
  # Get current alerts from the API
  def fetch_current_alerts
    response = HTTParty.get("#{ALERTS_API_BASE_URL}/states", 
                           headers: { 'X-API-Key' => ENV['ALERTS_API_KEY'] })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error fetching alerts: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      {}
    end
  end
  
  # Get oblast information
  def fetch_oblasts
    response = HTTParty.get("#{ALERTS_API_BASE_URL}/states")
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error fetching oblasts: #{response.code}"
      {}
    end
  end
  
  # Check if there are new alerts for specific oblasts
  def check_for_new_alerts(user_oblast_ids)
    current_alerts = fetch_current_alerts
    return [] unless current_alerts['states']
    
    new_alerts = []
    
    user_oblast_ids.each do |oblast_id|
      oblast_data = current_alerts['states'].find { |state| state['id'] == oblast_id }
      next unless oblast_data
      
      oblast_name = oblast_data['name']
      has_alert = oblast_data['alert']
      last_notified = @redis.get("alert_#{oblast_id}")
      
      if has_alert && last_notified != 'active'
        new_alerts << {
          oblast_id: oblast_id,
          oblast_name: oblast_name,
          status: 'active'
        }
        @redis.set("alert_#{oblast_id}", 'active')
        @redis.expire("alert_#{oblast_id}", 3600) # Expire in 1 hour
      elsif !has_alert && last_notified == 'active'
        new_alerts << {
          oblast_id: oblast_id,
          oblast_name: oblast_name,
          status: 'inactive'
        }
        @redis.set("alert_#{oblast_id}", 'inactive')
      end
    end
    
    new_alerts
  end
  
  # Format alert message
  def format_alert_message(alert)
    if alert[:status] == 'active'
      "🚨 ПОВІТРЯНА ТРИВОГА в #{alert[:oblast_name]}! Шукайте укриття!"
    else
      "✅ ВІДБІЙ ПОВІТРЯНОЇ ТРИВОГИ в #{alert[:oblast_name]}"
    end
  end
end

# user_manager.rb
require 'pg'
require 'json'

class UserManager
  def initialize
    @db = PG.connect(ENV['DATABASE_URL'] || {
      host: 'localhost',
      dbname: 'alerts_db',
      user: 'postgres',
      password: ENV['DB_PASSWORD']
    })
    
    create_tables
  end
  
  def create_tables
    @db.exec(<<-SQL)
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        telegram_chat_id BIGINT UNIQUE,
        oblast_ids INTEGER[] DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
      )
    SQL
  end
  
  def add_user(telegram_chat_id, oblast_ids)
    @db.exec_params(
      "INSERT INTO users (telegram_chat_id, oblast_ids) VALUES ($1, $2) 
       ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET oblast_ids = $2",
      [telegram_chat_id, "{#{oblast_ids.join(',')}}"]
    )
  end
  
  def remove_user(telegram_chat_id)
    @db.exec_params("DELETE FROM users WHERE telegram_chat_id = $1", [telegram_chat_id])
  end
  
  def get_users_by_oblast(oblast_id)
    result = @db.exec_params(
      "SELECT telegram_chat_id FROM users WHERE $1 = ANY(oblast_ids)",
      [oblast_id]
    )
    result.map { |row| row['telegram_chat_id'].to_i }
  end
  
  def get_user_oblasts(telegram_chat_id)
    result = @db.exec_params(
      "SELECT oblast_ids FROM users WHERE telegram_chat_id = $1",
      [telegram_chat_id]
    )
    return [] if result.ntuples.zero?
    
    result[0]['oblast_ids'][1..-2].split(',').map(&:to_i) # Parse PostgreSQL array
  end
end

    when '/subscribe'

    when '/unsubscribe'

    when '/help'

    else
      handle_oblast_selection(bot, message)
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error handling message: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  def send_welcome_message(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~TEXT
      🇺🇦 Ласкаво просимо до боту повітряних тривог!
      
      Команди:
      /subscribe - Підписатися на сповіщення
      /unsubscribe - Відписатися
      /status - Поточний статус
      /help - Допомога
    TEXT
    
    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end
  
  def send_oblast_selection(bot, chat_id)
    oblasts_text = @oblasts.map { |o| "#{o['id']}. #{o['name']}" }.join("\n")
    
    text = <<~TEXT
      Оберіть ваші області (введіть номери через кому):
      
      #{oblasts_text}
      
      Наприклад: 1,5,12
    TEXT
    
    bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end
  
  def handle_oblast_selection(bot, message)
    # Check if message contains only numbers and commas
    if message.text =~ /^[\d,\s]+$/
      oblast_ids = message.text.split(/[,\s]+/).map(&:to_i).uniq
      valid_ids = @oblasts.map { |o| o['id'] }
      
      if (oblast_ids - valid_ids).empty?
        @user_manager.add_user(message.chat.id, oblast_ids)
        bot.api.send_message(
          chat_id: message.chat.id, 
          text: "✅ Ви підписалися на сповіщення для обраних областей!"
        )
      else
        bot.api.send_message(
          chat_id: message.chat.id, 
          text: "❌ Будь ласка, введіть коректні номери областей"
        )
      end
    end
  end
  
  def unsubscribe_user(bot, chat_id)
    @user_manager.remove_user(chat_id)
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id, 
      text: "✅ Ви відписалися від сповіщень"
    )
  end
  
  def send_current_status(bot, chat_id)
    oblast_ids = @user_manager.get_user_oblasts(chat_id)
    return if oblast_ids.empty?
    
    alerts = @alert_notifier.check_for_new_alerts(oblast_ids)
    
    if alerts.empty?
      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id, 
        text: "ℹ️ В ваших областях немає активних тривог"
      )
    else
      alerts.each do |alert|
        bot.api.send_message(
          chat_id: chat_id, 
          text: @alert_notifier.format_alert_message(alert)
        )
      end
    end
  end
  
  def send_alert_notification(chat_id, alert_message)
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: alert_message)
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error sending notification to #{chat_id}: #{e.message}"
  end
end
