## Background Worker

```ruby
# alert_worker.rb
require 'sidekiq'
require_relative 'alert_notifier'
require_relative 'user_manager'
require_relative 'telegram_bot'

class AlertWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  
  def perform
    user_manager = UserManager.new
    alert_notifier = AlertNotifier.new
    telegram_bot = TelegramBot.new
    
    # Get all unique oblast IDs that users are subscribed to
    all_oblast_ids = []
    # This would need a proper method to get all subscribed oblasts
    
    alerts = alert_notifier.fetch_current_alerts
    return unless alerts['states']
    
    alerts['states'].each do |oblast|
      oblast_id = oblast['id']
      users = user_manager.get_users_by_oblast(oblast_id)
      
      next if users.empty?
      
      # Check if alert status changed
      last_status = alert_notifier.instance_variable_get(:@redis).get("alert_#{oblast_id}")
      current_status = oblast['alert'] ? 'active' : 'inactive'
      
      if last_status != current_status
        users.each do |chat_id|
          message = alert_notifier.format_alert_message({
            oblast_id: oblast_id,
            oblast_name: oblast['name'],
            status: current_status
          })
          
          telegram_bot.send_alert_notification(chat_id, message)
        end
        
        # Update last status
        alert_notifier.instance_variable_get(:@redis).set("alert_#{oblast_id}", current_status)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# binotel_caller.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class BinotelCaller
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api/2.0/'

  def initialize(api_key = nil, api_secret = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    
    unless @api_key && @api_secret
      raise "Binotel API credentials not found. Please set BINOTEL_API_KEY and BINOTEL_API_SECRET environment variables."
    end
  end

  # Make a voice call with a message
  def call_with_message(customer_number, message_text, options = {})
    # Required parameters
    params = {
      customerNumber: customer_number,
      voiceText: message_text
    }

    # Optional parameters
    params[:generalNumber] = options[:general_number] if options[:general_number]
    params[:internalNumber] = options[:internal_number] if options[:internal_number]
    params[:callerid] = options[:caller_id] if options[:caller_id]
    params[:apiCallerID] = options[:api_caller_id] if options[:api_caller_id]
    params[:dtmf] = options[:dtmf] if options[:dtmf]
    params[:voice] = options[:voice] || 'Slt' # Default voice: Slt (female)
    params[:language] = options[:language] || 'ru' # Default language: Russian

    make_request('calls/send-message-to-call', params)
  end

  # Get call status
  def call_status(call_id)
    params = {
      callID: call_id
    }
    
    make_request('calls/status', params)
  end

  private

  def make_request(endpoint, params)
    # Add authentication parameters
    params[:key] = @api_key
    params[:secret] = @api_secret

    # Make the API request
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
      body: params,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )

    # Parse and return the response
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    { 'status' => 'error', 'message' => "Failed to parse response: #{e.message}" }
  rescue StandardError => e
    { 'status' => 'error', 'message' => "API request failed: #{e.message}" }
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Create an instance of the caller
  caller = BinotelCaller.new

  # Example: Make a call with a voice message
  begin
    # Replace with actual phone number and message
    customer_number = '+1234567890'  # International format
    message_text = 'Hello! This is a test message from our system. Thank you for your attention.'

    # Optional parameters
    options = {
      general_number: 'your-general-number',  # Your Binotel general number
      voice: 'Slt',                          # Voice: Slt (female) or Tom (male)
      language: 'en'                         # Language: ru, en, etc.
    }

    puts "Making call to #{customer_number}..."
    result = caller.call_with_message(customer_number, message_text, options)

    if result['status'] == 'success'
      call_id = result['callID']
      puts "Call initiated successfully!"
      puts "Call ID: #{call_id}"
      puts "Status: #{result['callStatus']}"
      
      # Optionally, check call status
      sleep(2)
      status = caller.call_status(call_id)
      puts "Current call status: #{status['callStatus']}"
    else
      puts "Error: #{result['message']}"
    end

  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative '../config/environment'

module AlertSystem
  class AlertClient
    include HTTParty
    base_uri Config::ALERTS_API_BASE_URL

    def initialize(api_key = ENV['ALERTS_API_KEY'])
      @api_key = api_key
      @headers = {
        'X-API-Key' => api_key
      }
    end

    # Отримати всі активні тривоги
    def active_alerts
      response = self.class.get('/active_alerts', headers: @headers)
      handle_response(response)
    end

    # Отримати тривоги для конкретної області
    def alerts_by_region(region_id)
      response = self.class.get("/alerts/#{region_id}", headers: @headers)
      handle_response(response)
    end

    # Отримати список областей
    def regions
      response = self.class.get('/regions', headers: @headers)
      handle_response(response)
    end

    # Перевірити статус тривоги для області
    def region_status(region_id)
      alerts = alerts_by_region(region_id)
      return nil unless alerts && alerts['alerts']
      
      alerts['alerts'].any? { |alert| alert['active'] }
    end

    private

    def handle_response(response)
      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else

      end
    end
  end
```

```ruby
require_relative '../config/environment'
require_relative 'alert_client'

module AlertSystem
  class AlertManager
    def initialize
      @client = AlertClient.new
      @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')
      @last_alert_state = {}
    end

    # Отримати ID області за назвою
    def find_region_id(region_name)
      regions = @client.regions
      return nil unless regions

      region = regions.find { |r| r['name'].downcase.include?(region_name.downcase) }
      region ? region['id'] : nil
    end

    # Перевірити зміну статусу тривоги
    def check_alert_change(region_id)
      current_status = @client.region_status(region_id)
      last_status = @last_alert_state[region_id]

      # Зберегти поточний статус
      @last_alert_state[region_id] = current_status

      # Повернути зміни
      {
        region_id: region_id,
        previous_status: last_status,
        current_status: current_status,
        changed: last_status != current_status
      }
    end

    # Отримати інформацію про область
    def region_info(region_id)
      regions = @client.regions
      regions.find { |r| r['id'] == region_id } if regions
    end

    # Форматувати повідомлення про тривогу
    def format_alert_message(region_id, status_change)
      region = region_info(region_id)
      return nil unless region

      if status_change[:current_status]
        "🚨 ПОВІТРЯНА ТРИВОГА в #{region['name']}! Шукайте укриття!"
      else
        "✅ ВІДБІЙ тривоги в #{region['name']}. Небезпека минула."
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### lib/telegram_bot.rb
```ruby
require_relative '../config/environment'
require_relative 'alert_manager'
require 'telegram/bot'

module AlertSystem
  class TelegramBot
    def initialize
      @alert_manager = AlertManager.new
      @bot_token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
      @users_regions = {} # chat_id => [region_ids]
    end

    def start
      Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@bot_token) do |bot|
        bot.listen do |message|
          handle_message(bot, message)
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def handle_message(bot, message)
      case message.text
      when '/start'
        send_welcome_message(bot, message.chat.id)
      when '/subscribe'
        send_subscription_instructions(bot, message.chat.id)
      when '/regions'
        send_regions_list(bot, message.chat.id)
      when '/status'
        send_current_status(bot, message.chat.id)
      when /^\/subscribe (.+)/
        subscribe_to_region(bot, message.chat.id, $1)
      when /^\/unsubscribe (.+)/
        unsubscribe_from_region(bot, message.chat.id, $1)
      else
        send_help_message(bot, message.chat.id)
      end
    end

    def send_welcome_message(bot, chat_id)
      text = <<~TEXT
        🚨 Бот сповіщення про повітряні тривоги
        
        Команди:
        /subscribe [назва області] - Підписатися на сповіщення
        /unsubscribe [назва області] - Відписатися
        /status - Поточний статус тривог
        /regions - Список областей
        /subscribe - Інструкція підписки
      TEXT

      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    def send_subscription_instructions(bot, chat_id)
      text = <<~TEXT
        Щоб підписатися на сповіщення, використовуйте команду:
        /subscribe НазваОбласті
        
        Наприклад:
        /subscribe Київ
        /subscribe Львівська
        
        Список областей: /regions
      TEXT

      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    def send_regions_list(bot, chat_id)
      regions = @alert_manager.alert_client.regions
      if regions
        regions_list = regions.map { |r| "#{r['id']}. #{r['name']}" }.join("\n")
        text = "Доступні області:\n#{regions_list}"
      else
        text = "Не вдалося отримати список областей"
      end

      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    def subscribe_to_region(bot, chat_id, region_name)
      region_id = @alert_manager.find_region_id(region_name)
      
      if region_id
        @users_regions[chat_id] ||= []
        unless @users_regions[chat_id].include?(region_id)
          @users_regions[chat_id] << region_id
          text = "✅ Підписано на сповіщення для області: #{region_name}"
        else
          text = "ℹ️ Ви вже підписані на цю область"
        end
      else
        text = "❌ Область '#{region_name}' не знайдена. Спробуйте /regions"
      end

      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    def unsubscribe_from_region(bot, chat_id, region_name)
      region_id = @alert_manager.find_region_id(region_name)
      
      if region_id && @users_regions[chat_id]&.include?(region_id)
        @users_regions[chat_id].delete(region_id)
        text = "✅ Відписано від сповіщень для області: #{region_name}"
      else
        text = "❌ Ви не підписані на цю область"
      end

      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    def send_current_status(bot, chat_id)
      if @users_regions[chat_id]&.any?
        statuses = @users_regions[chat_id].map do |region_id|
          region = @alert_manager.region_info(region_id)
          status = @alert_manager.alert_client.region_status(region_id)
          status_text = status ? '🚨 Тривога' : '✅ Спокій'
          "#{region['name']}: #{status_text}"
        end.join("\n")
        
        text = "Поточний статус:\n#{statuses}"
      else
        text = "Ви не підписані жодну область. Використайте /subscribe"
      end

      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    def send_help_message(bot, chat_id)
      text = "Використайте /start для перегляду доступних команд"
      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
    end

    # Метод для розсилки сповіщень (викликається з AlertMonitor)
    def send_alert_notification(chat_id, message)
      bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: message)
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка відправки повідомлення: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative '../config/environment'

module AlertSystem
  class AlertMonitor
    def initialize
      @alert_manager = AlertManager.new
      @telegram_bot = TelegramBot.new
      @check_interval = ENV['CHECK_INTERVAL']&.to_i || 30
    end

    def start_monitoring
      puts "Запуск моніторингу тривог з інтервалом #{@check_interval} секунд..."
      
      loop do
        check_all_subscribed_regions
        sleep @check_interval
      end
    end

    private

    def check_all_subscribed_regions
      # Отримати всіх підписаних користувачів та їх області
      # У реальному додатку це зберігалося б у базі даних
      users_regions = {} # Тут має бути логіка отримання підписок
      
      users_regions.each do |chat_id, region_ids|
        region_ids.each do |region_id|
          check_region_for_user(chat_id, region_id)
        end
      end
    end

    def check_region_for_user(chat_id, region_id)
      status_change = @alert_manager.check_alert_change(region_id)
      
      if status_change[:changed]
        message = @alert_manager.format_alert_message(region_id, status_change)
        @telegram_bot.send_alert_notification(chat_id, message) if message
      end
    end
```

```ruby
require 'redis'
require 'json'

class AirAlertBot
  ALERT_MAP_URL = 'https://map.air-alarm.eu/'
  CACHE_DURATION = 60 # секунди
  
  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
    @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')
  end

  def start
    Telegram::Bot::Client.run(@token) do |bot|
      bot.listen do |message|
        handle_message(bot, message)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(bot, message)
    case message.text
    when '/start', '/help'
      send_welcome(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/map', '/alerts'
      send_alert_map(bot, message.chat.id)
    when '/status'
      send_status(bot, message.chat.id)
    else
      send_unknown_command(bot, message.chat.id)
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: "❌ Сталася помилка. Спробуйте пізніше."
    )
  end

  def send_welcome(bot, chat_id)
    text = <<~TEXT
      🚨 *Бот повітряних тривог України*
      
      Команди:
      /start, /help - показати це повідомлення
      /map, /alerts - отримати поточну мапу тривог
      /status - перевірити статус тривог
      
      Бот показує актуальну інформацію про повітряні тривоги з офіційних джерел.
    TEXT

    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: text,
      parse_mode: 'Markdown'
    )
  end

  def send_alert_map(bot, chat_id)
    map_data = fetch_alert_data
    
    if map_data[:image_url]
      bot.api.send_photo(
        chat_id: chat_id,
        photo: map_data[:image_url],
        caption: "🗺️ *Мапа повітряних тривог України* 🚨\n\n#{map_data[:caption]}",
        parse_mode: 'Markdown'
      )
    else
      bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: chat_id,
        text: "❌ Не вдалося отримати мапу тривог. Спробуйте пізніше."
      )
    end
  end

  def send_status(bot, chat_id)
    map_data = fetch_alert_data
    status_text = generate_status_text(map_data)
    
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: status_text,
      parse_mode: 'Markdown'
    )
  end

  def send_unknown_command(bot, chat_id)
    bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: chat_id,
      text: "❓ Невідома команда. Використовуйте /help для списку команд."
    )
  end

  def fetch_alert_data
    # Перевіряємо кеш
    cached_data = @redis.get('air_alert_data')
    return JSON.parse(cached_data, symbolize_names: true) if cached_data

    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(ALERT_MAP_URL, timeout: 10)
      doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
      
      # Шукаємо зображення мапи
      map_image = doc.css('img').find { |img| img['src']&.include?('map') }
      image_url = map_image ? URI.join(ALERT_MAP_URL, map_image['src']).to_s : nil
      
      # Шукаємо інформацію про тривоги
      alerts_info = extract_alerts_info(doc)
      
      data = {
        image_url: image_url,
        caption: alerts_info[:caption],
        regions: alerts_info[:regions],
        last_updated: Time.now,
        source: ALERT_MAP_URL
      }
      
      # Зберігаємо в кеш
      @redis.setex('air_alert_data', CACHE_DURATION, data.to_json)
      
      data
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка отримання даних: #{e.message}"
      { error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def extract_alerts_info(doc)
    # Спробуємо знайти інформацію про тривоги на сторінці
    text_content = doc.css('body').text.downcase
    
    # Простий аналіз тексту для визначення статусу
    if text_content.include?('тривога') || text_content.include?('alarm')
      regions_count = text_content.scan(/тривога|alarm/i).size
      caption = "🚨 Активні повітряні тривоги в #{regions_count} регіонах"
    else
      caption = "✅ Тривог немає. Всі регіони в безпеці"
    end
    
    {
      caption: caption,
      regions: ['Інформація оновлюється...'] # Можна розширити для конкретних регіонів
    }
  end

  def generate_status_text(map_data)
    if map_data[:error]
      return "❌ *Помилка отримання даних:* #{map_data[:error]}"
    end

    status = <<~TEXT
      *Статус повітряних тривог в Україні*
      
      #{map_data[:caption]}
      
      📍 *Джерело:* #{map_data[:source]}
      ⏰ *Оновлено:* #{map_data[:last_updated].strftime('%H:%M:%S %d.%m.%Y')}
      
      Використовйте /map для отримання мапи
    TEXT

    status
  end
end

# Запуск бота
if __FILE__ == $0
  token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
  
  unless token
    puts "Помилка: Встановіть змінну середовища TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"
    exit 1
  end
  
  bot = AirAlertBot.new(token)
  puts "Бот запущено..."
  bot.start
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'

class AdvancedAlertParser
  ALERT_API_URL = 'https://api.air-alarm.eu/alerts' # Приклад API (може змінитися)
  
  def self.get_regional_alerts
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(ALERT_API_URL, timeout: 10)
      
      if response.success?
        alerts = JSON.parse(response.body)
        parse_alerts_data(alerts)
      else
        { error: "Помилка API: #{response.code}" }
      end
    rescue => e
      { error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.parse_alerts_data(alerts_data)
    # Приклад парсингу JSON відповіді
    active_alerts = alerts_data.select { |alert| alert['active'] == true }
    
    {
      total_regions: alerts_data.size,
      active_alerts: active_alerts.size,
      regions_with_alerts: active_alerts.map { |alert| alert['region_name'] },
      last_update: Time.now
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# spell_checker.rb
require 'ffi/hunspell'

class SpellChecker
  def initialize(language: 'en_US', dictionary_path: nil)
    @dictionary_path = dictionary_path
    @language = language
    @hunspell = initialize_hunspell
  end

  def check(text)
    words = extract_words(text)
    misspelled_words = []
    
    words.each do |word|
      unless @hunspell.check?(word)
        suggestions = @hunspell.suggest(word)
        misspelled_words << {
          word: word,
          suggestions: suggestions
        }
      end
    end
    
    misspelled_words
  end

  def correct(text)
    words = extract_words(text)
    corrected_words = []
    
    words.each do |word|
      if @hunspell.check?(word)
        corrected_words << word
      else
        suggestions = @hunspell.suggest(word)
        corrected_words << (suggestions.first || word)
      end
    end
    
    corrected_words.join(' ')
  end

  private

  def initialize_hunspell
    if @dictionary_path
      FFI::Hunspell.direct(@dictionary_path)
    else
      FFI::Hunspell.new(@language)
    end
  end

  def extract_words(text)
    # Remove punctuation and split into words
    text.downcase.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, '').split
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Initialize the spell checker
  checker = SpellChecker.new
  
  # Example text with spelling errors
  text = "Ths is a sentnce with some speling errrs."
  
  puts "Original text: #{text}"
  puts ""
  
  # Check for misspelled words
  misspelled = checker.check(text)
  
  if misspelled.any?
    puts "Misspelled words found:"
    misspelled.each do |word_info|
      puts "- #{word_info[:word]}: #{word_info[:suggestions].join(', ')}"
    end
  else
    puts "No spelling errors found!"
  end
  
  puts ""
  
  # Get corrected text
  corrected_text = checker.correct(text)
  puts "Corrected text: #{corrected_text}"
end
```

This Ruby code provides a spell checking solution using the `ffi-hunspell` gem, which is a Ruby binding for the Hunspell spell checking library. Here's what the code does:

## Key Features:

1. **Spell Checking**: Identifies misspelled words in English text
2. **Suggestions**: Provides correction suggestions for misspelled words
3. **Auto-correction**: Automatically replaces misspelled words with the first suggestion

## How to use:

1. **Install dependencies**: Run `bundle install` with the provided Gemfile
2. **Basic usage**:
   ```ruby
   checker = SpellChecker.new
   errors = checker.check("Ths is a testt.")
   corrected = checker.correct("Ths is a testt.")
   ```

## Methods:

- `check(text)`: Returns an array of misspelled words with suggestions
- `correct(text)`: Returns the text with misspelled words automatically corrected

## Dependencies:

The `ffi-hunspell` gem requires the Hunspell library to be installed on your system:
- **macOS**: `brew install hunspell`
- **Ubuntu/Debian**: `sudo apt-get install libhunspell-dev`
- **Windows**: Download Hunspell binaries

The gem automatically uses the system's Hunspell dictionaries, which typically include English.

**binotel_call.rb:**
```ruby
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'

class BinotelCall
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api/1.0'

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
  end

  # Метод для здійснення дзвінка з голосовим повідомленням
  def make_voice_call(caller_id, phone_number, voice_message_url, options = {})
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/calls/makecall.json"

    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      callerid: caller_id,
      phoneNumber: phone_number,
      voiceMessageURL: voice_message_url
    }.merge(options)

    begin
      response = RestClient.post(endpoint, params)
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)

      if result['status'] == 'success'
        puts "Дзвінок успішно ініційовано!"
        puts "ID дзвінка: #{result['callID']}"
        return result
      else
        puts "Помилка: #{result['message']}"
        return nil
      end

    rescue RestClient::ExceptionWithResponse => e
      puts "Помилка HTTP: #{e.response}"
      return nil
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Загальна помилка: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу дзвінка
  def call_status(call_id)
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/calls/callstatus.json"

    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      callID: call_id
    }

    begin
      response = RestClient.post(endpoint, params)
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)

      if result['status'] == 'success'
        puts "Статус дзвінка #{call_id}: #{result['callStatus']}"
        return result
      else
        puts "Помилка отримання статусу: #{result['message']}"
        return nil
      end

    rescue RestClient::ExceptionWithResponse => e
      puts "Помилка HTTP: #{e.response}"
      return nil
    end
  end
end
```

## Реалізація

### config/initializers/diya_api_client.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'jwt'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'

class DiyaApiClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # Базовий URL API Дії
  base_uri 'https://api.diia.gov.ua'
  
  def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, private_key_path:)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(private_key_path))
  end
  
  # Генерація JWT токена для авторизації
  def generate_token
    payload = {
      iss: @client_id,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: 1.hour.from_now.to_i
    }
    
    JWT.encode(payload, @private_key, 'RS256')
  end
  
  # Надсилання push-сповіщення
  def send_push_notification(user_identifier:, title:, message:, data: {})
    token = generate_token
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    body = {
      userIdentifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      message: message,
      data: data,
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/notifications/push',
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу сповіщення
  def notification_status(notification_id:)
    token = generate_token
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/api/v1/notifications/#{notification_id}/status",
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise DiyaApiError, "Помилка запиту: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise DiyaApiError, "Помилка авторизації"
    when 404
      raise DiyaApiError, "Ресурс не знайдено"
    when 500
      raise DiyaApiError, "Внутрішня помилка сервера"
    else
      raise DiyaApiError, "Невідома помилка: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

class DiyaApiError < StandardError; end
```

### app/services/push_notification_service.rb

```ruby
class PushNotificationService
  def initialize
    @diya_client = DiyaApiClient.new(
      client_id: ENV['DIYA_CLIENT_ID'],
      client_secret: ENV['DIYA_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      private_key_path: ENV['DIYA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH']
    )
  end
  
  # Надсилання простого сповіщення
  def send_simple_notification(user_identifier, title, message)
    @diya_client.send_push_notification(
      user_identifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      message: message
    )
  end
  
  # Надсилання сповіщення з додатковими даними
  def send_notification_with_data(user_identifier, title, message, notification_data)
    @diya_client.send_push_notification(
      user_identifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      message: message,
      data: notification_data
    )
  end
  
  # Масове надсилання сповіщень
  def send_bulk_notifications(notifications)
    results = []
    
    notifications.each do |notification|
      begin
        result = @diya_client.send_push_notification(notification)
        results << { success: true, data: result }
      rescue DiyaApiError => e
        results << { success: false, error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу сповіщення
  def check_notification_status(notification_id)
    @diya_client.notification_status(notification_id: notification_id)
  end
end
```

```ruby
      template = NotificationTemplate.get_template(
        notification_params[:template_type],

      result = @push_service.send_notification_with_data(

      )

      )
    end
```

Here's a Ruby implementation that stems English words and removes stop words for indexing product descriptions:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'ruby-stemmer', '~> 1.2.0'
gem 'stopwords-filter', '~> 0.5.0'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# product_indexer.rb
require 'ruby-stemmer'
require 'stopwords/filter'

class ProductIndexer
  def initialize
    @stemmer = Stemmer::Stemmer.new
    @stopwords_filter = Stopwords::Filter.new
  end

  # Main method to process product descriptions
  def process_description(description)
    return [] unless description.is_a?(String)
    
    # Step 1: Tokenize the description
    tokens = tokenize(description)
    
    # Step 2: Remove stop words
    filtered_tokens = remove_stop_words(tokens)
    
    # Step 3: Stem the remaining words
    stemmed_tokens = stem_words(filtered_tokens)
    
    # Step 4: Remove duplicates and return
    stemmed_tokens.uniq
  end

  # Process multiple descriptions at once
  def process_descriptions(descriptions)
    descriptions.map { |desc| process_description(desc) }
  end

  # Create an index with product IDs
  def create_index(products)
    # products should be a hash: { product_id => description }
    index = {}
    
    products.each do |product_id, description|
      index[product_id] = process_description(description)
    end
    
    index
  end

  # Search the index for terms
  def search_index(index, query_terms)
    processed_terms = process_description(query_terms)
    
    results = index.select do |product_id, terms|
      # Find products that contain all processed query terms
      (processed_terms - terms).empty?
    end.keys
    
    results
  end

  private

  def tokenize(text)
    # Convert to lowercase and split into words
    # Remove punctuation and numbers, keep only letters
    text.downcase
        .gsub(/[^a-zA-Z\s]/, ' ')  # Replace non-letters with spaces
        .split                     # Split into words
        .reject(&:empty?)          # Remove empty strings
  end

  def remove_stop_words(tokens)
    @stopwords_filter.filter(tokens)
  end

  def stem_words(tokens)
    tokens.map { |token| @stemmer.stem(token) }
  end
end

# Example usage and demonstration
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Sample product descriptions
  products = {
    1 => "This amazing wireless Bluetooth headphones provide crystal clear sound quality and comfortable fit for all-day listening.",
    2 => "The premium leather wallet features multiple card slots and RFID protection for secure storage.",
    3 => "High-performance running shoes with advanced cushioning technology for maximum comfort during exercise.",
    4 => "Organic cotton t-shirt made from sustainable materials, perfect for everyday wear."
  }

  # Create indexer instance
  indexer = ProductIndexer.new

  # Process a single description
  sample_description = "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
  puts "Original: #{sample_description}"
  puts "Processed: #{indexer.process_description(sample_description).join(', ')}"
  puts "\n"

  # Create and display the full index
  index = indexer.create_index(products)
  puts "Product Index:"
  index.each do |product_id, terms|
    puts "Product #{product_id}: #{terms.join(', ')}"
  end
  puts "\n"

  # Search example
  query = "comfortable headphones"
  results = indexer.search_index(index, query)
  puts "Search results for '#{query}': Products #{results.join(', ')}"
end
```

## Additional utility class for batch processing

```ruby
# batch_product_processor.rb
require_relative 'product_indexer'

class BatchProductProcessor
  def initialize
    @indexer = ProductIndexer.new
  end

  # Process products from a CSV file
  def process_from_csv(file_path, id_column: 'id', description_column: 'description')
    require 'csv'
    
    products = {}
    CSV.foreach(file_path, headers: true) do |row|
      products[row[id_column]] = row[description_column]
    end
    
    @indexer.create_index(products)
  end

  # Export index to JSON file
  def export_index_to_json(index, file_path)
    require 'json'
    
    # Convert arrays to space-separated strings for better readability
    export_data = index.transform_values { |terms| terms.join(' ') }
    
    File.write(file_path, JSON.pretty_generate(export_data))
  end

  # Load index from JSON file
  def load_index_from_json(file_path)
    require 'json'
    
    data = JSON.parse(File.read(file_path))
    data.transform_values { |terms| terms.split(' ') }
  end
end
```

## Key Features:

1. **Gem Dependencies**: Uses `ruby-stemmer` for stemming and `stopwords-filter` for removing common English stop words.

2. **Text Processing Pipeline**:
   - Tokenization (splitting into words)
   - Stop word removal
   - Stemming (reducing words to root form)

4. **Batch Processing**: Handles multiple products efficiently.

5. **Flexible Input**: Works with various text formats and can be extended for CSV/JSON processing.

The stemming process converts words like "running", "runs", "ran" to their root form "run", making the index more effective for search operations. Stop words like "the", "and", "is" are removed as they don't add meaningful search value.

```ruby
# nova_poshta_sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class NovaPoshtaSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
  end

  # Send SMS notification to customer
  def send_delivery_notification(phone_number, message, options = {})
    # Format phone number to Ukrainian format if needed
    formatted_phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "sms",
      calledMethod: "save",
      methodProperties: {
        Recipients: [formatted_phone],
        MessageType: options[:message_type] || "orderDelivery",
        Sender: options[:sender] || "NovaPoshta",
        Text: message,
        DateTime: options[:schedule_time] || Time.now.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S")
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check SMS status
  def check_sms_status(message_id)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "sms",
      calledMethod: "getStatus",
      methodProperties: {
        MessageId: message_id
      }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get SMS balance
  def get_balance
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "sms",
      calledMethod: "getBalance"
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Remove all non-digit characters
    clean_phone = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Format as +380XXXXXXXXX
    if clean_phone.length == 12 && clean_phone.start_with?('380')
      "+#{clean_phone}"
    elsif clean_phone.length == 10 && clean_phone.start_with?('0')
      "+38#{clean_phone}"
    elsif clean_phone.length == 9
      "+380#{clean_phone}"
    else
      phone # Return as-is if format is unclear
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if json_response["success"]
        {
          success: true,
          data: json_response["data"],
          errors: json_response["errors"],
          warnings: json_response["warnings"]
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          errors: json_response["errors"],
          warnings: json_response["warnings"]
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: ["HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"]
      }
    end
  end
end

class DeliveryNotifier
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @sms_client = NovaPoshtaSMS.new(api_key)
  end

  # Send delivery notification
  def notify_delivery(customer_phone, tracking_number, delivery_date, options = {})
    message = generate_delivery_message(tracking_number, delivery_date, options)
    
    result = @sms_client.send_delivery_notification(
      customer_phone, 
      message, 
      options
    )
    
    if result[:success]
      puts "✅ SMS sent successfully!"
      puts "Message ID: #{result[:data].first['MessageId']}" if result[:data] && result[:data].first
    else
      puts "❌ Failed to send SMS: #{result[:errors].join(', ')}"
    end
    
    result
  end

  # Send package ready for pickup notification
  def notify_package_ready(customer_phone, tracking_number, warehouse_address, options = {})
    message = "Ваше замовлення #{tracking_number} готове до отримання. Адреса: #{warehouse_address}"
    
    @sms_client.send_delivery_notification(
      customer_phone,
      message,
      options.merge(message_type: "orderReadyForPickup")
    )
  end

  # Send delivery status update
  def notify_status_update(customer_phone, tracking_number, status, options = {})
    status_messages = {
      "in_transit" => "Ваше замовлення #{tracking_number} в дорозі",
      "arrived" => "Ваше замовлення #{tracking_number} прибуло у відділення",
      "delivered" => "Ваше замовлення #{tracking_number} доставлено"
    }
    
    message = status_messages[status] || "Статус вашого замовлення #{tracking_number}: #{status}"
    
    @sms_client.send_delivery_notification(
      customer_phone,
      message,
      options
    )
  end

  private

  def generate_delivery_message(tracking_number, delivery_date, options = {})
    if options[:message_template]
      return options[:message_template]
        .gsub('{tracking_number}', tracking_number)
        .gsub('{delivery_date}', delivery_date)
        .gsub('{warehouse}', options[:warehouse] || '')
    end

    # Default message template
    base_message = "Ваше замовлення #{tracking_number}"
    
    if delivery_date
      base_message += " буде доставлено #{delivery_date}"
    end
    
    if options[:warehouse]
      base_message += ". Адреса: #{options[:warehouse]}"
    end
    
    base_message
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class NovaPoshtaSmsSender
  def initialize(api_key = nil, base_url = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    @base_url = base_url || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_BASE_URL']
    
    validate_configuration
  end

  # Основний метод для надсилання SMS сповіщення
  def send_delivery_notification(phone_number, tracking_number, message_options = {})
    phone = format_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    default_message = "Ваше замовлення #{tracking_number} доставлено. Нова Пошта"
    message = message_options[:custom_message] || default_message
    
    send_sms(phone, message, tracking_number)
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу доставки та надсилання сповіщення
  def check_and_notify(tracking_number, phone_number)
    status = get_delivery_status(tracking_number)
    
    if status == 'delivered'
      send_delivery_notification(phone_number, tracking_number)
      { success: true, status: status, message: 'SMS сповіщення надіслано' }
    else
      { success: false, status: status, message: "Замовлення ще не доставлено. Поточний статус: #{status}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_configuration
    raise "API ключ не знайдено. Встановіть NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY у змінні оточення" unless @api_key
    raise "Базовий URL не знайдено. Встановіть NOVA_POSHTA_BASE_URL у змінні оточення" unless @base_url
  end

  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Приведення номера телефону до потрібного формату
    phone.gsub!(/\s+/, '')
    phone = "38#{phone}" if phone.start_with?('0')
    phone
  end

  def send_sms(phone, message, tracking_number)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "SMS",
      calledMethod: "save",
      methodProperties: {
        Sender: "NovaPoshta",
        DateTime: Time.now.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S"),
        PhoneNumber: phone,
        Message: message,
        OrderNumber: tracking_number
      }
    }

    response = RestClient.post(@base_url, request_body.to_json, {
      content_type: :json,
      accept: :json
    })

    handle_response(JSON.parse(response.body))
  end

  def get_delivery_status(tracking_number)
    request_body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: "TrackingDocument",
      calledMethod: "getStatusDocuments",
      methodProperties: {
        Documents: [
          {
            DocumentNumber: tracking_number
          }
        ]
      }
    }

    response = RestClient.post(@base_url, request_body.to_json, {
      content_type: :json,
      accept: :json
    })

    result = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if result['success']
      result['data'].first['Status'] rescue 'unknown'
    else
      'error'
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response['success']
      {
        success: true,
        data: response['data'],
        message: 'SMS успішно надіслано'
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: response['errors'],
        message: 'Помилка при надсиланні SMS'
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative '../lib/nova_poshta_sms_sender'

class SmsNotificationService
  def self.notify_customer(order_details)
    sender = NovaPoshtaSmsSender.new
    
    result = sender.send_delivery_notification(
      order_details[:phone],
      order_details[:tracking_number],
      order_details[:message_options] || {}
    )
    
    log_notification(order_details, result)
    result
  end
  
  def self.batch_notify(orders)
    results = []
    
    orders.each do |order|
      result = notify_customer(order)
      results << result.merge(order_id: order[:id])
      
      # Затримка між запитами щоб уникнути лімітів API
      sleep(1) if orders.size > 1
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.log_notification(order_details, result)
    timestamp = Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    status = result[:success] ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILED'
    
    log_message = "[#{timestamp}] #{status} - Order: #{order_details[:tracking_number]}, Phone: #{order_details[:phone]}"
    
    if result[:success]
      puts log_message
    else
      error_msg = result[:errors]&.join(', ') || 'Unknown error'
      puts "#{log_message} - Error: #{error_msg}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'active_record'
require_relative 'models/crm_call'
require_relative 'config/database'

class RingostatWebhookApp < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :port, ENV['PORT'] || 4567
    set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
  end

  before do
    content_type 'application/json'
  end

  # Health check endpoint
  get '/' do
    { status: 'OK', message: 'Ringostat Webhook Receiver is running' }.to_json
  end

  # Ringostat webhook endpoint
  post '/webhook/ringostat/call' do
    begin
      # Verify the request contains JSON data
      request.body.rewind
      webhook_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

      # Log the incoming webhook for debugging
      logger.info "Received Ringostat webhook: #{webhook_data.inspect}"

      # Validate required fields
      unless valid_webhook?(webhook_data)
        logger.error "Invalid webhook data: #{webhook_data}"
        status 400
        return { error: 'Invalid webhook data' }.to_json
      end

      # Create CRM call record
      crm_call = CrmCall.from_ringostat_webhook(webhook_data)

      if crm_call.save
        logger.info "Call logged successfully: #{crm_call.call_id}"
        status 201
        { 
          status: 'success', 
          message: 'Call logged successfully',
          call_id: crm_call.call_id 
        }.to_json
      else
        logger.error "Failed to save call: #{crm_call.errors.full_messages}"
        status 422
        { 
          status: 'error', 
          message: 'Failed to save call',
          errors: crm_call.errors.full_messages 
        }.to_json
      end

    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      logger.error "JSON parse error: #{e.message}"
      status 400
      { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Unexpected error: #{e.message}"
      status 500
      { error: 'Internal server error' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Endpoint to view recent calls (for debugging)
  get '/calls' do
```

```ruby
require_relative '../config/database'

class Call < Sequel::Model
  plugin :timestamps, update_on_create: true
  
  def validate
    super
    errors.add(:call_id, 'не може бути порожнім') if call_id.nil? || call_id.empty?
  end
  
  def self.create_from_webhook(data)
    # Перевіряємо, чи дзвінок вже існує
    existing_call = Call[call_id: data['call_id']]
    return existing_call if existing_call
    
    create(
      call_id: data['call_id'],
      caller_number: data['caller_number'],
      called_number: data['called_number'],
      call_status: data['call_status'],
      direction: data['direction'],
      start_time: parse_datetime(data['start_time']),
      end_time: parse_datetime(data['end_time']),
      duration: data['duration'],
      recording_url: data['recording_url'],
      source: data['source'],
      campaign_name: data['campaign_name'],
      visitor_id: data['visitor_id'],
      ip_address: data['ip_address'],
      user_agent: data['user_agent'],
      tags: data['tags']&.join(','),
      cost: data['cost']
    )
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.parse_datetime(datetime_str)
    return nil unless datetime_str
    DateTime.parse(datetime_str)
  rescue ArgumentError
    nil
  end
end
```

### services/ringostat_webhook_service.rb

```ruby
require 'json'
require_relative '../models/call'

class RingostatWebhookService
  def initialize(webhook_data)
    @data = webhook_data.is_a?(String) ? JSON.parse(webhook_data) : webhook_data
  end
  
  def process
    # Валідація базових полів
    return error_response('Некоректні дані вебхука') unless valid_data?
    
    begin
      # Створюємо або оновлюємо запис дзвінка
      call = Call.create_from_webhook(normalized_data)
      
      if call.valid?
        success_response(call)
      else
        error_response("Помилка валідації: #{call.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}")
      end
    rescue => e
      error_response("Помилка обробки: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def valid_data?
    @data && @data['call_id'] && @data['call_status']
  end
  
  def normalized_data
    {
      'call_id' => @data['call_id'],
      'caller_number' => @data['caller_number'] || @data['caller'],
      'called_number' => @data['called_number'] || @data['called'],
      'call_status' => @data['call_status'],
      'direction' => @data['direction'] || 'inbound',
      'start_time' => @data['start_time'] || @data['timestamp'],
      'end_time' => @data['end_time'],
      'duration' => @data['duration'],
      'recording_url' => @data['recording_url'],
      'source' => @data['source'],
      'campaign_name' => @data['campaign_name'] || @data['campaign'],
      'visitor_id' => @data['visitor_id'],
      'ip_address' => @data['ip_address'],
      'user_agent' => @data['user_agent'],
      'tags' => @data['tags'],
      'cost' => @data['cost']
    }
  end
  
  def success_response(call)
    {
      success: true,
      call_id: call.call_id,
      message: 'Дзвінок успішно записано',
      call: call.values
    }
  end
  
  def error_response(message)
    {
      success: false,
      error: message
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'

  end
```

```ruby
      "#{(distance_in_seconds / 3600).round} hours ago"
    when 86400..604799
      "#{(distance_in_seconds / 86400).round} days ago"
    when 604800..2591999
      "#{(distance_in_seconds / 604800).round} weeks ago"
    when 2592000..31535999
      "#{(distance_in_seconds / 2592000).round} months ago"
    else
      "#{(distance_in_seconds / 31536000).round} years ago"
    end
  end
  
  # Alternative implementation using ActiveSupport's built-in method
  def self.time_ago_in_words(from_time, to_time = Time.now)
    "#{from_time.to_fs(:time_ago_in_words)} ago"
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Pluralization examples
  puts "Pluralization examples:"
  puts "cat -> #{TextProcessor.pluralize('cat')}" # cats
  puts "cats -> #{TextProcessor.singularize('cats')}" # cat
  puts "1 cat -> #{TextProcessor.pluralize('cat', 1)}" # cat
  puts "2 cat -> #{TextProcessor.pluralize('cat', 2)}" # cats
  puts "child -> #{TextProcessor.pluralize('child')}" # children
  puts "person -> #{TextProcessor.pluralize('person')}" # people
  puts "ox -> #{TextProcessor.pluralize('ox')}" # oxen
  
  puts "\n" + "="*50 + "\n"
  
  # Time ago examples
  puts "Time ago examples:"
  now = Time.now
  
  # Test various time differences
  test_times = [
    now - 30,           # 30 seconds ago
    now - 90,           # 1.5 minutes ago
    now - 3600,         # 1 hour ago
    now - 7200,         # 2 hours ago
    now - 86400,        # 1 day ago
    now - 172800,       # 2 days ago
    now - 604800,       # 1 week ago
    now - 2592000,      # 1 month ago
    now - 31536000      # 1 year ago
  ]
  
  test_times.each do |time|
    puts "#{time}: #{TextProcessor.time_ago(time, now)}"
  end
  
  puts "\nUsing ActiveSupport's built-in method:"
  test_times.each do |time|
    puts "#{time}: #{TextProcessor.time_ago_in_words(time, now)}"
  end
end
```

This implementation provides:

1. **Pluralization and Singularization** using ActiveSupport's inflector which handles irregular nouns and complex pluralization rules.

2. **Time Ago Strings** in two ways:
   - Custom implementation that breaks down time into appropriate units (seconds, minutes, hours, etc.)
   - Using ActiveSupport's built-in `time_ago_in_words` method which provides more natural language output

```ruby
# spell_checker.rb
require 'hunspell'
require 'colorize'
require 'thor'

class SpellChecker
  def initialize(language: 'en_US', dictionary_path: nil)
    @dictionary_path = dictionary_path || find_dictionary_path
    @hunspell = Hunspell.new(@dictionary_path, language)
  end

  def check_text(text)
    words = extract_words(text)
    misspelled_words = []
    
    words.each do |word|
      unless @hunspell.check(word)
        suggestions = @hunspell.suggest(word)
        misspelled_words << {
          word: word,
          suggestions: suggestions,
          context: get_word_context(text, word)
        }
      end
    end
    
    misspelled_words
  end

  def suggest_corrections(word)
    @hunspell.suggest(word)
  end

  def correct_text(text)
    words = extract_words(text)
    corrected_text = text.dup
    
    words.each do |word|
      unless @hunspell.check(word)
        suggestions = @hunspell.suggest(word)
        if suggestions.any?
          # Замінюємо перше входження слова з урахуванням регістру
          corrected_text.gsub!(/\b#{Regexp.escape(word)}\b/i) do |match|
            suggestions.first
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    corrected_text
  end

  private

  def extract_words(text)
    text.scan(/[a-zA-Z]+(?:'[a-zA-Z]+)?/).map(&:downcase).uniq
  end

  def get_word_context(text, word, context_size: 3)
    words_in_text = text.split(/\b/)
    index = words_in_text.index { |w| w.downcase == word.downcase }
    
    return word unless index
    
    start_index = [0, index - context_size].max
    end_index = [words_in_text.length - 1, index + context_size].min
    
    context_words = words_in_text[start_index..end_index]
    context_words.join('')
  end

  def find_dictionary_path
    # Спроба знайти шлях до словників Hunspell в типових місцях
    possible_paths = [
      '/usr/share/hunspell',
      '/usr/local/share/hunspell',
      '/opt/local/share/hunspell',
      "#{Dir.home}/.local/share/hunspell"
    ]
    
    path = possible_paths.find { |p| File.directory?(p) }
    raise "Hunspell dictionaries not found. Please install hunspell and English dictionary." unless path
    
    path
  end
end

class SpellCheckerCLI < Thor
  desc "check FILE", "Check spelling in a file"
  option :language, default: 'en_US', desc: "Language code for dictionary"
  option :auto_correct, type: :boolean, desc: "Automatically correct misspelled words"
  
  def check(file_path)
    unless File.exist?(file_path)
      puts "Error: File '#{file_path}' not found.".red
      exit 1
    end
    
    text = File.read(file_path)
    checker = SpellChecker.new(language: options[:language])
    
    if options[:auto_correct]
      corrected_text = checker.correct_text(text)
      output_file = "#{File.basename(file_path, '.*')}_corrected#{File.extname(file_path)}"
      File.write(output_file, corrected_text)
      puts "Corrected text saved to: #{output_file}".green
    else
      misspelled_words = checker.check_text(text)
      display_results(misspelled_words, text)
    end
  end
  
  desc "interactive", "Interactive spell checking mode"
  option :language, default: 'en_US', desc: "Language code for dictionary"
  
  def interactive
    checker = SpellChecker.new(language: options[:language])
    
    puts "Interactive Spell Checker".green
    puts "Type 'quit' to exit, 'check' to check entered text"
    puts "-" * 50
    
    loop do
      print "Enter text to check: ".blue
      input = gets.chomp
      
      case input.downcase
      when 'quit', 'exit'
        break
      when 'check'
        print "Enter text to check: ".blue
        text = gets.chomp
        process_text(checker, text)
      else
        process_text(checker, input)
      end
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_text(checker, text)
    misspelled_words = checker.check_text(text)
    
    if misspelled_words.empty?
      puts "✓ No spelling errors found!".green
    else
      display_results(misspelled_words, text)
    end
  end
  
  def display_results(misspelled_words, original_text)
    puts "\nSpelling Check Results:".yellow
    puts "=" * 50
    
    misspelled_words.each_with_index do |error, index|
      puts "#{index + 1}. Misspelled word: #{error[:word].red}"
      puts "   Context: ...#{error[:context]}..."
      
      if error[:suggestions].any?
        puts "   Suggestions:".blue
        error[:suggestions].first(5).each_with_index do |suggestion, i|
          puts "     #{i + 1}. #{suggestion.green}"
        end
      else
        puts "   No suggestions available".yellow
      end
      puts
    end
    
    puts "Total misspelled words: #{misspelled_words.count}".yellow
  end
end

# Якщо файл запущено безпосередньо

    puts "macOS: brew install hunspell && brew install hunspell-dict-en-us"

  end
end
```

```ruby
class SlugGenerator
  def self.generate(title, separator: '-')
    return '' if title.nil? || title.empty?
    
    # Перетворення до нижнього регістру
    slug = Unicode.downcase(title.to_s)
    
    # Заміна діакритичних символів
    slug = slug.gsub(/[àáâãäåāăą]/, 'a')
               .gsub(/[çćĉč]/, 'c')
               .gsub(/[ďđ]/, 'd')
               .gsub(/[èéêëēĕėęě]/, 'e')
               .gsub(/[ĝğġģ]/, 'g')
               .gsub(/[ĥħ]/, 'h')
               .gsub(/[ìíîïĩīĭįı]/, 'i')
               .gsub(/[ĵ]/, 'j')
               .gsub(/[ķĸ]/, 'k')
               .gsub(/[łľļŀ]/, 'l')
               .gsub(/[ñńņňŉŋ]/, 'n')
               .gsub(/[òóôõöøōŏő]/, 'o')
               .gsub(/[ŕŗř]/, 'r')
               .gsub(/[śŝşšș]/, 's')
               .gsub(/[ţťŧț]/, 't')
               .gsub(/[ùúûüũūŭůűų]/, 'u')
               .gsub(/[ŵ]/, 'w')
               .gsub(/[ýÿŷ]/, 'y')
               .gsub(/[źżž]/, 'z')
    
    # Видалення спеціальних символів, залишаємо лише літери, цифри та пробіли
    slug = slug.gsub(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/, '')
    
    # Заміна пробілів та дефісів на роздільник

    slug
  end
```

```ruby
# number_to_words.rb
require 'humanize'

def number_to_english_words(number)
  # Перевірка на нуль
  return 'zero' if number == 0
  
  # Перевірка на від'ємне число
  if number < 0
    return "negative #{number_to_english_words(-number)}"
  end
  
  # Використання гему humanize для перетворення
  number.humanize
end

# Альтернативна реалізація без використання гему
class NumberToWordsConverter
  ONES = %w[zero one two three four five six seven eight nine]
  TEENS = %w[ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen]
  TENS = %w[zero ten twenty thirty forty fifty sixty seventy eighty ninety]
  THOUSANDS = ['', 'thousand', 'million', 'billion', 'trillion']

  def self.convert(number)
    return ONES[0] if number == 0
    
    if number < 0
      return "negative #{convert(-number)}"
    end
    
    result = ''
    thousand_index = 0
    
    while number > 0
      if number % 1000 != 0
        part = convert_hundreds(number % 1000)
        result = "#{part} #{THOUSANDS[thousand_index]} #{result}".strip
      end
      
      number /= 1000
      thousand_index += 1
    end
    
    result.strip
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.convert_hundreds(number)
    return '' if number == 0
    
    result = ''
    
    # Сотні
    if number >= 100
      result += "#{ONES[number / 100]} hundred"
      number %= 100
      result += ' ' if number > 0
    end
    
    # Десятки та одиниці
    if number >= 20
      result += TENS[number / 10]
      if number % 10 > 0
        result += "-#{ONES[number % 10]}"
      end
    elsif number >= 10
      result += TEENS[number - 10]
    elsif number > 0
      result += ONES[number]
    end
    
    result
  end
end

  [0, 1, 12, 123, 1234, 12345, 123456, 1234567, -1234].each do |num|
    puts "#{num} => #{number_to_english_words(num)}"
```

```ruby
require 'classifier-reborn'
require 'treat'
require 'stopwords-filter'

class SentimentAnalyzer
  def initialize
    # Ініціалізація класифікатора з алгоритмом Bayesian
    @classifier = ClassifierReborn::Bayes.new(
      'positive', 
      'negative', 
      'neutral'
    )
    
    # Завантаження стоп-слів англійською
    @stopwords_filter = Stopwords::Filter.new Stopwords::Snowball::WordList.new(:en)
    
    # Попередньо навчений набір даних
    train_classifier
  end
  
  def analyze(text)
    # Очищення тексту
    cleaned_text = preprocess_text(text)
    
    # Класифікація
    classification = @classifier.classify(cleaned_text)
    
    # Отримання балів для кожної категорії
    scores = {
      positive: @classifier.classify_with_score(cleaned_text, 'positive'),
      negative: @classifier.classify_with_score(cleaned_text, 'negative'),
      neutral: @classifier.classify_with_score(cleaned_text, 'neutral')
    }
    
    {
      sentiment: classification,
      confidence: scores[classification.to_sym],
      scores: scores
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Приведення до нижнього регістру
    text = text.downcase
    
    # Видалення спеціальних символів та цифр
    text = text.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z\s]/, '')
    
    # Токенізація
    words = text.split(/\s+/)
    
    # Видалення стоп-слів
    filtered_words = @stopwords_filter.filter(words)
    
    # Повернення обробленого тексту
    filtered_words.join(' ')
  end
  
  def train_classifier
    # Навчання на базових прикладах
    positive_examples = [
      "This product is amazing and works perfectly",
      "Excellent quality and fast delivery",
      "I love this product, it's fantastic",
      "Highly recommended, great value for money",
      "Outstanding performance and durability",
      "Perfect solution for my needs",
      "Excellent customer service",
      "Very satisfied with this purchase",
      "Works exactly as described",
      "Great product at a reasonable price"
    ]
    
    negative_examples = [
      "Terrible product, stopped working after one day",
      "Poor quality and bad customer service",
      "I hate this product, it's useless",
      "Waste of money, don't buy this",
      "Broken upon arrival, very disappointed",
      "Does not work as advertised",
      "Poor construction and materials",
      "Very unhappy with this purchase",
      "Failed after just one week of use",
      "Slow and inefficient product"
    ]
    
    neutral_examples = [
      "The product arrived on time",
      "It is a standard product with basic features",
      "The item was delivered as expected",
      "Average product for everyday use",
      "Nothing special but gets the job done",
      "Standard quality for the price",
      "The product functions normally",
      "Basic features without any surprises",
      "Regular product with no issues",
      "Typical performance for this category"
    ]
    
    # Навчання класифікатора
    positive_examples.each { |example| @classifier.train_positive(preprocess_text(example)) }
    negative_examples.each { |example| @classifier.train_negative(preprocess_text(example)) }
    neutral_examples.each { |example| @classifier.train_neutral(preprocess_text(example)) }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class TimeFormatter
  # Словник для перетворення одиниць часу на ключі локалізації
  TIME_UNITS = {
    second: :seconds,
    minute: :minutes,
    hour: :hours,
    day: :days,
    week: :weeks,
    month: :months,
    year: :years
  }.freeze

  def self.time_ago(duration)
    # Конвертуємо duration в секунди, якщо це ActiveSupport::Duration
    total_seconds = duration.is_a?(ActiveSupport::Duration) ? duration.to_i : duration.to_f
    
    # Знаходимо найбільшу підходящу одиницю часу
    unit_pair = find_appropriate_unit(total_seconds)
    return I18n.t('time.just_now') if unit_pair.nil?
    
    value, unit = unit_pair
    I18n.t('time.ago', count: value, unit: I18n.t("time.units.#{unit}", count: value))
  end

  private

  def self.find_appropriate_unit(total_seconds)
    units_in_seconds = {
      year: 365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60,
      month: 30.44 * 24 * 60 * 60,
      week: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
      day: 24 * 60 * 60,
      hour: 60 * 60,
      minute: 60,
      second: 1
    }

    units_in_seconds.each do |unit, seconds_in_unit|
      value = (total_seconds / seconds_in_unit).round
      return [value, TIME_UNITS[unit]] if value >= 1
    end
    
    nil # для дуже малих значень (менше 1 секунди)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# sentiment_analyzer.rb
require 'bundler/setup'
require 'sentimental'
require 'classifier-reborn'
require 'stopwords-filter'

class ProductReviewSentimentAnalyzer
  attr_reader :analyzer, :bayes_classifier, :filters
  
  def initialize
    setup_sentimental_analyzer
    setup_bayes_classifier
    setup_filters
  end
  
  def setup_sentimental_analyzer
    @analyzer = Sentimental.new
    @analyzer.load_defaults
    @analyzer.threshold = 0.1 # Adjust sensitivity for neutral classification
  end
  
  def setup_bayes_classifier
    # Initialize with sample training data
    @bayes_classifier = ClassifierReborn::Bayes.new(
      'positive', 
      'negative', 
      'neutral'
    )
    
    # Basic training data
    train_classifier_with_sample_data
  end
  
  def setup_filters
    @filters = Stopwords::Filter.new
  end
  
  def train_classifier_with_sample_data
    # Positive examples
    positive_samples = [
      "This product is amazing and works perfectly!",
      "Excellent quality and fast shipping.",
      "I love this product, it exceeded my expectations.",
      "Highly recommended, great value for money.",
      "Outstanding performance and durable build."
    ]
    
    # Negative examples  
    negative_samples = [
      "Terrible product, stopped working after one day.",
      "Poor quality and not worth the money.",
      "I hate this product, complete waste of money.",
      "Very disappointed with the performance.",
      "Defective item, would not recommend."
    ]
    
    # Neutral examples
    neutral_samples = [
      "The product arrived on time as expected.",
      "It does what it's supposed to do.",
      "Average product, nothing special.",
      "The packaging was adequate.",
      "Standard features and functionality."
    ]
    
    # Train the classifier
    positive_samples.each { |sample| @bayes_classifier.train_positive(sample) }
    negative_samples.each { |sample| @bayes_classifier.train_negative(sample) }
    neutral_samples.each { |sample| @bayes_classifier.train_neutral(sample) }
  end
  
  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Convert to lowercase and remove special characters
    cleaned_text = text.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9\s]/i, ' ')
    
    # Remove stopwords
    words = cleaned_text.split
    filtered_words = @filters.filter(words)
    
    filtered_words.join(' ')
  end
  
  def analyze_sentiment(review_text)
    return :neutral if review_text.nil? || review_text.strip.empty?
    
    # Preprocess the text
    processed_text = preprocess_text(review_text)
    
    # Get sentiment from sentimental gem
    sentimental_result = @analyzer.sentiment(review_text)
    sentimental_score = @analyzer.score(review_text)
    
    # Get classification from Bayes classifier
    bayes_classification = @bayes_classifier.classify(processed_text)
    
    # Combine results for final decision
    final_sentiment = combine_classifications(
      sentimental_result, 
      sentimental_score, 
      bayes_classification
    )
    
    {
      sentiment: final_sentiment,
      confidence: calculate_confidence(sentimental_score, bayes_classification),
      sentimental_result: sentimental_result,
      sentimental_score: sentimental_score,
      bayes_classification: bayes_classification
    }
  end
  
  def combine_classifications(sentimental_result, sentimental_score, bayes_classification)
    # If both methods agree, use that result
    if sentimental_result.to_s == bayes_classification.to_s
      return sentimental_result
    end
    
    # If sentimental has high confidence, prioritize it
    if sentimental_score.abs > 0.3
      return sentimental_result
    end
    
    # Otherwise, use Bayes classifier
    bayes_classification
  end
  
  def calculate_confidence(sentimental_score, bayes_classification)
    # Simple confidence calculation based on sentimental score
    base_confidence = sentimental_score.abs * 100
    
    # Adjust based on agreement between classifiers
    confidence = [base_confidence, 95].min # Cap at 95%
    confidence = [confidence, 10].max # Minimum 10% confidence
    
    confidence.round(2)
  end
  
  def train_with_custom_data(sentiment, samples)
    case sentiment.to_sym
    when :positive
      samples.each { |sample| @bayes_classifier.train_positive(sample) }
    when :negative  
      samples.each { |sample| @bayes_classifier.train_negative(sample) }
    when :neutral
      samples.each { |sample| @bayes_classifier.train_neutral(sample) }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage and testing

  # Test reviews

    "This product is absolutely fantastic! I love it!",

    result = analyzer.analyze_sentiment(review)
    
    puts "Review #{index + 1}: #{review}"
    puts "Sentiment: #{result[:sentiment].to_s.upcase}"
```

```ruby
# batch_sentiment_analyzer.rb
require_relative 'sentiment_analyzer'

class BatchSentimentAnalyzer
  def initialize
    @analyzer = ProductReviewSentimentAnalyzer.new
  end
  
  def analyze_reviews(reviews)
    results = {}
    
    reviews.each_with_index do |review, index|
      results[index] = {
        review: review,
        analysis: @analyzer.analyze_sentiment(review)
      }
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  def sentiment_summary(reviews)
    results = analyze_reviews(reviews)
    summary = { positive: 0, negative: 0, neutral: 0 }
    
    results.each do |_, data|
      sentiment = data[:analysis][:sentiment]
      summary[sentiment] += 1
    end
    
    total = reviews.size.to_f
    summary.transform_values { |count| ((count / total) * 100).round(2) }
  end
end

# Example batch usage

    "Terrible customer service and defective product."
  ]
  
  puts "Batch Sentiment Analysis:"
  puts "=" * 30
  
  summary = batch_analyzer.sentiment_summary(product_reviews)
  summary.each do |sentiment, percentage|
    puts "#{sentiment.to_s.capitalize}: #{percentage}%"
  end
end
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# language_detector.rb
require 'cld3'
require 'whatlanguage'
require 'fasttext'
require 'stopwords-filter'

class LanguageDetector
  def initialize
    @cld3_detector = CLD3::NNetLanguageIdentifier.new(1, 2048)
    @wl_detector = WhatLanguage.new(:all)
    setup_fasttext
  end

  def detect(comment)
    return nil if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?

    # Clean and preprocess the text
    cleaned_text = preprocess_text(comment)
    
    # Get results from all detectors
    results = {
      cld3: detect_with_cld3(cleaned_text),
      whatlanguage: detect_with_whatlanguage(cleaned_text),
      fasttext: detect_with_fasttext(cleaned_text)
    }
    
    # Return consensus or best guess
    determine_consensus(results, cleaned_text)
  end

  def detect_batch(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| detect(comment) }
  end

  private

  def setup_fasttext
    # FastText requires a pre-trained model
    # You'll need to download a model file like lid.176.bin
    model_path = ENV['FASTTEXT_MODEL_PATH'] || './lid.176.bin'
    
    if File.exist?(model_path)
      @fasttext_model = FastText::Model.new(model_path)
    else
      puts "Warning: FastText model not found at #{model_path}. FastText detection will be unavailable."
      @fasttext_model = nil
    end
  end

  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Remove extra whitespace and normalize
    text = text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
    
    # Remove URLs
    text = text.gsub(/https?:\/\/\S+/, '')
    
    # Remove special characters but keep accented characters for language detection
    text = text.gsub(/[^\p{L}\p{M}\s\.\?!,]/, '')
    
    text.strip
  end

  def detect_with_cld3(text)
    return nil if text.length < 3
    
    result = @cld3_detector.find_language(text)
    return nil unless result
    
    {
      language: result.language,
      probability: result.probability,
      reliable: result.reliable?
    }
  end

  def detect_with_whatlanguage(text)
    return nil if text.length < 3
    
    result = @wl_detector.language(text)
    return nil unless result && result != :unknown
    
    # WhatLanguage doesn't provide confidence scores by default
    {
      language: result.to_s,
      probability: 0.8, # Placeholder since WL doesn't provide confidence
      reliable: true
    }
  end

  def detect_with_fasttext(text)
    return nil unless @fasttext_model && text.length >= 3
    
    begin
      prediction = @fasttext_model.predict(text, k: 1)
      return nil if prediction.empty?
      
      lang_code = prediction.first.first.gsub('__label__', '')
      confidence = prediction.first.last
      
      {
        language: fasttext_code_to_language(lang_code),
        probability: confidence,
        reliable: confidence > 0.7
      }
    rescue => e
      puts "FastText error: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def fasttext_code_to_language(code)
    # Map FastText language codes to standard language names
    language_map = {
      'af' => 'afrikaans', 'ar' => 'arabic', 'bg' => 'bulgarian', 'bn' => 'bengali',
      'ca' => 'catalan', 'cs' => 'czech', 'cy' => 'welsh', 'da' => 'danish',
      'de' => 'german', 'el' => 'greek', 'en' => 'english', 'es' => 'spanish',
      'et' => 'estonian', 'fa' => 'persian', 'fi' => 'finnish', 'fr' => 'french',
      'gu' => 'gujarati', 'he' => 'hebrew', 'hi' => 'hindi', 'hr' => 'croatian',
      'hu' => 'hungarian', 'id' => 'indonesian', 'it' => 'italian', 'ja' => 'japanese',
      'kn' => 'kannada', 'ko' => 'korean', 'lt' => 'lithuanian', 'lv' => 'latvian',
      'mk' => 'macedonian', 'ml' => 'malayalam', 'mr' => 'marathi', 'ne' => 'nepali',
      'nl' => 'dutch', 'no' => 'norwegian', 'pa' => 'punjabi', 'pl' => 'polish',
      'pt' => 'portuguese', 'ro' => 'romanian', 'ru' => 'russian', 'sk' => 'slovak',
      'sl' => 'slovenian', 'so' => 'somali', 'sq' => 'albanian', 'sv' => 'swedish',
      'sw' => 'swahili', 'ta' => 'tamil', 'te' => 'telugu', 'th' => 'thai',
      'tl' => 'tagalog', 'tr' => 'turkish', 'uk' => 'ukrainian', 'ur' => 'urdu',
      'vi' => 'vietnamese', 'zh' => 'chinese'
    }
    
    language_map[code] || code
  end

  def determine_consensus(results, text)
    valid_results = results.values.compact
    
    return { language: 'unknown', confidence: 0.0 } if valid_results.empty?
    
    # If only one detector worked, use its result
    if valid_results.size == 1
      result = valid_results.first
      return {
        language: result[:language],
        confidence: result[:probability],
        method: results.key(valid_results.first)
      }
    end
    
    # Find consensus among detectors
    language_votes = Hash.new(0)
    total_confidence = 0.0
    
    valid_results.each do |result|
      language_votes[result[:language]] += result[:probability]
      total_confidence += result[:probability]
    end
    
    # Get the language with highest weighted vote
    best_language, best_score = language_votes.max_by { |_, score| score }
    average_confidence = best_score / valid_results.size
    
    {
      language: best_language,
      confidence: average_confidence,
      methods: results.select { |k, v| v && v[:language] == best_language }.keys,
      all_results: results
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class SimpleLanguageDetector
  def initialize

  end

  def detect(comment)
    return { language: 'unknown', confidence: 0.0 } if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?
    
    cleaned_text = comment.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
    return { language: 'unknown', confidence: 0.0 } if cleaned_text.length < 3

    if result && result.language != 'un'

        language: result.language,
        confidence: result.probability,
        reliable: result.reliable?
      }
    else
      { language: 'unknown', confidence: 0.0 }
    end
  end
end
```
