## Implementation

```ruby
# pdf_extractor.rb
require 'pdf-reader'
require 'combine_pdf'
require 'zip'
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'

class PDFExtractor
  def initialize(pdf_path)
    @pdf_path = pdf_path
    validate_file
  end

  # Extract all text content from PDF
  def extract_text
    text_content = []
    
    PDF::Reader.open(@pdf_path) do |reader|
      reader.pages.each_with_index do |page, index|
        text_content << {
          page: index + 1,
          text: page.text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
        }
      end
    end
    
    text_content
  rescue => e
    raise "Error extracting text: #{e.message}"
  end

  # Extract tables from PDF using text parsing (basic table detection)
  def extract_tables
    tables = []
    
    PDF::Reader.open(@pdf_path) do |reader|
      reader.pages.each_with_index do |page, index|
        page_text = page.text
        detected_tables = detect_tables(page_text, index + 1)
        tables.concat(detected_tables) if detected_tables.any?
      end
    end
    
    tables
  rescue => e
    raise "Error extracting tables: #{e.message}"
  end

  # Extract both text and tables
  def extract_all
    {
      text: extract_text,
      tables: extract_tables
    }
  end

  # Export extracted data to a new PDF
  def export_to_pdf(output_path, data = nil)
    data ||= extract_all
    
    Prawn::Document.generate(output_path) do |pdf|
      pdf.text "PDF Extraction Report", size: 20, style: :bold, align: :center
      pdf.move_down 20
      
      # Add text content
      pdf.text "Text Content", size: 16, style: :bold
      pdf.move_down 10
      
      data[:text].each do |page_content|
        pdf.text "Page #{page_content[:page]}:", style: :bold
        pdf.text truncate_text(page_content[:text], 500)
        pdf.move_down 10
      end
      
      # Add tables
      if data[:tables].any?
        pdf.start_new_page
        pdf.text "Detected Tables", size: 16, style: :bold
        pdf.move_down 10
        
        data[:tables].each_with_index do |table_data, index|
          pdf.text "Table #{index + 1} (Page #{table_data[:page]}):", style: :bold
          pdf.move_down 5
          
          # Create a simple table representation
          if table_data[:rows].any?
            table_content = [table_data[:headers]] + table_data[:rows]
            pdf.table(table_content, header: true) do
              row(0).font_style = :bold
              row(0).background_color = "f0f0f0"
            end
          end
          
          pdf.move_down 15
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # Save extracted data to text files
  def export_to_text(output_dir)
    data = extract_all
    Dir.mkdir(output_dir) unless Dir.exist?(output_dir)
    
    # Save text content
    File.open(File.join(output_dir, "extracted_text.txt"), "w") do |f|
      data[:text].each do |page_content|
        f.puts "=== Page #{page_content[:page]} ==="
        f.puts page_content[:text]
        f.puts "\n"
      end
    end
    
    # Save tables
    if data[:tables].any?
      File.open(File.join(output_dir, "extracted_tables.txt"), "w") do |f|
        data[:tables].each_with_index do |table_data, index|
          f.puts "=== Table #{index + 1} (Page #{table_data[:page]}) ==="
          
          # Write headers
          f.puts table_data[:headers].join(" | ")
          f.puts "-" * (table_data[:headers].join(" | ").length)
          
          # Write rows
          table_data[:rows].each do |row|
            f.puts row.join(" | ")
          end
          
          f.puts "\n"
        end
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_file
    unless File.exist?(@pdf_path)
      raise "PDF file not found: #{@pdf_path}"
    end
    
    unless File.extname(@pdf_path).downcase == '.pdf'
      raise "File is not a PDF: #{@pdf_path}"
    end
  end

  # Basic table detection algorithm
  def detect_tables(text, page_number)
    tables = []
    lines = text.split("\n").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
    
    # Look for patterns that might indicate tables
    potential_tables = []
    current_table = []
    
    lines.each do |line|
      # Check if line has table-like structure (multiple columns separated by spaces/tabs)
      if line.split(/\s{2,}/).length >= 2 || line.include?("\t")
        current_table << line
      elsif current_table.any?
        # End of table detected
        if current_table.length >= 2 # At least header and one row
          table_data = parse_table_data(current_table)
          tables << { page: page_number, headers: table_data[:headers], rows: table_data[:rows] }
        end
        current_table = []
      end
    end
    
    # Check if we have a table at the end
    if current_table.any? && current_table.length >= 2
      table_data = parse_table_data(current_table)
      tables << { page: page_number, headers: table_data[:headers], rows: table_data[:rows] }
    end
    
    tables
  end

  def parse_table_data(table_lines)
    # Simple table parsing - split by multiple spaces or tabs
    rows = table_lines.map do |line|
      # Split by multiple spaces (2 or more) or tabs
      line.split(/\s{2,}|\t/).map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
    end
    
    # Assume first row is header if we have multiple rows
    if rows.length > 1
      { headers: rows.first, rows: rows[1..-1] }
    else
      { headers: [], rows: rows }
    end
  end

  def truncate_text(text, length)
    if text.length > length
      text[0...length] + "..."
    else
      text
    end
  end
end

# Utility class for batch processing multiple PDFs
class PDFBatchExtractor
  def initialize(input_dir, output_dir)
    @input_dir = input_dir
    @output_dir = output_dir
  end

  def process_all
    pdf_files = Dir.glob(File.join(@input_dir, "*.pdf"))
    
    results = {}
    pdf_files.each do |pdf_file|
      begin
        extractor = PDFExtractor.new(pdf_file)
        filename = File.basename(pdf_file, ".pdf")
        results[filename] = extractor.extract_all
        
        # Create individual output directory for each PDF
        pdf_output_dir = File.join(@output_dir, filename)
        Dir.mkdir(pdf_output_dir) unless Dir.exist?(pdf_output_dir)
        
        # Export results
        extractor.export_to_text(pdf_output_dir)
        extractor.export_to_pdf(File.join(pdf_output_dir, "extraction_report.pdf"))
        
        puts "Processed: #{filename}"
      rescue => e
        puts "Error processing #{pdf_file}: #{e.message}"
        results[filename] = { error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Single PDF extraction example
  puts "PDF Text and Table Extractor"
  puts "=" * 40
  
  if ARGV.length >= 1
    pdf_path = ARGV[0]
    output_dir = ARGV[1] || "output"
    
    begin
      extractor = PDFExtractor.new(pdf_path)
      
      puts "Extracting from: #{pdf_path}"
      
      # Extract all content
      data = extractor.extract_all
      
      puts "Found #{data[:text].length} pages of text"
      puts "Found #{data[:tables].length} tables"
      
      # Export results
      Dir.mkdir(output_dir) unless Dir.exist?(output_dir)
      extractor.export_to_text(output_dir)
      extractor.export_to_pdf(File.join(output_dir, "extraction_report.pdf"))
      
      puts "Results saved to: #{output_dir}"
      
    rescue => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    end
  else
    puts "Usage: ruby pdf_extractor.rb <pdf_file> [output_directory]"
    puts "Example: ruby pdf_extractor.rb document.pdf ./extracted_data"
  end
end
```

```ruby
  # Використання WhatLanguage gem

    begin
      language = @wl_detector.language(text)
      {
        language: language.to_s,
        confidence: calculate_confidence(text, language)
      }
    rescue => e
      { error: "WhatLanguage error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

    # prediction = @fasttext_model.predict(text)
    # { language: prediction.first, probability: prediction.last }
    { note: "FastText requires separate model file" }
  end

  # Консолідація результатів від різних методів
  def consolidate_results(results, text)
    primary_result = results[:cld3]
    
    consolidated = {
      text: text,
      detected_language: primary_result[:language],
      confidence: primary_result[:probability],
      is_reliable: primary_result[:reliable],
      all_results: results,
      text_length: text.length,
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
    }

    # Перевірка узгодженості результатів
    consolidated[:consensus] = check_consensus(results)
    consolidated
  end

  private

  def calculate_confidence(text, language)
    # Проста евристика для whatlanguage
    text.length > 10 ? 0.8 : 0.5
  end

  def check_consensus(results)
    languages = []
    results.each do |method, result|
      languages << result[:language] if result[:language] && !result[:error]
    end
    
    if languages.uniq.length == 1
      "high" # Всі методи дають однаковий результат
    elsif languages.uniq.length == 2
      "medium" # Два методи узгоджуються
    else
      "low" # Результати розходяться
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    puts "-" * 40

    loop do
      print "Enter text to analyze: "
      input = gets.chomp

      break if input.downcase == 'quit'

      if input.empty?
        puts "Please enter some text"
        next
      end

      result = @detector.detect_language(input)
      display_result(result)
      puts "-" * 40
    end

    puts "Goodbye!"
  end

  private

  def display_result(result)
    puts "\nDetection Results:"
    puts "Text: #{result[:text][0..100]}#{'...' if result[:text].length > 100}"
    puts "Detected Language: #{result[:detected_language]}"
    puts "Confidence: #{(result[:confidence] * 100).round(2)}%"
    puts "Reliable: #{result[:is_reliable]}"
    puts "Consensus: #{result[:consensus]}"
    
    puts "\nDetailed Results:"
    result[:all_results].each do |method, method_result|
      puts "  #{method.to_s.upcase}:"
      if method_result[:error]
        puts "    Error: #{method_result[:error]}"
      else
        puts "    Language: #{method_result[:language]}"
        puts "    Probability: #{method_result[:probability]}" if method_result[:probability]
        puts "    Confidence: #{method_result[:confidence]}" if method_result[:confidence]
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# product_translator.rb
require 'deepl'
require 'redis'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ProductTranslator
  CACHE_EXPIRY = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 # 7 днів у секундах

  def initialize(api_key:, redis_url: nil, cache_namespace: 'product_translations')
    @cache_namespace = cache_namespace
    setup_deepl(api_key)
    setup_redis(redis_url)
  end

  # Основний метод для перекладу опису товару
  def translate(product_description, target_lang:, source_lang: nil, product_id: nil)
    return product_description if target_lang.to_s.downcase == 'en' # Якщо цільова мова - англійська, повертаємо оригінал
    
    cache_key = build_cache_key(product_description, target_lang, product_id)
    
    # Спроба отримати з кешу
    cached_translation = get_cached_translation(cache_key)
    return cached_translation if cached_translation

    # Переклад через DeepL
    translated_text = translate_with_deepl(product_description, target_lang, source_lang)
    
    # Збереження в кеш
    cache_translation(cache_key, translated_text)
    
    translated_text
  rescue DeepL::Exceptions::RequestError => e
    puts "Помилка DeepL API: #{e.message}"
    product_description # Повертаємо оригінал у разі помилки
  rescue Redis::BaseError => e
    puts "Помилка Redis: #{e.message}. Виконуємо переклад без кешування."
    translate_with_deepl(product_description, target_lang, source_lang)
  end

  # Масовий переклад для кількох товарів
  def translate_batch(products, target_lang:, source_lang: nil)
    results = {}
    to_translate = []

    products.each do |product_id, description|
      cache_key = build_cache_key(description, target_lang, product_id)
      cached = get_cached_translation(cache_key)
      
      if cached
        results[product_id] = cached
      else
        to_translate << { id: product_id, description: description, cache_key: cache_key }
      end
    end

    # Масовий переклад для товарів, яких немає в кеші
    unless to_translate.empty?
      translations = batch_translate_with_deepl(
        to_translate.map { |item| item[:description] },
        target_lang,
        source_lang
      )

      to_translate.each_with_index do |item, index|
        if translations[index]
          results[item[:id]] = translations[index]
          cache_translation(item[:cache_key], translations[index])
        else
          results[item[:id]] = item[:description] # Повертаємо оригінал у разі помилки
        end
      end
    end

    results
  end

  # Очищення кешу
  def clear_cache
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      keys = redis.keys("#{@cache_namespace}:*")
      redis.del(*keys) unless keys.empty?
    end
  end

  # Статистика кешу
  def cache_stats
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      keys = redis.keys("#{@cache_namespace}:*")
      {
        total_translations: keys.size,
        memory_usage: redis.info['used_memory_human']
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def setup_deepl(api_key)
    DeepL.configure do |config|
      config.auth_key = api_key
      config.host = 'https://api-free.deepl.com' # Використовуйте api.deepl.com для платної версії
      config.version = 'v2'
    end
  end

  def setup_redis(redis_url)
    redis_url ||= ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379/0'
    
    @redis_pool = ConnectionPool.new(size: 5, timeout: 5) do
      Redis.new(url: redis_url)
    end
  end

  def build_cache_key(text, target_lang, product_id = nil)
    key_parts = [Digest::MD5.hexdigest(text.strip.downcase), target_lang.downcase]
    key_parts << product_id.to_s if product_id
    "#{@cache_namespace}:#{key_parts.join(':')}"
  end

  def get_cached_translation(cache_key)
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      cached = redis.get(cache_key)
      JSON.parse(cached) if cached
    end
  end

  def cache_translation(cache_key, translation)
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      redis.setex(cache_key, CACHE_EXPIRY, translation.to_json)
    end
  end

  def translate_with_deepl(text, target_lang, source_lang = nil)
    options = { target_lang: target_lang.upcase }
    options[:source_lang] = source_lang.upcase if source_lang

    DeepL.translate(text, options).text
  end

  def batch_translate_with_deepl(texts, target_lang, source_lang = nil)
    options = { target_lang: target_lang.upcase }
    options[:source_lang] = source_lang.upcase if source_lang

    DeepL.translate(texts, options).map(&:text)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# profanity_filter.rb
require 'obscenity'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Default configuration
  DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    replacement: :default,  # Options: :default, :stars, :vowels, :garbled, or custom character
    blacklist: [],          # Additional custom words to block
    whitelist: []           # Words to allow even if they're in the blacklist
  }.freeze

  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.merge(config)
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Filter a single comment
  def filter(comment)
    return '' if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    # Clean and prepare the text
    cleaned_comment = comment.to_s.dup
    
    # Apply profanity filtering
    Obscenity.sanitize(cleaned_comment)
  end

  # Check if a comment contains profanity
  def profane?(comment)
    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    Obscenity.profane?(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Get the list of profane words found in a comment
  def profane_words(comment)
    return [] if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    Obscenity.offensive(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Replace profanity with custom replacement
  def custom_filter(comment, replacement = '***')
    return '' if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    Obscenity.sanitize(comment.to_s, replacement: replacement)
  end

  # More aggressive filtering with additional custom words
  def aggressive_filter(comment, additional_blacklist = [])
    return '' if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    temp_config = @config.merge(blacklist: additional_blacklist)
    with_custom_config(temp_config) do
      Obscenity.sanitize(comment.to_s)
    end
  end

  # Add words to the blacklist
  def add_to_blacklist(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = (config.blacklist + words).uniq
    end
  end

  # Add words to the whitelist (allow these words)
  def add_to_whitelist(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.whitelist = (config.whitelist + words).uniq
    end
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.replacement = @config[:replacement]
      config.blacklist   = @config[:blacklist] unless @config[:blacklist].empty?
      config.whitelist   = @config[:whitelist] unless @config[:whitelist].empty?
    end
  end

  def with_custom_config(temp_config)
    original_config = @config.dup
    @config = temp_config
    configure_obscenity
    result = yield
    @config = original_config
    configure_obscenity
    result
  end
end

# Example usage and testing
```

```ruby
# comment_processor.rb
require_relative 'profanity_filter'

module CommentProcessor
  class << self
    # Process a batch of comments
    def process_comments(comments, filter_options = {})
      filter = ProfanityFilter.new(filter_options)
      
      comments.map do |comment|
        {
          original: comment,
          filtered: filter.filter(comment),
          contains_profanity: filter.profane?(comment),
          offensive_words: filter.profane_words(comment)
        }
      end
    end
    
    # Generate a moderation report
    def moderation_report(comments, filter_options = {})
      processed = process_comments(comments, filter_options)
      
      {
        total_comments: processed.length,
        clean_comments: processed.count { |c| !c[:contains_profanity] },
        flagged_comments: processed.count { |c| c[:contains_profanity] },
        flagged_percentage: (processed.count { |c| c[:contains_profanity] }.to_f / processed.length * 100).round(2),
        details: processed.select { |c| c[:contains_profanity] }
      }
    end
  end
end
```

Here's a Ruby implementation that translates product descriptions using the DeepL API with caching:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# product_translator.rb
require 'deepl'
require 'redis'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ProductTranslator
  # Supported languages for translation
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = {
    'BG' => 'Bulgarian', 'CS' => 'Czech', 'DA' => 'Danish', 'DE' => 'German',
    'EL' => 'Greek', 'EN' => 'English', 'ES' => 'Spanish', 'ET' => 'Estonian',
    'FI' => 'Finnish', 'FR' => 'French', 'HU' => 'Hungarian', 'IT' => 'Italian',
    'JA' => 'Japanese', 'LT' => 'Lithuanian', 'LV' => 'Latvian', 'NL' => 'Dutch',
    'PL' => 'Polish', 'PT' => 'Portuguese', 'RO' => 'Romanian', 'RU' => 'Russian',
    'SK' => 'Slovak', 'SL' => 'Slovenian', 'SV' => 'Swedish', 'ZH' => 'Chinese'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(api_key:, redis_url: nil, cache_ttl: 86400) # 24 hours default TTL
    @api_key = api_key
    @cache_ttl = cache_ttl
    
    # Initialize DeepL client
    @deepl = DeepL.configure do |config|
      config.auth_key = api_key
      config.host = 'https://api-free.deepl.com' # Use api.deepl.com for paid plans
    end

    # Initialize Redis connection pool for caching
    redis_url ||= ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379'
    @redis_pool = ConnectionPool.new(size: 5, timeout: 5) do
      Redis.new(url: redis_url)
    end
  end

  # Translate a product description to target language
  def translate(product_id, description, target_lang, source_lang: nil, formality: 'default')
    validate_language(target_lang)
    validate_language(source_lang) if source_lang

    cache_key = generate_cache_key(product_id, description, target_lang, source_lang, formality)
    
    # Try to get from cache first
    cached_translation = get_cached_translation(cache_key)
    return cached_translation if cached_translation

    # Translate using DeepL API
    translated_text = call_deepl_api(description, target_lang, source_lang, formality)
    
    # Cache the result
    cache_translation(cache_key, translated_text)
    
    translated_text
  end

  # Batch translate multiple product descriptions
  def translate_batch(translations_data)
    results = {}
    uncached_items = []

    # Separate cached and uncached items
    translations_data.each do |data|
      product_id = data[:product_id]
      description = data[:description]
      target_lang = data[:target_lang]
      source_lang = data[:source_lang]
      formality = data[:formality] || 'default'

      cache_key = generate_cache_key(product_id, description, target_lang, source_lang, formality)
      cached = get_cached_translation(cache_key)
      
      if cached
        results[product_id] = cached
      else
        uncached_items << data.merge(cache_key: cache_key)
      end
    end

    # Process uncached items in batches (DeepL supports up to 50 texts per request)
    uncached_items.each_slice(50) do |batch|
      batch_translations = process_batch_translation(batch)
      
      batch.each_with_index do |item, index|
        translated_text = batch_translations[index]
        cache_translation(item[:cache_key], translated_text)
        results[item[:product_id]] = translated_text
      end
    end

    results
  end

  # Clear cache for specific product or entire cache
  def clear_cache(product_id = nil)
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      if product_id
        # Delete all cache keys for this product
        pattern = "translation:#{product_id}:*"
        keys = redis.keys(pattern)
        redis.del(*keys) unless keys.empty?
      else
        # Clear all translation cache
        keys = redis.keys("translation:*")
        redis.del(*keys) unless keys.empty?
      end
    end
  end

  # Get cache statistics
  def cache_stats
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      pattern = "translation:*"
      keys = redis.keys(pattern)
      {
        total_cached: keys.size,
        memory_usage: redis.info['used_memory_human']
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_language(lang_code)
    return if lang_code.nil? || lang_code.empty?
    
    unless SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.key?(lang_code.upcase)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported language: #{lang_code}. Supported languages: #{SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.keys.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def generate_cache_key(product_id, description, target_lang, source_lang, formality)
    # Create a unique key based on the content and parameters
    content_hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(description.to_s)
    "translation:#{product_id}:#{content_hash}:#{target_lang}:#{source_lang}:#{formality}"
  end

  def get_cached_translation(cache_key)
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      cached = redis.get(cache_key)
      cached ? JSON.parse(cached) : nil
    end
  rescue Redis::BaseError => e
    puts "Redis error: #{e.message}. Continuing without cache."
    nil
  end

  def cache_translation(cache_key, translation)
    @redis_pool.with do |redis|
      redis.setex(cache_key, @cache_ttl, translation.to_json)
    end
  rescue Redis::BaseError => e
    puts "Redis caching error: #{e.message}"
  end

  def call_deepl_api(text, target_lang, source_lang, formality)
    options = { formality: formality }
    options[:source_lang] = source_lang if source_lang

    DeepL.translate(text, target_lang.upcase, options).text
  rescue DeepL::Exceptions::RequestError => e
    raise "DeepL API error: #{e.message}"
  rescue DeepL::Exceptions::AuthorizationFailed => e
    raise "DeepL authorization failed: #{e.message}"
  end

  def process_batch_translation(batch_items)
    texts = batch_items.map { |item| item[:description] }
    target_lang = batch_items.first[:target_lang]
    source_lang = batch_items.first[:source_lang]
    formality = batch_items.first[:formality]

    options = { formality: formality }
    options[:source_lang] = source_lang if source_lang

    translations = DeepL.translate(texts, target_lang.upcase, options)
    translations.map(&:text)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# company_matcher.rb
require 'fuzzy_match'
require 'amatch'
require 'csv'

class CompanyMatcher
  attr_reader :companies, :levenshtein, :jaro_winkler
  
  def initialize(company_list)
    @companies = company_list
    @levenshtein = Amatch::Levenshtein.new('')
    @jaro_winkler = Amatch::JaroWinkler.new('')
  end
  
  # Find the closest match for a given company name
  def find_best_match(company_name, threshold: 0.8, algorithm: :jaro_winkler)
    best_match = nil
    best_score = 0
    
    @companies.each do |candidate|
      score = calculate_similarity(company_name, candidate, algorithm)
      
      if score > best_score && score >= threshold
        best_score = score
        best_match = candidate
      end
    end
    
    { match: best_match, score: best_score, algorithm: algorithm }
  end
  
  # Find all matches above a certain threshold
  def find_all_matches(company_name, threshold: 0.7, algorithm: :jaro_winkler)
    matches = []
    
    @companies.each do |candidate|
      score = calculate_similarity(company_name, candidate, algorithm)
      
      if score >= threshold && candidate != company_name
        matches << { company: candidate, score: score }
      end
    end
    
    matches.sort_by { |m| -m[:score] }
  end
  
  # Compare two companies using both algorithms
  def compare_companies(company1, company2)
    {
      levenshtein_distance: levenshtein_distance(company1, company2),
      levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_similarity(company1, company2),
      jaro_winkler_similarity: jaro_winkler_similarity(company1, company2),
      normalized_levenshtein: normalized_levenshtein(company1, company2)
    }
  end
  
  # Batch match two lists of companies
  def batch_match(company_list_a, company_list_b, threshold: 0.8, algorithm: :jaro_winkler)
    matches = []
    
    company_list_a.each do |company_a|
      best_match = find_best_match(company_a, threshold: threshold, algorithm: algorithm)
      
      if best_match[:match]
        matches << {
          company_a: company_a,
          company_b: best_match[:match],
          score: best_match[:score],
          algorithm: algorithm
        }
      end
    end
    
    matches.sort_by { |m| -m[:score] }
  end
  
  private
  
  def calculate_similarity(str1, str2, algorithm)
    case algorithm
    when :levenshtein
      levenshtein_similarity(str1, str2)
    when :jaro_winkler
      jaro_winkler_similarity(str1, str2)
    when :normalized_levenshtein
      normalized_levenshtein(str1, str2)
    else
      jaro_winkler_similarity(str1, str2)
    end
  end
  
  def levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    # Using Amatch gem's Levenshtein distance
    @levenshtein.match = str1
    @levenshtein.distance(str2)
  end
  
  def levenshtein_similarity(str1, str2)
    # Convert distance to similarity (0-1 scale, where 1 is identical)
    distance = levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    max_length = [str1.length, str2.length].max.to_f
    max_length == 0 ? 1.0 : (1 - distance / max_length)
  end
  
  def normalized_levenshtein(str1, str2)
    # Alternative normalization
    distance = levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    max_length = [str1.length, str2.length].max.to_f
    max_length == 0 ? 1.0 : (1 - distance / max_length)
  end
  
  def jaro_winkler_similarity(str1, str2)
    # Using Amatch gem's Jaro-Winkler similarity (returns value between 0-1)
    @jaro_winkler.match = str1
    @jaro_winkler.similar(str2)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# tfidf_analyzer.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'unicode_utils'

class TFIDFAnalyzer
  attr_reader :documents, :vocabulary, :tfidf_matrix, :idf
  
  def initialize(documents)
    @documents = documents
    @vocabulary = build_vocabulary
    @idf = calculate_idf
    @tfidf_matrix = calculate_tfidf_matrix
  end
  
  # Preprocess text: lowercase, remove punctuation, tokenize
  def preprocess(text)
    # Convert to lowercase and remove punctuation
    cleaned = UnicodeUtils.downcase(text.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, ' '))
    # Split into words and remove empty strings
    tokens = cleaned.split(/\s+/).reject(&:empty?)
    tokens
  end
  
  # Build vocabulary from all documents
  def build_vocabulary
    all_tokens = documents.flat_map { |doc| preprocess(doc) }
    all_tokens.uniq.sort
  end
  
  # Calculate term frequency for a document
  def term_frequency(doc_index)
    tokens = preprocess(documents[doc_index])
    total_terms = tokens.length.to_f
    
    tf = {}
    @vocabulary.each do |term|
      count = tokens.count(term)
      tf[term] = count / total_terms
    end
    
    tf
  end
  
  # Calculate inverse document frequency
  def calculate_idf
    total_docs = documents.length.to_f
    idf = {}
    
    @vocabulary.each do |term|
      # Count documents containing the term
      docs_with_term = documents.count do |doc|
        preprocess(doc).include?(term)
      end
      
      # Avoid division by zero
      docs_with_term = 1 if docs_with_term == 0
      
      idf[term] = Math.log(total_docs / docs_with_term)
    end
    
    idf
  end
  
  # Calculate TF-IDF matrix
  def calculate_tfidf_matrix
    matrix = []
    
    documents.each_index do |doc_index|
      tf = term_frequency(doc_index)
      tfidf_vector = []
      
      @vocabulary.each do |term|
        tf_value = tf[term]
        idf_value = @idf[term]
        tfidf_vector << tf_value * idf_value
      end
      
      matrix << tfidf_vector
    end
    
    Matrix[*matrix]
  end
  
  # Get top keywords for a document
  def top_keywords(doc_index, limit = 10)
    vector = @tfidf_matrix.row(doc_index).to_a
    terms_with_scores = @vocabulary.zip(vector)
    
    # Sort by TF-IDF score descending
    sorted_terms = terms_with_scores.sort_by { |term, score| -score }
    
    # Return top N terms (excluding zero scores)
    sorted_terms.reject { |term, score| score.zero? }.first(limit)
  end
  
  # Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
  def cosine_similarity(vec1, vec2)
    dot_product = vec1.zip(vec2).map { |a, b| a * b }.sum
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vec1.map { |x| x**2 }.sum)
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vec2.map { |x| x**2 }.sum)
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1.zero? || magnitude2.zero?
    
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end
  
  # Find similar documents to a given document
  def find_similar_documents(doc_index, limit = 5)
    target_vector = @tfidf_matrix.row(doc_index).to_a
    similarities = []
    
    @tfidf_matrix.row_count.times do |other_index|
      next if other_index == doc_index  # Skip the same document
      
      other_vector = @tfidf_matrix.row(other_index).to_a
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, other_vector)
      similarities << { index: other_index, similarity: similarity }
    end
    
    # Sort by similarity descending
    similarities.sort_by! { |sim| -sim[:similarity] }
    similarities.first(limit)
  end
  
  # Print analysis results
  def print_analysis
    puts "Vocabulary size: #{@vocabulary.size}"
    puts "Number of documents: #{documents.size}"
    puts "\nTop keywords per document:"
    
    documents.each_index do |i|
      puts "\nDocument #{i + 1}:"
      keywords = top_keywords(i, 5)
      keywords.each do |term, score|
        puts "  #{term}: #{score.round(4)}"
      end
    end
    
    puts "\nDocument similarities:"
    documents.each_index do |i|
      puts "\nDocuments similar to Document #{i + 1}:"
      similar_docs = find_similar_documents(i, 3)
      similar_docs.each do |sim|
        puts "  Document #{sim[:index] + 1}: #{sim[:similarity].round(4)}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# document_similarity.rb
class DocumentSimilarity
  def initialize(analyzer)
    @analyzer = analyzer
  end
  
  # Create a similarity matrix for all documents
  def similarity_matrix
    n = @analyzer.tfidf_matrix.row_count
    matrix = Matrix.build(n, n) do |i, j|
      if i == j
        1.0  # Document is identical to itself
      else
        vec1 = @analyzer.tfidf_matrix.row(i).to_a
        vec2 = @analyzer.tfidf_matrix.row(j).to_a
        @analyzer.cosine_similarity(vec1, vec2)
      end
    end
    matrix
  end
  
  # Find the most similar document pair
  def most_similar_pair
    matrix = similarity_matrix
    max_similarity = -1
    pair = [0, 0]
    
    matrix.each_with_index do |similarity, i, j|
      next if i >= j  # Avoid duplicates and self-comparison
      
      if similarity > max_similarity
        max_similarity = similarity
        pair = [i, j]
      end
    end
    
    { pair: pair, similarity: max_similarity }
  end
  
  # Cluster documents by similarity
  def cluster_documents(threshold = 0.1)
    clusters = []
    visited = Array.new(@analyzer.documents.size, false)
    
    @analyzer.documents.size.times do |i|
      next if visited[i]
      
      cluster = [i]
      visited[i] = true
      
      @analyzer.documents.size.times do |j|
        next if visited[j] || i == j
        
        similarity = @analyzer.cosine_similarity(
          @analyzer.tfidf_matrix.row(i).to_a,
          @analyzer.tfidf_matrix.row(j).to_a
        )
        
        if similarity > threshold
          cluster << j
          visited[j] = true
        end
      end
      
      clusters << cluster
    end
    
    clusters
  end
end
```

```ruby
class CompanyMatcher

  end
  
  # Метод для знаходження найкращих збігів з використанням різних алгоритмів
  def find_matches(query, options = {})
    limit = options[:limit] || 5
    threshold = options[:threshold] || 0.7
    
    results = []
    
    # Використання FuzzyMatch для початкового фільтрування
    fuzzy_results = fuzzy_matcher.find_all_with_score(query, limit: limit * 2)

      # Розрахунок різних метрик схожості
      levenshtein_distance = DamerauLevenshtein.distance(query.downcase, company.downcase)
      levenshtein_similarity = 1 - (levenshtein_distance.to_f / [query.length, company.length].max)
      
      jaro_winkler_distance = Text::WhiteSimilarity.jaro_winkler(query.downcase, company.downcase)
      
      # Комбінована оцінка
      combined_score = (jaro_winkler_distance + levenshtein_similarity) / 2
      
      if combined_score >= threshold
        results << {
          company: company,
          levenshtein_distance: levenshtein_distance,
          levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_similarity.round(4),
          jaro_winkler_similarity: jaro_winkler_distance.round(4),
          combined_score: combined_score.round(4)
        }
      end
    end
    
    # Сортування за комбінованою оцінкою
    results.sort_by { |r| -r[:combined_score] }.first(limit)
  end

      if jaro_winkler >= threshold
        levenshtein = DamerauLevenshtein.distance(company1.downcase, company2.downcase)
        levenshtein_similarity = 1 - (levenshtein.to_f / [company1.length, company2.length].max)
        
        similar_pairs << {
          company1: company1,
          company2: company2,
          jaro_winkler: jaro_winkler.round(4),
          levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_similarity.round(4),
          average_similarity: ((jaro_winkler + levenshtein_similarity) / 2).round(4)
        }
      end
    end
    
    similar_pairs.sort_by { |pair| -pair[:average_similarity] }
  end
  
  # Метод для кластеризації схожих назв компаній
  def cluster_similar_companies(threshold = 0.85)
    clusters = []
    processed = Set.new
    
    companies.each do |company|
      next if processed.include?(company)
      
      cluster = [company]
      processed.add(company)
      
      # Знаходимо всі схожі компанії
      companies.each do |other_company|
        next if processed.include?(other_company)
        
        similarity = Text::WhiteSimilarity.jaro_winkler(company.downcase, other_company.downcase)
        if similarity >= threshold
          cluster << other_company
          processed.add(other_company)
        end
      end
      
      clusters << cluster if cluster.size > 1
    end
    
    clusters
  end
end

# Допоміжні методи
module StringSimilarity
  def self.levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    DamerauLevenshtein.distance(str1.downcase, str2.downcase)
  end
  
  def self.jaro_winkler_similarity(str1, str2)
    Text::WhiteSimilarity.jaro_winkler(str1.downcase, str2.downcase)
  end
  
  def self.normalized_similarity(str1, str2)
    lev_dist = levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    max_len = [str1.length, str2.length].max
    lev_sim = 1 - (lev_dist.to_f / max_len)
    jw_sim = jaro_winkler_similarity(str1, str2)
    
    (lev_sim + jw_sim) / 2
  end
end
```

```ruby
class NaturalLanguageDateParser
  def self.parse(date_string, options = {})
    # Set default context if not provided
    context = options[:context] || :future
    
    # Parse using Chronic with the specified context
    Chronic.parse(date_string, options.merge(context: context))
  end

  def self.parse_with_timezone(date_string, timezone = 'UTC', options = {})
    # Store original timezone
    original_zone = Time.zone
    
    # Set the desired timezone
    Time.zone = timezone
    
    # Parse with timezone awareness
    result = parse(date_string, options)
    
    # Restore original timezone
    Time.zone = original_zone
    
    result
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'fuzzy_match'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Список нецензурних слів (спрощений варіант)
  DEFAULT_PROFANITIES = [
    'fuck', 'shit', 'asshole', 'bitch', 'bastard', 'damn', 'cunt',
    'piss', 'dick', 'cock', 'pussy', 'slut', 'whore', 'nigger',
    'retard', 'fag', 'faggot', 'motherfucker', 'bullshit'
  ].freeze

  # Замінники для цензурування
  REPLACEMENTS = ['*', '#', '!', '@', '$', '%'].freeze

  def initialize(custom_profanities = [])
    @profanities = (DEFAULT_PROFANITIES + custom_profanities).map(&:downcase).uniq
    @fuzzy_matcher = FuzzyMatch.new(@profanities)
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text, options = {})
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?

    options = {
      replacement_char: '*',
      fuzzy_match: false,
      threshold: 0.8
    }.merge(options)

    filtered_text = text.dup

    # Фільтрація точних збігів
    filter_exact_matches!(filtered_text, options[:replacement_char])

    # Фільтрація нечітких збігів (якщо ввімкнено)
    if options[:fuzzy_match]
      filter_fuzzy_matches!(filtered_text, options[:threshold], options[:replacement_char])
    end

    filtered_text
  end

  # Перевірка чи містить текст нецензурну лексику
  def profane?(text)
    return false if text.nil? || text.empty?

    words = text.downcase.split(/\W+/)
    
    words.any? do |word|
      @profanities.include?(word) || 
      @profanities.any? { |profanity| word.include?(profanity) }
    end
  end

  # Отримати список знайдених нецензурних слів у тексті
  def profanities_found(text)
    return [] if text.nil? || text.empty?

    words = text.downcase.split(/\W+/)
    found = []

    words.each do |word|
      @profanities.each do |profanity|
        if word.include?(profanity) || profanity.include?(word)
          found << profanity unless found.include?(profanity)
        end
      end
    end

    found
  end

  private

  # Фільтрація точних збігів
  def filter_exact_matches!(text, replacement_char)
    @profanities.each do |profanity|
      # Заміна повних слів
      text.gsub!(/\b#{Regexp.escape(profanity)}\b/i) do |match|
        replacement_char * match.length
      end

      # Заміна частин слів
      text.gsub!(/#{Regexp.escape(profanity)}/i) do |match|
        replacement_char * match.length
      end
    end
  end

  # Фільтрація нечітких збігів
  def filter_fuzzy_matches!(text, threshold, replacement_char)
    words = text.split(/\b/)

    words.map! do |word|
      if word.match?(/\w+/)
        best_match = @fuzzy_matcher.find(word.downcase)
        
        if best_match && similarity(word.downcase, best_match) >= threshold
          replacement_char * word.length
        else
          word
        end
      else
        word
      end
    end

    text.replace(words.join)
  end

  # Проста функція для визначення схожості слів
  def similarity(word1, word2)
    longer = [word1.length, word2.length].max
    return 1.0 if longer == 0

    common = longest_common_substring(word1, word2)
    common.length.to_f / longer
  end

  # Знаходження найдовшого спільного підрядка
  def longest_common_substring(a, b)
    a, b = a.downcase, b.downcase
    lengths = Array.new(a.length) { Array.new(b.length, 0) }
    greatest_length = 0
    output = ''

    a.each_char.with_index do |x, i|
      b.each_char.with_index do |y, j|
        if x == y
          lengths[i][j] = (i.zero? || j.zero?) ? 1 : lengths[i-1][j-1] + 1
          if lengths[i][j] > greatest_length
            greatest_length = lengths[i][j]
            output = a[i - greatest_length + 1, greatest_length]
          end
        end
      end
    end

    output
  end
end
```

```ruby
# tfidf_analyzer.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'unicode_utils'
require 'terminal-table'

class TFIDFAnalyzer
  STOP_WORDS = %w[
    a an the and or but in on at to for of with by as is was were be been have has had 
    will would can could shall should may might must this that these those i you he she 
    it we they me him her us them my your his its our their
  ].freeze

  def initialize(documents)
    @documents = documents.map { |doc| preprocess_text(doc) }
    @vocabulary = build_vocabulary
    @tf_matrix = compute_tf_matrix
    @idf_vector = compute_idf_vector
    @tfidf_matrix = compute_tfidf_matrix
  end

  # Попередня обробка тексту
  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Приведення до нижнього регістру та видалення спецсимволів
    cleaned_text = UnicodeUtils.downcase(text.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, ' '))
    # Токенізація та видалення стоп-слів
    tokens = cleaned_text.split.reject do |word|
      word.length < 2 || STOP_WORDS.include?(word)
    end
    tokens
  end

  # Побудова словника унікальних слів
  def build_vocabulary
    all_words = @documents.flatten
    all_words.uniq.sort
  end

  # Обчислення TF (Term Frequency) для кожного документа
  def compute_tf_matrix
    @documents.map do |doc_words|
      word_count = doc_words.size.to_f
      @vocabulary.map do |word|
        count = doc_words.count(word)
        count / word_count
      end
    end
  end

  # Обчислення IDF (Inverse Document Frequency)
  def compute_idf_vector
    total_docs = @documents.size.to_f
    @vocabulary.map do |word|
      docs_containing_word = @documents.count { |doc| doc.include?(word) }
      Math.log(total_docs / docs_containing_word)
    end
  end

  # Обчислення TF-IDF матриці
  def compute_tfidf_matrix
    @tf_matrix.map do |tf_vector|
      tf_vector.zip(@idf_vector).map { |tf, idf| tf * idf }
    end
  end

  # Отримати ключові слова для документа (топ-N слів за TF-IDF)
  def get_keywords(doc_index, top_n = 10)
    tfidf_scores = @vocabulary.zip(@tfidf_matrix[doc_index])
    sorted_keywords = tfidf_scores.sort_by { |_, score| -score }
    sorted_keywords.first(top_n).reject { |_, score| score.zero? }
  end

  # Обчислення косинусної схожості між документами
  def cosine_similarity(vec1, vec2)
    dot_product = vec1.zip(vec2).sum { |a, b| a * b }
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vec1.sum { |x| x**2 })
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vec2.sum { |x| x**2 })
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1.zero? || magnitude2.zero?
    
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  # Знайти схожі документи для заданого документа
  def find_similar_documents(doc_index, top_k = 5)
    target_vector = @tfidf_matrix[doc_index]
    similarities = []
    
    @tfidf_matrix.each_with_index do |vector, index|
      next if index == doc_index # Пропускаємо поточний документ
      
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, vector)
      similarities << { index: index, similarity: similarity }
    end
    
    similarities.sort_by { |doc| -doc[:similarity] }.first(top_k)
  end

  # Вивести звіт по ключовим словам
  def print_keywords_report(top_n = 5)
    tables = []
    
    @documents.each_with_index do |_, index|
      keywords = get_keywords(index, top_n)
      
      table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
        t.title = "Документ #{index + 1} - Топ #{top_n} ключових слів"
        t.headings = ['Слово', 'TF-IDF']
        keywords.each { |word, score| t << [word, score.round(4)] }
      end
      
      tables << table
    end
    
    tables.each { |table| puts table, "\n" }
  end

  # Вивести звіт по схожим документам
  def print_similarity_report(top_k = 3)
    tables = []
    
    @documents.each_with_index do |_, index|
      similar_docs = find_similar_documents(index, top_k)
      
      table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
        t.title = "Схожі документи для Документу #{index + 1}"
        t.headings = ['Документ', 'Схожість']
        similar_docs.each { |doc| t << ["Документ #{doc[:index] + 1}", doc[:similarity].round(4)] }
      end
      
      tables << table
    end
    
    tables.each { |table| puts table, "\n" }
  end
end
```

## Main Implementation

```ruby
# document_search.rb
require 'pg'
require 'pgvector'
require 'openai'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

class DocumentSearch
  def initialize
    @openai_client = OpenAI::Client.new(access_token: ENV['OPENAI_API_KEY'])
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    @conn = PG.connect(
      host: ENV['DB_HOST'] || 'localhost',
      port: ENV['DB_PORT'] || 5432,
      dbname: ENV['DB_NAME'] || 'vector_db',
      user: ENV['DB_USER'] || 'postgres',
      password: ENV['DB_PASSWORD'] || 'password'
    )
    
    # Enable pgvector extension
    @conn.exec('CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector')
    
    # Create documents table with vector column
    @conn.exec(<<~SQL)
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        embedding VECTOR(1536),
        metadata JSONB,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
      )
    SQL
    
    # Create index for efficient similarity search
    @conn.exec('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS documents_embedding_idx ON documents USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops)')
  end

  def generate_embedding(text)
    response = @openai_client.embeddings(
      parameters: {
        model: "text-embedding-3-small",
        input: text
      }
    )
    
    if response['error']
      raise "OpenAI API Error: #{response['error']['message']}"
    end
    
    response['data'][0]['embedding']
  end

  def add_document(content, metadata = {})
    embedding = generate_embedding(content)
    
    # Convert embedding to PostgreSQL vector format
    vector = Pgvector.encode(embedding)
    
    result = @conn.exec_params(
      'INSERT INTO documents (content, embedding, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING id',
      [content, vector, metadata.to_json]
    )
    
    result[0]['id']
  end

  def search_similar_documents(query, limit: 5, similarity_threshold: 0.7)
    query_embedding = generate_embedding(query)
    query_vector = Pgvector.encode(query_embedding)
    
    # Use cosine similarity (1 - cosine_distance)
    results = @conn.exec_params(<<~SQL, [query_vector, similarity_threshold, limit])
      SELECT id, content, metadata, 
             1 - (embedding <=> $1) as similarity
      FROM documents 
      WHERE 1 - (embedding <=> $1) > $2
      ORDER BY embedding <=> $1
      LIMIT $3
    SQL
    
    results.map do |row|
      {
        id: row['id'].to_i,
        content: row['content'],
        metadata: JSON.parse(row['metadata'] || '{}'),
        similarity: row['similarity'].to_f
      }
    end
  end

  def get_all_documents
    results = @conn.exec('SELECT id, content, metadata, created_at FROM documents ORDER BY created_at DESC')
    results.map do |row|
      {
        id: row['id'].to_i,
        content: row['content'],
        metadata: JSON.parse(row['metadata'] || '{}'),
        created_at: row['created_at']
      }
    end
  end

  def delete_document(id)
    @conn.exec_params('DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = $1', [id])
  end

  def close
    @conn.close if @conn
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables from .env file
  Dotenv.load
  
  search = DocumentSearch.new
  
  # Example documents to add
  documents = [
    "Ruby is a dynamic, open source programming language with a focus on simplicity and productivity.",
    "PostgreSQL is a powerful, open source object-relational database system.",
    "Machine learning is a method of data analysis that automates analytical model building.",
    "Artificial intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines.",
    "Vector databases are designed to handle vector embeddings for similarity search."
  ]
  
  puts "Adding sample documents..."
  documents.each_with_index do |doc, i|
    metadata = { category: "sample", index: i + 1 }
    doc_id = search.add_document(doc, metadata)
    puts "Added document #{doc_id}: #{doc[0..50]}..."
  end
  
  puts "\nSearching for documents similar to 'programming languages'..."
  results = search.search_similar_documents("programming languages")
  
  results.each do |result|
    puts "Similarity: #{(result[:similarity] * 100).round(2)}%"
    puts "Content: #{result[:content]}"
    puts "---"
  end
  
  search.close
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb

class DocumentSearchAPI < Sinatra::Base

  end
```

## Implementation Code

```ruby
# address_parser.rb
require 'street_address'
require 'geocoder'
require 'carmen'
require 'carmen/rails' # For country and state normalization

class USParsingError < StandardError; end

class USAddressParser
  def initialize
    # Configure Geocoder for US addresses
    Geocoder.configure(
      timeout: 5,
      units: :mi,
      cache: Redis.new # Optional: add redis gem for caching
    )
  end

  # Main method to parse and normalize a US address from free text
  def parse_address(free_text)
    return nil if free_text.nil? || free_text.strip.empty?

    # Clean the input
    cleaned_text = clean_input(free_text)
    
    # Try multiple parsing strategies
    parsed_address = try_street_address_gem(cleaned_text) ||
                    try_geocoder(cleaned_text) ||
                    try_custom_parsing(cleaned_text)
    
    # Normalize the parsed address
    normalize_address(parsed_address) if parsed_address
  rescue => e
    raise USParsingError, "Failed to parse address: #{e.message}"
  end

  private

  def clean_input(text)
    # Remove extra whitespace and common artifacts
    text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
        .gsub(/[,\s]+/, ', ')
        .gsub(/\b(P\.?O\.?\s*Box|PO\s*Box)\s*(\d+)/i, 'PO Box \2')
        .strip
  end

  def try_street_address_gem(text)
    # Use the street_address gem for parsing
    address = StreetAddress::US.parse(text)
    return nil unless address
    
    {
      street: format_street(address),
      city: address.city,
      state: address.state,
      zip_code: address.postal_code,
      zip_plus4: address.postal_code_ext,
      country: 'US',
      original: text,
      source: 'street_address_gem'
    }
  rescue => e
    nil # Fall back to other methods
  end

  def try_geocoder(text)
    # Use Geocoder for addresses that might be more ambiguous
    results = Geocoder.search(text, params: {countrycodes: 'us', limit: 1})
    return nil if results.empty?
    
    result = results.first
    data = result.data
    components = data['address_components'] || []
    
    {
      street: extract_component(components, ['street_address', 'route']),
      city: extract_component(components, ['locality', 'postal_town']),
      state: extract_component(components, ['administrative_area_level_1']),
      zip_code: extract_component(components, ['postal_code']),
      country: 'US',
      latitude: result.latitude,
      longitude: result.longitude,
      original: text,
      source: 'geocoder'
    }
  rescue => e
    nil
  end

  def try_custom_parsing(text)
    # Fallback custom parsing for simple cases
    # This handles common patterns like "123 Main St, City, STATE ZIP"
    match = text.match(/(.+?),\s*([^,]+?),\s*([A-Z]{2})\s*(\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?)$/i)
    return nil unless match
    
    street, city, state, zip_code = match.captures
    
    {
      street: street.strip,
      city: city.strip,
      state: state.upcase,
      zip_code: zip_code,
      country: 'US',
      original: text,
      source: 'custom_parser'
    }
  end

  def extract_component(components, types)
    component = components.find { |c| (c['types'] & types).any? }
    component ? component['long_name'] : nil
  end

  def format_street(address)
    parts = []
    parts << address.number if address.number
    parts << address.street if address.street
    parts << address.street_type if address.street_type
    parts << address.unit if address.unit && address.unit_type
    parts.compact.join(' ')
  end

  def normalize_address(parsed_address)
    {
      line1: normalize_street(parsed_address[:street]),
      line2: parsed_address[:unit] || '',
      city: normalize_city(parsed_address[:city]),
      state: normalize_state(parsed_address[:state]),
      zip_code: normalize_zip(parsed_address[:zip_code]),
      zip_plus4: parsed_address[:zip_plus4],
      country: 'US',
      latitude: parsed_address[:latitude],
      longitude: parsed_address[:longitude],
      normalized_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
    }.compact
  end

  def normalize_street(street)
    return nil unless street
    
    # Common street type abbreviations
    street_type_mapping = {
      'st' => 'ST', 'street' => 'ST',
      'ave' => 'AVE', 'avenue' => 'AVE',
      'blvd' => 'BLVD', 'boulevard' => 'BLVD',
      'dr' => 'DR', 'drive' => 'DR',
      'ln' => 'LN', 'lane' => 'LN',
      'rd' => 'RD', 'road' => 'RD',
      'ct' => 'CT', 'court' => 'CT',
      'pl' => 'PL', 'place' => 'PL'
    }
    
    # Directional abbreviations
    directional_mapping = {
      'n' => 'N', 'north' => 'N',
      's' => 'S', 'south' => 'S',
      'e' => 'E', 'east' => 'E',
      'w' => 'W', 'west' => 'W',
      'ne' => 'NE', 'northeast' => 'NE',
      'nw' => 'NW', 'northwest' => 'NW',
      'se' => 'SE', 'southeast' => 'SE',
      'sw' => 'SW', 'southwest' => 'SW'
    }
    
    words = street.split.map do |word|
      word.downcase!
      if street_type_mapping.key?(word)
        street_type_mapping[word]
      elsif directional_mapping.key?(word)
        directional_mapping[word]
      else
        word.capitalize
      end
    end
    
    words.join(' ')
  end

  def normalize_city(city)
    return nil unless city
    city.split.map(&:capitalize).join(' ')
  end

  def normalize_state(state)
    return nil unless state
    state.upcase
  end

  def normalize_zip(zip_code)
    return nil unless zip_code
    zip_code.to_s.gsub(/\D/, '')[0..4] # Take first 5 digits only
  end
end

# Example usage and testing
if __FILE__ == $0
  parser = USAddressParser.new
  
  test_addresses = [
    "123 Main Street, Springfield, IL 62701",
    "1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20500",
    "1 Infinite Loop, Cupertino, CA 95014",
    "PO Box 123, New York, NY 10001",
    "Empire State Building, 350 5th Ave, New York, NY 10118",
    "1234 Elm St Apt 5B, Chicago, Illinois 60601"
  ]
  
  puts "Address Parsing Results:"
  puts "=" * 80
  
  test_addresses.each do |address|
    puts "\nOriginal: #{address}"
    begin
      parsed = parser.parse_address(address)

        parsed.each { |k, v| puts "  #{k}: #{v}" }
      else
        puts "  Failed to parse address"
      end
    rescue USParsingError => e
      puts "  Error: #{e.message}"
    end
    puts "-" * 40
  end
end
```

Here's a Ruby solution for extracting named entities from English news articles:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'stanford-core-nlp'
gem 'engtagger'

```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# named_entity_extractor.rb
require 'stanford-core-nlp'
require 'engtagger'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'

class NamedEntityExtractor
  # Initialize with preferred extraction method
  def initialize(method: :stanford)
    @method = method
    setup_stanford_nlp if method == :stanford
    @tagger = EngTagger.new if method == :engtagger
  end

  # Main method to extract entities from text
  def extract_entities(text, options = {})
    return {} if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?

    case @method
    when :stanford
      extract_with_stanford(text, options)
    when :engtagger
      extract_with_engtagger(text, options)
    else
      raise "Unknown extraction method: #{@method}"
    end
  end

  # Extract entities from a URL (handles HTML parsing)
  def extract_from_url(url, options = {})
    response = HTTParty.get(url)
    html = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
    
    # Extract main text content (simplified - you might want to improve this)
    text = extract_main_text(html)
    extract_entities(text, options)
  end

  # Extract entities from HTML content
  def extract_from_html(html_content, options = {})
    html = Nokogiri::HTML(html_content)
    text = extract_main_text(html)
    extract_entities(text, options)
  end

  private

  # Stanford NLP setup and extraction
  def setup_stanford_nlp
    StanfordCoreNLP.use(:english)
    @pipeline = StanfordCoreNLP.load(:tokenize, :ssplit, :pos, :lemma, :ner, :parse)
  end

  def extract_with_stanford(text, options)
    text = StanfordCoreNLP::Annotation.new(text)
    @pipeline.annotate(text)
    
    entities = {
      people: [],
      organizations: [],
      places: [],
      misc: []
    }

    text.get(:sentences).each do |sentence|
      sentence.get(:tokens).each do |token|
        entity_type = token.get(:ner).to_s
        entity_text = token.get(:original_text).to_s
        
        case entity_type
        when 'PERSON'
          entities[:people] << entity_text
        when 'ORGANIZATION'
          entities[:organizations] << entity_text
        when 'LOCATION'
          entities[:places] << entity_text
        when 'MISC'
          entities[:misc] << entity_text
        end
      end
    end

    # Clean and consolidate results
    clean_entities(entities, options)
  end

  # EngTagger-based extraction (fallback method)
  def extract_with_engtagger(text, options)
    tagged = @tagger.add_tags(text)
    
    entities = {
      people: @tagger.get_proper_nouns(tagged).keys,
      organizations: @tagger.get_proper_nouns(tagged).keys, # EngTagger doesn't distinguish well
      places: @tagger.get_proper_nouns(tagged).keys,        # between person/org/location
      misc: []
    }

    clean_entities(entities, options)
  end

  # Extract main text content from HTML
  def extract_main_text(html)
    # Remove script and style elements
    html.search('script', 'style').each(&:remove)
    
    # Try to find main content areas
    main_content = html.at('article') || html.at('.content') || html.at('#content') || html.at('main') || html
    
    # Get text content
    text = main_content.text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
    
    # Remove excessive whitespace and normalize
    text.gsub(/\n+/, "\n").gsub(/[ ]+/, ' ').strip
  end

  # Clean and process extracted entities
  def clean_entities(entities, options)
    result = {}
    
    entities.each do |category, entity_list|
      # Remove duplicates and empty strings
      cleaned = entity_list.reject { |e| e.strip.empty? }.uniq
      
      # Apply filters if specified
      if options[:min_length]
        cleaned.reject! { |e| e.length < options[:min_length] }
      end
      
      if options[:case_sensitive] == false
        cleaned = cleaned.map(&:titleize).uniq
      end
      
      result[category] = cleaned
    end
    
    result
  end
end

# Example usage and testing
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Example 1: Extract from direct text
  extractor = NamedEntityExtractor.new(method: :stanford)
  
  sample_text = """
  Apple Inc. announced today that Tim Cook, the CEO, will be visiting London next week. 
  The company plans to open a new office in Paris. Microsoft Corporation and Google LLC 
  are also expanding their operations in Europe. President Biden will meet with the

  puts "Organizations: #{entities[:organizations].join(', ')}"
  puts "Places: #{entities[:places].join(', ')}"
  puts "Miscellaneous: #{entities[:misc].join(', ')}"
  
  # Example 2: Extract from URL (uncomment to test with a real URL)

end
```

```ruby
require 'pdf-reader'
require 'combine_pdf'
require 'rubyxl'
require 'csv'

class PDFExtractor
  def initialize(pdf_path)
    @pdf_path = pdf_path
    @reader = PDF::Reader.new(pdf_path)
  end

  # Витягнення всього тексту з PDF
  def extract_text
    text_content = ""
    
    @reader.pages.each_with_index do |page, index|
      text_content += "=== Сторінка #{index + 1} ===\n"
      text_content += page.text + "\n\n"
    end
    
    text_content
  end

  # Витягнення тексту з конкретної сторінки
  def extract_text_from_page(page_number)
    return nil unless page_number.between?(1, @reader.pages.count)
    
    @reader.pages[page_number - 1].text
  end

  # Простий метод для виявлення таблиць (базовий підхід)
  def detect_tables
    tables = []
    
    @reader.pages.each_with_index do |page, page_index|
      text = page.text
      
      # Простий алгоритм виявлення таблиць за наявністю табличних даних
      lines = text.split("\n")
      table_candidates = []
      current_table = []
      
      lines.each do |line|
        # Якщо рядок містить роздільники таблиці (табуляція, кілька пробілів)
        if line.match?(/\t|\s{2,}/) && !line.strip.empty?
          # Розділяємо рядок на колонки
          columns = line.split(/\t|\s{2,}/).map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
          current_table << columns if columns.any?
        elsif !current_table.empty?
          # Зберігаємо таблицю, якщо знайшли кінець
          if current_table.length > 1 # Принаймні заголовок + один рядок
            tables << {
              page: page_index + 1,
              data: current_table.dup
            }
          end
          current_table.clear
        end
      end
      
      # Зберігаємо останню таблицю на сторінці
      if current_table.length > 1
        tables << {
          page: page_index + 1,
          data: current_table.dup
        }
      end
    end
    
    tables
  end

  # Розширений метод виявлення таблиць з використанням позицій тексту
  def extract_tables_advanced
    tables = []
    
    @reader.pages.each_with_index do |page, page_index|
      # Отримуємо текст з координатами
      text_with_positions = []
      
      page.text.scan(/./) do |char|
        # Це спрощений підхід - у реальності потрібно використовувати page.text_positions
        text_with_positions << char
      end
      
      # Тут можна реалізувати складнішу логіку аналізу позицій тексту
      # для точнішого виявлення таблиць
      
      puts "Сторінка #{page_index + 1}: Аналіз позицій тексту для виявлення таблиць"
    end
    
    tables
  end

  # Експорт таблиць у CSV
  def export_tables_to_csv(tables, output_dir = "output")
    Dir.mkdir(output_dir) unless Dir.exist?(output_dir)
    
    tables.each_with_index do |table, index|
      filename = File.join(output_dir, "table_page_#{table[:page]}_#{index + 1}.csv")
      
      CSV.open(filename, "w") do |csv|
        table[:data].each do |row|
          csv << row
        end
      end
      
      puts "Експортовано таблицю #{index + 1} до #{filename}"
    end
  end

  # Експорт таблиць у Excel
  def export_tables_to_excel(tables, output_file = "tables.xlsx")
    workbook = RubyXL::Workbook.new
    worksheet = workbook[0]
    worksheet.sheet_name = "Таблиці з PDF"
    
    row_index = 0
    tables.each_with_index do |table, table_index|
      # Додаємо заголовок таблиці
      worksheet.add_cell(row_index, 0, "Таблиця #{table_index + 1} (сторінка #{table[:page]})")
      row_index += 2
      
      # Додаємо дані таблиці
      table[:data].each_with_index do |row, r_index|
        row.each_with_index do |cell, c_index|
          worksheet.add_cell(row_index + r_index, c_index, cell)
        end
      end
      
      row_index += table[:data].length + 2
    end
    
    workbook.write(output_file)
    puts "Експортовано всі таблиці до #{output_file}"
  end

  # Збереження тексту у файл
  def save_text_to_file(text, output_file = "extracted_text.txt")
    File.write(output_file, text)
    puts "Текст збережено до #{output_file}"
  end

  # Отримання метаданих PDF
  def get_metadata
    {
      pdf_version: @reader.pdf_version,
      page_count: @reader.page_count,
      metadata: @reader.info,
      encrypted: @reader.encrypted?
    }
  end
end

class PDFBatchProcessor
  def initialize(input_dir, output_dir = "output")
    @input_dir = input_dir
    @output_dir = output_dir
    Dir.mkdir(output_dir) unless Dir.exist?(output_dir)
  end

  def process_all_pdfs
    pdf_files = Dir.glob(File.join(@input_dir, "*.pdf"))
    
    results = {}
    
    pdf_files.each do |pdf_file|
      puts "Обробка файлу: #{pdf_file}"
      
      begin
        extractor = PDFExtractor.new(pdf_file)
        filename = File.basename(pdf_file, ".pdf")
        
        # Витягуємо текст
        text = extractor.extract_text
        extractor.save_text_to_file(
          text, 
          File.join(@output_dir, "#{filename}_text.txt")
        )
        
        # Витягуємо таблиці
        tables = extractor.detect_tables
        if tables.any?
          extractor.export_tables_to_csv(
            tables, 
            File.join(@output_dir, filename)
          )
        end
        
        results[pdf_file] = {
          text_length: text.length,
          table_count: tables.count,
          success: true
        }
        
      rescue => e
        puts "Помилка при обробці #{pdf_file}: #{e.message}"
        results[pdf_file] = { success: false, error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
end
```

```ruby
# advanced_table_detector.rb
require 'pdf-reader'

class AdvancedTableDetector
  def initialize(pdf_reader)
    @reader = pdf_reader
  end

  def extract_tables_with_positions
    tables = []
    
    @reader.pages.each_with_index do |page, page_index|
      # Отримуємо всі текстові об'єкти сторінки
      text_objects = extract_text_objects(page)
      
      # Групуємо текстові об'єкти за рядками
      rows = group_into_rows(text_objects)
      
      # Виявляємо таблиці серед рядків
      page_tables = detect_tables_from_rows(rows)
      
      page_tables.each do |table|
        tables << {
          page: page_index + 1,
          data: table,
          positions: text_objects
        }
      end
    end
    
    tables
  end

  private

  def extract_text_objects(page)
    text_objects = []
    
    page.walk do |operator, operands|
      if operator == 'BT' # Begin Text
        @current_text = ""
        @current_position = { x: 0, y: 0 }
      elsif operator == 'Tj' || operator == "'" || operator == '"'
        @current_text += operands.first if operands.any?
      elsif operator == 'Td' || operator == 'TD'
        # Оновлюємо позицію
        @current_position[:x] += operands[0] if operands[0]
        @current_position[:y] += operands[1] if operands[1]
      elsif operator == 'ET' # End Text
        if @current_text.strip.length > 0
          text_objects << {
            text: @current_text.strip,
            x: @current_position[:x],
            y: @current_position[:y]
          }
        end
      end
    end
    
    text_objects
  end

  def group_into_rows(text_objects, tolerance = 2)
    # Сортуємо за Y-координатою (зверху вниз)
    sorted = text_objects.sort_by { |obj| -obj[:y] }
    
    rows = []
    current_row = []
    current_y = nil
    
    sorted.each do |obj|
      if current_y.nil? || (obj[:y] - current_y).abs <= tolerance
        current_row << obj
        current_y ||= obj[:y]
      else
        rows << current_row.sort_by { |cell| cell[:x] } if current_row.any?
        current_row = [obj]
        current_y = obj[:y]
      end
    end
    
    rows << current_row.sort_by { |cell| cell[:x] } if current_row.any?
    rows
  end

  def detect_tables_from_rows(rows)
    tables = []
    current_table = []
    
    rows.each do |row|
      # Якщо рядок має кілька колонок і вони розташовані на однакових відстанях
      if row.length > 1 && has_consistent_spacing?(row)
        current_table << row.map { |cell| cell[:text] }
      else
        if current_table.length >= 2 # Принаймні заголовок + один рядок
          tables << current_table.dup
        end
        current_table.clear
      end
    end
    
    if current_table.length >= 2
      tables << current_table.dup
    end
    
    tables
  end

  def has_consistent_spacing?(row, tolerance = 5)
    return false if row.length < 2
    
    # Аналізуємо відстані між колонками
    gaps = []
    (0...row.length-1).each do |i|
      gap = row[i+1][:x] - (row[i][:x] + estimated_width(row[i][:text]))
      gaps << gap
    end
    
    # Перевіряємо консистентність відстаней
    avg_gap = gaps.sum / gaps.length.to_f
    gaps.all? { |gap| (gap - avg_gap).abs <= tolerance }
  end

  def estimated_width(text, char_width = 5)
    text.length * char_width # Спрощене припущення
  end
end
```

```ruby
# support_ticket_summarizer.rb
require 'anthropic'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class SupportTicketSummarizer
  def initialize(api_key: ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(api_key: api_key)
  end

  def summarize(ticket_content, max_tokens: 500, model: 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229')
    prompt = build_prompt(ticket_content)
    
    response = @client.messages(
      parameters: {
        model: model,
        max_tokens: max_tokens,
        messages: [
          { role: "user", content: prompt }
        ]
      }
    )
    
    extract_summary(response)
  end

  private

  def build_prompt(ticket_content)
    <<~PROMPT
      Please summarize the following support ticket conversation. Focus on:
      
      1. The main issue or problem described
      2. Key steps or troubleshooting already attempted
      3. The current status or resolution
      4. Any action items or next steps needed
      
      Keep the summary concise but informative, around 3-5 bullet points.
      
      Support Ticket Content:
      #{ticket_content}
      
      Summary:
    PROMPT
  end

  def extract_summary(response)
    # Handle different response structures based on Anthropic gem version
    if response.is_a?(Hash) && response['content']
      response['content'].first['text']
    elsif response.respond_to?(:dig) && response.dig('content', 0, 'text')
      response.dig('content', 0, 'text')
    else
      response.to_s
    end
  rescue => e
    "Error extracting summary: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Advanced version with batch processing and file handling
require 'csv'
require 'json'

class BatchSupportTicketSummarizer < SupportTicketSummarizer
  def summarize_from_file(input_file, output_file, column_name: 'content')
    tickets = read_tickets(input_file, column_name)
    summaries = []
    
    tickets.each_with_index do |ticket, index|
      puts "Processing ticket #{index + 1}/#{tickets.length}"
      summary = summarize(ticket)
      summaries << {
        original: ticket,
        summary: summary,
        timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
      }
      
      # Be nice to the API - small delay between requests
      sleep(1)
    end
    
    write_summaries(summaries, output_file)
    summaries
  end

  private

  def read_tickets(file_path, column_name)
    case File.extname(file_path).downcase
    when '.csv'
      read_csv_tickets(file_path, column_name)
    when '.json'
      read_json_tickets(file_path, column_name)
    when '.txt'
      File.readlines(file_path, chomp: true)
    else
      raise "Unsupported file format: #{file_path}"
    end
  end

  def read_csv_tickets(file_path, column_name)
    CSV.read(file_path, headers: true).map { |row| row[column_name] }
  end

  def read_json_tickets(file_path, column_name)
    JSON.parse(File.read(file_path)).map { |item| item[column_name] }
  end

  def write_summaries(summaries, output_file)
    case File.extname(output_file).downcase
    when '.json'
      File.write(output_file, JSON.pretty_generate(summaries))
    when '.csv'
      CSV.open(output_file, 'w') do |csv|
        csv << ['Original Ticket', 'Summary', 'Timestamp']
        summaries.each do |summary|
          csv << [summary[:original], summary[:summary], summary[:timestamp]]
        end
      end
    else
      File.write(output_file, summaries.map { |s| "Summary: #{s[:summary]}\n\nOriginal: #{s[:original]}\n#{'='*50}\n" }.join)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Ukrainian pluralization rules for Rails I18n

module I18n
  module Backend
    module Pluralization
      # Ukrainian pluralization rule
      # Rules based on Unicode Language Plural Rules:
      # one: n mod 10 = 1 and n mod 100 != 11
      # few: n mod 10 = 2..4 and n mod 100 != 12..14
      # many: n mod 10 = 0 or n mod 10 = 5..9 or n mod 100 = 11..14
      # other: (fractions)
      rule(:uk) do |n|
        n = n.respond_to?(:abs) ? n.abs : n.to_i.abs
        
        if n.is_a?(Float)
          :other
        else
          mod10 = n % 10
          mod100 = n % 100

          if mod10 == 1 && mod100 != 11
            :one
          elsif mod10 >= 2 && mod10 <= 4 && !(mod100 >= 12 && mod100 <= 14)
            :few
          elsif mod10 == 0 || (mod10 >= 5 && mod10 <= 9) || (mod100 >= 11 && mod100 <= 14)
            :many
          else
            :other
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# flesch_reading_ease.rb
require 'engtagger'
require 'linguistics'

class FleschReadingEase
  # Initialize Linguistics gem for English language features
  Linguistics.use(:en)
  
  def initialize(text)
    @text = text.to_s
    @tagger = EngTagger.new
  end
  
  def score
    # Calculate the three components of the Flesch Reading Ease formula
    words = word_count
    sentences = sentence_count
    syllables = syllable_count
    
    # Avoid division by zero
    return 0 if words.zero? || sentences.zero?
    
    # Flesch Reading Ease formula: 206.835 - 1.015*(words/sentences) - 84.6*(syllables/words)
    words_per_sentence = words.to_f / sentences
    syllables_per_word = syllables.to_f / words
    
    206.835 - (1.015 * words_per_sentence) - (84.6 * syllables_per_word)
  end
  
  def interpretation
    score_value = score
    
    case score_value
    when 90..100
      "Very Easy (5th grade)"
    when 80...90
      "Easy (6th grade)"
    when 70...80
      "Fairly Easy (7th grade)"
    when 60...70
      "Standard (8th-9th grade)"
    when 50...60
      "Fairly Difficult (10th-12th grade)"
    when 30...50
      "Difficult (College level)"
    when 0...30
      "Very Difficult (College graduate)"
    else
      "Score out of range"
    end
  end
  
  def detailed_report
    {
      score: score.round(2),
      interpretation: interpretation,
      word_count: word_count,
      sentence_count: sentence_count,
      syllable_count: syllable_count,
      words_per_sentence: (word_count.to_f / sentence_count).round(2),
      syllables_per_word: (syllable_count.to_f / word_count).round(2)
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def word_count
    # Remove punctuation and split into words
    clean_text = @text.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, ' ')
    clean_text.split.count
  end
  
  def sentence_count
    # Count sentences by splitting on common sentence terminators
    # This handles multiple sentence endings and abbreviations
    sentences = @text.split(/[.!?]+/).reject { |s| s.strip.empty? }
    sentences.count
  end
  
  def syllable_count
    # Use Linguistics gem to count syllables in each word
    total_syllables = 0
    
    words = @text.downcase.gsub(/[^\w\s]/, ' ').split
    
    words.each do |word|
      # Remove any remaining non-alphabetic characters
      clean_word = word.gsub(/[^a-z]/, '')
      next if clean_word.empty?
      
      # Use Linguistics gem to count syllables
      syllable_count = clean_word.en.syllables
      
      # Fallback to simple syllable estimation if Linguistics returns nil
      if syllable_count.nil? || syllable_count.zero?
        syllable_count = estimate_syllables(clean_word)
      end
      
      total_syllables += syllable_count
    end
    
    total_syllables
  end
  
  def estimate_syllables(word)
    # Simple syllable estimation as fallback
    # This is a basic implementation - Linguistics gem is more accurate
    word = word.downcase
    return 1 if word.length <= 3
    
    # Count vowel groups
    word = word.gsub(/[^aeiouy]/, ' ')
    word = word.gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
    syllables = word.split.length
    
    # Adjust for silent e
    syllables -= 1 if word.end_with?('e') && syllables > 1
    
    # Ensure at least 1 syllable
    [syllables, 1].max
  end
end
```

## How it Works

The Flesch Reading Ease formula:
- **Score = 206.835 - 1.015 × (total words ÷ total sentences) - 84.6 × (total syllables ÷ total words)**

**Score Interpretation:**
- 90-100: Very Easy (5th grade)
- 80-90: Easy (6th grade) 
- 70-80: Fairly Easy (7th grade)
- 60-70: Standard (8th-9th grade)
- 50-60: Fairly Difficult (10th-12th grade)
- 30-50: Difficult (College level)
- 0-30: Very Difficult (College graduate)

The implementation uses the `linguistics` gem for accurate syllable counting and `engtagger` for part-of-speech tagging, providing more reliable results than simple regex-based approaches.
