```ruby
# product_recommender.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'

# Set up database connection
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: ':memory:'
)

# Database schema
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :customers do |t|
    t.string :name
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :products do |t|
    t.string :name
    t.string :category
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :orders do |t|
    t.references :customer
    t.references :product
    t.integer :quantity, default: 1
    t.timestamps
  end
end

# Models
class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
  has_many :products, through: :orders
end

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
  has_many :customers, through: :orders
end

class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :customer
  belongs_to :product
end

# Main recommender class
class ProductRecommender
  def initialize
    @customers = Customer.all
    @products = Product.all
  end

  # Generate user-product matrix where values represent purchase counts
  def build_user_product_matrix
    customer_ids = @customers.pluck(:id)
    product_ids = @products.pluck(:id)
    
    # Initialize matrix with zeros
    matrix = Matrix.zero(customer_ids.size, product_ids.size)
    
    # Fill matrix with purchase counts
    customer_ids.each_with_index do |customer_id, cust_index|
      customer_orders = Order.where(customer_id: customer_id)
      
      product_ids.each_with_index do |product_id, prod_index|
        order = customer_orders.find_by(product_id: product_id)
        matrix[cust_index, prod_index] = order&.quantity.to_i
      end
    end
    
    { matrix: matrix, customer_ids: customer_ids, product_ids: product_ids }
  end

  # Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
  def cosine_similarity(vec1, vec2)
    dot_product = vec1.zip(vec2).sum { |a, b| a * b }
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vec1.sum { |x| x * x })
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vec2.sum { |x| x * x })
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1.zero? || magnitude2.zero?
    
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  # Find similar customers based on purchase history
  def find_similar_customers(target_customer_id, matrix_data, top_n = 5)
    customer_index = matrix_data[:customer_ids].index(target_customer_id)
    return [] unless customer_index
    
    target_vector = matrix_data[:matrix].row(customer_index).to_a
    
    similarities = []
    matrix_data[:customer_ids].each_with_index do |customer_id, index|
      next if customer_id == target_customer_id
      
      other_vector = matrix_data[:matrix].row(index).to_a
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, other_vector)
      
      similarities << { customer_id: customer_id, similarity: similarity }
    end
    
    similarities.sort_by { |s| -s[:similarity] }.first(top_n)
  end

  # Recommend products to a customer based on similar customers' purchases
  def recommend_products(target_customer_id, top_n = 5)
    matrix_data = build_user_product_matrix
    similar_customers = find_similar_customers(target_customer_id, matrix_data)
    
    target_customer_index = matrix_data[:customer_ids].index(target_customer_id)
    target_products = matrix_data[:matrix].row(target_customer_index).to_a
    
    # Get products purchased by similar customers but not by target customer
    recommendations = {}
    
    similar_customers.each do |similar_customer|
      customer_index = matrix_data[:customer_ids].index(similar_customer[:customer_id])
      customer_products = matrix_data[:matrix].row(customer_index).to_a
      
      customer_products.each_with_index do |purchase_count, product_index|
        # Only consider products the target customer hasn't purchased
        if purchase_count > 0 && target_products[product_index] == 0
          product_id = matrix_data[:product_ids][product_index]
          recommendations[product_id] ||= { score: 0.0, similarity: 0.0 }
          recommendations[product_id][:score] += purchase_count * similar_customer[:similarity]
          recommendations[product_id][:similarity] += similar_customer[:similarity]
        end
      end
    end
    
    # Sort by weighted score
    sorted_recommendations = recommendations.map do |product_id, data|
      weighted_score = data[:score] / (data[:similarity] + 0.0001) # Avoid division by zero
      { product_id: product_id, score: weighted_score }
    end.sort_by { |r| -r[:score] }
    
    sorted_recommendations.first(top_n)
  end

  # Alternative method: Item-based collaborative filtering
  def recommend_similar_products(product_id, top_n = 5)
    matrix_data = build_user_product_matrix
    product_index = matrix_data[:product_ids].index(product_id)
    return [] unless product_index
    
    target_vector = matrix_data[:matrix].column(product_index).to_a
    
    similarities = []
    matrix_data[:product_ids].each_with_index do |other_product_id, index|
      next if other_product_id == product_id
      
      other_vector = matrix_data[:matrix].column(index).to_a
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, other_vector)
      
      similarities << { product_id: other_product_id, similarity: similarity }
    end
    
    similarities.sort_by { |s| -s[:similarity] }.first(top_n)
  end
end

# Example usage and test data
def create_sample_data
  # Create sample customers
  customers = []
  10.times do |i|
    customers << Customer.create(name: "Customer #{i + 1}")
  end

  # Create sample products
  products = []
  20.times do |i|
    products << Product.create(name: "Product #{i + 1}", category: ["Electronics", "Books", "Clothing", "Home"].sample)
  end

  # Create sample orders (purchase history)
  customers.each do |customer|
    # Each customer buys 3-8 random products
    rand(3..8).times do
      product = products.sample
      Order.create(
        customer: customer,
        product: product,
        quantity: rand(1..3)
      )
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Create sample data
  create_sample_data
  
  # Initialize recommender
  recommender = ProductRecommender.new
  
  # Test with first customer
  target_customer = Customer.first
  puts "Target customer: #{target_customer.name}"
  puts "Products already purchased:"
  target_customer.products.each do |product|
    puts "  - #{product.name} (#{product.category})"
  end
  
  puts "\nRecommended products (user-based collaborative filtering):"
  recommendations = recommender.recommend_products(target_customer.id)
  recommendations.each do |rec|
    product = Product.find(rec[:product_id])
    puts "  - #{product.name} (#{product.category}) - Score: #{rec[:score].round(4)}"
  end
  
  # Test item-based recommendations
  puts "\nSimilar products to '#{target_customer.products.first.name}':"
  similar_products = recommender.recommend_similar_products(target_customer.products.first.id)
  similar_products.each do |rec|
    product = Product.find(rec[:product_id])
    puts "  - #{product.name} (#{product.category}) - Similarity: #{rec[:similarity].round(4)}"
  end
end

## Key Features:

1. **Collaborative Filtering**: Uses user-based collaborative filtering to find similar customers
2. **Cosine Similarity**: Measures similarity between customer purchase patterns
3. **Two Approaches**: Includes both user-based and item-based recommendations
4. **Weighted Scoring**: Recommendations are weighted by similarity scores
5. **ActiveRecord Integration**: Uses ActiveRecord for database operations
6. **Sample Data**: Includes methods to generate and test with sample data

## Usage:

1. Run `bundle install` to install dependencies
2. Execute the script: `ruby product_recommender.rb`
3. Or use the Rake task: `rake sample_data`

# lib/image_processor.rb
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'uri'

class ImageProcessor
  attr_reader :s3_client, :bucket_name, :cdn_base_url

  # Thumbnail sizes configuration
  THUMBNAIL_SIZES = {
    small: '200x200',
    medium: '400x400',
    large: '800x800'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(bucket_name:, region: 'us-east-1', cdn_base_url: nil)
    @bucket_name = bucket_name
    @cdn_base_url = cdn_base_url
    @s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new(region: region)
  end

  # Upload original image and generate thumbnails
  def upload_product_image(file_path, product_id, options = {})
    # Validate file exists
    unless File.exist?(file_path)
      raise "File not found: #{file_path}"
    end

    # Process image
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(file_path)
    
    # Upload original image
    original_key = "products/#{product_id}/original/#{File.basename(file_path)}"
    upload_to_s3(file_path, original_key, options[:content_type])

    # Generate and upload thumbnails
    thumbnail_urls = {}
    THUMBNAIL_SIZES.each do |size_name, dimensions|
      thumbnail_key = generate_thumbnail(image, product_id, file_path, size_name, dimensions)
      thumbnail_urls[size_name] = generate_url(thumbnail_key)
    end

    {
      original_url: generate_url(original_key),
      thumbnails: thumbnail_urls
    }
  end

  # Generate a specific thumbnail
  def generate_thumbnail(image, product_id, file_path, size_name, dimensions)
    # Create temp file for thumbnail
    temp_file = Tempfile.new(["#{size_name}_thumbnail", File.extname(file_path)])
    
    begin
      # Process image
      thumbnail = image.dup
      thumbnail.resize(dimensions)
      thumbnail.quality(85) # Good quality with compression
      thumbnail.strip # Remove metadata to reduce file size
      
      thumbnail.write(temp_file.path)
      
      # Upload thumbnail
      thumbnail_key = "products/#{product_id}/thumbnails/#{size_name}/#{File.basename(file_path)}"
      upload_to_s3(temp_file.path, thumbnail_key)
      
      thumbnail_key
    ensure
      temp_file.close
      temp_file.unlink
    end
  end

  # Upload file to S3
  def upload_to_s3(file_path, key, content_type = nil)
    content_type ||= guess_content_type(file_path)
    
    File.open(file_path, 'rb') do |file|
      s3_client.put_object(
        bucket: bucket_name,
        key: key,
        body: file,
        content_type: content_type,
        acl: 'public-read' # Adjust based on your security requirements
      )
    end
  end

  # Generate URL with CDN if configured
  def generate_url(key)
    if cdn_base_url
      # Use CDN URL
      "#{cdn_base_url}/#{key}"
    else
      # Generate S3 URL directly
      "https://#{bucket_name}.s3.amazonaws.com/#{key}"
    end
  end

  # Delete product images and thumbnails
  def delete_product_images(product_id, filename)
    # List all objects for this product
    objects = list_product_objects(product_id, filename)
    
    return if objects.empty?
    
    # Delete all objects
    s3_client.delete_objects(
      bucket: bucket_name,
      delete: {
        objects: objects.map { |obj| { key: obj.key } }
      }
    )
  end

  # List all objects for a product
  def list_product_objects(product_id, filename = nil)
    prefix = "products/#{product_id}/"
    objects = []
    
    resp = s3_client.list_objects_v2(bucket: bucket_name, prefix: prefix)
    objects.concat(resp.contents) if resp.contents
    
    # Filter by filename if provided
    if filename
      objects.select! { |obj| obj.key.include?(filename) }
    end
    
    objects
  end

  private

  def guess_content_type(file_path)
    ext = File.extname(file_path).downcase
    case ext
    when '.jpg', '.jpeg' then 'image/jpeg'
    when '.png' then 'image/png'
    when '.gif' then 'image/gif'
    when '.webp' then 'image/webp'
    else 'application/octet-stream'
    end
  end
end

# etsy_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'oauth2'

class EtsyAPIClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, access_token = nil)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = access_token
    
    # Configure HTTParty
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'User-Agent' => 'Etsy API Client/1.0'
    }
    
    @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}" if @access_token
  end

  # Get authentication URL for OAuth flow
  def get_auth_url(redirect_uri, scopes = ['listings_r', 'orders_r'])
    scopes_string = scopes.join('%20')
    "https://www.etsy.com/oauth/connect?response_type=code&client_id=#{@client_id}&redirect_uri=#{URI.encode_www_form_component(redirect_uri)}&scope=#{scopes_string}&state=#{SecureRandom.hex(10)}"
  end

  # Exchange authorization code for access token
  def get_access_token(authorization_code, redirect_uri)
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      @client_id,
      @client_secret,
      site: 'https://api.etsy.com',
      token_url: '/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )

    token = client.auth_code.get_token(
      authorization_code,
      redirect_uri: redirect_uri,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )
    
    @access_token = token.token
    @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    
    {
      access_token: token.token,
      refresh_token: token.refresh_token,
      expires_at: token.expires_at
    }
  end

  # Get shop ID by shop name
  def get_shop_id(shop_name)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops?shop_name=#{shop_name}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response['results'].first['shop_id'] if response['results'].any?
  end

  # Get all listings for a shop
  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, params = {})
    default_params = {
      limit: 100,
      offset: 0,
      state: 'active'
    }.merge(params)

    query_string = URI.encode_www_form(default_params)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings?#{query_string}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response['results']
  end

  # Get a specific listing by ID
  def get_listing(listing_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/listings/#{listing_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response['results'].first
  end

  # Get all orders for a shop
  def get_shop_orders(shop_id, params = {})
    default_params = {
      limit: 100,
      offset: 0
    }.merge(params)

    query_string = URI.encode_www_form(default_params)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts?#{query_string}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response['results']
  end

  # Get a specific order/receipt by ID
  def get_order(receipt_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response['results'].first
  end

  # Get transactions for a specific receipt/order
  def get_order_transactions(receipt_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/application/receipts/#{receipt_id}/transactions",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
    response['results']
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    unless response.success?
      error_message = "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      raise StandardError, error_message
    end
  end
end

# Utility class for handling pagination
class EtsyPaginator
  def initialize(client)
    @client = client
  end

  def paginate_listings(shop_id, params = {}, &block)
    paginate(:get_shop_listings, shop_id, params, &block)
  end

  def paginate_orders(shop_id, params = {}, &block)
    paginate(:get_shop_orders, shop_id, params, &block)
  end

  private

  def paginate(method, shop_id, params = {})
    offset = params[:offset] || 0
    limit = params[:limit] || 100
    all_results = []

    loop do
      params[:offset] = offset
      results = @client.send(method, shop_id, params)
      
      break if results.empty?
      
      if block_given?
        yield results
      else
        all_results.concat(results)
      end
      
      offset += limit
      break if results.length < limit
    end

    all_results unless block_given?
  end
end

  # Ініціалізація бази даних (спрощена версія)
  def setup_database
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: 'recommendations.db'
    )
  end

  # Генерація матриці користувач-товар
  def generate_user_product_matrix
    users = User.all
    products = Product.all
    
    # Створюємо матрицю розміром users.count x products.count
    matrix = Matrix.zero(users.count, products.count)
    
    user_index_map = users.each_with_index.to_h { |user, idx| [user.id, idx] }
    product_index_map = products.each_with_index.to_h { |product, idx| [product.id, idx] }
    
    # Заповнюємо матрицю на основі історії замовлень
    OrderItem.includes(:order, :product).find_each do |item|
      user_idx = user_index_map[item.order.user_id]
      product_idx = product_index_map[item.product_id]
      matrix[user_idx, product_idx] += item.quantity
    end
    
    {
      matrix: matrix,
      user_index_map: user_index_map,
      product_index_map: product_index_map.invert
    }
  end

  # Обчислення косинусної схожості між користувачами
  def calculate_user_similarities(matrix)
    n_users = matrix.row_count
    similarities = Matrix.zero(n_users, n_users)
    
    n_users.times do |i|
      n_users.times do |j|
        next if i == j
        
        user_i = matrix.row(i)
        user_j = matrix.row(j)
        
        # Косинусна схожість
        dot_product = user_i.dot(user_j)
        magnitude_i = Math.sqrt(user_i.dot(user_i))
        magnitude_j = Math.sqrt(user_j.dot(user_j))
        
        if magnitude_i > 0 && magnitude_j > 0
          similarities[i, j] = dot_product / (magnitude_i * magnitude_j)
        else
          similarities[i, j] = 0
        end
      end
    end
    
    similarities
  end

  # Рекомендації для конкретного користувача
  def recommend_for_user(user_id, limit: 10)
    cache_key = "recommendations:#{user_id}"
    cached = @redis.get(cache_key)
    
    return JSON.parse(cached) if cached
    
    data = generate_user_product_matrix
    matrix = data[:matrix]
    user_index_map = data[:user_index_map]
    product_index_map = data[:product_index_map]
    
    user_idx = user_index_map[user_id]
    return [] unless user_idx
    
    similarities = calculate_user_similarities(matrix)
    user_similarities = similarities.row(user_idx)
    
    recommendations = calculate_recommendations(
      matrix, 
      user_idx, 
      user_similarities, 
      product_index_map
    )
    
    # Кешуємо результати на 1 годину
    @redis.setex(cache_key, 3600, recommendations.to_json)
    
    recommendations.first(limit)
  end

  private

  def calculate_recommendations(matrix, user_idx, user_similarities, product_index_map)
    n_products = matrix.column_count
    user_vector = matrix.row(user_idx)
    predicted_scores = []
    
    n_products.times do |product_idx|
      # Пропускаємо товари, які користувач вже купував
      next if user_vector[product_idx] > 0
      
      score = predict_rating(matrix, user_idx, product_idx, user_similarities)
      product_id = product_index_map[product_idx]
      
      predicted_scores << {
        product_id: product_id,
        score: score,
        product_name: Product.find(product_id).name
      }
    end
    
    # Сортуємо за спаданням очікуваного рейтингу
    predicted_scores.sort_by { |item| -item[:score] }
  end

  def predict_rating(matrix, user_idx, product_idx, user_similarities)
    numerator = 0.0
    denominator = 0.0
    
    matrix.row_count.times do |other_user_idx|
      next if other_user_idx == user_idx
      
      similarity = user_similarities[other_user_idx]
      rating = matrix[other_user_idx, product_idx]
      
      if similarity > 0 && rating > 0
        numerator += similarity * rating
        denominator += similarity.abs
      end
    end
    
    denominator > 0 ? numerator / denominator : 0
  end
end

# Приклад використання
class RecommendationService
  def initialize
    @recommender = ProductRecommender.new
  end
  
  def get_recommendations(user_id, limit: 10)
    begin
      recommendations = @recommender.recommend_for_user(user_id, limit: limit)
      format_recommendations(recommendations)
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при генерації рекомендацій: #{e.message}"

    # Видаляємо кеш для оновлення рекомендацій

    get_recommendations(user_id)
  end
  
  private

        confidence_score: rec['score'].round(4),
        reason: "Схожі користувачі також купували цей товар"

class ImageUploaderService
  THUMBNAIL_SIZES = {
    small: '200x200',
    medium: '400x400',
    large: '800x800'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(bucket_name, cdn_base_url = nil)
    @bucket_name = bucket_name
    @cdn_base_url = cdn_base_url
    @s3_bucket = S3_RESOURCE.bucket(bucket_name)
  end

  # Основний метод для завантаження зображення та генерації мініатюр
  def upload_product_image(image_file, product_id, original_filename)
    # Генеруємо унікальне ім'я файлу
    file_extension = File.extname(original_filename)
    base_filename = "#{product_id}_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
    
    # Завантажуємо оригінальне зображення
    original_key = "products/#{product_id}/original/#{base_filename}#{file_extension}"
    original_url = upload_to_s3(image_file, original_key)
    
    # Генеруємо та завантажуємо мініатюри
    thumbnails = generate_thumbnails(image_file, product_id, base_filename, file_extension)
    
    {
      original: build_url(original_key),
      thumbnails: thumbnails
    }
  end

  # Генерація мініатюр різних розмірів
  def generate_thumbnails(image_file, product_id, base_filename, file_extension)
    thumbnails = {}
    
    THUMBNAIL_SIZES.each do |size_name, dimensions|
      temp_file = Tempfile.new(["thumbnail_#{size_name}", file_extension])
      
      begin
        # Використовуємо MiniMagick для обробки зображення
        image = MiniMagick::Image.read(image_file.read)
        image.resize dimensions
        image.write temp_file.path
        
        # Завантажуємо мініатюру на S3
        thumbnail_key = "products/#{product_id}/#{size_name}/#{base_filename}#{file_extension}"
        thumbnails[size_name] = upload_to_s3(temp_file, thumbnail_key)
        
      ensure
        temp_file.close
        temp_file.unlink
        image_file.rewind # Перемотуємо файл для наступної ітерації
      end
    end
    
    thumbnails
  end

  # Завантаження файлу на S3
  def upload_to_s3(file, key)
    obj = @s3_bucket.object(key)
    file.rewind if file.respond_to?(:rewind)
    
    obj.put(
      body: file,
      acl: 'public-read', # або 'private' за потребою
      content_type: determine_content_type(key)
    )
    
    build_url(key)
  end

  # Побудова URL з урахуванням CDN
  def build_url(key)
    if @cdn_base_url
      "#{@cdn_base_url}/#{key}"
    else
      "https://#{@bucket_name}.s3.#{Aws.config[:region]}.amazonaws.com/#{key}"
    end
  end

  # Видалення зображення та всіх мініатюр
  def delete_product_images(product_id, filename_base)
    # Отримуємо всі файли, пов'язані з продуктом
    objects = @s3_bucket.objects(prefix: "products/#{product_id}/")
    
    objects.each do |obj|
      if obj.key.include?(filename_base)
        obj.delete
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def determine_content_type(filename)
    case File.extname(filename).downcase
    when '.jpg', '.jpeg' then 'image/jpeg'
    when '.png' then 'image/png'
    when '.gif' then 'image/gif'
    when '.webp' then 'image/webp'
    else 'application/octet-stream'
    end
  end
end

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# product_recommender.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'active_record'
require 'active_record/import'

# Database setup
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: ':memory:'
)

# Database schema
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :customers do |t|
    t.string :name
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :products do |t|
    t.string :name
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :orders do |t|
    t.references :customer
    t.references :product
    t.integer :quantity, default: 1
    t.timestamps
  end
end

# Models
class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
  has_many :products, through: :orders
end

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
  has_many :customers, through: :orders
end

class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :customer
  belongs_to :product
end

# Main recommender class
class ProductRecommender
  def initialize
    @customer_matrix = nil
    @customer_ids = []
    @product_ids = []
  end

  # Build user-product matrix for collaborative filtering
  def build_customer_product_matrix
    # Get all customers and products
    @customer_ids = Customer.pluck(:id)
    @product_ids = Product.pluck(:id)
    
    # Initialize matrix (customers x products)
    matrix = Matrix.zero(@customer_ids.length, @product_ids.length)
    
    # Fill matrix with order quantities (binary or weighted)
    @customer_ids.each_with_index do |customer_id, customer_index|
      customer_orders = Order.where(customer_id: customer_id)
      
      customer_orders.each do |order|
        product_index = @product_ids.index(order.product_id)
        if product_index
          # Use binary (1 for purchased, 0 for not purchased)
          # or use quantity for weighted recommendations
          matrix[customer_index, product_index] = 1 # or order.quantity
        end
      end
    end
    
    @customer_matrix = matrix
  end

  # Calculate cosine similarity between two customers
  def cosine_similarity(vec1, vec2)
    dot_product = vec1.zip(vec2).map { |a, b| a * b }.sum
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vec1.map { |x| x ** 2 }.sum)
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vec2.map { |x| x ** 2 }.sum)
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1.zero? || magnitude2.zero?
    
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  # Find similar customers based on purchase history
  def find_similar_customers(target_customer_id, limit = 5)
    build_customer_product_matrix unless @customer_matrix
    
    target_index = @customer_ids.index(target_customer_id)
    return [] unless target_index
    
    target_vector = @customer_matrix.row(target_index).to_a
    
    similarities = []
    @customer_ids.each_with_index do |customer_id, index|
      next if customer_id == target_customer_id
      
      customer_vector = @customer_matrix.row(index).to_a
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_vector, customer_vector)
      
      similarities << { customer_id: customer_id, similarity: similarity }
    end
    
    # Sort by similarity (descending) and return top matches
    similarities.sort_by { |s| -s[:similarity] }.first(limit)
  end

  # Generate product recommendations for a customer
  def recommend_products(target_customer_id, limit = 10)
    similar_customers = find_similar_customers(target_customer_id)
    return [] if similar_customers.empty?
    
    # Get products the target customer already purchased
    target_customer_products = Order.where(customer_id: target_customer_id).pluck(:product_id)
    
    # Collect products from similar customers that target hasn't purchased
    recommended_products = Hash.new(0)
    
    similar_customers.each do |similar_customer|
      # Weight products by similarity score
      similarity_weight = similar_customer[:similarity]
      
      Order.where(customer_id: similar_customer[:customer_id])
           .where.not(product_id: target_customer_products)
           .each do |order|
        recommended_products[order.product_id] += similarity_weight
      end
    end
    
    # Sort by recommendation score and return top products
    recommended_products.sort_by { |product_id, score| -score }
                        .first(limit)
                        .map { |product_id, score| { product_id: product_id, score: score } }
  end

  # Alternative method: Item-based collaborative filtering
  def item_based_recommendations(target_customer_id, limit = 10)
    build_customer_product_matrix unless @customer_matrix
    
    target_index = @customer_ids.index(target_customer_id)
    return [] unless target_index
    
    target_products = @customer_matrix.row(target_index)
    
    # Get products target customer hasn't purchased
    unpurchased_products = []
    @product_ids.each_with_index do |product_id, product_index|
      unpurchased_products << product_id if target_products[product_index] == 0
    end
    
    # Calculate scores for unpurchased products
    product_scores = {}
    
    unpurchased_products.each do |product_id|
      product_index = @product_ids.index(product_id)
      product_vector = @customer_matrix.column(product_index)
      
      score = 0.0
      @product_ids.each_with_index do |purchased_product_id, purchased_index|
        if target_products[purchased_index] > 0
          purchased_vector = @customer_matrix.column(purchased_index)
          similarity = cosine_similarity(
            product_vector.to_a, 
            purchased_vector.to_a
          )
          score += similarity
        end
      end
      
      product_scores[product_id] = score
    end
    
    # Return top recommendations
    product_scores.sort_by { |product_id, score| -score }
                  .first(limit)
                  .map { |product_id, score| { product_id: product_id, score: score } }
  end
end

    [customers[0].id, products[2].id], # Keyboard
    [customers[0].id, products[3].id], # Monitor
    
    # Bob: Similar to Alice but also audio
    [customers[1].id, products[0].id], # Laptop
    [customers[1].id, products[1].id], # Mouse
    [customers[1].id, products[4].id], # Headphones
    [customers[1].id, products[6].id], # Microphone
    
    # Charlie: Audio focused
    [customers[2].id, products[4].id], # Headphones
    [customers[2].id, products[6].id], # Microphone
    [customers[2].id, products[7].id], # Tablet
    
    # Diana: Minimal purchases
    [customers[3].id, products[7].id], # Tablet
    
    # Eve: Video conferencing
    [customers[4].id, products[5].id], # Webcam
    [customers[4].id, products[6].id], # Microphone
    [customers[4].id, products[3].id]  # Monitor
  ]
  
  orders = orders_data.map do |customer_id, product_id|
    Order.new(customer_id: customer_id, product_id: product_id)
  end
  Order.import(orders)
  
  # Test the recommender
  recommender = ProductRecommender.new
  
  puts "Customer-based recommendations for Alice:"
  recommendations = recommender.recommend_products(customers[0].id)
  recommendations.each do |rec|
    product = Product.find(rec[:product_id])
    puts "  #{product.name}: #{rec[:score].round(3)}"
  end
  
  puts "\nItem-based recommendations for Alice:"
  item_recs = recommender.item_based_recommendations(customers[0].id)
  item_recs.each do |rec|
    product = Product.find(rec[:product_id])
    puts "  #{product.name}: #{rec[:score].round(3)}"
  end
  
  puts "\nSimilar customers to Alice:"
  similar = recommender.find_similar_customers(customers[0].id)
  similar.each do |sim|
    customer = Customer.find(sim[:customer_id])
    puts "  #{customer.name}: #{sim[:similarity].round(3)}"
  end
end

# etsy_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'oauth2'

Dotenv.load

class EtsyApiClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'

  def initialize(client_id: nil, client_secret: nil, access_token: nil)
    @client_id = client_id || ENV['ETSY_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = client_secret || ENV['ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @access_token = access_token || ENV['ETSY_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    
    validate_credentials
    setup_oauth_client
  end

  # Get shop listings
  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, params = {})
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings"
    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Get shop listings by state (active, draft, expired, etc.)
  def get_shop_listings_by_state(shop_id, state = 'active', params = {})
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings"
    params[:state] = state
    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Get a specific listing
  def get_listing(listing_id)
    endpoint = "/application/listings/#{listing_id}"
    make_request(endpoint)
  end

  # Get shop orders
  def get_shop_orders(shop_id, params = {})
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts"
    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Get a specific order/receipt
  def get_order(receipt_id)
    endpoint = "/application/receipts/#{receipt_id}"
    make_request(endpoint)
  end

  # Get orders by status
  def get_orders_by_status(shop_id, status, params = {})
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts"
    params[:status] = status
    make_request(endpoint, params)
  end

  # Get transactions for a receipt
  def get_transactions(receipt_id)
    endpoint = "/application/receipts/#{receipt_id}/transactions"
    make_request(endpoint)
  end

  # Get shop information
  def get_shop(shop_id)
    endpoint = "/application/shops/#{shop_id}"
    make_request(endpoint)
  end

  # Get user's shops
  def get_user_shops(user_id)
    endpoint = "/application/users/#{user_id}/shops"
    make_request(endpoint)
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    unless @client_id && @client_secret
      raise "Missing Etsy API credentials. Set ETSY_CLIENT_ID and ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables."
    end
  end

  def setup_oauth_client
    @oauth_client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      @client_id,
      @client_secret,
      site: 'https://openapi.etsy.com',
      token_url: '/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )
  end

  def make_request(endpoint, params = {})
    url = "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}"
    
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => @client_id
    }

    # Add access token to headers if available
    headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}" if @access_token

    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers, query: params)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    when 403
      raise "Access denied: #{response.body}"
    when 404
      raise "Resource not found: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "API Error (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# OAuth Helper Class
class EtsyOAuthHelper
  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @redirect_uri = redirect_uri
    @oauth_client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      client_id,
      client_secret,
      site: 'https://openapi.etsy.com',
      authorize_url: '/v3/public/oauth/connect',
      token_url: '/v3/public/oauth/token'
    )
  end

  # Generate authorization URL
  def authorization_url(scopes = [])
    @oauth_client.auth_code.authorize_url(
      redirect_uri: @redirect_uri,
      scope: scopes.join(' '),
      response_type: 'code'
    )
  end

  # Exchange authorization code for access token
  def get_access_token(authorization_code)
    token = @oauth_client.auth_code.get_token(
      authorization_code,
      redirect_uri: @redirect_uri,
      grant_type: 'authorization_code'
    )
    token.token
  end

  # Refresh access token
  def refresh_token(refresh_token)
    token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(@oauth_client, nil, refresh_token: refresh_token)
    new_token = token.refresh!
    new_token.token
  end
end

```ruby
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'securerandom'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class ImageUploader
  THUMBNAIL_SIZES = {
    small: '200x200',
    medium: '400x400',
    large: '800x800'
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    @s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new(
      access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
      secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'],
      region: ENV['AWS_REGION']
    )
    @bucket_name = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME']
    @cdn_base_url = ENV['CDN_BASE_URL']
  end

  # Основний метод для завантаження зображення та генерації мініатюр
  def upload_product_image(image_path, product_id, options = {})
    original_filename = File.basename(image_path)
    file_extension = File.extname(original_filename)
    
    # Генеруємо унікальне ім'я файлу
    base_filename = "#{product_id}_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
    
    # Завантажуємо оригінальне зображення
    original_key = "products/#{product_id}/original/#{base_filename}#{file_extension}"
    upload_to_s3(image_path, original_key)
    
    # Генеруємо мініатюри
    thumbnails = generate_thumbnails(image_path, product_id, base_filename, file_extension)
    
    {
      original: generate_cdn_url(original_key),
      thumbnails: thumbnails
    }
  end

  private

  def generate_thumbnails(original_image_path, product_id, base_filename, file_extension)
    thumbnails = {}
    
    THUMBNAIL_SIZES.each do |size_name, dimensions|
      temp_file = process_image(original_image_path, dimensions)
      thumbnail_key = "products/#{product_id}/#{size_name}/#{base_filename}#{file_extension}"
      
      upload_to_s3(temp_file.path, thumbnail_key)
      thumbnails[size_name] = generate_cdn_url(thumbnail_key)
      
      temp_file.close
      temp_file.unlink
    end
    
    thumbnails
  end

  def process_image(image_path, dimensions)
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(image_path)
    
    # Обрізаємо та масштабуємо зображення
    image.combine_options do |cmd|
      cmd.auto_orient
      cmd.strip
      cmd.resize "#{dimensions}^"
      cmd.gravity 'center'
      cmd.extent dimensions
      cmd.quality '85'
    end
    
    # Створюємо тимчасовий файл
    temp_file = Tempfile.new(['processed', '.jpg'])
    image.write(temp_file.path)
    temp_file
  end

  def upload_to_s3(file_path, s3_key)
    File.open(file_path, 'rb') do |file|
      @s3_client.put_object(
        bucket: @bucket_name,
        key: s3_key,
        body: file,
        acl: 'public-read',
        content_type: 'image/jpeg'
      )
    end
  end

  def generate_cdn_url(s3_key)
    "#{@cdn_base_url}/#{s3_key}"
  end

  # Метод для видалення всіх зображень товару
  def delete_product_images(product_id)
    objects = list_objects_by_prefix("products/#{product_id}/")
    
    unless objects.empty?
      @s3_client.delete_objects(
        bucket: @bucket_name,
        delete: {
          objects: objects.map { |obj| { key: obj.key } }
        }
      )
    end
  end

  def list_objects_by_prefix(prefix)
    response = @s3_client.list_objects_v2(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      prefix: prefix
    )
    response.contents || []
  end
end

### app/models/cart.rb
```ruby
class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  include AASM
  
  has_many :cart_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :products, through: :cart_items
  belongs_to :coupon, optional: true
  
  # Стани кошика
  aasm column: 'state' do
    state :active, initial: true
    state :completed
    state :abandoned
    
    event :complete do
      transitions from: :active, to: :completed
    end
    
    event :abandon do
      transitions from: :active, to: :abandoned
    end
  end
  
  # Додавання товару до кошика
  def add_product(product, quantity = 1)
    cart_item = cart_items.find_or_initialize_by(product_id: product.id)
    cart_item.quantity += quantity
    cart_item.save!
  end
  
  # Видалення товару з кошика
  def remove_product(product)
    cart_items.where(product_id: product.id).destroy_all
  end
  
  # Оновлення кількості товару
  def update_quantity(product, quantity)
    if quantity <= 0
      remove_product(product)
    else
      cart_item = cart_items.find_by(product_id: product.id)
      cart_item.update(quantity: quantity) if cart_item
    end
  end
  
  # Загальна вартість без знижки
  def subtotal
    cart_items.sum { |item| item.product.price * item.quantity }
  end
  
  # Розмір знижки
  def discount_amount
    return 0 unless coupon && coupon.valid_for_cart?(self)
    
    if coupon.percentage_discount?
      subtotal * (coupon.discount_value / 100.0)
    else
      coupon.discount_value
    end
  end
  
  # Загальна вартість з урахуванням знижки
  def total
    discount = discount_amount
    final_total = subtotal - discount
    [final_total, 0].max # Не може бути від'ємним
  end
  
  # Застосування купона
  def apply_coupon(coupon_code)
    coupon = Coupon.find_by(code: coupon_code, active: true)
    
    if coupon && coupon.valid_for_cart?(self)
      update(coupon: coupon)
      true
    else
      errors.add(:base, 'Недійсний купон')
      false
    end
  end
  
  # Видалення купона
  def remove_coupon
    update(coupon: nil)
  end
  
  # Перевірка, чи застосовано купон
  def coupon_applied?
    coupon.present?
  end
end

class Coupon < ApplicationRecord
  # Типи знижок
  PERCENTAGE = 'percentage'
  FIXED_AMOUNT = 'fixed_amount'
  
  validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :discount_type, inclusion: { in: [PERCENTAGE, FIXED_AMOUNT] }
  validates :discount_value, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :minimum_amount, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validate :expiration_date_cannot_be_in_past
  
  has_many :carts
  
  # Перевірка, чи купон дійсний для кошика
  def valid_for_cart?(cart)
    active? &&
    !expired? &&
    cart.subtotal >= minimum_amount &&
    usage_limit > used_count
  end
  
  # Чи є знижка відсотковою
  def percentage_discount?
    discount_type == PERCENTAGE
  end
  
  # Чи є знижка фіксованою сумою
  def fixed_amount_discount?
    discount_type == FIXED_AMOUNT
  end
  
  # Чи протермінований купон
  def expired?
    expiration_date.present? && expiration_date < Date.current
  end
  
  # Збільшення лічильника використань
  def increment_usage!
    update(used_count: used_count + 1)
  end
  
  private
  
  def expiration_date_cannot_be_in_past
    if expiration_date.present? && expiration_date < Date.current
      errors.add(:expiration_date, "не може бути в минулому")
    end
  end
end

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# lib/recommendation_engine.rb
require 'matrix'

class RecommendationEngine
  def initialize(orders)
    @orders = orders
    @user_item_matrix = build_user_item_matrix
    @similarity_cache = {}
  end

  # Основна функція для отримання рекомендацій
  def recommend_for_user(user_id, top_n: 5)
    user_index = user_id_to_index(user_id)
    return [] unless user_index

    # Знаходимо найбільш схожих користувачів
    similar_users = find_similar_users(user_index, top_n: 10)
    
    # Рекомендуємо товари, які схожі користувачі купували, а поточний - ні
    recommended_items = generate_recommendations(user_index, similar_users)
    
    recommended_items.first(top_n)
  end

  private

  def build_user_item_matrix
    users = @orders.map { |order| order[:user_id] }.uniq.sort
    items = @orders.map { |order| order[:item_id] }.uniq.sort
    
    @user_index_map = users.each_with_index.to_h
    @item_index_map = items.each_with_index.to_h
    @index_user_map = @user_index_map.invert
    @index_item_map = @item_index_map.invert

    # Створюємо матрицю user-item (кількість замовлень)
    matrix = Matrix.zero(users.size, items.size)
    
    @orders.each do |order|
      user_idx = @user_index_map[order[:user_id]]
      item_idx = @item_index_map[order[:item_id]]
      matrix[user_idx, item_idx] += order[:quantity] || 1
    end
    
    matrix
  end

  def user_id_to_index(user_id)
    @user_index_map[user_id]
  end

  def item_index_to_id(item_index)
    @index_item_map[item_index]
  end

  # Обчислення косинусної схожості між користувачами
  def cosine_similarity(user_a_index, user_b_index)
    cache_key = [user_a_index, user_b_index].sort
    return @similarity_cache[cache_key] if @similarity_cache[cache_key]

    vector_a = @user_item_matrix.row(user_a_index)
    vector_b = @user_item_matrix.row(user_b_index)

    dot_product = 0
    magnitude_a = 0
    magnitude_b = 0

    vector_a.each_with_index do |a_val, i|
      b_val = vector_b[i]
      dot_product += a_val * b_val
      magnitude_a += a_val * a_val
      magnitude_b += b_val * b_val
    end

    magnitude_a = Math.sqrt(magnitude_a)
    magnitude_b = Math.sqrt(magnitude_b)

    similarity = if magnitude_a > 0 && magnitude_b > 0
                  dot_product / (magnitude_a * magnitude_b)
                 else
                  0
                 end

    @similarity_cache[cache_key] = similarity
    similarity
  end

  # Пошук схожих користувачів
  def find_similar_users(target_user_index, top_n: 10)
    similarities = []
    
    @user_item_matrix.row_count.times do |other_user_index|
      next if other_user_index == target_user_index
      
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_user_index, other_user_index)
      similarities << {
        user_index: other_user_index,
        similarity: similarity
      }
    end

    similarities.sort_by { |s| -s[:similarity] }.first(top_n)
  end

  # Генерація рекомендацій на основі схожих користувачів
  def generate_recommendations(target_user_index, similar_users)
    target_user_items = @user_item_matrix.row(target_user_index)
    recommendations = {}
    
    similar_users.each do |similar_user|
      similarity = similar_user[:similarity]
      similar_user_index = similar_user[:user_index]
      similar_user_items = @user_item_matrix.row(similar_user_index)
      
      similar_user_items.each_with_index do |rating, item_index|
        # Пропускаємо товари, які вже купив цільовий користувач
        next if target_user_items[item_index] > 0
        
        # Додаємо вагу рекомендації на основі схожості та рейтингу
        item_id = item_index_to_id(item_index)
        recommendations[item_id] ||= 0
        recommendations[item_id] += rating * similarity
      end
    end

    # Сортуємо за вагою рекомендації
    recommendations.sort_by { |item_id, score| -score }.map do |item_id, score|
      { item_id: item_id, score: score.round(4) }
    end
  end
end
```

# services/recommendation_service.rb
class RecommendationService
  def initialize
    # Завантажуємо дані про замовлення з бази даних
    @orders = load_order_data
    @engine = RecommendationEngine.new(@orders)
  end

  def get_recommendations(user_id, limit: 5)
    recommendations = @engine.recommend_for_user(user_id, top_n: limit)
    
    # Додаємо інформацію про товари
    recommendations.map do |rec|
      item = Item.find_by(id: rec[:item_id])
      next unless item
      
      {
        item_id: item.id,
        item_name: item.name,
        score: rec[:score],
        price: item.price,
        category: item.category
      }
    end.compact
  end

  def batch_recommendations(user_ids, limit: 3)
    user_ids.index_with do |user_id|
      get_recommendations(user_id, limit: limit)
    end
  end

  private

  def load_order_data
    Order.includes(:user, :item).map do |order|
      {
        user_id: order.user_id,
        item_id: order.item_id,
        quantity: order.quantity,
        created_at: order.created_at
      }
    end
  end
end

Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaShipment
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.ukrposhta.ua/api/v3'
  
  def initialize(api_token, client_id)
    @api_token = api_token
    @client_id = client_id
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'ClientId' => client_id
    }
  end
  
  # Create a new shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/shipments"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers,
      body: shipment_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to create shipment: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Print label for a shipment
  def print_label(shipment_uuid, format = 'pdf')
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_uuid}/labels"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      endpoint,
      headers: @headers.merge('Accept' => "application/#{format}"),
      query: { format: format }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      raise "Failed to print label: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Save label to file
  def save_label(shipment_uuid, filename = nil, format = 'pdf')
    label_data = print_label(shipment_uuid, format)
    filename ||= "shipment_#{shipment_uuid}.#{format}"
    
    File.binwrite(filename, label_data)
    puts "Label saved to: #{filename}"
    filename
  end

# ukrposhta_shipment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaShipment
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.ukrposhta.ua/api/v1'.freeze
  
  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_SECRET']
    @token = authenticate
  end
  
  # Authenticate and get bearer token
  def authenticate
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/auth/token",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        client_id: @api_key,
        client_secret: @api_secret,
        grant_type: 'client_credentials'
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Create a new shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}"
      },
      body: shipment_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Shipment creation failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Print label for a shipment
  def print_label(shipment_uuid, format = 'pdf')
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_uuid}/label",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}"
      },
      query: {
        format: format
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      raise "Label printing failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Save label to file
  def save_label_to_file(shipment_uuid, filename, format = 'pdf')
    label_data = print_label(shipment_uuid, format)
    File.binwrite(filename, label_data)
    puts "Label saved to #{filename}"
  end
end

calculate_subtotal * (coupon.discount_value / 100.0) else Money.new(coupon.discount_value * 100) # Конвертуємо у грошовий об'єкт end end def calculate_final_amount [calculate_subtotal - calculate_discount, Money.zero].max end def empty? cart_items.empty? end def items_count cart_items.sum(:quantity) end end ``` ### Модель CartItem (Елемент кошика) ```ruby # app/models/cart_item.rb class CartItem < ApplicationRecord belongs_to :cart belongs_to :product monetize :unit_price_cents validates :quantity, numericality: { greater_than: 0 } def total_price unit_price * quantity end end ``` ### Модель Coupon (Купон) ```ruby # app/models/coupon.rb class Coupon < ApplicationRecord # Типи знижки enum discount_type: { percentage: 0, fixed_amount: 1 } # Валідації validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true validates :discount_value, numericality: { greater_than: 0 } validates :min_amount, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 } validates :max_uses, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }, allow_nil: true validates :expires_at, presence: true # Монетизація monetize :min_amount_cents, allow_nil: true # Scope для активних купонів scope :active, -> { where(active: true) .where('expires_at > ?', Time.current) .where('max_uses IS NULL OR uses_count < max_uses') } def valid_for_cart?(cart) active? && !expired? && within_usage_limit? && meets_minimum_amount?(cart) && applicable_to_cart?(cart) end def expired? expires_at < Time.current end def within_usage_limit? max_uses.nil? || uses_count < max_uses end def meets_minimum_amount?(cart) min_amount.zero? || cart.calculate_subtotal >= min_amount end def applicable_to_cart?(cart) # Додаткова логіка для перевірки застосовності # Наприклад, перевірка категорій товарів тощо true end def increment_uses! update(uses_count: uses_count + 1) end def discount_text if percentage? "#{discount_value}% знижки" else "#{discount_value} грн знижки" end end end ``` ### Модель Product (Товар) ```ruby # app/models/product.rb class Product < ApplicationRecord monetize :price_cents validates :name, presence: true validates :price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 } end ``` ## Контролери ### Контролер кошика ```ruby # app/controllers/carts_controller.rb class CartsController < ApplicationController before_action :set_cart, only: [:show, :update, :destroy, :apply_coupon, :remove_coupon] def show @cart_items = @cart.cart_items.includes(:product) end def add_item product = Product.find(params[:product_id]) quantity = params[:quantity].to_i if current_cart.add_product(product, quantity) redirect_to cart_path, notice: 'Товар додано до кошика' else redirect_to product_path(product), alert: 'Помилка при додаванні товару' end end def update_item product = Product.find(params[:product_id]) quantity = params[:quantity].to_i if current_cart.update_quantity(product, quantity) redirect_to cart_path, notice: 'Кошик оновлено' else redirect_to cart_path, alert: 'Помилка при оновленні кошика' end end def remove_item product = Product.find(params[:product_id]) if current_cart.remove_product(product) redirect_to cart_path, notice: 'Товар видалено з кошика' else redirect_to cart_path, alert: 'Помилка при видаленні товару' end end def apply_coupon if @cart.apply_coupon(params[:coupon_code]) redirect_to cart_path, notice: 'Купон застосовано' else redirect_to cart_path, alert: @cart.errors.full_messages.join(', ') end end def remove_coupon @cart.remove_coupon redirect_to cart_path, notice: 'Купон видалено' end def destroy @cart.destroy session[:cart_id] = nil redirect_to root_path, notice: 'Кошик очищено' end private def set_cart @cart = current_cart end def current_cart if session[:cart_id] Cart.find_by(id: session[:cart_id]) else cart = Cart.create session[:cart_id] = cart.id cart end end end ``` ## # app/models/bigcommerce_product.rb
class BigcommerceProduct
  include HTTParty
  base_uri "https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/#{ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH']}/v3"

  headers(
    'X-Auth-Token' => ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
    'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    'Accept' => 'application/json'
  )

  class << self
    def create(product_attributes)
      response = post('/catalog/products', body: product_attributes.to_json)
      handle_response(response)
    end

    def find(product_id)
      response = get("/catalog/products/#{product_id}")
      handle_response(response)
    end

    def update(product_id, product_attributes)
      response = put("/catalog/products/#{product_id}", body: product_attributes.to_json)
      handle_response(response)
    end

    def delete(product_id)
      response = delete("/catalog/products/#{product_id}")
      handle_response(response)
    end

    def all(page: 1, limit: 50)
      response = get("/catalog/products?page=#{page}&limit=#{limit}")
      handle_response(response)
    end

    private

    def handle_response(response)
      if response.success?
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      else
        raise "BigCommerce API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### app/services/bigcommerce_service.rb

```ruby
# app/services/bigcommerce_service.rb
class BigcommerceService
  def initialize
    @products_api = BigcommerceProduct
    @orders_api = BigcommerceOrder
  end

  # Product methods
  def create_product(product_data)
    product_attributes = format_product_attributes(product_data)
    @products_api.create(product_attributes)
  end

  def update_product(product_id, product_data)
    product_attributes = format_product_attributes(product_data)
    @products_api.update(product_id, product_attributes)
  end

  def find_product(product_id)
    @products_api.find(product_id)
  end

  def list_products(options = {})
    @products_api.all(options)
  end

  # Order methods
  def create_order(order_data)
    order_attributes = format_order_attributes(order_data)
    @orders_api.create(order_attributes)
  end

  def update_order(order_id, order_data)
    order_attributes = format_order_attributes(order_data)
    @orders_api.update(order_id, order_attributes)
  end

  def find_order(order_id)
    @orders_api.find(order_id)
  end

  def list_orders(options = {})
    @orders_api.all(options)
  end

  def add_product_to_order(order_id, product_data)
    @orders_api.create_order_product(order_id, product_data)
  end

  private

  def format_product_attributes(data)
    {
      name: data[:name],
      type: data[:type] || 'physical',
      sku: data[:sku],
      description: data[:description],
      weight: data[:weight],
      width: data[:width],
      depth: data[:depth],
      height: data[:height],
      price: data[:price],
      cost_price: data[:cost_price],
      retail_price: data[:retail_price],
      sale_price: data[:sale_price],
      categories: data[:categories] || [],
      is_visible: data[:is_visible] || true,
      availability: data[:availability] || 'available',
      inventory_level: data[:inventory_level] || 0
    }.compact
  end

  def format_order_attributes(data)
    {
      customer_id: data[:customer_id],
      date_created: data[:date_created] || Time.now.utc.iso8601,
      status_id: data[:status_id] || 0,
      billing_address: format_address(data[:billing_address]),
      shipping_addresses: [format_address(data[:shipping_address])].compact,
      products: format_order_products(data[:products])
    }.compact
  end

  def format_address(address_data)
    return nil unless address_data

    {
      first_name: address_data[:first_name],
      last_name: address_data[:last_name],
      street_1: address_data[:street_1],
      city: address_data[:city],
      state: address_data[:state],
      zip: address_data[:zip],
      country: address_data[:country],
      country_iso2: address_data[:country_iso2],
      email: address_data[:email]
    }.compact
  end

  def format_order_products(products)
    return [] unless products

    products.map do |product|
      {
        product_id: product[:product_id],
        quantity: product[:quantity],
        price_inc_tax: product[:price_inc_tax],
        price_ex_tax: product[:price_ex_tax]
      }.compact
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
module BigcommerceProductable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern
  
  included do
    after_create :create_bigcommerce_product, if: :should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
    after_update :update_bigcommerce_product, if: :should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
    after_destroy :delete_bigcommerce_product, if: :should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
  end
  
  def create_bigcommerce_product
    bigcommerce_api.create_product(product_attributes)
  rescue Bigcommerce::RequestError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to create product in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
  
  def update_bigcommerce_product
    return unless bigcommerce_product_id.present?
    
    bigcommerce_api.update_product(bigcommerce_product_id, product_attributes)
  rescue Bigcommerce::RequestError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to update product in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
  
  def delete_bigcommerce_product
    return unless bigcommerce_product_id.present?
    
    bigcommerce_api.delete_product(bigcommerce_product_id)
  rescue Bigcommerce::RequestError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to delete product in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
  
  def product_attributes
    {
      name: name,
      type: 'physical',
      sku: sku,
      description: description.to_s,
      price: price.to_f,
      categories: categories,
      weight: weight.to_f,
      width: width.to_f,
      height: height.to_f,
      depth: depth.to_f,
      is_visible: active?,
      availability: 'available',
      inventory_level: inventory_quantity.to_i
    }.compact
  end
  
  def bigcommerce_api
    @bigcommerce_api ||= Bigcommerce::Product.new
  end
  
  def should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
    ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_SYNC_ENABLED'] == 'true'
  end
end
```

module BigcommerceOrderable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern
  
  included do
    after_create :create_bigcommerce_order, if: :should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
    after_update :update_bigcommerce_order, if: :should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
  end
  
  def create_bigcommerce_order
    order_data = bigcommerce_order_attributes
    created_order = bigcommerce_api.create_order(order_data)
    
    update(bigcommerce_order_id: created_order['id'])
  rescue Bigcommerce::RequestError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to create order in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
  
  def update_bigcommerce_order
    return unless bigcommerce_order_id.present?
    
    if status_changed?
      bigcommerce_api.update_order(bigcommerce_order_id, { status_id: bigcommerce_status_id })
    end
  rescue Bigcommerce::RequestError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to update order in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
  
  def bigcommerce_order_attributes
    {
      customer_id: bigcommerce_customer_id,
      billing_address: billing_address_attributes,
      shipping_addresses: [shipping_address_attributes],
      products: order_items_attributes,
      status_id: bigcommerce_status_id,
      date_created: created_at.iso8601,
      subtotal_ex_tax: subtotal.to_f,
      subtotal_inc_tax: subtotal_with_tax.to_f,
      total_ex_tax: total_ex_tax.to_f,
      total_inc_tax: total.to_f,
      currency_code: currency || 'USD'
    }.compact
  end
  
  def order_items_attributes
    order_items.map do |item|
      {
        product_id: item.product.bigcommerce_product_id,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        price_ex_tax: item.unit_price.to_f,
        price_inc_tax: item.unit_price_with_tax.to_f
      }
    end
  end
  
  def billing_address_attributes
    {
      first_name: billing_first_name,
      last_name: billing_last_name,
      street_1: billing_address,
      city: billing_city,
      state: billing_state,
      zip: billing_zip,
      country: billing_country,
      email: email
    }.compact
  end
  
  def shipping_address_attributes
    {
      first_name: shipping_first_name,
      last_name: shipping_last_name,
      street_1: shipping_address,
      city: shipping_city,
      state: shipping_state,
      zip: shipping_zip,
      country: shipping_country
    }.compact
  end
  
  def bigcommerce_status_id
    case status
    when 'pending' then 0
    when 'processing' then 11
    when 'shipped' then 2
    when 'completed' then 10
    when 'cancelled' then 4
    else 0
    end
  end
  
  def bigcommerce_customer_id
    customer&.bigcommerce_customer_id
  end
  
  def bigcommerce_api
    @bigcommerce_api ||= Bigcommerce::Order.new
  end
  
  def should_sync_to_bigcommerce?
    ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_SYNC_ENABLED'] == 'true'
  end
end

## Сервіс для синхронізації продуктів

`app/services/bigcommerce_sync_service.rb`

```ruby
class BigcommerceSyncService
  def initialize
    @product_api = Bigcommerce::Product.new
    @order_api = Bigcommerce::Order.new
  end
  
  def sync_all_products
    Product.where(bigcommerce_product_id: nil).find_each do |product|
      sync_product(product)
    end
  end
  
  def sync_product(product)
    return if product.bigcommerce_product_id.present?
    
    begin
      response = @product_api.create_product(product.product_attributes)
      product.update(bigcommerce_product_id: response['id'])
      true
    rescue Bigcommerce::RequestError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync product #{product.id}: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
  
  def sync_orders_from_bigcommerce(since: 1.day.ago)
    orders = @order_api.orders(min_date_created: since.iso8601)
    
    orders.each do |order_data|
      create_or_update_local_order(order_data)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_or_update_local_order(order_data)
    order = Order.find_or_initialize_by(bigcommerce_order_id: order_data['id'])
    
    order.assign_attributes(
      email: order_data['billing_address']['email'],
      total: order_data['total_inc_tax'],
      status: map_bigcommerce_status(order_data['status_id']),
      created_at: order_data['date_created']
    )
    
    order.save!
  end
  
  def map_bigcommerce_status(status_id)
    case status_id
    when 0 then 'pending'
    when 11 then 'processing'
    when 2 then 'shipped'
    when 10 then 'completed'
    when 4 then 'cancelled'
    else 'pending'
    end
  end
end
```

## BigCommerce Service Class

```ruby
# app/services/bigcommerce_service.rb
class BigcommerceService
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores'

  def initialize
    @store_hash = ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH']
    @client_id = ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_CLIENT_ID']
    @access_token = ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'X-Auth-Token' => @access_token
    }
  end

  def create_product(product_params)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@store_hash}/v3/catalog/products"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: product_params.to_json
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def update_product(bigcommerce_product_id, product_params)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@store_hash}/v3/catalog/products/#{bigcommerce_product_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.put(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: product_params.to_json
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_product(bigcommerce_product_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@store_hash}/v3/catalog/products/#{bigcommerce_product_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def create_order(order_params)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@store_hash}/v2/orders"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: order_params.to_json
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_order(bigcommerce_order_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@store_hash}/v2/orders/#{bigcommerce_order_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def update_order_status(bigcommerce_order_id, status_id)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/@store_hash/v2/orders/#{bigcommerce_order_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.put(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: { status_id: status_id }.to_json
    })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise BigcommerceError, "BigCommerce API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

class BigcommerceError < StandardError; end
```

# app/jobs/bigcommerce_product_creation_job.rb
class BigcommerceProductCreationJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(product_id)
    product = Product.find(product_id)
    service = BigcommerceService.new
    
    response = service.create_product(product.bigcommerce_product_params)
    
    if response['data']
      product.update_column(:bigcommerce_product_id, response['data']['id'])
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to create product in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    raise e if Rails.env.development?
  end
end

require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaClient
  BASE_URL = ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_URL'] || 'https://www.ukrposhta.ua/ecom/0.0.1'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
    
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end
  
  # Створення нового відправлення
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments",
      headers: @headers,
      body: shipment_data.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Отримання етикетки у форматі PDF
  def get_label(shipment_uuid, format = 'pdf')
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_uuid}/labels",
      headers: @headers,
      query: { format: format }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      handle_response(response)
    end
  end
  
  # Збереження етикетки у файл
  def save_label_to_file(shipment_uuid, filename = "label_#{shipment_uuid}.pdf")
    label_data = get_label(shipment_uuid)
    
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      file.write(label_data)
    end
    
    puts "Етикетку збережено у файл: #{filename}"
    filename
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про відправлення
  def get_shipment_info(shipment_uuid)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_uuid}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      puts error_message
      raise error_message
    end
  end
end

    }

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'base64'

Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.ukrposhta.ua/ecom/0.0.1'.freeze

  def initialize(api_token = nil, bearer_token = nil)
    @api_token = api_token || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_TOKEN']
    @bearer_token = bearer_token || ENV['UKRPOSHTA_BEARER_TOKEN']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@bearer_token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Створення нового відправлення
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/shipments"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      body: shipment_data.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання етикетки у форматі PDF
  def get_label(shipment_uuid, label_format = 'PDF')
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_uuid}/labels"
    params = {
      labelFormat: label_format
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, {
      headers: @headers,
      query: params
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Збереження етикетки у файл
  def save_label_to_file(shipment_uuid, filename = "label_#{shipment_uuid}.pdf")
    label_data = get_label(shipment_uuid)
    
    if label_data['file']
      # Декодування base64
      pdf_content = Base64.decode64(label_data['file'])
      
      File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(pdf_content)
      end
      
      puts "Етикетку збережено у файл: #{filename}"
      filename
    else
      raise "Не вдалося отримати етикетку"
    end
  end

  # Друк етикетки (відкриття у переглядачі PDF)
  def print_label(shipment_uuid)
    filename = save_label_to_file(shipment_uuid)
    
    # Спроба відкрити PDF у переглядачі за замовчуванням
    if RUBY_PLATFORM =~ /win32|win64|\.NET|windows|cygwin|mingw32/i
      system("start #{filename}")
    elsif RUBY_PLATFORM =~ /darwin/
      system("open #{filename}")
    else
      system("xdg-open #{filename}")
    end
    
    filename
  end

  # Перевірка статусу відправлення
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_uuid)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_uuid}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      puts error_message
      raise error_message
    end
  end
end

require_relative 'ukrposhta_api'

class AdvancedShipmentManager
  def initialize
    @ukrposhta = UkrposhtaAPI.new
  end

  # Створення відправлення з валідацією
  def create_validated_shipment(shipment_params)
    # Валідація обов'язкових полів
    required_fields = [:sender, :recipient, :deliveryType, :parcels]
    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |field| shipment_params.key?(field) }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise "Відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end

    # Додавання стандартних полів
    default_params = {
      paidByRecipient: false,
      nonCashPayment: true,
      additionalServices: []
    }

    final_shipment_data = default_params.merge(shipment_params)
    
    @ukrposhta.create_shipment(final_shipment_data)
  end

  # Масове створення відправлень
  def create_batch_shipments(shipments_data)
    results = []
    
    shipments_data.each_with_index do |shipment_data, index|
      begin
        puts "Обробка відправлення #{index + 1}/#{shipments_data.size}"
        result = create_validated_shipment(shipment_data)
        results << { success: true, data: result }
      rescue StandardError => e
        results << { success: false, error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end

  # Генерація звіту про відправлення
  def generate_shipment_report(shipment_uuid)
    status = @ukrposhta.get_shipment_status(shipment_uuid)
    
    report = {
      uuid: shipment_uuid,
      status: status['status'],
      created_at: Time.now.iso8601,
      tracking_number: status['barcode'],
      recipient: status.dig('recipient', 'name'),
      destination: "#{status.dig('recipient', 'address', 'city')}, #{status.dig('recipient', 'address', 'street')}"
    }
    
    # Збереження звіту у файл
    filename = "report_#{shipment_uuid}.json"
    File.write(filename, JSON.pretty_generate(report))
    
    puts "Звіт збережено: #{filename}"
    report
  end
end

  end

    # OLX API typically requires images to be uploaded first
    # This is a placeholder - check OLX API documentation for exact endpoint
    raise "Image upload not implemented - check OLX API documentation"
  end

  private

  def make_request(endpoint, method: :get, body: nil)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Version' => '2.0'
    }

    options = {
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    }

    options[:body] = body.to_json if body

    response = HTTParty.send(method, "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", options)

    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = "API Error (#{response.code}): #{response.parsed_response}"
    puts error_message
    { error: true, code: response.code, message: response.parsed_response }
  end

# olx_partner_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

class OLXPartnerAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://olx.ua/partner/api'

  def initialize(api_key, user_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @user_id = user_id
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-User-ID' => @user_id
    }
  end

  # Get all adverts
  def get_adverts(status: nil, category_id: nil, page: 1, limit: 50)
    params = { page: page, limit: limit }
    params[:status] = status if status
    params[:category_id] = category_id if category_id

    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts",
      headers: @headers,
      query: params
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get specific advert by ID
  def get_advert(advert_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Create a new advert
  def create_advert(advert_data)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts",
      headers: @headers,
      body: advert_data.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Update existing advert
  def update_advert(advert_id, advert_data)
    response = HTTParty.patch(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      body: advert_data.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Delete advert
  def delete_advert(advert_id)
    response = HTTParty.delete(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Activate/deactivate advert
  def activate_advert(advert_id, active = true)
    response = HTTParty.patch(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      body: { active: active }.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get categories
  def get_categories
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/categories",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get locations (regions, cities)
  def get_locations(parent_id: nil)
    params = parent_id ? { parent_id: parent_id } : {}
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/locations",
      headers: @headers,
      query: params
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get advert statistics
  def get_advert_stats(advert_id, period: '7d')
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/adverts/#{advert_id}/stats",
      headers: @headers,
      query: { period: period }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise OLXAPIError, "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    raise OLXAPIError, "Invalid JSON response: #{response.body}"
  end
end

class OLXAPIError < StandardError; end

# Helper class for building advert data
class OLXAdvertBuilder
  attr_accessor :title, :description, :category_id, :price, :currency, :location_id,
                :contact_info, :images, :params, :external_id

  def initialize
    @params = {}
    @images = []
    @contact_info = {}
  end

  def set_basic_info(title, description, category_id, price, currency = 'UAH')
    @title = title
    @description = description
    @category_id = category_id

    self
  end

    self
  end

  def set_contact_info(name, phone, email = nil)

    @contact_info[:email] = email if email
    self
  end

  def add_image(image_url)
    @images << { url: image_url }
    self
  end

  def add_images(image_urls)
    @images += image_urls.map { |url| { url: url } }
    self
  end

  def add_param(key, value)
    @params[key] = value
    self
  end

  def set_external_id(id)

    self
  end

  def build
