```ruby
class GlovoOrder
  # Glovo API base URL (this might vary - check Glovo's latest API documentation)
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.glovoapp.com'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end
  
  # Step 1: Get available delivery zones in Kyiv
  def get_kyiv_zones
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}/v2/addresses/zones", headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      zones = JSON.parse(response.body)
      # Filter for Kyiv zones
      kyiv_zones = zones.select { |zone| zone['city']['name'].downcase.include?('kyiv') }
      kyiv_zones
    else
      puts "Error fetching zones: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      []
    end
  end
  
  # Step 2: Estimate delivery price and time
  def estimate_delivery(address_from, address_to)
    estimate_data = {
      addresses: [
        {
          type: 'PICKUP',
          lat: address_from[:lat],
          lng: address_from[:lng],
          label: address_from[:label] || 'Pickup location'
        },
        {
          type: 'DELIVERY',
          lat: address_to[:lat],
          lng: address_to[:lng],
          label: address_to[:label] || 'Delivery location'
        }
      ]
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v2/orders/estimate",
      headers: @headers,
      body: estimate_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error estimating delivery: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Step 3: Create an order
  def create_order(order_details)
    order_data = {
      addresses: order_details[:addresses],
      description: order_details[:description] || 'Fast delivery in Kyiv',
      scheduled_time: order_details[:scheduled_time] || nil # Optional: for scheduled deliveries
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v2/orders",
      headers: @headers,
      body: order_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      order = JSON.parse(response.body)
      puts "Order created successfully!"
      puts "Order ID: #{order['id']}"
      puts "Estimated delivery time: #{order['estimated_time']} minutes"
      puts "Total price: #{order['total_price']['amount']} #{order['total_price']['currency']}"
      order
    else
      puts "Error creating order: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Step 4: Track order status
  def track_order(order_id)
    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}/v2/orders/#{order_id}", headers: @headers)
    
    if response.success?
      order_status = JSON.parse(response.body)
      puts "Order Status: #{order_status['status']}"
      puts "Courier: #{order_status['courier']&.dig('name') || 'Not assigned yet'}"
      order_status
    else
      puts "Error tracking order: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Complete workflow to order a courier
  def order_courier(pickup_location, delivery_location, description = nil)
    puts "Starting Glovo courier order process for Kyiv..."
    
    # 1. Estimate delivery
    puts "Estimating delivery..."
    estimate = estimate_delivery(pickup_location, delivery_location)
    
    unless estimate
      puts "Failed to estimate delivery. Please check your addresses."
      return nil
    end
    
    puts "Estimated price: #{estimate['total_price']['amount']} #{estimate['total_price']['currency']}"
    puts "Estimated time: #{estimate['estimated_time']} minutes"
    
    # 2. Create order
    puts "Creating order..."
    order_details = {
      addresses: [
        {
          type: 'PICKUP',
          lat: pickup_location[:lat],
          lng: pickup_location[:lng],
          label: pickup_location[:label] || 'Pickup location'
        },
        {
          type: 'DELIVERY',
          lat: delivery_location[:lat],
          lng: delivery_location[:lng],
          label: delivery_location[:label] || 'Delivery location'
        }
      ],
      description: description
    }
    
    order = create_order(order_details)
    order
  end
end
```

```ruby
# bas_exporter.rb
require 'axlsx'

class BASExporter
  # BAS document types
  DOCUMENT_TYPES = {
    invoice: 'Рахунок-фактура',
    payment: 'Платіжне доручення',
    waybill: 'Товарно-транспортна накладна'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(config_path = 'bas_config.json')
    @config = load_config(config_path)
  end

  # Main export method
  def export_orders(orders, export_type: :excel, file_path: nil)
    case export_type
    when :excel
      export_to_excel(orders, file_path)
    when :csv
      export_to_csv(orders, file_path)
    when :xml
      export_to_xml(orders, file_path)
    else
      raise "Unsupported export type: #{export_type}"
    end
  end

  # Export to Excel (BAS preferred format)
  def export_to_excel(orders, file_path = nil)
    file_path ||= "bas_export_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.xlsx"

    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet(name: 'Замовлення') do |sheet|
        add_excel_headers(sheet)
        add_order_data(sheet, orders)
      end

      p.workbook.add_worksheet(name: 'Довідник контрагентів') do |sheet|
        add_counterparties_headers(sheet)
        add_counterparties_data(sheet, orders)
      end

      p.serialize(file_path)
    end

    puts "Exported #{orders.size} orders to #{file_path}"
    file_path
  end

  # Export to CSV (alternative format)
  def export_to_csv(orders, file_path = nil)
    file_path ||= "bas_export_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.csv"

    CSV.open(file_path, 'w', headers: true, encoding: 'UTF-8') do |csv|
      csv << csv_headers
      orders.each { |order| csv << order_to_csv_row(order) }
    end

    puts "Exported #{orders.size} orders to #{file_path}"
    file_path
  end

  # Export to XML (BAS XML format)
  def export_to_xml(orders, file_path = nil)
    file_path ||= "bas_export_#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.xml"

    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.Document do
        xml.Header do
          xml.ExportDate Time.now.iso8601
          xml.CompanyInfo @config['company_info']
        end
        xml.Orders do
          orders.each { |order| add_order_xml(xml, order) }
        end
      end
    end

    File.write(file_path, builder.to_xml)
    puts "Exported #{orders.size} orders to #{file_path}"
    file_path
  end

  private

  def load_config(config_path)
    if File.exist?(config_path)
      JSON.parse(File.read(config_path))
    else
      create_default_config(config_path)
    end
  end

  def create_default_config(config_path)
    default_config = {
      'company_info' => {
        'name' => 'Ваша компанія',
        'edrpou' => '00000000',
        'iban' => 'UA000000000000000000000000000',
        'bank_name' => 'Ваш банк',
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class GlovoClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.glovoapp.com'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required. Set GLOVO_API_KEY environment variable." unless @api_key
    
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end

  # Get available products/categories in a specific area
  def get_products(latitude, longitude)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/web/v3/addresses/available-products",
      headers: @headers,
      query: {
        latitude: latitude,
        longitude: longitude
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Estimate delivery cost and time
  def estimate_delivery(address_from, address_to)
    body = {
      addresses: [
        {
          type: "PICKUP",
          lat: address_from[:lat],
          lon: address_from[:lon],
          label: address_from[:label] || "Pickup location"
        },
        {
          type: "DELIVERY", 
          lat: address_to[:lat],
          lon: address_to[:lon],
          label: address_to[:label] || "Delivery location"
        }
      ]
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/web/v3/orders/estimate",
      headers: @headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Create a delivery order
  def create_order(order_data)
    body = {
      description: order_data[:description],
      addresses: order_data[:addresses],
      couponCode: order_data[:coupon_code]
    }.compact

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/web/v3/orders",
      headers: @headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get order status
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/web/v3/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Cancel an order
  def cancel_order(order_id)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/web/v3/orders/#{order_id}/cancel",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
# bas_exporter.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'dotenv/load'

class BASExporter
  BAS_API_ENDPOINT = ENV['BAS_API_ENDPOINT'] || 'https://api.bas.ua/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, company_id: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['BAS_API_KEY']
    @company_id = company_id || ENV['BAS_COMPANY_ID']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'X-Company-ID' => @company_id
    }
  end

  # Основний метод для експорту замовлення
  def export_order(order_data)
    validate_order_data(order_data)
    xml_data = build_order_xml(order_data)
    
    response = send_to_bas(xml_data)
    
    if response.success?
      parse_success_response(response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_order_data(order)
    required_fields = [:number, :date, :customer, :items]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| order[field].nil? || order[field].empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    validate_order_items(order[:items])
  end

  def validate_order_items(items)
    raise ArgumentError, "Замовлення повинно містити хоча б один товар" if items.empty?
    
    items.each do |item|
      required_item_fields = [:name, :quantity, :price, :unit]
      missing_fields = required_item_fields.select { |field| item[field].nil? }
      
      unless missing_fields.empty?
        raise ArgumentError, "В товарі відсутні обов'язкові поля: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      end
    end
  end

  def build_order_xml(order)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.order do |ord|
      ord.number order[:number]
      ord.date format_date(order[:date])
      ord.customer do |cust|
        cust.name order.dig(:customer, :name)
        cust.code order.dig(:customer, :code)
        cust.tax_id order.dig(:customer, :tax_id)
        cust.address order.dig(:customer, :address)
      end
      
      ord.items do |items|
        order[:items].each do |item|
          items.item do |i|
            i.code item[:code]
            i.name item[:name]
            i.quantity item[:quantity]
            i.price item[:price]
            i.unit item[:unit]
            i.vat_rate item[:vat_rate] || 20.0
            i.total (item[:quantity].to_f * item[:price].to_f).round(2)
          end
        end
      end
      
      ord.total_amount calculate_total(order[:items])
      ord.currency order[:currency] || 'UAH'
      ord.notes order[:notes] if order[:notes]
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end

  def format_date(date)
    case date
    when Date, Time, DateTime
      date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    when String
      date
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Невірний формат дати"
    end
  end

  def calculate_total(items)
    items.sum do |item|
      item[:quantity].to_f * item[:price].to_f
    end.round(2)
  end

  def send_to_bas(xml_data)
    HTTParty.post(
      "#{BAS_API_ENDPOINT}/orders",
      body: xml_data,
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
  end

  def parse_success_response(response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    
    {
      success: true,
      bas_order_id: doc.at_xpath('//order/id')&.text,
      bas_order_number: doc.at_xpath('//order/number')&.text,
      message: doc.at_xpath('//response/message')&.text || 'Замовлення успішно експортовано',
      timestamp: Time.now
    }
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = if response.body.include?('<?xml')
                      doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
                      doc.at_xpath('//error/message')&.text || "Помилка BAS: #{response.code}"
                    else
                      "Помилка BAS: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
                    end
    
    {
      success: false,
      error: error_message,
      status_code: response.code,
      timestamp: Time.now
    }
  end
end
```

## Додатковий сервіс для роботи з замовленнями

```ruby
# order_service.rb
class OrderService
  def initialize(bas_exporter)
    @bas_exporter = bas_exporter
  end

  def process_and_export(order_data)
    begin
      # Додаткова обробка замовлення перед експортом
      enriched_order = enrich_order_data(order_data)
      
      # Експорт до BAS
      result = @bas_exporter.export_order(enriched_order)
      
      # Логування результату
      log_export_result(order_data[:number], result)
      
      result
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Помилка обробки: #{e.message}",
        timestamp: Time.now
      }
    end
  end

  def export_batch(orders)
    results = []
    
    orders.each do |order|
      result = process_and_export(order)
      results << result.merge(order_number: order[:number])
      
      # Затримка між запитами щоб не перевантажити API
      sleep(1) unless order == orders.last
    end
    
    {
      total_processed: orders.size,
      successful: results.count { |r| r[:success] },
      failed: results.count { |r| !r[:success] },
      details: results
    }
  end

  private

  def enrich_order_data(order)
    # Додавання додаткової інформації до замовлення
    order.merge(
      exported_at: Time.now.iso8601,
      currency: order[:currency] || 'UAH'
    )
  end

  def log_export_result(order_number, result)
    log_entry = {
      order_number: order_number,
      success: result[:success],
      timestamp: Time.now
    }
    
    if result[:success]
      log_entry.merge!(
        bas_order_id: result[:bas_order_id],
        bas_order_number: result[:bas_order_number]
      )
      puts "✅ Замовлення #{order_number} успішно експортовано. BAS ID: #{result[:bas_order_id]}"
    else
      log_entry.merge!(error: result[:error])
      puts "❌ Помилка експорту замовлення #{order_number}: #{result[:error]}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Сервіс експорту

```ruby
# lib/services/bas_exporter.rb
module BASExport
  class BASExporter
    include HTTParty
    
    def initialize
      config = BASExport.configuration
      self.class.base_uri config.api_url
      self.class.default_timeout config.timeout
      
      @auth = {
        username: config.username,
        password: config.password
      }
    end
    
    def export_order(order)
      return { success: false, error: 'Invalid order' } unless order.valid?
      
      begin
        xml_data = build_xml(order)
        response = send_to_bas(xml_data)
        
        parse_response(response)
      rescue StandardError => e
        { success: false, error: "Export failed: #{e.message}" }
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def build_xml(order)
      xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
      xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
      
      xml.order do |ord|
        ord.number order.number
        ord.date order.date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        ord.totalAmount order.total_amount
        ord.currency order.currency
        
        ord.customer do |cust|
          cust.name order.customer.name
          cust.code order.customer.code
          cust.taxId order.customer.tax_id if order.customer.tax_id
          cust.address order.customer.address if order.customer.address
        end
        
        ord.items do |items|
          order.items.each do |item|
            items.item do |it|
              it.productCode item.product_code
              it.productName item.product_name
              it.quantity item.quantity
              it.unitPrice item.unit_price
              it.totalPrice item.total_price
              it.vatRate item.vat_rate
            end
          end
        end
      end
      
      xml.target!
    end
    
    def send_to_bas(xml_data)
      options = {
        basic_auth: @auth,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
          'Accept' => 'application/xml'
        },
        body: xml_data
      }
      
      self.class.post('/api/orders', options)
    end
    
    def parse_response(response)
      if response.success?
        doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
        
        {
          success: true,
          bas_order_id: doc.at_xpath('//orderId')&.text,
          message: doc.at_xpath('//message')&.text,
          response_code: response.code
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}",
          response_body: response.body
        }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
      order = convert_to_order(order_data)
      exporter.export_order(order)

    def self.convert_to_order(data)

      items = data[:items].map { |item_data| OrderItem.new(item_data) }
      
      Order.new(
        number: data[:number],
        date: data[:date],
        customer: customer,
        items: items,
        total_amount: data[:total_amount],
        currency: data[:currency]
      )
    end
  end
```

```ruby
class CommerceMlController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_1c
  before_action :setup_session, only: [:init, :file, :import, :query]
  
  # Ініціалізація сесії обміну
  def init
    mode = params[:mode]
    version = params[:version]
    
    @session.add_log("Ініціалізація сесії обміну. Режим: #{mode}, Версія: #{version}")
    
    render xml: build_response(success: true, session_id: @session.session_id)
  end
  
  # Завантаження файлів
  def file
    filename = params[:filename]
    file_content = request.body.read
    
    if filename.present? && file_content.present?
      save_exchange_file(filename, file_content)
      @session.add_log("Отримано файл: #{filename}")
      render xml: build_response(success: true)
    else
      @session.add_log("Помилка: відсутній файл або контент", 'error')
      render xml: build_response(success: false, message: 'File or content missing')
    end
  end
  
  # Імпорт даних
  def import
    filename = params[:filename]
    
    if filename.blank?
      @session.add_log("Помилка: відсутня назва файлу", 'error')
      render xml: build_response(success: false, message: 'Filename required')
      return
    end
    
    file_path = exchange_file_path(filename)
    
    unless File.exist?(file_path)
      @session.add_log("Помилка: файл не знайдено - #{filename}", 'error')
      render xml: build_response(success: false, message: 'File not found')
      return
    end
    
    # Запускаємо обробку в фоновому режимі
    CommerceMlImportJob.perform_async(@session.id, filename, file_path)
    
    @session.add_log("Початок імпорту з файлу: #{filename}")
    render xml: build_response(success: true)
  end
  
  # Запит даних
  def query
    case @session.exchange_type
    when 'catalog'
      handle_catalog_query
    when 'sale'
      handle_sale_query
    when 'order'
      handle_order_query
    else
      @session.add_log("Невідомий тип обміну: #{@session.exchange_type}", 'error')
      render xml: build_response(success: false, message: 'Unknown exchange type')
    end
  end
  
  # Завершення сесії
  def success
    session_id = params[:session_id]
    session = ExchangeSession.find_by(session_id: session_id)
    
    if session
      session.update!(status: 'completed')
      session.add_log("Сесія успішно завершена")
      render xml: build_response(success: true)
    else
      render xml: build_response(success: false, message: 'Session not found')
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def authenticate_1c
    # Базова автентифікація або перевірка токена
    authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic do |username, password|
      valid_user = User.find_by(username: username)&.authenticate(password)
      valid_user && valid_user.has_role?(:1c_exchange)
    end
  end
  
  def setup_session
    @session = ExchangeSession.find_by(session_id: params[:session_id])
    
    unless @session
      render xml: build_response(success: false, message: 'Invalid session ID')
      return
    end
    
    @session.update!(status: 'processing')
  end
  
  def handle_catalog_query
    # Генерація каталогу товарів

        else
```

```ruby
class CommerceMlImportJob
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  
  def perform(session_id, filename, file_path)
    session = ExchangeSession.find(session_id)
    
    begin
      case filename
      when /import\.xml\z/
        import_catalog(session, file_path)
      when /offers\.xml\z/
        import_offers(session, file_path)
      when /orders\.xml\z/
        import_orders(session, file_path)
      else
        session.add_log("Невідомий тип файлу: #{filename}", 'warning')
      end
      
      session.add_log("Імпорт завершено: #{filename}")
    rescue StandardError => e
      session.add_log("Помилка імпорту: #{e.message}", 'error')
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def import_catalog(session, file_path)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(file_path))
    
    doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/Классификатор/Группы/Группа').each do |group_node|
      import_category(group_node)
    end
    
    doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/Каталог/Товары/Товар').each do |product_node|
      import_product(product_node)
    end
    
    session.add_log("Імпортовано каталог товарів")
  end
  
  def import_offers(session, file_path)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(file_path))
    
    doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/ПакетПредложений/Предложения/Предложение').each do |offer_node|
      import_offer(offer_node)
    end
    
    session.add_log("Імпортовано ціни та залишки")
  end
  
  def import_orders(session, file_path)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(file_path))
    
    doc.xpath('//КоммерческаяИнформация/Документ').each do |order_node|

    end
    
    session.add_log("Імпортовано замовлення")
```

```ruby
# glovo_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class GlovoClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = ENV['GLOVO_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.glovoapp.com'
  
  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['GLOVO_API_SECRET']
    @token = nil
  end
  
  # Аутентифікація та отримання токену
  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/token",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @api_key,
        client_secret: @api_secret
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      true
    else
      false
    end
  end
  
  # Пошук доступних кур'єрів
  def search_couriers(address, city = 'Kyiv')
    authenticate unless @token
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v2/estimations/orders",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        address: address,
        city: city
      }
    )
    
    response.parsed_response if response.success?
  end
  
  # Створення замовлення
  def create_order(order_data)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    required_fields = {
      description: order_data[:description],
      addresses: order_data[:addresses] # [{address: "вул. Хрещатик, 1", lat: 50.4501, lng: 30.5234, type: "PICKUP"}, ...]
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v2/orders",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: order_data.to_json
    )
    
    response.parsed_response if response.success?
  end
  
  # Отримання статусу замовлення
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v2/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}"
      }
    )
    
    response.parsed_response if response.success?
  end
  
  # Скасування замовлення
  def cancel_order(order_id)
    authenticate unless @token
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v2/orders/#{order_id}/cancel",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    response.success?
  end
end
```

```ruby
# olx_partner_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

Dotenv.load

class OlxPartnerApi
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.olx.ua/partner/1.0'
  
  def initialize(client_id, client_secret)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = nil
  end
  
  # Аутентифікація та отримання токену
  def authenticate
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/token",
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        scope: 'basic user ads'
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      true
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка чи аутентифікований клієнт
  def authenticated?
    !@access_token.nil?
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про користувача
  def get_user_info
    make_authenticated_request(:get, '/users/me')
  end
  
  # Отримання списку категорій
  def get_categories
    make_authenticated_request(:get, '/categories')
  end
  
  # Отримання атрибутів категорії
  def get_category_attributes(category_id)
    make_authenticated_request(:get, "/categories/#{category_id}/attributes")
  end
  
  # Отримання локацій
  def get_locations(query = nil)
    endpoint = '/locations'
    endpoint += "?q=#{URI.encode_www_form_component(query)}" if query
    make_authenticated_request(:get, endpoint)
  end
  
  # Створення нового оголошення
  def create_advertisement(ad_data)
    validate_ad_data(ad_data)
    make_authenticated_request(:post, '/advertisements', ad_data)
  end
  
  # Оновлення існуючого оголошення
  def update_advertisement(ad_id, ad_data)
    make_authenticated_request(:put, "/advertisements/#{ad_id}", ad_data)
  end
  
  # Отримання списку оголошень
  def get_advertisements(status = nil, limit = 50, offset = 0)
    endpoint = "/advertisements?limit=#{limit}&offset=#{offset}"
    endpoint += "&status=#{status}" if status
    make_authenticated_request(:get, endpoint)
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про конкретне оголошення
  def get_advertisement(ad_id)
    make_authenticated_request(:get, "/advertisements/#{ad_id}")
  end
  
  # Видалення оголошення
  def delete_advertisement(ad_id)
    make_authenticated_request(:delete, "/advertisements/#{ad_id}")
  end
  
  # Отримання статусу оголошення
  def get_advertisement_status(ad_id)
    make_authenticated_request(:get, "/advertisements/#{ad_id}/status")
  end
  
  # Активація оголошення
  def activate_advertisement(ad_id)
    make_authenticated_request(:post, "/advertisements/#{ad_id}/activate")
  end
  
  # Деактивація оголошення
  def deactivate_advertisement(ad_id)
    make_authenticated_request(:post, "/advertisements/#{ad_id}/deactivate")
  end
  
  private
  
  def make_authenticated_request(method, endpoint, body = nil)
    authenticate unless authenticated?
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    url = BASE_URL + endpoint
    
    case method
    when :get
      response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    when :post
      response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    when :put
      response = HTTParty.put(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    when :delete
      response = HTTParty.delete(url, headers: headers)
    end
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_ad_data(ad_data)
    required_fields = ['title', 'description', 'category_id', 'price', 'location']
    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |field| ad_data.key?(field) }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'olx_partner_api'

class OlxAdManager

    @photo_manager = OlxPhotoManager.new(@api)

  def create_simple_ad(title, description, price, category_id, city_id, options = {})
    ad_data = {
      title: title,
      description: description,
      category_id: category_id,
      price: {
        value: price,
        currency: "UAH"
      },
      location: {
        city_id: city_id
      },
      contact: {
        name: options[:contact_name] || "Користувач",
        phone: options[:phone] || "+380501234567"
      }
    }
    
    # Додавання додаткових параметрів
    ad_data[:params] = options[:params] if options[:params]
    ad_data[:photos] = options[:photos] if options[:photos]
    
    @api.create_advertisement(ad_data)
  end
  
  # Масове отримання всіх оголошень
  def get_all_ads(status = nil)
    all_ads = []
    offset = 0
    limit = 100
    
    loop do
      ads_batch = @api.get_advertisements(status, limit, offset)
      break if ads_batch.empty?
      
      all_ads.concat(ads_batch)
      offset += limit
    end
    
    all_ads
  end
  
  # Пошук оголошень за ключовими словами
  def search_ads(keywords, status = 'active')
    all_ads = get_all_ads(status)
    keywords_array = keywords.downcase.split(' ')
    
    all_ads.select do |ad|
      ad_title = ad['title'].to_s.downcase
      ad_description = ad['description'].to_s.downcase
      
      keywords_array.any? { |keyword| ad_title.include?(keyword) || ad_description.include?(keyword) }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# glovo_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class GlovoClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.glovoapp.com'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
  end

  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end

  # Отримати доступні послуги в Києві
  def get_services(city_code = 'KBP')
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v3/services",
      headers: headers,
      query: { cityCode: city_code }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Розрахувати вартість доставки
  def calculate_price(from_address, to_address, city_code = 'KBP')
    body = {
      addresses: [
        {
          type: 'PICKUP',
          lat: from_address[:lat],
          lng: from_address[:lng],
          label: from_address[:label]
        },
        {
          type: 'DELIVERY',
          lat: to_address[:lat],
          lng: to_address[:lng],
          label: to_address[:label]
        }
      ],
      cityCode: city_code
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v3/orders/estimate",
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Створити замовлення
  def create_order(order_data)
    required_fields = %i[addresses description]
    missing_fields = required_fields - order_data.keys
    raise "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" unless missing_fields.empty?

    body = order_data.merge(cityCode: order_data[:cityCode] || 'KBP')

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v3/orders",
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримати статус замовлення
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v3/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Скасувати замовлення
  def cancel_order(order_id)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/v3/orders/#{order_id}/cancel",
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      raise error_message
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class AddressHelper
  # Геокодуюча функція для перетворення адреси в координати
  def self.geocode_address(address, city = 'Київ')
    # Використовуємо OpenStreetMap Nominatim API
    full_address = "#{address}, #{city}, Україна"
    encoded_address = URI.encode_www_form_component(full_address)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search",
      query: {
        q: full_address,
        format: 'json',
        limit: 1
      },
      headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'GlovoDeliveryApp/1.0'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success? && !response.body.empty?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body).first
      if data
        {
          lat: data['lat'].to_f,
          lng: data['lon'].to_f,
          label: full_address
        }
      end
    else
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# bas_exporter.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'httparty'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'json'
require 'csv'

class BASExporter
  # BAS XML namespace and schema constants
  BAS_NAMESPACE = 'http://bas-ex.com/ua'
  BAS_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.03'
  
  def initialize(company_info = {})
    @company_info = {
      edrpou: company_info[:edrpou],
      company_name: company_info[:company_name],
      tax_number: company_info[:tax_number],
      address: company_info[:address]
    }
    
    validate_company_info
  end
  
  # Export orders to BAS XML format
  def export_orders(orders, export_type: :sales)
    case export_type
    when :sales
      export_sales_orders(orders)
    when :purchases
      export_purchase_orders(orders)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported export type: #{export_type}"
    end
  end
  
  # Export sales orders (реалізація товарів/послуг)
  def export_sales_orders(orders)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.Document('xmlns' => BAS_NAMESPACE) do
        xml.Header do
          xml.Version BAS_SCHEMA_VERSION
          xml.CreateDate Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
          xml.CreateTime Time.now.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
          xml.Sender do
            xml.EDRPOU @company_info[:edrpou]
            xml.Name @company_info[:company_name]
          end
        end
        
        xml.Documents do
          orders.each_with_index do |order, index|
            xml.Document('ID' => index + 1) do
              add_sales_order_data(xml, order)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end
  
  # Export purchase orders (закупівля товарів/послуг)
  def export_purchase_orders(orders)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.Document('xmlns' => BAS_NAMESPACE) do
        xml.Header do
          xml.Version BAS_SCHEMA_VERSION
          xml.CreateDate Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
          xml.CreateTime Time.now.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
          xml.Sender do
            xml.EDRPOU @company_info[:edrpou]
            xml.Name @company_info[:company_name]
          end
        end
        
        xml.Documents do
          orders.each_with_index do |order, index|
            xml.Document('ID' => index + 1) do
              add_purchase_order_data(xml, order)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end
  
  # Generate Z-report for cash register integration
  def generate_z_report(cash_register_data)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.ZReport('xmlns' => BAS_NAMESPACE) do
        xml.Header do
          xml.Version BAS_SCHEMA_VERSION
          xml.CreateDate Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
          xml.SenderEDRPOU @company_info[:edrpou]
        end
        
        xml.CashRegister do
          xml.SerialNumber cash_register_data[:serial_number]
          xml.FiscalNumber cash_register_data[:fiscal_number]
        end
        
        xml.Sales do
          cash_register_data[:sales].each do |sale|
            xml.Sale do
              xml.DateTime sale[:datetime]
              xml.Amount sale[:amount]
              xml.PaymentType sale[:payment_type] || 'CASH'
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end
  
  # Export to CSV format (alternative format)
  def export_to_csv(orders, export_type: :sales)
    CSV.generate(col_sep: ';', write_headers: true, headers: csv_headers(export_type)) do |csv|
      orders.each do |order|
        csv << format_order_for_csv(order, export_type)
      end
    end
  end
  
  # Upload exported data to BAS system via API
  def upload_to_bas(xml_data, endpoint_url, api_key = nil)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
      'Accept' => 'application/xml'
    }
    
    headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{api_key}" if api_key
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      endpoint_url,
      body: xml_data,
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    {
      success: response.success?,
      status_code: response.code,
      body: response.body,
      headers: response.headers
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_company_info
    required_fields = [:edrpou, :company_name, :tax_number]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| @company_info[field].nil? || @company_info[field].empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required company information: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Validate EDRPOU format (8 digits for Ukrainian companies)
    unless @company_info[:edrpou] =~ /^\d{8}$/
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid EDRPOU format. Must be 8 digits."
    end
  end
  
  def add_sales_order_data(xml, order)
    xml.Number order[:number]
    xml.Date order[:date] || Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    xml.Contractor do
      xml.EDRPOU order[:contractor_edrpou] || order[:contractor_tax_number]
      xml.Name order[:contractor_name]
      xml.Address order[:contractor_address] if order[:contractor_address]
    end
    
    xml.Products do
      order[:items].each do |item|
        xml.Product do
          xml.Name item[:name]
          xml.Code item[:code] if item[:code]
          xml.Unit item[:unit] || 'шт.'
          xml.Quantity format_decimal(item[:quantity])
          xml.Price format_decimal(item[:price])
          xml.Amount format_decimal(item[:amount] || item[:quantity].to_d * item[:price].to_d)
          xml.VATRate item[:vat_rate] || '20%'
          xml.VATAmount format_decimal(item[:vat_amount]) if item[:vat_amount]
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.TotalAmount format_decimal(order[:total_amount])
    xml.VATTotal format_decimal(order[:vat_total]) if order[:vat_total]
    xml.Currency order[:currency] || 'UAH'
  end
  
  def add_purchase_order_data(xml, order)
    xml.Number order[:number]
    xml.Date order[:date] || Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    xml.Supplier do
      xml.EDRPOU order[:supplier_edrpou] || order[:supplier_tax_number]
      xml.Name order[:supplier_name]
      xml.Address order[:supplier_address] if order[:supplier_address]
    end
    
    xml.Products do
      order[:items].each do |item|
        xml.Product do
          xml.Name item[:name]
          xml.Code item[:code] if item[:code]
          xml.Unit item[:unit] || 'шт.'
          xml.Quantity format_decimal(item[:quantity])
          xml.Price format_decimal(item[:price])
          xml.Amount format_decimal(item[:amount] || item[:quantity].to_d * item[:price].to_d)
          xml.VATRate item[:vat_rate] || '20%'
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.TotalAmount format_decimal(order[:total_amount])
    xml.Currency order[:currency] || 'UAH'
  end
  
  def format_decimal(value)
    value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? value.to_s('F') : BigDecimal(value.to_s).to_s('F')
  end
  
  def csv_headers(export_type)
    case export_type
    when :sales
      ['Номер', 'Дата', 'Контрагент_ЄДРПОУ', 'Контрагент_Назва', 'Товар_Назва', 
       'Товар_Кількість', 'Товар_Ціна', 'Товар_Сума', 'ПДВ_Ставка', 'Загальна_Сума']
    when :purchases
      ['Номер', 'Дата', 'Постачальник_ЄДРПОУ', 'Постачальник_Назва', 'Товар_Назва',
       'Товар_Кількість', 'Товар_Ціна', 'Товар_Сума', 'ПДВ_Ставка', 'Загальна_Сума']
    end
  end
  
  def format_order_for_csv(order, export_type)
    # For CSV, we'll flatten the first item (simplified version)
    first_item = order[:items].first
    
    base_fields = [
      order[:number],
      order[:date] || Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
      order[:contractor_edrpou] || order[:supplier_edrpou],
      order[:contractor_name] || order[:supplier_name],
      first_item[:name],
      format_decimal(first_item[:quantity]),
      format_decimal(first_item[:price]),
      format_decimal(first_item[:amount] || first_item[:quantity].to_d * first_item[:price].to_d),
      first_item[:vat_rate] || '20%',
      format_decimal(order[:total_amount])
    ]
    
    base_fields
  end
end
```

```ruby
# bas_validator.rb - Validation utility
class BASValidator
  def self.validate_edrpou(edrpou)
    return false unless edrpou =~ /^\d{8}$/
    
    # Simple EDRPOU validation using control digit calculation
    weights = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
    digits = edrpou.chars.map(&:to_i)
    control_digit = digits.last
    
    sum = digits[0..6].each_with_index.sum { |digit, i| digit * weights[i] }
    calculated_control = sum % 11
    
    calculated_control == control_digit || calculated_control == 10
  end
  
  def self.validate_tax_number(tax_number)
    tax_number =~ /^\d{10,12}$/
  end
end
```

```ruby
# pdf_signer.rb
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'json'
require 'base64'

class DocuSignPDFSigner
  def initialize(integrator_key, user_id, base_path, private_key_file, account_id = nil)
    @integrator_key = integrator_key
    @user_id = user_id
    @base_path = base_path
    @private_key_file = private_key_file
    @account_id = account_id
    @api_client = nil
  end

  # Authenticate with DocuSign using JWT
  def authenticate
    configuration = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @base_path
    
    @api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    @api_client.configure_jwt_authorization_flow(@private_key_file, @integrator_key, @user_id, 3600)
    
    # Get user info to determine account ID if not provided
    if @account_id.nil?
      user_info = @api_client.get_user_info(@api_client.access_token)
      @account_id = user_info.accounts.find { |account| account.is_default == "true" }.account_id
    end
    
    puts "Authenticated successfully. Account ID: #{@account_id}"
    true
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Authentication failed: #{e.response_body}"
    false
  end

  # Create an envelope (signing request) with a PDF document
  def create_envelope(pdf_file_path, recipient_email, recipient_name, document_name = "Contract")
    # Read and encode the PDF file
    pdf_content = File.binread(pdf_file_path)
    encoded_pdf = Base64.encode64(pdf_content)

    # Create document object
    document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new({
      documentBase64: encoded_pdf,
      name: document_name,
      fileExtension: 'pdf',
      documentId: '1'
    })

    # Create signer object
    signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new({
      email: recipient_email,
      name: recipient_name,
      recipientId: '1',
      routingOrder: '1'
    })

    # Create signature tab
    sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new({
      documentId: '1',
      pageNumber: '1',
      recipientId: '1',
      tabLabel: 'SignHereTab',
      xPosition: '200',
      yPosition: '200'
    })

    # Add tabs to signer
    signer.tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new({
      signHereTabs: [sign_here]
    })

    # Create envelope definition
    envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new({
      emailSubject: "Please sign this document",
      documents: [document],
      recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new({signers: [signer]}),
      status: 'sent'
    })

    # Create the envelope
    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
    result = envelopes_api.create_envelope(@account_id, envelope_definition)
    
    puts "Envelope created successfully. Envelope ID: #{result.envelope_id}"
    result.envelope_id
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Failed to create envelope: #{e.response_body}"
    nil
  end

  # Check envelope status
  def get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
    envelope = envelopes_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
    envelope.status
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Failed to get envelope status: #{e.response_body}"
    nil
  end

  # Download the completed signed document
  def download_signed_document(envelope_id, output_file_path)
    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
    
    # Get the document list
    docs_list = envelopes_api.list_documents(@account_id, envelope_id)
    
    # Download the combined document (usually document ID 'combined')
    document_id = docs_list.envelope_documents.find { |doc| doc.document_id == 'combined' }&.document_id || '1'
    
    # Get the document
    document = envelopes_api.get_document(@account_id, document_id, envelope_id)
    
    # Save the document
    File.binwrite(output_file_path, document)
    puts "Signed document downloaded to: #{output_file_path}"
    true
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Failed to download document: #{e.response_body}"
    false
  end

  # Monitor envelope until completed
  def wait_for_completion(envelope_id, check_interval: 30, timeout: 3600)
    puts "Waiting for envelope #{envelope_id} to be signed..."
    start_time = Time.now
    
    while Time.now - start_time < timeout
      status = get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
      
      case status
      when 'completed'
        puts "Envelope completed successfully!"
        return true
      when 'declined', 'voided'
        puts "Envelope was #{status}"
        return false
      when 'sent', 'delivered'
        puts "Envelope status: #{status}. Waiting for recipient to sign..."
      end
      
      sleep(check_interval)
    end
    
    puts "Timeout waiting for envelope completion"
    false
  end
end

    else
      puts "Envelope was not completed successfully"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'json'
require 'base64'

class DocuSignPDFSigner
  def initialize(integration_key, user_id, account_id, base_path, private_key_file)
    @integration_key = integration_key
    @user_id = user_id
    @account_id = account_id
    @base_path = base_path
    @private_key_file = private_key_file
    @api_client = nil
  end

  def authenticate
    # Load private key
    private_key = File.read(@private_key_file)

    # Configure API client
    configuration = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @base_path
    @api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    @api_client.set_oauth_base_path(@base_path)

    # Get JWT token
    token = @api_client.request_jwt_user_token(
      @integration_key,
      @user_id,
      private_key,
      DocuSign_eSign::JwtScope::SIGNATURE,
      1 # token expires in 1 hour
    )

    # Set access token
    @api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{token.access_token}"

    # Get user info to verify authentication
    user_info = @api_client.get_user_info(token.access_token)
    base_uri = user_info.accounts.find { |account| account.account_id == @account_id }.base_uri
    @api_client.config.host = base_uri

    puts "Authentication successful!"
    true
  rescue => e
    puts "Authentication failed: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  def create_and_send_envelope(pdf_file_path, recipient_email, recipient_name, document_name = "Contract")
    return unless @api_client

    begin
      # Read and encode the PDF file
      document_data = File.binread(pdf_file_path)
      encoded_document = Base64.encode64(document_data)

      # Create document object
      document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new(
        document_base64: encoded_document,
        name: document_name,
        file_extension: 'pdf',
        document_id: '1'
      )

      # Create signer
      signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new(
        email: recipient_email,
        name: recipient_name,
        recipient_id: '1',
        routing_order: '1'
      )

      # Create signing tab (signature field)
      sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new(
        document_id: '1',
        page_number: '1',
        recipient_id: '1',
        tab_label: 'SignHereTab',
        x_position: '100',
        y_position: '100'
      )

      # Add tabs to signer
      tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new(sign_here_tabs: [sign_here])
      signer.tabs = tabs

      # Create envelope definition
      envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
        email_subject: "Please sign this document",
        documents: [document],
        recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new(signers: [signer]),
        status: 'sent'
      )

      # Create envelope API instance
      envelope_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)

      # Send the envelope
      result = envelope_api.create_envelope(@account_id, envelope_definition)
      
      puts "Envelope created successfully! Envelope ID: #{result.envelope_id}"
      result.envelope_id

    rescue => e
      puts "Error creating envelope: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def download_signed_document(envelope_id, output_file_path)
    return unless @api_client

    begin
      envelope_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
      
      # Get envelope documents
      docs_list = envelope_api.list_documents(@account_id, envelope_id)
      
      # Find the completed document (usually the first one)
      document_id = docs_list.envelope_documents.first.document_id
      
      # Download the document
      document_data = envelope_api.get_document(@account_id, envelope_id, document_id)
      
      # Save to file
      File.binwrite(output_file_path, document_data)
      
      puts "Signed document downloaded to: #{output_file_path}"
      true
      
    rescue => e
      puts "Error downloading document: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end

  def check_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    return unless @api_client

    begin
      envelope_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
      envelope = envelope_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
      
      puts "Envelope Status: #{envelope.status}"
      envelope.status
      
    rescue => e
      puts "Error checking envelope status: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def wait_for_completion(envelope_id, check_interval: 30, timeout: 3600)
    return unless @api_client

    puts "Waiting for envelope to be signed..."
    start_time = Time.now
    
    while Time.now - start_time < timeout
      status = check_envelope_status(envelope_id)
      
      if status == 'completed'
        puts "Envelope signed successfully!"
        return true
      elsif status == 'declined' || status == 'voided'
        puts "Envelope was #{status}. Cannot download."
        return false
      end
      
      sleep(check_interval)
    end
    
    puts "Timeout waiting for envelope completion"
    false
  end

  # Complete workflow method
  def sign_and_download_pdf(pdf_file_path, recipient_email, recipient_name, output_file_path)
    # Authenticate
    return unless authenticate
    
    # Create and send envelope
    envelope_id = create_and_send_envelope(pdf_file_path, recipient_email, recipient_name)
    return unless envelope_id
    
    # Wait for completion
    return unless wait_for_completion(envelope_id)
    
    # Download signed document
    download_signed_document(envelope_id, output_file_path)
  end
end
```

## CommerceML Client Implementation

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/client.rb
require 'net/http'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'

class CommerceML::Client
  include HTTParty
  
  def initialize(base_url, username, password)
    @base_url = base_url
    @username = username
    @password = password
    @auth = { username: username, password: password }
  end
  
  # Send catalog data to 1C
  def send_catalog_data(xml_data)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/exchange"
    self.class.post(
      endpoint,
      body: xml_data,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'User-Agent' => 'CommerceML-Rails-Client'
      },
      basic_auth: @auth,
      timeout: 30
    )
  end
  
  # Receive orders from 1C
  def get_orders
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/exchange/orders"
    self.class.get(
      endpoint,
      basic_auth: @auth,
      timeout: 30
    )
  end
  
  # Send order confirmations to 1C
  def send_order_status(xml_data)
    endpoint = "#{@base_url}/exchange/order_status"
    self.class.post(
      endpoint,
      body: xml_data,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/xml' },
      basic_auth: @auth,
      timeout: 30
    )
  end
end
```

## CommerceML XML Builder

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/xml_builder.rb
require 'builder'

class CommerceML::XmlBuilder
  # Generate catalog data XML
  def self.build_catalog_xml(products, categories)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.CommerceML do
      xml.Classifier do
        categories.each do |category|
          xml.Groups do
            xml.Id category.id
            xml.Name category.name
            xml.parent_id category.parent_id if category.parent_id
          end
        end
      end
      
      xml.Catalog do
        products.each do |product|
          xml.Product do
            xml.Id product.id
            xml.Name product.name
            xml.Description product.description
            xml.Unit product.unit
            xml.Article product.sku
            xml.CategoryId product.category_id
            xml.Weight product.weight if product.weight
            xml.Volume product.volume if product.volume
            
            # Product properties
            if product.properties.any?
              xml.Properties do
                product.properties.each do |prop|
                  xml.Property do
                    xml.Name prop.name
                    xml.Value prop.value
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
  
  # Generate price list XML
  def self.build_prices_xml(products, price_type = 'Розничная')
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.CommerceML do
      xml.Package do
        xml.Name 'PriceList'
        xml.PriceType price_type
        
        products.each do |product|
          xml.Product do
            xml.Id product.id
            xml.Price product.price
            xml.Currency product.currency || 'RUB'
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
  
  # Generate orders XML for export to 1C
  def self.build_orders_xml(orders)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.CommerceML do
      xml.Document do
        xml.Number 'OrdersExport'
        xml.Date Time.now.iso8601
        xml.OperationType 'Заказ'
        
        orders.each do |order|
          xml.Document do
            xml.Id order.id
            xml.Number order.number
            xml.Date order.created_at.iso8601
            xml.OperationType 'Заказ'
            xml.Currency order.currency
            xml.Sum order.total_amount
            xml.Contragent do
              xml.Id order.customer_id
              xml.Name order.customer_name
            end
            
            xml.Products do
              order.line_items.each do |item|
                xml.Product do
                  xml.Id item.product_id
                  xml.Name item.product_name
                  xml.Price item.price
                  xml.Quantity item.quantity
                  xml.Sum item.total_price
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
end
```

## CommerceML XML Parser

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/xml_parser.rb
require 'nokogiri'

class CommerceML::XmlParser
  # Parse orders XML received from 1C
  def self.parse_orders(xml_content)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    orders = []
    
    doc.xpath('//Document').each do |order_node|
      order_data = {
        external_id: order_node.xpath('Id').text,
        number: order_node.xpath('Number').text,
        date: DateTime.parse(order_node.xpath('Date').text),
        total_amount: order_node.xpath('Sum').text.to_f,
        currency: order_node.xpath('Currency').text,
        customer: parse_customer(order_node.xpath('Contragent')),
        line_items: parse_line_items(order_node.xpath('Products/Product'))
      }
      
      orders << order_data
    end
    
    orders
  end
  
  # Parse order status confirmation from 1C
  def self.parse_order_status(xml_content)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    statuses = []
    
    doc.xpath('//OrderStatus').each do |status_node|
      status_data = {
        order_id: status_node.xpath('OrderId').text,
        status: status_node.xpath('Status').text,
        comment: status_node.xpath('Comment').text,
        updated_at: DateTime.parse(status_node.xpath('Date').text)
      }
      
      statuses << status_data
    end
    
    statuses
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.parse_customer(customer_node)
    {
      external_id: customer_node.xpath('Id').text,
      name: customer_node.xpath('Name').text,
      inn: customer_node.xpath('INN').text,
      kpp: customer_node.xpath('KPP').text
    }
  end
  
  def self.parse_line_items(items_node)
    items = []
    
    items_node.each do |item_node|
      item_data = {
        product_id: item_node.xpath('Id').text,
        name: item_node.xpath('Name').text,
        price: item_node.xpath('Price').text.to_f,
        quantity: item_node.xpath('Quantity').text.to_f,
        total_price: item_node.xpath('Sum').text.to_f
      }
      
      items << item_data
    end
    
    items
  end
end
```

## Main Exchange Service

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/exchange_service.rb
class CommerceML::ExchangeService
  def initialize(shop_config)
    @client = CommerceML::Client.new(
      shop_config[:base_url],
      shop_config[:username],
      shop_config[:password]
    )
    @shop_config = shop_config
  end
  
  # Full catalog exchange
  def export_catalog
    categories = Category.all
    products = Product.active.includes(:properties)
    
    catalog_xml = CommerceML::XmlBuilder.build_catalog_xml(products, categories)
    prices_xml = CommerceML::XmlBuilder.build_prices_xml(products)
    
    # Send catalog data
    catalog_response = @client.send_catalog_data(catalog_xml)
    
    # Send prices (usually separate request)
    prices_response = @client.send_catalog_data(prices_xml)
    
    {
      catalog_sent: catalog_response.success?,
      prices_sent: prices_response.success?,
      catalog_response: catalog_response,
      prices_response: prices_response
    }
  end
  
  # Import orders from 1C
  def import_orders
    response = @client.get_orders
    
    if response.success?
      orders_data = CommerceML::XmlParser.parse_orders(response.body)
      
      imported_orders = []
      orders_data.each do |order_data|
        order = create_or_update_order(order_data)
        imported_orders << order if order.persisted?
      end
      
      { success: true, imported_count: imported_orders.count, orders: imported_orders }
    else
      { success: false, error: "Failed to fetch orders: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Export orders to 1C
  def export_orders(orders)
    orders_xml = CommerceML::XmlBuilder.build_orders_xml(orders)
    response = @client.send_catalog_data(orders_xml)
    
    {
      success: response.success?,
      orders_sent: orders.count,
      response: response
    }
  end
  
  # Send order status updates to 1C
  def send_order_statuses(orders)
    xml = build_order_statuses_xml(orders)
    response = @client.send_order_status(xml)
    
    {
      success: response.success?,
      statuses_sent: orders.count,
      response: response
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_or_update_order(order_data)
    Order.transaction do
      customer = Customer.find_or_create_by(external_id: order_data[:customer][:external_id]) do |c|
        c.name = order_data[:customer][:name]
        c.inn = order_data[:customer][:inn]
        c.kpp = order_data[:customer][:kpp]
      end
      
      order = Order.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: order_data[:external_id])
      order.assign_attributes(
        number: order_data[:number],
        customer: customer,
        total_amount: order_data[:total_amount],
        currency: order_data[:currency],
        order_date: order_data[:date],
        status: 'imported'
      )
      
      if order.save
        # Create line items
        order_data[:line_items].each do |item_data|
          product = Product.find_by(external_id: item_data[:product_id])
          
          line_item = order.line_items.find_or_initialize_by(
            product: product,
            external_product_id: item_data[:product_id]
          )
          
          line_item.assign_attributes(
            product_name: item_data[:name],
            price: item_data[:price],
            quantity: item_data[:quantity],
            total_price: item_data[:total_price]
          )
          
          line_item.save!
        end
      end
      
      order
    end
  end
  
  def build_order_statuses_xml(orders)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    xml.CommerceML do
      orders.each do |order|
        xml.OrderStatus do
          xml.OrderId order.external_id
          xml.Status order.status
          xml.Comment "Status updated: #{order.status}"
          xml.Date order.updated_at.iso8601
        end
      end
    end
    
    xml.target!
  end
end
```

## Background Job for Scheduled Exchange

```ruby
# app/jobs/commerce_ml_sync_job.rb
class CommerceMlSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(shop_id, sync_type = :full)
    shop = Shop.find(shop_id)
    service = CommerceML::ExchangeService.new(shop.commerce_ml_config)
    
    case sync_type.to_sym
    when :catalog
      service.export_catalog
    when :orders_import
      service.import_orders
    when :orders_export
      orders = Order.where('created_at > ?', 1.day.ago).pending_export
      service.export_orders(orders)
    when :full
      service.export_catalog
      service.import_orders
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    end

  # Manual sync endpoints
  def sync_catalog
    job_id = CommerceMlSyncJob.perform_lazy(current_shop.id, :catalog)
    render json: { job_id: job_id, status: 'queued' }
  end
  
  def sync_orders
    job_id = CommerceMlSyncJob.perform_lazy(current_shop.id, :orders_import)
    render json: { job_id: job_id, status: 'queued' }
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_order_webhook(xml_data)
    orders_data = CommerceML::XmlParser.parse_orders(xml_data)
    
    orders_data.each do |order_data|
      CommerceMlImportOrderJob.perform_lazy(current_shop.id, order_data)
    end
    
    render xml: success_response
  end
  
  def handle_catalog_webhook(xml_data)
    # Handle catalog updates from 1C if needed
    render xml: success_response
  end
  
  def handle_order_status_webhook(xml_data)
    statuses = CommerceML::XmlParser.parse_order_status(xml_data)
    
    statuses.each do |status_data|
      order = Order.find_by(external_id: status_data[:order_id])
      order.update(status: status_data[:status]) if order
    end
    
    render xml: success_response
  end
  
  def success_response
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Success>true</Success>'
  end
end
```

```ruby
# pdf_signer.rb
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class DocuSignPDFSigner
  def initialize
    @api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new
    @api_client.configure do |config|
      config.host = ENV['DOCUSIGN_BASE_PATH'] || 'https://demo.docusign.net/restapi'
      config.debugging = ENV['DEBUG'] == 'true'
    end
  end

  def authenticate
    # JWT Authentication
    jwt_scope = 'signature'
    private_key = File.read(ENV['DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH'])
    
    token = @api_client.request_jwt_user_token(
      ENV['DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATION_KEY'],
      ENV['DOCUSIGN_USER_ID'],
      private_key,
      3600, # token expires in 1 hour
      [jwt_scope]
    )
    
    @api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{token.access_token}"
    
    # Get user info
    user_info = @api_client.get_user_info(token.access_token)
    @account_id = user_info.accounts.find { |account| account.is_default == 'true' }.account_id
    
    puts "Authenticated successfully. Account ID: #{@account_id}"
    true
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Authentication failed: #{e.response_body}"
    false
  end

  def create_envelope(pdf_path, signer_email, signer_name, document_name = nil)
    document_name ||= File.basename(pdf_path, '.*')
    
    # Read PDF file
    document_content = File.binread(pdf_path)
    base64_file_content = Base64.encode64(document_content)
    
    # Create document object
    document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new(
      document_base64: base64_file_content,
      name: document_name,
      file_extension: 'pdf',
      document_id: '1'
    )
    
    # Create signer
    signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new(
      email: signer_email,
      name: signer_name,
      recipient_id: '1',
      routing_order: '1'
    )
    
    # Create signature tab
    sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new(
      document_id: '1',
      page_number: '1',
      recipient_id: '1',
      tab_label: 'SignHereTab',
      x_position: '100',
      y_position: '100'
    )
    
    # Add tabs to signer
    signer.tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new(
      sign_here_tabs: [sign_here]
    )
    
    # Create envelope definition
    envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
      email_subject: "Please sign #{document_name}",
      documents: [document],
      recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new(signers: [signer]),
      status: 'sent'
    )
    
    # Create envelope
    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
    envelope_summary = envelopes_api.create_envelope(@account_id, envelope_definition)
    
    puts "Envelope created with ID: #{envelope_summary.envelope_id}"
    envelope_summary.envelope_id
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Failed to create envelope: #{e.response_body}"
    nil
  end

  def download_completed_envelope(envelope_id, output_path)
    envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
    
    # Check envelope status
    envelope = envelopes_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
    
    if envelope.status == 'completed'
      # Download documents
      temp_file = envelopes_api.get_document(@account_id, 'combined', envelope_id)
      File.binwrite(output_path, temp_file)
      puts "Signed document saved to: #{output_path}"
      true
    else
      puts "Envelope is not completed. Current status: #{envelope.status}"
      false
    end
  rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
    puts "Failed to download envelope: #{e.response_body}"
    false
  end

  def sign_and_download(pdf_path, signer_email, signer_name, output_path = nil)
    return unless authenticate
    
    envelope_id = create_envelope(pdf_path, signer_email, signer_name)
    return unless envelope_id
    
    output_path ||= "signed_#{File.basename(pdf_path)}"
    
    # Wait for completion (in real application, you might want to use webhooks)
    puts "Waiting for signature completion..."
    wait_for_completion(envelope_id, output_path)
  end

  private

  def wait_for_completion(envelope_id, output_path, max_attempts = 30)
    attempts = 0
    while attempts < max_attempts
      if download_completed_envelope(envelope_id, output_path)
        return true
      end
      
      attempts += 1
      sleep 10 # Wait 10 seconds before checking again
      puts "Checked #{attempts} times..."
    end
    
    puts "Timeout waiting for signature completion"
    false
  end
end
```
