## CommerceML Service Classes

```ruby
# app/services/commerceml/exporter.rb
module CommerceML
  class Exporter
    def initialize(config = {})
      @config = config
    end

    def export_products(products, options = {})
      builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
      
      builder.instruct!(:xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8')
      builder.CommercialInformation do |xml|
        xml.Classifier do |xml|
          xml.Id 'products_classifier'
          xml.Name 'Products'
          
          products.each do |product|
            xml.Groups do |xml|
              # Add product categories/groups if needed
            end if options[:include_groups]
            
            xml.Products do |xml|
              build_product_xml(xml, product)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      
      builder.target!
    end

    def export_orders(orders, options = {})
      builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
      
      builder.instruct!(:xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8')
      builder.CommercialInformation do |xml|
        xml.Document do |xml|
          orders.each do |order|
            build_order_xml(xml, order)
          end
        end
      end
      
      builder.target!
    end

    def export_prices(products, options = {})
      builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
      
      builder.instruct!(:xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8')
      builder.CommerceInformation do |xml|
        xml.Package do |xml|
          xml.Prices do |xml|
            products.each do |product|
              build_price_xml(xml, product)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      
      builder.target!
    end

    private

    def build_product_xml(xml, product)
      xml.Product do
        xml.Id product.id
        xml.Name product.name
        xml.Description product.description
        xml.Article product.sku
        xml.Unit product.unit_name || 'шт'
        xml.Weight product.weight if product.weight
        xml.Volume product.volume if product.volume
        
        # Product properties
        if product.properties.any?
          xml.Properties do
            product.properties.each do |property|
              xml.Property do
                xml.Id property.id
                xml.Name property.name
                xml.Value property.value
              end
            end
          end
        end
        
        # Images
        if product.images.any?
          xml.Images do
            product.images.each do |image|
              xml.Image image.url
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def build_order_xml(xml, order)
      xml.Document do
        xml.Id order.id
        xml.Number order.number
        xml.Date order.created_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        xml.OperationType 'Order'
        xml.Sum order.total_amount
        xml.Currency order.currency || 'RUB'
        
        # Customer information
        xml.Contragent do
          xml.Id order.customer.id
          xml.Name order.customer.name
          xml.FullName order.customer.full_name
          xml.Inn order.customer.tax_id if order.customer.tax_id
          xml.Email order.customer.email
          xml.Phone order.customer.phone
        end
        
        # Order items
        xml.Products do
          order.order_items.each do |item|
            xml.Product do
              xml.Id item.product_id
              xml.Name item.product_name
              xml.Article item.product_sku
              xml.Price item.unit_price
              xml.Quantity item.quantity
              xml.Sum item.total_price
            end
          end
        end
        
        # Delivery information
        if order.shipping_address
          xml.Address do
            xml.Presentation order.shipping_address.full_address
            xml.Country order.shipping_address.country
            xml.City order.shipping_address.city
            xml.Postcode order.shipping_address.zip_code
            xml.AddressLine order.shipping_address.address_line
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def build_price_xml(xml, product)
      xml.Price do
        xml.Id product.id
        xml.ProductId product.id
        xml.Price product.price
        xml.Currency product.currency || 'RUB'
        xml.Unit product.unit_name || 'шт'
        xml.Coefficient 1  # Price coefficient
        
        # Price types (regular, wholesale, etc.)
        xml.PriceType do
          xml.Id 'regular'
          xml.Name 'Regular Price'
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## CommerceML Importer

```ruby
# app/services/commerceml/importer.rb
module CommerceML
  class Importer
    def initialize(xml_data)
      @doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)
      @doc.remove_namespaces!
    end

    def import_products
      products = []
      
      @doc.xpath('//Product').each do |product_node|
        product_data = extract_product_data(product_node)
        products << create_or_update_product(product_data)
      end
      
      products
    end

    def import_orders
      orders = []
      
      @doc.xpath('//Document').each do |order_node|
        order_data = extract_order_data(order_node)
        orders << create_or_update_order(order_data)
      end
      
      orders
    end

    def import_prices
      prices = []
      
      @doc.xpath('//Price').each do |price_node|
        price_data = extract_price_data(price_node)
        prices << update_product_price(price_data)
      end
      
      prices
    end

    private

    def extract_product_data(node)
      {
        external_id: node.xpath('Id').text,
        name: node.xpath('Name').text,
        description: node.xpath('Description').text,
        sku: node.xpath('Article').text,
        unit: node.xpath('Unit').text,
        weight: node.xpath('Weight').text.to_f,
        volume: node.xpath('Volume').text.to_f,
        properties: extract_properties(node),
        images: extract_images(node)
      }
    end

    def extract_order_data(node)
      {
        external_id: node.xpath('Id').text,
        number: node.xpath('Number').text,
        date: Time.parse(node.xpath('Date').text),
        total_amount: node.xpath('Sum').text.to_f,
        currency: node.xpath('Currency').text,
        customer: extract_customer_data(node.xpath('Contragent')),
        items: extract_order_items(node.xpath('Products/Product')),
        shipping_address: extract_address_data(node.xpath('Address'))
      }
    end

    def extract_price_data(node)
      {
        product_external_id: node.xpath('ProductId').text,
        price: node.xpath('Price').text.to_f,
        currency: node.xpath('Currency').text,
        price_type: node.xpath('PriceType/Id').text
      }
    end

    def extract_properties(product_node)
      properties = []
      product_node.xpath('Properties/Property').each do |prop_node|
        properties << {
          external_id: prop_node.xpath('Id').text,
          name: prop_node.xpath('Name').text,
          value: prop_node.xpath('Value').text
        }
      end
      properties
    end

    def extract_images(product_node)
      images = []
      product_node.xpath('Images/Image').each do |img_node|
        images << { url: img_node.text }
      end
      images
    end

    def extract_customer_data(customer_node)
      return nil if customer_node.empty?
      
      {
        external_id: customer_node.xpath('Id').text,
        name: customer_node.xpath('Name').text,
        full_name: customer_node.xpath('FullName').text,
        tax_id: customer_node.xpath('Inn').text,
        email: customer_node.xpath('Email').text,
        phone: customer_node.xpath('Phone').text
      }
    end

    def extract_order_items(items_node)
      items = []
      items_node.each do |item_node|
        items << {
          product_external_id: item_node.xpath('Id').text,
          product_name: item_node.xpath('Name').text,
          product_sku: item_node.xpath('Article').text,
          unit_price: item_node.xpath('Price').text.to_f,
          quantity: item_node.xpath('Quantity').text.to_f,
          total_price: item_node.xpath('Sum').text.to_f
        }
      end
      items
    end

    def extract_address_data(address_node)
      return nil if address_node.empty?
      
      {
        full_address: address_node.xpath('Presentation').text,
        country: address_node.xpath('Country').text,
        city: address_node.xpath('City').text,
        zip_code: address_node.xpath('Postcode').text,
        address_line: address_node.xpath('AddressLine').text
      }
    end

    def create_or_update_product(product_data)
      product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: product_data[:external_id])
      product.assign_attributes(
        name: product_data[:name],
        description: product_data[:description],
        sku: product_data[:sku],
        unit: product_data[:unit],
        weight: product_data[:weight],
        volume: product_data[:volume]
      )
      product.save!
      product
    end

    def create_or_update_order(order_data)
      order = Order.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: order_data[:external_id])
      customer = find_or_create_customer(order_data[:customer])
      
      order.assign_attributes(
        number: order_data[:number],
        order_date: order_data[:date],
        total_amount: order_data[:total_amount],
        currency: order_data[:currency],
        customer: customer
      )
      
      order.save!
      
      # Create order items
      order_data[:items].each do |item_data|
        product = Product.find_by(external_id: item_data[:product_external_id])
        order_item = order.order_items.find_or_initialize_by(product: product)
        order_item.assign_attributes(
          product_name: item_data[:product_name],
          unit_price: item_data[:unit_price],
          quantity: item_data[:quantity]
        )
        order_item.save!
      end
      
      order
    end

    def update_product_price(price_data)
      product = Product.find_by(external_id: price_data[:product_external_id])
      return unless product
      
      price = product.prices.find_or_initialize_by(price_type: price_data[:price_type])
      price.assign_attributes(
        price: price_data[:price],
        currency: price_data[:currency]
      )
      price.save!
      price
    end

    def find_or_create_customer(customer_data)
      return nil unless customer_data
      
      customer = Customer.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: customer_data[:external_id])
      customer.assign_attributes(
        name: customer_data[:name],
        full_name: customer_data[:full_name],
        tax_id: customer_data[:tax_id],
        email: customer_data[:email],
        phone: customer_data[:phone]
      )
      customer.save!
      customer
    end
  end
end
```

## API Controller

```ruby
# app/controllers/commerceml_controller.rb
class CommercemlController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_1c

  def exchange
    mode = params[:mode]
    type = params[:type]
    
    case mode
    when 'checkauth'
      handle_checkauth
    when 'init'
      handle_init
    when 'file'
      handle_file(type)
    when 'import'
      handle_import(type)
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown mode", status: :bad_request
    end
  end

  private

  def authenticate_1c
    authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic do |username, password|
      username == ENV['1C_USERNAME'] && password == ENV['1C_PASSWORD']
    end
  end

  def handle_checkauth
    render plain: "success\n#{rand(100000..999999)}\n#{Time.now.to_i}"
  end

  def handle_init
    render plain: "zip=no\nfile_limit=100000000"
  end

  def handle_file(type)
    filename = params[:filename]
    file_content = request.body.read
    
    # Save uploaded file
    FileUtils.mkdir_p('tmp/commerceml')
    File.write("tmp/commerceml/#{filename}", file_content)
    
    render plain: "success"
  end

  def handle_import(type)
    filename = params[:filename]
    file_path = "tmp/commerceml/#{filename}"
    
    unless File.exist?(file_path)
      render plain: "failure\nFile not found", status: :not_found
      return
    end

    xml_data = File.read(file_path)
    importer = CommerceML::Importer.new(xml_data)
    
    case type
    when 'catalog'
      products = importer.import_products
      render plain: "success\nImported #{products.count} products"
    when 'sale'
      orders = importer.import_orders
      render plain: "success\nImported #{orders.count} orders"
    when 'prices'
      prices = importer.import_prices
      render plain: "success\nImported #{prices.count} prices"
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown import type", status: :bad_request
    end
    
    # Clean up file
    File.delete(file_path)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/commerceml_export_job.rb
class CommercemlExportJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(export_type, options = {})
    exporter = CommerceML::Exporter.new
    
    case export_type
    when :products
      products = Product.all
      xml_data = exporter.export_products(products, options)
      upload_to_1c(xml_data, 'products.xml')
    when :orders
      orders = Order.where(exported_to_1c: false)
      xml_data = exporter.export_orders(orders, options)
      upload_to_1c(xml_data, 'orders.xml')
      orders.update_all(exported_to_1c: true)
    when :prices
      products = Product.active
      xml_data = exporter.export_prices(products, options)
      upload_to_1c(xml_data, 'prices.xml')
    end
  end

  private

  def upload_to_1c(xml_data, filename)
    # Implement upload logic to 1C server
    # This could be FTP, HTTP, or direct file transfer
    HTTParty.post(
      ENV['1C_EXPORT_URL'],
      body: xml_data,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'Authorization' => "Basic #{Base64.encode64("#{ENV['1C_USERNAME']}:#{ENV['1C_PASSWORD']}")}"
      }
    )
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

module KeyCRM
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri ENV.fetch('KEYCRM_API_URL', 'https://api.keycrm.com/v1')
    
    def initialize
      @api_key = ENV['KEYCRM_API_KEY']
      @headers = {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    end
    
    def create_order(order_data)
      self.class.post('/orders', {
        headers: @headers,
        body: order_data.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      })
    end
    
    def get_order(order_id)
      self.class.get("/orders/#{order_id}", {
        headers: @headers,
        timeout: 30
      })
    end
    
    def update_order(order_id, order_data)
      self.class.put("/orders/#{order_id}", {
        headers: @headers,
        body: order_data.to_json,
        timeout: 30
      })
    end
    
    def get_products(params = {})
      self.class.get('/products', {
        headers: @headers,
        query: params,
        timeout: 30
      })
    end
    
    def sync_products
      # Синхронізація продуктів з KeyCRM
      response = get_products(limit: 1000)
      if response.success?
        process_products_response(response.parsed_response)
      else
        handle_error(response)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def process_products_response(response)
      products_data = response['data'] || []
      products_data.each do |product_data|
        ProductSyncJob.perform_async(product_data)
      end
    end
    
    def handle_error(response)
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

## Джоби для фонових завдань

### app/jobs/keycrm_sync_job.rb

```ruby
class KeycrmSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(order_id, action)
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    return unless order
    
    client = KeyCRM::Client.new
    
    case action
    when 'create'
      create_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    when 'update'
      update_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    response = client.create_order(order.to_keycrm_format)
    
    if response.success?
      order.update(keycrm_order_id: response.parsed_response['id'])
      Rails.logger.info "Order #{order.id} synced with KeyCRM"
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order.id} with KeyCRM: #{response.body}"
      raise "KeyCRM sync failed for order #{order.id}"
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    return unless order.keycrm_order_id
    
    response = client.update_order(order.keycrm_order_id, {
      order: {
        status: order.map_status_to_keycrm
      }
    })
    
    if response.success?
      Rails.logger.info "Order #{order.id} updated in KeyCRM"
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to update order #{order.id} in KeyCRM: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :set_order, only: [:show, :update, :destroy]
  
  def index
    @orders = current_user.orders.order(created_at: :desc)
    render json: @orders
  end
  
  def show
    render json: @order
  end
  
  def create
    @order = current_user.orders.build(order_params)
    
    if @order.save
      render json: @order, status: :created
    else
      render json: @order.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def update
    if @order.update(order_params)
      render json: @order
    else
      render json: @order.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def webhook
    # Webhook для отримання оновлень від KeyCRM
    verify_webhook_signature
    
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    process_webhook_payload(payload)
    
    head :ok
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_order
    @order = current_user.orders.find(params[:id])
  end
  
  def order_params
    params.require(:order).permit(
      :status, 
      order_items_attributes: [:product_id, :quantity, :unit_price]
    )
  end
  
  def verify_webhook_signature
    signature = request.headers['X-KeyCRM-Signature']
    expected_signature = generate_webhook_signature(request.body.read)
    
    unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(signature, expected_signature)
      head :unauthorized
    end
  end
  
  def generate_webhook_signature(payload)
    secret = ENV['KEYCRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET']
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', secret, payload)
  end
  
  def process_webhook_payload(payload)
    case payload['event_type']
    when 'order.updated'
      update_order_from_webhook(payload['data'])
    when 'order.created'
      # Обробка створення замовлення з KeyCRM (якщо потрібно)
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_from_webhook(order_data)
    order = Order.find_by(keycrm_order_id: order_data['id'])
    return unless order
    
    new_status = map_keycrm_status_to_local(order_data['status'])
    order.update(status: new_status) if new_status
  end
  
  def map_keycrm_status_to_local(keycrm_status)
    case keycrm_status
    when 'new' then 'pending'
    when 'in_progress' then 'processing'
    when 'shipped' then 'shipped'
    when 'completed' then 'delivered'
    when 'cancelled' then 'cancelled'
    else nil
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Base API Client (app/services/keycrm/base_client.rb)

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/base_client.rb
module KeyCRM
  class BaseClient
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri KeyCRM.configuration.base_url
    timeout KeyCRM.configuration.timeout
    
    def initialize
      @headers = {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{KeyCRM.configuration.api_key}",
        'X-Shop-ID' => KeyCRM.configuration.shop_id
      }
    end
    
    private
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200..299
        parse_response(response)
      when 400
        raise KeyCRM::BadRequestError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
      when 401
        raise KeyCRM::UnauthorizedError, "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
      when 404
        raise KeyCRM::NotFoundError, "Resource not found"
      when 422
        raise KeyCRM::ValidationError, "Validation failed: #{response.body}"
      when 500..599
        raise KeyCRM::ServerError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
      else
        raise KeyCRM::Error, "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      end
    end
    
    def parse_response(response)
      return {} if response.body.nil? || response.body.empty?
      
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      { 'data' => response.body }
    end
  end
  
  # Custom exceptions
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class BadRequestError < Error; end
  class UnauthorizedError < Error; end
  class NotFoundError < Error; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end
  class ServerError < Error; end
end
```

```ruby
        body: order_data.to_json

    end
```

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/order_mapper.rb
module KeyCRM
  class OrderMapper
    def self.to_keycrm_format(rails_order)
      {
        external_id: rails_order.id.to_s,
        customer: map_customer(rails_order.customer),
        items: map_order_items(rails_order.order_items),
        totals: map_totals(rails_order),
        shipping_address: map_address(rails_order.shipping_address),
        billing_address: map_address(rails_order.billing_address),
        payment_method: rails_order.payment_method,
        shipping_method: rails_order.shipping_method,
        status: map_status(rails_order.status),
        notes: rails_order.notes,
        created_at: rails_order.created_at.iso8601,
        updated_at: rails_order.updated_at.iso8601
      }
    end
    
    private
    
    def self.map_customer(customer)
      return nil unless customer
      
      {
        external_id: customer.id.to_s,
        email: customer.email,
        first_name: customer.first_name,
        last_name: customer.last_name,
        phone: customer.phone
      }
    end
    
    def self.map_order_items(order_items)
      order_items.map do |item|
        {
          product_external_id: item.product_id.to_s,
          sku: item.sku,
          name: item.product_name,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit_price: item.unit_price.to_f,
          total_price: item.total_price.to_f
        }
      end
    end
    
    def self.map_totals(order)
      {
        subtotal: order.subtotal.to_f,
        tax: order.tax_amount.to_f,
        shipping: order.shipping_cost.to_f,
        discount: order.discount_amount.to_f,
        total: order.total_amount.to_f
      }
    end
    
    def self.map_address(address)
      return nil unless address
      
      {
        first_name: address.first_name,
        last_name: address.last_name,
        company: address.company,
        address1: address.street,
        address2: address.street2,
        city: address.city,
        state: address.state,
        zip: address.zip_code,
        country: address.country,
        phone: address.phone
      }
    end
    
    def self.map_status(status)
      # Map your Rails order status to KeyCRM status
      status_mapping = {
        'pending' => 'pending',
        'confirmed' => 'confirmed',
        'processing' => 'processing',
        'shipped' => 'shipped',
        'delivered' => 'delivered',
        'cancelled' => 'cancelled'
      }
      
      status_mapping[status] || status
    end
  end
end
```

### 6. Background Job for Order Sync (app/jobs/sync_order_to_keycrm_job.rb)

```ruby
# app/jobs/sync_order_to_keycrm_job.rb
class SyncOrderToKeycrmJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(order_id, action = :create)
    order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
    return unless order
    
    keycrm_service = KeyCRM::OrderService.new
    
    begin
      case action.to_sym
      when :create
        keycrm_data = KeyCRM::OrderMapper.to_keycrm_format(order)
        response = keycrm_service.create_order(keycrm_data)
        order.update(keycrm_order_id: response.dig('data', 'id'))
        
      when :update
        if order.keycrm_order_id
          keycrm_data = KeyCRM::OrderMapper.to_keycrm_format(order)
          keycrm_service.update_order(order.keycrm_order_id, keycrm_data)
        end
        
      when :cancel
        if order.keycrm_order_id
          keycrm_service.cancel_order(order.keycrm_order_id, "Cancelled from Rails shop")
        end
      end
      
      Rails.logger.info "Successfully synced order #{order.id} to KeyCRM"
      
    rescue KeyCRM::Error => e
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM sync error for order #{order.id}: #{e.message}"
      # Optionally retry the job or notify admins
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
      @keycrm_data = keycrm_order['data']
```

```ruby
class OFACChecker
  def initialize(api_key)

  end
```

## Gemfile

```ruby
gem 'docusign_esign'

```

## Основна реалізація

```ruby
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'dotenv'
require 'base64'

# Завантаження змінних середовища
Dotenv.load

class DocusignSigner
  def initialize
    @config = {
      integrator_key: ENV['DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATOR_KEY'],
      user_id: ENV['DOCUSIGN_USER_ID'],
      account_id: ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID'],
      base_path: ENV['DOCUSIGN_BASE_PATH'] || 'https://demo.docusign.net/restapi',
      private_key_file: ENV['DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE'],
      expires_in: 3600 # 1 година
    }

    validate_config!
    setup_client
  end

  def sign_pdf_contract(pdf_path, signer_email, signer_name, output_path = nil)
    # Читання PDF файлу
    document_content = File.binread(pdf_path)
    base64_file_content = Base64.encode64(document_content)

    # Створення конверта (envelope)
    envelope_definition = create_envelope_definition(base64_file_content, File.basename(pdf_path), signer_email, signer_name)

    # Відправлення конверта для підпису
    envelope_summary = @envelopes_api.create_envelope(@account_id, envelope_definition)

    puts "Конверт створено. Envelope ID: #{envelope_summary.envelope_id}"

    # Очікування завершення підпису
    wait_for_completion(envelope_summary.envelope_id)

    # Завантаження підписаного документа
    download_signed_document(envelope_summary.envelope_id, output_path || "signed_#{File.basename(pdf_path)}")

    puts "Підписаний документ збережено: #{output_path || "signed_#{File.basename(pdf_path)}"}"
  end

  private

  def validate_config!
    required_env_vars = ['DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATOR_KEY', 'DOCUSIGN_USER_ID', 'DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID', 'DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE']
    missing_vars = required_env_vars.select { |var| ENV[var].nil? || ENV[var].empty? }

    unless missing_vars.empty?
      raise "Відсутні обов'язкові змінні середовища: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def setup_client
    # Конфігурація клієнта
    configuration = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @config[:base_path]

    @api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(configuration)
    @api_client.configure_jwt_authorization_flow(
      @config[:private_key_file],
      @config[:integrator_key],
      @config[:user_id],
      @config[:expires_in]
    )

    # Отримання інформації про акаунт
    user_info = @api_client.get_user_info(@api_client.access_token)
    @account_id = user_info.accounts.find { |account| account.is_default == "true" }.account_id

    # Ініціалізація API
    @envelopes_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
  end

  def create_envelope_definition(document_content, document_name, signer_email, signer_name)
    # Створення документа
    document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new(
      document_base64: document_content,
      name: document_name,
      file_extension: 'pdf',
      document_id: '1'
    )

    # Створення підписувача
    signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new(
      email: signer_email,
      name: signer_name,
      recipient_id: '1',
      routing_order: '1'
    )

    # Позиція підпису на документі
    sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new(
      document_id: '1',
      page_number: '1',
      recipient_id: '1',
      tab_label: 'SignHereTab',
      x_position: '100',
      y_position: '100'
    )

    # Вкладка (tab) для підпису
    tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new(
      sign_here_tabs: [sign_here]
    )

    signer.tabs = tabs

    # Одержувачі
    recipients = DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new(
      signers: [signer]
    )

    # Визначення конверта
    DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
      email_subject: 'Будь ласка, підпишіть цей документ',
      documents: [document],
      recipients: recipients,
      status: 'sent'
    )
  end

  def wait_for_completion(envelope_id, timeout_seconds = 300)
    puts "Очікування завершення підпису..."
    
    start_time = Time.now
    while Time.now - start_time < timeout_seconds
      envelope_status = @envelopes_api.get_envelope(@account_id, envelope_id)
      
      case envelope_status.status
      when 'completed'
        puts "Підпис завершено!"
        return true
      when 'declined'
        raise "Підпис відхилено одержувачем"
      when 'voided'
        raise "Підпис скасовано"
      end

      sleep 5 # Перевіряти кожні 5 секунд
    end

    raise "Час очікування вичерпано. Статус: #{envelope_status.status}"
  end

  def download_signed_document(envelope_id, output_path)
    # Отримання списку документів у конверті
    envelope_documents = @envelopes_api.list_documents(@account_id, envelope_id)
    
    # Знаходження комбінованого документа (підписаного)
    combined_document = envelope_documents.envelope_documents.find do |doc|
      doc.document_id == 'combined'
    end

    # Завантаження документа
    document_content = @envelopes_api.get_document(
      @account_id, 
      envelope_id, 
      combined_document.document_id
    )

    # Збереження файлу
    File.binwrite(output_path, document_content)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    signer = DocusignSigner.new
    
    # Параметри для підпису
    pdf_path = 'contract.pdf' # Шлях до PDF файлу
    signer_email = 'signer@example.com' # Email підписувача
    signer_name = 'John Doe' # Ім'я підписувача
    output_path = 'signed_contract.pdf' # Шлях для збереження підписаного документу
    
    signer.sign_pdf_contract(pdf_path, signer_email, signer_name, output_path)
    
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    puts e.backtrace if ENV['DEBUG']
  end
end
```

## Фонові завдання

### app/jobs/keycrm_sync_job.rb

```ruby
class KeycrmSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(order_id, action)
    order = Order.find(order_id)
    client = KeyCRM::Client.new
    
    case action
    when 'create'
      create_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    when 'update'
      update_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM Sync Error: #{e.message}"
    # Можна додати сповіщення про помилку
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    # Спочатку перевіряємо чи є клієнт в KeyCRM
    customer_response = client.find_customer_by_email(order.customer.email)
    
    if customer_response.success?
      customers = customer_response.parsed_response['data'] || []
      if customers.empty?
        # Створюємо нового клієнта
        customer_data = order.customer.to_keycrm_format
        customer_result = client.create_customer(customer_data)
        
        if customer_result.success?
          keycrm_customer_id = customer_result.parsed_response['data']['id']
          order.update(keycrm_customer_id: keycrm_customer_id)
        end
      else
        # Використовуємо існуючого клієнта
        keycrm_customer_id = customers.first['id']
        order.update(keycrm_customer_id: keycrm_customer_id)
      end
    end
    
    # Створюємо замовлення
    order_data = order.to_keycrm_format
    result = client.create_order(order_data)
    
    if result.success?
      keycrm_order_id = result.parsed_response['data']['id']
      order.update(keycrm_order_id: keycrm_order_id, synced_with_keycrm: true)
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to create order in KeyCRM: #{result.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_in_keycrm(client, order)
    return unless order.keycrm_order_id
    
    order_data = {
      status: order.map_status_to_keycrm,
      total_amount: order.total_price
      # Додайте інші поля, які потрібно оновити
    }
    
    result = client.update_order(order.keycrm_order_id, order_data)
    
    if result.success?
      order.update(synced_with_keycrm: true)
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to update order in KeyCRM: #{result.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

### app/controllers/commerce_ml_controller.rb
```ruby
class CommerceMlController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_1c
  
  def import
    case params[:mode]
    when 'checkauth'
      handle_checkauth
    when 'init'
      handle_init
    when 'file'
      handle_file
    when 'import'
      handle_import
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown mode", status: 400
    end
  end
  
  def export
    case params[:mode]
    when 'checkauth'
      handle_checkauth
    when 'init'
      handle_export_init
    when 'query'
      handle_export_query
    when 'file'
      handle_export_file
    when 'success'
      handle_export_success
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown mode", status: 400
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def authenticate_1c
    authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic do |username, password|
      username == ENV['1C_USERNAME'] && password == ENV['1C_PASSWORD']
    end
  end
  
  def handle_checkauth
    render plain: "success\nsession_id\n#{rand(1000000)}"
  end
  
  def handle_init
    render plain: "zip=yes\nfile_limit=100000000"
  end
  
  def handle_file
    filename = params[:filename]
    file_content = request.body.read
    
    if filename.end_with?('.xml')
      process_xml_file(filename, file_content)
    elsif filename.end_with?('.zip')
      process_zip_file(filename, file_content)
    end
    
    render plain: "success"
  end
  
  def handle_import
    ImportFrom1cJob.perform_later
    render plain: "success"
  end
  
  def handle_export_init
    render plain: "zip=yes\nfile_limit=100000000"
  end
  
  def handle_export_query
    case params[:type]
    when 'catalog'
      generate_catalog_xml
    when 'sale'
      generate_orders_xml
    else
      render plain: "failure\nUnknown type", status: 400
    end
  end
  
  def handle_export_file
    # 1C підтверджує отримання файлу
    render plain: "success"
  end
  
  def handle_export_success
    # Обробка успішного завершення вивантаження
    Rails.logger.info "1C successfully received export data"
    render plain: "success"
  end
  
  def process_xml_file(filename, content)
    case filename
    when 'import.xml'
      CommerceMl::CatalogParser.new(content).parse
    when 'orders.xml'
      CommerceMl::OrdersParser.new(content).parse
    end
  end
  
  def process_zip_file(filename, content)
    temp_file = Tempfile.new(['import', '.zip'])
    temp_file.binmode
    temp_file.write(content)
    temp_file.close
    
    Zip::File.open(temp_file.path) do |zip_file|
      zip_file.each do |entry|
        if entry.name.end_with?('.xml')
          content = entry.get_input_stream.read
          process_xml_file(entry.name, content)
        end
      end
    end
  ensure
    temp_file.unlink if temp_file
  end
  
  def generate_catalog_xml
    xml = CommerceMl::CatalogExporter.new.export
    send_data xml, filename: 'catalog.xml', type: 'application/xml'
  end
  
  def generate_orders_xml
    xml = CommerceMl::OrdersExporter.new.export
    send_data xml, filename: 'orders.xml', type: 'application/xml'
  end
end
```

## Парсери CommerceML

### app/services/commerce_ml/catalog_parser.rb
```ruby
module CommerceMl
  class CatalogParser
    def initialize(xml_content)
      @doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
      @doc.remove_namespaces!
    end
    
    def parse
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        parse_catalog
        parse_prices
        parse_images
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def parse_catalog
      @doc.xpath('//Каталог/Товары/Товар').each do |product_node|
        external_id = product_node.xpath('Ид').text
        product = Product.find_or_initialize_by_external_id(external_id)
        
        product.assign_attributes(
          name: product_node.xpath('Наименование').text,
          article: product_node.xpath('Артикул').text,
          description: product_node.xpath('Описание').text,
          active: product_node.xpath('Статус').text == 'true',
          updated_at: Time.current
        )
        
        product.save!
      end
    end
    
    def parse_prices
      @doc.xpath('//ПакетПредложений/Предложения/Предложение').each do |offer_node|
        product_external_id = offer_node.xpath('Ид').text
        product = Product.find_by(external_id: product_external_id)
        
        next unless product
        
        price_node = offer_node.xpath('Цены/Цена')
        price_value = price_node.xpath('ЦенаЗаЕдиницу').text.to_f
        currency = price_node.xpath('Валюта').text
        
        price = product.prices.find_or_initialize_by(currency: currency)
        price.update!(
          value: price_value,
          updated_at: Time.current
        )
      end
    end
    
    def parse_images
      @doc.xpath('//Каталог/Товары/Товар').each do |product_node|
        product = Product.find_by(external_id: product_node.xpath('Ид').text)
        next unless product
        
        product_node.xpath('Картинка').each do |image_node|
          image_url = image_node.text
          ProductImage.find_or_create_by(
            product: product,
            image_remote_url: image_url
          )
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### app/services/commerce_ml/orders_parser.rb
```ruby
module CommerceMl
  class OrdersParser
    def initialize(xml_content)
      @doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
      @doc.remove_namespaces!
    end
    
    def parse
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        parse_orders
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def parse_orders
      @doc.xpath('//Документ').each do |order_node|
        external_id = order_node.xpath('Ид').text
        order = Order.find_or_initialize_by_external_id(external_id)
        
        order.assign_attributes(
          number: order_node.xpath('Номер').text,
          date: DateTime.parse(order_node.xpath('Дата').text),
          status: map_order_status(order_node.xpath('ХозОперация').text),
          total_amount: order_node.xpath('Сумма').text.to_f,
          updated_at: Time.current
        )
        
        order.save!
        
        parse_order_items(order, order_node)
      end
    end
    
    def parse_order_items(order, order_node)
      order_node.xpath('Товары/Товар').each do |item_node|
        product_external_id = item_node.xpath('Ид').text
        product = Product.find_by(external_id: product_external_id)
        
        next unless product
        
        OrderItem.find_or_create_by(
          order: order,
          product: product
        ).update!(
          quantity: item_node.xpath('Количество').text.to_f,
          price: item_node.xpath('ЦенаЗаЕдиницу').text.to_f,
          total: item_node.xpath('Сумма').text.to_f
        )
      end
    end
    
    def map_order_status(operation_type)
      case operation_type
      when 'Заказ товара'
        'pending'
      when 'Отмена заказа'
        'cancelled'
      else
        'processing'
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
module CommerceMl
  class CatalogExporter
    def export
      builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
        xml.КоммерческаяИнформация(
          'ВерсияСхемы' => '2.08',
          'ДатаФормирования' => Time.current.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        ) do
          xml.Каталог do
            xml.Ид Catalog.external_id
            xml.ИмяКратко Catalog.name
            xml.Товары do
              Product.active.includes(:prices).each do |product|
                xml.Товар do
                  xml.Ид product.external_id
                  xml.Наименование product.name
                  xml.Артикул product.article
                  xml.Описание product.description
                  xml.Статус product.active ? 'true' : 'false'
                  
                  product.product_images.each do |image|
                    xml.Картинка image.image.url
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          
          xml.ПакетПредложений do
            xml.Ид Offers.external_id
            xml.Наименование Offers.name
            xml.Предложения do
              Product.active.includes(:prices).each do |product|
                product.prices.each do |price|
                  xml.Предложение do
                    xml.Ид product.external_id
                    xml.Цены do
                      xml.Цена do
                        xml.Представление "#{price.value} #{price.currency}"
                        xml.ИдЦены price.external_id
                        xml.ЦенаЗаЕдиницу price.value
                        xml.Валюта price.currency
                        xml.Единица product.unit
                        xml.Коэффициент 1
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      
      builder.to_xml
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
module CommerceMl
  class OrdersExporter
    def export
      builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
        xml.КоммерческаяИнформация(
          'ВерсияСхемы' => '2.08',
          'ДатаФормирования' => Time.current.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
        ) do
          Order.where(status: ['pending', 'processing']).includes(:order_items => :product).each do |order|
            xml.Документ do
              xml.Ид order.external_id
              xml.Номер order.number
              xml.Дата order.date.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
              xml.ХозОперация map_order_status(order.status)
              xml.Роль 'Продавец'
              xml.Сумма order.total_amount
              xml.Время order.created_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')

                    xml.Сумма item.total_price

                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      
      builder.to_xml
```

```ruby
require 'onfido'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class OnfidoVerification
  def initialize
    @onfido = Onfido::API.new(
      api_token: ENV['ONFIDO_API_TOKEN'],
      region: ENV['ONFIDO_REGION'] || 'eu'
    )
  end

  # Створення applicant (користувача)
  def create_applicant(user_data)
    begin
      applicant = @onfido.applicant.create(
        first_name: user_data[:first_name],
        last_name: user_data[:last_name],
        email: user_data[:email],
        dob: user_data[:dob], # формат: "1990-01-01"
        address: {
          building_number: user_data[:building_number],
          street: user_data[:street],
          town: user_data[:town],
          postcode: user_data[:postcode],
          country: user_data[:country]
        }
      )
      
      puts "Applicant created: #{applicant.id}"
      applicant
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      puts "Помилка при створенні applicant: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Завантаження документа
  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_path, document_type = 'passport')
    begin
      document = @onfido.document.upload(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: File.open(document_path),
        type: document_type
      )
      
      puts "Document uploaded: #{document.id}"
      document
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      puts "Помилка при завантаженні документа: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Завантаження селфі (фото користувача)
  def upload_selfie(applicant_id, selfie_path)
    begin
      live_photo = @onfido.live_photo.upload(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: File.open(selfie_path),
        advanced_validation: true
      )
      
      puts "Selfie uploaded: #{live_photo.id}"
      live_photo
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      puts "Помилка при завантаженні селфі: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Створення перевірки (check)
  def create_check(applicant_id, report_names = ['document', 'facial_similarity'])
    begin
      check = @onfido.check.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        report_names: report_names
      )
      
      puts "Check created: #{check.id}, статус: #{check.status}"
      check
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      puts "Помилка при створенні перевірки: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу перевірки
  def check_status(check_id)
    begin
      check = @onfido.check.find(check_id)
      puts "Статус перевірки: #{check.status}"
      
      # Вивід результатів по кожному звіту
      check.reports.each do |report|
        puts "Звіт #{report.name}: #{report.status}"
        puts "Результат: #{report.result}" if report.respond_to?(:result)
      end
      
      check
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні статусу: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Повний процес перевірки
  def full_verification(user_data, document_path, selfie_path)
    puts "Початок процесу перевірки..."
    
    # 1. Створення applicant
    applicant = create_applicant(user_data)
    return unless applicant
    
    # 2. Завантаження документа
    document = upload_document(applicant.id, document_path)
    return unless document
    
    # 3. Завантаження селфі
    selfie = upload_selfie(applicant.id, selfie_path)
    return unless selfie
    
    # 4. Створення перевірки
    check = create_check(applicant.id)
    return unless check
    
    # 5. Перевірка статусу (можна викликати пізніше)
    check_status(check.id)
    
    {
      applicant_id: applicant.id,
      document_id: document.id,
      selfie_id: selfie.id,
      check_id: check.id
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'onfido'
require 'dotenv/load'

class OnfidoVerification
  def initialize
    @onfido = Onfido::API.new(
      api_key: ENV['ONFIDO_API_TOKEN'],
      region: ENV['ONFIDO_REGION'] || 'eu'
    )
  end

  # Створення заявника (applicant)
  def create_applicant(user_data)
    begin
      applicant = @onfido.applicant.create(
        first_name: user_data[:first_name],
        last_name: user_data[:last_name],
        email: user_data[:email],
        dob: user_data[:date_of_birth], # формат: "1990-01-01"
        address: {
          street: user_data[:street],
          town: user_data[:town],
          postcode: user_data[:postcode],
          country: user_data[:country]
        }
      )
      
      { success: true, applicant_id: applicant['id'] }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Завантаження документа
  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_file, document_type)
    begin
      document = @onfido.document.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: document_file,
        type: document_type # наприклад: 'passport', 'driving_licence', 'national_identity_card'
      )
      
      { success: true, document_id: document['id'] }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Завантаження селфі (фото обличчя)
  def upload_selfie(applicant_id, selfie_file)
    begin
      live_photo = @onfido.live_photo.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: selfie_file,
        advanced_validation: true
      )
      
      { success: true, live_photo_id: live_photo['id'] }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Створення перевірки (check)
  def create_check(applicant_id, report_names = ['document', 'facial_similarity'])
    begin
      check = @onfido.check.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        report_names: report_names,
        tags: ['ruby-sdk'],
        consider: ['facial_similarity_visual']
      )
      
      { success: true, check_id: check['id'], status: check['status'] }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу перевірки
  def check_status(check_id)
    begin
      check = @onfido.check.find(check_id)
      
      {
        success: true,
        status: check['status'],
        result: check['result'],
        reports: check['reports']
      }
    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Повний процес перевірки
  def full_verification(user_data, document_file, selfie_file, document_type = 'passport')
    # 1. Створення заявника
    applicant_result = create_applicant(user_data)
    return applicant_result unless applicant_result[:success]

    applicant_id = applicant_result[:applicant_id]

    # 2. Завантаження документа
    document_result = upload_document(applicant_id, document_file, document_type)
    return document_result unless document_result[:success]

    # 3. Завантаження селфі
    selfie_result = upload_selfie(applicant_id, selfie_file)
    return selfie_result unless selfie_result[:success]

    # 4. Створення перевірки
    create_check(applicant_id)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class VerificationService
  def verify_user(user, document_path, selfie_path)
    onfido = OnfidoVerification.new
    
    user_data = {
      first_name: user.first_name,
      last_name: user.last_name,
      email: user.email,
      date_of_birth: user.date_of_birth.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
      street: user.address_street,
      town: user.address_town,
      postcode: user.address_postcode,
      country: user.address_country
    }

    # Завантаження файлів
    document_file = File.open(document_path)
    selfie_file = File.open(selfie_path)

    result = onfido.full_verification(user_data, document_file, selfie_file)
    
    # Закриття файлів
    document_file.close
    selfie_file.close

    result
  end
end

# Контролер (для Rails)
class VerificationsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    user = current_user
    document_file = params[:document]
    selfie_file = params[:selfie]

    service = VerificationService.new
    result = service.verify_user(user, document_file.tempfile.path, selfie_file.tempfile.path)

    if result[:success]
      render json: { 
        message: 'Verification started successfully', 
        check_id: result[:check_id] 
      }
    else
      render json: { error: result[:error] }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def status
    onfido = OnfidoVerification.new
    result = onfido.check_status(params[:check_id])

    if result[:success]
      render json: {
        status: result[:status],
        result: result[:result],
        reports: result[:reports]
      }
    else
      render json: { error: result[:error] }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
module KeyCRM
  class Client
    class APIError < StandardError; end
    class AuthenticationError < APIError; end
    class NotFoundError < APIError; end

    def initialize
      @base_url = KeyCRM.config.base_url
      @api_key = KeyCRM.config.api_key
      @timeout = KeyCRM.config.timeout
      @max_retries = KeyCRM.config.max_retries
    end

    def create_order(order_data)
      post('/orders', order_data)
    end

    def get_order(order_id)
      get("/orders/#{order_id}")
    end

    def update_order(order_id, order_data)
      put("/orders/#{order_id}", order_data)
    end

    def list_orders(params = {})
      get('/orders', params)
    end

    def get_customer(customer_id)
      get("/customers/#{customer_id}")
    end

    def create_customer(customer_data)
      post('/customers', customer_data)
    end

    def update_customer(customer_id, customer_data)
      put("/customers/#{customer_id}", customer_data)
    end

    private

    def connection
      @connection ||= Faraday.new(url: @base_url) do |faraday|
        faraday.request :json
        faraday.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
        faraday.response :raise_error
        faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
        
        # Retry logic
        faraday.request :retry, {
          max: @max_retries,
          interval: 0.05,
          interval_randomness: 0.5,
          backoff_factor: 2,
          exceptions: [Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed]
        }
      end
    end

    def get(path, params = {})
      request(:get, path, params)
    end

    def post(path, body = {})
      request(:post, path, body)
    end

    def put(path, body = {})
      request(:put, path, body)
    end

    def request(method, path, data = {})
      response = connection.send(method) do |req|
        req.url path
        req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@api_key}"
        req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        req.headers['Accept'] = 'application/json'
        req.body = data.to_json if [:post, :put].include?(method)
        req.params = data if method == :get
        req.options.timeout = @timeout
      end

      handle_response(response)
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError => e
      raise APIError, "Request timeout: #{e.message}"
    rescue Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      raise APIError, "Connection failed: #{e.message}"
    rescue Faraday::ClientError => e
      handle_client_error(e)
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200..299
        response.body
      when 401
        raise AuthenticationError, "Authentication failed: #{response.body['error']}"
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, "Resource not found"
      else
        raise APIError, "API Error #{response.status}: #{response.body['error']}"
      end
    end

    def handle_client_error(error)
      if error.response
        handle_response(error.response)
      else
        raise APIError, "Client error: #{error.message}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### app/services/keycrm/order_synchronizer.rb

```ruby
module KeyCRM
  class OrderSynchronizer
    def initialize(shop_order)
      @shop_order = shop_order
      @client = Client.new
    end

    def sync
      return if @shop_order.keycrm_synced?

      keycrm_order_data = OrderMapper.to_keycrm_order(@shop_order)
      response = @client.create_order(keycrm_order_data)
      
      if response['id']
        update_shop_order_with_keycrm_data(response)
        true
      else
        false
      end
    rescue Client::APIError => e
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM sync failed for order #{@shop_order.id}: #{e.message}"
      false
    end

    def update_status
      return unless @shop_order.keycrm_id

      status_data = { status: OrderMapper.map_status(@shop_order.status) }
      @client.update_order(@shop_order.keycrm_id, status_data)
      true
    rescue Client::APIError => e
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM status update failed for order #{@shop_order.keycrm_id}: #{e.message}"
      false
    end

    private

    def update_shop_order_with_keycrm_data(keycrm_response)
      @shop_order.update!(
        keycrm_id: keycrm_response['id'],
        keycrm_synced_at: Time.current,
        keycrm_sync_status: 'success'
      )
    end
  end
end
```

### app/jobs/keycrm_sync_job.rb

```ruby
class KeyCRMSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(shop_order_id, action = :sync)
    shop_order = ShopOrder.find_by(id: shop_order_id)
    return unless shop_order

    synchronizer = KeyCRM::OrderSynchronizer.new(shop_order)

    case action.to_sym
    when :sync
      synchronizer.sync
    when :update_status
      synchronizer.update_status
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "KeyCRMSyncJob failed for order #{shop_order_id}: #{e.message}"
    raise e if Rails.env.development?
  end
end
```

```ruby
  }

  def keycrm_synced?
    keycrm_id.present? && keycrm_synced_at.present?
  end

  private

  def schedule_keycrm_sync
    KeyCRMSyncJob.perform_later(id, :sync)

    return unless keycrm_synced?

  end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'onfido'
require 'dotenv'
require 'sinatra'

Dotenv.load

class OnfidoIdentityVerification
  def initialize
    @onfido = Onfido::API.new(api_token: ENV['ONFIDO_API_TOKEN'])
  end

  # Create an applicant
  def create_applicant(first_name:, last_name:, email:)
    applicant_data = {
      first_name: first_name,
      last_name: last_name,
      email: email
    }

    @onfido.applicant.create(applicant_data)
  end

  # Create a check for document and facial similarity verification
  def create_check(applicant_id:, report_names: ['document', 'facial_similarity'])
    check_data = {
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      report_names: report_names
    }

    @onfido.check.create(check_data)
  end

  # Upload a document for verification
  def upload_document(applicant_id:, file_path:, type: 'passport', side: 'front')
    file = File.open(file_path, 'rb')
    
    document_data = {
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      file: file,
      type: type,
      side: side
    }

    @onfido.document.create(document_data)
  ensure
    file.close if file
  end

  # Upload a selfie for facial similarity check
  def upload_selfie(applicant_id:, file_path:)
    file = File.open(file_path, 'rb')
    
    live_photo_data = {
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      file: file
    }

    @onfido.live_photo.create(live_photo_data)
  ensure
    file.close if file
  end

  # Get check results
  def get_check_status(check_id)
    @onfido.check.find(check_id)
  end

  # Get applicant details
  def get_applicant(applicant_id)
    @onfido.applicant.find(applicant_id)
  end

  # Comprehensive verification flow
  def verify_identity(first_name:, last_name:, email:, document_path:, selfie_path:)
    begin
      # Step 1: Create applicant
      applicant = create_applicant(
        first_name: first_name,
        last_name: last_name,
        email: email
      )
      puts "Applicant created: #{applicant['id']}"

      # Step 2: Upload document
      document = upload_document(
        applicant_id: applicant['id'],
        file_path: document_path
      )
      puts "Document uploaded: #{document['id']}"

      # Step 3: Upload selfie
      selfie = upload_selfie(
        applicant_id: applicant['id'],
        file_path: selfie_path
      )
      puts "Selfie uploaded: #{selfie['id']}"

      # Step 4: Create verification check
      check = create_check(applicant_id: applicant['id'])
      puts "Check created: #{check['id']}"

      {
        success: true,
        applicant_id: applicant['id'],
        check_id: check['id'],
        status: 'pending'
      }

    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Onfido API error: #{e.message}"
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Verification error: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end
```

### 3. Web Server for Webhook Handling

```ruby
# server.rb
require_relative 'app'
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class OnfidoWebhookServer < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :port, ENV['PORT'] || 3000
  end

  before do
    content_type 'application/json'
  end

  # Webhook endpoint for Onfido callbacks
  post '/webhook' do
    # Verify webhook signature (recommended for production)
    verify_webhook_signature(request)

    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    process_webhook(payload)

    { status: 'received' }.to_json
  end

  # Start verification process
  post '/verify' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

    verifier = OnfidoIdentityVerification.new
    result = verifier.verify_identity(
      first_name: data['first_name'],
      last_name: data['last_name'],
      email: data['email'],
      document_path: data['document_path'],
      selfie_path: data['selfie_path']
    )

    result.to_json
  end

  # Check verification status
  get '/check/:check_id' do
    verifier = OnfidoIdentityVerification.new
    check = verifier.get_check_status(params[:check_id])
    check.to_json
  end
```

```ruby
# app/services/identity_verification_workflow.rb
require 'fileutils'

class IdentityVerificationWorkflow
  def initialize
    @onfido_service = OnfidoService.new
  end

  # Complete identity verification workflow
  def verify_identity(user_data, document_path, selfie_path)
    begin
      # Step 1: Create applicant
      puts "Creating applicant..."
      applicant = @onfido_service.create_applicant(user_data)
      puts "Applicant created with ID: #{applicant.id}"

      # Step 2: Upload document
      puts "Uploading document..."
      document = @onfido_service.upload_document(applicant.id, {
        type: user_data[:document_type],
        file: File.open(document_path, 'rb'),
        side: 'front'
      })
      puts "Document uploaded with ID: #{document.id}"

      # Step 3: Upload selfie
      puts "Uploading selfie..."
      selfie = @onfido_service.upload_selfie(applicant.id, {
        file: File.open(selfie_path, 'rb')
      })
      puts "Selfie uploaded with ID: #{selfie.id}"

      # Step 4: Create verification check
      puts "Creating verification check..."
      check = @onfido_service.create_verification_check(
        applicant.id, 
        [document.id], 
        selfie.id
      )
      puts "Check created with ID: #{check.id}"

      # Step 5: Wait for check completion (polling)
      check_result = wait_for_check_completion(check.id)
      
      {
        success: true,
        applicant_id: applicant.id,
        check_id: check.id,
        status: check_result.status,
        results: parse_check_results(check_result),
        reports: check_result.reports
      }

    rescue Onfido::RequestError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Onfido API error: #{e.message}",
        details: JSON.parse(e.response_body) rescue {}
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end

  private

  # Poll for check completion (simplified - in production, use webhooks)
  def wait_for_check_completion(check_id, max_attempts = 30, delay = 2)
    attempts = 0
    while attempts < max_attempts
      check = @onfido_service.get_check_results(check_id)
      return check if check.status != 'in_progress'
      
      sleep(delay)
      attempts += 1
      puts "Waiting for check completion... (#{attempts}/#{max_attempts})"
    end

    raise "Check timed out after #{max_attempts * delay} seconds"
  end

  def parse_check_results(check)
    {
      overall_result: check.result,
      document_report: check.reports.find { |r| r.name == 'document' },
      facial_similarity_report: check.reports.find { |r| r.name == 'facial_similarity_photo' }
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class OnfidoWebhookHandler < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :protection, except: [:json_csrf]
  end

  before do
    content_type 'application/json'
    verify_webhook_signature
  end

  post '/webhooks/onfido' do
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    case payload['action']
    when 'check.completed'
      handle_check_completed(payload)
    when 'check.started'
      handle_check_started(payload)
    when 'report.completed'
      handle_report_completed(payload)
    else
      puts "Unhandled webhook action: #{payload['action']}"
    end

    status 200
    { status: 'processed' }.to_json
  end

  private

  def verify_webhook_signature
    signature = request.env['HTTP_X_SHA256_SIGNATURE']
    payload_body = request.body.read
    request.body.rewind

    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(
      OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha256'), 
      ENV['ONFIDO_WEBHOOK_TOKEN'], 
      payload_body
    )

    halt 401, 'Invalid signature' unless signature == expected_signature
  end

  def handle_check_completed(payload)
    check_id = payload['object']['id']
    applicant_id = payload['object']['applicant_id']
    
    # Update your database or trigger next steps
    puts "Check #{check_id} completed for applicant #{applicant_id}"
    
    # You might want to fetch the full check details here
    onfido_service = OnfidoService.new
    check_details = onfido_service.get_check_results(check_id)
    
    # Process the results as needed
```

```ruby
class DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  
  # Екшен для ініціювання запиту документів
  def request_documents
    # Створюємо унікальний токен для цього запиту
    sharing_token = SecureRandom.uuid
    
    # Зберігаємо токен в сесії або базі даних для подальшої перевірки
    session[:document_sharing_token] = sharing_token
    
    # URL для зворотного виклику
    callback_url = documents_callback_url
    
    # Викликаємо Action Sharing API для запиту документів
    sharing_service = ActionSharing::DocumentService.new
    sharing_request = sharing_service.request_documents(
      user_id: current_user.id,
      callback_url: callback_url,
      token: sharing_token,
      requested_document_types: ['passport', 'driver_license', 'utility_bill']
    )
    
    if sharing_request.success?
      redirect_to sharing_request.authorization_url, allow_other_host: true
    else
      flash[:error] = 'Не вдалося ініціювати запит документів'
      redirect_to root_path
    end
  end
  
  # Екшен для обробки зворотного виклику
  def callback
    # Перевіряємо токен безпеки
    if params[:token] != session[:document_sharing_token]
      render json: { error: 'Invalid token' }, status: :unauthorized
      return
    end
    
    # Отримуємо документи через Action Sharing
    sharing_service = ActionSharing::DocumentService.new
    documents_response = sharing_service.get_documents(params[:sharing_session_id])
    
    if documents_response.success?
      # Обробляємо отримані документи
      process_documents(documents_response.documents)
      
      render json: { status: 'success' }
    else
      render json: { error: 'Failed to retrieve documents' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_documents(documents)
    documents.each do |document|
      # Зберігаємо документ в базі даних
      user_document = UserDocument.create!(
        user: current_user,
        document_type: document.type,
        file_data: document.file_data,
        metadata: document.metadata,
        verified_at: Time.current
      )
      
      # Додаткові дії з документом (вендоринг, аналіз тощо)
      DocumentProcessorJob.perform_later(user_document.id)
    end
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# ofac_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_model'

class OFACChecker
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  
  OFAC_SEARCH_URL = 'https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/'
  
  attr_accessor :first_name, :last_name, :country
  
  validates :first_name, :last_name, presence: true
  validates :country, presence: true, length: { is: 2 }
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    attributes.each do |key, value|
      send("#{key}=", value)
    end
  end
  
  def search
    return { error: errors.full_messages.join(', ') } unless valid?
    
    begin
      # Get the search page to obtain the CSRF token
      response = HTTParty.get(OFAC_SEARCH_URL)
      doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
      
      # Extract CSRF token (if present in form)
      csrf_token = extract_csrf_token(doc)
      
      # Prepare search parameters
      search_params = {
        'ctl00$MainContent$txtLastName' => last_name,
        'ctl00$MainContent$txtFirstName' => first_name,
        'ctl00$MainContent$ddlCountry' => country,
        'ctl00$MainContent$btnSearch' => 'Search'
      }
      
      # Add CSRF token if found
      search_params.merge!(csrf_token) if csrf_token
      
      # Perform the search
      search_response = HTTParty.post(
        OFAC_SEARCH_URL,
        body: search_params,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
          'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
        }
      )
      
      parse_search_results(search_response)
      
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: "Search failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def extract_csrf_token(doc)
    # Try to find CSRF token in various common locations
    token = doc.at_css('input[name="__REQUESTVERIFICATIONTOKEN"]') ||
            doc.at_css('input[name="csrf_token"]') ||
            doc.at_css('meta[name="csrf-token"]')
    
    return unless token
    
    if token['name'] && token['value']
      { token['name'] => token['value'] }
    end
  end
  
  def parse_search_results(response)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
    results_table = doc.at_css('#MainContent_gvSearchResults')
    
    if results_table.nil?
      { match: false, message: 'No matches found in OFAC sanctions list' }
    else
      matches = extract_matches(results_table)
      {
        match: matches.any?,
        matches: matches,
        message: matches.any? ? 'Potential match(es) found in OFAC sanctions list' : 'No matches found'
      }
    end
  end
  
  def extract_matches(table)
    matches = []
    rows = table.css('tr')
    
    # Skip header row
    rows[1..-1]&.each do |row|
      cells = row.css('td')
      next if cells.empty?
      
      match = {
        name: cells[0]&.text&.strip,
        address: cells[1]&.text&.strip,
        type: cells[2]&.text&.strip,
        programs: cells[3]&.text&.strip,
        list: cells[4]&.text&.strip,
        score: cells[5]&.text&.strip
      }
      
      matches << match
    end
    
    matches
  end
end
```

```ruby
# ofac_batch_checker.rb
require 'csv'

class OFACBatchChecker
  def initialize(checker)
    @checker = checker
  end
  
  def process_csv(csv_file_path)
    results = []
    
    CSV.foreach(csv_file_path, headers: true) do |row|
      person = {
        first_name: row['first_name'],
        last_name: row['last_name'],
        country: row['country']
      }
      
      result = @checker.search(person)
      results << {
        person: person,
        result: result
      }
      
      # Add delay to be respectful to the server
      sleep(1)
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  def generate_report(results, output_file)
    CSV.open(output_file, 'w') do |csv|
      csv << ['First Name', 'Last Name', 'Country', 'OFAC Match', 'Details']
      
      results.each do |item|
        person = item[:person]
        result = item[:result]
        
        csv << [
          person[:first_name],
          person[:last_name],
          person[:country],
          result[:match] ? 'YES' : 'NO',
          result[:message]
        ]
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Configure encryption key (in production, use environment variables)
# For development/test, you can generate a key with: SecureRandom.hex(32)
if Rails.env.production?
  ENV['ENCRYPTION_KEY'] ||= 'your_secure_encryption_key_here_32_bytes_long'
end

# Set up encryption configuration
```

```ruby
# app/models/concerns/personal_data_encryptable.rb
module PersonalDataEncryptable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    # Define which attributes should be encrypted
    def self.encrypts_personal_data(*attributes)
      attributes.each do |attribute|
        # Define encrypted attribute
        attr_encrypted attribute.to_sym,
                      key: Rails.application.credentials.encryption_key || ENV['ENCRYPTION_KEY'],
                      algorithm: 'aes-256-gcm',
                      mode: :per_attribute_iv_and_salt
        
        # Add validation for presence if needed
        validates attribute, presence: true, if: -> { send("#{attribute}_changed?") }
        
        # Add searchable encryption if needed (for exact matches only)
        define_singleton_method("find_by_#{attribute}") do |value|
          where("#{attribute}_encrypted" => encrypt_value(value))
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def self.encrypt_value(value)
      return nil if value.blank?
      encryptor = AttrEncrypted::Encryptors::AES256GCM.new(
        key: Rails.application.credentials.encryption_key || ENV['ENCRYPTION_KEY'],
        algorithm: 'aes-256-gcm'
      )
      encryptor.encrypt(value, iv: SecureRandom.hex(12))
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class User < ApplicationRecord
  include PersonalDataEncryptable
  
  # Define which personal data fields to encrypt
  encrypts_personal_data :passport_number, :date_of_birth
  
  # Regular validations
  validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  
  # Custom validation for date format
  validate :valid_date_of_birth_format
  
  # Virtual attributes for form handling (optional)
  attr_accessor :passport_number_temp, :date_of_birth_temp
  
  before_save :encrypt_temp_attributes

    return if date_of_birth.blank?
    
    begin
      Date.parse(date_of_birth)
    rescue ArgumentError
      errors.add(:date_of_birth, 'must be a valid date')
    end
  end
  
  def encrypt_temp_attributes
    self.passport_number = passport_number_temp if passport_number_temp.present?
    self.date_of_birth = date_of_birth_temp if date_of_birth_temp.present?
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/services/encryption_service.rb
class EncryptionService
  ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm'
  
  def initialize(key: nil)
    @key = key || Rails.application.credentials.encryption_key || ENV['ENCRYPTION_KEY']
  end
  
  def encrypt(value)
    return nil if value.blank?
    
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    cipher.encrypt
    cipher.key = @key
    iv = cipher.random_iv
    
    encrypted_data = cipher.update(value.to_s) + cipher.final
    auth_tag = cipher.auth_tag
    
    {
      iv: Base64.strict_encode64(iv),
      auth_tag: Base64.strict_encode64(auth_tag),
      encrypted_data: Base64.strict_encode64(encrypted_data)
    }
  end
  
  def decrypt(encrypted_hash)
    return nil if encrypted_hash.blank?
    
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    cipher.decrypt
    cipher.key = @key
    cipher.iv = Base64.strict_decode64(encrypted_hash[:iv])
    cipher.auth_tag = Base64.strict_decode64(encrypted_hash[:auth_tag])
    
    encrypted_data = Base64.strict_decode64(encrypted_hash[:encrypted_data])
    cipher.update(encrypted_data) + cipher.final
  rescue OpenSSL::Cipher::CipherError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Decryption failed: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end
end
```

```ruby
class EncryptionService
  ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm'

      auth_tag: Base64.strict_encode64(auth_tag),
      encrypted_data: Base64.strict_encode64(encrypted)
    }.to_json

    iv = Base64.strict_decode64(data['iv'])
    auth_tag = Base64.strict_decode64(data['auth_tag'])
    encrypted_data = Base64.strict_decode64(data['encrypted_data'])
    
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    cipher.decrypt
    cipher.key = @key
    cipher.iv = iv
    cipher.auth_tag = auth_tag
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# diia_sharing_client.rb
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'sinatra'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class DiiaSharingClient
  BASE_URL = ENV['DIIA_BASE_URL'] || 'https://diia.gov.ua/api/v1'
  
  def initialize(partner_id:, private_key:, client_id:)
    @partner_id = partner_id
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(private_key)
    @client_id = client_id
  end

  # Request user documents via Diia Sharing
  def request_documents(return_url, scope: ['documents'])
    endpoint = "#{BASE_URL}/sharing/auth"
    
    request_body = {
      partnerId: @partner_id,
      scope: scope,
      returnUrl: return_url,
      timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601
    }
    
    # Sign the request
    signature = sign_data(request_body.to_json)
    
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Partner-Signature' => signature,
      'X-Partner-Id' => @partner_id
    }
    
    response = RestClient.post(endpoint, request_body.to_json, headers)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue RestClient::Exception => e
    handle_error(e)
  end

  # Verify callback signature
  def verify_signature(data, signature)
    public_key = get_diia_public_key
    public_key.verify(OpenSSL::Digest.new('SHA256'), Base64.decode64(signature), data)
  end

  # Handle callback with user documents
  def handle_callback(callback_data, signature)
    unless verify_signature(callback_data, signature)
      raise 'Invalid signature'
    end
    
    parsed_data = JSON.parse(callback_data)
    process_documents(parsed_data)
  end

  private

  def sign_data(data)
    signature = @private_key.sign(OpenSSL::Digest.new('SHA256'), data)
    Base64.strict_encode64(signature)
  end

  def get_diia_public_key
    # In production, this should fetch the public key from Diia's API
    # For now, using a placeholder - you'll need to configure the actual public key
    public_key_pem = ENV['DIIA_PUBLIC_KEY']
    OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(public_key_pem)
  end

  def process_documents(documents_data)
    {
      status: 'success',
      user_id: documents_data['userId'],
      documents: documents_data['documents'] || [],
      timestamp: documents_data['timestamp']
    }
  end

  def handle_error(error)
    {
      error: 'Request failed',
      message: error.message,
      code: error.http_code
    }
  end
end
```
