# ukraine_vat_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class UkraineVATChecker
  BASE_URL = 'https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua'
  SEARCH_URL = "#{BASE_URL}/eb/pvat/checkrep"
  
  # Validates Ukrainian Individual Tax Number (ІПН)
  def self.valid_inn?(inn)
    return false unless inn.is_a?(String) || inn.is_a?(Integer)
    
    inn_str = inn.to_s
    return false unless inn_str.match?(/^\d{10}$/)
    
    # Validate checksum (algorithm for Ukrainian INN)
    coefficients = [-1, 5, 7, 9, 4, 6, 10, 5, 7]
    digits = inn_str.chars.map(&:to_i)
    
    sum = coefficients.each_with_index.sum do |coef, index|
      coef * digits[index]
    end
    
    checksum = sum % 11 % 10
    digits.last == checksum
  end
  
  def initialize
    @session_cookie = nil
  end
  
  # Main method to check VAT registration
  def check_vat_registration(inn)
    unless self.class.valid_inn?(inn)
      return { success: false, error: "Invalid INN format" }
    end
    
    begin
      # Step 1: Get session cookie
      session_response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, headers: default_headers)
      cookies = session_response.headers['set-cookie']
      @session_cookie = extract_session_cookie(cookies)
      
      return { success: false, error: "Failed to establish session" } unless @session_cookie
      
      # Step 2: Perform search
      search_result = perform_search(inn)
      
      unless search_result[:success]
        return search_result
      end
      
      # Step 3: Parse the response
      parse_search_result(search_result[:html])
      
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def default_headers
    {
      'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
      'Accept' => 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8',
      'Accept-Language' => 'uk,en-US;q=0.7,en;q=0.3',
      'Accept-Encoding' => 'gzip, deflate, br',
      'Connection' => 'keep-alive'
    }
  end
  
  def authenticated_headers
    default_headers.merge({
      'Cookie' => @session_cookie,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      'Referer' => BASE_URL
    })
  end
  
  def extract_session_cookie(cookies)
    return nil unless cookies
    
    if cookies.is_a?(Array)
      cookie_string = cookies.join('; ')
    else
      cookie_string = cookies
    end
    
    # Extract JSESSIONID or similar session cookie
    if match = cookie_string.match(/(JSESSIONID=[^;]+)/)
      match[1]
    else
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def perform_search(inn)
    form_data = {
      'filter' => 'true',
      'subjectCode' => inn.to_s,
      'subjectName' => '',
      'subjectAdress' => ''
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      SEARCH_URL,
      headers: authenticated_headers,
      body: URI.encode_www_form(form_data),
      follow_redirects: false
    )
    
    if response.success?
      { success: true, html: response.body }
    else
      { success: false, error: "Search failed with status: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  def parse_search_result(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    
    # Look for the results table
    table = doc.css('table.table-striped')
    
    if table.empty?
      return { 
        success: true, 
        registered: false, 
        message: "No registration found for this INN" 
      }
    end
    
    # Extract registration information
    rows = table.css('tr')
    
    # Assuming the first row after header contains the main info
    if rows.length > 1
      cells = rows[1].css('td')
      
      if cells.length >= 4
        name = cells[0].text.strip
        inn = cells[1].text.strip
        status = cells[2].text.strip
        registration_date = cells[3].text.strip
        
        registered = status.downcase.include?('зареєстровано') || 
                    status.downcase.include?('active') ||
                    status.downcase.include?('діючий')
        
        return {
          success: true,
          registered: registered,
          details: {
            name: name,
            inn: inn,
            status: status,
            registration_date: registration_date,
            registration_number: extract_registration_number(doc)
          }
        }
      end
    end
    
    { success: true, registered: false, message: "Could not parse response" }
  end
  
  def extract_registration_number(doc)
    # Try to find registration number in various places
    doc.css('td').each do |td|
      text = td.text.strip
      # Look for VAT registration number pattern
      if text.match?(/^\d{8,15}$/) && text.length > 8
        return text
      end
    end
    nil
  end
end

# ukrainian_sanctions_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'nokogiri'

class UkrainianSanctionsChecker
  # NAPC (National Agency for Prevention of Corruption) API endpoints
  NAPC_API_BASE = 'https://public.nazk.gov.ua/api'
  SANCTIONS_LIST_URL = "#{NAPC_API_BASE}/sanction/companies"
  SEARCH_API_URL = "#{NAPC_API_BASE}/search/companies"
  
  def initialize
    @cache = {} # Simple cache to avoid repeated API calls
  end
  
  # Check if a company is on the sanctions list
  # @param company_name [String] The name of the company to check
  # @param options [Hash] Additional search options
  # @return [Hash] Result with status and details
  def check_company(company_name, options = {})
    return @cache[company_name] if @cache[company_name]
    
    normalized_name = normalize_name(company_name)
    
    # Try direct search first
    result = search_company_direct(normalized_name, options)
    
    # If not found, try fuzzy search
    if result.nil? || !result[:found]
      result = search_company_fuzzy(normalized_name, options)
    end
    
    @cache[company_name] = result
    result
  end
  
  # Get the full sanctions list
  # @return [Array] List of sanctioned companies
  def get_full_sanctions_list
    response = HTTParty.get(SANCTIONS_LIST_URL, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'Ukrainian Sanctions Checker/1.0',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch sanctions list: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Normalize company name for better matching
  def normalize_name(name)
    name.to_s.downcase
        .gsub(/[^a-zа-яіїєґ0-9\s]/i, '') # Remove special chars, keep alphanumeric and spaces
        .gsub(/\s+/, ' ')                # Normalize whitespace
        .strip
  end
  
  # Direct search using NAPC API
  def search_company_direct(company_name, options)
    search_params = {
      'name' => company_name,
      'page' => options[:page] || 1,
      'limit' => options[:limit] || 50
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.get(SEARCH_API_URL, {
      query: search_params,
      headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'Ukrainian Sanctions Checker/1.0',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    })
    
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      process_search_results(data, company_name)
    else
      { found: false, error: "API error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Fuzzy search with multiple attempts
  def search_company_fuzzy(company_name, options)
    # Try different search variations
    variations = [
      company_name,
      company_name.split(' ').first, # First word only
      company_name.gsub(/\b(llc|inc|corp|company|limited)\b/i, '').strip, # Remove common suffixes
    ]
    
    variations.each do |variation|
      next if variation.empty?
      
      result = search_company_direct(variation, options)
      return result if result[:found]
    end
    
    { found: false, message: 'Company not found in sanctions list' }
  end
  
  # Process search results and determine matches
  def process_search_results(data, original_name)
    items = data['items'] || []
    exact_matches = []
    partial_matches = []
    
    items.each do |company|
      normalized_company_name = normalize_name(company['name'] || '')
      similarity = calculate_similarity(original_name, normalized_company_name)
      
      if similarity >= 0.9
        exact_matches << {
          name: company['name'],
          details: company,
          similarity: similarity
        }
      elsif similarity >= 0.7
        partial_matches << {
          name: company['name'],
          details: company,
          similarity: similarity
        }
      end
    end
    
    if exact_matches.any?
      {
        found: true,
        status: 'sanctioned',
        match_type: 'exact',
        matches: exact_matches,
        message: "Company found in sanctions list with #{exact_matches.size} exact match(es)"
      }
    elsif partial_matches.any?
      {
        found: true,
        status: 'potential_match',
        match_type: 'partial',
        matches: partial_matches,
        message: "Company has #{partial_matches.size} partial match(es) in sanctions list"
      }
    else
      { found: false, status: 'not_found', message: 'Company not found in sanctions list' }
    end
  end
  
  # Calculate string similarity using Jaro-Winkler distance
  def calculate_similarity(str1, str2)
    # Simple similarity calculation - you could use a gem like 'amatch' for better results
    return 1.0 if str1 == str2
    return 0.0 if str1.empty? || str2.empty?
    
    # Simple common substring approach
    longer = [str1, str2].max_by(&:length)
    shorter = [str1, str2].min_by(&:length)
    
    common_chars = shorter.chars.count { |char| longer.include?(char) }
    common_chars.to_f / longer.length
  end
end

# company_fuzzy_matcher.rb
require 'fuzzy_match'
require 'amatch'
require 'text'

class CompanyFuzzyMatcher
  def initialize(companies, threshold: 0.8, levenshtein_threshold: 3)
    @companies = companies.map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?)
    @threshold = threshold
    @levenshtein_threshold = levenshtein_threshold
  end

  # Find matches using Jaro-Winkler distance (fuzzy_match gem)
  def find_jaro_winkler_matches(target_company)
    target_company = target_company.strip.downcase
    matcher = FuzzyMatch.new(@companies, read: :downcase)
    
    matches = matcher.find_all_with_score(target_company)
    matches.select! { |company, score| score >= @threshold }
    
    matches.map do |company, score|
      {
        company: company,
        score: score.round(4),
        method: 'Jaro-Winkler'
      }
    end
  end

  # Find matches using Levenshtein distance (amatch gem)
  def find_levenshtein_matches(target_company)
    target_company = target_company.strip.downcase
    levenshtein = Amatch::Levenshtein.new(target_company)
    
    matches = @companies.map do |company|
      distance = levenshtein.match(company.downcase)
      similarity = 1.0 - (distance.to_f / [target_company.length, company.length].max)
      [company, distance, similarity]
    end
    
    matches.select! { |company, distance, similarity| distance <= @levenshtein_threshold }
    
    matches.map do |company, distance, similarity|
      {
        company: company,
        distance: distance,
        similarity: similarity.round(4),
        method: 'Levenshtein'
      }
    end
  end

  # Combine both methods for comprehensive matching
  def find_all_matches(target_company)
    jaro_matches = find_jaro_winkler_matches(target_company)
    levenshtein_matches = find_levenshtein_matches(target_company)
    
    {
      jaro_winkler: jaro_matches,
      levenshtein: levenshtein_matches,
      all_matches: jaro_matches + levenshtein_matches
    }
  end

  # Find the best match from both methods
  def find_best_match(target_company)
    all_matches = find_all_matches(target_company)
    
    jaro_best = all_matches[:jaro_winkler].max_by { |match| match[:score] } if all_matches[:jaro_winkler].any?
    levenshtein_best = all_matches[:levenshtein].max_by { |match| match[:similarity] } if all_matches[:levenshtein].any?
    
    {
      jaro_winkler_best: jaro_best,
      levenshtein_best: levenshtein_best,
      overall_best: [jaro_best, levenshtein_best].compact.max_by do |match|
        match[:score] || match[:similarity]
      end
    }
  end

  # Compare two specific companies using both methods
  def compare_companies(company1, company2)
    company1_down = company1.strip.downcase
    company2_down = company2.strip.downcase
    
    # Jaro-Winkler distance
    jaro_score = Text::WhiteSimilarity.new.similarity(company1_down, company2_down)
    
    # Levenshtein distance
    levenshtein = Amatch::Levenshtein.new(company1_down)
    levenshtein_distance = levenshtein.match(company2_down)
    max_length = [company1_down.length, company2_down.length].max
    levenshtein_similarity = 1.0 - (levenshtein_distance.to_f / max_length)
    
    {
      company1: company1,
      company2: company2,
      jaro_winkler: {
        score: jaro_score.round(4),
        match: jaro_score >= @threshold
      },
      levenshtein: {
        distance: levenshtein_distance,
        similarity: levenshtein_similarity.round(4),
        match: levenshtein_distance <= @levenshtein_threshold
      }
    }
  end
end

# vat_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'

class UkrainianVATChecker
  BASE_URL = "https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua/eb/pvn/"
  
  def initialize
    @session_cookie = nil
  end
  
  # Основна функція перевірки
  def check_vat_status(inn)
    return { error: "ІПН має містити 10 цифр" } unless valid_inn?(inn)
    
    begin
      # Отримуємо сесійну куку
      session_cookie = get_session_cookie
      return session_cookie if session_cookie[:error]
      
      # Виконуємо пошук за ІПН
      search_result = search_by_inn(inn, session_cookie[:cookie])
      return search_result if search_result[:error]
      
      # Отримуємо детальну інформацію
      detailed_info = get_detailed_info(search_result[:company_id], session_cookie[:cookie])
      
      detailed_info
    rescue => e
      { error: "Помилка під час запиту: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Перевірка формату ІПН
  def valid_inn?(inn)
    inn.to_s.match?(/^\d{10}$/)
  end
  
  # Отримання сесійної куки
  def get_session_cookie
    response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'
      }
    })
    
    if response.success?
      set_cookie = response.headers['set-cookie']
      if set_cookie && set_cookie.match(/JSESSIONID=([^;]+)/)
        { cookie: $1 }
      else
        { error: "Не вдалося отримати сесійну куку" }
      end
    else
      { error: "Помилка підключення до податкової служби" }
    end
  end
  
  # Пошук компанії за ІПН
  def search_by_inn(inn, session_cookie)
    search_url = "#{BASE_URL}public/pvn/query"
    
    response = HTTParty.post(search_url, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'Cookie' => "JSESSIONID=#{session_cookie}",
        'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        'Referer' => BASE_URL
      },
      body: {
        'query' => inn,
        'queryType' => 'INN'
      }
    })
    
    if response.success?
      parse_search_results(response.body, inn)
    else
      { error: "Помилка під час пошуку за ІПН" }
    end
  end
  
  # Парсинг результатів пошуку
  def parse_search_results(html, inn)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    
    # Шукаємо таблицю з результатами
    table = doc.css('table.table tbody tr')
    
    if table.empty?
      return { error: "Платника ПДВ з ІПН #{inn} не знайдено" }
    end
    
    # Беремо перший результат
    first_row = table.first
    cells = first_row.css('td')
    
    if cells.size >= 3
      company_name = cells[0].text.strip
      inn_from_table = cells[1].text.strip
      status = cells[2].text.strip
      link = first_row.css('a').first
      
      if link && link['href']
        company_id = link['href'].match(/id=(\d+)/)[1] rescue nil
      end
      
      {
        company_id: company_id,
        company_name: company_name,
        inn: inn_from_table,
        status: status,
        found: true
      }
    else
      { error: "Неочікуваний формат відповіді" }
    end
  end
  
  # Отримання детальної інформації
  def get_detailed_info(company_id, session_cookie)
    return { error: "ID компанії не знайдено" } unless company_id
    
    detail_url = "#{BASE_URL}public/pvn/details?id=#{company_id}"
    
    response = HTTParty.get(detail_url, {
      headers: {
        'Cookie' => "JSESSIONID=#{session_cookie}",
        'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        'Referer' => BASE_URL
      }
    })
    
    if response.success?
      parse_detailed_info(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Помилка під час отримання детальної інформації" }
    end
  end
  
  # Парсинг детальної інформації
  def parse_detailed_info(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    result = {}
    
    # Основна інформація
    doc.css('.panel-body dl').each do |dl|
      dt_elements = dl.css('dt')
      dd_elements = dl.css('dd')
      
      dt_elements.each_with_index do |dt, index|
        dd = dd_elements[index]
        next unless dd
        
        key = dt.text.strip.gsub(':', '').downcase.gsub(/\s+/, '_')
        value = dd.text.strip
        result[key.to_sym] = value
      end
    end
    
    # Статус платника ПДВ
    vat_status_element = doc.css('h2.text-primary, h3.text-primary').find { |el| el.text.include?('ПДВ') }
    if vat_status_element
      result[:vat_status] = vat_status_element.text.strip
    end
    
    result[:success] = true
    result
  rescue => e
    { error: "Помилка парсингу детальної інформації: #{e.message}" }
  end
end

end

# comment_language_detector.rb
require 'cld3'
require 'whatlanguage'
require 'fasttext'
require 'stopwords-filter'

class CommentLanguageDetector
  # Supported languages with their ISO 639-1 codes
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = {
    'en' => 'English',
    'es' => 'Spanish',
    'fr' => 'French',
    'de' => 'German',
    'it' => 'Italian',
    'pt' => 'Portuguese',
    'ru' => 'Russian',
    'zh' => 'Chinese',
    'ja' => 'Japanese',
    'ko' => 'Korean',
    'ar' => 'Arabic',
    'hi' => 'Hindi',
    'nl' => 'Dutch',
    'sv' => 'Swedish',
    'pl' => 'Polish',
    'tr' => 'Turkish'
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    # Initialize multiple detectors for better accuracy
    @cld3_detector = CLD3::NNetLanguageIdentifier.new(1, 1000)
    @wl_detector = WhatLanguage.new(:all)
    @filter = Stopwords::Filter.new
  end

  # Detect language using multiple methods and return the most probable result
  def detect(comment)
    return nil if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?

    # Clean the comment
    cleaned_comment = clean_comment(comment)
    return nil if cleaned_comment.strip.empty?

    # Get results from different detectors
    results = {
      cld3: detect_with_cld3(cleaned_comment),
      whatlanguage: detect_with_whatlanguage(cleaned_comment),
      heuristic: detect_with_heuristic(cleaned_comment)
    }

    # Determine the best result
    determine_best_language(results, cleaned_comment)
  end

  # Batch detect multiple comments
  def detect_batch(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| detect(comment) }
  end

  # Get confidence score for a detected language
  def confidence(comment, language_code)
    return 0.0 if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty? || !SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.key?(language_code)

    cleaned_comment = clean_comment(comment)
    return 0.0 if cleaned_comment.strip.empty?

    # Use CLD3 for confidence scoring as it provides reliable probabilities
    result = @cld3_detector.find_language(cleaned_comment)
    result&.language == language_code ? result.probability : 0.0
  end

  private

  def clean_comment(comment)
    # Remove URLs, mentions, and excessive whitespace
    comment.gsub(/https?:\/\/\S+/, '')
           .gsub(/@\w+/, '')
           .gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
           .strip
           .downcase
  end

  def detect_with_cld3(comment)
    result = @cld3_detector.find_language(comment)
    return nil unless result && result.reliable?
    
    {
      language: result.language,
      probability: result.probability,
      reliable: result.reliable?
    }
  end

  def detect_with_whatlanguage(comment)
    language = @wl_detector.language(comment)
    return nil if language == :unknown
    
    {
      language: language.to_s,
      probability: 0.8, # whatlanguage doesn't provide probabilities
      reliable: true
    }
  end

  def detect_with_heuristic(comment)
    # Simple heuristic based on common words and characters
    words = comment.split(/\s+/)
    return nil if words.empty?

    scores = {}

    # Check for language-specific patterns
    SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.each_key do |lang|
      scores[lang] = score_comment_for_language(comment, lang)
    end

    best_lang = scores.max_by { |_, score| score }&.first
    best_score = scores[best_lang].to_f

    return nil if best_score < 0.1

    {
      language: best_lang,
      probability: [best_score, 1.0].min,
      reliable: best_score > 0.3
    }
  end

  def score_comment_for_language(comment, language_code)
    score = 0.0
    words = comment.split(/\s+/)

    # Language-specific character sets and common words
    case language_code
    when 'en'
      score += comment.scan(/[a-z]/).size * 0.1
      score += words.count { |word| %w[the and you are for that with have this].include?(word) } * 2
    when 'es'
      score += comment.scan(/[áéíóúñ]/).size * 3
      score += words.count { |word| %w[el la que y en los del las].include?(word) } * 2
    when 'fr'
      score += comment.scan(/[àâäéèêëîïôöùûüÿç]/).size * 3
      score += words.count { |word| %w[le la les et de des un une].include?(word) } * 2
    when 'de'
      score += comment.scan(/[äöüß]/).size * 3
      score += words.count { |word| %w[der die das und in den von zu].include?(word) } * 2
    when 'zh', 'ja'
      score += comment.scan(/[\u4e00-\u9fff\u3040-\u309f\u30a0-\u30ff]/).size * 2
    when 'ru'
      score += comment.scan(/[а-яё]/i).size * 0.1
    when 'ar'
      score += comment.scan(/[\u0600-\u06FF]/).size * 0.1
    when 'ko'
      score += comment.scan(/[\uac00-\ud7af\u1100-\u11ff\u3130-\u318f]/).size * 2
    end

    score / [words.size, 1].max
  end

  def determine_best_language(results, comment)
    # Filter out nil results and unreliable detections
    valid_results = results.values.compact.select { |r| r[:reliable] }
    
    return { language: 'unknown', probability: 0.0, reliable: false } if valid_results.empty?

    # Group by language and calculate average probability
    language_scores = {}
    valid_results.each do |result|
      lang = result[:language]
      language_scores[lang] ||= { total: 0.0, count: 0 }
      language_scores[lang][:total] += result[:probability]
      language_scores[lang][:count] += 1
    end

    # Find language with highest average probability
    best_lang, scores = language_scores.max_by { |_, data| data[:total] / data[:count] }
    avg_probability = scores[:total] / scores[:count]

    # If we have agreement between multiple detectors, increase reliability
    reliable = scores[:count] > 1 || avg_probability > 0.8

    {
      language: best_lang,
      probability: avg_probability,
      reliable: reliable,
      method_agreement: scores[:count]
    }
  end
end

require 'cld3'
require 'whatlanguage'
require 'fasttext'

class CommentLanguageDetector
  def initialize
    # Ініціалізація CLD3
    @cld3_detector = CLD3::NNetLanguageIdentifier.new(1, 2048)
    
    # Ініціалізація WhatLanguage
    @wl_detector = WhatLanguage.new(:all)
    
    # Ініціалізація fastText (завантаження моделі)
    @fasttext_model = FastText::Model.new
    begin
      @fasttext_model.load_model("lid.176.bin")
    rescue => e
      puts "Попередження: Модель fastText не знайдена. Завантажте її з https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html"
      @fasttext_model = nil
    end
  end

  # Основний метод для визначення мови
  def detect_language(comment)
    return nil if comment.nil? || comment.strip.empty?

    results = {
      cld3: detect_with_cld3(comment),
      whatlanguage: detect_with_whatlanguage(comment),
      fasttext: detect_with_fasttext(comment)
    }

    determine_final_language(results, comment)
  end

  # Використання CLD3 для визначення мови
  def detect_with_cld3(comment)
    result = @cld3_detector.find_language(comment)
    {
      language: result.language,
      probability: result.probability,
      reliable: result.reliable?
    }
  rescue => e
    { error: "CLD3 помилка: #{e.message}" }
  end

  # Використання WhatLanguage для визначення мови
  def detect_with_whatlanguage(comment)
    result = @wl_detector.language(comment)
    {
      language: result.to_s,
      confidence: @wl_detector.language_confidence(comment, result)
    }
  rescue => e
    { error: "WhatLanguage помилка: #{e.message}" }
  end

  # Використання fastText для визначення мови
  def detect_with_fasttext(comment)
    return { error: "Модель fastText не завантажена" } unless @fasttext_model

    prediction = @fasttext_model.predict(comment)
    if prediction.any?
      lang = prediction.first.first.gsub('__label__', '')
      confidence = prediction.first.last
      {
        language: lang,
        confidence: confidence
      }
    else
      { error: "Не вдалося визначити мову" }
    end
  rescue => e
    { error: "fastText помилка: #{e.message}" }
  end

  private

  # Визначення фінальної мови на основі результатів всіх методів
  def determine_final_language(results, comment)
    # Якщо коментар дуже короткий, використовуємо CLD3 (краще працює з короткими текстами)
    if comment.length < 10
      return format_final_result(results[:cld3], :cld3) unless results[:cld3][:error]
    end

    # Перевіряємо узгодженість результатів
    languages = {}
    
    [results[:cld3], results[:whatlanguage], results[:fasttext]].each do |result|
      next if result[:error]
      
      lang_key = result[:language]&.downcase
      languages[lang_key] ||= { count: 0, sources: [], confidence: 0 }
      languages[lang_key][:count] += 1
      languages[lang_key][:sources] << result
      languages[lang_key][:confidence] += (result[:probability] || result[:confidence] || 0)
    end

    # Знаходимо мову з найбільшою кількістю збігів
    best_match = languages.max_by { |_, data| [data[:count], data[:confidence]] }

    if best_match && best_match[1][:count] >= 2
      {
        language: best_match[0],
        confidence: best_match[1][:confidence] / best_match[1][:count],
        sources: best_match[1][:sources].map { |s| s[:language] }.uniq,
        method: 'consensus'
      }
    else
      # Якщо немає збігів, вибираємо метод з найвищою впевненістю
      best_individual = [results[:cld3], results[:whatlanguage], results[:fasttext]]
                         .reject { |r| r[:error] }
                         .max_by { |r| r[:probability] || r[:confidence] || 0 }
      
      if best_individual
        format_final_result(best_individual, :individual)
      else
        { language: 'unknown', confidence: 0, method: 'none' }
      end
    end
  end

  def format_final_result(result, method)
    {
      language: result[:language],
      confidence: result[:probability] || result[:confidence] || 0,
      method: method.to_s
    }
  end
end

class BatchLanguageDetector
  def initialize

    results = {}

      puts "Обробка коментаря #{index + 1}/#{comments.length}"

  end

require 'net/http'
require 'fileutils'

class FastTextModelDownloader
  MODEL_URL = "https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/fasttext/supervised-models/lid.176.bin"
  MODEL_PATH = "lid.176.bin"

  def self.download
    if File.exist?(MODEL_PATH)
      puts "Модель вже завантажена"
      return true
    end

    puts "Завантаження моделі fastText..."
    
    uri = URI(MODEL_URL)
    Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true) do |http|
      request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
      
      http.request(request) do |response|
        if response.code == '200'
          File.open(MODEL_PATH, 'wb') do |file|
            response.read_body do |chunk|
              file.write(chunk)
            end
          end
          puts "Модель успішно завантажена"
          true
        else
          puts "Помилка завантаження: #{response.code}"
          false
        end
      end
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
end

require 'fuzzy_match'
require 'amatch'
require 'terminal-table'

class FuzzyCompanyMatcher
  attr_reader :companies
  
  def initialize(company_names)
    @companies = company_names
    @fuzzy_match = FuzzyMatch.new(company_names)
    @levenshtein = Amatch::Levenshtein.new('')
    @jaro_winkler = Amatch::JaroWinkler.new('')
  end
  
  # Пошук найкращих збігів з використанням алгоритму FuzzyMatch
  def find_best_matches(query, limit: 5)
    @fuzzy_match.find_all(query, limit: limit)
  end
  
  # Розрахунок відстані Левенштейна між двома рядками
  def levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    @levenshtein.pattern = str1.downcase
    @levenshtein.match(str2.downcase)
  end
  
  # Розрахунок відстані Джаро-Вінклера між двома рядками
  def jaro_winkler_distance(str1, str2)
    @jaro_winkler.pattern = str1.downcase
    @jaro_winkler.match(str2.downcase)
  end
  
  # Повний аналіз збігів з обома метриками
  def analyze_matches(query, limit: 5)
    matches = find_best_matches(query, limit: limit)
    
    results = matches.map do |match|
      {
        company: match,
        levenshtein: levenshtein_distance(query, match),
        jaro_winkler: jaro_winkler_distance(query, match)
      }
    end
    
    # Сортування за відстанню Джаро-Вінклера (зворотний порядок - більше значення = кращий збіг)
    results.sort_by { |r| -r[:jaro_winkler] }
  end
  
  # Вивід результатів у вигляді таблиці
  def print_analysis(query, limit: 5)
    results = analyze_matches(query, limit: limit)
    
    puts "\nЗапит: '#{query}'"
    puts "Знайдено #{results.size} найкращих збігів:\n\n"
    
    rows = results.map.with_index(1) do |result, index|
      [
        index,
        result[:company],
        '%.4f' % result[:levenshtein],
        '%.4f' % result[:jaro_winkler]
      ]
    end
    
    table = Terminal::Table.new(
      headings: ['#', 'Назва компанії', 'Левенштейн', 'Джаро-Вінклер'],
      rows: rows
    )
    
    puts table
    puts "\nПримітка: Левенштейн - менше значення = краще, Джаро-Вінклер - більше значення = краще"
  end
  
  # Порівняння двох конкретних назв компаній
  def compare_two_companies(company1, company2)
    {
      company1: company1,
      company2: company2,
      levenshtein: levenshtein_distance(company1, company2),
      jaro_winkler: jaro_winkler_distance(company1, company2)
    }
  end
end

To convert DOCX documents to HTML and plain text, we'll use the `reverse_docx` gem for DOCX to HTML conversion and then use Nokogiri to extract plain text from the HTML. Here's the solution:

**Gemfile:**

source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'reverse_docx'

**Ruby implementation:**
```ruby
require 'reverse_docx'
require 'nokogiri'

class DocxConverter
  def initialize(docx_path)
    @docx_path = docx_path
    validate_file_exists
  end

  def to_html
    @html ||= begin
      document = ReverseDocx.parse(@docx_path)
      document.to_html
    rescue => e
      raise "Failed to convert DOCX to HTML: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def to_text
    @text ||= begin
      html_content = to_html
      document = Nokogiri::HTML(html_content)
      
      # Remove script and style elements
      document.xpath('//script|//style').remove
      
      # Get text content and clean up
      text = document.text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
      text.gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, ' ') # Normalize whitespace
    rescue => e
      raise "Failed to convert to plain text: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def convert_all
    {
      html: to_html,
      text: to_text
    }
  end

  private

  def validate_file_exists
    unless File.exist?(@docx_path)
      raise "File not found: #{@docx_path}"
    end
    
    unless File.extname(@docx_path).casecmp('.docx').zero?
      raise "File is not a DOCX document: #{@docx_path}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage:
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.length != 1
    puts "Usage: ruby docx_converter.rb <path_to_docx_file>"

# fuzzy_company_matcher.rb
require 'fuzzy_match'
require 'amatch'
require 'text'

class FuzzyCompanyMatcher
  attr_reader :companies, :threshold, :verbose
  
  def initialize(companies, threshold: 0.8, verbose: false)
    @companies = companies
    @threshold = threshold
    @verbose = verbose
    @fuzzy_matcher = FuzzyMatch.new(companies)
  end
  
  # Levenshtein distance (0 = identical, higher = more different)
  def levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    Text::Levenshtein.distance(str1.downcase, str2.downcase)
  end
  
  # Normalized Levenshtein similarity (0-1, where 1 = identical)
  def levenshtein_similarity(str1, str2)
    distance = levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    max_length = [str1.length, str2.length].max.to_f
    max_length.zero? ? 1.0 : (1 - (distance / max_length))
  end
  
  # Jaro-Winkler similarity (0-1, where 1 = identical)
  def jaro_winkler_similarity(str1, str2)
    Text::WhiteSimilarity.new.similarity(str1.downcase, str2.downcase)
  end
  
  # Find all potential matches for a given company
  def find_matches(target_company)
    puts "Finding matches for: #{target_company}" if verbose
    
    results = companies.map do |company|
      next if company == target_company
      
      levenshtein_sim = levenshtein_similarity(target_company, company)
      jaro_winkler_sim = jaro_winkler_similarity(target_company, company)
      
      {
        company: company,
        levenshtein_distance: levenshtein_distance(target_company, company),
        levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_sim,
        jaro_winkler_similarity: jaro_winkler_sim,
        average_similarity: (levenshtein_sim + jaro_winkler_sim) / 2
      }
    end.compact
    
    # Filter by threshold and sort by average similarity
    results.select { |r| r[:average_similarity] >= threshold }
           .sort_by { |r| -r[:average_similarity] }
  end
  
  # Find all pairs of similar companies above threshold
  def find_all_similar_pairs
    puts "Finding all similar company pairs (threshold: #{threshold})..." if verbose
    
    pairs = []
    processed = Set.new
    
    companies.each do |company1|
      companies.each do |company2|
        next if company1 == company2 || processed.include?([company2, company1])
        
        levenshtein_sim = levenshtein_similarity(company1, company2)
        jaro_winkler_sim = jaro_winkler_similarity(company1, company2)
        average_sim = (levenshtein_sim + jaro_winkler_sim) / 2
        
        if average_sim >= threshold
          pairs << {
            company1: company1,
            company2: company2,
            levenshtein_distance: levenshtein_distance(company1, company2),
            levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_sim,
            jaro_winkler_similarity: jaro_winkler_sim,
            average_similarity: average_sim
          }
          processed.add([company1, company2])
        end
      end
    end
    
    pairs.sort_by { |p| -p[:average_similarity] }
  end
  
  # Use fuzzy_match gem for quick matching
  def fuzzy_match_gem_find(target_company, limit: 5)
    @fuzzy_matcher.find_all(target_company).first(limit)
  end
  
  # Detailed comparison report for two companies
  def detailed_comparison(company1, company2)
    {
      company1: company1,
      company2: company2,
      levenshtein_distance: levenshtein_distance(company1, company2),
      levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_similarity(company1, company2),
      jaro_winkler_similarity: jaro_winkler_similarity(company1, company2),
      average_similarity: (levenshtein_similarity(company1, company2) + jaro_winkler_similarity(company1, company2)) / 2
    }
  end
end

```ruby
require 'amatch'
require 'fuzzy_match'
require 'levenshtein'
require 'damerau-levenshtein'

class CompanyMatcher
  attr_reader :companies
  
  def initialize(company_names)
    @companies = company_names.map { |name| normalize_name(name) }
    @fuzzy_matcher = FuzzyMatch.new(@companies)
  end
  
  # Нормалізація назв компаній для кращого порівняння
  def normalize_name(name)
    name.to_s.downcase
        .gsub(/[^\w\s]/, '')     # Видаляємо спеціальні символи
        .gsub(/\b(llc|inc|corp|company|co|corporation)\b/, '') # Видаляємо юридичні форми
        .gsub(/\s+/, ' ')        # Замінюємо множинні пробіли на один
        .strip                   # Видаляємо пробіли на початку та в кінці
  end
  
  # Обчислення відстані Левенштейна (кількість операцій для перетворення)
  def levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    Levenshtein.distance(normalize_name(str1), normalize_name(str2))
  end
  
  # Обчислення відстані Джаро-Вінклера (враховує префікси)
  def jaro_winkler_distance(str1, str2)
    str1_norm = normalize_name(str1)
    str2_norm = normalize_name(str2)
    
    # Використовуємо gem amatch для Jaro-Winkler
    jarow = Amatch::JaroWinkler.new(str1_norm)
    jarow.match(str2_norm)
  end
  
  # Пошук найближчих збігів за відстанню Левенштейна
  def find_best_matches_levenshtein(company_name, limit = 5, max_distance = 10)
    normalized_target = normalize_name(company_name)
    matches = []
    
    @companies.each do |company|
      distance = Levenshtein.distance(normalized_target, company)
      if distance <= max_distance
        similarity = calculate_similarity(distance, normalized_target.length, company.length)
        matches << { company: company, distance: distance, similarity: similarity }
      end
    end
    
    matches.sort_by { |m| m[:distance] }
           .first(limit)
           .sort_by { |m| -m[:similarity] }
  end
  
  # Пошук найближчих збігів за відстанню Джаро-Вінклера
  def find_best_matches_jaro_winkler(company_name, limit = 5, min_similarity = 0.7)
    normalized_target = normalize_name(company_name)
    matches = []
    
    @companies.each do |company|
      similarity = jaro_winkler_distance(normalized_target, company)
      if similarity >= min_similarity
        matches << { company: company, similarity: similarity }
      end
    end
    
    matches.sort_by { |m| -m[:similarity] }.first(limit)
  end
  
  # Комбінований пошук (обидві метрики)
  def find_best_matches_combined(company_name, limit = 5)
    levenshtein_matches = find_best_matches_levenshtein(company_name, limit * 2)
    jaro_matches = find_best_matches_jaro_winkler(company_name, limit * 2)
    
    # Об'єднуємо результати та унікалізуємо
    all_matches = (levenshtein_matches + jaro_matches).uniq { |m| m[:company] }
    
    # Ранжуємо за комбінованою оцінкою
    all_matches.map! do |match|
      lev_match = levenshtein_matches.find { |m| m[:company] == match[:company] }
      jaro_match = jaro_matches.find { |m| m[:company] == match[:company] }
      
      combined_score = if lev_match && jaro_match
        (lev_match[:similarity] + jaro_match[:similarity]) / 2.0
      elsif lev_match
        lev_match[:similarity]
      else
        jaro_match[:similarity]
      end
      
      match.merge(combined_score: combined_score)
    end
    
    all_matches.sort_by { |m| -m[:combined_score] }.first(limit)
  end
  
  # Використання готового FuzzyMatch gem для швидкого пошуку
  def fuzzy_find(company_name, limit = 5)
    normalized_target = normalize_name(company_name)
    results = @fuzzy_matcher.find_all(normalized_target)
    
    results.first(limit).map do |company|
      {
        company: company,
        levenshtein: levenshtein_distance(normalized_target, company),
        jaro_winkler: jaro_winkler_distance(normalized_target, company)
      }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def calculate_similarity(distance, len1, len2)
    max_length = [len1, len2].max
    return 1.0 if max_length == 0
    1.0 - (distance.to_f / max_length)
  end
end

## Додатковий модуль для розширеного аналізу

```ruby
class AdvancedCompanyMatcher < CompanyMatcher
  def initialize(company_names)
    super(company_names)
    # Додаткові налаштування для кращої нормалізації
  end
  
  # Розширена нормалізація з врахуванням абревіатур
  def advanced_normalize_name(name)
    normalized = normalize_name(name)
    
    # Заміна поширених абревіатур
    abbreviations = {
      'intl' => 'international',
      'tech' => 'technology',
      'mfg' => 'manufacturing',
      'svcs' => 'services',
      'dept' => 'department'
    }
    
    abbreviations.each do |abbr, full|
      normalized.gsub!(/\b#{abbr}\b/, full)
    end
    
    normalized
  end
  
  # Пошук з урахуванням синонімів та абревіатур
  def find_matches_with_synonyms(company_name, synonyms = {}, limit = 5)
    base_matches = find_best_matches_combined(company_name, limit * 2)
    
    # Додаємо збіги для синонімів
    synonym_matches = []
    synonyms.each do |synonym, original|
      if company_name.downcase.include?(synonym.downcase)
        synonym_matches += find_best_matches_combined(original, limit)
      end
    end
    
    (base_matches + synonym_matches).uniq { |m| m[:company] }
                                   .sort_by { |m| -m[:combined_score] }
                                   .first(limit)
  end
end

# profanity_filter.rb
require 'obscenity'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Default profanity filter configuration
  DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    replacement: :garbled, # Options: :garbled, :vowels, :stars, :nonconsonants, or custom character
    allowlist: [],
    denylist: [],
    sanitize: true
  }

  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.merge(config)
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Filter profanity in a single comment
  def filter(comment)
    return "" if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    # Clean and prepare the text
    text = comment.to_s.dup
    
    # Apply filtering based on configuration
    if @config[:sanitize]
      text = Obscenity.sanitize(text, @config)
    else
      text = Obscenity.replacement(:garbled).sanitize(text, @config)
    end
    
    text
  end

  # Check if a comment contains profanity
  def profane?(comment)
    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    Obscenity.profane?(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Get the list of profane words found in a comment
  def profane_words(comment)
    return [] if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    Obscenity.offensive(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Add custom words to the denylist
  def add_to_denylist(words)
    words = Array(words)
    @config[:denylist] += words
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Add words to the allowlist (words that should not be filtered)
  def add_to_allowlist(words)
    words = Array(words)
    @config[:allowlist] += words
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Get current configuration
  def config
    @config.dup
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist   = @config[:denylist] if @config[:denylist].any?
      config.whitelist   = @config[:allowlist] if @config[:allowlist].any?
      config.replacement = @config[:replacement]
    end
  end
end

# bulk_profanity_filter.rb
require_relative 'profanity_filter'

class BulkProfanityFilter
  def initialize(filter_config = {})
    @filter = ProfanityFilter.new(filter_config)
    @stats = {
      total_processed: 0,
      profane_comments: 0,
      filtered_comments: 0
    }
  end

  # Process multiple comments at once
  def process_comments(comments)
    results = {
      clean: [],
      filtered: [],
      profane_words_found: []
    }

    comments.each do |comment|
      @stats[:total_processed] += 1
      
      if @filter.profane?(comment)
        @stats[:profane_comments] += 1
        @stats[:filtered_comments] += 1
        
        filtered_comment = @filter.filter(comment)
        profane_words = @filter.profane_words(comment)
        
        results[:filtered] << {
          original: comment,
          filtered: filtered_comment,
          profane_words: profane_words
        }
        results[:profane_words_found] += profane_words
      else
        results[:clean] << comment
      end
    end

    results[:profane_words_found].uniq!
    results[:stats] = @stats.dup
    results
  end

  # Generate a report of filtering activity
  def generate_report(processing_results)
    results = processing_results.is_a?(Hash) ? processing_results : process_comments(processing_results)
    
    report = <<~REPORT
      Profanity Filtering Report
      ==========================
      
      Total Comments Processed: #{results[:stats][:total_processed]}
      Clean Comments: #{results[:clean].size}
      Comments with Profanity: #{results[:stats][:profane_comments]}
      Filtered Comments: #{results[:stats][:filtered_comments]}
      
      Unique Profane Words Found: #{results[:profane_words_found].size}
      Profane Words: #{results[:profane_words_found].join(', ')}
      
      Filtered Comments Details:
      #{generate_filtered_details(results[:filtered])}
    REPORT

    report
  end

  private

  def generate_filtered_details(filtered_comments)
    return "None" if filtered_comments.empty?
    
    details = filtered_comments.map do |comment_data|
      "Original: #{comment_data[:original]}\nFiltered: #{comment_data[:filtered]}\nWords: #{comment_data[:profane_words].join(', ')}\n"
    end.join("---\n")
    
    details
  end
end

# profanity_filter.rb
require 'obscenity'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Default configuration for the obscenity gem
  DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    replacement: :garbled,  # Options: :default, :garbled, :vowels, :stars, or custom character
    profanity_list: Obscenity::Base.profanity_list  # Use default list
  }.freeze

  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = DEFAULT_CONFIG.merge(config)
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Filter profanity in a single comment
  def filter(comment)
    return "" if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    Obscenity.sanitize(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Check if a comment contains profanity
  def profane?(comment)
    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    Obscenity.profane?(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Get a list of profane words found in the comment
  def offensive_words(comment)
    return [] if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    Obscenity.offensive(comment.to_s)
  end

  # Filter multiple comments at once
  def filter_multiple(comments)
    Array(comments).map { |comment| filter(comment) }
  end

  # Add custom profanity words to the filter
  def add_custom_words(words)
    Array(words).each do |word|
      Obscenity::Base.profanity_list << word.downcase.strip
    end
    Obscenity::Base.profanity_list.uniq!
  end

  # Remove words from the profanity list (whitelist)
  def whitelist_words(words)
    Array(words).each do |word|
      Obscenity::Base.profanity_list.delete(word.downcase.strip)
    end
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist   = @config[:profanity_list]
      config.replacement = @config[:replacement]
    end
  end
end

# advanced_profanity_filter.rb
require_relative 'profanity_filter'

class AdvancedProfanityFilter < ProfanityFilter
  # Custom profanity list with common English profanities
  CUSTOM_PROFANITY_LIST = %w[
    damn hell crap shit fuck ass bitch bastard dick piss cunt
    slut whore fag faggot retard moron idiot stupid dumbass
    motherfucker bullshit cock suck sucks sucking sucked
  ].freeze

  # Common false positives to whitelist
  WHITELIST_WORDS = %w[
    assassin assignment bass class classic classy glass grass
    pass passage passenger compass embarrass Massachusetts
    cucumber scunthorpe
  ].freeze

  def initialize(config = {})
    custom_config = {
      replacement: :stars,
      profanity_list: CUSTOM_PROFANITY_LIST
    }.merge(config)
    
    super(custom_config)
    setup_custom_lists
  end

  # Enhanced filtering with leet speak detection
  def filter_with_leet_detection(comment)
    return "" if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    # Convert leet speak to normal text
    normalized_comment = normalize_leet_speak(comment)
    
    # Filter profanity
    filtered_comment = filter(normalized_comment)
    
    # Convert back to original format if needed (optional)
    maintain_original_format(comment, filtered_comment)
  end

  # Check multiple variations of a comment
  def thoroughly_profane?(comment)
    return false if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    variations = [
      comment,
      comment.downcase,
      normalize_leet_speak(comment),
      comment.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]/i, '')  # Remove special characters
    ]
    
    variations.any? { |variation| profane?(variation) }
  end

  # Get profanity score (0.0 to 1.0)
  def profanity_score(comment)
    return 0.0 if comment.nil? || comment.empty?
    
    words = comment.downcase.split(/\W+/)
    return 0.0 if words.empty?
    
    profane_words = offensive_words(comment)
    (profane_words.size.to_f / words.size).round(2)
  end

  private

  def setup_custom_lists
    # Add custom profanity list
    add_custom_words(CUSTOM_PROFANITY_LIST)
    
    # Whitelist common false positives
    whitelist_words(WHITELIST_WORDS)
  end

  def normalize_leet_speak(text)
    leet_mapping = {
      '4' => 'a', '@' => 'a', '3' => 'e', '0' => 'o',
      '1' => 'i', '!' => 'i', '7' => 't', '5' => 's',
      '$' => 's', '+' => 't'
    }
    
    normalized = text.dup
    leet_mapping.each { |leet, normal| normalized.gsub!(leet, normal) }
    normalized
  end

  def maintain_original_format(original, filtered)
    # Simple implementation - in production you might want more sophisticated logic
    filtered
  end
end

  if mod10 == 1 && mod100 != 11
    :one
  elsif [2, 3, 4].include?(mod10) && ![12, 13, 14].include?(mod100)
    :few
  elsif mod10 == 0 || [5, 6, 7, 8, 9].include?(mod10) || [11, 12, 13, 14].include?(mod100)
    :many
  else
    :other
  end
end
```

**Example usage in a Rails view:**
```erb
<!-- app/views/items/index.html.erb -->
<%= t('item', count: @items.count) %>
<%= t('apple', count: 5) %>
<%= t('message', count: 21) %>
```

The Ukrainian pluralization rules follow the CLDR (Common Locale Data Repository) specification:
- **one**: 1, 21, 31, 41... (but not 11, 111, etc.)
- **few**: 2-4, 22-24, 32-34...
- **many**: 0, 5-20, 25-30, 35-40...
- **other**: used as fallback

The code provides both the pluralization rule definition and example translations to demonstrate how it works.

# support_ticket_summarizer.rb
require 'anthropic'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class SupportTicketSummarizer
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(access_token: @api_key)
  end

  def summarize_ticket(ticket_content, max_tokens: 500, model: 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229')
    prompt = build_prompt(ticket_content)
    
    response = @client.messages(
      parameters: {
        model: model,
        max_tokens: max_tokens,
        messages: [
          { role: "user", content: prompt }
        ]
      }
    )
    
    extract_summary(response)
  end

  def summarize_multiple_tickets(tickets, max_tokens: 300, model: 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229')
    summaries = []
    
    tickets.each_with_index do |ticket, index|
      puts "Summarizing ticket #{index + 1}/#{tickets.length}..."
      
      if ticket.is_a?(Hash)
        content = format_ticket_hash(ticket)
        summary = summarize_ticket(content, max_tokens: max_tokens, model: model)
        summaries << {
          ticket_id: ticket[:id] || ticket['id'] || index,
          summary: summary,
          original_length: content.length
        }
      else
        summary = summarize_ticket(ticket, max_tokens: max_tokens, model: model)
        summaries << {
          ticket_id: index,
          summary: summary,
          original_length: ticket.length
        }
      end
    end
    
    summaries
  end

  private

  def build_prompt(ticket_content)
    <<~PROMPT
      Please provide a concise summary of the following support ticket. Focus on:

      1. The main issue or problem described
      2. Key symptoms or error messages mentioned
      3. Any troubleshooting steps already attempted
      4. The user's environment or context if provided
      5. The urgency or impact level

      Structure your response with clear sections and bullet points.

      Ticket content:
      #{ticket_content}
    PROMPT
  end

  def format_ticket_hash(ticket)
    if ticket.is_a?(Hash)
      ticket.map { |key, value| "#{key}: #{value}" }.join("\n")
    else
      ticket.to_s
    end
  end

  def extract_summary(response)
    if response['content'] && response['content'].is_a?(Array)
      response['content'].map { |content| content['text'] }.join(' ')
    else
      response.to_s
    end
  rescue => e
    "Error extracting summary: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# profanity_filter.rb
require 'obscenity'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Список додаткових нецензурних слів (можна розширити)
  CUSTOM_BAD_WORDS = [
    'hateword1', 'hateword2', 'abusive_term'
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    configure_obscenity
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text, replacement: '***', strategy: :default)
    return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?

    case strategy
    when :default
      default_filter(text, replacement)
    when :vowels_only
      vowels_only_filter(text, replacement)
    when :leetspeak
      leetspeak_filter(text, replacement)
    else
      default_filter(text, replacement)
    end
  end

  # Перевірка чи містить текст нецензурну лексику
  def profane?(text)
    return false if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    Obscenity.profane?(text.downcase) || contains_custom_bad_words?(text.downcase)
  end

  # Отримання списку нецензурних слів у тексті
  def offensive_words(text)
    return [] if text.nil? || text.empty?

    words = []
    words += Obscenity.offensive(text.downcase)
    words += find_custom_bad_words(text.downcase)
    
    words.uniq
  end

  # Фільтрація коментаря з можливістю кастомних налаштувань
  def filter_comment(comment_text, options = {})
    options = {
      replacement: '***',
      strategy: :default,
      preserve_capitalization: true
    }.merge(options)

    original_text = comment_text.dup
    filtered_text = filter(comment_text, replacement: options[:replacement], strategy: options[:strategy])
    
    if options[:preserve_capitalization]
      restore_capitalization(original_text, filtered_text)
    else
      filtered_text
    end
  end

  private

  def configure_obscenity
    Obscenity.configure do |config|
      config.blacklist = Obscenity::Base.blacklist + CUSTOM_BAD_WORDS
      config.replacement = :garbled  # or :stars, :vowels, :default
    end
  end

  def default_filter(text, replacement)
    Obscenity.sanitize(text.downcase)
  end

  def vowels_only_filter(text, replacement)
    Obscenity.sanitize(text.downcase, replacement: :vowels)
  end

  def leetspeak_filter(text, replacement)
    # Конвертуємо leetspeak у звичайний текст перед фільтрацією
    normalized_text = normalize_leetspeak(text)
    filtered_text = Obscenity.sanitize(normalized_text.downcase)
    
    # Повертаємо оригінальний текст з відфільтрованими словами
    restore_leetspeak_pattern(text, filtered_text)
  end

  def normalize_leetspeak(text)
    text.gsub(/[4@]/i, 'a')
        .gsub(/[3]/i, 'e')
        .gsub(/[1!]/i, 'i')
        .gsub(/[0]/i, 'o')
        .gsub(/[5$]/i, 's')
        .gsub(/[7]/i, 't')
  end

  def restore_leetspeak_pattern(original, filtered)
    # Спрощена реалізація відновлення leetspeak патерну
    # У реальному застосуванні може бути складніше
    filtered
  end

  def contains_custom_bad_words?(text)
    CUSTOM_BAD_WORDS.any? { |word| text.include?(word.downcase) }
  end

  def find_custom_bad_words(text)
    CUSTOM_BAD_WORDS.select { |word| text.include?(word.downcase) }
  end

  def restore_capitalization(original, filtered)
    # Проста спроба зберегти регістр першої літери
    if original.match?(/\A[A-Z]/) && filtered.match?(/\A[a-z]/)
      filtered.capitalize
    else
      filtered
    end
  end
end

## Додатковий клас для обробки коментарів

```ruby
# comment_processor.rb
class CommentProcessor
  def initialize
    @filter = ProfanityFilter.new
  end

  # Обробка коментаря з різними рівнями фільтрації
  def process_comment(comment_text, strictness: :medium)
    case strictness
    when :low
      filter_with_replacement(comment_text, '***')
    when :medium
      filter_with_replacement(comment_text, '[ред.]')
    when :high
      filter_with_replacement(comment_text, '[цензура]')
    when :reject
      reject_profane_comments(comment_text)
    else
      filter_with_replacement(comment_text, '***')
    end
  end

  # Перевірка та відхилення коментарів з надто великою кількістю нецензурної лексики
  def moderate_comment(comment_text, threshold: 0.3)
    offensive_count = @filter.offensive_words(comment_text).size
    total_words = comment_text.split.size
    
    profanity_ratio = total_words > 0 ? offensive_count.to_f / total_words : 0
    
    if profanity_ratio > threshold
      { status: :rejected, reason: "Занадто багато нецензурної лексики" }
    elsif @filter.profane?(comment_text)
      { status: :filtered, content: @filter.filter_comment(comment_text) }
    else
      { status: :approved, content: comment_text }
    end
  end

  private

  def filter_with_replacement(text, replacement)
    @filter.filter_comment(text, replacement: replacement)
  end

  def reject_profane_comments(text)
    @filter.profane?(text) ? nil : text
  end
end

```ruby
require 'active_support/all'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Базова база нецензурних слів (можна розширити)
  PROFANITY_WORDS = %w[
    fuck shit asshole bitch bastard dick damn crap piss slut whore
    cunt cock pussy faggot nigger retard moron idiot stupid dumb
  ].freeze

  def initialize(custom_words = [])
    @profanity_words = Set.new(PROFANITY_WORDS + custom_words)
    @profanity_words.merge(@profanity_words.map { |word| word.pluralize })
  end

  # Основний метод фільтрації
  def filter(text, replacement = '***')
    return text if text.nil? || text.empty?

    # Створюємо regex зі словами для фільтрації
    regex_pattern = build_regex_pattern
    
    # Замінюємо нецензурні слова
    text.gsub(regex_pattern) do |match|
      # Перевіряємо, чи це дійсно окреме слово (не частина іншого слова)
      if word_boundary_match?(match, text, Regexp.last_match)
        replacement
      else
        match
      end
    end
  end

  # Перевірка тексту на наявність нецензурної лексики
  def contains_profanity?(text)
    return false if text.nil? || text.empty?

    regex_pattern = build_regex_pattern
    !!text.match(regex_pattern)
  end

  # Отримати список знайдених нецензурних слів у тексті
  def detected_profanities(text)
    return [] if text.nil? || text.empty?

    regex_pattern = build_regex_pattern
    text.scan(regex_pattern).flatten.compact.uniq
  end

  # Додати кастомні слова до фільтра
  def add_words(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    @profanity_words.merge(words.map(&:downcase))
  end

  # Видалити слова з фільтра
  def remove_words(words)
    words = [words] unless words.is_a?(Array)
    words.each { |word| @profanity_words.delete(word.downcase) }
  end

  private

  def build_regex_pattern
    # Створюємо regex, який враховує різні варіанти написання
    escaped_words = @profanity_words.map { |word| Regexp.escape(word) }
    pattern = escaped_words.join('|')
    /(?i)\b(#{pattern})\b/
  end

  def word_boundary_match?(matched_word, full_text, match_data)
    # Додаткова перевірка меж слова для уникнення false positives
    start_pos = match_data.begin(0)
    end_pos = match_data.end(0)
    
    # Перевіряємо, чи перед та після слова межі слова
    before_char = start_pos > 0 ? full_text[start_pos - 1] : ' '
    after_char = end_pos < full_text.length ? full_text[end_pos] : ' '
    
    !before_char.match?(/\w/) && !after_char.match?(/\w/)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
class CommentProcessor
  def initialize(filter = nil)
    @filter = filter || ProfanityFilter.new
  end

  def process_comment(comment_text)
    return nil if comment_text.nil? || comment_text.strip.empty?

    {
      original: comment_text,
      filtered: @filter.filter(comment_text),
      contains_profanity: @filter.contains_profanity?(comment_text),
      detected_words: @filter.detected_profanities(comment_text)
    }
  end

  # Обробка масиву коментарів
  def process_comments(comments)
    comments.map { |comment| process_comment(comment) }
  end
end

require 'active_support/time'

class NaturalDateParser
  def self.parse(date_string, options = {})
    # Set default context if not provided
    context = options[:context] || :future
    
    # Handle common natural language patterns
    processed_string = preprocess_date_string(date_string)
    
    # Parse with Chronic
    parsed_time = Chronic.parse(processed_string, 
                               context: context,
                               guess: options.fetch(:guess, true),
                               ambiguous_time_range: options.fetch(:ambiguous_time_range, 6))
    
    # Handle timezone if specified
    if options[:timezone]
      parsed_time = parsed_time.in_time_zone(options[:timezone]) if parsed_time
    end
    
    parsed_time
  end
  
  def self.parse!(date_string, options = {})
    result = parse(date_string, options)
    raise "Unable to parse date: #{date_string}" if result.nil?
    result
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.preprocess_date_string(date_string)
    # Convert to lowercase for consistent parsing
    string = date_string.downcase.strip
    
    # Handle common patterns that Chronic might not handle perfectly
    string = handle_special_patterns(string)
    
    # Add "at" if time is specified but no preposition is present
    string = add_missing_prepositions(string)
    
    string
  end
  
  def self.handle_special_patterns(string)
    # Handle "next/last [day of week]" patterns
    string = string.gsub(/\b(next|last)\s+(\w+day)\b/i) do
      "#{$1} #{$2}"
    end
    
    # Handle "this [day of week]" 
    string = string.gsub(/\bthis\s+(\w+day)\b/i) do
      "this #{$1}"
    end
    
    # Handle "tomorrow/yesterday at [time]"
    string = string.gsub(/\b(tomorrow|yesterday)\s+(\d+)(?::(\d+))?\s*(am|pm)?\b/i) do
      "#{$1} at #{$2}#{':' + $3 if $3} #{$4 if $4}".strip
    end
    
    string
  end
  
  def self.add_missing_prepositions(string)
    # If we have a time but no "at", add it
    if string =~ /\b(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:am|pm)?)\b/i && 
       !string.include?('at') && 
       !string.include?('on') &&
       !string.include?('in')
      
      # Find where to insert "at"
      if string =~ /\b(?:next|last|this|tomorrow|yesterday|\w+day)\s+(\d+)/
        string = string.gsub(/\b(?:next|last|this|tomorrow|yesterday|\w+day)\s+(\d+)/, '\0 at')
      else
        string = "at #{string}"
      end
    end
    
    string
  end
end

require 'phonelib'

class UkrainianPhoneNumber
  # Known Ukrainian mobile operators and their codes
  OPERATORS = {
    'Kyivstar' => ['67', '68', '96', '97', '98'],
    'Vodafone' => ['50', '66', '95', '99'],
    'Lifecell' => ['63', '73', '93'],
    '3mob' => ['91'],
    'People.net' => ['92'],
    'intertelecom' => ['89', '94']
  }.freeze

  def self.normalize(phone_number)
    # Parse the phone number using phonelib
    parsed = Phonelib.parse(phone_number)
    
    # Check if it's a valid Ukrainian number
    return { error: 'Invalid Ukrainian phone number' } unless parsed.valid_for_country?('UA')
    
    # Get the number in international format (+380...)
    normalized_number = parsed.international
    
    # Extract the operator code (last 9 digits without country code)
    operator_code = parsed.national[-9..-1][0..1]
    
    # Find the operator
    operator = find_operator(operator_code)
    
    {
      normalized: normalized_number,
      operator: operator,
      operator_code: operator_code
    }
  end

  def self.find_operator(code)
    OPERATORS.each do |operator, codes|
      return operator if codes.include?(code)
    end
    'Unknown operator'
  end

  # Helper method to validate if a number is a Ukrainian mobile number
  def self.valid?(phone_number)
    parsed = Phonelib.parse(phone_number)
    parsed.valid_for_country?('UA') && parsed.type == :mobile
  end
end

require 'chronic'
require 'active_support/time'
require 'date'

class NaturalLanguageDateParser
  # Додаткові псевдоніми для покращення розпізнавання
  CUSTOM_PATTERNS = {
    /^today$/i => :today,
    /^tomorrow$/i => :tomorrow,
    /^yesterday$/i => :yesterday,
    /^now$/i => :now
  }

  def initialize
    # Налаштування Chronic для кращого розпізнавання
    Chronic.time_class = Time
    Chronic.debug = false
  end

  def parse(date_string)
    return nil if date_string.nil? || date_string.strip.empty?
    
    # Очищення та нормалізація рядка
    normalized_string = normalize_string(date_string)
    
    # Спроба розпізнати кастомні патерни
    custom_result = try_custom_patterns(normalized_string)
    return custom_result if custom_result
    
    # Використання Chronic для складних виразів
    parse_with_chronic(normalized_string)
  end

  def parse!(date_string)
    result = parse(date_string)
    raise "Неможливо розпізнати дату: #{date_string}" if result.nil?
    result
  end

  private

  def normalize_string(str)
    str = str.strip
    str = str.gsub(/\s+/, ' ') # Заміна множинних пробілів на один
    str = str.gsub(/(\d)\s*([ap]m)/i, '\1\2') # Видалення пробілів між числом та am/pm
    str.downcase
  end

  def try_custom_patterns(str)
    CUSTOM_PATTERNS.each do |pattern, method|
      if pattern.match(str)
        return send(method)
      end
    end
    nil
  end

  def today
    Time.now.beginning_of_day
  end

  def tomorrow
    Time.now.tomorrow.beginning_of_day
  end

  def yesterday
    Time.now.yesterday.beginning_of_day
  end

  def now
    Time.now
  end

  def parse_with_chronic(str)
    # Додавання контексту для кращого розпізнавання
    Chronic.parse(str, context: :future, guess: true, ambiguous_time_range: 6)
  end
end

# support_ticket_summarizer.rb
require 'anthropic'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class SupportTicketSummarizer
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']
    raise "Anthropic API key not found. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable." unless @api_key
    
    @client = Anthropic::Client.new(access_token: @api_key)
  end

  def summarize_ticket(ticket_content, max_length: 500, include_key_points: true)
    # Prepare the prompt for Claude
    prompt = build_prompt(ticket_content, max_length, include_key_points)
    
    begin
      response = @client.messages(
        parameters: {
          model: "claude-3-sonnet-20240229", # or "claude-3-haiku-20240307" for faster, cheaper summaries
          max_tokens: 1000,
          messages: [
            { role: "user", content: prompt }
          ]
        }
      )
      
      extract_summary_from_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise "Error calling Anthropic API: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def summarize_multiple_tickets(tickets, max_length: 300, include_key_points: true)
    summaries = {}
    
    tickets.each_with_index do |ticket, index|
      puts "Summarizing ticket #{index + 1}/#{tickets.length}..."
      
      if ticket[:content] && !ticket[:content].empty?
        summary = summarize_ticket(ticket[:content], max_length: max_length, include_key_points: include_key_points)
        summaries[ticket[:id] || "ticket_#{index + 1}"] = {
          original_length: ticket[:content].length,
          summary: summary,
          title: ticket[:title] || "Ticket #{index + 1}"
        }
      else
        summaries[ticket[:id] || "ticket_#{index + 1}"] = {
          error: "Empty ticket content",
          title: ticket[:title] || "Ticket #{index + 1}"
        }
      end
      
      # Small delay to avoid rate limiting
      sleep(1) if index < tickets.length - 1
    end
    
    summaries
  end

  private

  def build_prompt(ticket_content, max_length, include_key_points)
    <<~PROMPT
      Please provide a concise summary of the following support ticket. 
      #{include_key_points ? "Include 3-5 key points or issues mentioned." : "Focus on the main issue and resolution."}
      
      Target summary length: #{max_length} characters maximum.
      
      Format your response as:
      Summary: [concise summary here]
      #{include_key_points ? "Key Points:\n- [point 1]\n- [point 2]\n- etc." : ""}
      
      Support Ticket Content:
      #{ticket_content}
    PROMPT
  end

  def extract_summary_from_response(response)
    # Extract the content from the API response
    if response['content'] && response['content'].is_a?(Array)
      content_block = response['content'].find { |block| block['type'] == 'text' }
      return content_block['text'] if content_block
    end
    
    # Fallback: return the entire response text if structure is different
    response.to_s
  end
end

  def self.analyze_summaries(summaries)

'html' : 'txt'}" begin converter = DocxConverter.new(input_file) case format when 'html' content = converter.to_html when 'text' content = converter.to_text else puts "Invalid format. require 'phonelib'

class UkrainianPhoneNumber
  OPERATORS = {
    '039' => 'Kyivstar',
    '050' => 'Vodafone',
    '063' => 'Lifecell',
    '066' => 'Vodafone',
    '067' => 'Kyivstar',
    '068' => 'Kyivstar',
    '073' => 'Lifecell',
    '091' => 'TriMob',
    '092' => 'PEOPLEnet',
    '093' => 'Lifecell',
    '094' => 'Intertelecom',
    '095' => 'Vodafone',
    '096' => 'Kyivstar',
    '097' => 'Kyivstar',
    '098' => 'Kyivstar',
    '099' => 'Vodafone'
  }.freeze

  def self.normalize_and_detect(phone_number)
    # Parse the phone number
    parsed = Phonelib.parse(phone_number, 'UA')
    
    # Check if it's a valid Ukrainian number
    unless parsed.valid_for_country?('UA')
      return { 
        original: phone_number,
        normalized: nil,
        valid: false,
        operator: nil,
        error: 'Invalid Ukrainian phone number'
      }
    end
    
    # Get the normalized number in E164 format
    normalized = parsed.e164
    
    # Extract the operator code (first 3 digits after +380)
    operator_code = normalized[4..6]
    
    # Find the operator
    operator = OPERATORS[operator_code]
    
    {
      original: phone_number,
      normalized: normalized,
      valid: true,
      operator: operator,
      operator_code: operator_code,
      error: nil
    }
  rescue => e
    {
      original: phone_number,
      normalized: nil,
      valid: false,
      operator: nil,
      error: "Error processing number: #{e.message}"
    }
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  test_numbers = [
    '0501234567',
    '+380501234567',
    '380501234567',
    '050 123 45 67',
    '(050) 123-45-67',
    '050-123-45-67',
    '050123456789', # invalid
    '1234567890'    # invalid
  ]
  
  puts "Ukrainian Phone Number Normalization and Operator Detection"
  puts "=" * 60
  
  test_numbers.each do |number|
    result = UkrainianPhoneNumber.normalize_and_detect(number)
    
    puts "\nOriginal: #{result[:original]}"
    puts "Normalized: #{result[:normalized] || 'N/A'}"
    puts "Valid: #{result[:valid]}"
    puts "Operator: #{result[:operator] || 'N/A'}"
    puts "Error: #{result[:error]}" if result[:error]
    puts "-" * 40
  end
end
```

# Конфігурація українських правил множини для I18n
module I18n
  module Backend
    module Pluralization
      # Українські правила множини
      # Правила:
      # one: 1, 21, 31, 41... (числа, що закінчуються на 1, крім 11)
      # few: 2-4, 22-24, 32-34... (числа, що закінчуються на 2-4, крім 12-14)
      # many: 0, 5-19, 25-30, 35-40... (всі інші випадки)
      # other: для дробових чисел
      rule(:uk) do |count|
        if count == 0
          :zero
        elsif count % 10 == 1 && count % 100 != 11
          :one
        elsif count % 10 >= 2 && count % 10 <= 4 && (count % 100 < 10 || count % 100 >= 20)
          :few
        elsif count % 10 == 0 || (count % 10 >= 5 && count % 10 <= 9) || (count % 100 >= 11 && count % 100 <= 19)
          :many
        else
          :other
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

    }
  }
}

# Альтернативний спосіб - через конфігурацію i18n
module UkrainianPluralization
  def self.rule
    @rule ||= lambda do |count|
      if count % 10 == 1 && count % 100 != 11
        :one
      elsif [2, 3, 4].include?(count % 10) && ![12, 13, 14].include?(count % 100)
        :few
      elsif count % 10 == 0 || [5, 6, 7, 8, 9].include?(count % 10) || [11, 12, 13, 14].include?(count % 100)
        :many
      else
        :other
      end
    end
  end
end

I18n.backend.store_translations :uk, i18n: {
  plural: {
    rule: UkrainianPluralization.rule
  }
}

    when :many then many

# natural_date_parser.rb
require 'chronic'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'

class NaturalDateParser
  class << self
    # Основний метод для парсингу дат
    def parse(date_string, options = {})
      return nil if date_string.nil? || date_string.empty?
      
      # Нормалізація тексту
      normalized_string = normalize_date_string(date_string)
      
      # Парсинг за допомогою Chronic
      parsed_time = Chronic.parse(normalized_string, chronic_options(options))
      
      # Обробка результатів
      handle_parsing_result(parsed_time, normalized_string, options)
    end
    
    # Перевірка, чи може рядок бути розпізнаний як дата
    def parsable?(date_string)
      return false if date_string.nil? || date_string.empty?
      
      normalized_string = normalize_date_string(date_string)
      !Chronic.parse(normalized_string).nil?
    end
    
    private
    
    # Нормалізація рядка дати
    def normalize_date_string(date_string)
      string = date_string.to_s.downcase.strip
      
      # Заміна поширених варіантів написання
      replacements = {
        'noon' => '12:00',
        'midnight' => '00:00',
        'tomorrow' => 'next day',
        'yesterday' => 'last day',
        'today' => 'this day'
      }
      
      replacements.each do |key, value|
        string.gsub!(/\b#{key}\b/, value)
      end
      
      # Додавання "at" для часу, якщо потрібно
      if string.match?(/\d+[ap]m\b/i) && !string.match?(/\b(at|@)\b/)
        string.sub!(/(\d+[ap]m\b)/i, 'at \1')
      end
      
      string
    end
    
    # Налаштування для Chronic
    def chronic_options(options)
      {
        context: options[:context] || :future,
        guess: options.fetch(:guess, true),
        ambiguous_time_range: options.fetch(:ambiguous_time_range, 6),
        endian_precedence: options.fetch(:endian_precedence, [:little, :middle])
      }.compact
    end
    
    # Обробка результату парсингу
    def handle_parsing_result(parsed_time, original_string, options)
      return nil unless parsed_time
      
      # Застосування часового поясу, якщо вказано
      if options[:time_zone]
        time_zone = ActiveSupport::TimeZone[options[:time_zone]]
        parsed_time = parsed_time.in_time_zone(time_zone) if time_zone
      end
      
      parsed_time
    end
  end
end

# Додаткові утиліти для роботи з датами
module NaturalDateUtils
  # Отримання дати у зручному форматі
  def self.format_natural_date(date, format = :long)
    return nil unless date
    
    case format
    when :short
      date.strftime("%b %d, %Y at %I:%M%p")
    when :long
      date.strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p")
    when :iso
      date.iso8601
    else
      date.to_s
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка, чи є дата сьогодні
  def self.today?(date)
    date.to_date == Date.today
  end
  
  # Перевірка, чи є дата завтра
  def self.tomorrow?(date)
    date.to_date == Date.tomorrow
  end
end
