```ruby
# entity_extractor.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'stanford-core-nlp'
require 'unicode_utils'
require 'terminal-table'
require 'colorize'

class UkrainianEntityExtractor
  # Типи сутностей, які ми шукаємо
  ENTITY_TYPES = {
    'PERSON' => 'Особи',
    'ORGANIZATION' => 'Організації',
    'LOCATION' => 'Місця',
    'GPE' => 'Геополітичні об\'єкти' # Країни, міста тощо
  }.freeze

  def initialize
    setup_stanford_nlp
  end

  def setup_stanford_nlp
    # Шлях до Stanford NLP (потрібно завантажити та вказати правильний шлях)
    StanfordCoreNLP.use :ukrainian
    StanfordCoreNLP.model_files = {}
    StanfordCoreNLP.default_jars = [
      'stanford-corenlp-4.5.0.jar',
      'stanford-corenlp-4.5.0-models-ukrainian.jar'
    ]
  end

  def extract_from_text(text)
    return {} if text.nil? || text.strip.empty?

    # Попередня обробка тексту
    processed_text = preprocess_text(text)
    
    # Аналіз за допомогою Stanford NLP
    pipeline = StanfordCoreNLP.load(:tokenize, :ssplit, :pos, :lemma, :ner)
    text = StanfordCoreNLP::Annotation.new(processed_text)
    pipeline.annotate(text)

    entities = extract_entities(text)
    group_entities_by_type(entities)
  end

  def extract_from_url(url)
    puts "Отримання статті з: #{url}".yellow
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: {
        'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'
      })
      
      if response.success?
        extract_from_html(response.body)
      else
        puts "Помилка при отриманні сторінки: #{response.code}".red
        {}
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Помилка: #{e.message}".red
      {}
    end
  end

  def extract_from_html(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    
    # Видаляємо небажані елементи
    doc.css('script, style, nav, header, footer').remove
    
    # Отримуємо основний текст статті
    article_text = extract_article_text(doc)
    
    extract_from_text(article_text)
  end

  private

  def preprocess_text(text)
    # Базова очистка тексту
    text.gsub!(/\s+/, ' ')
    text.gsub!(/["«»„“”]/u, '"')
    text.strip
  end

  def extract_article_text(doc)
    # Спробуємо знайти основний вміст статті
    # Різні стратегії для різних сайтів
    selectors = [
      'article',
      '.article-content',
      '.post-content',
      '.news-content',
      '.story-content',
      'main',
      '[role="main"]'
    ]
    
    article_content = nil
    selectors.each do |selector|
      article_content = doc.css(selector).first
      break if article_content
    end
    
    # Якщо не знайшли спеціальний селектор, беремо весь body
    article_content ||= doc.css('body').first
    
    # Отримуємо текст, видаляємо зайві пробіли
    text = article_content.text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
    text[0..5000] # Обмежуємо довжину для продуктивності
  end

  def extract_entities(annotation)
    entities = []
    sentences = annotation.get(:sentences)
    
    sentences.each do |sentence|
      tokens = sentence.get(:tokens)
      entity_tokens = []
      current_entity_type = nil
      
      tokens.each do |token|
        word = token.get(:original_text).to_s
        ner_tag = token.get(:named_entity_tag).to_s
        
        if ner_tag != 'O' # 'O' означає "не сутність"
          if current_entity_type == ner_tag
            entity_tokens << word
          else
            # Зберігаємо попередню сутність
            if current_entity_type && !entity_tokens.empty?
              entities << {
                text: entity_tokens.join(' '),
                type: current_entity_type
              }
            end
            # Починаємо нову сутність
            entity_tokens = [word]
            current_entity_type = ner_tag
          end
        else
          # Зберігаємо попередню сутність
          if current_entity_type && !entity_tokens.empty?
            entities << {
              text: entity_tokens.join(' '),
              type: current_entity_type
            }
          end
          entity_tokens = []
          current_entity_type = nil
        end
      end
      
      # Зберігаємо останню сутність у реченні
      if current_entity_type && !entity_tokens.empty?
        entities << {
          text: entity_tokens.join(' '),
          type: current_entity_type
        }
      end
    end
    
    entities
  end

  def group_entities_by_type(entities)
    grouped = {}
    
    ENTITY_TYPES.each_key do |type|
      grouped[type] = entities
        .select { |e| e[:type] == type }
        .map { |e| e[:text] }
        .uniq
        .sort
    end
    
    grouped
  end
end

# Допоміжний клас для візуалізації результатів
class EntityDisplayer
  def self.display(entities)
    return puts("Сутностей не знайдено".red) if entities.values.all?(&:empty?)
    
    ENTITY_TYPES = UkrainianEntityExtractor::ENTITY_TYPES
    
    ENTITY_TYPES.each do |type, label|
      entity_list = entities[type]
      next if entity_list.empty?
      
      puts "\n#{label}:".green
      entity_list.each_with_index do |entity, index|
        puts "  #{index + 1}. #{entity}"
      end
    end
  end
  
  def self.display_table(entities)
    rows = []
    
    entities.each do |type, entity_list|
      entity_list.each do |entity|
        rows << [ENTITY_TYPES[type] || type, entity]
      end
    end
    
    return puts("Сутностей не знайдено".red) if rows.empty?
    
    table = Terminal::Table.new(
      title: "Знайдені сутності",
      headings: ['Тип', 'Назва'],
      rows: rows
    )
    
    puts table
  end
end
```

```ruby
# api_entity_extractor.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'nokogiri'

class APIEntityExtractor
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  # Використання OpenTapioca або іншого API для NER
  def extract_with_api(text)
    # Приклад використання OpenTapioca API
    response = HTTParty.post(
      'https://opentapioca.org/api/annotate',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        query: text,
        lang: 'uk'
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      parse_api_response(response.body)
    else
      puts "Помилка API: #{response.code}"
      {}
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_api_response(response_body)
    data = JSON.parse(response_body)
    entities = {}
    
    data['annotations']&.each do |annotation|
      entity_text = annotation['mention']
      entity_type = determine_type(annotation['tags'] || [])
      
      if entity_type
        entities[entity_type] ||= []
        entities[entity_type] << entity_text
      end
    end
    
    entities.transform_values { |v| v.uniq.sort }
  end

  def determine_type(tags)
    if tags.include?('PERSON') || tags.include?('Q5') # Q5 - human in Wikidata
      'PERSON'
    elsif tags.include?('ORGANIZATION') || tags.include?('Q43229') # organization
      'ORGANIZATION'
    elsif tags.include?('LOCATION') || tags.include?('Q17334923') # location
      'LOCATION'
    elsif tags.include?('GPE') || tags.include?('Q6256') # country
      'GPE'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# whatsapp_sender.rb
require 'httparty'

class WhatsAppSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0'

  def initialize(phone_number_id, access_token)
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  # Надсилання шаблонного повідомлення
  def send_template_message(to, template_name, language_code = 'en', components = [])
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages"
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    body = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: to,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        }
      }
    }

    # Додаємо компоненти, якщо вони є
    body[:template][:components] = components unless components.empty?

    response = HTTParty.post(url, {
      headers: headers,
      body: body.to_json
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Допоміжний метод для створення компонентів з параметрами
  def create_component(type, parameters)
    {
      type: type,
      parameters: parameters
    }
  end

  # Допоміжний метод для створення текстового параметра
  def create_text_parameter(text)
    {
      type: 'text',
      text: text
    }
  end

  # Допоміжний метод для створення параметра валюти
  def create_currency_parameter(amount, currency_code = 'USD')
    {
      type: 'currency',
      currency: {
        fallback_value: amount.to_s,
        code: currency_code,
        amount_1000: (amount * 1000).to_i
      }
    }
  end

  # Допоміжний метод для створення параметра дати
  def create_date_time_parameter(date_time)
    {
      type: 'date_time',
      date_time: {
        fallback_value: date_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
      }
    }
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      puts "Повідомлення успішно надіслано!"
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# firebase_notification_service.rb
require 'fcm'

class FirebaseNotificationService
  attr_reader :fcm_client

  def initialize(server_key, project_id = nil)
    @server_key = server_key
    @project_id = project_id
    @fcm_client = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data, options)
    
    response = @fcm_client.send([device_token], message)
    handle_response(response, device_token)
  end

  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data, options)
    
    response = @fcm_client.send(device_tokens, message)
    handle_response(response, device_tokens)
  end

  # Send to topic
  def send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data, options.merge(topic: topic))
    
    response = @fcm_client.send_to_topic(topic, message)
    handle_response(response, "topic: #{topic}")
  end

  # Send to condition
  def send_to_condition(condition, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data, options.merge(condition: condition))
    
    response = @fcm_client.send_with_notification_key(condition, message)
    handle_response(response, "condition: #{condition}")
  end

  # Subscribe device to topic
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_tokens, topic)
    response = @fcm_client.topic_subscription(topic, device_tokens)
    handle_subscription_response(response, "subscribe")
  end

  # Unsubscribe device from topic
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_tokens, topic)
    response = @fcm_client.topic_unsubscription(topic, device_tokens)
    handle_subscription_response(response, "unsubscribe")
  end

  private

  def build_message(title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    message = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }

    # Platform-specific configurations
    if options[:android]
      message[:android] = build_android_config(options[:android])
    end

    if options[:apns]
      message[:apns] = build_apns_config(options[:apns])
    end

    # Common options
    message[:priority] = options[:priority] || 'high'
    message[:content_available] = options[:content_available] || true
    
    # Topic or condition
    message[:topic] = options[:topic] if options[:topic]
    message[:condition] = options[:condition] if options[:condition]

    message
  end

  def build_android_config(android_options)
    {
      priority: android_options[:priority] || 'high',
      ttl: android_options[:ttl] || '86400s', # 24 hours
      notification: {
        sound: android_options[:sound] || 'default',
        tag: android_options[:tag],
        color: android_options[:color] || '#FF0000',
        click_action: android_options[:click_action]
      }
    }.compact
  end

  def build_apns_config(apns_options)
    {
      headers: {
        'apns-priority' => apns_options[:priority] || '10'
      },
      payload: {
        aps: {
          alert: {
            title: apns_options[:title],
            body: apns_options[:body]
          },
          sound: apns_options[:sound] || 'default',
          badge: apns_options[:badge],
          category: apns_options[:category],
          'content-available' => apns_options[:content_available] || 1
        }.compact
      }
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response, target)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      if body['success'] > 0
        {
          success: true,
          message: "Notification sent successfully to #{target}",
          response: body
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Failed to send notification to #{target}",
          errors: body['results'],
          response: body
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        message: "HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}",
        response: response
      }
    end
  end

  def handle_subscription_response(response, action)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      if body['error'].empty?
        {
          success: true,
          message: "Successfully #{action}d to topic",
          response: body
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          message: "Failed to #{action} to topic",
          errors: body['error'],
          response: body
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        message: "HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}",
        response: response
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# fcm_notification_sender.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'json'

class FCMNotificationSender
  def initialize(server_key)
    @fcm = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }
    
    response = @fcm.send([device_token], options)
    handle_response(response, device_token)
  end

  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }
    
    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response, device_tokens)
  end

  # Send notification with custom options for different platforms
  def send_advanced_notification(device_tokens, notification_data)
    options = {
      priority: 'high',
      content_available: true,
      notification: {
        title: notification_data[:title],
        body: notification_data[:body],
        sound: notification_data[:sound] || 'default',
        badge: notification_data[:badge]
      }.compact,
      data: notification_data[:data] || {},
      android: {
        notification: {
          sound: notification_data[:android_sound] || 'default',
          channel_id: notification_data[:android_channel_id] || 'default',
          priority: 'high'
        }
      },
      apns: {
        payload: {
          aps: {
            alert: {
              title: notification_data[:title],
              body: notification_data[:body]
            },
            sound: notification_data[:ios_sound] || 'default',
            badge: notification_data[:badge],
            content_available: 1
          }
        }
      }
    }

    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response, device_tokens)
  end

  # Send data-only message (no notification display)
  def send_data_message(device_tokens, data)
    options = {
      data: data,
      priority: 'high',
      content_available: true
    }

    response = @fcm.send(device_tokens, options)
    handle_response(response, device_tokens)
  end

  # Send to topic
  def send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data = {})
    options = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }

    response = @fcm.send_to_topic(topic, options)
    handle_response(response, "topic: #{topic}")
  end

  # Subscribe device to topic
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_tokens, topic)
    response = @fcm.topic_subscription(device_tokens, topic)
    handle_subscription_response(response, "subscribe")
  end

  # Unsubscribe device from topic
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_tokens, topic)
    response = @fcm.topic_unsubscription(device_tokens, topic)
    handle_subscription_response(response, "unsubscribe")
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response, target)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      if body['success'] > 0
        puts "✅ Successfully sent to #{target}"
        puts "Success: #{body['success']}, Failure: #{body['failure']}"
        
        # Handle individual results if multiple devices
        if body['results']
          body['results'].each_with_index do |result, index|
            if result['error']
              puts "Error for device #{index}: #{result['error']}"
            elsif result['message_id']
              puts "Message ID for device #{index}: #{result['message_id']}"
            end
          end
        end
        
        return true
      else
        puts "❌ Failed to send to #{target}"
        puts "Error: #{body}"
        return false
      end
    else
      puts "❌ HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}"
      puts "Response: #{response[:body]}"
      return false
    end
  end

  def handle_subscription_response(response, action)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      if body['error']
        puts "❌ #{action.capitalize} error: #{body['error']}"
        return false
      else
        puts "✅ Successfully #{action}d to topic"
        return true
      end
    else
      puts "❌ HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}"
      return false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# fcm_notification_service.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'json'

class FCMNotificationService
  def initialize(server_key, project_id = nil)
    @server_key = server_key
    @project_id = project_id
    @fcm = FCM.new(server_key)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на один пристрій
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data)
    message[:to] = device_token
    
    send_notification(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на кілька пристроїв
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data)
    message[:registration_ids] = device_tokens
    
    send_notification(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на групу пристроїв (топик)
  def send_to_topic(topic_name, title, body, data = {})
    message = build_message(title, body, data)
    message[:condition] = "'#{topic_name}' in topics"
    
    send_notification(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення з кастомними налаштуваннями
  def send_custom_notification(message_payload)
    send_notification(message_payload)
  end

  # Підписка пристрою на топик
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_token, topic_name)
    response = @fcm.topic_subscription(device_token, topic_name)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Відписка пристрою від топика
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_token, topic_name)
    response = @fcm.topic_unsubscription(device_token, topic_name)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_message(title, body, data = {})
    {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default',
        badge: 1
      },
      data: data,
      android: {
        priority: 'high',
        notification: {
          sound: 'default',
          tag: 'notification'
        }
      },
      apns: {
        payload: {
          aps: {
            sound: 'default',
            badge: 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
  end

  def send_notification(message)
    begin
      response = @fcm.send_notification(message)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response[:status_code] == 200
      body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
      
      if body['success'] == 1 || (body['failure'] == 0 && body['success'] >= 0)
        { success: true, response: body, message_id: body['message_id'] }
      else
        { 
          success: false, 
          response: body, 
          error: "Failed to send: #{body['results']&.first&.dig('error')}" 
        }
      end
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response[:status_code]}" }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'vonage'
require 'sinatra'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class SMSHandler
  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET'],
      application_id: ENV['VONAGE_APPLICATION_ID'],
      private_key: File.read(ENV['VONAGE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH'])
    )
  end

  def send_sms(to_number, from_number, message)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.send(
        from: from_number,
        to: to_number,
        text: message,
        callback: ENV['WEBHOOK_URL'] # URL for delivery receipts
      )

      if response.messages.first.status == '0'
        puts "SMS sent successfully!"
        puts "Message ID: #{response.messages.first.message_id}"
        return { success: true, message_id: response.messages.first.message_id }
      else
        puts "Failed to send SMS: #{response.messages.first.error_text}"
        return { success: false, error: response.messages.first.error_text }
      end
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      puts "Vonage API Error: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Method to check status of a specific message
  def check_message_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.search(message_id)
      return {
        message_id: response.message_id,
        status: response.status,
        error_text: response.error_text,
        date_received: response.date_received
      }
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      puts "Error checking message status: #{e.message}"
      return { error: e.message }
    end
  end
end

# Webhook server to receive delivery receipts
class DeliveryReceiptServer < Sinatra::Base
  # Store delivery receipts (in production, use a database)
  @@delivery_receipts = {}

  post '/webhook' do
    # Parse the delivery receipt
    receipt = {
      message_id: params['messageId'],
      status: params['status'],
      error_code: params['err-code'],
      error_text: params['error-text'],
      timestamp: params['message-timestamp'],
      client_ref: params['client-ref'],
      received_at: Time.now
    }

    # Store the receipt
    @@delivery_receipts[receipt[:message_id]] = receipt

    puts "Delivery receipt received:"
    puts "Message ID: #{receipt[:message_id]}"
    puts "Status: #{receipt[:status]}"
    puts "Error: #{receipt[:error_text]}" if receipt[:error_text]
    puts "---"

    # Return 200 OK to Vonage
    status 200
    body 'OK'
  end

  # Endpoint to check delivery status
  get '/status/:message_id' do
    receipt = @@delivery_receipts[params[:message_id]]
    
    if receipt
      content_type :json
      receipt.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Message ID not found' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Get all delivery receipts
  get '/status' do
    content_type :json
    @@delivery_receipts.to_json
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Start the webhook server in a thread
  Thread.new do
    DeliveryReceiptServer.run!(port: 4567, bind: '0.0.0.0')
  end

  # Wait for server to start
  sleep 2

  # Example: Send an SMS
  handler = SMSHandler.new
  
  # Replace with actual phone numbers
  to_number = ENV['TO_NUMBER'] || '+1234567890'
  from_number = ENV['FROM_NUMBER'] || 'Vonage'
  message = 'Hello from Vonage SMS API!'

  puts "Sending SMS..."
  result = handler.send_sms(to_number, from_number, message)

  if result[:success]
    puts "SMS queued successfully!"
    puts "Message ID: #{result[:message_id]}"
    puts "\nDelivery receipts will be sent to: #{ENV['WEBHOOK_URL']}"
    puts "Webhook server running on http://localhost:4567"
    puts "Check status at: http://localhost:4567/status/#{result[:message_id]}"
  else
    puts "Failed to send SMS: #{result[:error]}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/services/firebase_messaging_service.rb
require 'fcm'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class FirebaseMessagingService
  def initialize
    @fcm = FCM.new(ENV['FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY'])
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на один пристрій
  def send_to_device(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      to: device_token,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на кілька пристроїв
  def send_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      registration_ids: device_tokens,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення на тему
  def send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      to: "/topics/#{topic}",
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default'
      },
      data: data
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення лише з даними (без спливаючого вікна)
  def send_data_message(device_token, data)
    message = {
      to: device_token,
      data: data,
      priority: 'high'
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення з кастомними налаштуваннями для iOS
  def send_ios_notification(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      to: device_token,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default',
        badge: '1'
      },
      data: data,
      apns: {
        headers: {
          'apns-priority' => '10'
        },
        payload: {
          aps: {
            'content-available' => 1
          }
        }
      }
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Надсилання сповіщення з кастомними налаштуваннями для Android
  def send_android_notification(device_token, title, body, data = {})
    message = {
      to: device_token,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body,
        sound: 'default',
        click_action: 'FCM_PLUGIN_ACTIVITY'
      },
      data: data,
      android: {
        priority: 'high'
      }
    }

    send_message(message)
  end

  # Підписка пристрою на тему
  def subscribe_to_topic(device_tokens, topic)
    if device_tokens.is_a?(Array)
      @fcm.topic_subscription(device_tokens, topic)
    else
      @fcm.topic_subscription([device_tokens], topic)
    end
  end

  # Відписка пристрою від теми
  def unsubscribe_from_topic(device_tokens, topic)
    if device_tokens.is_a?(Array)
      @fcm.topic_unsubscription(device_tokens, topic)
    else
      @fcm.topic_unsubscription([device_tokens], topic)
    end
  end

  private

  def send_message(message)
    begin
      response = @fcm.send(message)
      
      if response[:status_code] == 200
        handle_success_response(response)
      else
        handle_error_response(response)
      end
      
      response
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def handle_success_response(response)
    body = JSON.parse(response[:body])
    
    if body['failure'] > 0
      puts "⚠️  Деякі сповіщення не вдалося відправити:"
      body['results'].each_with_index do |result, index|
        if result['error']
          puts "  Пристрій #{index}: #{result['error']}"
        end
      end
    end
    
    if body['success'] > 0
      puts "✅ Успішно відправлено: #{body['success']} сповіщень"
    end
  end

  def handle_error_response(response)
    puts "❌ Помилка відправки: #{response[:body]}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'vonage'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class SMSSender
  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET']
    )
    @delivery_statuses = {} # In production, use a proper database
  end

  def send_sms(to, message)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.send(
        from: ENV['VONAGE_BRAND_NAME'],
        to: to,
        text: message,
        status_report_req: 1, # Request delivery receipt
        callback: "#{ENV['WEBHOOK_URL']}/delivery-receipt" # Webhook URL for delivery status
      )
      
      if response.messages.first.status == '0'
        message_id = response.messages.first.message_id
        @delivery_statuses[message_id] = {
          to: to,
          message: message,
          status: 'sent',
          timestamp: Time.now,
          final_status: nil
        }
        puts "SMS sent successfully! Message ID: #{message_id}"
        return { success: true, message_id: message_id }
      else
        error_message = response.messages.first.error_text
        puts "Failed to send SMS: #{error_message}"
        return { success: false, error: error_message }
      end
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      puts "Vonage API error: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def update_delivery_status(message_id, status, timestamp)
    if @delivery_statuses[message_id]
      @delivery_statuses[message_id][:final_status] = status
      @delivery_statuses[message_id][:delivered_at] = Time.parse(timestamp) if timestamp
      
      puts "Delivery status updated for message #{message_id}: #{status}"
      return true
    else
      puts "Unknown message ID: #{message_id}"
      return false
    end
  end

  def get_delivery_status(message_id)
    @delivery_statuses[message_id]
  end

  def list_all_messages
    @delivery_statuses
  end
end
```

```ruby
  end

      message_id = data['messageId']
      status = data['status']
      timestamp = data['timestamp']
      
      puts "Received delivery receipt:"

      # Update the delivery status

    rescue => e
      puts "Error processing delivery receipt: #{e.message}"
      status 400
      { error: 'Bad request' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Endpoint to check message status
  get '/message/:message_id' do
    content_type :json
    
    message_id = params[:message_id]
    status = settings.sms_sender.get_delivery_status(message_id)
    
    if status

    else

      { error: 'Message not found' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Endpoint to list all messages
  get '/messages' do
    content_type :json
    settings.sms_sender.list_all_messages.to_json
  end
```

```ruby
# kyivstar_sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class KyivstarSMSSender
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.kyivstar.ua/business/messaging/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil, sender_id = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['KYIVSTAR_API_KEY']
    @sender_id = sender_id || ENV['KYIVSTAR_SENDER_ID']
    
    validate_credentials
  end
  
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    validate_message(message)
    
    payload = build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/sms/send",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/balance",
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/sms/status/#{message_id}",
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    raise "API key is required" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
    raise "Sender ID is required" if @sender_id.nil? || @sender_id.empty?
  end
  
  def validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    raise "Phone number is required" if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.empty?
    
    # Basic Ukrainian phone number validation (starts with +380)
    unless phone_number.match?(/^\+380\d{9}$/)
      raise "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format. Expected format: +380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message(message)
    raise "Message is required" if message.nil? || message.empty?
    raise "Message is too long (max 160 characters)" if message.length > 160
  end
  
  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    {
      sender: @sender_id,
      recipient: phone_number,
      message: message,
      message_id: options[:message_id] || generate_message_id,
      callback_url: options[:callback_url],
      validity_period: options[:validity_period] || 86400, # 24 hours default
      priority: options[:priority] || 'normal'
    }.compact
  end
  
  def generate_message_id
    "#{Time.now.to_i}#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 403
      raise "Forbidden: Insufficient permissions"
    when 404
      raise "Not Found: Invalid endpoint or resource"
    when 429
      raise "Rate Limit Exceeded: Too many requests"
    when 500..599
      raise "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# kievstar_sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class KievstarSMS
  # Kyivstar Business Messaging API configuration
  BASE_URL = 'https://business.kievstar.ua/api'.freeze
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil, sender_name = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['KIEVSTAR_API_KEY']
    @sender_name = sender_name || ENV['KIEVSTAR_SENDER_NAME']
    
    raise "API key is required" unless @api_key
    raise "Sender name is required" unless @sender_name
  end
  
  # Send a single SMS
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    validate_message(message)
    
    payload = build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/sms/send",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Send multiple SMS messages in one request
  def send_bulk_sms(messages_list)
    raise "Messages list must be an array" unless messages_list.is_a?(Array)
    raise "Messages list cannot be empty" if messages_list.empty?
    
    payload = {
      messages: messages_list.map do |msg|
        validate_phone_number(msg[:phone_number])
        validate_message(msg[:message])
        
        build_payload(msg[:phone_number], msg[:message], msg[:options] || {})
      end
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/sms/send_bulk",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 60
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check SMS status
  def check_status(message_id)
    raise "Message ID is required" unless message_id
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/sms/status/#{message_id}",
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 15
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/account/balance",
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 15
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'User-Agent' => 'KievstarSMS-Ruby/1.0'
    }
  end
  
  def build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    {
      phone_number: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      message: message,
      sender: @sender_name,
      callback_url: options[:callback_url],
      validity_period: options[:validity_period] || 48, # hours
      priority: options[:priority] || 'normal' # normal, high
    }.compact
  end
  
  def format_phone_number(phone)
    # Remove all non-digit characters and ensure proper format
    cleaned_phone = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # If phone starts with 0, assume it's Ukrainian format (0XXYYYYYYY)
    if cleaned_phone.start_with?('0')
      "38#{cleaned_phone}"
    elsif cleaned_phone.start_with?('380')
      cleaned_phone
    else
      # Assume it's already in international format
      cleaned_phone
    end
  end
  
  def validate_phone_number(phone)
    raise "Phone number is required" unless phone && !phone.strip.empty?
    
    cleaned_phone = format_phone_number(phone)
    
    # Basic validation for Ukrainian phone numbers
    unless cleaned_phone.match?(/^380\d{9}$/)
      raise "Invalid phone number format. Expected Ukrainian format: 380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message(message)
    raise "Message is required" unless message && !message.strip.empty?
    raise "Message is too long (max 1600 characters)" if message.length > 1600
    raise "Message is too short" if message.length < 1
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise "Bad request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise "Unauthorized: Invalid API key"
    when 403
      raise "Forbidden: Insufficient permissions"
    when 404
      raise "Not found: API endpoint not found"
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded"
    when 500..599
      raise "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    raise "Invalid JSON response from API"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

# Завантаження змінних середовища з .env файлу
Dotenv.load

class KyivstarSmsSender
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.kyivstar.ua/business/sms/v1'.freeze

  def initialize(login: nil, password: nil)
    @login = login || ENV['KYIVSTAR_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['KYIVSTAR_PASSWORD']
    @auth_token = nil
    
    validate_credentials
    authenticate
  end

  # Надсилання одного SMS
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, sender_name: nil, options: {})
    validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    validate_message(message)

    payload = build_payload([phone_number], message, sender_name, options)
    
    response = make_request('/messages', payload)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Надсилання групового SMS
  def send_bulk_sms(phone_numbers, message, sender_name: nil, options: {})
    validate_phone_numbers(phone_numbers)
    validate_message(message)

    payload = build_payload(phone_numbers, message, sender_name, options)
    
    response = make_request('/messages', payload)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    response = make_request("/messages/#{message_id}", nil, :get)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання статусу: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Отримання балансу
  def get_balance
    response = make_request('/balance', nil, :get)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання балансу: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    unless @login && @password
      raise "Не вказано логін або пароль. Вкажіть у конструкторі або через змінні середовища KYIVSTAR_LOGIN та KYIVSTAR_PASSWORD"
    end
  end

  def validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Базова перевірка формату номера телефону
    unless phone_number =~ /^380\d{9}$/
      raise "Невірний формат номеру телефону. Очікується формат: 380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end

  def validate_phone_numbers(phone_numbers)
    phone_numbers.each { |phone| validate_phone_number(phone) }
  end

  def validate_message(message)
    if message.nil? || message.empty?
      raise "Повідомлення не може бути порожнім"
    end
    
    if message.length > 160
      raise "Повідомлення занадто довге. Максимальна довжина: 160 символів"
    end
  end

  def authenticate
    auth_payload = {
      login: @login,
      password: @password
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/auth",
      body: auth_payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @auth_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['token']
    else
      raise "Помилка автентифікації: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def build_payload(phone_numbers, message, sender_name, options)
    {
      recipient: phone_numbers,
      message: message,
      sender: sender_name,
      options: {
        validity: options[:validity] || 1440, # Тривалість життя повідомлення у хвилинах
        priority: options[:priority] || 'normal' # normal, high
      }.merge(options)
    }
  end

  def make_request(endpoint, payload = nil, method = :post)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}"
    }

    case method
    when :post
      HTTParty.post(
        "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: headers
      )
    when :get
      HTTParty.get(
        "#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}",
        headers: headers
      )
    else
      raise "Непідтримуваний HTTP метод: #{method}"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      puts "SMS успішно відправлено! ID повідомлення: #{result['id']}"
      result
    else
      error_message = "Помилка відправки SMS: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      puts error_message
      raise error_message
    end
  end
end
```

## Main Bot Implementation

```ruby
# deployment_bot.rb
require 'discordrb'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class DeploymentBot
  def initialize
    @bot = Discordrb::Bot.new(
      token: ENV['DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN'],
      client_id: ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID']
    )
    
    # Deployment status tracking
    @deployments = {}
    
    setup_commands
    setup_events
  end

  def setup_commands
    # Slash command to start a deployment
    @bot.register_application_command(:deploy, 'Manage deployments') do |cmd|
      cmd.subcommand(:start, 'Start a new deployment') do |sub|
        sub.string(:environment, 'Environment to deploy to', required: true, choices: {
          'Production' => 'production',
          'Staging' => 'staging',
          'Development' => 'development'
        })
        sub.string(:version, 'Version to deploy (e.g., v1.2.3)', required: true)
        sub.string(:description, 'Deployment description', required: false)
      end
      
      cmd.subcommand(:status, 'Check deployment status') do |sub|
        sub.string(:environment, 'Environment to check', required: true, choices: {
          'Production' => 'production',
          'Staging' => 'staging',
          'Development' => 'development'
        })
      end
      
      cmd.subcommand(:list, 'List recent deployments')
    end

    # General bot info command
    @bot.register_application_command(:deploybot, 'Get bot information')
  end

  def setup_events
    # Deployment command handlers
    @bot.application_command(:deploy) do |event|
      case event.subcommand
      when :start
        handle_deploy_start(event)
      when :status
        handle_deploy_status(event)
      when :list
        handle_deploy_list(event)
      end
    end

    # Bot info command handler
    @bot.application_command(:deploybot) do |event|
      handle_bot_info(event)
    end

    # Ready event
    @bot.ready do
      puts "Deployment bot is ready! Connected as #{@bot.profile.username}"
      @bot.update_status('online', "deployments | /deploy", nil, 0, false, 3)
    end

    # Error handling
    @bot.include_error_handler do |event, error|
      puts "Error occurred: #{error.class}: #{error.message}"
      event.respond(content: "❌ An error occurred: #{error.message}", ephemeral: true)
    end
  end

  def handle_deploy_start(event)
    environment = event.options['environment']
    version = event.options['version']
    description = event.options['description'] || 'No description provided'

    # Generate a unique deployment ID
    deployment_id = "deploy_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000)}"
    
    # Store deployment info
    @deployments[deployment_id] = {
      environment: environment,
      version: version,
      description: description,
      status: 'in_progress',
      started_by: event.user.username,
      start_time: Time.now,
      message_id: nil
    }

    # Create deployment embed
    embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment_id, 'in_progress')
    
    # Send deployment notification
    message = event.respond(embeds: [embed])
    
    # Store message ID for updates
    @deployments[deployment_id][:message_id] = message.id
    
    # Simulate deployment process (in real app, this would call your deployment system)
    simulate_deployment(deployment_id, event.channel_id)

    nil # Return nil to avoid double response
  end

  def handle_deploy_status(event)
    environment = event.options['environment']
    
    # Find deployments for the specified environment
    env_deployments = @deployments.select { |_, d| d[:environment] == environment }
                                  .sort_by { |_, d| d[:start_time] }
                                  .reverse
                                  .first(5) # Last 5 deployments
    
    if env_deployments.empty?
      event.respond(content: "No deployments found for #{environment} environment.", ephemeral: true)
      return
    end

    embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "📊 Deployment Status - #{environment.capitalize}",
      color: 0x3498db,
      timestamp: Time.now
    )

    env_deployments.each do |id, deployment|
      status_emoji = deployment_status_emoji(deployment[:status])
      embed.add_field(
        name: "#{status_emoji} #{deployment[:version]}",
        value: "By: #{deployment[:started_by]}\nStatus: #{deployment[:status].gsub('_', ' ').capitalize}",
        inline: true
      )
    end

    event.respond(embeds: [embed], ephemeral: true)
  end

  def handle_deploy_list(event)
    recent_deployments = @deployments.sort_by { |_, d| d[:start_time] }
                                    .reverse
                                    .first(10) # Last 10 deployments

    if recent_deployments.empty?
      event.respond(content: "No deployments found.", ephemeral: true)
      return
    end

    embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "📋 Recent Deployments",
      color: 0x9b59b6,
      timestamp: Time.now
    )

    recent_deployments.each do |id, deployment|
      status_emoji = deployment_status_emoji(deployment[:status])
      embed.add_field(
        name: "#{status_emoji} #{deployment[:environment].capitalize} - #{deployment[:version]}",
        value: "By: #{deployment[:started_by]}\n#{deployment[:description]}",
        inline: false
      )
    end

    event.respond(embeds: [embed], ephemeral: true)
  end

  def handle_bot_info(event)
    embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "🤖 Deployment Bot",
      description: "A bot for managing deployment notifications and tracking",
      color: 0x2ecc71,
      thumbnail: { url: @bot.profile.avatar_url },
      fields: [
        { name: "Commands", value: "• `/deploy start` - Start a deployment\n• `/deploy status` - Check deployment status\n• `/deploy list` - List recent deployments", inline: false },
        { name: "Deployment Statuses", value: "✅ Success\n🔄 In Progress\n❌ Failed\n⚠️ Rolled Back", inline: false }
      ],
      footer: { text: "Deployment Bot v1.0" },
      timestamp: Time.now
    )

    event.respond(embeds: [embed], ephemeral: true)
  end

  def create_deployment_embed(deployment_id, status)
    deployment = @deployments[deployment_id]
    return nil unless deployment

    color = case status
            when 'in_progress' then 0xf39c12
            when 'success' then 0x2ecc71
            when 'failed' then 0xe74c3c
            when 'rolled_back' then 0x3498db
            else 0x95a5a6
            end

    Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "🚀 Deployment #{status.gsub('_', ' ').capitalize}",
      color: color,
      fields: [
        { name: "Environment", value: deployment[:environment].capitalize, inline: true },
        { name: "Version", value: deployment[:version], inline: true },
        { name: "Status", value: status.gsub('_', ' ').capitalize, inline: true },
        { name: "Started By", value: deployment[:started_by], inline: true },
        { name: "Description", value: deployment[:description], inline: false }
      ],
      footer: { text: "Deployment ID: #{deployment_id}" },
      timestamp: Time.now
    )
  end

  def deployment_status_emoji(status)
    case status
    when 'in_progress' then '🔄'
    when 'success' then '✅'
    when 'failed' then '❌'
    when 'rolled_back' then '⚠️'
    else '❓'
    end
  end

  def simulate_deployment(deployment_id, channel_id)
    # Simulate deployment process
    Thread.new do
      deployment = @deployments[deployment_id]
      
      # Simulate deployment steps
      sleep(2)
      
      # 80% chance of success, 20% chance of failure for demo purposes
      success = rand(100) < 80
      final_status = success ? 'success' : 'failed'
      
      # Update deployment status
      deployment[:status] = final_status
      deployment[:end_time] = Time.now
      
      # Update the original message with final status
      embed = create_deployment_embed(deployment_id, final_status)
      channel = @bot.channel(channel_id)
      message = channel.load_message(deployment[:message_id])
      message.edit('', embed) if message
      
      # Send completion notification
      completion_embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
        title: success ? "✅ Deployment Completed Successfully!" : "❌ Deployment Failed!",
        description: "Deployment to #{deployment[:environment]} has #{success ? 'completed' : 'failed'}",
        color: success ? 0x2ecc71 : 0xe74c3c,
        fields: [
          { name: "Environment", value: deployment[:environment].capitalize, inline: true },
          { name: "Version", value: deployment[:version], inline: true },
          { name: "Duration", value: "#{(deployment[:end_time] - deployment[:start_time]).round(2)}s", inline: true }
        ],
        timestamp: Time.now
      )
      
      channel.send_message('', false, completion_embed)
    end
  end

  def run
    @bot.run
  end
end

# Start the bot if this file is executed directly
if __FILE__ == $0
  unless ENV['DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN'] && ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID']
    puts "Error: Please set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and DISCORD_CLIENT_ID environment variables"
    puts "Create a .env file with these variables or set them in your environment"
    exit 1
  end

  bot = DeploymentBot.new
  bot.run
end
```

## Usage

The bot provides these slash commands:

- `/deploy start` - Start a new deployment with environment, version, and description
- `/deploy status` - Check deployment status for a specific environment
- `/deploy list` - List recent deployments

The bot automatically sends notifications when deployments start, succeed, or fail, and maintains a history of deployments that can be queried through the slash commands.

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'vonage'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

class SMSSender
  def initialize
    @client = Vonage::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['VONAGE_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['VONAGE_API_SECRET'],
      application_id: ENV['VONAGE_APPLICATION_ID'],
      private_key: File.read(ENV['VONAGE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH'])
    )
    
    @delivery_reports = {}
  end

  def send_sms(to, from, text, callback_url = nil)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.send(
        from: from,
        to: to,
        text: text,
        callback_url: callback_url
      )
      
      message = response.messages.first
      
      if message.status == '0'
        puts "SMS sent successfully! Message ID: #{message.message_id}"
        @delivery_reports[message.message_id] = {
          status: 'sent',
          to: to,
          timestamp: Time.now
        }
        return message.message_id
      else
        puts "Failed to send SMS. Error: #{message.error_text}"
        return nil
      end
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      puts "Vonage API error: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def check_delivery_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = @client.sms.search(message_id)
      
      if response
        @delivery_reports[message_id] = {
          status: response.status,
          to: response.to,
          timestamp: Time.parse(response['message-timestamp']),
          error_code: response['error-code'],
          error_text: response['error-text']
        }
        
        return @delivery_reports[message_id]
      end
    rescue Vonage::Error => e
      puts "Error checking delivery status: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def get_delivery_report(message_id)
    @delivery_reports[message_id]
  end

  def list_all_reports
    @delivery_reports
  end
end
```

## Вебхук сервер для отримання звітів про доставку

```ruby
# webhook_server.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class DeliveryReportServer < Sinatra::Base
  set :port, 4567
  
  # Хранилище для звітів про доставку
  @@delivery_reports = {}
  
  # Ендпоінт для отримання звітів про доставку
  post '/delivery-reports' do
    content_type :json
    
    begin
      report_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      
      message_id = report_data['messageId']
      status = report_data['status']
      
      @@delivery_reports[message_id] = {
        status: status,
        timestamp: Time.now,
        recipient: report_data['to'],
        error_code: report_data['error-code'],
        error_text: report_data['error-text'],
        full_data: report_data
      }
      
      puts "Отримано звіт про доставку:"
      puts "Message ID: #{message_id}"
      puts "Статус: #{status}"
      puts "Отримувач: #{report_data['to']}"
      puts "Час: #{Time.now}"
      
      status 200
      { success: true }.to_json
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка обробки звіту: #{e.message}"
      status 400
      { error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  # Ендпоінт для перегляду звітів
  get '/delivery-reports' do
    content_type :json
    @@delivery_reports.to_json
  end
  
  # Ендпоінт для перегляду конкретного звіту
  get '/delivery-reports/:message_id' do
    content_type :json
    report = @@delivery_reports[params[:message_id]]
    
    if report
      report.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Звіт не знайдено' }.to_json
    end
  end
end

DeliveryReportServer.run! if __FILE__ == $0
```

```ruby
# sms_monitor.rb
require_relative 'sms_sender'
require 'dotenv/load'

class SMSMonitor
  def initialize
    @sender = SMSSender.new
    @monitoring_messages = []
  end
  
  def send_and_monitor(to, from, text, check_interval = 10, max_checks = 6)
    message_id = @sender.send_sms(to, from, text)
    
    if message_id
      @monitoring_messages << message_id
      monitor_message(message_id, check_interval, max_checks)
    else
      puts "Не вдалося відправити повідомлення"
    end
  end
  
  def monitor_message(message_id, check_interval = 10, max_checks = 6)
    checks = 0
    
    while checks < max_checks
      report = @sender.check_delivery_status(message_id)
      
      if report
        status = report[:status]
        puts "Перевірка #{checks + 1}/#{max_checks}: Статус - #{status}"
        
        # Якщо повідомлення доставлено або не доставлено, припиняємо моніторинг
        if ['delivered', 'failed', 'undelivered', 'rejected'].include?(status)
          puts "Фінальний статус: #{status}"
          break
        end
      else
        puts "Перевірка #{checks + 1}/#{max_checks}: Звіт не знайдено"
      end
      
      checks += 1
      sleep(check_interval) unless checks >= max_checks
    end
    
    if checks >= max_checks
      puts "Досягнуто максимальну кількість перевірок. Останній статус: #{@sender.get_delivery_report(message_id)&.dig(:status) || 'невідомо'}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# sms_fly_client.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'builder'

class SMSFlyClient
  BASE_URL = 'http://sms-fly.ua/api/api.php'
  
  def initialize(login, password)
    @login = login
    @password = password
    @session_id = nil
  end
  
  # Authenticate and get session ID
  def authenticate
    xml = build_auth_xml
    response = send_request(xml)
    
    if response.success?
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
      @session_id = doc.at_xpath('//session/id')&.text
      @session_id ? true : false
    else
      false
    end
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, sender_name = 'SMS-FLY')
    authenticate unless @session_id
    
    xml = build_sms_xml(phone_number, message, sender_name)
    response = send_request(xml)
    
    parse_sms_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    authenticate unless @session_id
    
    xml = build_balance_xml
    response = send_request(xml)
    
    parse_balance_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check SMS status
  def check_sms_status(message_id)
    authenticate unless @session_id
    
    xml = build_status_xml(message_id)
    response = send_request(xml)
    
    parse_status_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def send_request(xml_body)
    HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: xml_body,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'Accept' => 'application/xml'
      },
      timeout: 30
    )
  end
  
  def build_auth_xml
    Builder::XmlMarkup.new.operation do |xml|
      xml.auth do
        xml.login(@login)
        xml.password(@password)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def build_sms_xml(phone_number, message, sender_name)
    Builder::XmlMarkup.new.operation do |xml|
      xml.auth do
        xml.login(@login)
        xml.password(@password)
      end
      xml.message('type' => 'single', 'sender' => sender_name) do
        xml.body(message)
        xml.recipient(phone_number)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def build_balance_xml
    Builder::XmlMarkup.new.operation do |xml|
      xml.auth do
        xml.login(@login)
        xml.password(@password)
      end
      xml.balance
    end
  end
  
  def build_status_xml(message_id)
    Builder::XmlMarkup.new.operation do |xml|
      xml.auth do
        xml.login(@login)
        xml.password(@password)
      end
      xml.status(messageid: message_id)
    end
  end
  
  def parse_sms_response(response)
    return { success: false, error: 'HTTP request failed' } unless response.success?
    
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    state = doc.at_xpath('//state')&.text
    
    if state == 'ACCEPT'
      message_id = doc.at_xpath('//message/id')&.text
      { success: true, message_id: message_id, state: state }
    else
      code = doc.at_xpath('//state/@code')&.value
      description = doc.at_xpath('//state/@description')&.value
      { success: false, code: code, description: description }
    end
  end
  
  def parse_balance_response(response)
    return { success: false, error: 'HTTP request failed' } unless response.success?
    
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    balance = doc.at_xpath('//balance')&.text
    
    if balance
      { success: true, balance: balance.to_f }
    else
      code = doc.at_xpath('//state/@code')&.value
      description = doc.at_xpath('//state/@description')&.value
      { success: false, code: code, description: description }
    end
  end
  
  def parse_status_response(response)
    return { success: false, error: 'HTTP request failed' } unless response.success?
    
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    state = doc.at_xpath('//state')&.text
    
    if state
      code = doc.at_xpath('//state/@code')&.value
      description = doc.at_xpath('//state/@description')&.value
      { success: true, state: state, code: code, description: description }
    else
      { success: false, error: 'Invalid response format' }
    end
  end
end
```

### lib/kyivstar_sms_sender.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class KyivstarSMSException < StandardError; end

class KyivstarSMSSender
  BASE_URL = ENV['KYIVSTAR_API_URL'] || 'https://api.it-sim.ru/api/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil, sender_name = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['KYIVSTAR_API_KEY']
    @sender_name = sender_name || ENV['KYIVSTAR_SENDER_NAME']
    
    validate_credentials
  end
  
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    validate_message(message)
    
    payload = build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/send",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_balance
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/balance",
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_status(message_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/status/#{message_id}",
      headers: headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    raise KyivstarSMSException, 'API key is required' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
    raise KyivstarSMSException, 'Sender name is required' if @sender_name.nil? || @sender_name.empty?
  end
  
  def validate_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Базова валідація українського номера телефону
    cleaned_phone = phone_number.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')
    
    unless cleaned_phone.match?(/^(38)?0(39|50|63|66|67|68|73|91|92|93|94|95|96|97|98|99)\d{7}$/)
      raise KyivstarSMSException, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number: #{phone_number}"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message(message)
    if message.nil? || message.empty?
      raise KyivstarSMSException, 'Message cannot be empty'
    end
    
    if message.length > 160
      raise KyivstarSMSException, 'Message is too long (max 160 characters)'
    end
  end
  
  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
    payload = {
      phone: format_phone_number(phone_number),
      text: message,
      sender: @sender_name
    }
    
    # Додаткові опції
    payload[:callback_url] = options[:callback_url] if options[:callback_url]
    payload[:priority] = options[:priority] if options[:priority]
    payload[:validity] = options[:validity] if options[:validity]
    
    payload
  end
  
  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Приводимо номер до формату 380XXXXXXXXX
    cleaned_phone = phone_number.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')
    cleaned_phone = cleaned_number[2..-1] if cleaned_phone.start_with?('38')
    "380#{cleaned_phone}"
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise KyivstarSMSException, 'Authentication failed - check your API key'
    when 400
      error_message = parse_error(response.body)
      raise KyivstarSMSException, "Bad request: #{error_message}"
    when 500
      raise KyivstarSMSException, 'Server error - please try again later'
    else
      raise KyivstarSMSException, "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_error(body)
    begin
      error_data = JSON.parse(body)
      error_data['message'] || error_data['error'] || 'Unknown error'
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      body
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# bot.rb
require 'discordrb'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class DeploymentBot
  def initialize
    @bot = Discordrb::Bot.new(
      token: ENV['DISCORD_TOKEN'],
      client_id: ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID']
    )
    
    # Store deployment status
    @deployments = {}
    
    setup_commands
  end

  def setup_commands
    # Slash command to get deployment status
    @bot.register_application_command(:deploy, 'Deployment commands') do |cmd|
      cmd.subcommand(:status, 'Get current deployment status') do |opt|
        opt.string('environment', 'Environment to check (production, staging, development)', 
                  required: false, 
                  choices: {
                    'Production' => 'production',
                    'Staging' => 'staging', 
                    'Development' => 'development'
                  })
      end
      
      cmd.subcommand(:start, 'Start a new deployment') do |opt|
        opt.string('environment', 'Environment to deploy to', 
                  required: true,
                  choices: {
                    'Production' => 'production',
                    'Staging' => 'staging'
                  })
        opt.string('version', 'Version to deploy (e.g., v1.2.3)', required: true)
        opt.string('description', 'Deployment description', required: false)
      end
      
      cmd.subcommand(:list, 'List recent deployments') do |opt|
        opt.string('environment', 'Filter by environment', required: false)
      end
    end

    # Handle deploy status command
    @bot.application_command(:deploy) do |event|
      case event.subcommand
      when :status
        handle_status_command(event)
      when :start
        handle_start_command(event)
      when :list
        handle_list_command(event)
      end
    end

    # Simple ping command
    @bot.register_application_command(:ping, 'Check if bot is responsive') do |cmd|
      cmd.string('message', 'Optional message to echo', required: false)
    end

    @bot.application_command(:ping) do |event|
      message = event.options['message'] || 'Pong!'
      event.respond(content: "🏓 #{message}")
    end

    # Help command
    @bot.register_application_command(:help, 'Show available commands') do |cmd|
      cmd.string('command', 'Specific command to get help for', required: false)
    end

    @bot.application_command(:help) do |event|
      command = event.options['command']
      help_message = if command
        get_command_help(command.downcase)
      else
        get_general_help
      end
      
      event.respond(content: help_message)
    end
  end

  def handle_status_command(event)
    environment = event.options['environment'] || 'production'
    deployment = @deployments[environment]
    
    if deployment
      embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
        title: "🚀 Deployment Status - #{environment.capitalize}",
        color: get_status_color(deployment[:status]),
        timestamp: Time.now
      )
      
      embed.add_field(name: "Version", value: deployment[:version], inline: true)
      embed.add_field(name: "Status", value: deployment[:status].capitalize, inline: true)
      embed.add_field(name: "Started", value: deployment[:started_at].strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), inline: true)
      embed.add_field(name: "Description", value: deployment[:description] || "No description provided")
      
      if deployment[:completed_at]
        embed.add_field(name: "Completed", value: deployment[:completed_at].strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), inline: true)
        duration = (deployment[:completed_at] - deployment[:started_at]).to_i
        embed.add_field(name: "Duration", value: "#{duration}s", inline: true)
      end
      
      event.respond(embeds: [embed])
    else
      event.respond(content: "❌ No deployment found for #{environment} environment")
    end
  end

  def handle_start_command(event)
    environment = event.options['environment']
    version = event.options['version']
    description = event.options['description'] || "Deployment initiated by #{event.user.username}"
    
    # Create deployment record
    @deployments[environment] = {
      version: version,
      description: description,
      status: 'in_progress',
      started_at: Time.now,
      started_by: event.user.username
    }
    
    # Send deployment notification
    send_deployment_notification(environment, version, description, event.user.username)
    
    embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "🚀 Deployment Started",
      description: "Deployment to **#{environment}** has been initiated",
      color: 0x00ff00,
      timestamp: Time.now
    )
    
    embed.add_field(name: "Environment", value: environment.capitalize, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Version", value: version, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Initiated By", value: event.user.username, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Description", value: description)
    
    event.respond(embeds: [embed])
  end

  def handle_list_command(event)
    environment_filter = event.options['environment']
    
    deployments_to_show = if environment_filter
      @deployments.select { |env, _| env == environment_filter }
    else
      @deployments
    end
    
    if deployments_to_show.any?
      embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
        title: "📋 Recent Deployments",
        color: 0x0099ff,
        timestamp: Time.now
      )
      
      deployments_to_show.each do |env, deployment|
        status_emoji = deployment[:status] == 'completed' ? '✅' : '🔄'
        embed.add_field(
          name: "#{status_emoji} #{env.capitalize} - #{deployment[:version]}",
          value: "By: #{deployment[:started_by]} | Status: #{deployment[:status].capitalize}",
          inline: false
        )
      end
      
      event.respond(embeds: [embed])
    else
      event.respond(content: "❌ No deployments found#{environment_filter ? " for #{environment_filter}" : ''}")
    end
  end

  # Public method to send deployment notifications
  def send_deployment_notification(environment, version, description, initiated_by, status: 'started')
    return unless @bot.connected?
    
    # Find the notification channel (you can customize this)
    channel_id = ENV['DEPLOYMENT_CHANNEL_ID']&.to_i
    return unless channel_id
    
    channel = @bot.channel(channel_id)
    
    status_emoji = case status
                  when 'started' then '🚀'
                  when 'completed' then '✅'
                  when 'failed' then '❌'
                  else 'ℹ️'
                  end
    
    embed = Discordrb::Webhooks::Embed.new(
      title: "#{status_emoji} Deployment #{status.capitalize}",
      color: get_notification_color(status),
      timestamp: Time.now
    )
    
    embed.add_field(name: "Environment", value: environment.capitalize, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Version", value: version, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Status", value: status.capitalize, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Initiated By", value: initiated_by, inline: true)
    embed.add_field(name: "Description", value: description, inline: false)
    
    channel.send_embed('', embed)
  end

  # Public method to update deployment status
  def update_deployment_status(environment, status, additional_info = nil)
    deployment = @deployments[environment]
    return false unless deployment
    
    deployment[:status] = status
    deployment[:completed_at] = Time.now if status == 'completed'
    
    # Send notification
    send_deployment_notification(
      environment, 
      deployment[:version], 
      deployment[:description], 
      deployment[:started_by],
      status: status
    )
    
    true
  end

  def get_status_color(status)
    case status
    when 'completed' then 0x00ff00
    when 'in_progress' then 0xffff00
    when 'failed' then 0xff0000
    else 0x0099ff
    end
  end

  def get_notification_color(status)
    case status
    when 'started' then 0xffff00
    when 'completed' then 0x00ff00
    when 'failed' then 0xff0000
    else 0x0099ff
    end
  end

  def get_general_help
    <<~HELP
    **🤖 Deployment Bot Commands**
    
    **/deploy status** - Check deployment status
    **/deploy start** - Start a new deployment
    **/deploy list** - List recent deployments
    **/ping** - Check if bot is responsive
    **/help** - Show this message
    
    Use `/help <command>` for detailed help on a specific command.
    HELP
  end

  def get_command_help(command)
    case command
    when 'deploy'
      <<~HELP
      **/deploy commands:**
      
      • **status** - Check current deployment status for an environment
        - Options: environment (production, staging, development)
      
      • **start** - Start a new deployment
        - Required: environment, version
        - Optional: description
      
      • **list** - List recent deployments
        - Optional: environment filter
      HELP
    when 'ping'
      "**/ping** - Simple command to check if the bot is responsive. Optional message parameter to echo back."
    else
      "❌ No help available for command: #{command}"
    end
  end

  def run
    puts "Bot is running! Invite URL: #{@bot.invite_url}"
    @bot.run
  end
end
```

## Implementation Code

```ruby
# sms_fly_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

class SMSFlyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # SMS-fly API endpoint
  BASE_URL = 'http://sms-fly.com/api/api.php'
  
  def initialize(login, password)
    @login = login
    @password = password
    @options = {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'Accept' => 'application/xml'
      }
    }
  end
  
  # Send SMS to single recipient
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
    phone_number = normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
    
    xml_body = build_sms_xml(phone_number, message, options)
    
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, @options.merge(body: xml_body))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Send bulk SMS to multiple recipients
  def send_bulk_sms(phone_numbers, message, options = {})
    phone_numbers = Array(phone_numbers).map { |phone| normalize_phone_number(phone) }
    
    xml_body = build_bulk_sms_xml(phone_numbers, message, options)
    
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, @options.merge(body: xml_body))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Check account balance
  def get_balance
    xml_body = build_balance_xml
    
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, @options.merge(body: xml_body))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_balance_response(response.body)
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Check SMS status by ID
  def get_sms_status(message_id)
    xml_body = build_status_xml(message_id)
    
    response = self.class.post(BASE_URL, @options.merge(body: xml_body))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_status_response(response.body)
    else
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Remove all non-digit characters except '+'
    phone = phone_number.to_s.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
    
    # Add Ukrainian country code if missing
    if phone.start_with?('0')
      phone = '38' + phone
    elsif phone.start_with?('80')
      phone = '3' + phone
    elsif phone.length == 9 && !phone.start_with?('+')
      phone = '380' + phone
    end
    
    phone
  end
  
  def build_sms_xml(phone_number, message, options = {})
    start_time = options[:start_time] || 'AUTO'
    end_time = options[:end_time] || 'AUTO'
    description = options[:description] || 'Ruby SMS'
    source = options[:source] || 'SMS Fly'
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 0
    
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" end_time="#{end_time}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="#{description}" source="#{source}">
          <body>#{message}</body>
          <recipient>#{phone_number}</recipient>
        </message>
      </request>
    XML
  end
  
  def build_bulk_sms_xml(phone_numbers, message, options = {})
    start_time = options[:start_time] || 'AUTO'
    end_time = options[:end_time] || 'AUTO'
    description = options[:description] || 'Ruby SMS'
    source = options[:source] || 'SMS Fly'
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 0
    
    recipients_xml = phone_numbers.map { |phone| "<recipient>#{phone}</recipient>" }.join("\n")
    
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" end_time="#{end_time}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="#{description}" source="#{source}">
          <body>#{message}</body>
          #{recipients_xml}
        </message>
      </request>
    XML
  end
  
  def build_balance_xml
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>GETBALANCE</operation>
      </request>
    XML
  end
  
  def build_status_xml(message_id)
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>GETMESSAGESTATUS</operation>
        <message id="#{message_id}"/>
      </request>
    XML
  end
  
  def parse_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    result = {
      success: doc.at_css('state')&.text == 'Accepted',
      message_id: doc.at_css('message')&.[]('id'),
      status: doc.at_css('state')&.text,
      code: doc.at_css('code')&.text.to_i
    }
    
    if result[:code] != 0
      result[:error] = doc.at_css('description')&.text
    end
    
    result
  end
  
  def parse_balance_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    {
      success: doc.at_css('state')&.text == 'Accepted',
      balance: doc.at_css('balance')&.text.to_f,
      currency: doc.at_css('balance')&.[]('currency'),
      status: doc.at_css('state')&.text,
      code: doc.at_css('code')&.text.to_i
    }
  end
  
  def parse_status_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    {
      success: doc.at_css('state')&.text == 'Accepted',
      status: doc.at_css('state')&.text,
      code: doc.at_css('code')&.text.to_i,
      message_status: doc.at_css('status')&.text,
      description: doc.at_css('description')&.text
    }
  end
end
```
