```ruby
# sms_fly_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dotenv/load'

class SmsFlyClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://sms-fly.ua/api/api.php'

  def initialize(login = nil, password = nil)
    @login = login || ENV['SMS_FLY_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['SMS_FLY_BALANCE']
    
    raise "Не вказано логін або пароль SMS Fly" unless @login && @password
  end

  # Перевірка балансу
  def get_balance
    xml_body = build_xml_request('balance')
    
    response = make_request(xml_body)
    parse_balance_response(response)
  end

  # Відправка SMS
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number(phone)
    
    xml_body = build_sms_xml(phone, message, options)
    response = make_request(xml_body)
    
    parse_sms_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання статусу повідомлення
  def get_status(message_id)
    xml_body = build_status_xml(message_id)
    
    response = make_request(xml_body)
    parse_status_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_xml_request(command)
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>#{command}</operation>
        <login>#{@login}</login>
        <password>#{@password}</password>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def build_sms_xml(phone, message, options = {})
    start_time = options[:start_time] || 'AUTO'
    end_time = options[:end_time] || 'AUTO'
    rate = options[:rate] || 1
    lifetime = options[:lifetime] || 4

    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>SENDSMS</operation>
        <message start_time="#{start_time}" end_time="#{end_time}" 
                 rate="#{rate}" lifetime="#{lifetime}" desc="sms">
          <sender>#{options[:sender] || 'SMS Fly'}</sender>
          <body>#{message}</body>
          <recipient>#{phone}</recipient>
        </message>
        <login>#{@login}</login>
        <password>#{@password}</password>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def build_status_xml(message_id)
    <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
      <request>
        <operation>GETSTATUS</operation>
        <message id="#{message_id}"/>
        <login>#{@login}</login>
        <password>#{@password}</password>
      </request>
    XML
  end

  def make_request(xml_body)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: xml_body,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'Accept' => 'application/xml'
      },
      timeout: 30
    )

    unless response.success?
      raise "Помилка запиту: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end

    response.body
  end

  def parse_balance_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    if error = doc.at('error')
      raise "Помилка SMS Fly: #{error.text}"
    end
    
    balance = doc.at('balance')&.text
    currency = doc.at('balance')&.[]('currency')
    
    { balance: balance.to_f, currency: currency }
  end

  def parse_sms_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    if error = doc.at('error')
      raise "Помилка відправки SMS: #{error.text}"
    end
    
    state = doc.at('state')&.text
    message_id = doc.at('message id')&.[]('id')
    phone = doc.at('to')&.text
    parts = doc.at('parts')&.text
    
    {
      state: state,
      message_id: message_id,
      phone: phone,
      parts: parts.to_i,
      success: state == 'ACCEPTED'
    }
  end

  def parse_status_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    if error = doc.at('error')
      raise "Помилка отримання статусу: #{error.text}"
    end
    
    state = doc.at('state')&.text
    message_id = doc.at('message')&.[]('id')
    last_update = doc.at('lastupdate')&.text
    
    {
      state: state,
      message_id: message_id,
      last_update: last_update
    }
  end

  def validate_phone_number(phone)
    # Базова валідація українського номеру телефону
    ukrainian_phone_pattern = /^(\+38|38)?(0\d{9})$/
    
    unless phone.gsub(/[\s\-\(\)]/, '') =~ ukrainian_phone_pattern
      raise "Невірний формат українського номеру телефону: #{phone}"
    end
  end
end

# bulk_sms_sender.rb
require_relative 'sms_fly_client'

class BulkSmsSender
  def initialize(sms_client)
    @sms_client = sms_client
  end

  def send_bulk(phones, message, options = {})
    results = []
    
    phones.each do |phone|
      begin
        result = @sms_client.send_sms(phone, message, options)
        results << { phone: phone, success: true, result: result }
        puts "Відправлено SMS на #{phone}"
      rescue StandardError => e
        results << { phone: phone, success: false, error: e.message }
        puts "Помилка відправки на #{phone}: #{e.message}"
      end
      
      # Затримка між відправками (щоб не перевантажувати API)
      sleep(options[:delay] || 1)
    end
    
    results
  end

  def generate_report(results)
    successful = results.count { |r| r[:success] }
    failed = results.count { |r| !r[:success] }
    
    puts "\n=== Звіт про розсилку ==="
    puts "Успішно відправлено: #{successful}"
    puts "Не вдалося відправити: #{failed}"
    
    if failed > 0
      puts "\nПомилки:"
      results.select { |r| !r[:success] }.each do |result|
        puts "#{result[:phone]}: #{result[:error]}"
      end
    end
  end
end

# sms_fly_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dotenv/load'

class SmsFlyClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://sms-fly.ua/api/api.noai.php'

  def initialize(login: nil, password: nil)
    @login = login || ENV['SMS_FLY_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['SMS_FLY_BALANCE']
    
    unless @login && @password
      raise ArgumentError, "Не вказано логін або пароль. Вкажіть або передайте як аргументи, або встановіть змінні оточення SMS_FLY_LOGIN та SMS_FLY_PASSWORD"
    end
  end

  # Надіслати SMS
  def send_sms(phone, message, options = {})
    operation = build_sms_operation(phone, message, options)
    response = send_request(operation)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Перевірити баланс
  def get_balance
    operation = build_balance_operation
    response = send_request(operation)
    parse_balance_response(response)
  end

  # Отримати статус повідомлення
  def get_status(message_id)
    operation = build_status_operation(message_id)
    response = send_request(operation)
    parse_status_response(response)
  end

  private

  def build_sms_operation(phone, message, options)
    {
      operation: 'SENDSMS',
      message: {
        recipient: normalize_phone(phone),
        message: {
          '@type' => options[:message_type] || 'A',
          '@source' => options[:source] || 'SMS-Fly',
          '@datetime' => options[:datetime] || DateTime.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
          '#text' => message
        }
      }
    }
  end

  def build_balance_operation
    { operation: 'GETBALANCE' }
  end

  def build_status_operation(message_id)
    { 
      operation: 'GETMESSAGESTATE',
      message: { id: message_id }
    }
  end

  def send_request(operation_data)
    xml_body = build_xml(operation_data)
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: xml_body,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
        'Accept' => 'application/xml'
      },
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    unless response.success?
      raise "Помилка запиту: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
    
    response.body
  end

  def build_xml(data)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.request {
        xml.operation_(data[:operation]) {
          if data[:message]
            build_message_xml(xml, data[:message])
          end
        }
      }
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end

  def build_message_xml(xml, message_data)
    xml.message {
      if message_data[:recipient]
        xml.recipient message_data[:recipient]
      end
      
      if message_data[:message]
        xml.message_(message_data[:message])
      end
      
      if message_data[:id]
        xml.id message_data[:id]
      end
    }
  end

  def parse_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    state = doc.at_xpath('//state')
    return { error: 'Некоректна відповідь від сервера' } unless state
    
    {
      code: state['code'],
      message_id: state['id'],
      description: state.text
    }
  end

  def parse_balance_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    balance_element = doc.at_xpath('//balance')
    return { error: 'Некоректна відповідь від сервера' } unless balance_element
    
    {
      balance: balance_element.text.to_f,
      currency: balance_element['currency']
    }
  end

  def parse_status_response(xml_response)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_response)
    
    state = doc.at_xpath('//state')
    return { error: 'Некоректна відповідь від сервера' } unless state
    
    {
      code: state['code'],
      status: state.text,
      sms_id: state['sms_id']
    }
  end

  def normalize_phone(phone)
    # Привести номер телефону до формату 380XXXXXXXXX
    phone.to_s.gsub(/[^\d]/, '').sub(/^0/, '')
  end
end

'https://one.unisender.com' : BASE_URL end # Send a transactional email def send_email(params) endpoint = @platform == 'unione' ? 'transactional/api/v1/email/send.json' : 'ru/api/sendEmail' response = HTTParty.post( "#{@base_url}/#{endpoint}", body: build_payload(params), headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } ) handle_response(response) end # Check email status def check_email_status(message_id) endpoint = @platform == 'unione' ? 'transactional/api/v1/email/status.json' : 'ru/api/checkEmail' response = HTTParty.post( "#{@base_url}/#{endpoint}", body: { api_key: @api_key, message_id: message_id }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } ) handle_response(response) end # Get list of available senders def list_senders endpoint = @platform == 'unione' ? 'transactional/api/v1/sender/list.json' : 'ru/api/getSenders' response = HTTParty.post( "#{@base_url}/#{endpoint}", body: { api_key: @api_key }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } ) handle_response(response) end private def build_payload(params) base_params = { api_key: @api_key } # Handle different parameter structures for Unisender vs UniOne if @platform == 'unione' build_unione_payload(base_params, params) else build_unisender_payload(base_params, params) end end def build_unione_payload(base_params, params) payload = base_params.merge(params) # Convert Ruby-style keys to JSON-style keys if needed payload.transform_keys! { |key| key.to_s.gsub(/_([a-z])/) { $1.upcase } } payload.to_json end def build_unisender_payload(base_params, params) payload = base_params.merge(params) payload.to_json end def handle_response(response) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else { 'error' => "HTTP Error: #{response.code}", 'body' => response.body } end rescue JSON::ParserError { 'error' => 'Invalid JSON response', 'body' => response.body } end end # Email template class for easier email creation class EmailTemplate attr_accessor :from_email, :from_name, :subject, :body, :to_email, :to_name, :reply_to, :cc, :bcc, :attachments, :headers, :tags def initialize @attachments = [] @headers = {} @tags = [] end def to_h(platform = 'unisender') base_params = { from_email: @from_email, from_name: @from_name, subject: @subject, body: @body, to_email: @to_email } base_params[:to_name] = @to_name if @to_name base_params[:reply_to] = @reply_to if @reply_to base_params[:cc] = @cc if @cc base_params[:bcc] = @bcc if @bcc base_params[:headers] = @headers if @headers.any? base_params[:tags] = @tags if @tags.any? if platform == 'unione' base_params[:message] = base_params.dup base_params.delete(:to_email) base_params.delete(:to_name) base_params.delete(:cc) base_params.delete(:bcc) base_params[:message][:recipients] = build_recipients base_params[:message][:attachments] = @attachments if @attachments.any? else base_params[:attachments] = @attachments if @attachments.any? end base_params end private def build_recipients recipients = [{ email: @to_email }] recipients[0][:name] = @to_name if @to_name # Add CC recipients if @cc if @cc.is_a?(Array) @cc.each { |email| recipients << { email: email, type: 'cc' } } else recipients << { email: @cc, type: 'cc' } end end # Add BCC recipients if @bcc if @bcc.is_a?(Array) @bcc.each { |email| recipients << { email: email, type: 'bcc' } } else recipients << { email: @bcc, type: 'bcc' } end end recipients end end # Example usage and demonstration if __FILE__ == $0 # Replace with your actual API key API_KEY = 'your_api_key_here' # Initialize client (use 'unione' for UniOne platform) client = UnisenderClient.new(API_KEY, 'unione') # Example 1: Simple email template = EmailTemplate.new template.from_email = 'noreply@yourdomain.com' template.from_name = 'Your Company' template.to_email = 'recipient@example.com' template.subject = 'Test Transactional Email' template.body = '

Hello!

This is a test email.

' puts "Sending email..." result = client.send_email(template.to_h('unione')) puts "Result: #{result}" # Example 2: Email with attachments and CC template2 = EmailTemplate.new template2.from_email = 'noreply@yourdomain.com' template2.from_name = 'Your Company' template2.to_email = 'recipient@example.com' template2.to_name = 'John Doe' template2.cc = 'manager@example.com' template2.subject = 'Email with Attachment' template2.body = 'Please see the attached file.' template2.tags = ['transactional', 'notification'] # Add attachment (Base64 encoded) # template2.attachments = [ # { # name: 'document.pdf', # content: Base64.encode64(File.read('document.pdf')), # type: 'application/pdf' # } # ] # Example 3: Check email status (if you have a message_id from previous send) # message_id = result['message_id'] if result['message_id'] # status = client.check_email_status(message_id) # puts "Email status: #{status}" # Example 4: List available senders # senders = client.list_senders # puts "Available senders: #{senders}" end ``` ## Usage Examples Create a separate file for your application: ```ruby # app.rb require_relative 'unisender_client' # Initialize with your API key client = UnisenderClient.new('your_unisender_api_key', 'unione') # Create and send an email template = EmailTemplate.new template.from_email = 'noreply@yourcompany.com' template.from_name = 'Your Company' template.to_email = 'customer@example.com' template.subject = 'Order Confirmation' template.body = <<~HTML

HTML # Send the email result = client.send_email(template.to_h('unione')) if result['job_id'] puts "Email sent successfully! Job ID: #{result['job_id']}" else puts "Error sending email: #{result}" end ``` ## Installation and Setup 1. Create the Gemfile and Ruby files 2. Run `bundle install` to install dependencies 3. Set your Unisender/UniOne API key in the code 4. Run the code with `ruby app.rb` ## Key Features - Supports both Unisender and UniOne platforms - Handles email sending with attachments, CC/BCC, and custom headers - Provides email status checking - Includes sender management - Error handling and response parsing - Easy-to-use template class for email creation The code is modular and can be easily extended for additional Unisender API endpoints.

", plaintext: "Ласкаво просимо!\nЦе тестове повідомлення." }, recipients: [ { email: "recipient@example.com", substitutions: { name: "Іван" } } ] } result = client.send_email(message) puts "Повідомлення успішно надіслано!" puts "Job ID: #{result['job_id']}" puts "Status: #{result['status']}" rescue => e puts "Помилка: #{e.message}" end # Приклад 2: Надсилання шаблонного повідомлення begin template_id = "welcome_template" # ID вашого шаблону в UniOne recipient_email = "user@example.com" variables = { "user_name" => "Петро", "activation_link" => "https://example.com/activate/12345" } result = client.send_template(template_id, recipient_email, variables) puts "Шаблонне повідомлення успішно надіслано!" puts "Job ID: #{result['job_id']}" rescue => e puts "Помилка: #{e.message}" end # Приклад 3: Перевірка статусу повідомлення begin job_id = "your_job_id_here" # отриманий job_id з попередніх викликів status = client.check_status(job_id) puts "Статус повідомлення: #{status['status']}" puts "Деталі: #{status.inspect}" rescue => e puts "Помилка перевірки статусу: #{e.message}" end ``` ## Файл змінних оточення (.env) Створіть файл `.env` у корені проекту: ```env UNIONE_API_KEY=your_unione_api_key_here ``` ## Додатковий клас для більш складної логіки ```ruby # email_service.rb class EmailService def initialize @client = UniOneClient.new end # Надсилання привітального листа def send_welcome_email(user_email, user_name, confirmation_url) message = { subject: "Ласкаво просимо до нашої платформи!", from_email: "welcome@yourdomain.com", from_name: "Your Platform", body: { html: <<~HTML

        send_help(message)
      else
        handle_unknown_command(message)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def send_welcome(message)
    text = <<~WELCOME
      🇺🇦 Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot 🇺🇦

      I can show you the current air-raid alert status across Ukraine.

      Available commands:
      /map - Get the latest air-raid alert map
      /status - Get detailed alert status by region
      /help - Show this help message

      Stay safe! 🛡️
    WELCOME

    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: text
    )
  end

  def send_current_map(message)
    begin
      # Try to get the latest map image
      response = HTTParty.get(MAP_IMAGE_URL)
      
      if response.success?
        # Send the map image
        @bot.api.send_photo(
          chat_id: message.chat.id,
          photo: MAP_IMAGE_URL,
          caption: "🛑 Current air-raid alert map of Ukraine\nUpdated: #{Time.now.strftime('%H:%M %d.%m.%Y')}"
        )
      else
        # Fallback to status text if map is unavailable
        send_status(message)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "⚠️ Could not retrieve the map. Please try again later."
      )
    end
  end

  def send_status(message)
    begin
      alerts = fetch_alerts
      
      if alerts.empty?
        @bot.api.send_message(
          chat_id: message.chat.id,
          text: "✅ No active air-raid alerts in Ukraine currently."
        )
        return
      end

      # Group alerts by region and status
      regions_with_alerts = alerts.select { |alert| alert['activeAlert'] }
      
      if regions_with_alerts.any?
        status_text = "🛑 ACTIVE AIR-RAID ALERTS:\n\n"
        regions_with_alerts.each do |alert|
          status_text += "• #{alert['regionName']}\n"
          status_text += "  Started: #{format_time(alert['startedAt'])}\n"
          status_text += "  Type: #{alert['alertType']}\n\n"
        end
      else
        status_text = "✅ No active air-raid alerts."
      end

      # Add regions without alerts
      safe_regions = alerts.reject { |alert| alert['activeAlert'] }
      if safe_regions.any?
        status_text += "\n✅ SAFE REGIONS:\n"
        safe_regions.first(10).each do |alert|  # Limit to first 10 for brevity
          status_text += "• #{alert['regionName']}\n"
        end
        status_text += "... and more" if safe_regions.size > 10
      end

      status_text += "\n\nLast updated: #{Time.now.strftime('%H:%M %d.%m.%Y')}"

      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: status_text
      )

    rescue StandardError => e
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "⚠️ Error fetching alert data: #{e.message}"
      )
    end
  end

  def fetch_alerts
    response = HTTParty.get(ALERT_MAP_URL, headers: {
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    })

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      # Fallback to sample data or alternative API
      fallback_alerts
    end
  end

  def fallback_alerts
    # This is a fallback in case the main API is unavailable
    # You might want to implement alternative data sources here
    []
  end

  def format_time(timestamp)
    return 'Unknown' unless timestamp
    
    Time.parse(timestamp).strftime('%H:%M %d.%m.%Y')
  rescue
    timestamp
  end

  def send_help(message)
    help_text = <<~HELP
      🤖 Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot Help

      /start - Start the bot and see welcome message
      /map - Get the latest air-raid alert map

      Stay informed and stay safe! 🛡️

    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: help_text

  def handle_unknown_command(message)
    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: "❓ Unknown command. Use /help to see available commands."
    )

# binotel_caller.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class BinotelCaller
  include HTTParty
  
  # Binotel API base URL
  base_uri 'https://api.binotel.com/api'
  
  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    
    unless @api_key && @api_secret
      raise "Binotel API credentials not found. Please set BINOTEL_API_KEY and BINOTEL_API_SECRET environment variables."
    end
  end
  
  # Make a voice call with a message
  def call_with_message(phone_number, message, options = {})
    # Default options
    default_options = {
      voice: 'female',      # or 'male'
      language: 'ru',       # or other supported languages
      caller_id: nil,       # caller ID to display
      max_duration: 60,     # maximum call duration in seconds
      retry_count: 0,       # number of retry attempts
      retry_delay: 60       # delay between retries in seconds
    }
    
    options = default_options.merge(options)
    
    # Prepare the request parameters
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      number: phone_number,
      text: message,
      voice: options[:voice],
      lang: options[:language],
      callerid: options[:caller_id],
      max_duration: options[:max_duration],
      retry: options[:retry_count],
      retry_delay: options[:retry_delay]
    }.compact # Remove nil values
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post('/2.0/calls/text-to-call', {
        body: params,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
          'User-Agent' => 'Binotel Ruby Client/1.0'
        }
      })
      
      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  # Check call status
  def call_status(call_id)
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      callID: call_id
    }
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post('/2.0/stats/call-details', {
        body: params,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
        }
      })
      
      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = response.parsed_response
      
      if result.is_a?(Hash) && result['status'] == 'success'
        { 
          success: true, 
          call_id: result['callID'],
          status: result['status'],
          message: result['message'],
          data: result
        }
      else
        { 
          success: false, 
          error: result['message'] || 'Unknown API error',
          data: result
        }
      end
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}",
        http_code: response.code
      }
    end
  end
end

# credit_card_form.rb
require 'active_model'

class CreditCardForm
  include ActiveModel::Model
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  
  attr_accessor :card_number
  
  # Remove any non-digit characters and validate
  validates :card_number, presence: true
  validate :valid_card_number_format
  validate :valid_luhn_check
  validate :supported_card_brand
  
  CARD_BRANDS = {
    visa: /^4\d{12}(?:\d{3})?$/,
    mastercard: /^5[1-5]\d{14}$/,
    amex: /^3[47]\d{13}$/,
    discover: /^6(?:011|5\d{2})\d{12}$/,
    diners_club: /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68]\d)\d{11}$/,
    jcb: /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}$/
  }.freeze
  
  def initialize(attributes = {})
    super
    # Clean the card number by removing spaces and dashes
    @card_number = @card_number.to_s.gsub(/[-\s]/, '') if @card_number
  end
  
  def brand
    return nil unless valid_card_number_format?
    
    CARD_BRANDS.each do |brand, pattern|
      return brand.to_s if pattern.match?(card_number)
    end
    
    'unknown'
  end
  
  def last_four_digits
    return nil unless valid_card_number_format?
    card_number[-4..-1]
  end
  
  private
  
  def valid_card_number_format?
    card_number =~ /^\d{13,19}$/
  end
  
  def valid_card_number_format
    return if card_number.blank?
    
    unless valid_card_number_format?
      errors.add(:card_number, 'must contain only digits and be between 13-19 characters long')
    end
  end
  
  def valid_luhn_check
    return if card_number.blank? || !valid_card_number_format?
    
    unless luhn_valid?
      errors.add(:card_number, 'failed Luhn check')
    end
  end
  
  def supported_card_brand
    return if card_number.blank? || !valid_card_number_format? || !luhn_valid?
    
    if brand == 'unknown'
      errors.add(:card_number, 'unsupported card brand')
    end
  end
  
  def luhn_valid?
    digits = card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.even?
        sum += digit
      else
        double = digit * 2
        sum += double > 9 ? double - 9 : double
      end
    end
    
    sum % 10 == 0
  end
end

  end

  private

  def send_welcome(message)
    text = <<~WELCOME
      🚨 Вітаю в боті повітряних тривог України! 🚨

      Доступні команди:
      /map - Отримати поточну мапу тривог
      /status - Статус тривог по областях
      /help - Допомога

      Бот використовує офіційні дані системи повітряних тривог.
    WELCOME

    send_message(message.chat.id, text)
  end

  def send_alert_map(message)
    begin
      # Завантажуємо актуальну мапу
      response = HTTParty.get(MAP_GENERATOR_URL)
      
      if response.success?
        # Створюємо тимчасовий файл для зображення
        temp_file = Tempfile.new(['alert_map', '.png'])
        temp_file.binmode
        temp_file.write(response.body)
        temp_file.rewind

        # Відправляємо фото
        @bot.api.send_photo(
          chat_id: message.chat.id,
          photo: Faraday::UploadIO.new(temp_file, 'image/png'),
          caption: "🗺️ Поточна мапа повітряних тривог в Україні\n🕒 Оновлено: #{Time.now.strftime('%H:%M %d.%m.%Y')}"
        )

        temp_file.close
        temp_file.unlink
      else
        send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Не вдалося отримати мапу тривог. Спробуйте пізніше.")
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні мапи: #{e.message}"
      send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Сталася помилка. Спробуйте пізніше.")
    end
  end

  def send_alert_status(message)
    begin
      # Отримуємо дані про тривоги через API
      response = HTTParty.get(ALERT_API_URL, headers: {
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer public_user'
      })

      if response.success?
        alerts_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
        status_text = generate_status_text(alerts_data)
        send_message(message.chat.id, status_text)
      else
        send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Не вдалося отримати дані про тривоги.")
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні статусу: #{e.message}"
      send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Сталася помилка при отриманні статусу.")
    end
  end

  def generate_status_text(alerts_data)
    regions_with_alerts = []
    all_regions_clear = true

    alerts_data.each do |region|
      region_name = region['regionName']
      alert_active = region['activeAlerts'].any? { |alert| alert['type'] == 'AIR' }

      if alert_active
        regions_with_alerts << region_name
        all_regions_clear = false
      end
    end

    if all_regions_clear
      text = "✅ Наразі повітряних тривог немає у всіх областях України"
    else
      text = "🚨 Повітряна тривога активна в наступних областях:\n\n"
      regions_with_alerts.each do |region|
        text += "• #{region}\n"
      end
    end

    text += "\n🕒 Оновлено: #{Time.now.strftime('%H:%M %d.%m.%Y')}"
    text
  end

  def send_help(message)
    text = <<~HELP
      ℹ️ Довідка по командам:

      /start - Початок роботи з ботом
      /map - Отримати поточну мапу повітряних тривог
      /status - Детальний статус тривог по областях
      /help - Ця довідка

      📡 Дані оновлюються в реальному часі
      🏠 Бот використовує офіційні джерела даних
    HELP

    send_message(message.chat.id, text)
  end

  def handle_unknown_command(message)
    text = "🤔 Не розпізнана команда. Використовуйте /help для переліку доступних команд."
    send_message(message.chat.id, text)
  end

  def send_message(chat_id, text)
    @bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end
end

**Ruby Implementation:**
```ruby
# binotel_caller.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class BinotelCaller
  # Binotel API endpoint
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api/1.0'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key = nil, api_secret = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['BINOTEL_API_SIGNATURE']
    
    validate_credentials
  end

  # Make a call with a voice message
  def call_customer(customer_number, voice_message_url, options = {})
    # Required parameters
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      signature: generate_signature,
      customerNumber: customer_number,
      voiceMessage: voice_message_url
    }

    # Optional parameters
    params[:generalNumber] = options[:general_number] if options[:general_number]
    params[:internalNumber] = options[:internal_number] if options[:internal_number]
    params[:callerid] = options[:caller_id] if options[:caller_id]
    params[:timeLimit] = options[:time_limit] if options[:time_limit]
    params[:record] = options[:record] ? 1 : 0 if options.key?(:record)
    params[:uniqueid] = options[:unique_id] if options[:unique_id]
    params[:callbackUrl] = options[:callback_url] if options[:callback_url]

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/calls/make-call-with-voice-message.json",
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check call status
  def call_status(call_id)
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      signature: generate_signature,
      callID: call_id
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/calls/status.json",
      body: params,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_secret.nil?
      raise ArgumentError, "API credentials missing. Set BINOTEL_API_KEY and BINOTEL_API_SIGNATURE environment variables or pass them to the constructor."
    end
  end

  def generate_signature
    # Binotel uses MD5 hash of (api_secret + current_timestamp)
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i.to_s
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest(@api_secret + timestamp)
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if json_response['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          data: json_response['data'],
          message: json_response['message']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: json_response['message'],
          code: json_response['code']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables from .env file
  Dotenv.load
  
  begin
    caller = BinotelCaller.new
    
    # Example: Make a call to a customer
    result = caller.call_customer(
      '+1234567890',  # Customer phone number
      'https://example.com/voice-message.mp3',  # URL to voice message audio file
      {
        general_number: '123',          # Your Binotel general number (optional)
        caller_id: '+1987654321',       # Caller ID to display (optional)
        time_limit: 60,                 # Call duration limit in seconds (optional)
        record: true,                   # Record the call (optional)
        unique_id: "call_#{Time.now.to_i}",  # Unique identifier for tracking (optional)
        callback_url: 'https://yourapp.com/callbacks'  # Webhook for call events (optional)
      }
    )
    
    if result[:success]
      puts "Call initiated successfully!"
      puts "Call ID: #{result[:data]['callID']}"
      puts "Status: #{result[:data]['status']}"
      puts "Message: #{result[:message]}"
      
      # You can check the call status later using the call ID
      # status_result = caller.call_status(result[:data]['callID'])
      # puts "Call status: #{status_result}"
    else
      puts "Error making call: #{result[:error]}"
      puts "Error code: #{result[:code]}" if result[:code]
    end
    
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end

require 'httparty'

class BinotelCall

  BINOTEL_API_SECRET = 'YOUR_API_SECRET'

    params = {

      {

        call_id: response['callID'],
        message: 'Дзвінок успішно ініційовано'

      {
        success: false,
        error: response['message'] || 'Невідома помилка',
        code: response['code'] || 'unknown'
      }
    end
  end

  # Метод для отримання статусу дзвінка
  def call_status(call_id)
    response = send_api_request('calls/status', { callID: call_id })

    if response.success? && response['status'] == 'success'
      {
        success: true,
        status: response['callStatus'],
        details: response
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: response['message'] || 'Невідома помилка'
      }
    end
  end

  private

  # Загальний метод для відправки запитів до API
  def send_api_request(endpoint, params = {})
    # Додаємо обов'язкові параметри авторизації
    full_params = params.merge({
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret
    })

    # Формуємо URL та відправляємо POST-запит
    url = "#{BINOTEL_API_URL}#{endpoint}.json"
    
    HTTParty.post(url, {
      body: full_params,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    })
  end
end

# invoice_generator.rb
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'
require 'mail'

class InvoiceGenerator
  def initialize(invoice_data)
    @invoice_data = invoice_data
  end

  def generate_pdf
    Prawn::Document.new do |pdf|
      # Header
      pdf.text "INVOICE", size: 24, style: :bold, align: :center
      pdf.move_down 20
      
      # Invoice details
      pdf.text "Invoice #: #{@invoice_data[:invoice_number]}", size: 12
      pdf.text "Date: #{@invoice_data[:date]}", size: 12
      pdf.text "Due Date: #{@invoice_data[:due_date]}", size: 12
      pdf.move_down 20
      
      # From/To addresses
      pdf.bounding_box([0, pdf.cursor], width: 250) do
        pdf.text "From:", style: :bold
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:from][:name]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:from][:address]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:from][:email]
      end
      
      pdf.bounding_box([300, pdf.cursor + 60], width: 250) do
        pdf.text "To:", style: :bold
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:to][:name]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:to][:address]
        pdf.text @invoice_data[:to][:email]
      end
      
      pdf.move_down 80
      
      # Line items table
      table_data = [["Description", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Amount"]]
      
      @invoice_data[:line_items].each do |item|
        amount = item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price]
        table_data << [
          item[:description],
          item[:quantity],
          format_currency(item[:unit_price]),
          format_currency(amount)
        ]
      end
      
      pdf.table(table_data, header: true, width: pdf.bounds.width) do
        row(0).font_style = :bold
        row(0).background_color = "E8E8E8"
        columns(2..3).align = :right
      end
      
      pdf.move_down 20
      
      # Totals
      subtotal = calculate_subtotal
      vat_amount = subtotal * (@invoice_data[:vat_rate] / 100.0)
      total = subtotal + vat_amount
      
      pdf.bounding_box([300, pdf.cursor], width: 250) do
        pdf.text "Subtotal: #{format_currency(subtotal)}", align: :right
        pdf.text "VAT (#{@invoice_data[:vat_rate]}%): #{format_currency(vat_amount)}", align: :right
        pdf.text "TOTAL: #{format_currency(total)}", style: :bold, size: 14, align: :right
      end
      
      # Footer
      pdf.move_down 40
      pdf.text "Thank you for your business!", align: :center, style: :italic
      
    end.render
  end
  
  private
  
  def calculate_subtotal
    @invoice_data[:line_items].sum { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price] }
  end
  
  def format_currency(amount)
    "$#{'%.2f' % amount}"
  end
end

class InvoiceMailer
  def initialize(smtp_settings)
    Mail.defaults do
      delivery_method :smtp, smtp_settings
    end
  end
  
  def send_invoice(recipient_email, subject, pdf_data, filename = "invoice.pdf")
    mail = Mail.new do
      from     'billing@yourcompany.com'
      to       recipient_email
      subject  subject
      body     "Please find your invoice attached.\n\nBest regards,\nYour Company"
      
      add_file filename: filename, content: pdf_data
    end
    
    mail.deliver!
    puts "Invoice sent successfully to #{recipient_email}"
  rescue => e
    puts "Failed to send email: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# binotel_call.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class BinotelCallService
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api/2.0/calls'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    @from_number = ENV['BINOTEL_FROM_NUMBER'] # Ваш віртуальний номер Binotel
  end

  # Метод для здійснення голосового дзвінка
  def make_call(to_number, message_text, options = {})
    # Перевірка наявності обов'язкових параметрів
    unless @api_key && @api_secret && @from_number
      raise "Будь ласка, налаштуйте змінні оточення: BINOTEL_API_KEY, BINOTEL_API_SECRET, BINOTEL_FROM_NUMBER"
    end

    # Параметри для API запиту
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      from: @from_number,
      to: to_number,
      text: message_text
    }.merge(options)

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(BASE_URL, {
        body: params,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
        }
      })

      handle_response(response)
    rescue HTTParty::Error => e
      { success: false, error: "Помилка мережі: #{e.message}" }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: "Неочікувана помилка: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу дзвінка
  def call_status(call_id)
    params = {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      callID: call_id
    }

    response = HTTParty.post("#{BASE_URL}/status", {
      body: params,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      }
    })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['status'] == 'success'
        { 
          success: true, 
          call_id: result['callID'],
          message: 'Дзвінок успішно ініційовано'
        }
      else
        { 
          success: false, 
          error: "Помилка API: #{result['errorDescription'] || 'Невідома помилка'}"
        }
      end
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        error: "HTTP помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      }
    end
  end
end

## Implementation

```ruby
# diia_notification_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'jwt'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'base64'

class DiiaNotificationSender
  # Diia Partner API endpoints
  DIIA_BASE_URL = 'https://api.diia.gov.ua'.freeze
  NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT = '/api/v1/notifications/push'.freeze
  AUTH_ENDPOINT = '/api/v1/auth'.freeze
  
  def initialize(partner_id:, private_key:, certificate:, base_url: DIIA_BASE_URL)
    @partner_id = partner_id
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(private_key)
    @certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(certificate)
    @base_url = base_url
    @access_token = nil
    @token_expires_at = nil
  end
  
  # Send push notification to a user
  def send_notification(user_identifier:, title:, text:, action_types: [], segment: nil, template_id: nil)
    authenticate unless valid_token?
    
    payload = build_notification_payload(
      user_identifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      text: text,
      action_types: action_types,
      segment: segment,
      template_id: template_id
    )
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      verify: true # Enable SSL verification for production
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Send bulk notifications to multiple users
  def send_bulk_notifications(notifications_list:, segment: nil, template_id: nil)
    authenticate unless valid_token?
    
    payload = {
      notifications: notifications_list.map do |notification|
        {
          userIdentifier: notification[:user_identifier],
          title: notification[:title],
          text: notification[:text],
          actionTypes: notification[:action_types] || []
        }
      end
    }
    
    payload[:segment] = segment if segment
    payload[:templateId] = template_id if template_id
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINT}/bulk",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json,
      verify: true
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def authenticate
    # Generate JWT token for authentication
    jwt_token = generate_jwt_token
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{jwt_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{AUTH_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: headers,
      body: { partnerId: @partner_id }.to_json,
      verify: true
    )
    
    if response.success?
      auth_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @access_token = auth_data['token']
      @token_expires_at = Time.now + (auth_data['expiresIn'] || 3600) # Default 1 hour
    else
      raise AuthenticationError, "Failed to authenticate: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def generate_jwt_token
    payload = {
      iss: @partner_id,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300, # 5 minutes expiration
      jti: SecureRandom.uuid
    }
    
    JWT.encode(payload, @private_key, 'RS256', { typ: 'JWT', x5c: [Base64.strict_encode64(@certificate.to_der)] })
  end
  
  def valid_token?
    @access_token && @token_expires_at && Time.now < @token_expires_at - 60 # 1 minute buffer
  end
  
  def build_notification_payload(user_identifier:, title:, text:, action_types:, segment:, template_id:)
    payload = {
      userIdentifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      text: text,
      actionTypes: action_types
    }
    
    payload[:segment] = segment if segment
    payload[:templateId] = template_id if template_id
    
    payload
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise AuthenticationError, "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    when 400
      raise BadRequestError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
    when 403
      raise ForbiddenError, "Access forbidden: #{response.body}"
    when 404
      raise NotFoundError, "Resource not found: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise RateLimitError, "Rate limit exceeded: #{response.body}"
    when 500..599
      raise ServerError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise ApiError, "Unexpected error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Custom exceptions for better error handling
class DiiaNotificationError < StandardError; end
class AuthenticationError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class BadRequestError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class ForbiddenError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class NotFoundError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class RateLimitError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class ServerError < DiiaNotificationError; end
class ApiError < DiiaNotificationError; end

# Usage example and configuration class
class DiiaNotificationConfig
  def self.from_files(partner_id:, private_key_path:, certificate_path:, base_url: nil)
    private_key = File.read(private_key_path)
    certificate = File.read(certificate_path)
    
    DiiaNotificationSender.new(
      partner_id: partner_id,
      private_key: private_key,
      certificate: certificate,
      base_url: base_url
    )
  end
end
```

# credit_card_form.rb
require 'active_model'

class CreditCardForm
  include ActiveModel::Model
  include ActiveModel::Attributes
  
  attribute :number, :string
  
  validates :number, presence: true
  validate :valid_credit_card_number
  validate :supported_card_brand
  
  CARD_BRANDS = {
    visa: /^4\d{12}(?:\d{3})?$/,
    mastercard: /^5[1-5]\d{14}$/,
    amex: /^3[47]\d{13}$/,
    diners: /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68]\d)\d{11}$/,
    discover: /^6(?:011|5\d{2})\d{12}$/,
    jcb: /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}$/
  }.freeze
  
  def brand
    return unless number.present?
    
    CARD_BRANDS.each do |brand, pattern|
      return brand.to_s if number.gsub(/\s+/, '') =~ pattern
    end
    
    nil
  end
  
  def valid_credit_card_number
    return if number.blank?
    
    cleaned_number = number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    errors.add(:number, 'must contain only digits and spaces') unless cleaned_number =~ /^\d+$/
    errors.add(:number, 'must be between 13 and 19 digits') unless cleaned_number.length.between?(13, 19)
    
    return if errors.any?
    
    unless luhn_valid?(cleaned_number)
      errors.add(:number, 'is not a valid credit card number')
    end
  end
  
  def supported_card_brand
    return if number.blank? || errors.any?
    
    if brand.nil?
      errors.add(:number, 'is from an unsupported card brand')
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def luhn_valid?(number)
    digits = number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.odd?
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        sum += digit
      end
    end
    
    sum % 10 == 0
  end
end

**Key features:**
- Uses ActiveModel for Rails-like form object pattern
- Handles spaces in the input by removing them for validation
- Supports major card brands with regex patterns
- Implements the Luhn algorithm correctly (doubling every second digit from the right)

The Luhn algorithm works by:
1. Starting from the rightmost digit and moving left
2. Doubling every second digit
3. If doubling results in a number > 9, subtract 9
4. Sum all digits
5. Valid if the sum is divisible by 10

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'coinbase/commerce'
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'sqlite3'

class PaymentProcessor
  def initialize
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new('payments.db')
    @db.results_as_hash = true
    
    # Configure Coinbase Commerce
    Coinbase::Commerce.api_key = ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_API_KEY']
  end

  def create_order(order_id, amount, currency = 'BTC')
    # Create a charge in Coinbase Commerce
    charge = Coinbase::Commerce::Charge.create(
      name: "Order ##{order_id}",
      description: "Payment for order #{order_id}",
      pricing_type: 'fixed_price',
      local_price: {
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency
      },
      metadata: {
        order_id: order_id
      }
    )

    # Store order in database
    @db.execute(
      "INSERT INTO orders (order_id, charge_id, amount, currency) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
      [order_id, charge.id, amount, currency]
    )

    charge
  end

  def handle_webhook(payload, signature)
    # Verify webhook signature
    unless Coinbase::Commerce::Webhook.verify(payload, signature, ENV['COINBASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET'])
      raise 'Invalid webhook signature'
    end

    event = JSON.parse(payload)
    
    case event['type']
    when 'charge:confirmed', 'charge:resolved'
      charge_id = event['data']['id']
      update_order_status(charge_id, 'paid')
    when 'charge:failed', 'charge:expired'
      charge_id = event['data']['id']
      update_order_status(charge_id, 'failed')
    end
  end

  def update_order_status(charge_id, status)
    @db.execute(
      "UPDATE orders SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE charge_id = ?",
      [status, charge_id]
    )
    
    # Here you would typically trigger your business logic
    # like sending confirmation emails, updating inventory, etc.
    puts "Order with charge #{charge_id} marked as #{status}"
  end

  def get_order_status(order_id)
    @db.execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id = ?", [order_id]).first
  end
end

# Sinatra Web Application
class App < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :payment_processor, PaymentProcessor.new
  end

  # Create a new payment
  post '/payments' do
    content_type :json
    
    begin
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      order_id = data['order_id']
      amount = data['amount']
      currency = data['currency'] || 'BTC'

      charge = settings.payment_processor.create_order(order_id, amount, currency)
      
      {
        success: true,
        charge_id: charge.id,
        hosted_url: charge.hosted_url,
        status: 'pending'
      }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 400
      { success: false, error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Webhook endpoint for Coinbase Commerce notifications
  post '/webhooks' do
    content_type :json
    
    begin
      payload = request.body.read
      signature = request.env['HTTP_X_CC_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE']
      
      settings.payment_processor.handle_webhook(payload, signature)
      
      { success: true }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 400
      { success: false, error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Check payment status
  get '/payments/:order_id/status' do
    content_type :json
    
    order = settings.payment_processor.get_order_status(params[:order_id])
    
    if order
      order.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Home page
  get '/' do
    "Bitcoin Payment Processor is running!"
  end
end

# Run the application
if __FILE__ == $0
  App.run!(port: 4567)
end

require 'httparty'

class ActionNotificationSender
  attr_reader :app_id, :partner_id, :private_key, :base_url

  def initialize

    @partner_id = ENV['ACTION_PARTNER_ID']
    @private_key_path = ENV['ACTION_PRIVATE_KEY']
    @base_url = ENV['ACTION_API_BASE_URL']

  end

    headers = build_headers
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{base_url}/api/v1/notifications",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Метод для масового надсилання
  def send_bulk_notifications(notifications)
    payload = {
      notifications: notifications.map do |notification|
        build_single_notification_payload(
          notification[:user_id],
          notification[:title],
          notification[:body],
          notification[:data] || {}
        )
      end
    }
    
    headers = build_headers
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{base_url}/api/v1/notifications/bulk",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Перевірка статусу сповіщення
  def get_notification_status(notification_id)
    headers = build_headers
    
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{base_url}/api/v1/notifications/#{notification_id}",
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_configuration
    required_vars = ['ACTION_APP_ID', 'ACTION_PARTNER_ID', 'ACTION_PRIVATE_KEY', 'ACTION_API_BASE_URL']
    missing_vars = required_vars.select { |var| ENV[var].nil? || ENV[var].empty? }
    
    unless missing_vars.empty?
      raise "Missing required environment variables: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    unless File.exist?(@private_key_path)
      raise "Private key file not found at: #{@private_key_path}"
    end
  end

  def build_payload(user_id, title, body, data = {})
    {
      notification: build_single_notification_payload(user_id, title, body, data)
    }
  end

  def build_single_notification_payload(user_id, title, body, data = {})
    {
      user_id: user_id,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data,
      app_id: app_id,
      # Додаткові параметри можна додати за потребою
      priority: data[:priority] || 'normal',
      ttl: data[:ttl] || 3600, # час життя сповіщення в секундах
      badge: data[:badge] || 1
    }
  end

  def build_headers
    token = generate_jwt_token
    
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'User-Agent' => "ActionPartnerApp/#{app_id}"
    }
  end

  def generate_jwt_token
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(@private_key_path))
    
    payload = {
      iss: partner_id,
      sub: app_id,
      aud: base_url,
      iat: Time.now.to_i,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300, # Токен дійсний 5 хвилин
      jti: SecureRandom.uuid
    }
    
    JWT.encode(payload, private_key, 'RS256')
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      raise "Bad Request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      raise "Unauthorized: Check your credentials"
    when 403
      raise "Forbidden: Insufficient permissions"
    when 404
      raise "Not Found: API endpoint not found"
    when 429
      raise "Rate Limit Exceeded: Too many requests"
    when 500..599
      raise "Server Error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'jwt'
require 'redis'
require 'dotenv/load'

class DiyaApiClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # Базовий URL API Дії
  base_uri 'https://api.diya.ua/partner/v1'
  
  def initialize(client_id: nil, client_secret: nil, redis_url: nil)
    @client_id = client_id || ENV['DIYA_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = client_secret || ENV['DIYA_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @redis = Redis.new(url: redis_url || ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')
    
    validate_credentials!
  end
  
  # Надсилання push-сповіщення
  def send_push_notification(user_ids, title, body, data = {})
    access_token = get_access_token
    
    payload = {
      user_ids: Array(user_ids),
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: data
    }
    
    options = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/notifications/push', options)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Масове надсилання сповіщень
  def send_bulk_notifications(notifications_batch)
    access_token = get_access_token
    
    payload = {
      notifications: notifications_batch
    }
    
    options = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/notifications/bulk', options)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу сповіщення
  def get_notification_status(notification_id)
    access_token = get_access_token
    
    options = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}"
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.get("/notifications/#{notification_id}/status", options)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def get_access_token
    # Перевіряємо чи є дійсний токен в кеші
    cached_token = @redis.get('diya_access_token')
    return cached_token if cached_token && !token_expired?(cached_token)
    
    # Якщо токен протух або відсутній, отримуємо новий
    new_token = fetch_new_access_token
    @redis.setex('diya_access_token', 3500, new_token) # Токен дійсний 1 годину
    new_token
  end
  
  def fetch_new_access_token
    payload = {
      client_id: @client_id,
      client_secret: @client_secret,
      grant_type: 'client_credentials'
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/auth/token', body: payload)
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response['access_token']
    else
      raise AuthenticationError, "Помилка автентифікації: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
  
  def token_expired?(token)
    begin
      decoded = JWT.decode(token, nil, false)
      exp = decoded.first['exp']
      return Time.now.to_i >= exp - 300 # Перевіряємо за 5 хвилин до справжнього expiry
    rescue JWT::DecodeError
      true
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      response.parsed_response
    when 401
      # Якщо токен недійсний, очищаємо кеш і пробуємо знову
      @redis.del('diya_access_token')
      raise AuthenticationError, "Неавторизований запит"
    when 400
      raise BadRequestError, "Невірний запит: #{response.parsed_response}"
    when 429
      raise RateLimitError, "Перевищено ліміт запитів"
    else
      raise ApiError, "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_credentials!
    if @client_id.nil? || @client_secret.nil?
      raise ConfigurationError, "Не вказано client_id або client_secret"
    end
  end
end

# Кастомні помилки
class DiyaApiError < StandardError; end
class AuthenticationError < DiyaApiError; end
class BadRequestError < DiyaApiError; end
class RateLimitError < DiyaApiError; end
class ApiError < DiyaApiError; end
class ConfigurationError < DiyaApiError; end

class NotificationService
  def initialize
    @diya_client = DiyaApiClient.new
  end
  
  # Надсилання одиночного сповіщення
  def send_single_notification(user_id, title, body, data = {})
    begin
      result = @diya_client.send_push_notification(user_id, title, body, data)
      log_notification(user_id, title, 'sent', result['notification_id'])
      result
    rescue DiyaApiError => e
      log_notification(user_id, title, 'failed', nil, e.message)
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  # Надсилання сповіщень групі користувачів
  def send_group_notification(user_ids, title, body, data = {})
    # Розбиваємо на батчі по 100 користувачів (якщо потрібно)
    user_ids.each_slice(100) do |batch|
      begin
        result = @diya_client.send_push_notification(batch, title, body, data)
        log_batch_notification(batch.size, title, 'sent', result['batch_id'])
      rescue DiyaApiError => e
        log_batch_notification(batch.size, title, 'failed', nil, e.message)
        # Можна продовжити відправку іншим батчам або зупинитись
        raise e if should_stop_on_error?
      end
    end
  end
  
  # Шаблонні сповіщення
  def send_welcome_notification(user_id)
    title = "Ласкаво просимо до Дії!"
    body = "Дякуємо за реєстрацію. Почати користуватись застосунком?"
    data = { type: 'welcome', action: 'open_app' }
    
    send_single_notification(user_id, title, body, data)
  end
  
  def send_reminder_notification(user_id, service_name)
    title = "Нагадування про послугу"
    body = "Не забудьте про #{service_name}. Термін дії скоро закінчується."
    data = { type: 'reminder', service: service_name, action: 'open_service' }
    
    send_single_notification(user_id, title, body, data)
  end
  
  private
  
  def log_notification(user_id, title, status, notification_id, error_message = nil)
    # Логування в базу даних або систему моніторингу
    puts "[Diya Notification] User: #{user_id}, Title: #{title}, Status: #{status}, ID: #{notification_id}, Error: #{error_message}"
  end
  
  def log_batch_notification(batch_size, title, status, batch_id, error_message = nil)
    puts "[Diya Batch Notification] Size: #{batch_size}, Title: #{title}, Status: #{status}, Batch ID: #{batch_id}, Error: #{error_message}"
  end
  
  def should_stop_on_error?
    # Логіка визначення чи зупиняти відправку при помилці
    false
  end
end

### 2. Main Diia Notification Service

```ruby
# lib/diia_notification_service.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'dotenv/load'

class DiiaNotificationService
  include HTTParty

  def initialize
    Dotenv.load
    @base_url = ENV['DIIA_API_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.diia.gov.ua'
    @partner_id = ENV['DIIA_PARTNER_ID']
    @client_id = ENV['DIIA_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['DIIA_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @certificate_path = ENV['DIIA_CERTIFICATE_PATH']
    @private_key_path = ENV['DIIA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH']
    
    validate_configuration
  end

  # Send push notification to a single user
  def send_notification(user_identifier, title, body, data = {})
    access_token = authenticate
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    payload = {
      userIdentifier: user_identifier,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/api/v1/notifications/push",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Send notification to multiple users
  def send_bulk_notifications(user_identifiers, title, body, data = {})
    access_token = authenticate
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    payload = {
      userIdentifiers: user_identifiers,
      title: title,
      body: body,
      data: data
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/api/v1/notifications/bulk-push",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get notification status
  def get_notification_status(notification_id)
    access_token = authenticate
    
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/api/v1/notifications/#{notification_id}/status",
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def authenticate
    # Diia API typically uses certificate-based authentication
    # This is a simplified version - actual implementation may vary
    # based on Diia's specific authentication requirements
    
    # Method 1: OAuth2 client credentials flow (if supported)
    if @client_id && @client_secret
      oauth_authenticate
    # Method 2: Certificate-based authentication
    elsif @certificate_path && File.exist?(@certificate_path)
      certificate_authenticate
    else
      raise 'No valid authentication method configured'
    end
  end

  def oauth_authenticate
    auth_payload = {
      client_id: @client_id,
      client_secret: @client_secret,
      grant_type: 'client_credentials'
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/api/v1/oauth/token",
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
      body: auth_payload.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def certificate_authenticate
    # Load certificate and private key
    certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(@certificate_path))
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(@private_key_path))

    # Create JWT token with certificate
    header = {
      alg: 'RS256',
      typ: 'JWT',
      x5c: [Base64.strict_encode64(certificate.to_der)]
    }

    payload = {
      iss: @partner_id,
      sub: @client_id,
      aud: @base_url,
      exp: Time.now.to_i + 300, # 5 minutes expiration
      iat: Time.now.to_i
    }

    jwt_token = create_jwt_token(header, payload, private_key)
    
    # Exchange JWT for access token
    token_response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/api/v1/auth/token",
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
      body: { assertion: jwt_token }.to_json
    )

    if token_response.success?
      JSON.parse(token_response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Certificate authentication failed: #{token_response.body}"
    end
  end

  def create_jwt_token(header, payload, private_key)
    encoded_header = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(header.to_json).delete('=')
    encoded_payload = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(payload.to_json).delete('=')
    
    signing_input = "#{encoded_header}.#{encoded_payload}"
    signature = private_key.sign(OpenSSL::Digest.new('SHA256'), signing_input)
    encoded_signature = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(signature).delete('=')
    
    "#{signing_input}.#{encoded_signature}"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      raise error_message
    end
  end

  def validate_configuration
    required_vars = ['DIIA_PARTNER_ID']
    missing_vars = required_vars.select { |var| ENV[var].nil? || ENV[var].empty? }
    
    unless missing_vars.empty?
      raise "Missing required environment variables: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# credit_card.rb
require 'active_model'

class CreditCard
  include ActiveModel::Model
  include ActiveModel::Validations

  attr_accessor :number

  validates :number, presence: true
  validate :valid_card_number
  validate :supported_card_system

  # Паттерни для визначення платіжних систем
  CARD_SYSTEMS = {
    visa: /^4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3})?$/,
    mastercard: /^5[1-5][0-9]{14}$/,
    amex: /^3[47][0-9]{13}$/,
    diners_club: /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68][0-9])[0-9]{11}$/,
    discover: /^6(?:011|5[0-9]{2})[0-9]{12}$/,
    jcb: /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}$/
  }.freeze

  # Алгоритм Луна для перевірки контрольної суми
  def luhn_valid?
    return false unless number && number.match?(/^\d+$/)

    digits = number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.odd?
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      else
        sum += digit
      end
    end

    sum % 10 == 0
  end

  # Визначення платіжної системи
  def card_system
    return nil unless number

    CARD_SYSTEMS.each do |system, pattern|
      return system.to_s if number.match?(pattern)
    end

    nil
  end

  def card_system_name
    system = card_system
    return nil unless system

    case system
    when 'visa' then 'Visa'
    when 'mastercard' then 'MasterCard'
    when 'amex' then 'American Express'
    when 'diners_club' then 'Diners Club'
    when 'discover' then 'Discover'
    when 'jcb' then 'JCB'
    else 'Unknown'
    end
  end

  private

  def valid_card_number
    return if number.blank?

    errors.add(:number, 'must contain only digits') unless number.match?(/^\d+$/)
    errors.add(:number, 'is invalid (Luhn check failed)') unless luhn_valid?
  end

  def supported_card_system
    return if number.blank? || errors[:number].any?

    errors.add(:number, 'has unsupported card system') if card_system.nil?
  end
end

class CoinbaseService
  def self.create_charge(order, metadata = {})
    client = Coinbase::Commerce::Client.new
    
    charge_data = {
      name: "Замовлення ##{order.id}",
      description: "Оплата за замовлення #{order.id}",
      pricing_type: "fixed_price",
      local_price: {
        amount: order.amount.to_s,
        currency: order.currency
      },
      metadata: metadata.merge(order_id: order.id)
    }
    
    response = client.charge.create(charge_data)
    
    if response.success?
      charge = response.data
      order.update!(
        coinbase_charge_id: charge['id'],
        payment_url: charge['hosted_url'],
        coinbase_code: charge['code']
      )
      charge
    else
      raise "Помилка створення платежу: #{response.error}"
    end
  end
  
  def self.get_charge(charge_id)
    client = Coinbase::Commerce::Client.new
    response = client.charge.get(charge_id)
    response.success? ? response.data : nil
  end

        ], cell_style: { borders: [] })
      end

      pdf.move_down 10

      pdf.bounding_box([0, pdf.cursor], width: pdf.bounds.width) do
        pdf.table([
          ["Отримувач:", @client_info[:name]],
          ["Адреса:", @client_info[:address]],
          ["ЄДРПОУ:", @client_info[:edrpou]]
        ], cell_style: { borders: [] })
      end

      pdf.move_down 20

      # Деталі рахунка
      pdf.table([
        ["Номер рахунку:", @invoice_data[:invoice_number]],
        ["Дата виставлення:", @invoice_data[:invoice_date]],
        ["Термін оплати:", @invoice_data[:due_date]]
      ], cell_style: { borders: [] })

      pdf.move_down 30

      # Таблиця позицій
      pdf.text "Позиції:", size: 14, style: :bold
      pdf.move_down 10

      items_table_data = [["№", "Опис", "Кількість", "Ціна", "Сума"]]
      
      @invoice_data[:items].each_with_index do |item, index|
        items_table_data << [
          index + 1,
          item[:description],
          item[:quantity],
          format_price(item[:price]),
          format_price(item[:quantity] * item[:price])
        ]
      end

      pdf.table(items_table_data, header: true, width: pdf.bounds.width) do |table|
        table.row(0).style(background_color: 'EEEEEE', font_style: :bold)
        table.columns(2..4).align = :right
      end

      pdf.move_down 20

      # Підсумки та ПДВ
      subtotal = calculate_subtotal
      vat_amount = calculate_vat(subtotal)
      total = subtotal + vat_amount

      pdf.table([
        ["Загальна сума:", format_price(subtotal)],
        ["ПДВ (#{@invoice_data[:vat_rate]}%):", format_price(vat_amount)],
        ["До сплати:", format_price(total)]
      ], width: 200, position: :right) do |table|
        table.columns(1).align = :right
        table.row(2).style(font_style: :bold)
      end

      # Підпис
      pdf.move_down 40
      pdf.text "Підпис: ___________________", align: :right

      # Низ сторінки
      pdf.repeat(:all) do
        pdf.bounding_box([pdf.bounds.left, pdf.bounds.bottom + 25], width: pdf.bounds.width) do
          pdf.stroke_horizontal_rule
          pdf.move_down 5
          pdf.text @company_info[:footer_note], size: 8, align: :center
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def calculate_subtotal
    @invoice_data[:items].sum { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:price] }
  end

  def calculate_vat(amount)
    amount * (@invoice_data[:vat_rate] / 100.0)
  end

  def format_price(amount)
    "%.2f грн" % amount
  end
end

class CreditCardValidator
  # Визначення платіжних систем за префіксами та довжинами карток
  PAYMENT_SYSTEMS = {
    visa: {
      prefixes: ['4'],
      lengths: [13, 16, 19]
    },
    mastercard: {
      prefixes: ['51', '52', '53', '54', '55', '2221', '2720'],
      lengths: [16]
    },
    american_express: {
      prefixes: ['34', '37'],
      lengths: [15]
    },
    discover: {
      prefixes: ['6011', '622126', '622925', '644', '645', '646', '647', '648', '649', '65'],
      lengths: [16, 19]
    },
    mir: {
      prefixes: ['2200', '2201', '2202', '2203', '2204'],
      lengths: [16, 17, 18, 19]
    }
  }.freeze

  def initialize(card_number)
    @card_number = card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Видаляємо пробіли
  end

  # Перевірка алгоритмом Луна
  def valid?
    return false unless @card_number.match?(/\A\d{13,19}\z/)
    
    digits = @card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.even?
        sum += digit
      else
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      end
    end
    
    sum % 10 == 0
  end

  # Визначення платіжної системи
  def payment_system
    PAYMENT_SYSTEMS.each do |system, rules|
      prefix_match = rules[:prefixes].any? { |prefix| @card_number.start_with?(prefix) }
      length_match = rules[:lengths].include?(@card_number.length)
      
      return system.to_s.capitalize if prefix_match && length_match
    end
    
    'Unknown'
  end

  # Повна перевірка картки
  def validate
    {
      card_number: @card_number,
      valid: valid?,
      payment_system: payment_system,
      length: @card_number.length
    }
  end

  # Статичний метод для швидкої перевірки
  def self.validate(card_number)
    new(card_number).validate
  end
end

require 'coinbase/commerce'

class CoinbaseService
  def initialize(api_key = ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_API_KEY'])
    @client = Coinbase::Commerce::Client.new(api_key: api_key)
  end

  def create_charge(order, metadata = {})
    charge_data = {
      name: order.description || "Order ##{order.order_id}",
      description: "Payment for order #{order.order_id}",
      pricing_type: 'fixed_price',
      local_price: {
        amount: order.amount.to_s,
        currency: order.currency
      },
      metadata: metadata.merge(order_id: order.order_id)
    }

    charge = @client.charge.create(charge_data)
    
    # Update order with charge ID
    order.update(charge_id: charge['id'])
    
    charge
  rescue Coinbase::Commerce::Errors::BaseError => e
    raise "Coinbase Commerce Error: #{e.message}"
  end

  def get_charge(charge_id)
    @client.charge.get(charge_id)
  rescue Coinbase::Commerce::Errors::BaseError => e
    raise "Coinbase Commerce Error: #{e.message}"
  end

  def verify_webhook_signature(request_body, signature_header, webhook_secret)

# webhooks/coinbase_webhook.rb
require 'json'
require 'sinatra'

class CoinbaseWebhook < Sinatra::Base
  set :protection, except: [:json_csrf]

  post '/webhook/coinbase' do
    # Get the raw request body
    request_body = request.body.read
    signature_header = request.env['HTTP_X_CC_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE']
    webhook_secret = ENV['COINBASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET']

    begin
      # Verify webhook signature
      coinbase_service = CoinbaseService.new
      coinbase_service.verify_webhook_signature(request_body, signature_header, webhook_secret)

      # Parse the webhook data
      event_data = JSON.parse(request_body)
      event_type = event_data['type']
      charge_data = event_data['data']

      # Handle charge confirmed event
      if event_type == 'charge:confirmed'
        handle_charge_confirmed(charge_data)
      end

      status 200
      { status: 'success' }.to_json
    rescue Coinbase::Commerce::Errors::SignatureError => e
      status 401
      { error: 'Invalid signature' }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 400
      { error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_charge_confirmed(charge_data)
    charge_id = charge_data['id']
    metadata = charge_data['metadata'] || {}

    # Find order by charge ID or order ID from metadata
    order = if metadata['order_id']
              Order.first(order_id: metadata['order_id'])
            else
              Order.first(charge_id: charge_id)
            end

    if order && order.pending?
      order.mark_as_paid!
      puts "Order #{order.order_id} marked as paid!"
      
      # Add your custom logic here (send email notification, update inventory, etc.)
      # Example: send_payment_confirmation_email(order)
    end
  end
end

# controllers/payment_controller.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class PaymentController < Sinatra::Base
  set :protection, except: [:json_csrf]

  post '/create-payment' do
    content_type :json

    begin
      data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      
      # Validate required fields
      required_fields = ['order_id', 'amount', 'customer_email']
      missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| data[field].nil? || data[field].empty? }
      
      if missing_fields.any?
        status 400
        return { error: "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" }.to_json
      end

      # Create order in database
      order = Order.create_order(
        order_id: data['order_id'],
        customer_email: data['customer_email'],
        amount: data['amount'],
        currency: data['currency'] || 'USD',
        description: data['description']
      )

      # Create Coinbase Commerce charge
      coinbase_service = CoinbaseService.new
      charge = coinbase_service.create_charge(order, data['metadata'] || {})

      {
        charge_id: charge['id'],
        checkout_url: charge['hosted_url'],
        order_id: order.order_id,
        status: 'pending'
      }.to_json

    rescue => e
      status 500
      { error: "Payment creation failed: #{e.message}" }.to_json
    end
  end

  get '/order/:order_id/status' do
    content_type :json

    order = Order.first(order_id: params[:order_id])
    
    if order
      {
        order_id: order.order_id,
        status: order.status,
        charge_id: order.charge_id,
        amount: order.amount,
        created_at: order.created_at
      }.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end
  end
end
