require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'date'

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    raise "API key not found. Please set ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY environment variable" unless @api_key
  end

  def fetch_historical_prices(ticker, days = 100)
    # Fetch more days than needed to ensure we have enough data for the moving average
    response = HTTParty.get(ALPHA_VANTAGE_BASE_URL, query: {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: ticker,
      apikey: @api_key,
      outputsize: days > 100 ? 'full' : 'compact'
    })

    if response.success?
      data = response.parsed_response
      
      if data['Error Message']
        raise "API Error: #{data['Error Message']}"
      elsif data['Note']
        raise "API Limit: #{data['Note']}"
      elsif data['Time Series (Daily)']
        return parse_historical_data(data['Time Series (Daily)'])
      else
        raise "Unexpected response format"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(prices, period = 20)
    return [] if prices.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    prices.each_cons(period) do |window|
      average = window.sum / period.to_f
      moving_averages << average.round(2)
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

  def analyze_stock(ticker, period = 20)
    puts "Fetching historical prices for #{ticker}..."
    
    begin
      # Fetch prices (most recent first)
      historical_prices = fetch_historical_prices(ticker, period + 10)
      
      if historical_prices.empty?
        puts "No data available for #{ticker}"
        return
      end
      
      # Extract closing prices (already in chronological order from parse_historical_data)
      closing_prices = historical_prices.map { |date_price| date_price[:close] }
      
      # Calculate moving average
      moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(closing_prices, period)
      
      # Display results
      display_results(historical_prices, moving_averages, period)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_historical_data(time_series_data)
    # Convert to array of hashes and sort by date (oldest first for moving average calculation)
    time_series_data.map do |date, values|
      {
        date: Date.parse(date),
        open: values['1. open'].to_f,
        high: values['2. high'].to_f,
        low: values['3. low'].to_f,
        close: values['4. close'].to_f,
        volume: values['5. volume'].to_i
      }
    end.sort_by { |entry| entry[:date] }
  end

  def display_results(historical_prices, moving_averages, period)
    puts "\n#{'-' * 60}"
    puts "Stock Analysis Results"
    puts "#{'-' * 60}"
    
    # Display most recent prices with moving averages
    puts "\nMost recent #{period} days (with moving averages):"
    puts "Date\t\tClose Price\t#{period}-Day MA"
    puts "#{'-' * 40}"
    
    # The moving averages start from the period-th day
    historical_prices.last(moving_averages.length).each_with_index do |price_data, index|
      ma_value = moving_averages[index]
      puts "#{price_data[:date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}\t$#{price_data[:close]}\t$#{ma_value}"
    end
    
    # Display summary
    latest_price = historical_prices.last[:close]
    latest_ma = moving_averages.last
    
    puts "\nSummary:"
    puts "Latest Price: $#{latest_price}"
    puts "#{period}-Day Moving Average: $#{latest_ma}"
    
    if latest_price > latest_ma
      puts "Status: Price is ABOVE moving average (Bullish)"
    elsif latest_price < latest_ma
      puts "Status: Price is BELOW moving average (Bearish)"
    else
      puts "Status: Price is AT moving average"
    end
  end

```ruby
# stock_moving_average.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'
require 'active_support/core_ext/numeric' # for rounding methods

class StockAnalyzer
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end
  
  def fetch_historical_prices(ticker, output_size: 'compact')
    params = {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: ticker,
      outputsize: output_size,
      apikey: @api_key
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, query: params)
    
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if data['Error Message']
        raise "API Error: #{data['Error Message']}"
      elsif data['Note']
        raise "API Limit Note: #{data['Note']}"
      elsif data['Time Series (Daily)']
        return parse_historical_data(data['Time Series (Daily)'])
      else
        raise "Unexpected API response: #{data}"
      end
    else
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def calculate_moving_average(prices, period = 20)
    # Ensure we have enough data points
    if prices.length < period
      raise "Not enough data points. Need at least #{period}, but got #{prices.length}"
    end
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    prices.each_with_index do |(date, price_data), index|
      if index >= period - 1
        # Calculate average for the previous 'period' days including current day
        window = prices[(index - period + 1)..index]
        average = window.sum { |_, data| data[:close] } / period.to_f
        moving_averages << {
          date: date,
          close_price: price_data[:close],
          moving_average: average.round(4),
          period: period
        }
      end
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end
  
  def analyze_stock(ticker, period: 20, output_size: 'compact')
    puts "Fetching historical prices for #{ticker}..."
    
    prices = fetch_historical_prices(ticker, output_size: output_size)
    puts "Retrieved #{prices.length} days of data"
    
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, period)
    
    {
      ticker: ticker,
      prices: prices,
      moving_averages: moving_averages,
      latest_price: prices.first[1][:close],
      latest_moving_average: moving_averages.first[:moving_average]
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_historical_data(time_series)
    # Convert the API response to a sorted array of [date, price_data]
    # Sort by date in descending order (most recent first)
    time_series.map do |date, data|
      [
        date,
        {
          open: data['1. open'].to_f,
          high: data['2. high'].to_f,
          low: data['3. low'].to_f,
          close: data['4. close'].to_f,
          volume: data['5. volume'].to_i
        }
      ]
    end.sort_by { |date, _| Date.parse(date) }.reverse
  end
end

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  def initialize(api_key: nil)

    end

  def get_stock_data(ticker, days: 100)
    begin
      stock = @client.stock(symbol: ticker)
      timeseries = stock.timeseries(type: "daily", outputsize: "full")
      
      # Отримуємо дані та обмежуємо кількість днів
      data = timeseries.chart.last(days)
      
      # Сортуємо за датою (від найстарішої до найновішої)
      sorted_data = data.sort_by { |point| Date.parse(point[0]) }
      
      sorted_data.map do |date, values|
        {
          date: date,
          open: values["1. open"].to_f,
          high: values["2. high"].to_f,
          low: values["3. low"].to_f,
          close: values["4. close"].to_f,
          volume: values["5. volume"].to_i
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні даних: #{e.message}"
      []
    end
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(stock_data, period: 20)
    return [] if stock_data.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    stock_data.each_with_index do |data_point, index|
      if index >= period - 1
        # Беремо закриті ціни за останні `period` днів
        prices = stock_data[(index - period + 1)..index].map { |d| d[:close] }
        average = prices.sum / period.to_f
        moving_averages << {
          date: data_point[:date],
          close_price: data_point[:close],
          moving_average: average.round(4),
          period: period
        }
      else
        moving_averages << {
          date: data_point[:date],
          close_price: data_point[:close],
          moving_average: nil,
          period: period
        }
      end
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

  def analyze_stock(ticker, period: 20, days: 100)

    stock_data = get_stock_data(ticker, days: days + period - 1)
    
    if stock_data.empty?
      puts "Не вдалося отримати дані для #{ticker}"
      return
    end
    
    puts "Розрахунок #{period}-денного ковзного середнього..."
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(stock_data, period: period)
    
    # Виводимо результати
    puts "\nРезультати для #{ticker}:"
    puts "=" * 80
    puts "Дата\t\tЦіна закриття\t#{period}-денне ковзне середнє"
    puts "-" * 80
    
    # Показуємо тільки останні 30 днів для зручності перегляду
    moving_averages.last(30).each do |result|
      ma_display = result[:moving_average] ? sprintf("%.2f", result[:moving_average]) : "N/A"
      puts "#{result[:date]}\t#{sprintf("%.2f", result[:close_price])}\t\t#{ma_display}"

# invoice_exporter.rb
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'oauth2'
require 'dotenv'
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

# Database setup (assuming you have an invoices table)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'db/invoices.db'
)

# Invoice model
class Invoice < ActiveRecord::Base
  enum status: { draft: 0, paid: 1, exported: 2 }
  
  validates :amount, :customer_name, :invoice_date, presence: true
end

# QuickBooks Online Service
class QuickBooksExporter
  def initialize
    @client = Quickbooks::Client.new(
      consumer_key: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_KEY'],
      consumer_secret: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_SECRET'],
      token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      token_secret: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET'],
      realm_id: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID'],
      sandbox: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_SANDBOX'] == 'true'
    )
  end

  def export_paid_invoices
    paid_invoices = Invoice.paid.where(exported_to_qb: false)
    
    if paid_invoices.empty?
      puts "No paid invoices to export."
      return []
    end

    exported_invoices = []
    
    paid_invoices.each do |invoice|
      begin
        qb_invoice = create_quickbooks_invoice(invoice)
        invoice.update!(
          exported_to_qb: true,
          status: :exported,
          qb_invoice_id: qb_invoice.id,
          exported_at: Time.current
        )
        
        exported_invoices << invoice
        puts "Successfully exported invoice ##{invoice.id} to QuickBooks (ID: #{qb_invoice.id})"
        
      rescue StandardError => e
        puts "Failed to export invoice ##{invoice.id}: #{e.message}"
        # Log the error for later review
        log_error(invoice, e)
      end
    end
    
    exported_invoices
  end

  private

  def create_quickbooks_invoice(invoice)
    # Find or create customer in QuickBooks
    customer = find_or_create_customer(invoice.customer_name, invoice.customer_email)
    
    # Create line items
    line_items = [{
      detail_type: 'SalesItemLineDetail',
      amount: invoice.amount,
      description: invoice.description || "Invoice ##{invoice.id}",
      sales_item_line_detail: {
        item_id: find_or_create_service_item.id
      }
    }]

    # Create the invoice in QuickBooks
    qb_invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    qb_invoice.customer_id = customer.id
    qb_invoice.txn_date = invoice.invoice_date
    qb_invoice.due_date = invoice.due_date || invoice.invoice_date + 30.days
    qb_invoice.line_items = line_items
    qb_invoice.doc_number = invoice.invoice_number || "INV-#{invoice.id}"
    
    @client.create(qb_invoice)
  end

  def find_or_create_customer(name, email = nil)
    # Try to find existing customer
    customers = @client.query("SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE DisplayName = '#{name}'")
    return customers.first if customers.any?

    # Create new customer if not found
    customer = Quickbooks::Model::Customer.new
    customer.display_name = name
    customer.email_address = email if email
    customer.primary_phone = Quickbooks::Model::TelephoneNumber.new
    customer.primary_phone.free_form_number = ''

    @client.create(customer)
  end

  def find_or_create_service_item
    # Try to find existing service item
    items = @client.query("SELECT * FROM Item WHERE Type = 'Service' AND Name = 'General Service'")
    return items.first if items.any?

    # Create new service item if not found
    item = Quickbooks::Model::Item.new
    item.name = 'General Service'
    item.type = 'Service'
    item.income_account_ref = find_income_account.id

    @client.create(item)
  end

  def find_income_account
    # Find the first income account
    accounts = @client.query("SELECT * FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Income'")
    accounts.first || raise("No income account found in QuickBooks")
  end

  def log_error(invoice, error)
    # Implement your error logging here
    # This could write to a log file, send to error tracking service, etc.
    error_message = <<~ERROR
      Failed to export invoice ##{invoice.id} to QuickBooks:
      Error: #{error.message}
      Time: #{Time.current}
      Invoice Details: #{invoice.attributes}
    ERROR
    
    File.open('logs/export_errors.log', 'a') { |f| f.puts(error_message) }
  end
end

# OAuth2 Authentication Helper (for initial setup)
class QuickBooksAuth
  def initialize
    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_KEY'],
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_SECRET'],
      site: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com',
      authorize_url: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2',
      token_url: 'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer'
    )
  end

  def authorization_url
    @client.auth_code.authorize_url(
      redirect_uri: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI'],
      scope: 'com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting',
      state: SecureRandom.hex(16)
    )
  end

  def get_token(authorization_code)
    @client.auth_code.get_token(
      authorization_code,
      redirect_uri: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI']
    )
  end
end

# Main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    exporter = QuickBooksExporter.new
    exported = exporter.export_paid_invoices
    
    puts "Export completed. #{exported.size} invoices exported successfully."
    
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Export failed: #{e.message}"
    puts e.backtrace.join("\n")
  end
end

```ruby
# quickbooks_invoice_exporter.rb
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'oauth2'
require 'dotenv'
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

# Database setup for storing invoice records
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'invoices.db'
)

# Invoice model to track payment status
class Invoice < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :invoice_number, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  
  scope :paid, -> { where(paid: true) }
  scope :not_exported, -> { where(exported_to_qb: false) }
end

# Create invoices table if it doesn't exist
unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?(:invoices)
  ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :invoices do |t|
    t.string :invoice_number, null: false
    t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2, null: false
    t.boolean :paid, default: false
    t.boolean :exported_to_qb, default: false
    t.datetime :paid_at
    t.text :customer_info
    t.text :line_items
    t.timestamps
  end
end

class QuickBooksInvoiceExporter
  def initialize
    @client = Quickbooks::Client.new(
      consumer_key: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_KEY'],
      consumer_secret: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_SECRET'],
      token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      token_secret: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET'],
      realm_id: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    )
  end

  # Find invoices that are paid but not yet exported to QuickBooks
  def find_paid_invoices_to_export
    Invoice.paid.not_exported
  end

  # Convert our invoice format to QuickBooks invoice format
  def convert_to_qb_invoice(invoice)
    customer_info = JSON.parse(invoice.customer_info || '{}')
    line_items = JSON.parse(invoice.line_items || '[]')
    
    qb_invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    qb_invoice.customer_id = customer_info['qb_customer_id']
    qb_invoice.txn_date = invoice.paid_at || Date.today
    
    # Add line items
    line_items.each do |item|
      line = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
      line.amount = item['amount']
      line.description = item['description']
      
      sales_line_item = Quickbooks::Model::SalesItemLineDetail.new
      sales_line_item.item_id = item['qb_item_id']
      sales_line_item.unit_price = item['unit_price']
      sales_line_item.quantity = item['quantity']
      
      line.sales_item_line_detail = sales_line_item
      qb_invoice.line_items << line
    end

    qb_invoice
  end

  # Export a single invoice to QuickBooks
  def export_invoice(invoice)
    begin
      qb_invoice = convert_to_qb_invoice(invoice)
      created_invoice = @client.create(qb_invoice)
      
      # Mark as exported
      invoice.update(
        exported_to_qb: true,
        qb_invoice_id: created_invoice.id,
        exported_at: Time.current
      )
      
      puts "Successfully exported invoice #{invoice.invoice_number} to QuickBooks (ID: #{created_invoice.id})"
      return true
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error exporting invoice #{invoice.invoice_number}: #{e.message}"
      return false
    end
  end

  # Batch export all paid invoices
  def export_all_paid_invoices
    invoices = find_paid_invoices_to_export
    
    if invoices.empty?
      puts "No paid invoices to export."
      return
    end
    
    puts "Found #{invoices.count} paid invoices to export..."
    
    success_count = 0
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      success_count += 1 if export_invoice(invoice)
    end
    
    puts "Export completed: #{success_count}/#{invoices.count} invoices successfully exported."
  end

  # Method to mark an invoice as paid (for testing/demo purposes)
  def mark_invoice_as_paid(invoice_number, paid_at: Time.current)
    invoice = Invoice.find_by(invoice_number: invoice_number)
    if invoice
      invoice.update(paid: true, paid_at: paid_at)
      puts "Marked invoice #{invoice_number} as paid."
    else
      puts "Invoice #{invoice_number} not found."
    end
  end
end

# Example usage and helper methods

end

      end

      # Оновлюємо статус експорту в нашій системі
      mark_invoice_exported(invoice_data[:id])
      
      puts "Інвойс #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]} успішно експортовано в QuickBooks"
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Помилка при експорті інвойсу #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def initialize_quickbooks_client
    Quickbooks.sandbox_mode = false # Використовуйте true для тестового режиму

    access_token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      OAuth2::Client.new(
        ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID'],
        ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET'],
        site: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com',
        authorize_url: 'https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2',
        token_url: 'https://oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer'
      ),
      ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      refresh_token: ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    )

    Quickbooks::Service::BaseService.configure do |config|
      config.access_token = access_token
      config.realm_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    end

    Quickbooks::Service::BaseService.new
  end

  def create_qb_invoice(invoice_data)
    invoice_service = Quickbooks::Service::Invoice.new
    invoice_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    
    invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    invoice.doc_number = invoice_data[:invoice_number]
    invoice.txn_date = Date.parse(invoice_data[:invoice_date])
    invoice.due_date = Date.parse(invoice_data[:due_date])
    
    # Додаємо клієнта
    customer_ref = Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new(invoice_data[:customer_qb_id])
    invoice.customer_ref = customer_ref
    
    # Додаємо товари/послуги
    invoice_data[:line_items].each do |item|
      line_item = Quickbooks::Model::InvoiceLineItem.new
      line_item.amount = item[:amount]
      line_item.description = item[:description]
      
      item_ref = Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new(item[:item_qb_id])
      line_item.sales_item! do |detail|
        detail.item_ref = item_ref
        detail.quantity = item[:quantity]
        detail.unit_price = item[:unit_price]
      end
      
      invoice.line_items << line_item
    end
    
    invoice.total = invoice_data[:total_amount]
    
    invoice_service.create(invoice)
  end

  def create_payment(invoice, invoice_data)
    payment_service = Quickbooks::Service::Payment.new
    payment_service.company_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    
    payment = Quickbooks::Model::Payment.new
    payment.customer_ref = Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new(invoice_data[:customer_qb_id])
    payment.total_amount = invoice_data[:payment_amount]
    payment.txn_date = Date.parse(invoice_data[:payment_date])
    
    # Додаємо посилання на інвойс
    payment_line = Quickbooks::Model::Line.new
    payment_line.amount = invoice_data[:payment_amount]
    payment_line.linked_transactions << Quickbooks::Model::LinkedTransaction.new(
      txn_id: invoice.id,
      txn_type: 'Invoice'
    )
    
    payment.line_items << payment_line
    
    payment_service.create(payment)
  end

  def mark_invoice_exported(invoice_id)
    # Тут має бути логіка оновлення статусу в вашій базі даних
    # Наприклад:
    # Invoice.find(invoice_id).update(exported_to_qb: true, exported_at: Time.current)
    puts "Інвойс #{invoice_id} позначено як експортований"
  end
end

# stock_analyzer.rb
require 'alphavantage'
require 'dotenv'
require 'date'

Dotenv.load

class StockAnalyzer
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY']
    validate_api_key!
    
    Alphavantage.configure do |config|
      config.api_key = @api_key
    end
  end

  def get_stock_data(ticker, timeframe: "daily", output_size: "compact")
    begin
      client = Alphavantage::Stock.new(symbol: ticker)
      
      case timeframe
      when "daily"
        timeseries = client.timeseries(type: output_size)
      when "weekly"
        timeseries = client.timeseries(type: "weekly", outputsize: output_size)
      when "monthly"
        timeseries = client.timeseries(type: "monthly", outputsize: output_size)
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Невірний timeframe. Дозволені значення: daily, weekly, monthly"
      end
      
      timeseries
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні даних: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def calculate_moving_average(ticker, period: 20, timeframe: "daily")
    puts "Отримання даних для #{ticker}..."
    
    stock_data = get_stock_data(ticker, timeframe: timeframe, output_size: "full")
    return unless stock_data
    
    # Отримуємо масив цін закриття
    closing_prices = extract_closing_prices(stock_data)
    
    # Обчислюємо ковзне середнє
    moving_averages = calculate_sma(closing_prices, period)
    
    display_results(ticker, closing_prices, moving_averages, period)
    
    { prices: closing_prices, moving_averages: moving_averages }
  end

  private

  def validate_api_key!
    unless @api_key
      raise ArgumentError, "API ключ не знайдено. 
        Встановіть ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY у змінні середовища або передайте як аргумент.
        Отримати ключ можна на https://www.alphavantage.com/support/#api-key"
    end
  end

  def extract_closing_prices(stock_data)
    # Сортуємо за датою (від найновіших до найстаріших)
    sorted_data = stock_data.hash["Time Series (#{stock_data.output["Time Series"] ? 'Daily' : stock_data.output["Meta Data"]["3. Last Refreshed"].include?(':') ? 'Intraday' : 'Daily'})"]
      .to_a
      .sort_by { |date, _| Date.parse(date) }
      .reverse
    
    sorted_data.map { |date, values| values["4. close"].to_f }
  end

  def calculate_sma(prices, period)
    return [] if prices.length < period
    
    moving_averages = []
    
    (period - 1).upto(prices.length - 1) do |i|
      window = prices[(i - period + 1)..i]
      average = window.sum / period
      moving_averages << average.round(2)
    end
    
    moving_averages
  end

  def display_results(ticker, prices, moving_averages, period)
    puts "\n" + "="*60
    puts "Аналіз акцій #{ticker}"
    puts "="*60
    puts "Період аналізу: #{period} днів"
    puts "Кількість доступних точок даних: #{prices.length}"
    puts "Кількість розрахованих ковзних середніх: #{moving_averages.length}"
    puts "\nОстанні 10 значень ковзного середнього:"
    puts "-"*40
    
    moving_averages.last(10).each_with_index do |ma, index|
      puts "#{index + 1}. #{ma}"
    end
    
    if moving_averages.any?
      current_price = prices.last
      current_ma = moving_averages.last
      trend = current_price > current_ma ? "вище" : "нижче"
      
      puts "\nПоточна ціна: #{current_price}"
      puts "Поточне #{period}-денне ковзне середнє: #{current_ma}"
      puts "Ціна знаходиться #{trend} за ковзним середнім"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# advanced_stock_analysis.rb
require_relative 'stock_analyzer'

class AdvancedStockAnalysis < StockAnalyzer
  def analyze_multiple_periods(ticker, periods: [10, 20, 50])
    puts "Аналіз ковзних середніх для #{ticker} за періодами: #{periods.join(', ')}"
    
    stock_data = get_stock_data(ticker)
    return unless stock_data
    
    closing_prices = extract_closing_prices(stock_data)
    
    results = {}
    periods.each do |period|
      results[period] = calculate_sma(closing_prices, period)
    end
    
    display_multiple_ma_results(ticker, closing_prices, results)
    results
  end
  
  def crossover_analysis(ticker, short_period: 10, long_period: 20)
    puts "Аналіз перетинів ковзних середніх для #{ticker}"
    puts "Короткий період: #{short_period}, Довгий період: #{long_period}"
    
    stock_data = get_stock_data(ticker, output_size: "full")
    return unless stock_data
    
    closing_prices = extract_closing_prices(stock_data)
    short_ma = calculate_sma(closing_prices, short_period)
    long_ma = calculate_sma(closing_prices, long_period)
    
    # Аналізуємо перетини
    analyze_crossovers(short_ma, long_ma, closing_prices, short_period, long_period)
  end
  
  private
  
  def display_multiple_ma_results(ticker, prices, results)
    puts "\n" + "="*60
    puts "Багатоперіодний аналіз для #{ticker}"
    puts "="*60
    
    results.each do |period, ma_values|
      next if ma_values.empty?
      
      current_ma = ma_values.last
      current_price = prices.last
      position = current_price > current_ma ? "вище" : "нижче"
      
      puts "#{period}-денне ковзне середнє: #{current_ma} (ціна #{position} MA)"
    end
  end
  
  def analyze_crossovers(short_ma, long_ma, prices, short_period, long_period)
    return if short_ma.empty? || long_ma.empty?
    
    # Вирівнюємо масиви за довжиною
    min_length = [short_ma.length, long_ma.length].min
    aligned_short = short_ma.last(min_length)
    aligned_long = long_ma.last(min_length)
    
    crossovers = []
    (1...min_length).each do |i|
      prev_short = aligned_short[i-1]
      prev_long = aligned_long[i-1]
      curr_short = aligned_short[i]
      curr_long = aligned_long[i]
      
      # Перетин знизу вгору (buy signal)
      if prev_short <= prev_long && curr_short > curr_long
        crossovers << { type: :bullish, index: i }
      # Перетин зверху вниз (sell signal)
      elsif prev_short >= prev_long && curr_short < curr_long
        crossovers << { type: :bearish, index: i }
      end
    end
    
    puts "\nЗнайдено перетинів: #{crossovers.length}"
    crossovers.last(5).each do |crossover|
      type_str = crossover[:type] == :bullish ? "БИЧИЙ" : "ВЕДМЕЖИЙ"
      puts "#{type_str} перетин на позиції #{crossover[:index]}"
    end
    
    crossovers
  end
end

Environment Configuration (.env) ```bash # .env LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY=your_public_key_here LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key_here LIQPAY_SANDBOX_MODE=true ``` ## LiqPay Service Class ```ruby # app/services/liqpay_service.rb class LiqPayService def initialize @liqpay = LiqPay.new( public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'], private_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'], sandbox: ENV['LIQPAY_SANDBOX_MODE'] == 'true' ) end # Generate payment form data def generate_payment(order_id, amount, currency, description, return_url, server_url) payment_params = { action: 'pay', amount: amount, currency: currency, description: description, order_id: order_id, version: '3', sandbox: ENV['LIQPAY_SANDBOX_MODE'] == 'true' ? 1 : 0, result_url: return_url, server_url: server_url } { data: Base64.strict_encode64(payment_params.to_json), signature: @liqpay.str_to_sign( @liqpay.private_key + payment_params.to_json + @liqpay.private_key ) } end # Verify callback signature def valid_signature?(data, signature) expected_signature = LiqPay.new( public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'], private_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'] ).str_to_sign(ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'] + data + ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']) expected_signature == signature end # Decode callback data def decode_callback_data(data) JSON.parse(Base64.decode64(data)) end # Check payment status def check_payment_status(order_id) @liqpay.api('request', { action: 'status', version: '3', order_id: order_id }) end end ``` ## Payments Controller ```ruby # app/controllers/payments_controller.rb class PaymentsController < ApplicationController before_action :set_liqpay_service, only: [:new, :create, :callback, :success, :failure] def new # Typically you'd load an order here @order = { id: generate_order_id, amount: 100.00, # Example amount currency: 'USD', description: 'Product purchase' } end def create @liqpay_service = LiqPayService.new payment_data = @liqpay_service.generate_payment( params[:order_id], params[:amount], params[:currency], params[:description], success_payment_url, # URL to redirect after payment callback_payment_url # Server callback URL ) render json: payment_data end # LiqPay server callback (POST request from LiqPay) def callback data = params[:data] signature = params[:signature] # Verify signature first unless @liqpay_service.valid_signature?(data, signature) Rails.logger.error "Invalid LiqPay signature: #{signature}" head :unprocessable_entity return end # Decode and process the callback data callback_data = @liqpay_service.decode_callback_data(data) # Process the payment result process_payment_callback(callback_data) # LiqPay expects 200 OK response head :ok end # Client redirect after successful payment def success data = params[:data] signature = params[:signature] if @liqpay_service.valid_signature?(data, signature) callback_data = @liqpay_service.decode_callback_data(data) # Update order status and show success message @order = find_order(callback_data['order_id']) if @order && callback_data['status'] == 'success' # Payment successful logic flash[:success] = 'Payment completed successfully!' else flash[:error] = 'Payment failed. Please try again.' redirect_to failure_payment_path and return end else flash[:error] = 'Invalid payment response.' redirect_to failure_payment_path end end # Client redirect after failed payment def failure flash[:error] = 'Payment was cancelled or failed.' # Handle failed payment logic end private def set_liqpay_service @liqpay_service = LiqPayService.new end def process_payment_callback(callback_data) order_id = callback_data['order_id'] status = callback_data['status'] amount = callback_data['amount'] currency = callback_data['currency'] transaction_id = callback_data['transaction_id'] # Find and update the order order = find_order(order_id) return unless order case status when 'success' order.update!( payment_status: 'completed', transaction_id: transaction_id, paid_at: Time.current ) # Additional success logic (send emails, etc.) when 'failure', 'error' order.update!(payment_status: 'failed') # Handle failure logic when 'wait_accept' order.update!(payment_status: 'pending') # Handle pending status end Rails.logger.info "Payment callback processed: Order #{order_id} - Status: #{status}" end def find_order(order_id) # Implement your order lookup logic # Example: Order.find_by(id: order_id) # For demo purposes, returning a hash { id: order_id, amount: 100.00 } end def generate_order_id # Generate unique order ID "ORD#{Time.now.to_i}#{rand(1000..9999)}" end end ``` ## Routes ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do resources :payments, only: [:new, :create] do collection do post 'callback' # LiqPay server callback get 'success' # Client redirect after success get 'failure' # Client redirect after failure end end end ``` ## Payment Form View ```erb

### app/services/qb_invoice_exporter.rb
```ruby
class QBInvoiceExporter
  attr_reader :qb_client, :logger

  def initialize(qb_client, logger: Rails.logger)
    @qb_client = qb_client
    @logger = logger
  end

  def export_paid_invoices
    invoices = Invoice.pending_export.includes(:customer, :invoice_items, :payments)
    
    if invoices.empty?
      logger.info "No paid invoices pending export to QuickBooks"
      return { success: true, exported_count: 0 }
    end

    results = {
      success: 0,
      failed: 0,
      errors: []
    }

    invoices.each do |invoice|
      result = export_invoice(invoice)
      if result[:success]
        results[:success] += 1
        invoice.mark_as_exported
      else
        results[:failed] += 1
        results[:errors] << { invoice_id: invoice.id, error: result[:error] }
      end
    end

    log_results(results)
    results
  end

  private

  def export_invoice(invoice)
    begin
      # Спочатку перевіряємо чи існує клієнт у QuickBooks, якщо ні - створюємо
      customer_ref = find_or_create_customer(invoice.customer)
      return { success: false, error: "Failed to find/create customer" } unless customer_ref

      # Створюємо рахунок у QuickBooks
      qb_invoice = create_qb_invoice(invoice, customer_ref)
      return { success: false, error: "Failed to create invoice" } unless qb_invoice

      # Створюємо платіж у QuickBooks
      qb_payment = create_qb_payment(invoice, qb_invoice, customer_ref)
      return { success: false, error: "Failed to create payment" } unless qb_payment

      { success: true, qb_invoice_id: qb_invoice.id, qb_payment_id: qb_payment.id }
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error "Failed to export invoice #{invoice.id}: #{e.message}"
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def find_or_create_customer(customer)
    # Спроба знайти клієнта за email
    existing_customer = qb_client.customer_service.query(
      "SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE PrimaryEmailAddr = '#{customer.email}'"
    ).entries.first

    return Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new(existing_customer.id) if existing_customer

    # Створення нового клієнта
    qb_customer = Quickbooks::Model::Customer.new
    qb_customer.display_name = customer.name
    qb_customer.primary_email_address = Quickbooks::Model::EmailAddress.new(customer.email)
    qb_customer.primary_phone = Quickbooks::Model::TelephoneNumber.new(customer.phone) if customer.phone

    created_customer = qb_client.customer_service.create(qb_customer)
    Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new(created_customer.id)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error "Customer creation failed: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def create_qb_invoice(invoice, customer_ref)
    qb_invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    qb_invoice.customer_id = customer_ref.value
    qb_invoice.txn_date = invoice.created_at.to_date
    qb_invoice.due_date = invoice.due_date

    # Додаємо позиції рахунку
    invoice.invoice_items.each do |item|
      line_item = Quickbooks::Model::InvoiceLineItem.new
      line_item.amount = item.amount
      line_item.description = item.description
      line_item.sales_item! do |sales_item|
        sales_item.item_id = find_or_create_item(item.product_name).value
        sales_item.quantity = item.quantity
        sales_item.unit_price = item.unit_price
      end
      qb_invoice.line_items << line_item
    end

    qb_client.invoice_service.create(qb_invoice)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error "Invoice creation failed: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def create_qb_payment(invoice, qb_invoice, customer_ref)
    qb_payment = Quickbooks::Model::Payment.new
    qb_payment.customer_id = customer_ref.value
    qb_payment.total = invoice.paid_amount
    qb_payment.txn_date = invoice.payments.last.paid_at.to_date
    
    # Зв'язуємо платіж з рахунком
    linked_txn = Quickbooks::Model::LinkedTransaction.new
    linked_txn.txn_id = qb_invoice.id
    linked_txn.txn_type = 'Invoice'
    qb_payment.linked_transactions << linked_txn

    qb_client.payment_service.create(qb_payment)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error "Payment creation failed: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def find_or_create_item(product_name)
    # Спрощена реалізація для пошуку/створення товару
    # У реальному додатку потрібна більш складна логіка
    item_ref = Quickbooks::Model::BaseReference.new('1') # Заглушка
    item_ref
  end

  def log_results(results)
    if results[:success] > 0
      logger.info "Successfully exported #{results[:success]} invoices to QuickBooks"
    end
    
    if results[:failed] > 0
      logger.error "Failed to export #{results[:failed]} invoices. Errors: #{results[:errors]}"
    end
  end
end

class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  enum status: { draft: 0, sent: 1, paid: 2, overdue: 3 }
  enum sync_status: { pending: 0, synced: 1, failed: 2 }

  validates :amount, :due_date, :contact_email, presence: true
  validates :xero_invoice_id, uniqueness: true, allow_nil: true

  after_create :schedule_xero_sync, if: -> { draft? }

  def schedule_xero_sync
    XeroSyncJob.perform_async(id)
  end

  def update_from_xero(xero_invoice)
    update(
      xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
      status: map_xero_status(xero_invoice.status),
      amount_paid: xero_invoice.amount_paid,
      updated_at: Time.current
    )
  end

  private

  def map_xero_status(xero_status)
    case xero_status.downcase
    when 'draft' then :draft
    when 'submitted', 'authorised' then :sent
    when 'paid' then :paid
    when 'voided' then :overdue
    else :draft
    end
  end
end

## Services

```ruby
# app/services/xero_invoice_service.rb
class XeroInvoiceService
  def initialize(tenant_id = ENV['XERO_TENANT_ID'])
    @tenant_id = tenant_id
    @api_instance = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new($xero_client)
  end

  def create_invoice(invoice)
    contact = find_or_create_contact(invoice.contact_email)
    xero_invoice = build_xero_invoice(invoice, contact)
    
    result = @api_instance.create_invoices(@tenant_id, { invoices: [xero_invoice] })
    created_invoice = result.invoices.first
    
    invoice.update(
      xero_invoice_id: created_invoice.invoice_id,
      sync_status: :synced
    )
    
    created_invoice
  rescue XeroRuby::Accounting::ApiError => e
    invoice.update(sync_status: :failed)
    Rails.logger.error "Xero API Error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def sync_payment_status(invoice)
    return unless invoice.xero_invoice_id

    xero_invoice = @api_instance.get_invoice(@tenant_id, invoice.xero_invoice_id)
    invoice.update_from_xero(xero_invoice.invoices.first)
    
    invoice
  rescue XeroRuby::Accounting::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Xero Sync Error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def sync_all_payments
    invoices = Invoice.where.not(xero_invoice_id: nil)
    invoices.find_each do |invoice|
      sync_payment_status(invoice)
    end
  end

  private

  def find_or_create_contact(email)
    # Try to find existing contact
    contacts = @api_instance.get_contacts(@tenant_id, where: "EmailAddress==\"#{email}\"")
    return contacts.contacts.first if contacts.contacts.any?

    # Create new contact
    contact = XeroRuby::Contact.new(
      name: email,
      email_address: email
    )
    
    result = @api_instance.create_contacts(@tenant_id, { contacts: [contact] })
    result.contacts.first
  end

  def build_xero_invoice(invoice, contact)
    XeroRuby::Invoice.new(
      type: XeroRuby::Invoice::ACCREC,
      contact: { contact_id: contact.contact_id },
      date: invoice.created_at.to_date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      line_items: [
        {
          description: invoice.description || "Invoice #{invoice.id}",
          quantity: 1,
          unit_amount: invoice.amount,
          account_code: 200 # Revenue account code - adjust as needed
        }
      ],
      status: XeroRuby::Invoice::AUTHORISED
    )
  end
end

# checkbox_receipt_issuer.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class CheckboxReceiptIssuer
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.checkbox.in.ua/api/v1'.freeze
  
  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['CHECKBOX_API_KEY']
    @cashier_id = ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ID']
    @cashier_access_token = ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    
    validate_credentials
  end
  
  def issue_receipt(payment_data)
    # Step 1: Create a receipt
    receipt_data = create_receipt(payment_data)
    
    # Step 2: Add goods to the receipt
    add_goods_to_receipt(receipt_data['id'], payment_data[:goods])
    
    # Step 3: Process payment
    process_payment(receipt_data['id'], payment_data[:payment])
    
    # Step 4: Close the receipt
    close_receipt(receipt_data['id'])
    
    puts "Receipt issued successfully! Receipt ID: #{receipt_data['id']}"
    receipt_data['id']
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Error issuing receipt: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials
    raise "Missing CHECKBOX_API_KEY environment variable" unless @api_key
    raise "Missing CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ID environment variable" unless @cashier_id
    raise "Missing CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable" unless @cashier_access_token
  end
  
  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Client-Name' => 'OnlineStore',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@cashier_access_token}"
    }
  end
  
  def create_receipt(payment_data)
    receipt_payload = {
      goods: [],
      payments: [],
      total_price: payment_data[:total_amount],
      order_id: payment_data[:order_id],
      delivery: payment_data[:delivery] || {},
      header: payment_data[:header] || "Online Payment Receipt",
      footer: payment_data[:footer] || "Thank you for your purchase!"
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/cashier/#{@cashier_id}/receipts",
      headers: headers,
      body: receipt_payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Failed to create receipt")
    response.parsed_response
  end
  
  def add_goods_to_receipt(receipt_id, goods)
    goods.each do |good|
      good_payload = {
        good: {
          code: good[:code],
          name: good[:name],
          price: good[:price],
          quantity: good[:quantity],
          tax: good[:tax] || [],
          barcode: good[:barcode],
          header: good[:header],
          footer: good[:footer],
          uktzed: good[:uktzed]
        }
      }
      
      response = HTTParty.post(
        "#{BASE_URL}/cashier/#{@cashier_id}/receipts/#{receipt_id}/goods",
        headers: headers,
        body: good_payload.to_json
      )
      
      handle_response(response, "Failed to add good: #{good[:name]}")
    end
  end
  
  def process_payment(receipt_id, payment)
    payment_payload = {
      payment: {
        type: payment[:type] || 'CASHLESS', # CASHLESS for online payments
        value: payment[:amount],
        label: payment[:label] || 'Online Payment',
        card_mask: payment[:card_mask],
        bank_name: payment[:bank_name],
        auth_code: payment[:auth_code],
        rrn: payment[:rrn],
        transaction_id: payment[:transaction_id]
      }
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/cashier/#{@cashier_id}/receipts/#{receipt_id}/payments",
      headers: headers,
      body: payment_payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Failed to process payment")
  end
  
  def close_receipt(receipt_id)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/cashier/#{@cashier_id}/receipts/#{receipt_id}/close",
      headers: headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Failed to close receipt")
    response.parsed_response
  end
  
  def handle_response(response, error_message)
    unless response.success?
      error_details = response.parsed_response
      puts "API Error Details: #{error_details}"
      raise "#{error_message}: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end

    @cashier_id = ENV['CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ID']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-License-Key' => @api_key

    response = HTTParty.post(

      headers: @headers,
      body: {
        cashier_id: @cashier_id
      }.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      @cashier_access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@cashier_access_token}"
      true
    else
      raise "Помилка авторизації касира: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Створення чеку
  def create_receipt(order_data)
    authenticate_cashier unless @cashier_access_token

    receipt_data = build_receipt_data(order_data)

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/sell",
      headers: @headers,
      body: receipt_data.to_json
    )

    if response.success?

      puts "Чек успішно видано!"
      puts "Фіскальний номер: #{receipt_info['fiscal_code']}"
      puts "Номер чеку: #{receipt_info['receipt_number']}"
      receipt_info
    else
      raise "Помилка створення чеку: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  private

  def build_receipt_data(order_data)
    {
      goods: build_goods(order_data[:items]),
      payments: [
        {
          type: order_data[:payment_type] || 'CARD',
          value: order_data[:total_amount],
          label: 'Оплата карткою'

      total: order_data[:total_amount],

      # Дані покупця (якщо потрібно)
      client_info: order_data[:client_info] || {},
      # Додаткові параметри
      context: {
        source: 'online_store',
        order_id: order_data[:order_id]
      }
    }
  end

  def build_goods(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        good: {
          code: item[:sku] || item[:id].to_s,
          name: item[:name],
          price: item[:price],
          tax: item[:tax_code] || [5] # ПДВ 20% (код 5)

        quantity: item[:quantity],
        is_return: false
      }
    end

    response = HTTParty.get(

    )

    else

    missing << 'CHECKBOX_API_KEY' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
    missing << 'CHECKBOX_CASHIER_ID' if @cashier_id.nil? || @cashier_id.empty?
    missing << 'CHECKBOX_LICENSE_KEY' if @license_key.nil? || @license_key.empty?
    
    raise "Missing required environment variables: #{missing.join(', ')}" if missing.any?
  end

  def validate_payment_data(payment_data)
    required_fields = [:order_id, :amount, :items, :payment_method]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| payment_data[field].nil? }
    
    raise "Missing required payment data: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" if missing_fields.any?
    
    if payment_data[:items].empty?
      raise "Receipt must contain at least one item"
    end
  end

  def build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    {
      id: payment_data[:order_id],
      cashier_id: @cashier_id,
      receipt: {
        payments: build_payments(payment_data),
        goods: build_goods(payment_data[:items]),
        delivery: payment_data[:delivery] || {},
        discounts: payment_data[:discounts] || [],
        round_sum: true,
        type: 'SELL'
      },
      taxes: build_taxes,
      context: {
        source: 'WEB',
        transaction_id: payment_data[:transaction_id] || payment_data[:order_id]
      }
    }
  end

  def build_payments(payment_data)
    case payment_data[:payment_method].to_s.upcase
    when 'CARD'
      [{ type: 'CARD', value: payment_data[:amount] }]
    when 'CASH'
      [{ type: 'CASH', value: payment_data[:amount] }]
    when 'CASHLESS'
      [{ type: 'CASHLESS', value: payment_data[:amount] }]
    else
      raise "Unsupported payment method: #{payment_data[:payment_method]}"
    end
  end

  def build_goods(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        good: {
          code: item[:code] || SecureRandom.uuid,
          name: item[:name],
          price: item[:price],
          barcode: item[:barcode],
          header: item[:header],
          footer: item[:footer],
          tax: item[:tax_code] || []
        },
        good_id: item[:good_id],
        quantity: item[:quantity],
        is_return: item[:is_return] || false,
        price: item[:price]
      }
    end
  end

  def build_taxes
    # Common tax groups in Ukraine
    [
      {
        code: "1",
        label: "ПДВ 20%",
        symbol: "1",
        rate: 20,
        extra: {
          letter: "A",
          type: "VAT"
        }
      }
    ]
  end

  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'X-License-Key' => @license_key,
      'X-Client-Name' => 'Online Store',
      'X-Client-Version' => '1.0.0'
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response, payment_data)
    if response.success?
      receipt_info = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      {
        success: true,
        receipt_id: receipt_info['id'],
        fiscal_code: receipt_info['fiscal_code'],
        serial: receipt_info['serial'],
        created_at: receipt_info['created_at'],
        raw_response: receipt_info
      }
    else
      error_message = parse_error_response(response)
      
      {
        success: false,
        error: error_message,
        status_code: response.code,
        order_id: payment_data[:order_id]
      }
    end
  end

  def parse_error_response(response)
    begin
      error_body = JSON.parse(response.body)
      error_body['message'] || error_body['error'] || "Unknown error (HTTP #{response.code})"
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      "HTTP Error #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# fondy_payment_processor.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'httparty'

class FondyPaymentProcessor
  # Your Fondy merchant credentials
  MERCHANT_ID = ENV['FONDY_MERCHANT_ID'] || 'your_merchant_id'
  SECRET_KEY = ENV['FONDY_SECRET_KEY'] || 'your_secret_key'
  FONDY_API_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/url/'

  # Generate payment URL
  def self.create_payment(order_params)
    # Required parameters
    base_params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      merchant_id: MERCHANT_ID,
      order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
      amount: order_params[:amount], # Amount in cents
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'USD',
      server_callback_url: order_params[:callback_url]
    }

    # Optional parameters
    optional_params = {
      sender_email: order_params[:sender_email],
      product_id: order_params[:product_id],
      lang: order_params[:lang] || 'en'
    }

    # Merge all parameters
    request_params = base_params.merge(optional_params).compact

    # Generate signature
    request_params[:signature] = generate_signature(request_params, SECRET_KEY)

    # Send request to Fondy
    response = HTTParty.post(
      FONDY_API_URL,
      body: { request: request_params.to_json },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Generate signature for request
  def self.generate_signature(params, secret_key)
    # Sort parameters alphabetically
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    
    # Create signature string
    signature_string = secret_key + '|' + sorted_params.values.join('|')
    
    # Generate SHA-1 hash
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end

  # Verify response signature
  def self.verify_signature(response_params, secret_key)
    # Extract signature from response
    received_signature = response_params['signature']
    
    # Remove signature from parameters for verification
    params_for_verification = response_params.dup
    params_for_verification.delete('signature')
    
    # Sort parameters alphabetically
    sorted_params = params_for_verification.sort.to_h
    
    # Create verification string
    verification_string = secret_key + '|' + sorted_params.values.join('|')
    
    # Generate expected signature
    expected_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(verification_string)
    
    # Compare signatures securely to prevent timing attacks
    secure_compare(received_signature, expected_signature)
  end

  # Secure string comparison to prevent timing attacks
  def self.secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.nil? || b.nil? || a.empty? || b.empty? || a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    
    l = a.unpack "C#{a.bytesize}"
    res = 0
    b.each_byte { |byte| res |= byte ^ l.shift }
    res == 0
  end

  private

  def self.parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      response_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if response_data['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          checkout_url: response_data['response']['checkout_url'],
          payment_id: response_data['response']['payment_id']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error_message: response_data['response']['error_message'],
          error_code: response_data['response']['error_code']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error_message: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    {
      success: false,
      error_message: "Failed to parse response: #{e.message}"
    }
  end
end

class XeroToken < ApplicationRecord

    token = first_or_initialize

      refresh_token: token_set['refresh_token'],
      expires_at: Time.at(token_set['expires_at']),
      token_type: token_set['token_type']
    )

  end

```ruby
class XeroInvoiceService
  def initialize(xero_client)
    @xero_client = xero_client
    @accounting_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(xero_client)
  end
  
  # Create invoice in Xero
  def create_invoice(invoice)
    xero_invoice = build_xero_invoice(invoice)
    
    response = @accounting_api.create_invoices(
      invoice.tenant_id, 
      { invoices: [xero_invoice] }
    )
    
    created_invoice = response.invoices.first
    create_xero_invoice_record(invoice, created_invoice)
    
    created_invoice
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Xero API Error: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end
  
  # Sync invoice status from Xero
  def sync_invoice_status(xero_invoice_id)
    response = @accounting_api.get_invoice(
      invoice.tenant_id,
      xero_invoice_id
    )
    
    invoice = response.invoices.first
    update_local_invoice_status(invoice)
    
    invoice
  end
  
  # Get all invoices with pagination
  def get_invoices_since(since_date, page = 1)
    @accounting_api.get_invoices(
      invoice.tenant_id,
      {
        if_modified_since: since_date.iso8601,
        page: page,
        statuses: ['AUTHORISED', 'PAID', 'VOIDED']
      }
    )
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_xero_invoice(invoice)
    {
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        contact_id: invoice.customer.xero_contact_id
      },
      date: invoice.issue_date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      invoice_number: invoice.number,
      reference: invoice.reference,
      line_items: build_line_items(invoice.line_items),
      status: 'AUTHORISED' # or 'DRAFT' depending on your workflow
    }
  end
  
  def build_line_items(line_items)
    line_items.map do |item|
      {
        description: item.description,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit_amount: item.unit_price,
        account_code: item.account_code,
        tax_type: item.tax_type || 'NONE'
      }
    end
  end
  
  def create_xero_invoice_record(invoice, xero_invoice)
    XeroInvoice.create!(
      invoice: invoice,
      xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
      status: xero_invoice.status.downcase,
      xero_updated_date: xero_invoice.updated_date_utc,
      sync_status: 'synced'
    )
  end
  
  def update_local_invoice_status(xero_invoice)
    local_xero_invoice = XeroInvoice.find_by(xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id)
    return unless local_xero_invoice
    
    local_xero_invoice.update!(
      status: xero_invoice.status.downcase,
      xero_updated_date: xero_invoice.updated_date_utc,
      amount_paid: xero_invoice.amount_paid,
      amount_due: xero_invoice.amount_due
    )
    
    # Update your main invoice status based on Xero status
    update_application_invoice_status(local_xero_invoice.invoice, xero_invoice.status)
  end
  
  def update_application_invoice_status(invoice, xero_status)
    case xero_status
    when 'PAID'
      invoice.mark_as_paid!
    when 'VOIDED'
      invoice.void!
    when 'AUTHORISED'
      invoice.authorize!
    end
  end
end
```

class BulkSyncXeroInvoicesJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :xero
  
  def perform(since_date = 24.hours.ago)
    xero_service = XeroInvoiceService.new(xero_client)
    page = 1
    
    loop do
      response = xero_service.get_invoices_since(since_date, page)
      break if response.invoices.empty?
      
      response.invoices.each do |xero_invoice|
        SyncXeroInvoiceStatusJob.perform_later(xero_invoice.invoice_id)
      end
      
      page += 1
      break if page > response.page_count
    end
  end
end

class XeroWebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :verify_webhook_signature
  
  def invoice_update
    webhook_event = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    webhook_event.events.each do |event|
      if event.event_type == 'UPDATE' && event.event_category == 'INVOICE'
        xero_invoice_id = event.resource_id
        SyncXeroInvoiceStatusJob.perform_later(xero_invoice_id)
      end
    end
    
    head :ok
  end
  
  private
  
  def verify_webhook_signature
    webhook_key = ENV['XERO_WEBHOOK_KEY']
    signature = request.headers['X-Xero-Signature']
    
    # Verify webhook signature (implementation depends on Xero's requirements)
    # This is a simplified version
    computed_signature = compute_signature(request.body.read, webhook_key)
    
    unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(computed_signature, signature)
      head :unauthorized
    end
  end
  
  def compute_signature(payload, key)
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', key, payload)
  end
end

## Основна реалізація

### app/services/fondy_service.rb

```ruby
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'base64'
require 'httparty'

class FondyService
  # Конфігурація Fondy
  MERCHANT_ID = ENV['FONDY_MERCHANT_ID']
  SECRET_KEY = ENV['FONDY_SECRET_KEY']
  
  # Базові URL Fondy API
  API_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api'
  CHECKOUT_URL = 'https://pay.fondy.eu'
  
  def initialize
    raise "FONDY_MERCHANT_ID is not set" unless MERCHANT_ID
    raise "FONDY_SECRET_KEY is not set" unless SECRET_KEY
  end
  
  # Створення платежу
  def create_payment(order_params)
    required_params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
      amount: order_params[:amount], # в копійках
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH'
    }
    
    request_data = {
      request: required_params.merge(
        merchant_id: MERCHANT_ID,
        signature: generate_signature(required_params)
      )
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_URL}/checkout/url",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  def check_payment_status(order_id)
    request_data = {
      request: {
        merchant_id: MERCHANT_ID,
        order_id: order_id,
        signature: generate_signature({ order_id: order_id })
      }
    }
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{API_URL}/status/order_id",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка підпису callback від Fondy
  def verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
    # Витягуємо параметри для перевірки підпису
    signature_params = callback_params.dup
    received_signature = signature_params.delete('signature')
    
    # Генеруємо очікуваний підпис
    expected_signature = generate_signature(signature_params)
    
    # Безпечне порівняння підписів
    secure_compare(expected_signature, received_signature)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Генерація підпису
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Сортуємо параметри за ключами та формуємо рядок для підпису
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    signature_string = SECRET_KEY + sorted_params.map { |k, v| "#{k}|#{v}" }.join('|')
    
    # Хешуємо та кодуємо в base64
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end
  
  # Обробка відповіді від API
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if json_response['response']['response_status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          data: json_response['response']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error_code: json_response['response']['error_code'],
          error_message: json_response['response']['error_message']
        }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error_message: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    {
      success: false,
      error_message: 'Invalid JSON response'
    }
  end
  
  # Безпечне порівняння рядків (запобігає timing attacks)
  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.nil? || b.nil? || a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    
    l = a.unpack "C#{a.bytesize}"
    res = 0
    b.each_byte { |byte| res |= byte ^ l.shift }
    res == 0
  end
end
```

# app/controllers/payments_controller.rb
class PaymentsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: [:callback]
  
  # Створення платежу
  def create
    fondy_service = FondyService.new
    
    payment_params = {
      order_id: generate_order_id,
      order_desc: params[:description] || 'Payment for order',
      amount: (params[:amount].to_f * 100).to_i, # Конвертуємо в копійки
      currency: params[:currency] || 'UAH'
    }
    
    result = fondy_service.create_payment(payment_params)
    
    if result[:success]
      redirect_to result[:data]['checkout_url']
    else
      flash[:error] = "Помилка створення платежу: #{result[:error_message]}"
      redirect_back fallback_location: root_path
    end
  end
  
  # Callback від Fondy (POST запит)
  def callback
    fondy_service = FondyService.new
    
    if fondy_service.verify_callback_signature(params)
      # Підпис вірний - обробляємо платеж
      process_payment_result(params)
      
      # Відповідь для Fondy
      render json: { response_status: 'OK' }
    else
      # Невірний підпис
      Rails.logger.error "Invalid Fondy callback signature: #{params}"
      render json: { response_status: 'ERROR' }, status: 400
    end
  end
  
  # Сторінка успішного платежу
  def success
    fondy_service = FondyService.new
    
    if fondy_service.verify_callback_signature(params)
      @order_id = params['order_id']
      @amount = params['amount'].to_f / 100 # Конвертуємо назад у гривні
    else
      redirect_to root_path, alert: 'Невірний підпис платежу'
    end
  end
  
  # Сторінка невдалого платежу
  def failure
    @error_message = params['response_description'] || 'Помилка платежу'
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_order_id
    "#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
  end
  
  def process_payment_result(callback_params)
    order_id = callback_params['order_id']
    status = callback_params['order_status']
    amount = callback_params['amount'].to_i
    
    # Знаходимо замовлення за order_id
    order = Order.find_by(payment_id: order_id)
    
    return unless order
    
    case status
    when 'approved'
      order.update!(status: 'paid', paid_at: Time.current)
      # Додаткова логіка для успішного платежу
    when 'declined', 'expired'
      order.update!(status: 'failed')
      # Логіка для невдалого платежу
    end
  end
end

# Prepare parameters for signature verification verification_params = params.dup # Remove the signature itself for verification received_signature = verification_params.delete('response_signature') received_signature ||= verification_params.delete(:response_signature) # Sort parameters alphabetically sorted_params = verification_params.sort.to_h # Create signature string signature_string = @secret_key + '|' + sorted_params.values.join('|') # Generate SHA1 hash calculated_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string) # Compare signatures if calculated_signature == received_signature { valid: true, message: "Signature verified successfully" } else { valid: false, error: "Invalid signature" } end rescue => e { valid: false, error: "Verification error: #{e.message}" } end # Parse and validate payment response def parse_payment_response(params) verification_result = verify_signature(params) return verification_result unless verification_result[:valid] { valid: true, order_id: params['order_id'], amount: params['amount'].to_f / 100, # Convert back from cents/kopecks currency: params['currency'], status: params['order_status'], transaction_id: params['payment_id'], response_time: params['response_time'], additional_data: params } end private def base_url ENV['BASE_URL'] || 'http://localhost:4567' end end # Sinatra application class PaymentApp < Sinatra::Base configure do set :fondy, FondyPaymentProcessor.new enable :logging end # Home page with payment form get '/' do <<-HTML Fondy Payment Demo

Make a Payment

Thank you for your purchase." end # Payment failure page get '/payment/failure' do "Payment failed. Please try again or contact support." end private def handle_successful_payment(payment_data) # Implement your business logic here: # - Update order status in database # - Send confirmation email # - Update inventory # - etc. logger.info "Processing successful payment for order: #{payment_data[:order_id]}" end def handle_failed_payment(payment_data) # Handle failed payment logger.info "Payment failed for order: #{payment_data[:order_id]}" end def handle_expired_payment(payment_data) # Handle expired payment logger.info "Payment expired for order: #{payment_data[:order_id]}" end end # Run the application if __FILE__ == $0 PaymentApp.run! end ``` ## Environment Configuration (.env file) ```bash # .env FONDY_MERCHANT_ID=your_actual_merchant_id FONDY_SECRET_KEY=your_actual_secret_key FONDY_CREDIT_KEY=your_actual_credit_key # Optional for some operations BASE_URL=http://yourdomain.com ``` ## Usage Instructions 1. **Install dependencies:** ```bash bundle install ``` 2. **Set up environment variables** in the `.env` file with your Fondy credentials. 3. **Run the application:** ```bash ruby app.rb ``` 4. **The application will be available at** `http://localhost:4567` ## Key Features - **Payment Creation**: Generates checkout URLs for Fondy payment page - **Signature Verification**: Validates callback signatures to ensure authenticity - **Callback Handling**: Processes both user redirects and server-to-server callbacks - **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error handling and logging - **Status Management**: Handles different payment statuses (approved, declined, expired) ## Testing You can test the implementation using Fondy's test credentials and their sandbox environment. # qr_generator.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'json'

class UkrainianQRCodeGenerator
  # Ukrainian QR Code Standard based on NBU requirements
  # Format: https://bank.gov.ua/admin_uploads/article/QR-code_2020.pdf
  
  def initialize(options = {})
    @options = {
      version: 4,
      size: 400,
      border_modules: 1,
      bank_account: nil,
      recipient_name: nil,
      recipient_edrpou: nil,
      amount: nil,
      payment_purpose: nil,
      currency: 'UAH',
      country: 'UA'
    }.merge(options)
  end

  def generate_qr_code
    validate_required_fields
    
    qr_string = build_qr_string
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string)
    
    # Generate QR code as PNG
    png = qrcode.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: @options[:border_modules],
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      file: nil,
      fill: 'white',
      module_px_size: 6,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      resize_gte_to: false,
      size: @options[:size]
    )
    
    png
  end

  def save_qr_code(filename = 'ukrainian_payment_qr.png')
    png = generate_qr_code
    File.open(filename, 'wb') { |f| f.write(png.to_s) }
    puts "QR code saved as #{filename}"
    filename
  end

  def display_qr_code
    png = generate_qr_code
    # For console display (basic representation)
    qr_string = build_qr_string
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string)
    puts qrcode.as_ansi
  end

  private

  def validate_required_fields
    required_fields = [:bank_account, :recipient_name, :recipient_edrpou]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| @options[field].nil? || @options[field].to_s.empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def build_qr_string
    # NBU QR Code standard format
    # Based on EMV QR Code specification for merchant payments
    
    fields = []
    
    # Payload Format Indicator (fixed)
    fields << format_field(0, '01')
    
    # Point of Initiation Method (1 - static, 2 - dynamic)
    fields << format_field(1, '11') # 11 = static QR code
    
    # Merchant Account Information
    merchant_info = build_merchant_account_info
    fields << format_field(26, merchant_info)
    
    # Merchant Category Code (default: 0000 - Unclassified)
    fields << format_field(52, '0000')
    
    # Transaction Currency
    fields << format_field(53, @options[:currency])
    
    # Transaction Amount (optional)
    if @options[:amount]
      fields << format_field(54, sprintf('%.2f', @options[:amount]))
    end
    
    # Country Code
    fields << format_field(58, @options[:country])
    
    # Merchant Name
    fields << format_field(59, truncate_string(@options[:recipient_name], 25))
    
    # Merchant City
    fields << format_field(60, 'Kyiv') # Default city, can be customized
    
    # Additional Data Field - Purpose of Payment
    if @options[:payment_purpose]
      additional_data = format_field(8, @options[:payment_purpose])
      fields << format_field(62, additional_data)
    end
    
    # CRC16 checksum (will be calculated last)
    fields << '6304'
    
    # Calculate CRC16 checksum
    data_string = fields.join('')
    crc = calculate_crc16(data_string)
    data_string + sprintf('%04X', crc)
  end

  def build_merchant_account_info
    # Ukrainian specific merchant account information
    # Format: bank account details
    
    fields = []
    
    # Global Identifier (UA - Ukraine)
    fields << format_field(0, 'UA')
    
    # Bank Account Number
    fields << format_field(1, @options[:bank_account])
    
    # Recipient Name
    fields << format_field(2, @options[:recipient_name])
    
    # Recipient EDRPOU (Ukrainian tax identification number)
    fields << format_field(3, @options[:recipient_edrpou])
    
    # Payment Purpose Code (optional)
    if @options[:payment_purpose_code]
      fields << format_field(4, @options[:payment_purpose_code])
    end
    
    fields.join('')
  end

  def format_field(id, value)
    # Format: [ID][Length][Value]
    # ID: 2 digits, Length: 2 digits, Value: string
    id_str = sprintf('%02d', id)
    length_str = sprintf('%02d', value.to_s.length)
    "#{id_str}#{length_str}#{value}"
  end

  def truncate_string(str, max_length)
    str.to_s[0...max_length]
  end

  def calculate_crc16(data)
    # CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE algorithm
    crc = 0xFFFF
    data.each_byte do |byte|
      crc ^= byte << 8
      8.times do
        if (crc & 0x8000) != 0
          crc = (crc << 1) ^ 0x1021
        else
          crc = crc << 1
        end
      end
      crc &= 0xFFFF
    end
    crc
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    # Example payment data
    qr_generator = UkrainianQRCodeGenerator.new(
      bank_account: 'UA123456789012345678901234567',
      recipient_name: 'ТОВ "ПРИКЛАД"',
      recipient_edrpou: '12345678',
      amount: 150.50,
      payment_purpose: 'Оплата за послуги',
      currency: 'UAH'
    )
    
    # Display in console
    puts "Ukrainian Payment QR Code:"
    puts "=" * 50
    qr_generator.display_qr_code
    
    # Save as PNG file
    filename = qr_generator.save_qr_code
    puts "\nQR code image saved as: #{filename}"
    
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

This Ruby code implements a Ukrainian bank transfer QR code generator according to the NBU (National Bank of Ukraine) QR payment standard. Here's what it does:

## Key Features:

1. **Gemfile** specifies required gems:

   - `chunky_png` for PNG image creation

2. **Main Class**: `UkrainianQRCodeGenerator` with:
   - Required fields validation
   - NBU-compliant QR string formatting
   - CRC16 checksum calculation
   - Multiple output options (console display, PNG file)

3. **QR Code Format**: Follows EMV QR Code specification with Ukrainian-specific fields:
   - Bank account number
   - Recipient name
   - EDRPOU (tax ID)
   - Payment amount and purpose
   - Currency (UAH) and country (UA)

# app/models/invoice.rb
class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  enum status: { draft: 0, sent: 1, paid: 2, overdue: 3 }
  enum sync_status: { pending: 0, synced: 1, failed: 2, needs_sync: 3 }

  validates :amount, :due_date, :invoice_number, presence: true
  validates :xero_invoice_id, uniqueness: true, allow_nil: true

  after_save :schedule_xero_sync, if: :should_sync_with_xero?
  after_save :schedule_payment_sync, if: :should_sync_payments?

  def schedule_xero_sync
    XeroSyncJob.perform_later(id) if needs_sync_to_xero?
  end

  def schedule_payment_sync
    XeroPaymentSyncJob.perform_later(id) if needs_payment_sync?
  end

  def needs_sync_to_xero?
    (draft? || sent?) && (pending? || needs_sync?) && xero_invoice_id.nil?
  end

  def needs_payment_sync?
    sent? && synced? && xero_invoice_id.present?
  end

  private

  def should_sync_with_xero?
    (status_changed? && sent?) || (sync_status_changed? && needs_sync?)
  end

  def should_sync_payments?
    sent? && xero_invoice_id.present?
  end
end

class XeroConnection < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user

  validates :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_at, presence: true

    expires_at > Time.current
  end

    update!(

      refresh_token: new_tokens['refresh_token'],
      expires_at: Time.current + new_tokens['expires_in'].to_i.seconds
    )
  end

# app/jobs/xero_sync_job.rb
class XeroSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  retry_on XeroRuby::ApiError, wait: :exponentially_longer, attempts: 5

  def perform(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
    xero_connection = XeroConnection.first # Or get appropriate connection
    
    invoice_service = XeroInvoiceService.new(xero_connection)
    
    if invoice.xero_invoice_id.nil?
      # Create invoice in Xero
      xero_invoice = invoice_service.create_invoice(invoice)
      invoice.update!(
        xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
        sync_status: :synced
      )
    else
      # Update existing invoice
      invoice_service.update_invoice(invoice)
      invoice.update!(sync_status: :synced)
    end
    
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    invoice.update!(sync_status: :failed)
    Rails.logger.error "Xero sync failed for invoice #{invoice_id}: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end
end

# app/jobs/xero_payment_sync_job.rb
class XeroPaymentSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  retry_on XeroRuby::ApiError, wait: :exponentially_longer, attempts: 5

  def perform(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
    xero_connection = XeroConnection.first
    
    invoice_service = XeroInvoiceService.new(xero_connection)
    xero_invoice = invoice_service.get_invoice(invoice.xero_invoice_id)
    
    if xero_invoice.status == 'AUTHORISED' && invoice.sent?
      # Invoice is paid in Xero but not in our system
      invoice.update!(status: :paid)
    elsif xero_invoice.status == 'PAID' && invoice.sent?
      invoice.update!(status: :paid)
    elsif xero_invoice.status == 'VOIDED' && !invoice.draft?
      invoice.update!(status: :draft)
    end
    
  rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Xero payment sync failed for invoice #{invoice_id}: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end
end

# app/services/xero_invoice_service.rb
class XeroInvoiceService
  def initialize(xero_connection)
    @xero_connection = xero_connection
    @accounting_api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new(@xero_connection.api_client)
  end

  def create_invoice(invoice)
    xero_invoice = build_xero_invoice(invoice)
    
    result = @accounting_api.create_invoices(
      @xero_connection.tenant_id,
      invoices: { invoices: [xero_invoice] }
    )
    
    result.invoices.first
  end

  def update_invoice(invoice)
    xero_invoice = build_xero_invoice(invoice)
    xero_invoice.invoice_id = invoice.xero_invoice_id
    
    @accounting_api.update_invoice(
      @xero_connection.tenant_id,
      invoice.xero_invoice_id,
      invoices: { invoices: [xero_invoice] }
    )
  end

  def get_invoice(invoice_id)
    @accounting_api.get_invoice(
      @xero_connection.tenant_id,
      invoice_id
    ).invoices.first
  end

  def get_invoice_payments(invoice_id)
    @accounting_api.get_invoice_payments(
      @xero_connection.tenant_id,
      invoice_id
    ).payments
  end

  private

  def build_xero_invoice(invoice)
    {
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        name: invoice.customer_name,
        email: invoice.customer_email
      },
      date: invoice.invoice_date,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      invoice_number: invoice.invoice_number,
      reference: invoice.reference,
      line_items: build_line_items(invoice),
      status: invoice.sent? ? 'AUTHORISED' : 'DRAFT'
    }
  end

  def build_line_items(invoice)
    invoice.line_items.map do |line_item|
      {
        description: line_item.description,
        quantity: line_item.quantity,
        unit_amount: line_item.unit_amount,
        account_code: line_item.account_code || '200' # Default sales account
      }
    end
  end
end

class XeroAuthController < ApplicationController

    xero_client = Rails.application.config.xero_client
    authorize_url = xero_client.authorize_url(redirect_uri: ENV['XERO_REDIRECT_URI'])

      expires_at: Time.current + token_set['expires_in'].to_i.seconds,
      tenant_id: get_tenant_id(xero_client)

    redirect_to root_path, alert: "Xero connection failed: #{e.message}"
