## Ruby Implementation

```ruby
# ukrainian_payment_qr.rb
require 'rqrcode'

class UkrainianPaymentQR
  # Payment types according to NBU standard
  PAYMENT_TYPES = {
    static: 'ST',    # Static QR (predefined amount)
    dynamic: 'DY'    # Dynamic QR (user enters amount)
  }.freeze

  # Character set for validation
  VALID_CHARS = /^[A-Za-z0-9\s\-\.\,\(\)\/\:\?\+\'\!\*\;]+$/

  def initialize(recipient_name:, iban:, bank_code:, purpose:, amount: nil, edrpou: nil, recipient_account: nil)
    @recipient_name = validate_field(recipient_name, 'Recipient name', 70)
    @iban = validate_iban(iban)
    @bank_code = validate_field(bank_code, 'Bank code', 6)
    @purpose = validate_field(purpose, 'Payment purpose', 140)
    @amount = amount
    @edrpou = edrpou
    @recipient_account = recipient_account
    
    @payment_type = amount ? PAYMENT_TYPE[:static] : PAYMENT_TYPE[:dynamic]
  end

  def generate_qr_code(size: 300, border_modules: 1, fill: 'white', color: 'black')
    qr_content = build_qr_content
    
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_content, level: :m)
    
    # Create PNG with custom styling
    png = qr.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: border_modules,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: color,
      fill: fill,
      module_px_size: 6,
      size: size
    )
    
    png
  end

  def save_qr_code(filename, size: 300)
    png = generate_qr_code(size: size)
    png.save(filename)
    puts "QR code saved as #{filename}"
  end

  def display_qr_content
    build_qr_content
  end

  private

  def build_qr_content
    # NBU QR standard format
    fields = [
      "HRV1.0",                    # Header - Ukrainian QR version 1.0
      "HRK",                       # Country code - Ukraine
      @payment_type,               # Payment type (ST/DY)
      "",                          # Reserved for future use
      @bank_code,                  # Bank MFO code
      @iban,                       # Recipient IBAN
      format_amount(@amount),      # Amount (empty for dynamic QR)
      @edrpou || "",               # EDRPOU code (optional)
      @recipient_account || "",    # Recipient account (optional)
      @recipient_name,             # Recipient name
      @purpose,                    # Payment purpose
      "",                          # Reserved
      "",                          # Reserved
      "",                          # Reserved
      "",                          # Reserved
      ""                           # Reserved
    ]

    fields.map { |field| escape_field(field) }.join("\r\n")
  end

  def format_amount(amount)
    return "" if amount.nil? || amount == 0
    
    # Format amount with 2 decimal places
    sprintf("%.2f", amount.to_f)
  end

  def escape_field(field)
    # Escape special characters according to NBU specification
    field.to_s.gsub(/[\\;,:]/, '\\\\\\0')
  end

  def validate_field(value, field_name, max_length)
    raise ArgumentError, "#{field_name} cannot be empty" if value.nil? || value.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "#{field_name} exceeds maximum length of #{max_length}" if value.length > max_length
    raise ArgumentError, "#{field_name} contains invalid characters" unless value.match?(VALID_CHARS)
    
    value
  end

  def validate_iban(iban)
    # Basic IBAN validation for Ukraine (UA country code, 29 characters total)
    raise ArgumentError, "IBAN cannot be empty" if iban.nil? || iban.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "IBAN must start with 'UA'" unless iban.start_with?('UA')
    raise ArgumentError, "Ukrainian IBAN must be 29 characters long" unless iban.length == 29
    raise ArgumentError, "IBAN contains invalid characters" unless iban.match?(/^[A-Z0-9]+$/)
    
    iban
  end
end

# Example usage and helper methods
class UkrainianPaymentQRGenerator
  def self.example_static_payment
    UkrainianPaymentQR.new(
      recipient_name: "ТОВ 'ПРИКЛАДНА КОМПАНІЯ'",
      iban: "UA123456789012345678901234567",
      bank_code: "123456",
      purpose: "Оплата за товари та послуги",
      amount: 1500.50,

    )
  end

  def self.example_dynamic_payment

      iban: "UA987654321098765432109876543",
      bank_code: "654321",
      purpose: "Оплата послуг",
      edrpou: "87654321"
    )
  end
end

# Command line interface
if __FILE__ == $0

    puts "Ukrainian Bank Payment QR Code Generator"
    puts "=" * 50
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require_relative '../config/checkbox_config'
require_relative '../models/receipt_item'
require_relative '../models/payment'

class CheckboxService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri CheckboxConfig::BASE_URL

  def initialize
    @options = {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'X-License-Key' => CheckboxConfig::LICENCE_KEY
      }
    }
  end

  # Авторизація касира
  def authenticate_cashier
    response = self.class.post(
      '/cashier/signin',
      @options.merge(
        body: { access_token: CheckboxConfig::CASHIER_TOKEN }.to_json
      )
    )

    if response.success?
      @options[:headers]['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{response.parsed_response['access_token']}"
      true
    else
      false
    end
  end

  # Створення чеку
  def create_receipt(receipt_items:, payments:, email: nil, phone: nil, 
                     delivery: nil, order_id: nil, header: nil, footer: nil)
    unless authenticate_cashier
      raise 'Помилка авторизації касира'
    end

    receipt_data = {
      goods: receipt_items.map(&:to_hash),
      payments: payments.map(&:to_hash),
      email: email,
      header: header,
      footer: footer,
      delivery: delivery,
      order_id: order_id
    }.compact

    response = self.class.post(
      '/receipts/sell',
      @options.merge(body: receipt_data.to_json)
    )

    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "Помилка створення чеку: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end

  # Отримання статусу чеку
  def get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
    unless authenticate_cashier
      raise 'Помилка авторизації касира'
    end

    response = self.class.get(
      "/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      @options
    )

    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання статусу чеку: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end

  # Скасування чеку
  def cancel_receipt(receipt_id, reason = "Скасування замовлення")
    unless authenticate_cashier
      raise 'Помилка авторизації касира'
    end

    cancel_data = {
      reason: reason
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      "/receipts/#{receipt_id}/cancel",
      @options.merge(body: cancel_data.to_json)
    )

    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "Помилка скасування чеку: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
        ReceiptItem.new(
          name: item[:name],

          type: 'CARD', # Тип платежу - картка для онлайн-оплати
          value: order_details[:total_amount],
          card_mask: order_details.dig(:payment, :card_mask),
          auth_code: order_details.dig(:payment, :auth_code),
          rrn: order_details.dig(:payment, :rrn)
        )
      ]

      # Створення чеку
      receipt = @checkbox_service.create_receipt(
        receipt_items: receipt_items,
        payments: payments,
        email: order_details[:customer_email],
        phone: order_details[:customer_phone],
```

### app/models/xero_token.rb

```ruby
class XeroToken < ApplicationRecord
  validates :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_at, presence: true
  
  def self.store_token_set(token_set)
    token = XeroToken.first_or_initialize
    token.update!(
      access_token: token_set['access_token'],
      refresh_token: token_set['refresh_token'],
      expires_at: Time.at(token_set['expires_at']),
      tenant_id: token_set['tenant_id']
    )
  end
  
  def self.current
    token = XeroToken.first
    return nil unless token
    
    # Refresh token if expired
    if token.expired?
      token.refresh!
      token.reload
    end
    
    token
  end
  
  def expired?
    expires_at <= Time.current
  end
  
  def refresh!
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
      ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      site: 'https://identity.xero.com',
      token_url: 'connect/token'
    )
    
    new_token = OAuth2::AccessToken.from_hash(client, {
      refresh_token: refresh_token
    }).refresh!
    
    update!(
      access_token: new_token.token,
      refresh_token: new_token.refresh_token,
      expires_at: Time.at(new_token.expires_at)
    )
  end
  
  def to_token_set
    {
      'access_token' => access_token,
      'refresh_token' => refresh_token,
      'expires_at' => expires_at.to_i,
      'tenant_id' => tenant_id
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class XeroInvoiceService
  def initialize
    @token_set = XeroToken.current&.to_token_set
    raise 'Xero token not found' unless @token_set
  end
  
  def create_invoice(invoice)
    xero_client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(
      token_set: @token_set,
      tenant_id: @token_set['tenant_id']
    )
    
    contact = find_or_create_contact(invoice.customer, xero_client)
    
    xero_invoice = XeroRuby::Accounting::Invoice.new(
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: contact,
      date: invoice.issue_date || Date.today,
      due_date: invoice.due_date,
      invoice_number: invoice.number,
      line_items: build_line_items(invoice),
      status: 'AUTHORISED' # Send immediately
    )
    
    result = xero_client.accounting_api.create_invoice(
      @token_set['tenant_id'], 
      xero_invoice
    )
    
    result.invoices.first
  end
  
  def get_invoice_status(xero_invoice_id)
    xero_client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(
      token_set: @token_set,
      tenant_id: @token_set['tenant_id']
    )
    
    result = xero_client.accounting_api.get_invoice(
      @token_set['tenant_id'], 
      xero_invoice_id
    )
    
    result.invoices.first
  end
  
  def get_paid_invoices_since(since_date)
    xero_client = XeroRuby::ApiClient.new(
      token_set: @token_set,
      tenant_id: @token_set['tenant_id']
    )
    
    where = "Date >= DateTime(#{since_date.year}, #{since_date.month}, #{since_date.day}) && Status == \"PAID\""
    
    result = xero_client.accounting_api.get_invoices(
      @token_set['tenant_id'],
      where: where
    )
    
    result.invoices
  end
  
  private
  
  def find_or_create_contact(customer, xero_client)
    # Try to find existing contact by name or email
    contacts = xero_client.accounting_api.get_contacts(
      @token_set['tenant_id'],
      where: "Name==\"#{customer.name}\""
    ).contacts
    
    return contacts.first if contacts.any?
    
    # Create new contact
    xero_contact = XeroRuby::Accounting::Contact.new(
      name: customer.name,
      email_address: customer.email,
      contact_number: customer.id.to_s
    )
    
    result = xero_client.accounting_api.create_contact(
      @token_set['tenant_id'], 
      xero_contact
    )
    
    result.contacts.first
  end
  
  def build_line_items(invoice)
    [XeroRuby::Accounting::LineItem.new(
      description: invoice.description || "Invoice #{invoice.number}",
      quantity: 1,
      unit_amount: invoice.amount,
      account_code: ENV['XERO_SALES_ACCOUNT_CODE'] || '200'
    )]
  end
```

```ruby
      xero_invoice = xero_service.create_invoice(invoice)
      
      invoice.update!(
        xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
        status: map_xero_status(xero_invoice.status),
        synced_at: Time.current
      )
      
      logger.info "Invoice #{invoice.number} synced to Xero successfully"
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error "Failed to sync invoice #{invoice.number} to Xero: #{e.message}"
      raise e # Re-raise to trigger retry
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def map_xero_status(xero_status)
    case xero_status
    when 'DRAFT' then :draft
    when 'SUBMITTED', 'AUTHORISED' then :sent
    when 'PAID' then :paid
    when 'VOIDED' then :voided
    else :sent
    end
  end
end
```

### app/workers/xero_payment_sync_worker.rb

```ruby
class XeroPaymentSyncWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  
  def perform(invoice_id = nil)
    if invoice_id
      sync_single_invoice(invoice_id)
    else
      sync_all_paid_invoices
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def sync_single_invoice(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)
    
    return unless invoice.xero_invoice_id
    
    begin
      xero_service = XeroInvoiceService.new
      xero_invoice = xero_service.get_invoice_status(invoice.xero_invoice_id)
      
      new_status = map_xero_status(xero_invoice.status)
      
      if invoice.status != new_status.to_s
        invoice.update!(status: new_status, last_sync_at: Time.current)
        logger.info "Invoice #{invoice.number} status updated to #{new_status}"
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error "Failed to sync payment status for invoice #{invoice.number}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def sync_all_paid_invoices
    since_date = 7.days.ago.to_date
    
    begin
      xero_service = XeroInvoiceService.new
      paid_invoices = xero_service.get_paid_invoices_since(since_date)
      
      paid_invoices.each do |xero_invoice|
        invoice = Invoice.find_by(xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id)
        next unless invoice && invoice.status != 'paid'
        
        invoice.update!(status: :paid, last_sync_at: Time.current)
        logger.info "Invoice #{invoice.number} marked as paid"
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error "Failed to sync paid invoices: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  def map_xero_status(xero_status)
    case xero_status
    when 'PAID' then :paid
    when 'VOIDED' then :voided
    when 'DRAFT' then :draft
    else :sent
    end
  end
end
```

## Реалізація класу FondyPayment

```ruby
# app/services/fondy_payment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class FondyPayment
  include HTTParty
  
  # Базові URL Fondy API
  LIVE_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api'
  TEST_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key, test_mode = true)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @test_mode = test_mode
    @base_url = test_mode ? TEST_URL : LIVE_URL
  end
  
  # Створення платежу
  def create_payment(order_params)
    required_params = {
      order_id: order_params[:order_id],
      order_desc: order_params[:order_desc],
      amount: order_params[:amount], # в копійках
      currency: order_params[:currency] || 'UAH'
    }
    
    # Додаємо обов'язкові параметри
    params = {
      request: required_params.merge(
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        signature: generate_signature(required_params)
      )
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/checkout/url",
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      verify_response_signature(response.parsed_response)
      response.parsed_response
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end
  
  # Обробка callback від Fondy
  def handle_callback(callback_params)
    # Перевіряємо підпис
    unless verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
      raise InvalidSignatureError, 'Невірний підпис callback'
    end
    
    # Обробляємо статус платежу
    process_payment_status(callback_params)
  end
  
  # Отримання статусу платежу
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    params = {
      request: {
        order_id: order_id,
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        signature: generate_signature({ order_id: order_id })
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/status/order_id",
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      verify_response_signature(response.parsed_response)
      response.parsed_response
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Генерація підпису для запиту
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Сортуємо параметри за ключами
    sorted_params = params.sort.to_h
    
    # Формуємо рядок для підпису
    signature_string = @secret_key + '|' + sorted_params.values.join('|')
    
    # Генеруємо SHA-1 хеш
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end
  
  # Перевірка підпису відповіді
  def verify_response_signature(response)
    response_data = response['response']
    return unless response_data
    
    # Отримуємо підпис з відповіді
    received_signature = response_data['signature']
    return unless received_signature
    
    # Видаляємо підпис для перевірки
    data_to_verify = response_data.dup
    data_to_verify.delete('signature')
    
    # Генеруємо очікуваний підпис
    expected_signature = generate_signature(data_to_verify)
    
    # Порівнюємо підписи
    unless secure_compare(received_signature, expected_signature)
      raise InvalidSignatureError, 'Невірний підпис відповіді'
    end
    
    true
  end
  
  # Перевірка підпису callback
  def verify_callback_signature(callback_params)
    # Копіюємо параметри для перевірки
    params_to_verify = callback_params.dup
    
    # Видаляємо підпис
    received_signature = params_to_verify.delete('signature')
    return false unless received_signature
    
    # Сортуємо параметри за ключами
    sorted_params = params_to_verify.sort.to_h
    
    # Формуємо рядок для перевірки
    verification_string = @secret_key + '|' + sorted_params.values.join('|')
    
    # Генеруємо очікуваний підпис
    expected_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(verification_string)
    
    # Безпечне порівняння
    secure_compare(received_signature, expected_signature)
  end
  
  # Безпечне порівняння рядків (запобігає timing attacks)
  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.blank? || b.blank? || a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    
    l = a.unpack "C#{a.bytesize}"
    
    res = 0
    b.each_byte { |byte| res |= byte ^ l.shift }
    res == 0
  end
  
  # Обробка статусу платежу
  def process_payment_status(params)
    order_id = params['order_id']
    status = params['order_status']
    
    case status
    when 'approved'
      # Успішний платіж
      { success: true, order_id: order_id, status: 'approved' }
    when 'declined'
      # Відхилений платіж
      { success: false, order_id: order_id, status: 'declined', 
        reason: params['response_description'] }
    when 'expired'
      # Час платежу вийшов
      { success: false, order_id: order_id, status: 'expired' }
    else
      # Інші статуси
      { success: false, order_id: order_id, status: status }
    end
  end
  
  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = if response.parsed_response && response.parsed_response['response']
      response.parsed_response['response']['error_message']
    else
      "HTTP Error: #{response.code}"
    end
    
    raise FondyAPIError, error_message
  end
end

# Класи помилок
class FondyAPIError < StandardError; end
class InvalidSignatureError < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
        redirect_back fallback_location: root_path

      redirect_back fallback_location: root_path
    rescue FondyPayment::InvalidSignatureError => e
      flash[:error] = "Помилка безпеки: #{e.message}"
      redirect_back fallback_location: root_path
    end
  end
  
  # Callback від Fondy
  def callback
    begin
      result = $fondy.handle_callback(params)
      
      if result[:success]
        # Оновлюємо статус замовлення в базі даних
        order = Order.find_by(id: result[:order_id])
        order.update(status: 'paid') if order
        
        render json: { status: 'ok' }
      else
        # Обробка неуспішного платежу
        Rails.logger.error "Платіж невдалий: #{result}"
        render json: { status: 'error' }, status: 400
      end
      
    rescue FondyPayment::InvalidSignatureError
      render json: { status: 'invalid signature' }, status: 400
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error "Помилка обробки callback: #{e.message}"
      render json: { status: 'error' }, status: 500
    end
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу платежу

      status_response = $fondy.get_order_status(order_id)
      render json: status_response
    rescue => e
      render json: { error: e.message }, status: 500
    end
  end
  
  private

  end
```

```ruby
require 'rqrcode'

class NBUQRCodeGenerator
  # Стандартні коди банків України
  BANK_CODES = {
    'privatbank' => '305299',
    'monobank' => '322313',
    'oschadbank' => '300465',
    'ukrgasbank' => '300012',
    'raiffeisen' => '380848',
    'pumb' => '334851'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(recipient_name:, iban:, amount:, currency: 'UAH', 
                 bank_code: 'privatbank', purpose: '', details: '')
    @recipient_name = recipient_name
    @iban = iban.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase # Видаляємо пробіли та переводимо у верхній регістр
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency
    @bank_code = BANK_CODES[bank_code.downcase] || bank_code
    @purpose = purpose
    @details = details
  end

  def generate_qr_string
    # Форматування за стандартом НБУ для платіжних QR-кодів
    qr_data = [
      "BCD",           # Ідентифікатор стандарту
      "001",           # Версія
      "1",             # Кодування символів (1 = UTF-8)
      "SCT",           # Ідентифікатор схеми (SCT = SEPA Credit Transfer)
      @bank_code,      # БІК банку отримувача
      @recipient_name, # Ім'я отримувача
      @iban,           # IBAN рахунку отримувача
      "#{format('%.2f', @amount)}#{@currency}", # Сума та валюта
      @purpose,        # Призначення платежу
      @details         # Деталі платежу
    ].join("\n")

    qr_data
  end

  def generate_qr_code(size: 300, file_path: nil)
    qr_string = generate_qr_string
    
    # Генеруємо QR-код
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string, level: :m)
    
    # Створюємо PNG зображення
    png = qrcode.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      file: nil,
      fill: 'white',
      module_px_size: 6,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      resize_gte_to: false,
      size: size
    )
    
    if file_path
      # Зберігаємо у файл
      File.open(file_path, 'wb') { |f| f.write(png.to_s) }
      puts "QR-код збережено у файл: #{file_path}"
    end
    
    png
  end

  def display_qr_info
    puts "=== Інформація про платіжний QR-код ==="
    puts "Отримувач: #{@recipient_name}"
    puts "IBAN: #{@iban}"
    puts "Сума: #{@amount} #{@currency}"
    puts "Банк: #{@bank_code}"
    puts "Призначення: #{@purpose}" unless @purpose.empty?
    puts "Деталі: #{@details}" unless @details.empty?
    puts "QR-дані:\n#{generate_qr_string.gsub("\n", "\n  ")}"
    puts "=" * 50
  end
end

# Додатковий клас для зручного використання
class QRCodePayment

    generator = NBUQRCodeGenerator.new(options)
    generator.display_qr_info
    generator.generate_qr_code(
      size: options[:size] || 300,
      file_path: options[:file_path]
    )
  end
end
```

## Додатковий модуль для валідації IBAN

```ruby
module IBANValidator
  def self.valid_iban?(iban)
    iban = iban.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Перевірка формату IBAN України
    return false unless iban =~ /^UA\d{27}$/
    
    # Переміщуємо перші 4 символи в кінець
    rearranged = iban[4..-1] + iban[0..3]
    
    # Замінюємо літери на числа (A=10, B=11, ..., Z=35)
    numeric_iban = rearranged.chars.map do |char|
      if char =~ /[A-Z]/
        (char.ord - 55).to_s
      else
        char
      end
    end.join
    
    # Перевіряємо залишок від ділення на 97
    numeric_iban.to_i % 97 == 1
  end
end

# Додаємо валідацію до основного класу
class NBUQRCodeGenerator
  def valid?
    IBANValidator.valid_iban?(@iban) && 
    @amount > 0 &&
    !@recipient_name.empty? &&
    @bank_code.length == 6
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'liqpay'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class LiqPayPayout
  # LiqPay P2P credit API documentation: https://www.liqpay.ua/documentation/api/aquiring/p2pcredit

  def initialize(public_key = nil, private_key = nil)
    @public_key = public_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']
    @private_key = private_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    
    validate_credentials!
    
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: @public_key,
      private_key: @private_key
    )
  end

  # Make a payout to a Ukrainian card
  # @param amount [Float] amount to pay out (in UAH)
  # @param card_number [String] recipient's card number (16 digits)
  # @param recipient_name [String] recipient's full name
  # @param description [String] payment description
  # @param order_id [String] unique order ID (optional, auto-generated if not provided)
  # @return [Hash] API response
  def payout(amount:, card_number:, recipient_name:, description: "Payout", order_id: nil)
    validate_payout_params(amount, card_number, recipient_name)
    
    order_id ||= generate_order_id
    
    params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      amount: amount.round(2),
      currency: 'UAH',
      description: description,
      order_id: order_id,
      receiver_card: normalize_card_number(card_number),
      receiver_first_name: extract_first_name(recipient_name),
      receiver_last_name: extract_last_name(recipient_name)
    }

    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: "API call failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  # Check payout status
  # @param order_id [String] order ID to check
  # @return [Hash] status information
  def status(order_id)
    params = {
      action: 'status',
      version: '3',
      order_id: order_id
    }

    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: "Status check failed: #{e.message}" }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    if @public_key.nil? || @public_key.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "LiqPay public key is required. Set LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY environment variable."
    end
    
    if @private_key.nil? || @private_key.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "LiqPay private key is required. Set LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable."
    end
  end

  def validate_payout_params(amount, card_number, recipient_name)
    if amount <= 0
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be positive"
    end
    
    unless valid_card_number?(card_number)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid card number format. Must be 16 digits."
    end
    
    if recipient_name.nil? || recipient_name.strip.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Recipient name is required"
    end
  end

  def valid_card_number?(card_number)
    # Remove spaces and validate 16 digits
    normalized = card_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    normalized.match?(/^\d{16}$/)
  end

  def normalize_card_number(card_number)
    card_number.gsub(/\s+/, '')
  end

  def extract_first_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').first
  end

  def extract_last_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').last
  end

  def generate_order_id
    "payout_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response['status']
    when 'success'
      { 
        success: true, 
        status: 'success',
        order_id: response['order_id'],
        payment_id: response['payment_id'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        receiver_card: response['receiver_card']
      }
    when 'error'
      { 
        success: false, 
        status: 'error',
        error: response['err_description'] || response['err_code'] || 'Unknown error'
      }
    when 'sandbox'
      { 
        success: true, 
        status: 'sandbox',
        message: 'Transaction processed in sandbox mode',
        order_id: response['order_id']
      }
    else
      { 
        success: false, 
        status: response['status'],
        error: 'Unexpected response status'
      }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage

    payout_service = LiqPayPayout.new

      recipient_name: 'Іван Петренко',

    end
    
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
class LiqpayPayoutService
  class LiqpayPayoutError < StandardError; end

  def initialize
    @liqpay = Liqpay.new
  end

  # Основний метод для виплати
  def create_payout(amount:, card_number:, currency: 'UAH', description: 'Payout', order_id: nil)
    validate_parameters(amount, card_number, currency)
    
    order_id ||= generate_order_id
    
    payout_params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: 3,
      public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      amount: amount.to_f,
      currency: currency,
      description: description,
      order_id: order_id,
      receiver_card: card_number,
      server_url: ENV['LIQPAY_WEBHOOK_URL'] # Опціонально для отримання статусу
    }

    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', payout_params)
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      raise LiqpayPayoutError, "LiqPay API error: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу транзакції
  def check_status(order_id)
    status_params = {
      action: 'status',
      version: 3,
      public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      order_id: order_id
    }

    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', status_params)
      response
    rescue => e
      raise LiqpayPayoutError, "Failed to check status: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_parameters(amount, card_number, currency)
    raise LiqpayPayoutError, 'Amount must be positive' unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise LiqpayPayoutError, 'Card number is required' if card_number.to_s.strip.empty?
    raise LiqpayPayoutError, 'Currency must be UAH for Ukrainian cards' unless currency == 'UAH'
  end

  def generate_order_id
    "payout_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response['status']
    when 'success'
      { success: true, order_id: response['order_id'], payment_id: response['payment_id'] }
    when 'error'
      raise LiqpayPayoutError, "LiqPay error: #{response['err_description']} (code: #{response['err_code']})"
    else
      raise LiqpayPayoutError, "Unexpected response: #{response}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# nbu_qr_generator.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'base64'

class NBUQRGenerator
  # Стандартні параметри за НБУ
  PAYLOAD_FORMAT_INDICATOR = '01'
  POINT_OF_INITIATION_METHOD = '12' # Статичний QR-код
  MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE = '0000' # Універсальний код
  
  def initialize(recipient_data)
    @recipient_data = validate_data(recipient_data)
  end
  
  def generate_qr_code
    qr_string = build_qr_string
    generate_qr_image(qr_string)
  end
  
  def generate_qr_string
    build_qr_string
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_data(data)
    required_fields = [:iban, :recipient_name, :amount, :purpose, :edrpou]
    
    required_fields.each do |field|
      unless data[field]
        raise ArgumentError, "Відсутнє обов'язкове поле: #{field}"
      end
    end
    
    # Перевірка формату IBAN
    unless data[:iban].match?(/^UA\d{27}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Невірний формат IBAN. Має бути UA + 27 цифр"
    end
    
    # Перевірка EDRPOU
    unless data[:edrpou].match?(/^\d{8}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Невірний формат EDRPOU. Має бути 8 цифр"
    end
    
    data
  end
  
  def build_qr_string
    # Основний шаблон за стандартом НБУ
    qr_data = []
    
    # Обов'язкові поля
    qr_data << format_field('00', PAYLOAD_FORMAT_INDICATOR)
    qr_data << format_field('01', POINT_OF_INITIATION_METHOD)
    
    # Ідентифікація отримувача
    qr_data << format_field('26', build_merchant_account_info)
    
    # Код категорії торговця
    qr_data << format_field('52', MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE)
    
    # Валюта (UAH = 980)
    qr_data << format_field('53', '980')
    
    # Сума
    qr_data << format_field('54', sprintf('%.2f', @recipient_data[:amount]))
    
    # Країна (UA)
    qr_data << format_field('58', 'UA')
    
    # Назва отримувача
    qr_data << format_field('59', @recipient_data[:recipient_name])
    
    # Місто отримувача
    qr_data << format_field('60', @recipient_data[:city] || 'Київ')
    
    # Поштовий індекс
    qr_data << format_field('61', @recipient_data[:postal_code] || '01001')
    
    # Призначення платежу
    qr_data << format_field('62', @recipient_data[:purpose])
    
    # EDRPOU отримувача
    qr_data << format_field('63', @recipient_data[:edrpou])
    
    # CRC16 checksum
    data_string = qr_data.join
    crc = calculate_crc16(data_string)
    qr_data << format_field('64', sprintf('%04X', crc))
    
    qr_data.join
  end
  
  def build_merchant_account_info
    # Інформація про рахунок отримувача
    account_info = []
    
    # IBAN отримувача
    account_info << format_field('00', 'UA')
    account_info << format_field('01', @recipient_data[:iban])
    
    # Банк отримувача (опціонально)
    if @recipient_data[:bank_name]
      account_info << format_field('02', @recipient_data[:bank_name])
    end
    
    account_info.join
  end
  
  def format_field(id, value)
    # Форматування поля: ID + довжина + значення
    length = sprintf('%02d', value.to_s.length)
    "#{id}#{length}#{value}"
  end
  
  def calculate_crc16(data)
    # CRC16 розрахунок за стандартом ISO/IEC 13239
    crc = 0xFFFF
    polynomial = 0x1021
    
    data.each_byte do |byte|
      crc ^= byte << 8
      8.times do
        if (crc & 0x8000) != 0
          crc = (crc << 1) ^ polynomial
        else
          crc <<= 1
        end
        crc &= 0xFFFF
      end
    end
    
    crc
  end
  
  def generate_qr_image(qr_string)
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_string)
    
    # Генерація PNG зображення
    png = qrcode.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      file: nil,
      fill: 'white',
      module_px_size: 6,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      resize_gte_to: false,
      size: 300
    )
    
    png
  end
end

# Допоміжний модуль для збереження QR-коду
module QRCodeSaver
  def self.save_to_file(png, filename)
    png.save(filename)
    puts "QR-код збережено у файл: #{filename}"
  end
  
  def self.to_base64(png)
    Base64.encode64(png.to_s)
  end
end
```

```ruby
      NBUQRGenerator.new(incomplete_data)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# privatbank_installments.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

require 'dotenv/load'

class PrivatBankInstallments
  # API endpoints
  SANDBOX_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'
  PRODUCTION_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'
  
  # API methods
  CREATE_INVOICE_ENDPOINT = '/create_invoice'
  CHECK_STATUS_ENDPOINT = '/check_status'
  CANCEL_INVOICE_ENDPOINT = '/cancel_invoice'

  def initialize(merchant_id: nil, password: nil, sandbox: true)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id || ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_ID']
    @password = password || ENV['PRIVATBANK_PASSWORD']
    @sandbox = sandbox
    @base_url = sandbox ? SANDBOX_BASE_URL : PRODUCTION_BASE_URL
    
    validate_credentials!
  end

  # Create installment payment invoice
  def create_invoice(order_params)
    validation_result = InvoiceSchema.call(order_params)
    return validation_result unless validation_result.success?
    
    request_data = build_invoice_request(order_params)
    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    
    response = send_request(CREATE_INVOICE_ENDPOINT, request_data.merge(signature: signature))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "HTTP Error: #{response.status}", details: response.body }
    end
  end

  # Check payment status
  def check_status(order_id, payment_id)
    request_data = {
      orderId: order_id,
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      paymentId: payment_id
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    
    response = send_request(CHECK_STATUS_ENDPOINT, request_data.merge(signature: signature))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "HTTP Error: #{response.status}", details: response.body }
    end
  end

  # Cancel invoice
  def cancel_invoice(order_id, payment_id)
    request_data = {
      orderId: order_id,
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      paymentId: payment_id
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    
    response = send_request(CANCEL_INVOICE_ENDPOINT, request_data.merge(signature: signature))
    
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      { error: "HTTP Error: #{response.status}", details: response.body }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    raise ArgumentError, 'Merchant ID is required' if @merchant_id.nil? || @merchant_id.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, 'Password is required' if @password.nil? || @password.empty?
  end

  def build_invoice_request(params)
    {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: params[:order_id],
      amount: params[:amount],
      currency: params[:currency] || 'UAH',
      installmentPlan: params[:installment_plan] || '3',
      products: params[:products],
      clientInfo: params[:client_info] || {},
      returnUrl: params[:return_url],
      callbackUrl: params[:callback_url]
    }
  end

  def generate_signature(data)
    # Create signature string by concatenating values in specific order
    signature_string = data.values_at(:merchantId, :orderId, :amount, :currency).join
    signature_string += @password
    
    # Generate SHA-1 hash
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, @password, signature_string)
    
    signature
  end

  def send_request(endpoint, data)
    conn = Faraday.new(url: @base_url) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      faraday.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    end

    conn.post do |req|
      req.url endpoint
      req.body = data.to_json
    end
  end

  def parse_response(response_body)
    JSON.parse(response_body, symbolize_names: true)
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { error: 'Invalid JSON response', raw_response: response_body }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# liqpay_payout.rb
require 'liqpay'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class LiqPayPayout
  def initialize
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      private_key: ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    )
  end

  # Основна функція для виплати на картку
  def payout_to_card(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name, description = "Payout")
    begin
      # Перевірка обов'язкових параметрів
      validate_parameters(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)

      # Підготовка параметрів для запиту
      params = {
        action: 'p2pcredit',
        version: '3',
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        description: description,
        order_id: generate_order_id,
        receiver_card: normalize_card_number(card_number),
        receiver_last_name: extract_last_name(recipient_name),
        receiver_first_name: extract_first_name(recipient_name)
      }

      # Виконання запиту
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
      
      # Обробка відповіді
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу транзакції
  def check_status(order_id)
    begin
      response = @liqpay.api('request', {
        action: 'status',
        version: '3',
        order_id: order_id
      })
      
      {
        success: response['status'] == 'success',
        status: response['status'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        error: response['err_description']
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  private

  # Валідація вхідних параметрів
  def validate_parameters(amount, currency, card_number, recipient_name)
    raise "Amount must be positive" unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise "Currency is required" if currency.nil? || currency.empty?
    raise "Card number is required" if card_number.nil? || card_number.empty?
    raise "Recipient name is required" if recipient_name.nil? || recipient_name.empty?
    raise "Card number must be 16 digits" unless card_number.gsub(/\s+/, "").match?(/^\d{16}$/)
  end

  # Генерація унікального ID замовлення
  def generate_order_id
    "payout_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

  # Нормалізація номера картки (видалення пробілів)
  def normalize_card_number(card_number)
    card_number.gsub(/\s+/, "")
  end

  # Виділення прізвища з повного імені
  def extract_last_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').last
  end

  # Виділення імені з повного імені
  def extract_first_name(full_name)
    full_name.split(' ').first
  end

  # Обробка відповіді від LiqPay
  def handle_response(response)
    case response['status']
    when 'success'
      {
        success: true,
        order_id: response['order_id'],
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        message: 'Payout successful'
      }
    when 'error'
      {
        success: false,
        error: response['err_description'] || 'Unknown error occurred',
        error_code: response['err_code']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected status: #{response['status']}",
        raw_response: response
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# batch_payouts.rb
require_relative 'liqpay_payout'

class BatchPayouts
  def initialize
    @payout = LiqPayPayout.new
    @results = []
  end

  # Масові виплати
  def process_payouts(payouts_list)
    payouts_list.each_with_index do |payout_data, index|
      puts "Обробка виплати #{index + 1}/#{payouts_list.size}..."
      
      result = @payout.payout_to_card(
        amount: payout_data[:amount],
        currency: payout_data[:currency] || 'UAH',
        card_number: payout_data[:card_number],
        recipient_name: payout_data[:recipient_name],
        description: payout_data[:description] || "Batch payout #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
      )
      
      @results << result.merge(original_data: payout_data)
      
      # Затримка між запитами щоб уникнути лімітів API
      sleep(1) unless index == payouts_list.size - 1
    end
    
    generate_report
  end

  private

  def generate_report
    successful = @results.count { |r| r[:success] }
    failed = @results.count { |r| !r[:success] }
    total_amount = @results.select { |r| r[:success] }.sum { |r| r[:amount].to_f }
    
    report = {
      timestamp: Time.now,
      total_processed: @results.size,
      successful: successful,
      failed: failed,
      total_amount: total_amount,
      details: @results
    }
    
    # Збереження звіту у файл
    File.write("payouts_report_#{Time.now.to_i}.json", JSON.pretty_generate(report))
    
    report
  end
end
```

```ruby
class PrivatBankInstallmentPayment
  # Константи для API ПриватБанку
  API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua'
  TEST_API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, password, test_mode: false)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @password = password
    @test_mode = test_mode
    @base_url = test_mode ? TEST_API_BASE_URL : API_BASE_URL
  end
  
  # Створення сесії оплати частинами
  def create_installment_session(order_data)
    endpoint = '/installment/create_session'
    
    # Підготовка даних для запиту
    request_data = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: order_data[:order_id],
      amount: order_data[:amount],
      currency: order_data[:currency] || 'UAH',

    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    request_data[:signature] = signature
    
    # Відправка запиту
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Перевірка статусу сесії
  def check_session_status(session_id)
    endpoint = '/installment/session_status'
    
    request_data = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      sessionId: session_id
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    request_data[:signature] = signature
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Підтвердження замовлення після успішної оплати
  def confirm_order(session_id, order_id)
    endpoint = '/installment/confirm_order'
    
    request_data = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      sessionId: session_id,
      orderId: order_id
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    request_data[:signature] = signature
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Скасування замовлення
  def cancel_order(session_id, order_id, reason = 'Customer cancelled')
    endpoint = '/installment/cancel_order'
    
    request_data = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      sessionId: session_id,
      orderId: order_id,
      reason: reason
    }
    
    signature = generate_signature(request_data)
    request_data[:signature] = signature
    
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Підготовка даних про товари
  def prepare_products(products)
    products.map do |product|
      {
        name: product[:name],
        price: product[:price],
        quantity: product[:quantity],
        code: product[:code] || ''
      }
    end
  end
  
  # Генерація підпису
  def generate_signature(data)
    # Створення строки для підпису
    data_string = data.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    
    # Додавання пароля
    data_string_with_password = "#{data_string}&password=#{@password}"
    
    # Створення SHA-1 хешу
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, @password, data_string_with_password)
    
    signature.upcase
  end
  
  # Обробка відповіді
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

class PrivatBankCallbackHandler

  end
  
  # Валідація callback даних
  def valid_callback?(callback_data, received_signature)
    expected_signature = generate_callback_signature(callback_data)
    expected_signature == received_signature
  end
  
  # Обробка успішного платежу
  def handle_successful_payment(callback_data)

      success: true,

      amount: callback_data['amount'],
      status: callback_data['status'],
      transaction_id: callback_data['transactionId']
    }

  def handle_failed_payment(callback_data)
    {
      success: false,
      session_id: callback_data['sessionId'],
      order_id: callback_data['orderId'],
      error_code: callback_data['errorCode'],
      error_message: callback_data['errorMessage']
    }
  end

  def generate_callback_signature(callback_data)
    data_string = callback_data.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    data_string_with_password = "#{data_string}&password=#{@password}"
    
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(digest, @password, data_string_with_password)
    
    signature.upcase
  end

    if callback_handler.valid_callback?(params.except(:controller, :action).to_unsafe_h, request.headers['X-Signature'])
      if params[:status] == 'success'
        result = callback_handler.handle_successful_payment(params)
        # Оновлення статусу замовлення в базі даних
        order = Order.find_by(id: result[:order_id])
        order.update(status: 'paid', transaction_id: result[:transaction_id]) if order
        
        render json: { success: true }
      else
        result = callback_handler.handle_failed_payment(params)
        # Обробка невдалого платежу
        order = Order.find_by(id: result[:order_id])
        order.update(status: 'payment_failed', error_message: result[:error_message]) if order
        
        render json: { success: true } # Все одно повертаємо 200 для ПриватБанку
      end
    else
      render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: 400
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'net/http'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

module PrivatbankApi
  class Base
    BASE_URL = ENV['PRIVATBANK_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.privatbank.ua'

    private

    def self.make_request(endpoint, params = {})
      uri = URI("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}")
      
      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
      request['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      request.body = params.merge(auth_params).to_json

      response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == 'https') do |http|
        http.request(request)
      end

      JSON.parse(response.body)
    end

    def self.auth_params
      {
        merchantId: ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_ID'],
        password: ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_PASSWORD']
      }
    end
  end

  class Installment < Base
    def self.create(amount:, currency:, order_id:, description:)
      params = {
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency.upcase,
        orderId: order_id.to_s,
        description: description,
        returnUrl: "#{ENV['APP_BASE_URL']}/payments/return",
        callbackUrl: "#{ENV['APP_BASE_URL']}/payments/callback"
      }

      response = make_request('/api/installment/create', params)

      if response['state'] == 'ok'
        {
          success: true,
          payment_id: response['id'],
          redirect_url: response['redirectUrl'],
          status: response['status']
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: response['message']
        }
      end
    end

    def self.status(payment_id)
      params = {
        paymentId: payment_id
      }

      response = make_request('/api/installment/status', params)

      {
        status: response['status'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        order_id: response['orderId'],
        created_at: response['createdAt']
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class PaymentService
  def initialize(order)
    @order = order
  end

  def create_installment
    result = PrivatbankApi::Installment.create(
      amount: @order.amount,
      currency: @order.currency,
      order_id: @order.id,
      description: @order.description
    )

    if result[:success]
      installment = InstallmentPayment.create!(
        order_id: @order.id,
        payment_id: result[:payment_id],
        status: :created,
        redirect_url: result[:redirect_url]
      )

      @order.update(status: :processing)
      
      {
        success: true,
        installment: installment,
        redirect_url: result[:redirect_url]
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: result[:error]
      }
    end
  end

  def check_status(installment_payment)
    result = PrivatbankApi::Installment.status(installment_payment.payment_id)
    
    installment_payment.update(status: result[:status])
    
    case result[:status]
    when 'approved'
      @order.update(status: :approved)
    when 'declined'
      @order.update(status: :rejected)
    when 'expired'
      @order.update(status: :rejected)
    end

    result
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

class PaymentsController < Sinatra::Base
  set :json_content_type, 'application/json'

  post '/payments/installment' do
    content_type :json

    order_params = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    order = Order.create!(
      amount: order_params['amount'],
      currency: order_params['currency'] || 'UAH',
      description: order_params['description'],
      status: :pending
    )

    payment_service = PaymentService.new(order)
    result = payment_service.create_installment

    if result[:success]
      status 201
      {
        order_id: order.id,
        payment_id: result[:installment].payment_id,
        redirect_url: result[:redirect_url],
        status: 'created'
      }.to_json
    else
      status 422
      { error: result[:error] }.to_json
    end
  end

  get '/payments/:payment_id/status' do
    content_type :json

    installment_payment = InstallmentPayment.find_by(payment_id: params[:payment_id])
    
    if installment_payment
      payment_service = PaymentService.new(installment_payment.order)
      status_info = payment_service.check_status(installment_payment)
      
      status_info.merge(order_status: installment_payment.order.status).to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Payment not found' }.to_json
    end
  end

  post '/payments/callback' do
    content_type :json

    callback_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    installment_payment = InstallmentPayment.find_by(payment_id: callback_data['paymentId'])

    if installment_payment
      PaymentStatusWorker.perform_async(installment_payment.id)
      status 200
      { status: 'processed' }.to_json
    else
      status 404
      { error: 'Payment not found' }.to_json
    end
  end

  get '/payments/return' do
    installment_payment = InstallmentPayment.find_by(payment_id: params[:paymentId])
    
    if installment_payment
      redirect "#{ENV['FRONTEND_URL']}/order/#{installment_payment.order_id}?payment_status=#{installment_payment.status}"
    else
      status 404
      'Payment not found'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'rest-client'
require 'dotenv'
require 'sequel'

Dotenv.load

# Database setup
DB = Sequel.connect(ENV['DATABASE_URL'] || 'postgres://localhost/privat_installments')

# Create tables if they don't exist
unless DB.table_exists?(:orders)
  DB.create_table :orders do
    primary_key :id
    String :order_id, unique: true, null: false
    String :customer_name, null: false
    String :customer_phone, null: false
    String :customer_email
    Integer :amount, null: false  # Amount in kopiykas (1 UAH = 100 kopiykas)
    String :currency, default: 'UAH'
    String :status, default: 'pending'  # pending, approved, rejected, completed
    String :privat_order_id
    DateTime :created_at
    DateTime :updated_at
  end
end

unless DB.table_exists?(:installment_plans)
  DB.create_table :installment_plans do
    primary_key :id
    foreign_key :order_id, :orders
    Integer :term, null: false  # Number of months
    Decimal :monthly_payment, null: false
    Decimal :total_amount, null: false
    Decimal :interest_rate, null: false
    DateTime :created_at
  end
end

# Order model
class Order < Sequel::Model
  plugin :timestamps
  one_to_many :installment_plans

  def validate
    super
    errors.add(:amount, 'cannot be empty') if amount.nil?
    errors.add(:amount, 'must be positive') if amount && amount <= 0
  end
end

# InstallmentPlan model
class InstallmentPlan < Sequel::Model
  plugin :timestamps
  many_to_one :order
end

# PrivatBank API client
class PrivatBankAPI
  BASE_URL = ENV['PRIVATBANK_API_URL'] || 'https://api.privatbank.ua/'

  def initialize(merchant_id:, merchant_password:)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
  end

  # Get available installment plans
  def get_installment_plans(amount, currency = 'UAH')
    response = RestClient.get("#{BASE_URL}/installment/plans", {
      params: {
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        merchantId: @merchant_id
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue RestClient::Exception => e
    { error: "API request failed: #{e.message}" }
  end

  # Create installment order
  def create_installment_order(order_data)
    data = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      orderId: order_data[:order_id],
      amount: order_data[:amount],
      currency: order_data[:currency],
      details: order_data[:details],
      customerInfo: order_data[:customer_info],
      installmentPlan: order_data[:installment_plan],
      signature: generate_signature(order_data)
    }

    response = RestClient.post("#{BASE_URL}/installment/orders", data.to_json, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue RestClient::Exception => e
    { error: "Order creation failed: #{e.message}" }
  end

  # Check order status
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    response = RestClient.get("#{BASE_URL}/installment/orders/#{order_id}", {
      params: {
        merchantId: @merchant_id
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue RestClient::Exception => e
    { error: "Status check failed: #{e.message}" }
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    # Generate signature according to PrivatBank requirements
    # This is a simplified example - check actual API documentation
    signature_data = [
      @merchant_id,
      data[:order_id],
      data[:amount],
      data[:currency],
      @merchant_password
    ].join

    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(signature_data)
  end
end

# Initialize API client
privat_api = PrivatBankAPI.new(
  merchant_id: ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_ID'],
  merchant_password: ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_PASSWORD']
)

# Web application
class InstallmentApp < Sinatra::Base
  set :show_exceptions, false

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  # Get available installment plans for an amount
  get '/api/installment/plans' do
    amount = params[:amount]&.to_i
    currency = params[:currency] || 'UAH'

    if amount.nil? || amount <= 0
      status 400
      return { error: 'Invalid amount' }.to_json
    end

    plans = privat_api.get_installment_plans(amount, currency)
    
    if plans['error']
      status 500
      return { error: plans['error'] }.to_json
    end

    plans.to_json
  end

  # Create a new order with installment payment
  post '/api/orders' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)

    # Validate required fields
    required_fields = [:customer_name, :customer_phone, :amount, :installment_term]
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| data[field].nil? || data[field].to_s.empty? }

    unless missing_fields.empty?
      status 400
      return { error: "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" }.to_json
    end

    # Create order in database
    order = Order.new(
      order_id: generate_order_id,
      customer_name: data[:customer_name],
      customer_phone: data[:customer_phone],
      customer_email: data[:customer_email],
      amount: data[:amount],
      currency: data[:currency] || 'UAH'
    )

    unless order.save
      status 422
      return { errors: order.errors }.to_json
    end

    # Get installment plan details
    plan_response = privat_api.get_installment_plans(data[:amount], data[:currency] || 'UAH')
    
    if plan_response['error']
      order.update(status: 'rejected')
      status 500
      return { error: plan_response['error'] }.to_json
    end

    selected_plan = plan_response['plans']&.find { |p| p['term'] == data[:installment_term] }

    unless selected_plan
      order.update(status: 'rejected')
      status 400
      return { error: 'Selected installment term not available' }.to_json
    end

    # Save installment plan details
    InstallmentPlan.create(
      order_id: order.id,
      term: selected_plan['term'],
      monthly_payment: selected_plan['monthly_payment'],
      total_amount: selected_plan['total_amount'],
      interest_rate: selected_plan['interest_rate']
    )

    # Create order in PrivatBank system
    privat_order_data = {
      order_id: order.order_id,
      amount: order.amount,
      currency: order.currency,
      details: "Order #{order.order_id}",
      customer_info: {
        name: order.customer_name,
        phone: order.customer_phone,
        email: order.customer_email
      },
      installment_plan: {
        term: selected_plan['term']
      }
    }

    privat_response = privat_api.create_installment_order(privat_order_data)

    if privat_response['error']
      order.update(status: 'rejected')
      status 500
      return { error: privat_response['error'] }.to_json
    end

    order.update(
      status: 'approved',
      privat_order_id: privat_response['orderId']
    )

    {
      order_id: order.order_id,
      privat_order_id: privat_response['orderId'],
      status: order.status,
      redirect_url: privat_response['redirectUrl'],  # URL for customer to complete payment
      installment_plan: selected_plan
    }.to_json
  end

  # Webhook for payment status updates from PrivatBank
  post '/api/webhook/privatbank' do
    webhook_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)

    # Verify webhook signature (implementation depends on PrivatBank requirements)
    unless valid_webhook_signature?(webhook_data)
      status 401
      return { error: 'Invalid signature' }.to_json
    end

    order = Order.first(order_id: webhook_data[:orderId])
    
    unless order
      status 404
      return { error: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end

    # Update order status based on webhook data
    case webhook_data[:status]
    when 'SUCCESS', 'APPROVED'
      order.update(status: 'completed')
    when 'FAILED', 'DECLINED'
      order.update(status: 'rejected')
    when 'PENDING'
      order.update(status: 'pending')
    end

    { status: 'ok' }.to_json
  end

  # Get order status
  get '/api/orders/:order_id' do
    order = Order.first(order_id: params[:order_id])
    
    unless order
      status 404
      return { error: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end

    {
      order_id: order.order_id,
      status: order.status,
      amount: order.amount,
      currency: order.currency,
      customer_name: order.customer_name,
      created_at: order.created_at
    }.to_json
  end

  private

  def generate_order_id
    "ORD#{Time.now.to_i}#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

  def valid_webhook_signature?(data)
    # Implement webhook signature validation
    # This is a placeholder - check PrivatBank documentation for actual implementation
    true
  end

  def privat_api
    PrivatBankAPI.new(
      merchant_id: ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_ID'],
      merchant_password: ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_PASSWORD']
    )
  end
end

# Run the application
if __FILE__ == $0
  InstallmentApp.run!
end
```

```ruby
  def initialize(public_key = nil, private_key = nil)
    @public_key = public_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']
    @private_key = private_key || ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']
    
    validate_credentials!
    
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(
      public_key: @public_key,
      private_key: @private_key
    )
  end

  # Main method to perform P2P payout
  def payout(amount, card_number, recipient_name, currency: 'UAH', description: 'P2P Payout', order_id: nil)
    validate_card_number(card_number)
    validate_amount(amount, currency)
    
    order_id ||= generate_order_id
    
    params = {
      action: 'p2pcredit',
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description,
      order_id: order_id,
      receiver_card: card_number,
      receiver_last_name: recipient_name.split(' ').last,
      receiver_first_name: recipient_name.split(' ').first
    }
    
    response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check payout status
  def check_status(order_id)
    params = {
      action: 'status',
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key,
      order_id: order_id
    }
    
    response = @liqpay.api('request', params)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_credentials!
    unless @public_key && @private_key
      raise ArgumentError, "LiqPay credentials not found. Set LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY and LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY environment variables."
    end
  end

  def validate_card_number(card_number)
    card_number = card_number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    
    unless card_number.match?(/^\d{16}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid card number format. Must be 16 digits."
    end
    
    unless UKRAINIAN_CARD_PREFIXES.include?(card_number[0..3])
      raise ArgumentError, "Card number does not appear to be from a Ukrainian bank."
    end
  end

  def validate_amount(amount, currency)
    amount = amount.to_f
    
    if amount <= 0
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be greater than 0."
    end
    
    if currency == 'UAH' && amount < 1
      raise ArgumentError, "Minimum payout amount for UAH is 1."
    end
    
    if currency == 'USD' && amount < 0.01
      raise ArgumentError, "Minimum payout amount for USD is 0.01."
    end
  end

  def generate_order_id
    "p2p_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response['status']
    when 'success', 'sandbox'
      {
        success: true,
        status: response['status'],
        order_id: response['order_id'],
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        receiver_card: response['receiver_card'],
        message: 'Payout initiated successfully'
      }
    when 'error'
      {
        success: false,
        status: response['status'],
        error_code: response['err_code'],
        error_description: response['err_description'],
        message: "Payout failed: #{response['err_description']}"
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        status: response['status'],
        message: "Unexpected response status: #{response['status']}"
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class IbanValidator
  def initialize(iban, bic)
    @iban = iban
    @bic = bic
  end

  def validate
    errors = []
    errors << validate_iban unless validate_iban
    errors << validate_bic unless validate_bic
    errors.empty? ? true : errors
  end

  private

  def validate_iban
    begin
      IBANTools::IBAN.new(@iban).valid?
    rescue IBANTools::InvalidIBANError
      'Invalid IBAN format'
    end
  end

  def validate_bic
    begin
      BankTools::BIC.new(@bic).valid?
    rescue BankTools::InvalidBICError
      'Invalid BIC format'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'sqlite3'

# Підключення до бази даних
db = SQLite3::Database.new('database.db')

# Створення таблиці для неоплачених рахунків
db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  amount REAL,
  purpose TEXT
)')

# Створення таблиці для імпортованих транзакцій
db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  amount REAL,
  purpose TEXT,
  invoice_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices (id)
)')

# Функція імпорту транзакцій з CAMT.053
def import_transactions(file_path)
  # Парсинг XML-файлу
  xml = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(file_path))

  # Отримання інформації про транзакції
  transactions = xml.xpath('//Tx')

  transactions.each do |tx|
    amount = tx.xpath('.//Amt').text.to_f
    purpose = tx.xpath('.//Purp').text

    # Пошук неоплачених рахунків за призначенням платежу
    invoice = db.execute('SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE purpose = ? AND amount = ?', [purpose, amount])

    if invoice.any?
      # Оновлення статусу рахунку на оплачений
      db.execute('UPDATE invoices SET paid = 1 WHERE id = ?', [invoice.first[0]])

      # Додавання транзакції до бази даних
      db.execute('INSERT INTO transactions (amount, purpose, invoice_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [amount, purpose, invoice.first[0]])
    end
  end
end

# Виклик функції імпорту з файлом CAMT.053
import_transactions('camt053.xml')
```

```ruby
  def initialize(country_code, vat_number)

    @vat_number = vat_number
  end

    client = Savon.client(wsdl: 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl')
    response = client.call(:check_vat, message: {
      countryCode: @country_code,
      vatNumber: @vat_number

    xml.at_xpath('//checkVatResponse/valid').text == 'true'
  end
end

end
```

```ruby
    self.save!

    # Redirect the user to PayPal for approval

  end

  def capture_paypal_payment
    # Get the payment from the database
    payment = self.payment

    # Get the PayPal payment
    paypal_payment = PayPal::SDK::REST::Payment.find(payment.paypal_id)

    # Capture the payment
    paypal_payment.execute({

    payment.status = 'captured'
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dalli'
require 'money'

class CurrencyConverter
  attr_accessor :cache

  def initialize
    @cache = Dalli::Client.new
  end

  def fetch_exchange_rates
    url = 'https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml'
    response = HTTParty.get(url)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
    exchange_rates = {}

    doc.css('Cube[currency]').each do |cube|
      currency = cube.attr('currency')
      rate = cube.attr('rate').to_f
      exchange_rates[currency] = rate
    end

    @cache.set('exchange_rates', exchange_rates, 1.day)
    exchange_rates
  end

  def get_exchange_rates
    @cache.get('exchange_rates') || fetch_exchange_rates
  end

  def convert(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
    exchange_rates = get_exchange_rates
    from_rate = exchange_rates[from_currency]
    to_rate = exchange_rates[to_currency]

    if from_rate && to_rate
      amount * (to_rate / from_rate)
    else
      raise "Unknown currency: #{from_currency} or #{to_currency}"
    end
  end
end
```

Цей клас має три методи:

* `fetch_exchange_rates`: завантажує курси валют з Європейського центрального банку та кешує їх на добу.
* `get_exchange_rates`: повертає закешовані курси валют або завантажує їх з Європейського центрального банку, якщо вони не закешовані.
* `convert`: конвертує ціну з однієї валюти в іншу за допомогою курсів валют.

```ruby
# camt_053_importer.rb
require 'nokogiri'

# Define the database connection
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'bank_transactions.db'
)

# Create the Invoice and Transaction models
class Invoice < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :transactions
end

class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :invoice
end

# Create the database tables if they don't exist
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :invoices, force: true do |t|
    t.string :reference
    t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2
    t.boolean :paid, default: false
  end

  create_table :transactions, force: true do |t|
    t.string :reference
    t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2
    t.references :invoice
  end
end

# Define the CAMT.053 XML parser
class Camt053Parser
  def initialize(xml_file)
    @xml_file = xml_file
  end

  def parse
    xml = Nokogiri::XML(File.read(@xml_file))
    transactions = xml.xpath('//Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry')

    transactions.each do |transaction|
      reference = transaction.at_xpath('Refs/NtryRef').text
      amount = transaction.at_xpath('Amt').text.to_f

      # Match the transaction to an unpaid invoice by reference
      invoice = Invoice.where(reference: reference, paid: false).first

      if invoice
        # Create a new transaction and associate it with the invoice
        Transaction.create(reference: reference, amount: amount, invoice: invoice)
        invoice.update(paid: true)
      else
        # Create a new transaction without an associated invoice
        Transaction.create(reference: reference, amount: amount)
      end
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
parser = Camt053Parser.new('example.xml')
parser.parse
```

4. The `parse` method reads the XML file, extracts the transactions, and creates new `Transaction` records in the database. If a transaction matches an unpaid invoice, it updates the invoice's `paid` status to `true`.

Також нам знадобиться гем `taxjar` якщо такий існує, або ж ми будемо використовувати тільки `httparty` для здійснення запитів до API TaxJar.

```ruby
# taxjar_calculator.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class TaxJarCalculator
  attr_accessor :api_token, :api_url

  def initialize(api_token)
    @api_token = api_token
    @api_url = 'https://api.taxjar.com/v2'
  end

  def calculate_tax(order)
    # Підготовка даних замовлення
    order_data = {
      'to_city' => order[:to_city],
      'to_state' => order[:to_state],
      'to_zip' => order[:to_zip],
      'to_country' => order[:to_country],
      'from_city' => order[:from_city],
      'from_state' => order[:from_state],
      'from_zip' => order[:from_zip],
      'from_country' => order[:from_country],
      'amount' => order[:amount],
      'shipping' => order[:shipping],
      'line_items' => order[:line_items]
    }

    # Реалізація розрахування податку
    response = HTTParty.post("#{@api_url}/taxes", 
                             headers: { 
                               'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_token}", 
                               'Content-Type' => 'application/json' 
                             },
                             body: order_data.to_json)

    # Перевірка статусу відповіді
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['tax']
    else
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

У цьому прикладі, ми створили клас `TaxJarCalculator`, який приймає токен API при ініціалізації. Метод `calculate_tax` приймає замовлення, яке містить інформацію про доставку та товари, і повертає розрахований податок.

Для використання цього класу, ви повинні створити екземпляр класу, передавши свій токен API, і потім викликати метод `calculate_tax` з даними замовлення:

```ruby

order = {
  to_city: 'Нью-Йорк',
  to_state: 'NY',
  to_zip: '10001',
  to_country: 'USA',
  from_city: 'Лос-Анджелес',
  from_state: 'CA',
  from_zip: '90001',
  from_country: 'USA',
  amount: 100.0,
  shipping: 10.0,
  line_items: [
    { quantity: 1, unit_price: 100.0 }
  ]
```

Замініть `'your_api_token'` на ваш справжній токен API TaxJar.

Цей код розрахує податок із продажів для замовлення за адресою доставки через API TaxJar.

```ruby
  end

      pdf.text "ПДВ: #{@invoice.vat}%", size: 18
      pdf.text "Підсумок: #{@invoice.total}", size: 24
    end
  end

  def send_email

  end
end
```

```ruby
class StripeController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  def create_checkout_session
    # Створіть сесію Stripe Checkout для разового платежу
    session = Stripe::Checkout::Session.create(
      payment_method_types: ['card'],
      line_items: [{
        name: 'Тестовий продукт',
        amount: 1000, # $10.00
        currency: 'usd',
        quantity: 1
      }],
      mode: 'payment',
      success_url: 'https://example.com/success',
      cancel_url: 'https://example.com/cancel'
    )

    redirect_to session.url
  end

  def webhook
    # Обробіть вебхук Stripe
    event = Stripe::Webhook.construct_event(
      request.body.read, request.env['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE'], 'whsec_...'
    )

    case event.type
    when 'checkout.session.completed'
      # Обробіть завершення сесії платежу
      session = event.data.object
      # Тут можна додати логіку для обробки завершення платежу
      render json: { message: 'Платіж успішно оброблений' }
    else
      render json: { message: 'Не підтримуваний тип події' }
    end
  end
end
```
У цьому прикладі ми створили два методи: `create_checkout_session` для створення сесії Stripe Checkout та `webhook` для обробки вебхуків Stripe.

Метод `create_checkout_session` створює сесію Stripe Checkout для разового платежу та перенаправляє користувача на сторінку оплати.

Метод `webhook` обробляє вебхук Stripe, який підтверджує завершення платежу. Ми використовуємо гем `stripe_event` для конструювання події з вебхука та обробки її відповідно до типу події.

Наостанок, нам потрібно додати маршрути для цих методів до нашого файла `config/routes.rb`:
```ruby

  post '/stripe/webhook', to: 'stripe#webhook'
  get '/stripe/create_checkout_session', to: 'stripe#create_checkout_session'
end
```

Далі, ми реалізуємо код для отримання залишків і транзакцій з API Plaid і збереження їх у базі даних. Цей приклад припускає, що ви використовуєте базу даних MySQL і гем `mysql2` для взаємодії з нею.

```ruby
require 'plaid'
require 'mysql2'

# Ключі клієнта Plaid
client_id = 'ваш_client_id'
secret = 'ваш_secret'
public_key = 'ваш_public_key'
environment = 'sandbox' #або 'development', 'production'

# Ініціалізація клієнта Plaid
client = Plaid::Client.new(client_id: client_id,
                           secret: secret,
                           public_key: public_key,
                           environment: environment,
                           api_version: '2019-05-29')

# Підключення до бази даних
client_db = Mysql2::Client.new(username: 'ваш_username',
                               password: 'ваш_password',
                               host: 'ваш_host',
                               database: 'ваш_database')

# Отримання доступу до рахунку
access_token = 'ваш_access_token'

# Отримання інформації про рахунок
accounts_response = client.accounts.get(access_token: access_token)
accounts = accounts_response.accounts

# Отримання транзакцій
start_date = '2022-01-01'
end_date = '2022-01-31'
transactions_response = client.transactions.get(access_token: access_token,
                                                start_date: start_date,
                                                end_date: end_date)
transactions = transactions_response.transactions

# Збереження інформації про рахунок і транзакцій у базі даних
accounts.each do |account|
  # Збереження інформації про рахунок
  query = "INSERT INTO accounts (id, name, type) VALUES ('#{account['id']}', '#{account['name']}', '#{account['type']}')"
  client_db.query(query)

  # Збереження транзакцій
  transactions.each do |transaction|
    query = "INSERT INTO transactions (id, account_id, name, amount, date) VALUES ('#{transaction['id']}', '#{account['id']}', '#{transaction['name']}', #{transaction['amount']}, '#{transaction['date']}')"
    client_db.query(query)
  end
end

# Закриття підключення до бази даних
client_db.close
```

Пам'ятайте, що вам потрібно замінити `'ваш_client_id'`, `'ваш_secret'`, `'ваш_public_key'`, `'ваш_access_token'`, `'ваш_username'`, `'ваш_password'`, `'ваш_host'`, `'ваш_database'` на свої реальні дані.

Цей приклад показує базовий спосіб отримання інформації про рахунок і транзакцій з API Plaid і збереження їх у базі даних. Реальне застосування може потребувати обробки помилок, перевірки наявності даних перед збереженням тощо.

```ruby
          date: transaction_data['date'],
          name: transaction_data['name'],
          amount: transaction_data['amount'],
```
