```ruby
require "httparty"
require "json"

class StockFetcher
  def initialize(api_key, ticker)
    @api_key = api_key
    @ticker = ticker
  end

  def fetch_historical_prices
    url = "https://www.alphavantage.co/query"
    params = {
      function: "TIME_SERIES_DAILY",
      symbol: @ticker,
      apikey: @api_key,
      outputsize: "full"
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, query: params)
    JSON.parse(response.body)["Time Series (Daily)"]
  end

  def compute_moving_average(prices, days = 20)
    sorted_prices = prices.to_a.sort_by { |date, _| date }.reverse
    moving_average = []

    (0...sorted_prices.size).each do |i|
      if i >= days - 1
        window = sorted_prices[i - days + 1..i].map { |_, price| price["4. close"].to_f }
        average = window.sum / window.size
        moving_average << [sorted_prices[i][0], average]
      end
    end

    moving_average
  end
end

  moving_average = fetcher.compute_moving_average(historical_prices)

  puts "20-day moving average for #{ticker}:"
  moving_average.each do |date, average|
    puts "#{date}: #{average}"
```

```ruby
class CreditCard
  include ActiveModel::Model

  attr_accessor :number

  validates :number, presence: true, numericality: true

  def payment_system
    return 'Unknown' unless valid?

    # Алгоритм Луна
    digits = number.to_s.split('').map(&:to_i)
    sum = 0
    digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      if index.even?
        sum += digit
      else
        doubled = digit * 2
        sum += doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
      end
    end

    # Перевірка алгоритмом Луна
    return 'Invalid' unless sum % 10 == 0

    case number.to_s
    when /^4/ then 'Visa'
    when /^5[1-5]/ then 'Mastercard'
    when /^3[47]/ then 'American Express'
    when /^6(?:011|5)/ then 'Discover'
    else 'Unknown'
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# lib/credit_card_validator.rb
require 'activemodel'

class CreditCardValidator < ActiveModel::Validator
  def validate(record)
    card_number = record.credit_card_number
    unless luhn_valid?(card_number)
      record.errors.add(:credit_card_number, 'is not a valid credit card number')
    end
    unless detect_card_brand(card_number).present?
      record.errors.add(:credit_card_number, 'is not a valid credit card brand')
    end
    record.credit_card_brand = detect_card_brand(card_number)
  end

  private

  def luhn_valid?(number)
    # Convert the card number to an array of integers
    digits = number.gsub(/\D/, '').split('').map(&:to_i)
    # Reverse the digits
    digits.reverse!
    # Double every second digit
    digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      digits[index] = digit * 2 if index.odd?
    end
    # Subtract 9 from numbers over 9
    digits.map! do |digit|
      digit > 9 ? digit - 9 : digit
    end
    # If the sum of the digits is divisible by 10, the number is valid
    digits.sum % 10 == 0
  end

  def detect_card_brand(number)
    # Regular expressions for different card brands
    brands = {
      visa: /^4/,
      mastercard: /^5[1-5]/,
      american_express: /^3[47]/,
      diners_club: /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68][0-9])[0-9]/,
      discover: /^6(?:011|5[0-9]{2})[0-9]{12}/,
      jcb: /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}/
    }
    brands.each do |brand, regex|
      return brand.to_s.capitalize if number =~ regex
    end
    nil
  end
end

  attr_accessor :credit_card_number
  attr_accessor :credit_card_brand

  validates_with CreditCardValidator
end
```

```ruby
require 'axlsx'
require 'axlsx_rails'

class LoanAmortizationSchedule
  def initialize(principal, annual_interest_rate, years)
    @principal = principal
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    @years = years
  end

  def calculate_schedule
    monthly_interest_rate = (@annual_interest_rate / 100) / 12
    number_of_payments = @years * 12
    monthly_payment = (@principal * monthly_interest_rate * (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** number_of_payments) / ((1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** number_of_payments - 1)

    schedule = []
    balance = @principal
    for i in 1..number_of_payments
      interest = balance * monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest
      balance -= principal_payment
      schedule << {
        month: i,
        payment: monthly_payment.round(2),
        interest: interest.round(2),
        principal_payment: principal_payment.round(2),
        balance: balance.round(2)
      }
    end

    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(schedule, filename)
    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet do |sheet|
        sheet.add_row ['Month', 'Payment', 'Interest', 'Principal Payment', 'Balance']
        schedule.each do |row|
          sheet.add_row [
            row[:month],
            row[:payment],
            row[:interest],
            row[:principal_payment],
            row[:balance]
          ]
        end
      end

      p.serialize(filename)
    end
  end
end

# Example usage

schedule = loan.calculate_schedule
```

```ruby
      # Store the charge ID in your database for later use
      Order.find(order_id).update(charge_id: charge_id)
    else
      # Handle error
      puts "Error creating charge: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def self.verify_webhook(event)
    # Verify the webhook event
    signature = event['signature']
    payload = event['payload']
    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', API_SECRET, payload)

    if signature != expected_signature
      # Handle invalid signature
      puts "Invalid signature: #{signature} != #{expected_signature}"
      return false
    end

    true
  end

  def self.process_webhook(event)
    # Process the webhook event
    event_type = event['event']['type']
    event_data = event['event']['data']

    case event_type
    when 'charge:confirmed'
      charge_id = event_data['id']
      order = Order.find_by(charge_id: charge_id)
      if order
        order.update(paid: true)
        # Send a confirmation email to the customer
      end
    when 'charge:failed'
      charge_id = event_data['id']
      order = Order.find_by(charge_id: charge_id)
      if order
        order.update(paid: false)
        # Send a failure email to the customer
      end
    end
  end
```

```ruby
require 'axlsx'

class CreditCalculator
  def initialize(loan_amount, annual_interest_rate, years)
    @loan_amount = loan_amount
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 100.0
    @years = years
    @monthly_interest_rate = (@annual_interest_rate / 12.0)
    @number_of_payments = @years * 12
    @monthly_payment = calculate_monthly_payment
  end

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    @monthly_payment = @loan_amount * (@monthly_interest_rate * (1 + @monthly_interest_rate) ** @number_of_payments) / ((1 + @monthly_interest_rate) ** @number_of_payments - 1)
  end

  def generate_schedule
    schedule = []
    balance = @loan_amount
    @number_of_payments.times do |i|
      interest_payment = balance * @monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = @monthly_payment - interest_payment
      balance -= principal_payment
      schedule << {
        payment_number: i + 1,
        monthly_payment: @monthly_payment.round(2),
        interest_payment: interest_payment.round(2),
        principal_payment: principal_payment.round(2),
        balance: balance.round(2)
      }
    end
    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(schedule, file_name)
    Axlsx::Package.new do |p|
      p.workbook.add_worksheet do |sheet|
        sheet.add_row ['Платіж #', 'Щомісячний платіж', 'Платіж процентів', 'Платіж тіла', 'Баланс']
        schedule.each do |row|
          sheet.add_row [
            row[:payment_number],
            row[:monthly_payment],
            row[:interest_payment],
            row[:principal_payment],
            row[:balance]
          ]
        end
      end
      p.serialize(file_name)
    end
  end
end

# Використання

schedule = calculator.generate_schedule
calculator.export_to_excel(schedule, 'credit_schedule.xlsx')
```

```ruby
      order_id: order_id,

    }

    request.body = params.to_json

    response = http.request(request)

    if response.code == '200'
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  def self.verify_callback(params, signature)
    private_key = 'Ваш приватний ключ'
    data = params.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', private_key, data)

    expected_signature == signature
  end
end
```

```ruby
class LiqPay
  attr_accessor :public_key, :private_key

  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def verify_signature(params)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    expected_signature == params['signature']
  end

    data = params.except('signature').sort.to_h
    string = data.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    Base64.strict_encode64(OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha1', private_key, string))
  end
```

```ruby
  def create_payment(order)
    # Set payment parameters
    payment_params = {
      amount: {
        currency: 'EUR',
        value: order.total_price.to_s
      },
      description: "Order ##{order.id}",
      redirect_url: "#{Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.order_url(order.id)}",
      webhook_url: "#{Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.mollie_webhook_url}",
      metadata: {
        order_id: order.id
      }
    }

    # Create payment
    payment = @mollie_client.payments.create(payment_params)

    # Update order with payment ID
    order.update(mollie_payment_id: payment.id)

    # Return payment URL
    payment.get_payment_url
  end

  # Handle Mollie webhook
  def handle_webhook(request)
    # Get payment ID from request
    payment_id = request.params['id']

    # Get payment from Mollie API
    payment = @mollie_client.payments.get(payment_id)

    # Get order ID from payment metadata
    order_id = payment.metadata['order_id']

    # Find order
    order = Order.find(order_id)

    # Update order status based on payment status
    case payment.status
    when 'paid'
      order.update(status: 'paid')
    when 'failed'
      order.update(status: 'failed')
    when 'expired'
      order.update(status: 'expired')
    end

    # Return success response
    { status: :ok }
  end
end
```

Replace the `ENV` variables with your actual Xero API credentials.

### Invoice Service

Create a new file `app/services/invoice_service.rb`:
```ruby
# app/services/invoice_service.rb
class InvoiceService
  def self.create_invoice(invoice)
    # Create a new Xero invoice
    xero_invoice = XeroClient.Invoice.build(
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        name: invoice.customer_name
      },
      line_items: invoice.line_items.map do |line_item|
        {
          description: line_item.description,
          quantity: line_item.quantity,
          unit_amount: line_item.unit_price
        }
      end
    )

    # Save the Xero invoice
    xero_invoice.save

    # Update the Rails invoice with the Xero invoice ID
    invoice.update(xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id)
  end

  def self.update_payment_status(invoice)
    # Get the Xero invoice
    xero_invoice = XeroClient.Invoice.find(invoice.xero_invoice_id)

    # Update the Rails invoice payment status
    invoice.update(payment_status: xero_invoice.status)
  end
end
```
This service creates a new Xero invoice and updates the Rails invoice with the Xero invoice ID. It also updates the Rails invoice payment status based on the Xero invoice status.

### Background Job

```ruby
# app/jobs/sync_xero_payment_status_job.rb
class SyncXeroPaymentStatusJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform
    # Get all invoices with a Xero invoice ID
    invoices = Invoice.where.not(xero_invoice_id: nil)

    # Update the payment status for each invoice
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      InvoiceService.update_payment_status(invoice)
    end
  end
end
```
This job updates the payment status for all invoices with a Xero invoice ID.

Add the following line to your `config/environments/*.rb` files to schedule the job to run periodically:

```ruby
end
```

This will run the job daily at midnight to update the payment status for all invoices.

```ruby
# config/initializers/fondy.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'digest/sha2'
require 'base64'

class FondyPayment
  attr_accessor :merchant_id, :merchant_password, :order_id, :amount, :currency

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
  end

  def make_payment(order_id, amount, currency)
    @order_id = order_id
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency

    url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/url/'
    response = HTTParty.post(url, body: payment_params)

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['response']['checkout_url']
    else
      raise "Failed to create payment: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def verify_signature(params)
    signature = params.delete('signature')
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)

    signature == expected_signature
  end

  private

  def payment_params
    {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: @order_id,
      amount: @amount,
      currency: @currency
    }
  end

  def generate_signature(params)
    string_to_sign = params.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    digest = Digest::SHA2.new
    digest.update(string_to_sign)
    Base64.strict_encode64(digest.digest + @merchant_password)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class WayForPayController < ApplicationController
  include HTTParty

  def payment_request

    }

    # Handle the payment request response
    if response.success?
      # Redirect the user to the payment page
      redirect_to response['url']
    else
      # Handle the payment request error
      render json: { error: 'Payment request failed' }, status: :bad_request
    end
  end

  def payment_callback
    # Set your WayForPay merchant account ID and secret key
    merchant_account_id = 'your_merchant_account_id'
    secret_key = 'your_secret_key'

    # Get the payment callback parameters
    order_id = params[:orderReference]
    amount = params[:amount]
    currency = params[:currency]
    transaction_status = params[:transactionStatus]

    # Verify the payment callback signature
    if verify_signature(merchant_account_id, order_id, amount, currency, secret_key, params[:merchantSignature])
      # Update the order status based on the transaction status
      order = Order.find(order_id)
      if transaction_status == 'Approved'
        order.update(status: :approved)
      elsif transaction_status == 'Declined'
        order.update(status: :declined)
      end

      # Return a success response
      render json: { success: 'Payment callback processed successfully' }, status: :ok
    else
      # Return an error response if the signature is invalid
      render json: { error: 'Invalid payment callback signature' }, status: :bad_request
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(merchant_account_id, order_id, amount, currency, secret_key)
    # Generate the payment request signature
    signature_string = "#{merchant_account_id}#{order_id}#{amount}#{currency}#{secret_key}"
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end

  def verify_signature(merchant_account_id, order_id, amount, currency, secret_key, signature)
    # Verify the payment callback signature
    expected_signature = generate_signature(merchant_account_id, order_id, amount, currency, secret_key)
    expected_signature == signature
  end
end
```

```ruby
# fondy_payment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'
require 'json'

class FondyPayment
  def initialize(order_id, amount, currency, merchant_id, secret_key)
    @order_id = order_id
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end

  def create_payment
    url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/redirect/'
    response = HTTParty.post(url,
                             body: {
                               order_id: @order_id,
                               amount: @amount,
                               currency: @currency,
                               merchant_id: @merchant_id,
                               redirect_url: 'https://example.com/redirect',
                               server_callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback'
                             },
                             headers: {
                               'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                             })

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['response']
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  def verify_signature(response)
    signature = response['signature']
    data = response.reject { |k, v| k == 'signature' }
    expected_signature = Base64.strict_encode64(OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha1', @secret_key, data.sort.to_a.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join))

    signature == expected_signature
  end
end
```

Цей код реалізує два методи: `create_payment` для створення нового платежу через Fondy, і `verify_signature` для перевірки підпису відповіді.

У методі `create_payment` ми надсилаємо POST-запит до сервера Fondy з необхідними даними про платіж. Якщо запит успішний, ми повертаємо відповідь сервера у форматі JSON.

У методі `verify_signature` ми порівнюємо підпис відповіді з очікуваним підписом, який ми генеруємо на основі даних відповіді і нашого секретного ключа. Якщо підписи збігаються, ми повертаємо true, інакше false.

```ruby
require "httparty"

class PortmoneApi
  BASE_URL = "https://www.portmone.com.ua/api"
  VERSION = "v1"

  def initialize(merchant_id, password)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @password = password
  end

  def create_payment_link(order_id, amount, currency, description)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/#{VERSION}/payment/link"
    headers = {
      "Content-Type" => "application/json",
      "Authorization" => "Basic #{Base64.encode64("#{@merchant_id}:#{@password}")}"
    }
    body = {
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description
    }
    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)["link"]
    else
      raise "Failed to create payment link: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def process_callback(params)
    # Validate callback request
    if params["order_id"].blank? || params["status"].blank?
      raise "Invalid callback request"
    end

    # Process payment status
    case params["status"]
    when "paid"
      # Update order status to paid
      puts "Order #{params["order_id"]} paid successfully"
    when "failed"
      # Update order status to failed
      puts "Order #{params["order_id"]} failed"
    else
      # Handle other status codes
      puts "Order #{params["order_id"]} has unknown status #{params["status"]}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# liqpay_payment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class LiqPayPayment
  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
    @base_url = 'https://www.liqpay.ua/api/'
  end

  def p2p_credit(to_card, amount, currency = 'UAH', description = '')
    # Підготовка параметрів платежу
    params = {
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key,
      action: 'p2p_credit',
      from: '', # Необов'язковий параметр для вказівки картки відправника
      to: to_card,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description
    }

    # Підписування параметрів
    signature = generate_signature(params)

    # Додавання підпису до параметрів
    params['signature'] = signature

    # Виконання запиту до LiqPay API
    response = HTTParty.post("#{@base_url}request", body: params)

    # Обробка відповіді
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { error: 'Помилка під час виконання запиту' }
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(params)
    # Генерування підпису за допомогою приватного ключа
    str = params.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    Base64.strict_encode64(OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha1', @private_key, str))
  end
end

# Приклад використання
public_key = 'ВАШ_ПУБЛІЧНИЙ_КЛЮЧ'

to_card = '5271431702241484' # Номер картки одержувача
amount = '100.00' # Сума платежу

payment = LiqPayPayment.new(public_key, private_key)
response = payment.p2p_credit(to_card, amount)

puts response
```

```ruby
# monetize.rb
require 'monetize'

class UkrainianMoney
  def initialize(amount)
    @amount = amount
  end

  def to_words
    whole_part = @amount.to_i
    fractional_part = (@amount * 100).to_i % 100

    whole_part_to_words = whole_number_to_words(whole_part)
    fractional_part_to_words = fractional_part_to_words(fractional_part)

    "#{whole_part_to_words} #{fractional_part_to_words}"
  end

  private

  def whole_number_to_words(number)
    ones = ['', 'один', 'два', 'три', 'чотири', 'п'ять', 'шість', 'сім', 'вісім', 'дев'ять']
    teens = ['десять', 'одинадцять', 'дванадцять', 'тринадцять', 'чотирнадцять', 'п'ятнадцять', 'шістнадцять', 'сімнадцять', 'вісімнадцять', 'дев'ятнадцять']
    tens = ['', '', 'двадцять', 'тридцять', 'сорок', 'п'ятдесят', 'шістдесят', 'сімдесят', 'вісімдесят', 'дев'яносто']
    hundreds = ['', 'сто', 'двісті', 'триста', 'чотириста', 'п'ятсот', 'шістьсот', 'сімсот', 'вісімсот', 'дев'ятсот']

    if number < 10
      ones[number]
    elsif number < 20
      teens[number - 10]
    elsif number < 100
      "#{tens[number / 10]} #{ones[number % 10]}" if number % 10 != 0
    else
      "#{hundreds[number / 100]} #{whole_number_to_words(number % 100)}"
    end
  end

  def fractional_part_to_words(number)
    ones = ['', 'одна', 'дві', 'три', 'чотири', 'п'ять', 'шість', 'сім', 'вісім', 'дев'ять']
    teens = ['десять', 'одинадцять', 'дванадцять', 'тринадцять', 'чотирнадцять', 'п'ятнадцять', 'шістнадцять', 'сімнадцять', 'вісімнадцять', 'дев'ятнадцять']
```

Next, you'll need to implement the Ruby code to interact with the LiqPay p2p credit API. The following example demonstrates how to make a payout to a Ukrainian card using the LiqPay API. Note that you will need to replace placeholders like `YOUR_LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY`, `YOUR_LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY`, `RECIPIENT_CARD_NUMBER`, `RECIPIENT_CARD_EXPIRY_MONTH`, `RECIPIENT_CARD_EXPIRY_YEAR`, and `PAYOUT_AMOUNT` with your actual LiqPay credentials, recipient's card details, and the payout amount.

```ruby
# liqpay_payout.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'uri'

class LiqPayPayout
  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
    @api_url = 'https://www.liqpay.ua/api/request'
  end

  def payout(card_number, card_expiry_month, card_expiry_year, amount)
    # Prepare payout data
    data = {
      "version" => "3",
      "action" => "p2p_credit",
      "public_key" => @public_key,
      "card" => card_number,
      "card_exp" => "#{card_expiry_month}#{card_expiry_year}",
      "amount" => amount
    }

    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data)

    # Prepare request data
    request_data = {
      "data" => Base64.strict_encode64(data.to_json),
      "signature" => signature
    }

    # Make request to LiqPay API
    response = HTTParty.post(@api_url, body: request_data)

    # Handle response
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      { error: "Failed to process payout" }
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    # Sort data by keys and convert to string
    sorted_data = data.sort_by { |k, v| k }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join

    # Calculate signature using private key
    OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', @private_key, sorted_data)
  end
end
```

```ruby
    if billions > 0
      words << process_number(billions)
      words << BILLIONS[(billions % 10) == 1 && (billions % 100) != 11 ? 1 : (billions % 10) == 2..4 && (billions % 100) != 12..14 ? 2 : 5]
      words << " "
      hryvnias %= 1_000_000_000
    end

    # Process millions
    millions = hryvnias / 1_000_000
    if millions > 0
      words << process_number(millions)
      words << MILLIONS[(millions % 10) == 1 && (millions % 100) != 11 ? 1 : (millions % 10) == 2..4 && (millions % 100) != 12..14 ? 2 : 5]
      words << " "
      hryvnias %= 1_000_000
    end

    # Process thousands
    thousands = hryvnias / 1_000
    if thousands > 0
      words << process_number(thousands)
      words << THOUSANDS[(thousands % 10) == 1 && (thousands % 100) != 11 ? 1 : (thousands % 10) == 2..4 && (thousands % 100) != 12..14 ? 2 : 5]
      words << " "
      hryvnias %= 1_000
    end

    # Process hundreds
    hundreds = hryvnias / 100
    if hundreds > 0
      words << process_number(hundreds)
      words << "сто"
      words << " "
      hryvnias %= 100
    end

    # Process tens and ones
    words << process_number(hryvnias) unless hryvnias == 0

    # Add currency word
    words << CURRENCY["hryvnias"] unless hryvnias == 0

    # Add kopecks
    words << " "
    words << process_number(kopecks)
    words << CURRENCY["kopecks"] unless kopecks == 0

    words.join
  end

  def self.process_number(number)
    return "" if number == 0

    words = []

    # Process hundreds
    hundreds = number / 100
    if hundreds > 0
      words << NUMBERS[hundreds * 100]
      number %= 100
    end

    # Process tens and ones
    if number >= 20
      tens = number / 10
      words << NUMBERS[tens * 10]
      number %= 10
    end

    # Process ones
    words << NUMBERS[number] unless number == 0

    words.join
  end
end

# Example usage:
puts UkrainianCurrencyWords.convert_to_words(1250.50)
```

This implementation first converts the amount into hryvnias and kopecks, then processes each part separately. It uses the `NUMBERS`, `THOUSANDS`, `MILLIONS`, `BILLIONS`, and `CURRENCY` hashes to map numbers to their Ukrainian words. The `process_number` method is used to process each number, and the `convert_to_words` method is used to convert the entire amount to words.

```ruby
    end

    # Create XML request using xml-simple gem
    xml = XmlSimple.xml_out(invoice_data, { 'RootName' => 'Invoice' })

    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(@private_key_path))

    Base64.encode64(signed_xml_request)
  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class IPayClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.ipay.ua/'.freeze
  TRANSACTION_STATUS_URL = "#{BASE_URL}payment/status".freeze

  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end

  def create_payment(order_id, amount, currency, description)
    # Реалізація створення платежу через iPay.ua
    # Дивіться документацію iPay.ua для отримання інформації про необхідні параметри
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}payment/create",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@secret_key}"
      },
      body: {
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        order_id: order_id,
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        description: description
      }.to_json
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  def check_transaction_status(transaction_id)
    # Перевіряємо статус транзакції
    response = HTTParty.get(
      TRANSACTION_STATUS_URL,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@secret_key}"
      },
      query: {
        transaction_id: transaction_id
      }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require "httparty"

class DHLExpressTracker
  def initialize(tracking_number)
    @tracking_number = tracking_number
  end

  def track
    url = "https://www.dhl.com/content/dam/dhl/global/core/services/tracking.json"
    headers = {
      "Content-Type" => "application/json",
      "User-Agent" => "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/58.0.3029.110 Safari/537.3"
    }
    params = {
      "trackingNumber" => @tracking_number,
      "languageCode" => "en",
      "countryCode" => "US"
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: params.to_json)

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to retrieve tracking information"
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response_body)
    json_response = JSON.parse(response_body, symbolize_names: true)
    events = json_response[:shipments].first[:events]

    events.each do |event|
      puts "Date: #{event[:date]}"
      puts "Time: #{event[:time]}"
      puts "Location: #{event[:location]}"
      puts "Status: #{event[:description]}"
      puts "------------------------"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class EasyPostShipper
  def initialize(package, to_address, from_address)
    @package = package
    @to_address = to_address
    @from_address = from_address
  end

  def compare_rates
    # Create a shipment
    shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
      package: @package,
      to_address: @to_address,
      from_address: @from_address,
      carrier_accounts: ['ca_123456789'] # Optional, specify carrier accounts to use
    )

    # Get rates for the shipment
    rates = shipment.rates

    # Sort rates by cost
    sorted_rates = rates.sort_by { |rate| rate.rate }

    # Print the cheapest rate
    cheapest_rate = sorted_rates.first
    puts "Cheapest rate: #{cheapest_rate.carrier} - #{cheapest_rate.service} - $#{cheapest_rate.rate}"

    # Buy the cheapest label
    buy_cheapest_label(cheapest_rate)
  end

  private

  def buy_cheapest_label(rate)
    # Create a label for the cheapest rate
    label = EasyPost::Shipment.create(
      package: @package,
      to_address: @to_address,
      from_address: @from_address,
      carrier: rate.carrier,
      service: rate.service,
      rate: rate
    )

    # Print the label
    puts "Label URL: #{label.postage_label.label_url}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
      dev_id: EBAY_DEV_ID,

      create_ebay_listing(client)
    end

      description: self.description,
      price: self.price,
      quantity: self.quantity,
      category_id: self.category_id
    )

    # Log the creation

  end
```

Here's an example implementation that fetches new orders from Amazon Seller Central through the Selling Partner API and saves them to a DynamoDB table.

```ruby
# config/initializers/amazon_selling_partner_api.rb
require 'aws-sdk-spscommerce'
require 'aws-sdk-sqs'
require 'aws-sdk-dynamodb'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'
require 'base64'

# Set up Amazon Selling Partner API credentials
class AmazonSellingPartnerAPI
  def initialize
    @access_key_id = ENV['AMAZON_ACCESS_KEY_ID']
    @secret_access_key = ENV['AMAZON_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
    @seller_id = ENV['AMAZON_SELLER_ID']
    @marketplace_id = ENV['AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ID']
    @region = ENV['AMAZON_REGION']
    @client_id = ENV['AMAZON_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['AMAZON_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @refresh_token = ENV['AMAZON_REFRESH_TOKEN']
    @endpoint = ENV['AMAZON_ENDPOINT']
  end

  # Fetch new orders from Amazon Seller Central
  def fetch_new_orders
    # Get access token
    access_token = get_access_token

    # Set up headers and query parameters
    headers = {
      'x-amz-access-token' => access_token,
      'x-amz-date' => Time.now.utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),
      'x-amz-target' => 'SellingPartnerAPI/v1/orders',
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    query_params = {
      'marketplaceIds' => @marketplace_id,
      'fulfillmentChannel' => 'MFN',
      'orderStatus' => ['Shipped', 'Unshipped']
    }

    # Make API request to fetch new orders
    response = HTTParty.get("#{@endpoint}/orders", headers: headers, query: query_params)

    # Check if response is successful
    if response.success?
      # Parse JSON response
      orders = JSON.parse(response.body)['payload']['Orders']

      # Save orders to DynamoDB
      save_orders_to_dynamodb(orders)
    else
      # Handle error
      puts "Error fetching new orders: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  # Get access token using refresh token
  def get_access_token
    # Set up headers and query parameters
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    }
    query_params = {
      'grant_type' => 'refresh_token',
      'refresh_token' => @refresh_token,
      'client_id' => @client_id,
      'client_secret' => @client_secret
    }

    # Make API request to get access token
    response = HTTParty.post("#{@endpoint}/tokens/2021-01-01", headers: headers, body: query_params)

    # Check if response is successful
    if response.success?
      # Parse JSON response
      access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']

      # Return access token
      access_token
    else
      # Handle error
      puts "Error getting access token: #{response.code}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Save orders to DynamoDB
  def save_orders_to_dynamodb(orders)
    # Set up DynamoDB client
    dynamodb = Aws::DynamoDB::Client.new(
      access_key_id: @access_key_id,
      secret_access_key: @secret_access_key,
      region: @region
    )

    # Create DynamoDB table if it doesn't exist
    table_name = 'orders'
    if !dynamodb.list_tables.table_names.include?(table_name)
      dynamodb.create_table({
        table_name: table_name,
        attribute_definitions: [
          {
            attribute_name: 'orderId',
            attribute_type: 'S'
          }
        ],
        key_schema: [
          {
            attribute_name: 'orderId',
            key_type: 'HASH'
          }
        ],
        provisioned_throughput: {
          read_capacity_units: 1,
          write_capacity_units: 1
        }
      })
    end

    # Save orders to DynamoDB table
    orders.each do |order|
      dynamodb.put_item({
        table_name: table_name,
        item: {
          'orderId' => order['orderId'],
          'buyerName' => order['buyerName'],
          'orderDate' => order['orderDate'],
          'orderStatus' => order['orderStatus']
        }
      })
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'xmlsimple'

class USPSAddressValidator
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_url = 'http://production.shippingapis.com/ShippingAPI.dll'
  end

  def validate_and_normalise(address)
    # Prepare the XML request
    xml_request = {
      'CityStateLookupRequest' => {
        'USERID' => @api_key,
        'CityStateLookupRequest' => {
          'Zip5' => address[:zip],
          'Zip4' => address[:zip4],
          'FirmName' => address[:firm_name],
          'Address1' => address[:address1],
          'Address2' => address[:address2],
          'Urbanization' => address[:urbanization],
          'City' => address[:city],
          'State' => address[:state]
        }
      }
    }

    # Send the request
    response = HTTParty.post(@api_url, body: xml_request.to_xml, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'text/xml' })

    # Parse the XML response
    response_xml = XmlSimple.xml_in(response.body)

    # Extract the normalised address
    normalised_address = {
      firm_name: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['FirmName'],
      address1: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['Address1'],
      address2: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['Address2'],
      urbanization: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['Urbanization'],
      city: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['City'],
      state: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['State'],
      zip: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['Zip5'],
      zip4: response_xml['CityStateLookupResponse']['CityStateLookupResponse']['Zip4']
    }

    normalised_address
  end
end

  }
```

```ruby
# product.rb (model)
require 'active_record'

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  # attributes: id, title, description, price, currency, image_url, link
end

# google_merchant_center_feed.rb (service)
require 'nokogiri'

class GoogleMerchantCenterFeed
  def initialize(products)
    @products = products
  end

  def generate_feed
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.feed(
        'xmlns' => 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom',
        'xmlns:app' => 'http://www.w3.org/2007/app',
        'xmlns:g' => 'http://base.google.com/ns/1.0'
      ) do
        xml.title 'Product Catalogue'
        xml.link(
          'rel' => 'self',
          'href' => 'https://example.com/product-catalogue'
        )
        xml.updated Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')
        xml.author do
          xml.name 'Your Company Name'
          xml.uri 'https://example.com'
        end
        xml.entry do
          @products.each do |product|
            xml.entry do
              xml.title product.title
              xml.description product.description
              xml.link(
                'rel' => 'alternate',
                'href' => product.link
              )
              xml.g:id product.id
              xml.g:price(
                'currency' => product.currency
              ) do
                xml.text product.price
              end
              xml.g:image_link product.image_url
              xml.g:condition 'new'
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    builder.to_xml
  end
end
```

```ruby
        # Add a page break after each product
        pdf.start_new_page unless index == @products.size - 1
      end
    end
  end
end
```

First, let's create a background job to import the product price list. We'll use Sidekiq for this.

**app/workers/import_product_prices_worker.rb**
```ruby
# app/workers/import_product_prices_worker.rb
class ImportProductPricesWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options queue: 'import_product_prices'

  def perform(file_path)
    # Read the Excel file
    xlsx = Roo::Spreadsheet.open(file_path)

    # Iterate over each row in the spreadsheet
    xlsx.each_row_streaming do |row|
      # Assuming the first row is the header, and the columns are: product_id, price
      next if row[0].nil? # skip header row
      product_id = row[0].value.to_i
      price = row[1].value.to_f

      # Find or create the product
      product = Product.find_or_create_by(id: product_id)

      # Update the product's price
      product.update(price: price)
    end
  end
end
```

### Step 1: Install Elasticsearch and required gems

Run the following commands in your terminal:
```bash
bundle install
rails generate elasticsearch:config
```

### Step 2: Configure Elasticsearch

Create a new file `config/elasticsearch.yml` with the following content:
```yml
development:
  host: localhost
  port: 9200
  index_name: products
```

### Step 3: Create Product model and Elasticsearch index

Create a new file `app/models/product.rb` with the following content:
```ruby
class Product < ApplicationRecord
  include Elasticsearch::Model
  include Elasticsearch::Model::Callbacks

  index_name 'products'

  settings index: {
    number_of_shards: 1,
    number_of_replicas: 0
  } do
    mapping do
      indexes :name, type: 'text', analyzer: 'standard'
      indexes :description, type: 'text', analyzer: 'standard'
      indexes :price, type: 'float'
      indexes :category, type: 'keyword'
    end
  end

  def as_indexed_json(options = {})
    as_json(
      only: [:name, :description, :price, :category],
      methods: []
    )
  end
end
```

### Step 4: Create a search service

Create a new file `app/services/product_search_service.rb` with the following content:
```ruby
class ProductSearchService
  def self.search(query, filters = {}, facets = [])
    query = {
      query: {
        bool: {
          must: [
            {
              multi_match: {
                query: query,
                fields: ['name', 'description']
              }
            }
          ],
          filter: []
        }
      },
      aggs: {}
    }

    filters.each do |field, value|
      query[:query][:bool][:filter] << { term: { "#{field}" => value } }
    end

    facets.each do |field|
      query[:aggs][field] = {
        terms: {
          field: field,
          size: 100
        }
      }
    end

    Product.search(query)
  end
end
```

### Step 5: Create a controller to handle search requests

Create a new file `app/controllers/products_controller.rb` with the following content:
```ruby
class ProductsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    query = params[:query]
    filters = params[:filters]
    facets = params[:facets]

    results = ProductSearchService.search(query, filters, facets)

    render json: {
      products: results,
      facets: results.aggregations
    }
  end
end
```

### Step 6: Add routes

Add the following route to your `config/routes.rb` file:
```ruby
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  get '/products', to: 'products#index'
end
```

```ruby
class WoocommerceProduct < ApplicationRecord
  self.table_name = 'woocommerce_products'

    client = WoocommerceApi::Client.new(
      url: 'https://example.com', # замінте на адрес вашого сайту WooCommerce
      consumer_key: 'consumer_key', # замінте на ваш consumer key

    product = client.create_product(
      name: name,
      description: description,
      price: price,
      images: [

        }
      ]
    )

    self.create(
      name: name,
      description: description,
      price: price,
      image_url: image_url,
      woocommerce_id: product.id
    )
  end

  def self.update_product(id, name, description, price, image_url)
    client = WoocommerceApi::Client.new(
      url: 'https://example.com', # замінте на адрес вашого сайту WooCommerce
      consumer_key: 'consumer_key', # замінте на ваш consumer key
      consumer_secret: 'consumer_secret' # замінте на ваш consumer secret

    product = client.update_product(
      id: id,
      name: name,
      description: description,
      price: price,
      images: [
        {
          src: image_url
        }
      ]
    )

    self.where(woocommerce_id: id).update(
      name: name,
      description: description,
      price: price,
      image_url: image_url
    )
  end

  def self.delete_product(id)
```

**etsy_api.rb:**

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'oauth2'

class EtsyApi
  def initialize(api_key, api_secret, shop_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
    @shop_id = shop_id
    @access_token = obtain_access_token
  end

  def obtain_access_token
    # З換ємо токен доступу за допомогою OAuth2
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(@api_key, @api_secret, site: 'https://api.etsy.com')
    client.client_credentials.get_token
  end

  def get_listings
    # Отримуємо оголошення магазину
    response = HTTParty.get("https://api.etsy.com/v3/shops/#{@shop_id}/listings", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token.token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    })
    JSON.parse(response.body)['results']
  end

  def get_orders
    # Отримуємо замовлення магазину
    response = HTTParty.get("https://api.etsy.com/v3/shops/#{@shop_id}/orders", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token.token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    })
    JSON.parse(response.body)['results']
  end
end
```

**Implementation**
```ruby
# etsy_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'oauth2'

class EtsyApiClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.etsy.com/v3'
  OAUTH_URL = 'https://www.etsy.com/oauth'

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, access_token)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, options = {})
    endpoint = "/shops/#{shop_id}/listings"
    query_params = {
      api_key: @client_id,
      access_token: @access_token
    }.merge(options)

    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", query: query_params)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def get_shop_orders(shop_id, options = {})
    endpoint = "/shops/#{shop_id}/receipts"
    query_params = {
      api_key: @client_id,
      access_token: @access_token
    }.merge(options)

    response = HTTParty.get("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", query: query_params)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def get_access_token(code)
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      @client_id,
      @client_secret,
      site: OAUTH_URL,
      authorize_url: '/login',
      token_url: '/token'
    )

    token = client.code.get_token(code)
    token.token
  end
end
```

**Implementation**

This implementation assumes you have a Rails application with a `Cart` model and a `User` model. It uses the `klaviyo` gem to interact with the Klaviyo API and the `sidekiq` gem to run the abandoned cart reminder job in the background.

### Cart Model

```ruby
# app/models/cart.rb
class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user

  def send_abandoned_cart_reminder
    AbandonedCartReminderJob.perform_later(self)
  end
end
```

### Abandoned Cart Reminder Job

```ruby
# app/jobs/abandoned_cart_reminder_job.rb
class AbandonedCartReminderJob < Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options queue: 'abandoned_cart_reminders'

  def perform(cart_id)
    cart = Cart.find(cart_id)
    user = cart.user

    # Check if the cart is still abandoned
    if cart.items.any? && !cart.checked_out?
      # Send abandoned cart reminder email through Klaviyo
      klaviyo = Klaviyo::Client.new(api_key: ENV['KLAVIYO_API_KEY'])
      klaviyo.trigger_campaign(
        campaign_id: ENV['KLAVIYO_ABANDONED_CART_CAMPAIGN_ID'],
        profile: {
          email: user.email,
          first_name: user.first_name,
          last_name: user.last_name
        },
        properties: {
          cart_id: cart.id,
          cart_url: Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.cart_path(cart)
        }
      )
    end
  end
end
```

### Cart Controller

```ruby
# app/controllers/carts_controller.rb
class CartsController < ApplicationController
  def update
    cart = Cart.find(params[:id])
    cart.update(cart_params)

    # Send abandoned cart reminder email if the cart is abandoned
    if cart.items.any? && !cart.checked_out?
      cart.send_abandoned_cart_reminder
    end

    redirect_to cart_path(cart)
  end

  private

  def cart_params
    params.require(:cart).permit(:checked_out)
  end
end
```

### Setup

1. Install the required gems by running `bundle install`.
2. Set up a Klaviyo account and create an abandoned cart campaign.
3. Set the `KLAVIYO_API_KEY` and `KLAVIYO_ABANDONED_CART_CAMPAIGN_ID` environment variables.
4. Run the Sidekiq worker by executing `sidekiq` in your terminal.

This implementation sends an abandoned cart reminder email through Klaviyo when a user leaves items in their cart. The email is triggered by the `AbandonedCartReminderJob` job, which is performed in the background using Sidekiq.

* `aws-sdk-s3` для взаємодії з Amazon S3
* `image_processing` для генерації мініатюр
* `fog` для роботи з CDN

Отже, наш Gemfile буде виглядати наступним чином:

Тепер перейдемо до реалізації. Створимо клас `ImageUploader`, який буде відповідальний за завантаження зображень до Amazon S3, генерацію мініатюр та видачу їх через CDN:
```ruby
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'image_processing'
require 'fog'

class ImageUploader
  def initialize(bucket_name, cdn_url)
    @bucket_name = bucket_name
    @cdn_url = cdn_url
    @s3 = Aws::S3::Client.new(region: 'your_region')
    @fog = Fog::Storage.new(provider: 'AWS', aws_access_key_id: 'your_access_key', aws_secret_access_key: 'your_secret_key')
  end

  def upload_image(image_path, image_name)
    # Завантаження зображення до Amazon S3
    obj = @s3.put_object(bucket: @bucket_name, key: image_name, body: File.open(image_path))
    # Генерація мініатюр
    thumbnails = generate_thumbnails(image_path)
    # Завантаження мініатюр до Amazon S3
    thumbnails.each do |thumbnail|
      @s3.put_object(bucket: @bucket_name, key: "#{image_name}_#{thumbnail[:size]}", body: thumbnail[:image])
    end
    # Віддача зображення через CDN
    url = "#{@cdn_url}/#{image_name}"
    { url: url, thumbnails: thumbnails.map { |t| "#{@cdn_url}/#{image_name}_#{t[:size]}" } }
  end

  private

  def generate_thumbnails(image_path)
    # Генерація мініатюр за допомогою геми image_processing
    ImageProcessing::Vips.new(image_path).resize_to_fit([100, 100]).call
    ImageProcessing::Vips.new(image_path).resize_to_fit([200, 200]).call
    # ...
  end
end
```
У цьому класі ми використовуємо гем `aws-sdk-s3` для взаємодії з Amazon S3, гем `image_processing` для генерації мініатюр та гем `fog` для роботи з CDN.

Метод `upload_image` приймає шлях до зображення та ім'я зображення, завантажує зображення до Amazon S3, генерує мініатюри та завантажує їх до Amazon S3, після чого повертає URL зображення та мініатюр через CDN.

Метод `generate_thumbnails` генерує мініатюри за допомогою геми `image_processing`. Ми можемо налаштувати розміри мініатюр згідно з нашими потребами.

Тепер ми можемо використовувати цей клас для завантаження зображень до Amazon S3, генерації мініатюр та видачі їх через CDN:

```ruby
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :order_items
  belongs_to :coupon, optional: true

  def total_price
    order_items.sum(:price)
  end

  def apply_coupon
    return unless coupon

    if coupon.type == 'percentage'
      discount = (total_price * coupon.value) / 100
    else
      discount = coupon.value
    end

    update(total_price: total_price - discount)
  end
```

Тепер давайте розглянемо реалізацію коду на Ruby, який замовляє кур'єра через API Uber Direct, коли замовлення готове:
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

# Ключі API Uber Direct
UBER_DIRECT_API_KEY = 'ВАШ_API_KEY'
UBER_DIRECT_API_SECRET = 'ВАШ_API_SECRET'

# URL API Uber Direct
UBER_DIRECT_API_URL = 'https://api.uber.com/v1/deliveries'

# Дані замовлення
order_id = 'ЗАМОВЛЕННЯ_123'
order_ready = true

# Перевірка, чи замовлення готове
if order_ready
  # Підготовка даних для замовлення кур'єра
  delivery_data = {
    'order_id' => order_id,
    'pickup_address' => 'ВУЛИЦЯ_МАЙДАНА_1',
    'dropoff_address' => 'ВУЛИЦЯ_ХРЕЩАТИК_10',
    'package_details' => {
      'length' => 10,
      'width' => 10,
      'height' => 10,
      'weight' => 1
    }
  }

  # Авторизація в API Uber Direct
  auth_response = HTTParty.post(
    "#{UBER_DIRECT_API_URL}/auth",
    headers: {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{UBER_DIRECT_API_KEY}"
    },
    body: {
      'grant_type' => 'client_credentials',
      'client_id' => UBER_DIRECT_API_KEY,
      'client_secret' => UBER_DIRECT_API_SECRET
    }.to_json
  )

  # Отримання токену авторизації
  access_token = JSON.parse(auth_response.body)['access_token']

  # Замовлення кур'єра
  delivery_response = HTTParty.post(
    "#{UBER_DIRECT_API_URL}/deliveries",
    headers: {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}"
    },
    body: delivery_data.to_json
  )

  # Перевірка статусу замовлення кур'єра
  if delivery_response.success?
    puts "Кур'єр замовлено успішно! Заказ №#{order_id}"
  else
    puts "Помилка при замовленні кур'єра: #{delivery_response.body}"
  end
else
  puts "Замовлення не готове. Кур'єр не замовлено."
end
```
У цьому коді ми використовуємо гем `httparty` для здійснення HTTP-запитів до API Uber Direct. Спочатку ми авторизуємося в API, отримуючи токен авторизації. Потім ми підготував дані для замовлення кур'єра і відправляємо запит на замовлення кур'єра. Нарешті, ми перевіряємо статус замовлення кур'єра і виводимо повідомлення про результат.

```ruby
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :order_items
  has_many :products, through: :order_items

  validates :subtotal, :tax, :total, presence: true

  def calculate_subtotal
    order_items.sum(&:subtotal)
  end

  def calculate_tax
    calculate_subtotal * 0.08 # assume 8% tax rate
  end

  def calculate_total
    calculate_subtotal + calculate_tax
  end

  def apply_coupon(coupon)
    if coupon.valid?
      discount_amount = calculate_subtotal * (coupon.discount_percentage / 100)
      update(total: calculate_total - discount_amount)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# collaborative_filtering.rb

require "matrix"

class CollaborativeFiltering
  def initialize(orders)
    @orders = orders
    @user_ids = orders.keys
    @product_ids = orders.values.map(&:keys).flatten.uniq
    @user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix
  end

  def recommend(user_id, num_recommendations)
    # Calculate similarity between users
    similarities = calculate_similarities(user_id)

    # Get recommended products
    recommended_products = get_recommended_products(similarities, num_recommendations)

    recommended_products
  end

  private

  def build_user_product_matrix
    matrix = Matrix.zero(@user_ids.size, @product_ids.size)
    @user_ids.each_with_index do |user_id, user_index|
      @product_ids.each_with_index do |product_id, product_index|
        matrix[user_index, product_index] = @orders[user_id][product_id] || 0
      end
    end
    matrix
  end

  def calculate_similarities(user_id)
    user_index = @user_ids.index(user_id)
    similarities = []
    @user_ids.each_with_index do |other_user_id, other_user_index|
      next if other_user_id == user_id
      similarity = cosine_similarity(@user_product_matrix.row(user_index), @user_product_matrix.row(other_user_index))
      similarities << [other_user_id, similarity]
    end
    similarities.sort_by { |_, similarity| -similarity }
  end

  def cosine_similarity(vector1, vector2)
    dot_product = vector1 * vector2.transpose
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vector1 * vector1.transpose)
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vector2 * vector2.transpose)
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  def get_recommended_products(similarities, num_recommendations)
    recommended_products = []
    similarities.each do |other_user_id, _|
      other_user_orders = @orders[other_user_id]
      other_user_orders.each do |product_id, rating|
        next if @orders[@user_ids[0]][product_id] # Skip products already ordered by the user
        recommended_products << [product_id, rating]
      end
    end
    recommended_products.sort_by { |_, rating| -rating }.first(num_recommendations).map(&:first)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'base64'

class UkrposhtaApi
  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
    @base_url = 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua'
  end

  def create_shipment(sender, recipient, package)
    auth_token = authenticate
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{auth_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    body = {
      sender: {
        name: sender[:name],
        address: sender[:address],
        phone: sender[:phone]
      },
      recipient: {
        name: recipient[:name],
        address: recipient[:address],
        phone: recipient[:phone]
      },
      package: {
        weight: package[:weight],
        length: package[:length],
        width: package[:width],
        height: package[:height]
      }
    }
    response = HTTParty.post("#{@base_url}/shipments", headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def print_label(shipment_id)
    auth_token = authenticate
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{auth_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    response = HTTParty.get("#{@base_url}/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label", headers: headers)
    label_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    label_base64 = label_data['label']
    label_file = Base64.decode64(label_base64)
    File.open("label_#{shipment_id}.pdf", 'wb') { |f| f.write(label_file) }
  end

  private

  def authenticate
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    body = {
      grant_type: 'client_credentials',
      client_id: @api_key,
      client_secret: @api_secret
    }
    response = HTTParty.post("#{@base_url}/oauth/token", headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
  end
end
```

```ruby
  dot_product = vector1.dot(vector2)
  magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(vector1.dot(vector1))
  magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(vector2.dot(vector2))
  dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
end

similarities = {}
client_ids.each_with_index do |client_id, client_index|
  similarities[client_id] = {}
  client_ids.each_with_index do |other_client_id, other_client_index|
    next if client_id == other_client_id
    vector1 = ratings_matrix.row(client_index)
    vector2 = ratings_matrix.row(other_client_index)
    similarity = cosine_similarity(vector1, vector2)
    similarities[client_id][other_client_id] = similarity
  end
end

# Крок 5: Рекомендація товарів клієнту
def recommend_products(client_id, similarities, orders, product_ids)
  # Відібрати клієнтів зі схожістю вище середнього
  similar_clients = similarities[client_id].select { |_, similarity| similarity > 0.5 }

  # Знайти товари, які замовляли схожі клієнти
  recommended_products = []
  similar_clients.each do |similar_client_id, _|
    similar_client_orders = orders.select { |o| o[:client_id] == similar_client_id }
    similar_client_orders.each do |order|
      product_id = order[:product_id]
      next if orders.any? { |o| o[:client_id] == client_id && o[:product_id] == product_id }
      recommended_products << product_id
    end
  end

  # Повернути унікальні товари
  recommended_products.uniq
end

# Підключення до бази даних для виводу рекомендацій
client_id = 1 # Ідентифікатор клієнта для якого потрібно вивести рекомендації
recommended_products = recommend_products(client_id, similarities, orders, product_ids)

puts "Рекомендації для клієнта #{client_id}:"

  puts "Товар ##{product_id}"
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class OlxApi
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.olx.ua'

  def initialize(access_token)
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  # Отримання токену доступу
  def self.get_access_token(client_id, client_secret)
    response = self.post('/partner/v1/oauth2/token', body: {
      grant_type: 'client_credentials',
      client_id: client_id,
      client_secret: client_secret
    })
    JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
  end

  # Створення нового оголошення
  def create_advertisement(title, description, price, category_id)
    response = self.post('/partner/v1/advertisement', headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }, body: {
      title: title,
      description: description,
      price: price,
      category_id: category_id
    }.to_json)
    response.code == 201
  end

  # Оновлення існуючого оголошення
  def update_advertisement(ad_id, title, description, price, category_id)
    response = self.put("/partner/v1/advertisement/#{ad_id}", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }, body: {
      title: title,
      description: description,
      price: price,
      category_id: category_id
    }.to_json)
    response.code == 200
  end
end
```

```ruby
# nova_poshta_calculator.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class NovaPoshtaCalculator
  API_KEY = 'YOUR_API_KEY' # Replace with your Nova Poshta API key
  API_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json'

  def initialize(weight, declared_value)
    @weight = weight
    @declared_value = declared_value
  end

  def calculate_cost
    # Get available cities
    cities_response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, body: {
      'apiKey' => API_KEY,
      'modelName' => 'Address',
      'calledMethod' => 'getCities',
      'methodProperties' => {}
    }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

    cities = JSON.parse(cities_response.body)['data']

    # Get available warehouses for each city
    warehouses = {}
    cities.each do |city|
      city_response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, body: {
        'apiKey' => API_KEY,
        'modelName' => 'Address',
        'calledMethod' => 'getWarehouses',
        'methodProperties' => {
          'CityRef' => city['Ref']
        }
      }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

      warehouses[city['Description']] = JSON.parse(city_response.body)['data']
    end

    # Calculate cost for each warehouse
    costs = {}
    warehouses.each do |city, warehouses|
      warehouses.each do |warehouse|
        cost_response = HTTParty.post(API_URL, body: {
          'apiKey' => API_KEY,
          'modelName' => 'InternetDocument',
          'calledMethod' => 'getDocumentPrice',
          'methodProperties' => {
            'CitySender' => 'Київ', # Replace with sender city
            'CityRecipient' => city,
            'WarehouseSender' => 'Київ-1', # Replace with sender warehouse
            'WarehouseRecipient' => warehouse['Description'],
            'Weight' => @weight,
            'Cost' => @declared_value
          }
        }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

        cost = JSON.parse(cost_response.body)['data']['Cost']
        costs[warehouse['Description']] = cost
      end
    end

    costs
  end
end

# Example usage:
calculator = NovaPoshtaCalculator.new(1.0, 100.0)
costs = calculator.calculate_cost

puts 'Costs for each warehouse:'
costs.each do |warehouse, cost|
  puts "#{warehouse}: #{cost}"
end
```

Note: You need to replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual Nova Poshta API key. Additionally, you should replace the sender city and warehouse with your actual values.

This code calculates the cost of address delivery by Nova Poshta courier for a parcel with a given weight and declared value. require 'httparty'

```ruby
class GlovoApiClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.glovoapp.com'
  API_VERSION = 'v1'

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
    @auth_token = authenticate
  end

  def authenticate
    response = HTTParty.post("#{BASE_URL}/#{API_VERSION}/auth/login", 
                             headers: {
                               'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
                             },
                             body: {
                               api_key: @api_key,
                               api_secret: @api_secret
                             }.to_json)

    JSON.parse(response.body)['token']
  end

  def order_courier(pickup_address, dropoff_address)
    response = HTTParty.post("#{BASE_URL}/#{API_VERSION}/orders", 
                             headers: {
                               'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
                               'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}"
                             },
                             body: {
                               pickup: {
                                 address: pickup_address
                               },
                               dropoff: {
                                 address: dropoff_address
                               },
                               courier_type: 'motorbike',
                               payment_method: 'cash'
                             }.to_json)

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/bas_exporter.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_support/all'

class BasExporter
  # Define the required fields for the BAS export
  REQUIRED_FIELDS = %i[
    order_number
    order_date
    customer_name
    customer_address
    total_amount
    vat_amount
  ].freeze

  # Define the XML namespace and schema
  XML_NAMESPACE = 'http://bas.ua/namespace'.freeze
  XML_SCHEMA = 'http://bas.ua/schema'.freeze

  # Initialize the exporter with the orders to export
  def initialize(orders)
    @orders = orders
  end

  # Export the orders to a BAS XML file
  def export_to_xml(file_path)
    # Create the XML document
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.doc.create_internal_subset(
        'bas',
        nil,
        "http://bas.ua/schema/bas.xsd"
      )
      xml.bas(
        'xmlns' => XML_NAMESPACE,
        'xmlns:xsi' => 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance',
        'xsi:schemaLocation' => "#{XML_NAMESPACE} #{XML_SCHEMA}"
      ) do
        @orders.each do |order|
          # Validate the order fields
          REQUIRED_FIELDS.each do |field|
            raise ArgumentError, "Order is missing required field: #{field}" unless order.key?(field)
          end

          # Create the order XML element
          xml.order do
            xml.order_number order[:order_number]
            xml.order_date order[:order_date]
            xml.customer do
              xml.name order[:customer_name]
              xml.address order[:customer_address]
            end
            xml.total_amount order[:total_amount]
            xml.vat_amount order[:vat_amount]
          end
        end
      end
    end

    # Write the XML document to the file
    File.open(file_path, 'w') { |f| f.write(builder.to_xml) }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class NovaPoshtaClient
  def initialize(api_key)

  end

    url = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/Address/getWarehouses'
    headers = { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    body = {

      'calledMethod' => 'getWarehouses',
      'methodProperties' => {
        'Latitude' => lat,
        'Longitude' => lon,
        'Radius' => radius
      }
    }

    JSON.parse(response.body)['data']
  end
```

```ruby
    response = get('/orders', headers: { 'Authorization' => 'Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN' })

    end
  end

    response = put("/orders/#{order.id}", body: order.to_json, headers: { 'Authorization' => 'Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN', 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'

class RozetkaFeedGenerator
  def initialize(products)
    @products = products
  end

  def generate_xml
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    xml.instruct! :xml, :version => "1.0", :encoding => "UTF-8"

    xml.offer do
      @products.each do |product|
        xml.product do
          xml.id product[:id]
          xml.categoryId product[:category_id]
          xml.name product[:name]
          xml.description product[:description]
          xml.price product[:price]
          xml.currencyId 'UAH'
          xml.category do
            xml.id product[:category_id]
            xml.name product[:category_name]
          end
          product[:parameters].each do |parameter|
            xml.parameter do
              xml.name parameter[:name]
              xml.value parameter[:value]
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    xml.target!
  end
end
```

```ruby
# mrz_parser.rb

require 'regexp_parser'

class MRZParser
  # Regular expression pattern for parsing the MRZ
  MRZ_PATTERN = %r{
    ^
    (?<document_type>[V|P|A|C|I|D])
    (?<country_code>[A-Z]{3})
    (?<document_number>[0-9]{9})
    (?<check_digit_1>[0-9])
    (?<surname>[A-Z<]{24})
    (?<given_names>[A-Z<]{24})
    (?<date_of_birth>[0-9]{6})
    (?<check_digit_2>[0-9])
    (?<sex>[M|F|X])
    (?<expiration_date>[0-9]{6})
    (?<check_digit_3>[0-9])
    (?<optional_data>[A-Z0-9<]{24})
    (?<check_digit_4>[0-9])
    $
  }x

  def self.parse_mrz(mrz_string)
    match_data = MRZ_PATTERN.match(mrz_string)
    return nil unless match_data

    {
      document_type: match_data[:document_type],
      country_code: match_data[:country_code],
      document_number: match_data[:document_number],
      surname: match_data[:surname].gsub('<', ' ').strip,
      given_names: match_data[:given_names].gsub('<', ' ').strip,
      date_of_birth: parse_date(match_data[:date_of_birth]),
      sex: match_data[:sex],
      expiration_date: parse_date(match_data[:expiration_date]),
      optional_data: match_data[:optional_data].gsub('<', ' ').strip
    }
  end

  private_class_method def self.parse_date(date_string)
    # Assuming the date format is YYMMDD
    year = "20#{date_string[0..1]}"
    month = date_string[2..3]
    day = date_string[4..5]

    "#{year}-#{month}-#{day}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
class SalesDriveAPI
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.salesdrive.com'

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
  end

  def send_order(order)
    # Підготовка даних для надсилання
    order_data = {
      'order_id' => order.id,
      'customer_name' => order.customer_name,
      'customer_email' => order.customer_email,
      'order_total' => order.total,
      'products' => order.products.map { |product| { 'product_id' => product.id, 'quantity' => product.quantity } }
    }

    # Надсилання замовлення до SalesDrive CRM
    response = self.class.post('/orders', body: order_data.to_json, headers: {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    })

    # Перевірка статусу відповіді
    if response.success?
      # Отримання ідентифікатора замовлення у SalesDrive CRM
      order_id = response['order_id']
      # Оновлення статусу замовлення у нашому магазині
      order.update_attribute(:sales_drive_order_id, order_id)
    else
      # Обробка помилки
      Rails.logger.error("Помилка надсилання замовлення до SalesDrive CRM: #{response.code}")
    end
  end

  def get_order_status(order)
    # Надсилання запиту на отримання статусу замовлення
    response = self.class.get("/orders/#{order.sales_drive_order_id}", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    })

    # Перевірка статусу відповіді
    if response.success?
      # Отримання статусу замовлення
      order_status = response['status']
      # Оновлення статусу замовлення у нашому магазині
      order.update_attribute(:status, order_status)
    else
      # Обробка помилки
      Rails.logger.error("Помилка отримання статусу замовлення з SalesDrive CRM: #{response.code}")
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'pdf/forms'

class PdfFormFiller
  def initialize(pdf_file, model)
    @pdf_file = pdf_file
    @model = model
  end

  def fill_form
    pdf = PDF::Forms.new(@pdf_file)
    pdf.form_fields.each do |field|
      value = @model.send(field.name)
      pdf.set_field(field.name, value)
      pdf.set_field_properties(field.name, readonly: true)
    end
    pdf.save(@pdf_file)
  end
end
```
У цьому коді ми створюємо об'єкт `PdfFormFiller`, який приймає два аргументи: шлях до PDF-файлу та об'єкт моделі, з якого будуть взяті дані для заповнення форми.

Метод `fill_form` відкриває PDF-файл за допомогою `PDF::Forms`, потім проходить по всіх полях форми та встановлює значення кожного поля за допомогою методу `set_field`. Після цього ми робимо кожне поле нередаговним за допомогою методу `set_field_properties`.

Нарешті, ми зберігаємо змінений PDF-файл за допомогою методу `save`.

```ruby
Onfido.configure do |config|
  config.api_token = 'YOUR_ONFIDO_API_TOKEN'
  config.api_environment = 'live' # or 'sandbox'

class OnfidoVerification
  def initialize(api_token, api_environment)
    @api_token = api_token
    @api_environment = api_environment
  end

  def create_applicant(applicant_data)
    # Create a new applicant
    applicant = Onfido::Applicant.create(
      first_name: applicant_data[:first_name],
      last_name: applicant_data[:last_name],
      email: applicant_data[:email]
    )

    applicant
  end

  def create_document_check(applicant_id, document_data)
    # Create a new document check
    document_check = Onfido::DocumentCheck.create(
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      document_type: document_data[:document_type],
      issuing_country: document_data[:issuing_country],
      file: document_data[:file]
    )

    document_check
  end

  def create_selfie_check(applicant_id, selfie_data)
    # Create a new selfie check
    selfie_check = Onfido::SelfieCheck.create(
      applicant_id: applicant_id,
      file: selfie_data[:file]
    )

    selfie_check
  end

  def verify_identity(applicant_id)
    # Get the applicant's checks
    checks = Onfido::Check.find(applicant_id: applicant_id)

    # Verify the checks
    checks.each do |check|
      case check['type']
      when 'document'
        # Verify the document check
        if check['status'] == 'complete' && check['result'] == 'clear'
          puts "Document check for applicant #{applicant_id} is clear"
        else
          puts "Document check for applicant #{applicant_id} is not clear"
        end
      when 'selfie'
        # Verify the selfie check
        if check['status'] == 'complete' && check['result'] == 'clear'
          puts "Selfie check for applicant #{applicant_id} is clear"
        else
          puts "Selfie check for applicant #{applicant_id} is not clear"
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

  last_name: 'Doe',
```

**Implementation**
```ruby
# Import necessary gems
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

# Set up DocuSign API credentials
class DocuSignConfig
  attr_accessor :integration_key, :secret_key, :base_url

  def initialize
    @integration_key = 'YOUR_INTEGRATION_KEY'
    @secret_key = 'YOUR_SECRET_KEY'
    @base_url = 'https://www.docusign.net/restapi'
  end
end

# Set up the API client
class DocuSignClient
  attr_accessor :config

  def initialize(config)
    @config = config
  end

  def authenticate
    auth_url = "#{config.base_url}/v2.1/oauth/token"
    headers = { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    body = {
      grant_type: 'client_credentials',
      client_id: config.integration_key,
      client_secret: config.secret_key
    }
    response = HTTParty.post(auth_url, headers: headers, body: body)
    @access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
  end

  def create_envelope(template_id, recipient_email, recipient_name)
    url = "#{config.base_url}/v2.1/accounts/#{config.integration_key}/envelopes"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    body = {
      emailSubject: 'Please sign the contract',
      emailBlurb: 'This is a test contract',
      templateId: template_id,
      status: 'sent',
      recipients: {
        signers: [
          {
            email: recipient_email,
            name: recipient_name,
            recipientId: '1',
            routingOrder: '1'
          }
        ]
      }
    }.to_json
    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['envelopeId']
  end

  def get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
    url = "#{config.base_url}/v2.1/accounts/#{config.integration_key}/envelopes/#{envelope_id}"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['status']
  end

  def download_envelope_document(envelope_id, document_id)
    url = "#{config.base_url}/v2.1/accounts/#{config.integration_key}/envelopes/#{envelope_id}/documents/#{document_id}"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    response = HTTParty.get(url, headers: headers)
    File.open("contract_#{document_id}.pdf", 'wb') { |file| file.write(response.body) }
  end
end

# Usage example
config = DocuSignConfig.new
client = DocuSignClient.new(config)
client.authenticate

template_id = 'YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID'
recipient_email = 'recipient@example.com'
recipient_name = 'Recipient Name'

envelope_id = client.create_envelope(template_id, recipient_email, recipient_name)

# Wait for the envelope to be completed
loop do
  status = client.get_envelope_status(envelope_id)
  break if status == 'completed'
  sleep 10 # wait 10 seconds before checking again
end

# Download the signed contract
document_id = '1' # replace with the ID of the document you want to download
client.download_envelope_document(envelope_id, document_id)
```

**Note:**

* Replace `YOUR_INTEGRATION_KEY` and `YOUR_SECRET_KEY` with your actual DocuSign API credentials.
* Replace `YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID` with the ID of the template you want to use.
* Make sure to install the required gems by running `bundle install` in your terminal.
* This code assumes that you have a template set up in your DocuSign account with a single recipient and a single document.
* The code will wait for the envelope to be completed before downloading the signed contract. You may want to add error handling and other features depending on your specific use case.

```ruby
require 'tesseract-ocr'
require 'rmagick'

class MrzParser
  def initialize(image_path)
    @image_path = image_path
  end

  def extract_data
    # Відкриємо зображення
    image = Magick::Image.read(@image_path).first

    # Визначимо область MRZ
    mrz_area = find_mrz_area(image)

    # Розпізнаємо текст в області MRZ
    text = recognize_text(mrz_area)

    # Розіб'ємо текст на окремі поля
    data = parse_text(text)

    data
  end

  private

  def find_mrz_area(image)
    # Визначимо область MRZ за допомогою опорних точок
    # Це можна зробити за допомогою алгоритмів обробки зображень
    # Для спрощення прикладу, припустимо, що MRZ знаходиться в нижній частині зображення
    width, height = image.columns, image.rows
    mrz_height = height / 3
    image.crop(width, mrz_height, 0, height - mrz_height)
  end

  def recognize_text(image)
    # Використаємо Tesseract-OCR для розпізнавання тексту
    engine = Tesseract::Engine.new
    text = engine.text_for(image)
    text
  end

  def parse_text(text)
    # Розіб'ємо текст на окремі поля за допомогою регулярних виразів
    # Це можна зробити за допомогою наступних виразів:
    # - Тип документа: /^[A-Z]{1,2}/
    # - Код країни: /^[A-Z]{3}/
    # - Номер паспорта: /^[0-9]{9}/
    # - Прізвище: /^[A-Z][a-z]*/
    # - Ім'я: /^[A-Z][a-z]*/
    # - Дата народження: /^\d{2}[A-Z][A-Z]\d{2}/
    # - Стать: /^[M|F]/
    # - Термін дії: /^\d{2}[A-Z][A-Z]\d{2}/

    data = {
      document_type: text.match(/^[A-Z]{1,2}/)[0],
      country_code: text.match(/^[A-Z]{3}/)[0],
      passport_number: text.match(/^[0-9]{9}/)[0],
      surname: text.match(/^[A-Z][a-z]*/)[0],
      name: text.match(/^[A-Z][a-z]*/)[0],
      date_of_birth: text.match(/^\d{2}[A-Z][A-Z]\d{2}/)[0],
      sex: text.match(/^[M|F]/)[0],
      expiration_date: text.match(/^\d{2}[A-Z][A-Z]\d{2}/)[0]
    }

    data
  end
end
```
