```ruby
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'docusign_esign'

# Ідентифікатор клієнта (Integrator Key)
client_id = 'ВАШ_INTEGRATOR_KEY'

# Секрет клієнта (Client Secret)
client_secret = 'ВАШ_CLIENT_SECRET'

# Ідентифікатор користувача (User ID)
user_id = 'ВАШ_USER_ID'

# URL-адреса авторизації DocuSign
authorization_url = 'https://account-d.docusign.com/oauth/auth'

# Отримання токену доступу
response = HTTParty.post(authorization_url,
                         headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                         body: {
                           grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
                           assertion: Base64.strict_encode64("{
                             \"iss\": \"#{client_id}\",
                             \"sub\": \"#{user_id}\",
                             \"iat\": #{Time.now.to_i},
                             \"exp\": #{Time.now.to_i + 3600},
                             \"aud\": \"account-d.docusign.com\",
                             \"scope\": \"impersonation signature\"
                           }")
                         }.merge({
                           client_id: client_id,
                           client_secret: client_secret
                         }))

access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']

# Ініціалізація клієнта DocuSign
configuration = DocuSign::Configuration.new
configuration.host = 'https://www.docusign.net/restapi'
api_client = DocuSign::ApiClient.new configuration
api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{access_token}"

# Створення нового документа
envelope_definition = DocuSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new({
  status: 'sent',
  documents: [
    {
      document_base64: Base64.strict_encode64(File.read('path/to/your/document.pdf')),
      name: 'Договір.pdf',
      file_extension: 'pdf',
      document_id: '1'
    }
  ],
  recipients: {
    signers: [
      {
        email: 'recipient@example.com',
        name: 'Ім\'я одержувача',
        recipient_id: '1',
        routing_order: '1'
      }
    ]
  }
})

# Відправлення документа на підпис
envelopes_api = DocuSign::EnvelopesApi.new(api_client)
envelope_summary = envelopes_api.create_envelope('account_id', envelope_definition)

# Отримання статусу документа
envelope_id = envelope_summary.envelope_id
envelope = envelopes_api.get_envelope('account_id', envelope_id)

# Завантаження підписаного документа
documents_api = DocuSign::EnvelopesApi.new(api_client)
document = documents_api.get_document('account_id', envelope_id, '1')
File.open('path/to/save/signed_document.pdf', 'wb') { |f| f.write(document) }
```

### Примітки:
1. **ВАШ_INTEGRATOR_KEY**, **ВАШ_CLIENT_SECRET**, **ВАШ_USER_ID** та **recipient@example.com** потрібно замінити на фактичні дані вашого аккаунту DocuSign та одержувача.
2. У цьому прикладі використовується файл `document.pdf`, який потрібно замінити на фактичний шлях до вашого PDF-договору.
3. Після підпису документа його буде збережено у файл `signed_document.pdf` у вказаному шляху.
4. У цьому прикладі використовується бібліотека `docusign_esign` для взаємодії з DocuSign eSignature API. Ця бібліотека автоматично обробляє авторизацію та підпис документу.
5. Будьте уважні при роботі з токенами доступу та іншими конфіденційними даними. Не публікуйте їх у відкритому доступі.

Ось приклад Gemfile:
```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
```

Тепер реалізуємо код перевірки особи в санкційному списку OFAC:
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class OfacChecker
  def initialize(name)
    @name = name
  end

  def check
    url = 'https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/Details.aspx'
    params = {
      'name' => @name
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(url, query: params)

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      false
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(body)
    # OFAC повертає сторінку з таблицею результатів, тому нам потрібно спарсити цю сторінку
    # Для спрощення прикладу припустимо, що результати повертаються у форматі JSON
    # Насправді це не так, але можна використовувати геми типу Nokogiri для парсингу HTML
    json = JSON.parse(body)
    json['Results'].any? { |result| result['Name'] == @name }
  end
end

# Приклад використання
checker = OfacChecker.new('John Doe')
if checker.check
  puts "Особа знаходиться в санкційному списку OFAC"
else
  puts "Особа не знайдена в санкційному списку OFAC"
end
```
Примітка: OFAC API не є публічним API, тому для використання цього коду потрібно буде домовитися з OFAC про доступ до їхніх даних. Також цей код не оброблює випадки, коли особа має декілька імен або псевдонімів. Для реального використання потрібно буде вдосконалити цей код та додати оброблення цих випадків.

Однак, оскільки на момент написання цього тексту офіційного гема для Onfido не було в реєстрі RubyGems, ми будемо використовувати гем `httparty` для здійснення HTTP-запитів до API Onfido безпосередньо.

Далі, створіть файл `onfido_client.rb` для реалізації клієнта Onfido:

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class OnfidoClient
  attr_accessor :api_token, :base_url

  def initialize(api_token)
    @api_token = api_token
    @base_url = 'https://api.onfido.com/v3.5'
  end

  def create_applicant
    response = HTTParty.post("#{base_url}/applicants", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    })

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_type, file)
    response = HTTParty.post("#{base_url}/applicants/#{applicant_id}/documents", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }, body: {
      document: {
        type: document_type
      }
    }.to_json)

    document_id = JSON.parse(response.body)['id']

    # Завантаження файлу документа
    file_response = HTTParty.post("#{base_url}/applicants/#{applicant_id}/documents/#{document_id}/files", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/octet-stream'
    }, body: File.read(file))

    JSON.parse(file_response.body)
  end

  def upload_live_photo(applicant_id, file)
    response = HTTParty.post("#{base_url}/applicants/#{applicant_id}/live_photos", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/octet-stream'
    }, body: File.read(file))

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def create_check(applicant_id, report_names)
    response = HTTParty.post("#{base_url}/applicants/#{applicant_id}/checks", headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }, body: {
      report_names: report_names
    }.to_json)

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
applicant_id = applicant_response['id']

```

To add two-factor authentication with time-based one-time passwords and QR-code enrolment to a Rails app, we will create a User model with a two-factor authentication feature. 

First, generate a User model and add the necessary columns to the users table:
```bash
rails generate model User username:string email:string password_digest:string otp_secret_key:string otp_enabled:boolean
rails db:migrate
```

Next, add the `has_secure_password` and `validate` methods to the User model to validate the presence of the username, email, and password:
```ruby
# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_secure_password
  validates :username, :email, :password, presence: true
  validates :email, uniqueness: true
end
```

Now, let's implement the two-factor authentication feature using the `rotp` gem. We will add methods to generate and verify one-time passwords:
```ruby
# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  # ...
  
  def generate_otp_secret_key
    self.otp_secret_key = ROTP::Base32.random_base32
    save
  end

  def generate_otp_qr_code
    otpauth_url = "otpauth://totp/#{username}?secret=#{otp_secret_key}&issuer=My%20App"
    RQRCode::QRCode.new(otpauth_url).to_img
  end

  def verify_otp(otp_code)
    totp = ROTP::TOTP.new(otp_secret_key)
    totp.verify(otp_code)
  end
end
```

Next, let's create a controller to handle the two-factor authentication:
```ruby
# app/controllers/sessions_controller.rb
class SessionsController < ApplicationController
  def new
    @user = User.new
  end

  def create
    @user = User.find_by(email: params[:email])
    if @user && @user.authenticate(params[:password])
      if @user.otp_enabled
        session[:user_id] = @user.id
        redirect_to verify_otp_path
      else
        session[:user_id] = @user.id
        redirect_to root_path
      end
    else
      render :new
    end
  end

  def destroy
```

```ruby
  DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_ID = 'YOUR_CLIENT_ID'.freeze

  DOCUSIGN_AUTH_BASE_URL = 'https://account.docusign.com/oauth/token'.freeze
  DOCUSIGN_USERNAME = 'YOUR_USERNAME'.freeze
  DOCUSIGN_PASSWORD = 'YOUR_PASSWORD'.freeze

  def self.docu_sign_config

      integrator_key: DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATOR_KEY,
      client_id: DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_ID,
      client_secret: DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_SECRET,
      base_url: DOCUSIGN_BASE_URL,
      auth_base_url: DOCUSIGN_AUTH_BASE_URL,
      username: DOCUSIGN_USERNAME,
      password: DOCUSIGN_PASSWORD
    }
  end
end

# docusign_client.rb
require_relative 'config'

class DocusignClient
  def initialize
    @config = Config.docu_sign_config
  end

  def authenticate
    auth_url = "#{@config[:auth_base_url]}"
    auth_response = HTTParty.post(auth_url,
                                  headers: {
                                    'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                                  },
                                  body: {
                                    grant_type: 'password',
                                    client_id: @config[:client_id],
                                    client_secret: @config[:client_secret],
                                    username: @config[:username],
                                    password: @config[:password]
                                  })

    @access_token = JSON.parse(auth_response.body)['access_token']
  end

  def create_envelope(file_path)
    authenticate

    api_client = DocusignEsign::ApiClient.new
    api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"

    configuration = DocusignEsign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @config[:base_url]
    api_client.config = configuration

    envelopes_api = DocusignEsign::EnvelopesApi.new(api_client)

    # Create an envelope definition
    envelope_definition = DocusignEsign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
      email_subject: 'Please sign this document',
      documents: [
        DocusignEsign::Document.new(
          document_base64: Base64.encode64(File.read(file_path)),
          name: 'contract.pdf',
          file_extension: 'pdf',
          document_id: '1'
        )
      ],
      recipients: {
        signers: [
          DocusignEsign::Signer.new(
            email: 'recipient@example.com',
            name: 'Recipient Name',
            recipient_id: '1',
            routing_order: '1'
          )
        ]
      },
      status: 'sent'
    )

    # Create an envelope
    envelope_response = envelopes_api.create_envelope('account_id', envelope_definition)
    envelope_id = envelope_response.envelope_id

    # Get the signing URL
    signing_url = envelopes_api.create_recipient_view('account_id', envelope_id, {
      return_url: 'https://www.example.com',
      client_user_id: '1',
      authentication_method: 'email',
      email: 'recipient@example.com',
      user_name: 'Recipient Name',
      recipient_id: '1'
    })

    # Return the signing URL
    signing_url.url
  end

  def download_envelope(envelope_id)
    authenticate

    api_client = DocusignEsign::ApiClient.new
    api_client.default_headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@access_token}"

    configuration = DocusignEsign::Configuration.new
    configuration.host = @config[:base_url]
    api_client.config = configuration

    envelopes_api = DocusignEsign::EnvelopesApi.new(api_client)

    # Get the envelope documents
    documents_response = envelopes_api.get_document('account_id', envelope_id, '1')

    # Save the signed document to a file
    File.open('signed_contract.pdf', 'wb') { |f| f.write(documents_response) }
  end
end

# Create an envelope and get the signing URL

# Print the signing URL
puts "Signing URL: #{signing_url}"

# Download the signed envelope
envelope_id = 'envelope_id' # Replace with the actual envelope ID
client.download_envelope(envelope_id)
```

```ruby
  end

        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

      headers: {

        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {

        report_name: 'document_report',
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: document_data
      }.to_json
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def create_selfie_check(applicant_id, selfie_data)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/applicants/#{applicant_id}/checks",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {

        report_name: 'facial_similarity_report',
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: selfie_data
      }.to_json
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def get_check_status(check_id)
    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/checks/#{check_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class OFACClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.ofac.gov'

  def self.check_sdn(name)
    response = get('/sdn_list.json', query: { name: name })
    if response.success?
      json_response = JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      if json_response[:data].any? { |entry| entry[:name] == name }
        puts "Особа #{name} знайдена в санкційному списку."
        return true
      else
        puts "Особа #{name} не знайдена в санкційному списку."
        return false
      end
    else
      puts "Помилка під час звернення до API: #{response.code}"
      return nil
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    return nil
  end
end
```

```ruby
# diia_document_sharing.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

class DiiaDocumentSharing
  # Diia API endpoint for requesting documents
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.diia.gov.ua/api/v1'.freeze

  # Diia API endpoint for receiving documents on callback
  CALLBACK_URL = 'https://api.diia.gov.ua/api/v1/callback'.freeze

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @redirect_uri = redirect_uri
  end

  # Request user's documents through Diia document sharing
  def request_documents
    # Generate authorization URL
    auth_url = "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/authorize?"
    auth_url += "client_id=#{@client_id}&"
    auth_url += "redirect_uri=#{@redirect_uri}&"
    auth_url += "response_type=code&"
    auth_url += "scope=document_sharing"

    # Redirect user to authorization URL
    puts "Please visit the following URL to authorize: #{auth_url}"
  end

  # Handle callback request from Diia API
  def handle_callback(code)
    # Exchange authorization code for access token
    token_url = "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/token"
    response = HTTParty.post(token_url,
                             body: {
                               grant_type: 'authorization_code',
                               code: code,
                               redirect_uri: @redirect_uri,
                               client_id: @client_id,
                               client_secret: @client_secret
                             })

    # Parse access token from response
    access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']

    # Use access token to request user's documents
    documents_url = "#{BASE_URL}/documents"
    response = HTTParty.get(documents_url,
                            headers: {
                              'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}"
                            })

    # Parse documents from response
    documents = JSON.parse(response.body)

    # Return documents
    documents
  end
end

# Example usage
client_id = 'your_client_id'
client_secret = 'your_client_secret'
redirect_uri = 'https://your-redirect-uri.com'

diia = DiiaDocumentSharing.new(client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri)
diia.request_documents

# Handle callback request from Diia API
code = 'authorization_code_from_callback'
documents = diia.handle_callback(code)
puts documents
```

Note: You should replace `your_client_id`, `your_client_secret`, and `https://your-redirect-uri.com` with your actual Diia API credentials and redirect URI.

**Implementation**

```ruby
# keverifier.rb

require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class KEVerifier
  def initialize(signature_file, original_file, certificate_file)
    @signature_file = signature_file
    @original_file = original_file
    @certificate_file = certificate_file
  end

  def verify
    # Read the signature file
    signature = File.binread(@signature_file)

    # Decode the signature from Base64
    signature = Base64.strict_decode64(signature)

    # Read the original file
    original_data = File.binread(@original_file)

    # Read the certificate file
    certificate = File.read(@certificate_file)

    # Load the certificate
    cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(certificate)

    # Verify the signature
    begin
      OpenSSL::PKCS7.verify(cert, signature, original_data, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA1.new)
      puts "Signature is valid"
    rescue OpenSSL::PKCS7::Error => e
      puts "Signature is invalid: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage:
verifier = KEVerifier.new('signature.sig', 'original.txt', 'certificate.cer')
verifier.verify
```

**Note:** The `OpenSSL::PKCS7.verify` method is used to verify the signature. This method takes the certificate, signature, original data, and digest algorithm as arguments. In this case, we use the `SHA1` digest algorithm, which is specified in the DSTU 4145 standard.

**DSTU 4145 Algorithm:** The DSTU 4145 algorithm is a Ukrainian standard for digital signatures. It is based on the GOST R 34.10-2001 algorithm, which is a variant of the RSA algorithm with a 256-bit key size. The algorithm uses the GOST R 34.11-2012 hash function, which is a variant of the SHA-256 hash function.

**Certificate Format:** The certificate file should be in PEM format, which is a text-based format that contains the certificate data in Base64-encoded form.

**Signature Format:** The signature file should be in Base64-encoded form, which is a text-based format that contains the signature data.

**Original File:** The original file can be in any format, but it should be the same file that was signed using the DSTU 4145 algorithm.

```ruby
# kepsignature.rb

require "openssl"
require "base64"

class KepSignature
  def initialize(file_path, signature_path, certificate_path)
    @file_path = file_path
    @signature_path = signature_path
    @certificate_path = certificate_path
  end

  def verify
    # Load the certificate
    certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(@certificate_path))

    # Load the signature
    signature = Base64.strict_decode64(File.read(@signature_path))

    # Load the file
    file = File.read(@file_path)

    # Create a digest
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new("sha256")

    # Sign the file with the digest
    signed_data = OpenSSL::PKCS7.sign(certificate, file, [], OpenSSL::PKCS7::BINARY)

    # Verify the signature
    verified = OpenSSL::PKCS7.verify(signed_data, certificate, [OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(certificate)], nil, digest)

    # Check if the signature is valid
    if verified
      puts "The signature is valid"
    else
      puts "The signature is invalid"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage:
file_path = "path/to/file.txt"
signature_path = "path/to/signature.der"
certificate_path = "path/to/certificate.pem"

kep_signature = KepSignature.new(file_path, signature_path, certificate_path)
kep_signature.verify
```

Please note that the DSTU 4145 algorithm is not directly supported by the OpenSSL library. However, the above implementation uses the PKCS#7 standard, which is widely used for digital signatures and is compatible with the DSTU 4145 algorithm.

Also, note that this implementation assumes that the signature is in DER format and the certificate is in PEM format. If your files are in different formats, you may need to convert them before using this code.

Для перевірки кваліфікованого електронного підпису (КЕП) на файлі, підписаному за українським алгоритмом ДСТУ 4145, нам потрібно використовувати геми, які підтримують обробку цифрових підписів і криптографічні операції. Одним із найбільш підходящих гемів для цього завдання є `openssl`, який вже включений у стандартну бібліотеку Ruby, тому не потрібно його вказувати у Gemfile. Проте, для роботи з певними форматами файлів, наприклад, CMS (Content Management System), можемо використовувати гем `ruby-pkcs7`, який дозволяє працювати з підписаними повідомленнями у форматі CMS.

Ось приклад Gemfile, який включає гем `ruby-pkcs7` для роботи з підписаними повідомленнями:

```ruby

```

Після оновлення залежностей за допомогою команди `bundle install`, можна приступити до реалізації скрипта на Ruby, який перевіряє КЕП на файлі. Нижче наведено приклад реалізації такого скрипта:

```ruby
require 'openssl'
require 'pkcs7'

def verify_signature(file_path, certificate_path)
  # Відкрити підписаний файл
  signed_data = File.binread(file_path)

  # Розпакувати підписані дані
  pkcs7 = PKCS7::SignedData.new(signed_data)

  # Отримати сертифікат із файлу
  certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(certificate_path))

  # Перевірити підпис
  store = OpenSSL::X509::Store.new
  store.add_cert(certificate)
  if pkcs7.verify(store, nil)
    puts "Підпис є дійсним."
  else
    puts "Підпис не дійсний."
  end
end

# Виклик функції з вказанням шляху до підписаного файлу та сертифіката
verify_signature('path/to/signed_file.p7s', 'path/to/certificate.cer')
```

У цьому прикладі, ми використовуємо гем `ruby-pkcs7` для обробки підписаних даних у форматі CMS, а гем `openssl` для роботи з криптографічними операціями та сертифікатами. Функція `verify_signature` приймає шлях до підписаного файлу та сертифіката як аргументи, після чого здійснює перевірку підпису за допомогою сертифіката.

```ruby
# sanctions_checker.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'

class SanctionsChecker
  NSDC_SANCTIONS_URL = 'https://nsdc.gov.ua/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/sanctions_list.json'.freeze
  USER_AGENT = 'Sanctions Checker/1.0'.freeze

  def initialize
    @sanctions_list = fetch_sanctions_list
  end

  def check_company(company_name)
    @sanctions_list.any? do |entity|
      entity['name'].downcase.include?(company_name.downcase)
    end
  end

  private

  def fetch_sanctions_list
    response = HTTParty.get(NSDC_SANCTIONS_URL, headers: { 'User-Agent' => USER_AGENT })
    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  rescue HTTParty::Error => e
    puts "Error fetching sanctions list: #{e.message}"
    []
  end
end

# Example usage:
checker = SanctionsChecker.new
company_name = 'Example Company'
if checker.check_company(company_name)
  puts "#{company_name} is on the Ukrainian sanctions list."
else
  puts "#{company_name} is not on the Ukrainian sanctions list."
end
```

Please note that this implementation is case-insensitive and will match company names even if they are not exact matches (e.g., "Example" will match "Example Company"). You may want to adjust the matching logic to suit your specific requirements.

Also, keep in mind that the sanctions list may change over time, and it's essential to respect the terms of use of the open data source.

Тепер, реалізація коду на Ruby для перевірки кваліфікованого електронного підпису (КЕП) за українським алгоритмом ДСТУ 4145, який використовує алгоритм ГМЧ (Гост28147) для шифрування та хеш-функцію ГМЧ (аналогічна до алгоритму GOST R 34.11-2012 для хешування):

```ruby
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

def verify_signature(data, signature, public_key)
  # Відкритий ключ повинен бути у форматі PEM
  public_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(public_key)

  # Дані та підпис повинні бути у вигляді рядків
  data = data.to_s
  signature = Base64.decode64(signature)

  # Алгоритм підпису за умовчанням для ДСТУ 4145
  # Тут ми використовуємо GOST R 34.10-2001 для підпису, але це залежить від реалізації
  digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('GOST3411')

  # Верифікація підпису
  begin
    public_key.verify(digest, signature, data)
    puts "Підпис вірний"
  rescue OpenSSL::PKey::RSAError
    puts "Підпис не вірний"
  end
end

# Приклад використання
data = "Дані для підпису"
signature = "Ваш підпис у base64" # Тут повинен бути ваш підпис у вигляді рядка base64
public_key = "Ваш відкритий ключ у форматі PEM" # Тут повинен бути ваш відкритий ключ у форматі PEM

verify_signature(data, signature, public_key)
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'uri'

class DiaSharingClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.dia.sharing' # Посилання на API Дія.Шерінг

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @redirect_uri = redirect_uri
  end

  # Метод для отримання авторизаційного коду
  def get_authorization_code
    auth_url = "https://api.dia.sharing/authorize?"
    params = {
      client_id: @client_id,
      redirect_uri: @redirect_uri,
      response_type: 'code',
      scope: 'documents' # Простір імен для доступу до документів
    }
    URI.parse(auth_url).tap do |uri|
      uri.query = URI.encode_www_form(params)
    end.to_s
  end

  # Метод для обміну коду на токен
  def get_token(code)
    response = self.class.post('/token', body: {
      grant_type: 'authorization_code',
      code: code,
      redirect_uri: @redirect_uri,
      client_id: @client_id,
      client_secret: @client_secret
    })
    JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
  end

  # Метод для отримання документів користувача
  def get_user_documents(token)
    response = self.class.get('/user/documents', headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}"
    })
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
client = DiaSharingClient.new('Ваш_client_id', 'Ваш_client_secret', 'https://example.com/callback')
auth_url = client.get_authorization_code
puts "Перейдіть за посиланням для авторизації: #{auth_url}"

# Після авторизації ви отримаєте код, який потрібно передати далі
code = 'код_от_авторизации'
token = client.get_token(code)
documents = client.get_user_documents(token)

puts "Документи користувача: #{documents}"
```

```ruby
require 'sqlite3'
require 'csv'

# Create a database if it doesn't exist
DB_FILE = 'kattg.db'
DB = SQLite3::Database.new(DB_FILE)

# Create table if it doesn't exist
DB.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settlements (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT,
            code TEXT
            )')

# Load data from CSV into the database
# Assuming we have a CSV file named 'kattg_data.csv' with columns: name, code
def load_data(csv_file)
  CSV.foreach(csv_file, headers: false) do |row|
    DB.execute('INSERT INTO settlements (name, code) VALUES (?, ?)', [row[0], row[1]])
  end
end

# Search settlements by name
def search_settlements(name)
  results = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM settlements WHERE name LIKE ?', ["%#{name}%"])
  results
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  csv_file = 'kattg_data.csv' # Make sure this file exists and is correctly formatted
  load_data(csv_file)
  
  print "Enter settlement name to search: "
  search_name = gets.chomp
  results = search_settlements(search_name)
  
  if results.any?
    puts "Found settlements:"
    results.each do |settlement|
      puts "ID: #{settlement[0]}, Name: #{settlement[1]}, Code: #{settlement[2]}"
    end
  else
    puts "No settlements found with that name."
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'uri'
require 'openssl'

# Конфігурація Дія.Шерінг
DIASHARING_URL = 'https://diasharing.gov.ua'
DIASHARING_CLIENT_ID = 'YOUR_CLIENT_ID'
DIASHARING_CLIENT_SECRET = 'YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET'
DIASHARING_REDIRECT_URI = 'YOUR_REDIRECT_URI'

# Запит на авторизацію
def get_authorization_url
  params = {
    client_id: DIASHARING_CLIENT_ID,
    redirect_uri: DIASHARING_REDIRECT_URI,
    response_type: 'code',
    scope: 'documents'
  }

  uri = URI.parse(DIASHARING_URL + '/oauth/authorize')
  uri.query = URI.encode_www_form(params)

  uri.to_s
end

# Отримання токену доступу
def get_access_token(code)
  params = {
    grant_type: 'authorization_code',
    code: code,
    redirect_uri: DIASHARING_REDIRECT_URI,
    client_id: DIASHARING_CLIENT_ID,
    client_secret: DIASHARING_CLIENT_SECRET
  }

  response = HTTParty.post(DIASHARING_URL + '/oauth/token', body: params)
  JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
end

# Запит на документи
def get_documents(access_token)
  headers = {
    'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}"
  }

  response = HTTParty.get(DIASHARING_URL + '/api/documents', headers: headers)
  JSON.parse(response.body)
end

# Зворотний виклик
def callback(params)
  code = params['code']
  access_token = get_access_token(code)
  documents = get_documents(access_token)

  # Обробка документів
  documents.each do |document|
    # Ваша логіка обробки документів
    puts document
  end
end

# Запустіть сервер для зворотного виклику
require 'webrick'
server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(:Port => 3000)

server.mount_proc '/' do |req, res|
  if req.path == '/callback'
    callback(req.query)
    res.status = 200
    res.body = 'Документи отримані!'
  else
    res.status = 404
    res.body = 'Не знайдено'
  end
end

trap 'INT' do
  server.shutdown
end

server.start
```
В цьому прикладі ми використовуємо гем `httparty` для здійснення HTTP-запитів, `json` для обробки JSON-даних, та `uri` для роботи з URL-адресами. Також ми використовуємо гем `openssl` для роботи з SSL/TLS.

Ми визначаємо конфігурацію Дія.Шерінг, таку як ідентифікатор клієнта, секрет клієнта та URL-адресу зворотного виклику.

Ми створюємо три методи: `get_authorization_url`, `get_access_token` та `get_documents`. Перший метод повертає URL-адресу для авторизації, другий метод повертає токен доступу після авторизації, а третій метод повертає документи користувача.

```ruby
require 'text'

class FuzzyMatcher
  def initialize(company_names)
    @company_names = company_names
  end

  def find_fuzzy_matches(name, distance_metric = :levenshtein, threshold = 0.5)
    @company_names.map do |company_name|
```

```ruby
# fuzzy_matcher.rb

require 'text'

class FuzzyMatcher
  def initialize(company_names)
    @company_names = company_names
  end

  # Calculate Levenshtein distance between two strings
  def levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    Text::Levenshtein.distance(str1, str2)
  end

  # Calculate Jaro-Winkler distance between two strings
  def jaro_winkler_distance(str1, str2)
    Text::JaroWinkler.distance(str1, str2)
  end

  # Find fuzzy matches between company names
  def find_fuzzy_matches(threshold = 0.8)
    matches = []
    @company_names.each_with_index do |name1, index1|
      @company_names.each_with_index do |name2, index2|
        next if index1 >= index2 # Avoid comparing a company to itself

        levenshtein_dist = levenshtein_distance(name1, name2)
        jaro_winkler_dist = jaro_winkler_distance(name1, name2)

        # Normalize Levenshtein distance to a similarity score (0-1)
        levenshtein_sim = 1 - (levenshtein_dist.to_f / [name1.length, name2.length].max)

        # Jaro-Winkler distance is already a similarity score (0-1)
        if levenshtein_sim >= threshold && jaro_winkler_dist >= threshold
          matches << {
            company1: name1,
            company2: name2,
            levenshtein_similarity: levenshtein_sim,
            jaro_winkler_similarity: jaro_winkler_dist
          }
        end
      end
    end
    matches
  end
end

# Example usage
company_names = ['Google', 'Goggle', 'Amazon', 'Amazn', 'Microsoft', 'Microsft']
matcher = FuzzyMatcher.new(company_names)
matches = matcher.find_fuzzy_matches

puts "Fuzzy matches:"
matches.each do |match|
  puts "#{match[:company1]} and #{match[:company2]} (Levenshtein similarity: #{match[:levenshtein_similarity]}, Jaro-Winkler similarity: #{match[:jaro_winkler_similarity]})"
end
```

It provides methods to calculate Levenshtein and Jaro-Winkler distances between two strings, as well as a method to find fuzzy matches between the company names. # claudesummarizer.rb

```ruby
require "httparty"
require "json"

class ClaudeSummarizer
  def initialize(api_key, api_url = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/complete")
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_url = api_url
  end

  def summarize(ticket_text, max_tokens = 128)
    headers = {
      "Authorization" => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      "Content-Type" => "application/json"
    }

    body = {
      "prompt" => "Summarize the following support ticket: #{ticket_text}",
      "max_tokens" => max_tokens,
      "temperature" => 0.7,
      "top_p" => 1,
      "stop" => "\n\n"
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(@api_url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)["completion"]
    else
      raise "Failed to summarize ticket: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage:
api_key = "YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
summarizer = ClaudeSummarizer.new(api_key)

ticket_text = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum."
summary = summarizer.summarize(ticket_text)

puts "Summary: #{summary}"
```
**Note:**

* The `max_tokens` parameter controls the length of the summary. You can adjust this value to suit your needs.
* The `temperature` and `top_p` parameters control the creativity and diversity of the summary. You can experiment with different values to find the best results for your use case.
* This implementation uses the `httparty` gem to make HTTP requests to the Anthropic API and the `json` gem to parse the response.
* The `ClaudeSummarizer` class encapsulates the API key and URL, and provides a simple `summarize` method that takes the ticket text and returns the summary.

```ruby
require 'docx'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'html/sanitizer'

class DocxConverter
  def initialize(docx_file)
    @docx_file = docx_file
  end

  def convert_to_html
    doc = Docx::Document.open(@docx_file)
    html = Nokogiri::HTML::Document.new

    doc.paragraphs.each do |paragraph|
      p = html.create_element('p')
      paragraph.text.runs.each do |run|
        text = run.text
        span = html.create_element('span')
        span.content = text
        p << span
      end
      html.root << p
    end

    # Очищення HTML-коду
    sanitizer = HTML::Sanitizer.new
    sanitized_html = sanitizer.sanitize(html.to_html)

    sanitized_html
  end

  def convert_to_text
    doc = Docx::Document.open(@docx_file)
    text = ''

    doc.paragraphs.each do |paragraph|
      text += paragraph.text + "\n\n"
    end

    text
  end
end

# Використання класу
converter = DocxConverter.new('example.docx')
html = converter.convert_to_html
text = converter.convert_to_text

puts "HTML:"
puts html

puts "\nТекст:"
puts text
```

```ruby
require 'obscenity'

class CommentFilter
  def initialize(comment)
    @comment = comment
  end

  def filter
    if Obscenity.profane?(@comment)
      # Якщо коментар містить нецензурну лексику, замінюємо її на зірочки
      @comment = Obscenity.censor(@comment)
    end
    @comment
  end
end

comment = "This is a bad comment with some bad words."

```

- `few`: used for numbers ending in 2-4 (except 12-14)
- `many`: used for numbers ending in 0 or 5-9, or numbers ending in 11-14
- `other`: used for all other numbers (i.e., 0)

```ruby
# phone_number_normalizer.rb

require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class PhoneNumberNormalizer
  # Ukrainian mobile phone number prefixes
  OPERATOR_PREFIXES = {
    'Vodafone' => ['50', '66', '95', '99'],
    'Kyivstar' => ['44', '67', '68', '96', '97', '98'],
    'Lifecell' => ['63', '73', '93']
  }

  def self.normalize_and_detect(phone_number)
    normalized_number = normalize(phone_number)
    operator = detect_operator(normalized_number)

    { normalized_number: normalized_number, operator: operator }
  end

  def self.normalize(phone_number)
    phone_number = phone_number.gsub(/[^\d]/, '')
    return phone_number if phone_number.starts_with?('380')

    # Add +380 prefix if it's a Ukrainian mobile number
    if phone_number.starts_with?('0')
      "+380#{phone_number[1..]}"
    else
      phone_number
    end
  end

  def self.detect_operator(phone_number)
    prefix = phone_number[4..6] # Extract the 3-digit prefix

    OPERATOR_PREFIXES.each do |operator, prefixes|
      return operator if prefixes.include?(prefix)
    end

    'Unknown'
  end
end

# Example usage:
phone_number = '+380 66 123 4567'
result = PhoneNumberNormalizer.normalize_and_detect(phone_number)
puts "Normalized Number: #{result[:normalized_number]}"
puts "Operator: #{result[:operator]}"
```

2. The `normalize` method removes non-digit characters, adds the +380 prefix if necessary, and returns the normalized number.
3. The `detect_operator` method extracts the 3-digit prefix from the normalized number and checks it against the known prefixes for each operator.
4. The `normalize_and_detect` method combines the normalization and detection steps and returns a hash with the normalized number and the detected operator.

```ruby
class UkrainianMobileNumber
  def self.normalize(number)
    # Remove all non-digit characters
    number = number.gsub(/\D/, '')

    # Check if the number starts with 0
    if number.start_with?('0')
      # Remove the leading 0 and add the country code
      "+380#{number[1..]}"
    elsif number.start_with?('380')
      # The number is already in the international format
      "+#{number}"
    else
      # The number is in the national format without the country code
      "+380#{number}"
    end
  end

  def self.detect_operator(number)
    normalized_number = normalize(number)
    # Extract the operator code from the normalized number
    operator_code = normalized_number[4..6].to_i

    case operator_code
    when 39, 50, 66, 95, 96, 97 then UkrainianOperator.kyivstar
    when 63, 93 then UkrainianOperator.vodafone
    when 73, 99 then UkrainianOperator.lifecell
    when 92 then UkrainianOperator.triangulum
    when 68 then UkrainianOperator.people_net
    when 91 then UkrainianOperator.intersat
    else
      # Unknown operator
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# profanity_filter.rb

require 'stopwords-uk'
require 'unicode-utilities'
require 'russian_diacritics'

class ProfanityFilter
  # List of Ukrainian profanity words
  # NOTE: This list is not exhaustive and may need to be updated
  PROFANITY_WORDS = [
    'хуй', 'пизда', 'блядь', 'ебать', 'срать', 'говно', 'долбить', 'мудак', 'пидор'
  ].freeze

  # Initialize the filter with a list of stopwords
  def initialize
    @stopwords = Stopwords::UK::STOPWORDS
  end

  # Filter profanity from a given text
  def filter(text)
    # Convert text to lowercase and normalize Unicode characters
    text = text.downcase
    text = UnicodeUtilities.normalize(text)

    # Remove stopwords
    text = text.split(' ').reject { |word| @stopwords.include?(word) }.join(' ')

    # Replace profanity words with asterisks
    PROFANITY_WORDS.each do |word|
      text = text.gsub(word, '**')
    end

    text
  end
end

# Example usage
filter = ProfanityFilter.new
text = 'Хуй, це дуже гарний фільм, пизда!'
filtered_text = filter.filter(text)
puts filtered_text # Output: '**, це дуже гарний фільм, **!'
```

```ruby
  OPERATORS = {
    '39' => 'Vodafone',
    '50' => 'Vodafone',
    '63' => 'UMC (life :) )',
    '66' => 'UMC (life :) )',
    '67' => 'Kyivstar',

    '91' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '92' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '93' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '94' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '95' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '96' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '97' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '98' => 'CDMA Ukraine',
    '99' => 'CDMA Ukraine'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(number)
    @number = number
  end

  def normalize
    # Видалення всіх нецифрових символів
    number = @number.gsub(/\D/, '')

    # Перевірка на валідність номера
    return 'Невалідний номер' if number.length != 12 && number.length != 10

    # Додавання коду країни, якщо його немає
    number = "380#{number}" if number.length == 10

    # Перевірка на валідність номера після додавання коду країни
    return 'Невалідний номер' unless number.start_with?('380') && number.length == 12

    # Форматування номера
    "+#{number[0, 3]} (#{number[3, 2]}) #{number[5, 3]}-#{number[8, 2]}-#{number[10, 2]}"
  end

  def operator
    # Отримання коду оператора
    code = @number.gsub(/\D/, '')[2, 2]

    # Повернення назви оператора
    OPERATORS[code]
  end
```

```ruby
require 'stopwords-uk'
require 'ukrainian-stemmer'

class ProfanityFilter
  # Initialize the filter with a list of profane words
  def initialize(profane_words)
    @profane_words = profane_words
    @stopwords = StopwordsUk::Stopwords.new
    @stemmer = UkrainianStemmer::Stemmer.new
  end

  # Filter profanity from a given text
  def filter(text)
    # Tokenize the text into words
    words = text.split(' ')

    # Filter out stopwords
    words = words.reject { |word| @stopwords.include?(word.downcase) }

    # Stem the words
    words = words.map { |word| @stemmer.stem(word) }

    # Check each word against the profane words list
    words.each do |word|
      @profane_words.each do |profane_word|
        if word.downcase == profane_word.downcase
          # Replace the profane word with a censored version
          text = text.gsub(word, '***')
        end
      end
    end

    text
  end
end

filtered_text = filter.filter(text)

puts filtered_text
# Output: 'Ця сторінка містить ***, ***, та інші нецензурні слова.'
```

```ruby
# language_detector.rb

require 'mecab'

class LanguageDetector
  def initialize
    @mecab = MeCab::Tagger.new
  end

  def detect_language(text)
    # Tokenize the text
    tokens = @mecab.parse(text).split("\n")

    # Initialize language counters
    ukrainian_count = 0
    russian_count = 0
    surzhyk_count = 0

    # Define Ukrainian and Russian words
    ukrainian_words = %w[україна українська мова Київ Львів]
    russian_words = %w[россия русский язык Москва Санкт-Петербург]

    # Iterate over tokens
    tokens.each do |token|
      # Check if token is a word
      if token =~ /\A([^\t]+)\t/
        word = $1

        # Check if word is Ukrainian
        if ukrainian_words.any? { |uw| word =~ /#{uw}/i }
          ukrainian_count += 1
        end

        # Check if word is Russian
        if russian_words.any? { |rw| word =~ /#{rw}/i }
          russian_count += 1
        end

        # Check if word is Surzhyk (mix of Ukrainian and Russian)
        if word =~ /[а-яА-Я]/ && word =~ /[їґє]/i
          surzhyk_count += 1
        end
      end
    end

    # Determine the language
    if ukrainian_count > russian_count && ukrainian_count > surzhyk_count
      'Ukrainian'
    elsif russian_count > ukrainian_count && russian_count > surzhyk_count
      'Russian'
    elsif surzhyk_count > ukrainian_count && surzhyk_count > russian_count
      'Surzhyk'
    else
      'Unknown'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
class WhatsAppClient
  def initialize(access_token, business_phone_number_id)
    @access_token = access_token
    @business_phone_number_id = business_phone_number_id
    @base_url = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v13.0'
  end

  def send_template_message(recipient_phone_number, template_name, language_code, parameters)
    url = "#{@base_url}/#{@business_phone_number_id}/messages"
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    body = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: recipient_phone_number,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        },
        components: [
          {
            type: 'body',
            parameters: parameters.map do |parameter|
              {
                type: 'text',
                text: parameter
              }
            end
          }
        ]
      }
    }
    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
    if response.success?
      puts 'Message sent successfully'
    else
      puts "Error sending message: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'open-uri'
require 'spacy'

class NamedEntityExtractor
  def initialize(url)
    @url = url
  end

  def extract_entities
    # Fetch the HTML content of the news article
    html = open(@url).read

    # Parse the HTML content using Nokogiri
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)

    # Remove all script and style elements
    doc.search('script, style').each { |node| node.remove }

    # Get the text content of the news article
    text = doc.text.strip

    # Use SpaCy to extract named entities
    nlp = Spacy::Language.new('uk_core_news_sm')
    doc = nlp.call(text)

    # Extract named entities (people, organisations, places)
    entities = []
    doc.each_entity do |entity|
      case entity.label
      when 'PER' # Person
        entities << { type: 'Person', name: entity.text }
      when 'ORG' # Organisation
        entities << { type: 'Organisation', name: entity.text }
      when 'LOC' # Location
        entities << { type: 'Place', name: entity.text }
      end
    end

    entities
  end
end

# Example usage:

extractor = NamedEntityExtractor.new(url)
entities = extractor.extract_entities

puts "Extracted entities:"
entities.each do |entity|
  puts "#{entity[:type]}: #{entity[:name]}"
end
```

**Note:**

* This implementation uses the SpaCy library with the `uk_core_news_sm` model, which is a pre-trained model for Ukrainian language.
* You need to download the `uk_core_news_sm` model using the following command: `python -m spacy download uk_core_news_sm`
* This implementation extracts named entities (people, organisations, places) from the text content of the news article.
* The extracted entities are stored in an array of hashes, where each hash contains the type of entity (Person, Organisation, Place) and the name of the entity.

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'open-uri'
require 'stanford-core-nlp'

class NamedEntityExtractor
  def initialize(url)
    @url = url
  end

  def extract_entities
    # Fetch the HTML content of the news article
    html = open(@url).read

    # Parse the HTML content using Nokogiri
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)

    # Remove all script and style elements
    doc.search('script, style').each { |node| node.remove }

    # Get the text content of the news article
    text = doc.text.strip

    # Use Stanford Core NLP to extract named entities
    pipeline = StanfordCoreNLP::Pipeline.new(
      annotators: [:tokenize, :ssplit, :pos, :lemma, :ner],
      properties: {
        'ner.model' => 'uk-ner-model.ser.gz'
      }
    )

    annotation = pipeline.annotate(text)

    # Extract named entities (people, organisations, places)
    entities = []
    annotation.get(:sentences).each do |sentence|
      sentence.get(:tokens).each do |token|
        if token.get(:ner) != 'O'
          case token.get(:ner)
          when 'PERSON'
            entities << { type: 'Person', name: token.get(:word) }
          when 'ORGANIZATION'
            entities << { type: 'Organisation', name: token.get(:word) }
          when 'LOCATION'
            entities << { type: 'Place', name: token.get(:word) }
          end
        end
      end
    end

    entities
  end
end
```

```ruby
# fcm_notification.rb

require 'firebase/cloud_messaging'

class FcmNotification
  def initialize(api_key)
    @fcm = Firebase::CloudMessaging.new(api_key)
  end

  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_notification(device_token, title, message)
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: message
    }

    message = {
      token: device_token,
      notification: notification
    }

    response = @fcm.send(message)

    if response.success?
      puts "Notification sent successfully to #{device_token}"
    else
      puts "Error sending notification to #{device_token}: #{response.error_message}"
    end
  end

  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_notification_to_multiple_devices(device_tokens, title, message)
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: message
    }

    messages = device_tokens.map do |device_token|
      {
        token: device_token,
        notification: notification
      }
    end

    responses = @fcm.send_all(messages)

    responses.each do |response|
      if response.success?
        puts "Notification sent successfully to #{response.token}"
      else
        puts "Error sending notification to #{response.token}: #{response.error_message}"
      end
    end
  end

  # Send notification to a topic
  def send_notification_to_topic(topic, title, message)
    notification = {
      title: title,
      body: message
    }

    message = {
      topic: topic,
      notification: notification
    }

    response = @fcm.send(message)

    if response.success?
      puts "Notification sent successfully to topic #{topic}"
    else
      puts "Error sending notification to topic #{topic}: #{response.error_message}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage

  api_key = 'YOUR_FCM_API_KEY'
  fcm = FcmNotification.new(api_key)
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class UnisenderApiClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.unisender.com/ru/api'.freeze
  API_VERSION = '1.0'.freeze

  attr_accessor :api_key, :api_secret

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
  end

  # Send a transactional message
  def send_transactional_message(email, subject, body)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/#{API_VERSION}/sendEmail",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'api-key' => @api_key,
        'api-secret' => @api_secret
      },
      body: {
        email: email,
        subject: subject,
        body: body,
        message_type: 'transactional'
      }.to_json
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
    when 400..499
      raise UnisenderApiError, "Client error: #{response.body}"
    when 500..599
      raise UnisenderApiError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise UnisenderApiError, "Unknown error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

class UnisenderApiError < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class StockFetcher
  def initialize(api_key, ticker)
    @api_key = api_key
    @ticker = ticker
    @base_url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
  end

  def fetch_historical_prices
    params = {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: @ticker,
      outputsize: 'full',
      apikey: @api_key
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(@base_url, query: params)
    JSON.parse(response.body)['Time Series (Daily)']
  end

  def compute_moving_average(prices, days = 20)
    dates = prices.keys
    moving_averages = {}

    dates.each_with_index do |date, index|
      if index >= days - 1
        prices_for_average = dates[index - days + 1..index].map { |d| prices[d]['4. close'].to_f }
        moving_average = prices_for_average.sum / prices_for_average.size
        moving_averages[date] = moving_average
      end
    end

    moving_averages
  end

  def run
    historical_prices = fetch_historical_prices
    moving_averages = compute_moving_average(historical_prices)

    moving_averages
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/credit_card_validator.rb
class CreditCardValidator
  def self.validate(card_number)
    # Remove non-digit characters
    card_number = card_number.gsub(/\D/, '')

    # Check if the card number is valid according to the Luhn algorithm
    luhn_valid = luhn_check(card_number)

    # Detect the card brand
    brand = detect_brand(card_number)

    { valid: luhn_valid, brand: brand }
  end

  private

  def self.luhn_check(card_number)
    # Convert card number to an array of integers
    digits = card_number.chars.map(&:to_i)

    # Reverse the array
    digits.reverse!

    # Double every second digit
    digits.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      digits[index] = digit * 2 if index.odd?
    end

    # Subtract 9 from numbers over 9
    digits.map! do |digit|
      digit > 9 ? digit - 9 : digit
    end

    # If the sum of the digits is divisible by 10, the card number is valid
    digits.sum % 10 == 0
  end

  def self.detect_brand(card_number)
    # Regular expressions for different card brands
    brands = {
      american_express: /\A3[47]\d{13}\z/,
      diners_club: /\A30[0-5]\d{11}\z/,
      discover: /\A6(?:011|5[0-9]{2})[0-9]{12}\z/,
      jcb: /\A(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})\d{11}\z/,
      mastercard: /\A5[1-5]\d{14}\z/,
      visa: /\A4\d{12}(\d{3})?\z/
    }

    # Find the first matching brand
    brands.find do |brand, regex|
      regex.match?(card_number)
    end&.first
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/credit_card_validator.rb
require 'active_support/concern'

module CreditCardValidator
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  BRANDS = {
    visa: /^4/,
    mastercard: /^5[1-5]/,
    amex: /^3[47]/,
    discover: /^6(?:011|5)/,
    diners_club: /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68][0-9])[0-9]/,
    jcb: /^(?:2131|1800|35\d{3})/
  }.freeze

  def validate_credit_card_number
    return false unless credit_card_number.present?

    if !valid_luhn?(credit_card_number)
      errors.add(:credit_card_number, 'is invalid')
      return false
    end

    detect_brand

    true
  end

  private

  def valid_luhn?(number)
    digits = number.gsub(/\D/, '').split('').map(&:to_i)
    check_digit = digits.pop
    sum = digits.reverse_each.with_index.sum do |digit, index|
      doubled = digit * (index.even? ? 2 : 1)
      doubled > 9 ? doubled - 9 : doubled
    end
    (sum * 9) % 10 == check_digit
  end

  def detect_brand
    BRANDS.each do |brand, regex|
      if regex.match?(credit_card_number)
        self.credit_card_brand = brand
        break
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    digits = card_number.to_s.split('').map(&:to_i)
    check_digit = digits.pop
    digits.reverse.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      digits[index] = digit * 2 > 9 ? digit * 2 - 9 : digit * 2 if index.even?
    end
    sum = digits.sum
    check_digit == (10 - sum % 10) % 10
  end

  def self.determine_card_system(card_number)
    # Визначення платіжної системи за номером картки
    card_number = card_number.to_s

    elsif card_number.start_with?('60', '64', '65') || (card_number.start_with?('62') && card_number.length == 16)

    elsif card_number.start_with?('51', '52', '53', '54', '55')
      'Mastercard'
    elsif card_number.start_with?('4')
      'Visa'
    else

    end
  end

    if validate_card_number(card_number)
      { valid: true, card_system: determine_card_system(card_number) }
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class CoinbaseCommerce
  def initialize(api_key)

        'X-CC-Api-Key' => @api_key

        local_price: {

          currency: currency

  end

  def get_charge(charge_id)

      "#{@base_url}/charges/#{charge_id}",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'X-CC-Api-Key' => @api_key
      }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
    end
```

```ruby
    order.save!
  end

  end
```

```ruby
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(url, headers: headers, body: body.to_json)
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'digest/sha2'

class FondyPaymentGateway
  # Fondy API endpoint
  FONDY_API_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/'.freeze

  # Your Fondy merchant ID
  MERCHANT_ID = 'your_merchant_id'.freeze

  # Your Fondy secret key
  SECRET_KEY = 'your_secret_key'.freeze

  # Generate payment request
  def self.generate_payment_request(order_id, amount, currency, description)
    params = {
      merchant_id: MERCHANT_ID,
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(FONDY_API_URL + 'payment/request/', body: params)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  # Verify payment response signature
  def self.verify_signature(response)
    signature = response['signature']
    response.delete('signature')

    expected_signature = Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(response.sort.to_a.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join + SECRET_KEY)

    signature == expected_signature
  end

  # Process payment response
  def self.process_payment_response(response)
    if verify_signature(response)
      # Payment is valid, proceed with order processing
      puts 'Payment is valid'
    else
      # Payment is invalid, handle error
      puts 'Payment is invalid'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# config/initializers/fondy.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'uri'
require 'digest/sha2'

class FondyPaymentGateway
  attr_accessor :merchant_id, :merchant_key, :currency, :order_id, :amount

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_key, currency, order_id, amount)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_key = merchant_key
    @currency = currency
    @order_id = order_id
    @amount = amount
  end

  def generate_payment_url
    url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/redirect/'
    params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: @order_id,
      amount: @amount,
      currency: @currency,
      signature: generate_signature
    }

    "#{url}?#{URI.encode_www_form(params)}"
  end

  def verify_signature(params)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    expected_signature == params['signature']
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(params = {})
    data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: @order_id,
      amount: @amount,
      currency: @currency
    }.merge(params)

    data_str = data.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(data_str + @merchant_key)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'digest/sha2'
require 'base64'
require 'uri'

class FondyPayment
  attr_accessor :merchant_id, :merchant_key, :order_id, :amount, :currency, :response

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_key, order_id, amount, currency)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_key = merchant_key
    @order_id = order_id
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency
  end

  def make_payment
    url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/checkout/redirect/'
    params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: @order_id,
      amount: @amount,
      currency: @currency
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(url, body: params)
    @response = response.parsed_response
    @response
  end

  def verify_signature
    signature = @response['signature']
    data = @response.except('signature')
    expected_signature = generate_signature(data)

    expected_signature == signature
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    string_to_sign = data.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    Digest::SHA2.hexdigest("#{@merchant_key}#{string_to_sign}#{@merchant_key}").upcase
  end
end
```

```ruby
  def initialize(payment_data)

  end

  def generate_qr_code
    # Стандарт НБУ для платіжних QR-кодів передбачає наступний формат даних:
    # "PB" + номер платіжної системи + номер банку + номер рахунку + сума + валюта
    data = "PB#{payment_data[:payment_system]}#{payment_data[:bank_code]}#{payment_data[:account_number]}#{payment_data[:amount]}#{payment_data[:currency]}"

    # Генеруємо QR-код за допомогою геми rqrcode

    # Зберігаємо QR-код у файл

      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      shape_rendering: ChunkyPNG::SHAPE_RENDERING_CRISP,
      text: nil,
      size: 200

  private
```

```ruby
class NBUQRGenerator
  # NBU QR payment standard fields
  FIELDS = {
    payee_name: 'Payee Name',
    payee_account: 'Payee Account',
    payee_bank_mfo: 'Payee Bank MFO',
    payment_amount: 'Payment Amount',
    payment_currency: 'Payment Currency',

  }

    @payee_account = payee_account
    @payee_bank_mfo = payee_bank_mfo
    @payment_amount = payment_amount
    @payment_currency = payment_currency
    @payment_purpose = payment_purpose
  end

  def generate_qr_code
    # Generate QR code data according to the NBU QR payment standard
    qr_data = "UA\n" \

              "#{@payee_account}\n" \
              "#{@payee_bank_mfo}\n" \
              "UAH\n" \
              "#{@payment_amount}\n" \
              "#{@payment_purpose}\n" \
              "UA"

    # Generate QR code
    qrcode = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_data, size: 200)

    # Create an empty PNG image

    qrcode.assemble.do |row, col, dark|
      png.set_pixel(col, row, dark ? ChunkyPNG::Color::BLACK : ChunkyPNG::Color::WHITE)
    end

    # Save the PNG image to a file
```

```ruby
# liqpay_p2p.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class LiqPayP2P
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.liqpay.com/api/'
  API_VERSION = '3'
  CURRENCY = 'UAH'

  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def payout(card_number, amount)
    # Create a signature
    signature = create_signature(card_number, amount)

    # Prepare the request data
    data = {
      'public_key' => @public_key,
      'version' => API_VERSION,
      'action' => 'p2p_credit',
      'card' => card_number,
      'amount' => amount.to_s,
      'currency' => CURRENCY,
      'signature' => signature
    }

    # Send the request
    response = HTTParty.post(BASE_URL + 'request', body: data)

    # Check the response
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['response']
    else
      raise "Error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  private

  def create_signature(card_number, amount)
    # Create a string to sign
    string_to_sign = "#{@private_key}#{card_number}#{amount}#{@private_key}"

    # Use SHA1 to create a signature
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(string_to_sign)
  end
end

amount = 10.0
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'uri'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'

class FondyPayment
  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_key = merchant_key
    @api_url = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/'
  end

  def create_payment(order_id, amount, currency)
    # Підготовка параметрів для створення платежу
    params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency
    }

    # Відправка запиту на створення платежу
    response = HTTParty.post(@api_url + 'payment/', body: params)

    # Перевірка успішності запиту
    if response.success?
      # Повертаємо URL для редиректу клієнта на сторінку оплати
      JSON.parse(response.body)['response']['payment_url']
    else
      # Обробка помилки
      nil
    end
  end

  def verify_signature(params, signature)
    # Формування рядка для перевірки підпису
    sign_string = params.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')

    # Перевірка підпису
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    hmac = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(digest, @merchant_key, sign_string)
    expected_signature = Base64.encode64(hmac).strip

    # Зрівняння очікуваного підпису з отриманим
    expected_signature == signature
  end
end

# Приклад використання

  merchant_key = 'Ваш_MERCHANT_KEY'
  fondy_payment = FondyPayment.new(merchant_id, merchant_key)

  # Створення платежу
  order_id = 'ORD-12345'
  amount = 10.0
  currency = 'USD'
  payment_url = fondy_payment.create_payment(order_id, amount, currency)
  puts "Payment URL: #{payment_url}"

  # Симулюємо відповідь від Fondy для перевірки підпису
  params = {
    'order_id' => order_id,
    'amount' => amount,
    'currency' => currency,
    'status' => 'approved'
  }
  signature = 'ваш_підпис' # Це потрібно замінити на справжній підпис з відповіді Fondy

  # Перевірка підпису
  if fondy_payment.verify_signature(params, signature)
    puts 'Підпис валідний'
  else
    puts 'Підпис невалідний'
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/services/xero_service.rb
class XeroService
  include OAuth2::Client

  def initialize(invoice)
    @invoice = invoice
    @client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID'],
      ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      site: 'https://api.xero.com',
      authorize_url: '/oauth/authorize',
      token_url: '/oauth/token'
    )
  end

  def sync
    # Authenticate with Xero
    token = authenticate

    # Create or update invoice in Xero
    xero_invoice = create_or_update_invoice(token)

    # Update payment status in Rails app
    update_payment_status(xero_invoice)
  end

  def update_payment_status(xero_invoice)
    # Get payment status from Xero
    payment_status = get_payment_status(xero_invoice)

    # Update payment status in Rails app
    xero_invoice.update(payment_status: payment_status)
  end

  private

  def authenticate
    # Authenticate with Xero using OAuth2
    client.client_credentials.get_token
  end

  def create_or_update_invoice(token)
    # Create or update invoice in Xero
    xero_invoices = XeroInvoice.where(invoice_id: @invoice.id)
    if xero_invoices.any?
      xero_invoice = xero_invoices.first
      update_invoice(token, xero_invoice)
    else
      create_invoice(token)
    end
  end

  def create_invoice(token)
    # Create new invoice in Xero
    response = token.get('api.xero.com/api/v2/Invoices', {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token.token}"
    }, {
      invoice: {
        type: 'ACCREC',
        contact: {
          name: @invoice.customer_name
        },
        date: @invoice.date,
        due_date: @invoice.due_date,
        line_items: @invoice.line_items.map do |line_item|
          {
            item_code: line_item.item_code,
            description: line_item.description,
            quantity: line_item.quantity,
            unit_amount: line_item.unit_amount,
            account_code: line_item.account_code
          }
        end
      }
    })

    # Save Xero invoice ID to Rails app
    xero_invoice = XeroInvoice.create(
      invoice_id: @invoice.id,
      xero_invoice_id: response['Invoices'][0]['InvoiceID']
    )

    xero_invoice
  end

  def update_invoice(token, xero_invoice)
    # Update existing invoice in Xero
    response = token.put("api.xero.com/api/v2/Invoices/#{xero_invoice.xero_invoice_id}", {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token.token}"
    }, {
      invoice: {
        type: 'ACCREC',
        contact: {
          name: @invoice.customer_name
        },
        date: @invoice.date,
        due_date: @invoice.due_date,
        line_items: @invoice.line_items.map do |line_item|
          {
            item_code: line_item.item_code,
            description: line_item.description,
            quantity: line_item.quantity,
            unit_amount: line_item.unit_amount,
            account_code: line_item.account_code
          }
        end
      }
    })

    xero_invoice
  end

  def get_payment_status(xero_invoice)
    # Get payment status from Xero
    response = token.get("api.xero.com/api/v2/Invoices/#{xero_invoice.xero_invoice_id}", {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token.token}"
    })

    response['Invoices'][0]['Status']
  end
end
```

```ruby
    @private_key = private_key

    # Make the request

    # Handle response
    if response.success?
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class LiqPayP2PCredit
  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def pay(card_number, card_exp, card_cvv, amount)
    # Підготовка даних для підпису
    data = {
      'version' => '3',
      'public_key' => @public_key,
      'action' => 'p2p_credit',
      'card' => card_number,
      'card_exp' => card_exp,
      'card_cvv' => card_cvv,
      'amount' => amount
    }

    # Підпис даних
    signature = generate_signature(data)

    # Відправка запиту на LiqPay API
    response = HTTParty.post('https://www.liqpay.ua/api/request',
                             body: {
                               'data' => data.to_json,
                               'signature' => signature
                             },
                             headers: {
                               'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                             })

    # Перевірка результату
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['result']
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  private
```

Тепер давайте перейдем до реалізації коду. Створіть файл `liqpay_payment.rb` із наступним вмістом:
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'uri'

class LiqPayPayment
  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  def pay(card_number, card_exp, card_cvv, amount)
    # Підготовка даних для запиту
    data = {
      'version' => '3',
      'public_key' => @public_key,
      'action' => 'p2p_credit',
      'card' => {
        'number' => card_number,
        'exp_month' => card_exp.split('/')[0],
        'exp_year' => card_exp.split('/')[1],
        'cvv' => card_cvv
      },
      'amount' => amount,
      'currency' => 'UAH',
      'description' => 'Оплата на картку'
    }

    # Підписування даних
    signature = generate_signature(data)

    # Формування URL-адреси запиту
    url = URI('https://www.liqpay.ua/api/request')
    url.query = URI.encode_www_form({
      'public_key' => @public_key,
      'signature' => signature,
      'data' => data.to_json
    })

    # Відправка запиту
    response = HTTParty.get(url)

    # Обробка відповіді
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['response']
    else
      raise "Помилка оплати: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(data)
    # Генерація підпису за допомогою секретного ключа
    digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1')
    signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(digest, @private_key, data.to_json)
    Base64.strict_encode64(signature)
  end
end
```
Цей код реалізує клас `LiqPayPayment`, який приймає публічний і приватний ключі LiqPay у конструкторі. Метод `pay` приймає дані про картку, суму оплати та інші параметри, підписує дані за допомогою секретного ключа і відправляє запит до API LiqPay.

Щоб виконати завдання перевірки номера платника ПДВ (VAT number) у ЄС через сервіс VIES з використанням Ruby, потрібно:

1. Використовувати гем `savon` для роботи з SOAP-сервісом VIES.
2. Налаштувати `Gemfile` з необхідними гемами.
3. Написати код для перевірки валідності VAT-номера.

### 1. Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'savon'
gem 'nokogiri'
```

### 2. Код для перевірки VAT-номера через VIES

```ruby
# check_vat.rb

require 'savon'
require 'nokogiri'

class VIESValidator
  VIES_WSDL_URL = 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/services/checkVatService?wsdl'.freeze

  def initialize
    @client = Savon.client(
      wsdl: VIES_WSDL_URL,
      log: false,
      raise_errors: false
    )
  end

  def validate_vat(country_code, vat_number)
    response = @client.call(:check_vat, message: {
      countryCode: country_code,
      vatNumber: vat_number
    })

    return false unless response.success?

    body = response.body
    return false unless body[:check_vat_response]

    result = body[:check_vat_response][:valid]
    result == true
  end

  def get_vat_info(country_code, vat_number)
    response = @client.call(:check_vat, message: {
      countryCode: country_code,
      vatNumber: vat_number
    })

    return nil unless response.success?

    body = response.body
    return nil unless body[:check_vat_response]

    result = body[:check_vat_response]
    {
      valid: result[:valid],
      name: result[:name],
      address: result[:address]
    }
  end
end

# Приклад використання:
if __FILE__ == $0
  validator = VIESValidator.new

  country_code = 'UA'  # Наприклад, Україна
  vat_number = '1234567890'  # Наприклад, тестовий номер

  if validator.validate_vat(country_code, vat_number)
    puts "VAT номер #{vat_number} для країни #{country_code} є валідним."
    info = validator.get_vat_info(country_code, vat_number)
    puts "Ім'я: #{info[:name]}"
    puts "Адреса: #{info[:address]}"
  else
    puts "VAT номер #{vat_number} для країни #{country_code} не валідний."
  end
end
```

---

### Щоб запустити:

1. Встановіть геми:

```bash
bundle install
```

2. Запустіть скрипт:

```bash
ruby check_vat.rb
```

---

### Примітки:

- `country_code` — код країни згідно ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (наприклад, `UA`, `DE`, `FR`).
- `vat_number` — номер платника ПДВ без коду країни.
- Повертає `true`/`false` у випадку перевірки, або `nil`, якщо помилка.
- Сервіс VIES доступний через HTTPS і має обмеження на кількість запитів.

Here's a complete Ruby solution for generating a PDF invoice with email attachment:

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'prawn'
gem 'prawn-table'
gem 'mail'
gem 'dotenv'

# app.rb
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'
require 'mail'
require 'dotenv/load'

class InvoiceGenerator
  def initialize
    @invoice_number = "INV-#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d')}-#{rand(1000..9999)}"
    @invoice_date = Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
  end

  def generate_pdf(invoice_data)
    Prawn::Document.generate("invoice_#{invoice_data[:customer][:name].downcase.gsub(/\s+/, '_')}_#{@invoice_number}.pdf") do |pdf|
      # Header
      pdf.text "INVOICE", size: 24, style: :bold, align: :center
      pdf.move_down 10
      pdf.text "Invoice Number: #{@invoice_number}", size: 12
      pdf.text "Date: #{@invoice_date}", size: 12
      pdf.move_down 20

      # Customer details
      pdf.text "Bill To:", size: 14, style: :bold
      pdf.text invoice_data[:customer][:name], size: 12
      pdf.text invoice_data[:customer][:address], size: 12
      pdf.text invoice_data[:customer][:email], size: 12
      pdf.move_down 20

      # Line items table
      table_data = [
        ['Description', 'Quantity', 'Unit Price', 'Total']
      ]

      invoice_data[:line_items].each do |item|
        table_data << [
          item[:description],
          item[:quantity].to_s,
          "$#{item[:unit_price].round(2)}",
          "$#{(item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price]).round(2)}"
        ]
      end

      # Add totals
      subtotal = invoice_data[:line_items].sum { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price] }
      vat_rate = invoice_data[:vat_rate] || 0.20
      vat_amount = subtotal * vat_rate
      total = subtotal + vat_amount

      table_data << ['', '', '', '']
      table_data << ['Subtotal', '', '', "$#{subtotal.round(2)}"]
      table_data << ["VAT (#{(vat_rate * 100).to_i}%)", '', '', "$#{vat_amount.round(2)}"]
      table_data << ['Total', '', '', "$#{total.round(2)}"]

      pdf.table(table_data, width: 500) do
        row(0).style(bold: true, background_color: 'cccccc')
        row(-1).style(bold: true)
        row(-2).style(bold: true)
        row(-3).style(bold: true)
      end

      pdf.move_down 20
      pdf.text "Thank you for your business!", size: 12, align: :center
    end
  end

  def send_email(pdf_path, email_data)
    # Configure mail gem
    Mail.defaults do
      delivery_method :smtp, {
        address: ENV['SMTP_ADDRESS'],
        port: ENV['SMTP_PORT'].to_i,
        user_name: ENV['SMTP_USERNAME'],
        password: ENV['SMTP_PASSWORD'],
        authentication: 'plain',
        enable_starttls_auto: true
      }
    end

    mail = Mail.new do
      from     ENV['EMAIL_FROM']
      to       email_data[:to]
      subject  email_data[:subject]
      body     email_data[:body]
      add_file filename: File.basename(pdf_path), content: File.read(pdf_path)
    end

    mail.deliver!
    puts "Email sent successfully to #{email_data[:to]}"
  end
end

# Example usage

  # Sample invoice data
  invoice_data = {
    customer: {
      name: "John Doe",
      address: "123 Main St, Anytown, USA",
      email: "john.doe@example.com"
    },
    line_items: [
      { description: "Web Design Services", quantity: 10, unit_price: 50.00 },

  # Send email (uncomment to actually send)

end
```
