## ✅ 2. Код для генерації `pain.001.001.03`

```ruby
# generate_sepa_payment.rb

require 'builder'
require 'date'

# Створюємо XML для SEPA Payment Initiation (pain.001.001.03)
def generate_sepa_xml(payments, initiating_party_name, initiating_party_iban, initiating_party_bic)
  xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
  xml.instruct!

  # Корінь документа
  xml.tag! 'Document', 'xmlns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001.03',
                       'xmlns:xsi' => 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' do

    xml.tag! 'CstmrCdtTrfInitn' do
      # Інформація про ініціатора
      xml.tag! 'GrpHdr' do
        xml.tag! 'MsgId', "MSG#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"
        xml.tag! 'CreDtTm', Time.now.iso8601
        xml.tag! 'NbOfTxs', payments.length
        xml.tag! 'CtrlSum', payments.sum { |p| p[:amount] }.round(2)
        xml.tag! 'InitgPty' do
          xml.tag! 'Nm', initiating_party_name
        end
      end

      # Інформація про переказ
      xml.tag! 'PmtInf' do
        xml.tag! 'PmtInfId', "PMT#{Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"
        xml.tag! 'PmtMtd', 'TRF'
        xml.tag! 'BtchBookg', 'false'
        xml.tag! 'NbOfTxs', payments.length
        xml.tag! 'CtrlSum', payments.sum { |p| p[:amount] }.round(2)
        xml.tag! 'PmtTpInf' do
          xml.tag! 'SvcLvl' do
            xml.tag! 'Cd', 'SEPA'
          end
        end
        xml.tag! 'ReqdExctnDt', Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

        xml.tag! 'Dbtr' do
          xml.tag! 'Nm', initiating_party_name
        end

        xml.tag! 'DbtrAcct' do
          xml.tag! 'Id' do
            xml.tag! 'IBAN', initiating_party_iban
          end
        end

        xml.tag! 'DbtrAgt' do
          xml.tag! 'FinInstnId' do
            xml.tag! 'BIC', initiating_party_bic
          end
        end

        # Один або кілька платежів
        payments.each do |payment|
          xml.tag! 'CdtTrfTxInf' do
            xml.tag! 'PmtId' do
              xml.tag! 'EndToEndId', payment[:end_to_end_id]
            end
            xml.tag! 'Amt' do
              xml.tag! 'InstdAmt', payment[:amount], 'Ccy' => 'EUR'
            end
            xml.tag! 'CdtrAgt' do
              xml.tag! 'FinInstnId' do
                xml.tag! 'BIC', payment[:bic]
              end
            end
            xml.tag! 'Cdtr' do
              xml.tag! 'Nm', payment[:supplier_name]
            end
            xml.tag! 'CdtrAcct' do
              xml.tag! 'Id' do
                xml.tag! 'IBAN', payment[:iban]
              end
            end
            xml.tag! 'RmtInf' do
              xml.tag! 'Ustrd', payment[:purpose] || 'Payment to supplier'
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# Приклад даних для платежів
payments = [
  {
    end_to_end_id: 'E2E001',
    supplier_name: 'Supplier A',
    iban: 'DE44500105170445678901',
    bic: 'COBADEFFXXX',
    amount: 1000.00,
    purpose: 'Invoice payment'
  },
  {
    end_to_end_id: 'E2E002',
    supplier_name: 'Supplier B',
    iban: 'FR7630001007941234567890185',
    bic: 'BNPAFRPPXXX',
    amount: 2500.50,
    purpose: 'Service payment'
  }
]

# Дані ініціатора
initiating_party_name = 'My Company Ltd'
initiating_party_iban = 'DE12500105170445678901'
initiating_party_bic = 'COBADEFFXXX'

# Генерація XML
xml_content = generate_sepa_xml(payments, initiating_party_name, initiating_party_iban, initiating_party_bic)

# Запис до файлу
File.write('sepa_payment.xml', xml_content)

puts "SEPA XML файл створено: sepa_payment.xml"
```

# currency_converter.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'active_support/cache'

class CurrencyConverter
  include HTTParty
  
  # URL щоденних курсів Європейського центрального банку
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml'
  
  # Ініціалізація конвертера
  def initialize(cache_store = nil)
    @cache = cache_store || ActiveSupport::Cache::MemoryStore.new
    @cache_key_prefix = 'currency_rates_'
    @default_base_currency = 'EUR'
  end
  
  # Конвертувати валюту
  def convert(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
    rates = fetch_rates
    
    # Перевірка валюти
    unless rates.key?(from_currency)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown source currency: #{from_currency}"
    end
    
    unless rates.key?(to_currency)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown target currency: #{to_currency}"
    end
    
    # Конвертація
    base_rate = rates[from_currency]
    target_rate = rates[to_currency]
    
    # Якщо обидві валюти відносяться до однієї базової (EUR)
    converted_amount = (amount / base_rate) * target_rate
    
    converted_amount
  end
  
  # Отримати курс між двома валютами
  def exchange_rate(from_currency, to_currency)
    rates = fetch_rates
    
    unless rates.key?(from_currency) && rates.key?(to_currency)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid currency pair"
    end
    
    # Якщо обидві валюти відносяться до однієї базової (EUR)
    base_rate = rates[from_currency]
    target_rate = rates[to_currency]
    
    target_rate / base_rate
  end
  
  # Отримати всі курси валюти
  def fetch_rates
    date_key = Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    cache_key = "#{@cache_key_prefix}#{date_key}"
    
    # Спроба отримати з кешу
    rates = @cache.read(cache_key)
    
    if rates.nil?
      puts "Fetching fresh rates from ECB..."
      rates = fetch_from_ecb
      # Кешування на добу
      @cache.write(cache_key, rates, expires_in: 24.hours)
    end
    
    rates
  end
  
  private
  
  # Отримати курси з ЄЦБ
  def fetch_from_ecb
    begin
      response = self.class.get(BASE_URL, headers: { 'Accept' => 'application/xml' })
      
      if response.success?
        xml = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
        xml.remove_namespaces!
        
        rates = {
          'EUR' => 1.0  # Базова валюта
        }
        
        # Парсимо XML для отримання курсів
        xml.xpath('//Cube').each do |cube|
          next if cube['currency'].nil?
          
          currency = cube['currency']
          rate = cube['rate'].to_f
          
          rates[currency] = rate
        end
        
        rates
      else
        raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates: #{response.code}"
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Error fetching rates: #{e.message}"
      # Повертаємо стандартні курси при помилці
      default_rates
    end
  end
  
  # Стандартні курси для випадку помилки
  def default_rates
    {
      'EUR' => 1.0,
      'USD' => 1.08,
      'GBP' => 0.85,
      'JPY' => 150.0,
      'CAD' => 1.35,
      'AUD' => 1.55,
      'CHF' => 0.92,
      'CNY' => 7.2,
      'SEK' => 10.5,
      'NZD' => 1.65
    }
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0

  # Приклади використання

    puts "100 USD = #{converter.convert(100, 'USD', 'EUR').round(2)} EUR"
    puts "50 EUR = #{converter.convert(50, 'EUR', 'USD').round(2)} USD"

    # Вивести всі курси

    rates = converter.fetch_rates

      puts "#{currency}: #{rate}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# models/user.rb
require 'active_record'

class User < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_one :subscription, dependent: :destroy
  
  def create_subscription(plan_id, trial_days = 7)
    # Create subscription with free trial
    result = Braintree::Subscription.create(
      payment_method_token: self.payment_method_token,
      plan_id: plan_id,
      trial_period: true,
      trial_duration: trial_days,
      trial_duration_unit: "day"
    )
    
    if result.success?
      # Save subscription reference to user
      self.subscription = Subscription.create!(
        user_id: self.id,
        braintree_subscription_id: result.subscription.id,
        status: result.subscription.status,
        next_billing_date: result.subscription.next_billing_date
      )
      return result.subscription
    else
      raise "Subscription creation failed: #{result.errors}"
    end
  end
  
  def cancel_subscription
    if self.subscription
      # Cancel the Braintree subscription
      result = Braintree::Subscription.cancel(self.subscription.braintree_subscription_id)
      
      if result.success?
        # Update local subscription status
        self.subscription.update!(
          status: result.subscription.status,
          canceled_at: Time.current
        )
        return true
      else
        raise "Subscription cancellation failed: #{result.errors}"
      end
    else
      return false
    end
  end
end

# models/subscription.rb
require 'active_record'

class Subscription < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :user
  
  # Valid statuses from Braintree
  VALID_STATUSES = %w[pending active past_due canceled expired].freeze
  
  def active?
    VALID_STATUSES.include?(status) && status != 'canceled'
  end
  
  def cancel!
    # Cancel the subscription in Braintree
    result = Braintree::Subscription.cancel(braintree_subscription_id)
    
    if result.success?
      update!(
        status: result.subscription.status,
        canceled_at: Time.current
      )
      return true
    else
      raise "Failed to cancel subscription: #{result.errors}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# controllers/user_controller.rb
require 'sinatra'
require_relative '../models/user'
require_relative '../models/subscription'

class UserController < Sinatra::Base
  # Create a user with subscription
  post '/users' do
    # Assume we have payment method token from frontend
    payment_method_token = params[:payment_method_token]
    plan_id = params[:plan_id] || 'premium_plan'
    
    user = User.create!(email: params[:email], payment_method_token: payment_method_token)
    
    begin
      subscription = user.create_subscription(plan_id, 7) # 7-day trial
      content_type :json
      { 
        success: true,
        user_id: user.id,
        subscription_id: subscription.id,
        trial_ends_at: subscription.next_billing_date
      }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 400
      { success: false, error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  # Delete user and cancel subscription
  delete '/users/:id' do
    user = User.find(params[:id])
    
    begin
      user.cancel_subscription
      user.destroy
      content_type :json
      { success: true, message: "User and subscription cancelled successfully" }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 400
      { success: false, error: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end
end

# lib/vat_validator.rb
require 'savon'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'
require 'dry/validation'

class VATValidator
  include Dry::Validation::Contract

  # VIES WSDL endpoint
  VIES_WSDL = 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/checkVatService.wsdl'.freeze
  
  # Valid EU country codes
  EU_COUNTRY_CODES = [
    'AT', 'BE', 'BG', 'CY', 'CZ', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'EL', 'ES', 'FI', 'FR',
    'GB', 'HR', 'HU', 'IE', 'IT', 'LT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'PL', 'PT',
    'RO', 'SE', 'SI', 'SK'
  ].freeze

  # Define validation rules
  params do
    required(:vat_number).filled(:string)
  end

  rule(:vat_number) do
    key.failure('must be a valid EU VAT number format') unless valid_eu_vat_format?(value)
  end

  def self.validate(vat_number)
    new.call(vat_number: vat_number)
  end

  def self.validate_and_check(vat_number)
    result = validate(vat_number)
    
    return result unless result.success?
    
    # If validation passes, check with VIES service
    check_vies_service(vat_number)
  end

  def self.check_vies_service(vat_number)
    begin
      # Extract country code and VAT number
      country_code = vat_number[0..1]
      vat_number_without_country = vat_number[2..-1]
      
      # Create SOAP client
      client = Savon.client(
        wsdl: VIES_WSDL,
        log: false,
        env_namespace: :soapenv,
        namespaces: {
          'xmlns:soapenv' => 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/',
          'xmlns:q0' => 'http://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/services/checkVat'
        }
      )
      
      # Call VIES service
      response = client.call(:check_vat, message: {
        'q0:countryCode' => country_code,
        'q0:vatNumber' => vat_number_without_country
      })
      
      # Parse response
      response_data = response.body[:check_vat_response]
      
      {
        valid: response_data[:valid] == true,
        country_code: country_code,
        vat_number: vat_number,
        name: response_data[:name],
        address: response_data[:address]
      }
      
    rescue Savon::Error => e
      {
        valid: false,
        error: "VIES service error: #{e.message}",
        vat_number: vat_number
      }
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        valid: false,
        error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}",
        vat_number: vat_number
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def self.valid_eu_vat_format?(vat_number)
    # Remove spaces and convert to uppercase
    clean_vat = vat_number.gsub(/\s+/, '').upcase
    
    # Basic format validation
    return false unless clean_vat.length >= 4
    
    # Check if starts with valid EU country code
    country_code = clean_vat[0..1]
    return false unless EU_COUNTRY_CODES.include?(country_code)
    
    # Basic structure validation for EU VAT numbers
    # Each country has its own specific format, but this covers most cases
    # This is a simplified validation - actual validation would be more complex
    /^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{4,11}$/.match?(clean_vat)
  end
end

# Example usage and testing
class ReverseChargeInvoice
  def self.create_invoice(vat_number, amount)
    puts "Validating VAT number: #{vat_number}"
    
    # Validate format first
    validation_result = VATValidator.validate(vat_number)
    
    if validation_result.success?
      puts "Format validation passed"
      
      # Validate against VIES service
      vies_result = VATValidator.check_vies_service(vat_number)
      
      if vies_result[:valid]
        puts "VAT number is valid and registered"
        puts "Company name: #{vies_result[:name]}"
        puts "Company address: #{vies_result[:address]}"
        
        # Proceed with reverse charge invoice creation
        {
          status: 'success',
          message: 'Invoice created with reverse charge',
          vat_number: vat_number,
          amount: amount,
          company_name: vies_result[:name]
        }
      else
        puts "VAT number is not valid or not registered"
        puts "Error: #{vies_result[:error]}" if vies_result[:error]
        
        {
          status: 'error',
          message: 'Invalid VAT number',
          vat_number: vat_number
        }
      end
    else
      puts "VAT number format validation failed"
      puts "Errors: #{validation_result.errors.to_h}"
      
      {
        status: 'error',
        message: 'Invalid VAT number format',
        errors: validation_result.errors.to_h
      }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage:
if __FILE__ == $0

    result = ReverseChargeInvoice.create_invoice(vat_number, 1000.00)
    puts "Result: #{result[:status]}"

## 🛠️ 3. `app.rb` – головний файл додатку

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'coinbase/commerce'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Ініціалізація клієнта Coinbase Commerce
Coinbase::Commerce.configure do |config|
  config.api_key = ENV['COINBASE_API_KEY']
end

# Створення замовлення
post '/create-order' do
  content_type :json

  begin
    order = Coinbase::Commerce::Order.create(
      name: "Покупка товару",
      description: "Опис замовлення",
      local_price: {
        amount: "10.00",
        currency: "USD"
      },
      pricing_type: "fixed_price"
    )

    # Зберігаємо order_id, щоб потім перевірити статус
    # У справжньому додатку це має бути у базі даних
    @order_id = order.id
    @checkout_url = order.checkout_url

    { order_id: @order_id, checkout_url: @checkout_url }.to_json

  rescue => e
    status 500
    { error: e.message }.to_json
  end
end

# Webhook для обробки оплати
post '/webhook' do
  payload = request.body.read
  signature = request.env['HTTP_X_CC_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE']

  begin
    # Перевірка підпису webhook
    Coinbase::Commerce::Webhook.verify_payload(payload, signature, ENV['COINBASE_WEBHOOK_SECRET'])

    event = JSON.parse(payload)
    order_id = event['data']['id']

    # Отримуємо замовлення за ID
    order = Coinbase::Commerce::Order.retrieve(order_id)

    if order.status == 'confirmed' || order.status == 'resolved'
      # Логіка: позначити замовлення як оплачене
      puts "Замовлення #{order_id} оплачено!"
      # Тут можна оновити статус замовлення в БД
    else
      puts "Статус замовлення: #{order.status}"
    end

    status 200
    "OK"

  rescue => e
    status 400
    puts "Webhook error: #{e.message}"
    "Error"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'
require 'mail'

class InvoiceGenerator
  def initialize(invoice_data)
    @items = invoice_data[:items]
    @tax_rate = invoice_data[:tax_rate] || 0.20
    @recipient_email = invoice_data[:recipient_email]
    @sender_email = invoice_data[:sender_email]
    @subject = invoice_data[:subject] || "Рахунок"
    @body = invoice_data[:body] || "Додано рахунок у вкладенні."
  end

  def generate_pdf
    filename = "invoice_#{Time.now.to_i}.pdf"
    Prawn::Document.generate(filename) do
      text "Рахунок", size: 20, style: :bold
      move_down 20

      table_data = [
        ["Назва", "Кількість", "Ціна", "Сума"]
      ]

      total = 0

      @items.each do |item|
        quantity = item[:quantity]
        price = item[:price]
        subtotal = quantity * price
        total += subtotal
        table_data << [
          item[:name],
          quantity,
          "$#{price}",
          "$#{subtotal}"
        ]
      end

      tax = total * @tax_rate
      grand_total = total + tax

      table_data << ["", "", "Підсумок:", "$#{total}"]
      table_data << ["", "", "ПДВ (#{@tax_rate * 100}%):", "$#{tax}"]
      table_data << ["", "", "Всього:", "$#{grand_total}"]

      table(table_data, cell_style: { size: 12 }) do
        row(0).style(bold: true)
        row(-1).style(bold: true)
      end

      move_down 20
      text "Дякуємо за покупку!", size: 14
    end

    filename
  end

  def send_email(pdf_path)
    Mail.defaults do
      delivery_method :smtp, address: "smtp.gmail.com", port: 587, user_name: @sender_email, password: "your_app_password", authentication: 'plain', enable_starttls_auto: true
    end

    mail = Mail.new do
      from     @sender_email
      to       @recipient_email
      subject  @subject
      body     @body
      add_file filename: File.basename(pdf_path), content: File.read(pdf_path)
    end

    mail.deliver!
    puts "Лист успішно надіслано!"
  end
end
```

require 'sinatra'
require 'braintree'
require './config/braintree'

# Розрахунок підписки (при створенні акаунту)
post '/subscribe' do
  customer = Braintree::Customer.create(
    first_name: "John",
    last_name: "Doe",
    email: "john.doe@example.com"
  )

  if customer.success?
    result = Braintree::Subscription.create(
      payment_method_token: customer.customer.payment_methods.first.token,
      plan_id: "your_plan_id", # Вкажіть ваш plan_id
      trial_period: true,
      trial_duration: 14, # пробний період у днях
      trial_duration_unit: "day"
    )

    if result.success?
      subscription_id = result.subscription.id
      puts "Підписка створена: #{subscription_id}"
      { status: 'success', subscription_id: subscription_id }.to_json
    else
      puts "Помилка створення підписки: #{result.errors}"
      status 422
      { error: result.errors }.to_json
    end
  else
    puts "Помилка створення клієнта: #{customer.errors}"
    status 422
    { error: customer.errors }.to_json
  end
end

# Скасування підписки (при видаленні акаунту)
delete '/unsubscribe/:subscription_id' do
  subscription_id = params[:subscription_id]

  result = Braintree::Subscription.cancel(subscription_id)

  if result.success?
    puts "Підписка скасована: #{subscription_id}"
    { status: 'cancelled' }.to_json
  else
    puts "Помилка скасування: #{result.errors}"
    status 422
    { error: result.errors }.to_json
  end
end
```

Here's a complete Ruby solution for importing bank transactions from CAMT.053 XML and matching them to unpaid invoices by reference.

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'nokogiri'
gem 'activerecord'
gem 'sqlite3'
gem 'csv'
gem 'builder'

# app.rb
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_record'
require 'csv'
require 'date'

# Configure database (using SQLite for simplicity)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'bank_transactions.db'
)

# Invoice model
class Invoice < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :reference, presence: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
  validates :due_date, presence: true
  
  scope :unpaid, -> { where(status: 'unpaid') }
end

# Transaction model
class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :reference, presence: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
  validates :date, presence: true
  
  scope :unmatched, -> { where(matched_invoice_id: nil) }
end

# Create tables if they don't exist
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?(:invoices)
    create_table :invoices do |t|
      t.string :reference, null: false
      t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2, null: false
      t.date :due_date, null: false
      t.string :status, default: 'unpaid'
      t.timestamps
    end
    
    add_index :invoices, :reference, unique: true
  end
  
  unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?(:transactions)
    create_table :transactions do |t|
      t.string :reference, null: false
      t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2, null: false
      t.date :date, null: false
      t.integer :matched_invoice_id
      t.timestamps
    end
    
    add_index :transactions, :reference
  end
end

# CAMT.053 Parser
class Camt053Parser
  def initialize(xml_content)
    @doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    @doc.remove_namespaces!
  end

  def parse
    transactions = []
    
    # Find transaction details in the CAMT.053 XML
    @doc.xpath('//Ntry').each do |entry|
      # Skip entries without amount
      next unless entry.xpath('.//Amt').first
      
      # Extract transaction details
      amount = entry.xpath('.//Amt').first.text.to_f
      date = entry.xpath('.//Dt').first&.text
      
      # Find transaction reference (can be in different locations)
      reference = extract_reference(entry)
      
      next if reference.nil? || reference.empty?
      
      transactions << {
        reference: reference,
        amount: amount,
        date: Date.parse(date) if date
      }
    end
    
    transactions
  end

  private

  def extract_reference(entry)
    # Try different possible reference locations in CAMT.053
    # This depends on the specific structure of your CAMT.053 file
    
    # Try to find reference in the transaction details
    entry.xpath('.//Refs/MsgId').first&.text ||
    entry.xpath('.//Refs/Prtry/Ref').first&.text ||
    entry.xpath('.//Refs/EndToEndId').first&.text ||
    entry.xpath('.//Refs/InstrId').first&.text ||
    entry.xpath('.//Refs/UETR').first&.text ||
    extract_reference_from_details(entry)
  end

  def extract_reference_from_details(entry)
    # If direct reference not found, try to extract from transaction details
    entry.xpath('.//NtryDtls/TFI').first&.text ||
    entry.xpath('.//NtryDtls/CDI').first&.text ||
    entry.xpath('.//NtryDtls/Refs/EndToEndId').first&.text
  end
end

# Transaction Matcher
class TransactionMatcher
  def initialize(invoices_scope = Invoice.unpaid)
    @invoices_scope = invoices_scope
  end

  def match_transactions(transactions)
    matched_count = 0
    unmatched_count = 0
    
    transactions.each do |transaction_data|
      transaction = Transaction.find_or_create_by(reference: transaction_data[:reference]) do |t|
        t.amount = transaction_data[:amount]
        t.date = transaction_data[:date]
      end
      
      # Try to find a matching unpaid invoice
      invoice = find_matching_invoice(transaction_data[:reference], transaction_data[:amount])
      
      if invoice
        transaction.update(matched_invoice_id: invoice.id)
        invoice.update(status: 'paid')
        matched_count += 1
        puts "Matched transaction #{transaction.reference} to invoice #{invoice.reference}"
      else
        unmatched_count += 1
        puts "No matching invoice found for transaction #{transaction.reference}"
      end
    end
    
    puts "Matched #{matched_count} transactions"
    puts "Unmatched #{unmatched_count} transactions"
    
    [matched_count, unmatched_count]
  end

  private

  def find_matching_invoice(reference, amount)
    # Look for invoice with matching reference
    invoice = @invoices_scope.find_by(reference: reference)
    
    # Fallback: try to find invoice with similar reference
    if invoice.nil?
      invoice = @invoices_scope.find_by("reference LIKE ?", "%#{reference}%")
    end
    
    # Additional check: if no direct match, try with amount tolerance
    if invoice.nil?
      invoice = @invoices_scope.find_by("reference LIKE ? AND amount = ?", "%#{reference}%", amount)
    end
    
    invoice
  end
end

# Main import and matching process
class BankTransactionImporter
  def initialize(xml_file_path)
    @xml_file_path = xml_file_path
  end

  def import_and_match
    # Read the XML file
    xml_content = File.read(@xml_file_path)
    
    # Parse CAMT.053 XML
    parser = Camt053Parser.new(xml_content)
    transactions = parser.parse
    
    puts "Found #{transactions.length} transactions in XML"
    
    # Match transactions to unpaid invoices
    matcher = TransactionMatcher.new
    matched_count, unmatched_count = matcher.match_transactions(transactions)
    
    # Generate report
    generate_report(matched_count, unmatched_count, transactions)
  end

  def generate_report(matched_count, unmatched_count, transactions)
    puts "\n=== IMPORT REPORT ==="
    puts "Total transactions: #{transactions.length}"
    puts "Matched to invoices: #{matched_count}"
    puts "Unmatched transactions: #{unmatched_count}"
    
    # List unmatched transactions
    if unmatched_count > 0
      puts "\n=== UNMATCHED TRANSACTIONS ==="
      Transaction.unmatched.each do |transaction|
        puts "Reference: #{transaction.reference}, Amount: #{transaction.amount}, Date: #{transaction.date}"
      end
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0

  Invoice.create!(reference: 'INV-2023-001', amount: 1500.00, due_date: Date.today - 10)
  Invoice.create!(reference: 'INV-2023-002', amount: 2300.00, due_date: Date.today - 5)
  Invoice.create!(reference: 'INV-2023-003', amount: 850.00, due_date: Date.today - 15)
  
  # Run import
  importer = BankTransactionImporter.new('sample_camt.xml')
  importer.import_and_match
end
```

2. **Core Components**:

## Plaid Integration Service

```ruby
# app/services/plaid_service.rb
require 'plaid'
require 'logger'

class PlaidService
  attr_reader :client
  
  def initialize
    @client = Plaid::Client.new(
      client_id: ENV['PLAID_CLIENT_ID'],
      secret: ENV['PLAID_SECRET'],
      public_key: ENV['PLAID_PUBLIC_KEY'],
      environment: ENV['PLAID_ENV'] || 'sandbox'
    )
    
    @logger = Logger.new('log/plaid_service.log')
  end
  
  def get_access_token(public_token)
    response = client.exchange_public_token(public_token)
    response['access_token']
  rescue Plaid::Error => e
    @logger.error("Error exchanging public token: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def get_accounts(access_token)
    response = client.accounts_get(access_token)
    response['accounts']
  rescue Plaid::Error => e
    @logger.error("Error getting accounts: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def get_transactions(access_token, start_date, end_date)
    response = client.transactions_get(access_token, start_date, end_date)
    response['transactions']
  rescue Plaid::Error => e
    @logger.error("Error getting transactions: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def get_item(access_token)
    response = client.item_get(access_token)
    response['item']
  rescue Plaid::Error => e
    @logger.error("Error getting item: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
end
```

## Database Operations Service

```ruby
# app/services/database_service.rb
require 'logger'

class DatabaseService
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new('log/database_service.log')
  end
  
  def store_accounts(accounts_data)
    accounts_data.map do |account_data|
      account = Account.find_or_initialize_by(plaid_account_id: account_data['account_id'])
      account.update!(
        name: account_data['name'],
        mask: account_data['mask'],
        type: account_data['type'],
        subtype: account_data['subtype'],
        balance: account_data['balances']['current'],
        available_balance: account_data['balances']['available'],
        currency: account_data['balances']['iso_currency_code'],
        updated_at: Time.current
      )
      account
    end
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error storing accounts: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def store_transactions(transactions_data, account_id)
    transactions_data.map do |transaction_data|
      # Skip transactions without required fields
      next if transaction_data['transaction_id'].nil? || transaction_data['name'].nil?
      
      transaction = Transaction.find_or_initialize_by(plaid_transaction_id: transaction_data['transaction_id'])
      transaction.update!(
        account_id: account_id,
        name: transaction_data['name'],
        category: transaction_data['category']&.join(', '),
        category_id: transaction_data['category_id'],
        amount: transaction_data['amount'],
        currency: transaction_data['iso_currency_code'],
        date: transaction_data['date'],
        pending: transaction_data['pending'],
        updated_at: Time.current
      )
      transaction
    end.compact
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error storing transactions: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
end
```

## Main Application Class

```ruby
# app/services/bank_sync_service.rb
require 'date'

class BankSyncService
  def initialize(plaid_service = nil, database_service = nil)
    @plaid_service = plaid_service || PlaidService.new
    @database_service = database_service || DatabaseService.new
    @logger = Logger.new('log/bank_sync_service.log')
  end
  
  def sync_from_access_token(access_token, start_date = nil, end_date = nil)
    start_date ||= 30.days.ago.to_date
    end_date ||= Date.today
    
    @logger.info("Starting sync for access token: #{access_token}")
    
    # Get account information
    accounts_data = @plaid_service.get_accounts(access_token)
    @logger.info("Retrieved #{accounts_data.length} accounts")
    
    # Store accounts in database
    accounts = @database_service.store_accounts(accounts_data)
    @logger.info("Stored #{accounts.length} accounts")
    
    # Process transactions for each account
    accounts.each do |account|
      @logger.info("Processing transactions for account: #{account.name}")
      
      transactions_data = @plaid_service.get_transactions(access_token, start_date, end_date)
      transactions = @database_service.store_transactions(transactions_data, account.plaid_account_id)
      
      @logger.info("Stored #{transactions.length} transactions for account: #{account.name}")
    end
    
    @logger.info("Sync completed successfully")
    true
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Sync failed: #{e.message}")
    @logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
    raise
  end
  
  def sync_with_public_token(public_token, start_date = nil, end_date = nil)
    @logger.info("Syncing with public token")
    
    # Exchange public token for access token
    access_token = @plaid_service.get_access_token(public_token)
    @logger.info("Exchanged public token for access token")
    
    # Perform sync
    sync_from_access_token(access_token, start_date, end_date)
  end
end

require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'

# Представляє транзакцію з CAMT.053
class Transaction
  attr_reader :amount, :currency, :description, :date, :account_number

  def initialize(amount:, currency:, description:, date:, account_number:)
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency
    @description = description
    @date = date
    @account_number = account_number
  end

  def ==(other)
    return false unless other.is_a?(Transaction)
    @amount == other.amount &&
      @currency == other.currency &&
      @description == other.description &&
      @date == other.date &&
      @account_number == other.account_number
  end

  def to_s
    "Transaction(amount: #{@amount}, currency: #{@currency}, description: #{@description}, date: #{@date}, account: #{@account_number})"
  end
end

# Представляє рахунок за призначенням платежу
class PaymentAccount
  attr_reader :description, :amount, :currency, :due_date, :account_number

  def initialize(description:, amount:, currency:, due_date:, account_number:)
    @description = description
    @amount = amount
    @currency = currency
    @due_date = due_date
    @account_number = account_number
  end

  def matches?(transaction)
    # Спробуємо знайти співпадіння за описом і сумою
    @description.casecmp(transaction.description) == 0 && @amount == transaction.amount
  end

  def to_s
    "PaymentAccount(description: #{@description}, amount: #{@amount}, currency: #{@currency}, due_date: #{@due_date}, account: #{@account_number})"
  end
end

# Основний клас для імпорту CAMT.053
class CamtImporter
  def initialize(xml_file_path)
    @xml_file_path = xml_file_path
    @doc = Nokogiri::XML(File.open(@xml_file_path))
  end

  def import_transactions
    transactions = []

    # Отримуємо всі транзакції
    @doc.xpath('//ns:entry', 'ns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02').each do |entry|
      amount = entry.xpath('.//ns:amt', 'ns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02').first&.text&.to_f
      currency = entry.xpath('.//ns:ccy', 'ns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02').first&.text
      description = entry.xpath('.//ns:rmk', 'ns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02').first&.text
      date = entry.xpath('.//ns:bookgDt/ns:dt', 'ns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02').first&.text
      account_number = entry.xpath('.//ns:acct/ns:iban', 'ns' => 'urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02').first&.text

      next unless amount && currency && description && date

      transactions << Transaction.new(
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        description: description,
        date: date,
        account_number: account_number
      )
    end

    transactions
  end

  def import_payment_accounts
    # Підставте ваші дані рахунків, що потребують оплати
    [
      PaymentAccount.new(
        description: 'Оплата за послуги',
        amount: 100.0,
        currency: 'USD',
        due_date: '2025-04-10',
        account_number: 'UA123456789012345678901234567'
      ),
      PaymentAccount.new(
        description: 'Оплата за послуги',
        amount: 200.0,
        currency: 'USD',
        due_date: '2025-04-15',
        account_number: 'UA123456789012345678901234567'
      )
    ]
  end

  def match_transactions_with_accounts(transactions, accounts)
    matched = []
    unmatched = []

    transactions.each do |transaction|
      matched_account = accounts.find { |account| account.matches?(transaction) }
      if matched_account
        matched << { transaction: transaction, account: matched_account }
      else
        unmatched << transaction
      end
    end

    { matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched }
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  importer = CamtImporter.new('camt053.xml')
  transactions = importer.import_transactions
  accounts = importer.import_payment_accounts

  puts "Знайдено транзакцій: #{transactions.size}"
  puts "Знайдено рахунків: #{accounts.size}"

  matched_results = importer.match_transactions_with_accounts(transactions, accounts)

  puts "\nЗіставлені транзакції:"
  matched_results[:matched].each do |match|
    puts "  #{match[:transaction]} -> #{match[:account]}"
  end

  puts "\nНезіставлені транзакції:"
  matched_results[:unmatched].each do |transaction|
    puts "  #{transaction}"
  end
end

require 'httparty'

class StockData
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'

      symbol: symbol,
      apikey: @api_key
    })

    if response.success?
      data = response.parsed_response
      time_series = data['Time Series (Daily)']

      return [] unless time_series

        {
          date: date,
          close: info['4. close'].to_f
        }
      end.sort_by { |entry| entry[:date] }.reverse

      prices
    else
      puts "Помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      []
    end
  end

  def calculate_sma(prices, period = 20)
    sma_values = []

    prices.each_with_index do |entry, index|
      if index >= period - 1
        window = prices[index - period + 1..index]
        sma = window.sum { |p| p[:close] } / period.to_f
        sma_values << { date: entry[:date], sma: sma.round(2) }
      end
    end

    sma_values
  end
end

# app/controllers/payments_controller.rb

class PaymentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_product, only: %i[create_checkout_session]

  def create_checkout_session
    session = Stripe::Checkout::Session.create({
      payment_method_types: ['card'],
      line_items: [{
        price_data: {
          currency: 'usd',
          product_data: {
            name: @product.name,
          },
          unit_amount: @product.price_cents, # в копійках
        },
        quantity: 1,
      }],
      mode: 'payment',
      success_url: root_url + '?success=true',
      cancel_url: root_url + '?canceled=true',
    })

    render json: { session_id: session.id }
  end

  def webhook
    payload = request.body.read
    sig_header = request.env['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE']
    event = nil

    begin
      event = Stripe::Webhook.construct_event(
        payload, sig_header, Rails.application.credentials.stripe[:webhook_secret]
      )
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      render json: { error: 'Invalid payload' }, status: 400 and return
    rescue Stripe::SignatureVerificationError => e
      render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: 400 and return
    end

    # Обробка події
    case event.type
    when 'checkout.session.completed'
      session = event.data.object
      # Логіка після успішного платежу
      puts "Payment completed for session: #{session.id}"
    when 'checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded'
      session = event.data.object
      puts "Async payment succeeded for session: #{session.id}"
    when 'checkout.session.async_payment_failed'
      session = event.data.object
      puts "Async payment failed for session: #{session.id}"
    end

    render json: { status: 'success' }
  end

  private

  def set_product
    @product = Product.find(params[:product_id]) # Передбачаємо, що є модель Product
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class TaxCalculator
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure the base URI and default headers
  base_uri 'https://api.taxjar.com/v2'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['TAXJAR_API_KEY']}",
          'User-Agent' => 'TaxJar Ruby Client/1.0.0'
  
  # Initialize with API key (can also use environment variable)
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    if api_key
      self.class.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{api_key}"
    end
  end
  
  # Calculate sales tax for an order
  def calculate_tax(order_data)
    # Prepare the request payload
    payload = {
      from_country: order_data[:from_country] || 'US',
      from_zip: order_data[:from_zip],
      from_state: order_data[:from_state],
      from_city: order_data[:from_city],
      from_street: order_data[:from_street],
      to_country: order_data[:to_country] || 'US',
      to_zip: order_data[:to_zip],
      to_state: order_data[:to_state],
      to_city: order_data[:to_city],
      to_street: order_data[:to_street],
      amount: order_data[:amount],
      shipping: order_data[:shipping],
      line_items: order_data[:line_items]
    }.compact
    
    # Remove nil values
    payload.delete_if { |_, value| value.nil? }
    
    # Make the API call
    response = self.class.post('/taxes', body: payload.to_json)
    
    # Handle API errors
    if response.code >= 400
      raise TaxJarError, "TaxJar API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
    
    # Parse and return the response
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
  
  # Get tax rates for a specific location (optional helper method)
  def get_rates(zip_code, state = nil, city = nil, street = nil)
    params = { zip: zip_code }
    params[:state] = state if state
    params[:city] = city if city
    params[:street] = street if street
    
    response = self.class.get('/rates/' + zip_code, query: params)
    
    if response.code >= 400
      raise TaxJarError, "TaxJar API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end

# Custom exception class
class TaxJarError < StandardError; end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class StockAnalyzer
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end
  
  def get_historical_prices(symbol, output_size: 'compact')
    # Alpha Vantage API endpoint for daily prices
    params = {
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      symbol: symbol,
      outputsize: output_size,
      apikey: @api_key
    }
    
    response = self.class.get(BASE_URL, query: params)
    
    if response['Error Message']
      raise "API Error: #{response['Error Message']}"
    end
    
    if response['Note']
      puts "Warning: #{response['Note']}"
    end
    
    time_series = response['Time Series (Daily)']
    
    if time_series.nil?
      raise "No data found for symbol: #{symbol}"
    end
    
    # Convert to array of [date, price] pairs, sorted by date (newest first)
    data = time_series.map do |date, values|
      {
        date: Date.parse(date),
        close: values['4. close'].to_f
      }
    end
    
    # Sort by date ascending (oldest first)
    data.sort_by { |entry| entry[:date] }
  end
  
  def calculate_moving_average(prices, window_size = 20)
    if prices.length < window_size
      puts "Warning: Not enough data points for #{window_size}-day moving average"
      return []
    end
    
    averages = []
    
    prices.each_with_index do |price_data, index|
      if index >= window_size - 1
        # Calculate moving average for current window
        window = prices[(index - window_size + 1)..index]
        average = window.map { |p| p[:close] }.sum / window_size.to_f
        averages << {
          date: price_data[:date],
          close: price_data[:close],
          moving_average: average.round(2)
        }
      else
        averages << {
          date: price_data[:date],
          close: price_data[:close],
          moving_average: nil
        }
      end
    end
    
    averages
  end
  
  def analyze_stock(symbol, window_size = 20)
    puts "Fetching historical prices for #{symbol}..."
    prices = get_historical_prices(symbol)
    
    puts "Calculating #{window_size}-day moving average..."
    moving_averages = calculate_moving_average(prices, window_size)
    
    # Display recent results
    puts "\nRecent data for #{symbol}:"
    puts "Date\t\tClose\t\tMA(#{window_size})"
    puts "-" * 40
    
    recent_data = moving_averages.last(10)
    
    recent_data.each do |data|
      ma_display = data[:moving_average] ? data[:moving_average].to_s : "N/A"
      puts "#{data[:date]}\t#{data[:close].round(2)}\t\t#{ma_display}"
    end
    
    # Return full results for further processing
    {
      symbol: symbol,
      data: moving_averages,
      latest_price: prices.last[:close],
      latest_ma: moving_averages.last[:moving_average]
    }
  end
end

# currency_converter.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'active_support/core_ext/integer'
require 'logger'

class CurrencyConverter
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml'
  CACHE_DURATION = 1.day
  DEFAULT_BASE_CURRENCY = 'EUR'
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize(logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @logger = logger
    @cache = {}
    @cache_timestamps = {}
  end
  
  # Convert amount from one currency to another
  def convert(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
    from_currency = from_currency.upcase
    to_currency = to_currency.upcase
    
    # Handle same currency conversion
    return amount if from_currency == to_currency
    
    # Get exchange rates
    rates = get_exchange_rates
    raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates" unless rates
    
    # Get conversion rates
    from_rate = rates[from_currency]
    to_rate = rates[to_currency]
    
    raise "Unsupported currency: #{from_currency}" unless from_rate
    raise "Unsupported currency: #{to_currency}" unless to_rate
    
    # Convert to base currency (EUR) first, then to target currency
    amount_in_eur = amount / from_rate
    converted_amount = amount_in_eur * to_rate
    
    @logger.info("Converted #{amount} #{from_currency} to #{converted_amount.round(2)} #{to_currency}")
    converted_amount
  end
  
  # Get current exchange rates with caching
  def get_exchange_rates
    cache_key = 'exchange_rates'
    
    # Check if cache is valid
    if cached?(cache_key) && !cache_expired?(cache_key)
      @logger.debug("Using cached exchange rates")
      return @cache[cache_key]
    end
    
    # Fetch fresh rates
    @logger.info("Fetching fresh exchange rates from ECB")
    rates = fetch_exchange_rates
    
    if rates
      # Cache the rates
      @cache[cache_key] = rates
      @cache_timestamps[cache_key] = Time.now
      @logger.info("Cached exchange rates for #{CACHE_DURATION} seconds")
      rates
    else
      # Return cached rates if available, even if fetching failed
      @cache[cache_key]
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Check if cache entry exists
  def cached?(key)
    @cache.key?(key) && @cache_timestamps.key?(key)
  end
  
  # Check if cache has expired
  def cache_expired?(key)
    return true unless cached?(key)
    Time.now - @cache_timestamps[key] > CACHE_DURATION
  end
  
  # Fetch exchange rates from ECB
  def fetch_exchange_rates
    begin
      response = self.class.get(BASE_URL, headers: { 'Accept' => 'application/xml' })
      
      if response.success?
        parse_xml_rates(response.body)
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to fetch exchange rates: HTTP #{response.code}")
        nil
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching exchange rates: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Parse XML response from ECB
  def parse_xml_rates(xml_content)
    # Simple XML parsing using Nokogiri or manual parsing
    # For this implementation, we'll use a more robust approach with proper XML parsing

# Alternative implementation with better XML parsing using a more robust approach
class CurrencyConverter
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml'
  CACHE_DURATION = 1.day
  DEFAULT_BASE_CURRENCY = 'EUR'
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize(logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @logger = logger
    @cache = {}
    @cache_timestamps = {}
  end
  
  def convert(amount, from_currency, to_currency)
    from_currency = from_currency.upcase
    to_currency = to_currency.upcase
    
    return amount if from_currency == to_currency
    
    rates = get_exchange_rates
    raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates" unless rates
    
    from_rate = rates[from_currency]
    to_rate = rates[to_currency]
    
    raise "Unsupported currency: #{from_currency}" unless from_rate
    raise "Unsupported currency: #{to_currency}" unless to_rate
    
    amount_in_eur = amount / from_rate
    converted_amount = amount_in_eur * to_rate
    
    @logger.info("Converted #{amount} #{from_currency} to #{converted_amount.round(2)} #{to_currency}")
    converted_amount
  end
  
  def get_exchange_rates
    cache_key = 'exchange_rates'
    
    if cached?(cache_key) && !cache_expired?(cache_key)
      @logger.debug("Using cached exchange rates")
      return @cache[cache_key]
    end
    
    @logger.info("Fetching fresh exchange rates from ECB")
    rates = fetch_exchange_rates
    
    if rates
      @cache[cache_key] = rates
      @cache_timestamps[cache_key] = Time.now
      @logger.info("Cached exchange rates for #{CACHE_DURATION} seconds")
      rates
    else
      @cache[cache_key]
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def cached?(key)
    @cache.key?(key) && @cache_timestamps.key?(key)
  end
  
  def cache_expired?(key)
    return true unless cached?(key)
    Time.now - @cache_timestamps[key] > CACHE_DURATION
  end
  
  def fetch_exchange_rates
    begin
      response = self.class.get(BASE_URL, headers: { 'Accept' => 'application/xml' })
      
      if response.success?
        parse_xml_rates(response.body)
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to fetch exchange rates: HTTP #{response.code}")
        nil
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching exchange rates: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def parse_xml_rates(xml_content)
    require 'nokogiri'
    
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    
    rates = { DEFAULT_BASE_CURRENCY => 1.0 }
    
    # Find all currency entries
    doc.xpath('//Cube[@currency]').each do |cube|
      currency = cube['currency']
      rate = cube['rate'].to_f
      rates[currency] = rate if rate > 0
    end
    
    rates
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error parsing XML rates: #{e.message}")
    nil
  end
end

Ось приклад реалізації для надсилання рахунків до Xero та синхронізації статусу їх оплати з додатком Rails. Програма використовує гем `xero-ruby`, щоб взаємодіяти з Xero API, і підходить для використання в Rails-додатку.

---

### 1. **Gemfile**

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rails', '~> 7.0'
gem 'xero-ruby', '~> 2.0'
gem 'dotenv-rails', '~> 2.7' # Для зберігання ключів в .env
gem 'httparty' # Якщо потрібно працювати з HTTP запитами
```

---

### 2. **Конфігурація Xero**

Створіть в `config/initializers/xero.rb`:

```ruby
# config/initializers/xero.rb

XeroRuby.configure do |config|
  config.client_id = ENV['XERO_CLIENT_ID']
  config.client_secret = ENV['XERO_CLIENT_SECRET']
  config.redirect_uri = ENV['XERO_REDIRECT_URI']
  config.scopes = ['accounting.invoices', 'accounting.contacts']
end
```

---

### 3. **Контролер, який надсилає рахунок до Xero**

Наприклад, `app/controllers/invoices_controller.rb`:

```ruby
# app/controllers/invoices_controller.rb

class InvoicesController < ApplicationController
  def create
    invoice_data = {
      type: 'ACCREC',
      contact: {
        contact_id: params[:contact_id]
      },
      line_items: [
        {
          description: params[:description],
          quantity: params[:quantity].to_f,
          unit_amount: params[:unit_amount].to_f
        }
      ],
      status: 'AUTHORISED'
    }

    begin
      response = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new.create_invoice(
        access_token: get_xero_token,
        invoice: invoice_data
      )

      invoice = response.invoice
      render json: { status: 'success', invoice_id: invoice.invoice_id }, status: :created
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      render json: { status: 'error', message: e.message }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def get_xero_token
    # Імітуємо отримання токена (в реальних умовах це може бути з бази або з сесії)
    ENV['XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN']
  end
end
```

---

### 4. **Синхронізація статусу оплати**

Додайте метод в модель `Invoice` або в `ApplicationJob` для синхронізації:

```ruby
# app/models/invoice.rb

class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  def sync_with_xero!
    api = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new

    response = api.get_invoice(
      access_token: get_xero_token,
      invoice_id: self.xero_invoice_id
    )

    xero_invoice = response.invoice

    update!(
      paid: xero_invoice.status == 'PAID',
      payment_date: xero_invoice.payment_date
    )
  end

  private

  def get_xero_token
    ENV['XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN']
  end
end
```

### 5. **Запуск синхронізації через cron або job**

Ви можете створити `InvoiceSyncJob`:

class InvoiceSyncJob < ApplicationJob

      invoice.sync_with_xero!
    end
  end
end

### ✅ 4. **Експорт рахунків до QuickBooks Online**

```ruby
# services/quickbooks_exporter.rb

require 'quickbooks-ruby'

class QuickbooksExporter
  def initialize(service)
    @service = service
  end

  def export_paid_invoices(invoices)
    invoices.each do |invoice|
      if invoice.paid?
        puts "Експортую рахунок #{invoice.id}"
        create_invoice_in_quickbooks(invoice)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def create_invoice_in_quickbooks(invoice)
    qb_invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
    qb_invoice.customer_id = invoice.customer_id
    qb_invoice.txn_date = invoice.date
    qb_invoice.due_date = invoice.date + 30 # 30 днів до сплати

    line_item = Quickbooks::Model::InvoiceLineItem.new
    line_item.description = "Платіж за рахунок #{invoice.id}"
    line_item.amount = invoice.amount
    line_item.unit_price = invoice.amount
    line_item.quantity = 1

    qb_invoice.line_items = [line_item]

    begin
      result = @service.create(qb_invoice)
      puts "Рахунок #{invoice.id} успішно експортовано: #{result.id}"
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при експортуванні рахунку #{invoice.id}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'axlsx'
require 'bigdecimal'

# Клас для розрахунку графіка погашення кредиту
class LoanAmortization
  def initialize(principal, annual_rate, months)
    @principal = BigDecimal(principal.to_s)
    @annual_rate = BigDecimal(annual_rate.to_s)
    @months = months
    @monthly_rate = @annual_rate / 12 / 100
  end

  def schedule
    schedule = []
    balance = @principal

    (1..@months).each do |month|
      interest_payment = balance * @monthly_rate
      principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest_payment
      balance -= principal_payment

      balance = [balance, 0].max # не дозволяє балансу бути від’ємним

      schedule << {
        month: month,
        payment: monthly_payment,
        principal: principal_payment,
        interest: interest_payment,
        balance: balance
      }
    end

    schedule
  end

  private

  def monthly_payment
    return @principal / @months if @monthly_rate.zero?

    @monthly_rate * @principal / (1 - (1 + @monthly_rate) ** -@months)
  end
end

# Експорт у Excel
def export_to_excel(schedule, filename)
  package = Axlsx::Package.new
  workbook = package.workbook

  workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Loan Schedule") do |sheet|
    sheet.add_row ["Month", "Payment", "Principal", "Interest", "Balance"]

    schedule.each do |row|

        format_currency(row[:payment]),
        format_currency(row[:principal]),
        format_currency(row[:interest]),
        format_currency(row[:balance])
      ]
    end
  end

  package.serialize(filename)
end

def format_currency(amount)

end

```ruby
# lib/credit_card_validator.rb
require 'active_model'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class CreditCardValidator
  include ActiveModel::Validations
  include ActiveModel::Validations::ClassMethods

  attr_accessor :number, :brand

  validates :number, presence: true
  validates :number, format: { with: /\A\d+\z/, message: "must contain only digits" }
  validates :number, length: { minimum: 13, maximum: 19, message: "must be between 13 and 19 digits" }

  def initialize(number)
    @number = number.to_s.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    @brand = detect_brand
  end

  def valid?
    super && luhn_valid?
  end

  def luhn_valid?
    return false if @number.nil? || @number.empty?
    
    # Remove any non-digit characters
    digits = @number.gsub(/\D/, '').chars.map(&:to_i)
    
    # Check if we have valid number of digits
    return false if digits.length < 13 || digits.length > 19
    
    # Apply Luhn algorithm
    sum = 0
    digits.length.times do |i|
      digit = digits[digits.length - 1 - i]
      if i.odd?
        digit *= 2
        digit -= 9 if digit > 9
      end
      sum += digit
    end
    
    sum % 10 == 0
  end

  def detect_brand
    return nil if @number.nil? || @number.empty?
    
    cleaned_number = @number.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    case cleaned_number
    when /^4/
      'visa'
    when /^5[1-5]/, /^2[2-7]/
      'mastercard'
    when /^3[47]/
      'amex'
    when /^6(?:011|5)/
      'discover'
    when /^35/
      'jcb'
    else
      'unknown'
    end
  end

  def brand_name
    case brand
    when 'visa'
      'Visa'
    when 'mastercard'
      'Mastercard'
    when 'amex'
      'American Express'
    when 'discover'
      'Discover'
    when 'jcb'
      'JCB'
    else
      'Unknown'
    end
  end

  def formatted_number
    return nil if @number.nil? || @number.empty?
    
    # Format with spaces every 4 digits for readability
    @number.gsub(/(\d{4})(?=\d)/, '\\1 ')
  end

  def valid?
    super && luhn_valid?
  end
end

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'mollie/api'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load' if File.exist?('.env')

# Ініціалізація Mollie API
Mollie::API::Client.set_api_key(ENV['MOLLIE_API_KEY'])

# Приклад замовлення
ORDER_ID = "ORDER-12345"
ORDER_AMOUNT = "100.00"
ORDER_DESCRIPTION = "Оплата замовлення"

# Створити платіж Mollie
post '/create-payment' do
  begin
    payment = Mollie::API::Client.create_payment(
      amount: ORDER_AMOUNT,
      description: ORDER_DESCRIPTION,
      redirect_url: "#{request.base_url}/payment-success",
      webhook_url: "#{request.base_url}/webhook",
      metadata: { order_id: ORDER_ID }
    )

    # Зберігаємо payment_id в сесії або БД (в реальному коді)
    session[:payment_id] = payment.id

    # Перенаправлення на сторінку оплати
    redirect payment.payment_url
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка створення платежу: #{e.message}"
    status 500
    body "Помилка створення платежу"
  end
end

# Сторінка успішної оплати (необов’язково)
get '/payment-success' do
  "Оплата успішна!"
end

# Вебхук від Mollie
post '/webhook' do
  begin
    # Отримуємо JSON з тіла запиту
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

    # Отримуємо payment_id
    payment_id = payload['id']

    # Оновлюємо замовлення (наприклад, змінюємо статус)
    payment = Mollie::API::Client.get_payment(payment_id)

    puts "Статус платежу: #{payment.status}"
    puts "ID замовлення: #{payment.metadata['order_id']}"

    # Тут можна оновити статус замовлення в БД
    # update_order_status(payment.metadata['order_id'], payment.status)

    status 200
    body "OK"
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка обробки вебхука: #{e.message}"
    status 500
    body "Помилка обробки вебхука"
  end
end

Основна реалізація (наприклад, `app.rb`) ```ruby require 'sinatra' require 'adyen' require 'json' require 'openssl' require 'dotenv/load' # Завантаження змінних з .env ADYEN_USERNAME = ENV['ADYEN_USERNAME'] ADYEN_PASSWORD = ENV['ADYEN_PASSWORD'] ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT = ENV['ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT'] ADYEN_HMAC_KEY = ENV['ADYEN_HMAC_KEY'] ADYEN_ORIGIN_URL = ENV['ADYEN_ORIGIN_URL'] # Ініціалізація клієнта Adyen adyen = Adyen::Client.new( username: ADYEN_USERNAME, password: ADYEN_PASSWORD, merchant_account: ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT, environment: :test # або :live ) # Сторінка для ініціалізації платежу get '/' do # Генеруємо payment session для Drop-in payment_response = adyen.checkout.payments({ amount: { currency: 'EUR', value: 1000 # 10 EUR }, reference: 'order-12345', returnUrl: 'http://localhost:4567/return', merchantAccount: ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT, channel: 'Web', origin: ADYEN_ORIGIN_URL }) erb :index, locals: { client_key: 'your-client-key', payment_session: payment_response['paymentSession'] } end # Сторінка повернення після оплати get '/return' do # Додатково можна обробити результат 'Payment completed successfully!' end # Сторінка для отримання сповіщень (notifications) post '/notification' do payload = request.body.read signature = request.env['HTTP_X_SHA256_SIGNATURE'] # Перевірка HMAC unless verify_hmac(payload, signature) status 401 return 'Unauthorized' end # Обробка сповіщення notification = JSON.parse(payload) puts "Received notification: #{notification}" # Відповідь на сповіщення status 200 'OK' end # Функція перевірки HMAC-підпису def verify_hmac(payload, signature) expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', ADYEN_HMAC_KEY, payload) OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', ADYEN_HMAC_KEY, payload) == signature end ``` --- ### 3. Шаблон `views/index.erb` (для інтеграції Drop-in) ```erb Adyen Payment
``` --- ### 4. Файл `.env` (для змінних оточення) ```env ADYEN_USERNAME=your_username ADYEN_PASSWORD=your_password ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT=your_merchant_account ADYEN_HMAC_KEY=your_hmac_key ADYEN_ORIGIN_URL=http://localhost:4567 ``` --- ### 5. Запуск 1. Запустіть за допомогою: ```bash bundle install ruby app.rb ``` 2. Відкрийте у браузері `http://localhost:4567` --- ### Пояснення - `Adyen::Client` — інтеграція з API Adyen. - `Drop-in` — інтерфейс для оплати, який використовується на клієнтській стороні. - `verify_hmac` — функція для перевірки підпису сповіщень, які надсилаються Adyen. - Сповіщення надсилаються на `/notification`, де відбувається перевірка HMAC. --- Якщо потрібно, можу допомогти із налаштуванням локального сервера для тестування, або інтеграцією з базою даних.

# app/models/money.rb
class Money < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :currency

  validates :amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :currency, presence: true

  # Store money using BigDecimal for precision
  def amount=(value)
    super(value.is_a?(BigDecimal) ? value : BigDecimal(value.to_s))
  end

  # Get amount as BigDecimal for calculations
  def amount
    super || BigDecimal('0')
  end

  # Format for display with currency symbol
  def formatted_amount
    "#{currency.symbol} #{amount.round(2).to_f}"
  end

  # Format for display with currency code
  def formatted_amount_with_code
    "#{amount.round(2).to_f} #{currency.code}"
  end

  # Format for display with proper decimal places
  def formatted_amount_precise
    decimal_places = currency.decimal_places || 2
    format_string = "%0.#{decimal_places}f"
    "#{currency.symbol} #{format_string % amount}"
  end

  # Perform arithmetic operations safely
  def +(other)
    if other.is_a?(Money) && other.currency == currency
      Money.new(amount: amount + other.amount, currency: currency)
    elsif other.is_a?(BigDecimal)
      Money.new(amount: amount + other, currency: currency)
    else
      super
    end
  end

  def -(other)
    if other.is_a?(Money) && other.currency == currency
      Money.new(amount: amount - other.amount, currency: currency)
    elsif other.is_a?(BigDecimal)
      Money.new(amount: amount - other, currency: currency)
    else
      super
    end
  end

  # Convert to different currency (placeholder for exchange rate logic)
  def convert_to(target_currency)
    # In a real application, you would implement exchange rate logic here
    # For now, we'll just return a new Money object with the same amount
    Money.new(amount: amount, currency: target_currency)
  end

  private

  # Ensure amount is always stored as BigDecimal
  def ensure_bigdecimal
    self.amount = BigDecimal(amount.to_s) if amount.is_a?(String) || amount.is_a?(Float)
  end
end

Ось приклад реалізації для обробки платежів через **WayForPay** з використанням Ruby, включаючи `Gemfile` та основну реалізацію.

### 1. `Gemfile`

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'sinatra'           # Для створення веб-сервера
gem 'wayforpay'         # Гем для взаємодії з WayForPay API
gem 'json'              # Для роботи з JSON
gem 'openssl'           # Для роботи з SSL/HTTPS
```

---

### 2. Основна реалізація (`app.rb`):

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'wayforpay'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

# Налаштування WayForPay (повинні бути збережені в environment variables)
WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT']
WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_SECRET = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_SECRET']

# Ініціалізація WayForPay
WayForPay.configure do |config|
  config.merchant_account = WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT
  config.merchant_secret = WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_SECRET
end

# Сторінка для ініціалізації платежу (наприклад, з форми замовлення)
post '/pay' do
  # Приклад даних замовлення
  order_data = {
    orderReference: "ORDER-#{Time.now.to_i}",
    amount: params[:amount],
    currency: 'UAH',
    orderDate: Time.now.to_i,
    productName: ['Product 1'],
    productPrice: [params[:amount]],
    productCount: [1],
    clientFirstName: params[:first_name],
    clientLastName: params[:last_name],
    clientEmail: params[:email],
    clientPhone: params[:phone]
  }

  # Створення платежу через WayForPay
  response = WayForPay::Api.new.pay(order_data)

  if response.success?
    redirect response.data['serviceUrl']
  else
    status 400
    body "Помилка створення платежу: #{response.message}"
  end
end

# Webhook для отримання статусу платежу від WayForPay
post '/wayforpay/webhook' do
  # Отримання JSON з WayForPay
  payload = request.body.read
  data = JSON.parse(payload)

  # Перевірка підпису (optional, але рекомендовано)
  signature = data['signature']
  expected_signature = WayForPay::Utils.generate_signature(data, WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_SECRET)

  if signature != expected_signature
    status 400
    return "Invalid signature"
  end

  # Перевірка статусу платежу
  if data['status'] == 'Approved'
    order_ref = data['orderReference']
    # Тут можна оновити стан замовлення в базі даних
    puts "Замовлення #{order_ref} успішно оплачено."
    # Наприклад: Order.where(reference: order_ref).update(status: 'paid')
    status 200
    body 'OK'
  else
    status 200
    body 'Payment not approved'
  end
end
```

---

### 3. Запуск

1. Встановіть залежності:

```bash
bundle install
```

2. Запустіть сервер:

```bash
ruby app.rb
```

3. Переконайтеся, що ви встановили наступні змінні середовища:

```bash
export WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT=your_merchant_account
export WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_SECRET=your_merchant_secret
```

---

### 4. Як це працює

- Клієнт переходить на `/pay` і заповнює форму.
- Створюється платіж у WayForPay.
- Користувач перенаправляється на сторінку WayForPay.
- Коли платіж успішний, WayForPay надсилає `POST` на `/wayforpay/webhook`.
- Якщо статус `Approved`, ваша система підтверджує замовлення.

---

Ось як можна реалізувати оплату карткою через LiqPay у Rails-застосунку з перевіркою підпису серверного зворотного виклику.

### 1. Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rails', '~> 7.0'
gem 'liqpay' # Гем для роботи з LiqPay
gem 'openssl' # Вбудований у Ruby, але може знадобитись для підписів
```

---

### 2. Конфігурація LiqPay

Додайте налаштування LiqPay у `config/application.rb` або `config/environments/production.rb`:

```ruby
# config/application.rb або config/environments/production.rb
config.liqpay_public_key = 'YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY'
config.liqpay_private_key = 'YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY'
```

Або в `config/initializers/liqpay.rb`:

```ruby
# config/initializers/liqpay.rb
LiqPay.public_key = Rails.application.config.liqpay_public_key
LiqPay.private_key = Rails.application.config.liqpay_private_key
```

---

### 3. Контроллер для оплати

```ruby
# app/controllers/payments_controller.rb
class PaymentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_liqpay, only: [:create, :callback]

  def create
    amount = params[:amount].to_f
    order_id = SecureRandom.uuid

    # Створюємо платіжний запит
    liqpay_params = {
      action: 'pay',
      amount: amount,
      currency: 'UAH',
      description: 'Оплата замовлення',
      order_id: order_id,
      result_url: payment_callback_url,
      server_url: payment_callback_url
    }

    @liqpay_form = @liqpay.form(liqpay_params)
  end

  def callback
    # Отримуємо параметри з LiqPay
    data = params[:data]
    signature = params[:signature]

    # Перевіряємо підпис
    if @liqpay.validate_signature(data, signature)
      # Розпаковуємо дані
      decoded_data = Base64.decode64(data)
      payment_data = JSON.parse(decoded_data)

      # Обробка платіжних даних
      order_id = payment_data['order_id']
      status = payment_data['status']
      amount = payment_data['amount']

      # Отримуємо статус та зберігаємо в БД або виконуємо інші дії
      if status == 'success'
        # Операція успішна
        Rails.logger.info "Успішна оплата за замовленням #{order_id}"
      else
        Rails.logger.warn "Помилка оплати за замовленням #{order_id}"
      end

      render json: { status: 'ok' }
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Невірний підпис від LiqPay"
      render json: { status: 'error' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  private

  def set_liqpay
    @liqpay = LiqPay.new(Rails.application.config.liqpay_public_key, Rails.application.config.liqpay_private_key)
  end
end
```

---

### 4. Маршрути

```ruby
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  post '/payment/callback', to: 'payments#callback'
  post '/payment', to: 'payments#create'
end
```

---

### 5. Вьюха для відображення форми

```erb
<!-- app/views/payments/create.html.erb -->
<%= raw @liqpay_form %>
```

---

### 6. Налаштування зворотного виклику

- У панелі LiqPay встановіть URL зворотного виклику на `https://yourdomain.com/payment/callback`

---

### 7. Пояснення

- `LiqPay` — гем для інтеграції з LiqPay API.
- `form` — створює форму для відправки на LiqPay.
- `validate_signature` — перевіряє, чи підпис відповідає даним, щоб переконатися, що запит дійсно надійшов із LiqPay.
- `data` та `signature` — параметри, що надсилаються LiqPay у зворотному виклику.

---

### 8. Перевірка підпису

```ruby
# Якщо ви хочете перевірити вручну (не через liqpay gem)
def verify_signature(data, signature)
  decoded_data = Base64.decode64(data)
  OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA1', Rails.application.config.liqpay_private_key, decoded_data) == Base64.decode64(signature)
end
```

---

Цей код реалізує основну функціональність: ініціалізацію платежу, відправку на LiqPay і перевірку підпису серверного зворотного виклику.

Ось реалізація на Ruby для створення рахунку через API еквайрингу **Monobank (Plata by mono)**, а також обробки вебхука зі статусом рахунку.

---

## 📁 1. `Gemfile`

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'sinatra'         # Для створення веб-сервера
gem 'httparty'        # Для HTTP-запитів до API

## 📁 2. `.env` файл (для змінних оточення)

```env
MONOBANK_API_KEY=your_monobank_api_key
MONOBANK_CLIENT_ID=your_monobank_client_id
WEBHOOK_URL=http://localhost:4567/webhook
```

---

## 📁 3. `app.rb` – основний файл додатку

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Конфігурація Monobank API
MONOBANK_API_URL = 'https://api.monobank.ua/api'
API_KEY = ENV['MONOBANK_API_KEY']
CLIENT_ID = ENV['MONOBANK_CLIENT_ID']
WEBHOOK_URL = ENV['WEBHOOK_URL']

# Створення рахунку (еквайринг)
post '/create_invoice' do
  content_type :json

  # Приклад даних для створення рахунку
  amount = params[:amount] || 1000
  description = params[:description] || "Оплата послуги"

  payload = {
    amount: amount,
    description: description,
    clientId: CLIENT_ID,
    webhookUrl: WEBHOOK_URL
  }

  headers = {
    'X-Token' => API_KEY,
    'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  }

  response = HTTParty.post(
    "#{MONOBANK_API_URL}/invoice/create",
    body: payload.to_json,
    headers: headers
  )

  if response.success?
    invoice_data = response.parsed_response
    status 200
    { status: 'success', invoice: invoice_data }.to_json
  else
    status 500
    { status: 'error', message: response.body }.to_json
  end
end

# Обробка вебхука
post '/webhook' do
  content_type :json

  # Отримуємо JSON з вебхука
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

  # Приклад: обробка статусу рахунку
  invoice_id = data['invoiceId']
  status = data['status']

  puts "Оновлено статус рахунку #{invoice_id}: #{status}"

  # Тут можна зберігати статус у базу даних, надсилати сповіщення тощо

  status 200
  { status: 'received' }.to_json
end
```

---

## 🔧 4. Запуск додатку

```bash
ruby app.rb
```

---

## 🧪 5. Тестування

### Створення рахунку:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:4567/create_invoice \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"amount": 1000, "description": "Платіж за послуги"}'

  end

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      []
    end
  end

    end

    puts "Курси гривні на #{date}:"
    rates.each do |rate|
      puts "#{rate['cc']} - #{rate['rate'].round(4)}"
    end
  end

# lib/hryvnia_rate_fetcher.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class HryvniaRateFetcher
  BASE_URL = 'https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange'
  
  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'User-Agent' => 'HryvniaRateFetcher/1.0'
    }
  end

  # Fetch exchange rates for a specific date
  # @param date [Date, String] The date to fetch rates for (format: 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  # @return [Hash] Exchange rates data
  def fetch_rates_for_date(date)
    date_str = parse_date(date)
    
    response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL, {
      query: {
        valcode: 'USD,EUR,GBP,PLN,CZK',
        date: date_str,
        json: true
      },
      headers: @headers
    })

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end

  # Fetch exchange rates for today
  # @return [Hash] Exchange rates data
  def fetch_today_rates
    fetch_rates_for_date(Date.today)
  end

  # Fetch exchange rates for yesterday
  # @return [Hash] Exchange rates data
  def fetch_yesterday_rates
    fetch_rates_for_date(Date.today - 1)
  end

  private

  def parse_date(date)
    case date
    when Date
      date.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    when String
      # Try to parse the string as a date
      parsed_date = Date.parse(date)
      parsed_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid date format. Expected Date or String, got #{date.class}"
    end
  end

  def parse_response(response_body)
    data = JSON.parse(response_body)
    
    # Transform the response into a more usable format
    rates = {}
    data.each do |rate_data|
      rates[rate_data['cc']] = {
        code: rate_data['cc'],
        rate: rate_data['rate'],
        exchange_date: rate_data['exchangedate']
      }
    end
    
    rates
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  fetcher = HryvniaRateFetcher.new
  
  begin
    # Fetch today's rates
    puts "Today's exchange rates:"
    today_rates = fetcher.fetch_today_rates
    today_rates.each do |code, rate_info|
      puts "  #{code}: #{rate_info[:rate]} UAH"
    end
    
    puts "\nRates for a specific date:"
    # Fetch rates for a specific date
    specific_rates = fetcher.fetch_rates_for_date('2023-06-15')
    specific_rates.each do |code, rate_info|
      puts "  #{code}: #{rate_info[:rate]} UAH"
    end
    
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class MonobankClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.monobank.ua'

  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def get_statement(from, to)
    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @token
    }

    response = self.class.get('/personal/statement', headers: headers, query: { from: from, to: to })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch statement: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def get_client_info
    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @token
    }

    response = self.class.get('/personal/client-info', headers: headers)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch client info: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

require 'active_record'

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(

class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'transactions'

  validates :operation_id, presence: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
  validates :currency, presence: true
  validates :description, presence: true

class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'transactions'

  def self.create_from_api_data(data)
    data.map do |item|
      transaction = Transaction.find_or_initialize_by(operation_id: item['id'])
      transaction.assign_attributes(
        operation_id: item['id'],
        amount: item['amount'],
        currency: item['currencyCode'],
        description: item['description'],
        date: Time.at(item['time']),
        mcc: item['mcc'],
        hold: item['hold']
      )
      transaction.save!
      transaction
    end
  end
end

class TransactionStorage
  def self.save_transactions(transactions)
    transactions.each do |tx|
      existing = Transaction.find_by(operation_id: tx.operation_id)
      unless existing
        tx.save!
        puts "New transaction saved: #{tx.description} (#{tx.amount})"
      else
        puts "Transaction already exists: #{tx.description}"
      end
    end
  end

  def self.get_last_transaction_timestamp
    last = Transaction.order(:date).last
    last ? last.date.to_i : 0
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'bundler/setup'
require_relative '../lib/monobank_client'
require_relative '../lib/transaction'
require_relative '../lib/transaction_storage'

# Configuration
TOKEN = ENV['MONOBANK_TOKEN'] || raise('MONOBANK_TOKEN environment variable is required')
FROM_TIMESTAMP = TransactionStorage.get_last_transaction_timestamp
TO_TIMESTAMP = Time.now.to_i

# Initialize client
client = MonobankClient.new(TOKEN)

begin
  puts "Fetching transactions from #{Time.at(FROM_TIMESTAMP)} to #{Time.at(TO_TIMESTAMP)}"

  # Get statement
  statement = client.get_statement(FROM_TIMESTAMP, TO_TIMESTAMP)

  # Process and save transactions
  new_transactions = Transaction.create_from_api_data(statement)
  TransactionStorage.save_transactions(new_transactions)

rescue => e
  puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  exit 1
end

require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class PrivateBankClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'

  attr_reader :merchant_id, :merchant_password

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
  end

  # Отримання залишків на рахунках
  def get_accounts_balance
    response = self.class.get(
      '/balance',
      query: {
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        merchant_password: @merchant_password
      }
    )
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання виписки за період
  def get_statement(start_date, end_date, account = nil)
    query = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      merchant_password: @merchant_password,
      start_date: start_date,
      end_date: end_date
    }
    query[:account] = account if account

    response = self.class.get('/statement', query: query)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
