```ruby
require 'date'
require 'active_support/core_ext/numeric'

class LoanCalculator
  def initialize(principal, annual_interest_rate, loan_term_years)
    @principal = principal.to_f
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate.to_f
    @loan_term_years = loan_term_years.to_i
    @monthly_interest_rate = @annual_interest_rate / 12 / 100
    @total_payments = @loan_term_years * 12
  end

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    return @principal if @monthly_interest_rate.zero?
    
    @monthly_payment = @principal * 
      (@monthly_interest_rate * (1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**@total_payments) / 
      ((1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**@total_payments - 1)
  end

  def generate_schedule
    monthly_payment = calculate_monthly_payment
    balance = @principal
    schedule = []
    current_date = Date.today

    @total_payments.times do |month|
      interest_payment = balance * @monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest_payment
      balance -= principal_payment

      # Ensure balance doesn't go negative due to rounding
      balance = [balance, 0].max

      schedule << {
        month: month + 1,
        date: current_date + month.months,
        payment: monthly_payment,
        principal: principal_payment,
        interest: interest_payment,
        balance: balance
      }
    end

    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(filename, schedule = nil)
    schedule ||= generate_schedule
    
    require 'axlsx'
    
    package = Axlsx::Package.new
    workbook = package.workbook

    workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Loan Amortization Schedule") do |sheet|
      # Header row
      sheet.add_row ["Month", "Date", "Payment", "Principal", "Interest", "Balance"]
      
      # Data rows
      schedule.each do |payment|
        sheet.add_row [
          payment[:month],
          payment[:date].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
          format_currency(payment[:payment]),
          format_currency(payment[:principal]),
          format_currency(payment[:interest]),
          format_currency(payment[:balance])
        ]
      end
      
      # Format header row
      sheet.add_style(1, 1..6, style: Axlsx::STYLE_BOLD)
      
      # Format currency columns
      (2..schedule.length + 1).each do |row|
        sheet.add_style(row, 3..6, style: Axlsx::STYLE_CURRENCY)
      end
    end

    package.serialize(filename)
  end

  private

  def format_currency(amount)
    "$#{amount.round(2)}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
class LiqpayController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  def create
    @payment = LiqpayPayment.create_payment(
      params[:amount].to_f,
      params[:order_id],
      params[:description],
      params[:email]
    )

    # Generate LiqPay parameters
    liqpay_params = @payment.generate_liqpay_params
    liqpay = LiqPay.new(ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'], ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'])
    
    # Create payment form
    @payment_form = liqpay.form({
      action: 'pay',
      amount: liqpay_params[:amount],
      currency: liqpay_params[:currency],
      description: liqpay_params[:description],
      order_id: liqpay_params[:order_id],
      result_url: liqpay_params[:result_url],
      server_url: liqpay_params[:server_url],
      email: liqpay_params[:email]
    })

    render json: { form: @payment_form }
  end

  def result
    # This is where user is redirected after payment
    # You can handle success/failure here
    render json: { status: 'success', message: 'Payment completed' }
  end

  def server_callback
    # This endpoint receives POST from LiqPay server
    signature = params[:signature]
    data = params[:data]
    
    # Verify signature
    if verify_liqpay_signature(data, signature)
      # Parse the data
      decoded_data = Base64.decode64(data)
      payment_data = JSON.parse(decoded_data)
      
      # Process payment
      order_id = payment_data['order_id']
      status = payment_data['status']
      amount = payment_data['amount']
      currency = payment_data['currency']
      
      # Find or create payment record
      payment = LiqpayPayment.find_by(order_id: order_id)
      
      if payment
        case status
        when 'success'
          payment.update(status: :success, amount: amount, currency: currency)
          # Process successful payment (e.g., update order status)
        when 'failure'
          payment.update(status: :failed)
        when 'refunded'
          payment.update(status: :refunded)
        end
        
        # Respond with success to LiqPay
        head :ok
      else
        # Handle unknown order
        render json: { error: 'Order not found' }, status: :not_found
      end
    else
      # Invalid signature
      render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: :bad_request
    end
  end

  private

  def verify_liqpay_signature(data, signature)
    # Reconstruct the original data for signature verification
    # LiqPay uses base64 encoded JSON data
    decoded_data = Base64.decode64(data)
    # Create signature using the private key
    liqpay = LiqPay.new(ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY'], ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY'])
    
    # The signature verification is handled by the liqpay gem
    # Check if the signature matches
    expected_signature = liqpay.signature(data)
    expected_signature == signature
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'logger'

class QuickBooksService
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new('log/quickbooks.log')
    
    @realm_id = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID']
    @access_token = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN']
    @consumer_key = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_KEY']
    @consumer_secret = ENV['QUICKBOOKS_CONSUMER_SECRET']
    
    setup_client
  end

  def setup_client
    @client = Quickbooks::Service::Invoice.new
    @client.oauth_token = @access_token
    @client.realm_id = @realm_id
    @client.service_endpoint = Quickbooks::Service::Base::QB_SERVICE_ENDPOINT_SANDBOX # Change to production endpoint when ready
  end

  def export_invoice(invoice_data)
    begin
      # Create invoice object
      invoice = Quickbooks::Model::Invoice.new
      invoice.customer_id = invoice_data[:customer_id]
      invoice.doc_number = invoice_data[:invoice_number]
      invoice.txn_date = invoice_data[:invoice_date]
      invoice.due_date = invoice_data[:due_date]
      invoice.private_note = invoice_data[:notes] || ''
      
      # Add line items
      invoice.line_items = []
      invoice_data[:line_items].each do |item|
        line_item = Quickbooks::Model::InvoiceLineItem.new
        line_item.description = item[:description]
        line_item.amount = item[:amount]
        line_item.quantity = item[:quantity]
        line_item.unit_price = item[:unit_price]
        line_item.sales_item_line_detail = Quickbooks::Model::SalesItemLineDetail.new
        line_item.sales_item_line_detail.item_id = item[:item_id] if item[:item_id]
        invoice.line_items << line_item
      end
      
      # Set invoice status
      invoice.status = 'Paid' if invoice_data[:status] == 'paid'
      
      # Save invoice
      saved_invoice = @client.create(invoice)
      
      @logger.info("Successfully exported invoice #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]} to QuickBooks")
      {
        success: true,
        invoice_id: saved_invoice.id,
        qb_invoice_ref: saved_invoice.doc_number
      }
      
    rescue Quickbooks::Service::Base::ServiceException => e
      @logger.error("QuickBooks API Error: #{e.message}")
      @logger.error("Error details: #{e.response}")
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message,
        error_code: e.response.try(:[], 'Fault')
      }
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Unexpected error exporting invoice: #{e.message}")
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  def get_customer(customer_id)
    begin
      customer_service = Quickbooks::Service::Customer.new
      customer_service.oauth_token = @access_token
      customer_service.realm_id = @realm_id
      customer_service.get(customer_id)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching customer: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end

  def get_item(item_id)
    begin
      item_service = Quickbooks::Service::Item.new
      item_service.oauth_token = @access_token
      item_service.realm_id = @realm_id
      item_service.get(item_id)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching item: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end

  def update_invoice_status(invoice_id, status)
    begin
      invoice = @client.get(invoice_id)
      invoice.status = status
      @client.update(invoice)
      @logger.info("Updated invoice status to #{status}")
      true
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error updating invoice status: #{e.message}")
      false
    end
  end
end
```

Here's a complete Ruby solution for reading Monobank transactions through their open API and saving new transactions.

## Implementation

### 1. Main Application File (main.rb)
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'active_record'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Configure logger
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Configure ActiveRecord to use SQLite
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'monobank_transactions.db'
)

# Transaction model
class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'transactions'
  
  validates :id, presence: true
  validates :date, presence: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
end

# Create transactions table if it doesn't exist
class CreateTransactionsTable < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0]
  def change
    create_table :transactions, force: true do |t|
      t.string :id, null: false
      t.integer :date, null: false
      t.decimal :amount, precision: 15, scale: 2, null: false
      t.string :currency_code, null: false
      t.string :description, null: false
      t.string :beneficiary_name
      t.string :category
      t.timestamps
    end
    
    add_index :transactions, :id, unique: true
    add_index :transactions, :date
  end
end

# Initialize database table
begin
  CreateTransactionsTable.new.change
rescue => e
  logger.info "Database table already exists or error: #{e.message}"
end

# Monobank API Client
class MonobankClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  
  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end
  
  def get_account_info
    response = self.class.get('/personal/client-info', headers: { 'X-Token' => @token })
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to get account info: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_transactions(from_date, to_date = nil)
    to_date ||= Time.now.to_i
    params = {
      'from' => from_date,
      'to' => to_date
    }
    
    response = self.class.get('/personal/statement', 
                             headers: { 'X-Token' => @token },
                             query: params)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to get transactions: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Transaction Processor
class TransactionProcessor
  def initialize(client, logger)
    @client = client
    @logger = logger
  end
  
  def process_transactions
    begin
      # Get the last processed transaction date
      last_transaction = Transaction.order(date: :desc).first
      from_date = last_transaction ? last_transaction.date + 1 : Time.now.to_i - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 # 30 days back
      
      @logger.info "Fetching transactions from #{Time.at(from_date)}..."
      
      # Get transactions from Monobank API
      transactions = @client.get_transactions(from_date)
      @logger.info "Found #{transactions.length} transactions"
      
      # Process and save new transactions
      new_transactions = 0
      transactions.each do |raw_transaction|
        transaction = process_single_transaction(raw_transaction)
        if save_transaction(transaction)
          new_transactions += 1
        end
      end
      
      @logger.info "Saved #{new_transactions} new transactions"
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error "Error processing transactions: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_single_transaction(raw_transaction)
    {
      id: raw_transaction['id'],
      date: raw_transaction['time'],
      amount: raw_transaction['amount'].to_f,
      currency_code: raw_transaction['currencyCode'],
      description: raw_transaction['description'],
      beneficiary_name: raw_transaction['beneficiaryName'],
      category: raw_transaction['category']
    }
  end
  
  def save_transaction(transaction)
    # Check if transaction already exists
    existing = Transaction.find_by(id: transaction[:id])
    return false if existing
    
    # Create new transaction
    Transaction.create!(
      id: transaction[:id],
      date: transaction[:date],
      amount: transaction[:amount],
      currency_code: transaction[:currency_code],
      description: transaction[:description],
      beneficiary_name: transaction[:beneficiary_name],
      category: transaction[:category]
    )
    
    true
  end
end

# Main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Check if API token is provided
  if !ENV['MONOBANK_TOKEN'] || ENV['MONOBANK_TOKEN'].empty?
    puts "Error: MONOBANK_TOKEN environment variable must be set"
    puts "Please set it like: export MONOBANK_TOKEN='your_token_here'"
    exit 1
  end
  
  begin
    # Initialize client and processor
    client = MonobankClient.new(ENV['MONOBANK_TOKEN'])
    processor = TransactionProcessor.new(client, logger)
    
    # Get account info to verify connection
    account_info = client.get_account_info
    logger.info "Connected to Monobank account: #{account_info['name']}"
    
    # Process transactions
    processor.process_transactions
    
    logger.info "Transaction processing completed successfully"
    
  rescue => e
    logger.error "Application error: #{e.message}"
    logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
    exit 1
  end
end
```

Ось приклад коду на Ruby для інтеграції з Fondy (CloudIPSP) для приймання платежів і перевірки підпису відповіді. У цьому прикладі використовується `openssl` для перевірки підпису, `sinatra` як фреймворк для створення веб-сервера і `json` для обробки JSON.

### 1. `Gemfile`

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

```

### 2. `app.rb` — основна реалізація

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'

# Конфігурація
MERCHANT_ID = 'your_merchant_id'
SECRET_KEY = 'your_secret_key'

# Маршрут для отримання платежів
post '/payment/callback' do
  # Отримуємо JSON з тіла запиту
  payload = request.body.read
  data = JSON.parse(payload)

  # Перевіряємо підпис
  if verify_signature(data)
    # Тут можна обробити успішний платіж
    status 200
    body 'OK'
  else
    # Якщо підпис не валідний
    status 400
    body 'Invalid signature'
  end
end

# Функція перевірки підпису
def verify_signature(data)
  signature = data['signature']
  return false unless signature

  # Формуємо список полів для підпису
  fields = [
    data['order_id'],
    data['order_status'],
    data['amount'],
    data['currency'],
    data['merchant_id'],
    data['pos_id'],
    data['payment_id'],
    data['sender_email'],
    data['sender_phone'],
    data['response_timeout'],
    data['verification_status'],
    SECRET_KEY
  ]

  # Формуємо рядок для хешування
  string_to_sign = fields.join('|')

  # Генеруємо SHA256 хеш
  expected_signature = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(string_to_sign)

  # Порівнюємо підписи
  signature == expected_signature
end
```

### 3. Щоб запустити:

1. Установіть залежності:

   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. Запустіть сервер:

   ```bash
   ruby app.rb
   ```

3. Використовуйте наступну URL для тестування:

   `POST http://localhost:4567/payment/callback`

   Запит має містити JSON з полями, включаючи `signature`.

```json

  "order_id": "123456",
```

- `SECRET_KEY` і `MERCHANT_ID` потрібно замінити на справжні значення з вашого облікового запису в Fondy.
- Значення `signature` в JSON потрібно генерувати на основі всіх інших полів, як описано в документації Fondy.

```ruby
class Invoice < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :customer, class_name: 'User'
  has_many :invoice_lines, dependent: :destroy
  
  enum status: { draft: 0, submitted: 1, approved: 2, paid: 3, voided: 4 }
  
  validates :invoice_number, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :customer_id, presence: true
  
  after_create :send_to_xero
  after_update :sync_with_xero
  
  def send_to_xero
    return if xero_invoice_id.present?
    
    begin
      xero_client = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new
      invoice_data = build_xero_invoice_data
      response = xero_client.create_invoices(
        XeroRuby::AccountingApi::CreateInvoicesRequest.new(
          invoices: [invoice_data]
        )
      )
      
      xero_invoice = response.invoices.first
      update!(
        xero_invoice_id: xero_invoice.invoice_id,
        status: :submitted
      )
      
      # Queue payment status sync
      InvoicePaymentSyncJob.perform_later(self.id)
      
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to send invoice #{invoice_number} to Xero: #{e.message}"
      raise "Xero API error: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def sync_with_xero
    return unless xero_invoice_id.present?
    
    begin
      xero_client = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new
      invoice_data = build_xero_invoice_data
      
      # Update existing invoice
      xero_client.update_invoice(
        xero_invoice_id,
        XeroRuby::AccountingApi::UpdateInvoiceRequest.new(invoice: invoice_data)
      )
      
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync invoice #{invoice_number} with Xero: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def update_payment_status_from_xero
    return unless xero_invoice_id.present?
    
    begin
      xero_client = XeroRuby::AccountingApi.new
      response = xero_client.get_invoice(xero_invoice_id)
      xero_invoice = response.invoices.first
      
      case xero_invoice.status
      when 'PAID'
        update!(status: :paid)
      when 'VOIDED'
        update!(status: :voided)
      when 'DRAFT'
        update!(status: :draft)
      when 'SUBMITTED'
        update!(status: :submitted)
      end
      
    rescue XeroRuby::ApiError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to fetch payment status for invoice #{invoice_number}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def build_xero_invoice_data
    XeroRuby::AccountingApi::Invoice.new({
      type: 'ACCREC',
      invoice_number: invoice_number,
      date: created_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
      due_date: due_date&.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
      status: status_to_xero,
      reference: reference,
      currency_code: currency_code || 'USD',
      line_items: invoice_lines.map { |line| build_xero_line_item(line) },
      contact: XeroRuby::AccountingApi::Contact.new({
        contact_id: customer.xero_contact_id
      })
    })
  end
  
  def status_to_xero
    case status
    when 'draft' then 'DRAFT'
    when 'submitted' then 'SUBMITTED'
    when 'approved' then 'SUBMITTED'
    when 'paid' then 'PAID'
    when 'voided' then 'VOIDED'
    else 'DRAFT'
    end
  end
  
  def build_xero_line_item(line)
    XeroRuby::AccountingApi::LineItem.new({
      description: line.description,
      quantity: line.quantity,
      unit_amount: line.unit_amount,
      account_code: line.account_code,
      tax_type: line.tax_type
    })
  end
  
  def self.sync_all_payment_status
    where.not(xero_invoice_id: nil).find_each do |invoice|
      invoice.update_payment_status_from_xero
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
  before_action :set_invoice, only: [:show, :update, :destroy]
  
  def index
    @invoices = Invoice.all
    render json: @invoices
  end
  
  def show
    render json: @invoice
  end
  
  def create
    @invoice = Invoice.new(invoice_params)
    
    if @invoice.save
      render json: @invoice, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: @invoice.errors }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def update
    if @invoice.update(invoice_params)
      render json: @invoice
    else
      render json: { errors: @invoice.errors }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def destroy
    @invoice.destroy
    head :no_content
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_invoice
    @invoice = Invoice.find(params[:id])
  end
  
  def invoice_params
    params.require(:invoice).permit(
      :invoice_number, :amount, :due_date, :reference, 
      :customer_id, :currency_code, :status,
      invoice_lines_attributes: [
        :id, :description, :quantity, :unit_amount, 
        :account_code, :tax_type, :_destroy
      ]
    )
  end
end
```

## main.rb
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'logger'

class PrivatBankBusinessAPI
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua/p24api'
  HEADERS = {
    'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    'Accept' => 'application/json'
  }.freeze

  def initialize(client_id, client_secret, logger: nil)
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @access_token = nil
  end

  def get_account_balance(account_number)
    authenticate!
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/balance",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        account: account_number,
        client_id: @client_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response, 'account balance')
  end

  def get_account_statement(account_number, date_from, date_to, page: 1, per_page: 100)
    authenticate!
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/statement",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        account: account_number,
        date_from: date_from,
        date_to: date_to,
        page: page,
        per_page: per_page,
        client_id: @client_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response, 'account statement')
  end

  def get_account_list
    authenticate!
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/accounts",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        client_id: @client_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response, 'account list')
  end

  private

  def authenticate!
    @logger.info('Authenticating with PrivatBank API...')
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/auth",
      headers: HEADERS,
      body: {
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        grant_type: 'client_credentials'
      }.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = response.parsed_response['access_token']
      @logger.info('Authentication successful')
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body}"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response, operation)
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("#{operation.capitalize} retrieved successfully")
      response.parsed_response
    else
      error_message = response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body
      @logger.error("Failed to retrieve #{operation}: #{error_message}")
      raise "API Error: #{error_message}"
    end
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Configuration - replace with your actual credentials
  CLIENT_ID = 'your_client_id_here'
  CLIENT_SECRET = 'your_client_secret_here'
  
  # Logger for debugging
  logger = Logger.new('privatbank.log')
  logger.level = Logger::INFO

  begin
    # Initialize the API client
    api = PrivatBankBusinessAPI.new(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, logger: logger)
    
    # Get account list first to see available accounts
    puts "Fetching account list..."
    accounts = api.get_account_list
    puts "Available accounts: #{accounts['accounts'].map { |acc| acc['account'] }.join(', ')}"
    
    # Use the first account for demonstration
    account_number = accounts['accounts'].first['account']
    
    # Get account balance
    puts "\nFetching account balance..."
    balance = api.get_account_balance(account_number)
    puts "Account: #{balance['account']}"
    puts "Balance: #{balance['balance']} #{balance['currency']}"
    puts "Available: #{balance['available']} #{balance['currency']}"
    
    # Get account statement for last 30 days
    puts "\nFetching account statement..."
    require 'date'
    date_to = Date.today.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    date_from = (Date.today - 30).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    
    statement = api.get_account_statement(
      account_number, 
      date_from, 
      date_to, 
      page: 1, 
      per_page: 10
    )
    
    puts "Statement for #{date_from} to #{date_to}:"
    statement['transactions'].each do |transaction|
      puts "- #{transaction['date']} | #{transaction['description']} | #{transaction['amount']} #{transaction['currency']}"
    end
    
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    logger.error("Error: #{e.message}")
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/ukrainian_iban_validator.rb
require 'iban-tools'
require 'active_model'

class UkrainianIBANValidator
  include ActiveModel::Validations

  attr_reader :iban, :mfo

  validates :iban, format: { with: /\AUA\d{24}\z/, message: "must be a valid Ukrainian IBAN (29 characters starting with UA)" }

  def initialize(iban)
    @iban = iban&.upcase&.gsub(/\s+/, '') # Normalize IBAN
    @mfo = extract_mfo
  end

  def valid?
    valid?
  end

  def valid_iban?
    return false unless @iban
    return false unless @iban.length == 29
    return false unless @iban.start_with?('UA')
    
    # IBAN validation using IBAN tools
    begin
      IBANTools::IBAN.new(@iban)
      true
    rescue
      false
    end
  end

  def mfo_code
    @mfo
  end

  def bank_name
    return nil unless @mfo
    
    # Ukrainian bank MFO lookup (simplified)
    bank_info = {
      '300000' => 'PrivatBank',
      '320000' => 'OTP Bank',
      '310000' => 'Bank of America',
      '330000' => 'Mono Bank',
      '340000' => 'Raiffeisen Bank',
      '350000' => 'Oschadbank',
      '360000' => 'Ukrsibbank',
      '370000' => 'Krakowska Bank',
      '380000' => 'Pumb Bank',
      '390000' => 'Veselin Bank'
    }
    
    bank_info[@mfo]
  end

  private

  def extract_mfo
    return nil unless @iban&.length == 29 && @iban.start_with?('UA')
    
    # MFO is characters 5-10 in Ukrainian IBAN format
    # Format: UA + 2 check digits + 6 MFO + 16 account number
    @iban[4..9]
  end
end

# Alternative implementation without external dependencies
class UkrainianIBANValidatorPure
  attr_reader :iban, :mfo

  def initialize(iban)
    @iban = iban&.upcase&.gsub(/\s+/, '')
    @mfo = extract_mfo
  end

  def valid?
    return false unless @iban
    return false unless @iban.length == 29
    return false unless @iban.start_with?('UA')
    return false unless @iban.match?(/\AUA\d{24}\z/)
    
    # Basic IBAN check: validate check digits
    validate_iban_checksum
  end

  def mfo_code
    @mfo
  end

  def bank_name
    return nil unless @mfo
    
    bank_info = {
      '300000' => 'PrivatBank',
      '320000' => 'OTP Bank',
      '310000' => 'Bank of America',
      '330000' => 'Mono Bank',
      '340000' => 'Raiffeisen Bank',
      '350000' => 'Oschadbank',
      '360000' => 'Ukrsibbank',
      '370000' => 'Krakowska Bank',
      '380000' => 'Pumb Bank',
      '390000' => 'Veselin Bank'
    }
    
    bank_info[@mfo]
  end

  private

  def extract_mfo
    return nil unless @iban&.length == 29 && @iban.start_with?('UA')
    
    # MFO is characters 5-10 (0-indexed: 4-9)
    @iban[4..9]
  end

  def validate_iban_checksum
    # Move first 4 characters to the end
    rearranged = @iban[4..28] + @iban[0..3]
    
    # Convert letters to numbers (A=10, B=11, ..., Z=35)
    numeric_string = rearranged.chars.map do |char|
      if char.match?(/[A-Z]/)
        (char.ord - 'A'.ord + 10).to_s
      else
        char
      end
    end.join
    
    # Calculate mod 97
    numeric_string.to_i % 97 == 1
  end
end
```

This implementation provides two versions of Ukrainian IBAN validator:

1. **UkrainianIBANValidator** - Uses the `iban-tools` gem for IBAN validation
2. **UkrainianIBANValidatorPure** - Pure Ruby implementation without external dependencies

## Key Features:

- **Validation**: Checks that the IBAN is 29 characters, starts with "UA", and contains only digits
- **MFO Extraction**: Extracts the 6-digit MFO (Bank Code) from positions 5-10 (0-indexed)
- **Checksum Validation**: Implements the standard IBAN mod-97 checksum validation
- **Bank Information**: Provides a lookup table for common Ukrainian banks by MFO code

## IBAN Structure (Ukrainian):
- Positions 0-1: Country code ("UA")
- Positions 2-3: Check digits  
- Positions 4-9: 6-digit MFO (Bank Code)
- Positions 10-28: 19-digit account number

  - Податковий збір = 20% від прибутку (для 3-ї групи)

```ruby
require 'bigdecimal'

# Функція для розрахунку ЄСВ

  if earnings <= 1_000_000
    earnings * 0.05
  else
    50_000 + (earnings - 1_000_000) * 0.10
  end
end

# Функція для розрахунку податкового збору (20%)

  earnings * 0.20
end
```

**lib/hryvnia_words.rb:**

```ruby
class HryvniaWords
  UAH_WORDS = {
    0 => 'нуль',
    1 => 'один',
    2 => 'два',
    3 => 'три',
    4 => 'чотири',
    5 => 'п\'ять',
    6 => 'шість',
    7 => 'сім',
    8 => 'вісім',
    9 => 'дев\'ять',
    10 => 'десять',
    11 => 'одинадцять',
    12 => 'дванадцять',
    13 => 'тринадцять',
    14 => 'чотирнадцять',
    15 => 'п\'ятнадцять',
    16 => 'шістнадцять',
    17 => 'сімнадцять',
    18 => 'вісімнадцять',
    19 => 'дев\'ятнадцять',
    20 => 'двадцять',
    30 => 'тридцять',
    40 => 'сорок',
    50 => 'п\'ятдесят',
    60 => 'шістдесят',
    70 => 'сімдесят',
    80 => 'вісімдесят',
    90 => 'дев\'яносто'
  }

  UAH_UNITS = {
    1 => ['копійка', 'копійки', 'копійок'],
    2 => ['гривня', 'гривні', 'гривень'],
    3 => ['тисяча', 'тисячі', 'тисяч'],
    4 => ['мільйон', 'мільйони', 'мільйонів']
  }

  def self.to_words(amount)
    return 'нуль гривень' if amount == 0

    # Split amount into hryvnias and kopecks
    hryvnias = (amount / 1).to_i
    kopecks = (amount * 100).round % 100

    result = []

    # Handle hryvnias
    hryvnia_words = convert_number_to_words(hryvnias, 2)
    result << hryvnia_words

    # Handle kopecks
    if kopecks > 0
      kopeck_words = convert_number_to_words(kopecks, 1)
      result << kopeck_words
    else
      result << 'нуль копійок'
    end

    result.join(' ')
  end

  private_class_method def self.convert_number_to_words(number, unit_type)
    return 'нуль' if number == 0

    words = []
    thousands = number.divmod(1000)
    millions = thousands[0].divmod(1000)

    # Handle millions
    if millions[0] > 0
      words << convert_thousands(millions[0], 4)
    end

    # Handle thousands
    if thousands[0] > 0
      words << convert_thousands(thousands[0], 3)
    end

    # Handle hundreds, tens, and units
    if number > 0
      words << convert_thousands(number % 1000, 2)
    end

    # Add appropriate unit
    unit = get_unit(number, unit_type)
    words << unit

    words.join(' ')
  end

  private_class_method def self.convert_thousands(number, unit_type)
    return '' if number == 0

    words = []

    # Handle hundreds
    hundreds = number / 100
    if hundreds > 0
      words << UAH_WORDS[hundreds] + 'сот'
    end

    # Handle tens and units
    tens_units = number % 100
    if tens_units > 0
      if tens_units < 20
        words << UAH_WORDS[tens_units]
      else
        tens = (tens_units / 10) * 10
        units = tens_units % 10
        words << UAH_WORDS[tens]
        words << UAH_WORDS[units] if units > 0
      end
    end

    words.join(' ')
  end

  private_class_method def self.get_unit(number, unit_type)
    # Get the correct form of the unit based on the number
    number = number % 100
    last_digit = number % 10

    # Special case for numbers 11-19
    if number >= 11 && number <= 19
      return UAH_UNITS[unit_type][2] # genitive plural
    end

    # Determine form based on last digit
    case last_digit
    when 1
      return UAH_UNITS[unit_type][0] # nominative singular
    when 2, 3, 4
      return UAH_UNITS[unit_type][1] # genitive plural
    else
      return UAH_UNITS[unit_type][2] # genitive plural
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Конфігурація Portmone API
PORTMONE_API_URL = 'https://api.portmone.com.ua'.freeze
API_KEY = ENV['PORTMONE_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key'
MERCHANT_ID = ENV['MERCHANT_ID'] || 'your_merchant_id'

# Створюємо платіжне посилання
post '/create_payment' do
  content_type :json

  data = {
    merchant_id: MERCHANT_ID,
    amount: params[:amount].to_f,
    currency: params[:currency] || 'UAH',
    description: params[:description] || 'Payment',
    success_url: params[:success_url],
    cancel_url: params[:cancel_url],
    callback_url: params[:callback_url]
  }

  response = HTTParty.post(
    "#{PORTMONE_API_URL}/payment/create",
    headers: {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{API_KEY}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    },
    body: data.to_json
  )

  if response.success?
    json response.parsed_response
  else
    status 500
    json error: response.body
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'rqrcode'
require 'json'

class PaymentQRGenerator
  def initialize(
    recipient_name,
    recipient_iban,
    recipient_bank_code,
    amount,
    purpose_code = nil,
    purpose_text = nil,
    currency = 'UAH'
  )
    @recipient_name = recipient_name
    @recipient_iban = recipient_iban
    @recipient_bank_code = recipient_bank_code
    @amount = amount
    @purpose_code = purpose_code
    @purpose_text = purpose_text
    @currency = currency
  end

  def generate_qr_data
    # Створюємо структуру даних за стандартом НБУ для QR-коду
    data = {
      'version' => '1.0',
      'recipient_name' => @recipient_name,
      'recipient_iban' => @recipient_iban,
      'recipient_bank_code' => @recipient_bank_code,
      'amount' => @amount,
      'currency' => @currency,
      'purpose_code' => @purpose_code,
      'purpose_text' => @purpose_text
    }

    # Перетворюємо на JSON та кодуємо у форматі UTF-8
    JSON.generate(data)
  end

  def generate_qr_code
    qr_data = generate_qr_data
    QRCode::QRCode.new(qr_data, level: :h).as_svg
  end

  def save_qr_code(filename = 'payment_qr.svg')
    File.write(filename, generate_qr_code)
    puts "QR-код збережено у файл: #{filename}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# tax_calculator.rb
require 'money'
require 'active_support/all'

class SoleProprietorTaxCalculator
  # Tax rates and constants for 3rd group sole proprietors (as of 2023)
  # These values should be updated according to current Ukrainian tax laws
  
  # Single tax rates for 3rd group (2023)
  SINGLE_TAX_RATES = {
    '1st_quarter' => 0.05,    # 5%
    '2nd_quarter' => 0.05,
    '3rd_quarter' => 0.05,
    '4th_quarter' => 0.05
  }.freeze

  # Social contribution rates (ЄСВ) for 3rd group (2023)
  SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION_RATES = {
    '1st_quarter' => 0.22,    # 22%
    '2nd_quarter' => 0.22,
    '3rd_quarter' => 0.22,
    '4th_quarter' => 0.22
  }.freeze

  # Minimum tax base for 3rd group
  MINIMUM_TAX_BASE = 1000 # UAH

  # Minimum social contribution base for 3rd group
  MINIMUM_SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION_BASE = 1000 # UAH

  def initialize(income, quarter)
    @income = income.to_f
    @quarter = quarter.to_s.downcase
    @quarter_name = quarter_name(@quarter)
  end

  def calculate_single_tax
    # Calculate single tax based on income
    tax_rate = SINGLE_TAX_RATES[@quarter] || 0.05
    base_income = [@income, MINIMUM_TAX_BASE].max
    tax_amount = base_income * tax_rate
    
    {
      quarter: @quarter_name,
      income: format_currency(@income),
      base_income: format_currency(base_income),
      tax_rate: "#{(tax_rate * 100).round(1)}%",
      tax_amount: format_currency(tax_amount)
    }
  end

  def calculate_social_contribution
    # Calculate social contribution (ЄСВ)
    contribution_rate = SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION_RATES[@quarter] || 0.22
    base_income = [@income, MINIMUM_SOCIAL_CONTRIBUTION_BASE].max
    contribution_amount = base_income * contribution_rate
    
    {
      quarter: @quarter_name,
      income: format_currency(@income),
      base_income: format_currency(base_income),
      rate: "#{(contribution_rate * 100).round(1)}%",
      amount: format_currency(contribution_amount)
    }
  end

  def calculate_all
    {
      single_tax: calculate_single_tax,
      social_contribution: calculate_social_contribution,
      total: format_currency(calculate_single_tax[:tax_amount].to_f + calculate_social_contribution[:amount].to_f)
    }
  end

  private

  def quarter_name(quarter)
    case quarter
    when '1st_quarter', 'q1'
      '1st Quarter (January - March)'
    when '2nd_quarter', 'q2'
      '2nd Quarter (April - June)'
    when '3rd_quarter', 'q3'
      '3rd Quarter (July - September)'
    when '4th_quarter', 'q4'
      '4th Quarter (October - December)'
    else
      quarter
    end
  end

  def format_currency(amount)
    # Format amount with Ukrainian currency (UAH)
    sprintf("%.2f UAH", amount)
  end
end

    end
```
```ruby
  end
end
```

I'll create a Ruby solution that integrates with the Checkbox PRRO API to issue fiscal receipts after online payments.

## Gemfile


## Implementation

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'securerandom'

class CheckboxReceipt
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.checkbox.ua'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key:, cash_register_id:, organization_id:)
    @api_key = api_key
    @cash_register_id = cash_register_id
    @organization_id = organization_id
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  # Create a fiscal receipt
  def create_receipt(payment_data)
    receipt_data = build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        '/receipts',
        body: receipt_data.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
          'X-CashRegisterId' => @cash_register_id,
          'X-OrganizationId' => @organization_id
        }
      )
      
      if response.success?
        puts "✅ Receipt created successfully!"
        puts "Receipt ID: #{response['id']}"
        puts "Receipt URL: #{response['url']}"
        return response.parsed_response
      else
        puts "❌ Failed to create receipt: #{response.body}"
        return nil
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "❌ Error creating receipt: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    # Generate unique receipt ID
    receipt_id = "receipt_#{SecureRandom.uuid}"
    
    # Build receipt data structure
    {
      id: receipt_id,
      type: "fiscal",
      cash_register_id: @cash_register_id,
      organization_id: @organization_id,
      items: build_items(payment_data[:items]),
      total_amount: payment_data[:total_amount],
      payment_methods: build_payment_methods(payment_data[:payment_methods]),
      customer: build_customer(payment_data[:customer]),
      created_at: Time.now.iso8601,
      status: "completed"
    }
  end
  
  def build_items(items_data)
    items_data.map do |item|
      {
        name: item[:name],
        price: item[:price],
        quantity: item[:quantity],
        tax_rate: item[:tax_rate] || 20,
        total: item[:price] * item[:quantity]
      }
    end
  end
  
  def build_payment_methods(payment_methods_data)
    payment_methods_data.map do |method|
      {
        type: method[:type],
        amount: method[:amount],
        currency: method[:currency] || "UAH"
      }
    end
  end
  
  def build_customer(customer_data)
    {
      name: customer_data[:name],
      email: customer_data[:email],
      phone: customer_data[:phone],
      tax_id: customer_data[:tax_id]
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class UkrainianAmountFormatter
  UNITS = {
    0 => '',
    1 => 'один',
    2 => 'два',
    3 => 'три',
    4 => 'чотири',
    5 => 'п’ять',
    6 => 'шість',
    7 => 'сім',
    8 => 'вісім',
    9 => 'дев’ять'
  }.freeze

  TEENS = {
    10 => 'десять',
    11 => 'одинадцять',
    12 => 'дванадцять',
    13 => 'тринадцять',
    14 => 'чотирнадцять',
    15 => 'п’ятнадцять',
    16 => 'шістнадцять',
    17 => 'сімнадцять',
    18 => 'вісімнадцять',
    19 => 'дев’ятнадцять'
  }.freeze

  TENS = {
    2 => 'двадцять',
    3 => 'тридцять',
    4 => 'сорок',
    5 => 'п’ятдесят',
    6 => 'шістдесят',
    7 => 'сімдесят',
    8 => 'вісімдесят',
    9 => 'дев’яносто'
  }.freeze

  HUNDRED = 'сто'
  TWO_HUNDRED = 'двісті'
  THREE_HUNDRED = 'триста'
  FOUR_HUNDRED = 'чотириста'
  FIVE_HUNDRED = 'п’ятсот'
  SIX_HUNDRED = 'шістсот'
  SEVEN_HUNDRED = 'сімсот'
  EIGHT_HUNDRED = 'вісімсот'
  NINE_HUNDRED = 'дев’ятсот'

  HUNDREDS = {
    1 => HUNDRED,
    2 => TWO_HUNDRED,
    3 => THREE_HUNDRED,
    4 => FOUR_HUNDRED,
    5 => FIVE_HUNDRED,
    6 => SIX_HUNDRED,
    7 => SEVEN_HUNDRED,
    8 => EIGHT_HUNDRED,
    9 => NINE_HUNDRED
  }.freeze

  THOUSANDS = %w[тисяча тисячі тисяч].freeze
  MILLIONS = %w[мільйон мільйони мільйонів].freeze
  BILLIONS = %w[мільярд мільярди мільярдів].freeze

  def self.format(amount)
    return 'нуль гривень нуль копійок' if amount == 0

    dollars = (amount / 1).to_i
    cents = (amount * 100).to_i % 100

    dollars_text = number_to_words(dollars)
    cents_text = number_to_words(cents)

    dollars_word = dollars == 1 ? 'гривня' : (dollars % 10 >= 2 && dollars % 10 <= 4 && (dollars % 100 < 10 || dollars % 100 >= 20) ? 'гривні' : 'гривень')
    cents_word = cents == 1 ? 'копійка' : (cents % 10 >= 2 && cents % 10 <= 4 && (cents % 100 < 10 || cents % 100 >= 20) ? 'копійки' : 'копійок')

    "#{dollars_text} #{dollars_word} #{cents_text} #{cents_word}"
  end

  private_class_method def self.number_to_words(n)
    return '' if n == 0

    result = []

    billions = n / 1_000_000_000
    millions = (n % 1_000_000_000) / 1_000_000
    thousands = (n % 1_000_000) / 1_000
    rest = n % 1_000

    result << convert_part(billions, BILLIONS) unless billions.zero?
    result << convert_part(millions, MILLIONS) unless millions.zero?
    result << convert_part(thousands, THOUSANDS) unless thousands.zero?
    result << convert_part(rest, []) unless rest.zero?

    result.join(' ')
  end

  private_class_method def self.convert_part(n, plural_forms)
    return '' if n.zero?

    result = []

    if n >= 100
      hundreds = n / 100
      result << HUNDREDS[hundreds]
      n %= 100
    end

    if n >= 20
      tens = n / 10
      result << TENS[tens]
      units = n % 10
      result << UNITS[units] unless units.zero?
    elsif n >= 10
      result << TEENS[n]
    elsif n > 0
      result << UNITS[n]
    end

    result.join(' ')
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Transaction
  attr_accessor :date, :description, :amount, :currency, :category

  def initialize(date, description, amount, currency)
    @date = Date.parse(date)
    @description = description
    @amount = BigDecimal(amount)
    @currency = currency
    @category = categorize
  end

  private

  def categorize
    desc = @description.downcase

    case
    when desc.include?('оплата за послуги') || desc.include?('послуги')
      'Послуги'
    when desc.include?('магазин') || desc.include?('маркет') || desc.include?('shop')
      'Магазин'
    when desc.include?('кафе') || desc.include?('ресторан')
      'Їжа'
    when desc.include?('таксі') || desc.include?('транспорт')
      'Транспорт'
    when desc.include?('зарплата')
      'Зарплата'
    when desc.include?('переказ')
      'Переказ'
    else
      'Інше'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'csv'

require_relative 'transaction'

class BankStatementImporter
  def initialize(csv_file_path)
    @csv_file_path = csv_file_path
    @transactions = []
  end

  def import
    CSV.foreach(@csv_file_path, headers: true, encoding: 'UTF-8') do |row|
      transaction = Transaction.new(
        row['Дата'],
        row['Опис'],
        row['Сума'],
        row['Валюта']
      )
      @transactions << transaction
    end
    @transactions
  end

  def categorize!
    @transactions.each(&:category)
    @transactions
  end

  def group_by_category
    @transactions.group_by(&:category)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'json'

# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Load environment variables
configure do
  set :port, ENV['PORT'] || 4567
  set :bind, ENV['BIND'] || '0.0.0.0'
end

# Configuration
PORTMONE_API_URL = ENV['PORTMONE_API_URL'] || 'https://api.portmone.com'
PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID = ENV['PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID']
PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY = ENV['PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY']
PORTMONE_CALLBACK_URL = ENV['PORTMONE_CALLBACK_URL'] || "#{ENV['BASE_URL'] || 'http://localhost:4567'}/callback"

# Error handling
class PortmoneError < StandardError; end

# Portmone API Client
class PortmoneClient
  include HTTParty
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
    self.class.base_uri PORTMONE_API_URL
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  def create_payment_link(amount, currency, description, customer_email = nil, custom_params = {})
    # Generate unique order ID
    order_id = "order_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
    
    # Prepare payment data
    payment_data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description,
      callback_url: PORTMONE_CALLBACK_URL,
      customer_email: customer_email,
      success_url: custom_params[:success_url] || "#{ENV['BASE_URL'] || 'http://localhost:4567'}/success",
      cancel_url: custom_params[:cancel_url] || "#{ENV['BASE_URL'] || 'http://localhost:4567'}/cancel"
    }.reject { |_, v| v.nil? }
    
    # Add custom parameters
    payment_data.merge!(custom_params) unless custom_params.empty?
    
    # Add signature
    payment_data[:signature] = generate_signature(payment_data)
    
    # Create payment link
    response = self.class.post('/payment/create', body: payment_data.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise PortmoneError, "Failed to create payment link: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def verify_signature(params)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params)
    signature = params.delete(:signature)
    
    # Compare signatures securely
    secure_compare(expected_signature, signature)
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Create signature string from sorted parameters
    sorted_params = params.sort_by { |k, _| k.to_s }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    
    # Generate HMAC SHA256 signature
    require 'openssl'
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', @secret_key, sorted_params)
  end
  
  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
    return false if a.length != b.length
    
    # Use secure comparison to prevent timing attacks
    result = 0
    a.chars.zip(b.chars).each do |char_a, char_b|
      result |= char_a.ord ^ char_b.ord
    end
    result == 0
  end
end

# Initialize Portmone client
portmone_client = PortmoneClient.new(PORTMONE_MERCHANT_ID, PORTMONE_SECRET_KEY)

    if missing_params.any?

    end

    payment_result = portmone_client.create_payment_link(
      params_hash[:amount].to_f,

      }
    )
    
    # Return the payment link
    {
```

# Ukrainian Bank Transfer QR Code Generator

I'll create a Ruby solution that generates payment QR codes according to the NBU (National Bank of Ukraine) QR payment standard.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rqrcode'
gem 'json'
gem 'activesupport'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# payment_qr_generator.rb
require 'rqrcode'
require 'json'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class UkrainianPaymentQRGenerator
  # NBU QR payment standard parameters
  REQUIRED_FIELDS = [
    :payment_type,  # 1 - Payment, 2 - Payment Request
    :amount,        # Payment amount
    :currency,      # 980 - UAH
    :purpose,       # Payment purpose
    :recipient_name, # Recipient name
    :recipient_iban, # Recipient IBAN
    :recipient_bank, # Recipient bank
    :recipient_code  # Recipient code (EDRPOU)
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @qr_data = {}
  end

  # Set all required fields
  def set_fields(payment_type:, amount:, currency:, purpose:, recipient_name:, 
                 recipient_iban:, recipient_bank:, recipient_code:)
    @qr_data = {
      payment_type: payment_type.to_s,
      amount: amount.to_s,
      currency: currency.to_s,
      purpose: purpose,
      recipient_name: recipient_name,
      recipient_iban: recipient_iban,
      recipient_bank: recipient_bank,
      recipient_code: recipient_code.to_s
    }
  end

  # Validate required fields
  def validate!
    missing_fields = REQUIRED_FIELDS.reject { |field| @qr_data[field] && !@qr_data[field].empty? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    # Validate amount format
    unless @qr_data[:amount] =~ /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid amount format"
    end
    
    # Validate currency code
    unless @qr_data[:currency] == '980'
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid currency code. Only UAH (980) is supported"
    end
    
    # Validate payment type
    unless ['1', '2'].include?(@qr_data[:payment_type])
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid payment type. Must be 1 (Payment) or 2 (Payment Request)"
    end
    
    # Validate IBAN format (basic validation)
    unless @qr_data[:recipient_iban] =~ /^UA\d{26}$/
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid IBAN format"
    end
    
    # Validate recipient code (EDRPOU)
    unless @qr_data[:recipient_code] =~ /^\d{8,10}$/
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid recipient code (EDRPOU)"
    end
  end

  # Generate the raw QR data according to NBU standard
  def generate_qr_data
    validate!
    
    # Format the data according to NBU QR standard
    # Format: field_id:field_value;
    qr_data = ""
    
    # Payment type (1)
    qr_data += "1:#{@qr_data[:payment_type]};"
    
    # Amount (2)
    qr_data += "2:#{@qr_data[:amount]};"
    
    # Currency (3)
    qr_data += "3:#{@qr_data[:currency]};"
    
    # Purpose (4)
    qr_data += "4:#{@qr_data[:purpose]};"
    
    # Recipient name (5)
    qr_data += "5:#{@qr_data[:recipient_name]};"
    
    # Recipient IBAN (6)
    qr_data += "6:#{@qr_data[:recipient_iban]};"
    
    # Recipient bank (7)
    qr_data += "7:#{@qr_data[:recipient_bank]};"
    
    # Recipient code (8)
    qr_data += "8:#{@qr_data[:recipient_code]};"
    
    # Remove trailing semicolon
    qr_data.chop!
  end

  # Generate QR code as an image
  def generate_qr_image(size: 300)
    qr_data = generate_qr_data
    qr_code = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_data, size: 10)
    
    # Generate PNG image
    qr_code.as_png(size: size, border_modules: 4)
  end

  # Generate QR code as string (for testing)
  def generate_qr_string
    generate_qr_data
  end

  # Save QR code to file
  def save_qr_to_file(filename, size: 300)
    qr_data = generate_qr_data
    qr_code = RQRCode::QRCode.new(qr_data, size: 10)
    
    File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
      qr_code.as_png(size: size, border_modules: 4).write(file)
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Create a new payment QR generator
  generator = UkrainianPaymentQRGenerator.new
  
  # Set payment details
  generator.set_fields(
    payment_type: 1,                        # Payment
    amount: 1500.50,                        # 1500.50 UAH
    currency: 980,                          # UAH
    purpose: "Payment for services",        # Payment purpose
    recipient_name: "John Doe",             # Recipient name
    recipient_iban: "UA383804020000000260000000000", # Recipient IBAN
    recipient_bank: "PrivatBank",           # Recipient bank
    recipient_code: 12345678                # Recipient code (EDRPOU)
  )
  
  # Generate and display QR data
  puts "Generated QR data:"
  puts generator.generate_qr_string
  puts
  
  # Save QR code to file
  generator.save_qr_to_file("payment_qr.png")
  puts "QR code saved to payment_qr.png"
  
  # Generate and display image (in a real application, you'd display this in a browser)
  puts "QR code generated successfully!"
end
```

## Usage Instructions

1. First, install the required gems:
```bash
bundle install
```

2. Run the script:
```bash
ruby payment_qr_generator.rb
```

3. The script will:
   - Generate a QR code for a Ukrainian bank transfer
   - Save it as "payment_qr.png"
   - Print the QR data to the console

## Features

- Implements the NBU (National Bank of Ukraine) QR payment standard
- Validates all required fields according to the standard
- Generates QR codes in PNG format
- Includes basic validation for IBAN, amount, currency, and recipient code
- Supports both payment and payment request types
- Follows the standard format with field identifiers

## Standard Format

The generated QR code data follows the NBU standard with fields:
- Field 1: Payment type (1 for payment, 2 for payment request)
- Field 2: Amount
- Field 3: Currency (980 for UAH)
- Field 4: Payment purpose
- Field 5: Recipient name
- Field 6: Recipient IBAN
- Field 7: Recipient bank
- Field 8: Recipient code (EDRPOU)

The QR code can be scanned by Ukrainian banking apps to initiate transfers.

```ruby
      }

      raise "Failed to check status: #{response.body}"

  end
```

```ruby
class EasyPayService
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api = EasyPayAPI.new(api_key)
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new('easypay_payments.db')
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    @db.execute <<-SQL
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipts (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER,
        payment_type TEXT,
        amount DECIMAL(10,2),
        status TEXT,
        response_data TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      );
    SQL
  end

  def pay_service(user_id, payment_type, amount, account_number)
    begin
      # Викликаємо API для оплати
      response = @api.pay_communal_service(user_id, payment_type, amount, account_number)
      
      # Зберігаємо квитанцію в БД
      receipt_data = {
        user_id: user_id,
        payment_type: payment_type,
        amount: amount,
        status: response[:status],
        response_data: response.to_json
      }
      
      # Зберігаємо в БД
      @db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO receipts (user_id, payment_type, amount, status, response_data) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        [user_id, payment_type, amount, response[:status], response.to_json]
      )
      
      puts "Успішно оплачено #{payment_type} на суму #{amount} для користувача #{user_id}"
      puts "ID транзакції: #{response[:transaction_id]}"

      raise
    end
  end

  def get_receipts(user_id)
    # Отримуємо всі квитанції для користувача
    results = @db.execute("SELECT * FROM receipts WHERE user_id = ?", [user_id])
    
    receipts = []
    results.each do |row|
      receipts << {
        id: row[0],
        user_id: row[1],
        payment_type: row[2],
        amount: row[3],
        status: row[4],
        response_data: row[5],
        created_at: row[6]
      }
    end
    
    receipts
  end
```

## 🧰 3. Синхронізаційна задача (Worker)

```ruby
# app/workers/shopify_sync_worker.rb

class ShopifySyncWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform
    client = ShopifyAPI::Session.temp(
      shop: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:shop],
      token: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:access_token]
    )

    ShopifyAPI::Base.activate_session(client)

    sync_products_and_inventory
  end

  private

  def sync_products_and_inventory
    products = ShopifyAPI::Product.all

    products.each do |shopify_product|
      product = Product.find_or_create_by(shopify_id: shopify_product.id) do |p|
        p.title = shopify_product.title
        p.description = shopify_product.body_html
      end

      # Перевіряємо, чи є відповідні inventory levels
      shopify_product.variants.each do |variant|
        inventory_level = ShopifyAPI::InventoryLevel.find(
          inventory_item_id: variant.inventory_item_id,
          location_id: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:location_id]
        )

        InventoryLevel.find_or_create_by(shopify_id: inventory_level.id) do |il|
          il.product = product
          il.available = inventory_level.available || 0
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
UPS_USER_ID = 'your_user_id'
UPS_PASSWORD = 'your_password'

ups = UPS::API.new(
  access_key: UPS_ACCESS_KEY,
  user_id: UPS_USER_ID,
  password: UPS_PASSWORD,
  test: true # Встановіть на false для реальних запитів
)

# Функція для отримання тарифів доставки
def get_shipping_rates(ups, weight, dimensions, origin, destination)
  begin
    response = ups.rate(
      weight: weight,
      dimensions: dimensions,
      origin: origin,
      destination: destination
    )
    puts JSON.pretty_generate(response)
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

# EasyPay Utility Bill Payment System

I'll create a Ruby solution for paying utility bills through the EasyPay API with receipt storage functionality.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'        # For making HTTP requests to the API
gem 'json'            # For JSON parsing
gem 'sqlite3'         # For storing receipts in a local database
gem 'activerecord'    # For ORM to manage receipt data
gem 'dotenv'          # For managing environment variables
gem 'pry'             # For debugging (optional)
```

## Implementation

### 1. Main Application Class

```ruby
# lib/easypay_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'active_record'
require 'logger'

class EasyPayClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.easypay.com/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key, logger = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    
    # Configure HTTParty
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end

  def pay_utility_bill(bill_params)
    @logger.info("Attempting to pay bill: #{bill_params[:bill_id]}")
    
    request_body = {
      bill_id: bill_params[:bill_id],
      amount: bill_params[:amount],
      user_id: bill_params[:user_id],
      account_number: bill_params[:account_number],
      payment_method: bill_params[:payment_method] || 'card'
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      '/payments',
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: request_body.to_json
    )

    case response.code
    when 200..201
      @logger.info("Bill payment successful: #{response['payment_id']}")
      {
        success: true,
        payment_id: response['payment_id'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        status: response['status'],
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        receipt_url: response['receipt_url']
      }
    when 400
      @logger.error("Bad request: #{response['error']}")
      { success: false, error: response['error'] }
    when 401
      @logger.error("Unauthorized access")
      { success: false, error: "Unauthorized access - invalid API key" }
    when 404
      @logger.error("Bill not found")
      { success: false, error: "Bill not found" }
    else
      @logger.error("Payment failed with status: #{response.code}")
      { success: false, error: "Payment failed with status: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end

  def get_bill_details(bill_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching bill details for: #{bill_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/bills/#{bill_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    )

    case response.code
    when 200
      {
        success: true,
        bill: response.parsed_response
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Failed to fetch bill details: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  end

  def get_user_bills(user_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching bills for user: #{user_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/users/#{user_id}/bills",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    )

    case response.code
    when 200
      {
        success: true,
        bills: response.parsed_response['bills']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Failed to fetch user bills: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. Receipt Storage System

```ruby
# lib/receipt_storage.rb
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'

class Receipt < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'receipts'
  
  validates :payment_id, presence: true
  validates :user_id, presence: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
  validates :bill_id, presence: true
end

class ReceiptStorage
  def initialize(database_path = 'receipts.db')
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: database_path
    )
    
    create_table if !ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?('receipts')
  end

  def create_table
    ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :receipts do |t|
      t.string :payment_id, null: false
      t.string :user_id, null: false
      t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2, null: false
      t.string :bill_id, null: false
      t.string :status
      t.string :transaction_id
      t.string :receipt_url
      t.datetime :payment_date, null: false
      t.text :payment_details
      t.timestamps
    end
    
    # Add indexes for better performance
    ActiveRecord::Base.connection.add_index :receipts, :payment_id, unique: true
    ActiveRecord::Base.connection.add_index :receipts, :user_id
    ActiveRecord::Base.connection.add_index :receipts, :bill_id
  end

  def store_receipt(payment_data)
    receipt = Receipt.find_or_initialize_by(payment_id: payment_data[:payment_id])
    
    receipt.update!(
      user_id: payment_data[:user_id],
      amount: payment_data[:amount],
      bill_id: payment_data[:bill_id],
      status: payment_data[:status],
      transaction_id: payment_data[:transaction_id],
      receipt_url: payment_data[:receipt_url],
      payment_date: Time.current,
      payment_details: payment_data[:details].to_json
    )
    
    receipt
  end

  def find_receipt(payment_id)
    Receipt.find_by(payment_id: payment_id)
  end

  def find_user_receipts(user_id)
    Receipt.where(user_id: user_id).order(created_at: :desc)
  end

  def find_receipts_by_date_range(start_date, end_date)
    Receipt.where(created_at: start_date..end_date)
  end
end
```

### 3. Main Utility Bill Payment Service

```ruby
# lib/utility_bill_service.rb
require_relative 'easypay_client'
require_relative 'receipt_storage'

class UtilityBillService
  def initialize(api_key, db_path = 'receipts.db')
    @easypay_client = EasyPayClient.new(api_key)
    @receipt_storage = ReceiptStorage.new(db_path)
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end

  def pay_bill(bill_id, amount, user_id, account_number, payment_method: 'card')
    @logger.info("Starting bill payment process")
    
    # First, get bill details to validate
    bill_result = @easypay_client.get_bill_details(bill_id)
    if !bill_result[:success]
      @logger.error("Failed to get bill details: #{bill_result[:error]}")
      return { success: false, error: bill_result[:error] }
    end
    
    # Prepare the payment data
    payment_params = {
      bill_id: bill_id,
      amount: amount,
      user_id: user_id,
      account_number: account_number,
      payment_method: payment_method
    }
    
    # Process the payment
    payment_result = @easypay_client.pay_utility_bill(payment_params)
    
    if payment_result[:success]
      # Store the receipt
      receipt_data = {
        payment_id: payment_result[:payment_id],
        user_id: user_id,
        amount: payment_result[:amount],
        bill_id: bill_id,
        status: payment_result[:status],
        transaction_id: payment_result[:transaction_id],
        receipt_url: payment_result[:receipt_url],
        details: {
          bill_details: bill_result[:bill],
          payment_params: payment_params
        }
      }
      
      receipt = @receipt_storage.store_receipt(receipt_data)
      
      @logger.info("Payment successful and receipt stored")
      {
        success: true,
        payment_id: payment_result[:payment_id],
        receipt_id: receipt.id,
        amount: payment_result[:amount],
        status: payment_result[:status],
        transaction_id: payment_result[:transaction_id]
      }
    else
      @logger.error("Payment failed: #{payment_result[:error]}")
      payment_result
    end
  end

  def get_user_bills(user_id)
    @easypay_client.get_user_bills(user_id)
  end

  def get_payment_receipt(payment_id)
    @receipt_storage.find_receipt(payment_id)
  end

  def get_user_receipts(user_id)
    @receipt_storage.find_user_receipts(user_id)
  end

  def get_receipts_by_date_range(start_date, end_date)
    @receipt_storage.find_receipts_by_date_range(start_date, end_date)
  end
end
```

# Рішення для видачі фіскального чека через API Checkbox після онлайн-оплати

Ось повне рішення для видачі фіскального чека через API програмного РРО Checkbox після онлайн-оплати.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'dotenv'
gem 'logger'
```

## app.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Конфігурація логування
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

class CheckboxAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  # Налаштування для HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.checkbox.com'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key, shop_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_id = shop_id
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  # Створення чека
  def create_receipt(receipt_data)
    logger.info("Створення чека для оплати: #{receipt_data[:order_id]}")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v1/receipts",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'X-Shop-Id' => @shop_id
      },
      body: receipt_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      logger.info("Чек успішно створено: #{response['id']}")
      response.parsed_response
    else
      logger.error("Помилка створення чека: #{response.body}")
      raise "Помилка створення чека: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Отримання статусу чека
  def get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
    logger.info("Отримання статусу чека: #{receipt_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/v1/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'X-Shop-Id' => @shop_id
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      logger.info("Статус чека отримано")
      response.parsed_response
    else
      logger.error("Помилка отримання статусу чека: #{response.body}")
      raise "Помилка отримання статусу чека: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Завантаження чека на фіскальний накопичувач
  def submit_receipt(receipt_id)
    logger.info("Відправка чека на фіскальний накопичувач: #{receipt_id}")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v1/receipts/#{receipt_id}/submit",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'X-Shop-Id' => @shop_id
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      logger.info("Чек успішно відправлений")
      response.parsed_response
    else
      logger.error("Помилка відправки чека: #{response.body}")
      raise "Помилка відправки чека: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

class PaymentProcessor
  def initialize(checkbox_api)
    @checkbox_api = checkbox_api
  end
  
  # Обробка онлайн-оплати і видача чека
  def process_payment(payment_data)
    logger.info("Обробка онлайн-оплати #{payment_data[:order_id]}")
    
    # Визначення типу оплати
    payment_method = case payment_data[:payment_method]
                     when 'card'
                       'card'
                     when 'cash'
                       'cash'
                     else
                       'unknown'
                     end
    
    # Формування даних для чека
    receipt_data = {
      order_id: payment_data[:order_id],
      items: payment_data[:items],
      total: payment_data[:total],
      payment_method: payment_method,
      customer: payment_data[:customer],
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601,
      shop_id: @checkbox_api.instance_variable_get(:@shop_id)
    }
    
    begin
      # Створення чека
      receipt = @checkbox_api.create_receipt(receipt_data)
      receipt_id = receipt['id']
      
      # Відправка чека на фіскальний накопичувач
      submitted_receipt = @checkbox_api.submit_receipt(receipt_id)
      
      # Перевірка статусу
      status = @checkbox_api.get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
      
      logger.info("Оплата #{payment_data[:order_id]} успішно оброблена")
      {
        success: true,
        receipt_id: receipt_id,
        status: status,
        submitted: submitted_receipt
      }
      
    rescue => e
      logger.error("Помилка обробки оплати: #{e.message}")
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Завантаження змінних оточення
  api_key = ENV['CHECKBOX_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key_here'
  shop_id = ENV['CHECKBOX_SHOP_ID'] || 'your_shop_id_here'
  
  # Ініціалізація API
  checkbox_api = CheckboxAPI.new(api_key, shop_id)
  
  # Приклад даних оплати
  payment_data = {
    order_id: 'ORD-12345',
    items: [
      {
        name: 'Товар 1',
        price: 100.0,
        quantity: 2,
        vat_rate: '20%'
      },
      {
        name: 'Товар 2',
        price: 50.0,
        quantity: 1,
        vat_rate: '20%'
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class CheckboxAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  # Налаштування для HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.checkbox.com'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key, shop_id)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_id = shop_id
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  # Створення чека
  def create_receipt(receipt_data)
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v1/receipts",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'X-Shop-Id' => @shop_id
      },
      body: receipt_data.to_json
    )
    
    process_response(response, 'створення чека')
  end
  
  # Отримання статусу чека
  def get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/v1/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'X-Shop-Id' => @shop_id
      }
    )
    
    process_response(response, 'отримання статусу чека')
  end
  
  # Завантаження чека на фіскальний накопичувач
  def submit_receipt(receipt_id)
    response = self.class.post(
      "/v1/receipts/#{receipt_id}/submit",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'X-Shop-Id' => @shop_id
      }
    )
    
    process_response(response, 'відправки чека')
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_response(response, operation)
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      error_msg = "Помилка #{operation}: #{response.body}"
      raise error_msg
    end
  end
end

class ReceiptProcessor
  def initialize(api_client)
    @api_client = api_client
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  def process_payment(payment_data)
    @logger.info("Обробка онлайн-оплати #{payment_data[:order_id]}")
    
    receipt_data = build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    
    begin
      # Створення чека
      receipt = @api_client.create_receipt(receipt_data)
      receipt_id = receipt['id']
      
      # Відправка чека
      @api_client.submit_receipt(receipt_id)
      
      # Отримання статусу
      status = @api_client.get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
      
      @logger.info("Оплата #{payment_data[:order_id]} успішно оброблена")
      
      {
        success: true,
        receipt_id: receipt_id,
        status: status,
        timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
      }
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Помилка обробки оплати: #{e.message}")
      
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message,
        timestamp: Time.now.iso8601
      }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    {
      order_id: payment_data[:order_id],
      items: payment_data[:items],
      total: payment_data[:total],
      payment_method: payment_data[:payment_method],
      customer: payment_data[:customer],
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601,
      shop_id: @api_client.instance_variable_get(:@shop_id)
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
  # Payout to Ukrainian card using LiqPay P2P API
  def payout_to_card(amount, card_number, recipient_name, description = nil)
    begin
      # Validate inputs
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be positive" if amount <= 0
      raise ArgumentError, "Card number must be provided" if card_number.nil? || card_number.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Recipient name must be provided" if recipient_name.nil? || recipient_name.empty?

      # Prepare parameters for API call
      params = {
        action: 'p2p',
        amount: amount,
        currency: 'UAH',
        card: card_number,
        description: description || "Payout to Ukrainian card",
        version: '3',
        public_key: @public_key
      }

      # Make the API request
      response = @liqpay.api('request', params)

      # Check if the request was successful
      if response['error']
        raise StandardError, "LiqPay API Error: #{response['error']}"
      end

      # Return transaction details
      {
        success: true,
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        status: response['status'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        description: response['description']
      }

    rescue => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  # Alternative implementation with more detailed error handling
  def payout_to_card_detailed(amount, card_number, recipient_name, description = nil)
    # Validate card number format (simplified)
    unless card_number.match?(/^\d{16}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid card number format. Should be 16 digits."
    end

    # Validate amount
    unless amount.is_a?(Numeric) && amount > 0
      raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be a positive number"
    end

    # Prepare API parameters
    params = {
      action: 'p2p',
      amount: amount,
      currency: 'UAH',
      card: card_number,
      description: description || "Payout to Ukrainian card",
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key
    }

    # Add additional parameters if needed
    params[:recipient_name] = recipient_name if recipient_name

    # Sign the request
    signed_params = @liqpay.sign_params(params)

    # Make API request
    response = @liqpay.api('request', signed_params)

    # Handle response
    case response['status']
    when 'success'
      {
        success: true,
        transaction_id: response['transaction_id'],
        amount: response['amount'],
        currency: response['currency'],
        status: response['status'],
        description: response['description'],
        timestamp: response['date']
      }
    when 'failure'
      {
        success: false,
        error_code: response['error_code'],
        error_message: response['error'],
        error_details: response['error_details']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected response status: #{response['status']}"
      }
    end
  end

  # Get transaction status
  def get_transaction_status(transaction_id)
    params = {
      action: 'status',
      transaction_id: transaction_id,
      version: '3',
      public_key: @public_key
    }

      }
    else

        error: response['error']
      }
    end
  end
```

```ruby
require 'csv'
require 'money'
require 'active_support/core_ext/numeric/conversion'
require 'date'

class Transaction
  include Comparable
  
  attr_reader :date, :description, :amount, :currency, :balance, :category
  
  def initialize(data)
    @date = Date.parse(data[:date])
    @description = data[:description]
    @amount = Money.new(data[:amount].to_f * 100, data[:currency])
    @currency = data[:currency]
    @balance = Money.new(data[:balance].to_f * 100, data[:currency])
    @category = data[:category] || categorize
    @original_data = data
  end
  
  def to_s
    "#{@date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} | #{@description} | #{@amount.format} | #{@category}"
  end
  
  def to_hash
    {
      date: @date,
      description: @description,
      amount: @amount,
      currency: @currency,
      balance: @balance,
      category: @category
    }
  end
  
  def amount_value
    @amount.cents / 100.0
  end
  
  def <=>(other)
    @date <=> other.date
  end
  
  private
  
  def categorize
    # Define category rules based on keywords in description
    rules = {
      'salary' => 'Income',
      'зарплата' => 'Income',
      'премія' => 'Income',
      'депозит' => 'Income',
      'transfer' => 'Transfer',
      'переказ' => 'Transfer',
      'оплата' => 'Payments',
      'платіж' => 'Payments',
      'кредит' => 'Payments',
      'комісія' => 'Fees',
      'відсотки' => 'Interest',
      'обмін' => 'Exchange',
      'кінотеатр' => 'Entertainment',
      'кино' => 'Entertainment',
      'кафе' => 'Food',
      'ресторан' => 'Food',
      'магазин' => 'Shopping',
      'продукти' => 'Food',
      'покупка' => 'Shopping',
      'авто' => 'Transport',
      'таксі' => 'Transport',
      'бензин' => 'Transport',
      'транспорт' => 'Transport',
      'одяг' => 'Shopping',
      'книга' => 'Shopping',
      'інтернет' => 'Utilities',
      'wifi' => 'Utilities',
      'інтернет' => 'Utilities',
      'мобільний' => 'Utilities',
      'зв\'язок' => 'Utilities',
      'електро' => 'Utilities',
      'газ' => 'Utilities',
      'вода' => 'Utilities',
      'відпочинок' => 'Entertainment',
      'мотель' => 'Travel',
      'відель' => 'Travel',
      'авіабілет' => 'Travel',
      'білет' => 'Travel',
      'готель' => 'Travel'
    }
    
    description_lowercase = @description.downcase
    
    # Check for matches
    rules.each do |keyword, category|
      return category if description_lowercase.include?(keyword)
    end
    
    # Default categories
    if @amount.cents < 0
      'Expenses'
    else
      'Income'
    end
  end
end
```
