### lib/bank_statement_importer.rb
```ruby
require 'csv'
require 'date'
require_relative 'transaction'

class BankStatementImporter
  def initialize(file_path)
    @file_path = file_path
    @transactions = []
  end
  
  def import
    validate_file!
    
    CSV.foreach(@file_path, col_sep: ';', headers: true) do |row|
      # Skip empty rows
      next if row.to_h.values.all?(&:blank?)
      
      # Parse transaction data
      transaction = parse_transaction(row)
      @transactions << transaction if transaction
    end
    
    @transactions.sort!
  end
  
  def transactions
    @transactions
  end
  
  def total_income
    @transactions.select { |t| t.amount_value > 0 }.sum(&:amount_value)
  end
  
  def total_expenses
    @transactions.select { |t| t.amount_value < 0 }.sum(&:amount_value).abs
  end
  
  def balance_at_date(date)
    @transactions.select { |t| t.date <= date }.last&.balance || Money.new(0, 'UAH')
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_file!
    raise "File not found: #{@file_path}" unless File.exist?(@file_path)
    
    # Check if file is readable
    File.open(@file_path, 'r') { |f| f.read(1) }
  rescue => e
    raise "Cannot read file: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  def parse_transaction(row)
    # Handle different PrivatBank CSV formats
    begin
      data = {
        date: row['Дата'],
        description: row['Опис'],
        amount: row['Сума'],
        currency: row['Валюта'],
        balance: row['Баланс']
      }
      
      # Validate required fields
      return nil if data.values.any?(&:nil?)
      
      # Convert amount to numeric
      data[:amount] = data[:amount].gsub(',', '.')
      data[:balance] = data[:balance].gsub(',', '.')
      
      # Handle empty currency
      data[:currency] = 'UAH' if data[:currency].nil? || data[:currency].strip.empty?
      
      Transaction.new(data)
    rescue => e
      puts "Warning: Could not parse transaction: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'terminal-table'

class CategoryReport
  def initialize(transactions)
    @transactions = transactions
  end
  
  def generate
    puts "\n=== Transaction Categories Summary ==="
    
    categories = {}
    @transactions.each do |transaction|
      category = transaction.category
      categories[category] ||= { count: 0, total: 0.0 }
      categories[category][:count] += 1
      categories[category][:total] += transaction.amount_value
    end
    
    table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
      t.headings = ['Category', 'Count', 'Total Amount']
      t.rows = categories.map do |category, stats|
        [
          category,
          stats[:count],
          format("%.2f", stats[:total])
        ]
      end.sort_by { |row| -row[2].to_f }
      
      # Add total row
      total_transactions = @transactions.length
      total_amount = @transactions.sum(&:amount_value)
      t.add_row ['Total', total_transactions, format("%.2f", total_amount)]
    end
    
    puts table
  end
  
  def generate_detailed
    puts "\n=== Detailed Transactions by Category ==="
    
    # Group transactions by category
    categories = @transactions.group_by(&:category)
    
    categories.sort.each do |category, transactions|
      puts "\n#{category}:"
      transactions.each do |transaction|
        puts "  #{transaction.date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} - #{transaction.description} (#{transaction.amount.format})"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
  # Встановлюємо базову URL для API DHL (приклад)
  base_uri 'https://www.dhl.com'

  def initialize
    # Можна додати авторизацію, якщо потрібно
  end

  # Метод для відстеження посилки за номером
  def track_shipment(tracking_number)
    # Використовуємо реальний API або веб-скрапінг, залежно від доступності
    # Це приклад з використанням веб-скрапінгу (в реальному випадку потрібно звертатися до офіційного API)
    url = "https://www.dhl.com/en/shipmentTracking?AWB=#{tracking_number}"

    begin
      response = self.class.get(url)
      parse_tracking_data(response.body)
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні даних: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  # Парсинг даних із відповіді (приклад для веб-скрапінгу)
  def parse_tracking_data(html)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(html)
    events = []

    # Простий приклад: знаходження елементів із інформацією про посылку
    # У реальній реалізації потрібно використовувати конкретні селектори
    doc.css('.tracking-event').each do |event|
      events << {
        date: event.css('.date').text.strip,
        location: event.css('.location').text.strip,
        status: event.css('.status').text.strip,
        description: event.css('.description').text.strip
      }
    end

    events
  end
end

# Приклад використання

  tracker = DHLTracker.new
  tracking_number = "YOUR_TRACKING_NUMBER"  # Замініть на справжній номер

  events = tracker.track_shipment(tracking_number)

  if events && !events.empty?
    puts "Події доставки для посилки #{tracking_number}:"
    events.each do |event|
      puts "Дата: #{event[:date]}"
      puts "Місце: #{event[:location]}"
      puts "Статус: #{event[:status]}"
      puts "Опис: #{event[:description]}"
      puts "-" * 40
    end
  else
    puts "Не вдалося отримати дані про доставку."
  end
end
```

```ruby
# main.rb
require 'bundler/setup'
require 'faraday'
require 'aws/sigv4'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_record'

require_relative 'models/order'

# Завантаження змінних оточення
ACCESS_KEY = ENV['ACCESS_KEY']
SECRET_KEY = ENV['SECRET_KEY']
SELLER_ID = ENV['SELLER_ID']
MERCHANT_ID = ENV['MERCHANT_ID']
REGION = ENV['REGION'] || 'eu-west-1'
ENDPOINT = "https://sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com"

# Функція для отримання токена доступу
def get_access_token
  # У цьому прикладі використовується статичний токен — у реальному коді потрібно реалізувати логіку оновлення токенів
  ENV['ACCESS_TOKEN']
end

# Функція для отримання замовлень через SP-API
def fetch_orders
  token = get_access_token
  url = "#{ENDPOINT}/orders/v0/orders"

  # Налаштування HTTP-запиту
  conn = Faraday.new(url: url) do |f|
    f.request :url_encoded
    f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
  end

  headers = {
    'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
    'x-amz-access-token' => token,
    'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    'Accept' => 'application/json'
  }

  response = conn.get do |req|
    req.headers.merge!(headers)
    req.params['createdAfter'] = 1.hour.ago.iso8601
  end

  JSON.parse(response.body)
end

# Функція збереження замовлення
def save_order(order_data)
  order = Order.find_or_create_by(amazon_order_id: order_data['AmazonOrderId'])
  order.update!(
    order_status: order_data['OrderStatus'],
    order_data: order_data.to_json,
    created_at: Time.current
  )
  puts "Saved order: #{order.amazon_order_id}"
end

# Основна програма
def main
  orders_response = fetch_orders

  orders_response['payload']['Orders'].each do |order|
    save_order(order)
  end
end

main if __FILE__ == $0
```

```ruby
require 'ebay_api'
require 'logger'
require 'active_record'

# Налаштування логування
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Налаштування бази даних (для прикладу - SQLite)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'products.db'
)

# Модель Product (відповідає таблиці в БД)
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :quantity, presence: true
end

# Клас для взаємодії з eBay API
class eBaySync
  def initialize
    # Тут використовуємо приклади налаштувань для eBay API
    @api = eBay::API.new(
      app_id: ENV['EBAY_APP_ID'],
      dev_id: ENV['EBAY_DEV_ID'],
      cert_id: ENV['EBAY_CERT_ID'],
      site_id: '0'  # US site
    )
  end

  def list_product(product)
    begin
      response = @api.add_item(
        title: product.name,
        quantity: product.quantity,
        # інші параметри
      )
      logger.info "Product #{product.name} listed on eBay with ItemID: #{response.item_id}"
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Failed to list product #{product.name}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def update_quantity(product)
    begin
      # Передбачаємо, що у нас є ItemID, який зберігається в БД
      response = @api.revise_item(
        item_id: product.ebay_item_id,
        quantity: product.quantity
      )
      logger.info "Quantity for #{product.name} updated on eBay"
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Failed to update quantity for #{product.name}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

# Основна логіка
def sync_products
  ebay_sync = eBaySync.new

  Product.all.each do |product|
    if product.ebay_item_id.nil?
      # Якщо товар ще не виставлений на eBay
      ebay_sync.list_product(product)
    else
      # Якщо вже виставлено, оновлюємо кількість
      ebay_sync.update_quantity(product)
    end
  end
end

# Запуск синхронізації
sync_products
```

**app/jobs/shopify_sync_job.rb**
```ruby
class ShopifySyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform
    sync_shopify_products
    sync_shopify_inventory
  end
  
  private
  
  def sync_shopify_products
    shopify_session = ShopifyAPI::Session.new(
      shop: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:shop],
      access_token: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:access_token]
    )
    
    ShopifyAPI::Base.activate_session(shopify_session)
    
    # Fetch all products
    products = ShopifyAPI::Product.all(limit: 250)
    products = products.concat(fetch_all_products) if products.length == 250
    
    products.each do |product|
      sync_product(product)
    end
    
    Rails.logger.info "Synced #{products.length} products from Shopify"
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error syncing Shopify products: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end
  
  def sync_shopify_inventory
    shopify_session = ShopifyAPI::Session.new(
      shop: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:shop],
      access_token: Rails.application.credentials.shopify[:access_token]
    )
    
    ShopifyAPI::Base.activate_session(shopify_session)
    
    # Fetch all inventory levels
    inventory_levels = ShopifyAPI::InventoryLevel.all(limit: 250)
    inventory_levels = inventory_levels.concat(fetch_all_inventory_levels) if inventory_levels.length == 250
    
    inventory_levels.each do |level|
      sync_inventory_level(level)
    end
    
    Rails.logger.info "Synced #{inventory_levels.length} inventory levels from Shopify"
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error syncing Shopify inventory: #{e.message}"
    raise
  end
  
  def sync_product(product_data)
    product = ShopifyProduct.find_or_initialize_by(shopify_id: product_data.id)
    
    product.update!(
      title: product_data.title,
      description: product_data.body_html,
      vendor: product_data.vendor,
      product_type: product_data.product_type,
      handle: product_data.handle,
      published_at: product_data.published_at,
      active: product_data.status == 'active',
      updated_at: Time.current
    )
    
    # Sync variants (inventory details)
    product_data.variants.each do |variant|
      sync_product_variant(variant, product)
    end
  end
  
  def sync_product_variant(variant_data, product)
    # Create or update inventory level for this variant
    inventory_level = ShopifyInventoryLevel.find_or_initialize_by(
      inventory_item_id: variant_data.inventory_item_id,
      shopify_product_id: product.id
    )
    
    inventory_level.update!(
      available: variant_data.inventory_quantity,
      updated_at: Time.current
    )
  end
  
  def sync_inventory_level(inventory_level_data)
    product = ShopifyProduct.find_by(shopify_id: inventory_level_data.product_id)
    
    return unless product
    
    inventory_level = ShopifyInventoryLevel.find_or_initialize_by(
      inventory_item_id: inventory_level_data.inventory_item_id,
      shopify_product_id: product.id
    )
    
    inventory_level.update!(
      available: inventory_level_data.available,
      updated_at: Time.current
    )
  end
  
  def fetch_all_products
    products = []
    page = 1
    
    loop do
      page_products = ShopifyAPI::Product.all(limit: 250, page: page)
      products.concat(page_products)
      
      break if page_products.length < 250
      page += 1
    end
    
    products
  end
  
  def fetch_all_inventory_levels
    inventory_levels = []
    page = 1
    
    loop do
      page_inventory_levels = ShopifyAPI::InventoryLevel.all(limit: 250, page: page)
      inventory_levels.concat(page_inventory_levels)
      
      break if page_inventory_levels.length < 250
      page += 1
    end
    
    inventory_levels
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'easypost'

class ShippingRateComparator
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    EasyPost.api_key = api_key
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  # Set up sender and recipient addresses
  def setup_addresses
    # Sender address (you'll need to customize this)
    @from_address = {
      name: "Your Company",
      street1: "123 Main St",
      city: "San Francisco",
      state: "CA",
      zip: "94105",
      country: "US",
      phone: "415-555-1234"
    }

    # Recipient address (you'll need to customize this)
    @to_address = {
      name: "Recipient Name",
      street1: "456 Oak Ave",
      city: "Los Angeles",
      state: "CA",
      zip: "90210",
      country: "US",
      phone: "310-555-9876"
    }
  end

  # Create EasyPost addresses
  def create_addresses
    begin
      @from_address_obj = EasyPost::Address.create(@from_address)
      @to_address_obj = EasyPost::Address.create(@to_address)
      @logger.info("Addresses created successfully")
    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      @logger.error("Error creating addresses: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  # Define packages for shipping
  def setup_packages
    @packages = [
      {
        weight: 10.5, # in ounces
        length: 10,   # in inches
        width: 8,     # in inches
        height: 6     # in inches
      }
    ]
  end

  # Compare shipping rates from different carriers
  def compare_rates
    @logger.info("Comparing shipping rates...")
    
    # Create a shipment object
    shipment_data = {
      from_address: @from_address_obj,
      to_address: @to_address_obj,
      parcels: @packages
    }

    begin
      shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.create(shipment_data)
      @logger.info("Shipment created successfully")
      
      # Get rates for each carrier
      rates = shipment.rates
      
      if rates.empty?
        @logger.error("No rates found for this shipment")
        return nil
      end
      
      # Display all rates
      @logger.info("Available shipping rates:")
      rates.each do |rate|
        @logger.info("- #{rate.carrier}: $#{rate.rate} (#{rate.service})")
      end
      
      # Find the cheapest rate
      cheapest_rate = rates.min_by(&:rate)
      
      @logger.info("Cheapest rate found: #{cheapest_rate.carrier} - $#{cheapest_rate.rate} (#{cheapest_rate.service})")
      
      return cheapest_rate
    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      @logger.error("Error comparing rates: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  # Purchase the cheapest shipping label
  def purchase_label(cheapest_rate)
    @logger.info("Purchasing label...")
    
    begin
      # Purchase the shipping label
      shipment = EasyPost::Shipment.retrieve(cheapest_rate.shipment_id)
      purchased_shipment = shipment.buy(rate: cheapest_rate)
      
      @logger.info("Label purchased successfully!")
      @logger.info("Tracking Number: #{purchased_shipment.tracking_code}")
      @logger.info("Label URL: #{purchased_shipment.postage_label.label_url}")
      
      return purchased_shipment
    rescue EasyPost::Error => e
      @logger.error("Error purchasing label: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  # Main method to run the comparison and purchase
  def run
    begin
      setup_addresses
      create_addresses
      setup_packages
      
      cheapest_rate = compare_rates
      return nil unless cheapest_rate
      
      purchased_shipment = purchase_label(cheapest_rate)
      
      puts "\n=== SHIPMENT SUMMARY ==="
      puts "Carrier: #{cheapest_rate.carrier}"
      puts "Service: #{cheapest_rate.service}"
      puts "Cost: $#{cheapest_rate.rate}"
      puts "Tracking Number: #{purchased_shipment.tracking_code}"
      puts "Label URL: #{purchased_shipment.postage_label.label_url}"
      
      return purchased_shipment
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error in main process: #{e.message}")
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# ipay_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'digest'

class IPayClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key, sandbox: false)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @base_url = sandbox ? 'https://api.sandbox.ipay.ua' : 'https://api.ipay.ua'
    @api_version = 'v1'
  end
  
  # Create a new payment
  def create_payment(amount, currency = 'UAH', description = '', 
                     success_url = '', fail_url = '', 
                     customer_email = '', customer_phone = '', 
                     custom_params = {})
    
    # Generate unique order ID
    order_id = generate_order_id
    
    # Prepare request data
    data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: order_id,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: description,
      success_url: success_url,
      fail_url: fail_url,
      customer_email: customer_email,
      customer_phone: customer_phone,
      custom_params: custom_params
    }.compact
    
    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data)
    data[:signature] = signature
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/#{@api_version}/payment", 
                              body: data.to_json,
                              headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check transaction status by ID
  def check_transaction_status(transaction_id)
    # Prepare request data
    data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      transaction_id: transaction_id
    }
    
    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data)
    data[:signature] = signature
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/#{@api_version}/payment/status", 
                              body: data.to_json,
                              headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get transaction details
  def get_transaction_details(transaction_id)
    # Prepare request data
    data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      transaction_id: transaction_id
    }
    
    # Generate signature
    signature = generate_signature(data)
    data[:signature] = signature
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/#{@api_version}/payment/detail", 
                              body: data.to_json,
                              headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Verify webhook signature (for callback verification)
  def verify_webhook_signature(data, received_signature)
    expected_signature = generate_signature(data)
    expected_signature == received_signature
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_order_id
    # Generate a unique order ID
    "#{Time.now.to_i}_#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end
  
  def generate_signature(data)
    # Sort the data by keys
    sorted_data = data.sort_by { |k, v| k.to_s }
    
    # Create string to hash
    string_to_hash = sorted_data.map do |key, value|
      if value.is_a?(Hash) || value.is_a?(Array)
        "#{key}=#{value.to_json}"
      else
        "#{key}=#{value}"
      end
    end.join('&')
    
    # Add secret key to the end
    string_to_hash += "&#{@secret_key}"
    
    # Generate SHA256 hash
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(string_to_hash)
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      begin
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        { error: 'Invalid JSON response', raw_response: response.body }
      end
    when 400
      { error: 'Bad Request', message: response.body }
    when 401
      { error: 'Unauthorized', message: response.body }
    when 404
      { error: 'Not Found', message: response.body }
    when 500
      { error: 'Internal Server Error', message: response.body }
    else
      { error: "HTTP Error #{response.code}", message: response.body }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'ipay_client'

class IPayWebhookHandler
  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key)
    @client = IPayClient.new(merchant_id, secret_key)
  end
  
  def handle_webhook(request_body)
    begin
      data = JSON.parse(request_body)
      
      # Verify signature
      signature = data['signature']
      data.delete('signature') # Remove signature for verification
      
      if @client.verify_webhook_signature(data, signature)
        # Process the webhook
        process_webhook_data(data)
      else
        { error: 'Invalid signature' }
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      { error: 'Invalid JSON in webhook data' }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_webhook_data(data)
    transaction_id = data['transaction_id']
    status = data['status']
    amount = data['amount']
    currency = data['currency']
    
    # Process based on status
    case status
    when 'success'
      # Payment successful - update database, send confirmation, etc.
      {
        status: 'processed',
        message: "Payment successful for transaction #{transaction_id}",
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency
      }
    when 'failed'
      # Payment failed - handle accordingly
      {
        status: 'failed',
        message: "Payment failed for transaction #{transaction_id}",
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency
      }
    when 'pending'
      # Payment pending
      {
        status: 'pending',
        message: "Payment pending for transaction #{transaction_id}",
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency
      }
    else
      {
        status: 'unknown',
        message: "Unknown status #{status} for transaction #{transaction_id}"
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    @use_test_server = use_test_server
    
    # Setup logger
    @logger = Logger.new('fedex_shipment.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    # Initialize FedEx client
    @fedex = Fedex::Client.new(
      key: @api_key,
      password: @password,
      account_number: @account_number,
      meter_number: @meter_number,
      use_test_server: @use_test_server
    )
  end

  def create_shipment(origin, destination, package_details)
    begin
      # Create shipment request
      shipment_request = {
        requested_shipment_details: {
          shipment_type: 'FEDEX_GROUND',
          service_type: 'FEDEX_GROUND',
          packaging_type: 'YOUR_PACKAGING',
          pickup_type: 'USE_ACCOUNT_PICKUP',
          rate_request_types: ['ACCOUNT'],
          preferred_currency: 'USD',
          shipper: {
            contact: {
              person_name: origin[:name],
              company_name: origin[:company],
              phone_number: origin[:phone]
            },
            address: {
              street_lines: [origin[:street]],
              city: origin[:city],
              state_or_province_code: origin[:state],
              postal_code: origin[:zip],
              country_code: origin[:country]
            }
          },
          recipient: {
            contact: {
              person_name: destination[:name],
              company_name: destination[:company],
              phone_number: destination[:phone]
            },
            address: {
              street_lines: [destination[:street]],
              city: destination[:city],
              state_or_province_code: destination[:state],
              postal_code: destination[:zip],
              country_code: destination[:country]
            }
          },
          shipping_charges_payment: {
            payment_type: 'SENDER',
            payor: {
              account_number: @account_number,
              country_code: origin[:country]
            }
          },
          packages: [{
            weight: {
              units: 'LB',
              value: package_details[:weight]
            },
            dimensions: {
              length: package_details[:length],
              width: package_details[:width],
              height: package_details[:height],
              units: 'IN'
            }
          }]
        }
      }

      # Send the request to FedEx
      response = @fedex.create_shipment(shipment_request)
      
      @logger.info("Shipment created successfully")
      @logger.info("Response: #{response.inspect}")
      
      # Extract tracking number and label
      tracking_number = response.dig('CompletedShipmentDetail', 'CompletedPackageDetails', 0, 'TrackingIds', 0, 'TrackingNumber')
      label_data = response.dig('CompletedShipmentDetail', 'CompletedPackageDetails', 0, 'Label', 'Parts', 0, 'Image')
      
      if tracking_number && label_data
        # Store tracking number
        @tracking_number = tracking_number
        
        # Download and save label
        save_label(label_data, tracking_number)
        
        # Return shipment information
        {
          tracking_number: tracking_number,
          status: 'success'
        }
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to extract tracking number or label from response")
        {
          status: 'error',
          message: 'Failed to create shipment or retrieve tracking number'
        }
      end
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error creating shipment: #{e.message}")
      {
        status: 'error',
        message: e.message
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def save_label(label_data, tracking_number)
    begin
      # Decode base64 label data if needed
      label_binary = Base64.decode64(label_data) if label_data.start_with?('JVBER')
      
      # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
      output_dir = 'shipments'
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(output_dir) unless Dir.exist?(output_dir)
      
      # Save PDF label
      filename = "#{output_dir}/label_#{tracking_number}.pdf"
      File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(label_binary || label_data)
      end
      
      @logger.info("Label saved to #{filename}")
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error saving label: #{e.message}")
      raise "Failed to save label: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class USPSAddressValidator
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://secure.shippingapis.com'

  def initialize(user_id)

  end

  def validate_address(address_line1, city, state, zip_code)
    # Формуємо запит до USPS Address Validation API
    url = "/ShippingAPI.dll"
    query = {
      API: 'Verify',
      XML: build_xml_request(address_line1, city, state, zip_code)
    }

          <City>#{city}</City>
          <State>#{state}</State>
          <Zip5>#{zip_code}</Zip5>
          <Zip4></Zip4>
        </Address>
      </AddressValidateRequest>
    XML
  end

  def parse_response(xml_body)
    # Простий парсер для демонстрації
    require 'nokogiri'

    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_body)
    address = doc.at_xpath('//Address')
    return nil unless address

    {
      address_line1: address.at_xpath('Address1')&.text,
      address_line2: address.at_xpath('Address2')&.text,
      city: address.at_xpath('City')&.text,
      state: address.at_xpath('State')&.text,
      zip_code: address.at_xpath('Zip5')&.text,
      zip4: address.at_xpath('Zip4')&.text,
      error: doc.at_xpath('//Error')&.text
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'
require 'builder'

class GoogleMerchantFeed
  NS = 'http://www.google.com/feeds/pubs/products/2008'
  XMLNS = "xmlns='#{NS}'"
  
  def initialize(products = [])
    @products = products
  end
  
  def generate_xml
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    builder.instruct!
    builder.feed(xmlns: NS) do |feed|
      feed.title('Product Catalog')
      feed.updated(Time.current.iso8601)
      
      @products.each do |product|
        feed.entry do |entry|
          entry.id(product[:id])
          entry.title(product[:title])
          entry.description(product[:description])
          entry.link(href: product[:link])
          entry.updated(product[:updated_at] || Time.current.iso8601)
          
          # Price
          if product[:price]
            entry.price do |price|
              price.amount(product[:price][:amount])
              price.currency(product[:price][:currency])
            end
          end
          
          # Availability
          if product[:availability]
            entry.availability(product[:availability])
          end
          
          # Condition
          if product[:condition]
            entry.condition(product[:condition])
          end
          
          # Brand
          if product[:brand]
            entry.brand(product[:brand])
          end
          
          # MPN
          if product[:mpn]
            entry.mpn(product[:mpn])
          end
          
          # GTIN
          if product[:gtin]
            entry.gtin(product[:gtin])
          end
          
          # Category
          if product[:category]
            entry.category(product[:category])
          end
          
          # Images
          if product[:images] && !product[:images].empty?
            product[:images].each do |image|
              entry.media_content(url: image)
            end
          end
          
          # Additional attributes
          product[:additional_attributes]&.each do |key, value|
            entry.send(key, value)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  def save_to_file(filename)
    File.write(filename, generate_xml)
  end
  
  # Helper method to add a product
  def add_product(product)
    @products << product
  end
  
  # Helper method to clear products
  def clear_products
    @products.clear
  end
  
  # Helper method to set products
  def products=(products)
    @products = products
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# lib/me_doc_invoice_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'logger'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'dotenv/load'

class MEDocInvoiceSender
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  attr_reader :api_url, :api_key, :logger
  
  def initialize(api_url:, api_key:, logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @api_url = api_url
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = logger
  end
  
  # Send tax invoice to Ukrainian tax service via M.E.Doc API
  def send_invoice(invoice_data)
    logger.info("Starting invoice submission to M.E.Doc API")
    
    # Validate required fields
    validate_invoice_data(invoice_data)
    
    # Prepare the request payload
    payload = build_invoice_payload(invoice_data)
    
    # Send the request
    response = post_invoice_request(payload)
    
    # Process response
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_invoice_data(invoice_data)
    required_fields = %w[document_number date supplier buyer amount vat_amount currency]
    missing_fields = required_fields - invoice_data.keys
    
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
  end
  
  def build_invoice_payload(invoice_data)
    {
      "documentNumber" => invoice_data[:document_number],
      "date" => invoice_data[:date],
      "supplier" => {
        "taxId" => invoice_data[:supplier][:tax_id],
        "name" => invoice_data[:supplier][:name],
        "address" => invoice_data[:supplier][:address]
      },
      "buyer" => {
        "taxId" => invoice_data[:buyer][:tax_id],
        "name" => invoice_data[:buyer][:name],
        "address" => invoice_data[:buyer][:address]
      },
      "items" => invoice_data[:items].map do |item|
        {
          "name" => item[:name],
          "quantity" => item[:quantity],
          "unitPrice" => item[:unit_price],
          "totalAmount" => item[:total_amount],
          "vatRate" => item[:vat_rate]
        }
      end,
      "amount" => invoice_data[:amount],
      "vatAmount" => invoice_data[:vat_amount],
      "currency" => invoice_data[:currency],
      "invoiceType" => invoice_data[:invoice_type] || "tax_invoice"
    }
  end
  
  def post_invoice_request(payload)
    logger.info("Sending invoice to M.E.Doc API")
    
    self.class.post(
      "#{api_url}/invoices",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    logger.info("Received response from M.E.Doc API")
    
    case response.code
    when 200..201
      logger.info("Invoice successfully submitted")
      result = {
        success: true,
        message: "Invoice submitted successfully",
        response_data: response.parsed_response
      }
    when 400
      logger.error("Bad request: #{response.body}")
      result = {
        success: false,
        error: "Bad request",
        message: response.body
      }
    when 401
      logger.error("Unauthorized access: Invalid API key")
      result = {
        success: false,
        error: "Unauthorized",
        message: "Invalid API key"
      }
    when 403
      logger.error("Forbidden access")
      result = {
        success: false,
        error: "Forbidden",
        message: "Access forbidden"
      }
    when 500..599
      logger.error("Server error: #{response.body}")
      result = {
        success: false,
        error: "Server error",
        message: "Internal server error"
      }
    else
      logger.warn("Unexpected response code: #{response.code}")
      result = {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected response",
        message: "Received unexpected response from API"
      }
    end
    
    logger.info("Invoice submission result: #{result[:success] ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILURE'}")
    result
  end
end

# lib/me_doc_invoice.rb
class MEDocInvoice
  attr_accessor :document_number, :date, :supplier, :buyer, :items, :amount, 
                :vat_amount, :currency, :invoice_type
  
  def initialize(attrs = {})
    @document_number = attrs[:document_number]
    @date = attrs[:date]
    @supplier = attrs[:supplier] || {}
    @buyer = attrs[:buyer] || {}
    @items = attrs[:items] || []
    @amount = attrs[:amount]
    @vat_amount = attrs[:vat_amount]
    @currency = attrs[:currency] || 'UAH'
    @invoice_type = attrs[:invoice_type] || 'tax_invoice'
  end
  
  def validate!
    errors = []
    
    errors << "Document number is required" if @document_number.nil? || @document_number.empty?
    errors << "Date is required" if @date.nil? || @date.empty?
    errors << "Supplier information is required" if @supplier.empty?
    errors << "Buyer information is required" if @buyer.empty?
    errors << "Items are required" if @items.empty?
    errors << "Amount is required" if @amount.nil?
    errors << "VAT amount is required" if @vat_amount.nil?
    errors << "Currency is required" if @currency.nil? || @currency.empty?
    
    # Validate supplier data
    if @supplier.is_a?(Hash)
      errors << "Supplier tax ID is required" if @supplier[:tax_id].nil? || @supplier[:tax_id].empty?
      errors << "Supplier name is required" if @supplier[:name].nil? || @supplier[:name].empty?
    end
    
    # Validate buyer data
    if @buyer.is_a?(Hash)
      errors << "Buyer tax ID is required" if @buyer[:tax_id].nil? || @buyer[:tax_id].empty?
      errors << "Buyer name is required" if @buyer[:name].nil? || @buyer[:name].empty?
    end
    
    # Validate items
    @items.each_with_index do |item, index|
      errors << "Item #{index + 1} name is required" if item[:name].nil? || item[:name].empty?
      errors << "Item #{index + 1} quantity is required" if item[:quantity].nil?
      errors << "Item #{index + 1} unit price is required" if item[:unit_price].nil?
      errors << "Item #{index + 1} total amount is required" if item[:total_amount].nil?
      errors << "Item #{index + 1} VAT rate is required" if item[:vat_rate].nil?
    end
    
    raise ArgumentError, errors.join("; ") unless errors.empty?
  end
end

# lib/me_doc_client.rb
class MEDocClient
  def initialize(api_url:, api_key:, logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @invoice_sender = MEDocInvoiceSender.new(api_url: api_url, api_key: api_key, logger: logger)
  end
  
  def send_invoice(invoice_data)
    invoice = MEDocInvoice.new(invoice_data)
    invoice.validate!
```

### 3. Main Application Class

```ruby
# ebay_manager.rb
require_relative 'models/product'
require_relative 'ebay_client'
require 'logger'

class EbayManager
  def initialize(ebay_client)
    @ebay_client = ebay_client
    @logger = Logger.new('ebay_manager.log')
  end
  
  def setup_database
    Product.create_table
    puts "Database table created successfully"
  end
  
  def add_product(name, price, quantity, description = nil)
    product = Product.create(
      name: name,
      price: price,
      quantity: quantity,
      description: description
    )
    
    puts "Added product: #{product.name}"
    product
  end
  
  def list_product_on_ebay(product)
    return if product.ebay_item_id.present?
    
    item_data = {
      title: product.name,
      description: product.description,
      price: product.price,
      quantity: product.quantity,
      category_id: 12345 # Example category
    }
    
    begin
      item_id = @ebay_client.list_item(item_data)
      product.update(ebay_item_id: item_id)
      @logger.info("Successfully listed product #{product.name} on eBay with ID: #{item_id}")
      puts "Successfully listed product #{product.name} on eBay"
      true
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to list product #{product.name} on eBay: #{e.message}")
      puts "Failed to list product #{product.name} on eBay: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
  
  def update_product_quantity(product, new_quantity)
    return if product.ebay_item_id.nil?
    
    begin
      success = @ebay_client.update_item_quantity(product.ebay_item_id, new_quantity)
      if success
        product.update(quantity: new_quantity)
        @logger.info("Successfully updated quantity for #{product.name} to #{new_quantity}")
        puts "Successfully updated quantity for #{product.name} to #{new_quantity}"
        true
      else
        @logger.error("Failed to update quantity for #{product.name}")
        puts "Failed to update quantity for #{product.name}"
        false
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error updating quantity for #{product.name}: #{e.message}")
      puts "Error updating quantity for #{product.name}: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
  
  def list_all_products_on_ebay
    products = Product.where(ebay_item_id: nil)
    puts "Listing #{products.count} products on eBay..."
    
    products.each do |product|
      list_product_on_ebay(product)
    end
  end
  
  def update_all_quantities
    products = Product.where.not(ebay_item_id: nil)
    puts "Updating quantities for #{products.count} eBay-listed products..."
    
    products.each do |product|
      update_product_quantity(product, product.quantity)
    end
  end
  
  def sync_products
    puts "Starting eBay sync process..."
    
    # List products not yet listed
    list_all_products_on_ebay
    
    # Update quantities
    update_all_quantities
    
    puts "Sync process completed"
  end
  
  def list_products
    products = Product.all
    puts "\n--- Product Inventory ---"
    products.each do |product|
      puts "ID: #{product.id} | Name: #{product.name} | Price: $#{product.price} | Quantity: #{product.quantity} | eBay ID: #{product.ebay_item_id}"
    end
    puts "--- End of Inventory ---\n"
  end
  
  def get_product_by_id(id)
    Product.find_by(id: id)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'aws-sigv4'
require 'faraday'
require 'json'
require 'time'

class AmazonSellerAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com'
  API_VERSION = '2021-06-30'
  
  def initialize(config)
    @region = config[:region] || 'us-east-1'
    @aws_access_key_id = config[:aws_access_key_id]
    @aws_secret_access_key = config[:aws_secret_access_key]
    @role_arn = config[:role_arn]
    @refresh_token = config[:refresh_token]
    @client_id = config[:client_id]
    @client_secret = config[:client_secret]
    @endpoint = config[:endpoint] || BASE_URL
    
    @token = nil
    @token_expires_at = nil
  end

  def get_orders(since_date = nil, max_results = 100)
    # Generate access token if needed
    refresh_access_token
    
    # Build query parameters
    params = {
      'createdAfter' => since_date || (Time.now - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
      'maxResultsPerPage' => max_results,
      'marketplaceIds' => ['ATVPDKIKX0DER'] # US marketplace ID
    }
    
    # Remove nil values
    params.delete_if { |_, v| v.nil? }
    
    # Make the API call
    response = make_api_call('/orders/' + API_VERSION + '/orders', 'GET', params)
    
    # Parse and return orders
    parse_orders_response(response)
  end

  def get_order(order_id)
    refresh_access_token
    
    response = make_api_call("/orders/" + API_VERSION + "/orders/#{order_id}", 'GET')
    parse_single_order_response(response)
  end

  def save_orders_to_file(orders, filename = 'orders.json')
    File.open(filename, 'w') do |file|
      file.write(JSON.pretty_generate(orders))
    end
    puts "Saved #{orders.length} orders to #{filename}"
  end

  def save_orders_to_database(orders)
    # This is a placeholder for database saving logic
    # You can implement your specific database saving here
    puts "Saving #{orders.length} orders to database..."
    
    orders.each do |order|
      # Example: Save to your database
      # Order.create!(
      #   order_id: order['OrderId'],
      #   purchase_date: order['PurchaseDate'],
      #   order_status: order['OrderStatus'],
      #   # ... other fields
      # )
      puts "Saved order: #{order['OrderId']}"
    end
  end

  private

  def refresh_access_token
    return if @token && @token_expires_at && Time.now < @token_expires_at
    
    # Get new token using refresh token
    conn = Faraday.new(url: 'https://api.amazon.com') do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
    
    response = conn.post do |req|
      req.url '/auth/o2/token'
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      req.body = {
        grant_type: 'refresh_token',
        refresh_token: @refresh_token,
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret
      }.to_query
    end
    
    token_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    @token = token_data['access_token']
    @token_expires_at = Time.now + token_data['expires_in']
  end

  def make_api_call(endpoint, method, params = {})
    # Create signature
    signer = Aws::Sigv4::Signer.new(
      service: 'execute-api',
      region: @region,
      access_key_id: @aws_access_key_id,
      secret_access_key: @aws_secret_access_key,
      role_arn: @role_arn
    )
    
    # Build URL with parameters
    url = @endpoint + endpoint
    if params.any?
      url += '?' + params.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{URI.encode_www_form_component(v.to_s)}" }.join('&')
    end
    
    # Create connection
    conn = Faraday.new(url: url) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
    
    # Add authentication headers
    headers = {
      'x-amz-access-token' => @token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    # Make request
    response = case method.upcase
               when 'GET'
                 conn.get { |req| req.headers.merge!(headers) }
               when 'POST'
                 conn.post { |req| req.headers.merge!(headers) }
               else
                 conn.get { |req| req.headers.merge!(headers) }
               end
    
    if response.status == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.status} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def parse_orders_response(response)
    orders = response['Orders'] || []
    
    # Extract and format order information
    formatted_orders = orders.map do |order|
      {
        order_id: order['OrderId'],
        purchase_date: order['PurchaseDate'],
        last_updated_date: order['LastUpdatedDate'],
        order_status: order['OrderStatus'],
        fulfillment_channel: order['FulfillmentChannel'],
        sales_channel: order['SalesChannel'],
        order_channel: order['OrderChannel'],
        ship_service_level: order['ShipServiceLevel'],
        number_of_items_shipped: order['NumberOfItemsShipped'],
        number_of_items_unshipped: order['NumberOfItemsUnshipped'],
        marketplace_id: order['MarketplaceId'],
        buyer_email: order['BuyerEmail'],
        buyer_name: order['BuyerName'],
        shipping_address: order['ShippingAddress'],
        order_total: order['OrderTotal'],
        payment_method: order['PaymentMethod'],
        payment_method_details: order['PaymentMethodDetails']
      }
    end
    
    formatted_orders
  end

  def parse_single_order_response(response)
    order = response['Order']
    
    {
      order_id: order['OrderId'],
      purchase_date: order['PurchaseDate'],
      last_updated_date: order['LastUpdatedDate'],

  end
```

Here's a complete solution for generating EAN-13 barcodes and printing them on PDF labels:

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'prawn'
gem 'rqrcode'
gem 'barby'
gem 'chunky_png'
gem 'mini_magick'
gem 'nokogiri'
```

```ruby
# barcode_label_generator.rb
require 'prawn'
require 'barby'
require 'barby/barcode/ean_13'
require 'barby/outputter/prawn_outputter'
require 'fileutils'

class BarcodeLabelGenerator
  def initialize
    @temp_dir = 'temp_labels'
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(@temp_dir)
  end

  def generate_labels(products)
    products.each_with_index do |product, index|
      generate_single_label(product, index + 1)
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_single_label(product, label_number)
    # Create Prawn document for the label
    pdf = Prawn::Document.new(page_size: 'A4', margin: 20)
    
    # Set font
    pdf.font_size 10
    
    # Create barcode
    barcode = Barby::EAN13.new(product[:ean])
    
    # Add product information
    pdf.text "Product: #{product[:name]}", style: :bold
    pdf.text "SKU: #{product[:sku]}"
    pdf.text "Price: $#{product[:price]}"
    pdf.text "Category: #{product[:category]}"
    pdf.text ""
    
    # Add barcode
    barcode_width = 100
    barcode_height = 30
    
    # Position barcode in center of label area
    barcode_x = (pdf.bounds.width - barcode_width) / 2
    barcode_y = pdf.bounds.height - 80
    
    # Draw the barcode using Barby outputter
    outputter = Barby::PrawnOutputter.new(pdf, barcode)
    outputter.draw_barcode(barcode_x, barcode_y)
    
    # Add EAN text below barcode
    pdf.text product[:ean], align: :center, size: 12, style: :bold
    
    # Add label number
    pdf.text "Label #{label_number}", align: :right, size: 8
    
    # Save PDF
    filename = "#{@temp_dir}/label_#{label_number}.pdf"
    pdf.render_file(filename)
    
    puts "Generated label: #{filename}"
  end

  def validate_ean(ean)
    # Basic EAN-13 validation
    return false unless ean.is_a?(String)
    return false unless ean.length == 13
    return false unless ean.match?(/^\d+$/)
    
    # Calculate check digit
    sum = 0
    ean.chars.each_with_index do |digit, index|
      digit_value = digit.to_i
      sum += digit_value * (index.even? ? 1 : 3)
    end
    
    check_digit = (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10
    ean[-1].to_i == check_digit
  end
end
```

```ruby
# import_excel_job.rb

require 'roo'

class ImportExcelJob
  include Sidekiq::Job

  def perform(file_path)
    logger = Logger.new('import.log')
    logger.info "Початок імпорту файлу: #{file_path}"

    begin
      # Відкриваємо Excel файл
      spreadsheet = Roo::Excelx.new(file_path)

      # Припустимо, що дані починаються з другого рядка (перший — заголовки)
      spreadsheet.row(1).each_with_index do |header, index|
        puts "Стовпець #{index}: #{header}"
      end

      (2..spreadsheet.last_row).each do |row_num|
        row = spreadsheet.row(row_num)
        product_name = row[0]
        price = row[1]

        # Створюємо або оновлюємо товар у базі даних
        # Product.find_or_create_by(name: product_name) do |p|
        #   p.price = price
        # end

        logger.info "Імпортовано: #{product_name} - #{price}"
      end

      logger.info "Імпорт завершено: #{file_path}"
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Помилка при імпорті: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. **Код для генерації штрихкодів та створення PDF-етикеток**

Файл: `generate_labels.rb`

```ruby
require 'barby'
require 'barby/barcode/ean_13'
require 'barby/outputter/prawn_outputter'
require 'prawn'
require 'prawn/table'

# Список товарів (наприклад, ID товару та назва)
products = [
  { id: "1234567890128", name: "Молоко 1л" },
  { id: "2345678901234", name: "Хліб пшеничний" },
  { id: "3456789012345", name: "Яйця 10 шт." },
  { id: "4567890123456", name: "Сир моцарелла" },
  { id: "5678901234567", name: "Картопля" }
]

# Функція для генерації PDF-етикеток
def generate_labels(products)
  Prawn::Document.generate("labels.pdf") do |pdf|
    pdf.stroke_bounds

    products.each_with_index do |product, index|
      # Створюємо штрихкод для EAN-13
      barcode = Barby::EAN13.new(product[:id])
      barcode_data = barcode.to_png

      # Встановлюємо розмір сторінки (наприклад, A4)
      pdf.start_new_page unless index == 0

      # Розміри етикетки (наприклад, 100x150 мм)
      label_width = 100
      label_height = 150

      # Додавання тексту
      pdf.text "#{product[:name]}", size: 12, align: :center
      pdf.text "Код: #{product[:id]}", size: 10, align: :center

      # Додавання штрихкоду (використовуємо кастомний вивід через Prawn)
      barcode_output = Barby::PrawnOutputter.new(barcode)
      barcode_output.draw_on(pdf, x: 20, y: 50, scale: 0.5)

      # Додавання рамки для етикетки
      pdf.stroke_rectangle [0, 150], label_width, label_height
    end
  end
end

# Запуск генерації
generate_labels(products)
puts "PDF-етикетки згенеровано: labels.pdf"
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EtsyClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end

  # Отримання оголошень магазину
  def get_shop_listings(shop_name, limit: 25, offset: 0)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_name}/listings/active",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Отримання замовлень магазину
  def get_shop_orders(shop_name, limit: 25, offset: 0, state: 'active')
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_name}/orders",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset,
        state: state
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Отримання деталей замовлення
  def get_order_details(shop_name, order_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/application/shops/#{shop_name}/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: {
        'x-api-key' => @api_key,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. **Код для надсилання нагадування про покинутий кошик**

```ruby
require 'klaviyo'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

# Ініціалізація Klaviyo API
Klaviyo.api_key = ENV['KLAVIYO_API_KEY']
Klaviyo.public_api_key = ENV['KLAVIYO_PUBLIC_API_KEY']

# Функція для надсилання нагадування про покинутий кошик
def send_cart_abandonment_reminder(email, cart_items)
  # Перевірка, чи користувач існує в Klaviyo, і якщо ні — додати його
  begin
    profile = Klaviyo::Profile.get_by_email(email)
  rescue Klaviyo::Error::NotFound
    # Якщо користувача немає, створити нового
    profile = Klaviyo::Profile.create({
      email: email,
      first_name: "Customer", # Тут можна зробити інші маніпуляції
    })
  end

  # Формуємо дані для події
  event_data = {
    event: "Cart Abandoned",
    customer_properties: {
      $email: email,
    },
    properties: {
      cart_items: cart_items,
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }
  }

  # Надсилання події в Klaviyo
  Klaviyo::Event.track(event_data)

  puts "Нагадування про покинутий кошик надіслано користувачу: #{email}"
end

# Приклад використання:
# send_cart_abandonment_reminder("user@example.com", ["Product A", "Product B"])
```

---

### 4. **Пояснення**

- **`Klaviyo::Profile.get_by_email`** — шукає користувача за email.
- **`Klaviyo::Profile.create`** — якщо користувача не існує, створює нового.
- **`Klaviyo::Event.track`** — надсилає подію в Klaviyo.
- `cart_items` — це масив товарів, що залишилися в кошику.

---

### 5. **Додатково (якщо ви хочете запустити це як веб-сервіс)**

```ruby
  cart_items = params[:cart_items]

  send_cart_abandonment_reminder(email, cart_items)

  { status: "success", message: "Нагадування надіслано" }.to_json
end
```


Here's a complete Ruby solution for booking a delivery courier through the Uber Direct API:

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'dotenv'
gem 'logger'

# app.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class UberDirectCourier
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://api.uber.com'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Accept' => 'application/json',
          'Authorization' => "Token #{ENV['UBER_TOKEN']}",
          'X-Client-ID' => ENV['UBER_CLIENT_ID']
  
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  # Book a courier delivery
  def book_courier(order_id, pickup_address, delivery_address, estimated_time = nil)
    payload = {
      service_level: 'uberx',
      pickup: {
        address: pickup_address
      },
      destination: {
        address: delivery_address
      },
      metadata: {
        order_id: order_id,
        estimated_delivery_time: estimated_time
      }
    }
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post('/v1/direct/book', 
                                body: payload.to_json,
                                headers: self.class.headers)
      
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to book courier: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  # Get courier status
  def get_courier_status(booking_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.get("/v1/direct/bookings/#{booking_id}")
      handle_response(response)
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to get courier status: #{e.message}")
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      @logger.info("Courier booking successful")
      { success: true, data: JSON.parse(response.body) }
    when 400
      @logger.error("Bad request: #{response.body}")
      { success: false, error: "Bad request", details: JSON.parse(response.body) }
    when 401
      @logger.error("Unauthorized access")
      { success: false, error: "Unauthorized access" }
    when 404
      @logger.error("Booking not found")
      { success: false, error: "Booking not found" }
    else
      @logger.error("API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      { success: false, error: "API error", status_code: response.code }
    end
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables
  Dotenv.load('.env') if File.exist?('.env')
  
  # Create courier booking instance
  courier = UberDirectCourier.new

  pickup = {
    "address_line1" => "123 Main St",

  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class UberCourier
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://api.uber.com'

  def initialize(access_token)
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept-Language' => 'en_US'
    }
  end

  def order_courier(pickup, destination, product_id = 'uberx')
    # Використовуємо endpoint для замовлення кур'єра через API Uber Direct
    # (предположимо, що використовується схожий API, як в Uber Direct)

    options = {
      headers: @headers,
      body: {
        product_id: product_id,
        surge_confirmation_id: nil, # Якщо потрібно
        pickup: pickup,
        destination: destination
      }.to_json
    }

    response = self.class.post('/v1/direct/orders', options)
    response.parsed_response
  end
end
```

```ruby
        "apiKey" => @api_key,
        "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
        "calledMethod" => "save",
        "methodProperties" => order_data
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def get_waybill_info(waybill_number)
    response = self.class.post(
      '/InternetDocument/GetTracking',
      body: {
        "apiKey" => @api_key,
        "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
        "calledMethod" => "getTracking",
        "methodProperties" => {
          "DocumentNumber" => waybill_number
        }
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'uri'
require 'fileutils'

# Завантаження змінних оточення
Dotenv.load

# Налаштування AWS
s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new(
  access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
  secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'],
  region: ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1'
)

s3_bucket = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME'] || 'your-bucket-name'
cdn_url = ENV['CDN_URL'] || 'https://your-cdn-url.com'

# Створення каталогів для зберігання тимчасових файлів
Dir.mkdir('tmp') unless Dir.exist?('tmp')
Dir.mkdir('tmp/thumbnails') unless Dir.exist?('tmp/thumbnails')

# Маршрут для завантаження зображення
post '/upload' do
  content_type :json
  
  begin
    # Перевірка наявності файлу
    unless params[:image] && params[:image][:tempfile]
      return { error: 'No image file provided' }.to_json
    end
    
    # Отримання даних файлу
    image_file = params[:image][:tempfile]
    original_filename = params[:image][:filename]
    
    # Генерація унікального імені файлу
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i
    unique_name = "#{timestamp}_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
    extension = File.extname(original_filename).downcase
    
    # Збереження оригінального зображення
    original_key = "products/originals/#{unique_name}#{extension}"
    
    s3_client.put_object(
      bucket: s3_bucket,
      key: original_key,
      body: image_file,
      content_type: 'image/jpeg'
    )
    
    # Генерація мініатюри
    thumbnail_key = "products/thumbnails/#{unique_name}_thumb#{extension}"
    
    # Збереження мініатюри в тимчасовому каталозі
    temp_file = "tmp/thumbnails/#{unique_name}_thumb#{extension}"
    image = MiniMagick::Image.open(image_file.path)
    image.resize "200x200>"
    image.write temp_file
    
    # Завантаження мініатюри в S3
    File.open(temp_file, 'rb') do |file|
      s3_client.put_object(
        bucket: s3_bucket,
        key: thumbnail_key,
        body: file,
        content_type: 'image/jpeg'
      )
    end
    
    # Видалення тимчасового файлу
    File.delete(temp_file) if File.exist?(temp_file)
    
    # Повернення URL для оригінального та мініатюри
    original_url = "#{cdn_url}/#{original_key}"
    thumbnail_url = "#{cdn_url}/#{thumbnail_key}"
    
    {
      message: 'Image uploaded successfully',
      original_url: original_url,
      thumbnail_url: thumbnail_url,
      original_key: original_key,
      thumbnail_key: thumbnail_key
    }.to_json
    
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    status 500
    { error: 'Failed to upload image' }.to_json
  end
end

# Маршрут для отримання мініатюри по ключу
get '/thumbnail/:key' do

  # Віддаємо мініатюру через CDN
  # Фактична реалізація залежить від вашого CDN
  content_type 'image/jpeg'

    response = s3_client.get_object(bucket: s3_bucket, key: key)
    response.body.read
  rescue Aws::S3::Errors::NoSuchKey
    status 404
    'Thumbnail not found'
  rescue => e
    status 500
    "Error retrieving thumbnail: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'active_record'
require 'similar'
require 'json'

# Налаштування бази даних
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'recommendations.db'
)

# Модель замовлення
class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :customer
  belongs_to :product
end

# Модель клієнта
class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
end

# Модель товару
class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
end

# Ініціалізація бази даних
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :customers, force: true do |t|
    t.string :name
  end

  create_table :products, force: true do |t|
    t.string :name
  end

  create_table :orders, force: true do |t|
    t.references :customer, null: false
    t.references :product, null: false
  end
end

# Тестові дані
Customer.create(name: 'Alice')
Customer.create(name: 'Bob')
Customer.create(name: 'Charlie')

Product.create(name: 'Laptop')
Product.create(name: 'Phone')
Product.create(name: 'Tablet')
Product.create(name: 'Headphones')
Product.create(name: 'Keyboard')

# Відповідність замовлень (тестові дані)
Order.create(customer_id: 1, product_id: 1) # Alice - Laptop
Order.create(customer_id: 1, product_id: 2) # Alice - Phone
Order.create(customer_id: 2, product_id: 1) # Bob - Laptop
Order.create(customer_id: 2, product_id: 3) # Bob - Tablet
Order.create(customer_id: 3, product_id: 2) # Charlie - Phone
Order.create(customer_id: 3, product_id: 4) # Charlie - Headphones

# Створення матриці користувачів-товарів (матриця оцінок)
def build_user_item_matrix
  customers = Customer.all
  products = Product.all
  matrix = {}

  customers.each do |customer|
    matrix[customer.id] = {}
    products.each do |product|
      matrix[customer.id][product.id] = Order.exists?(customer_id: customer.id, product_id: product.id) ? 1 : 0
    end
  end

  matrix
end

# Розрахунок схожості між користувачами (використовуємо коефіцієнт Косіна)
def cosine_similarity(matrix, user1, user2)
  vec1 = matrix[user1]
  vec2 = matrix[user2]

  return 0 if vec1.nil? || vec2.nil?

  dot = vec1.keys.sum { |k| vec1[k] * vec2[k] }
  norm1 = Math.sqrt(vec1.values.sum { |v| v * v })
  norm2 = Math.sqrt(vec2.values.sum { |v| v * v })

  return 0 if norm1 == 0 || norm2 == 0

  dot / (norm1 * norm2)
end

# Знаходження схожих користувачів
def find_similar_customers(matrix, target_customer_id)
  similarities = []

  matrix.each do |user_id, _|
    next if user_id == target_customer_id
    similarity = cosine_similarity(matrix, target_customer_id, user_id)
    similarities << [user_id, similarity]
  end

  similarities.sort_by { |_, sim| -sim }.first(3) # 3 найближчі користувачі
end

# Рекомендація товарів
def recommend_products(target_customer_id, matrix, similar_customers)
  target_orders = Order.where(customer_id: target_customer_id).pluck(:product_id)
  recommendations = Hash.new(0)

  similar_customers.each do |customer_id, _|
    orders = Order.where(customer_id: customer_id).pluck(:product_id)
    orders.each do |product_id|
      next if target_orders.include?(product_id)
      recommendations[product_id] += 1
    end
  end

  recommendations.sort_by { |_, count| -count }.first(3).map(&:first)
```

```ruby
    return { error: "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" } unless missing_fields.empty?
    
    # Construct USPS request
    request_params = construct_usps_request(normalized_address)
    
    # Call USPS API

    # Process response
    process_response(response, normalized_address)
  end

    {
      address1: address_data[:address1]&.strip&.gsub(/\s+/, ' '),

    {
      API: 'Verify',
      XML: build_xml_request(address)
    }

  def self.build_xml_request(address)
    xml = <<~XML

        <Address ID="0">

    begin
      response = post(base_uri, body: request_params, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' })

    rescue => e
```

```ruby
require 'fedex'

class FedExSender
  def initialize
    # Налаштування логування
    @logger = Logger.new('fedex.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    # Ініціалізація FedEx клієнта
    @fedex = FedEx::Client.new(
      key: ENV['FEDEX_KEY'],
      password: ENV['FEDEX_PASSWORD'],
      account_number: ENV['FEDEX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER'],
      meter_number: ENV['FEDEX_METER_NUMBER'],
      use_test: ENV['FEDEX_TEST_MODE'] == 'true' # true для тестового режиму
    )
  end

  def create_shipment
    begin
      # Створення відправлення
      shipment = @fedex.build_shipment do |s|
        s.shipper = {
          name: 'Відправник',
          company: 'Компанія Відправника',
          address: {
            street: 'Вулиця Відправника 1',
            city: 'Місто Відправника',
            state: 'Штат',
            postal_code: '12345',
            country: 'UA'
          }
        }

        s.recipient = {
          name: 'Отримувач',
          company: 'Компанія Отримувача',
          address: {
            street: 'Вулиця Отримувача 2',
            city: 'Місто Отримувача',
            state: 'Штат',
            postal_code: '67890',
            country: 'UA'
          }
        }

        s.package = {
          weight: {
            units: 'LB',
            value: 5.0
          },
          dimensions: {
            length: 10,
            width: 8,
            height: 6,
            units: 'IN'
          }
        }

        s.service_type = 'FEDEX_GROUND'
        s.packaging_type = 'YOUR_PACKAGING'
      end

      # Відправка відправлення
      response = @fedex.create_shipment(shipment)
      
      if response.success?
        # Отримання номера відстеження
        tracking_number = response.tracking_number
        @logger.info("Відправлення успішно створено. Номер відстеження: #{tracking_number}")
        
        # Завантаження етикетки
        label_data = download_label(tracking_number)
        
        # Збереження етикетки у PDF
        save_label_to_pdf(label_data, tracking_number)
        
        return tracking_number
      else
        @logger.error("Помилка створення відправлення: #{response.errors}")
        raise "Не вдалося створити відправлення: #{response.errors}"
      end
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Помилка при створенні відправлення: #{e.message}")
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def download_label(tracking_number)
    begin
      # Отримання етикетки
      label_response = @fedex.get_label(
        tracking_number: tracking_number,
        doc_format: 'PDF'
      )
      
      if label_response.success?
        @logger.info("Етикетка успішно завантажена для відстеження: #{tracking_number}")
        return label_response.label_data
      else
        @logger.error("Помилка завантаження етикетки: #{label_response.errors}")
        raise "Помилка завантаження етикетки: #{label_response.errors}"
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Помилка при завантаженні етикетки: #{e.message}")
      raise e
    end
  end

  def save_label_to_pdf(label_data, tracking_number)
    begin
      # Створення директорії для збереження файлів, якщо її немає
      FileUtils.mkdir_p('labels')
      
      # Збереження етикетки у PDF
      filename = "labels/fedex_label_#{tracking_number}.pdf"
      File.open(filename, 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(label_data)
      end
      
      @logger.info("Етикетка збережена: #{filename}")
      puts "Етикетка збережена: #{filename}"
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Помилка при збереженні етикетки: #{e.message}")
      raise e
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'fedex'

class FedExShipmentManager
  attr_reader :tracking_number, :logger

  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = config
    @logger = Logger.new('fedex_shipment.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    # Якщо конфігурація зчитується з файлу
    if @config[:config_file]
      load_config_from_file(@config[:config_file])
    end
    
    setup_fedex_client
  end

  def setup_fedex_client
    @fedex = FedEx::Client.new(
      key: @config[:key] || ENV['FEDEX_KEY'],
      password: @config[:password] || ENV['FEDEX_PASSWORD'],
      account_number: @config[:account_number] || ENV['FEDEX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER'],
      meter_number: @config[:meter_number] || ENV['FEDEX_METER_NUMBER'],
      use_test: @config[:test_mode] || ENV['FEDEX_TEST_MODE'] == 'true'
    )
  end

  def load_config_from_file(file_path)
    if File.exist?(file_path)
      config_data = JSON.parse(File.read(file_path))
      @config.merge!(config_data)
    else
      raise "Конфігураційний файл не знайдено: #{file_path}"
    end
  end

  def create_shipment(ship_info)
    begin
      @logger.info("Створення відправлення...")
      
      shipment = @fedex.build_shipment do |s|
        # Відправник
        s.shipper = {
          name: ship_info[:shipper][:name],
          company: ship_info[:shipper][:company],
          address: {
            street: ship_info[:shipper][:address][:street],
            city: ship_info[:shipper][:address][:city],
            state: ship_info[:shipper][:address][:state],
            postal_code: ship_info[:shipper][:address][:postal_code],
            country: ship_info[:shipper][:address][:country]
          }
        }

        # Отримувач
        s.recipient = {
          name: ship_info[:recipient][:name],
          company: ship_info[:recipient][:company],
          address: {
            street: ship_info[:recipient][:address][:street],
            city: ship_info[:recipient][:address][:city],
            state: ship_info[:recipient][:address][:state],
            postal_code: ship_info[:recipient][:address][:postal_code],
            country: ship_info[:recipient][:address][:country]
          }
        }

        # Пакет
        s.package = {
          weight: {
            units: ship_info[:package][:weight][:units],
            value: ship_info[:package][:weight][:value]
          },
          dimensions: {
            length: ship_info[:package][:dimensions][:length],
            width: ship_info[:package][:dimensions][:width],
            height: ship_info[:package][:dimensions][:height],
            units: ship_info[:package][:dimensions][:units]
          }
        }

        # Сервіс
        s.service_type = ship_info[:service_type] || 'FEDEX_GROUND'
        s.packaging_type = ship_info[:packaging_type] || 'YOUR_PACKAGING'
      end

      # Створення відправлення
      response = @fedex.create_shipment(shipment)
      
      if response.success?
        @tracking_number = response.tracking_number
        @logger.info("Відправлення створено успішно. Номер: #{@tracking_number}")
        
        # Завантаження та збереження етикетки
        download_and_save_label
        return true
      else
        error_msg = response.errors.join(', ')
        @logger.error("Помилка створення відправлення: #{error_msg}")
        raise "Створення відправлення не вдалося: #{error_msg}"

        tracking_number: @tracking_number,

      )
      
      if label_response.success?
        save_label_to_file(label_response.label_data)
        @logger.info("Етикетка успішно збережена")

      else
        error_msg = label_response.errors.join(', ')
        @logger.error("Помилка завантаження етикетки: #{error_msg}")
        raise "Завантаження етикетки не вдалося: #{error_msg}"
      end
```

### 2. Import Job Class
```ruby
# app/jobs/product_import_job.rb
class ProductImportJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(file_path, user_id = nil)
    @file_path = file_path
    @user_id = user_id
    @logger = Rails.logger

    begin
      @logger.info("Starting product import job for file: #{file_path}")
      
      # Validate file exists
      raise "File not found: #{file_path}" unless File.exist?(@file_path)
      
      # Process the Excel file
      process_excel_file
      
      @logger.info("Product import job completed successfully")
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Product import job failed: #{e.message}")
      @logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      
      # Notify user or handle error appropriately
      notify_user_of_failure(e.message) if @user_id
      
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def process_excel_file
    # Use Roo gem to handle Excel files
    spreadsheet = Roo::Excelx.new(@file_path)
    
    # Get number of rows
    total_rows = spreadsheet.last_row
    @logger.info("Processing #{total_rows} rows from Excel file")
    
    # Process in batches to avoid memory issues
    batch_size = 1000
    total_processed = 0
    
    # Extract headers from first row
    headers = spreadsheet.row(1).map(&:downcase)
    
    # Process in batches
    (2..total_rows).step(batch_size) do |start_row|
      end_row = [start_row + batch_size - 1, total_rows].min
      batch = []
      
      (start_row..end_row).each do |row_num|
        row_data = spreadsheet.row(row_num)
        product_data = extract_product_data(headers, row_data)
        
        # Skip empty rows
        next if product_data.nil? || product_data[:sku].blank?
        
        batch << product_data
      end
      
      # Process batch
      process_batch(batch)
      total_processed += batch.size
      
      @logger.info("Processed batch: #{total_processed}/#{total_rows} products")
      
      # Clear batch for memory management
      batch.clear
    end
    
    @logger.info("Import completed: #{total_processed} products processed")
  end

  def extract_product_data(headers, row_data)
    # Map Excel columns to product attributes
    product_data = {}
    
    headers.each_with_index do |header, index|
      value = row_data[index].to_s.strip if row_data[index]
      
      case header
      when 'sku', 'product_id'
        product_data[:sku] = value
      when 'name', 'product_name'
        product_data[:name] = value
      when 'price', 'cost'
        product_data[:price] = value.to_f
      when 'category'
        product_data[:category] = value
      when 'description'
        product_data[:description] = value
      when 'active'
        product_data[:active] = ['true', '1', 'yes'].include?(value.downcase)
      end
    end
    
    # Validate required fields
    return nil if product_data[:sku].blank? || product_data[:name].blank?
    
    # Set default values
    product_data[:active] = true if product_data[:active].nil?
    
    product_data
  end

  def process_batch(batch)
    return if batch.empty?
    
    # Use bulk insert for better performance
    Product.import(batch, on_duplicate_key_update: [:name, :price, :category, :description, :active])
    
    # Alternative: Process individually with error handling
    # batch.each do |product_data|
    #   Product.find_or_create_by(sku: product_data[:sku]) do |product|
    #     product.assign_attributes(product_data)
    #   end
    # end
  end

  def notify_user_of_failure(message)
    # Implement notification logic here
    # e.g., send email, create notification, etc.
    puts "Notification: Import failed - #{message}"
  end
end
```

### 3. Service Class for File Processing
```ruby
# app/services/product_import_service.rb
class ProductImportService
  def self.import_from_excel(file_path, user_id = nil)
    # Validate file format
    unless valid_excel_file?(file_path)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid file format. Please upload an Excel file."
    end
    
    # Queue the background job
    ProductImportJob.perform_later(file_path, user_id)
    
    { success: true, job_id: ProductImportJob.job_id }
  end

  def self.valid_excel_file?(file_path)
    return false unless File.exist?(file_path)
    
    extension = File.extname(file_path).downcase
    %w[.xlsx .xls].include?(extension)
  end

  def self.get_import_status(job_id)
    # This would typically check Sidekiq job status
    # Implementation depends on your monitoring setup
    { status: 'queued', job_id: job_id }
  end
end
```
