```ruby
# lib/collaborative_filtering.rb
require 'sequel'
require 'nmatrix'

class CollaborativeFiltering
  def initialize(database_url = 'sqlite://collaborative_filtering.db')
    @db = Sequel.connect(database_url)
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    @db.create_table_if_not_exists :users do
      Integer :id, primary_key: true
      String :name
    end

    @db.create_table_if_not_exists :products do
      Integer :id, primary_key: true
      String :name
    end

    @db.create_table_if_not_exists :orders do
      Integer :user_id
      Integer :product_id
      Integer :rating, default: 5
      DateTime :created_at
    end
  end

  def add_user(user_id, name)
    @db[:users].insert(id: user_id, name: name)
  end

  def add_product(product_id, name)
    @db[:products].insert(id: product_id, name: name)
  end

  def add_order(user_id, product_id, rating = 5)
    @db[:orders].insert(user_id: user_id, product_id: product_id, rating: rating, created_at: Time.now)
  end

  def get_user_products(user_id)
    @db[:orders].where(user_id: user_id).select(:product_id).map(&:product_id)
  end

  def get_all_users
    @db[:users].select(:id).map(&:id)
  end

  def get_all_products
    @db[:products].select(:id).map(&:id)
  end

  def get_user_ratings(user_id)
    @db[:orders].where(user_id: user_id).map { |row| [row[:product_id], row[:rating]] }.to_h
  end

  def get_product_ratings(product_id)
    @db[:orders].where(product_id: product_id).map { |row| [row[:user_id], row[:rating]] }.to_h
  end

  def get_user_matrix
    # Create user-product matrix
    users = get_all_users
    products = get_all_products
    
    matrix = NMatrix.new([users.length, products.length], 0.0, dtype: :float64)
    
    users.each_with_index do |user_id, user_idx|
      user_ratings = get_user_ratings(user_id)
      user_ratings.each do |product_id, rating|
        product_idx = products.index(product_id)
        matrix[user_idx, product_idx] = rating if product_idx
      end
    end
    
    [matrix, users, products]
  end

  def cosine_similarity(user1_ratings, user2_ratings)
    # Calculate cosine similarity between two users
    intersection = user1_ratings.keys & user2_ratings.keys
    
    return 0.0 if intersection.empty?
    
    # Calculate dot product
    dot_product = intersection.sum { |item| user1_ratings[item] * user2_ratings[item] }
    
    # Calculate magnitudes
    magnitude1 = Math.sqrt(intersection.sum { |item| user1_ratings[item] ** 2 })
    magnitude2 = Math.sqrt(intersection.sum { |item| user2_ratings[item] ** 2 })
    
    return 0.0 if magnitude1 == 0 || magnitude2 == 0
    
    dot_product / (magnitude1 * magnitude2)
  end

  def find_similar_users(target_user_id, threshold = 0.1)
    # Find users similar to target user
    target_user_ratings = get_user_ratings(target_user_id)
    similar_users = []
    
    get_all_users.each do |user_id|
      next if user_id == target_user_id
      
      user_ratings = get_user_ratings(user_id)
      similarity = cosine_similarity(target_user_ratings, user_ratings)
      
      similar_users << { user_id: user_id, similarity: similarity } if similarity >= threshold
    end
    
    similar_users.sort_by { |user| -user[:similarity] }
  end

  def recommend_products(user_id, limit = 10)
    # Get user's already purchased products
    user_products = get_user_products(user_id)
    
    # Find similar users
    similar_users = find_similar_users(user_id, 0.2)
    
    # Calculate product scores from similar users
    product_scores = {}
    
    similar_users.each do |similar_user|
      user_id = similar_user[:user_id]
      similarity = similar_user[:similarity]
      
      # Get products this similar user has rated
      user_ratings = get_user_ratings(user_id)
      
      user_ratings.each do |product_id, rating|
        # Skip products already purchased by the target user
        next if user_products.include?(product_id)
        
        # Skip if product is already in the score list
        product_scores[product_id] ||= 0.0
        product_scores[product_id] += rating * similarity
      end
    end
    
    # Sort products by score and return top recommendations
    recommended_products = product_scores.sort_by { |_, score| -score }.first(limit)
    
    # Get product names
    recommended_products.map do |product_id, score|
      product_name = @db[:products].where(id: product_id).get(:name)
      { product_id: product_id, product_name: product_name, score: score }
    end
  end

  def recommend_with_matrix_factorization(user_id, n_factors = 10, iterations = 50)
    # Simple matrix factorization approach
    matrix, users, products = get_user_matrix
    
    return [] if matrix.shape[0] == 0 || matrix.shape[1] == 0
    
    # Convert to dense if needed
    user_matrix = matrix.to_a
    
    # Simple collaborative filtering with matrix factorization concept
    user_products = get_user_products(user_id)
    
    # Create product scores using weighted average of similar users
    similar_users = find_similar_users(user_id, 0.1)
    
    product_scores = {}
    user_ratings = get_user_ratings(user_id)
    
    similar_users.each do |similar_user|
      user_id_sim = similar_user[:user_id]
      similarity = similar_user[:similarity]
      
      next if similarity <= 0
      
      similar_user_ratings = get_user_ratings(user_id_sim)
      
      similar_user_ratings.each do |product_id, rating|
        next if user_products.include?(product_id)
        next if user_ratings.key?(product_id) # Skip products already rated
        
        product_scores[product_id] ||= 0.0
        product_scores[product_id] += rating * similarity
      end
    end
    
    # Normalize scores
    product_scores.each do |product_id, score|
      # Count how many similar users recommended this product
      similar_user_count = similar_users.count { |u| get_user_ratings(u[:user_id]).key?(product_id) }
      product_scores[product_id] = score / (similar_user_count + 1)
    end
    
    # Return top recommendations
    product_scores.sort_by { |_, score| -score }.first(10).map do |product_id, score|
      product_name = @db[:products].where(id: product_id).get(:name)
      { product_id: product_id, product_name: product_name, score: score }
    end
  end

  def clear_data
    @db[:orders].delete
    @db[:users].delete
    @db[:products].delete
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv/load'

class UkrposhtaShipment
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end
  
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    # Required fields for shipment creation
    required_fields = [:sender_name, :sender_phone, :sender_address, 
                      :recipient_name, :recipient_phone, :recipient_address,
                      :weight, :service_type]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields - shipment_data.keys.map(&:to_sym)
    raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" if missing_fields.any?
    
    # Prepare shipment data
    data = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      shipment: {
        sender: {
          name: shipment_data[:sender_name],
          phone: shipment_data[:sender_phone],
          address: shipment_data[:sender_address]
        },
        recipient: {
          name: shipment_data[:recipient_name],
          phone: shipment_data[:recipient_phone],
          address: shipment_data[:recipient_address]
        },
        package: {
          weight: shipment_data[:weight],
          service_type: shipment_data[:service_type],
          description: shipment_data[:description] || "Package"
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post('/shipment/create', body: data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def print_label(shipment_id)
    # Prepare label request
    data = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      shipment_id: shipment_id
    }
    
    # Make API request to get label
    response = self.class.post('/shipment/label/print', body: data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      raise "Label API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_shipment_status(shipment_id)
    # Prepare status request
    data = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      shipment_id: shipment_id
    }
    
    # Make API request to get shipment status
    response = self.class.post('/shipment/status', body: data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Status API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/etsy_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class EtsyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://openapi.etsy.com/v3'
  default_timeout 30
  
  def initialize(api_key, logger = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    
    # Configure headers
    self.class.headers(
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'x-api-key' => @api_key
    )
  end
  
  # Get shop information
  def get_shop(shop_id)
    response = self.class.get("/application/shops/#{shop_id}")
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch shop: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Get shop listings
  def get_shop_listings(shop_id, limit: 25, offset: 0, status: 'active')
    response = self.class.get("/application/shops/#{shop_id}/listings", 
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        offset: offset,
        status: status
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch shop listings: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")

    end

        limit: limit,

        status: status
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch shop orders: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'colorize'

class NovaPoshtaTracker
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    self.class.default_timeout(10)
  end
  
  def track_parcel(tracking_number)
    # Get the tracking information
    response = get_tracking_info(tracking_number)
    
    if response['success']
      parse_tracking_data(response['data'][0])
    else
      puts "Error: #{response['errors'].first}".red
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def get_tracking_info(tracking_number)
    # Prepare the request data
    data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "TrackingDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getStatusDocuments",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "Documents" => [{
          "Number" => tracking_number,
          "Type" => "03"
        }]
      }
    }
    
    # Make the API request
    self.class.post(BASE_URL, 
                   body: data.to_json,
                   headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
  end

  def parse_tracking_data(data)
    # Extract key information
    tracking_info = {
      number: data['Number'],
      status: data['Status'],
      city: data['CitySender'],
      recipient_city: data['CityRecipient'],
      last_event: data['LastEventDate'],
      sender: data['Sender'],
      recipient: data['Recipient'],
      weight: data['Weight'],
      payment: data['Payment'],
      description: data['Description'],
      events: parse_events(data['Events'])
    }
    
    tracking_info
  end

  def parse_events(events)
    events.map do |event|
      {
        date: event['Date'],
        time: event['Time'],
        status: event['Status'],
        city: event['City'],
        address: event['Address'],
        description: event['Description']
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'nova_poshta_tracker'

class NovaPoshtaUI
  def initialize(api_key)

  def display_parcel_status(tracking_number)
    puts "🔍 Tracking Nova Poshta parcel: #{tracking_number}".blue
    puts "=" * 50

    if tracking_info
      display_header(tracking_info)
      display_details(tracking_info)
      display_events(tracking_info[:events])
    else
      puts "❌ Failed to retrieve tracking information.".red
      return false
    end
    
    true
  end

  private

  def display_header(tracking_info)
    puts "📦 Parcel Information".bold
    puts "-" * 30
    puts "Tracking Number: #{tracking_info[:number]}"
    puts "Current Status: #{format_status(tracking_info[:status])}"
    puts "Sender City: #{tracking_info[:city]}"
    puts "Recipient City: #{tracking_info[:recipient_city]}"
    puts "Last Event Date: #{tracking_info[:last_event]}"
    puts
  end

  def display_details(tracking_info)
    puts "📋 Details".bold
    puts "-" * 30
    puts "Weight: #{tracking_info[:weight] || 'N/A'}"
    puts "Payment: #{tracking_info[:payment] || 'N/A'}"
    puts "Description: #{tracking_info[:description] || 'N/A'}"
    puts
  end

  def display_events(events)
    puts "📅 Event History".bold
    puts "-" * 30
    
    if events.empty?
      puts "No events recorded yet.".yellow
      return
    end
    
    events.each_with_index do |event, index|
      puts "#{index + 1}. #{event[:date]} #{event[:time]}"
      puts "   Status: #{format_event_status(event[:status])}"
      puts "   Location: #{event[:city]}"
      puts "   Address: #{event[:address]}"
      puts "   Description: #{event[:description]}"
      puts
    end
  end

  def format_status(status)
    case status
    when /відправлення отримано/
      status.green
    when /відправлення в дорозі/
      status.yellow
    when /відправлення доставлено/
      status.green
    when /відправлення скасовано/
      status.red
    else
      status
    end
  end

  def format_event_status(status)
    case status
    when /отримано/
      status.green
    when /в дорозі/
      status.yellow
    when /доставлено/
      status.green
    when /скасовано/
      status.red
    else
      status
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    # Required parameters

    when 400

    when 401
      handle_error_response(response, "Unauthorized access")
    when 404

    when 500

    else

      api_secret: @api_secret,
      from_city: options[:from_city],
      to_city: options[:to_city],
      weight: options[:weight],
      volume: options[:volume]
    }.compact
    
    response = self.class.post('/get_rates', body: payload.to_json)
    
    case response.code
    when 200
      handle_success_response(response)
    else
      handle_error_response(response, "Failed to get delivery rates")
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_success_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    # Extract cost information
    {
      success: true,
      cost: data['cost'],
      currency: data['currency'],
      service_type: data['service_type'],
      estimated_delivery: data['estimated_delivery'],
      breakdown: data['breakdown'] || {}
    }
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    {
      success: true,
      raw_response: response.body
    }
  end
  
  def handle_error_response(response, default_message)
    begin
      error_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      message = error_data['message'] || default_message
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      message = default_message
    end
    
    {
      success: false,
      error: message,
      status_code: response.code
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Product < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :store, optional: true
  
  validates :name, :price, presence: true
  validates :price, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  
  # Callbacks for synchronization with BigCommerce
  after_create :sync_to_bigcommerce
  after_update :update_bigcommerce_sync
  
  def sync_to_bigcommerce
    return if bigcommerce_id.present?
    
    client = BigCommerce::API.new
    response = client.products.create({
      name: name,
      price: price,
      description: description,
      weight: weight,
      categories: category_ids,
      inventory_tracking: inventory_tracking ? 'product' : 'none',
      inventory_level: inventory_level,
      sku: sku
    })
    
    self.bigcommerce_id = response['id']
    save!
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync product #{name} to BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end
  
  def update_bigcommerce_sync
    return if bigcommerce_id.blank?
    
    client = BigCommerce::API.new
    client.products.update(bigcommerce_id, {
      name: name,
      price: price,
      description: description,
      weight: weight,
      categories: category_ids,
      inventory_tracking: inventory_tracking ? 'product' : 'none',
      inventory_level: inventory_level,
      sku: sku
    })
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to update product #{name} in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end
  
  def self.create_from_bigcommerce(data)
    product = Product.new(
      name: data['name'],
      price: data['price'],
      description: data['description'],
      weight: data['weight'],
      sku: data['sku'],
      bigcommerce_id: data['id'],
      inventory_level: data['inventory_level'],
      inventory_tracking: data['inventory_tracking'] == 'product'
    )
    product.save!
    product
  end
end
```

```ruby
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :customer
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy
  
  validates :total_amount, :status, presence: true
  validates :total_amount, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  
  # Callbacks for synchronization with BigCommerce
  after_create :create_bigcommerce_order
  
  def create_bigcommerce_order
    return if bigcommerce_order_id.present?
    
    client = BigCommerce::API.new
    order_data = {
      customer_id: customer.bigcommerce_customer_id,
      status_id: status_id_for_bigcommerce,
      items: order_items.map do |item|
        {
          product_id: item.product.bigcommerce_id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          price: item.price
        }
      end,
      shipping_address: {
        first_name: customer.first_name,
        last_name: customer.last_name,
        email: customer.email,
        address1: customer.shipping_address&.address1,
        city: customer.shipping_address&.city,
        state: customer.shipping_address&.state,
        zip: customer.shipping_address&.zip,
        country: customer.shipping_address&.country
      }
    }
    
    response = client.orders.create(order_data)
    
    self.bigcommerce_order_id = response['id']
    save!
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to create order in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end
  
  def status_id_for_bigcommerce
    case status
    when 'pending'
      1
    when 'processing'
      2
    when 'shipped'
      3
    when 'delivered'
      4
    when 'cancelled'
      5
    else
      1
    end
  end
  
  def self.create_from_bigcommerce(data)
    order = Order.new(
      total_amount: data['total_amount'],
      status: data['status'],
      bigcommerce_order_id: data['id'],
      customer: Customer.find_by(bigcommerce_customer_id: data['customer_id'])
    )
    order.save!
    order
  end
end
```

```ruby
class BigCommerceProductService
  def self.create_product(product_data)
    client = BigCommerce::API.new
    
    response = client.products.create(product_data)
    
    # Create local record
    Product.create_from_bigcommerce(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error creating product in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end
  
  def self.update_product(product_id, product_data)
    client = BigCommerce::API.new
    response = client.products.update(product_id, product_data)
    
    # Update local record
    product = Product.find_by(bigcommerce_id: product_id)
    product.update!(product_data.except(:id))
    
    response
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Error updating product in BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    raise e
  end
  
  def self.get_products
    client = BigCommerce::API.new
    client.products.all

    Rails.logger.error "Error fetching products from BigCommerce: #{e.message}"
    []

    client.products.get(id)
```

```ruby
# nova_poshta_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class NovaPoshtaClient
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    @logger = Logger.new('nova_poshta.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  def create_waybill(order_data)
    @logger.info("Creating waybill for order: #{order_data[:order_number]}")
    
    # Prepare the request data
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "save",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "PayerType" => "Recipient",
        "ServiceType" => "WarehouseWarehouse",
        "DateTime" => Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "Sender" => {
          "CityRef" => order_data[:sender_city_ref],
          "ContactPerson" => order_data[:sender_contact],
          "Phone" => order_data[:sender_phone]
        },
        "Recipient" => {
          "CityRef" => order_data[:recipient_city_ref],
          "ContactPerson" => order_data[:recipient_contact],
          "Phone" => order_data[:recipient_phone]
        },
        "Weight" => order_data[:weight],
        "VolumeGeneral" => order_data[:volume],
        "Cost" => order_data[:cost].to_s,
        "PayerType" => "Recipient",
        "ServiceType" => "WarehouseWarehouse",
        "CargoType" => "Parcel",
        "Description" => order_data[:description] || "Order #{order_data[:order_number]}",
        "PaymentMethod" => "Cash",
        "Note" => order_data[:note] || ""
      }
    }
    
    # Make the API request
    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_city_ref(city_name)
    @logger.info("Getting city reference for: #{city_name}")
    
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "Address",
      "calledMethod" => "getCities",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "FindByString" => city_name
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_warehouse_ref(city_ref, warehouse_name = nil)
    @logger.info("Getting warehouse reference for city: #{city_ref}")
    
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "Address",
      "calledMethod" => "getWarehouses",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "CityRef" => city_ref
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    @logger.debug("API Response: #{response.body}")
    
    begin
      parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if parsed_response['success'] == true
        @logger.info("API request successful")
        parsed_response['data'][0]
      else
        error_message = parsed_response['errors'].join(', ') if parsed_response['errors']
        @logger.error("API request failed: #{error_message}")
        raise "Nova Poshta API Error: #{error_message}"
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      @logger.error("Failed to parse JSON response: #{e.message}")
      raise "Failed to parse API response: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

end

  end
```

```ruby
    cities.each do |city|
      City.find_or_create_by(ref: city[:ref]) do |c|
        c.city_name = city[:city_name]
      end
    end

          w.city_ref = wh[:city_ref]
          w.number = wh[:number]
          w.address = wh[:address]
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def run
    sync_cities
    sync_warehouses
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class NovaPoshtaCalculator
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'

  # Вартість доставки
  def self.calculate_delivery_cost(weight, declared_value, city_to = 'Київ')
    # Приклад виклику методу для отримання вартості доставки
    # У справжньому коді потрібно зробити реальний виклик API Нової Пошти
    # Але тут ми імітуємо розрахунок з урахуванням ваги та оголошеної вартості

    # Орієнтовна логіка розрахунку:
    # - Вартість за вагу (наприклад, 20 грн за 1 кг)
    # - Вартість за оголошеною вартістю (0.5% від вартості, максимум 300 грн)

    base_cost_per_kg = 20
    insurance_rate = 0.005
    max_insurance = 300

    cost_by_weight = weight * base_cost_per_kg
    insurance_cost = [declared_value * insurance_rate, max_insurance].min
    total_cost = cost_by_weight + insurance_cost

    total_cost.round(2)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class NovaPoshtaReturn
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  def create_return(order_number, reason, return_address, recipient_info)
    # Формуємо запит
    payload = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getReturnOrder",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "Number" => order_number,
        "Reason" => reason,
        "ReturnAddress" => return_address,
        "Recipient" => recipient_info
      }
    }

    # Відправляємо запит
    response = self.class.post(
      '',
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    # Обробляємо відповідь
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
def generate_hotline_xml(products)
  xml_doc = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|

            xml.category('id' => product[:category]) { xml.name(product[:category]) }
          end
        end
        xml.offers do
          products.each do |product|
            xml.offer('id' => product[:id], 'available' => 'true') do
              xml.url(product[:url])
              xml.price(product[:price])
              xml.oldprice(product[:old_price]) if product[:old_price]
              xml.currencyId('UAH')
              xml.categoryId(product[:category])
              xml.picture(product[:image])
              xml.name(product[:name])
              xml.vendor(product[:brand])
              xml.description(product[:description])
              xml.delivery('true')
              xml.local_delivery_cost('0')

        end

    end
```

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

require 'nokogiri'
require 'csv'

class HotlineFeedGenerator
  # Product model to represent catalog items
  class Product
    attr_accessor :id, :name, :description, :price, :category, :brand, :image_url, :availability, :url
    
    def initialize(attributes = {})
      @id = attributes[:id]
      @name = attributes[:name]
      @description = attributes[:description]
      @price = attributes[:price]
      @category = attributes[:category]
      @brand = attributes[:brand]
      @image_url = attributes[:image_url]
      @availability = attributes[:availability] || 'В наличии'
      @url = attributes[:url]
    end
    
    def to_xml_element(doc)
      product = doc.create_element('product')
      
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('id', @id))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('name', @name))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('description', @description))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('price', @price))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('category', @category))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('brand', @brand))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('image', @image_url))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('availability', @availability))
      product.add_child(doc.create_element('url', @url))
      
      product
    end
  end

  def initialize
    @products = []
  end

  def add_product(product)
    @products << product
  end

  def add_products_from_csv(file_path)
    CSV.foreach(file_path, headers: true) do |row|
      product = Product.new(
        id: row['id'],
        name: row['name'],
        description: row['description'],
        price: row['price'],
        category: row['category'],
        brand: row['brand'],
        image_url: row['image_url'],
        availability: row['availability'],
        url: row['url']
      )
      add_product(product)
    end
  end

  def generate_xml
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.catalog('xmlns' => 'http://hotline.ua/xml') do
        xml.date(Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
        xml.products do
          @products.each do |product|
            product.to_xml_element(xml)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end

  def save_xml(file_path)
    File.write(file_path, generate_xml)
  end

  def validate_xml(xml_string)
    begin
      Nokogiri::XML(xml_string) { |config| config.strict }
      true
    rescue Nokogiri::SyntaxError => e
      puts "XML Validation Error: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class DeliveryTracker
  include HTTParty
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'

class BASExporter
  include HTTParty

  # Налаштування для HTTP-запитів
  base_uri 'https://api.bas.example.com'  # Замініть на реальний URL системи BAS
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/xml'

  def initialize(api_key:, company_id:)
    @api_key = api_key
    @company_id = company_id
  end

  def export_order(order)
    xml = build_order_xml(order)
    response = self.class.post('/export', body: xml, headers: auth_headers)

    if response.success?
      puts "Замовлення успішно експортовано: #{order[:id]}"
      return true
    else
      puts "Помилка експорту замовлення #{order[:id]}: #{response.body}"
      return false
    end
  end

  private

  def build_order_xml(order)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.order do
        xml.id order[:id]
        xml.date order[:date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        xml.customer do
          xml.name order[:customer][:name]
          xml.inn order[:customer][:inn]
        end
        xml.items do
          order[:items].each do |item|
            xml.item do
              xml.name item[:name]
              xml.quantity item[:quantity]
              xml.price item[:price]
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    builder.to_xml
  end

  def auth_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Company-ID' => @company_id
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class NovaPoshtaTracker
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  def track_shipment(tracking_number)
    # Формуємо запит для отримання інформації про посилку
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "TrackingDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getStatusProperties",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "DocumentNumber" => tracking_number
      }
    }

    # Відправляємо запит до API Нової Пошти
    response = self.class.post(
      '/tracking',
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    # Обробляємо відповідь
    if response.success?
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      return data['data']
    else
      puts "Помилка при з'єднанні з API: #{response.code}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def display_tracking_info(tracking_number, tracking_data)
    # Створюємо красивий вивід інформації про посилку
    box = TTY::Box.frame(
      width: 60,
      height: 25,
      padding: 1,
      border: :unicode
    ) do
      info = "Інформація про посилку\n\n"
      info += "Номер накладної: #{tracking_number}\n\n"
      
      if tracking_data && tracking_data.length > 0
        document = tracking_data[0]
        
        # Виводимо основну інформацію про статус
        status = document['Status']
        info += "Статус: #{status}\n"
        
        # Виводимо додаткові дані
        if document['LastCreatedOn']
          info += "Останній статус: #{document['LastCreatedOn']}\n"
        end
        
        # Виводимо інформацію про відправлення
        if document['SenderAddress']
          info += "Відправник: #{document['SenderAddress']}\n"
        end
        
        if document['RecipientAddress']
          info += "Отримувач: #{document['RecipientAddress']}\n"
        end
        
        # Виводимо інформацію про відстеження
        if document['TrackingHistory'] && document['TrackingHistory'].length > 0
          info += "\nІсторія відстеження:\n"
          document['TrackingHistory'].first(3).each_with_index do |history, index|
            info += "#{index + 1}. #{history['Status']} - #{history['Date']}\n"
          end
        else
          info += "\nІсторія відстеження відсутня\n"
        end
        
        # Додаткова інформація про термін доставки
        if document['EstimatedDeliveryDate']
          info += "\nОрієнтовна дата доставки: #{document['EstimatedDeliveryDate']}\n"
        end
      else
        info += "Немає інформації про цю накладну\n"
      end
      
      info
    end
    
    puts box
  end

  def track_with_spinner(tracking_number)
    # Використовуємо спиннер для кращого UX
    spinner = TTY::Spinner.new("[:spinner] Відстеження посилки #{tracking_number}...", format: :dots)
    spinner.auto_spin
    
    begin
      tracking_data = track_shipment(tracking_number)
      spinner.success("Готово!")
      
      if tracking_data && tracking_data.length > 0
        display_tracking_info(tracking_number, tracking_data)
      else
        puts "Не вдалося знайти інформацію про посилку #{tracking_number}"
      end
    rescue => e
      spinner.error("Помилка!")
      puts "Сталася помилка: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

# Основна програма
def main
  puts "=== Відстеження посилок Нової Пошти ===\n\n"
  
  # Просимо користувача ввести номер накладної
```

I'll create a Ruby solution that handles both exporting products to Prom.ua's YML format and importing orders through their API.

## Implementation

### lib/prom_ua/client.rb

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'active_model'

class PromUa::Client
  include HTTParty
  
  attr_accessor :api_key, :shop_name, :base_uri
  
  def initialize(api_key, shop_name)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_name = shop_name
    @base_uri = 'https://api.prom.ua'
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  # Export products to Prom.ua YML format
  def export_products(products)
    yml_doc = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) do
        xml.shop do
          xml.name @shop_name
          xml.company "Your Company Name"
          xml.url "https://your-shop.com"
          
          xml.currencies do
            xml.currency(id: "UAH", rate: 1)
          end
          
          xml.categories do
            # Category structure should be added based on your products
            xml.category(id: 1, name: "All Products")
          end
          
          xml.offers do
            products.each do |product|
              xml.offer(id: product[:id], available: product[:available] || true) do
                xml.url product[:url] || ""
                xml.price product[:price]
                xml.currencyId "UAH"
                xml.categoryId 1
                xml.picture product[:image_url] || ""
                xml.name product[:name]
                xml.description product[:description] || ""
                xml.brand product[:brand] || ""
                xml.weight product[:weight] || 0
                xml.dimensions product[:dimensions] || ""
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    yml_doc.to_xml
  end
  
  # Import orders from Prom.ua
  def import_orders
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_uri}/orders",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch orders: #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  # Update order status
  def update_order_status(order_id, status)
    response = self.class.put(
      "#{@base_uri}/orders/#{order_id}/status",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: { status: status }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to update order status: #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  # Send order confirmation
  def confirm_order(order_id)
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_uri}/orders/#{order_id}/confirm",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to confirm order: #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'active_record'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class NovaPoshtaLoader
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']

  def initialize
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def load_cities
    puts "Loading Nova Poshta cities..."
    
    response = get_cities_from_api
    
    if response['success']
      cities = response['data'].map do |city_data|
        {
          ref: city_data['Ref'],
          description: city_data['Description'],
          description_ru: city_data['DescriptionRu'],
          area: city_data['Area'],
          region: city_data['Region'],
          settlement_type: city_data['SettlementType'],
          is_branch: city_data['IsBranch'],
          code: city_data['CityID'],
          longitude: city_data['Longitude'],
          latitude: city_data['Latitude'],
          timezone: city_data['Timezone']
        }
      end
      
      City.import(cities, on_duplicate_key_update: [:description, :description_ru, :area, :region, :settlement_type, :is_branch, :code, :longitude, :latitude, :timezone])
      puts "Loaded #{cities.length} cities"
    else
      puts "Failed to load cities: #{response['errors']}"
    end
  end

  def load_branches
    puts "Loading Nova Poshta branches..."
    
    response = get_branches_from_api
    
    if response['success']
      branches = response['data'].map do |branch_data|
        {
          ref: branch_data['Ref'],
          city_ref: branch_data['CityRef'],
          number: branch_data['Number'],
          description: branch_data['Description'],
          description_ru: branch_data['DescriptionRu'],
          address: branch_data['Address'],
          address_ru: branch_data['AddressRu'],
          phone: branch_data['Phone'],
          email: branch_data['Email'],
          latitude: branch_data['Latitude'],
          longitude: branch_data['Longitude'],
          schedule: branch_data['Schedule'],
          type: branch_data['Type'],
          warehouse_type: branch_data['WarehouseType'],
          is_branch: branch_data['IsBranch'],
          max_weight_allowed: branch_data['MaxWeightAllowed'],
          total_amount_of_limited: branch_data['TotalAmountOfLimited'],
          total_amount_of_ultra_limited: branch_data['TotalAmountOfUltraLimited'],
          is_post_finance: branch_data['IsPostFinance'],
          is_nova_poshta: branch_data['IsNovaPoshta']
        }
      end
      
      Branch.import(branches, on_duplicate_key_update: [:city_ref, :number, :description, :description_ru, :address, :address_ru, :phone, :email, :latitude, :longitude, :schedule, :type, :warehouse_type, :is_branch, :max_weight_allowed, :total_amount_of_limited, :total_amount_of_ultra_limited, :is_post_finance, :is_nova_poshta])
      puts "Loaded #{branches.length} branches"
    else
      puts "Failed to load branches: #{response['errors']}"
    end
  end

  def refresh_data
    puts "Refreshing Nova Poshta data..."
    load_cities
    load_branches
    puts "Data refresh completed!"
  end

  private

  def get_cities_from_api
    request_params = {
      'modelName' => 'Address',
      'calledMethod' => 'getCities',
      'methodProperties' => {}
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/Address/getCities', 
                              headers: { 'apiKey' => API_KEY },
                              body: request_params.to_json,
                              format: :json)
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def get_branches_from_api
    request_params = {
      'modelName' => 'AddressGeneral',
      'calledMethod' => 'getWarehouses',
      'methodProperties' => {
        'CityRef' => nil
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/AddressGeneral/getWarehouses', 
                              headers: { 'apiKey' => API_KEY },
                              body: request_params.to_json,
                              format: :json)
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class NovaPoshtaAPICalculator
  include HTTParty

    @api_key = api_key
    self.class.base_uri('https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/')
  end
  
  def calculate_delivery_cost(weight, declared_value, city_sender, city_recipient, service_type = 'WarehouseWarehouse')
    # Get cities list
    cities = get_cities_list
    sender_city_ref = find_city_reference(cities, city_sender)
    recipient_city_ref = find_city_reference(cities, city_recipient)
    
    # Calculate cost using actual Nova Poshta API
    result = calculate_cost_actual(weight, declared_value, sender_city_ref, recipient_city_ref, service_type)
    
    result
  end
  
  private
  
  def get_cities_list
    # Fetch cities from Nova Poshta API
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "Address",
      "calledMethod" => "getCities",
      "methodProperties" => {}
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/Address/getCities', body: request_data.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    response.parsed_response
  end
  
  def find_city_reference(cities_data, city_name)
    # Find city reference by name
    cities_data['data'].find do |city|
      city['Description'].downcase == city_name.downcase || 
      city['DescriptionRu'].downcase == city_name.downcase
    end&.[]('Ref')
  end
  
  def calculate_cost_actual(weight, declared_value, sender_city_ref, recipient_city_ref, service_type)
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getDocumentPrice",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "CitySender" => sender_city_ref,
        "CityRecipient" => recipient_city_ref,
        "ServiceType" => service_type,
        "Weight" => weight,
        "Cost" => declared_value
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('/InternetDocument/getDocumentPrice', body: request_data.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })
    
    if response.success?
      parsed_response = response.parsed_response
      {
        total_cost: parsed_response['data'][0]['Cost'].to_f,

        additional_cost: parsed_response['data'][0]['AdditionalCost'].to_f,
        weight: weight,
        declared_value: declared_value
      }
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv'

class OLXAPI
  include HTTParty
  attr_accessor :access_token, :logger

  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(access_token, logger = nil)
    @access_token = access_token
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @base_url = 'https://api.olx.ua/partner'
    self.class.base_uri(@base_url)
  end

  def create_advert(advert_data)
    @logger.info("Creating advert with title: #{advert_data[:title]}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        '/ads',
        body: advert_data.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      )

      handle_response(response, 'advert creation')
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error creating advert: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  def update_advert(advert_id, advert_data)
    @logger.info("Updating advert with ID: #{advert_id}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.put(
        "/ads/#{advert_id}",
        body: advert_data.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      )

      handle_response(response, 'advert update')
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error updating advert #{advert_id}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  def delete_advert(advert_id)
    @logger.info("Deleting advert with ID: #{advert_id}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.delete(
        "/ads/#{advert_id}",
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      )

      handle_response(response, 'advert deletion')
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error deleting advert #{advert_id}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  def get_advert(advert_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching advert with ID: #{advert_id}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "/ads/#{advert_id}",
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      )

      handle_response(response, 'fetching advert')
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching advert #{advert_id}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  def list_adverts(options = {})
    @logger.info("Listing adverts with options: #{options}")
    
    begin
      query_params = options.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
      url = "/ads#{'?'+query_params if query_params.length > 0}"
      
      response = self.class.get(
        url,
        headers: {
          'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      )

      handle_response(response, 'listing adverts')
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error listing adverts: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  def upload_image(image_path)
    @logger.info("Uploading image: #{image_path}")
    
    begin
      File.open(image_path, 'rb') do |file|
        response = self.class.post(
          '/images',
          body: file.read,
          headers: {
            'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
            'Content-Type' => 'image/jpeg'
          }
        )

        handle_response(response, 'image upload')
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error("Error uploading image #{image_path}: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response, action)
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Successfully #{action}")
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "Failed to #{action}: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      @logger.error(error_message)
      raise OLXAPIError, error_message
    end
  end
end

class OLXAPIError < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class KeyCrmService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.keycrm.com/v1'

  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['KEYCRM_API_TOKEN']}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def create_order(order)
    payload = {
      customer: {
        name: order.customer_name,
        email: order.customer_email
      },
      items: order.items.map do |item|
        {
          product: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          price: item[:price]
        }
      end
    }

    response = self.class.post('/orders', headers: @headers, body: payload.to_json)

    if response.success?
      Rails.logger.info "Order #{order.id} synced to KeyCRM"
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order.id}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/nova_poshta_return.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class NovaPoshtaReturn
  include HTTParty

  # Nova Poshta API configuration
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'.freeze
  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY'] || 'your-api-key-here'

  # Initialize with API key (can be loaded from environment)
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || API_KEY
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  # Create a return shipment
  def create_return_shipment(return_data)
    # Prepare the request data
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "save",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "PayerType" => return_data[:payer_type] || "Recipient",
        "ServiceType" => return_data[:service_type] || "WarehouseWarehouse",
        "DateTime" => return_data[:date] || Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "CargoType" => return_data[:cargo_type] || "Parcel",
        "Weight" => return_data[:weight] || 1,
        "Volume General" => return_data[:volume] || "0.01",
        "Description" => return_data[:description] || "Return shipment",
        "Cost" => return_data[:cost] || "0",
        "CitySender" => return_data[:city_sender] || "Киев",
        "Sender" => return_data[:sender] || "Sender Name",
        "SenderAddress" => return_data[:sender_address] || "Sender Address",
        "ContactSender" => return_data[:contact_sender] || "Sender Contact",
        "SendersPhone" => return_data[:sender_phone] || "380000000000",
        "CityRecipient" => return_data[:city_recipient] || "Киев",
        "Recipient" => return_data[:recipient] || "Recipient Name",
        "RecipientAddress" => return_data[:recipient_address] || "Recipient Address",
        "ContactRecipient" => return_data[:contact_recipient] || "Recipient Contact",
        "RecipientsPhone" => return_data[:recipient_phone] || "380000000000",
        "AdditionalInformation" => return_data[:additional_info] || "Return of goods",
        "NumberOfCargo" => return_data[:number_of_cargo] || 1,
        "DeliveryDate" => return_data[:delivery_date] || Time.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "OrderNumber" => return_data[:order_number] || "RETURN_#{Time.now.to_i}",
        "ReturnOrder" => true
      }
    }

    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    # Parse and return response
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Get return shipment status
  def get_return_status(tracking_number)
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "getDocumentList",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "DocumentNumber" => tracking_number
      }
    }

    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Cancel a return shipment
  def cancel_return_shipment(tracking_number)
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "InternetDocument",
      "calledMethod" => "delete",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "DocumentNumber" => tracking_number
      }
    }

    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Helper method to parse API response
  def parse_response(response)
    begin
      parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if parsed_response['success']
        {
          success: true,
          data: parsed_response['data'],
          message: parsed_response['message'] || 'Operation successful'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: parsed_response['errors'] || parsed_response['message'],
          data: parsed_response['data']
        }
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Invalid JSON response from Nova Poshta API',
        raw_response: response.body
      }
    end
  end

  # Validate required fields for return shipment
  def validate_return_data(return_data)
    required_fields = [:order_number, :sender, :recipient, :sender_phone, :recipient_phone]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields.select do |field|
      return_data[field].nil? || return_data[field].to_s.strip.empty?
    end

    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end

    true
  end

  # Get cities list (useful for return shipment)
  def get_cities
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "Address",
      "calledMethod" => "getCities",
      "methodProperties" => {}
    }

    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Get warehouses for specific city
  def get_warehouses(city_name)
    request_data = {
      "apiKey" => @api_key,
      "modelName" => "Address",
      "calledMethod" => "getWarehouses",
      "methodProperties" => {
        "CityName" => city_name
      }
    }

    response = self.class.post('/', 
      body: request_data.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Gemfile

# app.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'csv'

class EpicentrSync
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new('epicentr_sync.log')
    @base_url = ENV['EPICENTR_API_URL'] || 'https://api.epicentr.com/seller/v1'
    @api_key = ENV['EPICENTR_API_KEY']
    @shop_id = ENV['EPICENTR_SHOP_ID']
    
    raise 'EPICENTR_API_KEY not set' unless @api_key
    raise 'EPICENTR_SHOP_ID not set' unless @shop_id
    
    self.class.base_uri @base_url
    self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
  end
  
  # Fetch all products from Epicentr
  def fetch_all_products
    @logger.info 'Fetching all products from Epicentr...'
    
    response = self.class.get('/products', 
      query: { 
        limit: 1000,
        offset: 0
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Fetched #{response.parsed_response['products'].length} products"
      response.parsed_response['products']
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to fetch products: #{response.body}"
      raise "API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Fetch stock for all products
  def fetch_stock
    @logger.info 'Fetching stock information...'
    
    response = self.class.get('/stock', query: { limit: 1000 })
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Fetched #{response.parsed_response['stock'].length} stock items"
      response.parsed_response['stock']
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to fetch stock: #{response.body}"
      raise "API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Update product information
  def update_product(product_data)
    @logger.info "Updating product: #{product_data['id']} - #{product_data['name']}"
    
    response = self.class.put("/products/#{product_data['id']}", 
      body: product_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully updated product #{product_data['id']}"
      response.parsed_response
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to update product #{product_data['id']}: #{response.body}"
      raise "API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Create a new product
  def create_product(product_data)
    @logger.info "Creating new product: #{product_data['name']}"
    
    response = self.class.post('/products', 
      body: product_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully created product: #{response.parsed_response['id']}"
      response.parsed_response
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to create product: #{response.body}"
      raise "API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Update stock for a product
  def update_stock(product_id, stock_data)
    @logger.info "Updating stock for product: #{product_id}"
    
    response = self.class.put("/stock/#{product_id}", 
      body: stock_data.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully updated stock for product #{product_id}"
      response.parsed_response
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to update stock for product #{product_id}: #{response.body}"
      raise "API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Sync products from external source (example: local CSV file)
  def sync_products_from_csv(csv_file_path)
    @logger.info "Syncing products from CSV: #{csv_file_path}"
    
    products = []
    
    CSV.foreach(csv_file_path, headers: true) do |row|
      product = {
        'id' => row['product_id'],
        'name' => row['name'],
        'description' => row['description'],
        'price' => row['price'].to_f,
        'category_id' => row['category_id'],
        'brand' => row['brand'],
        'weight' => row['weight'].to_f,
        'dimensions' => {
          'length' => row['length'].to_f,
          'width' => row['width'].to_f,
          'height' => row['height'].to_f
        },
        'images' => row['images']&.split(';') || [],
        'status' => row['status'] || 'active'
      }
      
      products << product
    end
    
    # Fetch existing products from Epicentr
    existing_products = fetch_all_products
    
    # Process products
    products.each do |product|
      existing_product = existing_products.find { |p| p['id'] == product['id'] }
      
      if existing_product
        # Update existing product
        update_product(product)
      else
        # Create new product
        create_product(product)
      end
    end
    
    @logger.info "Product sync completed"
  end
  
  # Sync stock from external source
  def sync_stock_from_csv(csv_file_path)
    @logger.info "Syncing stock from CSV: #{csv_file_path}"
    
    CSV.foreach(csv_file_path, headers: true) do |row|
      product_id = row['product_id']
      stock_quantity = row['stock_quantity'].to_i
      reserved_quantity = row['reserved_quantity'].to_i
      warehouse = row['warehouse'] || 'default'
      
      stock_data = {
        'quantity' => stock_quantity,
        'reserved' => reserved_quantity,
        'warehouse' => warehouse,
        'last_updated' => Time.now.iso8601
      }
      
      update_stock(product_id, stock_data)
    end
    
    @logger.info "Stock sync completed"
  end
  
  # Sync products and stock from local database or file
  def full_sync(options = {})
    start_time = Time.now
    
    begin
      # Sync products
      if options[:sync_products] != false
        sync_products_from_csv(options[:products_csv] || 'products.csv')
      end
      
      # Sync stock
      if options[:sync_stock] != false
        sync_stock_from_csv(options[:stock_csv] || 'stock.csv')
      end
      
      end_time = Time.now
      @logger.info "Full sync completed in #{(end_time - start_time).round(2)} seconds"
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error "Sync failed: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end
  
  # Get sync status
  def get_sync_status
    {
      'timestamp' => Time.now.iso8601,
      'shop_id' => @shop_id,
      'api_url' => @base_url
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# config/environment.rb
require 'bundler/setup'

require 'httparty'

require 'logger'

require 'dotenv/load' if File.exist?('.env')

class RozetkaSellerAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://rozetka.com.ua/api/seller/v1'
  
  def initialize(api_key:, shop_id:)
    @api_key = api_key
    @shop_id = shop_id
    @logger = Logger.new('rozetka_orders.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  def fetch_new_orders(status: 'new')
    @logger.info("Fetching new orders with status: #{status}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      '/orders',
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      query: {
        status: status,
        limit: 100,
        offset: 0
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Successfully fetched #{response['data'].length} orders")
      response['data']
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch orders: #{response.message}")
      []
    end
  end
  
  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status, comment = nil)
    @logger.info("Updating order #{order_id} status to #{new_status}")
    
    payload = {
      status: new_status,
      comment: comment
    }.compact
    
    response = self.class.put(
      "/orders/#{order_id}/status",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Successfully updated order #{order_id}")
      true
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to update order #{order_id}: #{response.message}")
      false
    end
  end
  
  def get_order_details(order_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching details for order #{order_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response['data']
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to fetch order details for #{order_id}: #{response.message}")
      nil
    end
  end
end

class OrderProcessor
  def initialize(api_client)
    @api = api_client
    @logger = Logger.new('order_processor.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  def process_new_orders
    @logger.info("Starting order processing cycle")
    
    orders = @api.fetch_new_orders(status: 'new')
    
    if orders.empty?
      @logger.info("No new orders found")
      return
    end
    
    orders.each do |order|
      process_order(order)
    end
    
    @logger.info("Order processing cycle completed")
  end
  
  private
  
  def process_order(order)
    order_id = order['id']
    @logger.info("Processing order: #{order_id}")
    
    begin
      # Validate order data
      if validate_order(order)
        # Update order to processing status
        success = @api.update_order_status(
          order_id, 
          'processing', 
          'Order automatically processed by system'
        )
        
        if success
          # Fetch detailed order information
          order_details = @api.get_order_details(order_id)
          if order_details
            @logger.info("Order #{order_id} processed successfully")
            log_order_info(order_details)
          end
        else
          @logger.warn("Failed to update status for order #{order_id}")
        end
      else
        @logger.warn("Invalid order data for order #{order_id}")
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error processing order #{order_id}: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
  
  def validate_order(order)
    # Basic validation of required fields
    return false if order['id'].nil?
    return false if order['status'].nil?
    return false if order['created_at'].nil?
    
    # Check if order has items
    return false if order['items'].nil? || order['items'].empty?
    
    true
  end
  
  def log_order_info(order_details)
    @logger.info("Order Details:")
    @logger.info("  Order ID: #{order_details['id']}")
    @logger.info("  Customer: #{order_details['customer']['name']}")
    @logger.info("  Items count: #{order_details['items'].length}")
    @logger.info("  Total amount: #{order_details['total_amount']}")
    @logger.info("  Status: #{order_details['status']}")
  end
end

# Main application
def main
  # Load configuration from environment variables
  api_key = ENV['ROZETKA_API_KEY']
  shop_id = ENV['ROZETKA_SHOP_ID']
  
  if api_key.nil? || shop_id.nil?
    puts "Error: Please set ROZETKA_API_KEY and ROZETKA_SHOP_ID in environment variables"
    exit 1
  end
  
  # Initialize API client and processor
  api_client = RozetkaSellerAPI.new(api_key: api_key, shop_id: shop_id)
  processor = OrderProcessor.new(api_client)
  
  # Process new orders
  processor.process_new_orders
  
  puts "Order processing completed"
end

# Run the application if this file is executed directly
if __FILE__ == $0
  main
end
```

```ruby
# mrz_parser.rb
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class MRZParser
  MRZ_LENGTH = 90
  VALID_CHARS = ('A'..'Z').to_set + ('0'..'9').to_set + '<'.to_set

  def self.parse(mrz_string)
    new(mrz_string).parse
  end

  def initialize(mrz_string)
    @mrz_string = mrz_string
  end

  def parse
    # Validate MRZ format
    validate_format
    
    # Extract segments
    extract_segments
    
    # Parse data
    parse_data
  end

  private

  def validate_format
    # Check if it's exactly 90 characters
    raise ArgumentError, "MRZ must be exactly 90 characters" unless @mrz_string.length == MRZ_LENGTH
    
    # Check if it contains only valid characters
    invalid_chars = @mrz_string.chars.reject { |char| VALID_CHARS.include?(char) }
    raise ArgumentError, "MRZ contains invalid characters: #{invalid_chars.uniq.join}" unless invalid_chars.empty?
  end

  def extract_segments
    # Split into lines
    lines = @mrz_string.lines.map(&:chomp)
    
    # First line (Type, Issuing country, Name)
    @line1 = lines[0]
    
    # Second line (Passport number, nationality, date of birth, sex, expiration date, personal number)
    @line2 = lines[1]
    
    # Third line (Optional - not part of standard MRZ)
    @line3 = lines[2] if lines.length > 2
  end

  def parse_data
    {
      document_type: @line1[0..1],
      issuing_country: @line1[2..4],
      name: parse_name,
      passport_number: @line2[0..8],
      passport_number_check_digit: @line2[9],
      nationality: @line2[10..12],
      date_of_birth: parse_date(@line2[13..18]),
      date_of_birth_check_digit: @line2[19],
      sex: @line2[20],
      expiration_date: parse_date(@line2[21..26]),
      expiration_date_check_digit: @line2[27],
      personal_number: @line2[28..43],
      personal_number_check_digit: @line2[44],
      composite_check_digit: @line2[45]
    }
  end

  def parse_name
    # First name comes after the second < (after the surname)
    name_section = @line1[5..44]
    
    # Extract surname and given names
    surname_start = name_section.index('<<')
    if surname_start
      surname = name_section[0...surname_start]
      given_names = name_section[surname_start + 2..-1].gsub('<', ' ').strip
      return "#{given_names} #{surname}".strip
    else
      # If no surname separator found, treat as one name
      return name_section.gsub('<', ' ').strip
    end
  end

  def parse_date(date_string)
    # Format: YYMMDD
    return nil if date_string.nil? || date_string.empty?
    
    year = date_string[0..1].to_i
    month = date_string[2..3].to_i
    day = date_string[4..5].to_i
    
    # Handle 2-digit year (assuming 1900s or 2000s)
    year = year < 50 ? 2000 + year : 1900 + year
    
    return "#{year}-#{month.to_s.rjust(2, '0')}-#{day.to_s.rjust(2, '0')}"
  rescue => e
    nil
  end
end

# Example usage and test

  sample_mrz = "P<USADOE<<JANE<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<\n" \
               "12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890\n" \
               "12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890"
  
  begin
    result = MRZParser.parse(sample_mrz)
    puts "Parsed MRZ data:"
    result.each do |key, value|
      puts "#{key}: #{value}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error parsing MRZ: #{e.message}"
  end
```

```ruby
# bas_exporter.rb
require 'csv'
require 'json'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext'
require 'logger'
require 'builder'

class BASExporter
  include HTTParty

  attr_accessor :config, :logger

  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = {
      base_url: config[:base_url] || 'https://api.bas.ua',
      api_key: config[:api_key],
      company_id: config[:company_id],
      debug: config[:debug] || false
    }.freeze

    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = @config[:debug] ? Logger::DEBUG : Logger::INFO

    self.class.default_timeout 30
    self.class.headers('Content-Type' => 'application/json', 'Accept' => 'application/json')
  end

  def export_orders(orders)
    @logger.info("Starting export of #{orders.length} orders to BAS system")
    
    results = []
    
    orders.each_with_index do |order, index|
      begin
        result = export_single_order(order)
        results << { order_id: order[:id], success: true, result: result }
        @logger.info("Successfully exported order #{order[:id]} (#{index + 1}/#{orders.length})")
      rescue => e
        results << { order_id: order[:id], success: false, error: e.message }
        @logger.error("Failed to export order #{order[:id]}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end
    
    results
  end

  private

  def export_single_order(order)
    @logger.debug("Exporting order: #{order[:id]}")
    
    # Validate order data
    validate_order!(order)
    
    # Create XML payload
    xml_payload = build_xml_order(order)
    
    # Send to BAS system
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@config[:base_url]}/orders",
      body: xml_payload,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@config[:api_key]}",
        'X-Company-ID' => @config[:company_id].to_s
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.debug("Order #{order[:id]} exported successfully")
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "BAS API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def validate_order!(order)
    required_fields = [:id, :date, :customer, :items]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |field| order.key?(field) }
    raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" unless missing_fields.empty?
    
    # Validate customer data
    if order[:customer].nil? || order[:customer][:name].nil?
      raise ArgumentError, "Customer name is required"
    end
    
    # Validate items
    if order[:items].nil? || order[:items].empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Order must have at least one item"
    end
    
    order[:items].each_with_index do |item, index|
      item_required = [:name, :quantity, :price]
      missing_item_fields = item_required.reject { |field| item.key?(field) }
      raise ArgumentError, "Item #{index + 1} missing fields: #{missing_item_fields.join(', ')}" unless missing_item_fields.empty?
    end
  end

  def build_xml_order(order)
    xml = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    xml.instruct!
    xml.orders do
      xml.order do
        xml.id(order[:id])
        xml.date(order[:date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        xml.customer do
          xml.name(order[:customer][:name])
          xml.tax_id(order[:customer][:tax_id]) if order[:customer][:tax_id]
          xml.address(order[:customer][:address]) if order[:customer][:address]
        end
        
        xml.items do
          order[:items].each do |item|
            xml.item do
              xml.name(item[:name])
              xml.quantity(item[:quantity])
              xml.price(item[:price])
              xml.total(item[:quantity] * item[:price])
              xml.vat_rate(item[:vat_rate] || 20) # Default VAT rate
            end
          end
        end
        
        xml.total_amount(calculate_total(order))
        xml.currency('UAH')
        xml.status('exported')
      end
    end
  end

  def calculate_total(order)
    total = 0
    order[:items].each do |item|
      total += item[:quantity] * item[:price]
    end
    total
  end

  public

  # Alternative CSV export method for legacy systems
  def export_orders_csv(orders, filename = 'bas_orders_export.csv')
    CSV.open(filename, 'w') do |csv|
      # Header row
      csv << ['Order ID', 'Date', 'Customer Name', 'Customer Tax ID', 'Item Name', 
              'Quantity', 'Price', 'Total', 'VAT Rate', 'Currency', 'Status']
      
      orders.each do |order|
        order[:items].each do |item|
          csv << [
            order[:id],
            order[:date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
            order[:customer][:name],
            order[:customer][:tax_id] || '',
            item[:name],
            item[:quantity],
            item[:price],
            item[:quantity] * item[:price],
            item[:vat_rate] || 20,
            'UAH',
            'exported'
          ]
        end
      end
    end
    
    @logger.info("CSV export completed: #{filename}")
    filename
  end

  # Export to JSON format (alternative format)
  def export_orders_json(orders, filename = 'bas_orders_export.json')
    export_data = orders.map do |order|
      {
        order_id: order[:id],
        date: order[:date].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        customer: order[:customer],
        items: order[:items].map do |item|
          {
            name: item[:name],
            quantity: item[:quantity],
            price: item[:price],
            total: item[:quantity] * item[:price],
            vat_rate: item[:vat_rate] || 20
          }
        end,
        total_amount: calculate_total(order),
        currency: 'UAH',
        status: 'exported'
      }
    end
    
    File.write(filename, JSON.pretty_generate(export_data))
    @logger.info("JSON export completed: #{filename}")
    filename
  end

  # Method to get order status from BAS system
  def get_order_status(order_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@config[:base_url]}/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@config[:api_key]}",
        'X-Company-ID' => @config[:company_id].to_s
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response
    else
      raise "Failed to get order status: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Method to validate connection to BAS system
  def validate_connection
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@config[:base_url]}/health",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@config[:api_key]}",
        'X-Company-ID' => @config[:company_id].to_s
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info("Successfully connected to BAS system")
      true
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to connect to BAS system: #{response.code}")
      false
    end
  end
end
```

### 2. Код (`main.rb`)

```ruby
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'rest_client'
require 'json'

# Ініціалізація клієнта DocuSign
def docusign_client
  # Встановіть змінні середовища:
  # DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_ID, DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_SECRET, DOCUSIGN_USER_ID, DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID
  # Інші необхідні значення: DOCUSIGN_BASE_URL, DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH

  credentials = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new
  credentials.configure do |config|
    config.host = ENV['DOCUSIGN_BASE_URL'] || 'https://demo.docusign.net/restapi'
    config.api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(config.host)
  end

  # Аутентифікація через JWT
  auth = DocuSign_eSign::AuthenticationApi.new
  auth_args = {
    client_id: ENV['DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_ID'],
    client_secret: ENV['DOCUSIGN_CLIENT_SECRET'],
    user_id: ENV['DOCUSIGN_USER_ID']
  }

  token_response = auth.request_jwt_user_token(
    auth_args[:client_id],
    auth_args[:client_secret],
    auth_args[:user_id],
    'signature impersonation'
  )

  DocuSign_eSign.configure do |config|
    config.access_token = token_response.access_token
  end

  DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new
end

# Створення документа для підпису
def create_envelope(envelope_api, pdf_path, recipient_email, recipient_name)
  # Читання PDF файлу
  file_content = File.read(pdf_path, mode: 'rb')
  file_name = File.basename(pdf_path)

  # Створення DocuSign документа
  document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new(
    document_base64: Base64.encode64(file_content),
    name: file_name,
    file_extension: 'pdf',
    document_id: '1'
  )

  # Створення підписувача
  signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new(
    email: recipient_email,
    name: recipient_name,
    recipient_id: '1',
    routing_order: '1'
  )

  # Створення поля підпису
  sign_here = DocuSign_eSign::SignHere.new(
    anchor_string: '/sn1/',
    anchor_units: 'pixels',
    anchor_x_offset: '20',
    anchor_y_offset: '10'
  )

  # Прикріплення поля підпису до документа
  tab = DocuSign_eSign::Tab.new(
    recipient_id: '1',
    document_id: '1',
    page_number: '1',
    x_position: '100',
    y_position: '100'
  )
  tab.sign_here = sign_here

  # Встановлення поля підпису
  signer.tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new(sign_here_tabs: [sign_here])

  # Створення обгортки (envelope)
  envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
    email_subject: 'Будь ласка, підпишіть цей договір',
    documents: [document],
    recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new(signers: [signer]),
    status: 'sent'
  )

  # Надсилання документа
  envelope_api.create_envelope(ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID'], envelope_definition)
end

# Завантаження підписаного документа
def download_envelope_document(envelope_api, envelope_id, document_id, output_path)
  response = envelope_api.get_document(ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID'], envelope_id, document_id)
  File.open(output_path, 'wb') do |file|
    file.write(response)
  end
  puts "Підписаний документ збережено: #{output_path}"
end

# Основна логіка
def main
  envelope_api = docusign_client

  pdf_path = 'contract.pdf'  # Шлях до вашого PDF
```
