I'll create a Ruby application that checks if a company is on the Ukrainian sanctions list (NSDC) using open data sources.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'nokogiri'
gem 'colorize'
gem 'thor'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# lib/sanctions_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'colorize'

class SanctionsChecker
  include HTTParty
  
  # Ukrainian sanctions data sources
  SANCTIONS_URLS = [
    'https://sanctions.gov.ua/api/v1/sanctions',
    'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ukraine-sanctions/ukraine-sanctions-list/main/data/sanctions.json',
    'https://www.ukraine.gov.ua/data/sanctions-list.json'
  ].freeze
  
  # Fallback static list for demonstration
  FALLBACK_LIST = [
    { name: "State Company 'Ukrainian Railways'", country: "Ukraine", type: "State-owned enterprise" },
    { name: "State Company 'Ukrainian Aviation'", country: "Ukraine", type: "State-owned enterprise" },
    { name: "State Company 'Ukrainian Shipbuilding'", country: "Ukraine", type: "State-owned enterprise" },
    { name: "State Company 'Ukrainian Telecom'", country: "Ukraine", type: "State-owned enterprise" },
    { name: "State Company 'Ukrainian Energy'", country: "Ukraine", type: "State-owned enterprise" }
  ].freeze
  
  def initialize
    self.class.base_uri 'https://sanctions.gov.ua/api/v1/sanctions'
  end
  
  # Check if a company name exists in the sanctions list
  def check_company(company_name)
    puts "Searching for: #{company_name}".colorize(:blue)
    puts "This may take a moment...".colorize(:yellow)
    
    # Try multiple data sources
    sanctions_data = fetch_sanctions_data
    
    # Search for the company
    matches = search_company(sanctions_data, company_name)
    
    if matches.empty?
      puts "\n❌ No matches found.".colorize(:red)
      return false
    else
      puts "\n✅ Match found!".colorize(:green)
      display_matches(matches)
      return true
    end
  end
  
  # Fetch data from various sources
  def fetch_sanctions_data
    # Try to fetch from online sources first
    begin
      SANCTIONS_URLS.each do |url|
        response = HTTParty.get(url, timeout: 10)
        if response.success? && response.content_type&.include?('application/json')
          data = JSON.parse(response.body)
          return data if data && data.is_a?(Array)
        end
      rescue => e
        puts "Warning: Could not fetch from #{url}: #{e.message}".colorize(:yellow)
        next
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Error fetching data: #{e.message}".colorize(:red)
    end
    
    # If online sources fail, return fallback data
    puts "Using fallback data for demonstration.".colorize(:yellow)
    FALLBACK_LIST
  end
  
  # Search for company in sanctions data
  def search_company(data, company_name)
    return [] unless data && data.is_a?(Array)
    
    matches = []
    
    data.each do |item|
      # Check if company name matches (case-insensitive, partial match)
      name = item['name'] || item['company_name'] || item['title'] || ''
      if name.downcase.include?(company_name.downcase)
        matches << {
          name: name,
          country: item['country'] || 'Unknown',
          type: item['type'] || 'Unknown',
          reason: item['reason'] || 'Not specified'
        }
      end
    end
    
    matches
  end
  
  # Display search results
  def display_matches(matches)
    matches.each_with_index do |match, index|
      puts "\n--- Match #{index + 1} ---".colorize(:cyan)
      puts "Company: #{match[:name]}".colorize(:bold)
      puts "Country: #{match[:country]}"
      puts "Type: #{match[:type]}"
      puts "Reason: #{match[:reason]}"
    end
  end
  
  # Get list of all sanctioned companies
  def list_all_sanctions
    data = fetch_sanctions_data
    puts "\n📋 All sanctioned companies:".colorize(:blue)
    
    data.each_with_index do |item, index|
      name = item['name'] || item['company_name'] || item['title'] || 'Unknown'
      country = item['country'] || 'Unknown'
      type = item['type'] || 'Unknown'
      puts "#{index + 1}. #{name} (#{country}) - #{type}"
    end
  end
end

# CLI Interface
require 'thor'

class SanctionsCLI < Thor
  desc "check COMPANY_NAME", "Check if a company is on the Ukrainian sanctions list"
  def check(company_name)
    checker = SanctionsChecker.new
    checker.check_company(company_name)
  end
  
  desc "list", "List all sanctioned companies"
  def list
    checker = SanctionsChecker.new
    checker.list_all_sanctions
  end
  
  desc "search TERM", "Search for companies containing TERM"
  def search(term)
    checker = SanctionsChecker.new
    puts "Searching for: #{term}".colorize(:blue)
    
    data = checker.fetch_sanctions_data
    matches = checker.search_company(data, term)
    
    if matches.empty?
      puts "No matches found for '#{term}'.".colorize(:red)
    else
      puts "\nFound #{matches.length} matches:".colorize(:green)
      checker.display_matches(matches)
    end
```

```ruby
# kupina_hash.rb

require 'digest'

class KupinaHash
  # Відповідно до ДСТУ 7564, геш Купина має виконувати специфічну функцію
  # Нижче наведено умовну реалізацію, яка може бути замінена на реальну
  # (враховуючи, що це виключно приклад)

  def self.digest(data)
    # Конвертуємо в байти, якщо потрібно
    data = data.encode('UTF-8') if data.is_a?(String)

    # Умовна реалізація: використовуємо SHA-256 як приблизна заміна
    # (насправді, потрібен реальний алгоритм Купина)
    Digest::SHA256.digest(data)
  end

  def self.hexdigest(data)
    digest(data).unpack('H*')[0].upcase
  end
end
```

```ruby
  end
```

**vchasno_client.rb**
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'active_support'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require_relative 'config'

class VchasnoClient
  include HTTParty

  base_uri Config.api_base_url
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Accept' => 'application/json',
          'X-API-Key' => Config.api_key

  def initialize
    @organization_id = Config.organization_id
  end

  # Метод для відправки підписаного документа
  def send_signed_document(document_data)
    # Перетворюємо дані документа у JSON
    payload = {
      organization_id: @organization_id,
      document: document_data
    }.to_json

    response = self.class.post('/documents/send', 
                               body: payload,
                               headers: {
                                 'X-API-Key' => Config.api_key,
                                 'X-API-Signature' => generate_signature(payload)
                               })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Метод для отримання документів від контрагента
  def get_documents(filter = {})
    params = { 
      organization_id: @organization_id,
      page: filter[:page] || 1,
      limit: filter[:limit] || 100,
      status: filter[:status] || 'all'
    }.compact

    response = self.class.get('/documents', 
                              query: params,
                              headers: {
                                'X-API-Key' => Config.api_key,
                                'X-API-Signature' => generate_signature(params.to_json)
                              })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Метод для підпису документа
  def sign_document(document_content, document_type)
    # Вимоги до підпису:
    # 1. Створюємо підпис на основі контенту
    # 2. Використовуємо API для підпису
    
    payload = {
      organization_id: @organization_id,
      document_content: document_content,
      document_type: document_type
    }.to_json

    response = self.class.post('/documents/sign', 
                               body: payload,
                               headers: {
                                 'X-API-Key' => Config.api_key,
                                 'X-API-Signature' => generate_signature(payload)
                               })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу документа
  def get_document_status(document_id)
    response = self.class.get("/documents/#{document_id}/status",
                              headers: {
                                'X-API-Key' => Config.api_key,
                                'X-API-Signature' => generate_signature(document_id)
                              })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Метод для отримання підписаного документа
  def get_signed_document(document_id)
    response = self.class.get("/documents/#{document_id}/download",
                              headers: {
                                'X-API-Key' => Config.api_key,
                                'X-API-Signature' => generate_signature(document_id)
                              })

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  # Генерація цифрового підпису
  def generate_signature(data)
    # У реальній реалізації потрібно:
    # 1. Створити HMAC SHA256 підпис
    # 2. Використовувати API secret для підпису
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i.to_s
    message = "#{data}#{timestamp}"
    
    # Це тимчасовий симуляційний підпис - в реальному коді використовуйте OpenSSL
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha256', Config.api_secret, message)
  end

  # Обробка відповіді від API
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..201
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise AuthenticationError, 'Unauthorized: Invalid API key or signature'
    when 403
      raise AuthorizationError, 'Forbidden: Access denied'
    when 404
      raise NotFoundError, 'Document not found'
    when 500
      raise ServerError, 'Internal server error'
    else
      raise APIError, "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Виключення
  class APIError < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < APIError; end
  class AuthorizationError < APIError; end
  class NotFoundError < APIError; end
  class ServerError < APIError; end
end
```

```ruby
class DocumentHandler
  def initialize
    @client = VchasnoClient.new
  end

  # Відправка підписаного документа
  def send_document(document_path, recipient_id)
    # Читаємо зміст документа
    document_content = File.read(document_path)
    
    # Формуємо дані документа
    document_data = {
      title: File.basename(document_path),
      content: Base64.encode64(document_content),
      content_type: 'application/pdf',
      recipient_id: recipient_id,
      document_type: 'contract'
    }

    # Відправляємо документ
    response = @client.send_signed_document(document_data)
    puts "Document sent successfully: #{response['document_id']}"
    response
  end

  # Отримання документів
  def receive_documents
    documents = @client.get_documents(status: 'received')
    puts "Received #{documents['documents'].length} documents"
    documents
  end

  # Підпис документа
  def sign_document(document_path)
    document_content = File.read(document_path)
    signed_document = @client.sign_document(document_content, 'contract')
    puts "Document signed successfully"
    signed_document
  end

  # Отримання статусу документа
  def check_document_status(document_id)
    status = @client.get_document_status(document_id)
    puts "Document status: #{status['status']}"
    status
  end
end
```

## Gemfile


## lib/email_sender.rb
```ruby
require 'sendgrid-ruby'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class EmailSender
  def initialize(api_key: ENV['SENDGRID_API_KEY'])
    @sendgrid = SendGrid::API.new(api_key: api_key)
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def send_transactional_email(to_email, template_id, dynamic_data = {}, from_email: nil, from_name: nil, subject: nil)
    # Validate required parameters
    raise ArgumentError, 'to_email is required' if to_email.nil? || to_email.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, 'template_id is required' if template_id.nil? || template_id.empty?

    # Set default from email if not provided
    from_email = ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL'] if from_email.nil?
    from_name = ENV['SENDGRID_FROM_NAME'] if from_name.nil?

    # Build email content
    email = SendGrid::Mail.new
    email.from = SendGrid::Email.new(email: from_email, name: from_name)
    email.to = SendGrid::Email.new(email: to_email)
    email.subject = subject if subject
    
    # Set template ID
    email.template_id = template_id
    
    # Set dynamic template data
    email.dynamic_template_data = dynamic_data if dynamic_data.any?

    begin
      # Send email
      response = @sendgrid.client.mail._('send').post(request_body: email.to_json)
      
      @logger.info("Email sent successfully to #{to_email}")
      
      {
        success: true,
        status_code: response.status_code,
        response_body: response.body
      }
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to send email to #{to_email}: #{e.message}")
      
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message,
        status_code: e.response&.code
      }
    end
  end

  def send_bulk_emails(recipients, template_id, dynamic_data = {}, from_email: nil, from_name: nil, subject: nil)
    results = []
    
    recipients.each do |recipient|
      # Merge recipient-specific data with global dynamic data
      merged_data = dynamic_data.dup
      merged_data.merge!(recipient[:dynamic_data]) if recipient[:dynamic_data]
      
      result = send_transactional_email(
        recipient[:email],
        template_id,
        merged_data,
        from_email: from_email,
        from_name: from_name,
        subject: subject
      )
      
      results << {
        email: recipient[:email],
        result: result
      }
    end
    
    results
  end
end
```

## lib/email_template_builder.rb
```ruby
class EmailTemplateBuilder
  class << self
    # Helper method to create dynamic data structure for SendGrid template
    def build_dynamic_data(data_hash)
      # This method can be extended to validate and format data
      data_hash
    end

    # Helper method to create recipient structure for bulk emails
    def build_recipient(email, dynamic_data = {})
      {
        email: email,
        dynamic_data: dynamic_data
      }
    end

    # Helper method to create multiple recipients
    def build_recipients(recipients_array)
      recipients_array.map do |recipient|
        if recipient.is_a?(Hash)
          build_recipient(recipient[:email], recipient[:dynamic_data])
        else
          build_recipient(recipient)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| data[field].nil? || data[field].to_s.strip.empty? }

      raise ArgumentError, "#{entity_name} data is missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
```

```ruby
  secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
)

sns_client = Aws::SNS::Client.new(
  region: 'us-east-1', # Змініть на ваш регіон
  access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
  secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
)

# Маршрут для надсилання листа
post '/send_email' do
  begin
    # Витягуємо параметри з запиту
    from = params[:from]
    to = params[:to]
    subject = params[:subject]
    body = params[:body]

    # Надсилаємо лист через SES
    response = ses_client.send_email({
      source: from,
      destination: {
        to_addresses: [to]
      },
      message: {
        subject: {
          data: subject
        },
        body: {
          text: {
            data: body
          }
        }
      }
    })

    status 200
    body "Email sent successfully! Message ID: #{response.message_id}"
  rescue Aws::SES::Errors::ServiceError => e
    status 500
    body "Failed to send email: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# Маршрут для отримання сповіщень від SNS (наприклад, про недоставлення)
post '/sns_notification' do
  begin
    # Отримуємо JSON з SNS
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

    # Виводимо повідомлення в лог
    puts "Received SNS notification: #{payload}"

    # Обробка повідомлення про недоставлення
    if payload['Type'] == 'Notification' && payload['Subject']&.include?('bounce')
      bounce_info = payload['Message']
      puts "Email bounced: #{bounce_info}"

      # Ви можете додати логіку обробки недоставленого листа тут
      # Наприклад, повторне надсилання, запис у БД тощо
    end

    status 200
    body 'Notification received'
  rescue => e
    status 500
    body "Error processing notification: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

# WhatsApp Template Messages with Business Cloud API

I'll create a Ruby implementation for sending WhatsApp template messages using the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.

```ruby
gem 'pry' if development?
```

## Implementation

### 1. Main WhatsApp Client Class

```ruby
# whatsapp_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class WhatsAppClient
  include HTTParty
  
  attr_reader :access_token, :phone_number_id, :version, :base_url
  
  def initialize(access_token, phone_number_id, version = 'v18.0')
    @access_token = access_token
    @phone_number_id = phone_number_id
    @version = version
    @base_url = "https://graph.facebook.com/#{version}"
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end
  
  # Send a template message
  def send_template_message(recipient_phone_number, template_name, language_code = 'en_US', components = [])
    # Build the message payload
    payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      to: recipient_phone_number,
      type: 'template',
      template: {
        name: template_name,
        language: {
          code: language_code
        },
        components: components
      }
    }
    
    # Send the request
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/#{@phone_number_id}/messages",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Send a message with text component
  def send_text_template(recipient_phone_number, template_name, text_params, language_code = 'en_US')
    components = [
      {
        type: 'body',
        parameters: text_params.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
      }
    ]
    
    send_template_message(recipient_phone_number, template_name, language_code, components)
  end
  
  # Send a message with button component
  def send_button_template(recipient_phone_number, template_name, text_params, button_params, language_code = 'en_US')
    components = [
      {
        type: 'body',
        parameters: text_params.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
      },
      {
        type: 'button',
        sub_type: 'quick_reply',
        index: 0,
        parameters: button_params.map { |param| { type: 'text', text: param } }
      }
    ]
    
    send_template_message(recipient_phone_number, template_name, language_code, components)
  end
  
  # Get message status
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/#{message_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get phone number info
  def get_phone_number_info
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/#{@phone_number_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get available templates
  def get_templates
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/#{@phone_number_id}/message_templates",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'bundler/setup'
Bundler.require

require 'active_record'
require 'logger'
require 'json'

# Configure logger
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Database setup
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'orders.db'
)

# Order model
class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :user_id, :order_id, presence: true
  validates :status, inclusion: { in: %w[pending processing shipped delivered cancelled] }
end

# Create tables if they don't exist
begin
  ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table(:orders) do |t|
    t.string :user_id, null: false
    t.string :order_id, null: false
    t.string :status, default: 'pending'
    t.text :details
    t.timestamps
  end
rescue ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid
  # Table already exists
end

# Add index if not exists
begin
  ActiveRecord::Base.connection.add_index :orders, [:user_id, :order_id], unique: true
rescue ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid
  # Index already exists
end

# Telegram bot
class OrderStatusBot
  def initialize(token)
    @bot = Telegram::Bot::Client.new(token)
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def run
    @bot.listen do |message|
      handle_message(message)
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(message)
    user_id = message.from.id.to_s
    command = message.text&.split(' ')&.first&.downcase
    
    case command
    when '/start'
      send_welcome_message(message)
    when '/help'
      send_help_message(message)
    when '/status'
      handle_status_command(message, user_id)
    when '/track'
      handle_track_command(message, user_id)
    when '/orders'
      handle_orders_command(message, user_id)
    when '/neworder'
      handle_new_order_command(message, user_id)
    else
      send_unknown_command_message(message)
    end
  end

  def send_welcome_message(message)
    welcome_text = <<~TEXT
Welcome to the Order Status Bot! 📦
I can help you track your orders and get status updates.

Available commands:
• /status <order_id> - Check order status
• /track <order_id> - Track an order
• /orders - View all your orders
• /neworder <order_id> - Add a new order
• /help - Show this help message

Please enter your order ID to check status.
    TEXT

    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: welcome_text
    )
  end

  def send_help_message(message)
    help_text = <<~TEXT
Available Commands:
• /start - Start the bot
• /help - Show this help message
• /status <order_id> - Check order status
• /track <order_id> - Track an order
• /orders - View all your orders
• /neworder <order_id> - Add a new order
• /cancel <order_id> - Cancel an order

Example usage:
/status ORD12345
/track ORD12345
/neworder NEW12345
    TEXT

    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: help_text
    )
  end

  def handle_status_command(message, user_id)
    order_id = message.text.split(' ').drop(1).join(' ')
    
    if order_id.empty?
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "Please provide an order ID. Usage: /status <order_id>"
      )
      return
    end

    order = Order.find_by(user_id: user_id, order_id: order_id)
    
    if order
      message_text = "Order ID: #{order.order_id}\nStatus: #{order.status}\n"
      message_text += "Details: #{order.details || 'No additional details'}\n"
      message_text += "Updated: #{order.updated_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}"
      
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: message_text
      )
    else
      # Create a new order if it doesn't exist
      new_order = Order.create(
        user_id: user_id,
        order_id: order_id,
        status: 'pending',
        details: 'Newly created order'
      )
      
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "New order created:\nOrder ID: #{order_id}\nStatus: pending"
      )
    end
  end

  def handle_track_command(message, user_id)
    order_id = message.text.split(' ').drop(1).join(' ')
    
    if order_id.empty?
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "Please provide an order ID. Usage: /track <order_id>"
      )
      return
    end

    order = Order.find_by(user_id: user_id, order_id: order_id)
    
    if order
      status_emoji = case order.status
                     when 'pending' then '⏳'
                     when 'processing' then '⚙️'
                     when 'shipped' then '🚚'
                     when 'delivered' then '📦'
                     when 'cancelled' then '❌'
                     else '❓'
                     end
      
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "Tracking Order #{order_id} #{status_emoji}\nStatus: #{order.status.capitalize}"
      )
    else
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "Order #{order_id} not found. Please check the ID and try again."
      )
    end
  end

  def handle_orders_command(message, user_id)
    orders = Order.where(user_id: user_id).order(created_at: :desc).limit(5)
    
    if orders.empty?
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "You don't have any orders yet. Use /neworder to add one."
      )
      return
    end

    message_text = "Your recent orders:\n\n"
    orders.each do |order|
      status_emoji = case order.status
                     when 'pending' then '⏳'
                     when 'processing' then '⚙️'
                     when 'shipped' then '🚚'
                     when 'delivered' then '📦'
                     when 'cancelled' then '❌'
                     else '❓'
                     end
      
      message_text += "#{status_emoji} #{order.order_id} - #{order.status.capitalize}\n"
    end

    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: message_text
    )
  end

  def handle_new_order_command(message, user_id)
    order_id = message.text.split(' ').drop(1).join(' ')
    
    if order_id.empty?
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "Please provide an order ID. Usage: /neworder <order_id>"
      )
      return
    end

    # Check if order already exists
    existing_order = Order.find_by(user_id: user_id, order_id: order_id)
    
    if existing_order
      @bot.api.send_message(
        chat_id: message.chat.id,
        text: "Order #{order_id} already exists with status: #{existing_order.status}"
      )
      return
    end

    # Create new order
    new_order = Order.create(
      user_id: user_id,
      order_id: order_id,
      status: 'pending',
      details: 'Newly created order'
    )
    
    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: "New order added!\nOrder ID: #{order_id}\nStatus: pending"
    )
  end

  def send_unknown_command_message(message)
    @bot.api.send_message(
      chat_id: message.chat.id,
      text: "Unknown command. Type /help for available commands."
    )
  end
end

# Initialize and run the bot
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Get bot token from environment variable
  token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
  
  if token.nil? || token.empty?
    puts "Error: Please set the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable"
    puts "Example: export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN='123456789:ABC-DEF1234ghIJK5678lmnopQR123456789'"
    exit 1
  end
  
  bot = OrderStatusBot.new(token)
  puts "Bot started..."
  bot.run
end
```

```ruby
    missing_fields = required_fields - order_data.keys
```

```ruby
# lib/mailchimp_subscriber.rb
require_relative 'environment'

class MailchimpSubscriber
  def initialize(api_key: MAILCHIMP_API_KEY, audience_id: MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID)
    @api_key = api_key
    @audience_id = audience_id
    @client = MailchimpV3.new(api_key)
  end

  def add_subscriber(email, first_name: nil, last_name: nil, double_opt_in: false)
    begin
      # Prepare subscriber data
      subscriber_data = {
        email_address: email,
        status: double_opt_in ? 'pending' : 'subscribed',
        merge_fields: {}
      }

      # Add optional fields
      subscriber_data[:merge_fields][:FNAME] = first_name if first_name
      subscriber_data[:merge_fields][:LNAME] = last_name if last_name

      # Add subscriber to audience
      response = @client.add_list_member(@audience_id, subscriber_data)
      
      puts "Successfully added subscriber: #{email}"
      return response
    rescue MailchimpV3::Error => e
      puts "Error adding subscriber: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end

  def get_subscriber(email)
    begin
      response = @client.get_list_member(@audience_id, email)
      return response
    rescue MailchimpV3::Error => e
      puts "Error retrieving subscriber: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def update_subscriber(email, first_name: nil, last_name: nil)
    begin
      update_data = {}
      update_data[:merge_fields] = {}
      update_data[:merge_fields][:FNAME] = first_name if first_name
      update_data[:merge_fields][:LNAME] = last_name if last_name

      response = @client.update_list_member(@audience_id, email, update_data)
      puts "Successfully updated subscriber: #{email}"
      return response
    rescue MailchimpV3::Error => e
      puts "Error updating subscriber: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end

  def remove_subscriber(email)
    begin
      response = @client.delete_list_member(@audience_id, email)
      puts "Successfully removed subscriber: #{email}"
      return response
    rescue MailchimpV3::Error => e
      puts "Error removing subscriber: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    rescue => e
      puts "Failed to subscribe user: #{e.message}"
      return {
        success: false,

      }
    end

  private

  def valid_email?(email)
    email.match?(/\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d\-]+(\.[a-z\d\-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i)
  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class TeamsNotifier
  include HTTParty

  def initialize(webhook_url)
    @webhook_url = webhook_url
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def send_message(text, title = nil)
    payload = {
      text: text,
      summary: title || text
    }

    payload[:title] = title if title

    response = self.class.post(
      @webhook_url,
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Повідомлення успішно надіслано до Microsoft Teams."
    else
      puts "Помилка надсилання повідомлення: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load' if File.exist?('.env')

class TeamsWebhook
  include HTTParty

  def initialize(webhook_url)
    @webhook_url = webhook_url
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Send a simple text message
  def send_message(text, title: nil, summary: nil)
    payload = {
      text: text
    }

    payload[:title] = title if title
    payload[:summary] = summary if summary

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  # Send a formatted card message
  def send_card(title:, text:, sections: [], potential_action: nil)
    payload = {
      "@type" => "MessageCard",
      "@context" => "http://schema.org/extensions",
      "themeColor" => "0076D7",
      "title" => title,
      "text" => text,
      "sections" => sections
    }

    payload["potentialAction"] = potential_action if potential_action

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  # Send a message with attachments (like images)
  def send_with_attachments(attachments:)
    payload = {
      "attachments" => attachments
    }

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  # Send a simple message with formatting
  def send_formatted_message(text, markdown: false)
    payload = {
      "text" => text
    }

    if markdown
      payload["markdown"] = true
    end

    send_payload(payload)
  end

  private

  def send_payload(payload)
    response = self.class.post(
      @webhook_url,
      headers: @headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Message sent successfully!"
      return true
    else
      puts "Failed to send message: #{response.body}"
      return false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class SupportTicket < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :attachments, dependent: :destroy
  validates :subject, :description, presence: true
  
  def self.create_from_email(email_params)
    ticket = SupportTicket.new(
      subject: email_params[:subject],
      description: email_params[:body],
      email_address: email_params[:from],
      created_at: email_params[:timestamp]
    )
    
    if ticket.save
      # Process attachments if they exist
      if email_params[:attachments]
        email_params[:attachments].each do |attachment_data|
          ticket.attachments.create!(
            name: attachment_data[:filename],
            file: attachment_data[:file],
            content_type: attachment_data[:content_type],
            size: attachment_data[:size]
          )
        end
      end
      ticket
    else
      ticket
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class InboundEmailsController < ApplicationController
  protect_from_forgery with: :null_session
  
  # POST /inbound_emails
  def create
    email = Mail.new(request.body.read)
    
    # Parse email data
    email_data = {
      subject: email.subject,
      body: parse_email_body(email),
      from: email.from.first,
      timestamp: email.date,
      attachments: parse_attachments(email)
    }
    
    # Create support ticket
    ticket = SupportTicket.create_from_email(email_data)
    
    if ticket.persisted?
      # Send confirmation email
      InboundEmailMailer.support_ticket_created(ticket).deliver_now
      
      render json: { status: 'success', ticket_id: ticket.id }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { status: 'error', errors: ticket.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_email_body(email)
    if email.html_part
      # Extract text from HTML
      Nokogiri::HTML(email.html_part.body.to_s).text
    elsif email.text_part
      email.text_part.body.to_s
    else
      email.body.to_s
    end
  end
  
  def parse_attachments(email)
    attachments = []
    
    email.attachments.each do |attachment|
      attachments << {
        filename: attachment.filename,
        content_type: attachment.content_type,
        size: attachment.size,
        file: StringIO.new(attachment.body.decoded)
      }
    end
    
    attachments
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'discordrb'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class DeploymentBot
  def initialize
    @bot = Discordrb::Bot.new(
      token: ENV['DISCORD_TOKEN'],
      client_id: ENV['DISCORD_CLIENT_ID'],
      intents: [:guild_messages, :message_content, :interaction]
    )
    
    setup_logger
    setup_commands
    setup_events
    
    puts "Deployment bot is running! Invite link: #{bot.invite_url}"
  end

  def run
    bot.run
  end

  private

  attr_reader :bot

  def setup_logger
    @logger = Logger.new('deployment_bot.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def setup_commands
    # Deployment status command
    bot.command(:deploy_status, 
                description: 'Check the current deployment status',
                usage: '/deploy_status') do |event|
      status = get_deployment_status
      event.respond("Current Deployment Status:\n```#{status}```")
    end

    # Deploy command
    bot.command(:deploy, 
                description: 'Trigger a new deployment',
                usage: '/deploy <environment>') do |event|
      environment = event.options[:environment] || 'production'
      result = trigger_deployment(environment)
      event.respond("Deployment triggered for #{environment} environment!\n#{result}")
    end

    # Rollback command
    bot.command(:rollback, 
                description: 'Rollback to previous deployment',
                usage: '/rollback <version>') do |event|
      version = event.options[:version] || 'previous'
      result = rollback_deployment(version)
      event.respond("Rollback to #{version} initiated!\n#{result}")
    end

    # Health check command
    bot.command(:health, 
                description: 'Check bot health',
                usage: '/health') do |event|
      event.respond("✅ Bot is healthy and running!")
    end

    # Help command
    bot.command(:help, 
                description: 'Show available commands',
                usage: '/help') do |event|
      help_text = <<~HELP
        **Deployment Bot Commands:**
        `/deploy_status` - Check current deployment status
        `/deploy <environment>` - Trigger a new deployment
        `/rollback <version>` - Rollback to previous deployment
        `/health` - Check bot health
        `/help` - Show this help message
      HELP
      event.respond(help_text)
    end
  end

  def setup_events
    bot.message(with_text: '!deploy') do |event|
      # Legacy command support for non-slash commands
      environment = event.message.content.split(' ')[1] || 'production'
      result = trigger_deployment(environment)
      event.respond("Deployment triggered for #{environment} environment!\n#{result}")
    end

    bot.ready do |event|
      @logger.info("Bot is ready! Connected as #{bot.profile.username}")
    end

    bot.message do |event|
      # Handle message events if needed
      if event.message.content.start_with?('!deploy')
        event.respond("Use slash commands instead: `/deploy <environment>`")
      end
    end
  end

  def get_deployment_status
    # Simulate deployment status check
    # In a real implementation, this would query your deployment system
    <<~STATUS
      Environment: Production
      Status: Active
      Last Deployment: #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}
      Version: v1.2.3
      Deployed By: CI/CD Pipeline
    STATUS
  end

  def trigger_deployment(environment)
    # Simulate deployment process
    @logger.info("Triggering deployment to #{environment}")
    
    # In a real implementation, this would call your CI/CD system
    # For example, trigger a webhook or API call
    <<~RESULT
      ✅ Deployment started for #{environment}
      - Environment: #{environment}
      - Timestamp: #{Time.now}
      - Status: In Progress
    RESULT
  end

  def rollback_deployment(version)
    # Simulate rollback process
    @logger.info("Initiating rollback to version #{version}")
    
    <<~RESULT
      🔄 Rollback process initiated
      - Version: #{version}
      - Timestamp: #{Time.now}
      - Status: Pending
    RESULT
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'discordrb'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class DeploymentNotifier
  def initialize(webhook_url = nil)
    @webhook_url = webhook_url
    @logger = Logger.new('deployment_notifier.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def notify_deployment_start(deployment_info)
    message = build_deployment_message(deployment_info, :start)
    send_message(message)
  end

  def notify_deployment_success(deployment_info)
    message = build_deployment_message(deployment_info, :success)
    send_message(message)
  end

  def notify_deployment_failure(deployment_info, error_message)
    message = build_deployment_message(deployment_info, :failure, error_message)
    send_message(message)
  end

  private

  def build_deployment_message(deployment_info, status, error_message = nil)
    case status
    when :start
      title = "🚀 Deployment Started"
      color = 0x3498db
      description = "Deployment has started for #{deployment_info[:environment]} environment"
    when :success
      title = "✅ Deployment Successful"
      color = 0x2ecc71
      description = "Deployment completed successfully for #{deployment_info[:environment]} environment"
    when :failure
      title = "❌ Deployment Failed"
      color = 0xe74c3c
      description = "Deployment failed for #{deployment_info[:environment]} environment"
    end

    {
      embeds: [{
        title: title,
        description: description,
        color: color,
        fields: [
          {
            name: "Environment",
            value: deployment_info[:environment],
            inline: true
          },
          {
            name: "Version",
            value: deployment_info[:version] || "Unknown",
            inline: true
          },
          {
            name: "Deployed By",
            value: deployment_info[:deployed_by] || "Unknown",
            inline: true
          },
          {
            name: "Timestamp",
            value: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'),
            inline: true
          }
        ],
        footer: {
          text: "Deployment Bot"
        }
      }]
    }
  end

  def send_message(message)
    if @webhook_url
      send_via_webhook(message)
    else
      @logger.warn("No webhook URL configured. Message would be: #{message}")
      # In a real implementation, you'd send to a Discord channel
    end
  end

  def send_via_webhook(message)
    begin
      # This would be implemented if you have a webhook setup
      # For now, just log it
      @logger.info("Would send webhook message: #{message}")
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Failed to send webhook message: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
end
```

Ось розв’язок завдання на Ruby для надсилання SMS через API Vonage (Nexmo) та відстеження звіту про доставку.

### 1. `Gemfile`
```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'nexmo' # Гем для взаємодії з API Vonage
gem 'json'  # Для роботи з JSON (використовується в Nexmo)
```

### 2. `send_sms.rb`
```ruby
require 'nexmo'
require 'json'

# Ініціалізуємо клієнт Vonage
# Замініть на ваші дійсні ключ і секрет
client = Nexmo::Client.new(
  api_key: 'YOUR_API_KEY',
  api_secret: 'YOUR_API_SECRET'
)

# Надсилання SMS
def send_sms(client, from, to, message)
  response = client.send_message(
    from: from,
    to: to,
    text: message
  )

  if response['messages'][0]['status'] == '0'
    puts "SMS успішно надіслано. Message ID: #{response['messages'][0]['message-id']}"
    return response['messages'][0]['message-id']
  else
    puts "Помилка надсилання SMS: #{response['messages'][0]['error-text']}"
    return nil
  end
end

# Отримання звіту про доставку
def check_delivery_status(client, message_id)
  response = client.get_message(message_id)

  if response['status'] == 'delivered'
    puts "SMS доставлено успішно."
  elsif response['status'] == 'failed'
    puts "SMS не доставлено. Причина: #{response['error-text']}"
  else
    puts "Статус доставки: #{response['status']}"
  end
end

# Приклад використання
from_number = 'Vonage'
to_number = '+380XXXXXXXXX' # Номер одержувача
message_text = 'Привіт! Це тестове повідомлення через Vonage.'

# Надсилання SMS
message_id = send_sms(client, from_number, to_number, message_text)

# Якщо повідомлення успішно надіслано, перевіряємо статус
if message_id
  sleep(5) # Зачекати трохи, щоб статус оновився
  check_delivery_status(client, message_id)
end
```

### 3. Інструкція

1. **Встановіть геми:**
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. **Отримайте API ключ і секрет у [Vonage Dashboard](https://dashboard.nexmo.com/)**

3. **Замініть `YOUR_API_KEY` та `YOUR_API_SECRET` у коді.**

4. **Запустіть скрипт:**
   ```bash
   ruby send_sms.rb
   ```

### 4. Пояснення

- `nexmo` — гем для взаємодії з API Vonage.
- `send_message` — надсилає SMS і повертає `message-id`.
- `get_message` — отримує статус доставки за `message-id`.
- Скрипт перевіряє успішність надсилання та статус доставки.

### 5. Вихідний приклад (якщо все добре):
```
SMS успішно надіслано. Message ID: abc123xyz
SMS доставлено успішно.
```

Ось розв’язання завдання: **надсилання push-сповіщень на пристрої iOS через APNs з автентифікацією за токеном** (via `apns2` gem), включаючи `Gemfile` та реалізацію.

---

## ✅ 1. `Gemfile`

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'apns2'
```

---

## ✅ 2. Реалізація

### Наприклад, файл `push_notification.rb`:

```ruby
require 'apns2/client'
require 'apns2/payload'

# Вкажіть ваші дані
token = 'your_device_token_here'  # Токен пристрою
certificate_path = 'path/to/your/AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8'  # Шлях до .p8 файлу
team_id = 'your_team_id'  # Ваш Team ID
key_id = 'your_key_id'  # Ваш Key ID
topic = 'your.bundle.id'  # Bundle ID вашого додатку

# Створюємо клієнт APNs
client = APNS2::Client.new(
  team_id: team_id,
  key_id: key_id,
  certificate: certificate_path,
  topic: topic,
  sandbox: false  # Встановіть true для тестування у sandbox
)

# Формуємо повідомлення
payload = APNS2::Payload.new
payload.alert = {
  title: 'Hello',
  body: 'Push notification from Ruby!'
}
payload.badge = 1
payload.sound = 'default'

# Надсилаємо push
begin
  response = client.push(token, payload)
  puts "Status: #{response.status}"
  puts "Response: #{response.body}"
rescue => e
  puts "Error: #{e.message}"
end
```

---

## 📌 Пояснення

- **`apns2`** — це гем для роботи з APNs через HTTP/2.
- **Автентифікація через токен (JWT)**: замість .p12 сертифіката, використовується .p8 файл.
- **Треба використовувати `AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8`**, який завантажується у Apple Developer Portal.
- **`team_id`, `key_id`** — знайдуться у Apple Developer Portal.
- **`topic`** — це bundle ID вашого додатку.
- **`sandbox: true`** — для тестування у розробці (використовується `api.sandbox.push.apple.com`).

---

## 🧪 Як запустити

1. Запустіть `bundle install`.
2. Виконайте скрипт:

```bash
ruby push_notification.rb
```

---

Ось як можна реалізувати надсилання push-сповіщень на Android та iOS через **Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)** в Ruby з використанням гему `fcm` (або `fcm-ruby`).

---

### 1. **Gemfile**

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'fcm'
gem 'sinatra'        # Якщо ви хочете створити простий API для надсилання push-сповіщень
gem 'json'
```

---

### 2. **Конфігурація FCM**

Вам потрібно мати **Firebase Service Account JSON Key** (файл `service_account.json`) — він доступний у налаштуваннях проекту Firebase.

---

### 3. **Код для надсилання push-сповіщення**

```ruby
require 'fcm'
require 'json'
require 'pathname'

# Шлях до вашого service account key файлу
key_file = Pathname.new(__dir__).join('service_account.json')

# Ініціалізація FCM з ключем
fcm = FCM.new(key_file.to_s)

# Приклад push-сповіщення
def send_push_notification(device_token, title, body, data = {})
  notification = {
    to: device_token,
    notification: {
      title: title,
      body: body
    },
    data: data
  }

  begin
    response = fcm.send(notification)
    puts "Push notification sent successfully: #{response}"
  rescue => e
    puts "Error sending push notification: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# Приклад виклику
device_token_ios = 'YOUR_IOS_DEVICE_TOKEN'
device_token_android = 'YOUR_ANDROID_DEVICE_TOKEN'

send_push_notification(device_token_ios, 'Hello iOS', 'This is iOS notification')
send_push_notification(device_token_android, 'Hello Android', 'This is Android notification')
```

---

### 4. **Як отримати `device_token`**

- Для **iOS**: Використовуйте `FirebaseMessaging` у Swift/Objective-C.
- Для **Android**: Використовуйте `FirebaseMessaging` у Java/Kotlin.

Після отримання `token` ви можете передавати його в ваш сервер.

---

### 5. **Приклад `service_account.json`**

Файл `service_account.json` має бути в такому форматі:

```json
{
  "type": "service_account",
  "project_id": "your-project-id",
  "private_key_id": "your-private-key-id",
  "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----\n",
  "client_email": "your-firebase-adminsdk@your-project-id.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
  "client_id": "your-client-id",
  "auth_uri": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth",
  "token_uri": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
  "auth_provider_x509_cert_url": "https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs",
  "client_x509_cert_url": "https://www.googleapis.com/robot/v1/metadata/x509/your-firebase-adminsdk%40your-project-id.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```

---

### 6. **Додатково: використання з Sinatra (якщо потрібен API)**

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'fcm'

set :port, 4567
set :bind, '0.0.0.0'

FCM_KEY_PATH = File.join(__dir__, 'service_account.json')
fcm = FCM.new(FCM_KEY_PATH)

post '/send_push' do
  request.body.rewind
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)

  device_token = data['token']
  title = data['title']
  body = data['body']

  notification = {
    to: device_token,
    notification: {
      title: title,
      body: body
    }
  }

  response = fcm.send(notification)
  content_type :json
  { status: 'sent', response: response }.to_json
end
```

---

### 7. **Запуск**

1. Встановіть геми:

```bash
bundle install
```

2. Запустіть сервер (якщо використовуєте Sinatra):

```bash
ruby app.rb
```

3. Надішліть запит:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:4567/send_push \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"token": "DEVICE_TOKEN", "title": "Test", "body": "Hello"}'
```

---

Якщо потрібно — можу допомогти з тестуванням або додатковими можливостями FCM (наприклад, використання `topic`, розсилка по темам тощо).

Ось розв'язок завдання на Ruby з використанням IMAP для зчитування нових листів з поштової скриньки та зберігання їх у файл. Використовується `mail` гем для роботи з електронною поштою та `chronic` для парсингу часу (за потреби). Також згадується `Gemfile`, який містить всі потрібні геми.

---

## 1. **Gemfile**

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'mail'
gem 'chronic'
gem 'logger'
```

---

## 2. **Код програми (`imap_reader.rb`)**

```ruby
require 'mail'
require 'logger'
require 'json'
require 'date'

# Налаштування логування
logger = Logger.new('imap_reader.log')

# Налаштування поштового сервера
Mail.defaults do
  retriever_method :imap, {
    address:    'imap.example.com',
    port:       993,
    user_name:  'your_email@example.com',
    password:   'your_password',
    ssl:        true
  }
end

# Шлях до файлу для зберігання листів
STORAGE_FILE = 'emails.json'

# Читання існуючих збережених листів
def load_saved_emails
  return [] unless File.exist?(STORAGE_FILE)
  JSON.parse(File.read(STORAGE_FILE))
rescue JSON::ParserError
  []
end

# Збереження листів
def save_emails(emails)
  File.write(STORAGE_FILE, JSON.pretty_generate(emails))
end

# Перевірка, чи лист вже збережений
def email_already_saved?(email, saved_emails)
  saved_emails.any? do |saved|
    saved['message_id'] == email.message_id
  end
end

# Основна функція для зчитування листів
def fetch_new_emails
  logger.info "Початок перевірки нових листів..."

  saved_emails = load_saved_emails
  new_emails = []

  Mail.all.each do |email|
    next if email_already_saved?(email, saved_emails)

    new_emails << {
      subject:     email.subject,
      from:        email.from.first,
      date:        email.date.to_s,
      message_id:  email.message_id,
      body:        email.body.decoded
    }

    logger.info "Збережено лист: #{email.subject}"
  end

  if new_emails.empty?
    logger.info "Немає нових листів"
  else
    save_emails(saved_emails + new_emails)
    logger.info "Збережено #{new_emails.length} нових листів"
  end
end

# Запуск через cron-подібний цикл
loop do
  fetch_new_emails
  logger.info "Чекаємо 5 хвилин..."
  sleep 300 # 5 хвилин
end
```

---

## 3. **Як запустити**

1. Встановіть геми:

```bash
bundle install
```

2. Запустіть програму:

```bash
ruby imap_reader.rb
```

---

## 4. **Примітки**

- Замініть `imap.example.com`, `your_email@example.com` та `your_password` на реальні дані.
- Для продакшну використання краще використовувати змінні оточення для паролів.
- Листи зберігаються у форматі JSON у файлі `emails.json`.
- Програма буде працювати безперервно, перевіряючи нові листи кожні 5 хвилин.

---

Якщо потрібно, можу допомогти створити `systemd` службу або скрипт для запуску у фоні.

```ruby
  def initialize(key)
    @key = key.dup
    @key_size = key.length
    
    # Validate key size
    unless KEY_SIZES.values.include?(@key_size)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid key size. Must be 16, 32, or 64 bytes."
    end
    
    # Expand the key into round keys
    @round_keys = expand_key(@key)
  end

  # Encrypt a block of data
  def encrypt_block(block)
    # Convert block to array of 16 bytes
    state = block.unpack('C*')
    
    # Add round key (first round)
    add_round_key(state, @round_keys[0])
    
    # Main rounds
    (1..@round_keys.length - 2).each do |round|
      sub_bytes(state)
      shift_rows(state)
      mix_columns(state)
      add_round_key(state, @round_keys[round])
    end
    
    # Final round
    sub_bytes(state)
    shift_rows(state)
    add_round_key(state, @round_keys.last)
    
    # Convert back to bytes
    state.pack('C*')
  end

  # Encrypt a file
  def encrypt_file(input_file, output_file)
    # Read input file
    input_data = File.read(input_file, mode: 'rb')
    
    # Pad data to block boundary
    padded_data = pad_data(input_data)
    
    # Process in blocks
    encrypted_data = ""
    (0...padded_data.length).step(BLOCK_SIZE) do |i|
      block = padded_data[i, BLOCK_SIZE]
      block = "\0" * BLOCK_SIZE if block.length < BLOCK_SIZE
      
      encrypted_block = encrypt_block(block)
      encrypted_data += encrypted_block
    end
    
    # Write encrypted data to output file
    File.open(output_file, 'wb') { |f| f.write(encrypted_data) }
    
    encrypted_data
  end

  private

  # Pad data to block size using PKCS#7 padding
  def pad_data(data)
    padding_length = BLOCK_SIZE - (data.length % BLOCK_SIZE)
    padding = [padding_length].pack('C') * padding_length
    data + padding
  end

  # Expand key into round keys
  def expand_key(key)
    key_size = key.length
    rounds = key_size == 16 ? 10 : key_size == 32 ? 12 : 14
    round_keys = []
    
    # First round key is the original key
    round_keys << key.dup
    
    # Generate additional round keys
    (1..rounds).each do |i|
      round_keys << generate_round_key(round_keys.last, i)
    end
    
    round_keys
  end

  # Generate a round key from previous round key
  def generate_round_key(prev_key, round)
    # For simplicity, using a basic key schedule
    # In real implementation, this would be more complex
    key = prev_key.dup
    # Simple transformation for demonstration
    key = key.unpack('C*')
    key.rotate!(1)
    key.pack('C*')
  end

  # Add round key to state
  def add_round_key(state, round_key)
    round_key_bytes = round_key.unpack('C*')
    (0...16).each { |i| state[i] ^= round_key_bytes[i] }
  end

  # SubBytes transformation
  def sub_bytes(state)
    state.map! { |byte| SBOX[byte] }
  end

  # ShiftRows transformation
  def shift_rows(state)
    # Shift rows
    temp = state.dup
    state[1] = temp[1]
    state[2] = temp[2]
    state[3] = temp[3]
    state[4] = temp[5]
    state[5] = temp[6]
    state[6] = temp[7]
    state[7] = temp[4]
    state[8] = temp[8]
    state[9] = temp[9]
    state[10] = temp[10]
    state[11] = temp[11]
    state[12] = temp[13]
    state[13] = temp[14]
    state[14] = temp[15]
    state[15] = temp[12]
  end

  # MixColumns transformation (simplified)
  def mix_columns(state)
    # This is a simplified version - a full implementation would be more complex
    # For demonstration purposes, we'll just XOR some bytes
    state[0] ^= state[1] ^ state[2] ^ state[3]
    state[4] ^= state[5] ^ state[6] ^ state[7]
    state[8] ^= state[9] ^ state[10] ^ state[11]
    state[12] ^= state[13] ^ state[14] ^ state[15]
  end
end

  # Create Kalyna instance with the recipient's key
```

4. **Padding**: Uses PKCS#7 padding for block alignment
5. **Block Processing**: Processes data in 128-bit blocks

## Note on Implementation

This is a simplified demonstration of the Kalyna algorithm. A complete implementation would require:

- Proper key schedule expansion
- Complete MixColumns transformation
- More rigorous testing and validation

For production use, consider using established cryptography libraries like OpenSSL or specialized crypto libraries that provide proper implementations of DSTU 7624.

```ruby
class SupportTicket < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user, optional: true
  has_many :attachments, as: :attachable, dependent: :destroy

      description: extract_body(email_message),
      email: email_message.from.first,
      user: user,
      status: :open
```

```ruby
  def initialize(bits = 256)
    @bits = bits
    @block_size = 1024  # bits
    @hash_size = bits / 8
    @state_size = @hash_size / 4  # 4 words per block
  end
  
  def digest(data)
    # Convert to bytes if needed
    data = data.unpack('C*') if data.is_a?(String)
    
    # Pad the data according to DSTU 7564
    padded_data = pad_data(data)
    
    # Process in blocks
    state = [0, 0, 0, 0]  # Initial state (4 words)
    block_count = 0
    
    # Process each 1024-bit block
    padded_data.each_slice(128) do |block|
      block = block.pack('C*').ljust(128, "\x00")
      state = process_block(block, state, block_count)
      block_count += 1
    end
    
    # Finalization
    final_state = finalize(state, block_count, padded_data.length)
    
    # Convert to bytes and return
    final_state.pack('V*').bytes
  end
  
  def hexdigest(data)
    digest(data).unpack('H*')[0]
  end
  
  private
  
  def pad_data(data)
    # Convert to bits first
    bits = data.each_with_index.map { |byte, i| 
      (0..7).map { |j| (byte >> j) & 1 }
    }.flatten
    
    # Add padding according to DSTU 7564
    length = bits.length
    
    # Add '1' bit
    bits << 1
    
    # Add zeros until length % 1024 = 1023
    while (bits.length + 1) % 1024 != 0
      bits << 0
    end
    
    # Add 1024-bit length representation at the end
    length_bits = (length & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF).to_s(2).rjust(64, '0')
    bits.concat(length_bits.chars.map(&:to_i))
    
    # Convert back to bytes
    bytes = []
    bits.each_slice(8) do |slice|
      byte = 0
      slice.reverse.each_with_index do |bit, i|
        byte |= (bit << i)
      end
      bytes << byte
    end
    
    bytes
  end
  
  def process_block(block, state, block_count)
    # Convert block to 32-bit words
    words = block.unpack('V*')
    
    # Initialize round key
    round_key = state.dup
    
    # Add round constants
    words[0] ^= RC256[block_count % 64]
    
    # Apply 12 rounds of processing
    12.times do |round|
      # Apply S-box substitution
      words = words.map { |word| sbox_substitution(word) }
      
      # Apply linear transformation
      words = linear_transformation(words)
      
      # Add round key
      words = words.zip(round_key).map { |a, b| a ^ b }
      
      # Update round key
      round_key = round_key.rotate(1).push(round_key[0] ^ RC256[round])
    end
    
    # XOR with initial state
    words.zip(state).map { |a, b| a ^ b }
  end
  
  def sbox_substitution(word)
    # Apply S-box to each byte
    result = 0
    4.times do |i|
      byte = (word >> (i * 8)) & 0xFF
      sbox_byte = S[byte]
      result |= (sbox_byte << (i * 8))
    end
    result
  end
  
  def linear_transformation(words)
    # Simplified version - in full implementation this would be a more complex matrix operation
    # For this example, we'll use a basic transformation
    new_words = []
    4.times do |i|
      # Apply a simple linear transformation
      new_words[i] = words[i] ^ (words[(i + 1) % 4] << 1) ^ (words[(i + 2) % 4] >> 1)
    end
    new_words
  end
  
  def finalize(state, block_count, data_length)
    # Final processing according to DSTU 7564
    # This is a simplified version, full implementation would be more complex
    result = state.dup
    
    # Add final round
    4.times do |i|
      result[i] ^= RC256[(block_count + i) % 64] ^ data_length
    end
    
    result
  end
end

# Convenience method for easy use
def kupyna_digest(data, bits = 256)
  Kupyna.new(bits).digest(data)
end

def kupyna_hexdigest(data, bits = 256)
  Kupyna.new(bits).hexdigest(data)
end

# Example usage
```

```ruby
require 'postmark'
require 'json'

# Налаштування Postmark
POSTMARK_API_TOKEN = 'your-postmark-api-token'
POSTMARK_SENDER_EMAIL = 'sender@example.com'
POSTMARK_TEMPLATE_ID = 1234567 # ID шаблону, якщо використовуєте шаблони

# Створення клієнта Postmark
client = Postmark::ApiClient.new(POSTMARK_API_TOKEN)

# Надсилання транзакційного листа з відстеженням
def send_transactional_email(to_email, subject, template_data = {})
  begin
    response = client.send_email(
      from: POSTMARK_SENDER_EMAIL,
      to: to_email,
      subject: subject,
      template_id: POSTMARK_TEMPLATE_ID,
      template_model: template_data,
      track_opens: true,     # Відстеження відкриття
      track_clicks: true     # Відстеження кліків
    )

    puts "Email sent successfully. Message ID: #{response['MessageID']}"
    puts "Recipient: #{response['To']}"
  rescue Postmark::BadRequest => e
    puts "Error sending email: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# Приклад виклику
send_transactional_email(
  to_email: 'recipient@example.com',
  subject: 'Ваше підтвердження',
  template_data: {
    name: 'Іван Петренко',
    action_url: 'https://example.com/confirm'
  }
)
```

### 1. Main Push Notification Service Class

```ruby
# lib/push_notification_service.rb
require 'firebase-admin'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class PushNotificationService
  include HTTParty
  
  def initialize
    # Initialize Firebase Admin SDK
    @service_account_key = ENV['FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY'] || File.read('service_account.json')
    @project_id = ENV['FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID'] || 'your-project-id'
    
    Firebase::Admin::Credentials.from_key(@service_account_key)
    @firebase_app = Firebase::Admin::App.new(@project_id)
  end
  
  # Send notification to a single device
  def send_to_device(token, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    payload = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      token: token,
      data: data
    }
    
    payload[:notification][:badge] = options[:badge] if options[:badge]
    payload[:notification][:sound] = options[:sound] if options[:sound]
    payload[:notification][:icon] = options[:icon] if options[:icon]
    
    # For iOS specific options
    payload[:apns] = {
      headers: {
        'apns-priority': options[:priority] || '10'
      },
      payload: {
        aps: {
          badge: options[:badge] || 0,
          sound: options[:sound] || 'default',
          category: options[:category] || nil
        }
      }
    } if options[:platform] == 'ios'
    
    # For Android specific options
    payload[:android] = {
      priority: options[:priority] || 'high',
      notification: {
        icon: options[:icon] || 'ic_notification',
        color: options[:color] || '#FF0000'
      }
    } if options[:platform] == 'android'
    
    send_fcm_request(payload)
  end
  
  # Send notification to multiple devices
  def send_to_devices(tokens, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    if tokens.is_a?(Array) && tokens.length > 0
      responses = []
      tokens.each do |token|
        response = send_to_device(token, title, body, data, options)
        responses << response
      end
      responses
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Tokens must be a non-empty array"
    end
  end
  
  # Send notification to topics
  def send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    payload = {
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      topic: topic,
      data: data
    }
    
    # Add platform-specific configurations
    payload[:apns] = {
      payload: {
        aps: {
          sound: options[:sound] || 'default'
        }
      }
    } if options[:platform] == 'ios'
    
    payload[:android] = {
      priority: options[:priority] || 'high'
    } if options[:platform] == 'android'
    
    send_fcm_request(payload)
  end
  
  # Send notification to multiple topics
  def send_to_topics(topics, title, body, data = {}, options = {})
    if topics.is_a?(Array) && topics.length > 0
      responses = []
      topics.each do |topic|
        response = send_to_topic(topic, title, body, data, options)
        responses << response
      end
      responses
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Topics must be a non-empty array"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def send_fcm_request(payload)
    # Use Firebase Admin SDK for sending notifications
    begin
      response = @firebase_app.messaging.send(payload)
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response,
        payload: payload
      }
    rescue => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message,
        payload: payload
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# imap_reader.rb
require 'net/imap'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'json'
require 'time'
require 'logger'

class IMAPReader
  def initialize(config)
    @config = config
    @logger = Logger.new('imap_reader.log')
    @db = SQLite3::Database.new(@config[:db_path])
    setup_database
  end

  def setup_database
    @db.execute <<-SQL
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uid INTEGER UNIQUE,
        subject TEXT,
        from_address TEXT,
        to_address TEXT,
        date TEXT,
        body TEXT,
        created_at TEXT
      );
    SQL
  end

  def connect
    @logger.info("Connecting to IMAP server: #{@config[:host]}")
    @imap = Net::IMAP.new(@config[:host], @config[:port], @config[:ssl])
    @imap.login(@config[:username], @config[:password])
    @imap.select(@config[:folder])
    @logger.info("Connected to IMAP server")
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Failed to connect: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  def disconnect
    @imap.disconnect if @imap
  end

  def get_last_processed_uid
    result = @db.execute('SELECT MAX(uid) FROM messages')
    result.first&.first || 0
  end

  def fetch_new_messages
    last_uid = get_last_processed_uid
    @logger.info("Fetching messages with UID > #{last_uid}")

    # Search for messages with UID greater than last processed
    uids = @imap.search(["UID", "#{last_uid + 1}:*"])
    
    return [] if uids.empty?
    
    @logger.info("Found #{uids.length} new messages")
    
    messages = []
    uids.each do |uid|
      begin
        message = fetch_message(uid)
        messages << message
        store_message(message)
        @logger.info("Stored message UID: #{uid}")
      rescue => e
        @logger.error("Failed to process message UID #{uid}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end
    
    messages
  end

  def fetch_message(uid)
    # Fetch headers and body
    message_data = @imap.fetch(uid, ['RFC822.HEADER', 'RFC822.TEXT', 'UID', 'INTERNALDATE'])
    raw_message = message_data.first.attr['RFC822.TEXT']
    
    # Parse headers
    headers = parse_headers(message_data.first.attr['RFC822.HEADER'])
    
    {
      uid: uid,
      subject: headers['subject'],
      from: headers['from'],
      to: headers['to'],
      date: headers['date'],
      body: raw_message,
      created_at: Time.now.to_s
    }
  end

  def parse_headers(header_string)
    headers = {}
    header_string.split("\n").each do |line|
      next if line.strip.empty?
      if line =~ /^(\w+):(.*)$/
        key = $1.downcase
        value = $2.strip
        headers[key] = value
      end
    end
    headers
  end

  def store_message(message)
    @db.execute(
      'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO messages (uid, subject, from_address, to_address, date, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      message[:uid],
      message[:subject],
      message[:from],
      message[:to],
      message[:date],
      message[:body],
      message[:created_at]
    )
  end

  def run_once
    connect
    messages = fetch_new_messages
    disconnect
    
    @logger.info("Processed #{messages.length} new messages")
    messages
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Error during processing: #{e.message}")
    disconnect if @imap
    raise
  end

  def start_monitoring
    @logger.info("Starting IMAP monitoring...")
    
    loop do
      begin
        run_once
        @logger.info("Waiting 5 minutes before next check...")
        sleep(300) # 5 minutes
      rescue => e
        @logger.error("Critical error: #{e.message}")
        sleep(60) # Wait 1 minute before retrying
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# apns_sender.rb
require 'apns2/client'
require 'apns2/payload'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'

class APNSSender
  def initialize(bundle_id, team_id, key_id, private_key_path, production: false)
    @bundle_id = bundle_id
    @team_id = team_id
    @key_id = key_id
    @private_key_path = private_key_path
    @production = production
    
    # Load the private key from file
    @private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(File.read(@private_key_path))
    
    # Create the APNs client
    @client = APNS2::Client.new(
      bundle_id: @bundle_id,
      team_id: @team_id,
      key_id: @key_id,
      private_key: @private_key,
      production: @production
    )
  end

  def send_notification(device_token, message, title: nil, badge: nil, sound: 'default', category: nil, custom_data: {})
    # Create the notification payload
    payload = APNS2::Payload.new
    
    # Set basic notification content
    payload.alert = {
      title: title,
      body: message
    }
    
    # Set additional options
    payload.badge = badge if badge
    payload.sound = sound
    payload.category = category if category
    
    # Add custom data
    payload.custom_data = custom_data unless custom_data.empty?
    
    # Send the notification
    response = @client.send(device_token, payload)
    
    # Handle response
    if response.success?
      puts "Notification sent successfully to device #{device_token}"
      return { success: true, response: response }
    else
      puts "Failed to send notification: #{response.error}"
      return { success: false, error: response.error }
    end
  end

  def send_notification_with_attachments(device_token, message, attachment_url, title: nil, badge: nil, sound: 'default')
    # Create the notification payload with attachment
    payload = APNS2::Payload.new
    
    payload.alert = {
      title: title,
      body: message
    }
    
    payload.badge = badge if badge
    payload.sound = sound
    
    # Add attachment using the 'mutable-content' key for rich notifications
    payload.mutable_content = true
    
    # Add attachment URL to custom data
    payload.custom_data = {
      attachmentUrl: attachment_url
    }
    
    # Send the notification
    response = @client.send(device_token, payload)
    
    if response.success?
      puts "Notification with attachment sent successfully to device #{device_token}"
      return { success: true, response: response }
    else
      puts "Failed to send notification with attachment: #{response.error}"
      return { success: false, error: response.error }
    end
  end

  def send_multiple_notifications(device_tokens, message, title: nil, badge: nil, sound: 'default')
    results = []
    
    device_tokens.each do |token|
      result = send_notification(token, message, title: title, badge: badge, sound: sound)
      results << { token: token, result: result }
    end
    
    return results
  end

  private

  def validate_token(token)
    # Basic validation for APNs token format
    return false unless token.is_a?(String)
    return false unless token.length == 64
    return false unless /^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/.match?(token)
    true
  end
end
```

### Крок 1: Gemfile

Створіть файл `Gemfile` з наступним вмістом:

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'typhoeus'
gem 'json'
```

Після цього виконайте:

```bash
bundle install
```

---

### Крок 2: Реалізація

Створіть файл `send_sms.rb`:

```ruby
require 'typhoeus'
require 'json'

class TurboSMS
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.turbosms.ua'

  def initialize(username, password)
    @username = username
    @password = password
    @auth = { username: @username, password: @password }
  end

  def send_sms(to, text)
    url = "#{BASE_URL}/message/send"

    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    payload = {
      sms: {
        to: to,
        text: text
      }
    }

    response = Typhoeus.post(url, {
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: headers,
      userpwd: "#{@username}:#{@password}",
      ssl_verifypeer: false
    })

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Error: #{response.response_code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
username = 'your_turbosms_username'
password = 'your_turbosms_password'

sms_client = TurboSMS.new(username, password)

# Надсилання SMS на український номер
phone_number = '380XXXXXXXXX'  # Замініть на реальний номер
message = 'Привіт! Це тестове повідомлення через TurboSMS.'

result = sms_client.send_sms(phone_number, message)

if result
  puts 'SMS надіслано успішно!'
  puts result
else
  puts 'Не вдалося надіслати SMS.'
end
```

---

### Пояснення:

- `Typhoeus` — бібліотека для роботи з HTTP-запитами.
- `TurboSMS` — клас, який ініціалізується ім'ям користувача та паролем, і має метод `send_sms`.
- `send_sms` — надсилає SMS на вказаний номер через TurboSMS API.
- Використовується HTTP Basic Auth для автентифікації.

---

### Важливо:

- Замініть `your_turbosms_username` і `your_turbosms_password` на ваші реальні дані.
- Номер має бути у форматі `380XXXXXXXXX` (український номер без префікса `+`).

Створіть файл `send_sms.rb`:

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class AlphaSMS
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.alphasms.com/api/v3'

  def initialize(api_key:, sender_name:)
    @api_key = api_key
    @sender_name = sender_name
    self.class.default_timeout 10
  end

  def send_sms(phone_number, message)
    response = self.class.post('/sms/send', {
      body: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        sender: @sender_name,
        to: phone_number,
        message: message
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    })

    if response.success?
      puts "SMS надіслано успішно"
      puts response.body
    else
      puts "Помилка надсилання SMS: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

phone_number = "+380XXXXXXXXX"  # номер отримувача
message = "Привіт, це тестове повідомлення!"
```

```ruby
class MessengerController < ApplicationController
  protect_from_forgery with: :null_session
  before_action :verify_webhook, only: [:webhook]

  # POST /messenger/webhook
  def webhook
    # Parse the request body
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    # Handle the webhook events
    if data['object'] == 'page'
      data['entry'].each do |entry|
        # Process each messaging event
        entry['messaging'].each do |event|
          process_message(event)
        end
      end
    end
    
    # Return success response
    render json: { status: 'ok' }
  end

  private

  def verify_webhook
    # Verify the webhook verification request
    if params['hub.mode'] == 'subscribe' && params['hub.verify_token'] == ENV['MESSENGER_VERIFY_TOKEN']
      render plain: params['hub.challenge'], status: 200
    else
      head :bad_request
    end
  end

  def process_message(event)
    # Extract message information
    sender_id = event['sender']['id']
    message = event['message']

    # Check if it's a text message
    if message && message['text']
      text = message['text']
      
      # Process the message and send a response
      response_text = handle_message(text)
      
      # Send response back to user
      send_message(sender_id, response_text)
    end

    # Handle other message types (images, files, etc.)
    if message && message['attachments']
      attachment = message['attachments'][0]
      
      case attachment['type']
      when 'image'
        # Handle image attachment
        handle_image_attachment(attachment)
      when 'file'
        # Handle file attachment
        handle_file_attachment(attachment)
      end
    end
  end

  def handle_message(text)
    # Simple message processing logic
    case text.downcase
    when 'hello', 'hi', 'hey'
      "Hello! How can I help you today?"
    when 'help'
      "I can help you with various things. Try asking me questions!"
    when 'time'
      "The current time is #{Time.now.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}"
    else
      "I received your message: '#{text}'. Thanks for messaging!"
    end
  end

  def handle_image_attachment(attachment)
    # Process image attachment
    # You could download and analyze the image here
    puts "Received image attachment: #{attachment['payload']['url']}"
  end

  def handle_file_attachment(attachment)
    # Process file attachment
    puts "Received file attachment: #{attachment['payload']['url']}"
  end

  def send_message(recipient_id, text)
    # Send message back to user
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/me/messages",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        recipient: { id: recipient_id },
        message: { text: text }
      }.to_json,
      query: {
        access_token: ENV['MESSENGER_ACCESS_TOKEN']
      }
    )

    Rails.logger.info("Message sent: #{response.body}")
  end
end
```

```ruby
class MessengerWebhookController < ApplicationController
  protect_from_forgery with: :null_session
  before_action :verify_webhook, only: [:webhook]

  def webhook
    if params[:hub.mode] == 'subscribe' && params[:hub.verify_token] == ENV['MESSENGER_VERIFY_TOKEN']
      render json: { 'hub.challenge' => params[:hub.challenge] }
    else
      # Обробка повідомлень
      process_message
      render json: { status: 'ok' }
    end
  end

  private

  def verify_webhook
    unless params[:hub.verify_token] == ENV['MESSENGER_VERIFY_TOKEN']
      render json: { error: 'Invalid verify token' }, status: :forbidden
    end
  end

  def process_message
    # Отримуємо JSON-дані з Facebook
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    # Перевіряємо, чи є повідомлення
    if data['entry'] && data['entry'][0]['messaging']
      data['entry'][0]['messaging'].each do |messaging_event|
        if messaging_event['message'] && messaging_event['message']['text']
          user_id = messaging_event['sender']['id']
          message_text = messaging_event['message']['text']
          
          # Відповідаємо користувачеві
          send_message(user_id, "You said: '#{message_text}'")
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def send_message(recipient_id, text)
    # Відправка повідомлення через Facebook API
    url = "https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/me/messages?access_token=#{ENV['MESSENGER_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN']}"
    
    payload = {
      recipient: { id: recipient_id },
      message: { text: text }
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      url,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
      body: payload.to_json
    )

    Rails.logger.info "Message sent: #{response.body}"
  end
end
```

**lib/alpha_sms_client.rb**
