```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class AlphaSMSClient
  include HTTParty

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret, base_url: 'https://www.alphasms.com/api')
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
    @base_url = base_url
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def send_sms(recipient, message, sender = nil)
    # Prepare the request payload
    payload = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      api_secret: @api_secret,
      to: recipient,
      message: message
    }
    
    # Add sender if provided (alphanumeric sender name)
    payload[:sender] = sender if sender && !sender.empty?
    
    # Make the API request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/send", 
                             headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
                             body: payload.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def send_sms_batch(recipients, message, sender = nil)
    # Prepare the request payload for batch sending
    payload = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      api_secret: @api_secret,
      to: recipients.join(','),
      message: message
    }
    
    # Add sender if provided
    payload[:sender] = sender if sender && !sender.empty?
    
    # Make the API request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/send", 
                             headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
                             body: payload.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      begin
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        { success: true, message: 'SMS sent successfully', raw_response: response.body }
      end
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "API Error: #{response.code}",
        message: response.body
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'alpha_sms_client'

class AlphaSMSSender
  def initialize
    @client = AlphaSMSClient.new(
      ENV['ALPHA_SMS_API_KEY'],
      ENV['ALPHA_SMS_API_SECRET']
    )
  end

  def send_sms(recipient, message, sender = nil)
    puts "Sending SMS to #{recipient} with message: #{message}"
    puts "Sender: #{sender || 'Default'}"
    
    response = @client.send_sms(recipient, message, sender)
    
    if response[:success]
      puts "✅ SMS sent successfully!"
      puts "Response: #{response}"
    else
      puts "❌ Failed to send SMS: #{response[:error]}"
      puts "Message: #{response[:message]}"
    end
    
    response
  end

  def send_batch_sms(recipients, message, sender = nil)
    puts "Sending batch SMS to #{recipients.length} recipients"
    puts "Message: #{message}"
    puts "Sender: #{sender || 'Default'}"
    
    response = @client.send_sms_batch(recipients, message, sender)
    
    if response[:success]
      puts "✅ Batch SMS sent successfully!"
      puts "Response: #{response}"
    else
      puts "❌ Failed to send batch SMS: #{response[:error]}"
      puts "Message: #{response[:message]}"
    end
    
    response
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class KyivstarSMS
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key:, base_url: 'https://api.kyivstar.ua')
    @api_key = api_key
    @base_url = base_url
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(to:, message:, from: nil, callback_url: nil)
    endpoint = '/sms/send'
    
    params = {
      to: to,
      message: message
    }
    
    params[:from] = from if from
    params[:callback_url] = callback_url if callback_url
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      headers: @headers,
      body: params.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get message status
  def get_status(message_id)
    endpoint = "/sms/status/#{message_id}"
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    endpoint = '/account/balance'
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}#{endpoint}",
      headers: @headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200..299
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise AuthenticationError, 'Invalid API key'
    when 400
      raise ValidationError, "Validation error: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded'
    when 500..599
      raise ServerError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise APIError, "Unexpected error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Custom exceptions
class APIError < StandardError; end
class AuthenticationError < APIError; end
class ValidationError < APIError; end
class RateLimitError < APIError; end
class ServerError < APIError; end
```

```ruby
# sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class TurboSmsSender
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty settings
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(username, password)
    @username = username
    @password = password
    @base_url = 'https://api.turbosms.ua'
  end
  
  # Authenticate and get token
  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/user/login", 
      body: { 
        username: @username,
        password: @password
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      @token = response['token']
      return true
    else
      puts "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
      return false
    end
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(phone, message, sender = nil)
    # Validate Ukrainian phone number format
    unless valid_ukrainian_phone?(phone)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid Ukrainian phone number format"
    end
    
    # Prepare the request body
    body = {
      sms: [
        {
          phone: phone,
          text: message,
          sender: sender
        }
      ]
    }
    
    # Set up headers with authentication
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
    
    # Send the request
    response = self.class.post("#{@base_url}/sms/send", 
      body: body.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response['sms']
    else
      puts "Failed to send SMS: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Get SMS status by ID
  def get_sms_status(sms_id)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}"
    }
    
    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/sms/status/#{sms_id}", 
      headers: headers
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response['sms']
    else
      puts "Failed to get SMS status: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@token}"
    }
    
    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/user/balance", 
      headers: headers
    )
    
    if response.success?
      response['balance']
    else
      puts "Failed to get balance: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Validate Ukrainian phone number (format: 380XXXXXXXXX or 0XXXXXXXXX)
  def valid_ukrainian_phone?(phone)
    # Remove all non-digit characters
    digits_only = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Check if it's a valid Ukrainian number format
    case digits_only.length
    when 10
      # 0XXXXXXXXX format (0-9)
      digits_only.match?(/\A0\d{9}\z/)
    when 12
      # 380XXXXXXXXX format (380-9)
      digits_only.match?(/\A380\d{9}\z/)
    else
      false
    end
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables from .env file
  Dotenv.load
  
  # Initialize the sender with your credentials
  # You can also pass credentials directly
  turbo_sms = TurboSmsSender.new(
    ENV['TURBOSMS_USERNAME'] || 'your_username',
    ENV['TURBOSMS_PASSWORD'] || 'your_password'
  )
  
  # Authenticate

    puts "Authentication successful"
    
    # Send SMS to Ukrainian number

      result = turbo_sms.send_sms(
        '380971234567',  # Ukrainian phone number (format: 380XXXXXXXXX)
        'Hello from Ruby! This is a test message.',
        'YourSenderName'  # Optional sender name

        puts "SMS ID: #{result['id']}"
      else

      end
      
      # Check balance

      puts "Account balance: #{balance}" if balance
      
    rescue => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    end
  else
    puts "Authentication failed"
  end
end
```

В цьому рішенні ми створимо Ruby-додаток для надсилання SMS через API Київстар.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'dotenv'
```

## app.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class KyivstarSMS
  include HTTParty

  # Налаштування базового URL і заголовків
  base_uri 'https://api.kyivstar.ua'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Accept' => 'application/json'

  def initialize(api_key, sender_id = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @sender_id = sender_id
  end

  # Надсилання SMS повідомлення
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, sender_id = nil)
    # Перевірка вхідних даних
    raise ArgumentError, "Номер телефону обов'язковий" if phone_number.nil? || phone_number.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Повідомлення обов'язкове" if message.nil? || message.empty?

    # Форматування номера телефону (при потребі)
    formatted_phone = format_phone(phone_number)

    # Налаштування запиту
    options = {
      body: {
        recipient: formatted_phone,
        message: message,
        sender: sender_id || @sender_id
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    }

    # Відправка запиту
    response = self.class.post('/sms/send', options)

    # Обробка відповіді
    case response.code
    when 200..201
      handle_success(response)
    when 400
      handle_bad_request(response)
    when 401
      handle_unauthorized(response)
    when 403
      handle_forbidden(response)
    when 422
      handle_unprocessable_entity(response)
    else
      handle_other_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Форматування номера телефону
  def format_phone(phone)
    # Видаляємо всі символи, крім цифр
    digits = phone.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Якщо номер починається з 380, то це український номер
    if digits.start_with?('380')
      digits
    elsif digits.length == 10
      # Якщо 10 цифр, додаємо префікс 380
      "380#{digits}"
    else
      # Якщо інший формат, залишаємо як є
      digits
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_success(response)
    result = JSON.parse(response.body)
    {
      success: true,
      message_id: result['messageId'],
      status: 'success',
      details: result
    }
  end

  def handle_bad_request(response)
    {
      success: false,
      status: 'bad_request',
      error: 'Неправильний запит',
      details: JSON.parse(response.body)
    }
  end

  def handle_unauthorized(response)
    {
      success: false,
      status: 'unauthorized',
      error: 'Неправильний API ключ',
      details: JSON.parse(response.body)
    }
  end

  def handle_forbidden(response)
    {
      success: false,
      status: 'forbidden',
      error: 'Доступ заборонено',
      details: JSON.parse(response.body)
    }
  end

  def handle_unprocessable_entity(response)
    {
      success: false,
      status: 'unprocessable_entity',
      error: 'Недопустимі дані',
      details: JSON.parse(response.body)
    }
  end

  def handle_other_error(response)
    {
      success: false,
      status: 'error',
      error: "Помилка сервера: #{response.code}",
      details: JSON.parse(response.body)
    }
  end
end

# Приклад використання

  # Завантаження змінних оточення

  # Отримання API ключа та інших параметрів з оточення
```

```ruby
require 'twilio-ruby'

# Перевірка наявності необхідних змінних середовища
def validate_environment
  required_vars = %w[TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER TO_PHONE_NUMBER]
  missing_vars = required_vars.select { |var| ENV[var].nil? || ENV[var].empty? }
  
  if missing_vars.any?
    puts "Помилка: Відсутні необхідні змінні середовища: #{missing_vars.join(', ')}"
    puts "Будь ласка, створіть файл .env з наступними змінними:"
    puts "TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=your_account_sid"
    puts "TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=your_auth_token"
    puts "TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER=your_twilio_phone_number"
    puts "TO_PHONE_NUMBER=recipient_phone_number"
    exit 1
  end
end

# Створення клієнта Twilio
def create_twilio_client
  account_sid = ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID']
  auth_token = ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
  Twilio::REST::Client.new(account_sid, auth_token)
end

# Виконання голосового дзвінка з синтезом мовлення
def make_voice_call(client, from_number, to_number, message)
  begin
    call = client.calls.create(
      url: "https://handler.twilio.com/twiml/EHXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
      to: to_number,
      from: from_number
    )
    
    puts "Дзвінок успішно надіслано! ID дзвінка: #{call.sid}"
    puts "Статус дзвінка: #{call.status}"
    
    # Для демонстрації використовуємо TwiML з синтезом мовлення
    # В реальному випадку ви можете використовувати TwiML з власним URL
    # або зберігати TwiML у файлі
    
  rescue Twilio::REST::TwilioError => e
    puts "Помилка при створенні дзвінка: #{e.message}"
  rescue => e
    puts "Невідома помилка: #{e.message}"
  end
end

# Головна функція
def main
  validate_environment
  client = create_twilio_client
  
  from_number = ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER']
  to_number = ENV['TO_PHONE_NUMBER']
  message = "Привіт! Це голосове повідомлення через Twilio. Дякуємо, що скористалися нашим сервісом."
  
  puts "Підготовка до здійснення дзвінка..."
  puts "Від: #{from_number}"
  puts "Кому: #{to_number}"
  puts "Повідомлення: #{message}"
  
  make_voice_call(client, from_number, to_number, message)
end

# Запуск програми
if __FILE__ == $0
  main
end
```

```ruby
require 'twilio-ruby'
require 'dotenv/load'

class VoiceCaller
  def initialize
    @account_sid = ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID']
    @auth_token = ENV['TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN']
    @twilio_number = ENV['TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER']
    
    raise 'Missing Twilio credentials. Set TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, and TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER environment variables.' unless all_credentials_present?
    
    @client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(@account_sid, @auth_token)
  end

  def make_call(to_number, message, voice = 'alice')
    begin
      call = @client.calls.create(
        url: generate_twiML_url(message, voice),
        to: to_number,
        from: @twilio_number
      )
      
      puts "Call initiated successfully!"
      puts "Call SID: #{call.sid}"
      puts "Status: #{call.status}"
      
      call.sid
    rescue Twilio::REST::TwilioError => e
      puts "Error making call: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def all_credentials_present?
    @account_sid && @auth_token && @twilio_number
  end

  def generate_twiML_url(message, voice)
    # Twilio requires a public URL for the TwiML
    # For local development, you might want to use a service like ngrok
    # This is a simple approach - in production, you'd host this somewhere public
    
    # For demonstration, we'll return a TwiML string directly
    # In practice, you'd create a web endpoint that returns TwiML
    "https://twimlets.com/voicemail?Email=#{CGI.escape(message)}"
  end
end
```

## lib/twilio_voice_call.rb
```ruby
require_relative 'voice_caller'
require 'uri'

class TwilioVoiceCall
  def self.send_call(to_number, message, options = {})
    caller = VoiceCaller.new
    
    # Validate phone number format
    formatted_number = format_phone_number(to_number)
    
    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid phone number format" unless formatted_number
    
    # Default voice options
    voice = options[:voice] || 'alice'
    
    caller.make_call(formatted_number, message, voice)
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.format_phone_number(number)
    # Remove non-digit characters
    digits_only = number.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Handle US numbers (10 digits)
    if digits_only.length == 10
      "+1#{digits_only}"
    elsif digits_only.length == 11 && digits_only.start_with?('1')
      "+#{digits_only}"
    else
      # Return original if it looks like it's already formatted
      number.start_with?('+') ? number : "+#{number}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class WebPushController < ApplicationController

    subscription_data = params[:subscription]
    
    if subscription_data
      current_user.update!(subscription_data: subscription_data)
      render json: { status: 'success' }, status: :ok
    else
      render json: { error: 'Invalid subscription data' }, status: :bad_request
    end
  end

  def send_notification
    title = params[:title] || 'Notification'
    body = params[:body] || 'You have a new message'
    user_ids = params[:user_ids] || []
    
    # Send to specific users or all users
    users = user_ids.any? ? User.where(id: user_ids) : User.all
    
    successful_notifications = 0
    failed_notifications = 0
    
    users.find_each do |user|
      begin
        user.send_web_push_notification(title, body)
        successful_notifications += 1
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to send notification to user #{user.id}: #{e.message}"
        failed_notifications += 1
      end
    end
    
    render json: {
      status: 'success',
      sent: successful_notifications,
      failed: failed_notifications
    }
  end
```

```javascript
// Web Push JavaScript for browser
class WebPushManager {
  constructor() {
    this.subscription = null;
    this.init();
  }

  async init() {
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && 'PushManager' in window) {
      try {
        const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js');
        this.subscription = await this.requestPermissionAndSubscribe(registration);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error setting up service worker:', error);
      }
    } else {
      console.warn('Push notifications are not supported in this browser');
    }
  }

  async requestPermissionAndSubscribe(registration) {
    try {
      const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
      if (permission === 'granted') {
        const subscription = await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: this.getVapidPublicKey()
        });
        return subscription;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error subscribing to push notifications:', error);
    }
    return null;
  }

  getVapidPublicKey() {
    // This should be replaced with your actual VAPID public key
    return 'BKJm3v37h7N4U7Q9D3R7G3S3R5Y6C2F8J3K9L0M1N2O3P4Q5R6S7T8U9V0W1X2Y3Z4';
  }

  async sendSubscriptionToServer() {
    if (!this.subscription) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/web_push/subscribe', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.getAuthToken()}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          subscription: this.subscription
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      console.log('Subscription sent to server');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending subscription to server:', error);
    }
  }

  getAuthToken() {
    // Get auth token from localStorage or cookies
    return localStorage.getItem('auth_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('auth_token');
  }
}

// Initialize web push manager
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const webPushManager = new WebPushManager();
  
  // Auto-send subscription when available
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (webPushManager.subscription) {
      webPushManager.sendSubscriptionToServer();
    }
  }, 1000);
});
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class SMSClubSender
  include HTTParty

  base_uri 'https://smsclub.mobi'

  def initialize(login, password)
    @login = login
    @password = password
  end

  def send_sms(phone, message)
    response = self.class.post('/sms/send', {
      body: {
        login: @login,
        password: @password,
        phone: phone,
        text: message,
        sender: 'VIBER' # Ім’я відправника
      }.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    })

    response.parsed_response
  end
end

class ViberSender
  def initialize(bot_token)
    @bot_token = bot_token
  end

  def send_viber_message(user_id, message)
    # Використовуємо бібліотеку viber_bot або HTTP-запити до Viber API

    # Для прикладу: реалізація через HTTParty до Viber API
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "https://chatapi.viber.com/pa/send_message",
      headers: {
        'X-Viber-Auth-Token' => @bot_token,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: {
        receiver: user_id,
        sender: {
          name: 'VIBER BOT'
        },
        text: message
      }.to_json
    )

    response.parsed_response
  end
end

# Виклик скрипта
def send_message_with_backup(phone, viber_message, sms_message, viber_bot_token, sms_login, sms_password)
  # Спочатку надсилаємо повідомлення через Viber
  viber_sender = ViberSender.new(viber_bot_token)
  viber_response = viber_sender.send_viber_message(phone, viber_message)

  if viber_response['status'] != 0
    puts "Помилка надсилання через Viber, надсилаємо SMS..."
    sms_sender = SMSClubSender.new(sms_login, sms_password)
    sms_response = sms_sender.send_sms(phone, sms_message)
    puts "SMS надіслано: #{sms_response}"
  else
    puts "Повідомлення надіслано через Viber: #{viber_response}"
  end
end

# Приклад використання
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class VodafoneNotifier
  include HTTParty

  # Встановлення базового URL для API Vodafone
  base_uri 'https://api.vodafone.ua'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }
  end

  # Надсилання SMS повідомлення
  def send_sms(phone_number, message)
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        '/sms/send',
        headers: @headers,
        body: {
          to: phone_number,
          text: message
        }.to_json
      )

      if response.success?
        puts "SMS успішно надіслано на #{phone_number}"
        return { success: true, data: response.parsed_response }
      else
        puts "Помилка надсилання SMS: #{response.body}"
        return { success: false, error: response.body }
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка під час надсилання SMS: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Надсилання Viber повідомлення
  def send_viber(phone_number, message, sender_name = nil, image_url = nil)
    begin
      payload = {
        to: phone_number,
        text: message
      }

      # Додавання додаткових параметрів, якщо вони передані
      payload[:sender] = { name: sender_name } if sender_name
      payload[:image] = image_url if image_url

      response = self.class.post(
        '/viber/send',
        headers: @headers,
        body: payload.to_json
      )

      if response.success?
        puts "Viber повідомлення успішно надіслано на #{phone_number}"
        return { success: true, data: response.parsed_response }
      else
        puts "Помилка надсилання Viber: #{response.body}"
        return { success: false, error: response.body }
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка під час надсилання Viber: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Перевірка статусу повідомлення
  def check_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "/status/#{message_id}",
        headers: @headers
      )

      if response.success?
        puts "Статус повідомлення: #{response.parsed_response}"
        return { success: true, data: response.parsed_response }
      else
        puts "Помилка отримання статусу: #{response.body}"
        return { success: false, error: response.body }
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка перевірки статусу: #{e.message}"
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ViberSender
  include HTTParty

  def initialize(api_key:, base_url: 'https://viber.infobip.com')
    @api_key = api_key
    @base_url = base_url
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def send_message(to_number, message_text, sender_name: nil, image_url: nil)
    # Ensure phone number is in international format (Ukraine starts with +380)
    formatted_number = format_phone_number(to_number)
    
    # Prepare the message payload
    payload = {
      "from" => sender_name || "Infobip",
      "to" => {
        "phoneNumber" => formatted_number
      },
      "message" => {
        "text" => message_text
      }
    }

    # Add image if provided
    if image_url
      payload["message"]["richMedia"] = {
        "type" => "rich_media",
        "richMedia" => {
          "items" => [
            {
              "type" => "image",
              "url" => image_url,
              "size" => "medium"
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    end

    # Send the request
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/viber/send",
      headers: {
        "Authorization" => "App #{@api_key}",
        "Content-Type" => "application/json",
        "Accept" => "application/json"
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    )

    # Handle response
    if response.success?
      {
        success: true,
        message_id: response.parsed_response['messageId'],
        status: response.parsed_response['status']['name']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body,
        status_code: response.code
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def format_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Remove all non-digit characters
    digits_only = phone_number.gsub(/\D/, '')
    
    # Handle different formats
    if digits_only.start_with?('380')
      # Already in correct format +380...
      "+#{digits_only}"
    elsif digits_only.start_with?('0')
      # Convert 0XXXXXXXXX to +380XXXXXXXXX
      "+380#{digits_only[1..-1]}"
    else
      # Assume it's a full international number
      "+#{digits_only}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# vodafone_messaging.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'openssl'

class VodafoneMessaging
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key, debug: false)
    @api_key = api_key
    @debug = debug
    @base_url = 'https://api.vodafone.com.ua'
    self.class.base_uri @base_url
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(to, message, from = nil)
    # Validate input
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipient number is required" if to.nil? || to.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Message content is required" if message.nil? || message.empty?
    
    # Prepare payload
    payload = {
      to: to,
      text: message
    }
    
    # Add sender ID if provided
    payload[:from] = from if from && !from.empty?
    
    # Send request
    response = self.class.post(
      '/sms/send',
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue => e
    handle_error(e)
  end
  
  # Send Viber message
  def send_viber(to, message, viber_service = nil)
    # Validate input
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipient number is required" if to.nil? || to.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Message content is required" if message.nil? || message.empty?
    
    # Prepare payload
    payload = {
      to: to,
      text: message,
      channel: 'viber'
    }
    
    # Add viber service info if provided
    payload[:viber_service] = viber_service if viber_service && !viber_service.empty?
    
    # Send request
    response = self.class.post(
      '/messaging/send',
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue => e
    handle_error(e)
  end
  
  # Send rich media message (for Viber)
  def send_viber_rich_media(to, rich_media, viber_service = nil)
    # Validate input
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipient number is required" if to.nil? || to.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Rich media content is required" if rich_media.nil? || rich_media.empty?
    
    # Prepare payload
    payload = {
      to: to,
      rich_media: rich_media,
      channel: 'viber'
    }
    
    # Add viber service info if provided
    payload[:viber_service] = viber_service if viber_service && !viber_service.empty?
    
    # Send request
    response = self.class.post(
      '/messaging/send',
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue => e
    handle_error(e)
  end
  
  # Send message to multiple recipients
  def send_bulk_sms(recipients, message, from = nil)
    # Validate input
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipients list is required" if recipients.nil? || recipients.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Message content is required" if message.nil? || message.empty?
    
    # Prepare payload
    payload = {
      recipients: recipients,
      text: message
    }
    
    # Add sender ID if provided
    payload[:from] = from if from && !from.empty?
    
    # Send request
    response = self.class.post(
      '/sms/send/bulk',
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue => e
    handle_error(e)
  end
  
  # Get message status
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    raise ArgumentError, "Message ID is required" if message_id.nil? || message_id.empty?
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/sms/status/#{message_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue => e
    handle_error(e)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Handle API response
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      if @debug
        puts "API Response: #{response.body}"
      end
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      puts error_message if @debug
      raise StandardError, error_message
    end
  end
  
  # Handle errors
  def handle_error(error)
    error_message = "Messaging Error: #{error.message}"
    puts error_message if @debug
    raise StandardError, error_message
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'colorize'
require 'tty-box'
require 'tty-prompt'
require 'dotenv/load'

class AirAlertNotifier
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://alerts.in.ua/api'
  
  def initialize
    @prompt = TTY::Prompt.new
    @alerts = []
  end
  
  def fetch_alerts
    begin
      response = self.class.get('/alerts')
      if response.success?
        @alerts = response.parsed_response
        puts "Завантажено #{response.parsed_response.length} сповіщень".green
        return true
      else
        puts "Помилка отримання даних: #{response.code}".red
        return false
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка підключення до API: #{e.message}".red
      return false
    end
  end
  
  def get_user_location
    puts "Введіть вашу область (наприклад: Київська, Харківська):".yellow
    location = @prompt.ask("Область:", required: true)
    location
  end
  
  def filter_alerts_by_location(location)
    # Фільтрація за локацією
    filtered = @alerts.select do |alert|
      alert['region'].downcase.include?(location.downcase) ||
      alert['district'].downcase.include?(location.downcase)
    end
    
    # Якщо немає співпадінь, шукаємо по назві міста
    if filtered.empty?
      filtered = @alerts.select do |alert|
        alert['city'].downcase.include?(location.downcase)
      end
    end
    
    filtered
  end
  
  def display_alerts(alerts)
    if alerts.empty?
      puts "Немає активних сповіщень для вашої області.".yellow
      return
    end
    
    puts "\n" + "=" * 60
    puts "ПОВІДОМЛЕННЯ ПРО ПОВІТРЯНІ ТРИВОГИ".center(60).bold
    puts "=" * 60
    
    alerts.each do |alert|
      puts "\n#{TTY::Box.frame(
        "Тривога: #{alert['type']}",
        width: 50,
        style: { border: { color: :red } }
      )}"
      
      puts "Дата: #{alert['date']}"
      puts "Час: #{alert['time']}"
      puts "Область: #{alert['region']}"
      puts "Район: #{alert['district']}"
      puts "Місто: #{alert['city']}"
      puts "Статус: #{alert['status']}"
      
      if alert['description']
        puts "Опис: #{alert['description']}"
      end
      
      puts "-" * 50
    end
  end
  
  def start
    puts "Програма сповіщення про повітряні тривоги".bold
    puts "Дані надаються через API alerts.in.ua\n\n"
    
    # Завантаження сповіщень
    unless fetch_alerts
      puts "Не вдалося отримати дані. Завершення програми.".red
      return
    end
    
    # Отримання області від користувача
    location = get_user_location
    
    # Фільтрація сповіщень
    alerts = filter_alerts_by_location(location)
    
    # Відображення результатів
    display_alerts(alerts)
    
    puts "\nНатисніть Enter для завершення..."
    gets
  end
end

# Запуск програми

  notifier.start
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
class SmsFlyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  # Base URL for SMS-fly API
  base_uri 'https://api.sms-fly.com'
  
  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  def send_sms(to, message, from = nil)
    # Validate required parameters
    raise ArgumentError, "Recipient number is required" if to.nil? || to.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Message is required" if message.nil? || message.empty?
    
    # Prepare request data
    data = {
      apikey: @api_key,
      to: to,
      text: message
    }
    
    # Add sender ID if provided
    data[:from] = from if from && !from.empty?
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post('/send', 
      body: data,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    # Parse and return response
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get balance information
  def get_balance
    response = self.class.get('/balance', 
      query: { apikey: @api_key }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get message status
  def get_message_status(message_id)
    response = self.class.get('/status', 
      query: { 
        apikey: @api_key,
        id: message_id
      }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  # Parse API response
  def parse_response(response)
    if response.code == 200
      begin
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        { error: "Invalid JSON response", response: response.body }
      end
    else
      { error: "API Error", status_code: response.code, response: response.body }
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# lib/viber_sms_sender.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ViberSMSSender
  include HTTParty

  def initialize(api_key:, logger: nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @base_url = 'https://smsclub.mobi'
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def send_message(recipient, message, sender_name: nil)
    # Try sending via Viber first (if supported by SMSClub)
    result = send_via_viber(recipient, message, sender_name)
    
    # If Viber fails or is not supported, fallback to SMS
    if result[:success] == false && !result[:viber_supported]
      @logger.info("Viber not supported or failed, falling back to SMS")
      result = send_via_sms(recipient, message, sender_name)
    end
    
    result
  end

  private

  def send_via_viber(recipient, message, sender_name)
    @logger.info("Attempting to send Viber message to #{recipient}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{@base_url}/sms/send",
        body: {
          login: @api_key,
          phone: recipient,
          text: message,
          viber: 1,
          sender: sender_name
        }.to_json,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
      )

      parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if parsed_response['status'] == 'success'
        @logger.info("Viber message sent successfully to #{recipient}")
        {
          success: true,
          method: 'viber',
          message_id: parsed_response['message_id'],
          viber_supported: true
        }
      else
        @logger.warn("Viber message failed: #{parsed_response['error']}")
        {
          success: false,
          method: 'viber',
          error: parsed_response['error'],
          viber_supported: true
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Viber API error: #{e.message}")
      {
        success: false,
        method: 'viber',
        error: e.message,
        viber_supported: false
      }
    end
  end

  def send_via_sms(recipient, message, sender_name)
    @logger.info("Sending SMS fallback to #{recipient}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{@base_url}/sms/send",
        body: {
          login: @api_key,
          phone: recipient,
          text: message,
          sender: sender_name
        }.to_json,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
      )

      parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if parsed_response['status'] == 'success'
        @logger.info("SMS message sent successfully to #{recipient}")
        {
          success: true,
          method: 'sms',
          message_id: parsed_response['message_id'],
          viber_supported: false
        }
      else
        @logger.warn("SMS message failed: #{parsed_response['error']}")
        {
          success: false,
          method: 'sms',
          error: parsed_response['error'],
          viber_supported: false
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("SMS API error: #{e.message}")
      {
        success: false,
        method: 'sms',
        error: e.message,
        viber_supported: false
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class LifecellSMS
  include HTTParty
  
  # Configure HTTParty
  default_timeout 30
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, username: nil, password: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['LIFECELL_API_KEY']
    @username = username || ENV['LIFECELL_USERNAME']
    @password = password || ENV['LIFECELL_PASSWORD']
    
    raise ArgumentError, 'API key, username, or password not provided' unless @api_key || (@username && @password)
    
    # Set base URI for Lifecell API
    self.class.base_uri 'https://sms.lifecell.ua'
  end
  
  # Send OTP via SMS
  def send_otp(phone_number, otp, sender_name: nil)
    # Generate message content
    message = "Your OTP is: #{otp}"
    
    # Prepare request data
    data = {
      phone: phone_number,
      text: message,
      sender: sender_name || 'OTP'
    }
    
    # Add authentication if using username/password
    if @username && @password
      data[:username] = @username
      data[:password] = @password
    else
      # For API key authentication
      data[:apiKey] = @api_key
    end
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post('/api/sms/send', body: data.to_json)
    
    # Handle response
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end
  
  # Send custom message
  def send_message(phone_number, message, sender_name: nil)
    # Prepare request data
    data = {
      phone: phone_number,
      text: message,
      sender: sender_name || 'OTP'
    }

    if @username && @password
      data[:username] = @username
      data[:password] = @password
    else
      # For API key authentication
      data[:apiKey] = @api_key
    end
    
    # Make API request
    response = self.class.post('/api/sms/send', body: data.to_json)
    
    # Handle response
    if response.success?
      parse_response(response)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_response(response)
    begin
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      {
        success: true,
        data: result,
        message_id: result['messageId']
      }
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {
        success: true,
        data: response.body,
        message_id: nil
      }
    end
  end
  
  def handle_error(response)
    begin
      error_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      {
        success: false,
        error: error_data['error'] || response.body,
        status_code: response.code
      }
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {
        success: false,
        error: response.body,
        status_code: response.code
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/air_raid_notifier.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'dotenv/load' if File.exist?('.env')

class AirRaidNotifier
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://alerts.in.ua/api'
  HEADERS = { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
  
  def initialize(logger = nil)
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.default_timeout 10
  end
  
  # Get all active alerts for a specific oblast
  def get_oblast_alerts(oblast_name)
    @logger.info("Fetching alerts for oblast: #{oblast_name}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get('/alerts', headers: HEADERS)
      
      if response.success?
        alerts = response.parsed_response
        filtered_alerts = filter_alerts_by_oblast(alerts, oblast_name)
        
        @logger.info("Found #{filtered_alerts.length} alerts for #{oblast_name}")
        filtered_alerts
      else
        @logger.error("API request failed with status: #{response.code}")
        []
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching alerts: #{e.message}")
      []
    end
  end
  
  # Get all oblasts with active alerts
  def get_active_oblasts
    @logger.info("Fetching all active oblasts")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get('/oblasts', headers: HEADERS)
      
      if response.success?
        response.parsed_response
      else
        @logger.error("API request failed with status: #{response.code}")
        []
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching oblasts: #{e.message}")
      []
    end
  end
  
  # Get detailed alert information
  def get_alert_details(alert_id)
    @logger.info("Fetching details for alert ID: #{alert_id}")
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get("/alerts/#{alert_id}", headers: HEADERS)
      
      if response.success?
        response.parsed_response
      else
        @logger.error("API request failed with status: #{response.code}")
        nil
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Error fetching alert details: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  # Filter alerts by oblast name
  def filter_alerts_by_oblast(alerts, oblast_name)
    alerts.select do |alert|
      # Normalize the oblast name for comparison
      normalized_oblast = normalize_oblast_name(oblast_name)
      
      # Check if alert is for the specified oblast
      alert['oblast'].nil? ? false : normalize_oblast_name(alert['oblast']) == normalized_oblast
    end
  end
  
  # Normalize oblast names for comparison
  def normalize_oblast_name(name)
    return '' if name.nil?
    name.downcase.strip.gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
  end
  
  # Check if there are any active alerts
  def has_active_alerts?(oblast_name)
    get_oblast_alerts(oblast_name).any?
  end
  
  # Send notification (simulated - replace with actual notification method)
  def notify_user(oblast_name, alerts)
    if alerts.empty?
      @logger.info("No active alerts for #{oblast_name}")
      return
    end
    
    alerts.each do |alert|
      message = format_alert_message(alert)
      @logger.info("Sending notification: #{message}")
      # In a real implementation, you would call:
      # send_sms_notification(alert)
      # send_email_notification(alert)
      # push_notification(alert)
    end
  end
  
  # Format alert message
  def format_alert_message(alert)
    timestamp = alert['timestamp'] || Time.now.iso8601
    message = alert['message'] || 'Air raid alert'
    oblast = alert['oblast'] || 'Unknown oblast'
    
    "⚠️ #{oblast} - #{message} (#{timestamp})"
  end
  
  # Monitor oblast for alerts
  def monitor_oblast(oblast_name, interval_seconds = 300)
    @logger.info("Starting monitoring for #{oblast_name} every #{interval_seconds} seconds")
    
    loop do
      current_alerts = get_oblast_alerts(oblast_name)
      notify_user(oblast_name, current_alerts)
      
      sleep(interval_seconds)
    end
  end
end

# Usage example

  notifier = AirRaidNotifier.new
  
  # Example usage
  puts "Active oblasts:"
  active_oblasts = notifier.get_active_oblasts
  active_oblasts.each { |oblast| puts "- #{oblast}" }
  
  # Check for alerts in a specific oblast
  oblast = ARGV[0] || 'Kyiv'
  puts "\nChecking alerts for #{oblast}:"
  
  alerts = notifier.get_oblast_alerts(oblast)
  if alerts.empty?
    puts "No active alerts"
  else
    alerts.each do |alert|
      puts notifier.format_alert_message(alert)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class MobizonClient
  include HTTParty

  # Конфігурація
  base_uri 'https://api.mobizon.com'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  def send_sms(to, message)
    # Перетворюємо номер телефону на формат +380XXXXXXXXX
    to = "+#{to}" unless to.start_with?("+")

    response = self.class.post('/service/message/sendsms', {
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        recipient: to,
        text: message
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    })

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      puts "Помилка: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
api_key = 'YOUR_API_KEY'  # Замініть на ваш API ключ з Mobizon
client = MobizonClient.new(api_key)

# Надсилання SMS
client.send_sms('380991234567', 'Привіт! Це тестове повідомлення.')
```

---

### 3. Що потрібно знати:

- Замініть `YOUR_API_KEY` на ваш справжній API ключ із [Mobizon](https://mobizon.com.ua/).
- Номер телефону має бути у форматі `+380XXXXXXXXX`.
- Якщо API відповідає помилкою, код виведе код та текст помилки.

---

### 4. Приклад відповіді:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "messageId": "123456789"
  }
}
```

## 🧠 Реалізація (main.rb)

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'terminal-table'
require 'tzinfo'
require 'date'

# Конфігурація
API_URL = "https://example.com/api/power-outages" # Приклад API
TIMEZONE = TZInfo::Timezone.get('Europe/Kiev')

# Модель для запису про відключення
class PowerOutage
  attr_accessor :address, :start_time, :end_time, :duration

  def initialize(address, start_time, end_time)
    @address = address
    @start_time = TIMEZONE.parse(start_time)
    @end_time = TIMEZONE.parse(end_time)
    @duration = (@end_time - @start_time) / 60 # у хвилинах
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@address} | #{@start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} - #{@end_time.strftime('%H:%M')} (#{@duration} хв)"
  end
end

# Клієнт API для отримання даних про відключення
class PowerOutageClient
  include HTTParty

  base_uri API_URL

  def self.get_outages_for_address(address)
    response = get("/outages?address=#{address}")
    return [] unless response.success?

    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    data.map do |item|
      PowerOutage.new(item['address'], item['start'], item['end'])
    end
  end
end

# Сповіщення
class NotificationService
  def self.notify_user(outage)
    puts "[СПОВІЩЕННЯ] Відключення електроенергії на адресі: #{outage.address}"
    puts "Час відключення: #{outage.start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} до #{outage.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}"
    puts "Тривалість: #{outage.duration} хвилин"
    puts "-" * 50
  end
end

# Головна логіка
def show_outages_for_address(address)
  puts "Отримуємо дані про відключення для адреси: #{address}"
  outages = PowerOutageClient.get_outages_for_address(address)

  if outages.empty?
    puts "Відключення не знайдено."
    return
  end

  table = Terminal::Table.new do |t|
    t << ['Адреса', 'Початок', 'Кінець', 'Тривалість (хв)']
    t.add_separator
    outages.each do |outage|
      t << [
        outage.address,
        outage.start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'),
        outage.end_time.strftime('%H:%M'),
        outage.duration
      ]
    end
  end

  puts table
end

# Основна функція
if __FILE__ == $0
  print "Введіть адресу: "
  address = gets.chomp

  show_outages_for_address(address)

  # Сповіщення користувача
  outages = PowerOutageClient.get_outages_for_address(address)
  outages.each do |outage|
    NotificationService.notify_user(outage)
  end
end
```

```ruby
bot.on_message do |message|

  text = message.text
  
  # Initialize user's order if not exists

    items: [],
    status: 'active'
  }
  
  # Handle different commands
  case text
  when /^\/start/i

      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^Order Pizza/i

      reply.keyboard = create_pizza_size_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^Order Burger/i
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "Please select a burger type:"
      reply.keyboard = create_burger_type_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^Order Salad/i
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "Please select a salad type:"
      reply.keyboard = create_salad_type_keyboard
    end

    orders[user_id][:items] << item

      reply.text = "Added #{item} pizza to your order."
      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^Classic Burger|Cheese Burger|Bacon Burger/i
    item = text.gsub(" Burger", "")
    orders[user_id][:items] << item
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "Added #{item} burger to your order."
      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^Caesar Salad|Greek Salad|Garden Salad/i
    item = text.gsub(" Salad", "")
    orders[user_id][:items] << item
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "Added #{item} salad to your order."
      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^View Order/i

    if order_items.empty?

        reply.text = "Your order is empty."
        reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
      end
    else
      bot.reply(message) do |reply|
        reply.text = "Your current order:\n#{order_items.join("\n")}"
        reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
      end
    end
    
  when /^Checkout/i
    order_items = orders[user_id][:items]
    if order_items.empty?
      bot.reply(message) do |reply|
        reply.text = "Your order is empty. Please add items before checkout."
        reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
      end
    else
      bot.reply(message) do |reply|
        reply.text = "Your order is:\n#{order_items.join("\n")}\n\nPlease confirm your order or cancel."
        reply.keyboard = create_confirmation_keyboard
      end

    if order_items.empty?
      bot.reply(message) do |reply|
        reply.text = "No items in your order."
        reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
      end
    else
      bot.reply(message) do |reply|
        reply.text = "Thank you for your order! Your items:\n#{order_items.join("\n")}\n\nWe'll prepare it right away!"
        reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
      end
      orders[user_id] = { items: [], status: 'completed' }
    end
    
  when /^Cancel Order/i
    orders[user_id] = { items: [], status: 'cancelled' }
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "Your order has been cancelled."
      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
    
  when /^Back to Menu/i
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "Back to main menu:"
      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
    
  else
    bot.reply(message) do |reply|
      reply.text = "I didn't understand that. Please use the menu buttons to navigate."
      reply.keyboard = create_menu_keyboard
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv/load'

class PushNotifier
  include HTTParty

  base_uri ENV['FCM_API_URL']

  def initialize
    self.class.default_timeout 30
  end

  def send_notification(token, title, body)
    payload = {
      to: token,
      notification: {
        title: title,
        body: body
      },
      data: {
        # Додаткові дані, якщо потрібно
      }
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      '',
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "key=#{ENV['FCM_SERVER_KEY']}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      },
      body: payload.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Push notification sent successfully to #{token}"
      return true
    else
      puts "Failed to send notification: #{response.body}"
      return false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# stemming_and_stopwords.rb
require 'stopwords'
require 'stemmer'
require 'nokogiri'

class ProductIndexer
  def initialize
    # Initialize stemmer and stop words
    @stemmer = Lingua::Stemmer.new
    @stop_words = Stopwords::Stopwords.new
  end

  # Main method to process product descriptions
  def process_product_description(description)
    # Clean and tokenize the description
    tokens = tokenize_description(description)
    
    # Remove stop words
    tokens_without_stops = remove_stop_words(tokens)
    
    # Stem the remaining words
    stemmed_tokens = stem_words(tokens_without_stops)
    
    # Join back into a processed string
    stemmed_tokens.join(' ')
  end

  # Tokenize the description into individual words
  def tokenize_description(description)
    # Remove HTML tags if present
    clean_description = strip_html_tags(description)
    
    # Split by whitespace and punctuation, convert to lowercase
    clean_description.downcase.scan(/\b\w+\b/).reject(&:empty?)
  end

  # Remove HTML tags using Nokogiri
  def strip_html_tags(text)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML::DocumentFragment.parse(text)
    doc.text
  end

  # Remove stop words from tokens
  def remove_stop_words(tokens)
    tokens.reject { |token| @stop_words.stopwords.include?(token) }
  end

  # Stem words using the Porter stemmer
  def stem_words(tokens)
    tokens.map { |token| @stemmer.stem(token) }
  end

  # Process multiple product descriptions
  def process_multiple_descriptions(descriptions)
    descriptions.map { |desc| process_product_description(desc) }
  end

  # Get the complete set of stop words for reference
  def get_stop_words
    @stop_words.stopwords
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  indexer = ProductIndexer.new
  
  # Sample product descriptions
  product_descriptions = [
    "This is a high-quality wireless mouse with excellent battery life.",
    "The smartphone features a stunning 6.1-inch display and powerful processor.",
    "Our coffee maker brews the perfect cup every morning with automatic features.",
    "These running shoes provide superior comfort and durability for long distances.",
    "The laptop has a fast processor and plenty of storage space for your files."
  ]
  
  puts "Original descriptions:"
  product_descriptions.each_with_index do |desc, index|
    puts "#{index + 1}. #{desc}"
  end
  
  puts "\nProcessed descriptions:"
  processed_descriptions = indexer.process_multiple_descriptions(product_descriptions)
  processed_descriptions.each_with_index do |desc, index|
    puts "#{index + 1}. #{desc}"
  end
  
  puts "\nStop words (first 10):"
  puts indexer.get_stop_words.first(10).join(', ')
end
```

```ruby
class AirRaidAlertAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  def self.get_alert_status
    # This would normally fetch from a real Ukrainian government API
    # For demo purposes, we'll simulate data
    {
      status: "alert",
      location: "Kyiv",

      { name: "Lviv", status: "normal", level: 1 }
    ]
  end

# Telegram bot class
class UkraineAlertBot
  def initialize(token)
    @token = token
    @bot = Telegram::Bot::Client.new(token)
  end

  def run
    @bot.listen do |message|
      case message.text
      when '/start'
        handle_start(message)
      when '/alert'
        handle_alert(message)
      when '/regions'
        handle_regions(message)
      when '/help'
        handle_help(message)
      else
        handle_unknown(message)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_start(message)
    response = "Welcome to the Ukraine Air Raid Alert Bot! 🇺🇦\n\n" \
               "I provide real-time air raid alert information for Ukraine.\n\n" \
               "Commands:\n" \
               "/alert - Show current alert status\n" \
               "/regions - Show alert status by regions\n" \
               "/help - Show this help message"
    
    send_message(message.chat.id, response)
  end

  def handle_alert(message)
    alert_data = AirRaidAlertAPI.get_alert_status
    
    response = "🚨 AIR RAID ALERT 🚨\n\n" \
               "📍 Location: #{alert_data[:location]}\n" \
               "🕒 Updated: #{alert_data[:updated_at]}\n" \
               "📝 Description: #{alert_data[:description]}\n\n" \
               "⚠️ This is an emergency alert. Please seek shelter immediately."
    
    send_message(message.chat.id, response)
    send_photo(message.chat.id, alert_data[:map_url])
  end

  def handle_regions(message)
    regions = AirRaidAlertAPI.get_alert_regions
    
    response = "📍 Current Alert Status by Regions:\n\n"
    
    regions.each do |region|
      status_emoji = case region[:status]
                     when 'alert'
                       '🔴'
                     when 'warning'
                       '🟡'
                     else
                       '🟢'
                     end
      
      response += "#{status_emoji} #{region[:name]} - #{region[:status].capitalize} (Level #{region[:level]})\n"
    end
    
    response += "\n⚠️ Please stay informed and follow official safety guidelines."
    
    send_message(message.chat.id, response)
  end

  def handle_help(message)
    response = "ℹ️ Available Commands:\n" \
               "/start - Start the bot and get welcome message\n" \
               "/alert - Show current air raid alert status\n" \
               "/regions - Show alert status for all regions\n" \
               "/help - Show this help message\n\n" \
               "For emergency situations, please follow official government guidance."
    
    send_message(message.chat.id, response)
  end

  def handle_unknown(message)
    response = "Sorry, I didn't understand that command. Type /help for available commands."
    send_message(message.chat.id, response)
  end

  def send_message(chat_id, text)
    @bot.api.send_message(chat_id: chat_id, text: text)
  end

  def send_photo(chat_id, url)
    # In a real implementation, you would use this to send photo
    # @bot.api.send_photo(chat_id: chat_id, photo: url)
    logger.info("Would send photo: #{url}")
  end
end

# Main execution

  token = ENV['TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN']
  
  if token.nil? || token.empty?
    puts "Please set the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable"
    exit 1
  end
  
  bot = UkraineAlertBot.new(token)
  bot.run
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'json'

class BinotelClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.binotel.com'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    @account_id = ENV['BINOTEL_ACCOUNT_ID']
  end

  def make_call(to_number, message)
    # Генеруємо timestamp та signature для автентифікації
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i
    signature = Digest::MD5.hexdigest("#{@api_secret}#{@account_id}#{timestamp}")

    # URL для дзвінка
    url = "/api/call/make"

    # Параметри запиту
    options = {
      query: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        account_id: @account_id,
        timestamp: timestamp,
        signature: signature,
        from: ENV['BINOTEL_PHONE_NUMBER'],
        to: to_number,
        message: message
      }
    }

    # Виконання HTTP-запиту
    response = self.class.post(url, options)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end

end
```

## binotel_call.rb
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class BinotelCall
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api'.freeze

  def initialize(account_id, api_key, secret_key)
    @account_id = account_id
    @api_key = api_key
    @secret_key = secret_key
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def make_call(customer_phone, message_text, caller_id = nil)
    # Prepare the call parameters
    params = {
      account_id: @account_id,
      api_key: @api_key,
      secret_key: @secret_key,
      phone: customer_phone,
      message: message_text,
      caller_id: caller_id
    }.delete_if { |_, v| v.nil? || v.empty? }

    # Make the API call
    response = self.class.post("#{BASE_URL}/call", 
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: params.to_json)

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def make_call_with_file(customer_phone, message_file, caller_id = nil)
    # Prepare the call parameters with file-based message
    params = {
      account_id: @account_id,
      api_key: @api_key,
      secret_key: @secret_key,
      phone: customer_phone,
      message_file: message_file,
      caller_id: caller_id
    }.delete_if { |_, v| v.nil? || v.empty? }

    # Make the API call
    response = self.class.post("#{BASE_URL}/call",
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: params.to_json)

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      if result['status'] == 'success'
        {
          success: true,
          call_id: result['call_id'],
          message: result['message'] || 'Call initiated successfully'
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          error: result['error'] || 'API returned error'
        }
      end
    when 400
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Bad Request - Invalid parameters'
      }
    when 401
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized - Invalid credentials'
      }
    when 403
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Forbidden - Access denied'
      }
    when 500
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Internal Server Error - API error'
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Unexpected response code: #{response.code}"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables from .env file
  # Create a .env file with:
  # BINOTEL_ACCOUNT_ID=your_account_id
  # BINOTEL_API_KEY=your_api_key
  # BINOTEL_SECRET_KEY=your_secret_key

  account_id = ENV['BINOTEL_ACCOUNT_ID']
  api_key = ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
  secret_key = ENV['BINOTEL_SECRET_KEY']

  if account_id.nil? || api_key.nil? || secret_key.nil?
    puts "Error: Please set BINOTEL_ACCOUNT_ID, BINOTEL_API_KEY, and BINOTEL_SECRET_KEY in your environment variables"
    exit 1
  end

  # Initialize the Binotel client
  binotel = BinotelCall.new(account_id, api_key, secret_key)

  # Example 1: Call with text message

  message = "Hello, this is an automated message from our company. Please call us back at your earliest convenience."
```

Ось реалізація на Ruby для надсилання SMS-сповіщень клієнтам про доставку через SMS-сервіс Нової Пошти.

### 1. Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rest-client'
gem 'json'
gem 'dotenv'
```

### 2. Запуск

1. Встановіть геми:
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. Створіть файл `.env` з вашим API-ключем:
   ```
   NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
   ```

3. Запустіть скрипт:
   ```bash
   ruby send_sms_notification.rb
   ```

### 3. Основний код

```ruby
# send_sms_notification.rb
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class NovaPoshtaSMS
  NOVA_POSHTA_API_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']

  def initialize
    raise 'Nova Poshta API key is required' unless API_KEY
  end

  def send_sms(phone_number, message)
    payload = {
      apiKey: API_KEY,
      modelName: 'InternetDocument',
      calledMethod: 'sendSMS',
      methodProperties: {
        phone: phone_number,
        message: message
      }
    }

    begin
      response = RestClient.post(
        NOVA_POSHTA_API_URL,
        payload.to_json,
        content_type: :json,
        accept: :json
      )
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      puts "SMS sent successfully: #{result['success']}"
      result
    rescue RestClient::Exception => e
      puts "Error sending SMS: #{e.message}"
      JSON.parse(e.response.body) rescue { error: e.message }
    end
  end

  def send_delivery_notification(client_phone, tracking_number)
    message = "Вашу посилку №#{tracking_number} вже в дорозі! " \
              "Відстежити можна за посиланням: https://novaposhta.ua/tracking/#{tracking_number}"
    send_sms(client_phone, message)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  sms_service = NovaPoshtaSMS.new

  # Надіслати сповіщення про доставку
  client_phone = '+380XXXXXXXXX'  # Замініть на реальний номер
  tracking_number = '1234567890'   # Замініть на реальний номер відстеження

  sms_service.send_delivery_notification(client_phone, tracking_number)
end
```

### 4. Як це працює

1. **Gemfile**: Визначає залежності:
   - `rest-client` — для HTTP-запитів
   - `json` — для роботи з JSON
   - `dotenv` — для завантаження змінних оточення

2. **NovaPoshtaSMS class**:
   - Ініціалізує API-ключ і URL
   - Метод `send_sms` надсилає SMS через API Нової Пошти
   - Метод `send_delivery_notification` створює спеціальне повідомлення про доставку

3. **Приклад використання**:
   - Встановлює номер клієнта та номер відстеження
   - Викликає метод для надсилання сповіщення

### 5. Вимоги

- API ключ Нової Пошти (можна отримати в особистому кабінеті)
- Дійсний номер телефону клієнта (у форматі +380XXXXXXXXX)
- Підключення до Інтернету

### 6. Відповідь API

API повертає JSON з результатом:
```json

  "success": true,
  "data": [...],
  "errors": [],
  "warnings": []
}
```

### 7. Обробка помилок

- Перевіряється наявність API-ключа
- Обробляються помилки HTTP-запитів
- Виводиться інформація про успішність надсилання

Ось приклад реалізації завдання на Ruby, яке включає:

1. **Використання Gemfile для управління залежностями**.
2. **Стемінг англійських слів** за допомогою гема `stemmer`.
3. **Видалення стоп-слів** за допомогою гема `stopwords`.
4. **Підготовка тексту товарів до індексації**.

---

## 1. `Gemfile`

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'stemmer'
gem 'stopwords'
```

---

## 2. `stem_and_filter.rb` — основний код

```ruby
require 'stemmer'
require 'stopwords'

class ProductTextProcessor
  def initialize
    @stemmer = Lingua::Stemmer.new(:language => :english)
    @stopwords = Stopwords::Stopwords::ENGLISH
  end

  def process_text(text)
    # Перетворення на маленькі літери
    text = text.downcase

    # Видалення пунктуації
    text = text.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z\s]/, '')

    # Розділення на слова
    words = text.split

    # Фільтрація стоп-слів
    filtered_words = words.reject { |word| @stopwords.include?(word) }

    # Стемінг
    stemmed_words = filtered_words.map { |word| @stemmer.stem(word) }

    # Об'єднання назад у рядок
    stemmed_words.join(' ')
  end
end

# Приклад використання
processor = ProductTextProcessor.new

product_description = "This is a beautiful and amazing product with great features and quality."
processed_text = processor.process_text(product_description)

puts "Original: #{product_description}"
puts "Processed: #{processed_text}"
```

---

## 3. Як запустити

1. Збережіть `Gemfile` у кореневій папці проекту.
2. Встановіть геми:

```bash
bundle install
```

3. Збережіть `stem_and_filter.rb` і запустіть:

```bash
ruby stem_and_filter.rb
```

---

## Приклад виводу:

```
Original: This is a beautiful and amazing product with great features and quality.
Processed: beauti amaz product great featur qualiti
```

---

## Пояснення

- **`Lingua::Stemmer` (gem `stemmer`)**: використовується для стемінгу слів (наприклад, "running" → "run").
- **`Stopwords::Stopwords::ENGLISH` (gem `stopwords`)**: список англійських стоп-слів (наприклад, "the", "and", "is").
- **Попередня обробка**: приведення до нижнього регістру, видалення пунктуації, розділення на слова.
- **Фінальний результат**: очищений і змінений текст, готовий до індексації.

### 📁 2. `spell_checker.rb`

```ruby
require 'hunspell'

class SpellChecker
  def initialize(dictionary_path = nil)
    # Якщо не вказано шлях, використовуємо стандартний словник
    @spell = Hunspell::Hunspell.new(dictionary_path || 'en_US')
  end

  def check_text(text)
    words = text.split(/\s+/)
    misspelled = []

    words.each do |word|
      # Видаляємо пунктуацію для перевірки
      clean_word = word.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z]/, '').downcase

      unless clean_word.empty? || @spell.spell?(clean_word)
        misspelled << {
          word: word,
          suggestions: @spell.suggest(clean_word)
        }
      end
    end

    misspelled
  end

  def correct_text(text)
    words = text.split(/\s+/)
    corrected = []

    words.each do |word|
      clean_word = word.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z]/, '').downcase

      if clean_word.empty? || @spell.spell?(clean_word)
        corrected << word
      else
        suggestions = @spell.suggest(clean_word)
        # Беремо перше пропозицію, якщо є
        corrected_word = suggestions.first || word
        corrected << word.gsub(clean_word, corrected_word)
      end
    end

    corrected.join(' ')
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  checker = SpellChecker.new

  text = "Ths is a smple text with som misstakes."
  puts "Original text: #{text}"

  misspelled = checker.check_text(text)
  if misspelled.empty?
    puts "No spelling errors found."
  else
    puts "Misspelled words and suggestions:"
    misspelled.each do |entry|
      puts "  '#{entry[:word]}' -> #{entry[:suggestions]}"
    end
  end

  corrected = checker.correct_text(text)
  puts "Corrected text: #{corrected}"
end
```

---

### 📌 Як запустити

1. Установіть залежності:
   ```bash

   ```

2. Запустіть скрипт:
   ```bash

   ```

### 🧠 Примітки

- `hunspell` потребує наявності словників (наприклад, `en_US`).
- У разі потреби встановіть словники в систему або вкажіть шлях до них.

Here's a complete Ruby solution for sending delivery notifications through the Nova Poshta SMS service:

## Gemfile
```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'dotenv' # for environment variables
gem 'logger'
```

## lib/nova_poshta_sms.rb
```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class NovaPoshtaSMS
  include HTTParty
  
  # Base URL for Nova Poshta API
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  
  def initialize(api_key, logger = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end
  
  # Send SMS notification to customer
  def send_sms(phone_number, message, sender_name = 'NovaPoshta')
    begin
      response = self.class.post('/sendSms', {
        body: {
          apiKey: @api_key,
          modelName: 'InternetDocument',
          calledMethod: 'sendSms',
          methodProperties: {
            phone: phone_number,
            message: message,
            sender: sender_name
          }
        }.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      })
      
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['success'] == true
        @logger.info("SMS sent successfully to #{phone_number}")
        return { success: true, message_id: result['data']&.first&.[]('smsId') }
      else
        error_message = result['errors']&.first || 'Unknown error'
        @logger.error("Failed to send SMS to #{phone_number}: #{error_message}")
        return { success: false, error: error_message }
      end
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Exception occurred while sending SMS to #{phone_number}: #{e.message}")
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
  
  # Bulk send SMS notifications
  def send_bulk_sms(recipients)
    results = []
    
    recipients.each do |recipient|
      phone = recipient[:phone]
      message = recipient[:message]
      sender = recipient[:sender] || 'NovaPoshta'
      
      result = send_sms(phone, message, sender)
      results << {
        phone: phone,
        success: result[:success],
        error: result[:error],
        message_id: result[:message_id]
      }
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  # Check SMS delivery status
  def check_sms_status(message_id)
    begin
      response = self.class.post('/getSmsStatus', {
        body: {
          apiKey: @api_key,
          modelName: 'InternetDocument',
          calledMethod: 'getSmsStatus',
          methodProperties: {
            smsId: message_id
          }
        }.to_json,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'Accept' => 'application/json'
        }
      })
      
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if result['success'] == true
        @logger.info("SMS status checked for message ID: #{message_id}")
        return { success: true, status: result['data'] }
      else
        error_message = result['errors']&.first || 'Unknown error'
        @logger.error("Failed to check SMS status for #{message_id}: #{error_message}")
        return { success: false, error: error_message }
      end
      
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Exception occurred while checking SMS status for #{message_id}: #{e.message}")
      return { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'language_detector'
require 'tesseract-ocr'

class CommentLanguageDetector
  def initialize
    @detector = LanguageDetector.new
  end

  def detect_language(text)
    @detector.detect(text)
  end

  def detect_language_from_image(image_path)
    # Використовуємо Tesseract OCR для отримання тексту з зображення
    text = Tesseract::Engine.new do |engine|
      engine.image = image_path
      engine.language = 'eng' # або інша мова за потреби
    end.text

    detect_language(text.strip)
  end

  def detect_comments_language(comments)
    comments.map do |comment|
      if comment.is_a?(String)
        detect_language(comment)
      elsif comment.is_a?(Hash) && comment.key?(:image_path)
        detect_language_from_image(comment[:image_path])
      else
        'unknown'
      end
    end
  end
end
```

Ось розв'язання завдання "Перетворювати Markdown від користувача на безпечний HTML із підсвічуванням синтаксису блоків коду" на Ruby. ### 1. **Gemfile** ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'kramdown' gem 'rouge' gem 'sanitize' ``` > Використовуємо: - `kramdown` — для парсингу Markdown. - `rouge` — для підсвічування синтаксису. - `sanitize` — для безпеки HTML (видалення небезпечного коду). --- ### 2. **main.rb** ```ruby require 'kramdown' require 'rouge' require 'sanitize' require 'kramdown/parser/html' # Функція для перетворення Markdown в безпечний HTML з підсвічуванням def markdown_to_safe_html(markdown_text) # 1. Перетворюємо Markdown в HTML за допомогою kramdown html = Kramdown::Document.new(markdown_text, input: 'GFM').to_html # 2. Підсвічування синтаксису коду за допомогою Rouge html = highlight_code_blocks(html) # 3. Очищуємо HTML від небезпечних тегів і атрибутів safe_html = Sanitize.fragment(html, Sanitize::Config::RELAXED) safe_html end # Функція для підсвічування коду за допомогою Rouge def highlight_code_blocks(html) # Використовуємо регулярні вирази для знаходження блоків коду html.gsub(/
(.*?)<\/code><\/pre>/m) do |match|
    lang = $1 || 'text'
    code = $2

    # Очищуємо код від HTML-тегів (щоб не було XSS)
    code = Sanitize.escape(code)

    # Підсвічування синтаксису
    lexer = Rouge::Lexer.find(lang)
    if lexer
      formatter = Rouge::Formatters::HTML.new
      highlighted = formatter.format(lexer.lex(code))
    else
      highlighted = "
#{code}
"
    end

    highlighted
  end
end
