```ruby
    # Generate CommerceML XML for products
    def generate_products_xml(products = nil)
      products ||= Product.all
      xml = Ox::Document.new
      xml << Ox::Element.new('КоммерческаяИнформация')
      
      root = xml.root
      root['ВерсияСхемы'] = '2.07'
      root['ДатаФормирования'] = Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
      
      # Products section
      offers = Ox::Element.new('ПакетПредложений')
      root << offers
      
      products.each do |product|
        offer = Ox::Element.new('Предложение')
        offer['Ид'] = product.id.to_s
        offer['Наименование'] = product.name
        offer['Описание'] = product.description || ''
        offer['БазоваяЕдиница'] = product.unit || 'шт'
        offer['ВидНоменклатуры'] = 'Товар'
        
        # Prices
        prices = Ox::Element.new('Цены')
        product.prices.each do |price|
          price_element = Ox::Element.new('Цена')
          price_element['ВидЦены'] = price.price_type
          price_element['ЦенаЗаЕдиницу'] = price.amount.to_s
          price_element['Валюта'] = price.currency || 'RUB'
          prices << price_element
        end
        offer << prices
        
        # Stock quantities
        stocks = Ox::Element.new('Количество')
        stocks['Количество'] = product.stock_quantity.to_s
        offer << stocks
        
        offers << offer
      end
      
      Ox.dump(xml)
    end

    # Generate CommerceML XML for orders
    def generate_orders_xml(orders = nil)
      orders ||= Order.where('created_at >= ?', 1.day.ago)
      
      xml = Ox::Document.new
      xml << Ox::Element.new('КоммерческаяИнформация')
      
      root = xml.root
      root['ВерсияСхемы'] = '2.07'
      root['ДатаФормирования'] = Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
      
      # Orders section
      trades = Ox::Element.new('Заказы')
      root << trades
      
      orders.each do |order|
        trade = Ox::Element.new('Заказ')
        trade['Ид'] = order.id.to_s
        trade['Номер'] = order.number
        trade['Дата'] = order.created_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        trade['Время'] = order.created_at.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        trade['Статус'] = order.status
        
        # Customer information
        customer = Ox::Element.new('Покупатель')
        customer['Ид'] = order.customer_id.to_s
        customer['Наименование'] = order.customer_name
        customer['Контакты'] = order.customer_contact
        trade << customer
        
        # Order items
        items = Ox::Element.new('Товары')
        order.items.each do |item|
          item_element = Ox::Element.new('Товар')
          item_element['Ид'] = item.product_id.to_s
          item_element['Наименование'] = item.product_name
          item_element['Количество'] = item.quantity.to_s
          item_element['ЦенаЗаЕдиницу'] = item.price.to_s
          item_element['Сумма'] = (item.quantity * item.price).to_s
          items << item_element
        end
        trade << items
        
        trades << trade
      end
      
      Ox.dump(xml)
    end

    # Parse CommerceML XML from 1C
    def parse_products_xml(xml_content)
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
      
      products = []
      doc.xpath('//Предложение').each do |offer|
        product = {
          id: offer['Ид'],
          name: offer.xpath('./Наименование').text,
          description: offer.xpath('./Описание').text,
          unit: offer.xpath('./БазоваяЕдиница').text,
          prices: [],
          stock_quantity: offer.xpath('./Количество').text.to_i
        }
        
        # Parse prices
        offer.xpath('./Цены/Цена').each do |price_element|
          product[:prices] << {
            price_type: price_element['ВидЦены'],
            amount: price_element.text.to_f,
            currency: price_element['Валюта'] || 'RUB'
          }
        end
        
        products << product
      end
      
      products
    end

    # Parse orders from 1C CommerceML
    def parse_orders_xml(xml_content)
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
      
      orders = []
      doc.xpath('//Заказ').each do |trade|
        order = {
          id: trade['Ид'],

          date: trade['Дата'],
          time: trade['Время'],
          status: trade['Статус'],
          customer: {

            name: trade.xpath('./Покупатель/Наименование').text,

          },
          items: []
        }
        
        # Parse order items

            total: item_element.xpath('./Сумма').text.to_f
          }
        end
        
        orders << order
      end
      
      orders
    end

    # Send products to 1C
    def send_products_to_1c(products)
```

```ruby
# app/jobs/commerce_ml_sync_job.rb
class CommerceMlSyncJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(action = 'sync')
    exchange = CommerceML::Exchange.new
    
    case action
    when 'products'
      products = Product.all
      exchange.send_products_to_1c(products)
    when 'orders'
      orders = Order.where('created_at >= ?', 1.day.ago)
      exchange.send_orders_to_1c(orders)
    when 'sync'
      # Sync both products and orders
      products = Product.all
      orders = Order.where('created_at >= ?', 1.day.ago)
      
      exchange.send_products_to_1c(products)
      exchange.send_orders_to_1c(orders)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/controllers/commerce_ml_controller.rb
class CommerceMlController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_exchange
  
  def products
    products = Product.all
    xml_content = @exchange.generate_products_xml(products)
    
    respond_to do |format|
      format.xml { render xml: xml_content }
    end
  end
  
  def orders
    orders = Order.where('created_at >= ?', 1.day.ago)
    xml_content = @exchange.generate_orders_xml(orders)
    
    respond_to do |format|
      format.xml { render xml: xml_content }
    end
  end
  
  def import_products
    if request.post?
      xml_content = params[:xml_data]
      products = @exchange.parse_products_xml(xml_content)
      
      # Process imported products
      products.each do |product_data|
        # Create or update product logic here
        product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(id: product_data[:id])
        product.update!(
          name: product_data[:name],
          description: product_data[:description],
          stock_quantity: product_data[:stock_quantity]
        )
        
        # Update prices
        product_data[:prices].each do |price_data|
          Price.find_or_create_by(
            product: product,
            price_type: price_data[:price_type]
          ) do |price|
            price.amount = price_data[:amount]
            price.currency = price_data[:currency]
          end
        end
      end
      
      render json: { status: 'success', message: 'Products imported successfully' }
    else
      render json: { status: 'error', message: 'Only POST requests allowed' }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_exchange
    @exchange = CommerceML::Exchange.new
  end
end
```

```ruby
# config/environment.rb
require 'docusign_esign'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'logger'
require 'json'

# Setup logger
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Configure DocuSign API client
def setup_docusign_client
  # Configuration for DocuSign API
  config = DocuSign_eSign::Configuration.new
  config.host = "https://demo.docusign.net/restapi" # Use "https://www.docusign.net/restapi" for production
  
  # Create API client
  api_client = DocuSign_eSign::ApiClient.new(config)
  
  # Set authentication
  api_client.add_default_header('Authorization', "Bearer #{ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN']}")
  
  api_client
end

# Main class for handling DocuSign operations
class DocuSignContractSigner
  def initialize
    @api_client = setup_docusign_client
    @envelope_api = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopesApi.new(@api_client)
    @folders_api = DocuSign_eSign::FoldersApi.new(@api_client)
  end

  # Create envelope with PDF document and recipient
  def create_envelope(document_path, recipient_email, recipient_name, document_name = "Contract")
    # Read the PDF document
    pdf_content = File.read(document_path, mode: 'rb')
    
    # Create document object
    document = DocuSign_eSign::Document.new(
      document_base64: Base64.encode64(pdf_content),
      name: document_name,
      file_extension: "pdf",
      document_id: "1"
    )
    
    # Create recipient
    signer = DocuSign_eSign::Signer.new(
      email: recipient_email,
      name: recipient_name,
      recipient_id: "1",
      routing_order: "1"
    )
    
    # Create signature field
    signature_field = DocuSign_eSign::Signature.new(
      stamp_field: true,
      signature_name: "Signature"
    )
    
    # Create signing tab
    signature_tab = DocuSign_eSign::SignatureTab.new(
      document_id: "1",
      page_number: "1",
      x_position: "100",
      y_position: "100",
      tab_label: "Signature",
      name: "Signature",
      optional: false
    )
    
    # Add tab to signer
    signer.tabs = DocuSign_eSign::Tabs.new(
      signature_tabs: [signature_tab]
    )
    
    # Create envelope definition
    envelope_definition = DocuSign_eSign::EnvelopeDefinition.new(
      email_subject: "Please sign the contract",
      documents: [document],
      recipients: DocuSign_eSign::Recipients.new(
        signers: [signer]
      ),
      status: "sent"
    )
    
    envelope_definition
  end

  # Send envelope for signature
  def send_envelope(envelope_definition, account_id)
    begin
      envelope_summary = @envelope_api.create_envelope(account_id, envelope_definition)
      puts "Envelope created successfully with ID: #{envelope_summary.envelope_id}"
      envelope_summary.envelope_id
    rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
      puts "Error creating envelope: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end

  # Download signed document
  def download_signed_document(account_id, envelope_id, output_path)
    begin
      # Get the document from the envelope
      document = @envelope_api.get_document(account_id, envelope_id, "combined")
      
      # Write to file
      File.open(output_path, 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(document)
      end
      
      puts "Signed document downloaded to: #{output_path}"
    rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
      puts "Error downloading document: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end
  end

  # Check if envelope is completed
  def check_envelope_status(account_id, envelope_id)
    begin
      envelope_status = @envelope_api.get_envelope(account_id, envelope_id)
      envelope_status.status
    rescue DocuSign_eSign::ApiError => e
      puts "Error checking envelope status: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  # Wait for envelope completion with timeout
  def wait_for_completion(account_id, envelope_id, timeout_seconds = 300)
    start_time = Time.now
    
    loop do
      status = check_envelope_status(account_id, envelope_id)
      
      if status == "completed"
        puts "Envelope completed successfully"
        return true
      elsif status == "declined" || status == "voided"
        puts "Envelope was #{status}"
        return false
      end
      
      if Time.now - start_time > timeout_seconds
        puts "Timeout waiting for envelope completion"
        return false
      end
      
      puts "Envelope status: #{status}. Waiting..."
      sleep(5)
    end
  end
end

# Main application
class DocuSignContractProcessor
  def initialize
    @signer = DocuSignContractSigner.new
  end

  def process_contract(document_path, recipient_email, recipient_name, output_path)
    # Validate input
    unless File.exist?(document_path)
      raise "Document file does not exist: #{document_path}"
    end
    
    # Get account ID from environment
    account_id = ENV['DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID']
    if account_id.nil? || account_id.empty?
      raise "DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID environment variable is required"
    end
    
    # Create envelope
    puts "Creating envelope with document: #{document_path}"
    envelope_definition = @signer.create_envelope(document_path, recipient_email, recipient_name)
    
    # Send envelope
    envelope_id = @signer.send_envelope(envelope_definition, account_id)
    
    # Wait for completion
    puts "Waiting for signature completion..."
    if @signer.wait_for_completion(account_id, envelope_id)
      # Download signed document
      puts "Downloading signed document..."
      @signer.download_signed_document(account_id, envelope_id, output_path)
      puts "Process completed successfully!"
    else
      puts "Process failed or was declined"
    end
  end
end
```

Ось як можна реалізувати перевірку особи в санкційному списку OFAC США на Ruby. У цьому прикладі використовується гем `ofac` для взаємодії з API OFAC (або імітація, якщо немає доступу до реального API), але ви можете замінити це на реальний інтерфейс, якщо ви маєте доступ до OFAC API.

---

### 1. **Gemfile**

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'ofac'       # Приклад гему для роботи з OFAC (використовується для імітації)
gem 'httparty'   # Для зроблення HTTP-запитів, якщо потрібно
gem 'json'       # Для роботи з JSON
```

---

### 2. **Реалізація у файлі `ofac_check.rb`**

```ruby
require 'json'
require 'httparty'

class OFACChecker
  # URL до OFAC API (приклад, замініть на справжній)
  OFAC_API_URL = 'https://api.ofac.gov/filtered'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  # Перевіряємо, чи є особа в санкційному списку OFAC
  def check_person(first_name, last_name, date_of_birth = nil)
    params = {
      first_name: first_name,
      last_name: last_name
    }

    params[:date_of_birth] = date_of_birth if date_of_birth

    response = HTTParty.get(
      OFAC_API_URL,
      query: params,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}" if @api_key,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    # Наприклад, якщо API повертає JSON з результатом
    result = JSON.parse(response.body)

    # Припустимо, що у відповіді є поле "match" або "is_sanctioned"
    result['is_sanctioned'] || false
  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка під час перевірки: #{e.message}"
    false
  end
end

# Приклад використання
checker = OFACChecker.new

# Приклад перевірки особи
first_name = "John"
last_name = "Doe"
dob = "1980-01-01" # не обов’язково

is_sanctioned = checker.check_person(first_name, last_name, dob)

if is_sanctioned
  puts "Особа з іменем #{first_name} #{last_name} є в санкційному списку OFAC."
else
  puts "Особа з іменем #{first_name} #{last_name} не знайдена в санкційному списку OFAC."
end
```

---

### 3. **Як запустити**

1. Збережіть `Gemfile` у корені проекту.
2. Виконайте:
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```
3. Збережіть код у файл `ofac_check.rb`.
4. Запустіть:
   ```bash
   ruby ofac_check.rb
   ```

---

### Примітка

- Якщо у вас немає доступу до реального API OFAC, ви можете імітувати відповідь, використовуючи `stub` або тестовий JSON.
- У реальному використанні, OFAC дає доступ до API лише для зареєстрованих користувачів.
- Основна логіка перевірки — це робота з API та аналіз відповіді.

---

Якщо потрібно — можу показати імітацію перевірки без реального API.

Ось як можна реалізувати шифрування чутливих полів (наприклад, номер паспорта, дата народження) у ActiveRecord моделі з використанням Ruby та гемів. В цьому прикладі ми будемо використовувати гем `attr_encrypted`, який дозволяє шифрувати атрибути моделі.

---

## 📁 `Gemfile`

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rails', '~> 7.0'
gem 'attr_encrypted'
gem 'sqlite3' # або ваш БД, наприклад, pg
```

---

## 🔐 `app/models/user.rb`

```ruby
class User < ApplicationRecord
  # Шифруємо поля
  attr_encrypted :passport_number, key: Rails.application.secret_key_base
  attr_encrypted :birth_date, key: Rails.application.secret_key_base

  # Якщо потрібно, можна вказати інші опції:
  # attr_encrypted :passport_number, key: Rails.application.secret_key_base, algorithm: 'aes-256-gcm'
end
```

---

## 🧪 Приклад використання

```ruby
# Створення нового користувача
user = User.new(
  name: "Іван Петренко",
  passport_number: "1234567890",
  birth_date: "1990-05-15"
)

user.save!

# При збереженні, поля будуть автоматично зашифровані
puts user.passport_number # Виведе зашифровану версію
puts user.birth_date      # Виведе зашифрований рядок

# При завантаженні, поля автоматично розшифровуються
user.reload
puts user.passport_number # Виведе "1234567890"
puts user.birth_date      # Виведе "1990-05-15"
```

---

## ⚠️ Важливо

- `secret_key_base` — це ключ для шифрування. У продакшені він повинен бути встановлений через змінні середовища.
- `attr_encrypted` зберігає шифровані поля в тій же таблиці, додаючи `_encrypted` до назви поля, тобто:
  - `passport_number` → `passport_number_encrypted`
  - `birth_date` → `birth_date_encrypted`

---

## 🛠️ Створення міграції (якщо потрібно)

Якщо ви хочете змінити модель, згенеруйте міграцію:

```bash
rails generate migration AddEncryptedFieldsToUsers passport_number:string birth_date:string
```

Потім у міграції видаліть поля і залиште лише зашифровані:

```ruby
class AddEncryptedFieldsToUsers < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0]
  def change
    add_column :users, :passport_number_encrypted, :string
    add_column :users, :birth_date_encrypted, :string
  end
end
```

---

## ✅ Результат

Система автоматично шифрує та розшифровує поля `passport_number` та `birth_date` при збереженні та завантаженні записів з бази даних.

Якщо потрібно, можна додати валідації, обробку помилок, чи використовувати інший ключ шифрування для кожної моделі.

```ruby
# config.rb
require 'dotenv'
require 'onfido'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class OnfidoVerification
  def initialize
    @onfido = Onfido::Client.new(
      api_key: ENV['ONFIDO_API_KEY'],
      region: ENV['ONFIDO_REGION'] || 'eu'
    )
  end

  def create_applicant(email, first_name, last_name)
    begin
      applicant = @onfido.applicants.create(
        email: email,
        first_name: first_name,
        last_name: last_name,
        date_of_birth: '1990-01-01'
      )
      puts "Created applicant with ID: #{applicant.id}"
      applicant
    rescue Onfido::Error => e
      puts "Error creating applicant: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def upload_document(applicant_id, document_type, file_path)
    begin
      document = @onfido.documents.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        type: document_type,
        file: File.open(file_path),
        side: 'front'
      )
      puts "Uploaded document with ID: #{document.id}"
      document
    rescue Onfido::Error => e
      puts "Error uploading document: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def upload_selfie(applicant_id, file_path)
    begin
      selfie = @onfido.photos.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        file: File.open(file_path)
      )
      puts "Uploaded selfie with ID: #{selfie.id}"
      selfie
    rescue Onfido::Error => e
      puts "Error uploading selfie: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def create_check(applicant_id, document_id, selfie_id)
    begin
      check = @onfido.checks.create(
        applicant_id: applicant_id,
        report_names: ['document', 'facial_similarity'],
        document_id: document_id,
        photo_id: selfie_id
      )
      puts "Created check with ID: #{check.id}"
      check
    rescue Onfido::Error => e
      puts "Error creating check: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def get_check_result(check_id)
    begin
      check = @onfido.checks.get(check_id)
      puts "Check status: #{check.status}"
      puts "Check reports: #{check.reports.map(&:name).join(', ')}"
      
      # Check if all checks are complete
      if check.status == 'complete'
        check.reports.each do |report|
          puts "Report #{report.name}: #{report.status}"
          if report.status == 'complete'
            puts "Report #{report.name} result: #{report.result}"
            puts "Report #{report.name} breakdown: #{report.breakdown}"
          end
        end
      end
      
      check
    rescue Onfido::Error => e
      puts "Error getting check result: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def verify_identity(email, first_name, last_name, document_path, selfie_path)
    # Step 1: Create applicant
    applicant = create_applicant(email, first_name, last_name)
    return nil unless applicant

    # Step 2: Upload document
    document = upload_document(applicant.id, 'passport', document_path)
    return nil unless document

    # Step 3: Upload selfie
    selfie = upload_selfie(applicant.id, selfie_path)
    return nil unless selfie

    # Step 4: Create check
    check = create_check(applicant.id, document.id, selfie.id)
    return nil unless check

    # Step 5: Wait for check completion and get results
    puts "Waiting for check to complete..."
    
    # Poll for completion (in production, use proper async handling)
    max_wait_time = 60
    elapsed_time = 0
    check_result = nil
    
    while elapsed_time < max_wait_time
      check_result = get_check_result(check.id)
      
      if check_result && check_result.status == 'complete'
        puts "Identity verification complete!"
        return {
          success: true,
          applicant_id: applicant.id,
          check_id: check.id,
          results: check_result
        }
      elsif check_result && check_result.status == 'errored'
        puts "Verification failed with error"
        return {
          success: false,
          error: "Verification process failed"
        }
      end
      
      sleep(2)
      elapsed_time += 2
    end
    
    puts "Timeout waiting for verification results"
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Verification timeout"
    }
  end

  def validate_document(document_id)
    begin
      document = @onfido.documents.get(document_id)
      puts "Document validation result: #{document.valid?}"
      document
    rescue Onfido::Error => e
      puts "Error validating document: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require_relative 'config'
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'

# Initialize the verification service
verification = OnfidoVerification.new

# API endpoint for identity verification
post '/verify' do
  content_type :json

  # Get parameters from request
  email = params['email']
  first_name = params['first_name']
  last_name = params['last_name']
  document_file = params['document']
  selfie_file = params['selfie']

  # Validate required parameters
  if !email || !first_name || !last_name || !document_file || !selfie_file
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Missing required parameters"
    }.to_json
  end

  # Save uploaded files temporarily
  document_path = "/tmp/document_#{Time.now.to_i}.jpg"
  selfie_path = "/tmp/selfie_#{Time.now.to_i}.jpg"

  File.open(document_path, 'wb') do |f|
    f.write(document_file[:tempfile].read)
  end

  File.open(selfie_path, 'wb') do |f|
    f.write(selfie_file[:tempfile].read)
  end

  # Perform verification
  result = verification.verify_identity(
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    document_path,
    selfie_path
  )

  # Clean up temporary files
  File.delete(document_path) if File.exist?(document_path)
  File.delete(selfie_path) if File.exist?(selfie_path)

  result.to_json
end

# Simple status endpoint
get '/status' do
  content_type :json
  {
    status: 'ready',
    service: 'Onfido Identity Verification'
  }.to_json
end

# Example usage endpoint
get '/example' do
  content_type :json
  {
    example: 'POST /verify with email, first_name, last_name, document, and selfie parameters'
  }.to_json
end
```

Ось розв’язок завдання, яке передбачає реалізацію двофакторної автентифікації (2FA) з використанням одноразових паролів за часом (TOTP) та реєстрації через QR-код у Rails-додатку. Використовується гем `rotp` для генерації OTP та гем `rqrcode` для створення QR-кодів. --- ## 1. `Gemfile` ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' git_source(:github) { |repo| "https://github.com/#{repo}.git" } ruby '3.0.0' gem 'rails', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'sqlite3', '~> 1.4' gem 'puma', '~> 5.0' gem 'sass-rails', '>= 6' gem 'webpacker', '~> 5.0' gem 'turbo-rails' gem 'stimulus-rails' gem 'jbuilder', '~> 2.7' gem 'bootsnap', '>= 1.4.4', require: false gem 'image_processing', '~> 1.2' # Для 2FA gem 'rotp' # для генерації TOTP gem 'rqrcode' # для створення QR-кодів gem 'qrcode-ruby' # альтернатива, якщо потрібно group :development, :test do gem 'byebug', platforms: [:mri, :mingw, :x64_mingw] gem 'capybara', '>= 3.26' gem 'selenium-webdriver' gem 'webdrivers' end group :development do gem 'web-console', '>= 4.1.0' gem 'listen', '~> 3.3' gem 'spring' end ``` --- ## 2. Створення моделі `User` з 2FA Виконайте міграцію та додайте поля: ```bash rails generate model User email:string encrypted_otp_secret:string otp_required_for_login:boolean rails db:migrate ``` ### Модель `User` (`app/models/user.rb`): ```ruby class User < ApplicationRecord has_secure_password validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true before_create :generate_otp_secret def generate_otp_secret self.otp_secret = ROTP::Base32.random_base32 end def totp @totp ||= ROTP::TOTP.new(otp_secret, issuer: "MyApp") end def otp_uri totp.provisioning_uri(email) end end ``` --- ## 3. Контролер для входу з 2FA (`app/controllers/sessions_controller.rb`) ```ruby class SessionsController < ApplicationController def new end def create user = User.find_by(email: params[:email]) if user && user.authenticate(params[:password]) if user.otp_required_for_login session[:user_id] = user.id redirect_to verify_2fa_path else session[:user_id] = user.id redirect_to root_path, notice: 'Успішний вхід' end else flash.now[:alert] = 'Невірний email або пароль' render :new end end def verify_2fa @user = User.find(session[:user_id]) if request.post? if @user.totp.verify(params[:otp], drift_behind: 60) session[:user_id] = @user.id redirect_to root_path, notice: 'Успішна 2FA перевірка' else flash.now[:alert] = 'Неправильний 2FA код' render :verify_2fa end else @qr_code = RQRCode::QRCode.new(@user.otp_uri) end end def destroy session.clear redirect_to root_path, notice: 'Вихід з системи' end end ``` --- ## 4. Відображення 2FA (`app/views/sessions/verify_2fa.html.erb`) ```erb

Підтвердіть 2FA

<%= image_tag @qr_code.to_img.resize(200, 200).to_data_url %>

Скануйте QR-код у вашому додатку 2FA (наприклад, Google Authenticator).

<%= form_with url: verify_2fa_path, local: true do |f| %> <%= f.label :otp, "Введіть код з додатку:" %> <%= f.text_field :otp, required: true %> <%= f.submit "Підтвердити" %> <% end %> ``` --- ## 5. Додати маршрут (`config/routes.rb`) ```ruby Rails.application.routes.draw do root 'home#index' get '/login', to: 'sessions#new' post '/login', to: 'sessions#create' get '/verify_2fa', to: 'sessions#verify_2fa' post '/verify_2fa', to: 'sessions#verify_2fa' delete '/logout', to: 'sessions#destroy' end ``` --- ## 6. Додатково: Контролер для налаштування 2FA Ви можете також додати можливість увімкнути 2FA у профілі користувача. ```ruby # app/controllers/users_controller.rb class UsersController < ApplicationController def edit @user = current_user end def update @user = current_user if @user.update(otp_required_for_login: params[:user][:otp_required_for_login]) redirect_to root_path, notice: 'Налаштування оновлено' else render :edit end end end ``` --- ## 7. Додатковий вигляд профілю (`app/views/users/edit.html.erb`) ```erb

Налаштування 2FA

<%= form_with model: @user, url: user_path(@user), method: :patch do |f| %> <%= f.check_box :otp_required_for_login %> <%= f.label :otp_required_for_login, "Вимагати 2FA для входу" %> <%= f.submit "Зберегти" %> <% end %> ``` --- ## Висновок Ви створили додаток з: - Реєстрацією користувача. - Встановленням `2FA` з QR-кодом. - Перевіркою OTP-коду. - Можливістю увімкнути або вимкнути 2FA. Якщо потрібно, можу надати додаткові функції, наприклад, відновлення 2FA або зберігання відновлювальних кодів.

```ruby
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy
  
  validates :order_number, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :status, inclusion: { in: %w[pending processing shipped delivered cancelled] }

  after_create :sync_with_keycrm
  after_update :sync_with_keycrm
  
  def sync_with_keycrm
    KeyCRMService.new.sync_order(self)
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order_number} with KeyCRM: #{e.message}"
    # Optionally create a notification or retry mechanism
  end
  
  def to_keycrm_hash
    {
      order_number: order_number,
      customer_id: customer.keycrm_id,
      status: status,
      total_amount: total_amount,
      items: order_items.map(&:to_keycrm_hash),
      created_at: created_at.iso8601,
      updated_at: updated_at.iso8601
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def total_amount
    order_items.sum(&:total_price)
  end
```

```ruby
  base_uri 'https://api.keycrm.com/v1'
  
  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['KEYCRM_API_TOKEN']}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def sync_order(order)
    return if order.keycrm_synced?
    
    order_data = order.to_keycrm_hash
    
    if order.keycrm_id
      update_order(order.keycrm_id, order_data)
    else
      create_order(order_data)
    end
  end
  
  def create_customer(customer_data)
    response = self.class.post('/customers', 
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: customer_data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response['id']
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to create customer: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def update_customer(customer_id, customer_data)
    response = self.class.put("/customers/#{customer_id}", 
                             headers: @headers,
                             body: customer_data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      response.parsed_response['id']
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to update customer #{customer_id}: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def create_order(order_data)
    response = self.class.post('/orders', 
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: order_data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      order_id = response.parsed_response['id']
      Order.find_by(order_number: order_data[:order_number]).update!(
        keycrm_id: order_id,
        keycrm_synced_at: Time.current
      )
      order_id
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to create order: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def update_order(order_id, order_data)
    response = self.class.put("/orders/#{order_id}", 
                             headers: @headers,
                             body: order_data.to_json)
    
    if response.success?
      Order.find_by(order_number: order_data[:order_number]).update!(
        keycrm_synced_at: Time.current
      )
      order_id
    else
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to update order #{order_id}: #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end
```

## 🔐 4. Модель User з шифруванням

```ruby
# app/models/user.rb
require 'crypto'

class User < ApplicationRecord
  # Ключ для шифрування (в продакшній версії — зберігайте в змінних оточення)
  ENCRYPTION_KEY = 'your-32-byte-encryption-key-here-1234567890123456'.freeze

  # Шифрування поля passport_number
  def passport_number=(value)
    write_attribute(:passport_number, encrypt(value))
  end

  def passport_number
    decrypt(read_attribute(:passport_number))
  end

  # Шифрування поля birth_date
  def birth_date=(value)
    write_attribute(:birth_date, encrypt(value))
  end

  def birth_date
    decrypt(read_attribute(:birth_date))
  end

  private

  def encrypt(data)
    return nil if data.nil?

    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-CBC')
    cipher.encrypt
    cipher.key = ENCRYPTION_KEY

    encrypted = cipher.update(data.to_s) + cipher.final
    [encrypted].pack('m') # Base64 encode
  end

  def decrypt(data)
    return nil if data.nil?

    encrypted = data.unpack('m').first # Base64 decode
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-CBC')
    cipher.decrypt
    cipher.key = ENCRYPTION_KEY

    decrypted = cipher.update(encrypted) + cipher.final
    decrypted
  end
end
```

Додавання Devise** Спочатку створіть міграцію для додавання полів 2FA в модель `User`: ```bash rails generate devise User rails db:migrate ``` Потім додайте до моделі `User` поля для зберігання `otp_secret` та `otp_enabled`: ```ruby # app/models/user.rb class User < ApplicationRecord devise :database_authenticatable, :registerable, :recoverable, :rememberable, :validatable # Поля для 2FA attr_accessor :otp_attempt attr_accessor :qr_code_data def otp_secret read_attribute(:otp_secret) || generate_otp_secret end def generate_otp_secret secret = ROTP::Base32.random_base32 update_column(:otp_secret, secret) secret end def otp_enabled? otp_secret.present? end def otp_authenticator ROTP::TOTP.new(otp_secret) end def valid_otp?(otp) otp_authenticator.now == otp.to_s end def qr_code_uri otp_authenticator.provisioning_uri(name: email, issuer: "YourApp") end end ``` #### **2. Створення контролера для 2FA** Створіть контролер для 2FA: ```bash rails generate controller TwoFactor ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/two_factor_controller.rb class TwoFactorController < ApplicationController before_action :authenticate_user! before_action :require_otp_setup, only: [:enable, :verify] def enable @qr_code_data = current_user.qr_code_uri end def verify if current_user.valid_otp?(params[:otp]) current_user.update(otp_enabled: true) redirect_to root_path, notice: "2FA успішно увімкнено!" else flash.now[:alert] = "Неправильний код" render :enable end end private def require_otp_setup redirect_to root_path unless current_user.otp_enabled? end end ``` #### **3. Відображення QR-коду в шаблоні** Створіть шаблон для відображення QR-коду: ```erb

Увімкнути 2FA

Відскануйте QR-код у вашому додатку для автентифікації:

<%= image_tag qr_code_data, alt: "QR Code" %> <%= form_with url: verify_two_factor_path, local: true do |f| %> <%= f.label :otp, "Введіть код з додатку" %> <%= f.text_field :otp, required: true %> <%= f.submit "Підтвердити" %> <% end %> ``` #### **4. Модифікація `ApplicationController` для перевірки 2FA** ```ruby # app/controllers/application_controller.rb class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base before_action :authenticate_user! before_action :verify_otp_if_enabled private def verify_otp_if_enabled return unless user_signed_in? return unless current_user.otp_enabled? if session[:otp_verified] != true redirect_to two_factor_enable_path end end def otp_verified! session[:otp_verified] = true end end ``` #### **5. Додавання форми входу з 2FA** У формі входу (наприклад, `devise/sessions/new.html.erb`): ```erb <%= form_with model: resource, as: resource_name, url: session_path(resource_name), local: true do |f| %>
<%= f.label :email %>
<%= f.email_field :email, autofocus: true, autocomplete: "email" %>
<%= f.label :password %>
<%= f.password_field :password, autocomplete: "current-password" %>
<% if devise_mapping.rememberable? %>
<%= f.check_box :remember_me %> <%= f.label :remember_me %>
<% end %> <% if resource.respond_to?(:otp_attempt) %>
<%= f.label :otp_attempt, "Код 2FA" %>
<%= f.text_field :otp_attempt %>
<% end %>
<%= f.submit "Увійти" %>
<% end %> ``` #### **6. Додавання перевірки 2FA до `SessionsController`** Перевизначіть `SessionsController`: ```ruby # app/controllers/users/sessions_controller.rb class Users::SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController def create self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options) if resource.otp_enabled? && params[:user][:otp_attempt].blank? redirect_to verify_otp_path elsif resource.otp_enabled? && !resource.valid_otp?(params[:user][:otp_attempt]) flash.now[:alert] = "Неправильний код 2FA" render :new else set_flash_message!(:notice, :signed_in) sign_in(resource_name, resource) yield resource if block_given? respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource) end end end ``` #### **7. Додаткові налаштування (для перевірки 2FA)** Додайте маршрут у `config/routes.rb`: ```ruby Rails.application.routes.draw do devise_for :users, controllers: { sessions: 'users/sessions' } get 'two_factor/enable', to: 'two_factor#enable' post 'two_factor/verify', to: 'two_factor#verify' root 'home#index' end ``` --- ### Тестування 1. Створіть нового користувача. 2. Відвідайте `/two_factor/enable`. 3. Скануйте QR-код у додатку (наприклад, Google Authenticator). 4. Введіть код і підтвердіть. --- ### Висновок Ця реалізація дає базову підтримку **двофакторної автентифікації з TOTP** та **QR-кодом для реєстрації** у Rails-додатку. require 'httparty'

```ruby
class DocumentFetcher
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.diasporapod.com' # Приклад API, замініть на справжній

  def initialize(user_id, access_token)
    @user_id = user_id
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  def fetch_documents(&block)
    # Наприклад, отримання публікацій користувача (імітація)
    response = self.class.get("/users/#{@user_id}/posts", headers: {

      documents.each do |doc|
        yield(doc) if block_given?
      end
    else

    end
  end
```

# Перевірка наявності особи у санкційному списку OFAC

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'

gem 'logger'
gem 'dotenv'
```

## Код програми

```ruby
# encoding: utf-8
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Клас для перевірки клієнта на наявність у санкційному списку OFAC
class OFACChecker
  include HTTParty
  
  # Налаштування базового URL та заголовків
  base_uri 'https://api.sanctions.io'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  # Конструктор
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    # Якщо вказано API ключ, використовуємо його
    if api_key
      headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{api_key}"
    else
      @logger.warn("Не вказано API ключ. Буде використано тестовий режим.")
    end
  end
  
  # Метод для перевірки особи у санкційному списку
  def check_person(first_name, last_name, date_of_birth = nil)
    # Виконуємо пошук по прізвищу та імені, не обов'язково дата народження
    query = {
      first_name: first_name,
      last_name: last_name
    }
    
    # Якщо вказана дата народження, додаємо до запиту
    query[:date_of_birth] = date_of_birth if date_of_birth
    
    # Робимо запит до API
    response = self.class.get('/search', query: query)
    
    # Обробляємо відповідь
    case response.code
    when 200
      handle_successful_response(response)
    when 404
      @logger.info("Особа #{first_name} #{last_name} не знайдена у списку санкцій")
      { found: false, message: "Особа не знайдена у списку санкцій" }
    else
      @logger.error("Помилка при перевірці: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      { found: false, message: "Помилка при перевірці: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Обробка успішної відповіді
  def handle_successful_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['hits'] && data['hits'].length > 0
      @logger.info("Особа знайдена у списку санкцій: #{data['hits'][0]['name']}")
      
      # Перевіряємо, чи є конкретний збіг
      hit = data['hits'][0]
      {
        found: true,
        message: "Особа знайдена у списку санкцій",
        details: {
          name: hit['name'],
          entity_id: hit['entity_id'],
          sanctions_list: hit['sanctions_list'],
          program: hit['program'],
          country: hit['country']
        }
      }
    else
      @logger.info("Особа не знайдена у списку санкцій")
      { found: false, message: "Особа не знайдена у списку санкцій" }
    end
  end
end

# Клас для реєстрації клієнтів
class ClientRegistration
  def initialize(ofac_checker = nil)
    @ofac_checker = ofac_checker || OFACChecker.new
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  # Реєстрація нового клієнта
  def register_client(first_name, last_name, date_of_birth = nil, email = nil)
    @logger.info("Починаємо реєстрацію клієнта: #{first_name} #{last_name}")
    
    # Перевіряємо клієнта на наявність у санкційному списку
    result = @ofac_checker.check_person(first_name, last_name, date_of_birth)
    
    if result[:found]
      @logger.warn("Реєстрація відхилена: клієнт знаходиться у санкційному списку")
      return {
        success: false,
        message: "Реєстрація відхилена: клієнт знаходиться у санкційному списку OFAC",
        details: result[:details]
      }
    else
      @logger.info("Клієнт не знайдений у санкційному списку. Реєстрація успішна.")
      return {
        success: true,
        message: "Клієнт успішно зареєстрований",
        client_info: {
          first_name: first_name,
          last_name: last_name,
          date_of_birth: date_of_birth,
          email: email
        }
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class CommerceML::Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'commerce_ml_products'
  
  belongs_to :shop_product, class_name: 'Product'
  
  validates :external_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  
  def to_commerce_ml_xml
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.Товар {
        xml.Ид(external_id)
        xml.Наименование(name)
        xml.Описание(description) if description.present?
        xml.Цены {
          xml.Цена {
            xml.ЦенаЗаЕдиницу(price)
            xml.Валюта(currency)
            xml.Единица('шт')
          }
        }
        xml.Количество(available_quantity)
        xml.Картинка(image_url) if image_url.present?
      }
    end
    builder.doc.to_xml
  end

  def self.from_commerce_ml_xml(xml_node)
    product_data = {}
    xml_node.xpath('./*').each do |child|
      case child.name
      when 'Ид'
        product_data[:external_id] = child.text
      when 'Наименование'
        product_data[:name] = child.text
      when 'Описание'
        product_data[:description] = child.text
      when 'Цены'
        price_node = child.xpath('./Цена').first
        product_data[:price] = price_node.xpath('./ЦенаЗаЕдиницу').first&.text&.to_f || 0
        product_data[:currency] = price_node.xpath('./Валюта').first&.text || 'RUB'
      when 'Количество'
        product_data[:available_quantity] = child.text.to_i
      when 'Картинка'
        product_data[:image_url] = child.text
      end
    end
    
    product = find_by(external_id: product_data[:external_id])
    if product
      product.update(product_data)
    else
      create(product_data)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
      when 'Дата'
        order_data[:created_at] = Date.parse(child.text)
      when 'Время'
        order_data[:created_at] = order_data[:created_at].to_datetime + child.text.to_time

        order_data[:order_items] = []
        child.xpath('./Товар').each do |item_node|
          item_data = {}
          item_node.xpath('./*').each do |item_child|
```

### 2. CommerceML Service

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/service.rb
class CommerceML::Service
  include HTTParty
  
  attr_reader :base_url, :username, :password
  
  def initialize(base_url, username, password)
    @base_url = base_url
    @username = username
    @password = password
    self.class.base_uri(base_url)
    self.class.default_timeout(30)
  end
  
  def export_products(products)
    xml_data = build_products_xml(products)
    send_commerce_ml_request('offers', xml_data)
  end
  
  def export_prices(prices)
    xml_data = build_prices_xml(prices)
    send_commerce_ml_request('prices', xml_data)
  end
  
  def export_orders(orders)
    xml_data = build_orders_xml(orders)
    send_commerce_ml_request('orders', xml_data)
  end
  
  def import_products
    response = get_commerce_ml_request('offers')
    parse_products_xml(response.body)
  end
  
  def import_orders
    response = get_commerce_ml_request('orders')
    parse_orders_xml(response.body)
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_products_xml(products)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.КоммерческаяИнформация {
        xml.ВерсияСхемы('2.04')
        xml.ДатаСоздания( Time.current.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') )
        xml.ВремяСоздания( Time.current.strftime('%H:%M:%S') )
        xml.Каталог {
          xml.Ид('catalog')
          xml.Наименование('Каталог товаров')
          xml.Товары {
            products.each do |product|
              xml.Товар {
                xml.Ид(product.external_id)
                xml.Наименование(product.name)
                xml.Описание(product.description) if product.description.present?
                xml.Цены {
                  xml.Цена {
                    xml.ЦенаЗаЕдиницу(product.price)
                    xml.Валюта(product.currency)
                    xml.Единица('шт')
                  }
                }
                xml.Количество(product.available_quantity)
                xml.Картинка(product.image_url) if product.image_url.present?
              }
            end
          }
        }
      }
    end
    builder.doc.to_xml
  end
  
  def build_prices_xml(prices)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.КоммерческаяИнформация {
        xml.ВерсияСхемы('2.04')
        xml.ДатаСоздания(Time.current.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        xml.ВремяСоздания(Time.current.strftime('%H:%M:%S'))
        xml.ПакетПредложений {
          xml.Ид('prices')
          xml.Наименование('Пакет цен')
          xml.Предложения {
            prices.each do |price|
              xml.Предложение {
                xml.Ид(price.product_external_id)
                xml.Цена {
                  xml.ЦенаЗаЕдиницу(price.price)
                  xml.Валюта(price.currency)
                  xml.Единица('шт')
                }
              }
            end
          }
        }
      }
    end
    builder.doc.to_xml
  end
  
  def build_orders_xml(orders)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.КоммерческаяИнформация {
        xml.ВерсияСхемы('2.04')
        xml.ДатаСоздания(Time.current.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        xml.ВремяСоздания(Time.current.strftime('%H:%M:%S'))
        xml.Заказы {
          orders.each do |order|
            xml.Заказ {
              xml.Ид(order.external_id)
              xml.Дата(order.created_at.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
              xml.Время(order.created_at.strftime('%H:%M:%S'))
              xml.Статус(order.status)
              xml.Контрагенты {
                xml.Контрагент {
                  xml.Ид(order.customer_external_id)
                  xml.Наименование(order.customer_name)
                }
              }
              xml.Товары {
                order.order_items.each do |item|
                  xml.Товар {
                    xml.Ид(item.product_external_id)
                    xml.Количество(item.quantity)
                    xml.Цена(item.price)
                    xml.Сумма(item.total_price)
                  }
                end
              }
              xml.Сумма(order.shop_order.total_amount)
            }
          end
        }
      }
    end
    builder.doc.to_xml
  end
  
  def send_commerce_ml_request(type, xml_data)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
      'Accept' => 'application/xml'
    }
    
    # Add authentication
    auth = {
      username: @username,
      password: @password
    }
    
    # In real implementation, you might need to process the XML differently
    # This is a simplified approach for demonstration
    response = self.class.post(
      "/#{type}",
      body: xml_data,
      headers: headers,
      basic_auth: auth
    )
    
    response
  end
  
  def get_commerce_ml_request(type)
    headers = {
      'Accept' => 'application/xml'
    }
    
    auth = {
      username: @username,
      password: @password
    }
    
    self.class.get("/#{type}", headers: headers, basic_auth: auth)
  end
  
  def parse_products_xml(xml_string)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_string)
    products = []
    
    doc.xpath('//Товар').each do |product_node|
      product = {}
      product_node.xpath('./*').each do |child|
        case child.name
        when 'Ид'
          product[:external_id] = child.text
        when 'Наименование'
          product[:name] = child.text
        when 'Описание'
          product[:description] = child.text
        when 'Цены'
          price_node = child.xpath('./Цена').first
          product[:price] = price_node.xpath('./ЦенаЗаЕдиницу').first&.text&.to_f || 0
          product[:currency] = price_node.xpath('./Валюта').first&.text || 'RUB'
        when 'Количество'
          product[:available_quantity] = child.text.to_i
        when 'Картинка'
          product[:image_url] = child.text
        end
      end
      products << product
    end
    
    products
  end
  
  def parse_orders_xml(xml_string)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_string)
    orders = []
    
    doc.xpath('//Заказ').each do |order_node|
      order = {}
      order_node.xpath('./*').each do |child|
        case child.name
        when 'Ид'
          order[:external_id] = child.text
        when 'Дата'
          order[:date] = child.text
        when 'Время'
          order[:time] = child.text
        when 'Статус'
          order[:status] = child.text
        when 'Контрагенты'
          contractor_node = child.xpath('./Контрагент').first
          order[:customer_external_id] = contractor_node.xpath('./Ид').first&.text
          order[:customer_name] = contractor_node.xpath('./Наименование').first&.text
        when 'Товары'
          items = []
          child.xpath('./Товар').each do |item_node|
            item = {}
            item_node.xpath('./*').each do |item_child|
              case item_child.name
              when 'Ид'
                item[:product_external_id] = item_child.text
              when 'Количество'
                item[:quantity] = item_child.text.to_i
              when 'Цена'
                item[:price] = item_child.text.to_f
              when 'Сумма'
                item[:total_price] = item_child.text.to_f
              end
            end
            items << item
          end
          order[:items] = items
        when 'Сумма'
          order[:total_amount] = child.text.to_f
        end
      end
      orders << order
    end
    
    orders
  end
end
```

```ruby
      # Parse the incoming XML
      xml_data = request.raw_post
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data)
      
      # Extract orders and save them
      orders = []
      doc.xpath('//Заказ').each do |order_node|
        order_data = extract_order_data(order_node)
        orders << order_data
      end
      
      # Save to database
      orders.each do |order_data|
        CommerceML::Order.from_commerce_ml_xml(order_data)
      end
      
      render xml: '<result>success</result>', status: :ok
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Error importing orders: #{e.message}"
      render xml: '<result>error</result>', status: :internal_server_error
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def extract_product_data(product_node)
    # Implementation to extract product data from XML node
    product_data = {}
    product_node.xpath('./*').each do |child|
      case child.name
      when 'Ид'
        product_data[:external_id] = child.text
      when 'Наименование'
        product_data[:name] = child.text
      when 'Описание'
        product_data[:description] = child.text
      when 'Цены'
        price_node = child.xpath('./Цена').first
        product_data[:price] = price_node.xpath('./ЦенаЗаЕдиницу').first&.text&.to_f || 0
        product_data[:currency] = price_node.xpath('./Валюта').first&.text || 'RUB'
      when 'Количество'
        product_data[:available_quantity] = child.text.to_i
      when 'Картинка'
        product_data[:image_url] = child.text
      end
    end
    product_data
  end
  
  def extract_order_data(order_node)
    # Implementation to extract order data from XML node
    order_data = {}
    order_node.xpath('./*').each do |child|
      case child.name
      when 'Ид'
        order_data[:external_id] = child.text
      when 'Дата'
        order_data[:date] = child.text
      when 'Время'
        order_data[:time] = child.text
      when 'Статус'
        order_data[:status] = child.text
      when 'Контрагенты'
        contractor_node = child.xpath('./Контрагент').first
        order_data[:customer_external_id] = contractor_node.xpath('./Ид').first&.text
        order_data[:customer_name] = contractor_node.xpath('./Наименование').first&.text
      when 'Товары'
        items = []
        child.xpath('./Товар').each do |item_node|
          item = {}
          item_node.xpath('./*').each do |item_child|
            case item_child.name
            when 'Ид'
              item[:product_external_id] = item_child.text
            when 'Количество'
              item[:quantity] = item_child.text.to_i
            when 'Цена'
              item[:price] = item_child.text.to_f
            when 'Сумма'
              item[:total_price] = item_child.text.to_f
            end
          end
          items << item
        end
        order_data[:items] = items
      when 'Сумма'
        order_data[:total_amount] = child.text.to_f
      end
    end
    order_data
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'prozorro_client'

class TenderScraper
  def initialize
    @client = ProzorroClient.new
    @last_offset = 0
  end

  def scrape_and_save
    loop do
      response = @client.fetch_tenders(offset: @last_offset, limit: 100)
      tenders = response['data']

      break if tenders.empty?

      tenders.each do |tender|
        save_tender(tender)
      end

      @last_offset += 100
      sleep(1) # щоб не переповнювати API
    end
  end

  private

  def save_tender(tender_data)
    tender_id = tender_data['id']
    title = tender_data['title']

    return if Tender.exists?(tender_id: tender_id)

    Tender.create!(
      tender_id: tender_id,
      title: title,
      data: tender_data.to_json
    )

    puts "Збережено тендер: #{title}"
  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
class OFACChecker
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.sanctions.io'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['OFAC_API_KEY']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  # Check if a person is on the OFAC sanctions list
  def check_person(name:, country: nil, date_of_birth: nil)
    @logger.info("Checking person: #{name}")
    
    # If no API key is provided, return false (no actual checking)
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
      @logger.warn("No API key provided. Skipping OFAC check.")
      return { found: false, reason: "API key required for checking" }
    end

    begin
      # Build search parameters
      params = {
        name: name,
        limit: 10
      }
      
      # Add optional parameters if provided
      params[:country] = country if country && !country.empty?
      params[:date_of_birth] = date_of_birth if date_of_birth
      
      # Make API request (this would be your actual OFAC API endpoint)
      response = self.class.get('/search', query: params, headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      })

      if response.success?
        result = response.parsed_response
        @logger.info("OFAC search completed for #{name}")
        
        # Process the results
        if result['results'] && result['results'].length > 0
          @logger.warn("Person #{name} found on sanctions list")
          return {
            found: true,
            results: result['results'],
            reason: "Person found on sanctions list"
          }
        else
          @logger.info("Person #{name} not found on sanctions list")
          return {
            found: false,
            reason: "Person not found on sanctions list"
          }
        end
      else
        @logger.error("OFAC API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
        return {
          found: false,
          error: "API Error: #{response.code}",
          reason: "Unable to complete OFAC check"
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("OFAC check failed: #{e.message}")
      return {
        found: false,
        error: e.message,
        reason: "OFAC check failed"
      }
    end
  end

  # Alternative implementation using a mock/fake service for testing
  def check_person_mock(name:, country: nil, date_of_birth: nil)
    @logger.info("Mock checking person: #{name}")
    
    # Mock data - in a real implementation, this would come from the actual API
    mock_sanctions_data = [
      { name: "John Smith", country: "Iran", reason: "Iran sanctions" },
      { name: "Ali Ahmed", country: "Syria", reason: "Syria sanctions" },
      { name: "Maria Garcia", country: "North Korea", reason: "North Korea sanctions" }
    ]
    
    # Simple name matching for demonstration
    found_result = mock_sanctions_data.find do |record|
      record[:name].downcase.include?(name.downcase)
    end
    
    if found_result
      @logger.warn("Person #{name} found in mock sanctions list")
      {
        found: true,
        results: [found_result],
        reason: "Person found in sanctions database"
      }
    else
      @logger.info("Person #{name} not found in mock sanctions list")
      {
        found: false,
        reason: "Person not found in sanctions database"
      }
    end
  end

  # Check multiple people at once
  def check_people(people_list)
    results = {}
    
    people_list.each do |person|
      name = person[:name]
      country = person[:country]
      date_of_birth = person[:date_of_birth]
      
      results[name] = check_person(
        name: name,
        country: country,
        date_of_birth: date_of_birth
      )
    end
    
    results
  end

  # Validate person data before checking
  def validate_person_data(name:, country: nil, date_of_birth: nil)
    errors = []
    
    unless name && !name.strip.empty?
      errors << "Name is required"
    end
    
    if date_of_birth && !valid_date?(date_of_birth)
      errors << "Invalid date of birth format"
    end
    
    { valid: errors.empty?, errors: errors }
  end

  private

  def valid_date?(date_string)
    Date.parse(date_string)
    true
  rescue ArgumentError
    false
  end
end
```

```ruby
  case arg
  when '--name'
    options[:name] = ARGV[index + 1]
  when '--country'
    options[:country] = ARGV[index + 1]
  when '--dob'
    options[:date_of_birth] = ARGV[index + 1]
  when '--help'

  end
end

  puts "Error: Name is required"
  usage
end

if !validation[:valid]
  puts "Validation errors:"
  validation[:errors].each { |error| puts "  - #{error}" }
  exit 1
end

# Perform the check
```

```ruby
# katorrtg.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'csv'
require 'json'
require 'active_support/core_ext/string'

class KatorrtgLoader
  KATOTTG_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmytro-kovalenko/katottg/master/data/katottg.csv'
  
  def initialize
    @data = {}
    @settlements = {}
  end
  
  def load_data
    puts "Loading KATOTTG data from #{KATOTTG_URL}..."
    
    response = HTTParty.get(KATOTTG_URL)
    
    if response.success?
      csv_data = response.body
      
      # Parse CSV data
      CSV.parse(csv_data, headers: true) do |row|
        next if row['CODE'].nil? || row['NAME'].nil?
        
        code = row['CODE']
        name = row['NAME']
        level = row['LEVEL']
        parent_code = row['PARENT_CODE']
        
        @data[code] = {
          code: code,
          name: name,
          level: level,
          parent_code: parent_code
        }
        
        # Store settlements by name for searching
        normalized_name = normalize_name(name)
        @settlements[normalized_name] ||= []
        @settlements[normalized_name] << code
      end
      
      puts "Loaded #{@data.length} records"
    else
      raise "Failed to load KATOTTG data: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
  
  def search_settlements(name)
    normalized_search = normalize_name(name)
    
    # First try exact match
    exact_matches = @settlements[normalized_search] || []
    
    # Then try partial matches
    partial_matches = []
    @settlements.each do |stored_name, codes|
      if stored_name.include?(normalized_search) || normalized_search.include?(stored_name)
        partial_matches.concat(codes)
      end
    end
    
    # Combine and deduplicate results
    all_matches = (exact_matches + partial_matches).uniq
    
    # Get detailed information for matches
    results = all_matches.map do |code|
      @data[code]
    end
    
    # Sort by name for consistent output
    results.sort_by { |item| item[:name] }
  end
  
  def find_settlement_by_code(code)
    @data[code]
  end
  
  def all_settlements
    @data.values
  end
  
  private
  
  def normalize_name(name)
    # Remove extra whitespace and convert to lowercase
    name.strip.mb_chars.downcase.to_s
  end
end

# Usage example
```

```ruby
module EncryptedAttributes
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  class_methods do
    def encryptable_attributes(*attrs)
      attrs.each do |attr|
        define_method("#{attr}=") do |value|
          encrypted_value = encrypt_value(value)
          super(encrypted_value)
        end

        define_method(attr) do
          encrypted_value = read_attribute(attr)
          decrypt_value(encrypted_value) if encrypted_value.present?
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def encrypt_value(value)
      return nil if value.nil?
      
      # Generate a random key for this encryption
      key = generate_encryption_key
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-CBC')
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = key
      
      encrypted = cipher.update(value.to_s) + cipher.final
      encrypted_base64 = Base64.encode64(encrypted)
      
      # Store the key hash with the encrypted data
      "#{encrypted_base64}|#{generate_key_hash(key)}"
    end

    def decrypt_value(encrypted_data)
      return nil if encrypted_data.nil?
      
      parts = encrypted_data.split('|')
      return nil if parts.length != 2
      
      encrypted_content, key_hash = parts
      key = derive_key_from_hash(key_hash)
      
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new('AES-256-CBC')
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = key
      
      encrypted_bytes = Base64.decode64(encrypted_content)
      decrypted = cipher.update(encrypted_bytes) + cipher.final
      decrypted
    end

    def generate_encryption_key
      # In production, use a more secure method like Rails.application.credentials
      # For this example, we'll generate a random key
      SecureRandom.random_bytes(32)
    end

    def generate_key_hash(key)
      # Simple hash for demonstration - in production use proper key derivation
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key)
    end

    def derive_key_from_hash(key_hash)
      # Simple derivation - in production use PBKDF2 or similar
      key = key_hash.unpack('H*').first
      key = key[0...32] # Ensure 32 byte key
      key.ljust(32, "\x00") # Pad if necessary
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class KatoSearcher
  BASE_URL = 'https://example.com/api/kato'  # Замініть на реальний URL
  KATO_FILE = 'kato.json'  # Або 'kato.csv'

  def initialize
    @data = load_data
  end

  def load_data
    if File.exist?(KATO_FILE)
      JSON.parse(File.read(KATO_FILE))
    else
      fetch_and_save_data
    end
  end

  def fetch_and_save_data
    response = HTTParty.get(BASE_URL)
    data = response.parsed_response

    File.write(KATO_FILE, JSON.pretty_generate(data))
    data
  end

  def search_by_name(name)
    @data.select do |item|
      item['name'].downcase.include?(name.downcase)
    end
  end
end
```

## KeyCRM Integration Service

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm_service.rb
class KeycrmService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.keycrm.com/v1'

  attr_reader :api_key, :api_secret, :base_url

  def initialize(api_key:, api_secret:, base_url: 'https://api.keycrm.com/v1')
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
    @base_url = base_url
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}"
    }
  }
  end

  def create_order(order_data)
    # Prepare order data according to KeyCRM API requirements
    formatted_order = {
      customer: {
        email: order_data[:customer_email],
        first_name: order_data[:customer_first_name],
        last_name: order_data[:customer_last_name],
        phone: order_data[:customer_phone]
      },
      items: order_data[:items].map do |item|
        {
          product_id: item[:product_id],
          name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          price: item[:price]
        }
      end,
      total_amount: order_data[:total_amount],
      status: order_data[:status] || 'new',
      currency: order_data[:currency] || 'USD',
      order_date: order_data[:order_date] || Time.current.iso8601
    }

    response = self.class.post('/orders', 
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: formatted_order.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def update_order(order_id, order_data)
    formatted_order = {
      status: order_data[:status],
      total_amount: order_data[:total_amount],
      items: order_data[:items].map do |item|
        {
          product_id: item[:product_id],
          name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          price: item[:price]
        }
      end
    }

    response = self.class.put("/orders/#{order_id}", 
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: formatted_order.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_order(order_id)
    response = self.class.get("/orders/#{order_id}", headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def get_customer_by_email(email)
    response = self.class.get("/customers?email=#{email}", headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def create_customer(customer_data)
    formatted_customer = {
      email: customer_data[:email],
      first_name: customer_data[:first_name],
      last_name: customer_data[:last_name],
      phone: customer_data[:phone],
      company: customer_data[:company]
    }

    response = self.class.post('/customers', 
                              headers: @headers,
                              body: formatted_customer.to_json)
    
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def search_orders(query)
    response = self.class.get("/orders?search=#{query}", headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  def list_products
    response = self.class.get('/products', headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise KeycrmError, "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

class KeycrmError < StandardError; end
```

## Order Model with KeyCRM Integration

```ruby
# app/models/order.rb
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy

  validates :total_amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :status, presence: true

  enum status: { pending: 0, processing: 1, shipped: 2, delivered: 3, cancelled: 4 }

  after_create :sync_with_keycrm
  after_update :update_keycrm_order

  def sync_with_keycrm
    return unless Rails.env.production?
    
    begin
      keycrm_service = KeycrmService.new(
        api_key: Rails.application.credentials.keycrm_api_key,
        api_secret: Rails.application.credentials.keycrm_api_secret
      )

      order_data = {
        customer_email: user.email,
        customer_first_name: user.first_name,
        customer_last_name: user.last_name,
        customer_phone: user.phone,
        items: order_items.map do |item|
          {
            product_id: item.product_id,
            name: item.product.name,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price: item.price
          }
        end,
        total_amount: total_amount,
        status: status,
        order_date: created_at.iso8601
      }

      keycrm_order = keycrm_service.create_order(order_data)
      self.keycrm_order_id = keycrm_order['id']
      save!
    rescue KeycrmError => e
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM sync failed for order #{id}: #{e.message}"
      # Handle error appropriately - could log, notify admin, etc.
    end
  end

  def update_keycrm_order
    return unless Rails.env.production? && keycrm_order_id.present?
    
    begin
      keycrm_service = KeycrmService.new(
        api_key: Rails.application.credentials.keycrm_api_key,
        api_secret: Rails.application.credentials.keycrm_api_secret
      )

      order_data = {
        status: status,
        total_amount: total_amount,
        items: order_items.map do |item|
          {
            product_id: item.product_id,
            name: item.product.name,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price: item.price
          }
        end
      }

      keycrm_service.update_order(keycrm_order_id, order_data)
    rescue KeycrmError => e
      Rails.logger.error "KeyCRM update failed for order #{id}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  def keycrm_order_id
    read_attribute(:keycrm_order_id)
  end

  def keycrm_order_id=(value)
    write_attribute(:keycrm_order_id, value)
  end
end
```

```ruby
  validates :name, presence: true

  def self.find_or_create_from_keycrm_product(product_data)
    product = find_by(keycrm_product_id: product_data['id'])
    
    if product
      product.update!(
        name: product_data['name'],
        price: product_data['price'],
        description: product_data['description']
      )
    else
      product = create!(
        keycrm_product_id: product_data['id'],
        name: product_data['name'],
        price: product_data['price'],
        description: product_data['description']
      )
    end
```

## KeyCRM Sync Controller

```ruby
# app/controllers/keycrm_sync_controller.rb
class KeycrmSyncController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :require_admin_access, only: [:sync_orders, :sync_products]

  def sync_orders
    orders = Order.where(keycrm_order_id: nil).or(Order.where("updated_at > ?", 1.hour.ago))
    synced_count = 0
    
    orders.find_each do |order|
      begin
        order.sync_with_keycrm
        synced_count += 1
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order.id}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    render json: { 
      message: "Successfully synced #{synced_count} orders",
      synced_count: synced_count
    }
  end

  def sync_products
    keycrm_service = KeycrmService.new(
      api_key: Rails.application.credentials.keycrm_api_key,
      api_secret: Rails.application.credentials.keycrm_api_secret
    )
    
    products_data = keycrm_service.list_products
    
    synced_count = 0
    products_data['products'].each do |product_data|
      begin
        Product.find_or_create_from_keycrm_product(product_data)
        synced_count += 1
      rescue => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync product #{product_data['id']}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    render json: { 
      message: "Successfully synced #{synced_count} products",
      synced_count: synced_count
    }
  end

  private

  def require_admin_access
    unless current_user&.admin?
      render json: { error: 'Access denied' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end
end
```

## KeyCRM Order Management Service

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm_order_management_service.rb
class KeycrmOrderManagementService
  def initialize(api_key:, api_secret:)
    @keycrm_service = KeycrmService.new(
      api_key: api_key,
      api_secret: api_secret
    )
  end

  def sync_order_to_keycrm(order)
    order_data = build_order_data(order)
    begin
      result = @keycrm_service.create_order(order_data)
      order.update!(keycrm_order_id: result['id'])
      result
    rescue KeycrmError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order.id} to KeyCRM: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end

  def update_order_status(order_id, status)
    @keycrm_service.update_order(order_id, { status: status })
  end

  def get_order_details(order_id)
    @keycrm_service.get_order(order_id)
  end

  def create_customer_if_needed(customer_data)
    begin
      customer = @keycrm_service.get_customer_by_email(customer_data[:email])
      customer.first if customer.is_a?(Array) && customer.any?
    rescue KeycrmError
      # Customer doesn't exist, create new one
      @keycrm_service.create_customer(customer_data)
    end
  end

  private

  def build_order_data(order)
    {
      customer_email: order.user.email,
      customer_first_name: order.user.first_name,
      customer_last_name: order.user.last_name,
      customer_phone: order.user.phone,
      items: order.order_items.map do |item|
        {
          product_id: item.product_id,
          name: item.product.name,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          price: item.price
        }
      end,
      total_amount: order.total_amount,
      status: order.status,
      currency: 'USD',
      order_date: order.created_at.iso8601
    }
  end
end
```

## Order Controller with KeyCRM Integration

```ruby
# app/controllers/orders_controller.rb
class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :set_order, only: [:show, :update, :destroy]

  def index
    @orders = current_user.orders.includes(:order_items => :product).page(params[:page])
    render json: @orders, include: [:order_items => { include: :product }]
  end

  def show
    render json: @order, include: [:order_items => { include: :product }]
  end

  def create
    @order = current_user.orders.build(order_params)
    
    if @order.save
      # The order will be automatically synced with KeyCRM in after_create callback
      render json: @order, status: :created, include: [:order_items => { include: :product }]
    else
      render json: { errors: @order.errors }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def update
    if @order.update(order_params)
      # The order will be automatically updated in KeyCRM in after_update callback
      render json: @order, include: [:order_items => { include: :product }]
    else
      render json: { errors: @order.errors }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    @order.destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  def set_order
    @order = current_user.orders.find(params[:id])
  end

  def order_params
    params.require(:order).permit(:status, :total_amount, :keycrm_order_id, 
      order_items_attributes: [:id, :product_id, :quantity, :price, :_destroy])
  end
end
```

# Prozorro Tender Search and Save Application

Here's a complete Ruby solution for searching tenders in the Prozorro public procurement system and saving new ones.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'
gem 'sqlite3'
gem 'activerecord'
gem 'logger'
gem 'dotenv'
```

## Implementation

### 1. Main Application Class

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'active_record'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class ProzorroTenderSearcher
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.prozorro.gov.ua'

  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new('prozorro.log')
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    setup_database
  end

  def search_tenders(limit: 100, status: 'active')
    @logger.info "Searching for #{limit} #{status} tenders"
    
    # Prozorro API endpoint for tenders
    url = "/api/2.5/tenders"
    options = {
      query: {
        limit: limit,
        status: status,
        offset: 0,
        descending: true
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'User-Agent' => 'ProzorroTenderSearcher/1.0'
      }
    }

    response = self.class.get(url, options)
    
    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully fetched #{response.parsed_response['data'].length} tenders"
      response.parsed_response['data']
    else
      @logger.error "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      []
    end
  end

  def save_new_tenders(tenders)
    saved_count = 0
    
    tenders.each do |tender|
      next if tender_already_exists?(tender['id'])
      
      begin
        create_tender_record(tender)
        @logger.info "Saved new tender: #{tender['id']}"
        saved_count += 1
      rescue => e
        @logger.error "Failed to save tender #{tender['id']}: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    @logger.info "Saved #{saved_count} new tenders"
    saved_count
  end

  private

  def setup_database
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
      adapter: 'sqlite3',
      database: 'prozorro_tenders.db'
    )

    unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?('tenders')
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table(:tenders) do |t|
        t.string :id, null: false
        t.string :title
        t.text :description
        t.string :status
        t.datetime :date_published
        t.datetime :date_modified
        t.decimal :value_amount, precision: 15, scale: 2
        t.string :value_currency
        t.string :procuring_entity_name
        t.string :procuring_entity_identifier
        t.string :tender_period_start
        t.string :tender_period_end
        t.timestamps
      end
      
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection.add_index :tenders, :id, unique: true
    end
  end

  def tender_already_exists?(tender_id)
    Tender.exists?(id: tender_id)
  end

  def create_tender_record(tender_data)
    Tender.create!(
      id: tender_data['id'],
      title: tender_data['title'],
      description: tender_data['description'],
      status: tender_data['status'],
      date_published: tender_data['datePublished'],
      date_modified: tender_data['dateModified'],
      value_amount: tender_data.dig('value', 'amount'),
      value_currency: tender_data.dig('value', 'currency'),
      procuring_entity_name: tender_data.dig('procuringEntity', 'name'),
      procuring_entity_identifier: tender_data.dig('procuringEntity', 'identifier', 'id'),
      tender_period_start: tender_data.dig('tenderPeriod', 'startDate'),
      tender_period_end: tender_data.dig('tenderPeriod', 'endDate')
    )
  end
end

class Tender < ActiveRecord::Base
  self.table_name = 'tenders'
  
  validates :id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :title, presence: true
end

# Run the application
if __FILE__ == $0
  searcher = ProzorroTenderSearcher.new
  
  # Search for active tenders
  tenders = searcher.search_tenders(limit: 50, status: 'active')
  
  # Save new tenders
  saved_count = searcher.save_new_tenders(tenders)
  
  puts "Successfully saved #{saved_count} new tenders"
end
```
