```ruby
# credit_card_validator.rb

require 'luhn'
require 'credit_card_type'

class CreditCardForm
  include ActiveModel::Model

  attr_accessor :card_number, :card_brand

  def validate_card
    if card_number.blank?
      errors.add(:card_number, "can't be blank")
      return false
    end

    # Clean the card number by removing all non-digit characters
    cleaned_number = card_number.gsub(/[^0-9]/, '')

    # Validate with Luhn algorithm
    if cleaned_number.length < 8
      errors.add(:card_number, "is too short")
      return false
    end

    unless Luhn.valid?(cleaned_number)
      errors.add(:card_number, "is not a valid credit card number")
      return false
    end

    # Detect card brand
    self.card_brand = detect_card_brand(cleaned_number)
    true
  end

  private

  def detect_card_brand(card_number)
    # First two digits determine the brand (mostly)
    first_two = card_number[0..1].to_i
    first_four = card_number[0..3].to_i
    first_six = card_number[0..5].to_i

    # Visa
    if card_number.start_with?('4')
      'Visa'
    # MasterCard
    elsif (51..55).cover?(first_two) || first_two == 22 || (22..27).cover?(first_two)
      'MasterCard'
    # AMEX
    elsif first_two == 34 || first_two == 37
      'American Express'
    # Discover
    elsif first_four == 6011 || (644..649).cover?(first_three) || first_two == 65
      'Discover'
    # Diners Club
    elsif first_two == 36 || (300..305).cover?(first_three)
      'Diners Club'
    # JCB
    elsif first_four == 3528 || first_four == 3529
      'JCB'
    # Maestro
    elsif (5018..5019).cover?(first_four) || (5020..5089).cover?(first_four) || (6304..6399).cover?(first_three)
      'Maestro'
    # UnionPay
    elsif (62..6299).cover?(first_two) || (88..8899).cover?(first_two)
      'UnionPay'
    # Unknown
    else
      'Unknown'
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'dotenv/load'

# Configuration class to handle QuickBooks API setup
class QuickBooksConfig
  def self.configure

    Quickbooks::Client.configure do |config|
      config.client_id     = ENV['QBO_CLIENT_ID']
      config.client_secret = ENV['QBO_CLIENT_SECRET']

    end
  end
end

# Invoice exporter class
class InvoiceExporter
  def initialize
    QuickBooksConfig.configure
  end

  # Export a single paid invoice to QuickBooks Online
  def export_paid_invoice(invoice_data)
    client = Quickbooks::Client.new
    client.company_id = ENV['QBO_REALM_ID']

    # Prepare the invoice data for QuickBooks
    qbo_invoice = build_qbo_invoice(invoice_data)

    # Create the invoice in QuickBooks
    response = client.create_invoice(qbo_invoice)

    if response.success?
      { success: true, qbo_id: response.data.Invoice.Id }
    else
      { success: false, error: response.error }
    end
  end

  # Export multiple paid invoices
  def export_paid_invoices(invoice_data_array)
    results = []

    invoice_data_array.each do |invoice_data|
      results << export_paid_invoice(invoice_data)
    end

    results
  end

  private

  # Convert your invoice data format to QuickBooks format
  def build_qbo_invoice(invoice_data)
    {
      CustomerRef: {
        value: invoice_data[:customer_id] # Your customer ID that matches QuickBooks
      },
      DocNumber: invoice_data[:invoice_number],
      TxnDate: invoice_data[:invoice_date].to_s,
      DueDate: invoice_data[:due_date].to_s,
      Line: invoice_data[:line_items].map do |item|
        {
          Description: item[:description],
          Amount: item[:amount],
          DetailType: 'SalesItemLineDetail',
          SalesItemLineDetail: {
            ItemRef: {
              value: item[:product_id] # Your product/service ID in QuickBooks
            },
            Qty: item[:quantity],
            UnitPrice: item[:unit_price]
          }
        }
      end,
      # Mark as paid since we're exporting after payment
      Payment: {
        Amount: invoice_data[:paid_amount],
        PaymentRef: {
          value: invoice_data[:payment_reference] # Your payment reference
        },
        PaymentMethodRef: {
          value: 'Check' # Or other payment method in QuickBooks
        }
      },
      TotalAmt: invoice_data[:total_amount]
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# config/initializers/quickbooks.rb
require 'quickbooks-ruby'
require 'logger'

# Initialize QuickBooks client
class QuickBooksService
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO

    # Load environment variables
    @client_id = ENV['QBO_CLIENT_ID']
    @client_secret = ENV['QBO_CLIENT_SECRET']
    @redirect_uri = ENV['QBO_REDIRECT_URI']
    @realm_id = ENV['QBO_REALM_ID'] # The company ID from QBO
    @refresh_token = ENV['QBO_REFRESH_TOKEN'] # Long-lived access token

    if @client_id.nil? || @client_secret.nil? || @realm_id.nil? || @refresh_token.nil?
      raise "Missing required QuickBooks environment variables"
    end

    # Initialize the client
    @client = Quickbooks::Client.new(
      consumer_key: @client_id,
      consumer_secret: @client_secret,
      token: OAuth::OAuthToken.new(
        token: @refresh_token,
        secret: ENV['QBO_ACCESS_SECRET'] || ''
      )
    )

    @client.service_type = :accounting
    @client.company_id = @realm_id
  end

  # Export an invoice to QuickBooks Online
  def export_invoice(invoice_data)
    @logger.info "Attempting to create invoice in QuickBooks for #{invoice_data[:customer_email]}"

    begin
      # Create the invoice payload
      invoice = {
        CustomerRef: {
          value: invoice_data[:customer_id] # QBO customer ID
        },
        TxnDate: invoice_data[:invoice_date],
        DueDate: invoice_data[:due_date],
        Line: invoice_data[:items].map do |item|
          {
            Description: item[:description],
            Amount: item[:amount],
            DetailType: "SalesItemLineDetail",
            SalesItemLineDetail: {
              Qty: item[:quantity],
              UnitPrice: item[:unit_price],
              ItemRef: {
                value: item[:item_id] # QBO item ID
              }
            }
          }
        end,
        TotalAmt: invoice_data[:total_amount],
        DocNumber: invoice_data[:invoice_number],
        PrivateNote: "Exported from our system on #{Time.now.to_s}"
      }

      # Create the invoice in QuickBooks
      response = @client.create_invoice(invoice)

      if response.success?
        @logger.info "Successfully created invoice in QuickBooks: #{response.data.Invoice.Id}"
        { success: true, invoice_id: response.data.Invoice.Id }
      else
        @logger.error "Failed to create invoice in QuickBooks: #{response.error_details}"
        { success: false, errors: response.error_details }
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error "Error exporting invoice to QuickBooks: #{e.message}"
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Refresh the OAuth token if needed
  def refresh_token
    begin
      @logger.info "Refreshing QuickBooks OAuth token"
      token_response = @client.refresh_access_token

      if token_response.success?
        @refresh_token = token_response.data.access_token
        @logger.info "Successfully refreshed token"
        true
      else
        @logger.error "Failed to refresh token: #{token_response.error_details}"
        false
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.error "Error refreshing token: #{e.message}"
      false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'coinbase-commerce'

class CoinbasePaymentService
  def initialize
    @client = CoinbaseCommerce::Client.new(api_key: ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_API_KEY'])
  end

  # Create a new charge for an order
  def create_charge(amount, metadata = {})
    charge = @client.charge.create(
      {
        name: 'Your Product/Service',
        description: 'Payment for order',
        local_price: {
          amount: amount,
          currency: 'USD' # or other currency
        },

          'order_id' => metadata[:order_id] || SecureRandom.uuid
        })
      }

  end

  def check_charge(charge_id)

  end

  # Webhook to handle payment events
  def handle_webhook(payload, signature)
    event = @client.webhook.verify_and_parse(
      payload: payload,
      signature: signature
    )

    case event.type
    when 'charge:confirmed'
      handle_confirmed_payment(event)
    when 'charge:delayed'
      # Handle delayed payment
    when 'charge:failed'
      handle_failed_payment(event)
    end
  end

  private

    order_id = event.data.metadata['order_id']
    # Mark the order as paid in your database
    # Example:
    # Order.find(order_id).update(payment_status: 'paid')
    puts "Order #{order_id} has been paid with Bitcoin!"
  end

  def handle_failed_payment(event)
    order_id = event.data.metadata['order_id']
    puts "Payment for order #{order_id} failed"
  end
end
```

Here's a complete implementation for accepting card payments with Adyen's Drop-in integration and verifying HMAC signatures for notifications.

```ruby
require 'adyen'
require 'sinatra'
require 'hmac'
require 'json'

# Configuration - replace with your actual values
ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT = 'YOUR_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT'
ADYEN_API_KEY = 'YOUR_API_KEY'
ADYEN_WEBHOOK_HMAC_KEY = 'YOUR_WEBHOOK_HMAC_KEY'
ADYEN_NOTIFICATION_ITEM = 'YOUR_NOTIFICATION_ITEM' # e.g., 'Payment'

# Set up Adyen client
adyen_client = Adyen::Client.new(
  xapi_key: ADYEN_API_KEY,
  environment: :test # or :live for production
)

# Helper method to generate HMAC signature
def generate_hmac(data, key)
  HMAC.hexdigest(HMAC.new(key), data)
end

# Helper method to verify HMAC signature
def verify_hmac(data, signature, key)
  expected_signature = generate_hmac(data, key)
  Rack::Utils.secure_compare(expected_signature, signature)
end

# Route to create a Drop-in payment session
post '/payment/session' do
  content_type :json

  # Create a payment session
  request = {
    merchantAccount: ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT
  }

  response = adyen_client.payment_methods.request(request)

  if response.success?
    {
      client_key: response.client_key,
      payment_methods: response.payment_methods
    }.to_json
  else
    status 500
    { error: response.error }.to_json
  end
end

# Route to handle payment submission
post '/payment/submit' do

  payment_data = params[:paymentData]
  payment_method = params[:paymentMethod]

  request = {
    merchantAccount: ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT,
    paymentMethod: payment_method,
    amount: {
      value: 1000, # 1000 = 10.00 EUR
      currency: 'EUR'
    },
    reference: "ORDER-#{Time.now.to_i}",
    returnUrl: 'https://your-shop.com/return', # URL to return to after payment
    paymentMethodModification: params[:modificationData]
  }

  response = adyen_client.payments.request(request)

  if response.success?
    { payment_result: response }.to_json
  else
    status 500
    { error: response.error }.to_json
  end
end

# Route to handle notifications (webhooks)
post '/notification' do
  content_type :json

  # Get notification data
  notification = request.body.read
  notification_hash = JSON.parse(notification)

  # Verify HMAC signature
  signature = request.env['HTTP_ADYEN_HMAC_SIGNATURE']

  if verify_hmac(notification, signature, ADYEN_WEBHOOK_HMAC_KEY)
    # Process successful payment
    if notification_hash['eventCode'] == 'AUTHORISATION'
      payment = notification_hash['pspReference']
      # Update your database with payment status
      { result: 'success' }.to_json
    else
      # Handle other notification types
      status 400
      { result: 'notification not processed' }.to_json
    end
  else
    # HMAC verification failed
    status 401
    { error: 'HMAC verification failed' }.to_json
  end
end

# Helper to start the server
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class NBUExchangeRates
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://bank.gov.ua'

  def initialize
    @base_url = '/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange'
  end

  def get_exchange_rates(date = Date.today)
    response = self.class.get("#{@base_url}/exchange?valcode=USD&date=#{date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}")

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response_body)
    rates = JSON.parse(response_body)

    if rates.is_a?(Array) && rates.first.is_a?(Hash)
      {
        date: rates.first['exchangedate'],
        currency: rates.first['cc'],
        rate: rates.first['rate'],
        unit: rates.first['txt'],
        source: "Національний банк України"
      }
    else
      { error: 'Невірний формат даних від API' }
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    { error: "Помилка при отриманні даних: #{response.code}" }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

class MonobankAPI
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.monobank.ua'

  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['MONOBANK_TOKEN']
  end

  # Create a new payment account (Plata)
  def create_account
    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @auth_token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    body = {
      account: {
        currency: 980, # 980 is UAH (Ukrainian Hryvnia)
        description: 'My new payment account',
        webhookUrl: ENV['WEBHOOK_URL'],
        webhookSecret: ENV['WEBHOOK_SECRET']
      }
    }.to_json

    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/merchants/accounts',
      headers: headers,
      body: body
    )

    response.parsed_response
  end

  # Get account details
  def get_account(account_id)
    headers = {
      'X-Token' => @auth_token
    }

    self.class.get(
      "/api/merchants/accounts/#{account_id}",
      headers: headers
    ).parsed_response
  end
end

# Webhook handler
class WebhookHandler
  def initialize
    @secret = ENV['WEBHOOK_SECRET']
  end

  # Verify webhook signature
  def verify_signature(params, raw_body)
    signature = params['X-Signature']
    return false unless signature

    calculated_signature = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_body + @secret)
    ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(signature, calculated_signature)
  end

  # Process webhook data
  def process_webhook(params, raw_body)
    unless verify_signature(params, raw_body)
      return { status: 401, message: 'Invalid signature' }
    end

    data = JSON.parse(raw_body)
    account_id = data['accountId']
    event_type = data['eventType']
    status = data['status']

    # Here you can add your business logic for handling different events
    case event_type
    when 'account.created'
      { status: 200, message: "Account #{account_id} created with status #{status}" }
    when 'account.updated'
      { status: 200, message: "Account #{account_id} updated, new status: #{status}" }
    when 'transaction.created'
      { status: 200, message: "New transaction for account #{account_id}" }
    else
      { status: 200, message: "Unhandled event type: #{event_type}" }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    { status: 400, message: 'Invalid JSON' }
  end
end

# Sinatra application
class PlataApp < Sinatra::Base
  post '/webhook' do
    content_type :json
    raw_body = request.body.read
    params = request.env

    handler = WebhookHandler.new
    result = handler.process_webhook(params, raw_body)

    status result[:status]
    { message: result[:message] }.to_json
  end

  get '/create_account' do
    content_type :json
    monobank = MonobankAPI.new
    result = monobank.create_account

    if result.key?('accountId')
      { success: true, account: result }.to_json
    else
      { success: false, error: result }.to_json
    end
  end

  get '/account/:id' do
    content_type :json
    monobank = MonobankAPI.new
    result = monobank.get_account(params[:id])

    if result.key?('id')
      { success: true, account: result }.to_json
    else
      { success: false, error: result }.to_json
    end
  end
end

# Start the server
PlataApp.run! if __FILE__ == $0
```

```ruby
# exchange_rates.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'date'

class HryvniaExchangeRates
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1'

  def initialize(date = Date.today)
    @date = date
  end

  def fetch_rates
    response = self.class.get("/statdirectory/exchange?date=#{@date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}&json")

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates: #{response.code} #{response.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    JSON.parse(response.body).map do |rate|
      {
        currency_code: rate['cc'],
        currency_name: rate['txt'],
        rate: rate['rate'].to_f,
        date: @date
      }
    end
  end
end

    # Get rates for a specific date

    past_rates = HryvniaExchangeRates.new(past_date).fetch_rates
    puts "\nExchange rates for #{past_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}:"
    past_rates.each { |rate| puts "#{rate[:currency_code]} (#{rate[:currency_name]}): #{rate[:rate]} UAH" }
```

Після створення Gemfile запустіть `bundle install` для встановлення всіх залежностей.

## Реалізація

```ruby
# credit_calculator.rb

require 'axlsx'
require 'money'
require 'date'

class CreditCalculator
  # Ініціалізація з параметрами кредиту
  def initialize(principal, annual_interest_rate, term_months, first_payment_date)
    @principal = principal
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    @term_months = term_months
    @first_payment_date = Date.parse(first_payment_date)
    @monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12.0 / 100
  end

  # Розрахунок аннуітетного платежу
  def monthly_payment
    @monthly_payment ||= Money.new(
      (@principal * @monthly_interest_rate * (1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**@term_months) /
      ((1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**@term_months - 1),
      "USD" # Можна змінити на потрібну валюту
    )
  end

  # Розрахунок графіка погашення
  def payment_schedule
    @payment_schedule ||= begin
      schedule = []
      remaining_principal = @principal.to_f

      (1..@term_months).each do |month|
        payment_date = @first_payment_date + month
        interest_payment = remaining_principal * @monthly_interest_rate
        principal_payment = [monthly_payment.to_f - interest_payment, remaining_principal].min
        remaining_principal -= principal_payment

        schedule << {
          month: month,
          payment_date: payment_date,
          monthly_payment: monthly_payment,
          interest_payment: Money.new(interest_payment, "USD"),
          principal_payment: Money.new(principal_payment, "USD"),
          remaining_principal: Money.new(remaining_principal, "USD")
        }
      end

      schedule
    end
  end

  # Експорт в Excel
  def export_to_excel(filename)
    package = Axlsx::Package.new
    workbook = package.workbook

    # Додаємо аркуш
    worksheet = workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Credit Schedule")

    # Заголовки
    headers = ["№", "Дата", "Сума платежу", "Сума відсотків", "Сума основного боргу", "Залишок боргу"]
    worksheet.add_row headers, style: Axlsx::STYLE_HEADER

    # Дані
    payment_schedule.each_with_index do |payment, index|
      row = [
        index + 1,
        payment[:payment_date].strftime("%d.%m.%Y"),
        payment[:monthly_payment].format,
        payment[:interest_payment].format,
        payment[:principal_payment].format,
        payment[:remaining_principal].format
      ]
      worksheet.add_row row
    end

    # Автопідбір ширини колонок
    worksheet.auto_fit_columns

    # Зберігання файлу
    package.serialize(filename)
    puts "Excel файл успішно створено: #{filename}"
  end
end

# Приклад використання

  # Параметри кредиту
  principal = 100_000 # Сумма кредиту
  annual_interest_rate = 10.0 # Річна процентна ставка
  term_months = 60 # Термін в місяцях
  first_payment_date = "01.01.2024" # Дата першого платежу

  # Створення об'єкту калькулятора

  # Розрахунок та експорт
  calculator.export_to_excel("credit_schedule.xlsx")
end
```

```ruby
require 'luhn'

class CardValidator
  # Дані про платіжні системи
  CARD_SYSTEMS = {
    visa: {
      patterns: [
        /^4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3,6})?$/,
        /^4(?:[0-9]{6}[0-9]{5})?$/  # Старіші номери Visa
      ],
      name: 'Visa'
    },
    mastercard: {
      patterns: [
        /^5[1-5][0-9]{14}$/,
        /^2[22-27][0-9]{12}$/  # MasterCard 2-series
      ],
      name: 'MasterCard'
    },
    amex: {
      patterns: [
        /^3[47][0-9]{13}$/
      ],
      name: 'American Express'
    },
    discover: {
      patterns: [
        /^6(?:011|5)/,
        /^65/
      ],
      name: 'Discover'
    },
    diners: {
      patterns: [
        /^3(?:0[0-5]|[68][0-9])[0-9]{11}$/,
        /^3[0-9]{14}/
      ],
      name: 'Diners Club'
    },
    jcb: {
      patterns: [
        /^(?:2131|1800|35[0-9]{3})[0-9]{11}$/
      ],
      name: 'JCB'
    }
  }.freeze

  attr_reader :number, :valid, :system

  def initialize(number)
    @number = number.to_s.gsub(/\D/, '')  # Очищення від пробілів та символів
    @valid = Luhn.valid?(@number)
    @system = determine_system
  end

  def determine_system
    return nil unless valid

    CARD_SYSTEMS.each do |name, system|
      system[:patterns].each do |pattern|
        return { name: name, full_name: system[:name] } if @number.match?(pattern)
      end
    end

    nil
  end

  # Для використання з формами (наприклад, Rails)
  def to_h
    {
      number: number,
      valid: valid,
      system: system&.transform_values(&:to_s)
    }
  end
end
```

# Loan Amortisation Schedule Generator

Here's a complete Ruby solution that calculates a loan amortisation schedule and exports it to an Excel file.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'axlsx' # For Excel file generation
gem 'money' # For currency formatting (optional)
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# loan_amortization.rb
require 'axlsx'
require 'money'
require 'money/bank/us'

class LoanAmortization
  def initialize(principal, annual_interest_rate, term_in_years, start_date = Date.today)
    @principal = principal.to_f
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate.to_f
    @term_in_years = term_in_years.to_i
    @start_date = start_date
    @monthly_interest_rate = @annual_interest_rate / 100 / 12
    @number_of_payments = @term_in_years * 12
  end

  def calculate
    monthly_payment = calculate_monthly_payment
    schedule = []

    remaining_balance = @principal
    payment_number = 1
    current_date = @start_date

    while payment_number <= @number_of_payments && remaining_balance > 0
      interest = remaining_balance * @monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest

      # Ensure we don't overpay in the last payment
      principal_payment = [remaining_balance, principal_payment].min

      remaining_balance -= principal_payment

      schedule << {
        payment_number: payment_number,
        date: current_date,
        payment: monthly_payment.round(2),
        principal_payment: principal_payment.round(2),
        interest_payment: interest.round(2),
        remaining_balance: remaining_balance.round(2)
      }

      payment_number += 1
      current_date = current_date.next_month
    end

    schedule
  end

  def to_excel(filename)
    package = Axlsx::Package.new
    workbook = package.workbook
    worksheet = workbook.add_worksheet(name: "Amortization Schedule")

    # Add headers
    headers = ["Payment #", "Date", "Payment", "Principal", "Interest", "Remaining Balance"]
    worksheet.add_row headers

    schedule = calculate

    # Add data rows
    schedule.each do |row|
      formatted_row = [
        row[:payment_number],
        row[:date].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        format_currency(row[:payment]),
        format_currency(row[:principal_payment]),
        format_currency(row[:interest_payment]),
        format_currency(row[:remaining_balance])
      ]
      worksheet.add_row formatted_row
    end

    # Add formatting
    add_formatting(worksheet, headers.size, schedule.size)

    # Save the file
    package.serialize(filename)
    puts "Excel file generated: #{filename}"
  end

  private

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    (@monthly_interest_rate * @principal) / (1 - (1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**(-@number_of_payments))
  end

  def format_currency(amount)
    Money.new(amount * 100, "USD").format
  end

  def add_formatting(worksheet, col_count, row_count)
    # Set column widths
    worksheet.column_widths = [10, 15, 12, 15, 15, 18]

    # Style headers
    headers = worksheet.add_table(0, 0, 0, col_count - 1)
    headers.name = "AmortizationSchedule"
    headers.show_header_row = true
    headers.table_style_info = {
      name: "TableStyleMedium9",
      show_first_column: false,
      show_last_column: false,
      show_row_stripes: true
    }

    # Add a title
    title = worksheet.add_row(["Loan Amortization Schedule"])
    worksheet.merge_cells!("A1:#{col_letter(col_count)}1")
    worksheet.row(0).height = 25
    title_style = Axlsx::STYLE do |s|
      s.f = Axlsx::STYLE_FONT.new(size: 18, bold: true, color: "000000")
      s.a = Axlsx::STYLE_ALIGNMENT.new(horizontal: :center)
    end
    title.each { |cell| cell.style = title_style }

    # Add totals
    if row_count > 0
      total_row = worksheet.add_row([
        "Total:",
        "",
        format_currency(schedule.sum { |r| r[:payment] }),
        format_currency(schedule.sum { |r| r[:principal_payment] }),
        format_currency(schedule.sum { |r| r[:interest_payment] }),
        ""
      ])

      total_row.each { |cell| cell.style = Axlsx::STYLE.new(b: true) }
    end
  end

  def col_letter(col_num)
    letters = []
    col_num.times do |i|
      letters.unshift((i / 26).chr)
    end
    letters.join
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  puts "Loan Amortization Schedule Generator"
  print "Enter loan principal amount: "
  principal = gets.chomp.to_f

  print "Enter annual interest rate (e.g., 5 for 5%): "
  interest_rate = gets.chomp.to_f

  print "Enter loan term in years: "
  term_years = gets.chomp.to_i

  puts "Generating amortization schedule..."
  loan = LoanAmortization.new(principal, interest_rate, term_years)
  excel_file = "loan_amortization_#{Date.today.strftime('%Y%m%d')}.xlsx"
  loan.to_excel(excel_file)
end
```

## How to Use

1. Install the required gems:
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. Run the script:
   ```bash

   ```

3. Follow the prompts to enter:

   - Annual interest rate (e.g., 5 for 5%)
   - Loan term in years

4. The script will generate an Excel file with the amortization schedule.

## Features

- Calculates monthly payments using standard loan amortization formula
- Generates a complete payment-by-payment breakdown

```ruby
class XeroClient

      Rails.application.config.xero[:client_secret],
      site: 'https://api.xero.com'

      }
```

```ruby
# lib/privat_bank_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

class PrivatBankClient
  include HTTParty

  # Base API URL for PrivatBank business services
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua'.freeze

  # API endpoints
  ACCOUNT_BALANCE_ENDPOINT = '/p24api/balance'.freeze
  ACCOUNT_STATEMENT_ENDPOINT = '/p24api/bankStatement'.freeze

  def initialize
    Dotenv.load
    @auth_token = ENV['PRIVATBANK_API_TOKEN']
    @merchant_id = ENV['PRIVATBANK_MERCHANT_ID']
    @account_id = ENV['PRIVATBANK_ACCOUNT_ID']
    raise 'Missing API credentials' unless @auth_token && @merchant_id && @account_id
  end

  # Get account balance
  def get_balance
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{ACCOUNT_BALANCE_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}"
      },
      query: {
        merchantId: @merchant_id,
        accountId: @account_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get account statement (transactions history)
  def get_statement(params = {})
    # Default parameters
    default_params = {
      merchantId: @merchant_id,
      accountId: @account_id,
      dateFrom: Date.today - 30, # Last 30 days by default
      dateTo: Date.today
    }.merge(params)

    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{ACCOUNT_STATEMENT_ENDPOINT}",
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}"
      },
      query: default_params
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  # Handle API response
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise 'Unauthorized: Invalid API token or credentials'
    when 403
      raise 'Forbidden: Insufficient permissions'
    when 404
      raise 'Not found: Account not found or invalid parameters'
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    # Перевірка на український IBAN (UA) і довжину 29 символів
    unless iban.upcase.start_with?('UA') && iban.length == 29
      raise ArgumentError, "IBAN має бути українським (UA) та містити 29 символів"
    end

    # Перевірка валідності IBAN за допомогою бібліотеки
    unless IBAN.valid?(iban)
      raise ArgumentError, "IBAN недійсний"
    end

    # Вилучення коду МФО (6 символів після UA)
    mfo_code = iban[2..7].upcase
    mfo_code
  end
end

# Приклади використання

    mfo = IBANValidator.validate_and_extract_mfo(iban)
    puts "Код МФО: #{mfo}"

    # Приклад невалідного IBAN
    invalid_iban = "UA12345678901234567890123456"

      puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    end

  rescue => e

  end
```

Make a Payment

Add Routes ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do resources :payments, only: [:new, :create] do collection do get 'success' post 'notification' end end root 'payments#new' end ``` ### 7. Add Background Job for Payment Processing ```ruby # app/jobs/payment_create_job.rb class PaymentCreateJob < ApplicationJob queue_as :default def perform(payment_id) payment = Payment.find(payment_id) # Here you can process the payment (e.g., create an order, send notification, etc.) # Example: # Order.create!(payment_id: payment.id, amount: payment.amount, currency: payment.currency) # Send email to customer PaymentMailer.payment_success(payment).deliver_later end end ``` ### 8. Add Mailer for Payment Confirmation ```ruby # app/mailers/payment_mailer.rb class PaymentMailer < ApplicationMailer def payment_success(payment) @payment = payment mail( to: payment.email, subject: "Payment Confirmation for Order #{payment.order_id}" ) end end ``` ### 9. Add Environment Variables Add these to your `.env` file (use `dotenv-rails` gem): ``` LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY=your_public_key LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key ``` ### 10. User fills out the payment form and submits it 2. The application creates a payment record and sends the user to LiqPay 3. After successful payment, LiqPay redirects to the success page 4. LiqPay also sends a server notification to your application 5. Your application verifies the notification signature and updates the payment status 6. Keep your private key secure 4. Implement rate limiting for the notification endpoint 5. class SumToWords
```ruby
  def self.convert(amount)
    amount = amount.to_f
    raise ArgumentError, "Incorrect amount" unless amount >= 0

    # Розділення на гривні та копійки
    rubles = amount.floor
    kopecks = (amount * 100).round % 100

    # Перетворення гривень
    rubles_part = I18n.translate(:rubles, count: rubles)

    # Перетворення копійок
    kopecks_part = if kopecks == 0
                     I18n.translate(:kopecks_zero)
                   else
                     I18n.translate(:kopecks, count: kopecks)
                   end

    # Об'єднання результатів
    "#{rubles_part} #{kopecks_part}".strip
  end
```

## Реалізація

```ruby
require "monobank_api"
require "dotenv"
require "sequel"
require "logger"

# Завантаження змінних середовища
Dotenv.load

# Налаштування логера
logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Налаштування бази даних SQLite
DB = Sequel.sqlite("monobank_transactions.db")

# Створення таблиці транзакцій, якщо її немає
DB.create_table? :transactions do
  primary_key :id
  String :type
  String :description
  Numeric :amount
  String :currency_code
  String :comment
  DateTime :created_date
  DateTime :updated_date
  DateTime :timestamp
  String :client_id
  String :card_id
  String :holding
  String :recipient_id
  String :recipient_name
  String :recipient_account
  String :mcc
  String :original_amount
  String :original_currency
  String :commission_amount
  String :commission_currency
  String :cashback_amount
  String :cashback_currency
  String : balance_after_transaction, default: 0
  DateTime :stored_at, default: Sequel.function(:datetime, 'now')
  index :stored_at
end

# Класи для роботи з транзакціями
class Transaction < Sequel::Model
  def self.store_new_transactions(client, account_id)
    logger.info("Старт отримання та зберігання транзакцій для рахунку #{account_id}")

    # Отримання останньої збереженої транзакції
    last_stored = Transaction.order(:stored_at).last

    # Отримання транзакцій з monobank API
    begin
      transactions = client.get_account_statement(account_id, last_stored ? last_stored.stored_at : Time.now - 30.days)

      if transactions.empty?
        logger.info("Нових транзакцій не знайдено")
        return 0
      end

      # Фільтрація та зберігання нових транзакцій
      count = 0
      transactions.each do |tx|
        next if Transaction.where(timestamp: tx[:time]).count.positive?

        Transaction.create(
          type: tx[:type],
          description: tx[:description],
          amount: tx[:amount],
          currency_code: tx[:currencyCode],
          comment: tx[:comment],
          created_date: tx[:createdDate],
          updated_date: tx[:updatedDate],
          timestamp: tx[:time],
          client_id: tx[:clientId],
          card_id: tx[:cardId],
          holding: tx[:holding],
          recipient_id: tx[:recipientId],
          recipient_name: tx[:recipientName],
          recipient_account: tx[:recipientAccount],
          mcc: tx[:mcc],
          original_amount: tx[:originalAmount],
          original_currency: tx[:originalCurrency],
          commission_amount: tx[:commissionAmount],
          commission_currency: tx[:commissionCurrency],
          cashback_amount: tx[:cashbackAmount],
          cashback_currency: tx[:cashbackCurrency],
          balance_after_transaction: tx[:balance]
        )
        count += 1
      end

      logger.info("Збережено #{count} нових транзакцій")
      count
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Помилка при отриманні транзакцій: #{e.message}")
      0
    end
  end
end

# Основна функція для роботи з Monobank API
def get_monobank_transactions
  # Ініціалізація клієнта Monobank
  client = MonobankApi::Client.new(
    token: ENV["MONOBANK_TOKEN"],
    logger: logger
  )

  # Отримання списку рахунків
  accounts = client.get_accounts

  if accounts.empty?
    logger.error("Не вдалося отримати список рахунків")
    return
  end

  # Отримання та зберігання транзакцій для кожного рахунку
  total_transactions = 0
  accounts.each do |account|
    transactions = Transaction.store_new_transactions(client, account[:id])
    total_transactions += transactions
  end

  logger.info("Загалом збережено #{total_transactions} нових транзакцій")
  total_transactions
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    stored_transactions = get_monobank_transactions
    puts "Збережено #{stored_transactions} нових транзакцій"
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Встановлення та використання

1. Створіть файл `.env` і додайте в нього свій токен доступу до Monobank API:

```ruby
require 'rqrcode'
require 'chronic'

class NBUQRCodeGenerator
  # Constants for NBU QR code standard
  BANK_ID = '300032' # Example bank ID (PrivatBank)
  MERCHANT_ACCOUNT = 'your_merchant_account' # Replace with your merchant account
  INVOICE_ID = 'INV123456789' # Invoice ID
  INVOICE_DATE = Time.now.to_date.to_s # Current date in YYYY-MM-DD format
  INVOICE_AMOUNT = 100.00 # Amount in UAH
  CURRENCY = '980' # Currency code for UAH
  DESCRIPTION = 'Payment for services' # Optional description

  def self.generate_qr_code
    # Construct the payment string according to NBU standard
    payment_string = construct_payment_string

    # Generate QR code
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(payment_string)

    # Generate PNG image
    png = qr.as_png(
      bit_depth: 1,
      border_modules: 4,
      color_mode: ChunkyPNG::COLOR_GRAYSCALE,
      color: 'black',
      file: nil,
      fill: 'white',
      module_px_size: 6,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      resize_gte_to: false,
      size: 300
    )

    png
  end

  def self.construct_payment_string
    # Construct the payment string according to NBU standard
    <<~QR_STRING
      ST000101UA53
      0030003200000000000000
      #{INVOICE_ID}
      #{INVOICE_DATE}
      #{INVOICE_AMOUNT.to_s.gsub('.', '')}#{CURRENCY}
      #{DESCRIPTION}
    QR_STRING
  end

  def self.save_qr_code(output_file = 'payment_qr.png')
    png = generate_qr_code
    File.open(output_file, 'wb') { |f| f.write(png.to_s) }
    output_file
  end
end

end
```

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

# Required gems for Checkbox API integration

```

Run `bundle install` after creating this Gemfile.

## Implementation

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for issuing a fiscal receipt through the Checkbox API:

```ruby
# config/initializers/checkbox.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class CheckboxAPI
  include HTTParty

  # Configuration
  attr_accessor :api_key, :api_secret, :base_url

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['CHECKBOX_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['CHECKBOX_API_SECRET']
    @base_url = ENV['CHECKBOX_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.checkbox.com.ua/v2'
  end

  # Method to create a fiscal receipt
  def create_fiscal_receipt(payload)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{generate_auth_token}"
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/receipts",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Generate authentication token
  def generate_auth_token
    request_body = {
      api_key: @api_key,
      api_secret: @api_secret
    }

    auth_response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/auth",
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    if auth_response.success?
      JSON.parse(auth_response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Authentication failed: #{auth_response.body}"
    end
  end

  private

  # Handle API response
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Checkbox API error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Example Usage

```ruby
# app/services/checkbox_receipt_service.rb
require_relative '../../config/initializers/checkbox'

class CheckboxReceiptService
  def initialize
    @checkbox = CheckboxAPI.new
  end

  def issue_receipt(order_data)
    # Prepare the receipt payload according to Checkbox documentation
    payload = {
      receipt: {
        type: 'sale', # or 'return' for refunds
        date: Time.now.iso8601,
        items: order_data[:items].map do |item|
          {
            name: item[:name],
            quantity: item[:quantity].to_f,
            price: item[:price].to_f,
            tax_rate: item[:tax_rate].to_f || 20.0, # Default VAT rate
            tax_type: 'vat' # or 'exempt'
          }
        end,
        total_amount: order_data[:total_amount].to_f,
        customer: {
          phone: order_data[:customer_phone] || '',
          email: order_data[:customer_email] || ''
        },
        # Additional required fields depending on your account settings
        payment_method: 'online',
        payment_reference: order_data[:payment_reference]
      }
    }

    @checkbox.create_fiscal_receipt(payload)
  end
```

Here's a complete implementation for processing Fondy payments and verifying their signatures:

```ruby
# lib/fondy_payment_processor.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'active_support/core_ext/object/try'
require 'active_support/core_ext/object/to_query'
require 'dotenv/load' if defined?(Dotenv)

class FondyPaymentProcessor
  include HTTParty

  # Fondy API endpoints
  API_URL = 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/'.freeze
  CHECK_SIGNATURE_URL = 'https://sci.fondy.eu/api/checkout/verification/'.freeze

  # Initialize with your Fondy merchant credentials
  def initialize(merchant_id: ENV['FONDY_MERCHANT_ID'],
                 merchant_secret_key: ENV['FONDY_SECRET_KEY'])
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_secret_key = merchant_secret_key
  end

  # Create a new payment request
  def create_payment(amount, order_id, currency = '980', return_url = nil, server_callback_url = nil)
    request_data = {
      request: {
        order_id: order_id,
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        payment_systems: 'card',
        description: "Payment for order ##{order_id}"
      }
    }.merge(return_url: return_url, server_callback_url: server_callback_url).compact

    response = self.class.post("#{API_URL}merchant/transaction/initialize/", body: request_data.to_json, headers: headers)
    response.parsed_response
  end

  # Verify the payment response signature
  def verify_signature(params)
    # Get the verification token from Fondy
    verification_token = get_verification_token

    # Prepare the verification data
    verification_data = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: params['order_id'],
      amount: params['amount'],
      currency: params['currency'],
      auth_code: params['auth_code'],
      transaction_status: params['transaction_status'],
      request_key: params['request_key'],
      signature: params['signature']
    }

    # Send verification request
    response = self.class.post(CHECK_SIGNATURE_URL, body: verification_data.to_json, headers: headers.merge('X-Verification-Token' => verification_token))

    # Check if verification was successful
    if response.success? && response.parsed_response['verified']
      true
    else
      false
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "Fondy verification error: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  # Get a verification token from Fondy
  def get_verification_token
    response = self.class.post("#{API_URL}merchant/token/", body: { merchant_id: @merchant_id }.to_json, headers: headers)
    response.parsed_response['token']
  end

  private

  # HTTP headers for Fondy API
  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@merchant_secret_key}"
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
  include HTTParty

    token_response = self.class.post(

    end
  end

    end
```


## Реалізація

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class LiqPayClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://core.liqpay.ua/api'

  def initialize(private_key, public_key)
    @private_key = private_key
    @public_key = public_key
  end

  def send_p2p_credit(amount, card_number, recipient_name, recipient_phone, description = "Вихідна виплата")
    # Генеруємо параметри для підпису
    params = {
      version: 3,
      action: "p2p",
      currency: "UAH",
      amount: amount.to_f.round(2),
      description: description,
      card: card_number,
      sender_first_name: recipient_name,
      sender_phone: recipient_phone,
      result_url: "http://example.com/result" # URL для повернення результату
    }

    # Генеруємо підпис
    params_string = params.sort.to_h.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    signature = Base64.strict_encode64(
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(
        OpenSSL::Digest.new('sha1'),
        @private_key,
        params_string
      )
    ).tr('+', '-').tr('/', '_')

    # Формуємо фінальний запрос
    request_body = {
      data: Base64.strict_encode64(JSON.generate(params)),
      signature: signature
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      '/3/checkout/start',
      body: request_body.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
```

```ruby
class SingleTaxCalculator
  # Tax rates for 3rd group (as of 2023)
  RATES = {
    min_tax: 2220,        # UAH for the quarter
    min_social: 1572,    # UAH for the quarter
    tax_rate: 0.05,      # 5% of income
    social_rate: 0.022   # 2.2% of income

  end

  end

  end

  end
```

Now, here's the implementation for paying out money to a Ukrainian card through LiqPay's P2P credit API:

```ruby
# lib/liqpay_payment.rb
require 'liqpay'
require 'json'

class LiqPayPayment
  # Initialize with your LiqPay credentials
  def initialize(public_key, private_key)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
  end

  # Create a payment to a Ukrainian card
  def pay_to_card(card_info, amount, currency = 'UAH')
    # Validate parameters
    raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be positive" unless amount.to_f > 0
    raise ArgumentError, "Card info must be a hash with 'card_number', 'exp_month', 'exp_year', and 'cvv'" unless valid_card_info?(card_info)

    # Prepare the payment data
    payment_data = {
      version: 3,
      public_key: @public_key,
      action: 'pay',
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      description: "P2P payment via LiqPay",
      # Card details
      card: {
        pan: card_info[:card_number],
        expiry: "#{card_info[:exp_month].to_s.rjust(2, '0')}#{card_info[:exp_year].to_s[-2..-1]}",
        cvv: card_info[:cvv],
        cardholder: card_info[:cardholder] || "Card Holder"
      },
      sender_card_id: nil,
      sender_card_token: nil,
      order_id: "P2P#{Time.now.to_i}",
      language: 'uk',
      result_url: 'https://yourwebsite.com/payment/result',
      server_url: 'https://yourwebsite.com/payment/notify',
      sandbox: false  # Set to true for testing
    }

    # Create the LiqPay client
    liqpay = LiqPay.new(@public_key, @private_key)

    # Make the payment
    response = liqpay.api("request", payment_data)

    # Process the response
    if response['status'] == 'success'
      payment_id = response['payment_id']
      puts "Payment successful! Payment ID: #{payment_id}"
      { success: true, payment_id: payment_id, response: response }
    else
      error = response['err_description'] || 'Unknown error'
      puts "Payment failed: #{error}"
      { success: false, error: error, response: response }
    end
  end

  private

  def valid_card_info?(card_info)
    card_info.is_a?(Hash) &&
    card_info.key?(:card_number) &&
    card_info.key?(:exp_month) &&
    card_info.key?(:exp_year) &&
    card_info.key?(:cvv)
  end
end
```

## Usage Example

```ruby
# config/initializers/liqpay.rb
# Load your LiqPay credentials from environment variables
LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY = ENV['LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY']
LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY = ENV['LIQPAY_PRIVATE_KEY']

# example.rb
require_relative 'lib/liqpay_payment'

  LIQPAY_PUBLIC_KEY,
```

## Notes:

1. **Security**: In a production environment, never hardcode your credentials. Use environment variables or a secure configuration management system.

2. **Testing**: LiqPay provides a sandbox environment for testing. Set `sandbox: true` in the payment data to test payments without real money.

```ruby
class TaxCalculator
  # Ставки налогов
  UNIFIED_TAX_RATE = 0.03  # 3% для 3-й группы
  ESV_RATE = 0.08  # Ставка ЕСВ 22%, но для расчета берем 8% (так как 1.5% - это 1.5% от МЗП)

  # Минимальная зарплата (можно обновить)
  MINIMUM_WAGE = 8165 # На 2023 год

  # Количество месяцев в квартале
  QUARTER_MONTHS = 3

  # Метод для расчета единого налога
  def self.unified_tax(income)
    return 0.0 if income <= 0
    income * UNIFIED_TAX_RATE
  end

  # Метод для расчета ЕСВ
  def self.esv(income)
    return 0.0 if income <= 0

    # Рассчитываем за каждый месяц отдельно
    monthly_income = income / QUARTER_MONTHS
    esv_per_month = [monthly_income * ESV_RATE, MINIMUM_WAGE * 0.015].min
    esv_per_month * QUARTER_MONTHS
  end

  # Метод для полного расчета
  def self.calculate_all_taxes(income)
    {
      unified_tax: unified_tax(income),
      esv: esv(income),
      total: unified_tax(income) + esv(income)
    }
  end
end
```

Here's a complete solution for creating a payment link through the Portmone API and processing its result callback.

## Gemfile


## Implementation

### 1. Portmone Client Class

```ruby
require 'rest-client'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

class PortmoneClient
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.portmone.com.ua'.freeze

  def initialize(merchant_id, merchant_password, test_mode: false)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @merchant_password = merchant_password
    @test_mode = test_mode
  end

  # Create a payment link
  def create_payment_link(amount, order_id, return_url, description = nil, client_email = nil)
    raise ArgumentError, "Order ID must be present" if order_id.blank?
    raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be positive" unless amount.to_f > 0

    params = {
      'merchant' => @merchant_id,
      'amount' => amount.to_f.round(2),
      'orderid' => order_id,
      'return' => return_url,
      'md5' => generate_md5(amount, order_id, return_url)
    }

    params['description'] = description if description.present?
    params['client_email'] = client_email if client_email.present?

    response = RestClient.post("#{BASE_URL}/neworder/", params, {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    })

    parse_payment_link_response(response.body)
  end

  # Verify a payment result callback
  def verify_payment_callback(callback_params)
    # Extract required parameters
    amount = callback_params['amount'].to_f
    order_id = callback_params['orderid']
    payment_id = callback_params['paymentid']
    status = callback_params['status']

    # Generate MD5 for verification
    callback_md5 = callback_params['md5']
    calculated_md5 = generate_md5(amount, order_id, payment_id, status)

    if callback_md5 == calculated_md5
      { verified: true, status: status, payment_id: payment_id }
    else
      { verified: false, reason: 'MD5 verification failed' }
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_md5(amount, order_id, *additional_params)
    data = [amount.to_s, order_id, @merchant_id, @merchant_password, *additional_params].join(':')
    Digest::MD5.hexdigest(data)
  end

  def parse_payment_link_response(response_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response_body)

    if doc.at_css('status')&.text == 'OK'
      {
        payment_url: doc.at_css('payment_url')&.text,
        payment_id: doc.at_css('payment_id')&.text,
        success: true
      }
    else
      {
        error: doc.at_css('error')&.text,
        success: false
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### Implementation (amount_in_words.rb)
```ruby
require 'i18n'

# Ukrainian translations for numbers and currency
I18n.load_path << File.expand_path('uk.yml', __dir__)
I18n.default_locale = :uk

def amount_in_words(amount)
  raise ArgumentError, "Amount must be a numeric value" unless amount.is_a?(Numeric)
  raise ArgumentError, "Amount cannot be negative" if amount < 0

  # Split into hryvnias and kopecks
  hryvnias = amount.floor
  kopecks = (amount * 100).round % 100

  # Convert parts to words
  hryvnias_words = convert_to_words(hryvnias, :hryvnia)
  kopecks_words = convert_to_words(kopecks, :kopeck)

  # Build the full string
  parts = []
  parts << hryvnias_words unless hryvnias_words.empty?
  parts << kopecks_words unless kopecks_words.empty?

  parts.join(' ')
end

def convert_to_words(number, unit)
  return '' if number == 0

  units = {
    :hryvnia => {1 => 'гривня', 2..4 => 'гривні', 5..20 => 'гривень', 21 => 'гривні', 22..31 => 'гривень', 32..41 => 'гривні', 42..100 => 'гривень'},
    :kopeck => {1 => 'копійка', 2..4 => 'копійки', 5..20 => 'копійок', 21 => 'копійки', 22..31 => 'копійок', 32..41 => 'копійки', 42..100 => 'копійок'}
  }

  # Handle millions, thousands, etc.
  parts = []
  billions = (number / 1_000_000_000).to_i
  millions = (number / 1_000_000) % 1000
  thousands = (number / 1000) % 1000
  hundreds = number % 1000

  if billions > 0
    parts << "#{convert_to_words(billions, nil)} мільйонів"
  end

  if millions > 0
    parts << "#{convert_to_words(millions, nil)} тисяч"
  end

  if thousands > 0
    parts << "#{convert_to_words(thousands, nil)} тисяч"
  end

  if hundreds > 0
    parts << "#{convert_to_words(hundreds, nil)}"
  end

  if number > 0
    # Get the correct unit ending
    unit_suffix = if units[unit]
                    case number % 100
                    when 0..19 then units[unit][number % 20]
                    when 20..100 then units[unit][number % 100]
                    end
                  end

    parts.join(' ').tap do |result|
      result << " #{unit_suffix}" if unit_suffix
    end
  else
    ''
  end
end

def convert_to_words(number, unit)
  return '' if number == 0

  units = {
    1 => 'одна', 2 => 'дві', 3 => 'три', 4 => 'чотири', 5 => 'п'ять',
    6 => 'шість', 7 => 'сім', 8 => 'вісім', 9 => 'дев'ять', 10 => 'десять',
    11 => 'одинадцять', 12 => 'дванадцять', 13 => 'тринадцять', 14 => 'чотирнадцять',
    15 => 'п'ятнадцять', 16 => 'шістнадцять', 17 => 'сімнадцять', 18 => 'вісімнадцять',
    19 => 'дев'ятнадцять', 20 => 'двадцять', 30 => 'тридцять', 40 => 'сорок',
    50 => 'п'ятдесят', 60 => 'шістдесят', 70 => 'сімдесят', 80 => 'вісімдесят',
    90 => 'дев'яносто'
  }

  tens = {
    20 => 'двадцять', 30 => 'тридцять', 40 => 'сорок', 50 => 'п'ятдесят',
    60 => 'шістдесят', 70 => 'сімдесят', 80 => 'вісімдесят', 90 => 'дев'яносто'
  }

  if number == 100
    return 'сто'
  elsif number < 20
    return units[number]
  elsif number < 100
    ten_part = (number / 10) * 10
    unit_part = number % 10
    if unit_part == 0
      return tens[ten_part]
    else
      return "#{tens[ten_part]} #{units[unit_part]}"
    end
  else
    hundreds = number / 100
    remainder = number % 100

    if hundreds == 1
      hundreds_word = 'сто'
    else
      hundreds_word = units[hundreds] + 'ста'
    end

    if remainder == 0
      return hundreds_word
    else
      return "#{hundreds_word} #{convert_to_words(remainder, nil)}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0

  input = gets.chomp
  amount = input.to_f

  begin
    puts "Amount in words: #{amount_in_words(amount)}"
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
  validates :service_type, presence: true
  validates :amount, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :payment_date, presence: true
  validates :transaction_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
```

### 2. Сервіс для роботи з EasyPay API

```ruby
# app/services/easypay_service.rb
require 'httparty'

class EasyPayService
  include HTTParty

  # Базовий URL API EasyPay
  base_uri 'https://api.easypay.ua/v1'

  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
  end

  # Метод для оплати послуги
  def pay_service(user_id, service_type, amount, account_number, payment_details)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    body = {
      user_id: user_id,
      service: service_type,
      amount: amount,
      account: account_number,
      details: payment_details
    }.to_json

    response = self.class.post('/payments', body: body, headers: headers)

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "EasyPay API error: #{response.message}"
    end
  rescue HTTParty::Error => e
    raise "HTTP error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

### 3. Контролер для обробки платежів

```ruby
# app/controllers/payment_controller.rb
class PaymentController
  def initialize
    @easypay = EasyPayService.new(
      ENV['EASYPAY_API_KEY'],
      ENV['EASYPAY_API_SECRET']
    )
  end

  # Метод для створення платежу
  def create_payment(user_id, service_type, amount, account_number, payment_details)
    begin
      # 1. Зробити запрос до EasyPay
      payment_response = @easypay.pay_service(user_id, service_type, amount, account_number, payment_details)

      # 2. Зберегти квитанцію
      receipt = Receipt.create(
        user_id: user_id,
        service_type: service_type,
        amount: amount,
        account_number: account_number,
        payment_details: payment_details,
        transaction_id: payment_response['transaction_id'],
        payment_date: Time.now,
        status: :paid
      )

      { success: true, receipt: receipt, payment_details: payment_response }
    rescue => e
      { success: false, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Метод для перевірки статусу платежу
  def check_payment_status(transaction_id)
    # Логіка перевірки статусу платежу через API EasyPay
    # Тут припускаємо, що ми отримуємо статус з бази даних
    receipt = Receipt.find_by(transaction_id: transaction_id)

    if receipt
      { status: receipt.status, receipt: receipt }
    else
      { error: 'Платіж не знайдено' }
    end
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Fondy (CloudIPSP) Payment Processing

Here's a complete implementation for accepting payments through Fondy (now CloudIPSP) and verifying the response signature, including the necessary Gemfile.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

# For HTTP requests and JSON handling
gem 'httparty'
gem 'json'

# For cryptographic operations (for signature verification)
gem 'openssl'

# For development/testing
group :development, :test do
  gem 'rack-test'
  gem 'rspec'
  gem 'pry'
end
```

## Implementation

### 1. Payment Processing Module

```ruby
# lib/fondy_payment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'

module Fondy
  class Payment
    include HTTParty
    base_uri 'https://api.fondy.eu/api/'

    # Initialize with your API credentials
    def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key, api_version: '2.1')
      @merchant_id = merchant_id
      @secret_key = secret_key
      @api_version = api_version
    end

    # Create a payment request
    def create_payment(amount, order_id, currency = 'USD', return_url = nil, server_callback_url = nil)
      params = {
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        order_id: order_id,
        order_desc: "Payment for order ##{order_id}",
        amount: amount,
        currency: currency,
        sender_email: nil, # Optional
        payment_systems: 'card', # or specific payment systems
        return_url: return_url,
        server_callback_url: server_callback_url
      }

      response = self.class.post(
        "/#{@api_version}/payment/merchant/#{@merchant_id}/create",
        body: params.merge(signature: generate_signature(params)),
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
      )

      parse_response(response)
    end

    # Verify a server callback signature
    def verify_signature(params, signature)
      # Ensure we have all required parameters for verification
      required_params = %w[merchant_id order_id amount currency sender_email payment_id response_status]
      missing_params = required_params - params.keys
      return false unless missing_params.empty?

      # Generate the expected signature
      expected_signature = generate_signature(params.merge(merchant_id: @merchant_id))

      # Compare the generated signature with the received one
      expected_signature == signature
    end

    private

    # Generate a signature for the given parameters
    def generate_signature(params)
      # Create a query string from the parameters
      query_string = params.sort_by { |k, _| k }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')

      # Create the signature string
      signature_string = "#{query_string}&#{@secret_key}"

      # Calculate the MD5 hash
      Digest::MD5.hexdigest(signature_string)
    end

    # Parse the API response
    def parse_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200
        { success: true, response: JSON.parse(response.body) }
      else
        { success: false, error: response.body }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Rack Middleware for Server Callback (Optional)

For handling server callbacks in a web application:

```ruby
# lib/fondy_callback_handler.rb
require_relative 'fondy_payment'

class FondyCallbackHandler
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
    @payment_processor = Fondy::Payment.new(ENV['FONDY_MERCHANT_ID'], ENV['FONDY_SECRET_KEY'])
  end

  def call(env)
    if env['REQUEST_METHOD'] == 'POST' && env['PATH_INFO'] == '/payment/server_callback'
      # Parse the callback parameters
      params = {
        merchant_id: env['HTTP_MERCHANT_ID'],
        order_id: env['HTTP_ORDER_ID'],
        amount: env['HTTP_AMOUNT'],
        currency: env['HTTP_CURRENCY'],
        sender_email: env['HTTP_SENDER_EMAIL'],
        payment_id: env['HTTP_PAYMENT_ID'],
        response_status: env['HTTP_RESPONSE_STATUS'],
        signature: env['HTTP_SIGNATURE']
      }

      # Verify the signature
      if @payment_processor.verify_signature(params, params[:signature])
        # Process the successful payment
        process_payment(params)
        [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ['OK']]
      else
        # Signature verification failed
        [403, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ['Invalid signature']]
      end
    else
      @app.call(env)
    end
  end

  private

  def process_payment(params)
    # Your payment processing logic here
    puts "Processing payment for order #{params[:order_id]}"
    puts "Status: #{params[:response_status]}"
    puts "Amount: #{params[:amount]} #{params[:currency]}"
  end
end
```

In a Rack application (like Sinatra or Rails):

For Rails, you can mount it in `config/routes.rb`:


Then create a controller action to handle the callback:

```ruby

  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: [:server_callback]

  def server_callback
    params.permit(
      :merchant_id, :order_id, :amount, :currency, :sender_email,
      :payment_id, :response_status, :signature
    )

    payment_processor = Fondy::Payment.new(
      ENV['FONDY_MERCHANT_ID'],
      ENV['FONDY_SECRET_KEY']
    )

    if payment_processor.verify_signature(params, params[:signature])
      # Process the successful payment
      head :ok
    else
      render plain: 'Invalid signature', status: :forbidden
    end
  end
end
```

Here's a complete solution with a Gemfile and implementation to generate a payment QR code for Ukrainian bank transfers according to the NBU (National Bank of Ukraine) QR payment standard.

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'rqrcode'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

# NBU QR Payment Standard implementation
class NbuQrPayment
  # Constants for NBU QR standard
  NBU_SPECIFICATION_ID = 'UA-QR'
  VERSION = '001'
  ENCRYPTION = 'N'
  CERTIFICATION = 'Y'  # Indicates compliance with NBU standards

  # Initialize with payment details
  def initialize(payment_details)
    validate_payment_details(payment_details)
    @payment_details = payment_details
  end

  # Generate the QR code content as a string
  def generate_qr_content
    {
      specification_id: NBU_SPECIFICATION_ID,
      version: VERSION,
      encryption: ENCRYPTION,
      certification: CERTIFICATION,
      data: {
        payer_bank: @payment_details[:payer_bank],
        recipient_bank: @payment_details[:recipient_bank],
        payment_purpose: @payment_details[:payment_purpose],
        payment_amount: @payment_details[:payment_amount],
        payment_currency: @payment_details[:payment_currency],
        payment_reference: @payment_details[:payment_reference],
        payer_details: build_payer_details,
        recipient_details: build_recipient_details
      }
    }.to_json
  end

  # Generate a QR code image
  def generate_qr_code(options = {})
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(generate_qr_content)
    qr.as_image(**options)
  end

  private

  # Validate input payment details
  def validate_payment_details(details)
    required_fields = [
      :payer_bank, :recipient_bank, :payment_purpose,
      :payment_amount, :payment_currency, :payment_reference
    ]

    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |f| details.key?(f) }
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end

    unless details[:payment_amount].to_s.match?(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid payment amount format"
    end

    unless details[:payment_currency] == 'UAH'
      raise ArgumentError, "NBU QR standard currently only supports UAH currency"
    end
  end

  # Build payer details block
  def build_payer_details
    {
      payer_name: @payment_details[:payer_name],
      payer_account: @payment_details[:payer_account],
      payer_phone: @payment_details[:payer_phone],
      payer_email: @payment_details[:payer_email]
    }.compact
  end

  # Build recipient details block
  def build_recipient_details
    {
      recipient_name: @payment_details[:recipient_name],
      recipient_account: @payment_details[:recipient_account],
      recipient_phone: @payment_details[:recipient_phone],
      recipient_email: @payment_details[:recipient_email],
      recipient_edrpou: @payment_details[:recipient_edrpou], # EDRPOU is Ukrainian tax ID
      recipient_address: @payment_details[:recipient_address],
      recipient_invoice: @payment_details[:recipient_invoice]
    }.compact
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Utility Bill Payments via EasyPay API

Here's a complete implementation for paying utility bills through the EasyPay API and storing payment receipts:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

# Core dependencies
gem 'httparty' # For making HTTP requests to the API
gem 'activerecord', '~> 7.0' # For database interactions
gem 'sqlite3' # SQLite adapter for development

# Optional gems for better error handling and logging
gem 'rest-client'
gem 'logger'
gem 'json'
```

## Implementation

### 1. Database Setup (db/schema.rb)

```ruby
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :users do |t|
    t.string :name
    t.string :email
    t.string :easypay_customer_id
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :utility_bills do |t|
    t.references :user, foreign_key: true
    t.string :bill_reference
    t.decimal :amount, precision: 10, scale: 2
    t.string :utility_provider
    t.date :due_date
    t.string :status, default: 'unpaid'
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :payment_receipts do |t|
    t.references :user, foreign_key: true
    t.references :utility_bill, foreign_key: true
    t.string :transaction_id
    t.decimal :amount_paid, precision: 10, scale: 2
    t.date :payment_date
    t.string :status
    t.text :receipt_data
    t.timestamps
  end
end
```

### 2. Models

```ruby
# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :utility_bills
  has_many :payment_receipts

  validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :name, presence: true

  def pay_utility_bill(bill, payment_details)
    response = EasyPayService.pay_bill(
      customer_id: self.easypay_customer_id,
      bill_reference: bill.bill_reference,
      amount: bill.amount,
      payment_details: payment_details
    )

    process_payment_response(bill, response)
  end

  private

  def process_payment_response(bill, response)
    if response.success?
      bill.update(status: 'paid')
      receipt = PaymentReceipt.create!(
        user: self,
        utility_bill: bill,
        transaction_id: response.transaction_id,
        amount_paid: bill.amount,
        payment_date: Date.today,
        status: 'completed',
        receipt_data: response.raw_data
      )
      receipt
    else
      raise StandardError, "Payment failed: #{response.error_message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/models/utility_bill.rb
class UtilityBill < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user
  has_one :payment_receipt

  validates :bill_reference, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :utility_provider, presence: true
  validates :due_date, presence: true

  def pay(payment_details)
    user.pay_utility_bill(self, payment_details)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/models/payment_receipt.rb
class PaymentReceipt < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user
  belongs_to :utility_bill

  def to_s
    "Payment Receipt ##{id} for #{utility_bill.bill_reference} - Amount: #{amount_paid}"
  end
end
```

### 3. EasyPay API Service

```ruby
# app/services/easy_pay_service.rb
class EasyPayService
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.easypay.com/v1'

  def self.pay_bill(customer_id:, bill_reference:, amount:, payment_details:)
    response = post(
      '/payments',
      body: {
        customer_id: customer_id,
        bill_reference: bill_reference,
        amount: amount,
        payment_method: payment_details[:method],
        account_number: payment_details[:account_number],
        expiry_date: payment_details[:expiry_date],
        cvv: payment_details[:cvv],
        billing_address: payment_details[:billing_address]
      }.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json', 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['EASYPAY_API_KEY']}" }
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  def self.parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      {
        success: true,
        transaction_id: JSON.parse(response.body)['transaction_id'],
        raw_data: response.body
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error_message: "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Example Usage

```ruby

# Payment details

}

# Pay the bill
begin
  receipt = bill.pay(payment_details)
  puts "Payment successful! Receipt: #{receipt}"
rescue StandardError => e
  puts "Payment failed: #{e.message}"

```

### 5. Error Handling and Logging

```ruby
# app/services/error_handler.rb
```

# Ruby Implementation for iPay.ua Payments

Here's a complete solution for accepting payments through iPay.ua and checking transaction statuses in Ruby.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty' # For making HTTP requests
gem 'dotenv', groups: [:development, :test] # For environment variables
```

Run `bundle install` after creating this file.

## Implementation

```ruby
# config/initializers/ipay.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Configuration for iPay.ua
class IpayConfig
  class << self
    def merchant_id
      ENV['IPAY_MERCHANT_ID'] || raise('IPAY_MERCHANT_ID not set')
    end

    def secret_key
      ENV['IPAY_SECRET_KEY'] || raise('IPAY_SECRET_KEY not set')
    end

    def base_url
      ENV['IPAY_ENV'] == 'production' ? 'https://api.ipay.ua' : 'https://sandbox.ipay.ua'
    end
  end
end

# Main iPay client
class IpayClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri IpayConfig.base_url

  def initialize
    @auth = { username: IpayConfig.merchant_id, password: IpayConfig.secret_key }
  end

  # Create a new payment
  def create_payment(amount, order_id, return_url, cancel_url, description = nil)
    options = {
      amount: amount,
      order_id: order_id,
      return_url: return_url,
      cancel_url: cancel_url,
      description: description,
      currency: 'UAH' # Default to UAH, can be parameterized if needed
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      '/payment/create',
      body: options,
      basic_auth: @auth
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Check payment status
  def check_payment_status(payment_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/payment/#{payment_id}",
      basic_auth: @auth
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "iPay API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load environment variables (for testing)
  Dotenv.load('.env.example') if File.exist?('.env.example')

  ipay = IpayClient.new

  begin
    # Example: Create a payment
    payment = ipay.create_payment(
      100.50, # amount
      'ORDER12345', # order_id
      'https://yourwebsite.com/success', # return_url
      'https://yourwebsite.com/cancel', # cancel_url
      'Test payment description' # optional description
    )

    puts "Created payment: #{payment}"

    # Get payment status
    payment_status = ipay.check_payment_status(payment['payment_id'])
    puts "Payment status: #{payment_status}"

  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
          error: rate_response.errors
        }
      end
```

# Ruby Implementation for iPay.ua Payments

## Gemfile

```ruby

gem 'json'

```

## Implementation

Here's a complete implementation for handling iPay.ua payments and checking transaction status:

```ruby
# lib/ipay_ua.rb
require 'httpclient'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'active_support/all'

class IPayUA
  # iPay.ua API endpoints
  API_URL = 'https://secure.ipay.ua'.freeze
  PAYMENT_URL = "#{API_URL}/oaip.php".freeze
  CHECK_STATUS_URL = "#{API_URL}/oaip.php".freeze

  attr_reader :merchant_id, :secret_key

  def initialize(merchant_id, secret_key)
    @merchant_id = merchant_id
    @secret_key = secret_key
  end

  # Create a payment request
  def create_payment(amount, currency: 'UAH', order_id: nil, description: nil, success_url: nil, fail_url: nil)
    order_id ||= generate_order_id
    params = {
      'oaip_marchant' => merchant_id,
      'oaip_amount' => amount,
      'oaip_orderid' => order_id,
      'oaip_currency' => currency,
      'oaip_description' => description,
      'oaip_successurl' => success_url,
      'oaip_failurl' => fail_url
    }.compact

    generate_payment_url(params)
  end

  # Check transaction status by order ID
  def check_transaction_status(order_id)
    client = HTTPClient.new
    response = client.get(CHECK_STATUS_URL, {
      'oaip_marchant' => merchant_id,
      'oaip_orderid' => order_id,
      'oaip_sig' => generate_signature(order_id)
    })

    parse_response(response.body)
  end

  private

  def generate_payment_url(params)
    params.merge!('oaip_sig' => generate_signature(params['oaip_orderid']))
    "#{PAYMENT_URL}?#{params.to_query}"
  end

  def generate_signature(order_id)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{merchant_id}:#{order_id}:#{secret_key}")
  end

  def generate_order_id
    "ORD-#{Time.now.to_i}-#{rand(1000..9999)}"
  end

  def parse_response(response_body)
    # iPay.ua responds with XML, we'll parse it and convert to hash
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)

    result = {
      status: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_status')&.text,
      order_id: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_orderid')&.text,
      amount: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_amount')&.text,
      currency: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_currency')&.text,
      transaction_time: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_datayymmdd')&.text,
      transaction_hour: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_hourhhmmss')&.text,
      transaction_id: doc.at_xpath('//oaip_paymentid')&.text
    }

    if doc.at_xpath('//oaip_errorcode')
      result[:error_code] = doc.at_xpath('//oaip_errorcode').text
      result[:error_text] = doc.at_xpath('//oaip_errortxt').text
    end

    result
  end
end
```

## Example Usage

```ruby
# example_usage.rb
require_relative 'lib/ipay_ua'

# Initialize with your merchant credentials
ipay = IPayUA.new(
  merchant_id: 'your_merchant_id',
  secret_key: 'your_secret_key'
)

# Create a payment link
payment_url = ipay.create_payment(
  amount: 100.50,
  order_id: 'CUSTOM-12345',
  description: 'Test payment for product XYZ',
  success_url: 'https://your-site.com/success',
  fail_url: 'https://your-site.com/fail'
)

puts "Payment URL: #{payment_url}"

# Later, check transaction status
status = ipay.check_transaction_status('CUSTOM-12345')
puts "Transaction status: #{status}"
```

## Notes

1. **Security**: Always keep your secret key secure. Never expose it in client-side code.

2. **Error Handling**: The implementation includes basic error handling. You might want to add more specific error handling for your application.

3. **Testing**: iPay.ua provides a test mode. You can use the test merchant ID and secret key to test your implementation before going live.

4. **Dependencies**: The code requires Ruby 2.5+ (for using `Digest` and other modern features). The `active_support` gem is used for time handling.

5. **Response Parsing**: The response parsing assumes a standard iPay.ua response format. You might need to adjust the XPaths based on the actual response structure.

```ruby
# lib/amazon_orders_fetcher.rb
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'selling_partner_api'
require 'sequel'
require 'logger'

# Initialize logger
logger = Logger.new($stdout)
logger.level = Logger::INFO

# Database setup
DB = Sequel.connect(
  adapter:  :postgres,
  host:     ENV['DB_HOST'],
  database: ENV['DB_NAME'],
  user:     ENV['DB_USER'],
  password: ENV['DB_PASSWORD']
)

# Create orders table if not exists
DB.create_table? :orders do
  primary_key :id
  String :amazon_order_id
  String :purchase_date
  String :last_updated_date
  String :order_status
  String :fulfillment_channel
  String :order_total
  String :currency_code
  String :shipping_address
  String :buyer_name
  String :buyer_email
  DateTime :created_at
  DateTime :updated_at
end

# Amazon Selling Partner API client
class AmazonOrdersClient
  def initialize
    @client = SellingPartnerApi::ApiClient.new(
      lwa_client_id: ENV['AMAZON_LWA_CLIENT_ID'],
      lwa_client_secret: ENV['AMAZON_LWA_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      refresh_token: ENV['AMAZON_REFRESH_TOKEN'],
      seller_id: ENV['AMAZON_SELLER_ID'],
      marketplace_id: ENV['AMAZON_MARKETPLACE_ID']
    )
  end

  def fetch_orders
    logger.info "Fetching orders from Amazon Seller Central..."

    orders_api = SellingPartnerApi::OrdersApi.new(@client)
    orders = orders_api.get_orders(
      CreatedAfter: (Time.now - 30).iso8601, # Get orders from last 30 days
      FulfillmentChannel: 'MFN', # Merchant Fulfillment Network
      OrderStatus: 'Unshipped' # Or any other status you need
    )

    orders.orders
  end

  def save_orders(orders)
    orders.each do |order|
      DB[:orders].insert(
        amazon_order_id: order.order_id,
        purchase_date: order.purchase_date,
        last_updated_date: order.last_updated_date,
        order_status: order.order_status,
        fulfillment_channel: order.fulfillment_channel,
        order_total: order.order_total.currency,
        currency_code: order.order_total.currency_code,
        shipping_address: order.shipping_address.address_line1,
        buyer_name: order.buyer_info.buyer_name,
        buyer_email: order.buyer_info.buyer_email,
        created_at: Time.now,
        updated_at: Time.now
      )
      logger.info "Saved order: #{order.order_id}"
    end
  end

  def process_orders
    orders = fetch_orders
    save_orders(orders)
    logger.info "Processed #{orders.size} orders from Amazon"
  end
end

# Main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  orders_client = AmazonOrdersClient.new
  orders_client.process_orders
end
```

# Ruby код для імпорту та категоризації банківської виписки з ПриватБанку

## Gemfile
