## Implementation

Here's a complete implementation for ordering a courier through the Uber Direct API:

```ruby
# config/initializers/uber_direct.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'logger'

# Configuration settings
UberDirect = {
  client_id: ENV['UBER_DIRECT_CLIENT_ID'],
  client_secret: ENV['UBER_DIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET'],
  server_token: ENV['UBER_DIRECT_SERVER_TOKEN'],
  sandbox_mode: ENV['UBER_DIRECT_SANDBOX_MODE'] == 'true',
  api_base_url: ENV['UBER_DIRECT_API_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.uber.com',
  logger: Logger.new(STDOUT)
}

# Uber Direct API Client
class UberDirectClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri UberDirect[:api_base_url]

  def initialize
    @auth_token = get_auth_token
  end

  def get_auth_token
    response = self.class.post(
      '/v1/tokens/grant',
      body: {
        client_id: UberDirect[:client_id],
        client_secret: UberDirect[:client_secret],
        grant_type: 'client_credentials'
      },
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      UberDirect[:logger].error "Failed to get auth token: #{response.body}"
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def create_pickup_request(pickup_details)
    response = self.class.post(
      '/v1/pickup-requests',
      body: {
        pickup_address: pickup_details[:address],
        pickup_email: pickup_details[:email],
        pickup_phone: pickup_details[:phone],
        pickup_notes: pickup_details[:notes],
        pickup_reference: pickup_details[:reference],
        pickup_vehicle_type: pickup_details[:vehicle_type],
        pickup_payment_method: pickup_details[:payment_method]
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Uber-Client': 'DIRECT',
        'X-Uber-Business-Sandbox' => UberDirect[:sandbox_mode] ? 'true' : 'false'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      UberDirect[:logger].info "Pickup request created successfully: #{result['id']}"
      result
    else
      UberDirect[:logger].error "Failed to create pickup request: #{response.body}"
      raise "Pickup request failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def get_pickup_request_status(request_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/v1/pickup-requests/#{request_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Uber-Client' => 'DIRECT',
        'X-Uber-Business-Sandbox' => UberDirect[:sandbox_mode] ? 'true' : 'false'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      UberDirect[:logger].error "Failed to get pickup request status: #{response.body}"
      raise "Status request failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Order Service
class OrderService
  def initialize
    @uber_client = UberDirectClient.new
  end

  def order_courier(order_details)
    # Validate order status is ready
    unless order_details[:status] == 'ready'
      UberDirect[:logger].warn "Order is not ready for pickup. Current status: #{order_details[:status]}"
      return { success: false, message: 'Order is not ready for pickup' }
    end

    # Prepare pickup details
    pickup_details = {
      address: order_details[:pickup_address],
      email: order_details[:pickup_email],
      phone: order_details[:pickup_phone],
      notes: "Order ##{order_details[:id]} is ready for pickup",
      reference: "ORDER_#{order_details[:id]}",
      vehicle_type: order_details[:vehicle_type] || 'standard',
      payment_method: order_details[:payment_method] || 'cash'
    }

    # Create pickup request
    begin
      result = @uber_client.create_pickup_request(pickup_details)
      { success: true, pickup_request_id: result['id'] }
    rescue StandardError => e
      UberDirect[:logger].error "Failed to order courier: #{e.message}"
      { success: false, message: e.message }
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Sample order data
  order = {
    id: 'ORD12345',
    status: 'ready',
    pickup_address: {
      full_address: '123 Main St, City, Country',
      coordinates: { lat: 37.7749, lng: -122.4194 }
    },
    pickup_email: 'contact@example.com',
    pickup_phone: '+1234567890',
    vehicle_type: 'standard',
    payment_method: 'cash'
  }

  # Order the courier
  service = OrderService.new
  result = service.order_courier(order)

  if result[:success]
    puts "Courier ordered successfully! Request ID: #{result[:pickup_request_id]}"
  else
    puts "Failed to order courier: #{result[:message]}"
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Product Recommendation using Collaborative Filtering

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'gemoji' # For emoji support in output
gem 'nmatrix' # For matrix operations in collaborative filtering
gem 'csv' # For reading/writing data files

# If you need a database, you might also want:
# gem 'sqlite3' # Or your preferred database adapter
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# product_recommender.rb
require 'csv'
require 'nmatrix'
require 'gemoji'  # Optional for emoji output

class ProductRecommender
  attr_reader :user_product_matrix, :product_similarity_matrix

  def initialize(orders_file: 'orders.csv', products_file: 'products.csv')
    @orders_file = orders_file
    @products_file = products_file
    @user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix
    @product_similarity_matrix = calculate_product_similarities
  end

  def recommend_products(user_id, product_id, limit = 5)
    return [] unless @product_similarity_matrix && @user_product_matrix

    # Get the similarity scores for the target product
    target_product_index = get_product_index(product_id)
    return [] unless target_product_index

    # Get all products the user hasn't purchased yet
    user_purchases = @user_product_matrix[row_index_for_user(user_id)]
    purchased_product_indices = user_purchases.each_index.select { |i| user_purchases[i] > 0 }

    # Get all other products and their similarity scores
    all_products = (0...@product_similarity_matrix.row_size).to_a
    similar_products = all_products.reject { |i| i == target_product_index || purchased_product_indices.include?(i) }
                            .sort_by { |i| -@product_similarity_matrix[target_product_index, i] }

    # Return the top recommendations
    similar_products.take(limit).map do |product_index|
      product_name = get_product_name(product_index)
      {
        product_id: product_index,
        product_name: product_name,
        similarity_score: @product_similarity_matrix[target_product_index, product_index]
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def build_user_product_matrix
    # Read the products file to get product IDs and names
    products = CSV.read(@products_file, headers: true).map { |row| [row['id'], row['name']] }
    product_index = products.each_with_object({}) { |(id, name), hash| hash[id.to_i] = hash.size }.freeze

    # Initialize a matrix with zeros
    num_users = 0
    num_products = product_index.size
    matrix = NMatrix::DSMatrix.new([0, num_products], :dtype => :float64)

    # Read the orders file and fill the matrix
    CSV.foreach(@orders_file, headers: true) do |row|
      user_id = row['user_id'].to_i
      product_id = row['product_id'].to_i
      quantity = row['quantity'].to_f

      # Grow the matrix if we encounter a new user
      if user_id >= num_users
        new_rows = user_id - num_users + 1
        new_matrix = NMatrix::DSMatrix.new([new_rows, num_products], :dtype => :float64)
        matrix = matrix.vcat(new_matrix)
        num_users = user_id + 1
      end

      product_index = product_index[product_id] || next
      matrix[user_id, product_index] = quantity
    end

    matrix
  end

  def calculate_product_similarities
    # Calculate cosine similarity between all pairs of products
    num_products = @user_product_matrix.column_size
    similarity_matrix = NMatrix::DSMatrix.new([num_products, num_products], :dtype => :float64)

    (0...num_products).each do |i|
      (0...num_products).each do |j|
        next if i == j

        # Get the two product vectors
        vec_i = @user_product_matrix.column(i)
        vec_j = @user_product_matrix.column(j)

        # Calculate cosine similarity
        dot_product = vec_i.dot(vec_j)
        norm_i = vec_i.norm
        norm_j = vec_j.norm

        next if norm_i == 0 || norm_j == 0

        similarity = dot_product / (norm_i * norm_j)
        similarity_matrix[i, j] = similarity
      end
    end

    similarity_matrix
  end

  def row_index_for_user(user_id)
    @user_product_matrix.row_size.times do |i|
      return i if @user_product_matrix.row(i).any? { |val| val > 0 }
    end
    nil
  end

  def get_product_index(product_id)
    products = CSV.read(@products_file, headers: true)
    products.each_with_index do |row, index|
      return index if row['id'].to_i == product_id
    end
    nil
  end

  def get_product_name(product_index)
    products = CSV.read(@products_file, headers: true)
    products[product_index]['name']
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  require_relative 'product_recommender'

  # Sample data setup
  products_csv = <<~CSVDATA
    id,name
    101,"Wireless Headphones"
    102,"Smartphone"
    103,"Laptop"
    104,"Tablet"
    105,"Smartwatch"
  CSVDATA

  orders_csv = <<~CSVDATA
    user_id,product_id,quantity
    1,101,1
    1,103,1
    2,102,1
    2,104,1
    3,101,1
    3,105,1
    4,102,1
  CSVDATA

  File.write('products.csv', products_csv)
  File.write('orders.csv', orders_csv)

  # Initialize the recommender
  recommender = ProductRecommender.new

  # Get recommendations for user 1 based on product 101 (Wireless Headphones)
  recommendations = recommender.recommend_products(1, 101, 3)

  puts "Recommendations for user 1 based on product 101:"
  recommendations.each_with_index do |rec, index|
    puts "#{index + 1}. #{rec[:product_name]} (Similarity: #{rec[:similarity_score].round(3)}) #{Gemoji.find_by_alias(:thumbsup:)}"
  end
end
```

## How to Use

1. Create a `products.csv` file with your product data (columns: id, name)
2. Create an `orders.csv` file with order history (columns: user_id, product_id, quantity)
3. Run the script: `ruby product_recommender.rb`
4. The example will show recommendations for user 1 based on product 101

## Key Features

1. **Collaborative Filtering**: Uses user-product interaction matrix to find similar products
2. **Cosine Similarity**: Calculates similarity between products based on co-purchase patterns
3. **Personalized Recommendations**: Only recommends products the user hasn't purchased yet
4. **Scalable**: Uses NMatrix for efficient matrix operations

## Notes

- For a production system, you would want to:
  - Store data in a proper database
  - Add caching for the similarity matrix
  - Implement more sophisticated similarity measures
  - Handle larger datasets more efficiently
- The example uses in-memory CSV files for simplicity, but you can modify it to use a database

```ruby
  base_uri 'https://api.meest.com'
```

# Nova Poshta Parcel Tracker

Here's a complete Ruby solution for tracking Nova Poshta parcels using the Nova Poshta API. The implementation includes a Gemfile with required gems and a Ruby script to handle the tracking functionality.

## Gemfile

```ruby

```

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class NovaPoshtaTracker
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0'

  # Nova Poshta API credentials (you should get these from Nova Poshta)
  API_KEY = 'YOUR_API_KEY'.freeze
  MODE = 'Test'.freeze # or 'Production' for live tracking

  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{API_KEY}",
      'X-NP-API-Key' => API_KEY
    }
  end

  # Track a parcel by its express invoice number
  def track_parcel(invoice_number)
    options = {
      query: {
        modelName: 'TrackingDocument',
        calledMethod: 'getStatusDocuments',
        apiKey: API_KEY,
        ref: invoice_number
      },
      headers: @headers
    }

    response = self.class.get('/JSON', options)

    unless response.success?
      raise "API request failed: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end

    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if data['success']
      documents = data['data']
      if documents.any?
        documents.first.tap do |doc|
          doc['status'] = find_status_name(doc['Status'].to_i)
          doc['date'] = format_date(doc['DateScan'])
        end
      else
        { error: 'Parcel not found or no tracking information available' }
      end
    else
      { error: data['warnings'] || data['errors'] || 'Unknown error' }
    end
  end

  # Convert status code to human-readable status name
  def find_status_name(status_code)
    statuses = {
      0 => 'Status not set',
      1 => 'Registered in the system',
      2 => 'Waiting for shipment',
      3 => 'Shipment accepted',
      4 => 'Shipped',
      5 => 'Delivered',
      6 => 'On the way to the recipient',
      7 => 'Not delivered',
      8 => 'Returned to sender',
      9 => 'Cancelled',
      10 => 'Waiting for payment',
      11 => 'Waiting for goods',
      12 => 'Waiting for documents',
      13 => 'Waiting for recipient',
      14 => 'Waiting for sender',
      15 => 'Waiting for goods from sender',
      16 => 'Waiting for documents from sender',
      17 => 'Waiting for payment from sender',
      18 => 'Waiting for goods from recipient',
      19 => 'Waiting for documents from recipient',
      20 => 'Waiting for payment from recipient',
      21 => 'Waiting for recipient documents',
      22 => 'Waiting for sender documents',
      23 => 'Waiting for sender payment',
      24 => 'Waiting for recipient payment',
      25 => 'Waiting for goods from recipient',
      26 => 'Waiting for goods from sender',
      27 => 'Waiting for documents from recipient',
      28 => 'Waiting for documents from sender',
      29 => 'Waiting for recipient to pick up',
      30 => 'Waiting for sender to pick up',
      31 => 'Waiting for recipient to pay',
      32 => 'Waiting for sender to pay'
    }
    statuses[status_code] || 'Unknown status'
  end

  # Format date from API response
  def format_date(date_string)
    return nil unless date_string

    # Convert from "dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss" to more readable format
    DateTime.parse(date_string).strftime('%d %B %Y %H:%M')
  rescue
    date_string
  end
end

# Example usage

  tracker = NovaPoshtaTracker.new
  invoice_number = ARGV[0] || 'YOUR_INVOICE_NUMBER' # Get from command line or set default

  begin
    result = tracker.track_parcel(invoice_number)

    if result.key?('error')
      puts "Error: #{result['error']}"
    else
      puts "Tracking Information for Invoice #{invoice_number}:"
      puts "Status: #{result['status']}"
      puts "Date: #{result['date']}"
      puts "Warehouse: #{result['WarehouseRecipient']} (Recipient) / #{result['WarehouseSender']} (Sender)"
      puts "Recipient: #{result['RecipientFullName']}"
      puts "Sender: #{result['SenderFullName']}"
      puts "Weight: #{result['Weight']} kg"
      puts "Service type: #{result['ServiceType']}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "An error occurred: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

Моделі (app/models) ```ruby # app/models/cart.rb class Cart include ActiveModel::Model attr_accessor :items, :coupon def initialize @items = [] @coupon = nil end def add_item(product, quantity = 1) item = items.find { |i| i[:product] == product } if item item[:quantity] += quantity else items << { product: product, quantity: quantity } end end def remove_item(product) items.reject! { |i| i[:product] == product } end def subtotal items.sum { |item| item[:product].price * item[:quantity] } end def discount return 0 unless coupon # Отримуємо знижку з купонів (реалізація залежить від логіки вашого купонів) coupon.discount_amount end def total subtotal - discount end end # app/models/coupon.rb class Coupon include ActiveModel::Model attr_accessor :code, :discount_type, :discount_value, :expires_at, :minimum_order_amount attr_accessor :id validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true validates :discount_value, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 } validates :expires_at, presence: true validates :minimum_order_amount, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0, allow_nil: true } def self.discount_types %w[fixed_amount percentage] end def discount_amount if discount_type == 'fixed_amount' discount_value elsif discount_type == 'percentage' (Cart.instance.subtotal * discount_value / 100.0).round(2) else 0 end end def valid? errors.empty? && !expired? && valid_for_order? end def expired? expires_at && expires_at < Time.current end def valid_for_order? minimum_order_amount.nil? || Cart.instance.subtotal >= minimum_order_amount end end ``` ### 2. # Ruby Implementation for Ukrposhta Shipment and Label Printing

Here's a complete solution for creating a shipment and printing a label through the Ukrposhta API. The implementation uses the `httparty` gem for HTTP requests.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.20.0'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8.0'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class UkrposhtaAPI
  include HTTParty

  # Base URL for Ukrposhta API
  base_uri 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua/api/v1'

  # Authentication header
  def auth_header
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['UKRPOSHTA_API_KEY']}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Create a new shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    response = self.class.post(
      '/shipments',
      body: shipment_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_header
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get shipment details (including label)
  def get_shipment(shipment_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/shipments/#{shipment_id}",
      headers: auth_header
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Print a label for a shipment
  def print_label(shipment_id, format: 'pdf')
    response = self.class.get(
      "/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label",
      query: { format: format },
      headers: auth_header
    )

    handle_response(response, binary: true)
  end

  private

  # Handle API responses
  def handle_response(response, binary: false)
    if response.success?
      if binary
        response.body
      else
        JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      end
    else
      raise "API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Initialize API client
  ukrposhta = UkrposhtaAPI.new

  begin
    # Example shipment data - adjust according to Ukrposhta's API requirements
    shipment_data = {
      sender: {
        name: 'Sender Name',
        phone: '+380123456789',
        address: {
          street: 'Sender Street',
          house: '1',
          apartment: '1',
          city: 'Sender City',
          region: 'Sender Region',
          postal_code: '12345'
        }
      },
      recipient: {
        name: 'Recipient Name',
        phone: '+380987654321',
        address: {
          street: 'Recipient Street',
          house: '10',
          apartment: '20',
          city: 'Recipient City',
          region: 'Recipient Region',
          postal_code: '54321'
        }
      },
      dimensions: {
        weight: 1.5,
        length: 20,
        width: 15,
        height: 10
      },
      content: 'Documents',
      service_code: 'EMS', # or other service code
      payment_method: 'cash'
    }

    # Create shipment
    puts "Creating shipment..."
    shipment = ukrposhta.create_shipment(shipment_data)
    shipment_id = shipment[:id]
    puts "Shipment created with ID: #{shipment_id}"

    # Print label
    puts "Printing label..."
    label_data = ukrposhta.print_label(shipment_id, format: 'pdf')

    # Save label to file
    File.write("shipment_label_#{shipment_id}.pdf", label_data)
    puts "Label saved to shipment_label_#{shipment_id}.pdf"

    puts "Process completed successfully!"

  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Setup Instructions

1. Create a `.env` file in your project directory with your Ukrposhta API key:
   ```
   UKRPOSHTA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
   ```

2. Install the required gems:
   ```
   bundle install
   ```

3. Run the script:
   ```
   ruby ukrposhta_shipment.rb
   ```

## Notes

1. The shipment data structure should be adjusted according to the actual requirements of the Ukrposhta API. You may need to consult their API documentation for the exact parameters needed.

2. The API key should be obtained from Ukrposhta by registering for their API service.

3. The script handles basic error responses, but you may want to add more specific error handling based on your needs.

4. The label format can be changed from 'pdf' to other supported formats if needed.

```ruby
# lib/meest_express.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class MeestExpress
  include HTTParty

  # Базовий URL API Meest Express
  base_uri 'https://api.meest.com'

  # Токен доступу (замість реального токена використано placeholder)
  # У реальному додатку токен повинен зберігатися у конфігураціях або змінних середовища

  end

  # Метод для розрахунку вартості доставки
  def calculate_delivery_cost(from_city: nil, to_city: nil, weight: nil, dimensions: nil, **options)
    # Перевірка обов'язкових параметрів
    raise ArgumentError, "Місто відправлення (from_city) не може бути порожнім" if from_city.nil? || from_city.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Місто отримання (to_city) не може бути порожнім" if to_city.nil? || to_city.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Вага (weight) повинна бути вказана" if weight.nil?
    raise ArgumentError, "Вага (weight) повинна бути додатньою" if weight <= 0

    # Підготовка тіла запиту
    request_body = {
      from: {
        city: from_city
      },

    # Виконання POST-запиту
```

## Implementation

Here's a complete implementation for exporting products to Prom.ua in YML format and importing orders through their API:

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'yaml'
require 'byebug'

class PromUaIntegration
  # Configuration
  PROM_UA_API_URL = 'https://api.prom.ua/v1'.freeze
  PRODUCTS_YML_PATH = 'prom_ua_products.yml'.freeze
  ORDERS_API_ENDPOINT = '/orders'.freeze

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
  end

  # Export products to Prom.ua YML format
  def export_products(products_data)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.products {
        products_data.each do |product|
          xml.product({
            'id' => product[:id],
            'url' => product[:url],
            'brand' => product[:brand],
            'name' => product[:name],
            'description' => product[:description],
            'price' => product[:price],
            'old_price' => product[:old_price],
            'currency' => product[:currency],
            'in_stock' => product[:in_stock],
            'image_url' => product[:image_url],
            'category' => product[:category],
            'tags' => product[:tags].join(',') if product[:tags]
          }) {
            xml.delivery_methods {
              product[:delivery_methods].each do |method|
                xml.delivery_method({
                  'id' => method[:id],
                  'name' => method[:name],
                  'price' => method[:price],
                  'period' => method[:period],
                  'currency' => method[:currency]
                })
              end
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    # Save to YML file
    File.open(PRODUCTS_YML_PATH, 'w') do |file|
      file.write(builder.to_xml)
    end

    PRODUCTS_YML_PATH
  end

  # Import orders from Prom.ua API
  def import_orders(params = {})
    headers = {
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    }

    response = HTTParty.get(
      "#{PROM_UA_API_URL}#{ORDERS_API_ENDPOINT}",
      query: params,
      headers: headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise "Unauthorized: #{response.body}"
    when 404
      raise "Not found: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Request failed with status #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

# Nova Poshta Delivery Cost Calculator

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for calculating Nova Poshta courier delivery costs. I'll start with the Gemfile and then provide the implementation.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Core dependencies
gem 'httparty' # For making HTTP requests to Nova Poshta API
gem 'json'     # For JSON parsing
```

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

# Nova Poshta Delivery Cost Calculator
class NovaPoshtaCalculator
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.org/v2'

  # API credentials (in a real app, these would be in environment variables or config)
  API_KEY = 'your_api_key_here'  # Replace with your actual Nova Poshta API key

  # Supported delivery types
  DELIVERY_TYPES = {
    'door_to_door' => 1,
    'warehouse_to_warehouse' => 2
  }.freeze

  # Calculate delivery cost
  def self.calculate(weight, declared_value, delivery_type = :door_to_door, city_id = 1, warehouse_id = 1)
    delivery_type = DELIVERY_TYPES[delivery_type.to_sym] || DELIVERY_TYPES[:door_to_door]

    options = {
      query: {
        apiKey: API_KEY,
        modelName: 'InternetDocument',
        calledMethod: 'getDocumentPrice',
        methodProperties: {
          CitySender: city_id,
          CityRecipient: city_id,
          WarehouseSender: warehouse_id,
          WarehouseRecipient: warehouse_id,
          PaymentMethod: 'Cash',
          DateTime: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
          CargoType: 'Cargo',
          Weight: weight,
          ServiceType: delivery_type,
          Cost: declared_value,
          SeatsAmount: 1
        }.to_json
      }
    }

    response = self.get('/JSON', options)

    if response.success?
      parse_response(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  private

  def self.parse_response(response_body)
    parsed = JSON.parse(response_body)
    return parsed['data'] if parsed['success']

    {
      success: false,
      error: parsed['warnings'].first || 'Unknown error occurred'
    }
  end

  def self.handle_error(response)
    {
      success: false,
      error: "API request failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}"
    }
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  puts "Nova Poshta Delivery Cost Calculator"
  puts "---------------------------------"

  puts "Enter parcel weight (kg):"
  weight = gets.chomp.to_f

  puts "Enter declared value (UAH):"
  declared_value = gets.chomp.to_f

  # By default, we'll calculate for door-to-door delivery from Kyiv to Kyiv
  result = NovaPoshtaCalculator.calculate(weight, declared_value, :door_to_door, 80000, 1)

  if result[:success]
    puts "\nEstimated delivery cost: #{result['Cost']} UAH"
    puts "Estimated delivery time: #{result['DeliveryTime']} days"
  else
    puts "\nError calculating cost: #{result[:error]}"
  end
end
```

## Notes:

1. **API Key**: You need to replace `'your_api_key_here'` with an actual Nova Poshta API key. You can get one by registering at their developer portal.

```ruby
# app/services/nova_poshta_api.rb
class NovaPoshtaAPI
  include HTTParty

  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'

  def initialize
    @api_key = API_KEY
  end

  def get_cities
    response = self.class.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'Address',
        calledMethod: 'getCities',
        methodProperties: {
          FindByString: '',
          Warehouse: 0,
          Page: 1
        }
      }.to_json
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  def get_departments(city_ref: nil)
    body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'Address',
      calledMethod: 'getWarehouses',
      methodProperties: {
        CityRef: city_ref || ''
      }
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: body.to_json
    )

    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    json = JSON.parse(response.body)
    if json['success']
      json['data']
    else
      raise "API Error: #{json['warnings'].join(', ')}" if json['warnings']
      raise "API Error: #{json['errors'].join(', ')}" if json['errors']

    end
  end
```

## Worker for Data Updates

```ruby
# app/workers/nova_poshta_updater_worker.rb
class NovaPoshtaUpdaterWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options retry: 3

  def perform
    logger = Logger.new($stdout)
    logger.info 'Starting Nova Poshta data update'

    begin
      api = NovaPoshtaAPI.new

      # Update cities
      logger.info 'Updating cities...'
      cities_data = api.get_cities
      update_cities(cities_data)

      # Update departments for all cities
      logger.info 'Updating departments...'
      cities = City.all
      cities.each do |city|
        departments_data = api.get_departments(city_ref: city.ref)
        update_departments(departments_data, city)
      end

      logger.info 'Nova Poshta data update completed successfully'
    rescue => e
      logger.error "Failed to update Nova Poshta data: #{e.message}"
      raise e
    end
  end

  private

  def update_cities(cities_data)
    cities = cities_data.map do |city_data|
      City.find_or_initialize_by(ref: city_data['Ref']) do |city|
        city.name = city_data['Description']
        city.ref = city_data['Ref']
      end
    end

    City.import cities, on_duplicate_key_update: [:name, :ref]
  end

  def update_departments(departments_data, city)
    departments = departments_data.map do |dept_data|
      Department.find_or_initialize_by(ref: dept_data['Ref']) do |dept|
        dept.name = dept_data['Description']
        dept.ref = dept_data['Ref']
        dept.phone = dept_data['Phone']
        dept.type = dept_data['WarehouseType']
        dept.address = dept_data['Address']
        dept.type_of_warehouse = dept_data['WarehouseType']
        dept.has_postal_operations = dept_data['CanGetMoneyTransfer'].to_s == '1'
        dept.latitude = dept_data['Latitude'] rescue nil
        dept.longitude = dept_data['Longitude'] rescue nil
        dept.city_ref = city.ref
      end
    end

    Department.import departments, on_duplicate_key_update: [:name, :ref, :phone, :type, :address, :type_of_warehouse, :has_postal_operations, :latitude, :longitude, :city_ref]
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Завантажуємо потрібні геми з Gemfile

require 'dotenv'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'tzinfo'

# Ініціалізація логера
LOGGER = Logger.new(STDOUT)
LOGGER.level = Logger::INFO

# Завантаження змінних середовища
Dotenv.load

class RozetkaOrderManager
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.rozetka.com.ua'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ROZETKA_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['ROZETKA_API_SECRET']
    @auth_token = ENV['ROZETKA_AUTH_TOKEN']
    @retry_attempts = 3
    @retry_delay = 5
  end

  # Отримання нових замовлень
  def get_new_orders
    LOGGER.info("Сподівання отримати нові замовлення від Rozetka...")

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = self.class.get(
      '/orders/new',
      headers: headers,
      query: { limit: 100, status: 'new' },
      timeout: 30
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Оновлення статусу замовлення
  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status)
    LOGGER.info("Сподівання оновити статус замовлення #{order_id} на #{new_status}")

    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    body = { status: new_status }.to_json

    response = self.class.post(
      "/orders/#{order_id}/status",
      headers: headers,
      body: body,
      timeout: 30
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Обробка відповіді від API
  def handle_response(response, attempts = 0)
    case response.code
    when 200
      LOGGER.info("Успішно отримано відповідь від API")
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      LOGGER.error("Помилка авторизації. Перевірте токен доступу.")
      raise "Авторизація вимагає оновлення"
    when 404
      LOGGER.error("Запитаний ресурс не знайдено")
      raise "Ресурс не знайдено"
    when 429
      if attempts < @retry_attempts
        LOGGER.warn("Забагато запитів. Спроба через #{@retry_delay} секунд (спроба #{attempts + 1})")
        sleep(@retry_delay)
        retry
      else
        LOGGER.error("Забагато запитів. Максимальна кількість спроб вичерпана")
        raise "Забагато запитів"
      end
    else
      LOGGER.error("Помилка при виконанні запиту: #{response.code} - #{response.message}")
      raise "Помилка при виконанні запиту: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE == $0
  begin
    order_manager = RozetkaOrderManager.new

    # Отримання нових замовлень
    new_orders = order_manager.get_new_orders

    if new_orders.is_a?(Array) && !new_orders.empty?
      LOGGER.info("Знайдено #{new_orders.size} нових замовлень")

      new_orders.each do |order|
        LOGGER.info("Опрацювання замовлення #{order['id']}")

        # Приклад: Оновлення статусу замовлення
        begin
          order_manager.update_order_status(order['id'], 'processing')
          LOGGER.info("Статус замовлення #{order['id']} успішно оновлено")
        rescue => e
          LOGGER.error("Помилка при оновленні статусу замовлення #{order['id']}: #{e.message}")
        end
      end
    else
      LOGGER.info("Нових замовлень не знайдено")
    end
  rescue => e
    LOGGER.error("Сталася критична помилка: #{e.message}")
    exit(1)
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class OlxPartnerApi
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.olx.ua'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['OLX_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['OLX_API_SECRET']
    @partner_id = ENV['OLX_PARTNER_ID']
    @environment = ENV['OLX_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'production'
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)

    setup_base_uri
  end

  private

  def setup_base_uri
    if @environment.downcase == 'sandbox'
      self.class.base_uri 'https://sandbox.olx.ua/api'
    else
      self.class.base_uri 'https://api.olx.ua'
    end
  end

  def auth_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{generate_access_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def generate_access_token
    # In a real implementation, you would generate and cache this token
    # For simplicity, we're returning a dummy token here
    # You should implement proper OAuth2 token generation/refresh
    "dummy_access_token_#{Time.now.to_i}"
  end

  public

  # Create a new advert
  def create_advert(advert_data)
    @logger.info "Creating new advert with data: #{advert_data.to_json}"

    response = self.class.post(
      '/adverts',
      body: advert_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Update an existing advert
  def update_advert(advert_id, advert_data)
    @logger.info "Updating advert #{advert_id} with data: #{advert_data.to_json}"

    response = self.class.put(
      "/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      body: advert_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get advert details
  def get_advert(advert_id)
    @logger.info "Fetching advert #{advert_id}"

    response = self.class.get(
      "/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get list of adverts
  def get_adverts(filters = {})
    @logger.info "Fetching adverts with filters: #{filters.to_json}"

    query_params = filters.merge(partner_id: @partner_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      '/adverts',
      query: query_params,
      headers: auth_headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    @logger.debug "API Response: #{response.inspect}"

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = response.parsed_response&.dig('error', 'message') || 'Unknown error'
      raise "OLX API Error: #{error_message} (HTTP #{response.code})"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    raise "Failed to parse OLX API response"
  end
end
```

### 3. Nova Poshta API Client

```ruby
# app/services/nova_poshta_api_client.rb
class NovaPoshtaApiClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.org/v2.0/json/'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
  end

  def get_cities
    response = self.class.post('', {
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'Address',
        calledMethod: 'getAreas',
        methodProperties: {
          Warehouse: 0
        }
      }.to_json
    })

    parse_response(response)
  end

  def get_warehouses(city_ref)
    response = self.class.post('', {
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'Address',
        calledMethod: 'getSettlements',
        methodProperties: {
          AreaRef: city_ref,
          Warehouse: 1
        }
      }.to_json
    })

    parse_response(response)
  end

  def get_warehouse_details(ref)
    response = self.class.post('', {
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'Address',
        calledMethod: 'getWarehouses',
        methodProperties: {
          Ref: ref
        }
      }.to_json
    })

    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['data']
    else
      raise "API request failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise "Failed to parse API response: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

### 4. Importer Service

```ruby
# app/services/nova_poshta_importer.rb
class NovaPoshtaImporter
  def initialize
    @client = NovaPoshtaApiClient.new
  end

  def import_all
    import_cities
    import_warehouses
  end

  def import_cities
    cities_data = @client.get_cities
    cities_data.each do |city_data|
      City.find_or_initialize_by(ref: city_data['Ref']).tap do |city|
        city.assign_attributes(
          description: city_data['Description'],
          description_ru: city_data['DescriptionRu'],
          description_en: city_data['DescriptionEn'],
          area: city_data['Ref'],
          settlement_type: city_data['Delivery1'],
          last_updated: Time.current
        )
        city.save!
      end
    end
  end

  def import_warehouses
    City.find_each do |city|
      warehouses_data = @client.get_warehouses(city.ref)
      warehouses_data.each do |warehouse_data|
        warehouse = Warehouse.find_or_initialize_by(ref: warehouse_data['Ref'])
        warehouse_details = @client.get_warehouse_details(warehouse_data['Ref']).first

        warehouse.assign_attributes(
          description: warehouse_data['Description'],
          description_ru: warehouse_data['DescriptionRu'],
          description_en: warehouse_data['DescriptionEn'],
          city_ref: warehouse_data['AreaRef'],
          settlement_type: warehouse_data['SettlementType'],
          settlement_type_description: warehouse_data['SettlementTypeDescription'],
          settlement_area: warehouse_data['Area'],
          settlement_region: warehouse_data['Region'],
          settlement_type_description_ru: warehouse_data['SettlementTypeDescriptionRu'],
          settlement_type_description_en: warehouse_data['SettlementTypeDescriptionEn'],
          settlement_area_description: warehouse_data['AreaDescription'],
          settlement_area_description_ru: warehouse_data['AreaDescriptionRu'],
          settlement_area_description_en: warehouse_data['AreaDescriptionEn'],
          settlement_region_description: warehouse_data['RegionDescription'],
          settlement_region_description_ru: warehouse_data['RegionDescriptionRu'],
          settlement_region_description_en: warehouse_data['RegionDescriptionEn'],
          latitude: warehouse_details['Latitude'],
          longitude: warehouse_details['Longitude'],
          phone: warehouse_details['Phone'],
          post_code: warehouse_details['PostCode'],
          type_of_warehouse: warehouse_details['TypeOfWarehouse'],
          warehouse_status: warehouse_details['WarehouseStatus'],
          warehouse_status_date: warehouse_details['WarehouseStatusDate'],
          warehouse_status_description: warehouse_details['WarehouseStatusDescription'],
          warehouse_status_description_ru: warehouse_details['WarehouseStatusDescriptionRu'],
          warehouse_status_description_en: warehouse_details['WarehouseStatusDescriptionEn'],
          warehouse_barcode: warehouse_details['WarehouseBarcode'],
          warehouse_floor: warehouse_details['WarehouseFloor'],
          warehouse_agreements: warehouse_details['WarehouseAgreements'],
          warehouse_public_counter: warehouse_details['WarehousePublicCounter'],
          warehouse_total_space: warehouse_details['WarehouseTotalSpace'],
          warehouse_belonging_type: warehouse_details['WarehouseBelongingType'],
          warehouse_legal_entity: warehouse_details['WarehouseLegalEntity'],
          warehouse_service_type: warehouse_details['WarehouseServiceType'],
          warehouse_rent: warehouse_details['WarehouseRent'],
          warehouse_owner: warehouse_details['WarehouseOwner'],
          warehouse_owner_type: warehouse_details['WarehouseOwnerType'],
          warehouse_owner_type_description: warehouse_details['WarehouseOwnerTypeDescription'],
          warehouse_owner_type_description_ua: warehouse_details['WarehouseOwnerTypeDescriptionUa'],

        )

  end
end
```

## Реалізація генератора XML-прайс

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'csv'

class HotlinePriceGenerator
  def initialize(catalog_file, output_file)
    @catalog_file = catalog_file
    @output_file = output_file
    @xml_builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8')
  end

  def generate
    # Створюємо кореневий елемент XML
    @xml_builder.doc.build do |xml|
      xml.price.first_day("2023-11-01") do
        generate_products(xml)
      end
    end

    # Зберігаємо результат у файл
    File.write(@output_file, @xml_builder.to_xml(indent: 2, save_with: Nokogiri::XML::Node::SaveOptions::FORMAT))
  end

  private

  def generate_products(xml)
    # Читаємо каталог товарів
    products = read_catalog

    products.each do |product|
      # Перевірка наявності всіх необхідних полів
      next unless product[:id] && product[:name] && product[:price] && product[:currency] && product[:url]

      xml.product do
        xml.product_id product[:id]
        xml.name product[:name]
        xml.price do
          xml.currency product[:currency]
          xml.value product[:price]
        end
        xml.url product[:url]

        # Додаткова інформація, якщо є
        xml.brand product[:brand] if product[:brand]
        xml.category product[:category] if product[:category]
        xml.old_price do
          xml.currency product[:currency] if product[:old_price]
          xml.value product[:old_price] if product[:old_price]
        end if product[:old_price]

        xml.description product[:description] if product[:description]
        xml.image product[:image] if product[:image]
      end
    end
  end

  def read_catalog
    # Приклад читання CSV файлу (можна адаптувати під свій формат)
    products = []

    CSV.foreach(@catalog_file, headers: true, encoding: 'utf-8') do |row|
      products << {
        id: row['id'].to_s,
        name: row['name'],
        price: row['price'].to_f,
        currency: row['currency'],
        url: row['url'],
        brand: row['brand'],
        category: row['category'],
        old_price: row['old_price'].to_f if row['old_price'].present?,
        description: row['description'],
        image: row['image']
      }
    end

    products
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Вказівка на файл каталогу (може бути CSV або інший формат)
  catalog_file = 'products.csv'
  output_file = 'hotline_price.xml'

  generator = HotlinePriceGenerator.new(catalog_file, output_file)
  generator.generate

  puts "XML-прайс успішно сгенеровано: #{output_file}"
end
```

```ruby
# Базовий клас для роботи з API EPICentre
class EpicenterAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.epicenter.com.ua'

  def initialize
    @client_id = config.client_id
    @client_secret = config.client_secret
    @access_token = nil
    @token_expiry = nil
  end

  # Метод для отримання access token
  def get_access_token
    return @access_token if @access_token && Time.now < @token_expiry

    response = RestClient.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/oauth/token",
      {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret
      },
      content_type: :json,
      accept: :json
    )

    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    @access_token = data['access_token']
    @token_expiry = Time.now + data['expires_in'].to_i

    @access_token
  end

  # Базовий HTTP GET запит з авторизацією
  def get(path, params = {})
    response = RestClient.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{path}",
      { params: params, Authorization: "Bearer #{get_access_token}" }
    )
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  # Базовий HTTP POST запит з авторизацією
  def post(path, body = {})
    response = RestClient.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{path}",
      body.to_json,
      { content_type: :json, accept: :json, Authorization: "Bearer #{get_access_token}" }
    )
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  # Синхронізація товарів
  def sync_products
    # Отримати список товарів з вашої системи
    local_products = get_local_products

    local_products.each do |product|
      # Перевірити, чи існує товар на Epicenter
      existing_product = find_product_by_sku(product[:sku])

      if existing_product
        # Оновлення існуючого товару
        update_product(existing_product['id'], product)
      else
        # Створення нового товару
        create_product(product)
      end
    end
  end

  # Синхронізація залишків
  def sync_stock
    # Отримати залишки з вашої системи
    stock_items = get_local_stock

    stock_items.each do |item|
      # Оновлення залишків для товару
      update_stock(item[:product_id], item[:quantity])
    end
  end

  private

  # Методи для пошуку та оновлення товарів
  def find_product_by_sku(sku)
    get('/api/v1/products', { sku: sku }).first
  rescue RestClient::NotFound
    nil
  end

  def create_product(product_data)
    post('/api/v1/products', product_data)
  end

  def update_product(product_id, product_data)
    post("/api/v1/products/#{product_id}", product_data)
  end

  def update_stock(product_id, quantity)
    post("/api/v1/products/#{product_id}/stock", { quantity: quantity })
  end

  # Методи для отримання даних з вашої системи (потрібно реалізувати)
```

Here's a complete solution for interacting with the Delivery Auto API to get shipment delivery statuses.


## Implementation

```ruby
# delivery_auto.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class DeliveryAutoAPI
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URL = 'https://api.deliveryauto.com.ua/v1' # Update with actual API base URL

  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_API_KEY']
    @username = ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_USERNAME'] # if required
    raise 'Missing API credentials' unless @auth_token
  end

  # Get delivery status for a specific shipment
  def get_delivery_status(shipment_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/#{shipment_id}/status",
      headers: auth_headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get statuses for multiple shipments
  def get_delivery_statuses(shipment_ids)
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/shipments/statuses",
      body: { shipment_ids: shipment_ids }.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def auth_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      response.parsed_response
    when 401
      raise 'Unauthorized - check your API key'
    when 404
      raise 'Shipment not found'
    else
      raise "API request failed with status #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Rozetka Marketplace Orders

Here's a complete solution with a Gemfile and implementation to fetch and update order statuses from the Rozetka marketplace seller API.

## Gemfile

## Implementation

```ruby
# rozetka_orders.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'logger'
require 'active_support/core_ext/time'

# Configure logger
LOGGER = Logger.new(STDOUT)
LOGGER.level = Logger::INFO

# Configuration class
class RozetkaConfig
  def self.client_id
    ENV['ROZETKA_CLIENT_ID'] || raise('ROZETKA_CLIENT_ID not set in environment')
  end

  def self.client_secret
    ENV['ROZETKA_CLIENT_SECRET'] || raise('ROZETKA_CLIENT_SECRET not set in environment')
  end

  def self.api_url
    ENV['ROZETKA_API_URL'] || 'https://api.rozetka.com.ua'
  end

  def self.auth_url
    ENV['ROZETKA_AUTH_URL'] || 'https://api.rozetka.com.ua/auth/oauth/token'
  end

  def self.orders_endpoint
    ENV['ROZETKA_ORDERS_ENDPOINT'] || '/orders/v1/orders'
  end

  def self.refresh_token
    ENV['ROZETKA_REFRESH_TOKEN'] || raise('ROZETKA_REFRESH_TOKEN not set in environment')
  end

  def self.database_url
    ENV['DATABASE_URL'] || 'sqlite:/db/rozetka_orders.db'
  end
end

# Database helper (using Sequel)
class Database
  def self.connect
    @db ||= Sequel.connect(RozetkaConfig.database_url)
  end

  def self.create_orders_table
    connect.create_table? :orders do
      primary_key :id
      String :rozetka_id, unique: true, null: false
      String :status, null: false
      DateTime :created_at
      DateTime :updated_at
      String :customer_name
      String :customer_phone
      String :delivery_method
      String :payment_method
      String :total_price
      String :delivery_address
    end
  end
end

# API Client
class RozetkaAPI
  include HTTParty
  base_uri RozetkaConfig.api_url

  def initialize
    @access_token = refresh_access_token
  end

  def refresh_access_token
    response = self.class.post(
      RozetkaConfig.auth_url,
      body: {
        grant_type: 'refresh_token',
        refresh_token: RozetkaConfig.refresh_token,
        client_id: RozetkaConfig.client_id,
        client_secret: RozetkaConfig.client_secret
      },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
      LOGGER.info "Refresh token successful. New access token: #{@access_token.first(4)}..."
      @access_token
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to refresh token: #{response.body}"
      raise "Token refresh failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def get_orders(start_date = 1.day.ago, end_date = Time.now)
    response = self.class.get(
      RozetkaConfig.orders_endpoint,
      query: {
        startDate: start_date.iso8601,
        endDate: end_date.iso8601,
        status: 'new' # or other statuses you want to filter
      },
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to fetch orders: #{response.body}"
      raise "Order fetch failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status)
    response = self.class.put(
      "#{RozetkaConfig.orders_endpoint}/#{order_id}",
      body: { status: new_status }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      LOGGER.info "Updated order #{order_id} to status #{new_status}"
      true
    else
      LOGGER.error "Failed to update order #{order_id} status: #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  end
end

# Order Processor
class OrderProcessor
  def initialize
    @db = Database.connect
    Database.create_orders_table
    @api = RozetkaAPI.new
  end

  def fetch_and_process_orders
    orders = @api.get_orders
    orders.each do |rozetka_order|
      process_order(rozetka_order)
    end
  end

  def process_order(rozetka_order)
    existing_order = @db[:orders].where(rozetka_id: rozetka_order['id']).first

    if existing_order
      update_existing_order(existing_order, rozetka_order)
    else
      create_new_order(rozetka_order)
    end
  end

  def create_new_order(rozetka_order)
    @db[:orders].insert(
      rozetka_id: rozetka_order['id'],
      status: rozetka_order['status'],
      created_at: Time.parse(rozetka_order['createdAt']),
      updated_at: Time.parse(rozetka_order['updatedAt']),
      customer_name: rozetka_order['customer']['fullName'],
      customer_phone: rozetka_order['customer']['phone'],
      delivery_method: rozetka_order['delivery']['method'],
      payment_method: rozetka_order['payment']['method'],
      total_price: rozetka_order['totalPrice'],
      delivery_address: rozetka_order['delivery']['address']
    )

    # Update status if needed
    if needs_status_update?(rozetka_order)
      @api.update_order_status(rozetka_order['id'], 'processing') # or your desired status
    end

    LOGGER.info "Created new order: #{rozetka_order['id']}"
  end

  def update_existing_order(existing_order, rozetka_order)
    if existing_order['status'] != rozetka_order['status']
      @db[:orders].where(id: existing_order['id']).update(
        status: rozetka_order['status'],
        updated_at: Time.parse(rozetka_order['updatedAt'])
      )

      LOGGER.info "Updated status for order #{rozetka_order['id']} to #{rozetka_order['status']}"
    end
  end

  def needs_status_update?(order)
    # Implement your business logic here
    # Example: update if order is new and has been paid
    order['status'] == 'new' && order['payment']['status'] == 'paid'
  end
end

# Main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    processor = OrderProcessor.new
    processor.fetch_and_process_orders
    LOGGER.info "Order processing completed successfully"
  rescue StandardError => e
    LOGGER.error "Error processing orders: #{e.message}"
    LOGGER.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/olx_partner_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'
require 'faraday'
require 'faraday_middleware'

Dotenv.load

class OlxPartnerAPI
  include HTTParty

  # Initialize with your API credentials
  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['OLX_API_KEY']
    @partner_id = ENV['OLX_PARTNER_ID']
    @base_url = 'https://api.olx.ua/partner/v1/'
    @timeout = 30
  end

  # Authenticate with OLX Partner API
  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}auth",
      body: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        partner_id: @partner_id
      }.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @access_token = JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
      @headers = {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
      true
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Create a new ad
  def create_ad(ad_data)
    unless @access_token
      authenticate
    end

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}ads",
      body: ad_data.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Update an existing ad
  def update_ad(ad_id, ad_data)
    unless @access_token
      authenticate
    end

    response = self.class.put(
      "#{@base_url}ads/#{ad_id}",
      body: ad_data.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Get ad details
  def get_ad(ad_id)
    unless @access_token
      authenticate
    end

    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}ads/#{ad_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Delete an ad
  def delete_ad(ad_id)
    unless @access_token
      authenticate
    end

    response = self.class.delete(
      "#{@base_url}ads/#{ad_id}",
      headers: @headers
    )

    if response.success?
      true
    else
      handle_error(response)
    end
  end

  # Handle API errors
  def handle_error(response)
    error_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
    raise StandardError, "OLX API Error: #{error_response['message']} (Code: #{error_response['code']})"
  end

  # Example ad data structure
  def sample_ad_data
    {
      category_id: 1000,  # Example category ID
      title: "Пример объявления",
      description: "Описание товара или услуги",
      price: 1000.0,
      currency: "UAH",
      region_id: 1,       # Example region ID
      city_id: 1,         # Example city ID
      photos: [
        { url: "https://example.com/photo1.jpg" },
        { url: "https://example.com/photo2.jpg" }
      ],
      attributes: {
        brand: "Brand Name",
        model: "Model Name",
        year: 2020,
        condition: "new"
      },
      contact_phone: "+380123456789",
      contact_name: "Контактное лицо",
      is_urgent: false,
      is_top: false
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
class OrdersImporter
  def initialize(api_client, last_import_time = nil)
    @api_client = api_client
    @last_import_time = last_import_time || Time.now - 1.day
  end

  def import_orders
    orders = fetch_orders
    process_orders(orders)
  end

  private

  def fetch_orders
    response = @api_client.get_orders(
      created_after: @last_import_time.iso8601,
      limit: 100
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['orders'] || []
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання замовлень: #{response.parsed_response}"
    end
  end

  def process_orders(orders)
    orders.each do |order_data|
      order = Order.new(order_data)
      order_items = fetch_order_items(order.id)
      order.assign_items(order_items)

      # Тут можна додати логіку збереження замовлення в вашу БД

  end

  def fetch_order_items(order_id)
    response = @api_client.get_order_items(order_id)

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['items'] || []
    else
      []
    end
  end
```

```ruby
# lib/nova_poshta/client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv/load'

class NovaPoshtaClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY']
    @test_mode = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_TEST_MODE'] == 'true'
    self.class.base_uri 'https://testapi.novaposhta.ua/v2.0' if @test_mode
  end

  def create_order(order_params)
    headers = { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    headers['X-Token'] = @api_key

    response = self.class.post(
      '/JsonAPI/',
      body: {
        apiKey: @api_key,
        modelName: 'InternetDocument',
        calledMethod: 'save',
        methodProperties: order_params
      }.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )

    process_response(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    { success: false, error: e.message }
  end

  private

  def process_response(response)
    response_body = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if response_body['success']
      {
        success: true,
        data: response_body['data'],
        errors: response_body['errors']
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        errors: response_body['errors']
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 3. Order Service

```ruby
# lib/nova_poshta/order_service.rb
require_relative 'client'

class OrderService
  def initialize
    @client = NovaPoshtaClient.new
  end

  def create_order(sender, recipient, items)
    order_params = build_order_params(sender, recipient, items)
    @client.create_order(order_params)
  end

  private

  def build_order_params(sender, recipient, items)
    {
      'Sender': {
        'CounterpartyType': 'PrivatePerson',
        'Refs': ['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'], # Default for private person
        'Description': sender[:description] || 'Sender',
        'Phone': sender[:phone]
      },
      'Recipient': {
        'CounterpartyType': recipient[:type] || 'PrivatePerson',
        'Ref': recipient[:ref] || '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'Description': recipient[:description] || 'Recipient',
        'Phone': recipient[:phone]
      },
      'PaymentMethod': 'Recipient',
      'VolumeGeneral': calculate_volume(items),
      'Weight': calculate_weight(items),
      'ServiceType': 'DoorToDoor',
      'SeatsAmount': 1,
      'Cost': calculate_cost(items),
      'CargoDescription': build_cargo_description(items),
      'CargoType': 'Cargo',
      'PayerType': 'Recipient',
      'PaymentMethod': 'Cash',
      'DateTime': Time.now.iso8601,
      'AfteracreaseSender': false,
      'AfteracreaseRecipient': false,
      'BackwardDeliveryData': {
        'PayerType': 'Recipient',
        'CargoDescription': 'Return',
        'AfteracreaseRecipient': false
      }
    }
  end

  def calculate_volume(items)
    items.sum { |i| i[:volume] || 0.01 }
  end

  def calculate_weight(items)
    items.sum { |i| i[:weight] || 0.1 }
  end

  def calculate_cost(items)
    items.sum { |i| i[:cost] || 0 }
  end

  def build_cargo_description(items)
    items.map { |i| "#{i[:name]} - #{i[:quantity]}" }.join('; ')
  end
end
```

```ruby
# epicentr_syncer.rb
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class EpicentrSyncer
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.epicentr.kz'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['EPICENTR_API_KEY']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
      "#{datetime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} [#{severity}] #{msg}\n"
    end
  end

  # Sync a single product
  def sync_product(product_data)
    product_response = create_or_update_product(product_data)
    return unless product_response.success?

    product_id = product_response.parsed_response['id']

    if product_data[:stock_quantity].present?
      sync_stock(product_id, product_data[:stock_quantity])
    end

    product_response
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error "Failed to sync product: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  # Sync multiple products
  def sync_products(product_data_array)
    product_data_array.each do |product_data|
      sync_product(product_data)
      sleep(0.5) # Add delay to avoid rate limiting
    end
  end

  # Sync stock for a product
  def sync_stock(product_id, quantity)
    body = {
      product_id: product_id,
      quantity: quantity
    }.to_json

    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/stock',
      body: body,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully updated stock for product #{product_id} to #{quantity}"
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to update stock: #{response.inspect}"
    end

    response
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error "Error updating stock: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  private

  def create_or_update_product(product_data)
    # Check if product exists
    product_id = find_product_id(product_data[:sku] || product_data[:external_id])

    if product_id
      @logger.info "Updating existing product with ID: #{product_id}"
      update_product(product_id, product_data)
    else
      @logger.info "Creating new product"
      create_product(product_data)
    end
  end

  def find_product_id(identifier)
    response = self.class.get(
      '/api/v1/products',
      query: { identifier: identifier },
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    )

    return unless response.success?

    products = response.parsed_response
    products.first[:id] if products.any?
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error "Error finding product: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def create_product(product_data)
    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/products',
      body: build_product_payload(product_data).to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully created product: #{response.parsed_response['id']}"
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to create product: #{response.inspect}"
    end

    response
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error "Error creating product: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def update_product(product_id, product_data)
    response = self.class.put(
      "/api/v1/products/#{product_id}",
      body: build_product_payload(product_data).to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      @logger.info "Successfully updated product: #{product_id}"
    else
      @logger.error "Failed to update product: #{response.inspect}"
    end

    response
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error "Error updating product: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def build_product_payload(product_data)
    {
      name: product_data[:name],
      description: product_data[:description],
      price: product_data[:price],
      category: product_data[:category],
      brand: product_data[:brand],
      sku: product_data[:sku],
      external_id: product_data[:external_id],
      images: product_data[:images],
      attributes: product_data[:attributes]
    }.compact
  end
end
```

```ruby
# glovo_order.rb
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class GlovoOrder
  include HTTParty

  API_BASE_URL = "https://api.glovoapp.com/v1"
  RETRY_DELAY = 2
  MAX_RETRIES = 3

  def initialize
    @base_headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-Glovo-Client-Id' => ENV['GLOVO_CLIENT_ID'],
      'X-Glovo-Client-Secret' => ENV['GLOVO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      'X-Glovo-Api-Key' => ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    }
  end

  def get_access_token
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/oauth2/token",
      headers: @base_headers,
      body: {
        grant_type: 'client_credentials'
      }.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Failed to get access token: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def get_available_couriers(latitude, longitude, radius = 5000)
    access_token = get_access_token
    headers = @base_headers.merge('Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}")

    response = self.class.get(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/couriers/available",
      query: {
        latitude: latitude,
        longitude: longitude,
        radius: radius,
        country_code: 'UA'
      },
      headers: headers
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to get available couriers: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def create_order(order_details)
    access_token = get_access_token
    headers = @base_headers.merge('Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}")

    # Validate required fields
    required_fields = %w[customer_name customer_phone recipient_name recipient_phone pickup_address delivery_address items]
    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |field| order_details.key?(field) }
    raise "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" unless missing_fields.empty?

    # Add default Kyiv location if not specified
    order_details[:pickup_address] ||= { country: 'UA', city: 'Kyiv', address: 'Khreshchatyk 1' }
    order_details[:delivery_address] ||= { country: 'UA', city: 'Kyiv', address: 'Maidan Nezalezhnosti 1' }

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/orders",
      headers: headers,
      body: order_details.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to create order: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def track_order(order_id)
    access_token = get_access_token
    headers = @base_headers.merge('Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}")

    response = self.class.get(
      "#{API_BASE_URL}/orders/#{order_id}",
      headers: headers
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to track order: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# bas_order_exporter.rb
require 'csv'
require 'date'
require 'i18n'

# Load BAS-specific formatting if available
begin
  require 'bas-export'
  require 'ukrainian-accounting'
rescue LoadError
  # Fallback to basic implementation if gems not available
end

class BASOrderExporter
  # Supported BAS document types
  DOCUMENT_TYPES = {
    sale: '01',
    purchase: '02',
    return_sale: '03',
    return_purchase: '04'
  }.freeze

  # VAT codes according to Ukrainian tax law
  VAT_CODES = {
    zero: '20',
    reduced_7: '21',
    reduced_14: '22',
    standard_20: '10'
  }.freeze

  # ISO 8601 date format for BAS
  DATE_FORMAT = '%Y%m%d'.freeze

  def initialize(orders, options = {})
    @orders = Array(orders)
    @options = {
      file_name: 'bas_orders_#{Date.today.strftime('%Y%m%d')}.csv',
      encoding: 'UTF-8',
      vat_inclusive: true  # Whether prices include VAT by default
    }.merge(options)
  end

  def export
    create_csv
  end

  private

  def create_csv
    CSV.open(@options[:file_name], 'w', encoding: @options[:encoding]) do |csv|
      csv << header_row

      @orders.each do |order|
        export_order(csv, order)
      end
    end

    @options[:file_name]
  end

  def header_row
    [
      'Документ',  # Document type
      'Номер',     # Document number
      'Дата',      # Date
      'Контрагент',  # Counterparty
      'Код товару',  # Product code
      'Назва товару',  # Product name
      'Кількість',  # Quantity
      'Ціна одиниці',  # Unit price
      'Сума',      # Total amount
      'ПДВ код',   # VAT code
      'ПДВ сума',  # VAT amount
      'Загальна сума'  # Total with VAT
    ]
  end

  def export_order(csv, order)
    return if order.blank?

    document_type = DOCUMENT_TYPES[order.document_type.to_sym] || '01'
    vat_code = VAT_CODES[order.vat_code.to_sym] || '10'

    # Calculate VAT amount based on whether prices are VAT inclusive
    unit_price = @options[:vat_inclusive] ? order.unit_price : order.unit_price_without_vat
    vat_amount = @options[:vat_inclusive] ? (order.total * 0.2).round(2) : (order.subtotal * 0.2).round(2)

    csv << [
      document_type,
      order.document_number || '',
      order.date.strftime(DATE_FORMAT),
      order.counterparty_name || '',
      order.product_code || '',
      order.product_name || '',
      order.quantity || 0,
      unit_price.round(2),
      (order.quantity * unit_price).round(2),
      vat_code,
      vat_amount.round(2),
      (order.quantity * unit_price + vat_amount).round(2)
    ]
  end
end
```

```ruby
  def initialize(api_key: ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY'], sandbox: ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_SANDBOX'] == 'true')
    @api_client = NovaPoshta::Client.new(api_key: api_key, sandbox: sandbox)
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
  end

  # Create a return shipment (повернення) for a Nova Poshta order
  #
  # @param reference [String] The reference (number) of the original shipment
  # @param recipient_address [Hash] Address details for the return recipient
  # @param sender_address [Hash] Address details for the return sender
  # @param packages [Array] Array of package details
  # @param service_type [String] Service type code (default: 'DoorsDoors')
  # @param payment_method [String] Payment method code (default: 'Cash')
  # @return [Hash] The response from Nova Poshta API
  def create_return_shipment(
    reference,
    recipient_address,
    sender_address,
    packages,
    service_type: 'DoorsDoors',
    payment_method: 'Cash'
  )
    logger.info("Creating return shipment for reference: #{reference}")

    # Get the original shipment details
    original_shipment = get_shipment(reference)
    return {} unless original_shipment

    # Prepare the return shipment data
    shipment_data = prepare_return_shipment_data(
      original_shipment,
      recipient_address,
      sender_address,
      packages,
      service_type,
      payment_method
    )

    # Create the return shipment
    response = @api_client.post_json(
      'InternetDocument/Return',
      shipment_data.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      logger.info("Return shipment created successfully: #{response.body}")
      Oj.load(response.body)
    else
      logger.error("Failed to create return shipment: #{response.body}")
      { error: response.body }
    end
  end

  private

  def get_shipment(reference)
    response = @api_client.get(
      "InternetDocument/GetDocumentDetails",
      {
        ref: reference
      }
    )

    if response.success?
      logger.debug("Fetched original shipment details")
      Oj.load(response.body).first
    else
      logger.error("Failed to fetch original shipment: #{response.body}")
      nil
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Error fetching original shipment: #{e.message}")
    nil
  end

  def prepare_return_shipment_data(
    original_shipment,
    recipient_address,
    sender_address,
    packages,
    service_type,
    payment_method
  )
    {
      'OwnerAddress': original_shipment['OwnerAddress'],
      'RecipientAddress': {
        'Region': recipient_address[:region],
        'City': recipient_address[:city],
        'Warehouse': recipient_address[:warehouse],
        'Street': recipient_address[:street],
        'Building': recipient_address[:building],
        'Flat': recipient_address[:flat],
        'AdditionalInfo': recipient_address[:additional_info]
      },
      'SenderAddress': {
        'Region': sender_address[:region],
        'City': sender_address[:city],
        'Warehouse': sender_address[:warehouse],
        'Street': sender_address[:street],
        'Building': sender_address[:building],
        'Flat': sender_address[:flat],
        'AdditionalInfo': sender_address[:additional_info]
      },
      'Description': "Return for order #{original_shipment['Ref']}",
      'ServiceType': service_type,
      'PaymentMethod': payment_method,
      'SeatsAmount': packages.size.to_s,
      'PackagesList': packages,
      'Cost': original_shipment['Cost'],
      'Date': Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
      'Weight': original_shipment['Weight'],
      'VolumeGeneral': original_shipment['VolumeGeneral'],
      'Redelivery': '1' # Enable redelivery
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# lib/bas_export.rb
require 'csv'
require 'time'
require 'faker' # Для тестових даних

class BasExport
  # Формат дати, який використовує BAS
  DATE_FORMAT = '%d.%m.%Y'.freeze

  def initialize
    @orders = []
  end

  # Додаємо тестове замовлення (для демонстрації)
  def add_test_order
    order = {
      order_number: "ORD-#{Faker::Number.number(digits: 6)}",
      date: Time.now.strftime(DATE_FORMAT),
      customer_name: Faker::Company.name,
      customer_address: Faker::Address.street_address,
      items: [
        {
          name: Faker::Commerce.product_name,
          quantity: Faker::Number.between(from: 1, to: 10),
          price: Faker::Commerce.price(range: 100..1000, as_string: true)
        },
        {
          name: Faker::Commerce.product_name,
          quantity: Faker::Number.between(from: 1, to: 5),
          price: Faker::Commerce.price(range: 50..500, as_string: true)
        }
      ],
      total_amount: Faker::Commerce.price(range: 1000..5000, as_string: true),
      additional_info: Faker::Lorem.sentence
    }

    @orders << order
  end

  # Експорт у CSV (найпоширеніший формат для BAS)
  def export_to_csv(filename)
    CSV.open(filename, 'wb', col_sep: ';', encoding: 'UTF-8') do |csv|
      # Заголовок CSV файлу
      csv << ['Номер замовлення', 'Дата', 'Покупець', 'Адреса покупця',
              'Товар 1', 'Кількість 1', 'Ціна 1',
              'Товар 2', 'Кількість 2', 'Ціна 2',
              'Загальна сума', 'Додаткова інформація']

      @orders.each do |order|
        # Витягуємо інформацію про товари (максимум 2 позиції для простого CSV)
        item1 = order[:items].first || {}
        item2 = order[:items][1] || {}

        csv << [
          order[:order_number],
          order[:date],
          order[:customer_name],
          order[:customer_address],
          item1[:name] || '',
          item1[:quantity] || 0,
          item1[:price] || 0,
          item2[:name] || '',
          item2[:quantity] || 0,
          item2[:price] || 0,
          order[:total_amount],
          order[:additional_info]
        ]
      end
    end
  end

  # Експорт у JSON (якщо BAS підтримує такий формат)
  def export_to_json(filename)
    File.open(filename, 'w') do |f|
      f.write(@orders.to_json)
    end
  end

  # Експорт у XML (якщо BAS підтримує такий формат)
  def export_to_xml(filename)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new do |xml|
      xml.orders do
        @orders.each do |order|
          xml.order do
            xml.order_number order[:order_number]
            xml.date order[:date]
            xml.customer_name order[:customer_name]
            xml.customer_address order[:customer_address]

            order[:items].each do |item|
              xml.item do
                xml.name item[:name]
                xml.quantity item[:quantity]
                xml.price item[:price]
              end
            end

            xml.total_amount order[:total_amount]
            xml.additional_info order[:additional_info]
          end
        end
      end
    end

    File.open(filename, 'w') do |f|
      f.write(builder.to_xml)
    end
  end
end
```

Here's a complete solution for integrating a Ruby on Rails application with 1C:Enterprise via CommerceML protocol.

## Gemfile
