## Реалізація

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

# Клас для роботи з Etsy API
class EtsyAPI
  include HTTParty

  BASE_URI = 'https://api.etsy.com/v3/'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['ETSY_API_KEY'] || raise('ETSY_API_KEY is required')
    @api_version = 'v3'
  end

  # Отримання оголошень (product listings) магазину
  # @param shop_id [String] ID магазину Etsy
  # @param limit [Integer] Кількість оголошень для отримання (максимум 100)
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Масив оголошень
  def get_listings(shop_id, limit = 20)
    raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid limit, max is 100' if limit > 100

    options = {
      query: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        limit: limit,
        shop_id: shop_id
      }
    }

    response = self.class.get("#{BASE_URI}listings/active", options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Отримання замовлень магазину
  # @param shop_id [String] ID магазину Etsy
  # @param limit [Integer] Кількість замовлень для отримання (максимум 25)
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Масив замовлень
  def get_orders(shop_id, limit = 10)
    raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid limit, max is 25' if limit > 25

    options = {
      query: {
        api_key: @api_key,
        limit: limit,
        shop_id: shop_id
      }
    }

    response = self.class.get("#{BASE_URI}orders", options)
    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  # Обробка відповіді від API
  # @param response [HTTParty::Response]
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Результат або виключення при помилці
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)['results']
    when 400..505
      error = JSON.parse(response.body)
      raise "#{response.code}: #{error['error']}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected response: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    shop_id = ARGV[0] || raise('Shop ID is required')

    etsy = EtsyAPI.new

    puts "Отримання оголошень магазину #{shop_id}..."
    listings = etsy.get_listings(shop_id, 5)
    listings.each { |listing| puts "- #{listing['title']} (#{listing['url']})" }

    puts "\nОтримання останніх замовлень магазину #{shop_id}..."
    orders = etsy.get_orders(shop_id, 3)
    orders.each { |order| puts "- Замовлення #{order['order_id']} на суму #{order['total_price']['amount']} #{order['total_price']['currency_code']}" }

  rescue => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

   ```ruby
   require 'rest-client'

   def self.create_product(product_params)
     url = "https://store-#{ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH']}.bigcommerce.com/api/v3/catalog/products"
     response = RestClient.post(
       url,
       product_params.to_json,
       {
         'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
         'X-Auth-Token' => ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
         'X-Auth-Client' => ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_CLIENT_ID']
       }

     Rails.logger.error "BigCommerce API Error: #{e.response}"
     nil
   end
   ```

## Implementation

### 1. Initialize the Etsy Client

```ruby
# lib/etsy_client.rb
require 'etsy'
require 'json'

class EtsyClient
  def initialize(api_key, sandbox: false)
    @etsy = Etsy::Client.new(
      api_key: api_key,
      sandbox: sandbox
    )
  end

  # Get listings (products)
  def get_listings(limit: 50, offset: 0, keywords: nil, category: nil)
    params = {
      limit: limit,
      offset: offset
    }

    params.merge!(keywords: keywords) unless keywords.nil?
    params.merge!( category: category) unless category.nil?

    response = @etsy.listings.listings_active(params)
    response.results
  end

  # Get orders
  def get_orders(limit: 50, min_created: nil, max_created: nil)
    params = { limit: limit }

    params.merge!(min_created: min_created) unless min_created.nil?
    params.merge!(max_created: max_created) unless max_created.nil?

    response = @etsy.orders.all(params)
    response.results
  end

  # Get specific order details
  def get_order(order_id)
    @etsy.orders.get({ order_id: order_id })
  end

  # Get order receipt (more detailed information)
  def get_order_receipt(order_id)
    @etsy.orders.get_receipt({ order_id: order_id })
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Amazon S3 Image Upload with Thumbnails and CDN

Here's a complete solution for uploading product images to Amazon S3, generating thumbnails, and serving them through a CDN.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

# Core dependencies
gem 'aws-sdk-s3'
gem 'mini_magick'
gem 'active_storage' # if using Rails
gem 'rack' # if not using Rails

# For Rails applications (uncomment if needed)
# gem 'rails'
# gem 'active_storage_aws_s3'
```

## Implementation

### 1. Configuration (config/initializers/s3.rb)

```ruby
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'

# Configure AWS S3
Aws.config.update(
  region: ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1',
  credentials: Aws::Credentials.new(
    ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
    ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
  )
)

# S3 Client
S3_CLIENT = Aws::S3::Client.new

# S3 Bucket
S3_BUCKET = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME'] || 'your-bucket-name'

# CDN URL (if using CloudFront or similar)
CDN_URL = ENV['CDN_URL'] || 'https://your-cdn-url.cloudfront.net'

# Image processing configuration
THUMBNAILS = {
  small: { resize: '100x100', format: :png },
  medium: { resize: '300x300', format: :png },
  large: { resize: '800x800', format: :png }
}.freeze
```

### 2. Image Uploader Class

```ruby
class ImageUploader
  def initialize(file, product_id)
    @file = file
    @product_id = product_id
  end

  def upload_original
    original_key = "products/#{@product_id}/original/#{secure_filename}"
    S3_CLIENT.put_object(
      bucket: S3_BUCKET,
      key: original_key,
      body: @file.read,
      content_type: @file.content_type
    )
    original_key
  end

  def upload_thumbnails
    THUMBNAILS.each do |size, options|
      thumbnail_key = "products/#{@product_id}/thumbnails/#{size}/#{secure_filename}"
      generate_thumbnail(options).tap do |thumbnail|
        S3_CLIENT.put_object(
          bucket: S3_BUCKET,
          key: thumbnail_key,
          body: thumbnail,
          content_type: "image/#{options[:format]}"
        )
      end
    end
  end

  def get_original_url
    original_key = "products/#{@product_id}/original/#{secure_filename}"
    "#{CDN_URL}/#{original_key}"
  end

  def get_thumbnail_url(size)
    raise "Invalid thumbnail size" unless THUMBNAILS.key?(size)
    thumbnail_key = "products/#{@product_id}/thumbnails/#{size}/#{secure_filename}"
    "#{CDN_URL}/#{thumbnail_key}"
  end

  private

  def secure_filename
    @secure_filename ||= begin
      timestamp = Time.now.to_i
      "#{timestamp}-#{@file.original_filename.gsub(/[^0-9A-Za-z\.]/, '_')}"
    end
  end

  def generate_thumbnail(options)
    image = MiniMagick::Image.read(@file)
    image.resize(options[:resize])
    image.format(options[:format].to_s)
    image.to_blob
  end
end
```

### 3. Usage Example

```ruby
# Example usage in a Rails controller or service object

def upload_product_image(product, image_file)
  uploader = ImageUploader.new(image_file, product.id)

  # Upload original
  original_key = uploader.upload_original

  # Generate and upload thumbnails
  uploader.upload_thumbnails

  # Store URLs in your database
  product.update(
    image_url: uploader.get_original_url,
    image_thumbnail_urls: {
      small: uploader.get_thumbnail_url(:small),
      medium: uploader.get_thumbnail_url(:medium),
      large: uploader.get_thumbnail_url(:large)
    }
  )

  product
end
```

## Additional Notes

1. **Environment Variables**: Make sure to set these environment variables:
   - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
   - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`
   - `AWS_REGION` (optional, defaults to 'us-east-1')
   - `S3_BUCKET_NAME` (your S3 bucket name)
   - `CDN_URL` (your CloudFront or CDN URL)

2. **S3 Bucket Policy**: Ensure your S3 bucket has proper policies to allow uploads and to be accessible through your CDN.

3. **CDN Configuration**: Configure your CDN (like CloudFront) to point to your S3 bucket.

4. **Error Handling**: The example doesn't include comprehensive error handling - you should add appropriate error handling for production use.

5. **Performance**: For high-traffic applications, consider using Amazon S3's built-in image resizing or a service like Thumbor instead of generating thumbnails on upload.

6. **Security**: The example doesn't include security measures like signed URLs - implement these for production applications.

### 1. Gemfile

### 2. Реалізація колаборативної фільтрації
```ruby
# lib/recommendations.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'csv'

class CollaborativeFilter
  def initialize
    @user_items = {}  # { user_id: { item_id => rating } }
    @item_users = {}  # { item_id: { user_id => rating } }
    @similarity_matrix = {}
  end

  # Завантаження даних з CSV (формат: user_id, item_id, rating)
  def load_data(file_path)
    CSV.foreach(file_path, headers: false) do |row|
      user_id, item_id, rating = row
      add_rating(user_id, item_id, rating.to_f)
    end
  end

  # Додавання оцінки товару користувачем
  def add_rating(user_id, item_id, rating)
    @user_items[user_id] ||= {}
    @user_items[user_id][item_id] = rating

    @item_users[item_id] ||= {}
    @item_users[item_id][user_id] = rating
  end

  # Обчислення подібності між користувачами за косинусною мірою
  def calculate_user_similarity
    @user_ids = @user_items.keys
    @item_ids = @item_items.values.flatten.uniq

    @user_ids.each do |user1|
      @user_ids.each do |user2|
        next if user1 == user2

        numerator = 0.0
        denominator1 = 0.0
        denominator2 = 0.0

        # Користувачі, які оцінили спільні товари
        common_items = @user_items[user1].keys & @user_items[user2].keys
        next if common_items.empty?

        common_items.each do |item|
          rating1 = @user_items[user1][item]
          rating2 = @user_items[user2][item]

          numerator += rating1 * rating2
          denominator1 += rating1**2
          denominator2 += rating2**2
        end

        denominator = Math.sqrt(denominator1 * denominator2)
        similarity = denominator > 0 ? (numerator / denominator) : 0

        @similarity_matrix[[user1, user2]] = similarity
      end
    end
  end

  # Рекомендація товарів для користувача
  def recommend_items(user_id, top_n = 5)
    raise "User #{user_id} not found" unless @user_items.key?(user_id)

    # Знайдемо подібних користувачів
    similar_users = @similarity_matrix.select { |(u, _), _| u == user_id }.sort_by { |_, sim| -sim }

    recommendations = {}

    # Переглянемо оцінки подібних користувачів
    similar_users.each do |(_, similar_user), similarity|
      next if similarity <= 0

      @user_items[similar_user].each do |item_id, rating|
        next if @user_items[user_id].key?(item_id) # Пропускаємо вже куплені товари

        recommendations[item_id] ||= 0
        recommendations[item_id] += rating * similarity
      end
    end

    # Сортуємо за рекомендаціями у спадному порядку
    recommendations.sort_by { |_, score| -score }.take(top_n).map(&:first)
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  recommender = CollaborativeFilter.new

  # Приклад даних (user_id, item_id, rating)
  data = [
    ["u1", "i1", 5],
    ["u1", "i2", 4],
    ["u2", "i1", 3],
    ["u2", "i3", 4],
    ["u3", "i2", 5],
    ["u3", "i3", 3]
  ]

  # Додавання даних
  data.each { |row| recommender.add_rating(*row) }

  # Обчислення подібності
  recommender.calculate_user_similarity

  # Рекомендації для користувача u1
  puts "Рекомендації для користувача u1: #{recommender.recommend_items('u1')}"
end
```

### 1. BigCommerce Service Class

Create a service class to handle all BigCommerce interactions:

```ruby
# app/services/bigcommerce_service.rb
class BigCommerceService
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/{store_hash}/v3/'

  def initialize(store_hash:, client_id:, client_secret:)
    @store_hash = store_hash
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
  end

  def create_product(product_params)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{@store_hash}/products",
      body: product_params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}"
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  def create_order(order_params)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}#{@store_hash}/orders",
      body: order_params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{access_token}"
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def access_token
    @access_token ||= OAuth2::AccessToken.new(
      OAuth2::Client.new(@client_id, @client_secret, site: BASE_URL),
      fetch_access_token,
      token_method: :post
    ).token
  end

  def fetch_access_token
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}oauth2/token",
      body: {
        client_id: @client_id,
        client_secret: @client_secret,
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        scope: 'store_v2_content store_v2_orders'
      },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['access_token']
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch access token: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "BigCommerce API error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
      client_id: Rails.configuration.bigcommerce[:api_client_id],
      access_token: Rails.configuration.bigcommerce[:api_access_token],

    )

    response = @client.put("/catalog/products/#{product_id}", product_params)
    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  def get_product(product_id)
    response = @client.get("/catalog/products/#{product_id}")
    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  # Order operations
  def create_order(order_params)
    response = @client.post("/orders", order_params)
    JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)

    response = @client.put("/orders/#{order_id}", order_params)
```

```ruby
require 'aws-sdk-s3'
require 'mini_magick'
require 'fileutils'
require 'tempfile'

class ImageUploader
  def initialize
    # Конфігурація AWS S3
    @s3_client = Aws::S3::Client.new(
      region: ENV['AWS_REGION'] || 'us-east-1',
      access_key_id: ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'],
      secret_access_key: ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
    )
    @bucket_name = ENV['S3_BUCKET_NAME'] || 'your-bucket-name'
  end

  # Завантажує зображення на S3 і створює мініатюри
  def upload_image(file_path, original_filename, thumbnail_width = 200)
    # Перевірка файлу
    unless File.file?(file_path)
      raise "File not found: #{file_path}"
    end

    # Завантаження оригінального зображення на S3
    original_key = "originals/#{original_filename}"
    upload_to_s3(file_path, original_key)

    # Створення мініатюри
    thumbnail_path = create_thumbnail(file_path, thumbnail_width)
    thumbnail_key = "thumbnails/#{original_filename}"

    # Завантаження мініатюри на S3
    upload_to_s3(thumbnail_path, thumbnail_key)

    # Повертаємо посилання на оригінал і мініатюру (через CDN)
    {
      original_url: get_cdn_url(original_key),
      thumbnail_url: get_cdn_url(thumbnail_key)
    }
  end

  private

  def upload_to_s3(file_path, key)
    @s3_client.put_object(
      bucket: @bucket_name,
      key: key,
      body: File.open(file_path)
    )
  end

  def create_thumbnail(original_path, width)
    Tempfile.create([File.basename(original_path, '.*'), '.jpg']) do |tmp|
      image = MiniMagick::Image.open(original_path)
      image.resize "#{width}x#{width}"
      image.write(tmp.path)
      tmp.path
    end
  end

  def get_cdn_url(key)
    # Замінить на ваш CDN URL (наприклад, CloudFront)
    "https://#{@bucket_name}.s3.amazonaws.com/#{key}"
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  uploader = ImageUploader.new
  image_file = 'path/to/your/image.jpg' # Замініть на шлях до вашого зображення
  original_name = 'product_image.jpg'

  result = uploader.upload_image(image_file, original_name)
  puts "Original URL: #{result[:original_url]}"
  puts "Thumbnail URL: #{result[:thumbnail_url]}"
end
```

```ruby
# recommendation_engine.rb
require 'matrix'
require 'numo/narray'

class RecommendationEngine
  def initialize
    @user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix
  end

  def recommend_products_for_user(user_id, top_n = 5)
    if @user_product_matrix.nil? || @user_product_matrix.empty?
      return []
    end

    # Calculate similarity between target user and all other users
    target_user_vector = @user_product_matrix[row_index(user_id)]

    # Calculate cosine similarities
    similarities = @user_product_matrix.each_with_index.map do |row, index|
      unless index == row_index(user_id) # Skip self
        cosine_similarity(target_user_vector, row)
      end
    end.compact

    # Find most similar users (excluding self)
    most_similar_users = similarities.each_with_index
                               .sort_by { |sim, idx| -sim }
                               .map { |sim, idx| idx }

    # Get products purchased by similar users (but not by target user)
    recommended_products = Set.new

    most_similar_users.each do |similar_user_index|
      similar_user_id = user_id_from_row(similar_user_index)
      similar_user_products = products_purchased_by(similar_user_id)

      similar_user_products.each do |product|
        unless product_purchased_by?(user_id, product)
          recommended_products.add(product)
        end
      end

      break if recommended_products.size >= top_n
    end

    # Return top N recommendations
    recommended_products.to_a.first(top_n)
  end

  private

  def build_user_product_matrix
    # Get all users and products
    users = User.all
    products = Product.all

    return Matrix[] if users.empty? || products.empty?

    # Create a matrix where each row is a user and each column is a product
    # Values are 1 if user purchased the product, 0 otherwise
    matrix_data = []

    users.each do |user|
      row = []
      products.each do |product|
        row << (product_purchased_by?(user.id, product) ? 1 : 0)
      end
      matrix_data << row
    end

    Matrix.rows(matrix_data)
  end

  def product_purchased_by?(user_id, product)
    OrderItem.where(user_id: user_id, product_id: product.id).exists?
  end

  def products_purchased_by(user_id)
    Product.joins(:orders)
           .where('orders.user_id' => user_id)
           .distinct
  end

  def row_index(user_id)
    @user_ids ||= User.pluck(:id)
    @user_ids.index(user_id)
  end

  def user_id_from_row(row_index)
    @user_ids[row_index]
  end

  def cosine_similarity(a, b)
    dot_product = a.dot(b)
    magnitude_a = Math.sqrt(a.sum { |x| x**2 })
    magnitude_b = Math.sqrt(b.sum { |x| x**2 })

    return 0.0 if magnitude_a == 0 || magnitude_b == 0
    dot_product / (magnitude_a * magnitude_b)
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/models/cart.rb
class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :cart_items
  has_many :products, through: :cart_items
  belongs_to :coupon, optional: true

  def total_price
    total = cart_items.sum { |item| item.product.price * item.quantity }
    apply_discount(total)
  end

  def apply_discount(total)
    return total if coupon.nil? || coupon.expired?

    discount = [coupon.discount_percentage.to_f / 100, 0.99].min
    (total * (1 - discount)).round(2)
  end

  def add_product(product, quantity = 1)
    item = cart_items.find_or_initialize_by(product: product)
    item.quantity = (item.quantity || 0) + quantity
    item.save
  end

  def remove_product(product)
    cart_item = cart_items.find_by(product: product)
    cart_item&.destroy
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/controllers/carts_controller.rb
class CartsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_cart, only: [:show, :update, :destroy, :apply_coupon, :remove_coupon]

  def show
    @cart_items = @cart.cart_items.includes(:product)
  end

  def create
    @cart = Cart.new
    if @cart.save
      render :show, status: :created
    else
      render json: @cart.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def update
    if @cart.update(cart_params)
      render :show
    else
      render json: @cart.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    @cart.destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  def apply_coupon
    coupon = Coupon.find_by(code: params[:coupon_code])

    if coupon && !coupon.expired?
      @cart.coupon = coupon
      if @cart.save
        render json: { message: "Coupon applied successfully", total: @cart.total_price }
      else
        render json: { error: "Could not apply coupon" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    else
      render json: { error: "Invalid or expired coupon code" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def remove_coupon
    @cart.coupon = nil
    if @cart.save
      render json: { message: "Coupon removed successfully", total: @cart.total_price }
    else
      render json: { error: "Could not remove coupon" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def set_cart
    @cart = Cart.find(params[:id])
  end

  def cart_params
    params.require(:cart).permit(:coupon_id)
  end
end
```

# Ukrposhta Shipment and Label Printing

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for creating a shipment and printing a label through the Ukrposhta API. The implementation includes a Gemfile with required dependencies and the main code.

## Gemfile

```ruby

source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.20.0'  # For making HTTP requests

```

## Implementation

```ruby
# ukrposhta_shipment.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class UkrposhtaClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua/v1'

  # Initialize with API credentials
  def initialize(api_key, client_id, client_secret)
    @options = {
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    }
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
  end

  # Create a shipment
  def create_shipment(shipment_data)
    response = self.class.post(
      '/shipments',
      body: shipment_data.to_json,
      headers: @options[:headers]
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to create shipment: #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise "Error creating shipment: #{e.message}"
  end

  # Print a label for a shipment
  def print_label(shipment_id, label_format = 'pdf')
    response = self.class.get(
      "/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label?format=#{label_format}",
      headers: @options[:headers]
    )

    if response.success?
      response.body
    else
      raise "Failed to print label: #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise "Error printing label: #{e.message}"
  end

  # Get shipping rates
  def get_rates(origin, destination, weight, service_code)
    params = {
      origin_zip: origin[:zip],
      origin_city: origin[:city],
      origin_region: origin[:region],
      destination_zip: destination[:zip],
      destination_city: destination[:city],
      destination_region: destination[:region],
      weight: weight,
      service_code: service_code
    }

    response = self.class.get(
      '/rates',
      query: params,
      headers: @options[:headers]
    )

    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to get rates: #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise "Error getting rates: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load if ENV['RACK_ENV'] == 'development' || ENV['RACK_ENV'] == 'test'

class UkrposhtaAPI
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.ukrposhta.ua'

  def initialize
    @client = HTTPClient.new
    @username = ENV['UKRPOSHTA_USERNAME']
    @password = ENV['UKRPOSHTA_PASSWORD']
    @auth_token = nil
  end

  def authenticate
    request_body = {
      username: @username,
      password: @password
    }

    response = post('/auth/login', request_body)
    if response && response.code == 200
      @auth_token = response.body['token']
      true
    else
      false
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Authentication error: #{e.message}"
    false
  end

  def create_shipment(shipment_params)
    unless @auth_token
      raise "Not authenticated. Call authenticate() first."
    end

    request_body = {
      sender: {
        name: shipment_params[:sender_name],
        address: shipment_params[:sender_address],
        phone: shipment_params[:sender_phone],
        email: shipment_params[:sender_email]
      },
      recipient: {
        name: shipment_params[:recipient_name],
        address: shipment_params[:recipient_address],
        phone: shipment_params[:recipient_phone],
        email: shipment_params[:recipient_email]
      },
      items: shipment_params[:items],
      delivery_method: shipment_params[:delivery_method] || 'standard',
      service: shipment_params[:service] || 'postal',
      payment_method: shipment_params[:payment_method] || 'recipient',
      declaration_number: shipment_params[:declaration_number],
      barcode: shipment_params[:barcode] || SecureRandom.alphanumeric(10).upcase
    }

    response = post('/shipments', request_body, @auth_token)
    if response && response.code == 201
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to create shipment: #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Shipment creation error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def print_label(shipment_id, format: 'pdf')
    unless @auth_token
      raise "Not authenticated. Call authenticate() first."
    end

    response = get("/shipments/#{shipment_id}/label?format=#{format}", @auth_token)
    if response && response.code == 200
      # For PDF format, return the raw binary
      if format == 'pdf'
        response.body
      else
        # For other formats (like PNG or SVG), you might need to handle differently
        response.body
      end
    else
      raise "Failed to print label: #{response.body}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Label printing error: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  private

  def get(endpoint, auth_token = nil)
    headers = {}
    headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{auth_token}" if auth_token

    @client.get("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", headers)
  end

  def post(endpoint, body, auth_token = nil)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{auth_token}" if auth_token

    @client.post("#{BASE_URL}#{endpoint}", body.to_json, headers)
  end
end
```

Here's a complete implementation for recommending related products based on past orders using collaborative filtering.

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'active_record'
require 'matrix'
require 'narray'
require 'csv'

# Database setup
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: 'sqlite3', database: 'recommendations.db')

# Models
class Customer < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :orders
end

class Product < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :order_items
  has_many :orders, through: :order_items
end

class Order < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :customer
  has_many :order_items
  has_many :products, through: :order_items
end

class OrderItem < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :order
  belongs_to :product
end

# Create tables if they don't exist
ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :customers, force: true do |t|
  t.string :name
  t.timestamps
end

ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :products, force: true do |t|
  t.string :name
  t.string :category
  t.decimal :price
  t.timestamps
end

ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :orders, force: true do |t|
  t.belongs_to :customer
  t.date :order_date
  t.timestamps
end

ActiveRecord::Base.connection.create_table :order_items, force: true do |t|
  t.belongs_to :order
  t.belongs_to :product
  t.integer :quantity
  t.timestamps
end

# Collaborative Filtering Implementation
class ProductRecommender
  def initialize
    @customers = Customer.all
    @products = Product.all
    @orders = Order.all
  end

  # User-based collaborative filtering
  def recommend_similar_products_for_customer(customer_id, limit = 5)
    # Get all customers who purchased at least one product in common with the target customer
    target_customer = Customer.find(customer_id)
    target_customer_orders = target_customer.orders

    # Build user-product matrix (users as rows, products as columns)
    user_product_matrix = build_user_product_matrix

    # Find similar customers (those who bought similar products)
    similar_customers = find_similar_customers(target_customer, user_product_matrix)

    return [] if similar_customers.empty?

    # Get products purchased by similar customers but not by the target customer
    similar_customers_product_ids = similar_customers.flat_map { |c| c.orders.map(&:product_ids) }.uniq
    target_customer_product_ids = target_customer.orders.flat_map(&:product_ids).uniq

    # Find products that similar customers bought but the target customer didn't
    potential_recommendations = similar_customers_product_ids - target_customer_product_ids

    # Rank recommendations by how often they appear among similar customers
    recommendations = potential_recommendations.group_by(&:itself)
                                           .map { |product_id, _| [product_id, recommendations.count(product_id)] }
                                           .sort_by { |_, count| -count }
                                           .take(limit)
                                           .map(&:first)

    # Return product objects
    Product.where(id: recommendations).order(:id)
  end

  private

  def build_user_product_matrix
    # Create a matrix where rows are customers and columns are products
    # Matrix entries are binary (1 if customer purchased the product, 0 otherwise)
    matrix_data = @customers.map do |customer|
      @products.map do |product|
        customer.orders.any? { |order| order.product_ids.include?(product.id) } ? 1 : 0
      end
    end

    Matrix.rows(matrix_data)
  end

  def find_similar_customers(target_customer, user_product_matrix)
    # Calculate similarity using cosine similarity
    target_vector = user_product_matrix.row(target_customer.id - 1) # Assuming IDs start at 1

    # Calculate similarity for all other customers
    similarities = @customers.map.with_index do |customer, index|
      next if customer.id == target_customer.id

      other_vector = user_product_matrix.row(index)
      next if other_vector.all_zero?

      # Calculate cosine similarity
      cosine_sim = cosine_similarity(target_vector, other_vector)

      # Only consider customers with a minimum similarity
      customer if cosine_sim > 0.3
    end.compact

    similarities
  end

  def cosine_similarity(a, b)
    # Convert Matrix rows to NArray for vector operations
    a_vec = a.to_a.to_na
    b_vec = b.to_a.to_na

    # Handle case where both vectors might be zeros (to avoid division by zero)
    return 0.0 if a_vec.all_zero? || b_vec.all_zero?

    # Calculate dot product
    dot_product = a_vec * b_vec

    # Calculate magnitudes
    a_magnitude = Math.sqrt(a_vec * a_vec)
    b_magnitude = Math.sqrt(b_vec * b_vec)

    # Avoid division by zero
    return 0.0 if a_magnitude.zero? || b_magnitude.zero?

    dot_product / (a_magnitude * b_magnitude)
  end
end
```

2. **Collaborative Filtering**:

```ruby
# lib/olx_partner.rb
require 'httparty'

Dotenv.load

class OlxPartner
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.partner.olx.ua'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['OLX_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['OLX_API_SECRET']
    @auth_token = nil
  end

  # Authenticate with OLX Partner API
  def authenticate
    response = self.class.post('/auth', {

        api_secret: @api_secret
      }.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }

    if response.success?
      @auth_token = Oj.load(response.body)['token']
      true
    else
      handle_error(response)
      false
    end
  end

  # Publish a new ad
  def publish_ad(params)
    ensure_authenticated

    response = self.class.post('/ads', {
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers
    })

    if response.success?
      Oj.load(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
      nil
    end
  end

  # Update an existing ad
  def update_ad(ad_id, params)
    ensure_authenticated

    response = self.class.put("/ads/#{ad_id}", {
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers
    })

    if response.success?
      Oj.load(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
      nil
    end
  end

  # Get ad details
  def get_ad(ad_id)

    response = self.class.get("/ads/#{ad_id}", headers: auth_headers)

    if response.success?
      Oj.load(response.body)
    else
      handle_error(response)
      nil
    end
  end

  # Delete an ad
  def delete_ad(ad_id)

    response = self.class.delete("/ads/#{ad_id}", headers: auth_headers)

    if response.success?
      true
    else
      handle_error(response)
      false
    end
  end

  private

  def ensure_authenticated
    authenticate unless @auth_token
  end

  def auth_headers
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
```

```ruby
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2/JSON/'

  def initialize(api_key)
    @api_key = api_key
    @headers = { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
  end

  # Створення відправлення (етикетки)
  def create_shipment(params)
    body = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      modelName: 'InternetDocument',
      calledMethod: 'save',
      methodProperties: params
    }

    response = self.class.post("", body: body.to_json, headers: @headers)
    parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)

    if parsed_response['success'] == true
      parsed_response['data']
    else
      raise StandardError, "Error creating shipment: #{parsed_response['errors']}"
    end
  rescue => e

  end

  # Приклад параметрів для створення відправлення
  def default_shipment_params
    {
      "PayerType": "Recipient", # Платник (Sender/Recipient/ThirdParty)
      "PaymentMethod": "Cash",  # Спосіб оплати (Cash/NonCash)
      "DateTime": Time.now.utc.iso8601, # Дата та час

      "SenderAddress": "a55e96fa-2673-11e3-8c0a-005056882694",
      "ContactSender": "e55e96fa-2673-11e3-8c0a-005056882694",
      "CityRecipient": "a55e96fa-2673-11e3-8c0a-005056882694", # Код міста отримувача
      "Recipient": "a55e96fa-2673-11e3-8c0a-005056882694",
      "RecipientAddress": "a55e96fa-2673-11e3-8c0a-005056882694",
      "ContactRecipient": "e55e96fa-2673-11e3-8c0a-005056882694",

    }
  end

  # Генерація QR-кода з даними відправлення
  def generate_qr_code(shipment_data)
    qr = RQRCode::QRCode.new(shipment_data.to_json)
    qr.as_png(
      resize_gte_to: false,
      resize_exactly_to: false,
      fill: 'white',
      color: 0,
      size: 300,
      border_modules: 4,
      module_px_size: 6,
      enable_correct_level: true
    )
  end

  # Виведення етикетки у консоль

    puts "===================== ЭТИКЕТКА УКРПОШТИ ====================="

    qr_code = generate_qr_code(shipment_data)

    puts qr_code.to_s
  end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'
require 'json'

Dotenv.load

class GlovoClient
  include HTTParty

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    @base_url = ENV['GLOVO_BASE_URL']
    @headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  # Get available stores/restaurants near a location
  def search_stores(latitude, longitude, query = '')
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/stores/search",
      query: {
        lat: latitude,
        lng: longitude,
        'search-term': query
      },
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get products from a specific store
  def get_products(store_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/stores/#{store_id}/products",
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Create an order
  def create_order(order_params)
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}/v1/orders",
      body: order_params.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
    else
      raise "Glovo API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/models/coupon.rb
class Coupon < ApplicationRecord
  validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :discount_percentage, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0, less_than_or_equal_to: 100 }
  validates :expires_at, date: { after_or_equal_to: :today }, allow_nil: true

  before_create :generate_code

  scope :active, -> { where(active: true) }
  scope :not_expired, -> { where("expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?", Time.current) }

  def generate_code
    self.code ||= SecureRandom.alphanumeric(10).upcase
  end

  def apply_to(cart)
    return false unless active? && not_expired? && !expired?

    CartCoupon.find_or_create_by(cart: cart, coupon: self)
    cart.update_discounts
  end

  def expired?
    !expires_at.nil? && expires_at < Time.current
  end

  def uses_count
    CartCoupon.where(coupon: self).count
  end

  def max_uses_reached?
    max_uses.present? && uses_count >= max_uses
  end
end

# app/models/cart_coupon.rb
class CartCoupon < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :cart
  belongs_to :coupon

  validates :cart, uniqueness: { scope: :coupon }
end
```

### 3. Сервісний об'єкт для обчислення знижки

```ruby
# app/services/cart_discount_calculator.rb
class CartDiscountCalculator
  def initialize(cart)
    @cart = cart
  end

  def calculate_discount
    return 0 if @cart.cart_coupons.empty?

    # Беремо найбільшу доступну знижку
    active_coupons = @cart.cart_coupons.joins(:coupon)
                               .where(coupons: { active: true, expires_at: nil })
                               .or(@cart.cart_coupons.joins(:coupon)
                                      .where("coupons.expires_at > ?", Time.current))

    return 0 if active_coupons.empty?

    # Знаходимо купон з найбільшою знижкою
    max_discount_coupon = active_coupons
                          .order(discount_percentage: :desc)
                          .first

    return 0 unless max_discount_coupon

    max_discount_coupon.coupon.discount_percentage
  end
end
```

### 4. Модель Cart

```ruby
# app/models/cart.rb
class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :cart_items
  has_many :cart_coupons
  has_many :coupons, through: :cart_coupons

  before_save :update_discounts

  def subtotal
    cart_items.sum { |item| item.price * item.quantity }
  end

  def discount_amount
    subtotal * (discount_percentage.to_f / 100)
  end

  def total
    subtotal - discount_amount
  end

  def apply_coupon(coupon_code)
    coupon = Coupon.find_by(code: coupon_code)

    if coupon&.apply_to(self)
      true
    else
      errors.add(:base, "Invalid or expired coupon") if coupon.nil?
      errors.add(:base, "Coupon already used") if coupon && coupon.max_uses_reached?
      false
    end
  end

  def remove_coupon(coupon_code)
    coupon = Coupon.find_by(code: coupon_code)
    cart_coupon = cart_coupons.find_by(coupon: coupon)

    cart_coupon&.destroy
  end

  def update_discounts
    calculator = CartDiscountCalculator.new(self)
    self.discount_percentage = calculator.calculate_discount
    save
  end
end
```

```ruby
        message: "Coupon removed successfully"
      }
    else
      render json: {
        success: false,
        message: "Coupon not found in cart"
      }, status: :not_found
    end
  end

  private

  def set_cart
    @cart = current_cart
  end
end
```

# Ruby Implementation for Glovo API Integration

Here's a complete implementation for ordering a Glovo delivery in Kyiv. This includes the Gemfile and the Ruby code to interact with Glovo's API.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.7'
```

## Implementation

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

class GlovoClient
  include HTTParty

  # Base configuration
  base_uri 'https://sandbox-api.glovoapp.com/v2'
  # For production, use: 'https://api.glovoapp.com/v2'

  # API credentials from environment variables
  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['GLOVO_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}"
    }
  end

  # Get available couriers for delivery
  def get_available_couriers(latitude, longitude)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/courier-service/search",
      query: {
        latitude: latitude,
        longitude: longitude,
        service_point_id: 'kyiv' # You might need to find the actual service point ID for Kyiv
      },
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Create a new delivery order
  def create_delivery_order(order_params)
    response = self.class.post(
      "/deliveries",
      body: order_params.to_json,
      headers: @headers
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Private helper method to handle API responses
  private

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      raise "Glovo API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load your API key from environment variables
  # You should have a .env file with: GLOVO_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

  # Initialize client
  client = GlovoClient.new
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'csv'
require 'logger'
require 'yaml'

# Конфігурація
config = YAML.load_file('config.yml') if File.exist?('config.yml')

class BASExporter
  include HTTParty
  base_uri config['bas_api_url'] || 'https://api.bas.com.ua'

  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO

    # Ініціалізація з конфігурацією
    @auth_token = config['auth_token']
    @company_id = config['company_id']
    @default_currency = config['default_currency'] || 'UAH'
  end

  # Отримання замовлень з вашої бази даних (псевдокод)
  def fetch_orders
    # Тут має бути ваша логіка отримання замовлень
    # Наприклад, з бази даних або іншої системи
    # Приклад даних:
    [
      {
        order_id: 'ORD-001',
        date: '2023-10-15',
        customer: {
          name: 'ТОВ "Приклад"',
          tax_code: '1234567890',
          address: 'м. Київ, вул. Прикладна, 1'
        },
        items: [
          { name: 'Товар 1', quantity: 2, unit_price: 100.00, unit: 'шт', discount: 0.0 },
          { name: 'Товар 2', quantity: 1, unit_price: 250.00, unit: 'шт', discount: 5.0 }
        ],
        total_amount: 350.00,
        payment_terms: 'Готівка',
        delivery_method: 'Самовивіз'
      }
    ]
  end

  # Форматування замовлення для BAS
  def format_order_for_bas(order)
    {
      orderNumber: order[:order_id],
      orderDate: order[:date],
      customer: {
        name: order[:customer][:name],
        taxNumber: order[:customer][:tax_code],
        address: order[:customer][:address]
      },
      items: order[:items].map do |item|
        {
          name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          unitPrice: item[:unit_price],
          unit: item[:unit],
          discount: item[:discount]
        }
      end,
      totalAmount: order[:total_amount],
      currency: @default_currency,
      paymentTerms: order[:payment_terms],
      deliveryMethod: order[:delivery_method]
    }
  end

  # Експорт замовлення до BAS
  def export_order_to_bas(order)
    formatted_order = format_order_for_bas(order)

    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/orders/import',
      body: formatted_order.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json'
      }
    )

    handle_response(response, order)
  end

  # Обробка відповіді від API
  def handle_response(response, order)
    @logger.info "Відправка замовлення #{order[:order_id]}"

    case response.code
    when 200..299
      @logger.info "Замовлення #{order[:order_id]} успішно експортовано. Відповідь: #{response.body}"
      true
    when 400..499
      @logger.error "Помилка клієнта при експорті замовлення #{order[:order_id]}: #{response.body}"
      false
    when 500..599
      @logger.error "Помилка сервера при експорті замовлення #{order[:order_id]}: #{response.body}"
      false
    else
      @logger.error "Неочікувана помилка при експорті замовлення #{order[:order_id]}: #{response.body}"
      false
    end
  end

  # Головний метод для експорту всіх замовлень
  def export_all_orders
    orders = fetch_orders
    success_count = 0
    failure_count = 0

    orders.each do |order|
      if export_order_to_bas(order)
        success_count += 1
      else
        failure_count += 1
      end
    end

    @logger.info "Експорт завершено. Успішно: #{success_count}, Помилки: #{failure_count}"
    { success: success_count, failures: failure_count }
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0

  result = exporter.export_all_orders

  puts "Успішно експортовано: #{result[:success]} замовлень"
  puts "Помилки: #{result[:failures]} замовлень"
end
```

### 1. First, set up environment variables

Create a `.env` file in your Rails root directory:


### 2. Create a BigCommerce service

Create `app/services/bigcommerce_service.rb`:

```ruby
class BigCommerceService
  def initialize
    @client = Bigcommerce::Client.new(
      store_hash: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH'],
      client_id: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_CLIENT_ID'],
      client_secret: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_CLIENT_SECRET'],
      access_token: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN'],
      api_version: ENV['BIGCOMMERCE_API_VERSION']
    )
  end

  # Products
  def create_product(product_params)
    @client.products.create(product_params)
  end

  def update_product(product_id, product_params)
    @client.products.update(product_id, product_params)
  end

  # Orders
  def create_order(order_params)
    @client.orders.create(order_params)
  end

  def get_order(order_id)
    @client.orders.find(order_id)
  end

  # Other BigCommerce API methods can be added here
end
```

### 3. Create a controller to handle product and order creation

Create `app/controllers/bigcommerce_controller.rb`:

```ruby
class BigcommerceController < ApplicationController
  before_action :initialize_bigcommerce_service

  def create_product
    product_params = {
      name: params[:name],
      type: params[:type] || 'physical',
      price: params[:price],
      description: params[:description],
      sku: params[:sku],
      inventory_level: {
        available: params[:inventory_level] || 0
      }
    }

    response = @bigcommerce_service.create_product(product_params)

    if response.success?
      render json: { message: "Product created successfully", product: response.data }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { error: "Failed to create product", details: response.error }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def create_order
    order_params = {
      customer_id: params[:customer_id] || 0,
      status_id: params[:status_id] || 10, # Pending status
      billing_address: {
        first_name: params[:billing_first_name],
        last_name: params[:billing_last_name],
        street_1: params[:billing_street_1],
        city: params[:billing_city],
        state: params[:billing_state],
        zip: params[:billing_zip],
        country: params[:billing_country],
        phone: params[:billing_phone]
      },
      items: [
        {
          product_id: params[:product_id],
          quantity: params[:quantity] || 1
        }
      ]
    }

    response = @bigcommerce_service.create_order(order_params)

    if response.success?
      render json: { message: "Order created successfully", order: response.data }, status: :created
    else
      render json: { error: "Failed to create order", details: response.error }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def initialize_bigcommerce_service
    @bigcommerce_service = BigCommerceService.new
  end
end
```

## Implementation

Here's the Ruby implementation for the OLX Partner API:

```ruby
# lib/olx_partner_api.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'faraday_middleware'
require 'oj'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class OlxPartnerAPI
  # Initialize with API credentials and configuration
  def initialize
    @config = {
      base_url: ENV.fetch('OLX_BASE_URL', 'https://partner-api.olx.ua/v1/'),
      partner_id: ENV.fetch('OLX_PARTNER_ID'),
      api_key: ENV.fetch('OLX_API_KEY'),
      api_secret: ENV.fetch('OLX_API_SECRET'),
      timeout: ENV.fetch('OLX_TIMEOUT', 30).to_i
    }

    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO

    initialize_http_client
  end

  # Create a new advert
  def create_advert(params)
    validate_params(params, :create)
    response = @http_client.post('/adverts') do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = build_request_body(params)
    end

    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Update an existing advert
  def update_advert(advert_id, params)
    validate_params(params, :update)
    response = @http_client.put("/adverts/#{advert_id}") do |req|
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      req.body = build_request_body(params)
    end

    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Get advert details
  def get_advert(advert_id)
    response = @http_client.get("/adverts/#{advert_id}")
    parse_response(response)
  end

  # Get list of adverts
  def list_adverts(params = {})
    query_params = build_query_params(params)
    response = @http_client.get("/adverts?#{query_params}")
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def initialize_http_client
    @http_client = Faraday.new(
      url: @config[:base_url],
      request: {
        timeout: @config[:timeout]
      },
      response: {
        logger: @logger
      }
    ) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :json
      faraday.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
      faraday.response :logger, bodies: true
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end

    @http_client.basic_auth(@config[:partner_id], @config[:api_key])
  end

  def build_request_body(params)
    {
      advert: params
    }.to_json
  end

  def build_query_params(params)
    params.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{URI.encode_www_form_component(v.to_s)}" }.join('&')
  end

  def validate_params(params, operation)
    required_fields = case operation
      when :create then %w[title description category price]
      when :update then %w[advert_id title description category price]
      else []
    end

    missing = required_fields.reject { |f| params.key?(f) || params.include?(f) }
    unless missing.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields for #{operation}: #{missing.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    case response.status
    when 200..299
      Oj.load(response.body)
    when 400..499
      error = Oj.load(response.body)
      raise ClientError, error['error']['message'] || 'Client error'
    when 500..599
      raise ServerError, 'Server error'
    else
      raise APIError, "Unexpected response status: #{response.status}"
    end
  rescue Oj::ParseError
    raise APIError, "Failed to parse response: #{response.body}"
  end

  # Custom error classes
  class APIError < StandardError; end;
  class ClientError < APIError; end;
  class ServerError < APIError; end;
end
```

# Collaborative Filtering for Product Recommendations in Ruby

Here's a complete implementation for a product recommendation system using collaborative filtering, starting with the Gemfile and then the implementation code.

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

# Core dependencies
gem 'nmatrix', '~> 0.1.2'
gem 'matrix', '~> 2.4.4'
gem 'numo-narray', '~> 1.0.0'  # For numerical computations

# Data processing and serialization
gem 'sqlite3', '~> 1.4'
gem 'json', '~> 2.5'
gem 'csv', '~> 3.1'  # For data import

# Utility gems
gem 'benchmark', '~> 0.2.0'  # For performance measurement
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# lib/product_recommender.rb
require 'nmatrix'
require 'matrix'
require 'numo/narray'
require 'json'
require 'sqlite3'
require 'csv'
require 'benchmark'

module ProductRecommender
  class CollaborativeFilter
    def initialize(db_path: 'products.db')
      @db_path = db_path
      setup_database unless File.exist?(@db_path)
    end

    def recommend_for_user(user_id, k = 5)
      # Get user's past orders
      user_orders = fetch_user_orders(user_id)

      return [] if user_orders.empty?

      # Get all other users and their orders
      all_users = fetch_all_users(user_id)
      user_items = all_users.map { |u| fetch_user_orders(u[:id]).map(&:to_i) }

      # Create user-item matrix
      all_items = fetch_all_items
      user_item_matrix = build_user_item_matrix(user_items, all_items)

      # Calculate similarity scores (Pearson correlation)
      similarities = calculate_similarities(user_item_matrix)

      # Find most similar users
      similar_users = find_most_similar_users(similarities, user_id)

      # Get recommendations
      recommendations = generate_recommendations(user_orders, similar_users, all_items, k)

      recommendations
    end

    private

    def setup_database
      DB = SQLite3::Database.new(@db_path)

      DB.execute <<-SQL
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          user_id INTEGER,
          product_id INTEGER,
          created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
      SQL

      DB.execute <<-SQL
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          name TEXT,
          description TEXT,
          category TEXT
        );
      SQL
    ensure
      DB.close unless DB.closed?
    end

    def fetch_user_orders(user_id)
      DB = SQLite3::Database.new(@db_path)
      result = DB.execute("SELECT product_id FROM orders WHERE user_id = ?", [user_id])
      result.map { |row| row[0] }
    ensure
      DB.close unless DB.closed?
    end

    def fetch_all_users(exclude_user_id)
      DB = SQLite3::Database.new(@db_path)
      result = DB.execute("SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE user_id != ?", [exclude_user_id])
      result.map { |row| { id: row[0] } }
    ensure
      DB.close unless DB.closed?
    end

    def fetch_all_items
      DB = SQLite3::Database.new(@db_path)
      result = DB.execute("SELECT id FROM products")
      result.map { |row| row[0] }
    ensure
      DB.close unless DB.closed?
    end

    def build_user_item_matrix(user_items, all_items)
      matrix = Numo::DFloat.zeros([user_items.size, all_items.size])

      user_items.each_with_index do |items, user_idx|
        items.each do |item_id|
          item_idx = all_items.index(item_id)
          matrix[user_idx, item_idx] = 1.0 if item_idx
        end
      end

      matrix
    end

    def calculate_similarities(matrix)
      # Center the data (subtract mean for each user)
      centered = matrix - Numo::DFloat.mean(matrix, axis: 1).reshape(-1, 1)

      # Calculate Pearson correlation between all users
      similarities = Numo::DFloat.zeros([matrix.shape[0], matrix.shape[0]])

      (0...matrix.shape[0]).each do |i|
        (0...matrix.shape[0]).each do |j|
          next if i == j

          # Calculate Pearson correlation
          numerator = Numo::DFloat.dot(centered[i, :], centered[j, :])
          si = Numo::DFloat.sqrt(Numo::DFloat.sum(centered[i, :] ** 2))
          sj = Numo::DFloat.sqrt(Numo::DFloat.sum(centered[j, :] ** 2))

          similarity = numerator / (si * sj) if si > 0 && sj > 0
          similarities[i, j] = similarity
        end
      end

      similarities
    end

    def find_most_similar_users(similarities, user_id)
      all_users = fetch_all_users(user_id)
      user_index = all_users.index { |u| u[:id] == user_id }

      return [] unless user_index

      # Get similarities for the target user
      user_similarities = similarities[user_index, :]

      # Sort users by similarity (descending)
      sorted_users = all_users.each_with_index.sort_by { |_, idx| -user_similarities[idx] }

      # Return the most similar users (excluding themselves)
      sorted_users[1..5].map { |u, _| u }
    end

    def generate_recommendations(user_orders, similar_users, all_items, k)
      # Get all items purchased by similar users
      recommendations = []

      similar_users.each do |user|
        user_orders = fetch_user_orders(user[:id])
        user_orders.each do |item_id|
          next if user_orders.include?(item_id)  # Skip items user already purchased

          # Get or create recommendation entry
          existing = recommendations.find { |r| r[:product_id] == item_id }
          if existing
            existing[:score] += 1
          else
            recommendations << {
              product_id: item_id,
              score: 1
            }
          end
        end
      end

      # Sort by score and return top k recommendations
      recommendations.sort_by { |r| -r[:score] }.first(k)
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Sample data setup
  db = SQLite3::Database.new('products.db')

  # Clear existing data
  db.execute('DELETE FROM orders')
  db.execute('DELETE FROM products')

  # Insert sample products
  products = [
    { name: 'Laptop', category: 'Electronics' },
    { name: 'Smartphone', category: 'Electronics' },
    { name: 'Headphones', category: 'Electronics' },
    { name: 'Desk Chair', category: 'Furniture' },
    { name: 'Monitor', category: 'Electronics' },
    { name: 'Keyboard', category: 'Electronics' },
    { name: 'Mouse', category: 'Electronics' },
    { name: 'Bookshelf', category: 'Furniture' }
  ]

  products.each do |p|
    db.execute('INSERT INTO products (name, category) VALUES (?, ?)', [p[:name], p[:category]])
  end

  # Insert sample orders (user_id, product_id)
  orders = [
    [1, 1], [1, 2], [1, 3],  # User 1 ordered Laptop, Smartphone, Headphones
    [2, 1], [2, 4], [2, 5],  # User 2 ordered Laptop, Desk Chair, Monitor
    [3, 2], [3, 6], [3, 7],  # User 3 ordered Smartphone, Keyboard, Mouse
    [4, 1], [4, 3], [4, 5],  # User 4 ordered Laptop, Headphones, Monitor
    [1, 6], [1, 7]          # User 1 also ordered Keyboard and Mouse
  ]

  orders.each do |user_id, product_id|
    db.execute('INSERT INTO orders (user_id, product_id) VALUES (?, ?)', [user_id, product_id])
  end

  db.close

  # Initialize and use the recommender
  recommender = ProductRecommender::CollaborativeFilter.new

  puts "Recommendations for user 1 (who bought laptop, smartphone, headphones, keyboard, mouse):"
  recommendations = recommender.recommend_for_user(1, 3)
  recommendations.each do |rec|
    puts "- Product ID: #{rec[:product_id]} (Score: #{rec[:score]})"
  end
end
```

## How It Works

1. **Database Setup**: The system uses SQLite to store product and order data.

2. **Collaborative Filtering**:
   - Builds a user-item matrix where rows represent users and columns represent products
   - Uses Pearson correlation to calculate similarity between users
   - Recommends items purchased by similar users that the target user hasn't bought yet

3. **Key Methods**:
   - `recommend_for_user`: Main method that generates recommendations
   - `build_user_item_matrix`: Creates the matrix for similarity calculations
   - `calculate_similarities`: Computes Pearson correlation between users
   - `generate_recommendations`: Aggregates recommendations from similar users

4. **Example Usage**: The script includes sample data setup and demonstrates recommendations for a user.

To use this in a real application, you would:
1. Add your actual product and order data
2. Adjust the database schema as needed
3. Potentially add caching for better performance
4. Consider adding more sophisticated similarity measures or hybrid approaches

```ruby
# lib/olx_ukraine_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class OLXUkraineAPI
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.olx.ua/v1'

  # Initialize with API credentials
  def initialize
    @auth_token = ENV['OLX_API_AUTH_TOKEN']
    @partner_id = ENV['OLX_API_PARTNER_ID']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  # Create a new advert
  def create_advert(advert_params)
    validate_required_params! advert_params

    response = self.class.post(
      '/adverts',
      body: advert_params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Partner-Id' => @partner_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Update an existing advert
  def update_advert(advert_id, advert_params)
    response = self.class.patch(
      "/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      body: advert_params.to_json,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Partner-Id' => @partner_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Get advert details
  def get_advert(advert_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Partner-Id' => @partner_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # List adverts (with optional filters)
  def list_adverts(filters = {})
    query_params = {
      limit: 100,
      offset: 0
    }.merge(filters)

    response = self.class.get(
      '/adverts',
      query: query_params,
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Partner-Id' => @partner_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  # Delete an advert
  def delete_advert(advert_id)
    response = self.class.delete(
      "/adverts/#{advert_id}",
      headers: {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
        'X-Partner-Id' => @partner_id
      }
    )

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_required_params!(params)
    required_fields = %w[title price category_id description]
    missing_fields = required_fields - params.keys

    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    @logger.info "API Response: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"

    case response.code
    when 200..299
      response.parsed_response
    when 400
      raise OLXAPIError, "Bad request: #{response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body}"
    when 401
      raise OLXAPIError, "Unauthorized: #{response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body}"
    when 404
      raise OLXAPIError, "Not found: #{response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body}"
    when 422
      raise OLXAPIError, "Unprocessable entity: #{response.parsed_response['error'] || response.body}"
    else
      raise OLXAPIError, "API request failed with status #{response.code}: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Custom error class
class OLXAPIError < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml_generator.rb
require 'commerce_ml'

class CommerceMLGenerator
  def initialize(products, orders, catalog_name = 'Shop Catalog')
    @products = products
    @orders = orders
    @catalog_name = catalog_name
  end

  def generate
    catalog = CommerceML::Catalog.new(name: @catalog_name, date: Time.current)

    # Add products
    @products.each do |product|
      catalog.add_product(
        id: product.code,
        name: product.name,
        price: product.price.to_f,
        quantity: product.stock_quantity,
        description: product.description,
        vendor_code: product.vendor_code
      )
    end

    # Add orders
    @orders.each do |order|
      catalog.add_order(
        id: order.order_number,
        date: order.created_at,
        status: order.status,
        total: order.total_amount.to_f,
        customer: order.customer_name,
        items: order.order_items.map do |item|
          {
            product_id: item.product_code,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price: item.unit_price.to_f
          }
        end
      )
    end

    catalog.to_xml
  end
end
```

### 3. CommerceML Parser

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml_parser.rb
require 'commerce_ml'
require 'nokogiri'

class CommerceMLParser
  def initialize(xml_content)
    @xml_content = xml_content
  end

  def parse
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(@xml_content)
    catalog = CommerceML::Catalog.from_xml(doc)

    {
      products: parse_products(catalog),
      orders: parse_orders(catalog)
    }
  end

  private

  def parse_products(catalog)
    catalog.products.map do |product|
      {
        code: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        price: product.price,
        quantity: product.quantity,
        description: product.description,
        vendor_code: product.vendor_code
      }
    end
  end

  def parse_orders(catalog)
    catalog.orders.map do |order|
      {
        order_number: order.id,
        date: order.date,
        status: order.status,
        total: order.total,
        customer: order.customer,
        items: order.items.map do |item|
          {
            product_code: item.product_id,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            unit_price: item.price
          }
        end
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Controller for Exchange

```ruby
# app/controllers/commerce_ml_controller.rb
class CommerceMLController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  def upload
    if params[:file].present?
      parser = CommerceMLParser.new(params[:file].read)
      result = parser.parse

      # Process products
      result[:products].each do |product_data|
        product = Product.find_or_initialize_by(code: product_data[:code])
        product.update!(
          name: product_data[:name],
          price: product_data[:price],
          stock_quantity: product_data[:quantity],
          description: product_data[:description],
          vendor_code: product_data[:vendor_code]
        )
      end

      # Process orders
      result[:orders].each do |order_data|
        order = Order.find_or_initialize_by(order_number: order_data[:order_number])
        order.update!(
          status: order_data[:status],
          total_amount: order_data[:total],
          customer_name: order_data[:customer],
          created_at: order_data[:date]
        )

        # Handle order items
        order_data[:items].each do |item|
          order.order_items.find_or_create_by!(
            product_code: item[:product_code],
            quantity: item[:quantity],
            unit_price: item[:unit_price]
          )
        end
      end

      render json: { status: 'success', processed_products: result[:products].size, processed_orders: result[:orders].size }
    else
      render json: { status: 'error', message: 'No file uploaded' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def download
    products = Product.all
    orders = Order.all

    generator = CommerceMLGenerator.new(products, orders)
    xml = generator.generate

    send_data xml, type: 'application/xml', disposition: 'attachment', filename: "commerce_ml_export_#{Time.current.to_i}.xml"
  end
end
```

## Implementation Code

```ruby
# lib/bas_exporter.rb
require 'csv'
require 'httparty'
require 'date'

class BASExporter
  # Configuration options
  attr_accessor :api_endpoint, :auth_token, :tax_number, :company_name

  # Initialize with configuration
  def initialize(options = {})
    @api_endpoint = options[:api_endpoint] || ENV['BAS_API_ENDPOINT']
    @auth_token = options[:auth_token] || ENV['BAS_AUTH_TOKEN']
    @tax_number = options[:tax_number] || ENV['BAS_TAX_NUMBER']
    @company_name = options[:company_name] || ENV['BAS_COMPANY_NAME']
    @default_currency = options[:default_currency] || 'UAH'
    @default_language = options[:default_language] || 'uk'
  end

  # Main method to export orders to BAS
  def export_orders(orders, options = {})
    validate_configuration!

    # Prepare the data structure for BAS
    bas_data = prepare_bas_data(orders, options)

    # Choose the export format based on BAS requirements
    format = options[:format] || detect_export_format

    case format.downcase
    when 'csv'
      export_to_csv(bas_data, options)
    when 'xml'
      export_to_xml(bas_data, options)
    when 'api'
      export_via_api(bas_data, options)
    else
      raise "Unsupported export format: #{format}"
    end
  end

  private

  # Validate configuration before export
  def validate_configuration!
    raise 'API endpoint is required' unless @api_endpoint
    raise 'Authentication token is required' unless @auth_token
    raise 'Tax number is required' unless @tax_number
    raise 'Company name is required' unless @company_name
  end

  # Prepare data in the format expected by BAS
  def prepare_bas_data(orders, options)
    {
      company: {
        tax_number: @tax_number,
        name: @company_name,
        language: @default_language
      },
      orders: orders.map do |order|
        {
          order_number: order.order_number,
          date: format_date(order.date),
          customer: format_customer(order.customer),
          items: format_items(order.items),
          totals: format_totals(order),
          notes: order.notes
        }
      end
    }
  end

  # Format date for BAS
  def format_date(date)
    date.is_a?(Date) ? date.iso8601 : date.to_s
  end

  # Format customer information
  def format_customer(customer)
    {
      name: customer.name,
      tax_number: customer.tax_number,
      address: customer.address,
      phone: customer.phone
    }
  end

  # Format order items
  def format_items(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        product_code: item.product_code,
        name: item.name,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit_price: item.unit_price,
        tax_rate: item.tax_rate || 20.0, # Default VAT rate in Ukraine
        discount: item.discount || 0.0
      }
    end
  end

  # Calculate and format totals
  def format_totals(order)
    subtotal = order.items.sum { |i| i.quantity * i.unit_price }
    discount = order.items.sum { |i| i.quantity * (i.unit_price * (i.discount.to_f / 100.0)) }
    vat = (subtotal - discount) * (order.items.first.tax_rate.to_f / 100.0) # Simplified VAT calculation

    {
      subtotal: subtotal,
      discount: discount,
      vat: vat,
      total: subtotal - discount + vat
    }
  end

  # Detect export format from configuration or options
  def detect_export_format
    ENV['BAS_EXPORT_FORMAT'] || 'csv'
  end

  # Export to CSV format
  def export_to_csv(data, options)
    filename = options[:filename] || "bas_export_#{Date.today}.csv"

    CSV.open(filename, 'wb') do |csv|
      # Write header
      csv << ['Company Tax Number', 'Company Name', 'Order Number', 'Order Date',
              'Customer Name', 'Customer Tax Number', 'Item Name',
              'Quantity', 'Unit Price', 'Tax Rate', 'Total Price']

      data[:orders].each do |order|
        order[:items].each do |item|
          csv << [
            data[:company][:tax_number],
            data[:company][:name],
            order[:order_number],
            order[:date],
            order[:customer][:name],
            order[:customer][:tax_number],
            item[:name],
            item[:quantity],
            item[:unit_price],
            item[:tax_rate],
            (item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price]).round(2)
          ]
        end
      end
    end

    puts "Successfully exported to #{filename}"
    filename
  end

  # Export to XML format
  def export_to_xml(data, options)
    require 'builder'

    filename = options[:filename] || "bas_export_#{Date.today}.xml"
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)

    File.open(filename, 'w') do |file|
      file.write(builder.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8')
      file.write(builder.bas_export do
        builder.company do
          builder.tax_number data[:company][:tax_number]
          builder.name data[:company][:name]
        end

        data[:orders].each do |order|
          builder.order do
            builder.order_number order[:order_number]
            builder.date order[:date]

            builder.customer do
              builder.name order[:customer][:name]
              builder.tax_number order[:customer][:tax_number]
              builder.address order[:customer][:address]
              builder.phone order[:customer][:phone]
            end

            builder.items do
              order[:items].each do |item|
                builder.item do
                  builder.product_code item[:product_code]
                  builder.name item[:name]
                  builder.quantity item[:quantity]
                  builder.unit_price item[:unit_price]
                  builder.tax_rate item[:tax_rate]
                  builder.discount item[:discount]
                end
              end
            end

            builder.totals do
              builder.subtotal order[:totals][:subtotal]
              builder.discount order[:totals][:discount]
              builder.vat order[:totals][:vat]
              builder.total order[:totals][:total]
            end

            builder.notes order[:notes] if order[:notes].present?
          end
        end
      end)
    end

    puts "Successfully exported to #{filename}"
    filename
  end

  # Export via API
  def export_via_api(data, options)
    headers = {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@auth_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      @api_endpoint,
      body: data.to_json,
      headers: headers
    )

    if response.success?
      puts "Successfully exported to BAS via API"
      response
    else
      raise "API export failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# lib/bas_exporter.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'logger'
require 'tzinfo'
require 'iso_country_codes'

class BASExporter
  # Configuration constants
  BAS_API_URL = 'https://api.bas.ua/v1'.freeze
  BAS_TIMEOUT = 30.seconds.freeze
  DEFAULT_ENCODING = 'UTF-8'.freeze

  attr_reader :logger, :config

  def initialize(config = {})
    @config = {
      api_key: ENV['BAS_API_KEY'],
      api_secret: ENV['BAS_API_SECRET'],
      timeout: BAS_TIMEOUT,
      encoding: DEFAULT_ENCODING,
      test_mode: ENV['BAS_TEST_MODE'] || false
    }.merge(config)

    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  # Main method to export orders to BAS
  def export_orders(orders)
    return unless valid_orders?(orders)

    orders.each do |order|
      begin
        export_order(order)
      rescue StandardError => e
        logger.error("Failed to export order #{order.id}: #{e.message}")
        next
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def export_order(order)
    xml_payload = build_bas_xml(order)
    response = post_to_bas(xml_payload)

    if response.success?
      logger.info("Successfully exported order #{order.id} to BAS")
      order.update(bas_exported: true, bas_export_date: Time.current)
    else
      logger.error("Failed to export order #{order.id} to BAS: #{response.body}")
      raise "BAS Export Failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def build_bas_xml(order)
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: config[:encoding]) do |xml|
      xml.BASExportRequest do
        xml.Version('1.0')
        xml.Timestamp(Time.now.utc.iso8601)
        xml.Order do
          xml.OrderID(order.id.to_s)
          xml.ExternalID(order.external_reference || 'N/A')
          xml.Date(order.created_at.utc.iso8601)
          xml.Customer do
            xml.Name(order.customer_name)
            xml.TaxID(order.customer_tax_id) if order.customer_tax_id.present?
            xml.Address do
              xml.Street(order.customer_address.street)
              xml.City(order.customer_address.city)
              xml.Region(order.customer_address.region)
              xml.PostalCode(order.customer_address.postal_code)
              xml.Country(ISO3166::Country.find_country_by_name('Ukraine').alpha2)
            end
            xml.ContactPerson(order.customer_contact_person) if order.customer_contact_person.present?
            xml.Email(order.customer_email) if order.customer_email.present?
            xml.Phone(order.customer_phone) if order.customer_phone.present?
          end
          xml.Items do
            order.line_items.each do |item|
              xml.Item do
                xml.ProductID(item.product_id.to_s)
                xml.Name(item.product_name)
                xml.Description(item.product_description)
                xml.Quantity(item.quantity.to_s)
                xml.Unit(item.unit || 'PC')
                xml.Price(item.unit_price.to_s)
                xml.Discount(item.discount || '0.0')
                xml.TaxRate(item.tax_rate.to_s) if item.tax_rate.present?
                xml.Total(item.line_total.to_s)
              end
            end
          end
          xml.Summary do
            xml.Subtotal(order.subtotal.to_s)
            xml.Tax(order.tax_total.to_s) if order.tax_total.present?
            xml.Discount(order.discount_total.to_s) if order.discount_total.present?
            xml.Total(order.total.to_s)
          end
          xml.Payment do
            xml.Method(order.payment_method || 'CASH')
            xml.Status(order.payment_status || 'PENDING')
          end
          xml.Shipping do
            xml.Method(order.shipping_method || 'PICKUP')
            xml.Cost(order.shipping_cost.to_s) if order.shipping_cost.present?
          end
        end
      end
    end

    builder.to_xml
  end

  def post_to_bas(xml_payload)
    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
      'X-API-KEY' => config[:api_key],
      'X-API-SECRET' => config[:api_secret]
    }

    options = {
      body: xml_payload,
      headers: headers,
      timeout: config[:timeout]
    }

    HTTParty.post(
      "#{BAS_API_URL}/orders#{config[:test_mode] ? '/test' : ''}",
      options
    )
  end

  def valid_orders?(orders)
    return false if orders.blank?
    orders.all? { |order| valid_order?(order) }
  end

  def valid_order?(order)
    !order.nil? &&
      order.respond_to?(:id) &&
      order.respond_to?(:customer_name) &&
      order.respond_to?(:created_at) &&
```
