```ruby
# lib/privatbank_installment_service.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'i18n'

# Configuration module
module PrivatbankInstallment
  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :merchant_id, :merchant_password,
                  :installment_url, :callback_url,
                  :api_version, :supported_currencies

    def initialize
      @supported_currencies = ['UAH', 'USD', 'EUR']
      @api_version = '1.2'
    end
  end

  def self.configure
    yield(configuration)
  end

  def self.configuration
    @configuration ||= Configuration.new
  end
end

# Main service class
class PrivatbankInstallmentService
  include HTTParty
  include I18n

  base_uri PrivatbankInstallment.configuration.installment_url

  # Initialize with order details
  def initialize(order, customer)
    @order = order
    @customer = customer
    @merchant_id = PrivatbankInstallment.configuration.merchant_id
    @merchant_password = PrivatbankInstallment.configuration.merchant_password
  end

  # Create an installment payment request
  def create_installment(payment_plan)
    validate_input(payment_plan)

    request_data = build_request_data(payment_plan)
    response = self.class.post('/api/payments/installments', body: request_data)

    handle_response(response)
  end

  private

  def validate_input(payment_plan)
    unless payment_plan[:installments] && payment_plan[:installments].positive?
      raise ArgumentError, I18n.t('errors.invalid_installment_count')
    end

    unless payment_plan[:first_payment_percentage] && payment_plan[:first_payment_percentage].between?(10, 100)
      raise ArgumentError, I18n.t('errors.invalid_first_payment_percentage')
    end

    unless @order.amount.positive?
      raise ArgumentError, I18n.t('errors.invalid_order_amount')
    end
  end

  def build_request_data(payment_plan)
    {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      merchant_password: generate_merchant_password_hash,
      order_id: @order.id,
      amount: @order.amount,
      currency: @order.currency,
      customer: {
        email: @customer.email,
        phone: @customer.phone,
        first_name: @customer.first_name,
        last_name: @customer.last_name
      },
      installment_plan: {
        installments: payment_plan[:installments],
        first_payment_percentage: payment_plan[:first_payment_percentage],
        interval_days: payment_plan[:interval_days] || 30,
        start_date: payment_plan[:start_date] || Date.today.to_s
      },
      callback_url: PrivatbankInstallment.configuration.callback_url
    }
  end

  def generate_merchant_password_hash
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{@merchant_password}#{@order.id}#{Time.now.to_i}")
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    if response.code == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      error_message = JSON.parse(response.body)['error'] || I18n.t('errors.generic_payment_error')
      raise PrivabankPaymentError, error_message
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
    state :awaiting_payment
    state :paid
    state :overdue
    state :partially_paid
    state :void

    event :mark_as_awaiting_payment do
      transitions from: :draft, to: :awaiting_payment
    end

    event :mark_as_paid do
      transitions from: [:awaiting_payment, :overdue, :partially_paid], to: :paid
    end

    event :mark_as_overdue do
      transitions from: :awaiting_payment, to: :overdue
    end

    event :mark_as_partially_paid do
      transitions from: :awaiting_payment, to: :partially_paid
    end

    event :mark_as_void do
      transitions from: [:draft, :awaiting_payment, :overdue, :partially_paid], to: :void
    end
  end

  def sync_to_xero
    XeroInvoiceSyncWorker.perform_async(id)
  end

  def sync_payment_status
    XeroPaymentSyncWorker.perform_async(id)
  end
end
```

```ruby
class XeroInvoiceSyncWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options retry: 3, queue: :xero_sync

  def perform(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)

    return if invoice.syncing? || invoice.synced?

    invoice.update!(sync_status: :syncing)

    xero_invoice = build_xero_invoice(invoice)

    begin
      client = Xero::Client.new
      response = client.put_invoice(xero_invoice)

      invoice.update!(
        sync_status: :synced,
        xero_id: response.invoices.first.invoice_id,
        sync_updated_at: Time.current
      )

      invoice.mark_as_awaiting_payment
    rescue StandardError => e
      invoice.update!(
        sync_status: :sync_failed,
        sync_error: e.message,
        sync_updated_at: Time.current
      )

      # Retry in 5 minutes
      XeroInvoiceSyncWorker.perform_in(5.minutes, invoice_id)
      raise
    end
  end

  private

  def build_xero_invoice(invoice)
    {
      Type: 'ACCPAY',
      InvoiceNumber: invoice.number,
      Reference: invoice.reference,
      Date: invoice.issue_date.to_date.to_s,
      DueDate: invoice.due_date.to_date.to_s,
      LineItems: build_line_items(invoice),
      TotalTax: invoice.tax_amount,
      SubTotal: invoice.subtotal,
      Total: invoice.total_amount,
      Contact: {
        ContactID: " #{invoice.customer_xero_id}",
        Name: invoice.customer_name
      }
    }
  end

  def build_line_items(invoice)
    invoice.line_items.map do |item|
      {
        Description: item.description,
        Quantity: item.quantity,
        UnitAmount: item.unit_price,
        AccountCode: item.account_code,
        TaxType: item.tax_type,
        LineAmount: item.total_amount
      }
    end
  end
end
```

### Xero Payment Sync Worker (app/workers/xero_payment_sync_worker.rb)

```ruby
class XeroPaymentSyncWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker
  sidekiq_options retry: 3, queue: :xero_sync

  def perform(invoice_id)
    invoice = Invoice.find(invoice_id)

    return unless invoice.synced? && invoice.xero_id.present?

    client = Xero::Client.new

    begin
      payments = client.get_payments(invoice:xero_id)

      if payments.any?
        total_paid = payments.sum(&:Amount)

        if total_paid >= invoice.total_amount
          invoice.mark_as_paid
        elsif total_paid > 0
          invoice.mark_as_partially_paid
        else
          if invoice.due_date < Date.current
            invoice.mark_as_overdue
          else
            invoice.mark_as_awaiting_payment
          end
        end

        # Update payments in the system
        payments.each do |payment|
          Payment.find_or_create_by(
            xero_id: payment.PaymentID,
            invoice_id: invoice.id,
            amount: payment.Amount,
            payment_date: payment.Date,
            status: :processed
          )
        end
      else
        if invoice.due_date < Date.current
          invoice.mark_as_overdue
        else
          invoice.mark_as_awaiting_payment
        end
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      invoice.update!(sync_status: :sync_failed, sync_error: e.message)
      raise
    end
  end
end
```

### Xero Client Service (app/services/xero/client.rb)

```ruby
module Xero
  class Client
    include ConnectionPool::Wrapper

    def initialize
      @config = Rails.application.config.xero
      @connection = create_connection
    end

    def put_invoice(invoice)
      response = @connection.put("#{@config[:api_endpoint]}/Invoices", invoice.to_json)
      handle_response(response)
    end

    def get_payments(invoice:)
      query = URI.encode_www_form(invoice: invoice)
      response = @connection.get("#{@config[:api_endpoint]}/Payments?#{query}")
      handle_response(response)
    end

    private

    def create_connection
      ConnectionPool.new(size: 5, timeout: 5) do
        Faraday.new(
          url: @config[:api_endpoint],
          headers: {
            'Authorization' => "Bearer #{get_access_token}",
            'Xero-Tenant-Id' => get_tenant_id,
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json'
          }
        ) do |f|
          f.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
          f.request :json
          f.response :json, content_type: 'application/json'
          f.response :raise_error
        end
      end
    end

    def get_access_token
      token = OAuthToken.find_by(provider: 'xero')
      raise "No Xero token found" unless token

      if token.expires_at < Time.current
        token.refresh!
        token.reload
      end

      token.access_token
    end

    def get_tenant_id
      # Get this from your configuration or OAuth flow
      Rails.application.config.xero[:tenant_id] || ENV['XERO_TENANT_ID']
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200..299 then response.body
      when 400..499 then raise Xero::ClientError.new(response.body)
      when 500..599 then raise Xero::ServerError.new(response.body)
      else raise Xero::UnknownError.new(response.body)
      end
    end
  end

  class ClientError < StandardError; end
  class ServerError < StandardError; end
  class UnknownError < StandardError; end
end
```

```ruby
class OAuthToken < ApplicationRecord

  validates :provider, :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_in, presence: true

  def refresh!
    client = OAuth2::Client.new(
      Rails.application.config.xero[:client_id],
      Rails.application.config.xero[:client_secret],
      site: Rails.application.config.xero[:auth_endpoint],
      token_url: Rails.application.config.xero[:token_endpoint]
    )

    token = OAuth2::AccessToken.new(client, refresh_token, expires_in: expires_in)

    refresh_response = token.refresh!

    update!(
      access_token: refresh_response.token,
      refresh_token: refresh_response.refresh_token,
      expires_at: Time.current + refresh_response.expires_in.seconds
    )
  end
end
```

1. Create an invoice in your Rails app
2. The `create` action will trigger `sync_to_xero` which enqueues a job
3. The worker will push the invoice to Xero

5. The payment status will be updated accordingly

### 2. Реалізація коду (app.rb)
```ruby
# app.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'logger'

class PrivatBankPayment
  include HTTParty

  # Базовий URL API ПриватБанку
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.privatbank.ua'.freeze

  # Клас для логірування (опціонально)
  def self.logger
    @logger ||= Logger.new(STDOUT)
  end

  # Ініціалізація з параметрами замовлення
  def initialize(order_details)
    @order_id = order_details[:order_id] || SecureRandom.uuid
    @amount = order_details[:amount] # Загальна сума замовлення
    @currency = order_details[:currency] || 'UAH' # Валюта
    @parts = order_details[:parts] || 1 # Кількість частин оплати
    @merchant_id = order_details[:merchant_id] || 'YOUR_MERCHANT_ID' # ID продавця
    @secret_key = order_details[:secret_key] || 'YOUR_SECRET_KEY' # Секретний ключ
  end

  # Створення посилання на оплату частинами
  def create_payment_link
    # Розраховуємо суму кожної частини
    part_amount = (@amount.to_f / @parts).round(2)

    # Генерація унікального ідентифікатора платежу
    payment_id = SecureRandom.uuid

    # Параметри для запиту до API ПриватБанку
    payment_params = {
      merchant_id: @merchant_id,
      order_id: @order_id,
      amount: part_amount,
      currency: @currency,
      payment_id: payment_id,
      parts: @parts,
      description: "Оплатіть частину замовлення #{@order_id}",
      return_url: "https://your-shop.com/payment_success", # URL для успішного завершення
      server_url: "https://your-shop.com/payment_callback"  # URL для Callback від ПриватБанку
    }

    # Підписання запиту (залежно від вимог ПриватБанку)
    payment_params[:signature] = generate_signature(payment_params)

    # Відправка запиту до API ПриватБанку
    response = self.class.post("#{BASE_URL}/p24api/rest_payment", body: payment_params.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' })

    if response.success?
      result = JSON.parse(response.body)
      logger.info("Платежне посилання успішно створено: #{result['payment_link']}")
      result['payment_link']
    else
      logger.error("Помилка при створенні платежного посилання: #{response.body}")
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  # Генерація підпису (залежно від вимог API)
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Приклад генерації підпису (може змінюватись залежно від документації)
    data_to_sign = [params[:merchant_id], params[:order_id], params[:amount], params[:currency], params[:payment_id]].join(';')
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(data_to_sign + @secret_key)
  end
end
```

Okay, let's craft a Ruby solution using Rails and ActiveRecord to handle monetary values accurately, avoiding floating-point issues, and providing formatting capabilities. **Gemfile** ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'rails', '~> 7.0' # Adjust to your Rails version gem 'pg' # Or your database gem (mysql, sqlite3, etc.) gem 'money' gem 'number_to_currency' ``` **Explanation of Gems:** * `rails`: The core Rails framework. * `pg`: PostgreSQL adapter (adjust if using a different database). * `money`: A Ruby gem designed specifically for handling money in a precise way, avoiding floating-point errors. It uses decimal types internally. * `number_to_currency`: A Rails helper that can format numbers as currency. **Implementation (Rails Model, Controller, and View)** 1. **Create the Model (e.g., `app/models/transaction.rb`)** ```ruby class Transaction < ApplicationRecord monetize :amount, with: Money validates :amount, presence: true validates :currency, presence: true end ``` **Explanation:** * `monetize :amount, with: Money`: This is the key line. It tells ActiveRecord to treat the `amount` attribute as a `Money` object from the `money` gem. **Implementation (currency_converter.rb)**

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'date'
require 'active_support/core_ext/date'
require 'active_support/cache/memory_store'

class CurrencyConverter
  CACHE_EXPIRY = 1.day # Cache rates for 1 day

  def initialize(cache_store = ActiveSupport::Cache::MemoryStore.new)
    @cache_store = cache_store
  end

  def fetch_exchange_rates
    today = Date.today
    cache_key = "ecb_exchange_rates_#{today.to_s}"

    # Try to retrieve from cache
    rates = @cache_store.fetch(cache_key, expires_in: CACHE_EXPIRY) do
      puts "Fetching rates from ECB..." # for demonstration
      ecb_rates_from_api
    end
    rates
  end

  private

  def ecb_rates_from_api
    response = HTTParty.get('https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref.xml')

    if response.code == 200
      parse_xml(response.body)
    else
      raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates from ECB: #{response.code}"
    end
  end

  def parse_xml(xml_data)
    require 'xmlsimple'  # This needs to be here as it is not a core ruby lib

    parsed_xml = XMLSimple.parse(xml_data)

    rates = {}
    parsed_xml['gesamt']['Cube']['Cube'].each do |cube|
      currency = cube['currency']
      rate = cube['rate'].to_f
      rates[currency] = rate
    end
    rates
  end
end

# Example Usage
converter = CurrencyConverter.new
rates = converter.fetch_exchange_rates

if rates
  puts "Exchange Rates:"
  rates.each { |currency, rate| puts "#{currency}: #{rate}" }

  # Convert an amount
  amount = 100.0
  from_currency = 'USD'
  to_currency = 'EUR'

  if rates.key?(from_currency) && rates.key?(to_currency)
    exchange_rate = rates[from_currency] / rates[to_currency]
    converted_amount = amount * exchange_rate
    puts "#{amount} #{from_currency} is equal to #{converted_amount.round(2)} #{to_currency}"
  else
    puts "Could not find exchange rates for #{from_currency} or #{to_currency}"
  end
else
  puts "Failed to retrieve exchange rates."
end
```

**Explanation and Key Improvements:**

1. **Gemfile:**  Includes `httparty` for making HTTP requests, `date` for handling dates, and `active_support` for caching features.
2. **Caching:**
   - `CACHE_EXPIRY`: Defines how long rates are cached (1 day in this case).
   - `ActiveSupport::Cache::MemoryStore`:  Uses an in-memory cache.  You can easily swap this out for a more persistent cache (e.g., Redis, Memcached) by changing the `cache_store` in the `initialize` method.
   - Cache Key:  The cache key is based on the current date, ensuring that rates are refreshed daily.
   - `@cache_store.fetch`: This method attempts to retrieve the rates from the cache. If they are not found (or have expired), it executes the block (which fetches the rates from the ECB API) and stores the result in the cache.
3. **ECB API Interaction:**
   - `HTTParty.get`: Makes a GET request to the ECB's XML endpoint.
   - Error Handling: Checks the HTTP response code and raises an error if the request fails.
4. **XML Parsing:**
   - `XMLSimple.parse`: Parses the XML response.  *Important:*  `XMLSimple` is *not* a standard Ruby library.  It needs to be installed (it's a gem).
   - The XML parsing logic is adapted to the structure of the ECB XML response.
5. **Currency Conversion:**
   - The conversion logic calculates the exchange rate based on the fetched rates.
   - Basic error handling if the currencies are not found in the rates.
6. **Clearer Structure:**
   - Uses a class `CurrencyConverter` to encapsulate the functionality.
   - Separates concerns (fetching rates, parsing XML, converting amounts).
7. **Example Usage:**
   - Provides a simple example of how to use the `CurrencyConverter` class.
8. **Logging:**
   - Includes `puts "Fetching rates from ECB..."` to indicate when the API is being called (helpful for debugging and understanding caching behavior).

**How to Run:**

1.  **Install Gems:**
    ```bash

    ```

2.  **Run the script:**
    ```bash

    ```

The first time you run it, it will fetch the rates from the ECB. Subsequent runs within the same day will retrieve the rates from the cache.

*   **Persistent Cache:** Use a persistent cache (Redis, Memcached, database) for production environments.  This ensures that rates are available even if the application restarts.

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'vies_client'

class VatValidator
  def self.validate_vat_number(vat_number, country_code)
    begin
      client = ViesClient::Client.new

      # Validate the VAT number
      result = client.valid?(vat_number, country_code)

      if result.valid?
        puts "VAT number #{vat_number} for country #{country_code} is valid."
        return true
      else
        puts "VAT number #{vat_number} for country #{country_code} is invalid."
        puts "Reason: #{result.reason}"
        return false
      end
    rescue ViesClient::InvalidVatNumberError => e
      puts "Invalid VAT number format: #{e.message}"
      return false
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "An error occurred: #{e.message}"
      return false
    end
  end
end


# Example usage:

  vat_number = "DE123456789"  # Replace with a valid VAT number
  country_code = "DE"      # Replace with the correct country code (e.g., "DE" for Germany, "FR" for France)

  is_valid = VatValidator.validate_vat_number(vat_number, country_code)

  if is_valid
    puts "You can proceed with the reverse-charge invoice."

    puts "Do not issue a reverse-charge invoice. VAT number is invalid."
  end

  vat_number = "INVALIDVAT"
  country_code = "DE"
  is_valid = VatValidator.validate_vat_number(vat_number, country_code)

  vat_number = "ES123456789"
  country_code = "ZZ" #Invalid country code
  is_valid = VatValidator.validate_vat_number(vat_number, country_code)
end
```

**Explanation:**

1. **Dependencies:**
   - `httparty`:  Used for making HTTP requests.  While `vies_client` handles the specifics of the VIES API, it might internally use `httparty` or a similar library.
   - `vies_client`:  Provides a Ruby interface for interacting with the VIES API, simplifying the process of making requests and parsing responses.

2. **`VatValidator` Class:**
   - Encapsulates the VAT validation logic.
   - `validate_vat_number(vat_number, country_code)`:
     - Takes the VAT number and country code as input.
     - Creates a `ViesClient::Client` instance.
     - Calls `client.valid?(vat_number, country_code)` to perform the validation.  This sends a request to the VIES API.
     - Checks the `result.valid?` property to determine if the VAT number is valid.

```ruby
    )

    if event.type == 'checkout.session.completed'
      session = Stripe::Checkout::Session.retrieve(event.data.object.id)

      # Process the payment and update your database
      # For example, mark the order as paid, send confirmation emails, etc.
      puts "Payment confirmed for session: #{session.id}"

      render :text => "Payment confirmed!", status: :ok
    else
      render :text => "Event type not supported", status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    rescue Stripe::SignatureVerificationError => e
      render :text => "Invalid signature", status: :forbidden
    rescue Stripe::Error => e
      render :text => "Stripe error: #{e.message}", status: :internal_server_error
    end
  end

  private

  def verify_stripe_signature
    Stripe.api_key = Rails.application.credentials.stripe[:secret_key]

    if request.env['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE'].present?
      event = Stripe::Event.construct_event(
        request.body.read,
        Rails.application.credentials.stripe[:secret_key],
        request.headers['Stripe-Signature']
      )
    else
      render :text => "No Stripe signature provided", status: :forbidden
    end
  end
end
```

**7. Important Considerations and Enhancements**

*   **Error Handling:**  The code includes basic error handling, but you should enhance it with more robust logging and error reporting.
*   **Security:**  Always verify the Stripe signature to ensure that the webhook request is coming from Stripe.  The `verify_stripe_signature` method handles this.
*   **Database Updates:**  In the `payment_confirmation` method, you'll need to update your database to reflect the completed payment.  This might involve marking an order as paid, creating a new record, or updating existing records.
*   **Idempotency:** Stripe recommends implementing idempotency keys to prevent duplicate payments.  You can add an idempotency key to the `Stripe::Checkout::Session.create` call.
*   **Testing:** Thoroughly test your webhook integration using Stripe's test mode.

*   **Credentials Management:**  Use Rails' encrypted credentials (`credentials.yml.enc`) to store your Stripe API keys securely.  Avoid hardcoding them directly in your code.
*   **Input Validation:** Validate the data received in the webhook event to ensure that it is correct and complete.
*   **Logging:**  Log important events, such as successful payments, errors, and webhook requests, for debugging and auditing purposes.

```ruby
require 'braintree'
require 'dotenv/load' # Завантаження змінних оточення з .env файлу

# Налаштування Braintree
Braintree::Configuration.environment = ENV['BRAINTREE_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'sandbox'
Braintree::Configuration.merchant_id = ENV['BRAINTREE_MERCHANT_ID']
Braintree::Configuration.public_key = ENV['BRAINTREE_PUBLIC_KEY']
Braintree::Configuration.private_key = ENV['BRAINTREE_PRIVATE_KEY']

# Клас для управління підписками
class SubscriptionManager
  def create_subscription(customer_id, plan_id, billing_frequency, trial_period_days = 0)
    begin
      subscription = Braintree::Subscription.create(
        customer_id: customer_id,
        plan_id: plan_id,
        billing_frequency: billing_frequency,
        trial_period_days: trial_period_days
      )
      return subscription
    rescue Braintree::Error => e
      puts "Помилка при створенні підписки: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def cancel_subscription(subscription_id)
    begin
      subscription = Braintree::Subscription.cancel(subscription_id)
      return subscription
    rescue Braintree::Error => e
      puts "Помилка при скасуванні підписки: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  def get_subscription(subscription_id)
    begin
      subscription = Braintree::Subscription.find(subscription_id)
      return subscription
    rescue Braintree::Error => e
      puts "Помилка при отриманні підписки: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання

# Ініціалізація менеджера підписок
subscription_manager = SubscriptionManager.new

# Припустимо, що у нас є ID клієнта та план
customer_id = 'some_customer_id' # Замініть на реальний ID клієнта
plan_id = 'monthly_plan' # Замініть на реальний ID плану

# Створення підписки з 7-денним пробним періодом
subscription = subscription_manager.create_subscription(customer_id, plan_id, 'monthly', 7)

if subscription
  puts "Підписка створена з ID: #{subscription.id}"
  puts "Статус: #{subscription.status}"
end

# Скасування підписки
if subscription
  cancellation = subscription_manager.cancel_subscription(subscription.id)
  if cancellation
    puts "Підписка скасована. Статус: #{cancellation.status}"
  else
    puts "Не вдалося скасувати підписку."
  end
end

# Отримання інформації про підписку
if subscription
  retrieved_subscription = subscription_manager.get_subscription(subscription.id)
  if retrieved_subscription
    puts "Статус підписки: #{retrieved_subscription.status}"
  else
    puts "Не вдалося отримати інформацію про підписку."
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'

def generate_pain_001(payments, batch_id, creditor_name, creditor_account, creditor_bic)
  # Create the XML document
  xml = Nokogiri::XML::Document.new
  root = xml.root_node do
    node 'CstmrCdtTrfInitn' do
      node 'GrpHdr' do
        node 'MsgId' , "pain.001.001.#{batch_id}"
        node 'CreDtTm', DateTime.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z")
        node 'NbOfTxs', payments.length
        node 'CtrlSum' do
          node 'InstdAmt', payments.sum(&:amount).to_s, 'Ccy' => 'EUR'
        end
      end

      node 'PmtInfInitn' do
        node 'PmtInfId', "pain.001.#{batch_id}"
        node 'PmtMtId', 'pain.001'
        node 'NbOfTxs', payments.length
        node 'CtrlSum' do
          node 'InstdAmt', payments.sum(&:amount).to_s, 'Ccy' => 'EUR'
        end
        node 'PmtTm' , DateTime.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z")

        payments.each do |payment|
          node 'PmtTm' , DateTime.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z")

          node 'Txs' do
            node 'Sts' do
              node 'SldgDt', DateTime.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z")
              node 'ReqdColltnDt', DateTime.now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z")
              node 'Amt' do
                node 'InstdAmt', payment[:amount].to_s, 'Ccy' => 'EUR'
              end
              node 'DbtTx' do
                node 'Mtd' , "DD" # Direct Debit
                node 'Nb' , payment[:reference]
              end

              node 'Cdtr' do
                node 'Nm' , creditor_name
              end

              node 'CdtrAcct' do
                node 'Id' do
                  node 'IBAN', creditor_account
                end
              end

              node 'CdtrAgt' do
                node 'FinInstId' do
                  node 'BIC', creditor_bic
                end
              end

              node 'Debtor' do
                node 'Nm' , payment[:supplier_name]
              end

              node 'DebtorTrf' do
                node 'Cdtr' do
                  node 'Nm' , creditor_name
                end
              end

              node 'DebtorAcct' do
                node 'Id' do
                  node 'IBAN', payment[:supplier_iban]
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  xml.to_xml(indent: true)
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'date'

module CacheExchangeRates

  VERSION = '0.1.0'

  class << self
    attr_accessor :cache_file
  end

  self.cache_file = 'exchange_rates_cache.yml' # Default cache file

  def self.get_exchange_rate(base_currency, target_currency)
    cache_key = "#{base_currency}_#{target_currency}"
    cached_rates = load_cache

    if cached_rates && cached_rates[cache_key]
      return cached_rates[cache_key]
    end

    rate = fetch_exchange_rate(base_currency, target_currency)
    save_cache(cache_key => rate)
    return rate
  end


  private

  def self.fetch_exchange_rate(base_currency, target_currency)
    today = Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    url = "https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref/html/eurofxref.#{today}.xml"

    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(url)
      raise "Failed to fetch exchange rates: #{response.code}" if response.code != 200

      xml = Nokogiri::XML(response.body)
      # Find the correct exchange rate
      rate_node = xml.xpath("//Cube[@currency='#{target_currency.upcase}']/@rate")

      if rate_node.empty?
        raise "Exchange rate for #{target_currency} not found"
      end

      rate = rate_node.first.value.to_f

      # Ensure that the base currency is EUR, if not, we need to find the EUR to target rate.
      if base_currency.upcase != 'EUR'
        eur_to_base_rate = get_exchange_rate('EUR', base_currency)
        rate = 1.0 / eur_to_base_rate * rate
      end

      return rate

    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error fetching exchange rate: #{e.message}"
      return nil # Or raise the error, depending on desired behavior
    end
  end

  def self.load_cache
    if File.exist?(cache_file)
      begin
        YAML.load_file(cache_file)
      rescue StandardError => e
        puts "Error loading cache: #{e.message}"
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
  end

  def self.save_cache(data)
    cached_rates = load_cache || {}
    cached_rates.merge!(data)
    begin
      File.open(cache_file, 'w') do |file|
        YAML.dump(cached_rates, file)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Error saving cache: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

require 'yaml'
```

```ruby
require 'plaid'
require 'active_record'
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

# Configure Plaid client
PLAID_CLIENT_ID = ENV['PLAID_CLIENT_ID']
PLAID_SECRET = ENV['PLAID_SECRET']
PLAID_ENVIRONMENT = ENV['PLAID_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'sandbox' # Default to sandbox
PLAID_ACCESS_TOKEN = ENV['PLAID_ACCESS_TOKEN'] # Required for fetching data

client = Plaid::Client.new(
  client_id: PLAID_CLIENT_ID,
  secret: PLAID_SECRET,
  environment: PLAID_ENVIRONMENT
)

# Configure ActiveRecord (database connection)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'bank_data.db' # Or your database file
)

# Define models (database tables)
class Account < ActiveRecord::Base
  # Add validations as needed
end

class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :account
  # Add validations as needed
end

# Create tables if they don't exist
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :accounts do |t|
    t.string :account_id
    t.string :name
    t.string :type
    t.string :subtype
    t.decimal :balance
    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :transactions do |t|
    t.string :transaction_id
    t.string :date
    t.string :description
    t.decimal :amount
    t.boolean :pending
    t.references :account, foreign_key: true # Relationship to Account model
    t.timestamps
  end
end

# Logger setup
$logger = Logger.new('bank_data.log')

# Function to fetch account and transaction data
def fetch_bank_data(access_token)
  begin
    $logger.info "Fetching account and transaction data for access token: #{access_token}"
    accounts = client.accounts_get(access_token: access_token)
    transactions = client.transactions_get(access_token: access_token, start_date: '2023-01-01', end_date: Time.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) # Adjust date range as needed

    # Process accounts
    accounts['accounts'].each do |account_data|
      account = Account.find_or_create_by(account_id: account_data['account_id']) do |a|
        a.name = account_data['name']
        a.type = account_data['type']
        a.subtype = account_data['subtype']
        a.balance = account_data['balance']['amount']
      end
      $logger.info "Account created/updated: #{account.name}"
    end

    # Process transactions
    transactions['transactions'].each do |transaction_data|
      transaction = Transaction.create(
        transaction_id: transaction_data['transaction_id'],
        date: transaction_data['date'],
        description: transaction_data['description'],
        amount: transaction_data['amount'],
        pending: transaction_data['pending'],
        account_id: accounts['accounts'].find { |a| a['account_id'] == transaction_data['account_id'] }['account_id']
      )
      $logger.info "Transaction created: #{transaction.description}"
    end

    $logger.info "Data fetching and storage completed successfully."
  rescue Plaid::RatioError => e
    $logger.error "Plaid API Error: #{e.message}"
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    $logger.error "ActiveRecord Error: #{e.message}"
  rescue StandardError => e
    $logger.error "An unexpected error occurred: #{e.message}"
    $logger.error e.backtrace
  end
end


# Main execution
if PLAID_ACCESS_TOKEN
  fetch_bank_data(PLAID_ACCESS_TOKEN)
else
  $logger.error "PLAID_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable not set."
  puts "Please set the PLAID_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable."
end
```

```ruby
def get_balance(account_id)
  response = plaid_client.accounts_balance(account_id: account_id)
  if response.success?
    balance_data = response.data.accounts.first
    Balance.create(
      account_id: account_id,
      date: Time.now.to_s,
      amount: balance_data.balances.on_us.amount
    )
    puts "Баланс для #{account_id}: #{balance_data.balances.on_us.amount}"
  else
    puts "Помилка отримання балансу для #{account_id}: #{response.error_message}"
  end
end

# Функція для отримання транзакцій
def get_transactions(account_id)
  response = plaid_client.transactions_get(
    account_ids: [account_id],
    start_date: '2023-01-01', # Замініть на потрібний діапазон дат
    end_date:   Time.now.to_s[0..9] # До сьогоднішньої дати
  )

  if response.success?
    transactions = response.data.transactions

    transactions.each do |transaction|
      Transaction.create(
        account_id: account_id,
        date: transaction.date,
        amount: transaction.amount,
        description: transaction.description,
        category: transaction.category
      )
      puts "Транзакція для #{account_id}: #{transaction.description} - #{transaction.amount}"
    end
  else
    puts "Помилка отримання транзакцій для #{account_id}: #{response.error_message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'date'

# Клас для представлення банківської транзакції
class BankTransaction
  attr_reader :amount, :date, :description

  def initialize(amount:, date:, description:)
    @amount = amount.to_f
    @date = Date.parse(date)
    @description = description
  end
end

# Клас для представлення неоплаченого рахунку за призначенням платежу
class AccountPayable
  attr_reader :amount, :due_date, :description

  def initialize(amount:, due_date:, description:)
    @amount = amount.to_f
    @due_date = Date.parse(due_date)
    @description = description
  end
end

# Клас для зіставлення банківських транзакцій з неоплаченими рахунками
class BankTransactionMatcher
  def initialize(camt_file_path:, account_payables:)
    @camt_file_path = camt_file_path
    @account_payables = account_payables
    @transactions = parse_camt_file
  end

  def matched_transactions
    matched = []
    unmatched_account_payables = @account_payables.dup

    @transactions.each do |transaction|
      found_match = false
      unmatched_account_payables.each_with_index do |account_payable, index|
        if (transaction.amount.abs == account_payable.amount.abs) &&
           (transaction.description.downcase.include?(account_payable.description.downcase))
          matched << {
            transaction: transaction,
            account_payable: account_payable
          }
          unmatched_account_payables.delete_at(index)
          found_match = true
          break
        end
      end

      # If no match is found, you might want to log it or handle it differently
      # puts "No match found for transaction: #{transaction.description}" if !found_match
    end

    {
      matched: matched,
      unmatched_account_payables: unmatched_account_payables
    }
  end

  private

  def parse_camt_file
    xml = File.read(@camt_file_path)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml)

    transactions = []
    doc.xpath('//CstmrDrctDebitTxInf').each do |transaction_node|
      amount = transaction_node.xpath('./Amt/Cd').text
      date = transaction_node.xpath('./DtAcc').text
      description = transaction_node.xpath('./RmtInf/Ustrd').text

      transactions << BankTransaction.new(amount: amount, date: date, description: description)
    end

    transactions
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'rexml/document'
require 'date'

class SepaPain001Generator
  def initialize(initiating_party, payment_information)
    @initiating_party = initiating_party
    @payment_information = payment_information
    @doc = REXML::Document.new
    @root = @doc.add_element("Document")
    @root.add_attribute("xmlns", "urn:iso:std:iso20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001")
    @root.add_attribute("xmlns:xsi", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance")
    @root.add_attribute("xsi:schemaLocation", "urn:iso:std:iso20022:tech:xsd:pain.001.001 pain.001.001.xsd")
  end

  def generate_xml
    add_group_header
    add_payment_information_header
    add_payment_transactions
    add_signature_and_date
    @doc.to_xml
  end

  private

  def add_group_header
    group_header = @root.add_element("CstmrCdtTrfInitn")
    msg_info = group_header.add_element("MsgInf")
    msg_info.add_element("MsgRcvr").add_text("ABCD") # Замініть на фактичний IBAN отримувача
    msg_info.add_element("MsgSndr").add_text(@initiating_party[:name])
    msg_info.add_element("InitgPty").add_attribute("Nm", @initiating_party[:name])
    msg_info.add_element("InitgPty").add_attribute("Id", @initiating_party[:id]) # Замініть на фактичний ідентифікатор ініціатора
    payment_order_information = msg_info.add_element("PmtOrdrInf")
    payment_order_information.add_attribute("CtrlTp", "RCUR") # Regular payment
    payment_order_information.add_attribute("NbOfTxs", @payment_information[:payments].length.to_s)
    payment_order_information.add_attribute("PmtMtd", "DD") # Direct Debit
    payment_order_information.add_attribute("ReqdColltnDt", format_date(@payment_information[:collection_date]))
    payment_order_information.add_element("InstdAmt").add_text(@payment_information[:total_amount].to_s)
    payment_order_information.add_element("InstdAmtCcy").add_text(@payment_information[:currency])
    payment_order_information.add_element("PmtTpInf").add_element("Cd").add_text("COL")
  end

  def add_payment_information_header
    payment_information_header = @root.add_element("PmtInf")
    payment_information_header.add_attribute("PmtId", @payment_information[:payment_id])
    payment_information_header.add_attribute("NbOfTxs", @payment_information[:payments].length.to_s)
    payment_information_header.add_attribute("CtrlTp", "RCUR")
    payment_information_header.add_attribute("PmtMtd", "DD")
    payment_information_header.add_attribute("ReqdColltnDt", format_date(@payment_information[:collection_date]))
    payment_information_header.add_element("PmtTpInf").add_element("Cd").add_text("COL")
    payment_information_header.add_element("InstdAmt").add_text(@payment_information[:total_amount].to_s)
    payment_information_header.add_element("InstdAmtCcy").add_text(@payment_information[:currency])
    payment_information_header.add_element("Cdtr").add_element("Nm").add_text(@initiating_party[:name])
    payment_information_header.add_element("Cdtr").add_element("Id").add_element("FinInstnId").add_element("BIC").add_text(@initiating_party[:bic])
  end

  def add_payment_transactions
    @payment_information[:payments].each do |payment|
      payment_transaction = @root.add_element("Dpst")
      payment_transaction.add_element("Amt").add_text(payment[:amount].to_s)
      payment_transaction.add_element("Amt").add_attribute("Ccy", payment[:currency])
      payment_transaction.add_element("CdtrAcct").add_element("Id").add_element("IBAN").add_text(payment[:creditor_iban])
      payment_transaction.add_element("Cdtr").add_element("Nm").add_text(payment[:creditor_name])
      payment_transaction.add_element("RmtInf").add_element("Ustrd").add_text(payment[:reference])
    end
  end

  def add_signature_and_date
    signature = @root.add_element("Signature")
    signature.add_element("SignatureDateTime").add_text(format_date(Date.today))
  end

  def format_date(date)
    date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  end
end
```

```ruby
# Функція для генерації HTML
def generate_invoice_html(data)
  doc = Nokogiri::HTML::Builder.new do |html|
    html.html do
      html.head do
        html.title "Рахунок #{data[:invoice_number]}"
      end
      html.body do
        html.h1 "Рахунок: #{data[:invoice_number]}"
        html.p "Дата: #{data[:invoice_date]}"
        html.p "Строк оплати: #{data[:due_date]}"
        html.h2 "Клієнт"
        html.p "Ім'я: #{data[:customer_name]}"
        html.p "Адреса: #{data[:customer_address]}"

        html.h2 "Позиції"
        html.table 'border="1"' do
          html.tr do
            html.th "Назва"
            html.th "Кількість"
            html.th "Ціна за одиницю"
            html.th "Сума"
          end
          data[:items].each do |item|
            html.tr do
              html.td item[:name]
              html.td item[:quantity]
              html.td item[:unit_price]
              html.td "%.2f" % (item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price])
            end
          end
        end

        # Обчислення підсумків
        subtotal = data[:items].map { |item| item[:quantity] * item[:unit_price] }.sum
        tax_amount = subtotal * data[:tax_rate]
        total = subtotal + tax_amount

        html.h2 "Підсумок"
        html.p "Сума: %.2f" % subtotal
        html.p "ПДВ (#{data[:tax_rate] * 100}%): %.2f" % tax_amount
        html.p "Загалом: %.2f" % total
      end
    end
  end
  doc.to_html
end

# Функція для генерації PDF
def generate_pdf(html)
  kit = PDFKit.new(html, {
    wkhtmltopdf: '/usr/local/bin/wkhtmltopdf' # Вкажіть шлях до wkhtmltopdf, якщо він не в PATH
  })
  kit.to_pdf
end

# Функція для надсилання електронного листа
def send_invoice_email(pdf, data)
  Mail.defaults do
    delivery_method :smtp, {
      address:   'smtp.example.com', # Замініть на ваш SMTP сервер
      port:      587,
      domain:    'example.com',
      user_name: 'your_email@example.com', # Замініть на вашу електронну адресу
      password:  'your_password', # Замініть на ваш пароль
      authentication: 'plain',
      enable_starttls_auto: true
    }
  end

  mail = Mail.new do
    from     MAIL_FROM
    to       MAIL_TO
    subject  MAIL_SUBJECT
    body     "Будь ласка, дивіться вкладений PDF-рахунок."
    attachments[data[:invoice_number] + '.pdf'] = {
      mime_type: 'application/pdf',
      content: pdf
    }
  end

  mail.deliver
  puts "Рахунок було надіслано на #{MAIL_TO}"
rescue => e
  puts "Помилка при надсиланні електронної пошти: #{e.message}"
end
```

```ruby
class CheckoutController < ApplicationController
  require 'stripe'

  def create
    # Перевіряємо, чи передано токен Stripe
    if params[:stripeToken]
      begin
        # Створюємо сесію Stripe Checkout
        session = Stripe::Checkout::Session.create(
          payment_method_types: ['card'],
          line_items: [
            {
              amount: 1099, # Сума в центах (наприклад, 10.99 доларів США)
              currency: 'usd',
              description: 'Оплата за продукт',
              quantity: 1,
            },
          ],
          mode: 'payment',
          success_url: success_checkout_url,  # URL, куди перенаправити користувача після успішної оплати
          cancel_url: cancel_checkout_url,   # URL, куди перенаправити користувача при скасуванні
        )

        # Перенаправляємо користувача на URL Stripe Checkout
        redirect_to session.url, allow_other_host: true

      rescue Stripe::Error => e
        # Обробка помилок Stripe
        logger.error "Stripe Checkout Error: #{e.message}"
        render :text => "Error creating Checkout session: #{e.message}", status: :internal_server_error
      end
    else
      # Якщо токен Stripe не передано, відображаємо помилку
      render :text => "Stripe token not provided", status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def success
    # Обробка успішного платежу
    # Можете оновити базу даних, відправити електронний лист тощо
    puts "Payment successful!"
    render :text => "Payment successful!", status: :ok
  end

  def cancel
    # Обробка скасованого платежу
    puts "Payment cancelled!"
    render :text => "Payment cancelled!", status: :ok
  end

  # Вебхук (обробка подій Stripe)
  def webhook
    # Перевіряємо, чи є запит POST
    if request.method == 'POST'
      # Отримуємо події Stripe з тіла запиту
      event = request.body.read

      # Перевіряємо підпис вебхука (дуже важливо для безпеки)
      begin
        event = Stripe::Event.construct(event, Stripe.api_key, Rails.application.credentials.stripe.webhook_secret)
      rescue Stripe::SignatureVerificationError
        # Підпис недійсний
        render :text => "Invalid signature", status: :unprocessable_entity
        return
      end

      # Обробляємо події
      case event.type
      when 'checkout.session.completed'
        session = event.data.object
        # Обробка завершеної сесії Checkout
        puts "Checkout session completed: #{session.id}"
        # Можна оновити базу даних, надіслати електронний лист тощо
        # Доступ до інформації про клієнта: session.customer_email, session.customer_name
        # Доступ до інформації про товари: session.line_items.data
      when 'payment_intent.succeeded'
        # Обробка успішного платежу (якщо використовуєте PaymentIntent замість Checkout)
        puts "Payment Intent succeeded!"
      else
        # Обробка інших типів подій
        puts "Unhandled event type: #{event.type}"
      end

      # Повертаємо 200 OK
      render :text => "Event processed successfully", status: :ok

    else
      # Якщо запит не POST, відображаємо помилку
      render :text => "Method not allowed", status: :method_not_allowed
    end
  end
end
```

**2. Implementation (stock_moving_average.rb)**

```ruby
require 'alpha_advantage'
require 'date'

# Configuration - Replace with your Alpha Vantage API key
ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY = 'YOUR_ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY'

def fetch_historical_data(ticker, start_date, end_date)
  alpha_advantage = AlphaAdvantage::Client.new(ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY)

  begin
    time_series = alpha_advantage.time_series(
      ticker,
      function: 'TIME_SERIES_DAILY',
      series_type: 'daily',
      start_date: start_date,
      end_date: end_date
    )

    return time_series.daily
  rescue AlphaAdvantage::Exceptions::APIError => e
    puts "API Error: #{e.message}"
    return nil
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "An unexpected error occurred: #{e.message}"
    return nil
  end
end


def calculate_moving_average(data, window=20)
  closing_prices = data.map { |day_data| day_data['4. close'] }.map(&:to_f)

  moving_averages = []
  (window...closing_prices.length).each do |i|
    window_sum = closing_prices[i - window, window].sum
    moving_average = window_sum / window
    moving_averages << moving_average
  end

  moving_averages
end

def main
  ticker = 'AAPL'  # Example ticker: Apple
  end_date = Date.today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
  start_date = (Date.today - 35).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') # Get data for the last 35 days

  historical_data = fetch_historical_data(ticker, start_date, end_date)

  if historical_data
    moving_average = calculate_moving_average(historical_data)

    if moving_average.any?
      puts "20-Day Moving Average for #{ticker}:"
      moving_average.each_with_index do |ma, index|
        date = historical_data[index]['date']
        puts "#{date}: #{ma.round(2)}"
      end
    else
      puts "Could not calculate moving average.  Not enough data."
    end
  else
    puts "Failed to fetch historical data for #{ticker}."
  end
end

main if __FILE__ == $0
```

    *   Initializes an `AlphaAdvantage::Client` with your API key. **Replace `'YOUR_ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY'` with your actual API key.**
    *   Calls `alpha_advantage.time_series` to request daily time series data for the specified ticker and date range.
    *   Handles potential `AlphaAdvantage::Exceptions::APIError` (e.g., invalid API key, rate limiting) and general `StandardError` exceptions.
    *   Returns the `daily` data (a hash) if successful, otherwise `nil`.

3.  **`calculate_moving_average(data, window=20)`:**
    *   Extracts the closing prices from the `data` hash, converting them to floats.
    *   Calculates the 20-day moving average (or a different window size if specified).
    *   Returns an array of moving average values.

4.  **`main`:**

    *   Calls `fetch_historical_data` to get the data.

```ruby
require 'card'
require 'form_builder'

class CreditCardForm
  include FormBuilder

  attribute :credit_card_number, String

  validates :credit_card_number, presence: true
  validates :credit_card_number, length: { is: 16..19 } # Common card lengths

  def validate_credit_card_number
    return if credit_card_number.nil?

    begin
      card = Card::Card.new(credit_card_number)
      @card_brand = card.brand
      @is_valid = card.valid?
      true
    rescue Card::InvalidCardNumberError
      @is_valid = false
      @card_brand = nil
      false
    end
  end

  def card_brand
    @card_brand
  end

  def is_valid?
    @is_valid
  end
end

  #form.credit_card_number = "1234567890123456" # Invalid
  #form.credit_card_number = "1234"  # too short

  form.validate_credit_card_number

  if form.is_valid?
    puts "Credit card number is valid."
    puts "Card brand: #{form.card_brand}"
  else
    puts "Credit card number is invalid."
  end
end
```

```ruby
  # Initialize variables
  schedule = []
  balance = loan_amount
  total_paid = 0

  # Generate the loan schedule
  (1..loan_term_months).each do |month|
    interest_payment = balance * monthly_interest_rate
    principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest_payment
    balance -= principal_payment
    total_paid += monthly_payment

    schedule << {
      Month: month,
      Payment: monthly_payment.round(2),
      Principal: principal_payment.round(2),
      Interest: interest_payment.round(2),
      Balance: balance.round(2)
    }
  end

  return schedule
end

def export_to_excel(schedule, filename="loan_schedule.xlsx")
  book = Spreadsheet::Writer.new(filename)
  sheet = book.create_sheet("Loan Schedule")

  # Write headers
  sheet.row(0).push "Month", "Payment", "Principal", "Interest", "Balance"

  # Write data
  schedule.each_with_index do |row, index|
    sheet.row(index + 1).push row[:Month], row[:Payment], row[:Principal], row[:Interest], row[:Balance]
  end

  book.close
  puts "Loan schedule exported to #{filename}"
end
```

```ruby
# Coinbase Commerce API client
class CoinbaseCommerceClient
  include HTTParty
  base_uri 'https://api.commerce.coinbase.com/v2'

  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['COINBASE_COMMERCE_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'X-CC-Api-Key' => @api_key,
      'X-CC-Version' => '2018-03-22'
    }
  end

  def create_checkout(metadata)
    body = {
      "metadata": metadata,
      "local_price": {
        "amount": 1, # Example amount, adjust as needed
        "currency": "USD" # Example currency, adjust as needed
      }
    }.to_json

    response = post('/charges', headers: @headers, body: body)

    if response.code == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)['data']['id']
    else
      puts "Error creating checkout: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def get_charge(charge_id)
    response = get("/charges/#{charge_id}", headers: @headers)

    if response.code == 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)['data']
    else
      puts "Error getting charge: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
      nil
    end
  end
end

# Payment Processor
class PaymentProcessor
  def initialize(coinbase_client)
    @coinbase_client = coinbase_client
  end

  def process_payment(metadata)
    charge_id = @coinbase_client.create_checkout(metadata)

    if charge_id
      return charge_id
    else
      return nil
    end
  end

  def mark_order_as_paid(charge_id)
    charge = @coinbase_client.get_charge(charge_id)

    if charge
      if charge['status'] == 'confirmed'
        puts "Charge #{charge_id} confirmed. Marking order as paid."
        #  Here you would update your database to mark the order as paid.
        #  For example:
        #  Order.find(order_id).update(paid: true)
        return true
      else
        puts "Charge #{charge_id} is not yet confirmed. Status: #{charge['status']}"
        return false
      end
    else
      puts "Charge #{charge_id} not found."
      return false
    end
  end

  def poll_for_confirmation(charge_id, interval_seconds = 60)
    loop do
      if mark_order_as_paid(charge_id)
        break
      else
        puts "Waiting for confirmation for charge #{charge_id}..."
        sleep interval_seconds
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class StockPriceAnalyzer
  def initialize(ticker)
    @ticker = ticker
  end

  def fetch_historical_data
    url = "#{BASE_URL}?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=#{@ticker}&apikey=#{ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY}"
    response = HTTParty.get(url)

    if response.code == 200
      response['Time Series (Daily)']
    else
      puts "Помилка отримання даних: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def calculate_20_day_moving_average(data)
    if data.nil?
      puts "Немає даних для обчислення ковзного середнього."
      return nil
    end

    daily_prices = data.map { |date, values| Float(values['4. close']) }
    daily_prices.sort! # Важливо відсортувати за часом, щоб обчислити ковзне середнє правильно

    if daily_prices.length < 20
      puts "Недостатньо даних для обчислення 20-денного ковзного середнього."
      return nil
    end

    moving_averages = []
    (20..daily_prices.length).each do |i|
      window = daily_prices[(i - 20)..(i - 1)]
      moving_average = window.sum / window.length
      moving_averages << moving_average
    end

    moving_averages
  end

  def analyze
    data = fetch_historical_data
    moving_average = calculate_20_day_moving_average(data)

    if moving_average
      puts "20-денне ковзне середнє для #{@ticker}:"
      moving_average.each_with_index do |avg, index|
        date = data.keys[-index - 1] # Отримуємо дату з кінця масиву
        puts "#{date}: #{avg.round(2)}"
      end
    else
      puts "Не вдалося обчислити 20-денне ковзне середнє для #{@ticker}."
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'spreadsheet'
require 'axlsx'

class LoanAmortization
  def initialize(loan_amount, annual_interest_rate, loan_term_years)
    @loan_amount = loan_amount
    @annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    @loan_term_years = loan_term_years
    @monthly_interest_rate = (@annual_interest_rate / 100) / 12
    @loan_term_months = @loan_term_years * 12
  end

  def calculate_monthly_payment
    numerator = @loan_amount * @monthly_interest_rate * (1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**@loan_term_months
    denominator = (1 + @monthly_interest_rate)**@loan_term_months - 1
    @monthly_payment = numerator / denominator
    @monthly_payment.round(2) # Round to 2 decimal places
  end

  def generate_schedule
    schedule = []
    remaining_balance = @loan_amount
    schedule << ['Payment #', 'Date', 'Payment', 'Principal', 'Interest', 'Remaining Balance']

    (1..@loan_term_months).each do |payment_number|
      date = Date.new(Date.today.year, Date.today.month, 1) + (payment_number - 1).months
      interest_payment = remaining_balance * @monthly_interest_rate
      principal_payment = @monthly_payment - interest_payment
      remaining_balance -= principal_payment

      schedule << [
        payment_number,
        date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        @monthly_payment.round(2),
        principal_payment.round(2),
        interest_payment.round(2),
        remaining_balance.round(2)
      ]
    end

    schedule
  end

  def export_to_excel(filename)
    schedule = generate_schedule
    package = Axlsx::Package.new
    workbook = package.workbook

    sheet = workbook.create_sheet do |sheet|
      sheet.name = 'Amortization Schedule'
      # Write header row
      sheet.rows.add schedule[0]
      # Write data rows
      schedule[1..-1].each do |row|
        sheet.rows.add row
      end
    end

    package.serialize(filename)
    puts "Amortization schedule exported to #{filename}"
  end
end

# Example Usage

  annual_interest_rate = 5
  loan_term_years = 30

  amortization.calculate_monthly_payment

  excel_filename = 'amortization_schedule.xlsx'
  amortization.export_to_excel(excel_filename)
end
```

It iterates through each month of the loan term, calculates the interest payment, principal payment, and updates the remaining balance.  The schedule includes columns for:

```ruby
require 'httparty'

class AdyenPayment
  attr_reader :adyen_api_key, :adyen_endpoint, :notification_callback_url

  def initialize(adyen_api_key, adyen_endpoint, notification_callback_url)
    @adyen_api_key = adyen_api_key
    @adyen_endpoint = adyen_endpoint
    @notification_callback_url = notification_callback_url
  end

  # Генерує URL для Drop-in платіжного інтерфейсу
  def generate_dropin_url(amount, currency, return_url, payment_method_types: ['card'])
    payload = {
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      return_url: return_url,
      paymentMethodTypes: payment_method_types.join(',')
    }.to_json

    headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }

    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{@adyen_endpoint}/payments",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload
    )

    if response.success?
      return response['url']
    else
      puts "Помилка генерації URL Drop-in: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  # Перевіряє HMAC підпис сповіщення
  def verify_notification_hmac(notification_data, hmac)
    expected_hmac = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha512', notification_data, @adyen_api_key)
    return hmac == expected_hmac
  end

  # Обробляє сповіщення Adyen
  def process_notification(notification_data)
    hmac = notification_data[:hmac]

    if !hmac
      puts "Сповіщення не містить HMAC."
      return false
    end

    if verify_notification_hmac(JSON.generate(notification_data), hmac)
      # HMAC підпис валідний. Обробляємо сповіщення.
      event_code = notification_data[:eventCode]
      transaction_amount = notification_data[:amount][:value]
      transaction_currency = notification_data[:amount][:currency]
      transaction_id = notification_data[:ref]

      puts "Сповіщення оброблено. Event Code: #{event_code}, Amount: #{transaction_amount} #{transaction_currency}, Transaction ID: #{transaction_id}"

      # Тут можна обробити сповіщення, наприклад:
      # - Оновити статус замовлення в базі даних
      # - Відправити email покупцю

      return true
    else
      puts "Неправильний HMAC підпис."
      return false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'date'

# Configuration
NBU_API_URL = 'https://bank.gov.ua/api/exchange/nbu/public/'

# Function to fetch exchange rates for a specific date
def get_exchange_rates(date_str)
  begin
    # Validate date format (YYYY-MM-DD)
    date = Date.parse(date_str)
    date_str = date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') # Ensure correct format for API

    response = HTTParty.get("#{NBU_API_URL}#{date_str}")

    if response.success?
      return response.parsed_response
    else
      puts "Error fetching data: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      return nil
    end

  rescue ArgumentError
    puts "Invalid date format. Please use YYYY-MM-DD."
    return nil
  rescue HTTParty::Error => e
    puts "HTTParty Error: #{e.message}"
    return nil
  end
end


# Example Usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  date_to_fetch = ARGV[0] || '2023-12-31' # Default date if none provided
  exchange_rates = get_exchange_rates(date_to_fetch)

  if exchange_rates
    puts "Exchange rates for #{date_to_fetch}:"
    exchange_rates.each do |rate|
      currency = rate['currency']
      exchange_rate = rate['rate']
      description = rate['description']
      puts "  #{currency}: #{exchange_rate} (#{description})"
    end
  else
    puts "Failed to retrieve exchange rates."
  end
end
```

    *   `date`: For date parsing and formatting.

    *   **Date Formatting:**  Formats the `Date` object back into the `YYYY-MM-DD` string format that the NBU API expects using `strftime('%Y-%m-%d')`.
    *   **HTTParty Request:**  Uses `HTTParty.get` to make a GET request to the NBU API URL with the specified date.
    *   **Error Handling:**  Includes a `rescue` block to handle potential errors:
        *   `ArgumentError`: Catches invalid date formats.
        *   `HTTParty::Error`: Catches generic HTTParty errors (e.g., network issues, timeouts).
    *   **Response Handling:**
        *   Checks `response.success?` to ensure the HTTP request was successful (status code 200-299).
        *   If successful, `response.parsed_response` returns the JSON data as a Ruby hash.

```ruby
require 'rest-client'
require 'json'
require 'date'
require 'active_record'
require 'sqlite3'

# Database Configuration (if using ActiveRecord)
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: 'sqlite3',
  database: 'monobank_transactions.db'
)

# Define a Transaction model (if using ActiveRecord)
class Transaction < ActiveRecord::Base
  validates :date, presence: true
  validates :amount, presence: true
  validates :description, presence: true
end

# Create the table if it doesn't exist
unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection.table_exists?(:transactions)
  ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
    create_table :transactions do |t|
      t.date :date
      t.decimal :amount
      t.string :description
      t.string :account_id
      t.timestamps
    end
  end
end

# Monobank API credentials (Replace with your actual credentials)
MONOBANK_API_TOKEN = 'YOUR_MONOBANK_API_TOKEN'
ACCOUNT_ID = 'YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID'  # e.g., '4200000000000000'

def fetch_transactions(account_id, token)
  url = "https://api.monobank.ua/v1/statements/#{account_id}"
  headers = {
    'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}"
  }

  begin
    response = RestClient.get(url, headers)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    return data['transactions']
  rescue RestClient::ExceptionWithResponse => e
    puts "API Error: #{e.response.code} - #{e.response.body}"
    return []
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    puts "JSON Parsing Error: #{e.message}"
    return []
  end
end

def save_new_transactions(existing_transactions, new_transactions)
  new_transactions.each do |transaction|
    date = Date.parse(transaction['date'])
    amount = transaction['amount']
    description = transaction['description']

    # Check if the transaction already exists
    if existing_transactions.none? { |existing|
      existing[:date] == date && existing[:amount] == amount && existing[:description] == description
    }
      # Save the new transaction to the database (if using ActiveRecord)
      Transaction.create(
        date: date,
        amount: amount,
        description: description,
        account_id: ACCOUNT_ID
      )
      puts "Saved new transaction: #{transaction['description']} - #{transaction['amount']} on #{date}"
    else
      puts "Transaction already exists: #{transaction['description']} - #{transaction['amount']} on #{date}"
    end
  end
end

# Main execution
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Load existing transactions from the database (if using ActiveRecord)
  existing_transactions = Transaction.select(:date, :amount, :description).all.map(&:attributes)

  # Fetch new transactions from Monobank API
  new_transactions = fetch_transactions(ACCOUNT_ID, MONOBANK_API_TOKEN)

  # Save new transactions
  save_new_transactions(existing_transactions, new_transactions)
end
```

```ruby
  before_action :verify_signature, only: [:callback]  # Verify signature before processing callback

    else

      render plain: "Error" # Respond with "Error" to LiqPay
    end
  end

  def verify_signature
    # Verify the signature sent by LiqPay to ensure the callback is legitimate.
    # This is crucial for security.

    secret_key = Rails.application.credentials.liqpay[:secret_key] # Get secret key from credentials

    calculated_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(secret_key, liqpay_data.to_query)

    received_signature = liqpay_data['signature']

    if calculated_signature == received_signature
      Rails.logger.info "LiqPay Signature verification successful."
    else
      Rails.logger.error "LiqPay Signature verification failed. Calculated: #{calculated_signature}, Received: #{received_signature}"
      render plain: "Invalid Signature", status: :forbidden and return
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'number_to_words'

def amount_to_ukrainian_words(amount)
  amount = amount.to_f
  uah = amount.floor
  kopecks = (amount - uah).round(2).to_i

  uah_words = number_to_words(uah, :number_word).to_s
  kopecks_words = number_to_words(kopecks, :number_word).to_s

  if uah > 0
    result = "#{uah_words} гривень"
    if kopecks > 0
      result += " та #{kopecks_words} копійок"
    else
      result += "."
    end
  else
    result = "#{kopecks_words} копійок"
  end

  result
end

# Example Usage

puts amount_to_ukrainian_words(1234567.89) # Output: "одна мільйон двісті тридцять чотири тисячі п'ятсот шістдесят сім гривень та вісімдесят дев'ять копійок"
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'

class AdyenPaymentHandler
  def initialize(adyen_api_key, endpoint_url, notification_callback_url)
    @adyen_api_key = adyen_api_key
    @endpoint_url = endpoint_url
    @notification_callback_url = notification_callback_url
  end

  # Method to initiate a payment with the Drop-in
  def initiate_payment(amount, currency, return_url, merchant_reference)
    payload = {
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      return_url: return_url,
      merchant_reference: merchant_reference,
      store_and_fetch: 'true', # Enable storing payment methods
      shopper_locale: 'en_US' # Optional: Set shopper locale
    }

    begin
      response = HTTParty.post(
        @endpoint_url,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
          'X-API-Key' => @adyen_api_key
        },
        body: JSON.generate(payload)
      )

      if response.success?
        # The Drop-in will redirect the user to Adyen.
        # Return the payment URL provided in the response.
        return response['paymentMethods'][0]['url'] # Assuming you want the first payment method URL
      else
        # Handle errors
        puts "Error initiating payment: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
        puts "Response Body: #{response.body}"
        return nil
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "An error occurred: #{e.message}"
      return nil
    end
  end

  # Method to verify the HMAC signature of a notification
  def verify_notification(notification_data)
    # Extract necessary data from the notification
    json_notification = JSON.parse(notification_data)
    hmac = json_notification['hmac']
    merchant_reference = json_notification['merchantReference']
    notification_content = JSON.generate(json_notification).delete_suffix("\n") # Remove trailing newline

    # Calculate the expected HMAC signature
    expected_hmac = calculate_hmac(merchant_reference, notification_content, @adyen_api_key)

    # Compare the received HMAC with the calculated HMAC
    return hmac == expected_hmac
  end

  private

  def calculate_hmac(merchant_reference, notification_content, api_key)
    message = merchant_reference + notification_content
    hmac = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('sha512', api_key, message)
    hmac.upcase # Adyen expects uppercase hex
  end

  # Method to process a successful payment notification
  def process_successful_notification(notification_data)
    # Here you would typically update your database, fulfill the order, etc.
    # This is just an example.
    puts "Successful payment notification received!"
    puts "Merchant Reference: #{notification_data['merchantReference']}"
    # ... your order fulfillment logic here ...
  end

  # Method to process a failed payment notification
  def process_failed_notification(notification_data)
    # Here you would typically handle the failed payment, notify the user, etc.
    puts "Failed payment notification received!"
    puts "Merchant Reference: #{notification_data['merchantReference']}"
    puts "Reason: #{notification_data['reason']}"
    # ... your error handling logic here ...
  end

  # Method to handle incoming notifications (example)
  def handle_notification(notification_data)
    if verify_notification(notification_data)
      json_notification = JSON.parse(notification_data)
      if json_notification['eventCode'] == 'payment.success'
        process_successful_notification(json_notification)
      elsif json_notification['eventCode'] == 'payment.failed'
        process_failed_notification(json_notification)
      else
        puts "Unknown event code: #{json_notification['eventCode']}"
      end
    else
      puts "Invalid HMAC signature!"
      # Log the invalid notification for investigation
    end
  end
end

# Example Usage

  endpoint_url = 'https://test.adyen.com/hpp/pay' # Use test.adyen.com for testing
```

```ruby
class LiqpayController < ApplicationController
  require 'openssl'
  require 'httparty'

  def create
    # Отримайте дані платежу з параметрів запиту
    params[:amount] = params[:amount].to_i
    params[:currency] = params[:currency] || 'UAH' # За замовчуванням UAH

    # Створіть URL-адресу для перенаправлення користувача на LiqPay
    liqpay_url = "https://www.liqpay.ua/pay/"

    # Побудуйте параметри запиту для LiqPay
    query_params = {
      p: params[:merchant_id],
      s: params[:secret_key],
      a: params[:amount],
      c: params[:currency],
      d: params[:description] || 'Оплата',
      i: params[:invoice_id] || SecureRandom.uuid, # Унікальний ідентифікатор інвойсу
      url: payment_return_url,
      fail_url: payment_fail_url
    }

    # Створіть підпис
    signature = generate_signature(query_params)

    # Додайте підпис до параметрів запиту
    query_params[:sig] = signature

    # Створіть повну URL-адресу запиту
    liqpay_url += query_params.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{CGI.escape(v.to_s)}" }.join('&')

    # Перенаправте користувача на LiqPay
    redirect_to liqpay_url
  end

  def callback
    # Перевірте підпис
    if verify_signature(params)
      # Отримайте дані платежу з параметрів запиту
      status = params[:status]
      transaction_id = params[:transaction_id]
      amount = params[:amount].to_i
      currency = params[:currency]

      # Обробка статусу платежу
      case status
      when 'success'
        # Платіж успішний
        # Оновіть статус замовлення в базі даних
        # Замовлення: order_id = params[:order_id]
        # Order.find(params[:order_id]).update(status: 'paid')

        render plain: "OK" # Поверніть OK для успішної перевірки
      when 'decline'
        # Платіж відхилено
        # Оновіть статус замовлення в базі даних
        # Order.find(params[:order_id]).update(status: 'failed')
        render plain: "OK"
      else
        # Інший статус
        render plain: "OK"
      end

    else
      # Підпис недійсний
      render plain: "Invalid signature"
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_signature(params)
    # Сортуйте параметри за ключем
    sorted_params = params.sort.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')

    # Додайте секретний ключ
    sorted_params += "&secret_key=#{params[:secret_key]}"

    # Обчисліть MD5-підпис
    OpenSSL::Digest::MD5.hexdigest(sorted_params)
  end

  def verify_signature(params)
    # Відтворіть підпис з отриманих параметрів
    expected_signature = generate_signature(params.except(:sig))

    # Порівняйте підпис з отриманим
    expected_signature == params[:sig]
  end

  def payment_return_url
    # URL-адреса, на яку LiqPay перенаправить користувача після успішної оплати
    return_url = "#{request.scheme}://#{request.host}/payments/success"
  end

  def payment_fail_url
    # URL-адреса, на яку LiqPay перенаправить користувача після невдалої оплати
    fail_url = "#{request.scheme}://#{request.host}/payments/fail"
  end
end
```

```ruby
    # Необхідно, але зазвичай не робиться тут.  Mollie вже створив платіж.
```

```ruby
require 'number_to_words'

def number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(amount)
  amount = amount.to_f  # Переконайтеся, що ми працюємо з числом з плаваючою комою

  integer_part = amount.floor
  fractional_part = amount - integer_part

  integer_words = NumberToWords::Ukrainian.number_to_words(integer_part)
  fractional_words = if fractional_part > 0
                         "#{NumberToWords::Ukrainian.number_to_words(fractional_part.round)} копійок"
                       else
                         "нуль копійок"
                       end

  "#{integer_words} гривень, #{fractional_words}"
end

# Приклади використання:
puts number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(1250.50)  # => одна тисяча двісті п'ятдесят гривень, п'ятьдесят копійок
puts number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(100)     # => сто гривень, нуль копійок
puts number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(5.75)    # => п'ять гривень, сімдесят п'ять копійок
puts number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(10000)   # => десять тисяч гривень, нуль копійок
puts number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(0.25)    # => нуль гривень, двадцять п'ять копійок
puts number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(1234567.89) # => один мільйон двісті тридцять чотири тисячі п'ятсот шістдесят сім гривень, вісімдесят дев'ять копійок
```

2. **`number_to_ukrainian_currency_words(amount)` функція:**
   - Приймає `amount` як аргумент (число, яке потрібно перетворити).
   - Перетворює `amount` на `float`, щоб забезпечити правильну роботу з дробовою частиною.
   - Розділяє `amount` на цілу частину (`integer_part`) і дробову частину (`fractional_part`).
   - Використовує `NumberToWords::Ukrainian.number_to_words(integer_part)` для перетворення цілої частини числа в українські слова.
   - Використовує `NumberToWords::Ukrainian.number_to_words(fractional_part.round)` для перетворення дробової частини числа в українські слова.  `round` використовується для округлення дробової частини до цілого числа перед перетворенням, щоб отримати правильне представлення копійок.
   - Формує результуючий рядок, об'єднуючи слова для цілої та дробової частин, додаючи "гривень" і "копійок" відповідно.
   - Якщо `fractional_part` дорівнює 0, то виводиться "нуль копійок".

**Як запустити код:**

1. **Встановіть Bundler:** Якщо у вас ще не встановлено Bundler, встановіть його: `gem install bundler`

**Важливі моменти:**

* **Округлення:** Округлення дробової частини (копійок) є важливим для отримання правильного текстового представлення.
* **Форматування:**  Форматування вихідного рядка (додавання "гривень" та "копійок") робить результат читабельним та зрозумілим.
* **Обробка нульової дробової частини:**  Обробка випадку, коли дробова частина дорівнює нулю, робить код більш повним.
* **Робота з великими числами:** `number_to_words` gem коректно обробляє великі числа (наприклад, мільйони та мільярди).

```ruby
require 'iban4r'
require 'securerandom'

# Метод для перевірки IBAN та вилучення МФО
def validate_iban_and_extract_bank_code(iban)
  begin
    iban_object = IBAN4R::IBAN.new(iban)

    if iban_object.valid?
      # Вилучення коду банку з IBAN (останні 6 символів)
      bank_code = iban_object.iban[iban_object.iban.length - 6..-1]
      return { valid: true, bank_code: bank_code }
    else
      return { valid: false, error: iban_object.errors.full_messages.join(', ') }
    end

  rescue IBAN4R::InvalidIBANError => e
    return { valid: false, error: "Некоректний формат IBAN: #{e.message}" }
  rescue ArgumentError => e
    return { valid: false, error: "Некоректний формат IBAN: #{e.message}" }
  end
end

# Приклади використання
iban1 = "UA12345678901234567890123456" # Недійсний IBAN
iban2 = "UA7235235234523452345234523456" # Дійсний IBAN (приклад)

result1 = validate_iban_and_extract_bank_code(iban1)
result2 = validate_iban_and_extract_bank_code(iban2)

puts "IBAN: #{iban1}"
puts "Результат: #{result1}"

puts "\nIBAN: #{iban2}"
puts "Результат: #{result2}"
```

2. **iban_validator.rb:**
   - `require 'iban4r'`:  Підключає гем `iban4r`.
   - `require 'securerandom'`: Підключає гем `securerandom`.  Він не використовується в цьому прикладі, але може знадобитися для генерації випадкових чисел, якщо ви плануєте генерувати IBAN для тестування (не рекомендується для реального використання).
   - `validate_iban_and_extract_bank_code(iban)`:  Це основний метод, який приймає IBAN як аргумент.
     - `IBAN4R::IBAN.new(iban)`: Створює об'єкт IBAN з вхідного рядка.
     - `iban_object.valid?`: Перевіряє, чи є IBAN дійсним, використовуючи правила IBAN.
     - Якщо IBAN дійсний:
       - `iban_object.iban[iban_object.iban.length - 6..-1]`: Вилучає останні 6 символів IBAN, які є кодом банку.

     - `rescue IBAN4R::InvalidIBANError`:  Обробляє помилки, специфічні для `iban4r`, якщо IBAN взагалі не відповідає формату.

```ruby
require 'sinatra'
require 'mollie-api'

require 'json'

# Load environment variables
Dotenv.load

# Configure Mollie API
Mollie::Client.api_key = ENV['MOLLIE_API_KEY']

# Order Model (ActiveModel)
class Order
  attr_accessor :id, :amount_total, :payment_id

  def initialize(attributes = {})
    @id = attributes[:id]
    @amount_total = attributes[:amount_total]
    @payment_id = attributes[:payment_id]
  end
end

# In-memory storage for Orders (Replace with database in a real application)
ORDERS = {}

# Create a payment
def create_payment(order_id, amount_total)
  payment = Mollie::Payment.create(
    amount: amount_total,
    currency: 'EUR', # Or your desired currency
    method: 'ideal',  # Or your desired payment method
    redirect_url: 'https://example.com/success', # Replace with your success URL
    description: "Payment for order ##{order_id}"
  )
  return payment
end

# Handle Webhooks
post '/webhook' do
  content_type :json

  # Verify webhook signature
  signature = request.env['HTTP_X_MOLLIE_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE']
  payload = request.body.read
  if !Mollie::Webhook.verify(payload, signature, ENV['MOLLIE_WEBHOOK_SECRET'])
    status 400
    return { error: 'Invalid signature' }.to_json
  end

  begin
    webhook_data = JSON.parse(payload)

    event_type = webhook_data['event']
    payment_id = webhook_data['data']['id']
    status = webhook_data['data']['status']

    # Find the order associated with this payment (in a real app, you'd look this up in your database)
```
